title: My Hero Academia: ULTIMATE COMPLETE RPG | Full Sandbox | Inner Self
description:
900 Storycards

INNER SELF + AUTO CARDS

NOTE: This scenario is about making the best possible MHA scenario on AIDungeon, so any feedback, suggestions etc. are appreciated.

Enter the world of *My Hero Academia*, where nearly everyone possesses a supernatural ability known as a Quirk. Heroes protect society, Villains threaten it, and the line between justice and chaos grows thinner every day.

Create your own character and forge your path through the canon timeline of MHA, beginning from the U.A. Entrance Exam and progressing through major arcs including the U.S.J. Incident, Sports Festival, Hero Killer Stain, Kamino Incident, Paranormal Liberation War, Dark Hero Arc, Final War Arc, and beyond.

Become a U.A. student, Pro Hero, Vigilante, Villain, Support Course inventor, underground informant, or anything else imaginable. Form rivalries, build friendships, join organizations, survive deadly battles, and influence the future of Hero Society itself.

Encounter iconic characters such as Izuku Midoriya, Katsuki Bakugo, Shoto Todoroki, All Might, Tomura Shigaraki, Hawks, Endeavor, and many others as the world slowly changes around you.

Your decisions matter. Save lives, destroy reputations, rewrite canon events, or completely alter the fate of Hero Society.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
Upcoming Features
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
• Crossovers
• Maintenance and other miscellaneous updates

Will be continuously updated over time.

Update 11:

- Additional Scenarios: New addition, the Epilogue. Inner Self + Base options, as well as Lightweight and Heavyweight options.

NOTE: Please comment your overall experience with this scenario. I also take recommendations and would really like some feedback.

If something is broken within the scenario please let me know.
prompt:
[-- WELCOME TO THE UNIVERSE OF MY HERO ACADEMIA --]

Heavyweight Storycards
• All storycards are over 1000 characters, recommended for premium users.

Lightweight Storycards
• All storycards are under 1000 characters, recommended for free users.

Middleweight Storycards
• All storycards are between 800-1200 characters each, recommended for premium users. (Legend, Mythic, Ultimate)

Less Storycards
• 530 Storycards, niche characters + Quirks removed. (More niche characters and Quirks will be removed as time goes on, this greatly helps reduce card overcrowding and mass triggers, as many niche unimportant characters were in there, and a lot of generically named Quirks were also in there.)

Additional Scenarios
• Crossovers from different anime/games, whether it be direct adaptations or custom fitted suited for MHA, other custom scenarios/situations. Stay tuned for these ones if you are interested. Currently available scenarios in this category:

JJK Crossovers (MHA adjacent, or direct adaptation)
My Hero Academia: Epilogue (Continuation of the original story!)

IMPORTANT!
To write your Quirk storycard, you have to do it *in game* as the usual prompt can and will mess up your formatting.

Otherwise, there are a lot of prewritten Quirks to pick from if you don't want to write your own.

options.authorsNote:
Theme: superhero, hero, villain, academy, school, slice of life, romance, combat

"This scenario takes place in the My Hero Academia universe. Use information from My Hero Academia."
options.instructions:
You are an AI dungeon master for an anime-inspired superhero RPG scenario based on My Hero Academia. The world is a modern hero society where most people have unique powers called Quirks.

Instructions:
- Write in a dramatic anime/shonen style with action, emotion, rivalry, comedy, training, danger, and character growth.
- Be specific, descriptive, and creative.
- Avoid repetition, filler, and summarization.
- Generally use second person, like: “He looks at you.” Use third person only if that is what the story seems to follow.
- Never decide or write for the user. Do not control the user’s actions, thoughts, feelings, dialogue, Quirk, or backstory unless already established.
- If the input ends mid-sentence, continue where it left off.
- > tokens mean a character action attempt. Describe what happens when the player attempts that action.
- Do not make actions automatically succeed or fail. Base results on skill, creativity, risk, Quirk limits, environment, and consequences.
- Quirks should have clear strengths, weaknesses, drawbacks, and creative uses.
- Describe Quirks vividly through movement, sound, impact, color, strain, and physical effects.
- Include hero schools, pro heroes, rivals, classmates, teachers, villains, support gear, exams, internships, rescue missions, and public attention.
- Create memorable characters with distinct names, costumes, Quirks, personalities, motives, flaws, and goals.
- Make combat cinematic and tactical, with positioning, teamwork, injuries, collateral damage, terrain, and emotional pressure.
- Villains should have motives and philosophies, not just evil plans. They may be cruel, tragic, charismatic, or morally complicated.
- Let the user’s choices shape relationships, reputation, injuries, consequences, and future opportunities.
- Keep scenes moving with clear stakes, strong atmosphere, and chances for the user to act.
- Generating “###” is forbidden.

options.instructions:
You are an AI dungeon master for an anime-inspired superhero RPG scenario based on My Hero Academia. The world is a modern hero society where most people have unique powers called Quirks.

Instructions:
- Write in a dramatic anime/shonen style with action, emotion, rivalry, comedy, training, danger, and character growth.
- Be specific, descriptive, and creative.
- Avoid repetition, filler, and summarization.
- Generally use second person, like: “He looks at you.” Use third person only if that is what the story seems to follow.
- Never decide or write for the user. Do not control the user’s actions, thoughts, feelings, dialogue, Quirk, or backstory unless already established.
- If the input ends mid-sentence, continue where it left off.
- > tokens mean a character action attempt. Describe what happens when the player attempts that action.
- Do not make actions automatically succeed or fail. Base results on skill, creativity, risk, Quirk limits, environment, and consequences.
- Quirks should have clear strengths, weaknesses, drawbacks, and creative uses.
- Describe Quirks vividly through movement, sound, impact, color, strain, and physical effects.
- Include hero schools, pro heroes, rivals, classmates, teachers, villains, support gear, exams, internships, rescue missions, and public attention.
- Create memorable characters with distinct names, costumes, Quirks, personalities, motives, flaws, and goals.
- Make combat cinematic and tactical, with positioning, teamwork, injuries, collateral damage, terrain, and emotional pressure.
- Villains should have motives and philosophies, not just evil plans. They may be cruel, tragic, charismatic, or morally complicated.
- Let the user’s choices shape relationships, reputation, injuries, consequences, and future opportunities.
- Keep scenes moving with clear stakes, strong atmosphere, and chances for the user to act.
- Generating “###” is forbidden.

options.title: Play as a U.A. Student
options.prompt:
Japan, 2143 — U.A. High School

Eight years have passed since the Final War. Hero society has entered a new era of peace, but the need for heroes has never truly disappeared.

Today marks the beginning of a new academic year at U.A. High School, Japan's most prestigious hero academy.

The morning sun shines over the massive campus as crowds of students make their way through the front gates. Some chatter excitedly about their Quirks, others nervously check their schedules, and a few already seem determined to prove themselves.

Among them is you.

You are **${What is your name? (Last name included)}**, an 18-year-old student beginning your first year in U.A.'s prestigious Class 1-A.

Whether you've dreamed of becoming a Pro Hero since childhood or have your own reasons for enrolling, you've finally made it into U.A.'s Hero Course.

Now, you are heading to the auditorium to listen to Principal Nezu's speech.

- Quirks should have clear strengths, weaknesses, drawbacks, and creative uses.
- Describe Quirks vividly through movement, sound, impact, color, strain, and physical effects.

- Let the user’s choices shape relationships, reputation, injuries, consequences, and future opportunities.
- Keep scenes moving with clear stakes, strong atmosphere, and chances for the user to act.
- Generating “###” is forbidden.

cardPool.title: Sekijiro Kan
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Sekijiro Kan

Alias: Blood Hero: Vlad King

Quirk Name: Blood Control

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero and homeroom teacher of Class 1-B at UA High School

Personality: Gruff and strict on the surface, but genuinely caring toward his students and protective of their safety. He encourages them to excel and uses Class 1-A as motivation for his own class, though he shows a comical bias favoring Class 1-B. Quick to react in danger and values the well-being of his fellow teachers.

Appearance: An exceptionally tall, wide-set man with a bulky, muscular build and lightly tanned skin. He has short pale gray hair spiked upward with one small clump hanging over his left forehead. His distinctive features include very small thin eyes, a wide mouth with two prominent lower canines visible even when closed. He wears his hero costume: a dark red skin-tight suit with a low U-shaped collar exposing his pectoral muscles, lined with thick black Y-shaped trim, white over-the-knee boots, red gloves, and an orange eye mask. A thin wire connects his left vambrace to the back of his neck.

Backstory: An experienced Pro Hero who has worked alongside other faculty at UA High School for years. He is one of the few who knew All Might's true form and later expressed regret about not doing more to support him during his tenure as Symbol of Peace. He maintains a long-standing friendship with fellow teacher Hound Dog.

Additional Information: His Blood Ejecting Gauntlet allows him to eject and reabsorb large quantities of blood. His Quirk grants enhanced physical strength and speed, and he can tolerate fatal levels of blood loss that would kill ordinary humans.

cardPool.title: Sickle Claw
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Sickle Claw
Quirk Name: Iron Claws
Occupation/Role: F-rank Villain
Personality: Confident in his abilities despite low rank, willing to challenge professional heroes; minimal information suggests a straightforward, aggressive temperament typical of minor villains.
Appearance: A short man with a severely deformed face featuring a bald, elongated head and widely spaced eyes on stalks. His mouth displays a wide set of prominent teeth. His hands are solid iron with four large metallic claws replacing his fingers. He wears a dark blue sleeveless gi with matching dark blue loafers.
Backstory: Recruited by Tomura Shigaraki as one of approximately seventy villains for the U.S.J. assault, Sickle Claw participated in the invasion of the Unforeseen Simulation Joint. During the attack, he engaged the weakened Shota Aizawa alongside other villains after Aizawa was injured by Shigaraki's Decay Quirk, but was defeated and subsequently arrested when Pro Heroes arrived.
Additional Information: F-rank villain with minimal documented history. His deformed appearance and metallic claws are his defining characteristics. He was overpowered by Aizawa despite the hero being injured, indicating his combat ability is relatively weak despite his confidence.

cardPool.title: Toshie Yagi
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Toshie Yagi

Alias: None

Quirk Name: None

Occupation/Role: Homemaker, Mother

Personality: Kind and easy-going, deeply devoted to her son Toshinori. Patient and encouraging, she supported his heroic dreams despite his lack of a Quirk by reading superhero stories with him. Gentle and nurturing by nature.

Appearance: A tall woman with bright golden blonde hair featuring two distinctive tufts parted at the sides, worn long down to her waist and held back with a scrunchie. Soft, round grey eyes and thin eyebrows give her a gentle appearance. She carries herself with quiet warmth and grace.

Backstory: Mother of Toshinori Yagi, later known as All Might. She raised her Quirkless son with love and encouragement, regularly reading superhero books with him to fuel his dreams. Toshie was killed during civil unrest incited by All For One's influence, a tragedy that profoundly shaped her son's resolve to become a hero and protect others.

Additional Information: Deceased before the start of the series. Her legacy directly influenced All Might's heroic path and his eventual adoption by Nana Shimura. She represents the foundational love that inspired the world's greatest hero.

cardPool.title: One For All
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
One For All

Description:
A transferable stockpiling Quirk born from the merger of two abilities: a power accumulation Quirk and a Quirk transference ability. It allows the user to accumulate and store immense physical power within their body, which compounds with each successive user's training and can be transferred to another person via blood contact or intentional passing.

Functions/Applications:
Grants superhuman strength, speed, and durability that multiplies across generations of users. The user inherits all accumulated power from previous hosts and can add their own strength to the reservoir. Power transfers when blood mingles with a new host's body, passing both the Quirk and all stockpiled strength forward.

Limits:
Possession dramatically shortens the user's lifespan due to the strain of maintaining two Quirks simultaneously. The Quirk can only be transferred through direct blood contact and requires willing acceptance or forced biological integration. If transferred to someone already possessing All For One's Quirk, it becomes permanently destroyed and unusable.

Additional Notes:
Originally created when All For One forcibly gave his younger brother Yoichi a stockpiling Quirk, unknowingly uniting it with Yoichi's hidden transference ability. Each user must actively train to unlock the power's full potential. The Quirk carries the "will" of previous users and was designed as a weapon to eventually challenge All For One's dominance.

cardPool.title: Gearshift
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Gearshift

Description:
Gearshift manipulates acceleration and speed, allowing the user to alter how quickly objects or beings move through space while ignoring normal inertia laws. Originally a weak ability affecting only small objects, it evolved dramatically after merging with One For All, becoming a devastating but dangerous power that envelops targets in blue energy aura.

Functions/Applications:
Can drastically accelerate the user's body or external targets to sonic-boom-inducing speeds with massive impact force. Effective when combined with other abilities—enhancing combat moves, boosting projectiles, or launching allies at extreme velocities. Works at cellular levels when fully evolved, capable of warping reality itself when paired with One For All's raw power.

Limits:
Initial use limited to five minutes before severe incapacitation. Prolonged use beyond this causes oxygen deprivation. Repeated activation stacks exponential damage and pain—second use doubles the blowback, risking paralysis. Extended strain leaves the user vulnerable and immobile. If transferred during recoil recovery, the backlash affects the new user. Originally only worked on small objects before power evolution.

Additional Notes:
Primary user managed bullet trajectories through arm gauntlets. Most effective as a last resort due to control difficulty and severe physical toll.

cardPool.title: New Order
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
New Order

Description:
A reality-warping Quirk that allows the user to impose rules onto targets by touching them and speaking their name. These rules can redefine properties of physical objects, living beings, the environment, or even other Quirks themselves. The user can set conditional rules based on cause-and-effect relationships, fundamentally altering how reality functions within their influence.

Functions/Applications:
Grant temporary abilities to oneself, manipulate an opponent's bodily functions, affect intangible things like air and energy, suppress or destabilize other Quirks, create conditional effects (e.g., "if X happens, then Y occurs"). Rules persist even if the Quirk transfers to another user.

Limits:
User can only maintain two active rules simultaneously—establishing a third requires deactivating one. Rules require direct physical contact with the target and verbal naming; living beings with strong self-awareness can resist if the user's understanding of their identity doesn't match their own. Rules cannot affect targets indirectly through clever wording. Power enhancement has a hard ceiling—the user cannot become invincible or match All Might's strength. Inanimate objects are far easier to affect than conscious beings.

Additional Notes:
New Order is extraordinarily rare and powerful; even high-ranking villains consider it a critical threat.

cardPool.title: Wave Motion
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Wave Motion

Description:
Wave Motion converts the user's vitality into golden spiral energy that can be discharged as powerful blast waves. The user can adjust the intensity of energy output at will, releasing it from their palms or feet. This Quirk drains stamina with each use, but extensive training allows the user to build massive vitality reserves and stamina resilience.

Functions/Applications:
Offensive blasts effective against large or slow enemies; mobility enhancement by releasing energy beneath feet for levitation and rapid repositioning; close-range combat amplification for punches and kicks; support applications including civilian rescue, object manipulation, and ally empowerment; defensive capabilities for mid to long-range protection.

Limits:
The spiraling energy travels slower than direct projectiles. Overuse causes significant fatigue and stamina depletion. The user cannot sustain prolonged discharge without exhaustion. Energy output requires conscious control to avoid harming nearby allies or civilians.

Additional Notes:
The Quirk's true strength lies in battlefield control and versatility rather than raw speed. Users benefit from combining mobility and close-range tactics to compensate for slow projectile travel. Extensive training dramatically increases available vitality and fatigue resistance.

cardPool.title: Accelerator Rings
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Accelerator Rings

Description:
The user generates yellow rings of energy from their hands and feet that, after a variable delay, release directional bursts of force before dissipating. Originally manifested in infancy but stolen before full development, the Quirk has since grown dramatically in strength through exposure to other Quirks.

Functions/Applications:
Launch self across great distances and achieve rapid aerial maneuverability through multiple simultaneous ring activations. Deliver swift, crushing blows using sharp velocity bursts. Can scale to building-size rings when combined with other Quirks, enabling continental-range flight and massive force delivery.

Limits:
The variable delay between ring generation and force release creates a timing vulnerability. Rings dissipate after activation, requiring continuous generation for sustained movement. Original strength at first manifestation remains unknown; current power level is inflated by mingling with stolen Quirks rather than reflecting the Quirk's true baseline. Requires precise control for delicate aerial maneuvering versus raw acceleration.

Additional Notes:
The Quirk's true owner was unaware of its origins for extended periods. Effectiveness varies dramatically depending on user's control and whether it operates independently or alongside other Quirks. Most potent when layering multiple rings in different orientations simultaneously for complex three-dimensional movement.

cardPool.title: 2D-ify
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
2D-ify

Description:
A transformation Quirk that converts three-dimensional beings and objects into two-dimensional paintings trapped within picture frames. The user channels this power through specially prepared frames, absorbing targets into flat, painted forms that retain consciousness and limited mobility.

Functions/Applications:
The user can immobilize enemies by framing them as paintings, removing them from active combat while keeping them alive. Trapped victims remain aware and can move within their painted form, but cannot escape the frame's boundaries. This allows for non-lethal containment or strategic removal of threats from the battlefield.

Limits:
The Quirk deactivates and releases trapped subjects if the user becomes immobilized or incapacitated. Victims cannot be held indefinitely—exact duration and release conditions remain unclear. The user requires a physical picture frame to activate the ability and likely has limits on how many subjects can be contained simultaneously.

Additional Notes:
This Quirk excels at crowd control and capture but fails against swift, overwhelming opponents who can disable the user before frames are deployed. The exact mechanics of how consciousness persists in painted form remain mysterious, suggesting untapped potential or hidden weaknesses in the ability.

cardPool.title: Acid
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Acid

Description:
The user secretes corrosive liquid from their skin, which naturally resists the acid's effects. The Quirk alters skin pigmentation to purple-pink while producing gray-colored acid capable of melting solid materials including metal and durable structures. The user can generate acid in high quantities from any body part and manipulate it with varying solubility and viscosity levels.

Functions/Applications:
Create corrosive barriers by raising viscosity to glue protective layers onto surfaces. Burn infiltration holes through walls and secure barriers. Melt climbing handholds into vertical surfaces. Generate slippery acid pools for ground-based skating mobility. At Maximum Output, condense and release acid with devastating force capable of penetrating exceptional durability. Lower solubility to reduce lethality against living targets.

Limits:
Prolonged use causes skin to gradually lose natural acid resistance, risking severe corrosion and dehydration—potentially fatal if overextended. User struggles with precision control around living beings, preferring inorganic targets. Accidental self-dissolution of clothing occurs without careful focus. Endurance is limited by physical stamina and the body's ability to withstand corrosive exposure.

Additional Notes:
User wears acid-proof footwear with ventilation holes for secretion. Constant training builds skin durability against the Quirk's own corrosive properties.

cardPool.title: Acid Sweat
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Acid Sweat

Description:
The user secretes an acidic sweat from their palms with combustive and explosive properties. Unlike derivatives of this quirk, the acid cannot be forcibly produced—it emerges passively like normal perspiration, limiting control and output intensity.

Functions/Applications:
By rubbing hands together, the user can generate controlled explosions for combat or obstacle destruction. The acidic sweat can corrode materials and surfaces over time. Useful for sustained pressure tactics rather than burst damage.

Limits:
Explosions are weaker than forced-secretion variants and depend on natural sweat production rates. Cannot trigger explosions at will without hand friction. Power scales with physical exertion and stress levels. Extended use causes hand fatigue and skin irritation.

Additional Notes:
This quirk is a genetic foundation for more potent explosion-type quirks when combined with compatible partner quirks. The passive sweat secretion makes it unsuitable for stealth applications.

cardPool.title: Alchemy
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Alchemy

Description:
Valdo transmutes non-living matter he touches into nearly any object or energy form. He can reshape objects continuously while maintaining contact, create functional constructs that obey commands, manipulate his appearance with durability-enhancing bodysuits, and generate kinetic shockwave attacks by converting materials into glowing energy states capable of devastating destruction.

Functions/Applications:
Create weapons, tools, and complex devices from simple materials. Fashion protective bodysuits that alter appearance and enhance durability. Generate ranged kinetic energy attacks in various shapes. Construct mindless golems and constructs for combat or labor. Modify environment through terrain manipulation—pillars, pitfalls, hidden doors. Repair and continuously modify creations while touching them.

Limits:
Cannot transmute living organisms or create actual life. Appearance changes are hollow bodysuits, not true transformation—tear under damage to reveal weaker true form beneath. Creations require sustained focus; all constructs collapse if user is incapacitated. Kinetic shockwaves are imitated strength, not genuine power. Constructs can be destroyed, dodged, or bypassed with proper tactics. Requires physical contact with objects to initiate transmutation.

Additional Notes:
Valdo commonly uses gold coins as catalysts, converting them into kinetic energy projectiles.

cardPool.title: Anivoice
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Anivoice

Description:
A sound-based Quirk that allows the user to communicate with and command animals through speech. The user gains a progressively hardening head that eventually develops horns, amplifying the Quirk's range and eventually enabling telepathic communication with animals. Humans and artificial creatures are immune to its effects.

Functions/Applications:
Command diverse animals for varied tactical purposes—insects for underground infiltration, birds for aerial reconnaissance, predators for combat support. With vocal training and equipment amplification, control large animal groups across extended distances. Telepathic horns enable silent communication when fully developed, bypassing sound-based interference.

Limits:
Effective range depends on vocal strength and equipment; requires the user to speak (silencing disables the Quirk entirely). Louder sounds drown out or disrupt commands, scaring animals away. Animals must understand basic intent—no complex dialogue possible. Humans and artificial creatures cannot be influenced. The user's personal fears (such as insects) can create psychological friction despite the Quirk functioning normally.

Additional Notes:
The Quirk appears to foster genuine rapport with animals, as if they willingly cooperate. Voice-amplifying devices significantly expand operational range. Initial development is gradual, but stress or conflict can accelerate horn growth and capability upgrades.

cardPool.title: Anthropomorph
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Anthropomorph

Description:
A Meta Ability allowing the user to transform human-sized objects into perfect lookalike puppets of any person. Multiple puppets can be created simultaneously and remotely controlled via earpiece devices, designated by letter codes. The puppets are formed from a liquid substance exuded from the user's hand and can be customized with clothing and altered appearances.

Functions/Applications:
Create decoys and duplicates for infiltration, reconnaissance, or psychological warfare. Overwhelm opponents through numerical superiority using multiple puppet soldiers. Exploit psychological vulnerabilities by replicating traumatic figures. Control puppets from a safe distance while maintaining tactical awareness of the battlefield.

Limits:
Requires human-sized physical objects as templates; cannot create puppets from nothing. Remote control range appears limited by earpiece signal. Puppets possess no independent intelligence or autonomy—they follow direct orders only. Transformation process takes time, making it vulnerable during execution. Puppets are ultimately inanimate constructs and can be damaged or destroyed through sufficient force.

Additional Notes:
Most effective as a tactical tool for commanders or manipulators who excel at long-range strategy. The psychological impact of seeing duplicated loved ones or enemies can be weaponized.

cardPool.title: Antigen Swap
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Antigen Swap

Description:
The user can alter their blood type at will, changing their biochemical composition instantaneously. This allows them to leave no biological trace behind and evade identification through blood evidence.

Functions/Applications:
Eliminates forensic tracking via blood samples. Bypasses blood-type-specific effects or abilities targeting the user's specific blood. Can be combined with other Quirks like Bloodlet to counteract blood-based restraints or curses.

Limits:
Does not affect physical injuries or wound closure. Cannot be used while severely blood-depleted or unconscious. Switching takes a moment of concentration; rapid successive changes are exhausting. Does not fool abilities that detect Quirk usage itself rather than blood type.

Additional Notes:
Primarily defensive and evasive rather than offensive. Most effective for espionage, investigation avoidance, and countering blood-manipulation Quirks. Requires knowledge of compatible blood types to avoid biological incompatibility issues.

cardPool.title: Arbor
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Arbor

Description:
A wood-generation Quirk that allows the user to sprout and manipulate wooden tendrils from any part of their body. These tendrils extend over long distances with precise control, enabling simultaneous multi-tasking and complex maneuvers.

Functions/Applications:
Restraint and binding of enemies to prevent movement. Rescue operations by wrapping tendrils around multiple casualties and carrying them to safety. Evasion and locomotion by grasping tall structures and swinging through urban environments. Can manipulate tendrils independently across the body.

Limits:
Highly vulnerable to fire and explosion-based attacks due to wood's combustibility. Cannot function effectively against flame-wielding opponents. Tendrils require physical anchor points for swinging/locomotion. Sustained control of multiple tendrils simultaneously may cause fatigue.

Additional Notes:
Arbor excels in rescue scenarios and crowd control but struggles in combat against fire-type Quirks. Best used defensively or for non-lethal subdual. Works well in urban environments with tall structures for mobility.

cardPool.title: Attraction of Small Objects
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name: Attraction of Small Objects

Description: A gravity-based telekinetic ability that allows the user to pull lightweight objects toward themselves through deliberate hand gestures. Objects are drawn gradually rather than instantaneously, requiring sustained concentration and repeated hand movements to guide items across distance.

Functions/Applications: Retrieving dropped or distant items without moving, gathering scattered objects efficiently, pulling lightweight tools or weapons closer during combat, manipulating small objects in puzzle-solving scenarios without physical contact.

Limits: Only affects objects significantly lighter than a book or action figure; attempting heavier items results in failure. Requires multiple hand movements rather than instant activation, making the ability relatively slow. Distance limitations unknown but appears to work within moderate room-range. Cannot function on living creatures or organic matter.

Additional Notes: The power operates on gravitational principles rather than pure telekinesis, suggesting it manipulates localized gravity fields. Effectiveness depends on hand gesture precision and user concentration. Best used for utility and support rather than direct combat applications.

cardPool.title: Barrier
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name: Barrier

Description: Hekiji Tengai generates telekinetic protective domes around himself and nearby allies. The barriers manifest as invisible but tangible force fields with exceptional durability, comparable to striking steel. He can adjust barrier size and deployment speed with practiced control, raising defenses faster than most offensive attacks can land.

Functions/Applications: Deploy personal defense barriers instantly; expand barriers to protect additional allies within range; scale barrier radius strategically; react to incoming threats with rapid activation; maintain continuous protection during combat or threats.

Limits: Purely defensive—cannot damage or repel enemies offensively. Hekiji must remain at the barrier's center, preventing remote protection. Extreme overwhelming force can eventually shatter barriers. Physical exhaustion or injury prevents summoning new barriers. Barrier effectiveness may diminish against sustained, concentrated attacks.

Additional Notes: Ideal for tanking and protecting teammates in dangerous situations. The Quirk's strength depends on Hekiji's stamina and health condition. Size variability suggests tactical flexibility—smaller barriers may be more durable than larger ones, though this remains unconfirmed.

cardPool.title: Bat
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Bat

Description:
Grants the user bat-like physical features including wings, fangs, pointed ears, and enhanced sensory organs. The user gains superhuman speed and flight capabilities that scale dramatically with Trigger enhancement.

Functions/Applications:
High-speed running and aerial flight at varying velocities. Enhanced olfactory tracking to follow scents over long distances. Powerful claws capable of grappling and carrying targets mid-flight. Physical strength increases with Trigger modification.

Limits:
Base Quirk flight capabilities are minimal or unstable without Trigger enhancement. Olfactory tracking requires a scent source and can be disrupted by strong competing odors. Wing structure may restrict fine manipulation tasks. Sustained high-speed flight drains stamina.

Additional Notes:
This Quirk becomes significantly more potent when chemically enhanced with Trigger, transforming the user into a more monstrous bat-humanoid with exponentially improved physical prowess and sensory range. Combat effectiveness increases substantially under Trigger influence but at the cost of potential loss of control.

cardPool.title: Beast
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Beast

Description:
Jurota transforms into a massive, feral creature covered in thick fur with enlarged fangs and claws. His body grows significantly larger and more animalistic, granting immense physical prowess. He retains partial intelligence despite heightened aggression and enthusiasm during transformation.

Functions/Applications:
Superhuman strength and speed for combat; enhanced sense of smell with impressive range for tracking and scouting; ability to maul opponents with claws and fangs; temporary reversion to human form for evasion; capable of carrying additional weight while transformed; resistance to electrical damage.

Limits:
Transformation increases target size, making evasion more difficult; user becomes reckless and overeager when transformed, leading to poor tactical decisions; sense of smell can be masked or confused by strong odors; straight melee combat vulnerability if opponent exploits his larger frame; euphoria clouds judgment despite retained intelligence.

Additional Notes:
Beast is optimal for sustained confrontations and direct assault. Jurota's greatest weakness is sensory deception—obscuring his scent undermines his primary advantage. Switching between forms grants tactical flexibility but requires conscious effort. Most effective when paired with strategy that leverages his intelligence despite transformation-induced recklessness.

cardPool.title: Big Monkey
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Big Monkey

Description:
A transformation Quirk that allows the user to assume the form of a giant ape. The transformation grants immense size and physical power, dramatically increasing strength and durability. This Quirk is typically dormant and only activates under the influence of the Trigger drug.

Functions/Applications:
The user gains massive physical strength capable of devastating attacks and overwhelming opponents through sheer force. The enlarged form provides increased durability and presence in combat. The transformation can intimidate enemies and allows the user to physically dominate smaller opponents through size alone.

Limits:
Transformation requires external chemical stimulation via Trigger drug; the Quirk cannot activate naturally on its own. Duration and control are limited by Trigger's effects. The enlarged form may reduce mobility and agility despite increased strength. Mental control is compromised under Trigger influence, potentially affecting tactical decision-making.

Additional Notes:
This Quirk is heavily dependent on external substances, making the user vulnerable when Trigger is unavailable. The transformation appears to be a raw power-based ability with limited finesse or technique. Long-term use of Trigger to activate this Quirk likely carries significant health and addiction risks.

cardPool.title: Binging Ball
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Binging Ball

Description:
The user generates small floating spheres with mouths that emerge from their body. These orbs act as independent projectiles capable of consuming various materials through their mouths, from ice to solid matter.

Functions/Applications:
Spheres launch at high velocity as effective ranged attacks. They can ingest and break down materials by consuming them with their mouths, useful for destroying obstacles, neutralizing ice-based attacks, or clearing debris. Multiple spheres can be deployed simultaneously for multi-directional offense.

Limits:
Spheres have limited range and durability. Unclear if consumed materials are stored or expelled; sustained consumption likely drains stamina. Spheres cannot be controlled once launched, moving only in set trajectories. Close-range combat capability is minimal since spheres originate from the user's body.

Additional Notes:
Best utilized for mid-range combat and environmental destruction. Effectiveness depends on sphere generation speed and material hardness limits. Requires strategic positioning to maximize projectile angles.

cardPool.title: Black
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Black

Description:
The user can merge their entire body into any dark-colored object or shadow, becoming one with it. They move freely through darkness at high speeds and can control the merged object's movements, even if it's naturally mobile like an animal or living thing.

Functions/Applications:
Ambush attacks from within shadows or dark objects. Transport through darkness while carrying others. Possession and control of dark-colored creatures or appendages. Evasion by merging into nearby dark environments. Manipulation of mobile dark objects to create distractions or barriers.

Limits:
Exposure to bright light forces instant ejection from the dark object. Only works with naturally dark colors or shadows—bright objects are inaccessible. Cannot merge if physically forced into a dark object against will. Ineffective in well-lit areas with minimal shadows. Does not account for mass, so tiny dark objects may prove unstable for extended use.

Additional Notes:
Most powerful in cramped, shadowy spaces where opponents have limited mobility and escape routes. Light-based Quirks are direct counters. Originally limited to stationary black objects, but mastery allows control of mobile dark entities. User can hold the ability "ready" while seeking suitable dark targets.

cardPool.title: Black Hole
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Black Hole

Description:
A destructive ability that creates small black holes emanating from the user's fingers. These voids pull in and atomize all matter and certain energy forms like light, leaving no residue behind. The user's hands and forearms bear mysterious dark markings from prolonged use.

Functions/Applications:
Generate localized suction fields to pull enemies within range and disable attacks. Disintegrate wreckage and debris for rapid disaster cleanup. Prevent enemy escape by creating inescapable gravitational zones. Neutralize energy-based attacks by consuming them.

Limits:
User is not immune and will disintegrate if caught in their own black hole, requiring constant awareness. Must deactivate the ability before targets reach atomic disintegration range, leaving user vulnerable to counterattack. Unsuitable for close-quarters combat. Enemies with redirection or spatial manipulation Quirks can turn the suction against the user. Loss of fingers or hands eliminates Quirk functionality entirely. Brief exposure leaves victims in critical condition rather than instant death.

Additional Notes:
Originally developed for rescue and disaster relief, not combat. User typically employs it defensively to halt enemy advances rather than as an offensive weapon. The Quirk's immense destructive potential is offset by ethical restraint and practical inexperience in battle applications. Highly volatile and dangerous to surroundings if not carefully controlled.

cardPool.title: Blackwhip
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Blackwhip

Description:
The user generates controllable energy tendrils from any body part, appearing black with teal luminescent outlines. Power scales with the user's emotional intensity, particularly anger and hatred. Originally a top-grade Quirk, it gains exponential potential when integrated with One For All.

Functions/Applications:
Offensive restraint and enemy binding; mobility enhancement via grappling and swinging; object manipulation and transport; internal reinforcement as a protective brace for limbs and muscles; puppeteering one's own body when paralyzed; creating armor-like protective coating around the body.

Limits:
Control directly tied to emotional stability—uncontrolled anger causes loss of precision and potential self-harm. High-power usage causes severe numbness and physical pain; at full strength, causes user submission. Extended duration at high percentages risks injury. Safe operation requires staying calm and remaining below 5% power output for sustained use without strain.

Additional Notes:
Mastery develops through practice; low-power versions enable support techniques like catching falling objects. Emotional regulation is critical—careless use risks catastrophic loss of control. When empowered by One For All, the Quirk becomes significantly more dangerous and difficult to master, requiring exceptional discipline to operate safely.

cardPool.title: Blast
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Blast

Description:
A ranged energy projection quirk that allows the user to fire continuous bursts of powerful energy from their body. The quirk can be channeled through hands and legs via specialized hero gear, though its natural emission point remains unclear. Each blast carries significant stopping power effective against most threats.

Functions/Applications:
Rapid-fire energy projectiles for combat suppression and villain neutralization. Energy can be focused and redirected through costume augmentations to strike from multiple angles. Sustained barrages provide overwhelming offensive pressure and crowd control capabilities.

Limits:
The user is temporarily blinded by the intense flashes their own blasts generate, causing severe aiming inaccuracy and unpredictable shot trajectories. Extended use risks self-inflicted blindness. Protective eyewear (shades) negates the blinding effect and restores accuracy, but requires constant wearing during combat.

Additional Notes:
Blast is highly effective for straightforward combat but demands tactical awareness to compensate for accuracy problems without proper eye protection. The quirk's true strength emerges when the user properly equips countermeasures, making gear customization critical to performance.

cardPool.title: Blood Control
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Blood Control

Description:
Manipulate your own blood after it leaves your body, controlling its flow and hardening it into solid constructs. You can withstand massive blood loss that would kill ordinary people and reabsorb expelled blood through specialized equipment.

Functions/Applications:
Harden blood into restraints or barriers to immobilize enemies. Release large quantities of blood rapidly through gloves connected to body tubes for offensive pressure attacks. Reabsorb blood to recover resources mid-combat. Create whip-like blood streams for striking or grappling.

Limits:
Blood must leave your body before you can control it—you cannot manipulate blood while inside your veins. Requires specialized gloves and tubing system to function effectively. Excessive blood loss eventually causes weakness and incapacity despite enhanced tolerance. Blood hardens slowly and can be destroyed by opponents before solidifying.

Additional Notes:
This Quirk trades health for combat utility—strategic blood management is essential. Works best in prolonged fights where reabsorption is possible. Psychological impact of self-inflicted bleeding may affect user morale. Ineffective against opponents who can prevent blood from leaving the body or contaminate it.

cardPool.title: Bloodcurdle
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Bloodcurdle

Description:
A parasitic quirk that grants the user an extraordinarily long, textured tongue covered in small papillae. By making contact between their tongue and a target's blood—whether fresh or dried—the user can ingest it and trigger temporary paralysis. The paralysis duration varies based on the target's blood type, with maximum immobilization lasting 8 minutes.

Functions/Applications:
The user collects blood samples from wounds, blades, or contaminated surfaces, then licks the blood to activate the quirk and paralyze their target. This leaves enemies vulnerable and defenseless for finishing moves. The quirk works on any opponent regardless of strength, making it exceptionally effective for ambushes or one-on-one combat where the user gains the first blood sample.

Limits:
Paralysis duration is unpredictable since the user cannot identify blood types beforehand; blood type O causes the shortest paralysis while type B causes the longest. Maximum paralysis time caps at 8 minutes. Quirks that expel blood or alter blood type (such as Bloodlet or Antigen Swap) can break the paralysis effect. The user requires physical access to the target's blood and must have a means to collect or wound their opponent first.

Additional Notes:
This quirk demands cunning strategy and battlefield control rather than raw power. Users benefit from weapons, stealth tactics, and combat skill to obtain initial blood samples.

cardPool.title: Bloodlet
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Bloodlet

Description:
A dangerous Quirk allowing the user to expel and absorb their own blood at will. The user can withstand extreme blood loss that would kill a normal person, making them difficult to incapacitate through bleeding or dehydration tactics.

Functions/Applications:
Expel blood as a weapon or distraction; absorb expelled blood to recover lost fluids and maintain combat capability; counter blood-based Quirks when combined with other abilities; survive catastrophic injuries that rely on blood loss as a killing mechanism.

Limits:
Cannot manipulate others' blood, only the user's own. Expelling all blood leaves the user vulnerable during reabsorption. The Quirk does not heal wounds themselves, only prevents death from blood loss. Requires the user to have blood available to reabsorb—if separated from expelled blood, recovery is impossible.

Additional Notes:
Most effective when paired with other Quirks for strategic advantage. The psychological impact of witnessing blood expulsion can disorient opponents. Extended use risks organ damage despite survival of blood loss.

cardPool.title: Blueflame
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Blueflame

Description:
A fire-generation Quirk that allows the user to create and ignite intensely hot blue flames anywhere on their body with minimal effort. The flames burn at temperatures exceeding 2,000°C, far hotter than normal fire or lava, and ignite with near-instantaneous speed. The Quirk's power scales with the user's emotional state—greater anger produces hotter, more uncontrollable flames.

Functions/Applications:
Instantly combust objects and living creatures on contact, from trees to robust minerals. Deploy flames across the entire body or concentrated areas for offensive combat. The brightness of blue flames proves effective against shadow-based opponents. At extreme emotional distress, the Quirk can manifest secondary ice-based abilities to supplement fire output.

Limits:
The user's body cannot withstand the heat generated due to inherited cold-resistant genetics from maternal lineage. Prolonged use causes severe burns, skin deterioration, numbness, and progressive bodily destruction. Emotional instability causes flames to ignite uncontrollably, potentially harming the user. Extended combat is impossible—the Quirk severely limits endurance and cannot sustain prolonged battles without catastrophic self-injury.

Additional Notes:
Blueflame is a double-edged power; its tremendous offensive capability is offset by devastating physical consequences. The user must maintain emotional control to prevent self-immolation.

cardPool.title: Body Morph
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Body Morph

Description:
A transformation quirk that grants the user two additional arms beyond their natural pair, along with significantly enhanced physical strength. The extra limbs are fully functional and controllable.

Functions/Applications:
The user can perform multiple tasks simultaneously, lift heavier objects, wield additional weapons or tools, and gain superior grappling advantage in combat. The enhanced strength amplifies striking power and physical capability across all limbs.

Limits:
The extra arms require conscious control and coordination; sudden growth can be disorienting. Fatigue affects all four limbs equally, and the increased body mass demands more stamina. Opponents can target the additional limbs as weak points.

Additional Notes:
This quirk excels in versatility and raw power but trades finesse for brute force. Heavy armor or tight spaces may hinder movement. The quirk is always active, making stealth and deception more difficult.

cardPool.title: Bombify
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Bombify

Description:
The user mutates body parts to grow bombs of various sizes from their surface. This artificial Quirk functions through specialized Bomber cells embedded in the user's body, allowing rapid manifestation of explosive ordnance across multiple limbs simultaneously.

Functions/Applications:
Create bombs on fists, arms, and other body parts for ranged or melee explosive attacks. Bombs can vary in size and yield. Synergizes with Self-Detonation to trigger explosives and Regeneration to restore damaged limbs after detonation.

Limits:
Requires Bomber cells to function; cannot work without this biological foundation. Bomb generation takes time proportional to size—larger explosives require longer manifestation. Each detonation leaves the user temporarily limbless unless Regeneration is active. Overuse risks cellular exhaustion. Cannot create explosives faster than the user's mutation speed allows.

Additional Notes:
Most effective when paired with complementary Quirks like Self-Detonation and Regeneration. Standalone, the Quirk requires external detonation methods or careful timing. The Bomber cells appear unique to artificial Quirk creation and cannot be naturally acquired.

cardPool.title: Boomerang
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Boomerang

Description:
A trajectory-manipulation Quirk that allows the user to control the path of thrown objects with precision, causing them to home in on targets and change direction mid-flight. The user's hands and affected projectiles glow purple during activation.

Functions/Applications:
The user can throw any object and redirect it multiple times before impact, making attacks difficult to evade. Objects can curve around obstacles, strike from unexpected angles, and return to the user. Effective for ranged combat, trapping opponents, or retrieving distant items.

Limits:
Projectiles remain subject to physics and can be stopped by sufficiently hard impacts or viscous substances like acids that disrupt their trajectory. The Quirk requires direct contact or proximity to throw objects and cannot function without physical projectiles. Distance and object weight may affect control precision.

Additional Notes:
The purple glow indicates active Quirk usage and may serve as a visual tell. Most effective against opponents relying on dodging rather than defensive barriers. Users benefit from carrying varied ammunition types to overcome different obstacles.

cardPool.title: Brainwashing
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Brainwashing

Description:
A mental control ability activated when a target verbally responds to the user's speech. Once triggered, the victim enters a fog-like state where their body obeys all commands while their mind remains trapped and aware. Their eyes turn milky white and they become motionless until ordered otherwise.

Functions/Applications:
The user can control one target at a time through direct concentration and simple verbal commands. Advanced training allows brainwashed victims to speak while emotionally blocked, defeating lie detectors. Multiple people can be controlled sequentially but not simultaneously. Works only on living beings capable of speech.

Limits:
Requires verbal response to activate—silence breaks the Quirk entirely. Victims cannot perform complex mental tasks like recalling memories or writing. Physical trauma or sufficiently strong pain breaks control instantly. Electronic voice transmission (megaphone, speakers) negates the effect. Bright flashing lights can disrupt the hold. The Quirk controls actions only, not thoughts or emotions, allowing victims to potentially use their own Quirks to escape.

Additional Notes:
Lacks offensive or defensive capabilities but can instantly win encounters by commanding opponents to forfeit or disable themselves. Victims remain aware of their helplessness throughout, creating a psychological strain. Most effective in one-on-one scenarios requiring quick mental engagement.

cardPool.title: Brawn Boost
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Brawn Boost

Description:
A stolen Quirk that amplifies the user's physical strength beyond normal limits. Possessing multiple copies compounds the effect, granting exponentially greater power with each additional instance.

Functions/Applications:
Enhanced striking force, lifting capacity, and physical durability. Multiple copies stack their effects, allowing the user to overpower opponents through sheer physical superiority. Useful for direct combat, restraining targets, and demolishing barriers.

Limits:
Single copy provides modest strength enhancement; effectiveness scales with number of copies possessed. Does not grant speed, durability against energy-based attacks, or tactical advantages. Requires direct physical contact or proximity for application.

Additional Notes:
Originally stolen from an unknown source. All For One's possession of three copies makes this Quirk substantially more potent than standard versions. The stacking nature means duplicate copies are valuable acquisitions for strength-focused users.

cardPool.title: Bristle
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Bristle

Description:
A hardening-type Quirk that allows the user to drastically increase the density and rigidity of their hair, transforming it into steel-like strands. The hair becomes an offensive and defensive tool comparable to hardened metal.

Functions/Applications:
The user can deploy hardened hair as weapons for striking and piercing attacks, create a protective barrier by stiffening hair around the body, or manipulate hardened strands for entanglement and restraint. Hair can be angled and shaped for maximum combat effectiveness.

Limits:
The Quirk only affects the user's own hair and cannot be extended indefinitely; hardened hair remains attached to the scalp. Maintaining the hardening state likely requires active concentration and stamina. The user's head remains vulnerable to attacks that bypass the hair defense, and baldness or hair loss would severely limit effectiveness.

Additional Notes:
Tsuyoshi's full combat applications and fighting style remain largely unexplored, leaving room for creative interpretation of advanced techniques. The Quirk's power scales with hair length and density. Situational disadvantages emerge in confined spaces where hair manipulation becomes restricted.

cardPool.title: Brown Bear
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Brown Bear

Description:
A transformation quirk that grants the user bear-like physiology, including enhanced musculature, thick fur coat, and animalistic instincts. The user gains a more bestial appearance but retains human cognition and speech.

Functions/Applications:
Grants superhuman strength for melee combat and grappling, increased durability to withstand heavy impacts, acute smell and hearing for tracking or detection, and sharp claws effective for slashing attacks or climbing. Useful for close-quarters fighting and survival scenarios.

Limits:
The transformation is permanent or semi-permanent, potentially limiting social interaction. Acute senses can be overwhelming in chaotic environments. Heavy build may reduce agility and speed compared to lighter combat styles. Claws are fixed weapons unsuitable for fine manipulation.

Additional Notes:
This quirk excels in direct confrontation and wilderness settings but struggles with precision tasks or stealth. The user's bestial nature may influence behavior and decision-making in combat situations.

cardPool.title: Bruiser
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Bruiser

Description:
A power-enhancement quirk that allows the user to concentrate strength into a single limb, delivering devastating strikes. Charging time directly correlates to attack power—longer preparation yields exponentially stronger blows. When chemically enhanced by external stimulants, the entire body becomes supercharged instead.

Functions/Applications:
Focus energy into arms or legs for single powerful attacks. Charge duration ranges from instant strikes to devastating charged blows. Can be used defensively by powering limbs to block or brace impact. External chemical enhancement (Trigger) expands the quirk to full-body augmentation for overwhelming force.

Limits:
Cannot split power between multiple limbs simultaneously—commitment to one limb only. Charging leaves user vulnerable and telegraphs intentions. Excessive charging time creates tactical windows for counterattack. Chemical enhancement causes dependency and serious side effects with prolonged use.

Additional Notes:
Strength lies in raw power output and tactical flexibility of limb selection. Requires disciplined timing and positioning to maximize effectiveness in combat. Best suited for direct confrontation rather than ranged or evasive fighting styles.

cardPool.title: Bubble
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Bubble

Description:
The user creates bubbles of varying sizes filled with any aroma they have previously smelled. These aromatic bubbles can be deployed offensively or defensively, ranging from pleasant fragrances to putrid stinks. When the user is panicked or nervous, involuntary bubbles form with foul odors that detonate spontaneously.

Functions/Applications:
Deploy sweet-smelling bubbles to mask scents or create diversions during combat. Produce foul-smelling bubbles to disorient, sicken, or temporarily incapacitate enemies while the user moves in to restrain them. Use bubbles as non-lethal crowd control or as personal olfactory camouflage in stealth scenarios.

Limits:
User must have previously experienced an aroma to replicate it; cannot create novel scents. Bubbles require time to form and are vulnerable to destruction mid-creation. Panic triggers involuntary, uncontrollable foul bubbles that explode unpredictably, potentially affecting the user and allies. Effectiveness reduced against foes immune to olfactory distraction or wearing scent-blocking gear.

Additional Notes:
This Quirk excels at non-lethal incapacitation and tactical support but lacks direct damage output. Success depends heavily on target psychology and environmental factors. User must maintain composure to retain control during high-stress combat situations.

cardPool.title: Bull Head
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Bull Head

Description:
A transformation quirk that grants the user a pair of large, robust bull-like horns protruding from their head. The horns are sharp, durable, and naturally suited for ramming and goring attacks.

Functions/Applications:
The user can perform powerful charging tackles using their horns as battering rams, devastating charging attacks that increase in force with momentum, and direct goring strikes in close combat. The horns provide excellent armor-piercing capability and can break through barriers.

Limits:
The horns cannot be retracted once manifested, limiting stealth and social situations. They are structurally fixed to the skull, so damage to them causes direct pain. The quirk requires a running start for maximum charging impact; stationary horn strikes deal reduced damage. Twisting or rotational movements are awkward and slow with the extra head weight.

Additional Notes:
Best suited for aggressive, direct combat strategies. Works effectively against rigid defenses but performs poorly against evasive opponents. The user trades mobility and finesse for raw power and intimidation.

cardPool.title: Bullet Laser
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Bullet Laser

Description:
The user fires purple-colored laser beams from their fingertips with precision and destructive force. These lasers can travel in straight trajectories or be curved mid-flight through deliberate manipulation, making them difficult to predict or evade.

Functions/Applications:
Direct offensive blasts that pierce flesh and demolish structures; explosive impact capability upon contact with solid surfaces; curved trajectory firing for striking targets behind cover or around obstacles; suitable for both close-range and distance combat scenarios.

Limits:
Requires line of sight from fingertips to project beams; energy expenditure increases with distance and power output; curved beams require concentration and are slower than direct shots; no defensive capabilities or sustained barriers; effectiveness reduced against certain resistances or reflective surfaces.

Additional Notes:
This Quirk was stolen rather than naturally inherited, suggesting potential instability or incomplete mastery in some users. The destructive power is considerable but demands precise aim and tactical awareness for optimal effectiveness in combat.

cardPool.title: Bullhorn
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Bullhorn

Description:
The user's voice becomes unnaturally loud and powerful, amplifying sound output far beyond normal human limits. The user can project their voice with tremendous volume and carry without strain.

Functions/Applications:
Project voice across vast distances with clarity; intimidate or disorient enemies through sheer volume; create sonic disturbances that can disrupt concentration; communicate across battlefields or large crowds instantly.

Limits:
No directional control—amplification affects all sound equally in all directions; cannot modulate frequency or create focused sonic attacks; prolonged use may cause throat damage; effectiveness diminishes in soundproofed or noise-dampening environments; relies on the user's base voice quality and speaking ability.

Additional Notes:
Primarily utility-focused with limited offensive potential. Effectiveness depends heavily on environmental acoustics and proximity to targets. Works best for crowd control, psychological pressure, or tactical communication rather than direct combat damage.

cardPool.title: Burst
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name: Burst

Description: A destructive self-detonation ability that allows the user to explode their entire body in a violent burst of intense light and force. The explosion is catastrophic and consumes the user entirely, making it a final resort technique.

Functions/Applications: Creates a powerful area-of-effect explosion dealing massive damage to all nearby targets. Generates blinding light that disorients enemies and obscures vision. Can be used as a tactical distraction to create openings for allies or escape.

Limits: One-time use only—activation destroys the user's body completely. Cannot be reversed or controlled once initiated. Requires the user to be in close proximity to targets for maximum effectiveness. User dies upon activation, making it unsuitable for prolonged combat.

Additional Notes: This Quirk is exclusively viable for expendable combatants or as a last-stand desperation move. Most effective when coordinated with ally tactics to capitalize on the confusion created by the explosion and blinding light.

cardPool.title: Cemedine
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Cemedine

Description:
The user secretes a versatile adhesive liquid from cranial orifices that can be sprayed at targets. This glue can either harden into a rigid binding substance or remain tacky and hazardous, with the user controlling the solidification rate.

Functions/Applications:
Restrain opponents by spraying glue that hardens around limbs or bodies; create sticky traps that damage or slow movement; adjust drying speed to catch fast-moving targets or allow strategic repositioning; seal objects or seal wounds temporarily.

Limits:
Glue requires direct contact to be effective; excessive spraying depletes the user's supply; hardened glue can be broken with sufficient strength; the adhesive cannot affect the user's own body; drying time adjustment has a minimum and maximum threshold; ranged application is less precise than melee contact.

Additional Notes:
The quirk is most effective in close-to-mid range combat. Environmental factors like high heat may accelerate drying unpredictably. The user must have a clear line of sight to spray effectively.

cardPool.title: Cement
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Cement

Description:
A manipulation Quirk that allows the user to reshape and control existing cement and concrete through physical contact. The user cannot create cement from nothing, only mold what already exists into desired forms. A faint green glow emanates from the user's hands when actively using this ability.

Functions/Applications:
Reshape concrete into weapons, barriers, and complex structures for offense and defense. Create elaborate constructions like buildings and arenas within minutes. Trap and contain enemies by materializing concrete walls. Dual-purpose combat tool for both attacking and protecting. Exceptional utility in urban construction and infrastructure work.

Limits:
Requires direct contact with existing cement or concrete to function—cannot operate without a source material. Severely diminished effectiveness in rural or natural environments lacking concrete infrastructure. Users with sufficient destructive power can break through concrete constructs, though skilled users can overwhelm even strong opponents with proper strategy. Range limited to areas where the user can maintain physical contact with the material being manipulated.

Additional Notes:
Provides overwhelming advantage in urban combat zones but becomes nearly useless in countryside or wilderness settings. Requires expert skill and quick thinking to maximize effectiveness. Best suited for defensive strategies and trap-based tactics rather than pure offensive power.

cardPool.title: Centipede
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Centipede

Description:
Grants the user elongated, segmented limbs resembling a centipede's body. The user's arms, legs, and head can extend dramatically from their body. These limbs remain concealed within clothing until deployed, allowing for surprise attacks.

Functions/Applications:
Extended reach for grappling and restraint from distance. Venomous pincers deliver paralyzing toxin that causes severe pain to victims. Multi-limb coordination enables complex entanglement tactics. Concealment provides tactical advantage in combat initiation.

Limits:
Limbs are constrained by clothing capacity when retracted, limiting sudden extensions. Venom takes time to take effect and requires direct contact via pincer attack. Extended limbs may be difficult to control with precision at maximum range. Head extension exposes the user's vulnerable center point.

Additional Notes:
The venomous nature makes this Quirk particularly effective against unarmored foes. Stealth potential is high due to concealment, but speed of deployment determines combat effectiveness. This Quirk favors grappling and control strategies over direct striking power.

cardPool.title: Chameleon
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Chameleon

Description:
The user gains the physiology and capabilities of a chameleon, including adhesive skin for climbing, independently rotating eyes, an extendable tongue, and color-changing camouflage. This Quirk transforms the user into a hybrid creature capable of blending seamlessly with surroundings.

Functions/Applications:
Scale vertical surfaces and ceilings with sticky limbs. Monitor multiple directions simultaneously using independent eye rotation. Extend a long, prehensile tongue for surprise attacks or utility. Activate full-body camouflage to become invisible to most observers, enabling ambushes, reconnaissance, or evasion. The chameleon physiology grants enhanced agility and climbing speed.

Limits:
Camouflage is not perfect—observant or keen-eyed individuals can detect the user if they look closely. The adhesive grip weakens on smooth, non-porous surfaces. The extendable tongue has limited reach and strength. Eyes rotating independently may be disorienting in combat. Camouflage breaks if the user moves too quickly or attacks.

Additional Notes:
Chameleon excels at hit-and-run tactics, infiltration, and defensive positioning. The Quirk is most effective in environments with varied colors and terrain. Direct confrontation is disadvantageous; the user should rely on surprise and mobility rather than brute strength.

cardPool.title: Charging Muscles
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Charging Muscles

Description:
A power-enhancement Quirk that allows the user to accumulate and concentrate strength within their musculature before releasing it in a devastatingly powerful strike. The longer the charge period, the greater the force of the resulting attack.

Functions/Applications:
Channeling energy into muscles to amplify punch or kick damage. Charging can be done mid-combat or before engagement. Creates explosive melee attacks capable of significant destruction and knockback.

Limits:
Charging requires time and cannot be instant; premature release wastes buildup. Overcharging causes severe muscle soreness, pain, and temporary loss of function. Sustained charging drains stamina rapidly. Works only with physical strikes, not ranged attacks.

Additional Notes:
Best used as a finishing move or to overcome defensive opponents. The user must balance charging duration against the risk of overexertion. Most effective when opponent cannot interrupt the charging phase. Muscle recovery time is essential after maximum-power charges.

cardPool.title: Chart
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Chart

Description:
Chart enables the user to manifest a holographic page displaying real-time tracking data on designated targets. The page acts as a living document, updating continuously with vital information about tracked individuals.

Functions/Applications:
Creates a tangible holographic interface showing target location, distance, and vital status. User can observe tracked enemies in action from afar, gaining tactical awareness. Useful for surveillance, pursuit, coordination in combat, and determining if targets remain alive.

Limits:
Requires initial target designation before tracking begins. Distance appears limited by the user's sensory range or concentration. Cannot track multiple targets simultaneously without creating separate pages. Holographic display is visible to others nearby, potentially compromising secrecy.

Additional Notes:
Chart grants significant reconnaissance advantages but relies on preparation and information gathering. Effective for strategic encounters rather than direct combat. The holographic nature suggests the tracking page may be disrupted by interference with the user's concentration or proximity to the target.

cardPool.title: Chest Hair
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Chest Hair

Description:
A Quirk that enhances the user's masculine physical traits and attributes. The exact mechanisms are unclear, but it grants notably increased strength and durability. Some evidence suggests the user may project destructive purple energy beams from their chest, though this could be a secondary manifestation or visual representation of amplified virility.

Functions/Applications:
Enhanced physical strength for combat and labor; increased resilience and muscle density; possible energy projection as offensive capability; psychological intimidation through exaggerated masculine appearance.

Limits:
The full scope of this Quirk remains poorly documented. Energy projection, if real, appears inconsistent or situational. No apparent ranged combat versatility beyond chest-based attacks. Strength enhancement alone may not overcome trained combat technique.

Additional Notes:
Tenma Nakaoji is the known user. The Quirk's true nature is ambiguous—whether laser emission is a core ability or merely aesthetic exaggeration requires further investigation. Most reliable aspect is physical augmentation through enhanced masculine traits.

cardPool.title: Chimera
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Chimera

Description:
The user can manifest characteristics of various animals, permanently adopting a blue werewolf form as their base state. They can temporarily shift to gain traits of birds, lizards, dragons, and other creatures, enlarging these animal features to monstrous proportions for enhanced combat capability.

Functions/Applications:
Grants tremendous strength and durability scaling with the animal form adopted. Dragon form enables fire breath attacks, including powerful concentrated energy beams. Bird traits provide flight or enhanced mobility; lizard traits offer climbing and flexibility. Each form stacks its animal advantages—claws, teeth, wings, scales—making the user a versatile transformer in combat.

Limits:
Transformations consume stamina; extended use of multiple forms drains energy quickly. Larger transformations reduce speed and agility despite increased power. The user cannot simultaneously access all animal traits—only one primary form at a time. Sustained dragon-form beam attacks are exhausting and have cooldown periods.

Additional Notes:
The permanent werewolf state suggests the user is always partly transformed, making them a hybrid fighter by default. This Quirk excels in prolonged battles through form versatility but requires tactical form-switching to avoid fatigue. Opponents familiar with specific animal weaknesses can exploit individual forms.

cardPool.title: Chronostasis
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Chronostasis

Description:
The user's hair transforms into arrow-shaped projectiles that extend in straight lines and can cut targets. The hair is divided into two sections: the "Minute Hand" on the forehead and the "Hour Hand" at the nape, each representing different time units. Upon impact, struck targets experience a slowdown effect whose duration depends on which hand struck them.

Functions/Applications:
Launch hair arrows as offensive cutting weapons with varying slowdown durations. The Minute Hand inflicts shorter slowdown periods, while the Hour Hand inflicts longer ones. Use slowdown effects to immobilize or hamper enemy movement during combat. Position strategically before attacking to maximize effectiveness.

Limits:
The user must remain completely stationary to extend and fire hair arrows; any movement cancels the ability. This creates vulnerability windows where the user cannot both attack and defend actively. Hair regenerates but likely has a recharge time between uses. Slowdown effects have finite duration and do not permanently disable targets.

Additional Notes:
Chronostasis rewards patient, tactical gameplay over aggressive rushing. Users benefit from cover or defensive positioning while channeling attacks. The dual-hand system creates strategic choice in selecting between quick, weak slowdowns or powerful, long-duration ones depending on tactical needs.

cardPool.title: Clean Bubbler
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Clean Bubbler

Description:
Susugu Mitarai generates pressurized soapy water and large soap bubbles from his body. The bubbles possess surprising strength and buoyancy, capable of lifting multiple people simultaneously while remaining controllable. The solution carries disinfectant properties useful for medical aid.

Functions/Applications:
Create powerful streams of soapy water for offensive pressure or propulsion. Generate large enveloping bubbles to lift, transport, or contain targets. Use bubbles to cleanse wounds and provide basic medical treatment to the injured. Combine streams and bubbles for crowd control or rescue operations.

Limits:
Requires an internal tank of soapy solution with finite capacity. Bubbles are fragile and can burst from sharp objects or excessive force. The Quirk is non-lethal and struggles against determined resistance. Extended use depletes reserves, requiring time to replenish.

Additional Notes:
Clean Bubbler excels in support and utility roles rather than direct combat. The disinfectant quality makes Mitarai valuable in humanitarian situations. Opponents with piercing weapons or ranged attacks gain significant advantage. Water-based Quirks may interact unpredictably with the soapy medium.

cardPool.title: Cleaning
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Cleaning

Description:
The user secretes a potent dish soap-like substance from their body that can weaken or temporarily negate the Quirks of others through direct contact. This substance is also effective at removing biological evidence like blood and fingerprints from surfaces.

Functions/Applications:
Apply the secreted soap by brushing or rubbing it directly onto an opponent's skin to suppress their Quirk's effectiveness. Use the substance to cleanse crime scenes and eliminate forensic evidence. The soap works best on exposed skin and active Quirk manifestations.

Limits:
Requires direct physical contact with the target or surface; cannot affect Quirks from a distance. Effectiveness diminishes over time as the substance dries or is washed away. Works better against external Quirks than internal ones. Overuse causes the user's skin to dry out and become irritated. The soap does not permanently destroy Quirks, only temporarily weakens them.

Additional Notes:
This Quirk is more utility-focused than combat-oriented, making the user valuable for both law enforcement and reconnaissance. The user must be close enough to make contact, creating personal risk in direct confrontation. The substance has a limited supply per secretion cycle.

cardPool.title: Clones
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Clones

Description:
