Ectoplasm expels a glowing viscous fluid from his mouth that he shapes into exact duplicates of himself. He can create up to thirty clones (thirty-six when in a good mood), each sharing his consciousness and capable of speech. All clones can be willfully dispersed at any time.

Functions/Applications:
Deploy clones for overwhelming numerical advantage in combat or to patrol vast areas simultaneously. Use clones for surveillance and reconnaissance, as the user perceives through all duplicates regardless of distance. Redirect clones to individual tasks—ideal for teaching, search operations, or crowd control. Create a single massive clone capable of trapping enemies within or on its body, though this prevents spawning additional clones.

Limits:
Each clone is fragile and can be destroyed by a single strong blow. Creating the giant clone eliminates the ability to generate smaller clones simultaneously. The Quirk requires oral expulsion of the fluid, making it vulnerable during channeling. Clones cannot exceed the user's own physical capabilities or knowledge.

Additional Notes:
This Quirk excels at force multiplication and surveillance rather than raw power. The shared consciousness creates a hive-mind advantage for coordination. Best used for overwhelming numbers or covering large territories rather than defeating single powerful opponents.

cardPool.title: Cloud
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Cloud

Description:
The user generates solid, touchable clouds of varying sizes and densities that can support the weight of people and objects. These clouds float freely through the air, granting the user exceptional aerial mobility and the ability to store items within them.

Functions/Applications:
Cloud enables rapid vertical and horizontal movement by riding clouds at high speed, perfect for swift escapes or aerial reconnaissance. The clouds can shield allies from falling debris or attacks through defensive density manipulation. Users can create diversionary clouds to confuse enemies, hide within them for ambush tactics, or generate obscuring billows to block vision and create tactical advantages in combat.

Limits:
The Quirk is vulnerable to abilities that disperse gases or liquids, as cloud density cannot withstand sustained elemental attacks. Movement speed depends on cloud size—larger clouds are slower but sturdier. The user cannot generate clouds faster than once per few seconds, limiting rapid repositioning. Clouds dissipate if the user loses concentration or becomes incapacitated, making this Quirk unreliable when unconscious.

Additional Notes:
Cloud is primarily a mobility and evasion Quirk rather than an offensive one. Its greatest strength lies in tactical positioning and escape routes.

cardPool.title: Comic
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Comic

Description:
The user materializes spoken onomatopoeia into giant Japanese letters that manifest with real-world effects matching their sound. The user's head transforms into a comic speech bubble, affecting their appearance and height. Overuse causes throat soreness, limiting performance.

Functions/Applications:
Create protective barriers, offensive blasts, and utility effects by speaking sound words. Examples include "BOOM" for explosions, "CRASH" for impacts, and "SPLASH" for water effects. The manifested letters are remarkably durable and can withstand laser attacks. Versatility allows adaptation to multiple combat situations through creative wording.

Limits:
Rapid successive use causes throat strain, eventually preventing further activation. The user must speak clearly and intentionally—casual speech doesn't trigger the Quirk. Each onomatopoeia has a fixed effect based on its actual sound, limiting creative freedom. Physical durability of manifested letters decreases with distance or scale.

Additional Notes:
The user's distinctive comic bubble head makes them visually recognizable and potentially hinders stealth. Their black-ink blood suggests biological integration with the Quirk. Best suited for versatile support roles requiring creative problem-solving in combat.

cardPool.title: Compress
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Compress

Description:
Compress allows the user to shrink anything within a spherical area into a small, weightless marble by touching it with their hand. The compressed objects retain their properties but become pocket-sized and portable. Release is triggered by snapping fingers, restoring all marbles or individual ones to full size instantly.

Functions/Applications:
Capture and transport enemies, allies, or environmental objects. Create traps by releasing marbles to restore obstacles in enemy paths. Selectively compress body parts to inflict damage or dismemberment. Combine with environmental hazards by compressing targets alongside fire, debris, or other threats. Use marbles as decoys or launch platforms for vehicles and terrain manipulation.

Limits:
Activation requires hand contact with the target; user's own arm cannot be compressed. After losing the left arm, Compress functions only through the right arm. Selective compression of single body parts risks mutilation. User cannot compress themselves unless within the area being compressed. Large-scale compression drains focus and requires precise targeting.

Additional Notes:
The user's background in stage magic enhances this Quirk through illusion tactics, decoy creation, and stealth application. Compress is remarkably silent, allowing covert capture without alerting nearby allies. Weight reduction makes it ideal for escape scenarios and breaking through solid obstacles.

cardPool.title: Confession
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Confession

Description:
After posing a question, the user compels the target to answer with absolute truthfulness. The victim cannot lie, resist, or refuse to respond, revealing their deepest secrets, intentions, and emotions. This Quirk operates on a literal level—answers reflect exactly what the target believes to be true, not necessarily objective reality.

Functions/Applications:
Extract intelligence from enemies and allies. Expose hidden loyalties, fears, and shameful truths. Prevent betrayal by interrogating suspects. Manipulate opponents emotionally by forcing humiliating admissions during conflict. Verify the honesty of subordinates.

Limits:
Completely non-offensive; the user cannot damage or fight directly. Ineffective if either party cannot speak or communicate. The Quirk interprets answers literally—loopholes exist if the target's understanding differs from reality. Requires the user to ask specific questions; vague inquiries yield vague answers. Does not compel physical action, only verbal response.

Additional Notes:
Most effective during interrogation or investigation rather than combat. Users should prepare targeted questions in advance for maximum utility. Emotional vulnerability of the target may increase the psychological impact of forced confessions. The Quirk's greatest strength lies in information gathering and organizational security, not direct confrontation.

cardPool.title: Conjure
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name: Conjure

Description: A warping ability that instantly teleports small objects directly into the user's hand from their line of sight. The user focuses on a target and the object materializes in their grasp without physical travel.

Functions/Applications: Retrieve weapons, tools, or items from a distance instantly. Disarm opponents by conjuring their held objects away. Gather resources quickly in exploration. Snatch items mid-air or from secured locations within range.

Limits: Only works on relatively small objects—large or bulky items cannot be conjured. Requires clear line of sight to the target object. Objects must be targetable and distinct; cannot conjure abstract things or pull from sealed containers. Range appears moderate, not unlimited distance. User must have hand capacity to receive the conjured item.

Additional Notes: Highly useful for theft, procurement, and tactical advantage in combat. Effectiveness depends on environmental awareness and quick thinking. Works best against unprepared opponents or in cluttered environments with many available objects.

cardPool.title: Control Glass
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Control Glass

Description:
The user commands and reshapes glass matter within their vicinity, altering its physical state between solid and liquid forms at will. This grants them dominion over existing glass structures and the ability to transmute their properties instantaneously.

Functions/Applications:
Create levitating glass platforms for flight and rapid movement. Absorb glass from environmental sources like windows and structures to augment available mass. Form glass projectiles of varying sizes for ranged attacks. Liquefy glass to trap or ensnare foes, then resolidify to immobilize them. Construct barriers and shields by consolidating nearby glass.

Limits:
Requires existing glass sources within the user's area—cannot generate glass from nothing. Effectiveness diminishes in environments with scarce glass. Liquefied glass remains difficult to control with precision. The user must maintain concentration to sustain floating platforms. Large-scale reshaping consumes significant stamina.

Additional Notes:
This Quirk excels in urban environments with abundant glass. The user can sense glass composition and location within their operational radius. Mobility depends on available glass reserves; rural or stone-heavy areas severely hamper capability. Offensive power scales with the amount of glass the user can gather.

cardPool.title: Control Horn
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Control Horn

Description:
The user possesses specialized horns that project psychic dominion over bovine creatures. By maintaining both horns intact, the user can establish mental command over cattle, forcing them to obey commands through direct neural influence.

Functions/Applications:
Control herds of hundreds of cattle simultaneously for stampedes or mass intimidation. Redirect cattle movements to block passages, create diversions, or threaten populated areas. Compel cattle to attack or defend on command. Useful for agriculture, siege tactics, or extortion involving livestock.

Limits:
Only functions on bovine animals; ineffective against humans, horses, or other species. Requires both horns to be undamaged and intact; loss of even one horn completely disables the Quirk. Control range and herd size appear limited by user focus and mental stamina. Cannot control already-trained attack animals with strong independent will.

Additional Notes:
The user is entirely dependent on the presence of nearby cattle to utilize this Quirk offensively. Opponents can strategically target or destroy the horns to neutralize the ability instantly. Most effective as a threat or area-control tool rather than direct combat. Urban environments with limited livestock severely reduce tactical advantage.

cardPool.title: Copy
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Copy

Description:
Copy allows the user to replicate any Quirk after making physical contact with its user—even brief contact like touching a few strands of hair grants full access. The user gains instinctive knowledge of how to use the copied Quirk at a basic level and can store multiple copied Quirks simultaneously, switching between them as needed.

Functions/Applications:
Instantly acquire an opponent's Quirk for tactical advantage in combat. Adapt to any situation by switching between stored Quirks on the fly. Preserve lingering effects of used Quirks (such as size alterations) even after switching to another power. Stack up to four or more Quirks within the body through training.

Limits:
Active duration is 10 minutes per copied Quirk before it expires and must be re-copied. Only one Quirk can be activated at a time; switching requires active management. Requires physical contact to function—useless without access to other Quirk users. Cannot replicate Quirks dependent on accumulated resources or stockpiled power (called "blanks"). User lacks the physical conditioning of the original Quirk wielder and may sustain injury using powerful Quirks without proper training. Mastery requires repeated copying and practice; initial use is basic and lacks versatility.

Additional Notes:
Copy is fundamentally parasitic, offering no inherent combat ability. The user must rely on tactical thinking, deception, and rapid adaptation rather than raw power.

cardPool.title: Cow
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Cow

Description:
The user transforms portions of their body to gain bovine characteristics including hooves, horns, and hardened hide. This grants them enhanced speed and strength comparable to a large cattle animal, making them a formidable physical force.

Functions/Applications:
Transform legs into powerful hooves for rapid ground movement and enhanced kicking force. Grow hardened horns for goring attacks and charging strikes. Thicken hide for improved damage resistance. Stack multiple bovine traits simultaneously for cumulative strength and speed benefits.

Limits:
Transformations are partial rather than complete—user remains partially human. Bovine form is slower than dedicated speed-type quirks. Increased body mass from transformation may limit agility and precision movement. Sustained transformation drains stamina over extended use.

Additional Notes:
Optimal in direct combat and charging scenarios but struggles with finesse-based encounters. Transformation is visually obvious, limiting stealth applications. Works best against opponents relying on speed rather than raw power.

cardPool.title: Creation
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Creation

Description:
Momo transmutes her body's fat cells into physical matter, materializing objects from her skin with a distinctive blue-pink glow. She can create virtually any non-living object if she understands its atomic structure, from simple weapons to complex machinery, limited only by her knowledge and lipid reserves.

Functions/Applications:
Creates melee weapons (poles, pikes) for close combat and cannons for ranged attacks. Can produce objects larger than her body by expending sufficient fat reserves. Partial materialization allows dual-tasking—leaving items half-formed within her body while using hands freely. Creations can be shared with allies. Her mastery of matryoshka dolls allows near-instantaneous production and storage of other items within them.

Limits:
Requires substantial food intake to replenish lipids; overuse causes weakness, exhaustion, and physical frailty. Complex or large creations demand extended preparation time, leaving her vulnerable to sustained attacks. Cannot create living beings. Requires deep atomic-level knowledge of any object before creation—unfamiliar items cannot be made. Relentless pressure forces defensive positioning, negating her strategic advantage.

Additional Notes:
Momo's high intelligence and quick thinking enable creative problem-solving through fabricated tools. Close-range combat suits her best; long-range engagements require pre-planned cannons.

cardPool.title: Crystallize
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name: Crystallize

Description: Yu Hojo can rapidly grow durable crystals across his entire body, coating his skin in a protective crystalline armor. The crystals form near-instantaneously from any point on his body and can be shaped into weapons like bladed gauntlets to extend his combat reach.

Functions/Applications: Deploy crystalline armor for defense and increased durability in combat. Form crystal blades along the arms for extended melee range. Layer crystals across vulnerable areas for targeted protection. Use rapid crystallization to counter incoming attacks or break restraints.

Limits: The crystals, while dense, are not unbreakable and can be shattered with sufficient force. Hair inhibits crystallization, requiring the user to remain shaved for optimal crystal growth. The crystals destroy clothing during formation. Generated crystals have no monetary or structural value outside the Quirk's use—they cannot be salvaged or repurposed.

Additional Notes: Best suited for close-range combat and defensive strategies. The rapid deployment makes it effective for surprise blocking or counterattacks. Users should maintain appearance upkeep for reliable activation. Crystal formation is visually distinctive, eliminating stealth options.

cardPool.title: Cubism
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Cubism

Description:
A transformation Quirk that converts touched targets into three-dimensional cubist artwork. Contact—even the slightest graze—triggers instant crystallization into geometric, fragmented forms. Victims remain conscious and mobile but permanently locked in their cubist state.

Functions/Applications:
The user can incapacitate enemies by transforming them into immobile sculptural forms, removing them from combat. Transformed targets retain awareness but lose combat effectiveness. The Quirk deactivates if the user is restrained or immobilized, potentially reversing transformations.

Limits:
Requires direct physical contact to activate. Transformed individuals cannot revert on their own—reversal depends on the user's continued consciousness and freedom. The user must avoid being captured or restrained, or the Quirk's effects may fail. Unclear if transformations can be reversed by other means.

Additional Notes:
A devastating mid-range control Quirk best suited for leaders who can maintain positioning. The permanent nature of transformation makes it psychologically potent but creates moral complications. Effectiveness heavily depends on the user avoiding capture or defeat.

cardPool.title: Curse
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Curse

Description:
The user's body transforms into sentient paper runes, granting extreme lightness and malleability. This allows for unconventional combat tactics and rapid repositioning across battlefields.

Functions/Applications:
Launch razor-sharp paper strands as projectile attacks. Create temporary paper clones to confuse or overwhelm opponents. Exploit reduced body weight for enhanced mobility and evasion. Fold or compress the paper form to fit through tight spaces.

Limits:
Paper form is vulnerable to fire and water, which degrades structural integrity. Clone creation requires sustained focus and dissipates quickly. Sharp attacks lose effectiveness against heavily armored foes. Transformation is total—cannot selectively paper-coat only parts of the body.

Additional Notes:
The paper runes maintain cohesion through unknown means; damage causes visible tears but doesn't permanently sever limbs. Best suited for hit-and-run tactics rather than prolonged direct combat. Clones are decoys only and cannot perform independent complex actions.

cardPool.title: Danger Sense
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Danger Sense

Description:
A sixth sense that detects potential threats through a sharp, stabbing sensation—visualized as a lightning bolt striking the user's mind. The Quirk reads intent and negative emotions (malice, hatred, anger) from individuals and threats in the surrounding area, allowing the user to anticipate danger and react accordingly.

Functions/Applications:
Warns of hostile intentions and evaluates threat levels by sensing malice. Enables rapid dodging and evasion. Can detect danger from multiple sources simultaneously. Works passively without conscious activation. Effectiveness scales with training, reducing physical toll over time.

Limits:
Fails to trigger against those with no true malice or hostile intent, even if objectively dangerous (e.g., friendly sparring partners). Overwhelmed by high concentrations of negative emotions in crowds. Ineffective against sufficiently fast attacks or projectiles that allow no reaction time. Misdirected by aware opponents using decoys. Weakened when multiple weaker threats converge, creating sensory confusion. Does not function against those perceived as non-threats, even genuine dangers.

Additional Notes:
Initial use caused severe physical strain, though training mitigates this. The Quirk reads emotional intent rather than objective danger, making it unreliable against emotionally complex attackers. Originally used by Hikage Shinomori in conjunction with One For All.

cardPool.title: Dark Ball
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Dark Ball

Description:
The user generates and launches spherical projectiles of concentrated dark energy, manifesting as black orbs with purple outlines. These balls emit volatile dark energy that can be released in rapid succession or coordinated barrages.

Functions/Applications:
Dark Ball excels at ranged offensive attacks and area denial, allowing the user to bombard enemies from distance. The projectiles can be fired in multiple directions simultaneously, making it effective for overwhelming opponents or creating chaotic combat scenarios. Works well in combination with other abilities for compound attacks.

Limits:
Individual projectiles have limited tracking capability and can be dodged or blocked by agile opponents or defensive barriers. The Quirk requires concentration to aim and control; rapid-fire usage becomes less accurate. Sustained barrages drain stamina quickly, limiting prolonged offensive pressure.

Additional Notes:
Dark Ball relies on overwhelming force rather than precision. It pairs well with close-range or tanking abilities to cover an attacker's weaknesses. The Quirk is most effective when the user can control the battlefield space and prevent enemies from closing distance rapidly.

cardPool.title: Darkness
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Darkness

Description:
The user manifests a dark purple liquid substance from their fingers and soles of their feet. This misty, sludge-like material spreads across terrain and surroundings, causing anything it contacts to sink into the substance as if it were quicksand. The quirk emerged spontaneously in the user's youth and has no known relation to family abilities.

Functions/Applications:
Creates zones of sinking terrain to trap or slow enemies. Can be released from hands for targeted attacks or from feet to create mobile hazard zones while moving. The substance blankets wide areas when fully unleashed, potentially covering entire rooms or outdoor spaces.

Limits:
Full extent of capabilities remains unknown. The quirk is difficult to control—initial manifestations were involuntary and uncontrollable, flooding entire rooms. No clear information on duration, range limits, or whether the substance can be reabsorbed. Cannot be shaped with precision; spreads naturally through environment.

Additional Notes:
A rare variant quirk with no precedent in user's bloodline, suggesting unique or unstable origins. Extremely powerful but dangerous to the user and surroundings alike, making it difficult to master safely.

cardPool.title: Day Dream
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Day Dream

Description:
By making direct eye contact, the user traps a target's consciousness in a personalized dream world reflecting their deepest fantasies and desires, rendering their body nearly comatose. The victim's eyes turn pure white while the user's glow red. The user can telepathically perceive the victim's dreams and innermost secrets.

Functions/Applications:
Control and incapacitation of single targets through psychological imprisonment. Espionage and information gathering by reading victims' fantasies. With Quirk amplification, affects multiple targets simultaneously. Useful for interrogation, restraint, and sustained mind control without physical force.

Limits:
Requires direct line of sight to activate. Normally limited to one conscious target at a time. Effects break if the user sustains significant injury. Victims can escape if made aware of the illusion's nature by external parties. Personalities or consciousnesses within the victim (like separate entities or implants) remain unaffected and can free the trapped mind. Artificial body parts operate independently and may act against the user.

Additional Notes:
Day Dream is a control-oriented Quirk prioritizing psychological domination over combat. Its greatest weakness is awareness—once victims know they dream, they regain agency. Multiple consciousnesses within one body counter the ability entirely. Best deployed covertly before targets realize their situation.

cardPool.title: Decay
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Decay

Description:
A destructive Quirk that disintegrates anything or anyone touched by the user's hands, reducing targets to dust. The disintegration spreads rapidly across organic and inorganic matter alike, with speed increasing as the Quirk evolves. Originally a reverse-engineered copy of Overhaul, stripped of its restoration properties.

Functions/Applications:
Touch-based destruction of matter and living tissue. Can trigger chain reactions of disintegration across multiple targets. Spreads through victims' bodies unless the affected limb is severed or the process is interrupted before completion. At full power, capable of destroying entire structures and multiple enemies simultaneously.

Limits:
Requires direct physical contact with fingers to activate—gloves or distance negates the effect. Cannot properly affect fluid or particle-based matter (sand, water). High-power usage causes severe recoil damage to the user's own body. Loses effectiveness if the user loses their hands or fingers. Disintegration can be interrupted by destroying the affected area before spread completes or by erasing the Quirk effect itself.

Additional Notes:
Manifests as cracks and degradation on the user's body over prolonged use. Originally manifested in childhood with uncontrolled, accidental destruction. The Quirk factor is localized in the user's hands, making hand-loss a critical vulnerability.

cardPool.title: Delay Spot
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Delay Spot

Description:
Bruno Gollini creates a semi-spherical bubble that traps everything inside in severe slow motion. The user moves at normal speed within the bubble, remaining unaffected while targets become nearly helpless. Others can move normally if physically touching the user.

Functions/Applications:
Incapacitate enemies and slow projectiles to a crawl. Retrieve hostages safely by entering the bubble at full speed. Manipulate combat situations by isolating opponents in temporal stasis. Extended range allows covering entire mansion yards after enhancement.

Limits:
Sufficiently fast-moving objects (faster than bullets) can partially bypass the effect and still deal damage. Range is limited to semi-sphere coverage area. Requires line of effect to establish the bubble. Cannot protect the user from extreme velocity attacks that exceed the slowdown threshold.

Additional Notes:
User becomes overconfident when Delay Spot dominates combat, sometimes underestimating opponents. The Quirk's effectiveness drops dramatically against high-speed Quirks or enhancements that exceed bullet velocity. Physical contact with the user allows allies to bypass slowdown effects.

cardPool.title: Despot
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Despot

Description:
The user extrudes thin, nearly invisible threads from their body that can penetrate and puppeteer other humans. Victims remain conscious and aware but cannot resist the user's commands, functioning as living extensions of the user's will. Several dozen individuals can be controlled simultaneously.

Functions/Applications:
Create an army of controlled soldiers while maintaining their skills and knowledge. Send puppets into danger without personal risk. Gather intelligence through multiple controlled perspectives. Overwhelm opponents through sheer numbers of coordinated bodies.

Limits:
Control breaks if victims receive a sudden, strong physical shock or impact. Control instantly ceases if the user loses consciousness. Victims cannot be forced to harm themselves fatally. Thread range appears limited to moderate distances. Cannot control those with specific defensive Quirks or exceptional willpower without difficulty.

Additional Notes:
Victims retain muscle memory and combat training but execute only the user's tactical decisions. The psychological toll on controlled individuals creates potential moral complications. The Quirk's power scales with the user's ability to coordinate multiple bodies effectively.

cardPool.title: Dog
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Dog

Description:
A canine-based transformation quirk that grants the user enhanced senses of smell and hearing, alongside physical dog characteristics. The manifestation varies between users—some develop full dog features while others display partial transformations. All users gain acute sensory perception capable of tracking targets across vast distances.

Functions/Applications:
Users can detect and identify individuals by scent from miles away, track prey through forests, and perceive threats via heightened hearing. Physical dog traits (claws, paws, fur, enhanced nose) provide combat advantages and climbing ability. The quirk likely enhances overall physical attributes including strength and agility.

Limits:
Sensory abilities, while powerful, can be overwhelmed by strong odors or noise pollution. Physical transformations are permanent and unchangeable, affecting social interactions. The quirk does not grant animal control or communication abilities. Tracking effectiveness diminishes in heavily scented environments or during storms.

Additional Notes:
Manifestation varies significantly between users—some remain largely human-shaped while others undergo extreme transformation. The quirk appears to scale with user strength; more powerful individuals demonstrate greater sensory range. Dog-like behavioral quirks (woofing, instinctive reactions) may occasionally emerge involuntarily.

cardPool.title: Double
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Double

Description:
Double allows the user to create up to two identical copies of any person or object by touching them with a viscous dark fluid secreted from their hands. The duplicates possess the original's memories from their last interaction with the user, complete personalities, and full abilities, making them nearly indistinguishable from the real thing.

Functions/Applications:
Create perfect clones for combat support, labor, or infiltration. Self-duplication enables exponential multiplication if copies duplicate themselves. Clones retain all original abilities and knowledge, multiplying the user's effective strength. Can replicate objects with precise structural knowledge. Detection of clone destruction is possible regardless of distance.

Limits:
User can maintain only two active copies at a time. Creation requires flawless mental image of target—any physical change to original requires new measurements or the clone will be malformed. Clones possess full autonomy and may refuse orders or turn hostile. Copies are less durable than originals, dissolving into viscous liquid after damage equivalent to a broken bone. Clones of damaged individuals inherit their injuries. Objects without precise compositional data decompose quickly. Second copies are notably more fragile than first duplicates.

Additional Notes:
Self-duplication is significantly faster than copying others.

cardPool.title: Dragon
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Dragon

Description:
The user transforms their body into a massive dragon form, gaining reptilian features including wings, scales, powerful jaws, and sharp claws. The transformation grants extraordinary physical prowess and durability far exceeding normal human limits.

Functions/Applications:
Flight via functional wings, devastating melee attacks with claws and fangs, powerful biting force, enhanced grappling and restraint techniques using multiple limbs, blocking and absorbing heavy impact damage, overpowering opponents with raw strength regardless of their enhancements.

Limits:
Transformation appears to have energy costs or duration constraints limiting sustained use. The user can still be weakened by opposing Quirks that target physical capability. Effectiveness reduced against opponents whose Quirks specifically counter physical strength or durability.

Additional Notes:
The dragon form retains the user's fighting technique and combat intelligence, allowing skilled martial artists to utilize grappling submissions and tactical holds with their claws and fangs. This Quirk excels in direct confrontation but may be vulnerable to ranged attacks, speed-based tactics, or mental/environmental manipulation outside its physical dominance.

cardPool.title: Dragon Breath
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Dragon Breath

Description:
A fire-expulsion quirk that enables the user to exhale intense flames from their mouth. The quirk requires alcohol consumption beforehand to activate and function effectively, making the user's state of intoxication directly tied to their combat capability.

Functions/Applications:
The user can project streams or bursts of fire as offensive attacks, capable of scorching enemies and terrain. The quirk scales in power with alcohol intake, allowing for ranged combat superiority when properly fueled. It can also be used for environmental destruction or creating barriers of flame.

Limits:
The quirk is completely dependent on prior alcohol consumption; without it, no fire can be produced. The user's accuracy and control diminish as intoxication increases beyond optimal levels. Prolonged use causes fatigue, and the quirk cannot function if the user is sober or has metabolized all consumed alcohol.

Additional Notes:
This quirk shares mechanics with similar alcohol-dependent abilities, creating a high-risk playstyle that rewards careful resource management. Users must balance intoxication levels to maintain combat effectiveness without losing control entirely.

cardPool.title: Dupli-Arms
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Dupli-Arms

Description:
Mezo manifests arm-like tentacles capable of transforming into duplicates of any body part. The replicated organs are enhanced versions of originals, emerging from pods at each tentacle's tip. Multiple different parts can be manifested simultaneously, stacking their benefits.

Functions/Applications:
Enhanced sensory reconnaissance: Eye duplicates grant 360° vision; ear duplicates detect distant or obstructed sounds. Combat multiplier: Replicated arms generate half-ton force per set. Mobility: Webbed tentacles enable wall-climbing, gliding, and carrying multiple people. Communication: Mouth replicas bypass facial mask restrictions. Scalability: Pods can self-replicate to extend tentacle length indefinitely.

Limits:
Tentacles and duplicated parts are as vulnerable to injury as normal body parts. Regrowing severed duplicates is painful and time-consuming. Manifesting multiple organs from single pods reduces control and effectiveness. Gliding duration is limited. Tentacles lack precision for fine manipulation despite strength.

Additional Notes:
Dupli-Arms excels in reconnaissance, defense, and strength-based tasks but struggles in close-quarters combat requiring dexterity. Extended tentacles via pod self-replication risk uncontrolled growth if overused.

cardPool.title: Dust
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name: Dust

Description: The user's body generates fine, ash-like particles that can be expelled at will. Konako Haizono weaponizes this dust by hurling it at opponents' sensory organs to blind, choke, or disorient them in combat.

Functions/Applications: Creates obscuring clouds for evasion or escape; targets eyes to blind enemies; targets nose and mouth to cause choking or respiratory distress; serves as a tactical distraction during prolonged battles.

Limits: Overuse causes severe desiccation of the user's skin, becoming dry and rough with prolonged activation. Dust effectiveness diminishes in wet environments or against opponents with sealed sensory protection. Requires direct contact or close range for maximum impact.

Additional Notes: Effective as a support ability rather than direct damage. Best used in short bursts with recovery periods. Works well combined with speed-based tactics to exploit temporary blind spots created by dust clouds.

cardPool.title: Eagle
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name: Eagle

Description: The user undergoes a physical transformation into an eagle-like humanoid form, gaining avian features including feathered wings, sharp talons, and enhanced predatory senses. This transformation grants capabilities comparable to a natural eagle.

Functions/Applications: Flight via functional wings enables aerial mobility and reconnaissance. Enhanced vision allows spotting targets from extreme distances. Sharp talons serve as devastating melee weapons. The user gains the physical attributes of an eagle including strength and agility befitting the form.

Limits: The full extent of the Quirk remains unknown and unpredictable. Extended flight duration is likely limited by fatigue. The transformation may restrict fine manual dexterity due to talons replacing hands. Unable to utilize most human tools or equipment effectively while transformed.

Additional Notes: This Quirk appears to be a straightforward animalistic transformation with combat and mobility applications. Takahiro's specific mastery level and whether partial transformation is possible remain unclear from available information.

cardPool.title: Earphone Jack
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Earphone Jack

Description:
The user possesses elongated, cable-like earlobes that can stretch up to 6 meters and terminate in jack-shaped plugs. These earlobes are prehensile, controllable limbs capable of piercing hard materials and detecting sound across a 12-meter radius, even through thick barriers. The user can channel their heartbeat vibrations through the jacks to damage objects from within.

Functions/Applications:
Reconnaissance and espionage via sound detection through walls and obstacles. Offensive combat by weaponizing heartbeat vibrations as internal damage or directional sound blasts when amplified through external speakers. Utility function as actual headphone cables for listening to audio privately. The earlobes can also function as extra limbs for gripping and manipulating objects.

Limits:
Range extends only 6 meters for stretching and 12 meters for sound detection. Overuse causes ear bleeding and physical fatigue. Loud sound sources can overwhelm the user with sensory overload, causing incapacitation. Multiple simultaneous noise sources can mask target sounds, making detection unreliable. The Quirk factor resides in the ears themselves; losing an ear severely reduces Quirk effectiveness. Sound-based counterattacks of equal or greater volume can neutralize offensive applications.

Additional Notes:
Originally a dual-ear ability, now limited to single-ear operation. A prosthetic jack replacement exists but effectiveness remains uncertain.

cardPool.title: Earth Flow
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Earth Flow

Description:
The user manipulates soil and earth with precise control, molding it into any desired form. This Quirk grants considerable destructive and constructive power, enabling the creation of avalanches, terrain shifts, and detailed earthen structures.

Functions/Applications:
Create animated earth golems ("Earth Beasts") capable of independent combat. Reshape terrain across vast distances for rescue operations in mountainous regions. Construct custom training grounds and obstacles suited to multiple users simultaneously. Trigger geological hazards like avalanches through remote earth manipulation.

Limits:
Ineffective in areas lacking accessible soil or earth; useless on barren stone, metal surfaces, or open water. Range is extensive but finite, limited to manipulable earth within sight or sensory range. Requires sustained concentration; complexity of constructs demands mental effort.

Additional Notes:
Mastery allows earth golems to pass as natural creatures, deceiving observers. Primarily suited for mountain and forest environments. Demonstrates high skill ceiling with expert practitioners achieving remarkable precision and scale.

cardPool.title: Eel
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Eel

Description:
A transformation Quirk that allows the user to shift into a medium-sized eel form. When enhanced by Trigger, the user becomes a massive eel-like creature with intensely slick, mucous-covered skin that deflects physical attacks with ease.

Functions/Applications:
User can transform partially or fully into an eel for aquatic mobility and combat. The enhanced slimy coating acts as a defensive barrier, causing strikes and projectiles to slide harmlessly away. The viscous slime also aids swimming and evasion in water environments.

Limits:
The protective slime can be neutralized by moisture-draining substances such as flour, sand, or similar desiccating materials, leaving the user vulnerable to physical damage. Transformation requires concentration and energy. The Quirk does not provide enhanced strength or offensive capabilities beyond the defensive coating.

Additional Notes:
This Quirk evolved into Electric Eel through external experimentation. The slime layer's effectiveness depends on maintaining moisture; environmental conditions or deliberate counter-measures can render it useless. Best utilized in wet or aquatic settings where the user's form is most effective.

cardPool.title: Elasticity
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Elasticity

Description:
A touch-based Quirk that grants elasticity properties to any object or surface the user contacts, transforming them into bouncy, flexible materials. The user can make floors into trampolines, crane structures into slingshots, and even create invisible elastic barriers in midair. Effects persist for a set duration and cannot be manually deactivated early.

Functions/Applications:
Create springy surfaces for mobility and bouncing movement; launch objects or self across distances; generate aerial platforms for navigation and defense; weaken enemy footing by elasticizing ground; disguise Quirk activation through flamboyant gestures; apply elasticity to personal clothing for protection against pulling or grappling.

Limits:
Effects automatically wear off after a time period with no early deactivation option. Opponents who adapt to the elastic environment can turn it against the user. Requires direct physical contact to activate, though touching invisible air is possible. Overuse risks telegraphing intentions or exhausting the user.

Additional Notes:
Most effective for escape and evasion tactics. User's dramatic fighting style naturally conceals Quirk activation, catching enemies off-guard. Works best against unprepared opponents; skilled fighters who recognize the Quirk's mechanics can exploit its predictability. Combines well with deceptive or misdirecting combat strategies.

cardPool.title: Electric Eel
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Electric Eel

Description:
A mutated evolution of the Eel Quirk, granting the user an eel-like humanoid form with slimy, frictionless skin and the ability to discharge electrical surges. The user retains a permanent eel appearance even when not actively using the Quirk's powers.

Functions/Applications:
Generate and discharge electricity of varying intensities for combat, environmental manipulation, or stunning opponents. The slimy skin provides enhanced mobility and reduced friction in water and on surfaces. Electricity can be concentrated and released as powerful shocks or dispersed more broadly. The Quirk's genetic material can theoretically be transferred to other users, who manifest electricity generation in different ways.

Limits:
Excessive electrical discharge causes the user to lose consciousness, making sustained high-intensity combat dangerous. The permanent eel transformation cannot be reversed and affects social interaction and appearance. Electricity effectiveness is reduced against insulated or grounded opponents. Water environments amplify electrical range but increase risk of uncontrolled discharge.

Additional Notes:
This Quirk represents a forced evolution from captivity rather than natural development, suggesting potential instability or unforeseen side effects. The user's weaknesses remain tied to the original Eel Quirk despite the enhancement.

cardPool.title: Electromagnetic Bullets
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Electromagnetic Bullets

Description:
The user projects an electromagnetic field around thrown objects, accelerating them to high velocities and increasing their destructive impact. The field enhances whatever is thrown—pebbles, coins, or debris—turning ordinary projectiles into potent weapons.

Functions/Applications:
Launch projectiles with devastating force and precision; create rapid-fire barrages by throwing multiple objects in succession; the electromagnetic acceleration makes even small objects dangerous; useful for ranged combat and area denial.

Limits:
Requires objects to throw—cannot generate projectiles from nothing; effectiveness depends on the user's throwing accuracy and arm strength; likely consumes stamina with repeated use; maximum effective range unclear but presumably moderate distance; cannot enhance objects already in flight without initial contact.

Additional Notes:
Best suited for users with good aim and access to environmental ammunition. The Quirk is straightforward but tactical, rewarding clever use of surroundings. Vulnerable at close range where throwing becomes impractical.

cardPool.title: Endurance
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Endurance

Description:
Converts motivation and morale into physical stamina and resilience. The user becomes a tireless, durable combatant whose strength scales with their emotional investment in a goal or loyalty to a person. An "extraordinarily durable body" allows simultaneous use of multiple Quirks without strain or surgical modification.

Functions/Applications:
Enhanced stamina for prolonged combat and physical exertion. Increased durability and resistance to damage when emotionally driven. Ability to wield multiple Quirks simultaneously without bodily degradation. Strength and resilience surge when motivated by loyalty or determination to complete a task.

Limits:
Energy depletes under sustained, repeated attacks without morale reinforcement. User becomes significantly weakened and inactive without a clear command or objective from their loyalty figure. Requires direct orders or motivation to function at full capacity; standby mode renders the user sluggish and vulnerable. Emotional state directly impacts combat effectiveness—loss of motivation causes rapid power decline.

Additional Notes:
This Quirk excels as a defensive ability for loyal bodyguards but falters without psychological reinforcement. The user's greatest strength becomes their greatest weakness: dependency on external motivation and commands makes them unreliable without clear direction or a person to serve.

cardPool.title: Enfeeble
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name: Enfeeble

Description: A paralytic Quirk activated through eye contact that temporarily locks the target's muscles, rendering them immobile for three seconds while maintaining full consciousness. The user can affect multiple targets simultaneously if all maintain visual contact.

Functions/Applications: Disable opponents in combat by freezing them mid-action, create openings for allies to attack, restrain multiple enemies at once, escape dangerous situations by immobilizing pursuers.

Limits: Requires direct eye contact with each target to function; breaks if line of sight is lost. Duration is fixed at three seconds with no extension possible. Targets remain conscious and aware, so they can plan counterattacks. Cannot be used while the user's eyes are obscured or closed.

Additional Notes: Highly effective in one-on-one confrontations but becomes harder to maintain against multiple mobile targets. Works best as a setup for follow-up attacks rather than a standalone ability. Environmental factors blocking vision severely limit combat utility.

cardPool.title: Engine
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Engine

Description:
Engine grants the user mechanical exhaust ports on their body that function like actual engines, enabling extraordinary speed and momentum. The user's limbs gain engine-like protrusions with mufflers that require regular fuel intake to maintain functionality. The Quirk adapts and strengthens when the user endures intense strain, generating more powerful mufflers over time.

Functions/Applications:
Users can dash vast distances at superhuman speed and chase fast-moving targets or escape threats. Tenya's leg engines enable powerful kicks capable of crushing metal and switching between speed gears. Tensei's arm engines allow vertical propulsion, wall-climbing, and hovering. Both can execute Recipro Burst for a devastating speed surge. Mufflers regenerate after removal and improve through rigorous training.

Limits:
Requires specific fuel types (orange juice for Tenya, grapefruit for Tensei); carbonated drinks cause stalling. Without refueling, the Quirk gradually loses power until it fails. Muffler removal is extremely painful. Overheating mufflers beyond safe limits causes explosions and injury. Mufflers clog when blocked by ice or foreign substances, halting speed. Loss of the limbs housing the engines renders the Quirk unusable. Recipro Burst causes mandatory cooldown after use.

Additional Notes:
Engine users must train extensively to maximize leg or arm strength and stamina.

cardPool.title: Erasure
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Erasure

Description:
The user can nullify any target's Quirk Factor by maintaining eye contact with them. The Quirk remains active as long as the user's eyes stay open, affecting multiple targets simultaneously once activated. When deactivated, the user's hair returns to its normal position, signaling a brief cooldown before reactivation is possible.

Functions/Applications:
Disable an opponent's Quirk to force hand-to-hand combat on equal footing. Effective against Quirk-dependent fighters and Transformation-type abilities. Can be combined with binding weapons and enhanced agility for close-quarters restraint. Creates a minor anti-gravity effect around the user's head, useful for equipment manipulation.

Limits:
Requires direct line of sight to the target's physical body; obstacles or illusions block activation. Has no effect on Quirkless individuals or physical enhancements unrelated to Quirks. Mutant-type Quirk appendages remain functional but impaired. Causes severe dry eye syndrome, limiting sustained use without eye drops. Requires a recharge interval between deactivations and new activations, creating openings for counterattack.

Additional Notes:
Vision is essential to this Quirk's function; loss of eyesight severely weakens or eliminates its use. User relies on goggles to conceal which targets are being observed and when blinking occurs. Most effective against opponents with heavy Quirk reliance rather than those trained in pure combat.

cardPool.title: Eruption
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Eruption

Description:
The user metabolizes body fat into superheated lava-like magma and projects it from their body. With proper equipment modifications, the right hand disperses wide-range magma bursts while the left hand focuses energy into concentrated lava lasers.

Functions/Applications:
Ranged magma attacks across varying areas of effect, precise lava laser strikes for targeted damage, area denial through widespread magma dispersal, and sustained offensive pressure through continuous fat conversion.

Limits:
Requires sufficient body fat reserves to fuel the Quirk; prolonged use causes rapid depletion and physical exhaustion. Magma projections are limited by the user's control and equipment modifications. Range and intensity scale with remaining fat stores.

Additional Notes:
Effectiveness diminishes as body fat depletes, making endurance management critical. Specialized suit modifications are necessary to optimize hand-based attack patterns. The Quirk excels in direct combat but becomes unreliable during extended engagements without recovery time.

cardPool.title: Explosion
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Explosion

Description:
The user excretes nitroglycerin-like sweat from their palms and ignites it at will to create devastating explosions of varying sizes. The user is immune to their own blasts except for minor recoil damage. Power scales with sweat production, growing stronger during extended physical activity and in warm conditions.

Functions/Applications:
Create fiery shockwaves that burn and shatter targets; propel self through air for mobility; blind opponents with flash; launch long-range blasts; fire multiple condensed explosions simultaneously after Quirk Awakening. Naturally counters darkness-based abilities.

Limits:
Cold weather slows detonation time. Dual-palm simultaneous use disperses overall strength into weaker individual blasts. Repeated large explosions cause throbbing arm and shoulder pain. Loss of palms renders Quirk unusable. Indiscriminate use causes excessive collateral damage. Requires conscious ignition effort.

Additional Notes:
User typically employs all-out offensive strategy, closing distance before unleashing close-range bombardments. Grenadier bracers reduce physical strain from overuse. Versatile for creative combat applications when paired with tactical intelligence. User's psychological pride in this Quirk historically led to arrogance but has tempered over time.

cardPool.title: Extend-o-Hair
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Extend-o-Hair

Description:
The user manipulates their hair's growth and movement with precision control. Their hair is unnaturally resilient and indestructible, unable to be damaged or cut. The user can extend hair rapidly to form protective armor, grapple multiple enemies simultaneously, or create barriers of woven strands.

Functions/Applications:
Deploy hair as offensive whips or restraints to incapacitate foes. Form full-body armor plating for defense. Create nets or cages to trap large groups. Establish barriers or shields during combat. Use hair as mobility aids or sensory extensions.

Limits:
Hair becomes easily tangled, restricting movement and requiring time to untangle. Extended hair requires concentration to control; distraction weakens precision. Tangled hair significantly reduces combat effectiveness. Range diminishes with distance—hair loses responsive control beyond 30 feet.

Additional Notes:
User typically maintains an unusually hairy appearance; unclear if this reflects constant Quirk activation or natural biology. Quirk excels in group combat and defense but falters when mobility is compromised by tangling. Best suited for users with patience and tactical thinking.

cardPool.title: Extra Arms
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Extra Arms

Description:
A mutation-type Quirk that grants the user an additional set of functional arms, doubling their limb count to four total. All arms possess equal strength and dexterity.

Functions/Applications:
The user can perform multiple actions simultaneously—wielding dual weapons, grappling while striking, or manipulating objects independently. Provides enhanced climbing, melee combat versatility, and the ability to execute complex physical tasks that require more than two limbs.

Limits:
The extra arms do not grant superhuman strength; their power matches the user's baseline physical capability. Coordination requires conscious effort initially, and the user may suffer from diminished reflexes if attempting too many simultaneous actions. Armor and clothing must be specially fitted; standard gear cannot accommodate the extra limbs.

Additional Notes:
This Quirk excels in close-quarters combat and grappling scenarios but offers no ranged advantage. Users with martial training gain the most benefit from the enhanced mobility and tactical positioning available through four-limb operation.

cardPool.title: Fan
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Fan

Description:
A wind-generation quirk activated by rapidly spinning the user's wrists. The user can produce localized gusts or devastating tornadoes depending on rotation speed and intensity. Wind scales from gentle breeze to destructive cyclone force.

Functions/Applications:
Create directional wind attacks to knock back or disorient opponents. Generate tornadoes for area-of-effect damage or environmental manipulation. Use wind to deflect projectiles, create barriers, or assist with movement and mobility.

Limits:
Maximum continuous use of one minute before risking tenosynovitis (tendon inflammation). Overuse causes severe wrist pain and potential long-term joint damage. Cannot generate wind without active wrist rotation; immobilized wrists nullify the quirk.

Additional Notes:
Highly effective at range and against multiple opponents, but requires strategic timing due to strict time constraints. Users must manage fatigue carefully to avoid debilitating injury that could end combat effectiveness permanently.

cardPool.title: Fat Absorption
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Fat Absorption

Description:
The user can adhere objects and living beings to their body upon contact, causing them to sink into their accumulated body fat. This grants exceptional physical protection against blades, bullets, and conventional attacks. Maintaining this Quirk requires constant high body mass through regular consumption of large quantities of food.

Functions/Applications:
Absorbs impact force from enemy attacks and can release it in a single devastating counterattack punch. Restrains opponents by enveloping them with the user's large frame. Acts as a mobile shield, protecting allies from incoming damage while absorbing the brunt of attacks meant for others.

Limits:
Requires substantial body fat to function; a slim build renders the Quirk ineffective. Counterattack technique burns significant fat reserves, leaving the user vulnerable and nearly defenseless if it fails to defeat the opponent. Recovery of lost body mass takes three days. Quirks that consume flesh or fat rapidly deplete the user's mass and disable the ability mid-combat.

Additional Notes:
Best suited for defensive roles and restraint operations. Users must adopt a disciplined eating regimen to maintain operational capacity. Physical speed and agility may be compromised due to large body mass, making this Quirk dependent on positioning and anticipation rather than evasion.

cardPool.title: Fierce Gains
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Fierce Gains

Description:
The user's muscles harden to exceptional toughness on command, creating an almost impenetrable defensive state. When activated, muscular tissue becomes dense and rock-like, dramatically increasing physical durability against piercing and slashing attacks.

Functions/Applications:
Hardens muscles to deflect or absorb damage from weapons and impacts. Can be layered with other defensive abilities or body modifications for exponential protection. Allows the user to withstand attacks that would normally pierce or cut through flesh.

Limits:
Requires conscious activation and cannot protect against blunt force trauma equally well. Hardened muscles still conduct kinetic energy, so crushing impacts transfer damage internally. Cannot be maintained indefinitely without exhaustion. Works only on the user's own musculature.

Additional Notes:
Most effective when combined with high pain tolerance or insensitivity, as the user can take damage without flinching. Works best on users with naturally large muscle mass. Does not enhance strength or speed, only defensive capability.

cardPool.title: Fierce Wings
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Fierce Wings

Description:
A pair of large, crimson wings composed of dozens of individually controllable feathers. The user can detach feathers at will and maintain telepathic connection with each one. Feathers vary in size, strength, and sharpness, functioning as both tools and weapons. The wings grant extraordinary flight speed and enhanced sensory perception through vibration detection.

Functions/Applications:
Flight at superhuman velocities; precision aerial combat and evasion. Detached feathers can carry objects or people, act as cutting weapons, or serve as remote sensors expanding the user's awareness over wide areas. Feathers can be reattached if intact. Regeneration occurs within two days for destroyed feathers. Supports allies by lending wing strength or enhancing their mobility.

Limits:
Fire severely damages feathers, crippling flight capability. Excessive feather detachment progressively worsens flying ability and maneuverability. Wings require extended healing time after major damage. Quirk does not enhance overall physical strength—user relies on speed and technique. Damaged feathers cannot be instantly restored. If wings are severely burned, flight capacity may be permanently reduced.

Additional Notes:
Best utilized by speed-focused fighters with tactical awareness. User must strategically manage feather expenditure to maintain mobility. Works exceptionally well in support roles, enhancing stronger allies' combat effectiveness.

cardPool.title: Fire Cracker
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Fire Cracker

Description:
The user can detach chunks of their hair and detonate them as explosive projectiles. These blasts are destructive enough to demolish structures, though significantly weaker than similar explosion-based quirks. The user can also harness the explosions for limited propulsion and mobility.

Functions/Applications:
Hair chunks serve as ranged explosive weapons for combat and environmental destruction. Secondary application allows using detonations to boost movement speed and distance, enabling rapid repositioning or escape. Effective for area denial and creating chaos in confined spaces.

Limits:
Explosions are notably weaker than comparable quirks, limiting raw destructive power. Hair regeneration appears necessary for sustained use, suggesting finite ammunition per encounter. Propulsion capability is inferior to specialized movement quirks, making it unreliable as primary mobility. Close-range detonation poses risk to user if not carefully timed.

Additional Notes:
Quirk is most effective at medium range. User requires tactical placement rather than overwhelming force. Hair-based mechanics suggest vulnerability to abilities targeting hair or head. Works best in combination with other strategies rather than as standalone combat solution.

cardPool.title: Flash Bang Sweat
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Flash Bang Sweat

Description:
The user secretes a volatile substance through their sweat that detonates with brilliant light and thunderous sound upon impact. The substance can be collected and weaponized through specialized equipment, making it versatile for both offensive and supportive applications.

Functions/Applications:
Launch explosive sweat projectiles via costume-mounted missile systems for area denial and crowd control. Create blinding flashes and deafening concussive bursts to disorient enemies or signal allies across vast distances. Deploy wide-pattern salvos to cover large areas simultaneously.

Limits:
The Quirk produces no direct physical harm or injury—only sensory disruption through light and sound. Effectiveness heavily reduced against enemies with sound/light resistance or sensory protection. Requires specialized gear to deploy effectively; the user cannot weaponize sweat without equipment. Continuous sweating may cause dehydration or exhaustion with prolonged use.

Additional Notes:
The constant perspiration may be an inherent trait of the Quirk or an unrelated condition. The Quirk's true potential lies in tactical applications rather than direct combat damage. Romero Fujimi noted the ability lacks lethal stopping power, limiting its value in life-threatening situations.

cardPool.title: Flight
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Flight

Description:
The user levitates and flies at high speeds while projecting an aerodynamic barrier around themselves and anything they touch. This barrier protects from heat, cold, and physical harm. The user can selectively control which targets receive protection and how much coverage each receives.

Functions/Applications:
The user can carry massive objects or multiple people while flying, gaining superhuman strength proportional to the barrier's focus. The barrier scales with concentration—full focus on self grants maximum protection and strength, while dispersing it across allies weakens personal defenses. Ideal for rescue operations, transport missions, and aerial combat when maintaining self-protection.

Limits:
The primary weakness is inverse scaling: protecting others reduces the user's own barrier strength and durability. Spreading protection too thin leaves the user vulnerable. Flight speed and carrying capacity depend on barrier concentration. The user cannot fly without maintaining the barrier, making them immobile if exhausted.

Additional Notes:
This Quirk grants both mobility and utility, making it valuable for team-based scenarios. However, the protection trade-off creates tactical decisions—the user must balance heroism against self-preservation. Variants exist in other species that simply manifest as wings without the barrier properties.

cardPool.title: Float
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Float

Description:
Float grants the user the ability to levitate and suspend themselves in mid-air indefinitely. When amplified by stored energy from a powerful source, it transforms into high-speed flight, enabling aerial combat and rapid transportation across distances.

Functions/Applications:
The user can hover stationary or move through the air at controlled speeds. Enhanced versions enable sustained flight at considerable velocity, allowing pursuit of airborne opponents and evasion of ground-based threats. Can be combined with other movement-based abilities to achieve greater speeds or perform aerial maneuvers.

Limits:
Requires active concentration to maintain levitation; user cannot fly faster than their physical conditioning allows without external enhancement. Cannot lift others through the air without additional Quirks. The Quirk provides no defensive properties and leaves the user vulnerable while airborne. Sustained high-speed flight drains stamina over extended use.

Additional Notes:
Float is a foundational mobility Quirk best suited for hit-and-run tactics, positioning in combat, and transportation. Its true power emerges only when paired with energy amplification or complementary Quirks. Users must develop aerial awareness and combat techniques distinct from ground-based fighting.

cardPool.title: Fly Swatter
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Fly Swatter

Description:
The user generates kinetic energy waves by rapidly swinging their arms, projecting force at distant targets as if struck directly. The waves travel several meters but maintain the power equivalent to a standard melee strike at close range.

Functions/Applications:
Rapid arm swings can be performed multiple times in succession to create multiple projectile waves. Useful for striking enemies beyond normal reach, striking multiple targets, or creating distance between the user and threats.

Limits:
Energy waves only travel a few meters before dissipating. Force output cannot exceed what a normal person could generate through direct physical contact. Requires visible arm movement to activate—cannot be used while restrained or immobilized. Repeated rapid swings risk fatigue.

Additional Notes:
The quirk is relatively straightforward and non-combative in origin, making it suitable for everyday utility. Its true range ceiling remains untested. Works best in open spaces where arm movement is unrestricted.

cardPool.title: Flying Squirrel
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Flying Squirrel

Description:
The user develops wing-like membranes of skin stretched between their arms and body, allowing them to glide through the air like a flying squirrel. These films enable sustained flight and aerial maneuverability, granting exceptional mobility in combat and reconnaissance.

Functions/Applications:
Gliding and sustained flight for transportation and tactical repositioning. Can carry one additional person during flight. Useful for infiltration, reconnaissance, and providing aerial support to allies in battle.

Limits:
Cannot achieve true powered flight—only gliding and short bursts of altitude gain. Weight capacity limited to one passenger plus the user's own body weight. Requires open space to maneuver effectively; cramped environments severely restrict mobility. Sustained flight causes fatigue.

Additional Notes:
Best utilized as a support ability for allies rather than direct combat. The user's combat effectiveness depends on partner synergy. Ideal for hit-and-run tactics and quick escapes from dangerous situations.

cardPool.title: Foldabody
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Foldabody

Description:
Foldabody grants the user the ability to manipulate their body's thickness and stretch their limbs into paper-thin forms. The user can flatten, fold, and reshape their entire body or individual sections at will, transforming into blades, drills, or threads while maintaining consciousness and control.

Functions/Applications:
The user can slip through narrow spaces undetected, transform body parts into piercing weapons that strike faster than sound, and strike vital points to incapacitate enemies instantly by cutting blood flow to the brain. Mid-air combat is possible by twisting the body into drill-like shapes for mobility. The Quirk allows body regeneration, though slowly.

Limits:
Extreme thinning gradually shortens the user's lifespan and causes progressive physical deterioration. The ultimate technique (reducing to thread-size) causes severe weakness, unconsciousness, and requires extended medical recovery. Overuse leaves the user in critical condition. Regeneration is slow, taking years to fully restore damaged body parts.

Additional Notes:
Mastery allows transformation at supersonic speeds. The user maintains a ninja combat style, exploiting speed and precision strikes. Even in severely weakened states, the user retains tiny functional forms with regenerative capacity, though at drastically reduced size and capability.

cardPool.title: Food
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Food

Description:
The user can bite, chew, and digest virtually any physical material they come into direct contact with, from metal to stone to wood. Their jaw possesses supernatural strength and their digestive system processes consumed matter without filling them, creating a seemingly bottomless appetite.

Functions/Applications:
Consume and destroy barriers, walls, or obstacles in the user's path. Break through locked doors or restraints by eating through them. Neutralize thrown projectiles or incoming attacks by eating them. Consume enemy equipment or weapons to disarm opponents.

Limits:
The user must be within biting range to activate the Quirk, making them vulnerable to ranged attackers. Toxic or poisonous substances still cause illness if consumed, negating the Quirk's protection. The user cannot digest intangible things, magical constructs, or purely magical attacks. Extremely hard materials may require extended time to chew through.

Additional Notes:
The Quirk's main tactical weakness is its close-range requirement, forcing the user into dangerous proximity with enemies. Best used defensively for obstacle removal or as a last resort for disarming. The "bottomless" nature means no satiation, which could create psychological complications in extended campaigns.

cardPool.title: Forced Quirk Activation
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Forced Quirk Activation

Description:
A control-based quirk that forcibly triggers another person's quirk against their will, bypassing any mental resistance or physical incapacity. The activation works regardless of the target's consciousness or consent, making it devastatingly effective for tactical manipulation.

Functions/Applications:
Activate allied quirks remotely without waiting for cooperation; trigger enemy quirks to exhaust them or create unintended consequences; self-activate additional quirks even while paralyzed or incapacitated; combine with physical contact abilities like Rivet Stab to ensure targeting precision.

Limits:
Requires knowledge of what quirk the target possesses to use effectively; most effective with direct physical contact; cannot create new quirks or modify existing ones, only force activation; drains stamina with each use; useless on those with no quirks; does not guarantee the activated quirk will do what the user intends.

Additional Notes:
Best utilized by quirk collectors or multi-quirk users. Works on willing allies and unwilling enemies with equal effectiveness. Particularly dangerous in combination with other quirks that facilitate contact or control.

cardPool.title: Foresight
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Foresight

Description:
A prediction Quirk that grants the user the ability to accurately perceive a target's future actions and movements for up to one hour after activation. The user witnesses events from a third-person perspective similar to viewing a flashback, including the target and their immediate surroundings. Activation requires physical touch followed by eye contact with the target.

Functions/Applications:
Combat evasion becomes near-perfect when eye contact is maintained, as the user can predict every move an opponent makes. Investigative work benefits greatly, as witnessing a target's future actions reveals extensive information about their plans, locations, and associates. The Quirk can perceive events years into the future, though dating such distant events requires rough estimation with some margin of error.

Limits:
A 24-hour cooldown period must pass before reactivating on any target. Breaking eye contact immediately halts further prediction. The Quirk is purely visual—the user cannot hear dialogue or interpret actions lacking visual context, creating blind spots in understanding. The future shown cannot be changed through normal means, though strong collective will or determination may alter outcomes. Activation conditions must be met precisely: touch and eye contact both required.

Additional Notes:
Users tend toward fatalistic thinking, believing foreseen outcomes are inevitable.

cardPool.title: Free Walker
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Free Walker

Description:
A mobility-based Quirk that grants the user's legs exceptional freedom of movement and resistance to fatigue. The user can move their legs with unprecedented speed, agility, and endurance without experiencing typical muscular exhaustion.

Functions/Applications:
Enhanced sprinting and sustained running at peak performance, rapid directional changes without losing momentum, extended physical activity without leg fatigue, superior footwork in combat or traversal situations.

Limits:
Unknown upper speed threshold; fatigue may still affect other body parts; prolonged use duration unclear; does not grant strength enhancement or jumping ability beyond normal limits; the Quirk appears to affect only the legs.

Additional Notes:
The exact mechanics and full extent of Free Walker remain largely undocumented. It is primarily a movement and endurance-focused ability rather than offensive or defensive in nature. Best suited for pursuits, escapes, and sustained physical exertion.

cardPool.title: Frog
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Frog

Description:
Tsuyu possesses the collective abilities of all frog species, granting her frog-like anatomy, enhanced leg strength, wall-clinging grip, and an extensible tongue. She can camouflage, swim rapidly, secrete paralytic or scent-hiding mucus, and regurgitate with precision. Her body functions as a cold-blooded creature, making her exceptionally agile in aquatic environments while maintaining terrestrial acrobatics through hopping and climbing.

Functions/Applications:
Tsuyu excels in water-based combat and rescue operations, moving with full strength and agility underwater. Her extendable tongue serves as a grappling tool, whip, or rescue line capable of carrying and launching people. She can hop to extreme heights, cling to vertical surfaces, camouflage for stealth, and deploy paralytic secretions defensively. Mucus production masks her scent, aiding evasion and reconnaissance.

Limits:
Cold exposure severely weakens her Quirk and induces lethargy; prolonged cold triggers hibernation, rendering her completely immobilized until warmed. High temperatures and fire threaten to dehydrate her aquatic biology, causing vulnerability despite her otherwise resilient nature. Her cold-blooded physiology ties her strength directly to ambient temperature conditions.

Additional Notes:
Tsuyu trained extensively to build tongue and full-body musculature through rock-climbing techniques, suggesting her abilities scale with physical conditioning.

cardPool.title: Frost
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Frost

Description:
The user generates and manipulates ice, coating their body in frozen armor and projecting ice blasts outward. This Quirk provides natural resistance to cold and freezing temperatures, making the user difficult to harm with ice-based attacks.

Functions/Applications:
Create protective ice armor around the body; launch ice projectiles or waves; lower ambient temperature in a localized area; shield allies from heat or fire by absorbing thermal energy; sustain defensive positions against overwhelming force through ice barriers.

Limits:
Prolonged use causes frostbite and rapid body temperature drops, potentially leading to hypothermia and incapacitation. Extended combat drains stamina quickly. Users with insufficient fire resistance (if exposed to Hellflame-level heat) risk severe burns while attempting to use the Quirk defensively.

Additional Notes:
Most effective in defensive or support roles rather than sustained offense. Works best when combined with other Quirks or used cooperatively with allies. The Quirk's true strength emerges when protecting others rather than attacking independently.

cardPool.title: Gale Gale
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Gale Gale

Description:
The user manipulates wind currents around their body, creating powerful whirling vortexes that enable flight and act as a protective barrier. The swirling winds are strong enough to deflect incoming attacks and projectiles with ease.

Functions/Applications:
Flight through sustained wind manipulation, deflection of physical and ranged attacks, creating offensive wind blasts, enhanced mobility in combat. The user can maintain a defensive wind shell while moving freely through the air.

Limits:
The user's head remains completely exposed and unprotected by the wind barrier, creating a critical vulnerability. Maintaining the Quirk requires constant concentration; disruption or exhaustion weakens the wind shield. The Quirk consumes stamina proportional to flight duration and intensity of wind deflection.

Additional Notes:
Despite appearing non-threatening in appearance, the Gale Gale Quirk is deceptively powerful due to its defensive properties. Opponents must exploit the head vulnerability through elevated angles or coordinated attacks to overcome the wind shield's protection.

cardPool.title: Gas
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Gas

Description:
The user generates a massive, swirling cloud of purple, sleep-inducing poison gas from their body. Anyone inhaling it falls unconscious immediately until treated. The gas forms a typhoon centered on the user, with highest concentration near them and weakening at the edges. The user can sense the presence and movement of creatures within the gas through its fluctuations.

Functions/Applications:
Crowd control and area denial—ideal for trapping enemies and blocking escape routes across vast territories like forests.
