Detection of movement within the gas cloud allows the user to track targets without direct sight. Best used as support during ambushes rather than direct combat, keeping the user at distance from threats.

Limits:
Anyone wearing a gas mask or breathing apparatus is immune to the gas entirely. The gas cannot be manipulated beyond its natural flow, making it useless for precision attacks. Lighter gas concentrations are less effective. Wind or physical force easily disperses the gas, reducing detection ability. The user is not immune and will fall unconscious if exposed, forcing them to wear a gas mask. If the user loses consciousness, the gas immediately dissipates. Range is limited despite its area effect.

Additional Notes:
The user must remain vigilant against masked opponents and typically carries a handgun as backup. Success depends on maintaining distance and reading gas movements rather than close-quarters engagement.

cardPool.title: Gatling
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Gatling

Description:
The user's arms transform into gun-like biological organs capable of rapid-fire projectile attacks. These organs generate and launch claw-like projectiles composed of keratin, functioning as a natural ranged weapon system integrated into the user's body.

Functions/Applications:
Fire keratin claws in rapid bursts for suppressive fire and area control. Effective in close-quarters combat for forcing opponents back or creating distance. Projectiles can penetrate soft targets and deter multiple enemies simultaneously through sheer volume of fire.

Limits:
Keratin projectiles have limited range and stopping power compared to actual firearms. Sustained firing depletes the user's keratin reserves, requiring recovery time. The gun-like organs cannot be concealed and announce the user's combat capabilities immediately.

Additional Notes:
Best utilized as a defensive tool rather than an offensive finisher. Works synergistically with hand-to-hand combat techniques to maintain pressure. Keratin regeneration rate determines how long the user can sustain continuous fire.

cardPool.title: Gecko
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Gecko

Description:
Grants the user a reptilian appearance and the ability to cling to walls and other sheer surfaces with exceptional adhesive power. The user can remain attached even to fast-moving vehicles.

Functions/Applications:
Scaling vertical surfaces in urban environments, evading pursuers through vertical movement, reconnaissance from elevated positions, clinging to moving targets. Most effective in built-up areas with abundant walls and structures.

Limits:
Severely limited outside urban environments where suitable surfaces are scarce. Considered a weak Quirk even among reptilian families. Cannot function effectively on rough terrain, natural rock faces, or open areas. Adhesion requires intact surfaces—worn or damaged walls reduce effectiveness.

Additional Notes:
Best utilized as a mobility and evasion tool in cities rather than direct combat. Users should develop strategies for non-urban scenarios where the Quirk's natural advantages diminish significantly.

cardPool.title: Gigantification
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Gigantification

Description:
The user drastically increases their body size to colossal proportions, gaining immense mass and strength. Different users experience varying limits and control—some grow to fixed maximum heights, others can adjust size fluidly. The transformation grants devastating physical power but demands substantial space to function effectively.

Functions/Applications:
Enables overpowering larger opponents through size-matched combat, destroying structures and obstacles with ease, intimidating enemies through sheer presence, and serving as mobile transportation. Some variants allow blob-like transformation with stretching capabilities or creation of smaller clones for reconnaissance and tactical advantage.

Limits:
Most users cannot assume intermediate sizes between normal and maximum form, requiring full commitment to transformation. The Quirk demands open spaces—enclosed areas severely hamper mobility and combat effectiveness. Some variants force automatic shrinkage after prolonged activation. Emotional instability (anger, frustration) may trigger uncontrolled transformation. Maximum size varies by user: standard limit ~67 feet, but some users exceed 82 feet or possess lower thresholds with mandatory time restrictions.

Additional Notes:
Exceptionally effective against giant-class villains and in urban combat where space permits. However, the Quirk's recklessness often causes substantial collateral damage and property destruction.

cardPool.title: Glamour
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Glamour

Description:
The user emits a mist-like substance from their mouth that materializes into vivid visual and auditory illusions. These illusions can be large enough to fill entire rooms and are designed to deceive, distract, or misdirect opponents and allies alike.

Functions/Applications:
Create convincing illusions of people, monsters, or environments to confuse enemies in combat. Use illusions as decoys to protect allies from incoming attacks. Craft illusions based on real individuals by studying their appearance and personality traits. Illusions can range from charming and appealing (shojo manga-style) to horrifying and grotesque depending on intent.

Limits:
Illusions are temporary and eventually dissipate on their own; duration appears short and involuntary dissipation timing is unreliable. Illusions cannot cause physical damage—they only deceive the senses. The user must expel mist from their mouth, creating a visible casting action. Large-scale illusions require more effort and cannot be maintained indefinitely. Illusions may fail against opponents with heightened awareness or sensory resistance.

Additional Notes:
The Quirk's effectiveness relies heavily on the user's creativity and knowledge of what they're mimicking. Training involves studying others to improve illusion quality and versatility. Best used in supportive roles or tactical situations rather than direct combat engagement.

cardPool.title: Glide and Slide
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Glide and Slide

Description:
A movement-based Quirk that allows users to glide across surfaces as if wearing roller skates. By making skating-like gestures, users build momentum and achieve enhanced speed far beyond normal human capability. Only one foot needs contact with the ground to maintain the effect.

Functions/Applications:
Rapid pursuit and evasion across flat or sloped terrain. Users can accelerate quickly through momentum-building gestures and maintain high-speed travel with minimal physical exertion. Effective for covering ground quickly during combat or escape scenarios.

Limits:
Top speed is unknown but demonstrably slower than comparable Quirks like Slide and Glide. Requires at least one foot maintaining contact with a surface—cannot function in mid-air or on unstable terrain. Momentum must be actively maintained through skating gestures; sudden stops may be difficult.

Additional Notes:
This Quirk favors hit-and-run tactics and mobility-focused strategies rather than direct combat power. Multiple users can coordinate movement for group pursuits. Effectiveness varies based on surface quality and available space for momentum building.

cardPool.title: Glycerin
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name: Glycerin

Description: A secretion-type Quirk that allows the user to produce a smooth, oily liquid from their skin. The glycerin possesses powerful moisturizing properties that maintain youthful appearance and skin health regardless of age. When genetically combined with an Explosion-type Quirk, it produces offspring with volatile sweat-based abilities.

Functions/Applications: Create slippery surfaces for evasion or mobility; maintain physical conditioning and appearance; potentially use secretions for lubrication or non-combat utility; enhance durability through skin conditioning.

Limits: The Quirk is primarily cosmetic and defensive rather than offensive. Glycerin production is limited to natural skin secretion rates and cannot be weaponized into projectiles. Effectiveness diminishes in extremely dry environments. Overuse causes skin dehydration and fatigue.

Additional Notes: This Quirk demonstrates genetic combination potential with explosive abilities, suggesting compatibility with volatile Quirks. Best suited for support roles, infiltration, or defensive strategies rather than direct combat. The user's youthful appearance may create tactical advantages through misdirection.

cardPool.title: Good Ear
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name: Good Ear

Description: A sensory enhancement Quirk that grants the user the ability to perceive and process ultrasonic frequencies far beyond normal human hearing range. The user can detect vibrations and sounds in the high-frequency spectrum, allowing them to gather information invisible to standard hearing.

Functions/Applications: Long-distance communication with compatible allies through high-frequency signals, crowd assessment by detecting the distinct acoustic signatures of multiple individuals, surveillance of areas through sound analysis, and potential echolocation-like environmental mapping through frequency feedback.

Limits: Only functions with sound-based information; useless in complete silence or against sound-dampening effects. Long-distance communication requires a recipient capable of producing compatible frequencies. Cannot hear standard human speech as clearly without concentration. Overexposure to high frequencies causes disorientation or discomfort.

Additional Notes: Best utilized in team settings with coordinated partners. Effectiveness increases with the user's familiarity with specific sound patterns. Environmental noise pollution can interfere with precision detection at range.

cardPool.title: Grasshopper
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Grasshopper

Description:
A transformation Quirk that allows the user to morph into a large humanoid grasshopper form, dramatically enhancing physical prowess. The Hotta Brothers typically activate this ability through Trigger injections, though the Quirk's baseline capabilities remain largely unexplored.

Functions/Applications:
Grants massive increases to strength, agility, and jumping height in grasshopper form. Users can perform powerful synchronized combo attacks when coordinated. Primary application is close-quarters combat with enhanced mobility and striking force.

Limits:
True natural limitations are unknown due to reliance on Trigger enhancement. The Quirk's independent functionality without external stimulants has never been properly tested. Transformation appears to require preparation or chemical activation rather than instantaneous deployment.

Additional Notes:
Most effective when two users coordinate their attacks. The Trigger-dependent usage suggests potential dependency issues or that the Quirk may have been artificially modified or suppressed. Full potential awaits discovery without chemical enhancement.

cardPool.title: Gyrate
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Gyrate

Description:
Sen Kaibara's Quirk allows him to rotate any part of his body at extreme speeds, transforming his limbs into spinning drill-like weapons. Combined with his spiral-patterned finger gloves, his strikes become devastating cutting and piercing attacks capable of grinding through defenses.

Functions/Applications:
Enhanced close-range melee combat with rotating limbs that drill and cut through armor and flesh. His gloved hands amplify offensive damage significantly, making physical blocking against his attacks ineffective. Gyrate excels at offense through rapid rotational strikes and can maintain combat effectiveness even when grappled or restrained.

Limits:
Gyrate is purely a close-range Quirk with no long-distance applications. While the user can fight back when grappled, the Quirk cannot prevent being grabbed or carried, limiting mobility options. Effectiveness relies heavily on the spiral gloves for maximum damage output.

Additional Notes:
Sen's Quirk transforms hand-to-hand combat into a dangerous engagement zone where rotation speed and angular momentum become lethal. The gloves are essential equipment rather than mere accessories, functioning as force multipliers that activate the Quirk's true potential.

cardPool.title: Hair Control
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Hair Control

Description:
A Quirk allowing manipulation of one's own hair with precision and force. The user can harden, extend, and weaponize their hair strands for offensive and defensive purposes. The extent of control and application varies based on hair length, density, and the user's training.

Functions/Applications:
Hair can be fired as projectiles with bullet-like velocity and impact. Hair can be shaped into solid weapons like whips, blades, or bludgeons for melee combat. Hair serves as an extension of the user's body for grappling, binding, or striking enemies from range.

Limits:
Control is restricted to the user's own hair only; cannot manipulate others' hair. Hardened hair remains vulnerable to sharp cuts and fire-based attacks. Extended hair strands deplete stamina with prolonged use. Hair growth rate limits how much material is available for sustained combat. Users with short or thin hair have significantly reduced offensive potential.

Additional Notes:
Effectiveness scales with hair length and density; longer-haired users possess tactical advantages. Training determines precision and speed of hair manipulation. Hair-based attacks leave the user's head exposed if overextended. Works best in close-to-mid range combat scenarios.

cardPool.title: Hair-Raiser
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Hair-Raiser

Description:
The user can extend, harden, and detach hair strands from their scalp at will. These strands become malleable weapons or tools that can be shaped and manipulated during combat or utility tasks.

Functions/Applications:
Hair strands can be hardened into spears, whips, or cutting implements for offense. They can serve as grappling hooks, restraints, or construction tools. The user maintains control over detached strands, allowing dynamic repositioning mid-combat.

Limits:
Effectiveness diminishes as hair is depleted—excessive use leaves the user bald and vulnerable. Hardened hair can be cut or broken by sufficiently sharp or strong forces. The user cannot regrow hair faster than normal human growth, creating a finite resource pool per engagement.

Additional Notes:
Best suited for creative, adaptable fighters who think tactically. Hair-Raiser rewards resourcefulness but punishes wasteful combat approaches. The Quirk's versatility makes it valuable for both combat and non-combat scenarios.

cardPool.title: Hardening
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Hardening

Description:
The user hardens any part or all of their body into rock-like material, transforming skin into an impenetrable, jagged surface. This grants extreme durability against physical trauma and increases offensive striking power through rough, cutting edges.

Functions/Applications:
Provides near-total defense against bullets, blades, and blunt force trauma. Offensive applications include devastating close-range strikes and grazing cuts from hardened skin. Can serve as a human shield for allies. Hardness improves with repeated damage taken while activated, making the user progressively stronger through combat experience.

Limits:
Requires close-range combat; no long-distance capability. Cannot protect against extreme temperatures or thermal attacks, though the user may endure high heat without burning. Stamina depletes when maintaining hardness under sustained damage. Hardened form slowly dissipates under extreme pressure and must be reactivated. Eyes remain vulnerable if entire body is hardened. Effect weakens under psychological stress like fear or pain.

Additional Notes:
Maximum hardness state ("Unbreakable") provides temporary near-invulnerability but demands significant stamina. Manifests early in life but requires intense training to reach peak effectiveness. Dangerous in rescue situations due to rough texture causing accidental injury to civilians. Comparable to Steel-type Quirks but distinctly adaptive through damage accumulation.

cardPool.title: Hardflame Fan
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Hardflame Fan

Description:
The user generates walls or layers of solidified fire that can be positioned across their body for defensive protection. The fire appears as a shiny, viscous liquid that hardens into barriers. Heat exceeding the Quirk's own temperature can penetrate these defenses.

Functions/Applications:
Deploy layered fire walls to shield against physical and thermal attacks. Position barriers around vulnerable body parts or across limbs. Create multiple defensive layers for increased protection. The hardened fire can absorb moderate-level heat-based strikes.

Limits:
Fire hotter than the user's own generated flames passes through unimpeded. Cannot be used for offensive attacks—purely defensive in nature. Requires continuous focus to maintain the barriers; dissipates if concentration breaks. Each additional layer drains stamina progressively. Users with significantly higher heat output (like high-tier fire Quirks) bypass this defense entirely.

Additional Notes:
This is a stolen Quirk, suggesting the original user was relatively unknown or weaker. Best used defensively as part of a layered tactical approach rather than as primary protection. Most effective against opponents with moderate fire power or physical attackers.

cardPool.title: Heal
keys:
(empty result)

"Heal" is a common English verb and should be removed according to the instruction to remove common words.
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Heal

Description:
The user accelerates and amplifies a target's natural healing process by kissing them. Injuries that would normally take months to heal can be fully restored in seconds. The user maintains fine control over healing intensity to manage stamina drain.

Functions/Applications:
Rapidly mend wounds, broken bones, and internal injuries. Heal severe trauma in multiple sessions rather than one. Works best when combined with conventional surgery for life-threatening conditions. User can selectively refuse to heal certain injuries for disciplinary or medical reasons.

Limits:
Healing consumes the receiver's stamina; severe healing can cause complete exhaustion or death if they lack sufficient stamina reserves. Cannot regrow lost limbs or body parts. Cannot fully heal extremely severe injuries or permanent scarring from overexertion. Requires the receiver to be alive and capable of healing naturally. Most dangerous injuries need surgical intervention before Heal can be safely applied.

Additional Notes:
The user must be in close physical proximity and willing contact to activate the Quirk. Repeated overuse of One For All or similar self-damaging Quirks may result in refusal to heal. User's medical knowledge and surgical skill are vital to the Quirk's effectiveness in critical situations. Stamina depletion is the primary risk factor—not the healing itself.

cardPool.title: Heavy Payload
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Heavy Payload

Description:
A stolen Quirk that amplifies the destructive force of the user's attacks. When combined with other offensive Quirks, Heavy Payload exponentially increases damage output, making it a powerful multiplier for energy-based or kinetic attacks.

Functions/Applications:
Heavy Payload enhances the user's striking power and can be layered with complementary Quirks like Air Cannon or Radio Waves to create devastating combination attacks. A single beam boosted by Heavy Payload can rival the destructive capacity of multiple stacked combat Quirks used by master strategists.

Limits:
The Quirk provides no defensive capabilities and requires synergy with other offensive abilities to reach maximum potential. Its power scales with the base strength of the paired Quirk—weak attacks gain modest boosts while already powerful techniques become catastrophic. Solo use offers minimal advantage over raw physical force.

Additional Notes:
Heavy Payload is most effective when combined with ranged or energy-projection Quirks rather than melee combat. The Quirk's true strength emerges in coordinated multi-Quirk strategies, making it a tactical asset rather than a standalone power.

cardPool.title: Helical Scythe
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Helical Scythe

Description:
The user manifests large, crimson appendages resembling scythe-like tendrils on their fingers and head. These extensions can grow, contract, and rotate at high speeds, granting exceptional reach and piercing power capable of cutting through solid ice.

Functions/Applications:
Tendrils function as independent grappling tools for ensnaring or striking distant targets. The user can rotate appendages to manipulate environmental elements—redirecting water currents into typhoons they can ride, influencing fire patterns, or constructing large solid forms of themselves for intimidation or structural purposes.

Limits:
Appendages require significant stamina to extend and maintain; prolonged use causes fatigue. Rotation-based elemental manipulation demands precise control and concentration. The Quirk's true strength appears dependent on external enhancement (Trigger drugs); baseline functionality without enhancement remains unclear. Range is limited by appendage length.

Additional Notes:
This Quirk excels at mid-to-long-range combat and environmental control but struggles against opponents who can close distance rapidly or disrupt concentration. The user's reliance on enhancement drugs suggests potential vulnerability when unstimulated. Versatility is high, but mastery requires practice with elemental manipulation techniques.

cardPool.title: Hellflame
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Hellflame

Description:
An extremely powerful fire-based Quirk that allows the user to generate and control flames of varying temperatures, from low-heat warning shots to devastating blue-hot infernos. The user can cover their body in flames, project fire as blasts and rays, and even achieve limited flight through controlled flame expulsion.

Functions/Applications:
Large-scale flamethrower attacks, precise heat rays, flame-wreathed melee strikes, aerial propulsion via foot/back jets, wall-running by creating molten footprints, cellular-level burning to bypass regeneration, medical cauterization, and fire-conjured weapon shapes. Signature technique Flashfire Fist raises flames to maximum temperature for a vaporizing heat ray.

Limits:
Overuse causes dangerous body temperature buildup that impairs physical abilities; user requires external cooling assistance (no internal temperature regulation like ice-based counterparts). Rain and wet conditions hinder performance and reduce speed. High-temperature attacks carry severe bodily strain and backfire risk. User is heat-resistant but not heat-immune and can sustain burns. Extended battles without cooling recovery become progressively more dangerous.

Additional Notes:
Low-temperature flames minimize strain and serve as tactical warning shots; high-temperature attacks are finishing moves with catastrophic cost. User typically maintains flaming body state for intimidation.

cardPool.title: High Specs
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
High Specs

Description:
An intellect-enhancing quirk that elevates the user's mind and body far beyond normal limits. Grants superhuman intelligence, perception, reaction speed, and comprehension. The user gains enhanced physical attributes including strength, dexterity, and growth, becoming fully sapient and capable of human-level cognition and speech regardless of original species.

Functions/Applications:
Devise complex, multi-layered strategies instantly from minimal information. Execute intricate plans involving chain reactions and precise calculations. Perfect recall of all experienced events and knowledge. Leadership and tactical command at the highest level. Enhanced physical coordination for delicate or demanding tasks.

Limits:
Cannot increase physical power beyond enhanced baseline—remains dependent on strategy over brute force. Flawless memory creates emotional baggage; past traumas and grudges persist with perfect clarity, potentially clouding judgment. Intelligence does not grant invulnerability or precognition. Requires time to fully formulate strategies in genuinely novel situations. Physical body, though enhanced, remains limited by biological constraints.

Additional Notes:
The quirk fundamentally transforms a non-human user into a fully sapient being, making it transformative rather than purely combat-oriented.

cardPool.title: Hologram
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Hologram

Description:
Mahoro Shimano projects illusory holograms of any object or creature she visualizes. The projections scale from small decoys to massive constructs visible from great distances. They exist as pure light with no physical substance, casting no shadows and leaving no tangible traces in the environment.

Functions/Applications:
Create diversionary illusions to confuse or frighten opponents. Generate emergency signal constructs visible across wide areas. Stage elaborate pranks or false scenarios to mislead targets. Project multiple holograms simultaneously to overwhelm perception.

Limits:
Holograms possess zero tangibility—they cannot interact with physical matter, deal damage, or block attacks. Strong winds or physical force disperses the projections instantly. Targets with keen perception or skeptical minds (such as Bakugo or Nine) easily see through the deception. Requires active concentration; losing focus causes immediate dissipation. No direct offensive or defensive capabilities. Ineffective against analytical or battle-hardened opponents.

Additional Notes:
Best suited for psychological warfare, tactical misdirection, and non-combat scenarios. Pairs well with escape strategies or information gathering. Utterly useless in direct confrontation against determined foes.

cardPool.title: Homing
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Homing

Description:
The user locks onto any visible target within 600 meters and launches projectiles that automatically chase their prey. Once released, the projectile homes in on the target with relentless accuracy, making evasion difficult. However, the strikes themselves lack significant force, prioritizing tracking over impact damage.

Functions/Applications:
Lock onto distant enemies for guaranteed hit tracking; maintain pressure on mobile or fleeing targets; suppress enemy movement; execute precise strikes from range without line-of-sight adjustments mid-flight; work effectively in open terrain where targets remain visible.

Limits:
Requires visual line of sight to the target at lock-on moment; effective range capped at 600 meters; projectiles deal minimal damage regardless of aim; user cannot dictate hit location on target's body; useless against invisible or obscured enemies; projectile speed appears standard, allowing skilled opponents brief time to react.

Additional Notes:
Best suited for harassment, area denial, and target tracking rather than direct combat damage. Pairs well with sustained volleys rather than single shots. Ineffective against heavily armored or durable opponents who can endure repeated low-impact strikes.

cardPool.title: Horn Cannon
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Horn Cannon

Description:
Pony can detach and launch her horns as independent projectiles, with new horns regenerating almost instantly. She maintains remote telekinetic control over up to four horns simultaneously, allowing mid-air trajectory adjustments. The horns are dense and curved, ideal for piercing, restraining, or transporting targets.

Functions/Applications:
Launch multiple horns in rapid succession for offensive strikes. Remotely steer horns around obstacles mid-flight to bypass defenses. Use horns to restrain or pin enemies due to their strength. Transport allies and objects by riding horns or having them carry cargo. Assist mobility and climbing in navigation scenarios.

Limits:
Only four horns can be controlled remotely at once. Horns are breakable and weaken without regular keratin intake. Transporting multiple people or objects significantly reduces horn speed. Holding Pony's horns in place prevents detachment and negates the Quirk's use. Horns require time to regenerate if destroyed faster than production rate.

Additional Notes:
Best suited for long-range and mid-range combat. Control requires hand gestures mimicking horn positions. Curved horn shape makes precision targeting possible but may limit damage against heavily armored foes. Regeneration speed appears nearly instant in typical combat conditions.

cardPool.title: Hula Hoop
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Hula Hoop

Description:
The user generates large hoops of concentrated energy by raising their arm, then hurls them at targets as projectile weapons. The hoops are solid enough to impact with force.

Functions/Applications:
Primary offensive ranged attack through energy hoop projection. Can be used to strike multiple targets if hoops are thrown in sequence. Useful for medium-range combat engagement.

Limits:
Requires deliberate arm-raising motion before generating each hoop, creating a telegraphed attack pattern. Energy hoops dissipate after traveling a moderate distance. Cannot be rapidly fired in succession due to generation cooldown.

Additional Notes:
Best suited for direct combat scenarios rather than stealth. Effectiveness depends on aim and opponent distance. Most potent against stationary or slow-moving targets.

cardPool.title: Hydra
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Hydra

Description:
A stolen Quirk that allows the user to summon massive serpentine shark-like creatures from their back. These creatures possess immense strength and can be controlled at will by the user. The beasts are large enough to crush a human in their jaws.

Functions/Applications:
Summon a single snake creature to crush or attack enemies; the creature can split into two separate heads when damaged, effectively multiplying offensive capability. Two snake heads can lift the user airborne for mobility or evasion. With enhancer drug boost, multiple snake heads can be summoned simultaneously for overwhelming force.

Limits:
Initially limited to summoning one creature; splitting only occurs when the summoned creature takes damage. Multiple simultaneous summons require external enhancement drugs to achieve. Most effective as a surprise attack from behind; less effective in anticipated confrontations.

Additional Notes:
The Quirk is stolen and unnamed, making it unstable or unreliable in some conditions. Enhancement drugs significantly expand combat potential but create dependency. The creatures' large size may be a liability in confined spaces.

cardPool.title: Hypertrophy
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Hypertrophy

Description:
The user can enlarge their arm to massive proportions at will, increasing its size and mass dramatically. The enlarged limb retains full strength and control, allowing for devastating physical attacks and restraint capabilities.

Functions/Applications:
Deliver crushing blows with devastating force. Restrain or grapple opponents by overwhelming them with size. Combine with other Quirks for enhanced lethality. Break through obstacles and structures.

Limits:
Only affects the arm; cannot enlarge other body parts. Enlargement takes a moment to activate, making it unsuitable for surprise attacks. Requires the user to be physically strong to leverage the increased mass effectively. Extended use may cause fatigue.

Additional Notes:
Most effective when combined with other Quirks or abilities. The enlarged arm becomes a prominent target during use. Works best in direct combat rather than tactical situations requiring subtlety.

cardPool.title: Ice Ply
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Ice Ply

Description:
A manipulation quirk that grants the user complete control over existing ice and water in their vicinity. The user can gather, shape, and weaponize ice freely within a town-sized range. After awakening, the user gained the ability to lower ice temperature and freeze water, dramatically expanding their available ice supply and combat potential.

Functions/Applications:
The user shapes ice into complex constructs—giant fists, platforms, dragons—for offense and defense. By freezing nearby water sources, they generate massive amounts of manipulable ice for large-scale attacks. They can ride ice platforms for swift aerial movement and lower ice temperature to counter high-heat attacks, creating defensive barriers against fire-based quirks.

Limits:
The quirk cannot create ice from nothing; it only manipulates existing ice and water. The user is severely weakened in dry environments lacking water or ice. The control range extends only to town-sized areas; distant targets are unreachable. Extended large-scale attacks drain stamina significantly.

Additional Notes:
Raw power scales with available environmental resources. The quirk excels in wet climates and urban areas with water infrastructure but becomes nearly useless in deserts or arid zones. Mastery requires years of training to achieve complex constructions and temperature precision.

cardPool.title: Ignition
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Ignition

Description:
A fire-generation quirk that allows the user to produce and control flames. The user generates a small flame atop their head as a baseline, and can exhale powerful flares through their mouth. When enhanced by external stimulants like Trigger, flames spread across the upper body and intensify significantly in power.

Functions/Applications:
Ranged attacks via fire breath, close-range flame projection, and offensive combat support. Enhanced form enables wide-area fire generation across the torso for increased damage output and area coverage.

Limits:
Base form produces only modest flames; requires significant power enhancement to reach combat effectiveness. Flames originate primarily from the head and mouth, limiting directional versatility. Trigger dependency creates reliance on external substances to reach full potential. Overuse risks exhaustion or physical strain.

Additional Notes:
The user's upper body becomes the focal point for power amplification, suggesting potential durability concerns in that region when quirk is active. Enhanced form appears temporary, indicating Trigger's effects are not permanent.

cardPool.title: Impact Recoil
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Impact Recoil

Description:
A defensive Quirk that reverses incoming physical force back upon the attacker, redirecting kinetic damage rather than absorbing it. The user becomes a conduit for impact, turning an opponent's own power against them.

Functions/Applications:
Reflects melee strikes, projectiles, and collision-based attacks back at their source with amplified force. Can be chained with other abilities—using objects or people as intermediary shields to redirect attacks indirectly or protect vulnerable moments during reversal.

Limits:
Does not fully negate impact; the user still experiences brief incapacitation from extremely powerful strikes. Cannot reflect indirect damage like energy, heat, or environmental hazards. Requires physical contact or proximity to active force; ranged non-kinetic attacks bypass it entirely.

Additional Notes:
Most effective against direct, forceful attackers. Becomes less reliable against opponents using heat-based, elemental, or ranged abilities. Strategic positioning and timing are critical—a well-timed reversal turns overwhelming offense into liability.

cardPool.title: Impure Beam
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name: Impure Beam

Description: A devastating light-based Quirk that fires massive, destructive beams of concentrated luminous energy. The user channels intense light into a single catastrophic blast capable of obliterating large targets and structures. This Quirk ranks among the most powerful offensive abilities, dealing widespread devastation in one strike.

Functions/Applications: Unleash a massive beam attack dealing extreme damage to single or multiple targets. The beam can be combined with other Quirks to amplify its destructive output tenfold. Effective against most physical defenses and organic matter. Can be charged for increased potency.

Limits: At maximum output, especially when boosted through Quirk combinations, the user's arm and body suffer severe recoil damage or explosive trauma. Light-based beams are vulnerable to refraction or redirection by light-manipulating Quirks like Invisibility. Extended use risks catastrophic self-injury. Requires proper physiology or regenerative ability to use safely at full power.

Additional Notes: Best suited for users with enhanced durability or healing factors. Most effective as a finishing move rather than sustained combat technique. Combinations with complementary Quirks dramatically increase potency but proportionally increase recoil risk. Vulnerable to defensive light-manipulation abilities.

cardPool.title: Incite
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Incite

Description:
The user's voice is laced with an electromagnetic pulse that physically and mentally enhances those who view them as a worthy leader. Power scales with volume—louder speech means stronger effects. Enhancement comes at a physical cost to the recipient.

Functions/Applications:
Amplifies physical strength, speed, and mental fortitude of loyal followers. Can temporarily push recipients beyond normal limits. Works best when delivered through amplification devices or in crowded settings where volume maximizes effect.

Limits:
Only functions on people with genuine loyalty to the user; wavering faith nullifies effects entirely. Fear and conflicting emotions override the ability completely. Repeated use exhausts the recipient's body. Cannot compel unwilling targets or create loyalty where none exists.

Additional Notes:
The user must actively speak to activate Incite; silence negates it. External amplification (loudspeakers, masks) dramatically increases effectiveness. Best suited for rallying groups rather than enhancing individuals. Followers develop dependency on enhancement, making them vulnerable if separated from the user.

cardPool.title: Infrared
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Infrared

Description:
The user perceives their surroundings through infrared radiation, gaining thermal vision similar to heat-sensing predators. This allows navigation and awareness independent of light or sight, compensating entirely for blindness. The quirk extends to sensing emotional states through thermal fluctuations in living beings.

Functions/Applications:
Navigate in darkness or obscured environments with perfect clarity. Detect living creatures by their body heat signatures. Read emotional states through thermal changes in physiology. Bypass visual-based obstacles and camouflage.

Limits:
Effective range is limited to nearby surroundings, not long-distance sensing. Sensor technology and electromagnetic interference can disrupt thermal perception. Cannot function against objects with uniform temperature or heat-isolated targets. Requires cognitive processing to interpret thermal data meaningfully.

Additional Notes:
This quirk is stolen rather than innate, suggesting moderate compatibility with the user. Most effective as a defensive and navigational tool rather than offensive combat ability. Environmental factors like extreme heat or cold may impair accuracy.

cardPool.title: Invisibility
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Invisibility

Description:
The user's body unconsciously refracts all light that contacts it, rendering them completely invisible to the naked eye. Physical features, emotions, and presence cannot be detected visually. The Quirk is permanently active and cannot be toggled off. Clothing and carried objects remain visible, forcing the user to strip completely for effective use. Extreme temperatures directly affect exposed skin, creating environmental vulnerability.

Functions/Applications:
Perfect stealth and infiltration—bypassing visual detection for ambushes, reconnaissance, and evasion. With training, the user can consciously manipulate refracted light to blind opponents or redirect harmful light-based attacks (such as laser projectiles), intensifying and focusing them through their prism-like body. Enhanced light control allows tactical repositioning of enemy attacks.

Limits:
Permanence leaves the user constantly visible when clothed. Complete nudity is required for stealth effectiveness but exposes skin to cold, heat, and environmental damage. Sensory-based detection methods (sound, thermal, touch, scent, fungi-based tracking) bypass the Quirk entirely. Extremely powerful light sources can cause the Quirk to glitch or malfunction, potentially revealing the user's silhouette. The user cannot turn the ability off, even accidentally.

Additional Notes:
Ideal for hit-and-run tactics and information gathering.

cardPool.title: IQ
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
IQ

Description:
A mental enhancement Quirk that multiplies the user's intellectual capacity to genius levels. Activation requires consuming tea and closing one's eyes to enter a deep thinking state. While active, yellow equations and orange circuit diagrams materialize visually around the user's head, reflecting rapid calculations.

Functions/Applications:
Saiko can devise complex strategic plans, analyze enemy movements, predict opponent behavior, and solve tactical problems with superhuman intelligence. The Quirk excels at information gathering, trap construction, and coordinating multi-target containment. Different tea varieties produce varying enhancement effects.

Limits:
Activation depends entirely on tea consumption—without it, the Quirk cannot function. Plans generated are never perfect and have exploitable flaws. The Quirk provides no physical combat enhancement, defensive capability, or reflexive advantage. Highly versatile or unpredictable opponents (like those with multiple applications) introduce variables that exceed calculation accuracy, causing strategic failure.

Additional Notes:
IQ is purely cerebral and unsuitable for direct confrontation. Users require physical support or allies to execute plans, as Saiko was eventually restrained despite superior tactics. The Quirk's strength lies in preparation and foresight, not adaptation or real-time combat adjustment.

cardPool.title: Iron Ball
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Iron Ball

Description:
The user produces and launches iron spheres from their knuckles with considerable force. The projectiles can vary dramatically in size, from egg-sized to larger than the user's body, with the user maintaining fair control over each ball's mass and density.

Functions/Applications:
Primary offensive weapon for ranged attacks; generates ammunition for allies to use; larger projectiles can create barriers or crush obstacles; variable sizing allows tactical flexibility for different combat scenarios.

Limits:
Sustained production drains stamina; larger spheres require more energy and slower generation; accuracy decreases with distance and extreme sizes; user must have knuckles available to produce balls; projectiles cannot be remotely controlled once launched.

Additional Notes:
Best used in offensive or support roles; balances raw power with tactical versatility through size manipulation; works effectively in group combat when allies utilize generated ammunition.

cardPool.title: Iron Claws
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Iron Claws

Description:
The user's fingertips transform into hard metallic claws. The claws' size, sharpness, and application vary by user—some develop large slashing weapons, while others maintain dexterous claws suited for excavation and tunneling.

Functions/Applications:
Metallic claws can pierce tough materials, slash opponents, or dig through earth and stone. Users can burrow underground for mobility, concealment, or surprise attacks. Claws retain enough precision for climbing and manipulation tasks.

Limits:
Claws are only as strong as the user's physical strength and durability allow. Extended underground burrowing drains stamina. The quirk doesn't increase speed or reflexes—only provides sharp tools. Claws can be damaged or broken by superior materials or force.

Additional Notes:
Manifestation varies significantly between users. Bulky claw variants sacrifice dexterity for slashing power, while refined versions maintain control. Underground movement leaves obvious tunnels, potentially revealing the user's position or intentions.

cardPool.title: Iron Club
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Iron Club

Description:
The user transforms their arms into massive iron clubs covered in jagged spikes. The transformation increases body mass and height to 229cm, granting an imposing ogre-like appearance with enhanced physical presence.

Functions/Applications:
Devastating melee strikes capable of crushing boulders and shattering fortifications. The spike-covered surfaces inflict additional trauma on impact. Useful for intimidation due to dramatic physical transformation. Can be used for demolition or environmental destruction.

Limits:
Arms cannot be used for fine manipulation or dexterous tasks while transformed. Transformation likely requires significant stamina to maintain. Speed and agility may decrease due to increased body mass and weight. The transformation appears permanent until deactivated, leaving user vulnerable during the change.

Additional Notes:
Iron Club is a straightforward, offensive-focused Quirk best suited for direct combat scenarios. The spike coverage prevents easy disarming or grappling. Limited defensive capability; user relies on durability rather than evasion.

cardPool.title: Jet
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Jet

Description:
Jet allows the user to expel compressed air from holes in the soles of their feet, propelled by breath drawn from their lungs. This grants extreme speed both in flight and ground movement, enabling the user to move faster than the eye can follow and change direction with explosive bursts.

Functions/Applications:
The user can achieve short-range flight and superhuman ground acceleration by releasing pulses of air. Each directional change requires a new breath intake. The momentum generated amplifies the user's physical strikes, allowing devastating tackles and kicks. Excellent for evasion, pursuit, and delivering high-impact blows before opponents can react. Can be used for rescue operations and rapid repositioning in combat.

Limits:
Flight duration is severely restricted by lung capacity—cannot sustain hover like dedicated flight Quirks. Each direction shift costs breath, limiting maneuverability in prolonged engagements. Advanced age or physical deterioration weakens both stamina and bone integrity, reducing repeated use capability. Warping-type Quirks can bypass the speed advantage by negating the need to track movement.

Additional Notes:
Peak effectiveness requires mastery of impact timing and momentum control to maximize striking force. Users naturally develop exceptional combat instinct and spatial awareness.

cardPool.title: Kaiju
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Kaiju

Description:
A transformation Quirk that allows the user to metamorphose into a colossal dinosaur-like beast resembling Godzilla. The full scope of this ability remains largely unknown, as its manifestation has only been observed while the user is under the influence of Trigger. The transformation grants massive size and power comparable to Gigantification Quirks.

Functions/Applications:
Grants enormous physical strength and size for combat purposes. The beast form can devastate large areas through sheer mass and destructive capability. Useful for overwhelming opponents through scale advantage and raw power output.

Limits:
Transformation appears to require Trigger drug activation to manifest, suggesting the user cannot access this power naturally without chemical enhancement. The massive form likely reduces mobility and agility despite increased strength. Normal state abilities are entirely unknown and potentially non-existent without Trigger.

Additional Notes:
This Quirk's true capabilities and limitations remain mysterious due to limited observed usage. The dependency on Trigger presents significant vulnerability when the drug is unavailable. Long-term effects of repeated transformations are unknown.

cardPool.title: Kinetic Booster
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Kinetic Booster

Description:
A Quirk that amplifies the kinetic energy generated and released by the user's body during movement and actions. Each copy possessed multiplies the effect, allowing for exponentially greater force output. All For One holds four copies, making him devastatingly powerful.

Functions/Applications:
Enhanced striking force, explosive movement speed, amplified jumping distance, and increased momentum behind physical attacks. Multiple copies compound these effects, enabling simultaneous bursts of kinetic energy or sustained acceleration far beyond normal limits.

Limits:
Requires active physical exertion to generate kinetic energy; passive users gain minimal benefit. Energy output is finite per activation and depletes with repeated use. Effectiveness depends on user's physical conditioning and control. Stacking multiple copies requires significant mental focus to manage simultaneously without backfire.

Additional Notes:
Originally stolen from an unknown source by All For One. The Quirk's true power emerges only when multiple copies are combined, suggesting its baseline form is relatively modest. Control and finesse are essential—raw power without technique risks self-injury or collateral damage.

cardPool.title: King Slam
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
King Slam

Description:
The user can manifest a massive hammer from thin air and wield it as a weapon. The hammer appears instantly when summoned and can be used for direct melee strikes or hurled at opponents with considerable force.

Functions/Applications:
Deploy the hammer for powerful close-range bludgeoning attacks or launch it as a projectile. The weapon can be summoned repeatedly, allowing for sustained offensive pressure in combat situations.

Limits:
The hammer requires conscious summoning and cannot be maintained indefinitely—it dissipates after use. The user's physical strength ultimately determines impact force; a weak individual cannot generate the same destructive power as a strong one. Range is limited when throwing, and recovery time between summons may exist.

Additional Notes:
This is a straightforward offensive Quirk favored by aggressive combatants. Best suited for close-quarters or mid-range encounters rather than strategic or defensive scenarios.

cardPool.title: Landmine
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Landmine

Description:
Chitose infuses explosive properties into any object or being she touches, detonating them at will. The explosions are individually weak but devastating in numbers and through strategic placement. She can even weaponize her own allies' bodies or blood as living mines.

Functions/Applications:
Plant trap networks to funnel enemies into kill zones. Detonate multiple charges simultaneously for cumulative damage. Infuse allies' blood as contingency explosives. Use the Curious Flattener chain weapon to detonate explosive pieces at close range, bypassing distance limitations.

Limits:
Individual explosions are relatively weak; effectiveness depends on quantity and tactical setup. Cannot detonate targets at extreme distances without direct line of sight to detonation point. Requires physical contact to infuse objects initially. Detonating allies requires their willing cooperation or incapacitation.

Additional Notes:
Chitose's strength lies in preparation and control of the battlefield rather than raw power. She excels in coordinated group combat where allies can help position enemies. The Quirk works on any material and living tissue, making it versatile but ethically questionable when used on people.

cardPool.title: Larceny
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Larceny

Description:
Toya Setsuno can instantly steal any object from a target's person and bring it directly into his hands. This includes weapons, armor, and even manifestations created by other Quirks, giving him a natural advantage against armed opponents.

Functions/Applications:
Disarm enemies by stealing weapons or tools mid-combat. Steal Quirk manifestations to neutralize magical abilities. Works best in coordinated team fights where allies exploit the resulting vulnerability. Primary tactical use is forcing opponents into disadvantageous positions.

Limits:
Cannot steal objects larger than a certain size threshold. Requires direct line of sight to the target and their possessions—blindness renders the Quirk completely unusable. Cannot steal from objects outside the user's visual range. Ineffective against unarmed opponents or those with no portable items.

Additional Notes:
Toya relies heavily on allies to capitalize on disarmed enemies. The Quirk's effectiveness is entirely dependent on maintaining vision; any sight obstruction is catastrophic to his combat capability. Best paired with aggressive team members who can exploit openings created by successful thefts.

cardPool.title: Laser
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name: Laser

Description: The user projects concentrated energy beams directly from their right eye with precise targeting capability. These beams possess destructive force sufficient to damage high-level threats and break down complex materials.

Functions/Applications: Fire focused energy beams for offensive attacks against enemies and objects; destroy or disable targets from distance; breach material defenses and structural integrity.

Limits: Beam originates only from the right eye, creating a predictable attack vector; likely requires line of sight; unknown cooldown or energy expenditure between shots; extended use may cause eye strain or fatigue.

Additional Notes: Effective against both organic and synthetic targets. The Quirk's precision makes it suitable for tactical combat but leaves the user vulnerable if the right eye is compromised or obscured.

cardPool.title: Leafipulation
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Leafipulation

Description:
The user manipulates leaves from nearby plant life, shaping and launching them as sharp projectiles. This Quirk grants control over vegetation in the immediate environment, turning natural foliage into weapons.

Functions/Applications:
Gather and fire leaves as ranged attacks; create leaf shields or barriers for defense; strike multiple targets by dispersing projectile patterns; scout areas by controlling leaves as extensions of sight.

Limits:
User cannot generate leaves from their own body—must rely on existing plant sources nearby. Completely ineffective in barren or urban environments lacking vegetation. Leaf projectiles lack the stopping power of harder materials. Range and potency depend entirely on plant availability.

Additional Notes:
Best utilized in forests, gardens, or natural settings. Urban combat severely restricts this Quirk's effectiveness. Leaves deteriorate quickly once separated from plants, limiting sustained offensive pressure.

cardPool.title: Leap
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Leap

Description:
A mobility quirk that grants the user the ability to jump extraordinary distances and heights. When activated, Leap provides cushioning on landing, negating fall damage during intentional jumps. However, the quirk requires solid ground to function effectively and does not protect against accidental falls.

Functions/Applications:
Execute massive horizontal and vertical jumps for traversal and evasion. Land from great heights without injury when the quirk is consciously activated. Clear obstacles and reach elevated positions quickly in combat or exploration scenarios.

Limits:
Requires solid, stable ground to function—muddy or soft surfaces significantly reduce jump distance and height. Does not protect against unintended falls or passive drops; only cushions damage from activated leaps. User remains vulnerable to fall damage if knocked off a ledge without triggering the quirk first.

Additional Notes:
Leap is a pure mobility tool with defensive applications, not a flight quirk. Success depends on environmental conditions and user awareness. Skilled use requires timing activation before impact to maximize protective benefits.

cardPool.title: Life Force
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Life Force

Description:
Doubles the user's natural lifespan and slows aging dramatically, allowing the user to appear decades younger than their actual age. A user of 120 years may appear only sixty.

Functions/Applications:
Grants extended longevity and youthful appearance for centuries of life. Can be duplicated and transferred to another person. Enables long-term planning and accumulation of knowledge across generations.

Limits:
If the Quirk is cancelled or removed, the user rapidly ages into extreme decrepitude, potentially causing severe physical deterioration or death. The Quirk naturally causes reduced physical mobility and slower reflexes, making combat difficult without supplementary abilities.

Additional Notes:
This Quirk trades vitality for duration—users gain time but lose physical prowess. The rapid aging reversal upon cancellation makes this Quirk dangerous to lose mid-conflict. Duplicating the Quirk is possible but requires mastery of its mechanics.

cardPool.title: Lion
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Lion

Description:
A transformation quirk granting the user the physical attributes of a lion, including enhanced strength, speed, and a devastating roar. The user gains feline power and agility comparable to the apex predator.

Functions/Applications:
Enhanced strength for powerful melee attacks, increased running speed for rapid pursuit or evasion, and a sonic roar capable of disrupting sensory-based attacks or creating defensive shockwaves. The roar can specifically counter high-frequency paralysis abilities.

Limits:
The quirk does not grant full animal form transformation, only attribute enhancement. The roar requires buildup and leaves the user vulnerable during recovery. Effectiveness decreases against targets immune to sound or vibration-based effects. Sustained use causes physical fatigue.

Additional Notes:
Most effective in direct combat scenarios where raw power and speed provide advantage. The roar serves as both offensive weapon and defensive countermeasure, making it versatile against ability-based opponents. Works best when user has space to move freely.

cardPool.title: Liquification
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Liquification

Description:
The user can transform their body into a liquid state at will, allowing them to flow and reshape themselves. This Quirk serves primarily as a defensive mechanism, enabling the user to avoid physical harm by becoming intangible to solid attacks.

Functions/Applications:
Evasion of melee and projectile attacks by liquefying the body. Can be combined with other Quirks to amplify offensive capabilities, such as launching liquefied body matter as a projectile weapon. Grants mobility through confined spaces by flowing through gaps.

Limits:
The user cannot liquify selectively—the entire body must transform or remain solid. Liquified form is vulnerable to elemental attacks like fire or freezing. Maintaining liquified state likely drains stamina. Cannot interact with solid objects effectively while liquefied. Concentration required to reform the body.

Additional Notes:
Most effective as a defensive tool rather than primary offense. Best utilized by users with complementary Quirks that can weaponize the liquified form. The Quirk's evasive nature makes it difficult to pin down but limits aggressive combat options.

cardPool.title: Lizard
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Lizard

Description:
A reptilian transformation quirk that grants the user a scaled, lizard-like appearance with a tail and forked tongue. The user gains enhanced physical resilience and accelerated healing capabilities beyond normal human limits.

Functions/Applications:
The quirk provides superior endurance for extended combat and physical exertion. Enhanced regeneration allows recovery from wounds and injuries faster than baseline humans. Under the influence of the Trigger drug, the transformation intensifies dramatically—the user's arms morph into functional pterosaur-like wings enabling sustained flight.

Limits:
The quirk does not grant superhuman strength or speed without Trigger enhancement. Flight is only possible under Trigger's effects, making it unreliable for sustained aerial combat. The user's reptilian form may be vulnerable to extreme temperatures or conditions that affect cold-blooded creatures. Trigger dependency creates significant risk and potential addiction hazards.

Additional Notes:
The quirk's full capabilities remain partially unexplored. The forked tongue suggests enhanced sensory perception, though this is unconfirmed. Trigger transforms the user's physiology dramatically but with unknown long-term consequences to health and stability.

cardPool.title: Lock Down
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Lock Down

Description:
A spatial locking ability that freezes touched objects into a fixed point in space, rendering them completely immobile. The user activates this through key-tooth-like protrusions extending from their fingertips, which must make direct contact with the target object.

Functions/Applications:
Immobilize environmental hazards like falling debris, shifting terrain, or moving obstacles. Secure objects in place during combat or construction. Create barriers by locking structural elements. Useful for tactical positioning by neutralizing dynamic threats.

Limits:
Cannot affect living beings or organic matter. Effectiveness decreases with object size and force—massive or powerfully moving objects may resist or break free. Requires direct finger contact with the object to activate. Duration and energy cost scale with object mass.

Additional Notes:
Most effective against environmental hazards and inanimate objects. Works well defensively but lacks offensive capability. Synergizes with strategies that manipulate the battlefield rather than damage opponents directly.

cardPool.title: Longbow
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name: Longbow

Description: The user transforms their left hand's thumb and pinky finger into a functional bow. Arrows fired from this bio-weapon possess absolute trajectory control and pierce-through power capable of penetrating vehicles. Projectiles can actively pursue moving targets through the air.

Functions/Applications: Transform left hand into a ranged weapon for combat. Fire arrows with guided trajectory to track fleeing opponents. Penetrate fortified positions and vehicles. Use scavenged ammunition from the environment when personal supplies deplete.

Limits: User cannot generate ammunition independently and must rely on found arrows or makeshift projectiles. Once ammunition runs out, the Quirk becomes useless. Only the left hand can form the bow, limiting combat versatility if the hand is injured or restrained.

Additional Notes: Strategic dependency on resource management makes this Quirk powerful in prepared engagements but vulnerable in prolonged conflicts. The guided arrow capability provides significant accuracy advantage over conventional archery, compensating somewhat for ammunition scarcity through precision rather than volume.

cardPool.title: Longleg
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Longleg

Description:
A transformation Quirk that grants the user the ability to extend their legs to extraordinary lengths. The user's limbs become elastic and elongated, allowing them to cover vast distances and reach otherwise inaccessible areas.

Functions/Applications:
Extended leg length enables rapid travel across terrain, scaling walls and structures, executing far-reaching kicks, and escaping from confined spaces. The user can reach high or distant objects and traverse obstacles that would stop others.

Limits:
Extension has a maximum range before the legs become unstable or difficult to control. Overextension causes loss of balance and reduced combat effectiveness. The Quirk cannot function if the legs are immobilized or restrained. Speed decreases proportionally with extension distance.

Additional Notes:
Particularly effective for theft and reconnaissance due to mobility advantages. Works best in open environments where the user has space to maneuver. The Quirk's usefulness diminishes in cramped indoor spaces or when facing opponents who can restrict movement.

cardPool.title: Love
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Love

Description:
The user empowers a target by confessing genuine romantic feelings for them. The confession transmits a surge of physical enhancement to the target, with intensity scaling to the depth of the user's emotional connection. The empowered state manifests as heart-shaped smoke surrounding the target's body, called "Lover Mode."

Functions/Applications:
Dramatically increases target's physical strength and speed for combat or critical tasks. Works across any distance if the user's voice reaches the target. Acts as a strategic trump card for high-stakes moments requiring a decisive power boost.

Limits:
Activates only once per 24 hours, making it a carefully rationed ability. Cannot empower the user themselves—only affects genuine romantic interests. Requires sincere emotional confession to function; false declarations fail. Enhanced state, while powerful, doesn't guarantee victory against skilled opponents.

Additional Notes:
The user must consciously choose their target based on authentic feelings; Lover Mode enhancement is most effective when the user's love is most intense. Best employed as a last-resort tactic due to its severe cooldown. The quirk's strategic value lies in timing rather than raw power output.

cardPool.title: Luminescence
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Luminescence

Description:
The user emits bright light from their body, ranging from pure white to duller orange-yellow hues depending on the wielder. The light intensity and color appear influenced by the user's state and circumstances. Activation can be controlled at will, though it may have been constantly active in infancy.

Functions/Applications:
Emit blinding light to disorient or blind opponents in combat. Use as an illumination source in darkness. Create visual distraction or misdirection tactics. The light output scales with the user's growth and development over time.

Limits:
No offensive or defensive properties beyond the light itself; purely emission-based with no kinetic force or energy projection. Effectiveness reduced against opponents with light resistance or those already adapted to bright conditions. Energy cost and duration unknown but likely taxing during extended use. Requires line of sight to affect targets.

Additional Notes:
The Quirk's visual properties may vary between users—original holder used pure white light while a later user produced orange-yellow luminescence. Originally belonging to an infant, its full potential remains unclear. Most effective in dark environments or as a surprise tactic rather than sustained combat ability.

cardPool.title: Mad Gluttony
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Mad Gluttony

Description:
A consumption-based Quirk that grants the user a massive mouth in their stomach capable of rapidly inhaling, crushing, and destroying objects and matter. When artificially enhanced through Overmodification, additional mouths sprout across the user's body, functioning as prehensile, biting tendrils for ranged attacks and restraint.

Functions/Applications:
Devour and destroy solid materials with extreme speed and force. Deploy spawned mouth-tendrils for multi-directional offense, grappling, and ranged bite attacks. Inhale to create suction effects for environmental manipulation or pulling objects closer. Enhanced form provides significant combat versatility and crowd control capabilities.

Limits:
The stomach mouth has finite capacity and requires time to process consumed matter. Spawned tendrils are destructible by concentrated, powerful attacks—kinetic-based or impact damage is particularly effective. The Quirk requires close proximity for the primary mouth; enhanced form extends range but spreads defensive capacity thin. Overmodification is unstable and not naturally sustainable without external modification.

Additional Notes:
Mad Gluttony transforms from a single-target consumption tool into a multi-vector threat when enhanced, making it formidable but tactically vulnerable to focused strikes on individual tendrils.

cardPool.title: Magic
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Magic

Description:
The user creates glowing energy rings around their wrists that can ensnare people and objects, allowing telekinetic manipulation. Once trapped within a ring, the user gains complete control over its speed and trajectory, from gentle movement to explosive acceleration.

Functions/Applications:
Propel allies toward distant targets at high velocity. Rescue civilians or teammates from danger by moving them out of harm's way. Manipulate large objects or multiple targets simultaneously using multiple rings. Fine-tune speed for precision placement or raw power delivery.

Limits:
Rings have a fixed maximum size, preventing the user from moving objects or beings larger than the ring's circumference. Creating and maintaining multiple rings drains stamina with extended use. The user cannot manipulate ring speed if the target escapes the ring's boundary. Requires direct line of sight and proximity to generate rings effectively.

Additional Notes:
This Quirk excels at rescue and repositioning allies in chaotic combat scenarios. Its greatest weakness is rigid size constraints—massive threats cannot be moved regardless of the user's power level. Best used tactically rather than as primary offense. Works effectively in team compositions where allies need rapid deployment or extraction.

cardPool.title: Magnetism
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name: Magnetism

Description: The user magnetizes targets within a 4.5-meter radius, polarizing them by sex—men become south-aligned (blue aura), women north-aligned (red aura). Same-sex targets repel; opposite-sex targets attract. The user themselves cannot be magnetized and cannot affect those outside range.

Functions/Applications: Launch allies by positioning them between opposing polarities for momentum. Separate enemies by matching their polarities to force repulsion. Pin or crush foes using attraction between opposite-polarized targets. Combine with external magnetic objects (like metal weapons or platforms) to amplify effects.

Limits: Only functions within 4.5 meters; no effect beyond this radius. User is immune to their own Quirk. Requires line of effect—cannot magnetize through total obstruction. Power scales with number of targets; complex multi-target coordination drains focus. Metallic non-sentient objects need external magnetism to interact with the Quirk's effects.

Additional Notes: Most effective in coordinated team settings where allies can be positioned strategically. Useless against solo opponents outside the radius. Environmental factors—walls, dense crowds, or confined spaces—limit tactical options. Works best when combined with ranged or mobility-based allies.

cardPool.title: Manifest
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Manifest

Description:
The user can enhance their body parts with the characteristics of anything consumed, as long as it remains in their digestive system. Eaten food grants its physical properties—octopus tentacles from takoyaki, hardened clam shells, sharp talons, or reinforced muscle tissue—all manifested on command and dismissed at will.

Functions/Applications:
Offense: Tentacle fingers for binding, sharp talons for cutting, reinforced striking limbs. Defense: Clam shell hardening, flexible absorption using octopus traits. Tactical: Multiple simultaneous manifestations allow combining traits (e.g., talons with octopus muscle). User can prepare specific foods before missions to counter known threats. Versatility increases dramatically with training and creativity.

Limits:
Manifestation strength depends directly on quantity consumed—eating more of a substance yields stronger traits. User must eat daily to maintain reserves; depleted digestive stores render the Quirk unusable. Manifestations only last while the food remains in the user's system, creating a natural time limit. Non-food items work if the body can digest them, but this is rare. Overpreparation can lead to wasted resources and unnecessary manifestations.

Additional Notes:
This Quirk rewards strategic preparation and creative thinking. Users benefit from routine consumption of reliable foods and scouting enemy weaknesses beforehand.

cardPool.title: Mantis
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Mantis

Description:
A transformation quirk that grants the user mantis-based physiology and abilities. The user develops enhanced insectoid traits including sharpened claws, increased agility, and predatory instincts. When artificially enhanced through bio-engineering or chemical stimulants like Trigger, the transformation becomes more pronounced, enlarging the user into a humanoid mantis form with lethally honed blades for hands.

Functions/Applications:
High-speed slashing attacks using razor-sharp claws capable of cutting through most materials. Enhanced reflexes and predatory awareness allow tracking and pursuit of fast-moving targets. The transformation grants increased strength proportional to size when fully manifested. Climbing and wall-adherence similar to natural mantises provides tactical mobility advantages.

Limits:
Without enhancement, the quirk provides only partial transformation with modest physical boosts. Over-reliance on Trigger or similar stimulants causes instability and loss of control. The enlarged form is less agile in confined spaces and consumes significant stamina to maintain. Extended use risks permanent biological changes or addiction to enhancement substances.

Additional Notes:
This quirk pairs well with hit-and-run combat strategies and ambush tactics. The user's mantis nature may create psychological vulnerability to threats exploiting insect predator weaknesses.

cardPool.title: Meatball
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Meatball

Description:
The user manipulates raw human flesh with telekinetic precision, separating and controlling their own limbs independently while molding flesh into offensive and defensive shapes. Victims touched by flesh constructs can be kneaded into immobilized meatballs, retaining full sensory awareness while trapped.

Functions/Applications:
Create levitating flesh projectiles for ranged attacks; form protective shields from compacted flesh; ensnare multiple targets simultaneously by rolling them into helpless spheres; separate limbs for independent combat maneuvers; expand and compress flesh for both offense and defense.

Limits:
User must maintain constant focus to keep victims restrained—sufficient physical damage breaks concentration and releases captives. The user has vastly superior control over their own flesh than others'; manipulating foreign flesh requires direct contact. Meatball form restricts victim mobility but doesn't cause unconsciousness, leaving them aware and potentially dangerous if restraint fails.

Additional Notes:
Most effective at mid-to-long range, using flesh bullets to weaken opponents before close-range capture. User demonstrates exceptional tactical control, layering hidden ambush attacks beneath distraction maneuvers. Flesh constructs display surprising durability, withstanding significant explosive impact.

cardPool.title: Metal Manipulation
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Metal Manipulation

Description:
Wolfram can control and reshape pre-existing metallic materials by touching them, causing his hand to glow with blue electrical energy. He bends metal freely into offensive and defensive structures without limit to form or complexity.

Functions/Applications:
Creates iron pillars, walls, and cubes to attack or defend. Can construct large fortifications and barriers to trap opponents. Capable of assembling multiple metal pieces into massive structures like giant steel blocks. Excels in metal-rich environments where abundant materials amplify his power.

Limits:
Requires pre-existing metal to function—useless in metal-scarce or metal-free environments. Ineffective at close-range combat. Strength depends entirely on available metal quantity and quality. Power scales with amplification devices but remains stationary-focused.

Additional Notes:
Best utilized in industrial or metallic settings. Creates visual tell through blue hand discharge when activating. Defensive capabilities proven capable of withstanding powerful physical attacks when properly fortified.

cardPool.title: Mimicry
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Mimicry

Description:
The user transfers their consciousness and body into solid objects, controlling them as if they were their own physical form. Without enhancement, objects are limited to refrigerator-size; with Trigger drug, manipulation extends to entire structures and landscapes.

Functions/Applications:
Inhabit and animate solid matter for combat and mobility; reshape environments by twisting corridors, creating barriers, and repositioning terrain; manifest specific body parts externally to perceive surroundings and interact with others; launch attacks while remaining hidden inside the object.

Limits:
While immersed, perception becomes severely limited without exposing body parts on the object's exterior, creating exploitable weak points. Standard objects capped at refrigerator-size without Trigger enhancement. Emotional manipulation can force desperate moves that expose position. Quirk-negating abilities like Erasure cannot affect the user while hidden inside inanimate matter, but direct environmental damage to the inhabited object remains a threat.

Additional Notes:
User Joi Irinaka typically inhabits a small black cloak for everyday use. Most effective in structured environments with manipulable terrain. Requires Trigger drug for large-scale reality warping capabilities.

cardPool.title: Mind Reaper
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Mind Reaper

Description:
Upon physical contact with a target, Mind Reaper forces the victim to involuntarily expose their deepest secrets, embarrassing memories, and hidden truths they wish to conceal. The compulsion manifests as uncontrollable verbal disclosure.

Functions/Applications:
Extract concealed information through forced confession. Incapacitate targets psychologically by revealing shameful secrets. Interrogate prisoners or suspects without traditional torture. Humiliate opponents by exposing their vulnerabilities.

Limits:
Requires direct physical touch to activate. Victims with strong willpower can resist full disclosure, though Mind Reaper will then reveal secrets itself—less accurately and with gaps. Exceptionally resolute individuals may resist entirely, preventing the Quirk from functioning regardless of secret severity. Cannot force revelations the user doesn't suspect exist.

Additional Notes:
Effectiveness depends on the victim's mental fortitude versus the user's activation strength. The Quirk prioritizes the target's own confessions over secondhand revelation, making willing resistance strategically valuable. Works best on psychologically vulnerable or guilt-ridden individuals.

cardPool.title: Mole
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Mole

Description:
