Grants the user elongated, razor-sharp claws on their fingers, protective spines along their back, and a hardened visor across the face. These features mimic a mole's natural digging anatomy, enabling rapid excavation through earth and stone. The spines enhance underground mobility and environmental camouflage, while the visor shields eyes from debris.

Functions/Applications:
Dig through mountains, soil, and rock with exceptional speed. The claws serve as formidable melee weapons, capable of shredding through obstacles, vegetation, structures, and enemies. Spines facilitate sliding underground and concealment. User can selectively activate different components—maintaining spines while toggling claws and visor on demand. Ideal for infiltration, escape, terrain manipulation, and sustained combat.

Limits:
Effectiveness depends heavily on user's base strength and durability; the Quirk amplifies existing physical power rather than granting independent might. Claws cannot penetrate enchanted or magically-reinforced barriers. Underground navigation is slowed by solid rock versus soil. Prolonged transformation causes fatigue. Visor reduces peripheral vision slightly.

Additional Notes:
Best suited for large, powerful users who can exploit the Quirk's terraforming potential. Originally stolen and granted to Gigantomachia by All For One.

cardPool.title: Monster Cat (Quirk)
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Monster Cat

Description:
Monster Cat allows the user to merge with and assume the shape of objects or machinery, gaining complete control over the merged form. The user can detach from the object at will. Without enhancement, the Quirk's true capacity remains unknown, but when chemically boosted, it enables control of large vehicles like buses.

Functions/Applications:
Merge with objects or machinery to pilot them from within, assume their physical form, control their movement and functions completely, detach and separate at any time, infiltrate or commandeer vehicles and devices by becoming one with them.

Limits:
Capacity severely restricted without external enhancement; cannot merge with living beings; detachment takes time and concentration; merged form is limited by the host object's structural integrity and durability; larger objects require significant power boost to control effectively.

Additional Notes:
Monster Cat is non-humanoid and operates as a small animal user, making stealth integration easier but limiting independent combat ability. The Quirk's true potential under natural conditions remains unexplored. Chemical enhancement dramatically increases control range and object size capacity.

cardPool.title: Monster Summon
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Monster Summon

Description:
Simon Gollini can conjure various blob-like creatures resembling dungeon monsters. These eyeless beings possess large mouths and vary in form—some are bulky, multi-headed, winged, or resemble wyverns, dinosaurs, and giant frogs. The mechanics remain mysterious, possibly magical in nature.

Functions/Applications:
Summon diverse monsters for combat, scouting, and overwhelming opponents through numbers. Each creature can be tailored in appearance and capabilities. When enhanced through Overmodification, production becomes nearly limitless, allowing swarm tactics and sustained offensives.

Limits:
Creating monsters requires focus and energy expenditure; sustained summoning causes fatigue. Individual creatures lack intelligence and require direction. Quantity and power are inversely balanced—more summons weaken each monster individually. The true creation method remains unknown, limiting potential improvements.

Additional Notes:
Effectiveness scales dramatically with Overmodification enhancement. Best utilized in open terrain where swarms can maneuver. Against single powerful opponents or in confined spaces, this Quirk struggles despite numerical advantage.

cardPool.title: Muddied
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Muddied

Description:
A contact-based Quirk that induces temporary memory disruption. When the user touches someone's head, they experience localized amnesia affecting approximately five minutes before and five minutes after contact, leaving affected memories vague and fragmented.

Functions/Applications:
Useful for disorienting opponents in combat, escaping pursuers by making them forget the chase, or extracting information by obscuring the target's sense of time. Can be applied tactically to single opponents within arm's reach.

Limits:
Requires direct physical contact with the target's head to activate. Effect duration is fixed at roughly ten minutes total of memory interference. Does not affect long-term memories or knowledge, only recent events. Repeated use on the same person may show diminishing effectiveness. Cannot be applied from a distance.

Additional Notes:
The vagueness of affected memories makes them unreliable rather than completely absent, potentially leaving targets confused but still dangerous. Works best in surprise situations or close-quarters scenarios. No apparent physical toll on the user.

cardPool.title: Multiplier
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Multiplier

Description:
A stolen Quirk allowing the user to rapidly generate and manifest multiple additional limbs from their body at will. The manifested limbs are fully functional and independent, granting extraordinary combat versatility and manipulation capabilities beyond normal human limits.

Functions/Applications:
The user can sprout multiple arms simultaneously to perform complex actions, wield multiple weapons at once, grapple multiple opponents, or execute coordinated multi-directional attacks. Each manifested limb retains full strength and dexterity, enabling simultaneous independent tasks or devastating synchronized strikes.

Limits:
The exact limit on simultaneous limbs is unclear, but excessive manifestation likely causes stamina drain and biological strain. Manifested limbs can be severed or destroyed individually. The Quirk provides no inherent defense against damage to the limbs themselves, making them vulnerable targets during combat.

Additional Notes:
Originally stolen from an unknown person by All For One. The Quirk's full specifications remain poorly understood even by its current user, suggesting untapped potential or hidden mechanics. Most effective when combined with other Quirks for enhanced destructive capability.

cardPool.title: Mummification
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Mummification

Description:
Hoyo can animate and control red bandages wrapped around his body, ensnaring inanimate objects and transforming them into humanoid mummy constructs that obey his commands. He can simultaneously control dozens of these mummy servants in combat.

Functions/Applications:
Animate objects into controllable mummy soldiers for direct combat. Indirectly control living enemies by manipulating their clothing, equipment, or nearby objects, turning them into unwilling tools or human shields. Restrain and immobilize targets through bandage entanglement.

Limits:
Cannot directly control living beings—only inanimate matter and objects worn by people. Bandages break under sufficient force, freeing controlled constructs. Captured enemies can sacrifice equipment to escape wrapping. Quirk deactivates entirely if Hoyo is rendered unconscious. Each mummy requires sustained focus and willpower to maintain.

Additional Notes:
Hoyo's strength lies in overwhelming numbers and indirect control tactics rather than raw power. Targets aware of the Quirk's restrictions can strategically discard gear to break free. The bandages are his only power source—damage to them directly weakens his abilities.

cardPool.title: Muscle Augmentation
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Muscle Augmentation

Description:
The user amplifies and manipulates their muscle fibers, both internal and external, to achieve superhuman strength, speed, and durability. Muscle layers can protrude visibly from the skin or glow internally depending on the user's control. Users can augment specific body parts selectively and stack up to 12,000+ muscle layers for maximum effect.

Functions/Applications:
Grants immense physical strength capable of shattering cliffs and overwhelming opponents. Enhanced speed allows blurring movement and attack avoidance. Muscle fibers act as natural armor, absorbing impacts from powerful attacks. Selective augmentation enables tactical flexibility—concentrating power in legs for speed or arms for striking force. Can contend with top-tier power users at their peak output.

Limits:
Depleted muscle fibers tear and rip away from the body, leaving users temporarily vulnerable and weakened. Vibration-based attacks efficiently destroy multiple fiber strands at once. The Quirk can be overwhelmed by sufficiently greater power levels. Exposed muscle architecture creates exploitable weak points if fibers are trapped or damaged strategically. Regeneration is not inherent unless combined with healing Quirks.

Additional Notes:
Different users display variations: some manifest visible muscle bulges, others show internal glowing. Effectiveness scales with user's physical conditioning and control.

cardPool.title: Muscle Expansion
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Muscle Expansion

Description:
The user can expand and strengthen their muscles at will, dramatically increasing their physical power and size. This grants substantial boosts to strength, allowing them to perform feats beyond normal human capability.

Functions/Applications:
Enhanced striking force and grappling power. Ability to lift and move heavy objects. Increased durability from muscle mass expansion. Can be applied selectively to specific body parts or full-body enhancement.

Limits:
Sustained expansion consumes stamina and causes fatigue. Overuse risks muscle strain or injury. Expanded form is slower and less agile than normal. Cannot be maintained indefinitely without rest.

Additional Notes:
Best suited for close-range combat and heavy lifting tasks. Works poorly against speed-based opponents. Requires time to activate, leaving user vulnerable during transformation.

cardPool.title: Mushroom
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Mushroom

Description:
Kinoko Komori generates and spreads fungus spores from her body that rapidly grow into full-sized mushrooms upon contact with any solid surface—terrain, objects, or living beings. Spore dispersal accelerates in high-humidity environments. The mushrooms persist for two to three hours before naturally withering.

Functions/Applications:
Terrain control via rapid mushroom proliferation to obstruct movement and vision. Asphyxiation attacks by forcing mushroom growth in an opponent's throat. Area denial when combined with humidity spray bottles. Provides allies with cover or hiding spots if properly coordinated. Works synergistically with allies who can manipulate humidity or exploit mushroom clusters.

Limits:
Spores indiscriminately affect all organisms, including allies, requiring pre-treatment with anti-fungal sterilization spray. Fungicides and ethanol neutralize spores effectively. Fire destroys airborne spores before germination. High moisture dependency—dry environments severely reduce effectiveness. Mushroom lifespan is only two to three hours. Requires preparation time and spray equipment for optimal effectiveness.

Additional Notes:
Kinoko must sterilize teammates before deployment to prevent accidental infection. The asphyxiation application is a high-risk, last-resort tactic. Humidity-control allies exponentially amplify her capability.

cardPool.title: Mutant Bovini
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Mutant Bovini

Description:
A transformation quirk that grants the user bovine-like facial features capable of emitting powerful directional energy beams. The user's face becomes the primary conduit for concentrated laser attacks.

Functions/Applications:
The user can fire lasers from their face in sustained or burst patterns, useful for ranged combat, environmental destruction, and crowd control. Beams can be aimed by turning the head and vary in intensity from warning shots to devastating strikes.

Limits:
Sustained firing causes facial strain and overheating. Accuracy decreases at extreme ranges. The user cannot fire while moving erratically without losing precision. Eyes and facial area become vulnerable pressure points during combat.

Additional Notes:
This quirk suits offensive-focused fighters who position themselves strategically. Recovery time between volleys is necessary to prevent overload. Close-range melee opponents pose significant tactical threats.

cardPool.title: Neutralization
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name: Neutralization

Description: A touch-based Quirk that temporarily nullifies a target's Quirk abilities through contact with the user's right hand, which glows bright light blue when activated. The glow's intensity and duration correlate with the target Quirk's power level. Originally limited to the right arm, but can spread throughout the body if modified by external Quirk factors.

Functions/Applications: Suppresses active Quirks temporarily, allowing treatment of harmful Quirk side effects like seizures or dangerous overmodification. Effective for medical intervention rather than combat. Can potentially render a target completely Quirkless with sufficient power or modification. Works through gloved contact, not requiring direct skin touch.

Limits: Taxing on the user when neutralizing powerful Quirks; prolonged use against strong abilities risks severe injury or death. Originally required right arm contact, making the user vulnerable if that limb is disabled or lost. Cannot permanently destroy Quirks, only temporarily suppress them. Weaker Quirks may resist or require extended contact time.

Additional Notes: Quirk Factor naturally resides in the right arm, creating a critical vulnerability—loss of this limb results in complete inability to use the Quirk unless the factor spreads to other body parts through external modification. The Quirk's strength depends on user stamina and willpower rather than raw power, making it unsuitable for direct combat scenarios.

cardPool.title: Octopus
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Octopus

Description:
The user manifests octopus-like physiology, gaining eight elastic tentacle appendages in place of or alongside normal limbs. These tentacles possess powerful suckers for gripping and climbing, and the user can expel ink clouds from a specialized mouth structure for concealment or offense.

Functions/Applications:
Tentacles provide exceptional reach, grappling strength, and dexterity for manipulation tasks. Suckers enable scaling vertical surfaces and restraining targets. Ink expulsion creates visual obstruction for escape or tactical advantage. Multiple appendages allow simultaneous actions impossible for typical humanoids.

Limits:
Tentacles require conscious control and tire with sustained exertion. Ink reserves are finite and must regenerate. Sucker adhesion weakens on dry surfaces. The quirk does not grant enhanced speed or durability beyond what elastic tissue provides. Water environments may reduce effectiveness of ink-based tactics.

Additional Notes:
Best suited for close-quarters combat, reconnaissance, and environmental navigation. The elasticity of appendages offers creative problem-solving but lacks the offensive cutting power of harder-bodied quirks. Works synergistically with aquatic or confined spaces.

cardPool.title: Octopus (Squid)
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Octopus (Squid)

Description:
Transforms the user's body into a humanoid cephalopod form, granting eight total limbs. Six visible arms function as standard limbs, while two additional tentacle-like appendages remain concealed within the torso and can emerge for surprise attacks.

Functions/Applications:
Multi-limb combat enables simultaneous attacks and grappling. Hidden tentacles provide ambush capabilities and unexpected offensive options. Enhanced dexterity allows manipulation of multiple objects or opponents at once.

Limits:
Increased limb count requires coordination and stamina to control effectively. Hidden tentacles have limited reach and concealment. Bulkier form may hinder agility or fitting through tight spaces. Requires sustained focus to manage all limbs simultaneously in complex scenarios.

Additional Notes:
The Quirk fundamentally alters the user's physiology, not merely granting extra limbs cosmetically. The distinction between visible and hidden appendages creates tactical depth—enemies cannot account for two surprise attack vectors. Best suited for users with high coordination and spatial awareness.

cardPool.title: Orcinus
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Orcinus

Description:
A marine-mammal transformation quirk granting the user orca physiology and abilities. The user gains massive size, enhanced strength and speed, and the capacity to generate devastating ultrasonic waves that can paralyze targets and shatter environmental hazards like ice. Functions equally on land and in water, though water amplifies effectiveness.

Functions/Applications:
Ultrasonic wave emission for instant paralysis of targets; effectiveness diminishes with distance. Waves serve as both offensive and defensive tools, deflecting attacks and creating deterrents. Enhanced physical strength enables grappling and restraint. Can combine immobilization with paralysis for finishing moves. Extreme durability allows sustained combat against multiple opponents.

Limits:
Ultrasonic effectiveness decreases significantly at range. Vulnerable to extreme heat and dehydration, which saps strength. Rehydration required to maintain peak performance; must carry water or access aquatic environments for sustained combat. Land-based combat, while formidable, is less efficient than aquatic engagements.

Additional Notes:
User becomes a top-tier combatant capable of overwhelming multiple high-level opponents simultaneously. Requires tactical awareness of heat sources and hydration availability. Best utilized in environments with water access or in prolonged battles where dehydration can be managed.

cardPool.title: Outburst
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Outburst

Description:
A comedic Quirk that forces nearby targets into uncontrollable, intense laughter. When activated, a distinctive blue aura surrounds the user. The laughter is so overwhelming it impairs motor coordination and mental processing, rendering victims temporarily helpless.

Functions/Applications:
Incapacitate multiple enemies simultaneously through involuntary laughter. Useful for crowd control, disarming dangerous situations, and preventing villain attacks. The Quirk appears to affect all nearby targets indiscriminately when triggered.

Limits:
Activation method unclear—unclear if verbal commands or pure presence triggers laughter. Full power extent unknown. No documented resistance mechanisms or duration limits. Likely ineffective against those immune to humor or mental manipulation.

Additional Notes:
Rarely used in combat despite tactical potential. The blue aura serves as a visible activation indicator. Effectiveness may vary depending on target psychology and environmental factors.

cardPool.title: Overclock
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Overclock

Description:
A speedster Quirk that accelerates the user's brain function and perception, making the world appear frozen. The user can move 3-10 times faster than normal in standard situations, or dozens of times faster when adrenaline surges. Heightened senses allow perception of ultra-fast audio and visual input. With a healing factor, the user can accelerate cellular growth to repair injuries or merge parasitic cells with their body.

Functions/Applications:
Sprint at supersonic speeds to outpace bullets and evade attacks. Read subconscious reactions in opponents to predict and manipulate their behavior. Accelerate cell regeneration to heal grievous wounds in seconds. Grow new limbs or fuse biological material into the body. Process hyper-accelerated sensory information to navigate and react in frozen time.

Limits:
Severely limited by oxygen deprivation—only usable for seconds before mandatory cooldown. Brain injury, concussions, or oxygen starvation seal the Quirk temporarily. Intense focus drains available activation time. Sustained use while highly focused risks permanent oxygen-deprivation lockout. Useless if the user is airborne or knocked into the air. Extensive physical trauma beyond the head can seal access.

Additional Notes:
The Quirk's true power lies in perception acceleration rather than pure speed. Synergizes dangerously with regenerative abilities.

cardPool.title: Overhaul
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Overhaul

Description:
A deconstruction and reconstruction ability activated by bare-handed touch. The user can instantly disassemble matter—living or non-living—and reassemble it into its original form, a new shape, or leave it destroyed. A single finger contact is sufficient to trigger the effect.

Functions/Applications:
Reshape terrain into walls, spikes, platforms, and holes for offense and defense. Merge two separate objects or beings into a hybrid entity with combined properties. Heal injuries by reconstructing bodies to perfect biological condition. Isolate and extract components from targets. Dual-hand merging allows combining quirks from different subjects.

Limits:
Requires physical contact; useless in mid-air or on unreachable surfaces. Short cooldown between uses prevents rapid successive activation. Fractured terrain reduces effectiveness—disassembly scatters matter across disconnected pieces. Cannot function if arms are destroyed or disabled. Disassembly causes extreme pain to living subjects.

Additional Notes:
Overhaul becomes deadlier when the user merges with others, gaining additional limbs and access to their quirks. The ability's versatility makes it dangerous at any combat range, though terrain control is most effective on solid, unified ground. Deconstructing and perfectly reconstructing targets leaves no evidence, making it ideal for clandestine operations.

cardPool.title: Overmodification
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Overmodification

Description:
A perpetually active Quirk that amplifies and enhances other Quirks through physical contact. When activated, the user's hair turns black and rose petals bloom around them. Compatible recipients gain boosted abilities or entirely new powers; incompatible ones suffer devastating pain and unconsciousness. The Quirk cannot be controlled or deactivated without a cancellation ability.

Functions/Applications:
Enhances compatible Quirks dramatically, sometimes granting entirely new functions. Can transform weak single-target abilities into multi-target powerhouses. Works through skin contact; effects persist and stack with repeated applications. Rose petals bloom as a visual indicator of compatibility or rejection.

Limits:
Compatibility is extremely rare and unpredictable. Incompatible contact causes severe backlash pain to the recipient. The Quirk is always active and uncontrollable, making it dangerous in social situations. If not regularly discharged, it builds up and causes the user agonizing seizures. Overcharging causes exponential range expansion and loss of control, spawning destructive plant life. Multiple-Quirk users nearby trigger negative feedback automatically. Enhanced abilities fade if the modified user sustains overwhelming damage.

Additional Notes:
Neutralization-type Quirks can cancel or even be enhanced by this ability to permanently nullify Overmodification.

cardPool.title: Pain Blocker
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Pain Blocker

Description:
The user becomes completely unable to sense pain from any source—internal or external. This allows them to sustain massive damage without distraction or hesitation. The quirk can be toggled on and off with practice, granting the user precise control over when pain sensation is disabled.

Functions/Applications:
The user can withstand extreme attacks, including intense heat and blunt force trauma, while continuing to fight at full capacity. Injuries that would incapacitate normal fighters become mere obstacles. When combined with high durability or endurance quirks, the user gains an overwhelming advantage in prolonged combat, capable of pushing through enemy lines without fatigue.

Limits:
Pain blocking does not prevent actual damage—the user still accumulates injuries and wounds, they simply cannot feel them. This creates risk of death from unnoticed critical damage. The quirk requires active concentration to maintain; sudden shocks or distractions may briefly reactivate pain sensation. Unconsciousness or severe trauma can force the quirk offline involuntarily.

Additional Notes:
Most effective when paired with superhuman durability or strength quirks. The user must rely on visual and tactical awareness rather than pain signals to judge their condition. Long-term use without monitoring injuries can lead to catastrophic hidden damage that manifests all at once.

cardPool.title: Papyrus
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Papyrus

Description:
The user can flatten their entire body to papyrus-like thinness, allowing them to compress into two-dimensional form. Their body becomes malleable and can be stretched, folded, and manipulated at will while in this state.

Functions/Applications:
Slip through narrow gaps and confined spaces. Stretch limbs to extreme lengths for reaching or grappling. Fold body parts for compact storage or evasion. Ride air currents and wind patterns to achieve high-speed movement across distances.

Limits:
The user remains vulnerable to mold and degradation in humid or moisture-rich environments. Flattened form may be more fragile to certain attacks. Cannot maintain full body strength while in compressed state. Wind-riding ability depends on sufficient air currents being present.

Additional Notes:
Exceptionally useful for infiltration, rescue operations, and traversal in urban environments. Best deployed in dry climates. Requires practice to maintain balance and control while riding wind currents.

cardPool.title: Permeation
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Permeation

Description:
The user phases their body through all matter by rendering themselves intangible. They can selectively phase individual body parts or their entire form, allowing seamless passage through obstacles and evasion of attacks. Mastery requires intense concentration and training to control safely.

Functions/Applications:
Phase through walls, floors, and solid objects without obstruction. Dodge incoming attacks by becoming intangible at precise moments. Perform swift, unpredictable combat maneuvers by phasing body parts independently. Navigate environments unrestricted by physical barriers.

Limits:
Clothing and carried objects slip off when activated unless made from user's own hair. Full-body phasing negates all senses except falling sensation, causing disorientation and downward gravitational pull through solid ground. Cannot extend phasing to other people, making protection impossible without deactivating the Quirk. Ineffective against sudden, unpredictable attacks. Reactivating while phased inside solid matter instantly repels the user to the surface, risking injury. Requires precise footwork and concentration to move through surfaces without falling; fails under time pressure without extensive training.

Additional Notes:
Extremely difficult to master; improper use carries fatal consequences. Mastery demands rigorous, sustained training to develop the muscle memory and mental discipline for split-second activation control.

cardPool.title: Plant
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Plant

Description:
The user transforms body parts into living plant structures, including vines, roots, and flora. These botanical forms possess regenerative properties capable of mending wounds in allies through direct contact or proximity.

Functions/Applications:
Transform limbs into grasping vines for restraint or manipulation; sprout roots for stability and subterranean movement; generate healing flora that restores health to nearby allies when activated; use plant barriers for defense.

Limits:
Transformations consume stamina and require concentration to maintain. Plant structures are vulnerable to fire, ice, and herbicidal toxins. Healing output is limited by the user's own vitality—cannot heal beyond what the user possesses. Extended transformation causes fatigue.

Additional Notes:
Most effective in natural environments with soil and sunlight. Works best supporting team members rather than direct combat. The user must remain conscious to sustain plant growth; knocked out ends all active transformations immediately.

cardPool.title: Playtime
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Playtime

Description:
A transformation quirk that enlarges the user to gigantic proportions while altering their physiology and mental state. Under Trigger influence, the user's skin darkens, an additional pair of arms manifests, and their intellect regresses to childlike behavior, causing them to treat their surroundings like toys.

Functions/Applications:
Grants immense size and strength for overwhelming physical force in combat. The extra limbs enable complex multi-directional attacks. The regressed mental state removes inhibitions, making the user unpredictable and fearless in battle.

Limits:
Full capabilities remain poorly understood without Trigger enhancement. The intelligence regression is a severe liability, removing tactical thinking and leaving the user vulnerable to cunning opponents. Size increase may restrict mobility in confined spaces. Trigger dependency suggests the quirk is unstable or incomplete without external chemical enhancement.

Additional Notes:
The quirk's true nature is obscured—whether the transformation is the quirk's natural function or an effect of Trigger is unclear. The childlike mentality transforms combat into "play," potentially making the user more destructive but less strategic. Duration and exhaustion effects unknown.

cardPool.title: Pliabody
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Pliabody

Description:
A transformation quirk that allows the user to stretch and flatten their body at will, granting superhuman flexibility and elasticity. The user's body becomes malleable like clay, enabling them to compress, extend, and reshape themselves for various purposes.

Functions/Applications:
Combat evasion by dodging incoming attacks through body deformation. Physical restraint of opponents by wrapping around limbs or torso like living bondage. Navigation through tight spaces, narrow passages, and confined areas during rescue operations. Enhanced grappling and unconventional combat positioning.

Limits:
Cannot stretch beyond approximately 2-3 times normal body length before losing structural integrity. Extreme flattening reduces combat effectiveness and leaves the user vulnerable. The quirk requires conscious control—panic or unconsciousness reverts the body to normal form. Sharp, piercing weapons bypass the flexibility advantage and can still cause injury.

Additional Notes:
Most effective in rescue and reconnaissance scenarios where mobility matters more than raw power. In direct combat, works best against unprepared opponents unfamiliar with elastic fighters. Requires significant stamina for extended use of extreme deformations.

cardPool.title: Pointer
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Pointer

Description:
A navigational quirk that allows the user to locate people, places, and things they're searching for. The user's limbs act as directional indicators, pointing toward the desired target with accuracy.

Functions/Applications:
The user must spin in place to activate the quirk. Once activated, their arms and legs point simultaneously toward up to three different targets or directions. Useful for tracking, navigation, rescue operations, and locating specific objectives in combat or exploration scenarios.

Limits:
The user can only point toward three directions at once, restricting multi-target searches. Activation requires a full spin, making it vulnerable during combat. The quirk only works for things the user consciously seeks—vague or unfocused searches won't function. Range and accuracy details are unclear.

Additional Notes:
Best used for preparation and scouting rather than active combat. The spinning activation requirement makes this quirk tactically predictable. Works as a support ability for team operations and navigation challenges.

cardPool.title: Poison Gas
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Poison Gas

Description:
Takeshi Bushijima continuously generates toxic fog from his body. The gas causes illness and sickness in those who breathe it. If unreleased, the poison accumulates dangerously within him, eventually poisoning his own body if the buildup exceeds critical limits.

Functions/Applications:
Creates noxious clouds to incapacitate or sicken enemies through inhalation. Can be withheld temporarily to protect bystanders, though prolonged retention damages the user. The gas is highly flammable and ignites easily when exposed to combustion or explosives.

Limits:
Generates involuntarily with no on-off switch—the user must periodically release accumulated toxins or suffer severe health degradation. Unusable in crowded areas without harming innocents. Combustion destroys the gas entirely. Effectiveness depends on how long toxins have accumulated in the user's body.

Additional Notes:
Takeshi must balance offense with self-preservation; holding poison too long becomes counterproductive. The Quirk's potency increases with prolonged accumulation but creates a dangerous threshold beyond which his own health fails. Strategic release timing is crucial for both combat effectiveness and survival.

cardPool.title: Poltergeist
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Poltergeist

Description:
A telekinetic Quirk that grants the user the ability to mentally manipulate objects and people within close proximity. The user can exert precise control over multiple targets simultaneously, directing them with focused intent.

Functions/Applications:
The user can lift and move large swarms of objects to barrage opponents, restrain or manipulate people through telekinetic force, and create complex patterns of coordinated movement. This Quirk excels at area control and multi-target offense.

Limits:
The maximum weight the user can manipulate is approximately that of a single adult human (roughly 62 kg or 137 lbs). The Quirk only functions on objects and people in close proximity to the user. The precise range limitation and maximum object count remain unclear.

Additional Notes:
Poltergeist requires significant mental focus and control to manage multiple targets effectively. Fatigue from sustained use or managing numerous objects simultaneously likely impacts performance. The Quirk's effectiveness depends on the user's concentration and tactical awareness.

cardPool.title: Polygraph
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Polygraph

Description:
Allows the user to detect truth and falsehood in a target's words through direct physical contact. When activated, green-yellow lightning sparks from the user's hands and around the touched target, revealing the authenticity of their speech.

Functions/Applications:
Interrogation and investigation of suspects or witnesses. Detection of deception in negotiations or conversations. Quick verification of claims during combat or crisis situations by maintaining contact with the target.

Limits:
Requires unbroken physical contact to function—breaking contact ends the ability. Vulnerable to technicalities and precise wording; targets can unintentionally bypass the Quirk by speaking truths from their perspective, even if factually incorrect or based on misunderstandings. Cannot detect lies about intentions, only spoken falsehoods.

Additional Notes:
Most effective in controlled environments where physical contact can be maintained. Unreliable against cunning opponents who exploit semantic loopholes or those speaking subjective "truths." The sparking visual effect may alert the target that they're being scanned.

cardPool.title: Pop Off
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Pop Off

Description:
The user produces sticky spheres from their scalp that can be plucted painlessly and regrow instantly. These spheres adhere to any surface except the user's own body, making them versatile tools for binding, trapping, and mobility. Water does not diminish their adhesive properties.

Functions/Applications:
Launch spheres as projectiles to restrain opponents or bind weapons. Construct ground traps and obstacle courses. Use spheres as bouncing platforms to traverse difficult terrain or scale surfaces. Chain spheres together as whip-like weapons for medium-range combat. The user's physical intelligence enables creative tactical applications beyond direct combat.

Limits:
Adhesive strength depends on the user's health and physical condition, lasting hours to a full day when well-rested but weakening when exhausted. Rapid sphere removal causes scalp bleeding and limits sustained output. Spheres do not stick to the user, preventing self-application. The ability requires close proximity for most applications and is unsuitable for long-distance engagement.

Additional Notes:
This quirk is often underestimated, granting users tactical advantage against overconfident opponents. Effective users should focus on trap-setting and environmental manipulation rather than direct combat, leveraging the quirk's versatility over raw power.

cardPool.title: Power
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Power

Description:
Power allows the user to accumulate tremendous raw strength within their body, enabling feats of extraordinary physical force. The user can generate enough force to demolish reinforced concrete structures and overpower formidable opponents through sheer physical might.

Functions/Applications:
The user can deliver devastating melee attacks capable of destroying architecture and terrain. When combined with other Quirks, Power amplifies overall combat effectiveness, allowing users to manipulate or displace large objects and enemies with ease.

Limits:
Power is purely physical strength with no range or area-of-effect capabilities. It requires direct physical contact to be effective and offers no defensive properties beyond durability gained through muscle buildup. The Quirk provides no speed enhancement or special mobility advantages.

Additional Notes:
Power is most effective when paired with complementary Quirks that provide additional utility or defensive coverage. Users gain no special resistance to non-physical damage types and must rely on positioning and other abilities to handle ranged threats.

cardPool.title: Power Stock
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Power Stock

Description:
A meta ability that stockpiles and accumulates raw power and speed through training and physical cultivation. The exact mechanism of storage is unknown, but the user can release this accumulated energy in devastating bursts. Originally designed as a safe ability for users with fragile bodies, it becomes exponentially stronger when transferred between users, with each successor building upon the previous generation's stockpiled strength.

Functions/Applications:
Users can channel accumulated power into explosive bursts of strength and speed far beyond normal capability. The quirk grows stronger with each transfer to a new user, creating a compounding effect. Users can apply this power selectively to specific limbs or across their entire body. With sufficient training, users can combine Power Stock with other quirks to exceed normal limitations.

Limits:
Power Stock requires extensive training to safely control; excessive output causes severe injury to the user's body. As accumulated power grows across generations, it eventually exceeds what a single user can safely handle without specialized training and physical conditioning. Rapid or forced transfer between incompatible users can cause the quirk to destabilize and collapse entirely. Users must gradually increase their capacity over time or risk permanent damage to their limbs and body structure.

cardPool.title: Propagation
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Propagation

Description:
The user can grow and duplicate body parts across their form, multiplying them at will. By increasing duplications, power scales proportionally—three duplicates yield triple strength. The Quirk pairs dangerously with regenerative abilities, allowing fusion of duplicate cells into smaller, independent entities.

Functions/Applications:
Duplicate limbs for enhanced striking force and combat versatility. Create fused composite forms by merging multiple body duplicates into one larger mass. Generate independent mini-entities from duplicate cells, each capable of autonomous action. Stack duplicates to achieve exponential power increases for devastating coordinated attacks.

Limits:
Power gain is linear and dependent on number of duplicates—few duplicates yield minimal advantage. Requires significant biological mass to sustain multiple duplicates; overextension causes resource depletion. Mini-entities created from cell fusion are individually weaker and vulnerable to dispersal. No stated limit on duplication number, but practical constraints from user stamina and durability apply.

Additional Notes:
Most effective when combined with regeneration or self-detonation abilities, as seen in specialized bomber usage. Duplication quality and control may degrade with quantity, potentially creating liabilities. The Quirk emphasizes quantity-over-quality tactics rather than precision combat.

cardPool.title: Quad Arms
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Quad Arms

Description:
Grants the user a second pair of functional arms, creating four limbs total. The extra appendages are fully capable and proportional to the user's body, enabling simultaneous multi-tasking and enhanced physical combat capability.

Functions/Applications:
Wield multiple weapons or tools simultaneously; perform complex manual tasks at double speed; execute advanced grappling and striking combinations in unarmed combat that single-armed opponents cannot defend against; gain positional advantage in melee fights through increased attack angles and reach.

Limits:
Requires conscious control of all four arms—divided attention reduces combat effectiveness if executing separate tasks. Strength is distributed across four limbs rather than concentrated, preventing the additional arms from achieving superhuman power individually. Armor, clothing, and equipment designed for two arms become cumbersome or unusable.

Additional Notes:
Best utilized by users trained in hand-to-hand combat who can leverage the extra limbs for tactical advantage. Psychological adjustment period needed to avoid arm interference during movement. Effective primarily in close-range engagements where multiple simultaneous attacks or defensive positions provide decisive advantage.

cardPool.title: Queen Beam
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Queen Beam

Description:
The user projects a straight-travelling beam of pure energy from their face, accompanied by a pink heart symbol that manifests over their features. The beam travels in a direct line and can be consciously cancelled mid-flight after release.

Functions/Applications:
Offensive ranged attacks with reliable accuracy; beam can be directed by facing the target. The cancellation ability allows tactical repositioning or mercy strikes. Useful for combat at medium-to-long distances without physical contact.

Limits:
Beam travels only in straight lines with no homing or curved trajectory capability. User must maintain line of sight to cancel the effect. Limited information on beam power, durability, or energy consumption prevents sustained multi-fire. Range and intensity appear modest compared to more destructive quirks.

Additional Notes:
Manifests at primary school age, suggesting relatively low power output. The heart symbol is a consistent visual marker of activation. Best suited for precise targeting rather than area damage or defense.

cardPool.title: Queen Bee
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Queen Bee

Description:
A parasitic bee colony that invades a host's body through the eye socket, burrowing into the brain to seize complete control. The queen bee connects neurologically to her host, allowing full command of their body, actions, and even access to their Quirk. A vast swarm nests behind a medical patch on the host's left eye, destroyed upon possession.

Functions/Applications:
Host possession and puppet control; bee swarm surveillance and reconnaissance; injectable substance delivery via stinger-syringes for drugs, toxins, or blood samples; temporary Quirk absorption by collecting host blood; swarm-based neural disruption and signal hijacking; mass area coverage with coordinated bee deployment. Fused personality emerges blending hive instinct with host consciousness.

Limits:
Destroys host's left eye permanently. Trigger drug use weakens the queen's mental grip, allowing host consciousness to resurface temporarily. Single bee can become new queen if original dies, but requires time to rebuild strength and find fresh host. Host resistance increases with strong-willed individuals. Bee☆Pop variant loses direct control—bees follow instinct and only activate when she sings.

Additional Notes:
The quirk's survival depends on maintaining hosts; a destroyed hive can perpetuate through one remaining bee. Personality manifestation varies by host—Kuin's cruelty differs from Bee☆Pop's destructive cheerfulness.

cardPool.title: Rabbit
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Rabbit

Description:
A transformation quirk that grants the user rabbit-like anatomy and heightened animal instincts. The user develops functional rabbit features including long ears, powerful hind legs, and a fluffy tail, along with enhanced sensory perception and survival awareness.

Functions/Applications:
Enhanced hearing and smell allow precise detection of distant threats and locations. Powerful leg muscles enable rapid bouncing movement and devastating kick/stomp attacks. A single ground stomp generates wind pressure strong enough to disperse fire. Rabbit instincts provide automatic danger awareness and tactical advantage in combat situations.

Limits:
The quirk's power is primarily lower-body focused, limiting upper-body combat versatility. Enhanced senses can be overwhelmed by sensory overload. Bouncing mobility may be restricted in tight spaces or difficult terrain. The user remains vulnerable to attacks targeting the distinctive ears or tail.

Additional Notes:
This is a combat-oriented quirk best suited for aggressive, mobile fighting styles. The wind pressure from stomps suggests the user can engage multiple enemies or environmental hazards simultaneously. The survival instinct component provides both defensive awareness and tactical positioning benefits in prolonged engagements.

cardPool.title: Radio Waves
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Radio Waves

Description:
An electromagnetic quirk that emits pulses of radio waves to disrupt electrical systems and communications. When activated, black lightning with purple outlines crackles around the user's arms and palms. Originally stolen by All For One, this quirk grants control over technology and can transmit waveforms for remote communication and command.

Functions/Applications:
Disrupts and disables electrical appliances and communicators within range. Transmits waveforms through induced currents to awaken and directly command Nomu creatures. The electromagnetic force is strong enough to parry attacks and push enemies back. Can be combined with other quirks like Air Cannon for devastating wide-range blasts that disable hero communications and infrastructure simultaneously.

Limits:
User requires knowledge and experience to issue precise commands through waveforms; inexperienced users cannot control Nomu effectively. The quirk's range and power scale with the user's mastery—combining it with other quirks amplifies effectiveness but demands significant control. Cannot function against non-electronic targets or purely mechanical systems without electrical components.

Additional Notes:
Most effective when paired with other offensive quirks for area denial. The quirk works at both close range for direct force application and long range for broadcast disruption.

cardPool.title: Razor Sharp
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Razor Sharp

Description:
The user generates sharp blades of varying shapes and sizes from any part of their body. These blades are composed of an unknown material strong enough to cut steel and withstand point-blank explosions, making them both offensive and defensive tools.

Functions/Applications:
Blades can be produced from forearms for slashing attacks, feet for stability and ground combat, or any body part as tactical need requires. The versatility allows simultaneous offense and defense, with the user controlling blade geometry and deployment in real-time.

Limits:
Blade generation requires conscious effort and energy expenditure; sustained combat depletes stamina. The user must be within melee range to utilize the quirk effectively. Blades cannot be thrown or separated from the body—they function only as attached appendages.

Additional Notes:
Best suited for close-quarters combat specialists. The quirk's true strength lies in tactical flexibility and unpredictable blade placement rather than raw power alone.

cardPool.title: Reflect
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Reflect

Description:
An always-active Quirk that absorbs incoming energy—physical or ranged—and rebounds it back at the attacker in a spiraling wave. The user's skin glows blue during use. However, the Quirk reflects all contact indiscriminately, preventing any physical touch and rendering the user blind due to light reflection from their eyes, necessitating special eye masks to see.

Functions/Applications:
Automatic defense against both melee and ranged attacks without conscious effort. Can redirect reflected energy through technological augmentation (exoskeletons) to change trajectory or fuel flight. Works best when combined with stationary positioning and external firepower to exhaust opponents.

Limits:
Drains stamina proportionally to reflected energy strength; sustained barrages quickly deplete reserves and overwhelm the Quirk. Cannot be disabled, making all physical contact with anyone impossible—eliminating emotional bonds and social connection. The constant reflection of light blinds the user without protective gear. Overloads catastrophically under relentless, powerful multi-hit attacks.

Additional Notes:
This Quirk's curse is as significant as its power—the inability to touch others created severe social ostracization and psychological trauma for the user. Requires technological support to maximize effectiveness in combat scenarios.

cardPool.title: Rewind
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Rewind

Description:
A rare mutant Quirk that allows the user to reverse a living being's body to a previous physical state. Activation causes a small horn on the user's forehead to grow and glow brightly, affecting all living creatures in contact or nearby vicinity. The power can theoretically rewind a target back to non-existence, making it exceptionally dangerous.

Functions/Applications:
Restores injured bodies to pre-injury states, heals wounds and broken limbs, reverses genetic modifications, and can restore erased Quirks. User can consciously control which targets are affected through training. Effective range requires close proximity or physical contact with the target.

Limits:
Only affects living things; cannot rewind objects or non-organic matter. Requires accumulation of unexplained "Rewind Energy" to activate; once used, the horn shrinks and must recharge before next activation. User lacks innate control and risks catastrophic consequences without proper training. Emotional state influences power potency. Cannot be safely practiced on living beings without supervision.

Additional Notes:
Manifests as a small brown horn on the right forehead that grows during activation. Emotional determination and hope significantly amplify Quirk strength and effectiveness. User is young and inexperienced; control improves through training on small organisms like insects and lizards. Power can run dangerously out of control if user is overwhelmed.

cardPool.title: Rifle
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Rifle

Description:
Kaina can extrude a functional rifle from her right elbow that fires ammunition crafted from her own hair. The weapon operates silently using organic muscle and bone sinew propulsion rather than gunpowder, making it ideal for covert operations. She manifests a flesh tendril scope for precision targeting and can increase output power at the cost of jamming risk.

Functions/Applications:
Fire custom hair-bullets up to 3km with superior penetration and no audible report or shell casings. Mold hair into specialized rounds: hollow-point, tracking, or curved trajectory variants. Bullets are reusable, caseless, and maintain integrity through impact. Increase firepower output for devastating single shots. Deploy flesh scope tendril for enhanced accuracy at range.

Limits:
Hair length determines ammunition capacity; short hair severely restricts sustained fire. Individual round loading creates reload delays that skilled opponents can exploit to close distance. Rifle is fragile in close combat and doesn't self-repair, requiring manual maintenance. Identifiable by distinctive dark blue and pink bullet coloring. Using the Quirk while injured reopens wounds and strains her body dangerously.

Additional Notes:
Ideal for assassins and snipers; vulnerability to close-range combatants makes positioning critical. Requires tactical patience and hair maintenance. Effective against high-durability targets but limited by ammunition reserves in prolonged engagements.

cardPool.title: Rivet
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Rivet

Description:
A transformation quirk that enables the user to generate metallic rivet-like growths from their arms. These hardened projectiles or protrusions can be expelled with force or extended as a defensive barrier.

Functions/Applications:
The user can launch rivets as high-velocity projectiles for ranged attacks or extend them along their arms for melee combat enhancement. The growths provide armor-like protection and can be used for climbing or anchoring surfaces.

Limits:
Rivet generation is limited to the arms and requires physical exertion to manifest. The growths deplete stamina with each use and cannot be regenerated indefinitely. Once expelled, rivets take time to regrow. The quirk offers no protection against quirks that bypass physical defense.

Additional Notes:
This is a straightforward combat quirk suited for aggressive, direct fighters. Its effectiveness diminishes in prolonged battles due to stamina drain. The quirk pairs well with close-range combat styles but is vulnerable to speed-based or energy-type quirks.

cardPool.title: Rocket Thrust
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Rocket Thrust

Description:
A devastating ranged combat quirk that enables the user to detach and launch their right fist as a projectile at extreme velocities. The fist travels in a straight line toward its target before returning to reattach to the user's arm.

Functions/Applications:
The user can fire their right fist repeatedly at high speed to strike distant enemies, break through obstacles, or perform surprise attacks. The fist can be launched at variable distances and maintains considerable impact force upon contact.

Limits:
The user loses their right arm's functionality while the fist is in flight and cannot throw it again until it reattaches. The projectile travels only in straight lines and cannot change direction mid-flight. Overuse causes arm fatigue and joint strain.

Additional Notes:
Most effective when combined with tactical positioning to prevent close-range vulnerability. The quirk excels in one-on-one combat but becomes predictable in prolonged engagements. Compatible users typically possess above-average durability to withstand the recoil forces generated during launch.

cardPool.title: Rupture
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Rupture

Description:
Rupture grants the user the ability to detonate their own body or body parts at will, creating explosive force and sending fragments outward. The user controls the detonation's timing and intensity, making it a devastating offensive tool.

Functions/Applications:
The user can detonate localized body sections or their entire form to damage enemies in a radius around them. When combined with other Quirks like Liquification, Rupture becomes even more lethal—transforming the user's liquefied body into a projectile spray of explosive matter.

Limits:
Detonating the body causes severe self-damage and requires recovery time. The explosion radius is limited to the user's physical size, and repeated use drains stamina rapidly. The Quirk cannot be used defensively to block incoming attacks, only offensively.

Additional Notes:
Rupture is most effective when paired with regenerative or transformation-type Quirks that allow the user to survive or rebuild their body after detonation. Predictable timing makes it vulnerable to fast-moving opponents who can escape the blast zone.

cardPool.title: Saber
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Saber

Description:
The user can transform portions of their body into sharp, sword-shaped appendages at will. These bladed limbs are hard and durable, capable of cutting through most materials with ease.

Functions/Applications:
Transform arms, legs, or other body parts into blade-like weapons for close combat; can execute powerful slashing attacks; useful for penetrating armor or barriers; allows versatile offensive positioning with multiple bladed appendages.

Limits:
Transformation is localized to specific body parts—cannot transform entire body at once; transformed sections lose fine motor control and dexterity; speed of transformation takes a brief moment; extensive use causes fatigue; blades can be dulled or damaged by impact with extremely hard materials.

Additional Notes:
This Quirk favors aggressive melee fighters and direct confrontation. The user sacrifices mobility and precision for raw cutting power. Ideal for Pro Heroes who rely on physical strength and battlefield control rather than speed or ranged techniques.

cardPool.title: Sandstorm
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Sandstorm

Description:
The user transforms their upper body into manipulable sand, gaining a fluid, shapeshifting form. This grants enhanced physical adaptability and the ability to reform after damage, making them difficult to restrain or grapple with effectively.

Functions/Applications:
Transform limbs into sand constructs for attacking and defending. Manipulate sand to shield against incoming strikes, create barriers, or restrain opponents. Swing sand densely enough to repel flames and other projectiles. Exploit fluidity to slip free from grapple-type Quirks like Decay that require direct contact.

Limits:
Provides no defense against area-of-effect abilities or wide-radius attacks like Compress. Cannot protect the user's lower body or head, leaving those areas vulnerable. Sand form is still vulnerable to blunt force trauma and may scatter under extreme pressure. Requires concentration to maintain precise shapes; rapid shape-shifting drains stamina.

Additional Notes:
Most effective against contact-dependent Quirks and single-target attacks. Strategic weakness to elemental or crowd-control abilities that don't rely on grabbing. User's combat skill and creativity determine sand manipulation effectiveness in battle.

cardPool.title: Scalemail
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Scalemail

Description:
The user's body generates sharp, dark red armored scales that cover their skin, providing enhanced physical defense and strength. Activating the scales causes bleeding as they rupture through the skin, making each deployment painful.

Functions/Applications:
Deploy scales across the body for increased durability against strikes and physical attacks. The scales grant moderate strength enhancement, allowing the user to hit harder and withstand impacts. Can be selectively activated on specific body areas or full-body coverage.

Limits:
The scales shatter under sustained high-force impact, particularly from powerful punches or combined attacks. Generating the armor causes physical pain and bleeding each time activated. Effectiveness may be reduced if the user's body is incompatible with the Quirk. Repeated use risks severe blood loss and exhaustion from rupturing skin.

Additional Notes:
This Quirk was stolen and implanted into its current user by All For One, suggesting it may perform differently in its original owner's body. Durability is significant against standard attacks but fails against concentrated power. The pain cost makes prolonged deployment strategically risky.

cardPool.title: Scales
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Scales

Description:
The user generates hard, sharp reptilian scales across their body that serve as both protective armor and ranged ammunition. Scale production requires adequate collagen and calcium intake. The scales are naturally weaponized—sharp enough to cut through vines and damage metal—making them effective for both defense and offense.

Functions/Applications:
Deploy scales as full-body armor for damage mitigation during close combat. Launch individual scales as cutting projectiles with exceptional accuracy at medium to long range. Switch seamlessly between melee and ranged combat depending on enemy distance and threat level. Scales can be stored in specialized gauntlets to enable rapid-fire projectile attacks similar to automatic weaponry.

Limits:
Scales break or dislodge relatively easily when struck with sufficient force, providing inferior protection compared to hardening-based quirks. Continuous scale production depletes collagen and calcium reserves, requiring dietary supplementation. Projectile accuracy depends on user skill and line of sight. Gauntlets have storage capacity limits before requiring regeneration time.

Additional Notes:
Hiryu Rin demonstrates remarkable accuracy, capable of striking small targets without collateral damage. The quirk's versatility enables adaptability across combat ranges, though sustained use requires nutritional awareness.

cardPool.title: Scanning
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Scanning

Description:
A detection-based Quirk that grants the user the ability to identify and analyze other individuals' Quirks and power levels. The user perceives targets through a heat signature-like visual overlay, revealing their Quirk nature and current strength output.

Functions/Applications:
Identify active Quirks in nearby targets. Measure relative power levels and detect power surges or deliberate strength increases. Create tactical advantages in combat by understanding enemy abilities before engagement. Track multiple targets simultaneously through visual scanning.

Limits:
Cannot identify Quirks if the user cannot see the target. Effectiveness decreases with distance and obstructions. Cannot reveal Quirk limitations or specific mechanics, only that a Quirk is present and its general power tier. Sustained scanning causes mental fatigue with prolonged use.

Additional Notes:
Originally stolen from an unknown hero, this Quirk is invaluable for reconnaissance and team coordination. The heat signature visualization requires active concentration and is disrupted by sensory interference or environmental distortions.

cardPool.title: Scatter
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Scatter

Description:
A stolen Quirk that allows the user to split and multiply projectiles mid-flight, dramatically expanding their coverage area and destructive potential. Originally used by Tomura Shigaraki during combat against Star and Stripe, this Quirk transforms focused attacks into devastating dispersed barrages.

Functions/Applications:
Multiplies incoming or outgoing projectiles into numerous smaller ones across a wider radius. Increases effective range and impact area of long-range attacks. Can be combined with other Quirks like Reflect to redirect and amplify enemy fire. Effective for overwhelming defenses and area denial.

Limits:
Requires projectiles to function—cannot create attacks from nothing. Multiplied projectiles are individually weaker than the original. Does not enhance melee combat. Effectiveness diminishes against mobile or evasive targets. Cannot be used continuously without a source of projectiles to split.

Additional Notes:
This is a stolen Quirk, suggesting the user lacks innate mastery and may face unpredictable limitations. Best utilized in mid-to-long range engagements. Synergizes well with reflection-based or projectile-generating abilities. Strategic timing is crucial for maximum impact.

cardPool.title: Serpentress
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Serpentress

Description:
The user possesses three living serpents integrated into their hair as biological extensions. These snakes possess heightened sensory perception, allowing the user to detect hidden targets and locate disaster victims through enhanced detection capabilities beyond normal human limits.

Functions/Applications:
The snakes can scout ahead and sense the presence of concealed individuals or survivors in dangerous environments. They enable rapid victim location during rescue operations and provide reconnaissance advantages in stealth situations. The snakes move independently under the user's control while remaining part of their body.

Limits:
The snakes cannot be separated from the user's body for extended periods. Their offensive capabilities remain unclear and possibly limited. Detection range is constrained by the snakes' sensory reach, and they cannot pierce physical barriers like dense earth or sealed structures. The user cannot operate effectively while unconscious or restrained at the head.

Additional Notes:
Serpentress is primarily a utility Quirk designed for reconnaissance and rescue operations rather than direct combat. The snakes' exact offensive potential and maximum sensory range should be determined by campaign context. This Quirk requires the user to maintain control and focus to effectively utilize the snakes' abilities.

cardPool.title: Shame
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Shame

Description:
A transformation Quirk that amplifies the user's physical power in direct proportion to their embarrassment level. The user becomes exponentially stronger as shame intensifies, with peak power achieved through extreme public humiliation or exposure.

Functions/Applications:
The user can strip clothing and expose themselves to crowds to trigger maximum embarrassment and unlock full combat potential. Shame-induced power boost enhances strength, speed, and durability. Works best in populated areas where witnesses amplify the user's mortification.

Limits:
Requires public presence and audience to generate sufficient embarrassment; ineffective in isolation or with no witnesses. Power is weak or absent when the user feels no shame. Sustained use causes extreme psychological distress. The Quirk is impractical in stealth or covert missions due to its exposure requirement.

Additional Notes:
User must overcome natural inhibitions to activate the Quirk effectively. Power scales with intensity of public observation and ridicule. Combat effectiveness depends heavily on the user's willingness to endure social humiliation. Best suited for direct confrontation rather than tactical engagements.

cardPool.title: Shield
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Shield

Description:
The user manifests stone-like hexagonal shields from their body, constructed from rapidly multiplying geometric layers. These shields are exceptionally durable and can be wielded defensively or offensively with sharp, cutting edges. The user can detach and throw shields as ranged weapons or keep them anchored for defense.

Functions/Applications:
Create shields of variable size and shape by controlling hexagon multiplication; detach shields to throw as mid-to-long-range projectiles with considerable force; stack multiple small shields on legs and torso for passive armor; extend shield geometry into unconventional shapes to protect multiple allies simultaneously; use shields offensively at close range by driving sharpened edges into targets, then detaching them to cause internal damage.

Limits:
Shield durability, while exceptional, can be overwhelmed by sufficiently powerful attacks from elite-tier opponents. Creating oversized or complex shield configurations likely requires greater concentration and energy expenditure. The user cannot generate shields faster than their hexagon multiplication rate allows. Detached shields cannot be remotely controlled after throwing.

Additional Notes:
This Quirk excels at supporting group combat through defensive coverage and tactical positioning. The user's proficiency depends heavily on combat awareness and spatial control rather than raw power output.

cardPool.title: Shoulder-Mounted Jets
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Shoulder-Mounted Jets

Description:
Four retractable jet boosters mounted on the user's upper back enable high-speed flight. The jets provide powerful thrust for rapid acceleration and aerial movement, though sustained control requires significant effort and coordination.

Functions/Applications:
Grants speed-boosted flight for traversal and aerial combat positioning. Jets can be deployed or retracted at will. Allows quick escapes or pursuit of airborne targets. Works in conjunction with other physical quirks to stabilize mid-air maneuvers.

Limits:
Flight is difficult to maneuver precisely without additional support quirks. Requires the user's arms or other abilities to maintain balance and directional control during extended flight. Jets likely consume stamina with prolonged use. Cannot be used effectively while fully restrained or immobilized.

Additional Notes:
This quirk is most effective when paired with stabilizing or manipulative abilities. Hood relies on his Transforming Arms Quirk to assist in controlling his trajectory mid-flight, suggesting the jets alone lack fine maneuverability. The jet boosters are durable enough for combat use but appear vulnerable if directly damaged.

cardPool.title: Size
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Size

Description:
A transmutation quirk that allows the user to alter the physical dimensions of inanimate objects through tactile contact. When activated by pressing five fingertips together, targeted objects glow pink and shift to the desired size—larger or smaller. The quirk is precise and reliable on non-living matter.

Functions/Applications:
Resize weapons, tools, or environmental objects to gain tactical advantage in combat or puzzle-solving. Enlarge barriers for defense or shrink obstacles for passage. Create size disparities to confuse opponents or manipulate battlefield terrain. Useful for carrying or concealing large items by reducing their dimensions.

Limits:
The quirk cannot affect living organisms, including people, animals, or plants with life. Activation requires deliberate hand positioning—pressing all five fingertips together—making it unsuitable for rapid-fire use. Objects return to original size when the user's contact breaks, limiting sustained applications. No stated limit on how large or small objects can become, but extreme size changes may require more concentration.

Additional Notes:
The pink glow of affected objects serves as a visible tell of quirk activation, removing surprise factor. Best suited for strategic rather than direct combat roles. Works only on matter the user can physically touch and manipulate.

cardPool.title: Slice
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Slice

Description:
The user can move, harden, and sharpen their own hair at will, transforming it into a versatile weapon and tool. Hair can be weaponized as blades, fired as needle-like projectiles, or used defensively as shields and mobility aids.

Functions/Applications:
Offensive strikes using hardened hair as cutting blades; launching individual hair strands as high-speed piercing projectiles capable of puncturing boats and detonating structures; defensive barriers by interweaving hair into shields; parrying incoming attacks; mobility enhancement using thick hair locks as stilts or climbing aids.

Limits:
Hair retains its natural chemical vulnerability and can be destroyed by corrosive substances like acid. Reduced hair length directly decreases combat effectiveness and firing range. Hair cannot be regrown mid-combat, making attrition a serious tactical concern. Requires conscious control to harden and shape hair, limiting reaction speed in surprise situations.

Additional Notes:
Slice excels in versatile close-to-mid-range combat with strong defensive utility. The quirk's effectiveness is heavily dependent on hair maintenance and length preservation, making it vulnerable to area-denial strategies using caustic agents or extreme heat. Best used by strategic fighters who manage resources carefully.

cardPool.title: Sloshed
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Sloshed

Description:
An aura-based Quirk that induces severe vertigo and loss of equilibrium in anyone within the user's vicinity, simulating acute intoxication. Affected targets struggle with balance, coordination, and purposeful movement.

Functions/Applications:
The user can selectively activate the effect on chosen targets while maintaining immunity for allies. They can conceal themselves while the Quirk manifests, allowing undetected disorientation of enemies. The effect persists briefly even if the user loses consciousness.

Limits:
The Quirk requires proximity to function—maintaining distance negates its effects entirely. Targets with prior exposure or accustomed to disorientation can gradually resist the inebriating sensation. Strong-willed individuals may fight through the effects with concentrated effort.

Additional Notes:
This Quirk excels at area denial and disrupting enemy coordination rather than direct damage. It works best against unprepared opponents unfamiliar with equilibrium disturbance. Users should employ stealth and positioning to maximize effectiveness before enemies adjust to the sensation.

cardPool.title: Smile
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Smile

Description:
A vision-based incapacitation Quirk that forces targets into uncontrollable laughter lasting two hours. Activation requires the user to display their teeth directly to a victim, or via real-time reflection (mirror, video, holographic projection). The laughter completely immobilizes targets, leaving them barely able to move or fight.

Functions/Applications:
Forces involuntary incapacitation through laughter; works on humans and machines (causing short circuits). User can create distance advantage using holographic tooth projectors. Victims may lose Quirk control during the effect. Some strong-willed individuals can resist psychological effects but remain physically immobilized.

Limits:
Completely ineffective if target's vision is obscured or blocked; limited effective range without technological aid. Requires direct line of sight or real-time visual transmission. Does not work on those who cannot see the user's teeth display. Highly resistant individuals like ice-users can partially resist the compulsion but still suffer physical incapacity.

Additional Notes:
Duration of two hours makes escape or objectives extremely viable. Powerful against law enforcement and multiple opponents simultaneously. Effectiveness diminishes dramatically at distance without equipment. Particularly dangerous against unsuspecting or visually-dependent combatants. Some individuals may knock themselves unconscious resisting the effect rather than laugh.

cardPool.title: Smoke
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Smoke

Description:
The user expels irritating pink smoke from holes across their body, creating dense screens that obscure vision and cause eye irritation. An antenna atop their head can fire concentrated smoke bursts directly at targets.

Functions/Applications:
Generate thick smoke barriers for concealment and escape; launch focused smoke attacks via antenna to distract or disorient enemies; exploit reduced visibility to mount surprise attacks or flee confrontations; cause eye irritation in close quarters to gain tactical advantage.

Limits:
Smoke disperses naturally over time and cannot persist indefinitely; ineffective against opponents who don't rely on sight or can navigate smoke; requires the antenna to be unobstructed for direct attacks; user remains vulnerable when smoke clears; heavily dependent on environmental factors like wind.

Additional Notes:
Primarily a utility Quirk favored for evasion and misdirection rather than direct combat. Most effective in urban or enclosed environments where smoke accumulates. User's mobility and cunning are essential to maximize this Quirk's potential.

cardPool.title: Smokescreen
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Smokescreen

Description:
The user generates thick purple smoke from their body that spreads across wide areas to obscure vision and disorient opponents. The smoke can be emitted from the mouth as a breath weapon. Enhanced through One For All's stockpiling, making it denser and more expansive than the original user's version.

Functions/Applications:
Creates a visual obstruction to hide movements, catch enemies by surprise, or guide them toward desired locations. Can be combined with other abilities for tactical advantage. Useful for reconnaissance and escape when paired with mobility Quirks like Float.

Limits:
No offensive damage capability and cannot reach Ultimate Move level. Loses effectiveness in humid or rainy environments where it dissipates rapidly. Powerful shockwaves dispel the smoke quickly. User can become disoriented if releasing excessive amounts without preparation. Overuse obscures the user's own vision and movement.

Additional Notes:
Most effective when deployed strategically rather than defensively. Works best in combination with other Quirks to maximize tactical potential. Requires experience to control output and prevent self-hindrance. Environmental conditions significantly impact reliability and coverage duration.

cardPool.title: Snip Clip
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Snip Clip

Description:
The user can cut through nearly any material by placing it between their index and middle fingers, then performing a scissor motion. The cutting force is proportional to the user's strength and can sever solid objects like reinforced exoskeletons. Larger cuts are possible when material is positioned between the user's legs.

Functions/Applications:
Precision cutting of objects, armor, and structural materials. Can disable mechanical suits by severing limbs or joints. Useful for environmental manipulation, creating openings, or disarming opponents. Works on organic and inorganic matter alike.

Limits:
The space between the user's fingers severely restricts what can be cut—only thin or narrow objects fit. Cutting larger items requires repositioning between the legs, leaving the user vulnerable. The Quirk cannot cut beyond the user's physical reach. Effectiveness depends on the user's strength and leverage.

Additional Notes:
This Quirk excels at tactical dismantling but struggles against very thick or wide objects. The user must maintain contact and positioning to execute cuts, making it ineffective at range. Most useful against armored or mechanical opponents rather than highly mobile targets.

cardPool.title: Soccer
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Soccer

Description:
