Emperor Yotsuura's enigmatic quirk grants superhuman soccer mastery, enabling flawless ball control in chaotic environments while executing other actions simultaneously. The user can kick with devastating force, weaponizing the ball into a projectile capable of serious harm.

Functions/Applications:
Dribble through crowds without obstruction or loss of control; execute complex maneuvers while committing theft or other tasks; deliver powerful kicks that transform the ball into a dangerous projectile; maintain perfect spatial awareness during play.

Limits:
Effectiveness questionable—may not be a true Quirk but rather exceptional skill. Requires a ball to function offensively; useless in situations where the ball is unavailable or restricted. Power scaling unclear; distance and impact force limitations unknown. Cannot function if unable to move freely.

Additional Notes:
The nature of this Quirk remains disputed among quirk analysts, suggesting it borders on being a supernatural ability versus trained expertise. Best suited for misdirection, crowd navigation, and ranged attacks during chaotic situations.

cardPool.title: Softening
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Softening

Description:
Juzo Honenuki can transform any solid object into a semi-liquid mud-like state through touch, then revert it back with a second touch. The effect works on ice, metal, stone, and structures but cannot affect living beings. Softened materials trap and sink anything caught upon them, becoming treacherous terrain.

Functions/Applications:
Creates environmental traps by softening ground or structures that appear solid but collapse when stepped on. Restricts enemy mobility and movement options. Allows Juzo to swim through softened material for rapid battlefield traversal or escape. Can neutralize attacks composed of solid substances. Excellent for controlling battle flow and dictating enemy positioning.

Limits:
Cannot affect living organisms or their bodies. Targets with propulsion abilities or devices can escape softened traps. All softened objects revert to solid form if Juzo loses consciousness. Requires direct physical contact to activate and deactivate effects. Works best against mobility-dependent enemies and loses effectiveness against opponents unaffected by terrain changes.

Additional Notes:
Pairs well with Juzo's excellent reflexes for defensive countering. Functions as both offensive trap-laying tool and defensive escape mechanism. Range is great but depends on what solid materials are available in the environment.

cardPool.title: Solid Air
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Solid Air

Description:
The user solidifies air through breath to create floating constructs—walls, platforms, and barriers—that remain suspended without support. These barriers are soundproof, blocking voice-based abilities and external noise. Construct durability scales with the user's lung capacity and training.

Functions/Applications:
Create defensive walls and platforms mid-air for mobility or protection. Form soundproof enclosures to contain or isolate targets, silencing their voices. Shape constructs into complex forms like cubes or barriers by hand-shaping exhaled air. Adapt barriers to counter sound-dependent quirks.

Limits:
Durability increases with experience but remains breakable by sufficient physical force. Maximum construct size limited by lung capacity—prolonged use causes fatigue. Cannot create animated or mobile constructs; all formations are static. Requires conscious breath control; suffocation or breathlessness disables the quirk entirely.

Additional Notes:
Early barriers are relatively fragile but become substantially more resilient with training and refinement. Soundproofing property makes this quirk especially effective against vocally-dependent opponents. The transparency of constructs provides tactical advantage by obscuring their presence visually.

cardPool.title: Somnambulist
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Somnambulist

Description:
The user exudes a sleep-inducing lavender-purple aroma from their skin that renders targets unconscious. The fragrance is significantly more potent against males than females, requiring greater concentration to affect women. Anyone breathing in sufficient amounts falls into deep slumber, making close-range combat hazardous for opponents.

Functions/Applications:
Release aroma passively or actively to incapacitate enemies at medium range. Use hand fans or support items to spread and direct the fragrance with greater accuracy and distance. Effective crowd control tool for preventing dangerous actions or subduing opponents immune to physical damage. Can be concentrated for stronger effect on resistant targets.

Limits:
Requires the user's skin to be exposed; tight clothing reduces effectiveness and takes time to remove. Opponents with air-filtering masks or who cover their mouths avoid the aroma entirely. Significantly less effective against female targets unless the user concentrates extra power. Low ventilation environments improve effectiveness; open spaces reduce potency. Breath-holding provides temporary resistance.

Additional Notes:
The Quirk makes the user an excellent referee or law enforcement officer due to non-lethal incapacitation. Support items like fans enhance range and directional control. The user's appearance can paradoxically hinder effectiveness due to legal costume restrictions.

cardPool.title: Soul
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Soul

Description:
Soul manifests as Pino, a small pink bird-like creature permanently bonded to the user's soul. Pino physically embodies the user's true thoughts and feelings, making deception impossible—any lie creates a visible disconnect between the user's words and Pino's actions, revealing their genuine intent.

Functions/Applications:
Pino can be directed to perform tasks independently, such as retrieving objects or creating distractions. The user can exploit Soul's truth-telling nature strategically through feints, where Pino's honest reactions contradict false statements to confuse opponents. Pino acts autonomously based on the user's subconscious desires, even when the user is incapacitated or unaware.

Limits:
The user cannot lie effectively, severely limiting deception tactics. Any physical injury or blood loss to the user causes Pino to weaken or fade temporarily. Pino's small size and fragility limit her combat capability. The user's emotional state directly affects Pino's visibility and strength, making emotional instability a vulnerability.

Additional Notes:
While Soul appears limited, it functions as both a powerful truth-detector and a tool for reading unconscious intent. The Quirk's greatest strength lies in its paradox—the inability to hide one's thoughts becomes a tactical advantage when weaponized through calculated feints and misdirection.

cardPool.title: Spatial Excursion
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Spatial Excursion

Description:
Allows the user to freely manipulate the position and movement of objects and people within a spatial field, completely bypassing gravitational constraints. Objects can be repositioned, suspended, or propelled without physical contact.

Functions/Applications:
Reposition allies and enemies during combat; suspend falling objects or people mid-air; create spatial puzzles by rearranging environmental elements; with Overmodification enhancement, control vastly larger areas and heavier structures, including massive fortifications.

Limits:
Range and control capacity are finite—baseline ability limited to moderate distances and weights. Overmodification greatly expands these limits but requires significant power. Quirk deactivates if the user is rendered unconscious or incapacitated. Cannot affect users with certain defensive Quirks that negate external manipulation.

Additional Notes:
Most effective when user maintains consciousness and focus. Overmodification transforms this into a large-scale environmental control ability suitable for tactical warfare. Enemies should prioritize incapacitating the user to neutralize the threat.

cardPool.title: Spear Hand Missiles
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Spear Hand Missiles

Description:
The user's fingers are compact, reloadable missiles that can be fired from their hands. Each digit detaches and launches as a projectile, making the user a living ranged weapon system with rapid-fire capability.

Functions/Applications:
Fire individual finger missiles in quick succession for suppressive fire or focused attacks. The projectiles are fast-moving and can stun targets or cause injury on direct hits, including bloody noses and knockdowns. Effective for mid-range combat and covering retreats.

Limits:
Flight paths are highly erratic and unpredictable, making accuracy difficult without training. Projectiles are easily blocked by objects or defensive Quirks with minimal damage to the barrier. User is vulnerable while reloading fingers and cannot use hands for melee combat while firing. Limited ammunition—fingers must regenerate between engagements.

Additional Notes:
Best suited for aggressive combatants who can overwhelm opponents with volume of fire rather than precision. Requires tactical positioning to maximize effectiveness. Works poorly against agile or defensive opponents who can dodge or block consistently.

cardPool.title: Spearlike Bones
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Spearlike Bones

Description:
The user generates cone-shaped bone spears from any part of their body, including the mouth, jaw, and limbs. These spears are sharp, hard, and capable of piercing flesh with ease. The user can control the size, length, and quantity of spears produced.

Functions/Applications:
Deploy spears as melee weapons or ranged projectiles in combat. Generate multiple spears simultaneously for area attacks. Manifest spears from unexpected body parts to bypass defenses or create diversionary strikes. Scale spear dimensions for different tactical situations, from small piercing attacks to large impaling weapons.

Limits:
Spear generation requires conscious activation and focus. The user cannot generate spears faster than they can consciously direct. Extended or massive spear production drains stamina. Spears, once separated from the body, are brittle and can be destroyed or caught. The Quirk is ineffective against opponents with superior defensive abilities or those who can neutralize projectiles.

Additional Notes:
Initially manifests as uncontrolled hardened growths until the user masters control. Works effectively when combined with other combat Quirks or strategies. The spears are biological projections, not infinite in number per activation cycle. Most effective at close to mid-range combat distances.

cardPool.title: Spotted Seal
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Spotted Seal

Description:
The user embodies all physical and biological capabilities of a spotted seal, granting amphibious prowess. Enhanced strength and agility function equally well on land and in water, while aquatic abilities far exceed human limits.

Functions/Applications:
Enhanced strength allows overwhelming melee combat and environmental manipulation. Amphibious agility enables rapid evasion and positioning. Underwater echolocation maps large areas and detects threats through sound. Prolonged breath-holding and 1500-meter diving access deep locations. High-pitched vocalizations communicate across distances and through water.

Limits:
Echolocation only functions underwater. Enhanced attributes diminish effectiveness in extreme temperatures or toxic environments. Prolonged land use without water immersion causes strain. Vulnerability to sound-based attacks due to sensitive hearing. Cannot breathe underwater despite seal physiology.

Additional Notes:
Best suited for reconnaissance, rescue operations, and aquatic combat scenarios. Synergizes with hearing-based allies. Primary weakness is extended dry-land engagement where seal physiology becomes disadvantageous.

cardPool.title: Spray Art
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Spray Art

Description:
The user generates clouds of colorful spray paint that induce mild hallucinations in anyone caught within them. By wielding spray paint cans, they release massive paint clouds similar to smoke that linger until deliberately dispersed or the user is incapacitated.

Functions/Applications:
Create disorienting illusions to confuse enemies and obscure vision. Control cloud duration and deployment area. Use hallucinations to separate groups or create tactical advantages in combat. Useful for escape, misdirection, or area denial.

Limits:
The user must have spray paint cans available to activate the Quirk. Hallucinations are only mild, not complete mental incapacity. Clouds dissipate if the user is immobilized or rendered unconscious. The Quirk affects allies as well as enemies within the cloud. Effectiveness diminishes against those with strong mental resistance.

Additional Notes:
This Quirk emphasizes battlefield control and confusion tactics over direct damage. The user retains awareness within their own clouds, making positioning critical. Duration appears indefinite while active, granting sustained pressure if the user remains mobile.

cardPool.title: Spring
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Spring

Description:
Spring grants the user the ability to imbue objects and surfaces with elasticity, making them bounce with enhanced recoil. The effect can be applied to both inanimate objects and potentially environmental terrain, creating unpredictable rebounds and impacts.

Functions/Applications:
The user can make floors, walls, weapons, or projectiles bounce with increased force and resilience. This allows for creative combat tactics such as ricocheting attacks, creating springy platforms for mobility, or deflecting incoming strikes. The bouncy effect persists until the user chooses to revoke it.

Limits:
Spring cannot be applied to living beings or organic matter directly. The bouncy effect requires prior contact or proximity to activate. Overuse or applying the quirk to too many objects simultaneously may cause fatigue. The intensity and duration of the bounce effect appear limited by the user's concentration.

Additional Notes:
Spring is relatively obscure and rarely documented in combat scenarios. While useful for creative problem-solving, it lacks offensive potency compared to combat-specialized quirks. The true potential of Spring remains largely unexplored due to its niche user base.

cardPool.title: Springlike Limbs
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Springlike Limbs

Description:
The user's muscles coil and contract like mechanical springs, storing kinetic force and releasing it explosively. When activated, black lightning with red outlines may crackle around the limbs. This Quirk transforms the body into a living coil mechanism.

Functions/Applications:
Launch objects or people with devastating force at close range. Propel the user through the air for rapid movement or escape. Amplify the power of other Quirks when combined, particularly emitter-type abilities like Air Cannon. Use as a solo combat tool or as a force multiplier.

Limits:
Requires close proximity for maximum effect. The stored force must be released deliberately—cannot be maintained indefinitely without fatigue. Effectiveness depends on muscle condition and physical stamina. Works best when augmenting other attacks rather than standalone use.

Additional Notes:
Originally stolen by All For One and later used by Tomura Shigaraki. The black lightning manifestation appears inconsistently between users. Most powerful when paired with complementary Quirks to compound damage output.

cardPool.title: Squirmy Fingers
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Squirmy Fingers

Description:
The user gains supernatural control over their fingers, allowing them to bend and manipulate them in any direction with perfect precision and grace. This grants exceptional dexterity and fine motor control far beyond normal human capability.

Functions/Applications:
Craft intricate mechanisms and detailed work with unmatched speed and accuracy. Manipulate small objects with flawless control. Create complex Hero Costumes and advanced equipment. Pick locks or perform delicate assembly tasks that would be impossible for ordinary hands.

Limits:
Only affects the user's fingers—cannot extend control beyond the hands themselves. Requires direct physical contact with objects to manipulate them. Provides no offensive combat capability. The user acknowledges it as "barely useful" in direct conflict situations.

Additional Notes:
Best suited for crafting, engineering, and support roles rather than direct combat. The Quirk's true value lies in creation and construction rather than heroic combat applications. User is non-combatant despite the Quirk's practical utility.

cardPool.title: Static
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Static

Description:
By rubbing their body to generate friction, the user accumulates electrical charge similar to natural static electricity. This allows them to discharge electrical currents from their body in controlled bursts. The charge remains relatively modest in power compared to more developed electrical quirks.

Functions/Applications:
The user can build up electrical energy through deliberate friction against their skin or clothing, then release it as a shock for stunning, repelling, or disorienting targets. Useful for short-range combat, defense, or incapacitating nearby opponents temporarily.

Limits:
Requires active charging time through rubbing to accumulate power—cannot generate charge instantly. Output damage is relatively weak and unsuitable for heavy combat or armored foes. Extended use causes fatigue. Wet conditions severely diminish or neutralize the quirk's effectiveness.

Additional Notes:
This quirk demands tactical patience and preparation rather than spontaneous activation. Most effective in dry environments against unarmored or lightly-armored opponents. The user must remain mobile and maintain composure during the charging phase to avoid interruption.

cardPool.title: Steel
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Steel

Description:
The user transforms their entire body into steel, becoming a nigh-impenetrable living weapon. The steel form dramatically increases physical strength to superhuman levels while providing exceptional resistance to physical damage, extreme cold, and moderate heat (with training). The user's body takes on a metallic sheen, turning reddish when exposed to flames.

Functions/Applications:
Tetsutetsu can withstand bullets, blades, falling debris, and extreme cold without injury. His enhanced strength allows him to break through most obstacles and deliver powerful close-range strikes. He can serve as a human shield to protect allies. Iron intake from food extends duration and potency of Steel activation.

Limits:
Prolonged use causes iron fatigue, gradually reducing the quirk's hardness until deactivation is necessary. Steel has a hardness ceiling that cannot be improved through training, unlike similar abilities. Poisonous gas and toxic vapors remain effective since breathing is required. Extreme heat can potentially melt the steel form without sufficient prior training. The quirk does not protect against all damage types.

Additional Notes:
Steel functions similarly to hardening-type quirks but lacks the potential for unlimited improvement that other comparable abilities possess. The user benefits from iron-rich diets and heat-resistance training to maximize effectiveness.

cardPool.title: Stiffening
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Stiffening

Description:
By touching and kneading objects with both hands, the user hardens any non-living material to extreme durability—transforming soft items like rubber into concrete-hard substances capable of shattering rock when thrown.

Functions/Applications:
Reinforces projectiles, tools, and structural materials for combat or construction. Works synergistically with boomerang-type attacks. Can compact and strengthen multiple objects simultaneously through hand manipulation.

Limits:
Cannot affect living tissue or organic beings. Hardened objects remain vulnerable to acids and corrosive substances. Requires direct physical contact and kneading motion—cannot harden objects at distance. Viscous or sticky materials can trap hardened items.

Additional Notes:
Most effective when paired with throwing weapons or ranged combat styles. User must use both hands to activate the Quirk, limiting simultaneous actions. The harder the original material, the greater the end durability achieved.

cardPool.title: Stock
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Stock

Description:
A storage-based quirk that allows the user to absorb incoming attacks and convert them into physical lumps on their back. These stored attacks can be released at will during combat, giving the user tactical flexibility and counteroffensive capability.

Functions/Applications:
The user devours incoming attacks to absorb their energy, which manifests as a lump on their back. When needed, the lump detaches and floats toward the user's face before releasing the absorbed attack at an opponent. This enables defense-turned-offense strategies and the ability to retaliate with an enemy's own force.

Limits:
Storage capacity is limited by the number of lumps the user can grow on their back. Each stored attack takes physical space, constraining how many can be accumulated. The floating lump requires time to position before releasing, making it vulnerable to interruption. Attacks must make direct contact to be absorbed.

Additional Notes:
Stock excels at turning defensive situations into offensive advantages by weaponizing enemy force. The quirk's effectiveness depends on absorbing powerful attacks; weak strikes provide minimal tactical benefit. The user must maintain awareness of their back's storage capacity during prolonged combat.

cardPool.title: Storage
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Storage

Description:
A containment-based Quirk that allows the user to store objects and living creatures inside their body, preserving them in a suspended state. The user can carry multiple specimens simultaneously and release them at will as tactical reinforcements or distractions.

Functions/Applications:
Store inorganic objects, living creatures, and biological entities within body cavity without harm to either party. Release stored contents instantly during combat or ambushes. Proven effective for deploying multiple reinforcements in rapid succession while engaging primary targets.

Limits:
Storage capacity appears to have an upper threshold, though exact maximum remains unclear. Retrieving items requires conscious activation—cannot be forced or stolen while stored. Storing living creatures risks alerting allies to hidden reserves through sounds or movements. Size limitations unknown but likely restrict very large organisms.

Additional Notes:
Ideal for surprise tactics and overwhelming opponents through numerical advantage. User remains mobile despite carrying cargo. Effectiveness depends heavily on what is stored and tactical deployment timing rather than raw power.

cardPool.title: Stress
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Stress

Description:
Converts negative emotions—anger, dread, frustration, and stress—into raw physical power. The user's body swells with black markings spreading across enhanced areas, granting increased strength, resilience, and size proportional to emotional intensity. Can enhance individual limbs or the entire body simultaneously.

Functions/Applications:
Selective limb enhancement for precision strikes or full-body transformation for overwhelming power. At high intensity (80%+ "Liberation"), manifests as a hulking monster form capable of releasing concentrated stress energy projectiles. Scales dynamically with opponent threat level; user can modulate enhancement percentage for efficient power usage.

Limits:
Positive emotions—peace, relief, confidence—actively diminish stress levels and weaken the ability. Requires constant negative emotional state for peak performance, making prolonged use psychologically taxing. Physical anchors (prosthetics, injuries) can restrict the ability's full potential by failing to support increased mass and power output.

Additional Notes:
Prolonged reliance on this quirk causes severe side effects including male pattern baldness and emotional instability. User must carefully balance power needs against mental health deterioration. Most effective against durability-based opponents; maneuverability decreases significantly in maximum transformation state.

cardPool.title: Strongarm
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Strongarm

Description:
The user's shoulders rotate at superhuman speeds, enabling them to unleash rapid, devastatingly powerful punches in quick succession. Each strike carries immense force capable of wearing down even defensive Quirk users through sheer shock impact.

Functions/Applications:
Rapid-fire punching combinations with extreme velocity and power. Can penetrate defenses through accumulated strike trauma. Effective for close-range combat against armored or durable opponents.

Limits:
Usable for only a few seconds before muscle fatigue sets in. Excessive use causes severe muscular exhaustion. Cannot break through absolute barrier-type Quirks. Shoulder joints require recovery time between uses.

Additional Notes:
Best suited for short, explosive engagements rather than prolonged battles. User must manage stamina carefully to avoid complete physical incapacity mid-combat.

cardPool.title: Sugar Rush
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Sugar Rush

Description:
By consuming sugar, Rikido multiplies his physical strength five-fold for three minutes per ten grams ingested. His body visibly bulks up during activation, converting glucose into raw muscle power.

Functions/Applications:
Ideal for breaking through obstacles, overpowering opponents in direct combat, and sustained heavy lifting. Rikido carries granulated sugar in belt pouches for quick activation mid-battle. His baking skills provide reliable sugar sources for extended hero work.

Limits:
Requires sugar consumption to activate—useless without accessible sugar sources. Activation causes severe hypoglycemia: lowered intelligence, reduced cognitive function, and lethargy during the three-minute boost. Cannot be sustained beyond the duration without additional sugar intake. Rikido becomes a straightforward brawler unable to execute complex strategies while empowered.

Additional Notes:
Rikido's weightlifting regimen while consuming sweets has maximized his Quirk's potency. The effect duration and strength multiplier scale directly with sugar quantity consumed, making careful rationing essential for prolonged conflicts.

cardPool.title: Suicide Bomb
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Suicide Bomb

Description:
A volatile Quirk that allows the user to generate devastating explosions centered on their body. The exact mechanism remains unclear, but the ability creates massive destructive force capable of razing entire areas. The explosions can be triggered by the user's will or external sources.

Functions/Applications:
Deploy large-scale area-denial explosions for combat or destruction. The Quirk functions as both offensive weapon and potential last-resort defensive measure. External triggers like intense heat can activate detonations involuntarily.

Limits:
The user is vulnerable to the explosions they create and can suffer lethal damage from their own Quirk activation. Fire-based Quirks that can control heat externally pose severe matchup disadvantages, as they risk accidental detonation. The Quirk appears uncontrollable once triggered by outside sources.

Additional Notes:
This Quirk represents extreme danger to both user and environment. Requires careful strategic use to avoid self-destruction. Most effective as a last-stand tactic rather than sustained combat ability.

cardPool.title: Super Regeneration
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Super Regeneration

Description:
A rare and artificially engineered Quirk that enables the user to rapidly regenerate any physical damage to their body, including severed limbs and catastrophic wounds. The regeneration occurs at incredible speeds, making users exceptionally difficult to permanently disable through conventional injury.

Functions/Applications:
The user can recover from nearly any physical trauma—burns, lacerations, amputation, blunt force damage—as long as their brain remains active and undamaged. Regeneration speed scales with the user's physical condition; a fully prepared body regenerates faster than an unprepared one. Allows survival from attacks that would instantly kill most combatants.

Limits:
The Quirk cannot heal pre-existing cauterized wounds, spiritual damage, or damage to Quirk Factors themselves. Regeneration requires active brain function; unconsciousness or brain destruction halts healing entirely. Damage dealt faster than regeneration can occur will eventually overwhelm the user. Complete incineration or molecular disintegration bypasses regeneration entirely. Killing the user through non-physical means (heart stoppage, suffocation) circumvents the Quirk. An incompletely prepared body experiences dramatically slower regeneration rates.

Additional Notes:
Super Regeneration is considered one of the most dangerous Quirks due to its near-invulnerability potential. Targeting the head is the most reliable method to disable users.

cardPool.title: Swan
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Swan

Description:
The user manifests two large, pristine white wings resembling those of a swan on their back. These wings enable aerial locomotion, granting the ability to soar through the skies with grace and speed.

Functions/Applications:
Flight across distances and terrain. Enhanced mobility for escape, pursuit, or reconnaissance. The wings are powerful enough to generate significant wind gusts when deployed.

Limits:
Flight requires the user to strip naked first, as clothing weight prevents takeoff. The user cannot maintain flight while clothed. Wings are vulnerable to damage during flight, leaving the user defenseless mid-air if injured.

Additional Notes:
The quirk's awkward activation requirement makes it impractical in combat or emergencies. Best suited for scouting or travel in private settings. The user's vulnerability while unclothed makes sustained flight a tactical disadvantage.

cardPool.title: Sword Kill
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Sword Kill

Description:
The user generates flexible, accordion-like swords from their arms and shoulders that extend and retract at will. When enhanced by Trigger, the Quirk produces up to six blades simultaneously, including from the mouth, and the user's face becomes more serpentine and menacing.

Functions/Applications:
Deploy multiple melee weapons for combat versatility, defense, or crowd control. Extended blades allow mid-range strikes while maintaining close-quarters capability. Trigger enhancement multiplies offensive potential for overwhelming assault.

Limits:
Base form limited to two primary swords. Continuous blade generation taxes stamina. Trigger dependence creates vulnerability without enhancement and potential addiction/instability. Accordion flexibility reduces blade rigidity compared to solid weapons.

Additional Notes:
Blade retraction speed and extension range scale with user control and experience. Trigger enhancement is temporary and may alter user judgment. The serpentine transformation suggests possible psychological side effects from prolonged enhancement use.

cardPool.title: Tape
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name: Tape

Description: The user's elbows function as biological tape dispensers, ejecting strong adhesive tape of variable length and thickness. The tape is durable enough to support body weight and restrain opponents, yet remains breakable under extreme force. Continuous overuse causes dry skin irritation.

Functions/Applications: Fire tape strands for binding and immobilizing distant targets; swing or rappel using tape anchored to surfaces; create environmental traps and blockades; shoot multiple strands simultaneously; produce double-sided adhesive tape; craft improvised tools and masks; coordinate with allies for combo effects.

Limits: Tape supply is finite per usage cycle—extended firing depletes reserves. Tape is not unbreakable and can snap under sufficient stress. Overuse causes dry skin degradation. User must manually cut tape strands with hands to reset firing. Effectiveness reduced against surfaces tape cannot adhere to.

Additional Notes: Most effective at medium range where accuracy is high. Versatile support Quirk that enables mobility, restraint, and environmental control. Synergizes well with mobility-based or levitation Quirks. User benefits from physical conditioning to increase capacity, tensile strength, and firing speed.

cardPool.title: Telekinesis
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Telekinesis

Description:
A mental power that grants the user the ability to move and manipulate inanimate objects through force of will alone, without physical contact. The user perceives and controls these objects as extensions of their mind.

Functions/Applications:
Move objects of varying sizes across distances, construct barriers or projectiles mid-combat, solve environmental puzzles by manipulating distant mechanisms, lift multiple items simultaneously during exploration or raids.

Limits:
Only affects inanimate objects; cannot move living creatures or organic matter. Control becomes difficult with larger or heavier objects. Concentration required—distraction weakens precision. Cannot be used while the user is unconscious or mentally incapacitated.

Additional Notes:
Power scales significantly when enhanced through Overmodification, allowing simultaneous control of far more objects than typical use permits. Versatility makes it effective in both combat and utility roles, though raw output depends on user's mental fortitude and focus.

cardPool.title: Telepath
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Telepath

Description:
A one-way telepathic ability allowing the user to broadcast thoughts and messages directly into the minds of others. The user can target single individuals or reach multiple people simultaneously across considerable distances.

Functions/Applications:
Send tactical instructions to allies during combat. Broadcast warnings or information across large areas. Distract enemies by projecting disorienting messages into their minds, lowering their guard and creating openings for attacks.

Limits:
Communication is strictly one-way; the user cannot hear thoughts or receive telepathic responses from targets. Effective range is unknown but limited to specific areas or groups. Cannot force actions, only deliver messages. Overuse or attempting to contact too many people simultaneously may cause mental strain.

Additional Notes:
Highly effective for battlefield coordination and psychological tactics. Useless against deaf or mentally shielded opponents. Works best when paired with direct combat abilities or coordinated team strategies.

cardPool.title: Teleportation
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Teleportation

Description:
Gil Gollini can instantly move himself and anything he touches to any location within his line of sight. Enhanced through Overmodification, his activation speed becomes dramatically faster, making him difficult to predict or counter.

Functions/Applications:
Instantaneous repositioning in combat or exploration. Transport of allies and objects by physical contact. Rapid escape from danger or tactical repositioning. Enhanced speed allows near-instantaneous consecutive teleports when overmodified.

Limits:
User must maintain clear line of sight to destination; obscured vision prevents teleportation. Cannot teleport to areas outside visual range. Environmental hazards (fire, smoke, debris) can force unsafe teleportation positions. Vision obstruction leaves user vulnerable and cornered.

Additional Notes:
Strength lies in mobility and unpredictability. Weakness exploitable through vision denial or environmental control. Overmodification significantly increases combat effectiveness but may strain the user.

cardPool.title: Telescopic
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Telescopic

Description:
The user can rapidly retract their body parts into themselves like a turtle withdrawing into its shell. Retraction is nearly instantaneous, allowing swift evasion of incoming threats. However, unretracting takes several seconds and leaves the user vulnerable during the process.

Functions/Applications:
Defensive evasion against projectiles and melee attacks; quick dodge-and-counter tactics; protection from piercing or cutting damage while retracted. Effective against fast, targeted strikes when reaction time permits.

Limits:
Unretracting is slow and leaves the user exposed and immobile. Cannot retract selectively—must withdraw entire body or specific limbs at once. Ineffective against area-of-effect attacks or sustained pressure. User remains conscious but trapped during retraction, unable to act offensively.

Additional Notes:
Best suited for defensive combat roles requiring quick reflexes. Combines well with counterattack strategies that exploit the opponent's momentum. Requires spatial awareness to position safely before unretracting.

cardPool.title: Tidal Bore
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Tidal Bore

Description:
The user expels massive quantities of water from their mouth with tremendous force. This water can be generated rapidly and in overwhelming volumes, capable of manipulating heavy objects and creating destructive floods in the surrounding area.

Functions/Applications:
Generate powerful water jets to lift or push objects of significant weight. Create widespread flooding to disrupt terrain and enemies. Use water discharge as an offensive blast or defensive barrier. The quirk's output scales with the user's emotional state, intensifying when triggered by strong stimuli like hunger.

Limits:
Water generation drains stamina quickly with prolonged use. The user cannot control the direction precisely once emotional—the quirk activates involuntarily around favorite foods, causing indiscriminate flooding. Effectiveness reduces in arid environments with limited water sources nearby. The water must originate from the user's mouth, limiting range and maneuverability.

Additional Notes:
Best suited for large-scale environmental control rather than precise combat. The quirk's involuntary activation is both a weakness and a liability in social situations. Most effective near bodies of water or in wet climates where water can be replenished naturally.

cardPool.title: Toho
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name: Toho

Description: Grants the user kaiju-like attributes, transforming them into a massive reptilian creature. The user gains enormous size and superhuman strength proportional to their enlarged form, alongside reptilian physical features.

Functions/Applications: Devastating melee combat through sheer size and strength; intimidation through monstrous appearance; crushing objects and structures; enhanced durability from thickened, scaled skin; use as a living siege weapon or tank in battle.

Limits: Extreme size makes stealth and navigation of confined spaces impossible; increased energy consumption from maintaining such a massive body; slow movement speed compared to human-sized fighters; vulnerability to tactics exploiting the quirk's lack of agility; psychological strain from monstrous transformation.

Additional Notes: The transformation appears permanent or semi-permanent rather than temporary. Effectiveness scales with the user's physical conditioning and combat experience. Best suited for direct assault roles rather than tactical flexibility.

cardPool.title: Tongue Tank
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Tongue Tank

Description:
The user's tongue transforms into a retractable tank cannon housed within their mouth. When the mouth opens, the tongue-cannon extends outward and can fire hard, rock-like projectiles with considerable force. The exact mechanism of ammunition generation remains unclear—whether the user must consume materials or produces them internally.

Functions/Applications:
Fires projectile attacks at moderate to long range. Can be deployed quickly by opening the mouth. Useful for ranged combat, area denial, or breaking through obstacles. The cannon retracts for protection when not in use.

Limits:
Projectile capacity and firing rate are unknown. The user must open their mouth to fire, creating a predictable attack pattern. Close-quarters combat is severely hampered since the tongue is transformed. Ammunition source is uncertain, potentially limiting sustained fire. The mouth remains a vulnerable target area.

Additional Notes:
Quirk manifests in young users, suggesting early-stage development potential. Practical applications depend on whether ammunition is finite or self-regenerating. Users may require tactical positioning to maximize effectiveness while maintaining defensive capability.

cardPool.title: Traject
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Traject

Description:
A trajectory manipulation quirk that allows the user to alter the path of any object or energy that passes through their bandages. By redirecting incoming attacks, projectiles, or elemental forces, the user can turn threats into advantages or shield themselves from harm.

Functions/Applications:
Redirect enemy attacks toward other targets or away from allies. Deflect high-temperature energy like fire or plasma without absorbing damage. Alter the course of moving objects mid-flight. Protect self during combat by channeling dangerous forces through bandaged areas.

Limits:
The quirk only works on objects or energy actively passing through the bandages—it cannot redirect stationary targets. Requires precise positioning and timing to intercept projectiles effectively. Extremely intense heat can overwhelm the redirection if the user lacks sufficient experience. The bandages themselves can be damaged or destroyed, disabling the quirk entirely.

Additional Notes:
Effectiveness increases with combat experience and familiarity with specific threat types. Best suited for defensive or tactical support roles rather than direct offense. Works best against ranged attacks or elemental projectiles rather than melee strikes.

cardPool.title: Transform
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Transform

Description:
The user consumes blood to perfectly replicate another person's physical appearance, voice, and clothing. One cup of blood grants approximately one day of transformation. After awakening, the user can also duplicate the quirk of emotionally close targets, provided they've studied it thoroughly.

Functions/Applications:
Perfect physical disguise including facial features, voice replication, and copied attire. Rapid appearance-switching between multiple consumed blood sources without reverting to original form. Post-awakening: Quirk duplication and blood type matching for safe transfusions with transformed individuals.

Limits:
Cannot copy personality, knowledge, or mannerisms—user must learn these separately or risk exposure. Transformation time and blood capacity are finite. Vulnerable to tainted or booby-trapped blood from other quirks. Serious damage causes partial transformation failure. Quirk copying requires emotional closeness and extensive prior study. No inherent offensive or defensive capabilities without copied quirks. User suffers compulsive blood-drinking urges with dangerous psychological consequences if suppressed.

Additional Notes:
This quirk prioritizes deception and infiltration over combat. The blood-drinking compulsion creates roleplay tension between user instinct and restraint. Effectiveness depends heavily on preparation, intelligence gathering, and emotional bonds rather than raw power.

cardPool.title: Transforming Arms
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Transforming Arms

Description:
The user reshapes their arms at will, extending them elastically for long-range strikes or splitting them to attack from multiple angles simultaneously. Arms can enlarge, harden, or transform into different shapes to suit combat needs. This Quirk grants exceptional reach and versatility in offense.

Functions/Applications:
Stretch arms to grab distant targets or objects. Enlarge fists for devastating close-range power. Split arms to surround and strike from multiple directions. Transform arms into alternative shapes like wings for aerial mobility. Combine with other Quirks or enhancements for hybrid combat styles.

Limits:
Effectiveness decreases if the user's natural fighting style conflicts with shapeshifting mechanics—rigid martial artists experience lag between transformation and execution, creating exploitable openings. Transformation speed and complexity drain stamina with extended use. Arm durability depends on how thin or spread the user stretches them.

Additional Notes:
Most effective when paired with a fighting style that embraces flexibility and unconventional approaches. Users favoring pure hand-to-hand combat may find the Quirk burdensome rather than beneficial, reducing overall combat efficiency despite raw power potential.

cardPool.title: Trap Flex
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Trap Flex

Description:
The user can flex their trapezius muscles to extraordinary degrees, allowing their shoulders to expand and completely envelop their head. This muscular contraction grants the user enhanced speed and strength beyond normal human capability.

Functions/Applications:
Provides significant boosts to physical speed and striking power. The expanded shoulder coverage offers partial defensive protection for the head and neck region. Useful for close-quarters combat, grappling, and quick evasive maneuvers.

Limits:
Strength output is modest compared to dedicated strength-based Quirks and cannot match powerhouses like One For All. Continuous flexing likely causes fatigue. The head protection is incomplete and vulnerable to direct strikes on exposed areas, particularly the back of the head where the user has no coverage.

Additional Notes:
Best suited for hit-and-run tactics rather than prolonged brawls. Effectiveness diminishes against significantly stronger opponents. Works optimally when combined with tactical positioning and speed-based strategies rather than direct power contests.

cardPool.title: Tree Frog
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Tree Frog

Description:
A frog-type Quirk that grants the user an extended, curling tongue and webbed fingers. The user develops a tadpole-like appearance with physical amphibian traits suited for climbing and aquatic environments.

Functions/Applications:
The extendable tongue can be used for grappling, manipulation of nearby objects, or adhesive climbing. Webbed fingers enhance swimming capability and grip strength on wet surfaces. The user gains improved agility in both arboreal and aquatic settings.

Limits:
The tongue extension is minimal compared to similar Quirks, limiting its reach and grappling power. Primarily useful for close-range interactions rather than long-distance attacks. Effectiveness diminishes in dry environments; the user requires moisture for optimal performance. Cannot compete with more specialized amphibian Quirks in combat scenarios.

Additional Notes:
Tree Frog is a subtle, utility-focused Quirk best suited for mobility and environmental adaptation rather than direct confrontation. The tadpole-like appearance is partially inherent but may not all stem from the Quirk itself. Users excel in jungle, swamp, or aquatic terrains but struggle in arid conditions.

cardPool.title: Tripod
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Tripod

Description:
The user manifests a fully functional third leg positioned centrally between their two natural legs. This additional limb grants enhanced stability and balance, allowing the user to maintain footing on precarious or uneven surfaces where others would falter.

Functions/Applications:
The third leg provides superior balance during combat, enables traversal of unstable terrain, and allows the user to adopt three-point stances for enhanced stability. It can be used defensively to anchor the body against knockback or offensive pressure.

Limits:
The third leg cannot move independently from the user's natural movement pattern and does not grant increased speed. It provides no enhanced strength or striking power. The user must adapt their gait and coordination to effectively utilize the extra limb, which takes practice.

Additional Notes:
While primarily a stability-based quirk, the third leg's positioning offers tactical advantages in balance-dependent scenarios. Its effectiveness is nullified on surfaces where no footing is possible and provides minimal benefit against aerial opponents.

cardPool.title: Twin Impact
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Twin Impact

Description:
Twin Impact allows the user to create a delayed secondary impact at the location of any initial strike or contact. The second impact detonates remotely at the user's command and strikes with amplified force, often several times stronger than the original blow.

Functions/Applications:
Effective against both objects and living targets. User can deliver a normal attack, then trigger a devastating secondary explosion at the exact impact point. Useful for surprise damage, environmental destruction, and unpredictable combat patterns. Can be layered with physical strikes or thrown objects.

Limits:
Secondary impact only activates at the precise location of the initial contact—moving targets escape the effect if they leave the area. User must consciously trigger each second impact, requiring focus and tactical awareness. Activation delay leaves brief vulnerability window. No effect on ethereal or intangible matter.

Additional Notes:
Ideal for tactical fighters who can predict opponent movement and position themselves strategically. Combines well with speed-based combat. Less effective against fast, mobile enemies who rapidly relocate. Requires physical contact or projectile impact to initiate the chain.

cardPool.title: Vibrate
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name: Vibrate

Description: The user generates and controls shockwaves and vibrations through any medium they touch, from solid objects to the ground itself. By modulating frequency and intensity with their hands, the user can create precise tremors or devastating seismic disturbances. Prolonged exposure to their own vibrations grants the user natural resistance to vibration-based attacks.

Functions/Applications: Shatters and breaks objects through vigorous vibration. Creates controlled earthquakes that disrupt terrain and enemy formations. Weakens structural integrity of materials and muscle fibers from within. Works against groups by destroying footing and balance. Can be used defensively to counter vibration-based Quirks.

Limits: Excessively fast or powerful vibrations cause severe aftershock damage to the user's own body, temporarily paralyzing them. Once vibrations exceed the user's control threshold, they cannot be stopped and must dissipate naturally. The user cannot match raw physical strength and relies on weakening opponents rather than direct power. Overuse risks neurological strain despite built-in resistance.

Additional Notes: The user develops vibration resistance gradually through repeated exposure to their own Quirk's aftereffects. This Quirk excels at area control and indirect damage but requires careful calibration to avoid self-harm. Most effective against multiple opponents or durable materials rather than single strong adversaries.

cardPool.title: Vibration Detection
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Vibration Sense

Description:
The user perceives their surroundings through detection of subtle vibrations in the air and physical matter, functioning as a sensory replacement similar to echolocation. This Quirk compensates for visual impairment by mapping spatial awareness through vibration patterns.

Functions/Applications:
The user can navigate complex environments, detect nearby objects and beings, track movement through tremors, and identify threats in darkness or obscured conditions. This allows combat awareness and spatial navigation without relying on sight.

Limits:
The Quirk cannot penetrate materials that dampen vibrations effectively, such as thick stone or specialized absorption surfaces. It requires an environment where vibrations can propagate; total silence or vibration-dampening fields severely limit its effectiveness. It cannot discern fine details like facial features or colors.

Additional Notes:
This Quirk's primary strength lies in adapting to sensory loss, making it especially valuable for users who have lost eyesight. It works best in environments with active movement or sound; perfectly still environments reduce its range and clarity. The Quirk pairs well with other compensatory sensory abilities.

cardPool.title: Vines
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Vines

Description:
The user's hair transforms into controllable, thorny vines that can be freely manipulated and detached from the head. The vines are remarkably durable, capable of piercing skin and cutting through concrete, while remaining non-conductive to electricity.

Functions/Applications:
Vines can restrain or bind opponents, grapple distant objects, form defensive barriers, and be severed as independent weapons. The thorns inflict cutting damage on contact. The user gains natural resistance to electrical-type attacks due to the vines' non-conductive nature.

Limits:
The vines can be cut or severed by sharp objects, requiring time to regenerate. Growth and regeneration depend on adequate sunlight and water availability. Extended use without these resources diminishes vine strength and length. The vines remain connected to the user's head as their primary anchor point.

Additional Notes:
The vines are sharp enough to cause significant abrasion wounds despite appearing organic. They function as both offensive and defensive tools, making this a versatile middle-range Quirk. Users should prioritize positioning in well-lit, moist environments for sustained combat effectiveness.

cardPool.title: Viral Cosmos
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Viral Cosmos

Description:
The user possesses two distinctive flowers growing from their head that generate an endless supply of petals. These petals can be hurled as projectile weapons that inflict harm upon impact. The petals manifest naturally from the flora and can be launched with varying force.

Functions/Applications:
Throw petals as ranged attacks to damage enemies from distance. Adjust petal velocity and volume for different combat situations. The continuous petal generation allows sustained offensive pressure without ammunition limitation.

Limits:
Petals have limited effective range and gradually lose velocity over distance. The flowers can be targeted and damaged by opponents. Petal attacks deal moderate damage compared to more powerful Quirks. User cannot control petal trajectory mid-flight, only initial launch force.

Additional Notes:
This Quirk is best suited for ranged harassment and mid-range combat. The botanical nature of the Quirk makes it vulnerable to fire-type attacks or environmental hazards. Effectiveness decreases in confined spaces where petals cannot disperse properly.

cardPool.title: Voice
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name: Voice

Description: A sonic amplification Quirk that allows the user to project their voice at devastating volumes and frequencies. The user can generate high-pitched sounds capable of reaching extreme decibel levels, sufficient to rupture eardrums and incapacitate targets through auditory trauma.

Functions/Applications: Create devastating sonic attacks that disorient and damage enemies; drown out competing sound-based Quirks; project commands and warnings across large distances; use directional speakers to shield nearby allies from the sound's effects.

Limits: Prolonged use causes sore throat and vocal strain, limiting sustained combat duration. Ineffective against underground opponents or those in soundproof environments since sound travels poorly through solid barriers. Requires close proximity or speaker equipment for directional control; uncontrolled use endangers allies.

Additional Notes: The user typically wears a directional speaker support item around the neck to control sound propagation and protect nearby companions. Most effective in open terrain and against multiple opponents. Dual-purpose utility makes it valuable for civilian rescue operations beyond combat scenarios.

cardPool.title: Voyance
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Voyance

Description:
The user can see through solid objects and barriers within their line of sight, gaining an x-ray vision effect. However, living organisms remain opaque and cannot be seen through. By peering through a finger-formed aperture, the user narrows their vision field, significantly extending the Quirk's duration and reducing mental strain.

Functions/Applications:
Locate hidden objects, bombs, or contraband behind walls and containers. Scout enemy positions behind cover without exposing oneself. Detect structural weaknesses or hidden compartments. Track mechanical devices or technological threats through barriers.

Limits:
Cannot see through living matter—organic tissue blocks vision entirely. Continuous use without the finger-aperture technique exhausts the user quickly. The Quirk only works on objects within direct line of sight; walls blocking the user's view prevent seeing beyond them. Cannot penetrate certain dense or specially designed materials if sufficiently opaque.

Additional Notes:
The finger-aperture focusing method is essential for sustained use; without it, the Quirk drains stamina rapidly. Best suited for reconnaissance, detective work, and bomb-detection scenarios. Ineffective against hidden enemies or creatures, limiting combat applications.

cardPool.title: Warp Gate
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Warp Gate

Description:
The user generates dark purple and black mist that forms portals, transporting anything touching the fog to a predetermined location. The user can cloak themselves entirely in mist, becoming nearly invisible while channeling teleportation. This is an artificial Quirk synthesized from multiple sources, with Cloud Quirk as its base foundation.

Functions/Applications:
Create coordinate-based portals for instant transportation of objects and people across vast distances. Cloak the user's body to obscure their true form and location. Open portals from sight-based locations or memorized coordinates. Transport multiple targets simultaneously. Establish escape routes or ambush points during combat.

Limits:
The user's neck area cannot be covered by mist, creating a critical weak point for attack. Portals require precise coordinate knowledge—the user must see or know exact positions to open gates in unseen areas. Cannot locate missing persons without knowing their exact location. Closing a portal while someone is partially inside causes severe bisection. Overuse causes physical exhaustion and bodily deterioration. Coordinate-based nature makes it slower than purely instinctive warping abilities.

Additional Notes:
Warp Gate is exceptionally useful for large-scale tactical operations, making the user invaluable for organization and evasion. The mist color shifts to light blue when the user's original personality influences the Quirk.

cardPool.title: Warping
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Warping

Description:
A stolen teleportation quirk that manifests as black ooze erupting from a target's mouth, enveloping their body as a portal before they vanish and reappear elsewhere. The ooze carries a repugnant stench and can transport multiple people simultaneously to separate locations.

Functions/Applications:
The user can summon targets to their current location or banish them away, but only those they know well or those near someone they know. Works as a short-range teleportation tool for tactical repositioning, extraction, or dispersal of enemies in combat scenarios.

Limits:
Range is restricted—targets must be within a certain distance to activate. User cannot teleport themselves. Only functions on people the user has sufficient familiarity with or proximity to. Strong-willed individuals can resist by swallowing the ooze before full envelopment. Cannot function like coordinate-based warping; requires specific people as anchors. Repeated use causes severe physical strain on the user's body.

Additional Notes:
Unlike coordinate-based teleportation, this quirk requires personal connection or proximity to work, making it less versatile but potentially more controllable. The quirk's foul odor and reliance on intimate knowledge makes it unsuitable for surprise mass evacuations.

cardPool.title: Water Control
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Water Control

Description:
A water-manipulation Quirk that grants the user command over nearby water. The user shapes water into offensive constructs and projectiles with precision, from razor-sharp claws capable of cleaving through wood and metal to devastating aqueous torrents. Power scales with available water supply.

Functions/Applications:
Form water into bladed weapons (claws, spikes, blades) for melee combat. Launch pressurized water jets as ranged attacks. Create temporary barriers or shields from solidified water. Redirect or absorb incoming water-based attacks.

Limits:
Requires proximity to a water source; effectiveness drastically diminishes in arid environments. Cannot generate water from nothing—only manipulates existing supplies. Sustained constructs drain stamina proportionally to their size and density. Water-based defenses are vulnerable to rapid evaporation or freezing.

Additional Notes:
Most effective near bodies of water, rain, or humid conditions. The user's skill determines attack precision and construct complexity. Dehydrated opponents are harder targets but don't negate the Quirk entirely if environmental water remains available.

cardPool.title: Water Gun
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name: Water Gun

Description: The user projects pressurized streams of water from their hands with precision and force. A straightforward offensive and utility Quirk that channels liquid projectiles as a combat tool or environmental solution.

Functions/Applications: Fire suppression and large-scale water dispersal; tactical distraction by targeting opponents' faces or eyes; crowd control through water spray; assistance with environmental hazards like wildfires.

Limits: Limited to water already present or internally stored—cannot create water from nothing. Pressure and range decrease with sustained use. Ineffective against water-resistant or fully aquatic opponents. Requires hand positioning and aim; cannot function if hands are restrained or immobilized.

Additional Notes: Most effective in supporting roles rather than as primary offense. Practical utility makes it valuable in rescue operations and disaster response. Strength lies in versatility and non-lethal control rather than raw damage output.

cardPool.title: Water Pump
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Water Pump

Description:
The user's hands are replaced with functional water hose spigots capable of generating pressurized water on demand. Water can be shaped and controlled with precision into various forms, from barriers to implements.

Functions/Applications:
Create defensive barriers marked with warning symbols, generate hand-like water constructs for manipulation, deliver pressurized water attacks, and extinguish fires with controlled water output. The user maintains fine control over water flow rate and shape.

Limits:
Requires a water source or internal reserves to function; prolonged use depletes reserves. Cannot generate water indefinitely without replenishment. The hose-hand design limits fine manipulation tasks requiring dexterity. Water constructs disperse if pressure is lost.

Additional Notes:
Best suited for defensive and utility roles. Highly effective in firefighting scenarios. The distinctive warning-marked barriers serve both protective and intimidation purposes. User must manage water reserves carefully during extended engagements.

cardPool.title: Weather Manipulation
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Weather Manipulation

Description:
The user freely controls all weather phenomena including storms, lightning, wind, and tornadoes on a massive scale. Nine could envelope entire islands in storm clouds and summon devastating weather events capable of destroying landscapes. The Quirk also grants the user flight via wind manipulation.

Functions/Applications:
Create massive storm systems and tornadoes for area denial or destruction. Summon precise lightning bolts for targeted offense. Generate powerful winds for propulsion and flight. Scale attacks from localized strikes to island-wide devastation depending on intent and available energy.

Limits:
Using the Quirk causes severe cellular degeneration and excruciating pain to the user's body, forcing conservative use. Overuse leads to loss of control and potential collapse. Lightning can be redirected or grounded by electricity-based Quirks. Continuous application of multiple powers simultaneously accelerates physical deterioration and risks fatal exhaustion.

Additional Notes:
This Quirk's immense power isolates users socially and psychologically. The user cannot sustain full-power weather manipulation without external aid like cell regeneration abilities. Rage or desperation can trigger uncontrolled massive storms. The burden of this "godlike" power often warps the user's worldview toward social Darwinism.

cardPool.title: Weld
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Weld

Description:
Yosetsu can merge organic and inorganic matter at a subatomic level by making physical contact. Objects, people, or his own body fuse seamlessly with targets, creating permanent physical bonds until he consciously reverses the effect.

Functions/Applications:
Restraint and incapacitation by fusing enemies to structures or each other. Equipment enhancement by welding shields and armor to his body. Transport assistance by fusing limbs with allies. Steel logs in his hero costume allow him to bridge separate targets without simultaneous contact.

Limits:
Requires contact with at least two objects or surfaces to activate. Cannot fuse only one item. Reversing the effect requires conscious effort and time. Organic matter fusion risks injury to merged partners if separation is forced.

Additional Notes:
Weld excels as a tactical restraint tool rather than direct combat. Yosetsu carries specialized steel logs and shields designed to maximize versatility. The Quirk works equally on willing allies, making it valuable for rescue operations and cooperative strategies.

cardPool.title: Whale
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Whale

Description:
A transformation Quirk allowing the user to convert parts or their entire body into that of a sperm whale. When fully transformed, the user gains the physiology and capabilities of a massive aquatic mammal, including immense size and strength.

Functions/Applications:
Enables partial or complete body transformation into whale form for enhanced physical power and aquatic capability. In full transformation, the user can expel powerful water streams from their mouth as an offensive weapon. Useful for underwater combat, traversal, and overwhelming opponents through sheer size and force.

Limits:
Transformation duration and frequency are unknown but likely taxing. Water-based attacks require full transformation and expend significant energy. Whale form is cumbersome on land and vulnerable to harpoon-type weapons or electricity in water. The Quirk does not grant enhanced intelligence or special senses beyond whale biology.

Additional Notes:
Most effective in aquatic environments where the whale form's advantages are maximized. Partial transformations may allow tactical flexibility but are likely weaker than full conversion. The water-projection ability requires the user's throat and mouth systems to function as whale anatomy dictates.

cardPool.title: Whirlwind
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Whirlwind

Description:
Inasa commands the air itself, generating powerful gusts and tornadoes with minimal physical movement. He can manipulate multiple wind currents simultaneously with precise control, propelling objects, allies, and himself through the air without causing collisions.

Functions/Applications:
Offensive wind blasts that knock enemies away; defensive deflection of projectiles and evasive maneuverability; support abilities to amplify allies' attacks. Flight achieved through costume-enhanced miniaturized tornadoes or ground-burst propulsion for speed boosts. Can combine with heat-based Quirks to create spiraling flame tornadoes.

Limits:
Significantly weakened if limbs cannot move freely—full power requires mobility. High temperatures and large fire sources disrupt airflow and destabilize control. Initially incompatible with cold-heat manipulation Quirks, though cooperation can overcome this weakness.

Additional Notes:
Whirlwind excels in versatility across offense, defense, and support roles. Its effectiveness scales with Inasa's physical freedom and environmental conditions. Synergizes well with complementary Quirks when users coordinate tactically.

cardPool.title: Whiteline
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Whiteline

Description:
The user manipulates and controls painted lane lines on roads as if they were flexible tentacles. These white lines can extend, coil, and move with considerable force, allowing the user to ensnare targets or hurl objects with devastating impact.

Functions/Applications:
Entangle and immobilize enemies by wrapping animated lane lines around them. Lift and throw heavy objects like vehicles through the air. Create barriers or obstacles by manipulating road markings. Requires painted road surfaces to function effectively.

Limits:
The Quirk only works on existing painted lane lines; bare pavement or unpainted surfaces provide no material to manipulate. Raw power level remains unknown as the user was only observed while under external enhancement. Effectiveness diminishes in areas lacking road infrastructure or clear markings.

Additional Notes:
Best suited for urban or highway environments where abundant painted lines exist. The Quirk's true baseline strength is untested, limiting assessment of its independent combat potential. Works as a tactical tool for restraint and object manipulation rather than direct damage.

cardPool.title: Whole-Body Lens
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Whole-Body Lens

Description:
The user's body functions as a living camera system, capable of generating lens-like apertures anywhere on their skin to capture images. Photographs can be produced and printed from the user's chest at will, with no apparent limit to storage capacity.

Functions/Applications:
Create optical lenses across any body surface for surveillance, reconnaissance, or documentation. Print physical photographs on demand from stored images. Useful for gathering intelligence, creating evidence, or tactical mapping without external equipment.

Limits:
Cannot modify or edit captured images—only reproduce them as-is. Printing consumes stamina and requires chest access. Lenses are vulnerable while active. Cannot capture images the user cannot see or in complete darkness. Storage has unknown psychological or physical constraints.

Additional Notes:
Best suited for support and intelligence roles. The quirk's true potential lies in information gathering rather than direct combat. Weakness to damage near the chest or eyes may hinder performance during combat.

cardPool.title: Wing
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Wing

Description:
The user sprouts massive black wings from their body, granting them the ability to achieve free-form flight at extreme speeds. Originally manifested by a Near High-End Nomu, this Quirk was later obtained by Tomura Shigaraki through Quirk absorption.

Functions/Applications:
The wings enable sustained aerial locomotion and rapid escape across long distances. Users can carry additional passengers or objects while airborne. The Quirk facilitates tactical repositioning in combat and access to otherwise unreachable locations.

Limits:
Flight speed and maneuverability depend on the user's physical condition and control. The wings are vulnerable to targeted attacks while deployed. Extended flight at maximum velocity causes fatigue. The Quirk does not inherently grant enhanced strength or durability beyond mobility advantages.

Additional Notes:
Whether extreme speeds derive solely from Wing or synergize with other Quirks remains unclear. The Quirk's power scales with the user's overall capabilities and combat experience. Wing serves primarily as a mobility and evasion tool rather than offensive capability.

cardPool.title: Zero Gravity
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name: Zero Gravity

Description: Upon touching solid objects with the pads of her fingertips, the user removes gravitational effects, rendering targets weightless and suspended in mid-air. Contact is maintained by keeping fingers pressed; releasing them cancels the effect. After Awakening, the user can generate anti-gravity bubbles at range and spread effects between connected objects without direct touch.

Functions/Applications: Float objects and opponents up to three tons (pre-Awakening); disable enemies by eliminating their footing; manipulate environmental wreckage as projectiles or melee weapons; transport unconscious allies; increase personal agility by removing self-weight; create diversions with levitating decoys; generate shockwaves through bubble compression that repels multiple targets simultaneously.

Limits: Activation requires direct hand contact (pre-Awakening); user suffers nausea and potential vomiting with prolonged use or multiple simultaneous targets; loss of hands means total Quirk inability; vulnerable to ranged opponents who maintain distance; Awakened bubble effects lack precise control, affecting indiscriminately in the vicinity; three-ton weight limit applies pre-Awakening only.

Additional Notes: Training reduces nausea severity significantly. Awakened form removes weight restrictions and enables remote bubble generation, but control difficulties persist.

cardPool.title: Zombie Virus
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Zombie Virus

Description:
Romero Fujimi releases a pinkish gas that temporarily transforms those who inhale it into zombies with enhanced strength and endurance. Infected victims gain bluish-gray skin, sunken eyes, and an insatiable drive to bite the uninfected to spread the virus. Quirk users lose control of their powers when zombified, using abilities randomly. The user must wear a mask to avoid self-infection.

Functions/Applications:
Creates hordes of temporarily-controlled undead soldiers through viral gas dispersal. Zombified Quirk users become unpredictable weapons with compromised ability control. Victims retain fragmented personality, allowing friendships to sometimes override infection instinct. Zombie-like appearances fool infected into treating them as allies, enabling infiltration or escape.

Limits:
The user is not immune to their own virus and risks self-infection if bitten. Zombification is temporary but reversal mechanics are unclear. Zombified Quirk users suffer complete cognitive shutdown, focusing only on biting uninfected targets. Victims with retained personality may resist the infection's compulsions. The virus spreads only through inhalation of gas or infectious bites, not touch alone.

Additional Notes:
Highly contagious but requires proximity for gas dispersal. Zombified individuals maintain some self-awareness, making control unreliable. Requires strategic mask management to prevent accidental self-infection during combat.

cardPool.title: Zoom
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Zoom

Description:
A vision enhancement Quirk that grants the user extraordinary magnification abilities. The user's eyes transform with distinctive crosshair-shaped irises and can focus on distant targets with perfect clarity up to 5 kilometers away.

Functions/Applications:
The user can zoom vision on specific points of interest to observe people, objects, and details from extreme distances. This makes them exceptional at reconnaissance, surveying crowds, identifying individuals, or examining distant locations without being noticed. Practical uses include scouting, investigation, or identifying potential contacts and opportunities from afar.

Limits:
The Quirk requires active focus to magnify vision—passive sight remains normal. Extreme distances beyond 5 kilometers become blurry. The user cannot zoom while moving quickly without losing focus. Environmental obstructions like dense fog, darkness, or heavy rain significantly impair effectiveness. The Quirk provides no combat advantage in direct confrontation.

Additional Notes:
The crosshair irises are a permanent physical marker of this Quirk. Extended use causes mild eye strain. This Quirk excels for information gathering and observation rather than active combat or defense.

cardPool.title: Class 1-B
cardPool.value:
Name: Class 1-B Classroom

Location: U.A. High School, Heroics Department, First-Year Wing

Inhabitants: Twenty-plus hero students including Itsuka Kendo, Tetsutetsu Tetsutetsu, Nirengeki Shoda, Neito Monoma, and Yosetsu Awase, overseen by their homeroom instructor.

Appearance: A modern academic space within Japan's premier hero academy, equipped with desks, training materials, and tactical boards displaying combat strategies and rivalry records against Class 1-A. The room bears subtle marks of friendly competition—victory tallies, posted exam results showing their superior licensing pass rate, and memorabilia from tournaments. Despite their quieter path compared to Class 1-A's combat experience, the space reflects disciplined, focused students who have steadily honed their quirks through dedicated training rather than crisis response.

cardPool.title: U.A. High School
cardPool.value:
Name: U.A. High School

Location: Perched atop a forested hill overlooking the city of Musutafu, Japan's premier heroics academy stands as a fortress of education and training. The grounds are partitioned like a game board with advanced security systems, including the "U.A. Barrier" at the entrance.

Inhabitants: Elite students separated into multiple departments and classes (A through K) based on ability, rigorous teaching staff with unrestricted pedagogical authority, and administrative personnel including Power Loader overseeing security systems. The school has produced legendary heroes including All Might, Endeavor, and Best Jeanist.

Appearance: A sprawling campus featuring dormitory facilities, training grounds, and multiple departmental buildings. Underground emergency shelters connected via maglev network lie beneath fortified grounds. Security walls with ID-card authentication systems guard the entrance. The architecture blends modern institutional design with combat-training infrastructure, featuring transformation mechanisms and Decay-resistant reinforcement throughout the grounds.

cardPool.title: Shiketsu High School
cardPool.value:
Name:
Shiketsu High School

Location:
A prestigious Hero Academy connected to U.A. High School via secure underground tunnels, serving as both an elite training institution and civilian refuge during crises.

Inhabitants:
Students in distinguished blue and orange uniform hats with white collared shirts and dark jackets bearing the Shiketsu logo; notable students include Class Representative Nagamasa Mora, prodigy Inasa Yoarashi, and Seiji. Faculty oversee rigorous hero training and maintain strict codes of dignity and heroic obligation.

Appearance:
