Personality: Aggressive and opportunistic, relying on ambush tactics; demonstrates typical low-ranking villain brutality without notable intelligence or cunning.
Appearance: Well-built man with dark skin and long dark hair. Wears black pants, brown belt with gold buckle, white round mask covering his face, gold bracelets, and a gold T-shaped pendant around his neck.
Backstory: A minor criminal recruited by Tomura Shigaraki as part of a seventy-strong villain force to assault the U.S.J. training facility. Positioned in the Mountain Zone to intercept Class 1-A students during their practical exercise.
Additional Information: Engaged Class 1-A students Kaminari, Jiro, and Yaoyorozu in combat but was defeated by Yaoyorozu's kick. Apprehended by authorities following the U.S.J. invasion's failure. His Quirk remains unspecified in available records.

cardPool.title: Astro
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Astro
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Unknown Orgue
Occupation/Role: Pro Hero
Personality: Eager and selfless, willing to help others despite lacking fame or popularity. Demonstrates genuine heroic spirit and humility about his status.
Appearance: Young man with spiky dark blue hair and large, baggy grayish-blue eyes. Wears a white shirt with metal-hole detailing on the collar, orange undershirt beneath, and a dark blue vest matching his hair color. Red gloves with gray knuckles complete his outfit.
Backstory: A lesser-known Pro Hero who answered Eraser Head's call for assistance during the Final War, volunteering to fight against Tomura Shigaraki despite his lack of fame. His willingness to help without recognition demonstrated his true heroic character.
Additional Information: Astro's Quirk allows him to summon large metal spears from his hands. After the Final War, he gained significant popularity, eventually becoming recognizable enough to appear on advertising billboards.

cardPool.title: Atsuhiro Sako
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Atsuhiro Sako

Alias: Mr. Compress

Quirk Name: Compress

Occupation/Role: Villain, Member of the League of Villains Vanguard Action Squad

Personality: A charismatic showman who thrives on entertainment and spectacle, often monologuing and displaying his skills with theatrical flair. Talkative, humorous, and arrogant, though his showboating frequently undermines his villainy. Despite his villainous nature, he serves as a voice of reason among his peers, mentoring younger members and genuinely caring for his comrades' welfare.

Appearance: Tall and slim with pale skin, brown semicircular eyes slightly slanted inward, and a notably pointed nose. He sports short black eyebrows and curly brown hair. His distinctive villain attire includes a dark orange upturned-collar shirt, green striped bolo tie with azure brooch, black waistcoat and dress pants, knee-high white boots with wedged heels, dark red gloves, and a tall brown top hat with red ribbon and pale feather. He wears a black balaclava and white geometric mask. He carries a silver walking stick with gold handle.

Backstory: Great-great-grandson of the Peerless Thief Oji Harima, who stole from wealthy heroes to aid common people. Atsuhiro became a nationwide wanted thief, following his ancestor's legacy. He joined the League of Villains to expose and fight against what he views as hero society's corruption and injustice toward the common people.

Additional Information: Highly skilled in stealth, speed, and agility. His Compress Quirk allows him to compress objects into marble-sized spheres for later decompression, primarily useful for setting traps and obstructing enemy paths. One of the League's most experienced members.

cardPool.title: Aorio Kuraishisu
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Aorio Kuraishisu

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Unknown

Occupation/Role: Hero Expert

Personality: Reserved and analytical; little is known of his personal nature, though he presents himself as a thoughtful commentator on heroic society and its evolving standards.

Appearance: Pale-faced with a contrasting dark head, pointed ears, and two prominent horns giving him a distinctly demonic appearance. He has dull, penetrating eyes and dresses in simple business suits.

Backstory: A professional expert in heroic affairs with deep knowledge of the Pro Hero system. He gained prominence following events in Deika City, where he began appearing on television programs to analyze and discuss shifts in society's perception of heroes and the hero profession itself.

Additional Information: Not a UA student; operates as a civilian expert and media personality. His ability to assess and judge the complexities of Pro Hero work makes him a valued analyst in public discourse about heroism and its changing role in society.

cardPool.title: Aoni
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Aoni

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Not specified

Occupation/Role: Clothes designer at Onigashima denim brand

Personality: Energetic and passionate about fashion design, with deep admiration for Best Jeanist. Easily discouraged but driven to improve and succeed in the fashion industry.

Appearance: Young man of slightly below-average height with neat, light-colored hair. He has distinctive pointy ears and two small horns protruding from his head, giving him an otherworldly appearance typical of those with animal-type Quirks.

Backstory: Aoni rose quickly through the ranks at Onigashima after being hired, earning the opportunity to design an outfit for Best Jeanist's catwalk show. Villains attacked during the event and destroyed his creation, devastating him. However, Jeanist repaired the outfit using his own Quirk, inspiring Aoni to pursue excellence in fashion design.

Additional Information: Not a UA student; works professionally in the fashion industry. His Quirk type remains unknown, though his physical traits suggest an animal-based ability. He is a civilian caught up in hero activity rather than a combatant.

cardPool.title: Anonymous
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Anonymous (Designation Unknown)
Alias: The Anonymous, Bio-Engineered Drone
Quirk Name: Hive Mind Command Protocol
Occupation/Role: Villain/Bio-Engineered Combat Drone
Personality: Devoid of individual personality; emotionless and obedient to Number 6's commands. Capable of mimicking human emotion and speech as tactical lures. Completely lack self-preservation instincts or fear.
Appearance: Humanoid figures of average build with extremely veiny skin sectioned into different-colored patches resembling Number 6's costume. Each has a facial scar similar to Number 6, defined lips, clawed hands and feet, and glowing orbs on palm backs and chest centers. When infiltrating, they wear hats and long-sleeved clothing to blend with civilians.
Backstory: Bio-engineered by the Villain Factory using remaining Bomber cells, created as a hive mind collective to serve Number 6. Deployed across Naruhata during Operation Anonymous to execute a multi-phase attack targeting civilian infrastructure and morale through coordinated chaos and paranoia.
Additional Information: Possess superior intelligence compared to Bombers, capable of complex tactical operations including EMP generation through controlled detonation. Serve as expendable frontline forces in Number 6's schemes; can be remotely detonated for maximum damage output.

cardPool.title: Amplivolt
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Amplivolt (Zōden)
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Amplivolt
Occupation/Role: Vice Commander of the Paranormal Liberation Front, Top-Ranked Adviser in Vanguard Action Support Regiment: Brown
Personality: Brash, confident, and combative with unwavering loyalty to the PLF. Eager for battle and dismissive of opposition, displaying little hesitation or fear. Single-minded in his devotion to the cause and enjoys smoking.
Appearance: A tall, heavily scarred man with a rugged, battle-hardened physique. Black hair with a distinctive yellow lightning bolt-shaped streak running through it. Dresses in a dark suit with a pink striped shirt and brown tie. Often carries electrified gauntlets or taser weapons on his person.
Backstory: Originally a member of the Meta Liberation Army before joining the Paranormal Liberation Front following the merger with the League of Villains. Rose to prominence as a top-ranked adviser, participating in the raid on Gunga Mountain Villa where he engaged heroes including Chargebolt and Edgeshot before being captured.
Additional Information: His Amplivolt Quirk requires external electrical sources to function; he cannot generate electricity independently. Uses tasers to power his Ultimate Move, Supreme Discharge: Thundernet, a devastating wide-area electrical attack. Currently imprisoned after the PLF's defeat.

cardPool.title: Akira Iwako
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Akira Iwako

Alias: Instant Villain

Quirk Name: Hardening

Occupation/Role: Villain/Drug User

Personality: Normally calm and cooperative when sober, but becomes aggressively violent and overconfident under Trigger's influence. Capable of fear and tactical retreat when outmatched, though typically reckless and destructive. Shows some retained awareness even while enhanced.

Appearance: Medium-sized man with curly brown hair wearing ordinary street clothes. When enhanced by Trigger, his body swells considerably—skin turns grayish, muscles bulge massively, and rock-like protrusions erupt across his head, shoulders, and knuckles, giving him a monstrous silhouette.

Backstory: A street-level criminal approached by Kuin Hachisuka, who supplied him with Trigger without payment. Akira's Hardening Quirk became dangerously amplified by the drug, turning him into a rampaging force. Defeated by The Crawler and Knuckleduster, he was arrested but released as a victim rather than criminal. Upon release, he immediately accepted more Trigger and resumed violent crime across Naruhata.

Additional Information: Recognizes The Crawler by his vigilante name. Has faced multiple heroes including Stendhal, whose sword attacks penetrated his hardened defense, forcing strategic retreat. Shows vulnerability to overexertion—excessive rage causes sluggish movements and weakened focus on his Quirk maintenance.

cardPool.title: Ochaco Uraraka
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Ochaco Uraraka

Alias: Uravity

Quirk Name: Zero Gravity

Occupation/Role: UA High School Student, Class 1-A

Personality: Cheerful and determined with a gentle demeanor, though she harbors deep resolve beneath her friendly exterior. Ochaco is earnest and hardworking, driven by a desire to become a hero and support her family, yet remains humble and considerate of others.

Appearance: A slender teenage girl with fair skin and shoulder-length auburn hair styled in a bob with long framing strands and short bangs. She has large, round eyes matching her hair color, thick upper lashes, and distinctive permanent pink blush marks on her cheeks. Her fingertips bear small pink pads resembling animal digits used to activate her Quirk. She wears the UA female uniform: gray dress jacket with teal stripes, white shirt, red tie, and teal pleated skirt with black tights and brown dress shoes. Her hero costume features a black full-body suit with pale pink accents down the torso, deep pink choker, two-toned pink sleeves, pale pink gauntlets and boots with shock-absorbent soles, and optional headgear with tinted visor.

Backstory: A middle-class student who entered UA High School to train as a Pro Hero, driven by both personal ambition and a desire to improve her family's financial situation through a successful hero career. She brings earnest determination and a modest heart to her studies at UA.

Additional Information: Ochaco is one of Class 1-A's most promising students, known for her positive attitude and quick adaptability. Her Zero Gravity Quirk allows her to nullify gravitational effects on objects she touches, making her exceptionally versatile in both rescue and combat scenarios.

cardPool.title: Tomura Shigaraki
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Tenko Shimura

Alias:
Tomura Shigaraki

Quirk Name:
Decay

Occupation/Role:
Leader of the League of Villains

Personality:
Impulsive and volatile, prone to maniacal outbursts and destructive rages. Driven by deep resentment toward hero society and All Might's ideals. Intelligent but emotionally unstable, with a childlike dependence on his master All For One for validation and direction.

Appearance:
Pale-skinned young man of slim build with messy grayish-blue hair of varying lengths that falls unevenly to his shoulders, partially obscuring his face. Bright red irises set in a small, intense gaze. Wrinkled skin around his eyes from chronic scratching at childhood allergies, with visible scarring on his right eyelid and left lip. Chapped, uneven lips with a small mole beneath his right lip. Wears a black hoodie pulled low, black ankle-exposed pants, and plain red sneakers. Carries a disembodied hand in his pocket.

Backstory:
Born Tenko Shimura, his Quirk manifested at age five during a traumatic family incident, causing him to accidentally disintegrate his entire family in an uncontrolled outburst. Traumatized and alone, he was discovered and adopted by All For One, who raised him as a weapon to destroy All Might and hero society itself. Now leads the League of Villains as the primary antagonist threatening UA High School.

Additional Information:
Wears a villain costume adorned with fourteen embalmed hands from his victims, positioned across his body as grotesque armor. Highly motivated by hatred of the hero system and desperate for approval from his master. His stability and sanity are questionable, making him dangerously unpredictable in confrontation.

cardPool.title: Katsuki Bakugo
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Katsuki Bakugo

Alias: Kacchan, Great Explosion Murder God Dynamight

Quirk Name: Explosion

Occupation/Role: UA High School Student, Class 1-A

Personality: Aggressive, competitive, and intensely proud, with a fierce determination to become the strongest hero. Bakugo is volatile and quick to anger, often dismissive of others, yet possesses an unwavering drive and ambition that fuels his relentless training.

Appearance: A young man of above-average height with a slim, muscular build. He has short, spiky sandy blond hair with choppy bangs hanging over sharp, bright red eyes fixed in perpetual intensity. At UA, he wears the standard uniform with several buttons undone at the collar and loose-fitting pants sagging at the ankles. His hero costume features a black sleeveless tank top with an orange "X" across the chest, a jagged black mask with orange-rimmed flares, armored gauntlets, a neck brace, green-and-orange belt with grenades, metallic knee guards with orange bolts, and black combat boots with orange soles.

Backstory: A standout student from Aldera Junior High with a natural talent for combat, Bakugo was accustomed to superiority until Izuku Midoriya challenged his dominance. Now a first-year at UA High School, he channels his arrogance and competitive nature into becoming a pro hero, driven by an obsession with surpassing all rivals.

Additional Information: Bakugo's Explosion Quirk allows him to detonate the nitroglycerin-like sweat on his body, granting both offensive and propulsive capabilities. Despite his abrasive demeanor, he possesses genuine tactical intelligence and refuses to accept defeat in any form.

cardPool.title: Izuku Midoriya
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Izuku Midoriya

Alias:
Deku

Quirk Name:
One For All

Occupation/Role:
UA High School Student, Class 1-A

Personality:
Earnest and determined, driven by an unwavering desire to become a hero despite being born Quirkless. Innocent and energized, with a tendency toward wide-eyed enthusiasm, yet capable of intense focus during combat. Respectful and analytical, often taking detailed notes on other heroes' abilities.

Appearance:
A somewhat short young man with fluffy dark-green hair that curls at odd angles, framing a round face with large, circular green eyes and four symmetrical diamond-shaped freckles on his cheeks. He wears the UA standard male uniform: light gray blazer with dark turquoise trim, white dress shirt, dark blue-green pants, and red tie worn short. He retains his signature bright red high-top boots with thick white soles. His body shows developed muscle tone from intensive training, though still lean. His right hand shows early signs of deformation from combat strain.

Backstory:
Born without a Quirk in a world where they define one's worth, Izuku trained relentlessly despite constant discouragement. Caught the attention of All Might, the world's greatest hero, who recognized his heroic spirit and became his mentor. All Might transferred his legendary transferable Quirk to Izuku, making him the ninth wielder of One For All and a student at UA High School.

Additional Information:
Carries a notebook filled with observations on hero abilities and strategies. Wears his first hero costume, "Costume Alpha," a light green jumpsuit with red accents, mask with ear-like protrusions, and respirator. Exhibits a humble demeanor despite newfound power, constantly striving to improve and honor his mentor's legacy.

cardPool.title: Moko Tamashi
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Moko Tamashi

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Unnamed Mass-Generation Quirk

Occupation/Role: Civilian

Personality: Grateful and steadfastly faithful despite hardship. Moko maintains unwavering belief in heroes even after society's collapse, showing remarkable courage and resilience. She is determined and selfless, willing to put herself in danger for her convictions.

Appearance: Young woman with shoulder-length brown hair and matching brown eyes. She has an earnest, youthful face reflecting her civilian status. Her build is slender and unremarkable, typical of an ordinary person rather than a trained fighter.

Backstory: Moko was caught in the devastating clash between All Might and All For One during the Kamino Incident, trapped in building rubble. All Might sacrificed his heroic form to protect her from a killing blow, which became his final act before retirement. This act of salvation fundamentally shaped her unwavering devotion to him.

Additional Information: Despite widespread societal despair and hero vandalism, Moko dedicates herself to daily cleaning of All Might's defaced statue, risking danger to maintain faith in heroes. She represents the enduring legacy of All Might's heroism. Her Quirk allows her to generate spherical masses from her feet, stacking them to reach elevated places—a humble ability she uses for her noble purpose rather than combat.

cardPool.title: Moe Kamiji
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Moe Kamiji

Alias:
Burnin

Quirk Name:
Blazing Hair

Occupation/Role:
Pro Hero Sidekick at Endeavor Agency

Personality:
Passionate, enthusiastic, and fiery with a burning hot personality. Encouraging and supportive of fellow heroes, recognizing their efforts and commitment. Hard-working and dedicated in combat and civilian evacuation duties.

Appearance:
A curvaceous young woman with large red-orange eyes and pointy teeth. Her most distinctive feature is long, flaming yellowish-green hair with two side bangs and a center bang sweeping right. Her fingertips are notably pointed. She wears a light-gray double-breasted mini dress with orange and black lining, side slits, black collar and belt, silver screw-like buttons, and a temperature gauge belt with fire extinguisher attachment. Black knee-high socks and short black boots complete her outfit, along with a black mask connected to a red headband.

Backstory:
One of over thirty sidekicks working under the renowned Pro Hero Endeavor at his agency. She mentors and evaluates hero students during their internships, demonstrating her experience and dedication to hero work.

Additional Information:
Not a UA High School student; established Pro Hero working in the field. Her Blazing Hair Quirk allows her to detach and throw fire-like hair as projectiles and enables flight capabilities. Her bold personality often clashes with other strong-willed heroes like Katsuki Bakugo.

cardPool.title: Mocha
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Mocha
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Double
Occupation/Role: Experimented Nomu in Kyudai Garaki's Laboratory
Personality: Loyal and protective of his master Kyudai Garaki, willing to sacrifice himself in defense despite his small stature and limited combat capability.
Appearance: A diminutive Nomu with light yellow skin, round eyes, and an exposed brain visible atop his head. Distinctive cat-like ears are actually human noses, and a spinal tail extends from his body. He wears pale lace-up shoes on his upper limbs.
Backstory: Created and held captive in Kyudai Garaki's secret laboratory as an experimental Nomu subject, Mocha developed a genuine attachment to his captor and master, demonstrating unexpected emotional bonds despite his artificial origin.
Additional Information: Mocha's Double Quirk appears to be a duplication of Twice's ability, allowing creation of autonomous duplicates of individuals, though the full mechanics remain unclear. As a small-scale Nomu, he poses minimal direct threat but serves as a loyal asset to Garaki's operations.

cardPool.title: Miyashita
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Miyashita
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Unknown
Occupation/Role: Detnerat Company Employee
Personality: Straightforward and honest, prone to casual joking even with superiors, critical thinker who questions ideology, unguarded in speech and opinions.
Appearance: Middle-aged man with a distinctly rodent-like head featuring circular ears, dark beady eyes, and a small animal-like nose and muzzle. Short dark hair swept forward around his ears. Dressed in professional business attire: white dress shirt, pale blazer, and dark tie.
Backstory: A dedicated employee of the Detnerat Company working in their hero support gear division. Orphaned after his mother's death a year prior with no remaining family. Known for his candid rapport with his boss Rikiya Yotsubashi, frequently making light-hearted jabs including jokes about his superior's appearance.
Additional Information: Killed by Rikiya Yotsubashi after expressing moral opposition to Destro's ideology and the Meta Liberation Army. His death demonstrates Yotsubashi's ruthlessness toward those who question his extremist views. Not a UA student.

cardPool.title: Miu
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Miu

Alias: Feathers (with twin sister Yu)

Quirk Name: Unknown

Occupation/Role: Underground idol performer

Personality: Sharp-tongued and judgmental with a critical edge, though capable of warming to others as bonds deepen. Initially dismissive and harsh in her assessments, she softens when genuinely befriending someone. Competitive and observant.

Appearance: Short-statured young girl with straight, shoulder-length light hair styled in a high left-side ponytail with side-swept bangs. Dark, stern eyes that tilt slightly inward, giving her an aggressive appearance. Wears a sleeveless knee-length idol dress with pointed skirt, thick collar, feather accent, tights, and one long glove—the mirror image of her twin's costume in reversed colors and design. Dark training tracksuit with pale side stripes when not performing.

Backstory: Miu is half of the underground idol duo Feathers, performing alongside her twin sister Yu at local festivals. Known as "the mean one," she initially judges others harshly, particularly those she deems less talented, but gradually learns to see past first impressions through genuine connections.

Additional Information: Possesses exceptional singing talent, notably superior to other underground performers. Works within the underground idol community rather than attending formal institutions. Her contrasting costume design and opposing personality to Yu creates a dynamic duo performance style.

cardPool.title: Mirio Togata
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Mirio Togata

Alias: Lemillion, The Comedy Hero

Quirk Name: Permeation

Occupation/Role: Class 3-B Student at UA High School, Member of The Big 3

Personality: Highly goofy and energetic with an infectious optimism and constant smile. Known for corny, puerile humor and making a fool of himself for others' amusement. Despite his laid-back nature, he is an extremely dedicated and hard-working hero candidate with serious determination to master his Quirk and become a symbol of peace.

Appearance: Tall with a very muscular build. Distinctive beady blue eyes with no visible sclera, a prominently rounded nose, and blond hair styled in a quiff on top with the bottom section swept backward. Wears standard UA school uniform with a large golden buckle belt shaped like a carnivorous mouth. His hero costume features a white skin-tight top with "1000000" stamped across the chest in yellow, green belt lines, baggy dark blue pants with white backing, white knee-high boots with yellow soles, red cape, and thick red gloves.

Backstory: A top-tier UA student and member of The Big 3, Mirio has spent considerable time mastering his nearly unmasterable Permeation Quirk through relentless training and innovation. He cut his former ponytail to allow the support department to craft a specialized hero costume compatible with his abilities, demonstrating his commitment to heroism.

Additional Information: Sir Nighteye believes Mirio has the potential to replace All Might as the next symbol of peace. His journey showcases how dedication and humor can coexist in a true hero candidate.

cardPool.title: Mirai Sasaki
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Mirai Sasaki

Alias: Sir Nighteye

Quirk Name: Foresight

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero

Personality: Stoic and intimidating with a sharp, cold demeanor, yet values humor deeply and requires those around him to make him laugh. Pragmatic, protective of his subordinates, and unafraid to admit mistakes. Fiercely devoted to All Might and his ideals, though willing to disagree when he believes the greater good is at stake.

Appearance: Tall and lean with sharp, angular features and stern yellow eyes behind triangular glasses. Dark green hair slicked back with three yellow streaks is parted to his left, and his yellowish eyebrows match his glasses' rims. He dresses unusually for a hero in a plain white suit with gold buttons, white dress shirt, and red tie with white dots—practical office wear that belies his combat capability.

Backstory: A former sidekick to All Might, Nighteye served as the brains behind the Symbol of Peace and studied his hero extensively. He became a respected Pro Hero and mentor figure, though his falling out with All Might over the choice of successor shapes his current path. His prescient abilities burden him greatly.

Additional Information: Not a UA student; an established Pro Hero and mentor to sidekicks. Deeply knowledgeable about All Might's heroic history. Fears the consequences of using his Foresight, particularly regarding death premonitions.

cardPool.title: Minotaurus
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Minotaurus
Quirk Name: Bull Head
Occupation/Role: E-rank Villain, League of Villains recruit
Personality: Temperamental and violent with a quick temper, but prone to intimidation when facing powerful opponents. Easily unnerved by superior strength.
Appearance: A hulking man with bluish skin and a single cyclopean eye dominating his face. Two large horns protrude from either side of his head. He wears a ripped black sleeveless shirt, grayish-brown pants, and a large white belt across his torso. His muscular build reflects his aggressive nature.
Backstory: Recruited by Tomura Shigaraki as one of roughly seventy villains for the U.S.J. assault, Minotaurus sought to eliminate All Might and strike fear into UA's student body. His confidence wavered when confronted by Eraser Head's combat prowess, and he was quickly subdued by All Might's overwhelming power before arrest.
Additional Information: Minotaurus possesses no formal combat training beyond his Quirk's physical advantages. His intimidation by authority figures suggests reliance on numerical superiority rather than individual skill. He serves as a minor antagonist during the U.S.J. Arc invasion.

cardPool.title: Minoru Mineta
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Minoru Mineta

Alias: Grape Juice

Quirk Name: Pop Off

Occupation/Role: UA High School Student, Class 1-A

Personality: Timid yet perverted, with a reputation for lewd behavior that makes him unpopular. Easily jealous and envious of cooler classmates, he frequently speaks his mind with cynical harshness. Despite his crass exterior, he shows genuine kindness and concern for others in danger, though he panics easily under stress. His motivations for heroism stem from wanting popularity and attention from girls.

Appearance: A short teenage boy with an unusually large, round head and puffy cheeks. His dark purple hair forms four ball-shaped clumps resembling a mohawk. He has a small, stubby upturned nose, oval eyes with large black pupils, and thin eyebrows. At UA, he wears the standard male uniform modified for his short stature: light gray blazer with dark turquoise trim, white dress shirt, dark blue-green pants, red tie, and brown shoes.

Backstory: A first-year student at UA High School determined to become a Pro Hero. Driven partly by genuine heroic aspirations but primarily by desires for popularity and female attention, Minoru trains alongside his Class 1-A peers despite feeling his Quirk is underwhelming compared to theirs.

Additional Information: Often attempts to act charming and impressive but comes across as obnoxious instead. Can be hypocritical and enjoys teasing others, yet demonstrates capacity for genuine apology when confronted with his mistakes.

cardPool.title: Mina Ashido
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Mina Ashido

Alias:
Ridley Hero: Pinky

Quirk Name:
Acid

Occupation/Role:
UA High School Student, Class 1-A

Personality:
Cheerful, easygoing, and perpetually smiling. Highly social and excitable, Mina thrives in group settings and genuinely loves spending time with friends. She displays infectious enthusiasm and upbeat energy that lifts those around her.

Appearance:
A girl of medium height with a sturdy, athletic build. Her light pink skin—a result of her Quirk—contrasts with her short, fluffy, slightly darker pink hair that frames her face in an unruly manner. She has distinctive square-shaped eyes with black sclera, yellow irises, and notably long eyelashes. Two pale yellow horns protrude from her head, hooked and leaning diagonally opposite. At UA, she wears the standard female uniform: gray dress jacket with teal stripes and golden buttons, white dress shirt, red tie, and teal pleated skirt with brown shoes and knee-high socks.

Backstory:
A student training to become a Pro Hero at UA High School during her first year. Mina joined UA's Class 1-A to develop her Quirk and combat abilities. Her background at Mustafa Private Middle School shaped her into the socially confident individual she is today.

Additional Information:
Her hero costume, "Prism Sky," features a white mask, purple and turquoise skintight bodysuit with camouflage pattern, and cropped beige waistcoat with white fur collar. Custom acid-proof boots with ventilation holes allow her to secrete acid from her feet for enhanced mobility. Her Quirk grants her control over acidic secretions from her body.

cardPool.title: Mika Jiro
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Mika Jiro

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Earphone Jack

Occupation/Role: Musician; Mother

Personality: Kind-hearted and encouraging, Mika is a supportive parent who respects her daughter's autonomy and life choices. She maintains composure in tense situations and balances her husband's passionate nature with level-headed wisdom. Her understanding nature stems from genuine care for those around her.

Appearance: A slender woman with short, straight dark purple hair styled with bangs falling to the right. She wears black-framed glasses and typically dresses in professional yet casual attire—a collared shell top, pencil skirt, and tights. Her most distinctive feature is her plug-like earlobes, inherited by her daughter Kyoka.

Backstory: Mika is an accomplished musician whose talent attracted her husband Kyotoku, leading to their marriage and the birth of Kyoka. She passed her love of music to her daughter but, unlike her husband, readily accepted when Kyoka chose to pursue heroics instead of a musical career, encouraging her to help others through whatever path she chose.

Additional Information: Mika possesses the Earphone Jack Quirk, granting her plug-type jacks on her earlobes. She can channel vibrations through connected objects and likely extend her earlobes over distance. She is not a UA student but an established adult supporting her daughter's enrollment at the school.

cardPool.title: Mihaera
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Mihaera
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Unknown
Occupation/Role: Villain/Spy Infiltrator at U.A. High School
Personality: Serious and obedient, willing to follow orders without question in service of her goals. She is pragmatic and focused on securing her future through loyalty to All For One's cause.
Appearance: A young woman with long hair concealed beneath a beanie, wearing a simple shirt and jacket. Her style is deliberately unremarkable, designed for blending in among refugees and students.
Backstory: One of five undercover spies sent by All For One to infiltrate U.A. High School under the guise of a refugee. She participated in psychological operations intended to force Izuku Midoriya to leave the school, and later assisted in disrupting U.A.'s evacuation systems during the Final War under Skeptic's command.
Additional Information: Mihaera was captured by Class 1-A students Itsuka Kendo and Tetsutetsu Tetsutetsu while pinned against a wall with a bomb, preventing her from detonating it. She has demonstrated experience with explosives and sabotage tactics. Her current status following All For One's defeat remains unknown, though she is presumed to be in custody.

cardPool.title: Mick
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Mick
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Unknown
Occupation/Role: Pro Hero Sidekick, Oki Mariner Crew Member
Personality: Responsible and dependable, capable of managing crew operations independently and maintaining discipline aboard ship.
Appearance: Muscular build with blond close-cropped hair and matching beard. Wears a white sailor's uniform with blue horizontal stripes as part of Selkie's crew.
Backstory: A seasoned sidekick under the Pro Hero Selkie, Mick serves as a trusted member of the Oki Mariner crew. His competence has earned him command responsibilities when Selkie is absent.
Additional Information: Not a UA student; operates as a professional hero alongside Selkie and the Oki Mariner crew in an aquatic-focused hero agency.

cardPool.title: Mezo Shoji
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Mezo Shoji

Alias: Tentacle Hero: Tentacole

Quirk Name: Dupli-Arms

Occupation/Role: UA High School Student, Class 1-A

Personality: Friendly, gentle, and selfless despite his intimidating appearance. Mezo is empathetic and mature, avoiding emotional impulses while remaining deeply protective of his classmates. Thick-skinned and unbothered by prejudice, he harbors no grudges and willingly risks himself for others. He claims to desire few material possessions.

Appearance: A tall, muscular young man with pale gray hair swept forward and bent downward over his eye. His most distinctive feature is six arms connected by webbing—the front two have hands while the others end in thin stumps. He has an elongated face with eyes set toward the sides, concealed by a light blue mask covering from below his eyes to his neck, which he wears constantly. He dons the standard UA male uniform with a sleeveless blazer to accommodate his tentacles, paired with brown shoes.

Backstory: Hailing from a hometown plagued by prejudice against heteromorphs, Mezo adopted his signature mask after his appearance made a young girl cry. Despite societal fear and discrimination rooted in his altered physique, he remained determined to become a Pro Hero. Now training at UA High School, he channels his experiences into protecting others and proving that his Quirk and appearance define neither his character nor his heroic potential.

Additional Information: Mezo is a UA Class 1-A student training during the Quirk Apprehension Test arc. As a heteromorph, he faces unique societal challenges but maintains unwavering resolve to succeed as a hero while remaining compassionate toward all.

cardPool.title: Meryl Hope
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Meryl Hope

Alias:
None

Quirk Name:
Unknown

Occupation/Role:
Weather Forecaster for BCD News

Personality:
Professional and bold, with an unwavering commitment to truth and resistance against corruption. Meryl is direct and courageous, willing to publicly oppose government capitulation even at personal risk. She communicates in a condensed, efficient manner while maintaining strong moral conviction.

Appearance:
A dark-skinned woman of average height with a curvaceous build, blue eyes, and thick eyebrows. Her light blonde hair falls to shoulder length. She typically wears an all-white thigh-length dress with matching white shoes and a wristwatch on her left wrist, maintaining a professional appearance befitting a news broadcaster.

Backstory:
Meryl works as a weather forecaster for BCD News in Washington State, where she has built a reputation for accurate reporting and thorough meteorological research. Her dedication to journalism has evolved into active resistance against governmental corruption, positioning her as a voice of defiance against powerful forces threatening freedom.

Additional Information:
Not a UA High School student. Operates independently in the United States media landscape. Her Quirk type remains unrevealed. She serves as a civilian voice of resistance and moral authority within her community.

cardPool.title: Melissa Shield
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Melissa Shield
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Quirkless
Occupation/Role: Third-year student at I-Island Academy
Personality: Kindhearted and intelligent with unwavering determination to become a hero despite lacking a Quirk. Outgoing, generous, and naturally curious, she quickly befriends those around her and remains calm under pressure. She deeply admires her father and All Might, believing indirect support through invention is a valid path to fighting for peace.
Appearance: A pale-skinned young woman of slightly above average height with a round face. She has wavy blonde hair reaching midway down her back with side-swept bangs framing her face, aqua-blue eyes with pronounced eyelashes, and wears pink oval-framed glasses. Typically dressed in the I-Island Academy uniform: white short-sleeved dress shirt with plaid cuffs, large matching bow at neck, dark raspberry waistcoat, pale gray Capri pants, plaid pink socks, and heeled brown boots. She wears a wristwatch and maintains coral-pink nail polish.
Backstory: The brilliant daughter of Professor David Shield, a renowned inventor and hero support scientist. Melissa inherited her father's genius and dedication to advancing heroics through technology. She was present at the I-Expo when her father's plans were disrupted, displaying heroic courage by assisting UA students against villains despite her Quirkless status.
Additional Information: Inventor of support equipment including the Full Gauntlet, designed to reduce strain on Quirk users. Close ally of Izuku Midoriya and Class 1-A. Demonstrated exceptional bravery by tackling the villain Swordkil to save Izuku despite having no combat Quirk.

cardPool.title: Mei Hatsume
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Mei Hatsume
Alias: The Support Department's Genius
Quirk Name: Zoom
Occupation/Role: UA High School Support Department student, Class 1-H
Personality: Smart, assertive, and shameless; loves her inventions with obsessive passion. Direct and opportunistic in conversation, often making others uncomfortable by invading personal space. Shows no fear of failure and views setbacks as learning opportunities. Self-centered but driven by genuine motivation to improve her craft rather than selfish greed. Somewhat absent-minded and poor at reading social cues.
Appearance: Reasonably short with mature build for her age. Salmon pink shoulder-length hair styled in thick dreadlocks, swept to the right. Wide, upward-sloped green-yellow eyes with distinctive cross-shaped irises resembling scope lenses with notably long upper lashes. Wears modified UA gym uniform (dark blue tracksuit) accessorized with red and gold steampunk goggles, utility belt, oversized speed-assisting boots, and a jet pack. Frequently adorned with various self-made gadgets.
Backstory: A naturally gifted inventor enrolled in UA's Support Department. Her exceptional talent for creating functional equipment has earned recognition from even experienced faculty like Power Loader. She views support items as equally vital to heroics as combat ability, believing inventors play a crucial role in the hero industry.
Additional Information: Expert at rapid prototyping, capable of creating new inventions in seconds with single-handed construction. Proved surprisingly combat-capable against speedster Tenya Iida during the Quirk Apprehension Test, lasting ten minutes before voluntarily forfeiting. Relies primarily on her gadgets rather than combat abilities.

cardPool.title: Mawata Fuwa
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Mawata Fuwa

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Unknowable (inferred from context, specific mechanics not detailed in source)

Occupation/Role: UA High School Class 2-A Student, Pro Hero in Training

Personality: Cheerful and carefree with a lax demeanor, yet capable of serious responsibility when needed. Respects tough teaching methods and understands their value despite initial fear. Shows fondness for difficult experiences that foster growth and maturity.

Appearance: Girl with layered light pink hair reaching shoulder-length, straight bangs parted left and tucked behind ear, falling over right eye. Round gray eyes sloping slightly downward, framed by long eyelashes and dark eye makeup with star or cloud-shaped pupils. Wears standard female UA uniform and distinctive puffy cotton ball-shaped earrings. Hero costume consists of a fluffy white sleeveless jacket with black arm bracers and enlarged cotton ball earrings.

Backstory: A first-year student under Eraser Head's instruction, Mawata initially feared his harsh training methods. She was expelled alongside her entire class during a lesson, then immediately re-enrolled to experience "a death" and grow as heroes. This formative experience shaped her understanding of heroic purpose and strengthened her class bonds.

Additional Information: Class 2-A student during the Quirk Apprehension Test arc. Participated in the Final War against All For One at Mt. Fuji. Chosen as class point of contact for post-war restoration efforts, demonstrating leadership despite her casual personality.

cardPool.title: Master Driller
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown

Alias: Master Driller

Quirk Name: Drill

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero

Personality: Courageous and resolute, Master Driller demonstrates unwavering determination to protect civilians and aid fellow heroes in danger. He fights without hesitation even when facing overwhelming odds, willing to sacrifice himself for the greater good.

Appearance: Master Driller wears a maroon combat suit with reinforced metal leg protectors and asymmetrical shoulder armor—the left circular with red and gray coloring, the right blocky and fully red. His left arm features a metallic armband and forearm guard, while his right arm is replaced by a massive mechanical drill. A black helmet with a white facial plate and yellow star design on the forehead covers his head, with a blue visor protecting his eyes.

Backstory: A dedicated Pro Hero who answered the call to evacuate Jaku City during the Paranormal Liberation Front crisis. Master Driller fought valiantly against Near High-End Nomu reinforcements, prioritizing the safety of civilians and supporting fellow heroes in combat.

Additional Information: Master Driller operates as part of organized hero task forces. His Drill Quirk allows him to bore through materials and organic matter with devastating precision, making him effective against heavily armored or biological threats.

cardPool.title: Master Beast
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Master Beast
Quirk Name: Unnamed Werewolf Quirk
Occupation/Role: Underground fighter in the Underground Masquerade
Personality: Aggressive and brutal in combat, relying on his natural physical advantages. Shows resilience by continuing to fight despite injuries and recovering alongside defeated opponents without apparent animosity.
Appearance: Muscular werewolf-like humanoid with a coat of thick fur covering his body. Wears only dark pants and leather shoulder pads with straps crossing his chest. A domino mask covers his eyes per Underground Masquerade dress code. His most distinctive features are his razor-sharp claws and feral, bestial physiology.
Backstory: An underground fighter who competes in the illicit Underground Masquerade fighting circuit. His origins and true identity remain shrouded in mystery, known only by his combat moniker. He faced defeat against Drunk Lee in an official bout, suffering severe burns when his fur was ignited by his opponent's Dragon Breath Quirk.
Additional Information: Not a UA High School student. His Quirk grants him enhanced physical attributes including superhuman strength and razor-sharp claws designed for close-quarters combat. Despite his loss to Drunk Lee, the two later recovered together, suggesting the Underground Masquerade maintains a community among its fighters regardless of match outcomes.

cardPool.title: Mashirao Ojiro
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Mashirao Ojiro

Alias:
Tailman

Quirk Name:
Tail

Occupation/Role:
UA High School Student, Class 1-A

Personality:
Calm and noble with a strong sense of dignity, Mashirao is a hard worker who avoids the spotlight due to his sheepish nature. Despite his humble demeanor, he is reliable and focused during hero work. Sensitive about being perceived as "plain," he shocks easily but maintains composure in combat.

Appearance:
A muscular young man with short blond hair swept forward and thin eyes lacking lower eyelashes. His most distinctive feature is a hairless, prehensile tail tinted like his hair with a tufted tip. At UA, he wears the standard male uniform with pale gray sneakers instead of brown shoes. His hero costume consists of a plain karate gi with a black belt, blue accessories, fur-lined collar, and black boots with light blue accents.

Backstory:
Mashirao trained at UA High School alongside Class 1-A to become a Pro Hero. His martial arts knowledge combined with his natural tail physiology earned him 7th place in the Quirk Apprehension Test, demonstrating his combat capabilities early in his hero journey.

Additional Information:
Mashirao uses his tail for both offensive attacks and mobility, launching himself airborne by striking the ground. However, he fights somewhat predictably due to his tail's natural movement patterns. He is working to eliminate this weakness through improved fundamentals. He occasionally hangs his tail over his shoulder to relieve strain.

cardPool.title: Masaki Mizushima
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Masaki Mizushima

Alias: Normal Hero: Manual

Quirk Name: Water Control

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero (No. 222), based in Hosu City

Personality: Kind, attentive, and inspiring with an ordinary demeanor. He aspires to be a role model for modern heroes and possesses keen observational skills, able to discern others' motivations and intentions with ease.

Appearance: A man with messy brown hair and black eyes. He wears a blue and white skin-tight long-sleeved shirt tucked into orange gloves, dark pants, and white boots. His signature helmet features a fish-like fin and blue visor, completing his distinctive hero costume.

Backstory: Masaki rose through the hero ranks to become the No. 222 Pro Hero, establishing his base of operations in Hosu City. He mentored young hero hopefuls and became known for his reliable, straightforward approach to heroism, earning respect through consistent dedication.

Additional Information: His Quirk allows him to manipulate pre-existing water but has a weakness to air pressure, which disrupts his control. He selected his intern based on recognizing similar qualities in them, demonstrating his perceptive nature beyond his combat abilities.

cardPool.title: Martial Hair
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Martial Hair
Quirk Name: Hair Control
Occupation/Role: F-rank Villain
Personality: Aggressive and combat-ready, willing to engage pro heroes despite limited power. Shows confidence in her abilities despite her low rank.
Appearance: Young woman of average height with a lean build. Light brown hair styled in pigtails reaching just above her shoulders, with side-swept bangs. Matching light brown, ovalish eyes. Wears magenta boots, magenta shorts, magenta sports bra, and two large darker magenta armbands.
Backstory: Recruited by Tomura Shigaraki as one of approximately seventy villains for the assault on the Unforeseen Simulation Joint. She participated in the U.S.J. invasion but was quickly defeated by Eraser Head with a single kick to her face before being arrested by arriving pro heroes.
Additional Information: F-rank villain with modest combat experience. Her Quirk allows her to shape her ponytails into weapons like drills. Despite her low ranking and quick defeat, she demonstrates willingness to confront professional heroes.

cardPool.title: Mario Kugutsu
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Mario Kugutsu

Alias: The Toy Man

Quirk Name: Playtime

Occupation/Role: Trigger Dealer and Instant Villain for the Villain Factory

Personality: Outwardly timid and apologetic, appearing spiritless with perpetually closed eyes. This is a calculated disguise masking his true nature—a cunning predator who targets vulnerable individuals with weak wills. When activated by Trigger, he regresses to a childlike state, treating people as toys and making playful sound effects. He is manipulative, sinister, and displays a perverse obsession with both toys and the drug itself.

Appearance: Average height with neatly combed black hair and plain office salaryman clothing. His eyes remain shut, giving him a dull appearance, but when opened they appear manic and unusual. His long, protruding tongue adds to his creepy demeanor. Under Trigger's influence, his body becomes colossal like a tall building, jet black with no body hair, simplified facial features, and four arms instead of two.

Backstory: Mario operates as a Trigger dealer for the Villain Factory, exploiting desperate or prideful individuals by offering them the drug to amplify their Quirks into destructive rampages. He has proven skilled enough to deceive both heroes and authorities, convincing them he was simply an unwilling Instant Villain rather than an active predator.

Additional Information: Mario's Quirk only manifests when under the effects of Trigger. His childlike behavior while transformed contradicts his monstrous appearance. He is not a UA student but an active criminal operating in the vigilante underworld.

cardPool.title: Manga Fukidashi
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Manga Fukidashi

Alias: Comicman

Quirk Name: Comic

Occupation/Role: UA High School Class 1-B Student, Hero-in-Training

Personality: Expressive and dramatically enthusiastic, with a soft spot for children and a desire to make them smile. Strategic team player who excels at supporting allies during combat scenarios.

Appearance: A notably short young man with fair skin and a distinctive blank, pale-white speech bubble for a head and neck that can change shape to display his thoughts in written form. He wears a blue shirt with red sleeves, ink bottle-patterned armor around his torso and legs, a yellow manga panel-decorated belt, short elbow-length gloves, and a mask resembling a manga page template.

Backstory: A UA High School student training to become a Pro Hero in Class 1-B. Despite his unusual quirk-based appearance, he demonstrates genuine compassion and tactical intelligence, making him a versatile and valued team member among his peers.

Additional Information: Comic allows him to materialize onomatopoeia in midair, creating real effects matching the sounds he speaks—enabling offensive, defensive, and support capabilities. Overuse causes severe throat soreness. His effective quirk application and teamwork impressed Pro Hero Wash during the Joint Training Battle.

cardPool.title: Manami Aiba
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Manami Aiba

Alias: La Brava

Quirk Name: Love

Occupation/Role: Villain Associate / Hacker

Personality: Deeply devoted and loyal to those she admires, with an intense capacity for love that borders on obsessive. Initially withdrawn and socially isolated after past rejection, but gains confidence and purpose through her admiration for Danjuro. Protective and supportive of her partner, prone to worry despite understanding his abilities. Sensitive to rejection but fiercely committed once emotionally invested.

Appearance: A notably short young woman with a disproportionately large, round head and narrow body. She has distinctive raspberry pink hair styled in two high pigtails that taper to thin ends, with a single centered bang swept to the right. Her most striking features are her large, pointed-down eyes with dark under-eye rings and oval pink irises containing two concentric circles, creating a hypnotic gaze. She wears an elaborate outfit: white bow at her neck, thick white gloves, an indigo shirt with large pink buttons and frilly upturned sleeve cuffs, puffy white pinstriped pants with heart motifs, golden belts with heart buckles, shiny high-heeled boots over dark tights, and heart-shaped earrings. The extensive heart designs reflect her passionate nature.

Backstory: Once a lonely middle schooler who fell into depression after her love confession was rejected and mocked. She became a reclusive shut-in, finding renewed purpose upon discovering Danjuro's online videos. Grateful for his acceptance, she became his devoted supporter and partner, managing his online presence while assisting him in his activities.

Additional Information: Not a UA student. Operates primarily as a hacker and online content manager. Her Quirk amplifies her emotional connection and influence over those she loves.

cardPool.title: Makoto Tsukauchi
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Makoto Tsukauchi

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Polygraph

Occupation/Role: General Manager of Captain Celebrity Corporation

Personality: Intelligent, independent, and determined with a pleasant demeanor that masks subtle manipulation. She is skilled at organizing groups and getting people to cooperate, though she possesses a rebellious streak and isn't afraid to bend rules to achieve her goals. Generally charming and social, she knows how to talk her way through difficult situations.

Appearance: An attractive young woman of slim build and above-average height. She has jet black hair extending to her mid-lower back, parted to the right, and dark eyes typically concealed behind bright green contacts. A small mole adorns the lower left corner of her mouth. She dresses fashionably befitting her corporate position and consistently wears gold-colored hoop earrings.

Backstory: The younger sister of Detective Naomasa Tsukauchi, Makoto has leveraged her intelligence and social skills to become General Manager at Captain Celebrity Corporation, where she effectively runs the PR department. Her natural talent for manipulation and information-gathering mirrors her brother's detective work, though she applies it in the corporate world. Her rebellious nature has been present since childhood, often creating tension with her more rule-abiding sibling.

Additional Information: Makoto's Quirk allows her to detect lies through physiological monitoring when touching someone, though it fails if the subject is relaxed or genuinely believes their statement. She is not a UA student but operates in the hero society's entertainment and public relations sector. She is highly regarded by those around her, though her methods can be somewhat underhanded.

cardPool.title: Mako Magi
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Mako Magi

Alias: None

Quirk Name: None

Occupation/Role: Homemaker, Grandmother

Personality: Caring and compassionate toward her grandchildren, but timid and conflict-averse. She witnessed abuse but feared confrontation with her son-in-law. Despite her gentleness, she ultimately tried to protect her family by joining efforts to stop the violence, showing hidden courage.

Appearance: An elderly woman with a black bob-cut hairstyle and glasses. She has a soft, aging face reflecting decades of quiet domestic life. Her attire is simple and practical, befitting her role as a homemaker in a traditional household.

Backstory: Mako lived with her husband Chizuo in her daughter Nao's home, helping raise her grandchildren Tenko and Hana. She grew increasingly distressed by her son-in-law Kotaro's violent abuse of the children for admiring heroes, but remained silent out of fear of eviction. When Kotaro's brutality escalated, she finally joined her family in confronting him—only to witness her grandson Tenko's Decay Quirk manifest uncontrollably, killing her entire family in a tragic accident.

Additional Information: Deceased. She perished when Tenko Shimura's Quirk spiraled out of control. Her remains were later recovered and incorporated into the villain Tomura Shigaraki's costume, becoming twisted relics of a family tragedy.

cardPool.title: Maina Furasu
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Maina Furasu

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Not specified

Occupation/Role: UA High School Support Department student, Class 1-H

Personality: Timid and easily startled, yet dutiful and brave when called upon. Less energetic and assertive than peers, but capable of recognizing absurdity even in desperate situations. Dedicated to her responsibilities despite her shy nature.

Appearance: Dark brown hair tied in a ponytail with a beige headband adorned with two blue bells, a flat screw and screwdriver head detail on the left side. Average build with wide, expressive eyes. Wears standard UA Support Department plain beige workshop coveralls.

Backstory: A talented support course student at UA High School with no combat experience. Maina proved her bravery by joining the Heroes during the Final War against All For One's villain army, maintaining critical fortress systems and equipment while under attack. Her intelligence and technical aptitude earned her place among UA's support specialists.

Additional Information: Works closely with Momo Yaoyorozu for supply management. Capable of maintaining complex UA equipment and systems under pressure. Not a frontline fighter but essential infrastructure support personnel. Her Quirk type remains undocumented in available records.

cardPool.title: Mahoro Shimano
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Mahoro Shimano

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Hologram

Occupation/Role: Nabu Island resident; student

Personality: Stubborn and quick to judge, Mahoro is fiercely protective of her younger brother Katsuma following their mother's death. Initially cynical about heroes, she deliberately tests Class 1-A's resolve by creating false emergencies. Through her encounters with true heroism, she gradually develops genuine appreciation and respect for those who dedicate themselves to saving others.

Appearance: A small girl with dark brown eyes and straight brown hair styled in pigtails with dark pink bubble-shaped bands. She has a light patch of freckles across her face and wears a pink dress with dark pink overall straps over a black tank top, white sandals with pink accents, and a large sun hat with a dark pink scarf and bow. On her left wrist is a handmade floral charm bracelet matching her brother's, a gift from their mother.

Backstory: Living on Nabu Island with her younger brother after their mother's death, Mahoro has become the emotional anchor in their family while their father works away. Disillusioned with the hero system due to her father's frequent absences, she initially sees heroes as overrated. Her perspective shifts dramatically during Nine's invasion of the island, when Class 1-A and other heroes genuinely risk their lives to protect her and Katsuma.

Additional Information: Mahoro's Hologram Quirk creates realistic but non-corporeal projections of any size, making her a valuable asset for reconnaissance or deception. She carries deep emotional scars from family tragedy that inform her protective nature and initial distrust of authority figures.

cardPool.title: Maguma Iwata

Eruption

Villain, Leader of the Volcano Thieves

Personality:
Commanding and ruthless, Maguma leads his criminal organization with confidence. He is tactical in his approach to theft and combat, relying on his overwhelming power to dominate confrontations.

Appearance:
A tall, heavily muscular man with large brown eyes and distinctive orange, flame-shaped hair. He wears a baggy navy blue bodysuit paired with bulky, rock-like boots, gauntlets, and shoulder pads lined with smoke-expelling pores. An orange belt cinches his waist, and a gas mask with a mercury thermometer hangs from his shoulder pads.

Backstory:
Maguma founded and leads the Volcano Thieves, a criminal organization operating outside the law. His mastery of his Quirk and imposing physique have earned him respect among his subordinates and fear among his enemies.

Additional Information:
His Eruption Quirk produces lava-like substance by burning fat cells. His technological gear—gauntlets, shoulder pads, and mask—amplifies his fire projection range and regulate his dangerous body temperature, making him a formidable threat in direct confrontation.

cardPool.title: Madame Puppimil
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Madame Puppimil
Alias: The Dognapping Boss
Quirk Name: Trimming
Occupation/Role: Villain, Dognapper Leader
Personality: Callous and greed-driven, yet surprisingly affectionate and charismatic. She commands unwavering loyalty from her henchmen through charm and can lavish genuine warmth on those she favors, though this affection masks her ruthless criminal nature.
Appearance: A moderately-built woman with waist-length, right-parted hair adorned with a flower on the right side. She wears a spotted mini-dress beneath a fur-lined cape with a fur stole, matching arm and leg bands, black tights, and black high-heels, presenting an elegant yet extravagant aesthetic.
Backstory: A cunning criminal entrepreneur who leads a dog-trafficking operation, stealing and selling dogs for profit. Her ability to recognize value in her "acquisitions" and her capacity for genuine affection make her a complex antagonist who views her victims both as commodities and cherished possessions.
Additional Information: Operates a hideout warehouse stocked with caged dogs awaiting sale. Her Trimming Quirk allows her to groom and modify the appearance of living beings. She was ultimately subdued by Class 1-A students during their investigation into a missing puppy, falling into a pit before being captured by authorities.

cardPool.title: Madam President
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Madam President
Quirk Name: Unknown
Occupation/Role: Head of the Hero Public Safety Commission
Personality: Calm and steely, reassuring in public but pragmatic and willing to make morally questionable decisions for perceived societal benefit. She balances ruthlessness with a degree of mercy, disagreeing with her predecessor's extreme methods while still orchestrating manipulation and coercion.
Appearance: Middle-aged woman with turquoise eyes and ash-blonde hair slicked back. She wears a black suit jacket and dress paired with a purple shirt and a necklace, projecting an air of professional authority and control.
Backstory: Once Vice President under a more brutal predecessor, she witnessed the commission's use of Lady Nagant as an assassin. After Nagant killed the previous president out of disillusionment, she assumed leadership and imprisoned Nagant rather than execute her. She discovered young Keigo Takami after his heroic Quirk usage and recruited him into the commission's fold, grooming him to replace Nagant as their operative hero.
Additional Information: Operates from a position of institutional power rather than personal Quirk strength. Her influence shapes Japan's hero society through policy and strategic placement of operatives. She maintains the commission's public image while orchestrating covert operations against villains and managing internal corruption through calculated pragmatism.

cardPool.title: Madam

Unknown

Madam

Unknown

Professional Shopper

Personality:
Highly competitive and charismatic, Madam thrives on the thrill of department store sales events. She is cunning and quick to exploit newcomers' inexperience, yet shows gratitude when outsmarted. Her passion for shopping borders on obsession—the threat of being banned reduced her to tears. Despite her aggressive tactics, she possesses enough self-awareness to respect clever opponents.

Appearance:
A short, plump woman with voluminous curly black hair. She wears a tight-fitted dress with sharp pointed shoulder pads, accessorized with a prominent pearl necklace and heavy makeup that emphasizes her bold presence. Her style reflects her status as a veteran of competitive shopping events.

Backstory:
Madam is a fixture at local department stores, renowned for her legendary shopping prowess and ability to energize sale events. Her reputation precedes her—store staff recognize her contributions to event success. She encountered Momo Yaoyorozu during a blowout sale, initially targeting the novice shopper before being outwitted. A rule violation incident nearly resulted in her permanent ban, but the store granted her clemency due to her value to their events.

Additional Information:
Not a UA student. Operates independently in the civilian world. Her Quirk ability, if she possesses one, remains unspecified. She serves as a foil to UA students experiencing normal civilian life.

cardPool.title: Luminescent Baby
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Unknown

Alias:
Luminescent Baby

Luminescence

Occupation/Role:
Peace Activist, Historical Figure

Personality:
Charismatic and idealistic, possessed unwavering conviction in peaceful coexistence and societal harmony. Used their influence to inspire millions, demonstrating remarkable persuasive ability despite their young age.

Appearance:
An infant with luminous skin capable of emitting brilliant light. Their glow was distinctive enough to draw worldwide attention and become instantly recognizable across continents.

Backstory:
Born in Qing Qing City, China, as the first officially recorded person worldwide to possess a Quirk. Their birth sparked global fascination and hope for a new era. They leveraged their fame to establish a massive peace movement exceeding 10 million followers, advocating for safety and return to pre-Quirk society. This prominence attracted the attention of All For One, who murdered them and seized their Luminescence Quirk, erasing their direct influence but not their legacy.

Additional Information:
Deceased for many decades prior to the current timeline. Became a deity figure to Humarise, with an infant statue erected at their headquarters, symbolizing their enduring impact on quirk-related ideology and history.

cardPool.title: Leviathan

Spiraling red appendages extend from fingers, toes, and back, connecting to his head via tube-like structures. Wears torn black pants with brown belt. Without Trigger, fair-skinned and less muscular with smaller white spirals.

Additional Information: Relies heavily on Trigger drug enhancement to maximize combat effectiveness and pain suppression. His Helical Scythe Quirk becomes significantly more destructive when chemically augmented, allowing him to destroy ice barriers and wield semi-liquid appendages with lethal force.

None

Unknown

Student/Resident of Otheon Shantytown

Personality:
Kind-hearted and cheerful despite severe hardship, deeply devoted to her older brothers Rody and Roro. Resilient and adaptable, maintaining hope even when living in poverty and social ostracization. Obedient to Rody's protective instructions.

Appearance:
A small young girl with brown flat noodle-textured hair styled in a high side ponytail secured with a flower hair tie. Gray eyes and a youthful, innocent expression. Wears a sundress decorated with two flowers (one small, one large) over dark leggings ending above the knee, paired with slip-on sneakers.

Backstory:
Born in Otheon to engineer Eddie Soul and a deceased mother, Lala was raised primarily by her eldest brother Rody after their mother's death. When her father abandoned the family to join the anti-Quirk sect Humarise, the Soul children faced severe social ostracization, expulsion from school, and eventually homelessness, forcing them to live in a caravan in the shantytown. She endured this suffering alongside her siblings but maintained her affection for them.

Additional Information:
Non-combatant civilian character. Experiences the World Heroes' Mission crisis when Humarise plants bombs across twenty-five countries. Reunites with Rody after his heroic actions save the city and her siblings. Subsequently able to return to normal school life.

cardPool.title: L.A. Villains
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Red Villain (L.A. Villains)
Quirk Name: Rocket Launcher
Occupation/Role: Criminal/Villain
Personality: Selfish and greedy, willing to endanger innocent lives for profit. Relentless and cunning, using his Quirk strategically to create escape opportunities for allies during combat.
Appearance: Slim build with blonde hair and a distinctly long, pointed nose. Wears a red skin-tight full-body suit with white markings and a large white "R" emblazoned across the face mask.
Backstory: Member of the L.A. Villains, a California-based criminal duo responsible for robbing millions from a casino. Encountered and defeated by All Might during his time studying abroad in America, marking a significant defeat in his criminal career.
Additional Information: Works alongside a larger six-armed blue villain. His Quirk can fire two missiles simultaneously from transformed arm cannons. Arrested by Pro Heroes Elecplant and Cow Lady with assistance from All Might and David Shield.

cardPool.title: Kyudai Garaki
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Kyudai Garaki

Alias: Daruma Ujiko, Dr. Tsubasa, Doctor

Quirk Name: Life Force

Occupation/Role: Villain affiliated with the League of Villains; Chairman of Jaku General Hospital

Personality: Eccentric and deranged scientist devoted to All For One's will. Prideful of his Nomu creations, treating them as "children" and masterpieces. Overly cautious and secretive, communicating primarily through electronics to maintain anonymity. Despite unethical practices, he possesses genuine loyalty and care for those he deems worthy. Cowardly when threatened, prone to panic and exaggerated expressions, yet capable of extreme joy and gloating over successful plans. Believes hatred strengthens individuals.

Appearance: Fairly old man of portly, short stature with a completely bald head and very large, bushy mustache. Wears gear-shaped goggles and a white buttoned labcoat as a villain. As hospital chairman, he wears circular black-framed glasses, a shirt and tie beneath a regular labcoat. His Quirk makes him appear younger than his true age; without it, his skin is pale and heavily wrinkled with sunken eyes.

Backstory: A disgraced scientist rendered an outcast by former colleagues, Kyudai found patronage and friendship in All For One, who believed in his unethical research when others rejected him. He became the faithful servant of All For One and later Tomura Shigaraki, dedicating himself to creating powerful Nomu as offerings to his master.

Additional Information: Maintains a public persona as a benevolent medical researcher. Prefers electronic communication and warping-based travel to avoid direct contact. Fiercely loyal to All For One despite his cowardly nature when facing immediate threats.

cardPool.title: Kyotoku Jiro
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Kyotoku Jiro

Alias:
None

Quirk Name:
Earphone Jack

Occupation/Role:
Music Composer, Father

Personality:
Emotional and easygoing despite projecting a stern exterior. Deeply supportive of his daughter's heroic ambitions despite his passion for music. Quick to bicker playfully and has a theatrical side, as evidenced by his "concerned parent act."

Appearance:
A man with wavy, shoulder-length light-gold hair and triangular eyes matching his daughter's features. Casual in demeanor with a warm presence that belies his initial stern expressions.

Backstory:
A talented music composer who fell in love with Mika's musical abilities, leading to their marriage and adoption of her family name. He and his wife nurtured their daughter Kyoka's musical interests from youth, but readily embraced her dream of becoming a hero at UA High School despite their own artistic passions.

Additional Information:
Kyotoku possesses deep knowledge of music theory and shares his daughter's love of rock music. He is a supporting parent figure rather than a combatant, primarily appearing during UA-related family interactions.

cardPool.title: Kyoka Jiro
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Kyoka Jiro

Alias: Hearing Hero: Earphone Jack

Quirk Name: Earphone Jack

Occupation/Role: UA High School Student, Class 1-A

Personality: Pragmatic and blunt with a teasing nature, especially toward those she finds irritating. Despite appearing cold and indifferent, she is genuinely friendly with close classmates and surprisingly sensitive beneath her sarcastic exterior. Prefers intelligent approaches during hero activities and communicates plans clearly. Uses physical punishment via her Quirk to keep troublemakers in line.

Appearance: Petite girl with a slender build, black triangular eyes with notably long lower eyelashes, and dark-purple chin-length hair styled asymmetrically with sound-wave-shaped reflections on either side. Her most distinctive features are the flexible, plug-like earphone jacks hanging from her earlobes that function as controllable limbs. At UA, she wears the standard female student uniform: gray dress jacket with teal stripes and golden buttons over a white shirt, red tie, and teal pleated skirt with brown dress shoes and knee-high socks.

Backstory: Training to become a hero at UA High School alongside her Class 1-A peers. Comes from a background that shaped her pragmatic worldview, though details of her early life remain understated.

Additional Information: Often gesticulates through her elongated earlobes instead of using her hands. Best socializes with female classmates like Momo Yaoyorozu. Known targets of her snark include classmate Denki Kaminari for his cluelessness and Minoru Mineta for his behavior.

cardPool.title: Kurosagi
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Kurosagi
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Unknown
Occupation/Role: Former Assistant to Toy Company CEO
Personality: Greed-driven and opportunistic, willing to betray anyone for profit. Hypocritical—he despises copies and those with copying abilities despite producing bootlegs himself. Quick to abandon loyalty when usefulness ends, he prioritizes self-preservation over responsibility.
Appearance: Adult man with short, light-colored hair and a square jaw. Wears a full business suit with a distinctive kendama-shaped tie and square-framed shaded glasses, maintaining a professional corporate aesthetic.
Backstory: Kurosagi exploited his position as CEO assistant to access toy blueprints, which he stole to manufacture bootlegs that flooded the market. When the CEO's business suffered, he was tasked with investigating the very theft he committed. When Heroes intervened, he attempted to steal the master blueprint list and flee, only to be apprehended by Phantom Thief and arrested.
Additional Information: Not a UA student. A corporate criminal with access to proprietary industrial information. His downfall stemmed from underestimating Hero involvement and the consequences of his greed.

cardPool.title: Kurogiri
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Oboro Shirakumo
Alias: Kurogiri
Quirk Name: Warp Gate
Occupation/Role: High-End Nomu and member of the League of Villains
Personality: Level-headed and polite, serving as a grounding force to Tomura's immaturity. Intensely loyal to his masters with a sinister nature, yet retains fragments of Oboro's caring personality, worrying about those he was programmed to protect.
Appearance: A humanoid figure composed entirely of dark purple mist with glowing yellow eyes. Wears an elegant dark suit with a matching tie and a metal brace extending from his collarbone to below his eyes. His mist-form body occasionally reveals glimpses of his human features.
Backstory: Originally Oboro Shirakumo, a U.A. High School student, before being transformed by Doctor Kyudai Garaki into a High-End Nomu using his corpse. Created to serve and protect Tomura Shigaraki under All For One's command, he was imprisoned in Tartarus before relocation for research.
Additional Information: As a Nomu, Kurogiri is programmed to obey only select individuals and resist interrogation. A fragment of Oboro's original personality persists within him, occasionally manifesting through concern for others' safety, creating internal conflict between his Nomu programming and his former human identity.

cardPool.title: Kuin Hachisuka
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Kuin Hachisuka

Alias: Queen Bee

Quirk Name: Queen Bee

Occupation/Role: Student (High School); Part-time Villain serving the Villain Factory

Personality: Deceptively cheerful and social on the surface, masking a sadistic, ruthless, and cunning nature. Kuin is manipulative and enjoys causing harm through her Quirk, preying on vulnerable individuals. She operates with calculated cruelty while maintaining a carefree facade, finding entertainment in death and destruction. Vengeful and possessive of her bee colony, which she refers to as her "babies."

Appearance: While possessing Tamao Oguro, Kuin wears a dark green varsity jacket with a white bee insignia and yellow "Queen Bee" logo on the back, paired with a white dress shirt and light orange bow tie. She has short orange-brown hair with two small ahoge at her parting, green eyes, and visibly sharp teeth. A medical patch covers her missing left eye. She wears a short blue skirt with black and orange knee-high socks and dark nail polish. In her true form, she appears as a bloated queen bee.

Backstory: A parasitic queen bee colony that achieves sentience and gains the ability to possess human hosts, particularly young girls. Kuin infiltrates victims' bodies and controls them entirely while maintaining their appearance and using them as cover for her villainous operations. She works under the Villain Factory, distributing Trigger to create Instant Villains while hunting to sustain her colony through murder and theft.

Additional Information: Kuin can inject victims with Trigger to transform them into rampaging villains. She survives by infiltrating households, killing inhabitants, and consuming their resources. Her possession leaves hosts with distinctive features: short swept hair covering a missing left eye with a medical patch and sharp teeth. She operates in plain sight as an ordinary student, making her nearly undetectable.

cardPool.title: Kunieda
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Kunieda

Alias: None known

Quirk Name: Not specified in source material
