Occupation/Role: Villain, serial killer, assassin for All For One

Personality: Pragmatic and cunning, viewing intangible concepts like trust and hope as meaningless. Deeply sadistic with no conscience, deriving pleasure from violence and collection. Dismissive and taunting toward those he deems weak or inferior, yet shows unwavering loyalty to All For One as repayment for his freedom from Tartarus.

Appearance: A tall, skeletal man with long limbs, thin waist, and broad shoulders. He wears an ornate, unconventional outfit: a tattered cloth held by a metal ring as a hood over a triangle-patterned poncho with hanging tassels. His face features inverted eyes—black scleras with white irises—a wide rectangular nose bridge, hairless brows, and a long dark mask covering his mouth and nose tip. Black rolled-sleeve shirt with leather vambraces, pinstriped suit pants on each leg, a suit jacket worn around his hips like a skirt over a white dress shirt and striped necktie-belt, completed with simple dress shoes.

Backstory: A serial killer who collected corpses to fuel his Quirk before being imprisoned in Tartarus for mass murder. Freed during All For One's prison break, Kunieda pledged absolute allegiance to the villain and joined his forces as one of his deadliest assassins, viewing his liberation as a debt he must repay.

Additional Information: Operates as part of All For One's assassination network targeting Izuku Midoriya. Demonstrates extreme prejudice against traitors, having threatened to execute Yuga Aoyama for betraying All For One.

cardPool.title: Kugo Sakamata
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Kugo Sakamata

Alias:
Aqua Hero: Gang Orca

Quirk Name:
Orcinus

Occupation/Role:
Pro Hero (No. 21), Director of Okuto Island Aquarium, Provisional License Exam Proctor

Personality:
A calm and serious hero who maintains a menacing exterior but genuinely cares about aspiring heroes. Despite his harsh teaching methods and intimidating demeanor, he secretly enjoys mentoring students and helping them grow. He's friendly with fellow Pro Heroes and unafraid to call out mistakes or tease peers.

Appearance:
A tall, powerfully built man with killer whale features—deep white eyes with concentric red pupils and dark skin. His body bears the muscular physiology of a whale. He wears a white high-collared hero suit decorated with diamond-shaped tooth patterns, a pink tie styled like a tongue, and a whale-like cape. His imposing appearance ranks him third among heroes who resemble villains.

Backstory:
A highly ranked Pro Hero who has served as No. 10, No. 12, and currently No. 21. He directs Okuto Island Aquarium while actively patrolling and teaching. He takes mentoring seriously, running remedial courses for failed licensing exam candidates despite his strict methods.

Additional Information:
Kugo's Orcinus Quirk grants enhanced physical parameters and the ability to generate paralyzing hypersonic waves for offense and defense. He's equally effective in aquatic and land-based combat. His marine biology expertise complements his combat prowess, making him a formidable pro hero respected by peers.

cardPool.title: Kotaro Shimura
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Kotaro Shimura
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Unknown (not manifested or undisclosed)
Occupation/Role: Civilian; Father and Husband
Personality: Resentful and controlling, harboring deep hatred for Heroes due to maternal abandonment in childhood. Emotionally and physically abusive toward his children to prevent them from pursuing Hero paths. Despite his cruelty, capable of remorse and conflicted about his methods, though rarely acts on these doubts. Easily influenced and manipulated by those he trusts.
Appearance: Short dark hair with a small cowlick on the right side. Wears a striped polo shirt and black pants. Average build with a stern, perpetually troubled expression reflecting his inner turmoil.
Backstory: Son of Pro Hero Nana Shimura, placed in foster care as a child after his father's death to protect him from villain threats. This abandonment festered into lifelong resentment toward Heroes. As an adult, he married Nao and had two children: Tenko and Hana. Unbeknownst to him, he was manipulated by the villain All For One, who cultivated his hatred and encouraged his abusive parenting, believing it would serve a greater purpose.
Additional Information: Non-combatant civilian with no known Quirk. His actions directly contributed to his son Tenko's tragic awakening and loss of control. Despite recognizing his destructive behavior, Kotaro's cycle of violence ultimately led to his own death.

cardPool.title: Kotaba Honyakuji
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Kotoba Honyakuji
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Animal Communication
Occupation/Role: Zookeeper at Megalo-Safari
Personality: Energetic, passionate, and deeply caring about animal welfare. She is attentive to those around her and shows genuine concern for both the animals and people in her charge, though she can be cautious about human interference with natural animal behavior.
Appearance: A woman with black hair wearing a standard zoo uniform, a hoodie tied around her waist, work gloves, and a distinctive polka dot scarf. She maintains a practical yet approachable appearance suited to her outdoor profession.
Backstory: Kotoba works as a dedicated zookeeper at Megalo-Safari, where her Quirk allows her to understand and communicate with animals. She assists Gang Orca in guiding UA students through team-up missions at the zoo, teaching them about animal behavior and the park's various topographical zones while mediating between humans and wildlife.
Additional Information: Not a UA student. Her Quirk enables her to interpret animal communications through specialized devices she provides to others. Despite her expertise with animals, she was surprised to discover that some animals, like Brutus, can adapt to using human tools and behaviors.

cardPool.title: Kosei Tsuburaba
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Kosei Tsuburaba
Alias: Tsuburaba
Quirk Name: Solid Air
Occupation/Role: UA High School Student, Class 1-B
Personality: Enthusiastic and competitive, holding himself to high standards while maintaining good sense. A reliable support player rather than offensive combatant, though capable of taunting rivals. Generally mild-mannered compared to his classmates.
Appearance: Young man with short auburn hair spiked at odd angles. Large oval eyes with prominent pupils. Wears a light blue high-collared jacket with black undershirt, pale pants with grey kneepads, and large brown boots with cylindrical sole shapes.
Backstory: A first-year student at UA High School training to become a Pro Hero. Comes from Class 1-B and is considered one of the class's pragmatic voices alongside Kaibara, Awase, and Rin. Develops his Quirk through rigorous training.
Additional Information: Solid Air allows him to solidify exhaled air into invisible walls and platforms. Initially fragile but improves significantly during his first year. His Ultimate Move, Air Prison, creates soundproof barriers effective against voice-based Quirks. Functions best as a support specialist in team scenarios.

cardPool.title: Konako Haizono
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Konako Haizono

Alias: Dusty Ash

Quirk Name: Dust

Occupation/Role: Villain

Personality: Reserved and enigmatic; little is known of her motivations or temperament, though her tactical use of her Quirk suggests cunning and strategic thinking.

Appearance: A tall woman with a voluptuous build and long, wavy white hair tied in a ponytail with loose side locks. Her right eye is partially obscured by bangs. She wears a black low-cut sports bra, light purple panties, purple gloves, arm pads, black ankle boots, a thin face mask, and a large metal respirator around her neck. A utility belt with garters completes her combat gear.

Backstory: Konako emerged as a dangerous villain wielding her Dust Quirk with tactical precision. Her origins and motivations remain shrouded in mystery, though her equipment suggests long-term planning and awareness of her Quirk's limitations.

Additional Information: Her Quirk allows her to generate ash-like dust from her body, which she weaponizes by targeting opponents' sensory organs as a distraction tactic. Overuse causes her skin to become dry and rough. She wields a ninjato-like club as her primary weapon and relies on her dust-proof mask and metal respirator to protect herself from her own Quirk's effects during combat.

cardPool.title: Komari Ikoma
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Komari Ikoma

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Not specified

Occupation/Role: Elementary school teacher at Masegaki Primary School

Personality: Easily distressed and apologetic, constantly struggling to maintain discipline among her rowdy students. Despite her anxious demeanor, she is deeply committed to her students' development and becomes inspired when witnessing their growth. She is grateful, empathetic, and genuinely cares about helping children develop safe Quirk abilities through proper counseling.

Appearance: A young woman with straight, shoulder-length dark hair and large navy blue eyes that frequently tear up. She wears a white blouse beneath a tan jacket, paired with a long ankle-length green skirt secured by a belt, and heeled work shoes. Her appearance is neat and professional, befitting her role as an educator.

Backstory: Komari teaches at Masegaki Primary School, where she oversees a particularly difficult class of rowdy, undisciplined students who lack sufficient Quirk counseling. She believes their misbehavior stems from closed hearts due to inadequate emotional guidance. She arranges for them to meet aspiring heroes, hoping to inspire better behavior and show them the earnest potential within themselves.

Additional Information: Komari is not a UA student but rather a professional educator. Her students were later sheltered at UA during the Paranormal Liberation War crisis. She demonstrates genuine concern for child development and shows resilience in her commitment to teaching despite constant challenges with classroom management.

cardPool.title: Komako Masu
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Komako Masu

Alias:
None

Quirk Name:
Unknown

Occupation/Role:
UA High School Student, Department of Management (Business Course)

Personality:
Outgoing and charismatic, serving as the life of the party with nerves of steel. She is a natural moodmaker who focuses on the business and marketability aspects of heroism rather than hero work itself. Pragmatic and observant, particularly interested in analyzing how heroes can be effectively promoted to society.

Appearance:
A young girl of below-average height with short, dark green hair slicked back with a single strand hanging in front. She has large, round eyes and wears rounded glasses. Always seen in her UA gym uniform, presenting a neat and put-together appearance despite her casual demeanor.

Backstory:
A first-year student in UA High School's Department of Management business course, Komako approaches heroism from an entrepreneurial angle rather than a combat one. She gained attention during the UA Sports Festival for analyzing Izuku's marketability and potential as a hero brand, demonstrating her keen eye for opportunity and public perception.

Additional Information:
Often seen alongside classmates Ronaudo and Futo from the business course. Member of UA's Department of Management, not the Hero Course. Her business-focused perspective provides a unique viewpoint within the student body, emphasizing the commercial and public relations aspects of professional heroism.

cardPool.title: Koku Hanabata
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Koku Hanabata

Alias: Trumpet

Quirk Name: Incite

Occupation/Role: Politician and Top Commander of the Meta Liberation Army

Personality: Calm, calculating, and highly manipulative. Koku presents himself as level-headed and intelligent, capable of turning tragedy into opportunity. He is arrogant and demands absolute respect, becoming malicious toward those who dare claim equality with him. Fiercely loyal to his ideals and leadership structure, yet pragmatic enough to accept new authority when directed by those he respects.

Appearance: A man with reasonably long black hair swept back with a single strand falling over his face. He has thin eyebrows, a small mustache, an angular nose, and small feminine eyes with dark blue irises. He wears distinctive yellow glasses with purple-tinted lenses. His attire is formal business wear: white dress shirt, black tie, and black blazer, projecting an air of political authority and professionalism.

Backstory: Koku rose to prominence as a politician leading the Hearts and Mind Party while secretly commanding the Meta Liberation Army as one of its top officers. His dual role allowed him to influence both government and underground forces, working toward the Liberation Army's vision for a free society. He gained renown for his exceptional leadership during military campaigns and his ability to inspire loyalty in over 100,000 soldiers.

Additional Information: Koku's Quirk amplifies his voice with electromagnetic pulses that enhance the physical and mental state of those who view him as a worthy leader. The effect strengthens with volume but strains the recipient's body. He uses the Sevens Loud, a Detnerat helmet with seven amplifiers disguised as wristbands to maximize his Quirk's range and power during critical moments.

cardPool.title: Kojiro Bondo
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Kojiro Bondo

Alias: Plamo

Quirk Name: Cemedine

Occupation/Role: UA High School Student, Class 1-B

Personality: A gentle giant and shrinking violet who stammers when speaking with teammates despite being easygoing and well-liked. He gets along well with classmates and maintains a calm demeanor despite his imposing stature.

Appearance: Tall and heavily muscular with exceptionally wide shoulders tapering to a slender waist and oversized hands. His skin is yellow straw-colored with a head shaped like a glue dispenser topped with a lappet. Seven eye-holes dot his face as Quirk outlets. He wears a baggy yellow hero suit with red circular bottle-cap accessories at neck, wrists, waist, and ankles; white gloves and red-soled shoes; red-trimmed black squares on sleeves; and dual glue bottle emblems on his belt.

Backstory: A first-year UA High School student training to become a Pro Hero, Kojiro has spent his life managing his unusual appearance and learning to harness his adhesive Quirk despite initial social hesitation.

Additional Information: Possesses enhanced strength from his massive frame. His Cemedine Quirk sprays fast-drying adhesive liquid from facial holes that can trap enemies and bond objects; he can control drying speed. Despite his intimidating size, he remains one of the gentler personalities in his year group.

cardPool.title: Koji Koda
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Koji Koda

Alias: Petting Hero: Anima

Quirk Name: Anivoice

Occupation/Role: UA High School Student, Class 1-A

Personality: Timid and quiet, preferring sign language over speech, though capable of speaking. Kind-hearted and averse to violence, he enjoys animal companionship and cute things. Deathly afraid of bugs despite his ability to command them. Gradually growing more vocal and confident, inspired by his father's courage.

Appearance: Tall young man with broad, muscular build and peach-colored skin. His head resembles an unevenly shaped rock with a pointed crown and square jaw, with thick hair-like protrusions extending from the back. Wears the standard UA male uniform: light gray blazer with dark turquoise trim, white dress shirt, dark blue-green pants, red tie, and brown shoes. His hero costume consists of a tight yellow suit reaching mid-thigh and mid-forearm, featuring a large red marking across the torso and sleeve ends with a mouth-like symbol on his chest.

Backstory: A UA High School student training to become a Pro Hero in Class 1-A. Inspired by his father to stand up for those he cares about, Koji has gradually overcome his initial meekness through his hero training, becoming more determined and vocal when his comrades need him.

Additional Information: Commands animals through his Quirk, enabling diverse tactical applications from insect reconnaissance to bird surveillance. Despite his fearsome appearance and powerful abilities, he is genuinely gentle and kind. Owns a pet rabbit and animal decorations in his dorm room.

cardPool.title: Koichi Haimawari
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Koichi Haimawari

Alias:
The Crawler, Nice Guy

Quirk Name:
Slide and Glide

Occupation/Role:
Vigilante, University Student

Personality:
Easy-going and mild-mannered with a heroic nature, Koichi is generous and helpful but socially awkward, often accidentally insulting others. He remains calm under pressure and is willing to reason with criminals, though he cannot ignore those in need. He dreams of becoming a recognized hero.

Appearance:
A slim young man with short brown hair and large round brown eyes. He typically wears one of several All Might-themed hoodies over black tactical gear, including knee and elbow pads. He favors black sneakers with red accents and wears a black medical mask and red-tinted shades during vigilante work. His casual look includes a black gakuran uniform with yellow buttons and white sneakers from his middle school days.

Backstory:
Once an ordinary student, Koichi discovered his Quirk and began operating as a vigilante under the alias "The Crawler," helping citizens with small tasks and fighting petty crime. He trained under the mentor Knuckleduster and refined his methods, gradually building confidence in his abilities despite lacking official hero status. His actions have earned him a reputation, though not always positive.

Additional Information:
Not a UA High School student. Operates independently as a vigilante, casually using his Quirk in public despite lacking official hero credentials. He works various jobs while pursuing his dream of becoming a recognized hero through unconventional means.

cardPool.title: Koga Iga
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Koga Iga

Alias:
None

Quirk Name:
Unknown

Occupation/Role:
Aspiring Hero / Student

Personality:
Confident and proud, with a cocky attitude toward those he perceives as weak. Koga teases and mocks "wimpy" individuals but is willing to change his opinion if impressed by genuine courage or ability. Despite his arrogance, he shows gratitude and respect when others prove themselves worthy.

Appearance:
A young boy with short black hair styled in two large bangs framing either side of his face and a prominent strand sticking up at the back of his head. He typically wears jeans with suspenders and dresses in themed ninja outfits when participating in hero-related activities.

Backstory:
An aspiring hero who idolizes the Pro Hero Edgeshot and dreams of becoming a ninja hero and debuting as his sidekick. Koga attended Hero Festa where he initially mocked another boy, Katsuma Shimano, for his perceived weakness. During Edgeshot's trap house display, Koga injured his ankle but was rescued by Katsuma, leading to mutual respect and a shared promise to both become Heroes.

Additional Information:
Not confirmed as a UA High School student. Highly ambitious and influenced by Pro Hero Edgeshot's ninja-style heroics. Values courage and capability over initial appearances, capable of growth through positive influence.

cardPool.title: Kodama
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Kodama

Alias: Priestess of Kamino-ga-fuchi

Quirk Name: Plant Healing

Occupation/Role: Village Priestess and Guardian of the Sacred Tree

Personality: Devoted and protective to the point of self-sacrifice, Kodama is initially suspicious of outsiders but quick to apologize and cooperate once trust is established. She prioritizes the welfare of her village and its sacred tree above her own safety, displaying unwavering determination and quiet nobility.

Appearance: A young woman with short dark hair styled with side bangs and a center part, secured by a light hairband adorned with leaf decorations on both sides near her ears. She wears traditional miko priestess clothing in white and red.

Backstory: Kodama serves as the priestess of Kamino-ga-fuchi village, tasked with maintaining and healing the ancient Sacred Tree that serves as the spiritual and symbolic heart of her community. When heroes visit the village, she initially mistakes them for villains threatening the tree but quickly becomes an invaluable ally in protecting her home during a catastrophic landslide.

Additional Information: Not a UA student; a civilian priestess with deep spiritual and practical ties to her village. Her Quirk, while modest in power, is essential to her role as protector of the Sacred Tree. Kodama demonstrates that heroism extends beyond combat abilities—her determination and willingness to sacrifice embody heroic spirit.

cardPool.title: Kiruka Hasaki
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Kiruka Hasaki
Alias: Slice
Quirk Name: Slice
Occupation/Role: Villain
Personality: Confident and ruthless in combat, willing to cause destruction and threaten innocents for her goals. However, she shows concern for her teammates, particularly Nine, and values cooperation. She yearns to create a world where power alone determines worth, having been ostracized by society. Vain about her appearance, especially her hair.
Appearance: Fair-skinned young woman with inward-sloping blue eyes and full, glossy lips. She has long, straight shiny red hair with chin-length bangs partially obscuring her right eye; the back reaches her thighs with two front strands looping to her knees. She wears a pale purple blouse with frilled cuffs under a low-collared navy dress with a thick brown belt. Dark red gloves, purple frilled thigh-high socks, black knee-high boots with red binding at the calves, a black choker with a red center, and a black domino mask complete her outfit.
Backstory: A powerful villain recruited by Nine to help establish a new world order based on strength. Ostracized by society due to her formidable Quirk, she seeks validation through conquest and power alongside her teammates.
Additional Information: Highly skilled hand-to-hand combatant with excellent agility and reflexes. Her Slice Quirk allows her to manipulate hair for offense, defense, and mobility—hardening, sharpening, elongating, and projecting it as weaponized strands. Weakness: If her Quirk is suppressed, her combat effectiveness diminishes significantly.

cardPool.title: Kirihito Kamachi
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Kirihito Kamachi

Alias: Kamayan

Quirk Name: Mantis

Occupation/Role: Manager at Hopper's Cafe (formerly a regular civilian before bio-engineering modification)

Personality: Not particularly intelligent but surprisingly insightful about society's treatment of mutant Quirk users; laments his transformation despite enjoying refined tastes like tea and classical music. Values manners and privacy but hypocritically prejudges others with mutated bodies. Complains exaggeratedly about his condition yet maintains genuine friendships.

Appearance: Before modification: thuggish face with prominent cheekbones, sharp teeth, flat nose, pupilless eyes, no eyebrows, protruding ears, short pointed black hair. After bio-engineering: humanoid mantis form with scythe-like arms, insectoid chest, mantis abdomen, four additional legs, chitinous protuberances, and antennae on face. Currently wears waiter's uniform at the cafe.

Backstory: Once an ordinary person who made poor decisions, Kirihito was kidnapped and radically bio-engineered by the Villain Factory, his Quirk artificially boosted to extreme levels. He became a Next-Level Villain through forced modification and Trigger drug use, struggling with his new identity and appearance.

Additional Information: Close friends with brothers Ichiro and Jiro Hotta, who affectionately call him "Kamayan." Possesses enhanced strength capable of destroying concrete and augmented speed matching experienced fighters, though both abilities diminish without Trigger supplementation. Easily defeated by Captain Celebrity despite enhanced abilities.

cardPool.title: Kinoko Komori
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Kinoko Komori

Alias: Shemage

Quirk Name: Mushroom

Occupation/Role: UA High School Class 1-B Student, aspiring Pro Hero

Personality: Initially shy and reserved with a sullen demeanor, Kinoko grows increasingly confident and cheerful around her peers. She possesses a gleeful obsession with mushrooms, frequently making puns and using scientific nomenclature with affectionate honorifics. Despite her playful nature, she demonstrates genuine kindness and concern for others' wellbeing.

Appearance: A short, slender girl with honey-brown inward-curved hair in a mushroom-shaped bob reaching her narrow shoulders. Long bangs cover her wide, cat-like warm brown eyes with distinctive cross-shaped pupils resembling shiitake mushroom caps. She has a large mouth and long lower eyelashes. Her hero costume features a turtleneck dress with red and white fly agaric patterns, a matching mushroom-shaped hat, furred long sleeves, pale pink knee-high boots with frilled shafts, and a dark brown belt with a golden buckle for her Shroom-Shooters.

Backstory: A first-year student at UA High School training to become a Pro Hero, Kinoko initially struggles with social anxiety but gradually builds confidence through combat training and teamwork. Her Quirk-related passion for mushrooms drives her scholarly interest and battle strategies, while her kind nature reveals her heroic potential beneath her shy exterior.

Additional Information: Kinoko excels in support roles rather than direct combat, using humidity-controlled spore dispersal to create mushroom barriers and smokescreens. She can render opponents unconscious through fungal inhalation despite appearing non-threatening. Antifungal sterilization protects allies from her Quirk effects. She is a fan of Pro Hero Hawks.

cardPool.title: Kesagiri Man
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown

Alias: Kesagiri Man

Quirk Name: Enhanced Speed

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero

Personality: Quiet and composed with a commanding presence, Kesagiri Man speaks in a deep, authoritative voice. He shows empathy when consoling others about life adjustments, yet remains focused and analytical during tactical discussions. He demonstrates sharp critical thinking when questioning assumptions about criminal connections.

Appearance: A tall, imposing figure clad in a full-body suit of dense black fur that covers everything except his fingers, giving him a sleek, predatory silhouette. His deep voice and measured demeanor suggest a mature, professional hero.

Backstory: An experienced Pro Hero with a reputation for quiet competence, Kesagiri Man was recruited by Sir Nighteye to investigate the Eight Bullets Yakuza organization and their connection to the League of Villains. He participates in strategic briefings and the assault on the Yakuza's base, where his speed proves invaluable in neutralizing threats.

Additional Information: Kesagiri Man is a senior hero capable of independent field operations and tactical decision-making. His Enhanced Speed allows him to move with incredible swiftness, enabling him to intercept projectile attacks and dispatch enemies before they can react. He works alongside other Pro Heroes and interns during major operations against organized crime.

cardPool.title: Kido
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Kido
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Not specified in source material
Occupation/Role: Pro Hero Sidekick at Endeavor Agency
Personality: Reserved and logical, maintaining composure in high-pressure situations. Expresses quiet pride in his role as a Flaming Sidekicker and follows orders dutifully. Fair-minded and impartial, treating all interns equally regardless of status.
Appearance: Man of average build with gray eyes and brown hair. His entire face is covered in signature bandages, with additional wrapping on parts of his arms and hands. Wears a flak jacket over a short-sleeved shirt as part of his hero costume.
Backstory: Became a Pro Hero approximately ten years before the Paranormal Liberation War. Works as one of over thirty sidekicks under Endeavor at his agency, where he has earned respect through reliable service and calm judgment during dangerous operations.
Additional Information: Experienced in villain apprehension and containment. Participates in major hero operations including the Jaku Hospital Raid and conflicts with the Paranormal Liberation Front. Survived the catastrophic Decay attack during the hospital operation and continues active duty in Japan's post-war reconstruction efforts.

cardPool.title: Kenji Tsuragamae
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Kenji Tsuragamae
Alias: Chief Tsuragamae
Quirk Name: Dog
Occupation/Role: Chief of the Police Force
Personality: Stern and rule-bound yet pragmatic, willing to bend enforcement for justice when warranted. Respectful of genuine heroism and carries himself with official dignity, though his dog-related speech tics undercut formality. Compassionate toward young heroes despite maintaining lawful order.
Appearance: An exceptionally tall, powerfully built man with the head of a beagle featuring dark brown markings around his eyes and ears separated by a tan line down his forehead, widening toward his muzzle with pale brown flecking. Large black nose, dark eyes, tan skin, and human body. Wears a formal black suit with dress shirt, waistcoat, black blazer, matching dress pants, large-buckled belt, and a black-and-white dalmatian-patterned tie.
Backstory: Rose through law enforcement to become Chief of Police after Quirks emerged. Witnessed the Police Force's initial rejection of Quirk users due to weaponization fears, leading to heroes filling that void. Maintains strict adherence to law while understanding the moral complexities heroes face.
Additional Information: Not a UA student; operates as a law enforcement authority figure. Known for dog-related puns and his "woof" verbal tic. Demonstrates flexibility in punishment interpretation when circumstances warrant leniency, as shown when he covered up young heroes' unauthorized Quirk use during the Stain incident.

cardPool.title: Kenji Hikiishi
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Kenji Hikiishi
Alias: Magne
Quirk Name: Magnetism
Occupation/Role: Villain, League of Villains Vanguard Action Squad member
Personality: Cruel and brutal, driven by desire for freedom and autonomy. Perceptive and quick-thinking in combat, refusing subjugation. Shows ruthlessness balanced with tactical intelligence.
Appearance: Wide, muscular build with shoulder-length reddish-magenta hair and a square jaw with light facial hair. Large pink-tinted lips. Wears triangular white-framed sunglasses obscuring her eyes, dark orange unbuttoned shirt over white v-neck undershirt, blue jeans with belt, and dark brown boots.
Backstory: A hardened criminal with a reputation for 9 armed robberies, 3 murders, and 29 attempted murders. Joined the League of Villains seeking freedom from societal constraints. Skilled combatant who uses her Quirk with brutal efficiency, operating as part of the Vanguard Action Squad during the Forest Training Camp invasion.
Additional Information: Magnetism Quirk polarizes targets within 4.5-meter radius—males south, females north. Cannot magnetize herself. Carries a large cloth-wrapped magnet as a weapon to draw magnetized targets in with devastating force. Expert at close-range combat and tactical ambushes.

cardPool.title: Kendo Rappa
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Kendo Rappa

Alias: The Rapper

Quirk Name: Strongarm

Occupation/Role: Eight Bullets member of the Shie Hassaikai

Personality: Hot-blooded and violence-driven, Kendo lives for the thrill of combat and respects only those who can challenge him. Despite his brutal nature, he possesses a strict sense of honor—refusing to rely on weapons or allies when he can win through his own strength. He disdains those who cannot satisfy his hunger for battle, yet shows unexpected mercy to worthy opponents.

Appearance: A massive, heavily muscular man with long light brown hair. His plague mask obscures his face entirely. He wears a tattered t-shirt beneath a light blue tunic, dark pants, and dual belts. His signature leather gloves cover his hands and wrists with metal-reinforced knuckles and multiple straps.

Backstory: Rising from the Underground Masquerade as an undefeated MMA fighter, Kendo's raw power attracted Kai Chisaki's attention. Though he sought to defeat Overhaul in single combat to earn his respect, Chisaki's overwhelming Quirk overhauled him repeatedly. Now an Eight Bullets member, Kendo serves primarily to pursue the ultimate fight that might one day come.

Additional Information: Expert hand-to-hand combatant with techniques honed in cage fighting. Uses precise, rapid punches amplified by his Quirk, leaving no openings in close-quarters duels. Pairs well with defensive fighters in tag-team scenarios.

cardPool.title: Ken Takagi
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Ken Takagi

Alias: Lock Hero: Rock Lock

Quirk Name: Lock Down

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero

Personality: Pragmatic and blunt, quick to judge others' competence. Especially critical of inexperienced students, viewing their youth as a liability in dangerous situations. Confident to the point of arrogance in his own abilities. Does not tolerate being underestimated or patronized. Despite harsh snap judgments, he genuinely respects those who exceed his expectations and can revise his opinions.

Appearance: Average height man with short, dark coily hair styled in an afro. Pierced ears adorned with padlock earrings. Key-shaped protrusions at his fingertips. Wears a small yellow mask covering his eyes, red necklace with dangling keys, and a yellow and dark green short-sleeved bodysuit patterned with keyholes. Light gray shoulder pads with dark keyhole designs, white boots, and brown belt with additional keys complete his hero costume.

Backstory: An experienced Pro Hero with a proven track record of competence in the field. Father to an infant son, which heightens his awareness of the dangers young heroes face. Participated in major operations against organized crime, relying on both his Quirk and tactical judgment.

Additional Information: His Quirk immobilizes nonliving objects he touches, freezing them in place. Can be overcome by sufficient force and has limited area coverage. Often uses thrown tiles as mobile footholds during combat. His confidence sometimes blinds him to potential threats, though his experience generally validates his self-assurance.

cardPool.title: Ken Ishiyama
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Ken Ishiyama
Alias: Cementoss
Quirk Name: Cement
Occupation/Role: Pro Hero and Modern Literature Teacher at UA High School
Personality: Serious yet pleasant, deeply caring about others' wellbeing and safety. Brave and principled in combat, willing to sacrifice for those he protects. Respectful of authority and devoted to his duties as an educator and hero.
Appearance: A humanoid figure composed of gray cement with a blocky, evenly-proportioned body. Black, typically closed eyes with tiny pupils when opened, and gray hair styled in a short ponytail. Wears a sleeveless brown suit with yellow stripe accents, matching shorts, and gray shoes with yellow soles. Overall sturdy, imposing build befitting his cement-based nature.
Backstory: A seasoned Pro Hero who has earned a position on UA High's faculty, where he teaches Modern Literature to first-year students. Known among his peers for his exceptional control over his Quirk and his unwavering commitment to student safety and hero principles.
Additional Information: His Quirk allows him to manipulate and reshape any cement-based material he touches into various forms and sizes. Recovery Girl considers his Quirk among the most difficult to combat among UA teachers. He uses high-density weight bracelets during training exercises to handicap himself when sparring with students. A devoted admirer of All Might and trusted keeper of his secret identity.

cardPool.title: Keigo Takami
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Keigo Takami

Alias: Wing Hero: Hawks

Quirk Name: Fierce Wings

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero (No. 2 on Hero Billboard Chart)

Personality: Highly intelligent with a deceptively carefree demeanor that masks constant vigilance. Hawks is cocky and laid-back, speaking his mind bluntly while maintaining emotional control. He follows orders with subtle cynicism, dislikes formalities, and acts unpredictably with a joking submissiveness.

Appearance: Average height with a slim build. Ash-blonde feathered hair swept messily backward with front tufts standing in arcs. Golden-brown triangular eyes with black markings resembling a bird's. Thick eyebrows, faint stubble, and square piercings on each ear. His hero costume features a black wavy-patterned shirt under a tan shearling-lined jacket with shoulder slits for his large, bright red folded wings. He wears black gloves, a yellow-tinted visor, and yellow ear-protective headphones.

Backstory: Keigo Takami rose to become the second-highest ranked Pro Hero through exceptional skill and intelligence. His rise through the hero ranks demonstrates his natural talent and the effectiveness of his Quirk. He operates under the Hero Public Safety Commission's direction.

Additional Information: Hawks possesses an elite Quirk granting large crimson wings that enhance his aerial capabilities and speed significantly. His intelligence extends to both tactical combat assessment and social manipulation. He maintains a facade of casualness while being perpetually calculating and aware.

cardPool.title: Kazuho Haneyama
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Kazuho Haneyama

Alias: Pop☆Step

Quirk Name: Not explicitly stated in source material

Occupation/Role: Freelance idol and former vigilante; student

Personality: Logical and intellectual, serving as strategic brains of her group. Enthusiastic performer with notable vanity about appearance. Fierce and sharp-tongued, quick to berate allies she disapproves of. Secretive by nature, keeping her vigilante activities hidden from family. Cares deeply for her companions despite harsh demeanor.

Appearance: Pink messy hair typically concealed by round blue-framed glasses; blue eyes. In civilian form, wears black long-sleeved seifuku with white collar and red accents, red tie, white knee-high socks, and blue sneakers. As Pop☆Step, transforms into black backless leotard with pink heart-shaped chest opening, high pigtails, black mask with pink eye makeup, red bow tie, fingerless gloves, mini-skirt with purple hearts, and black knee-high boots with pink details.

Backstory: A talented vocalist and performer who leads a double life as both idol and unlicensed street vigilante. Works alongside fellow vigilantes including Koichi, keeping her activities secret from her unaware family. Driven by both entertainment passion and desire to help her community through unconventional means.

Additional Information: Not a UA High School student; operates independently in Naruhata. Performs with groups like FeatherHATS when not engaged in vigilante activities. Known for meticulous planning and strategic thinking despite her flashy performance persona.

cardPool.title: Katsuma Shimano
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Katsuma Shimano
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Cell Activation
Occupation/Role: UA High School Student, Hero Course, Class 1-A
Personality: Timid and soft-spoken, easily influenced by his older sister despite his own heroic aspirations. Admires Pro Heroes deeply and demonstrates genuine remorse for his mistakes. Selfless and brave when protecting loved ones, willing to sacrifice his own Quirk for others' safety.
Appearance: Young boy with brown eyes, curly light brown hair, and a small patch of freckles across his face. Wears the UA school uniform as a first-year student. Notably carries a yellow messenger bag with an Edgeshot enamel pin, wears a floral charm bracelet on his left arm (handmade by his mother), and sports a large sun hat with a blue band and light blue rim stripe.
Backstory: Originally from Nabu Island, Katsuma lived with his older sister Mahoro before enrolling at UA High School. He idolizes heroes and dreams of becoming one himself. Following an invasion of his island by a villain named Nine, Katsuma bravely stood against the threat to protect his sister, cementing his resolve to walk the hero path.
Additional Information: His Cell Activation Quirk heals wounds and enhances physical performance through cellular stimulation via touch, but drains his stamina with extended use. Unlike his father's version, his Quirk works on multiple blood types, demonstrating superior control and versatility that earned him acceptance into UA's competitive Hero Course.

cardPool.title: Kashiko Sekigai
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Kashiko Sekigai
Alias: Sensor Girl
Quirk Name: Holographic Map
Occupation/Role: Isami Academy High School Student, Class President
Personality: Responsible and level-headed with strong leadership qualities, similar in demeanor to those in positions of authority; uninterested in casual romantic advances.
Appearance: Petite girl with a round face and periwinkle-blue shoulder-length hair styled with a long inward-curling bang on the right and left side tucked behind her ear. Intelligent gray eyes behind thick-framed triangular glasses. Wears the Isami High uniform: white dress shirt with dark red bow tie, dark blue blazer, pleated gray knee-length skirt, below-the-knee socks, and brown loafers.
Backstory: A trusted student leader at Isami Academy High School, Kashiko has earned her position as Class President through reliability and tactical thinking. Her Quirk makes her invaluable for reconnaissance and coordination, abilities that have shaped her responsible nature.
Additional Information: Her hero costume features a navy turtleneck bodysuit with geometric patterns, shoulder-pads marked with "S," a visor replacing her glasses, red gloves, wrist-mounted radar screens, and thigh-high boots. She participated in her class team during the Quirk Apprehension Test arc.

cardPool.title: Kameko
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Kameko
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Unnamed Tortoise Quirk
Occupation/Role: Hero School Student (Hiroshima)
Personality: Loyal and cautious friend who attempts to restrain her more impulsive companion Rumi; level-headed and grounded despite her tortoise-like nature.
Appearance: Young woman with tortoise characteristics including a visible shell on her back, dark hair, small round eyes, and minimal facial nose. She maintains a humanoid form despite her reptilian features.
Backstory: A student at a hero school in Hiroshima where she befriended Rumi Usagiyama and Sameko. During a school trip to Osaka to visit Tsutenkaku Tower, the trio became lost before encountering a young Fat Gum, who provided directions. Kameko witnessed Rumi's impulsive nature when she abandoned the group to investigate a nearby battle.
Additional Information: Not a UA High School student; attends a hero school in Hiroshima. Her Quirk grants tortoise attributes, though specific abilities remain largely unexplored. She values her friendships and attempts to be the voice of reason within her friend group.

cardPool.title: Kashiko Kashi
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Kashiko Kashi

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Unknown

Occupation/Role: Prison Escapee, Criminal

Personality: Pragmatic and calculating, Kashiko demonstrates cunning by choosing to lie low rather than cause chaos like other escapees. He possesses a cynical worldview and looks down on criminals who attract attention, suggesting he views himself as intellectually superior. Despite his dark past, he shows a capacity for finding contentment in quietude, smiling at the prospect of a peaceful suburban life amid societal turmoil.

Appearance: A young-looking man with long, spiky orange hair that extends above his face and slightly forward. He has small, piercing pupils within his eyes and wears a pair of earrings. His casual attire reflects his fugitive status, appearing simple and unremarkable.

Backstory: Imprisoned for robbery and murder, Kashiko was freed during the chaos following the Paranormal Liberation War. Rather than joining other escapees in wreaking havoc, he sought refuge in an abandoned suburban home with an unnamed partner. He believed society's collapse provided the perfect opportunity to disappear and live undetected.

Additional Information: Kashiko's Quirk remains unknown. He was killed by a corrupted Tomura Shigaraki who attempted to steal his Quirk to safely store the New Order ability. His body was later discovered by Endeavor, Hawks, and Best Jeanist.

cardPool.title: Kaoruko Awata
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Kaoruko Awata

Alias: Bubble Girl

Quirk Name: Bubble

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero Sidekick at Sir Nighteye's Hero Office

Personality: Serious and dedicated professional who remains composed under pressure, maintaining calm even during stressful situations. She demonstrates loyalty to her work despite frequent threats of dismissal.

Appearance: Fair-skinned young woman with a distinctly light blue complexion and short, ruffled dark blue hair that curves upward and downward, parted to the right. She has wide yellow eyes with thick eyelashes. Her hero costume includes a dark blue crop top with white high collar and central zipper, black tights with white shorts marked by yellow stripes, and thick white boots with yellow rings. She wears a transparent visor with dual air filters and dark blue gloves.

Backstory: A dedicated sidekick working under the renowned Pro Hero Sir Nighteye, Kaoruko has built her career around mastering her aromatic bubble abilities. She maintains her position despite her boss's temperamental management style, suggesting strong resolve and commitment to hero work.

Additional Information: Kaoruko's Bubble Quirk enables her to generate bubbles filled with any aroma she has previously smelled, including both pleasant and foul odors. Her experience as a working sidekick makes her more experienced than typical UA students, positioning her as a professional already active in the hero community.

cardPool.title: Kamile Gollini
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Kamile Gollini
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Spatial Excursion
Occupation/Role: Member of the Gollini Family mafia
Personality: Devious and sadistic with a perpetual wicked smile, Kamile delights in tormenting enemies. He is ruthless and shows no mercy, yet somewhat lazy, preferring to enjoy tea and pie while others fight. Loyal to his boss Dark Might, though quick to abandon when facing defeat.
Appearance: A short, elderly man with pale wrinkled skin and a pronounced upper body. His most striking feature is his large, beaked nose paired with a sharp chin and white split-end hair. He dresses formally as a butler in a red tailcoat, white gloves, green neckcloth, navy-gray pants, and buckled shoes, adorned with a rose on his coat.
Backstory: Kamile is a seasoned member of the Gollini Family's criminal organization, serving as a trusted aide to Dark Might. He has participated in numerous schemes involving the fortress Symbol of Paradise and the capture of targets like Anna.
Additional Information: Not a UA student. His Quirk allows him to move objects and people freely without gravity restrictions. When enhanced by Anna's Overmodification Quirk, his range and control expand dramatically, enabling him to relocate entire structures. He is ultimately defeated by Mirio when attempting to escape the collapsing fortress.

cardPool.title: Kai Chisaki
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Kai Chisaki
Alias: Overhaul
Quirk Name: Overhaul
Occupation/Role: Villain, Leader of the Shie Hassaikai Yakuza organization
Personality: A mysophobic, antisocial sociopath with an enormous ego and no moral compass. Despite his obsession with eradicating Quirks, he paradoxically relies entirely on his own Quirk. Outwardly polite and strategic, but fundamentally a manipulative mastermind convinced he alone understands the "true nature" of Quirks as a plague on humanity.
Appearance: A pale young man of narrow build with short, shaggy auburn hair parted to the right. Small gold irises with thin eyes and long lower eyelashes, three piercings in his left ear. He wears a distinctive magenta plague doctor mask embroidered with gold over his mouth, white surgical gloves, a black dress shirt and pants with pale gray tie, dark olive-green bomber jacket with thick purple fur collar, and white lace-up sneakers with tan soles.
Backstory: Driven by a combination of mysophobia and a discredited theory linking Quirks to rats, Kai became obsessed with returning the world to its pre-Quirk state. He rose to leadership of the Shie Hassaikai, believing only he possesses the enlightenment to reclaim the Yakuza's former power over society and reshape the world according to his vision.
Additional Information: Kai operates through meticulous planning and strategic thinking rather than brute force. He views both heroic sacrifice and petty villainy as "sicknesses" symptomatic of Quirk infection. His polite, calm demeanor masks a deeply disturbed individual incapable of empathy.

cardPool.title: Kagero Okuta
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Kagero Okuta

Alias: Giran

Quirk Name: Muddied

Occupation/Role: Villain broker and scout for the League of Villains

Personality: Indifferent and profit-driven, wearing a constant smirk that masks his calculating nature. Despite his mercenary focus, he maintains strict standards—refusing lucrative deals with those he dislikes and protecting client confidentiality even under torture. He possesses an unexpected kindness toward outcasts and those at their lowest, offering genuine counsel when warranted. His eccentric tastes are evident in his bunny-eared phone case and habit of lighting cigarettes with gunfire.

Appearance: A middle-aged man of moderate height and slight build with notably squinted, pink eyes and drawn-up eyebrows. He sports short gray hair parted to the right with side bangs, a thin mustache, small goatee, and a gap-toothed grin from a missing front tooth. He dresses in matching dress pants and blazer over a partially unbuttoned black shirt, paired with plain black shoes. A thick golden segmented tube necklace adorns his neck, sometimes accompanied by an intestine-shaped fluffy scarf. Circular glasses frame his face, and a cigarette frequently dangles from his lips.

Backstory: Giran built a reputation as a well-known underworld figure, becoming the League of Villains' premier scout and supplier of illegal goods. His keen intellect in chemistry and underworld trends made him invaluable to villain organizations seeking new talent.

Additional Information: Not a UA student. Possesses extensive business acumen and scientific knowledge. Uses his Quirk strategically in his brokerage work to manage sensitive information exchanges.

cardPool.title: Juzo Moashi
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Juzo Moashi

Alias: Centipeder

Quirk Name: Centipede

Occupation/Role: Sidekick at Sir Nighteye's Hero Office

Personality: A gentleman of impeccable manners and refined conduct, Juzo carries himself with quiet professionalism and respectful composure. He is disciplined and loyal to his mentor's ideals.

Appearance: A tall, lean man with a distinctive centipede-like face of brown coloration. His most striking feature is his elongated centipede neck draped elegantly across his shoulders. He dresses formally in a black tuxedo, maintaining a polished and professional appearance befitting his role as a hero sidekick.

Backstory: Juzo serves as a dedicated sidekick under the mentorship of Sir Nighteye, learning the ways of heroism within the agency. He is being groomed as a successor to eventually take over the hero office's operations.

Additional Information: Juzo's centipede-like limbs grant him exceptional reach and versatility in combat, allowing him to attack and restrain opponents from considerable distances. His refined demeanor and physical abilities make him a capable and trustworthy member of Sir Nighteye's team.

cardPool.title: Juzo Honenuki
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Juzo Honenuki

Alias:
Mudman

Quirk Name:
Softening

Occupation/Role:
Class 1-B Student at U.A. High School

Personality:
Calm and understanding with excellent judgment, Juzo dislikes losing but respects when others deserve their victories. He demonstrates soft, flexible thinking in strategy and genuinely cares about his classmates' well-being. Though composed, he acknowledges needing more stubbornness to overcome unfavorable conditions.

Appearance:
A pale-skinned young man with angular eyes, mid-length spiky beige hair, and a flat nose. His most distinctive feature is teeth that protrude from his face with no visible lips, creating a skull-like appearance. He wears a dark bodysuit under layered orange and black armor plating, with a rounded black helmet featuring white visor lines. Orange-accented vambraces, green boots with pipe-like shafts, and white gloves complete his hero costume.

Backstory:
Juzo earned his place at U.A. through official recommendation, indicating exceptional aptitude. His Quirk allows him to soften any material into mud-like substances, which he has mastered with remarkable control and precision.

Additional Information:
Recommended student with exceptional reflexes and battle awareness. Excels at controlling terrain through his Quirk to restrict enemy movement and dictate combat flow. Can swim through softened materials for stealth or escape. Most effective against opponents reliant on solid footing and stable positions.

cardPool.title: Jurota Shishida
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Jurota Shishida
Alias: Gevaudan
Quirk Name: Beast
Occupation/Role: UA High School Student, Class 1-B
Personality: Intellectually refined and formally polite, addressing others respectfully due to his well-mannered upbringing. When transformed, he becomes boisterous and energetic. He admires Hound Dog's freedom but feels constrained by his own propriety. Despite his bestial nature, he retains sharp tactical thinking even in Beast form.
Appearance: A tall young man with shaggy brown hair covering most of his body and sharp, prominent teeth with two lower canines protruding between his lips. He wears small rectangular glasses with thick black lenses. His hero costume features dark brown boots with fur-lined collars, a shirt collar worn alone, and stylized goggles replacing his standard glasses.
Backstory: Raised in a doting, well-mannered family that instilled formality and propriety in him. He developed his Beast Quirk early and has trained at UA to become a Pro Hero, becoming one of Class 1-B's strongest members through disciplined control and strategic application of his power.
Additional Information: Transforms into a massive, monstrous beast-man with increased size, thicker hair, and pronounced fangs. In this form, he runs on all fours and possesses incredible physical strength. His intellect and tactical awareness persist even during transformation, allowing him to strategize in combat. He later interns under Pro Hero Shishido (No. 13) to refine his combat techniques.

cardPool.title: Jube Namimaru
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Jube Namimaru
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Wooden Swords From His Hands
Occupation/Role: Middle School Student
Personality: Appears intimidating and aggressive due to his delinquent appearance, but is genuinely kind and friendly to those he considers friends. Devoted fan of Pop☆Step and willing to aid vigilantes in combating Trigger drug distribution.
Appearance: Short and stocky middle schooler with prominent chops as his most distinctive facial feature. Wears a black jacket worn open with torn and folded sleeves over a plain white t-shirt, black pants, and sandals. Sports a black cap with an x-shaped buckle at the crown, torn at the back where it mingles with his dark hair, giving him a rough Yankii aesthetic.
Backstory: A middle school student navigating the underground hero world through association with vigilante groups. Inspired by Pop☆Step's heroic activities, Jube has chosen to use his combat abilities to help fight against the proliferation of dangerous Trigger drugs in his community.
Additional Information: Not a UA High School student; operates as a civilian vigilante supporter. His wooden sword generation Quirk produces weapons roughly the length of his arms, emerging from his wrists. Despite his rough appearance, he represents an example of civilian heroism outside formal hero training systems.

cardPool.title: Joi Irinaka
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Joi Irinaka

Alias:
Mimic

Quirk Name:
Mimicry

Occupation/Role:
General Manager of Shie Hassaikai, Yakuza member

Personality:
Hot-tempered and emotionally volatile, often allowing his anger to override strategic thinking. Fiercely loyal to his boss Overhaul and quick to rage at perceived disrespect. Despite his aggressive nature, he demonstrates cunning in combat and administrative competence managing the organization's finances and operations.

Appearance:
A tall, muscular man with pointed facial features including a spiked nose, long square chin, and notably large mouth. He has long spiky blonde hair and a matching goatee. Typically wears a black dress shirt with pinstriped pants and suspenders in traditional Yakuza style. When using his Quirk, he inhabits a small black cloak-like bodysuit with short limb protrusions and wears a white plague mask to conceal his face.

Backstory:
A high-ranking member of the Shie Hassaikai criminal organization, Joi has risen to the position of general manager, overseeing both financial operations and administrative duties. His unwavering loyalty to Overhaul defines his role within the yakuza hierarchy. He participates in the organization's key decisions and conflicts, including negotiations with the League of Villains.

Additional Information:
Not a UA student. Joi's Mimicry Quirk allows him to possess and control objects, which he uses to manipulate the Shie Hassaikai's underground tunnel system during combat. His emotional outbursts often compromise his stealth advantage, making him vulnerable to tactical opponents.

cardPool.title: Johnny
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Johnny

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Warping

Occupation/Role: Nomu experiment subject; teleportation device under Daruma Ujiko's control

Personality: Minimal documented personality; appears docile and content during supervised walks; behavior heavily influenced by external control mechanisms rather than independent agency.

Appearance: A small Nomu with dark skin, round eyes, and exposed brain tissue. His lower body is replaced by a thick cable connecting to his torso. He wears pale lace-up shoes on his upper limbs and a transparent helmet with mechanical protrusions, one serving as a manual Quirk activator.

Backstory: Created or modified as a Nomu by Daruma Ujiko and kept imprisoned in a secret laboratory, Johnny was engineered specifically to serve as a living teleportation apparatus under his creator's command rather than as an independent individual.

Additional Information: Johnny can only teleport individuals to and from his own location; he requires a familiar person at the destination as an anchor point. Overuse causes tonsillitis. His Quirk is manually operated through his helmet device by Daruma, leaving Johnny with little autonomous control over his own abilities.

cardPool.title: Jiro Hotta
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Jiro Hotta

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Grasshopper

Occupation/Role: Trigger dealer and manager of Hopper's Cafe

Personality: Pragmatic and morally ambiguous, Jiro maintains a code of ethics within his criminal enterprise—refusing to deal adulterated Trigger despite its profitability. He is easily frustrated by unwanted interference in his business but remains loyal to friends, offering aid when truly needed. He balances self-interest with genuine concern for those close to him.

Appearance: An average-height adult man with pale brown hair, tanned skin, sharp eyes with small black pupils, and a goatee with a small forehead bump. His face is slimmer than his brother's and features a mustache. He typically wears an open white hoodie with the hood up, grey pants, white sneakers, a blue apron beneath his hoodie, and an orange-yellow bandanna around his neck—the only garment that survives his transformations.

Backstory: Jiro operates as a Trigger dealer alongside his brother Ichiro, managing their distribution network through Hopper's Cafe. Though engaged in illegal activity, he maintains principles by refusing to distribute dangerous adulterated versions of the drug. His frustration with heroes and vigilantes using his establishment as a base drives much of his motivation.

Additional Information: When injected with his legal Trigger variant, Jiro transforms into a large humanoid grasshopper with increased muscle mass, chitinous exoskeletons, and an insect-like head complete with jaws, antennae, and compound eyes. His Trigger boost is less potent than adulterated versions but avoids cognitive decline.

cardPool.title: Jin Bubaigawara
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Jin Bubaigawara

Alias: Twice

Quirk Name: Double

Occupation/Role: Villain, League of Villains member, Vanguard Action Squad operative

Personality: Explosively manic and contradictory, Jin shifts between opposing statements with chaotic energy. Beneath his comedic dramatics lies severe dissociative disorder and identity fragmentation from a nine-day conflict with his own clones, leaving him unsure of his originality. He craves acceptance and friendship desperately, making him loyal but vulnerable to betrayal. Without his mask, his fractured personalities openly argue; with it, he appears unified. His mental instability drives him between humor and destructive aggression.

Appearance: A well-built man with shoulder-length blond hair and gray-blue eyes lacking eyebrows. His face shows sparse facial hair above his mouth and on his chin. He wears a black-and-gray bodysuit with distinctive gray "T" and "W" patterns across his chest formed by intersecting lines. Red wristbands with green accents and circular details store his measuring tapes. His iconic dual-toned mask features a gray upper half with white eye sockets and black lower half covering his mouth.

Backstory: Jin was once a lonely individual who created clones seeking companionship, only to endure a traumatic nine-day conflict questioning his own existence. The League of Villains accepted his fractured mind when society rejected him, offering belonging he desperately needed. This acceptance drove his unwavering loyalty to the group.

Additional Information: Expert at creating duplicates of himself through his Quirk, though his clones retain independent consciousness and share his identity confusion. His mental state remains fragile despite overcoming initial trauma, occasionally experiencing relapses that concern even his allies.

cardPool.title: Iyaro Tenba
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Iyaro Tenba

Alias:
None

Quirk Name:
Multiple Arms

Occupation/Role:
Villain/Criminal

Personality:
Ruthless and violent, willing to threaten and kill without hesitation. Iyaro shows no regard for human life during his crimes, treating victims as obstacles to eliminate.

Appearance:
A muscular man of average height with short brown hair. He wears small round glasses and dresses in a gray tank top with green pants. His most distinctive feature is two extra sets of arms sprouting from his back, a result of his Quirk.

Backstory:
Released from prison after serving time for an unknown crime, Iyaro descended into a two-month spree of armed robberies and murders across multiple locations. His escalating violence caught the attention of hero society, and he was classified as a high-priority villain with heroes mobilizing to apprehend him.

Additional Information:
Iyaro was ultimately eliminated by the Vigilante Stendhal before law enforcement could capture him, his body left abandoned in an alley. He represents a dangerous criminal element in the underground villain network of the My Hero Academia universe.

cardPool.title: Iwao Oguro
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Iwao Oguro

Alias: Knuckleduster

Quirk Name: Overclock

Occupation/Role: Vigilante, former Pro Hero (High-Speed Hero: O'Clock)

Personality: Driven by an unwavering sense of justice, Knuckleduster is direct and aggressive, preferring action over deliberation. He thrives on challenging fights against strong opponents and grows bored with easy victories. Though reckless and prone to violence-first solutions, he possesses surprising intelligence and perceptiveness. He shows no resentment toward Quirkless individuals and genuinely admires Heroes despite operating outside the law.

Appearance: A tall, heavily muscled man with short black hair, thick eyebrows, and heavy stubble. He wears a loose black ragged wrap-around mask, tight black shirt, khaki military pants with black belt, black boots, and a long hunter green trench coat. Black gloves topped with silver knuckledusters complete his vigilante outfit.

Backstory: Once a licensed Pro Hero, Oguro's Quirk was stolen by All For One, rendering him Quirkless. Rather than abandon his mission, he became a vigilante, patrolling his neighborhood each night to combat street-level crime and gangs that professional Heroes ignore.

Additional Information: Operates without government authorization. Despite lacking a Quirk, he remains fearless against powered villains and willing to challenge even Pro Heroes when morality demands it. His greatest frustration is the absence of worthy opponents to test himself against.

cardPool.title: Itsuka Kendo
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Itsuka Kendo

Alias: Battle Fist

Quirk Name: Big Fist

Occupation/Role: UA High School Student, Class 1-B Representative

Personality: Spirited and thoughtful, Itsuka is the compassionate "big sister" of Class 1-B who doesn't hesitate to correct others when needed. She's analytical in combat, friendly across class lines, and willing to sacrifice personal opportunities for teammates. Despite her stern discipline, she holds no ill-will toward rivals and shows genuine concern for others.

Appearance: Medium height with a slim build, Itsuka has sharp teal eyes with white pupils and long orange hair styled in a high left-side ponytail with three-clump bangs and tufted crown. She wears a teal knee-length qipao with yellow accents over a black double-breasted corset, black shorts, a brown utility belt, thin black domino mask, and navy blue heeled boots with white trim.

Backstory: A natural leader and capable combatant, Itsuka earned 5th place in the UA Entrance Exam through skill and determination. Chosen as Class 1-B's representative, she has become the emotional anchor of her class, balancing competitive ambition with genuine kindness toward all heroes-in-training.

Additional Information: Itsuka's Big Fist Quirk allows her to enlarge her hands for devastating close-range attacks and versatile utility—from restraining criminals to protecting allies from airborne hazards. Her analytical mind lets her exploit enemy weaknesses through tactical observation and creative Quirk application.

cardPool.title: Itejiro Toteki
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Itejiro Toteki

Alias: Boomerang Man

Quirk Name: Boomerang

Occupation/Role: Third-year student at Ketsubutsu Academy High School

Personality: Reserved and shy in demeanor, but genuinely talkative and confident in his abilities. Maintains graceful composure during performances, though this makes him apologetic about his own power usage even when helping others.

Appearance: Young man with small black oval eyes, small mouth, and round nose. Wavy shoulder-length black hair pushed back at the forehead, framing his face. Wears a black shirt with elbow-length sleeves, black capri pants with tights, and black sneakers. Accessorized with a wide red scarf covering his chin, thin red wristbands, and dark red fingerless gloves.

Backstory: Training to become a Pro Hero alongside his Ketsubutsu classmates. Participated in the Provisional Hero License Exam as a second-year, where he faced Class 1-A in the traditional "Crushing of U.A." competition. Demonstrated exceptional accuracy with his projectile-throwing ability during the exam.

Additional Information: Known for precise, strategic combat tactics and cooperative teamwork with classmates like Yo Shindo. Excels in coordinated rescue operations, as shown during the disaster zone simulation phase of the licensing exam.

cardPool.title: Invisible Wall
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown

Alias: Invisible Wall

Quirk Name: Chameleon

Occupation/Role: Villain, League of Villains recruit

Personality: Cunning and deceptive in combat, quick to underestimate opponents. Arrogant enough to mock foes mid-battle, relying too heavily on his camouflage advantage.

Appearance: Tall and scrawny with bright green, scaly skin characteristic of a chameleon. His head is distinctly reptilian with prominent spikes, large bulbous eyes capable of independent rotation, and an elongated tongue. He wears a simple black bodysuit with black sneakers and a communications headset.

Backstory: A minor villain recruited by Tomura Shigaraki as part of a force of roughly seventy combatants for the assault on the U.S.J. During the attack, Invisible Wall attempted to ambush Katsuki Bakugo and Eijiro Kirishima. He leaped from the ceiling while camouflaged, believing Bakugo had lowered his guard, only to be immediately defeated by a direct explosion to the head. He was arrested alongside other defeated villains after Pro Heroes arrived.

Additional Information: Specializes in stealth attacks using his camouflage abilities and wall-climbing skills. Carries a knife as his primary weapon and demonstrates basic proficiency with it. His overconfidence in his Quirk's defensive capabilities proved fatal against opponents faster than his tactics anticipated.

cardPool.title: Innsmouth
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Innsmouth
Alias: None documented
Quirk Name: Octopus
Occupation/Role: Petty criminal and cargo smuggler
Personality: Greedy and ruthless, willing to take hostages and use underhanded tactics to achieve his goals. Highly determined and aggressive when opposed, showing no hesitation to escalate violence when his plans are threatened.
Appearance: A semi-anthropomorphic octopus with a reddish-dull skin dotted with bumps and papillae. His head resembles an octopus mantle with two ridges above his eyes and no visible nose. A trunk-like mouth structure with three suction cups on each side extends forward. Two fully prehensile tentacles flank the trunk, while four boneless arms possess suction cups at shoulder, elbow, and wrist. He wears grey baggy pants, red pointed-toe boots, a brown leather belt, a long maroon sleeveless coat, and a red scarf worn as a hood, along with various watches and bracelets.
Backstory: An independent villain operating as a smuggler involved in illegal drug trafficking. Innsmouth works with accomplices referred to as his brothers, coordinating cargo theft and contraband distribution. He has been arrested following confrontations with law enforcement.
Additional Information: Possesses enhanced strength capable of lifting adults single-handedly and delivering strikes strong enough to damage rock and metal. Can lengthen and weaponize his tentacles in combat. Capable of secreting ink to partially blind opponents. Not affiliated with any known villain organization.

cardPool.title: Inko Midoriya
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Inko Midoriya

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Object Attraction

Occupation/Role: Homemaker, Mother of UA Student Izuku Midoriya

Personality: Kind and deeply supportive, though prone to excessive worry and panic that often leads to fainting. She cries dramatically when emotional and shares her son's anxious tendencies. Inko is protective and selfless, feeling guilty about her son's hardships and eager to make amends for doubting his dreams.

Appearance: A woman in her late thirties with shoulder-length dark green hair styled with a small spiky ponytail at the back. She has large, circular dark green eyes similar to her son's. Once slim in her youth, she has gained weight over the years and shows signs of maturity. Her face carries a gentle, motherly quality.

Backstory: Inko is the devoted wife of Hisashi Midoriya and mother to Izuku. When her son was diagnosed as Quirkless, she felt overwhelming guilt, believing she had failed him. Her emotional burden caused visible changes to her appearance over time. After Izuku gained his Quirk and was accepted to UA High School, she initially doubted the school's safety due to his injury-prone abilities, but came to support his heroic aspirations after All Might's personal assurance.

Additional Information: Skilled at tailoring and sewing; handcrafted Izuku's first hero costume. Her Quirk allows her to pull small objects toward herself from a distance. She remains hesitant about UA's dormitory system due to protective concerns for her son's wellbeing.

cardPool.title: Inasa Yoarashi
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Inasa Yoarashi
Alias: Gale Force
Quirk Name: Whirlwind
Occupation/Role: First-year student at Shiketsu High School
Personality: Energetic, hyperactive, and exuberant, Inasa expresses himself with loud vigor and formal politeness. He is driven by an unwavering belief in passion as the core of heroism and despises those with "cold eyes" and angry spirits. While headstrong and vocal, he is genuinely pure-hearted beneath his boisterous exterior. He holds deep grudges against those he perceives as lacking passion, particularly Endeavor and Shoto Todoroki.
Appearance: A very tall and well-built young man with buzzed dark brown hair and black eyes. He wears the standard Shiketsu High uniform—white collared shirt and dark pants—along with the school's signature hat. His hero costume features a burgundy suit with yellow buttons, a fur-collared cape, and a jetpack-like propulsion system on his back. His left arm is concealed in thick brown material with a tan glove featuring air pipes on the knuckles, while his right arm remains exposed beneath a blue skintight sleeve. Tubes run along his torso and ankles for wind expulsion, and he wears knee and shoulder pads resembling gas masks.
Backstory: Originally the top-recommended student for U.A. High School, Inasa withdrew his application and enrolled at Shiketsu instead. His rejection stemmed from a negative first encounter with Shoto and Endeavor Todoroki, whose perceived lack of passion ignited a lasting grudge.
Additional Information: Inasa claims to dislike almost nothing and enjoys making friends with strangers, though his enthusiastic approach can confuse people. His obsession with passion sometimes caused him to let emotions override his judgment during hero licensing exams.

cardPool.title: Ikkaku
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Ikkaku
Alias: Future Hero
Quirk Name: Horn
Occupation/Role: Student at Terakoya Private Hero School
Personality: Jovial, energetic prankster who craves attention and approval. Idolizes flashy heroes and looks down on those with modest Quirks, masking an inferiority complex about his own abilities. Impulsive and mischievous, frequently scolded by teachers. Seeks validation through grand gestures and boasts of becoming awesome.
Appearance: A boy with long spiky hair combed downward, covering his right eye. A prominent horn grows from his head due to his Quirk. Wears a short-sleeved shirt layered over a long-sleeved dark shirt, dark shorts, two small fanny packs at his waist, and a spotted neckerchief around his neck.
Backstory: A student at Terakoya hero school with dreams of becoming a celebrated hero. Ikkaku harbors deep doubts about his own Quirk, viewing it as unremarkable compared to his classmates' powers. He compensates by seeking constant attention through pranks and boasting, believing true heroes possess spectacular abilities and flashy Ultimate Moves rather than steady training and dedication.
Additional Information: Ikkaku's horn grants him heightened sensory perception, allowing him to detect vibrations and changes in his environment. He has a talent for crafting traps and obstacles. His perspective on heroism begins shifting after witnessing Mashirao Ojiro's competence, suggesting capacity for growth beyond his initial arrogance.

cardPool.title: Ikajiro Takobe
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Ikajiro Takobe

Alias: Octoid

Quirk Name: Octopus

Occupation/Role: Former Next-Level Villain, currently reforming

Personality: Once a violent, uncontrolled brute under Trigger influence, Ikajiro is now a kind and educated individual who deeply regrets his past actions. He is apologetic, sensitive, and surprisingly gentle—he loves cats and shows genuine remorse for the harm he caused.

Appearance: A tall, muscular humanoid with jet-black skin and no hair. Six powerful arms line his torso, each covered in suction cups; two additional tentacles remain hidden within his body until deployed. His face is almost featureless save for faint lines running from his mouth to forehead, which conceal tiny eyes. He wears tank tops, shorts, foam clogs, and various colored durags.

Backstory: Ikajiro was physically modified by the Villain Factory and enhanced with Trigger, transforming him into an unstoppable force. Under the drug's influence, he became a mindless instrument of destruction, attacking heroes and civilians alike. After the Trigger wore off and he regained consciousness, his true gentle nature emerged, leaving him horrified by his own actions.

Additional Information: Possesses superhuman strength, speed, and durability from bio-engineering. His Quirk grants cephalopod attributes, making him exceptionally powerful. Despite his formidable abilities, he seeks redemption and has shown he can be reasoned with once freed from chemical influence.

cardPool.title: Ichiro Hotta
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Ichiro Hotta
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Grasshopper
Occupation/Role: Trigger dealer and manager of Hopper's Cafe
Personality: Pragmatic and business-minded with an underlying moral code; frustrated by unwanted interference in his operations but loyal to friends; protective of his reputation as a "respectable" dealer of legal Trigger.
Appearance: Average-height adult man with pale brown hair showing early signs of baldness, tanned skin, sharp eyes with small black pupils, light goatee, and a small forehead bump. Wears a backwards red cricket cap, green hoodie, black pants, white sneakers, white apron over his hoodie, and yellow bandanna around his neck. When using Trigger, transforms into a large humanoid grasshopper with insect-like chitinous exoskeletons, compound eyes, antennae, and powerful jaws.
Backstory: A drug dealer operating alongside his brother Jiro at Hopper's Cafe, Ichiro deals exclusively in legal Trigger formulations to avoid the dangerous additives of black-market versions. He takes pride in his "respectable racket" despite its illegality and grows frustrated when heroes and vigilantes use his cafe as a meeting place or hideout.
Additional Information: Carries Trigger samples for self-enhancement in combat. His legal Trigger provides moderate power boosts without cognitive side effects, unlike adulterated variants. Values friendship despite business frustrations and will help allies when circumstances demand it.

cardPool.title: Ichimoku Samazu
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Ichimoku Samazu
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Beams From His Eyes
Occupation/Role: Middle School Student
