Personality: Kind and polite to friends despite intimidating appearance; devoted fan of Pop☆Step; willing to help vigilantes combat crime and Trigger distribution.
Appearance: Tall middle schooler with short black hair swept back in a pompadour and a small moustache. Wears modified goggles with side mufflers and a central slit visor to control his Quirk. Dressed in typical delinquent style: plain black gakuran, black shoes, and an armlet that complete his Yankii aesthetic.
Backstory: A middle school student who adopted the delinquent lifestyle while maintaining a good heart. Inspired by the hero Pop☆Step, he became involved in vigilante efforts to stop Trigger distribution in his community.
Additional Information: Not a UA High School student; his Quirk's permanent activation status is unknown. His visor goggles are essential equipment for controlling his eye beam output in combat.

cardPool.title: Ichi Anrakuki
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Ichi Anrakuki
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Static
Occupation/Role: Prisoner at Mikuzu Prison
Personality: Serious and embittered by betrayal and societal rejection, yet capable of kindness and fairness. Initially cynical about redemption, but gradually rekindled to hope through witnessing genuine selflessness. Polite and cooperative despite his despair.
Appearance: Adult man with short black hair and a perpetually scowling face. Wears standard blank prison clothing. His stern expression reflects years of hardship and disillusionment.
Backstory: Once worked at a tech startup with a trusted friend, both dreaming of success. Coerced into falsifying financial statements, Ichi was framed and imprisoned for fraud. After release, unable to find employment as an ex-convict, he became homeless. Upon witnessing his former friend's wealth and success, Ichi attacked him in rage and was re-incarcerated for aggravated assault. Now serving his second sentence, he has surrendered to despair—until meeting Danjuro Tobita's unwavering optimism.
Additional Information: Holds a mechanic certification earned during his first imprisonment. His Quirk, Static, allows him to generate electrical discharge. He becomes willing to sacrifice his own chance at redemption to stand alongside those who show him compassion, suggesting deep capacity for loyalty beneath his bitter exterior.

cardPool.title: Hoyo Makihara
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Hoyo Makihara

Alias: Mummy

Quirk Name: Mummification

Occupation/Role: Villain, member of Nine's criminal organization

Personality: Apathetic and merciless, showing no remorse in combat. Highly cautious and tactical, preferring to control the battlefield through preparation and manipulation rather than direct confrontation. Demonstrates calculated intelligence in attrition-based strategies.

Appearance: A tall, lanky man with pale orange, baggy forward-slanting eyes and straight gray hair. His entire body is wrapped in burgundy-colored bandages except for his hands and eyes. He wears a dark gray combat vest over the bandages, light gray skin-tight pants with beige knee guards, black fingerless gloves, and grey dress shoes. A brown garter belt holds numerous pouches, and he carries a small sword on his left shoulder.

Backstory: A skilled villain recruited into Nine's organization for the Nabu Island operation. Hoyo participated in attacking an urban settlement, overwhelming inexperienced UA students through sheer superiority in combat ability and Quirk mastery before being defeated by Bakugo's explosive counterattack.

Additional Information: Exceptionally proficient with his Quirk, capable of simultaneously controlling over a dozen mummified objects as combat puppets. Uses an attrition-based tactical approach, creating diversions and human shields by manipulating clothing and possessions of living opponents. His bandages can be broken with sufficient force. Not a UA student.

cardPool.title: Hokuto Hario
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Hokuto Hario

Alias: Compass Kid

Quirk Name: Pointer

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero (Lower-class rank)

Personality: Optimistic and amicable, Hokuto values his work for bringing peace to civilians. He deeply loves his family and desires to be a hero they can admire. His trusting nature and positive outlook, while endearing, make him vulnerable to deception from those he works alongside.

Appearance: A middle-aged man with small circular eyes, large chin, and short black hair parted left. His hero costume is a slightly-too-small bodysuit with exposed stomach, fastened by a C-shaped belt buckle. An eight-wind compass rose adorns the chest. He wears light gloves, a light cape, and dark boots all decorated with arrows. A small domino mask with outward-facing arrow eyebrows completes the look.

Backstory: Hokuto became a pro hero driven by the desire to protect civilians and be a role model for his children. During a patrol with the hero Rock, he discovered Rock's true villainous identity while investigating attacks. His integrity and moral conviction led him to confront this betrayal, though it ultimately cost him his life.

Additional Information: Pointer requires Hokuto to spin to activate, allowing him to point toward targets in up to three directions simultaneously using his arms and legs. Despite his lower pay grade, he found fulfillment in his heroic duties and the safety he provided to others.

cardPool.title: Hitoshi Shinso
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Hitoshi Shinso

Alias: Hypnosis Hero: NightHide

Quirk Name: Brainwashing

Occupation/Role: Student, Class 1-C Department of General Education at UA High School

Personality: Stoic and reserved with a sharp wit, Hitoshi manipulates conversations to his advantage without hesitation. Resentful toward those he views as naturally blessed with heroic Quirks, he masks his longing for acceptance behind a calculating demeanor. Despite claiming indifference to friendship, he secretly desires validation and recognition as a true hero.

Appearance: A relatively tall young man with messy, indigo hair that flares outward in large tufts. His distinctive purple eyes are thin and triangular with white pupils, usually half-closed beneath dark eye bags, and he has straight teeth. Currently wears the standard UA student uniform; during combat training, he dons a dark blue PE uniform with white UA markings, a detachable artificial vocal cord device over his mouth, a capturing weapon around his neck, and green-white sneakers.

Backstory: Persecuted throughout his life for possessing a Quirk perceived as villainous, Hitoshi has internalized deep resentment toward those with naturally heroic abilities. Despite discrimination and fear from peers, his determination to become a Pro Hero has never wavered. He enrolled in UA's General Education Department, driven to prove his heroic intentions and disprove those who doubt him.

Additional Information: His Brainwashing Quirk requires verbal responses from targets to activate, making him dependent on manipulation and conversation. He lacks natural combat prowess, compensating through cunning and tactical awareness. The artificial vocal cords enhance his Quirk's activation capability.

cardPool.title: Hisashi Midoriya
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Hisashi Midoriya
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Fire Breath
Occupation/Role: Businessman (abroad)
Personality: Unknown; absent from his son's life for extended periods, suggesting either dedication to work or emotional distance.
Appearance: Not extensively described in available records; presumed to be an adult male with features potentially inherited by his son Izuku.
Backstory: Married Inko and fathered Izuku before taking a work post abroad. His whereabouts and current activities remain mysterious.
Additional Information: Not a UA student. His Fire Breath Quirk contrasts sharply with his son's lack of a Quirk, creating family tension. His prolonged absence suggests he may not be directly involved in current events at UA High School.

cardPool.title: Hiroshi Tameda
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Hiroshi Tameda

Alias:
"Can't You See?" Kid

Quirk Name:
Not specified

Occupation/Role:
Civilian/Endeavor Fan

Personality:
Passionate and loyal fan of Endeavor who admires the hero's relentless determination to reach the top. Initially naive but emotionally invested in hero society; prone to dramatic emotional swings when his beliefs are challenged. Despite setbacks, remains fundamentally supportive and hopeful, showing capacity for faith even when disillusioned.

Appearance:
Plain-looking young man of average height with distinctive spiky pink hair and large brown eyes. Youthful civilian clothing, bearing a resemblance to Kosei Tsuburaba from Class 1-B. Clean-faced with no distinguishing marks or scars.

Backstory:
An ordinary civilian deeply devoted to Pro Hero Endeavor, admiring his single-minded pursuit of excellence. Witnessed Endeavor's character shift firsthand and became emotionally turbulent when learning of the hero's abusive past through Dabi's broadcast. Experienced the collapse of hero society and subsequent conflicts from evacuation centers, where his faith in heroes was tested repeatedly.

Additional Information:
Not a UA student. Became an internet meme after interrupting live broadcast coverage to defend Endeavor during the High-End battle. Represents the civilian perspective on hero society's moral complexities and the emotional toll of hero worship during societal upheaval.

cardPool.title: Hiryu Rin
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Hiryu Rin
Alias: Long Weizi
Quirk Name: Scales
Occupation/Role: UA High School Class 1-B Student
Personality: Willing collaborator with a severe demeanor in combat, diligent in academics and Quirk mastery, possesses strong tactical intellect and quick reflexes for strategic problem-solving.
Appearance: Lightly tanned skin with black hair in a low braid reaching his shoulders; reptilian-shaped eyes with notably small irises. Wears a high-collared black bodysuit with thin yellow clouds across the torso, white knee-high boots with yellow back straps, red belt with brown pouches, large yellow gauntlets with black sleeves, and a yellow visor resembling a talisman.
Backstory: A Class 1-B student training to become a Pro Hero at UA High School during the hero academy's foundational year, Hiryu has distinguished himself through strategic thinking and combat versatility, earning respect among his peers through collaborative efforts.
Additional Information: Excels in both close and long-range combat through scale projection; possesses terrific projectile accuracy and sharp tactical awareness. Scale armor has durability limitations against sufficient force. Wears specialized Scale Gauntlets that enhance his ranged offensive capability.

cardPool.title: Hizashi Yamada
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Hizashi Yamada

Alias: Voice Hero: Present Mic

Quirk Name: Voice

Occupation/Role: English Teacher at UA High School / Pro Hero (No. 45)

Personality: An eccentric, high-energy entertainer with a radio host persona who constantly poses and maintains excitement regardless of situation. He has an innate desire to engage crowds as his "listeners" and exaggerate events for hype. Despite his jovial nature, he harbors deep loyalty to friends and is capable of intense rage when betrayed. He suffers from entomophobia and prefers urban areas to forests.

Appearance: A tall, slim man with long blond hair spiked upward in a large tuft, small brown mustache, and rectangular eyes with concentric greenish-yellow irises. He wears orange-tinted shades, black headphones labeled "HAGE," and maintains an almost permanent large smile. His hero costume consists of a black studded jacket with an imposing tall collar, black pants and knee-high boots, tan shoulder pads, red studded belt and elbow pads, black fingerless gloves, and a directional speaker around his neck.

Backstory: A current Pro Hero and former UA High School student, Hizashi teaches English while maintaining his hero career. He shares a tragic history with classmate Shota Aizawa, involving their deceased friend Oboro Shirakumo.

Additional Information: UA High School staff and Pro Hero. Known for commentating events and bringing entertainment value to any situation. His Quirk amplification devices are essential to his combat effectiveness.

cardPool.title: Himiko Toga
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Himiko Toga

Alias:
Toga

Quirk Name:
Transform

Occupation/Role:
UA High School Student (Class 1-A); Member of the League of Villains

Personality:
Cheerful and sadistic with a twisted perception of love, viewing absorption of others as intimacy. Mentally unstable, prone to blushing from excitement rather than embarrassment. Easily shifts between playful affection and dangerous aggression based on interest level.

Appearance:
Fair-skinned girl with distinctive inward-tilting yellow cat-like eyes, thin slit pupils, and bags beneath them. Sharp canines give her a vampiric appearance. Pale ash-blonde hair styled in two messy buns with wild strands, straight fringe, and chin-length side bangs. Wears a dark blue seifuku with white trim and red scarf, paired with an oversized beige cardigan, knee-length black socks, and dark brown school shoes.

Backstory:
A UA student harboring a dual life as a member of the League of Villains. Her Quirk allows her to assume the appearance of others after consuming their blood, which she views as an expression of love rather than predation. Her fractured mental state stems from childhood isolation due to her unusual nature.

Additional Information:
Combat-ready despite student status, carrying concealed blades and blood extraction equipment. Her Transform Quirk requires ingesting blood to copy physical forms. Capable fighter prone to sudden mood shifts and unpredictable behavior in conflict situations.

cardPool.title: Hime
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Hime

Alias:
None

Quirk Name:
Unknown

Occupation/Role:
Civilian Child

Personality:
Cheeky and demanding despite her young age, Hime speaks her mind without hesitation even when insensitive. She is quick to develop crushes on attractive boys and expresses gratitude readily to those who help her. Her romantic inclinations drive her actions, though she remains endearing in her earnestness.

Appearance:
A small girl with short, slightly curly light hair held back by a black headband decorated with butterfly motifs on both sides. She dresses in a sophisticated manner befitting her refined demeanor. Her youthful features and petite frame make her appear delicate, though her personality suggests otherwise.

Backstory:
While walking the streets of Osaka, Hime was attacked by members of the Octo-Lover's Brigade during a revolt. A hero in his slender form rescued her, and she became infatuated with him. Unable to identify her rescuer by name, she requested help from the Fat Gum Agency to find him, launching an investigation that involved UA students Tamaki Amajiki, Tenya Ida, and Momo Yaoyorozu.

Additional Information:
Hime eventually discovered her "prince" was Fat Gum himself, who had been in his muscular form during previous encounters. She was delighted to finally meet him again and requested he maintain his slender appearance, as she preferred him that way.

cardPool.title: Higari Maijima
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Higari Maijima

Alias: Excavation Hero: Power Loader

Quirk Name: Iron Claws

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero and Support Course faculty member at U.A. High School; manages the Costume Development Studio

Personality: Strict and demanding teacher who pushes students to excel without limits. Easily angered but acknowledges talent and effort. A self-described loner who prefers solitude and machinery to socializing, though he genuinely cares for colleagues and students beneath his gruff exterior.

Appearance: A short, lean man with a youthful face despite advanced age. Spiky ginger hair reaches past his shoulders; dull blue eyes and notably large mouth. Disproportionately large hands tipped with orange L-shaped metallic claws. Wears a massive yellow rectangular excavator-claw helmet that covers his head and face. Shirtless torso with large fingerless gray gloves featuring metal arm guards; plain cyan pants. In combat, uses a large steel mecha with articulated metal arms.

Backstory: An experienced Pro Hero specializing in excavation and support equipment. Now dedicates himself to teaching and developing hero costumes at U.A., where he trains the next generation while maintaining his own mechanical inventions and projects.

Additional Information: Licensed costume developer and creator. Operates a specialized combat mecha resembling construction equipment to augment his burrowing Quirk abilities. Uses High Density Weight bracelets during combat training to handicap himself against students.

cardPool.title: Hekiji Tengai
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Hekiji Tengai

Alias:
Shield of the Eight Bullets

Quirk Name:
Barrier

Occupation/Role:
Member of the Shie Hassaikai's Eight Bullets; Kendo Rappa's assigned partner

Personality:
Calm and composed with monk-like demeanor, maintaining serenity even in conflict. Philosophically opposed to excessive violence and views fighting as a low, selfish desire. Analytical and observant, often commenting on situations with an enlightened perspective. Keeps his eyes closed while speaking, projecting wisdom and restraint.

Appearance:
Tall and slim man with pale, short spiky hair and straight dark eyebrows. Light-colored irises with thin eyes usually kept closed. Wears a traditional dark yukata with white cloth belt and wooden geta sandals. Bears the Shie Hassaikai's signature brown plague mask secured with three belts—one across forehead and two on sides covering ears.

Backstory:
Former devout Buddhist recruited into the Shie Hassaikai by Overhaul to serve as a stabilizing influence on the volatile Kendo Rappa. Paired strategically with Kendo due to complementary Quirk synergy, functioning as "Spear and Shield" against aggressive opponents. Newest member of the Eight Bullets organization.

Additional Information:
Specializes in defensive barrier creation that absorbs and blocks powerful impacts. Works best alongside offensive partners, demonstrated during confrontations with Fat Gum and Kirishima. Eventually arrested following the Shie Hassaikai's defeat and imprisonment.

cardPool.title: Haruaki Sun-Sun
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Haruaki Sun-Sun

Alias: Mr. Sunny

Quirk Name: Unnamed Sunflower Quirk

Occupation/Role: Orphanage Caretaker

Personality: Perpetually cheerful and welcoming on the surface, though his true nature remains ambiguous; he works as an agent of All For One, raising children as potential vessels without visible mistreatment, yet his capacity for deception and loyalty to darker forces is evident.

Appearance: A tall adult man with a distinctive yellow sunflower-like face, yellow ears and neck, brown hair on the back of his head, and tan-colored hands. He wears a white hoodie with a pink apron, maintaining a consistently bright, cheerful expression.

Backstory: Employed by Kyudai Garaki as a caretaker at an orphanage secretly operated to cultivate spare vessels for All For One, Haruaki oversaw the upbringing of children including the badly burned Toya Todoroki. When Toya awoke from his coma and lashed out in despair, Haruaki attempted to restrain him but was burned by the boy's flames, resulting in Toya setting the orphanage ablaze and fleeing. Kyudai subsequently blamed Haruaki for the fire to protect the operation's secrecy.

Additional Information: His Quirk grants him a sunflower-like appearance, though its full capabilities remain unknown; he operates outside normal society as part of a covert villain organization; his role involves psychological management and manipulation of vulnerable children.

cardPool.title: Ibara Shiozaki
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Ibara Shiozaki
Alias: Vine
Quirk Name: Vines
Occupation/Role: UA High School Student, Class 1-B
Personality: Modest and courteous with deep religious conviction, Ibara speaks softly but firmly about her pure intentions. Beneath her graceful demeanor lies an unexpectedly vindictive streak and rigid moral code—she judges others harshly for dishonesty and refuses to participate in underhanded tactics, even when strategically advantageous. She values fairness and truth above all else.
Appearance: Medium-height girl with dark green eyes and long lower eyelashes, regarded as cute. Her most distinctive feature is her hair of thorn-covered green vines, which she keeps at a manageable length just above her waist, with one set wrapped around her forehead in a cross pattern. She wears a plain white toga-like robe with dark brown knee-high boots, giving her the appearance of an ancient Greek goddess.
Backstory: A talented student who earned fourth place in the UA Entrance Exam through balanced combat and rescue capabilities. Her vine Quirk and disciplined fighting style caught the attention of professional heroes, establishing her as a rising talent within her cohort.
Additional Information: Stationary-type combatant who restricts opponents with vine manipulation while maintaining position; vulnerable to high-speed and close-quarters fighters. Her vines regenerate with proper sunlight and water, and she can detach them at will. She values honesty to the point of self-sabotage, often apologizing for unintentional deception.

cardPool.title: Horse Man
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Horse Man
Quirk Name: Horse Quirk
Occupation/Role: Petty Thug/Villain; Later Dishwasher at Hopper's Cafe
Personality: Brash and aggressive, prone to yelling and intimidation. Despite his criminal inclinations, he appears capable of rehabilitation when given legitimate opportunity and work. Shows enthusiasm when cheering on heroes.
Appearance: Brown-skinned man with black hair styled like a horse's mane. Wears a white tank top under a black jacket, blue jeans, and green wristbands. Bears a tattoo on his left shoulder. His Quirk gives him equine facial features and characteristics.
Backstory: A small-time criminal operating in Naruhata's backstreets alongside Rhino Man, conducting petty robberies and extortion. After being defeated by the Crawler and apprehended by Hopper's Cafe workers, he was offered employment as an alternative to arrest and accepted reformation.
Additional Information: Not a UA student. His Quirk's exact abilities remain unclear beyond physical appearance alterations. Later reformed and became an ally to the Crawler during the Naruhata Lockdown incident.

cardPool.title: Hood
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Unknown (formerly an underground fighter)

Alias:
Hood, High-End

Quirk Name:
Muscle Augmentation, Super Regeneration

Occupation/Role:
Intelligent High-End Nomu, Doctor Kyudai Garaki's creation

Personality:
Obeys his master with unwavering loyalty. Speaks with a stutter and broken grammar. Displays disturbing eagerness for combat against strong opponents, growing bored once victory is achieved. Possesses tactical cunning, using diversions and protecting vulnerabilities strategically.

Appearance:
Extraordinarily muscular build with an unnaturally long neck lined with jutting vertebrae. Skin is dark purple-black. His head is shrouded by a hood of skin with only glowing yellow eyes visible beneath. Neck and shoulder muscles are exposed. Underneath the hood lies an exposed brain, distorted red eyes, and a mouth filled with jagged teeth.

Backstory:
Originally a muscular underground fighter with a thug's mentality and battle-lust, this individual was transformed by Doctor Kyudai Garaki into Hood, the first of the High-End Nomu breed. Enhanced with multiple Quirks and augmentations, he became a weapon capable of rivaling top Pro Heroes, driven by his master's will and his own insatiable hunger for worthy opponents.

Additional Information:
Not a UA student. Possesses multiple combat Quirks beyond Muscle Augmentation and Super Regeneration. Can summon weaker Nomu to handle lesser threats. His head serves as his critical weakness—destruction of it prevents regeneration. Demonstrates intelligence rare among Nomu, enabling strategic decision-making during prolonged battles.

cardPool.title: Hina
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Hina

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Unknown

Occupation/Role: Sophomore at Naruhata Women's College; Trigger drug dealer

Personality: Shy and withdrawn in normal circumstances, struggling with social interaction especially around men. Undergoes a dramatic personality shift when perceiving threats to her best friend Rin, becoming fiercely protective and hostile. Views all men as beasts and shows extreme jealousy when they show interest in Rin. Willing to drug innocent people without hesitation to protect her friend's interests.

Appearance: Young woman with an unremarkable, plain appearance she deliberately maintains to avoid attention. Brown bob-cut hair with bangs that conceal her brown eyes. Wears drab, flat clothing that blends into crowds. When manipulating targets, she transforms dramatically—adopting a cuter outfit, applying makeup, revealing her eyes, and presenting an attractive, adorable persona designed to deceive.

Backstory: A college student who bonded deeply with Rin Yaritezawa, her only genuine social connection. Began distributing Trigger drugs supplied by the villain Number 6 at social mixers, specifically targeting men who showed romantic interest in Rin. Her actions caused multiple incidents of uncontrolled Quirks, drawing police attention and Midnight's investigation. Apprehended after attempting to drug a student at a mixer for comforting Rin.

Additional Information: Obtained an oral variant of Trigger from Number 6, requiring only ingestion to activate. Connected to a dealer with an acceleration Quirk linked to the Osaka Incident. Currently in police custody.

cardPool.title: Hikage Shinomori
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Hikage Shinomori

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Danger Sense

Occupation/Role: One For All User, Hermit Warrior

Personality: Valiant and noble, driven to defeat All For One, yet realistic about his limitations. Solitary by nature, preferring isolation—likely due to his Quirk's constant vigilance keeping him on edge. Selfless in his dedication to strengthening One For All for the next user.

Appearance: Lean, muscular man with short beige hair parting from his forehead and thin, downward-slanting green eyes. Wears a dark, baggy bodysuit with torn shin-length pants, a large sage-colored belt, and padded kneecaps. A light puffy jacket cuts off at his chest with the right sleeve worn separately. His physique is hardened from relentless training.

Backstory: The fourth wielder of One For All, Hikage inherited the power from Bruce and spent his life in solitary training, aware he lacked the strength to defeat All For One alone. He devoted himself to perfecting the Quirk and his own abilities, preparing to pass his legacy to a stronger successor.

Additional Information: Danger Sense grants him the ability to sense incoming threats, triggering a stabbing sensation in his head upon detection, allowing effortless evasion. One For All grants superhuman strength, speed, agility, and durability—he could split boulders with ease. His constant state of alertness from his Quirk drove him toward isolation.

cardPool.title: Harusaburo Nanboku
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Harusaburo Nanboku

Alias:
The Enka Master

Quirk Name:
Unknown

Occupation/Role:
Professional Enka Singer

Personality:
Reserved and contemplative, with a deep affection for his hometown of Naruhata that shines through his artistic work. He carries himself with the dignity befitting an established performer.

Appearance:
A middle-aged man with short, curly brown hair and warm, expressive eyes. He typically wears a purple yukata draped casually, giving him an approachable yet dignified presence. His weathered features suggest years of experience in the entertainment industry.

Backstory:
Harusaburo rose to prominence as an Enka master, earning renown throughout Naruhata for his emotionally resonant performances. His most celebrated work, "Yearning for Naruhata," became a super-long-running hit that cemented his connection to his beloved city ward.

Additional Information:
Harusaburo was featured as a headlining artist at Narufest, a musical celebration event held on the rooftop of the Marukane Department Store following its reconstruction. His vocal mastery and emotional delivery have made him a cultural fixture in Naruhata's community.

cardPool.title: Haruhisa
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Haruhisa
Alias: Haruhisa the Bare-Handed
Quirk Name: Unnamed Transformation Quirk
Occupation/Role: Yakuza Executive, Abegawa Tenchu Kai
Personality: Stoic and composed, habitually calm even in combat; appears unfazed by danger and maintains composure while smoking. Disciplined and tactical in approach to conflict.
Appearance: A large, imposing elderly man with a defined jawline and prominent cheekbones. Dark hair swept back with whitened temples and front crown. Wears dark sunglasses and a light-colored yukata. Maintains a cigar in his mouth during confrontation, projecting an air of calculated confidence.
Backstory: A seasoned member of the Abegawa Tenchu Kai yakuza organization, Haruhisa rose to executive rank through demonstrated combat prowess and unwavering loyalty. His reputation as "the Bare-Handed" reflects his formidable unarmed fighting capability enhanced by his Quirk.
Additional Information: Haruhisa's Quirk enables him to transform into a muscular, gray hulk-like creature, dramatically increasing his physical power during combat. He perished defending yakuza headquarters alongside fellow executives against the vigilante Stendhal.

cardPool.title: Hari Kurono
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Hari Kurono
Alias: Chronostasis
Quirk Name: Chronostasis
Occupation/Role: Yakuza member of the Shie Hassaikai; assistant to Overhaul
Personality: Composed and cold-hearted, unfazed by cruelty. Fiercely loyal to his leader with subservient tendencies. Tactical and analytical, capable of reading opponents' weaknesses in combat.
Appearance: Fair-skinned with thin, dark eyes and pointed eyebrows. Pale chin-length hair styled into arrow-shaped clock needles due to his Quirk. Wears a black plague mask with gold trim, circular glasses, and a distinctive long white raincoat with the hood permanently raised.
Backstory: A subordinate within the Shie Hassaikai criminal organization, Hari serves as the right-hand man to Kai Chisaki. His unwavering loyalty and lack of independent judgment have bound him to Kai's increasingly ruthless decisions, including the mistreatment of the child Eri.
Additional Information: Expert marksman and espionage specialist capable of remaining undetected for extended periods. His Chronostasis Quirk slows target movements to near-immobility for up to one hour through contact with his hair. Relies on tactics and stealth rather than direct combat, though proved no match for U.A. student Mirio Togata.

cardPool.title: Hard Head
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Hard Head
Quirk Name: Muscle Expansion
Occupation/Role: F-rank Villain, League of Villains Member
Personality: Confident and willing to engage strong opponents despite low rank; personality otherwise unremarkable and largely unknown.
Appearance: An extremely tall, powerfully built man with massive arms. He wears a full-encasing helmet with only an eye slit, a black sleeveless tank top, greenish-brown trousers, and brown shoes. His physique is notably muscular and imposing.
Backstory: Hard Head was recruited by Tomura Shigaraki as one of roughly seventy villains to assault the Unforeseen Simulation Joint. He participated in the Mountain Zone ambush targeting Class 1-A students, attacking Denki Kaminari but was quickly incapacitated when Denki's Electrification quirk was reflexively activated. He was arrested upon U.A. staff arrival.
Additional Information: F-rank villain with no criminal notoriety. His muscle expansion quirk provides raw physical strength but proved ineffective against electrical attacks. Defeated and apprehended during the U.S.J. assault arc.

cardPool.title: Hanta Sero
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Hanta Sero

Alias: Taping Hero: Cellophane

Quirk Name: Tape

Occupation/Role: UA High School Student, Class 1-A

Personality: Amicable and sociable, often loud and showy while trying to impress peers. Humorous and quick to call out classmates' eccentric behavior. Laid-back and confident despite odds, maintaining determination even through defeats. Has a teasing side and speaks his mind freely, sometimes unintentionally insulting others. Shows interest in girls and enjoys gossip among friends.

Appearance: Tall and lean young man with chin-length black hair spiked downward and jagged bangs reaching mid-forehead. Large almond-shaped eyes with small pupils and a broad grin revealing straight teeth. His elbows are cylindrical tape dispenser-shaped, serving as his Quirk's source. Wears standard UA male uniform: light gray blazer with dark turquoise trim, white dress shirt, dark blue-green pants, red tie, and brown shoes.

Backstory: Hanta is a first-year student at UA High School training to become a professional hero. He has integrated himself as a valued member of Class 1-A, earning respect through his competence and friendly demeanor. His Tape Quirk allows him to bind and restrain targets from distance, making him a versatile combatant despite lacking flashy offensive abilities.

Additional Information: Competed in the Sports Festival against Shoto Todoroki despite knowing the odds were against him. Failed the Final Exam after being put to sleep by Midnight but retained his commitment to improvement alongside classmates. Demonstrates strong teamwork potential and emotional resilience.

cardPool.title: Hana Shimura
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Hana Shimura
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Unknown
Occupation/Role: Student
Personality: Carefree and loving toward her brother, Hana aspired to become a hero like her grandmother. Despite her genuine affection and remorse, she could be selfish and cowardly when afraid of punishment, prioritizing self-preservation over honesty.
Appearance: A young girl with shoulder-length dark hair styled in side pigtails with thick framing strands and short bangs. She had distinctive dark brown, cat-like eyes that angled inward. She wore a light-colored striped t-shirt with cuffed sleeves.
Backstory: Granddaughter of Pro Hero Nana Shimura, Hana lived under her abusive father Kotaro's strict rule forbidding hero worship. She discovered a photo of her grandmother and, seeking to inspire her younger brother Tenko, showed him the truth about their heroic legacy. When discovered, she falsely blamed Tenko to escape punishment, leading to their father's brutal beatings. Attempting to apologize that evening, she was accidentally disintegrated by Tenko's newly manifested Decay Quirk, becoming the tragic catalyst for his descent into villainy.
Additional Information: Deceased. Not a UA student. Her death profoundly shaped her brother Tenko's transformation into the villain Tomura Shigaraki, making her a pivotal figure in the series' backstory despite minimal screen time.

cardPool.title: Haishin
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Haishin

Alias: Haishin

Quirk Name: Not specified

Occupation/Role: Social media influencer and charity event host

Personality: Energetic, cheery, and slightly pushy with an enthusiastic demeanor. He is genuine in his charitable nature and quick to appreciate heroic efforts, though his loud attitude can come across as an acquired taste to some.

Appearance: A man with short two-tone hair and pointed ears adorned with earrings. He has subtle stubble beneath his chin. He typically wears a black long-sleeved shirt under a casual t-shirt bearing his own name.

Backstory: Haishin has built a following as a social media influencer, leveraging his platform to host charitable events that benefit the community. He distributes trending treats like sugar bombs to the public during his videos, combining entertainment with generosity. His methods attract attention and admiration, though not always without criticism.

Additional Information: Haishin is not a UA High School student. He operates independently as a content creator and philanthropist. He demonstrates genuine appreciation for heroic action and quickly recognizes the students who aided him as true Heroes. His popularity makes him a recognizable figure to UA students like Toru Hagakure.

cardPool.title: Habuko Mongoose
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Habuko Mongoose

Alias:
None

Quirk Name:
Paralysis

Occupation/Role:
Student of Isami Academy High School

Personality:
Once lonely and self-perceived as treacherous, Habuko became sociable and friendly after befriending Tsuyu Asui in middle school. She remains shy around strangers but deeply values her friendships, showing remarkable loyalty even when afflicted by a zombie virus.

Appearance:
Habuko's most distinctive feature is her serpentine head and neck with gray patterned scales, bright yellow eyes with slit pupils, and spiky shoulder-length red hair. Her body is petite and fair-skinned with regular human proportions. She wears the Isami Academy uniform: white dress shirt with dark red bow, dark blue blazer, gray pleated knee-length skirt, black socks, and brown loafers.

Backstory:
Two years before Tsuyu entered UA, Habuko attended the same middle school and initially stalked her, using her Quirk to paralyze her. Tsuyu's kind offer of friendship transformed Habuko's life, ending her isolation. Though they attended different high schools afterward, they remained close. Habuko now has made new friends at Isami Academy and participates in inter-school training exercises.

Additional Information:
Habuko is a guest student from Isami Academy High School who participated in the Survival Training exercise alongside Class 1-A during the Quirk Apprehension Test arc. Her Quirk paralyzes targets for three seconds through eye contact. She was temporarily zombified during the training but retained enough awareness to spare her friend Tsuyu from attack.

cardPool.title: Gyges
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Gyges
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Multiple Arms
Occupation/Role: Tartarus Prison Guard
Personality: Dutiful and serious, with strong loyalty to his post and fellow guards; demonstrates courage in the face of overwhelming danger.
Appearance: Lanky build with six arms total, providing exceptional reach and combat capability. Wears a distinctive horned helmet that completely conceals his face, forming the centerpiece of his guard uniform.
Backstory: A dedicated guard stationed at Tartarus' Bronze Gate alongside his brother Briareos. Gyges maintains his post with unwavering commitment, calling for code-red alerts when detecting threats. During the catastrophic prison break orchestrated by All For One, he fights valiantly against Tomura Shigaraki and High-End Nomu before being killed in the assault.
Additional Information: Possesses six functional arms, likely permanent additions rather than retractable; this grants him significant combat advantage in melee and defensive operations. His Quirk bears similarity to Mezo Shoji's Dupli-Arms but with greater arm count. Gyges' final act was reporting his brother's death and initiating emergency lockdown protocols before being eliminated by All For One's power.

cardPool.title: Gunhead
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Gunhead
Quirk Name: Unknown
Occupation/Role: Pro Hero specializing in armed combat; internship mentor
Personality: Professional and friendly with excellent teaching values. Composed and fierce in combat but unexpectedly kind otherwise, with a tendency toward teasing and playful posing.
Appearance: Wide-set, muscular man with long pale mint-green hair spiking backward. White mask with four gun-muzzle-like holes and a padded combat vest over a dark grayish-cyan bodysuit. Brown pants, black boots, silver revolver chamber-shaped bracers, and knuckle spikes.
Backstory: An established Pro Hero who runs an agency focused on armed combat training and crime suppression. Known for taking on internship students and providing hands-on field training in patrol work and martial arts instruction.
Additional Information: Gunhead Martial Arts is his signature fighting technique. He mentored UA Class 1-A student Ochaco Uraraka during her internship, teaching her practical combat skills and proper fighting form. Later participated in civilian evacuation efforts during the Final War against All For One's forces.

cardPool.title: Goto Imasuji
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Goto Imasuji
Alias: Muscular
Quirk Name: Muscle Augmentation
Occupation/Role: Villain, League of Villains Vanguard Action Squad member
Personality: Sadistic and bloodthirsty, Muscular craves violence and killing above all else. He joined the League purely to indulge his brutal nature rather than follow ideology. Despite his savagery, he holds a strict personal code: one's worth is determined by whether they accomplish their stated intentions. He respects worthy opponents and bears no grudge against those who defeat him fairly. His fatal flaw is overconfidence—he underestimates opponents and toys with them rather than fighting seriously, often becoming distracted. He grows bored against weaker foes and dismisses tactics he deems "cheap."
Appearance: An enormous, muscular man with a bulky build set wide across the shoulders. He has short, spiky sandy-blond hair and tiny black eyes. His most distinctive features are scars: one large scar across his left face and a smaller one on his right forehead. He wears a white hockey mask with multiple holes and a black hooded cloak. Beneath this is a red tank top, dark jacket hanging at his waist, dark green pants, and black knee-high boots.
Backstory: A hardened criminal imprisoned in Tartarus, Muscular was freed by All For One and recruited into the League of Villains' Vanguard Action Squad. He previously killed the hero duo Water Hose in combat, earning the scar across his face—a wound he accepts without resentment, respecting their strength. He operates as a brutal enforcer for the League's schemes.
Additional Information: Muscular's Quirk allows him to augment his already formidable musculature to devastating levels. His overconfidence in his power's superiority has repeatedly cost him in critical moments. He possesses a twisted sense of honor, speaking respectfully of fallen opponents to their loved ones and eagerly anticipating rematches with strong fighters.

cardPool.title: Gorilla
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown

Alias: Gorilla

Quirk Name: Gorilla Arm

Occupation/Role: League of Villains member, U.S.J. assault participant

Personality: Cautious and easily startled, quick to express shock when situations turn unfavorable. She lacks independent initiative and follows orders within the villain hierarchy.

Appearance: Adult woman with shoulder-length maroon hair and bangs obscuring her left eye. Indigo markings surround her right eye with two diagonal lines extending toward her ear and cheek. Her arms are notably enlarged and covered in brown hair, adapted to her Quirk. She wears a short sleeveless purple dress with a v-neck and three diagonal light purple stripes on the right side.

Backstory: Recruited as one of roughly seventy low-ranking villains by Tomura Shigaraki for the coordinated U.S.J. assault. She served as part of the horde attacking Pro Hero Shota Aizawa but was overwhelmed when the League's long-range squad fell rapidly to his power.

Additional Information: Defeated and arrested following the U.S.J. incident. Her Quirk grants her gorilla-like arm strength and physiology, making her suitable for close-combat roles despite her minor status within the League.

cardPool.title: Gori
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Gori
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Unknown
Occupation/Role: Police Force Officer
Personality: Firm yet fair, perceptive, and empathetic. Gori believes in redemption and second chances, able to read people's intentions with accuracy. He is strict with dangerous criminals but willing to listen and understand circumstances. Shows compassion by offering tea to reformed criminals and recognizing genuine bonds between people.
Appearance: A bulky man with the head of a mountain gorilla, wearing a dark gray suit with a black tie. During combat situations, he dons armored police gear. His imposing physique contrasts with his measured demeanor.
Backstory: Gori serves as a dedicated member of the Police Force, handling interrogations and criminal intake. He first gained notice interrogating Gentle Criminal after his failed UA School Festival infiltration, where his perceptiveness allowed him to see through false confessions and recognize Gentle's capacity for change. Later, he extracted crucial information from Kyudai Garaki regarding Tomura's revival during post-war investigations.
Additional Information: Not a UA student. Gori played a key role during the Paranormal Liberation War aftermath, discovering that Gentle had single-handedly prevented mass prisoner escapes at Mikuzu Prison. He later facilitated Gentle and La Brava's assistance to heroes in the Final War as repayment for their heroic actions.

cardPool.title: Godzillo
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Godzillo

Alias: Godzillo

Quirk Name: Toho

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero

Personality: Friendly and charismatic, greeting fans and onlookers warmly. Maintains a public presence befitting a celebrated hero with film star status.

Appearance: A massive anthropomorphic creature resembling the Heisei Godzilla design, with a dragon-like body covered in dark gray scales, long tail, and bear-like head. Wide build through legs and torso with clawed paws for hands. Wears a white high-collared coat with tattered hem, baggy white pants with red flame patterns lined in yellow, a thick golden belt with matching patterns, spike-banded clawed feet, and silver-plated kneepads.

Backstory: Originally from Japan, Godzillo relocated to the United States for unknown reasons and rose to prominence as both a Pro Hero and film star. He appears at prestigious events like the I-Island expo, where he mingles with other heroes and the public.

Additional Information: Godzillo is a Pro Hero unaffiliated with UA High School. His Quirk grants him kaiju-like attributes including immense size and strength, making him a formidable force in hero work. He collaborates with other high-ranking heroes like Hawks.

cardPool.title: Gil Gollini
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Gil Gollini
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Teleportation
Occupation/Role: Member of the Gollini Family mafia
Personality: Emotionless and stoic, acting like an automaton while loyally following orders. Shows minimal emotional response except when annoyed or shocked, yet remains capable of pain and surprise when outmaneuvered.
Appearance: A very large, muscular man with wide shoulders and burly arms. He sports a buzzcut hairstyle with a Dutch-styled beard and a large, rough nose. His eyes are stern and squinted, barely visible. He wears a well-tailored gray suit with black stripes, a tie, black coat, and scarf, with a rose emblazoned on his coat.
Backstory: Gil serves as a loyal operative of the Gollini Family mafia under boss Valdo's command. He typically acts as transportation and backup for fellow member Ugo, using his Quirk to position himself strategically in conflicts against the family's enemies.
Additional Information: Gil demonstrates exceptional combat coordination with fluid, dance-like footwork during teleportation sequences. His Quirk allows him to teleport himself and anyone he touches to any location within his line of sight. When enhanced by Anna's Overmodification, his teleportation activation speed increases dramatically.

cardPool.title: Giulio Gandini
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Giulio Gandini

Alias:
The Scervino Butler

Quirk Name:
Trigger (Disabled)

Occupation/Role:
Butler for the Scervino Family; Former combatant

Personality:
A stern, composed gentleman with fierce loyalty to those he serves. Giulio maintains sophisticated politeness despite his cold demeanor toward strangers. Once happier and more openly grateful, he has become hardened by trauma and loss, though his warm heart surfaces when shown genuine compassion. He views Heroes with cynicism, believing them hypocritical, yet demonstrates restraint in combat and respects honor in his enemies. Relentless in pursuit of his goals, he refuses to back down regardless of odds.

Appearance:
A man of average build with brownish-red hair pulled into a short ponytail, thin greenish-blue eyes, and sharp teeth marked by a mole beneath his left eye. He dresses formally in a black tailcoat, grey vest, striped tie, and white undershirt with popped collar. His right arm and left leg are Support Item prosthetics, with his right sleeve rolled up and left pant leg torn to expose them. Ammunition pouches and holster belts cross his torso and left leg.

Backstory:
Raised by the Scervino family after being taken in by Anna's father, Giulio found purpose and home as their butler. He was brutally attacked by the Gollini Family, losing his right eye, arm, and left leg—and his Quirk's effectiveness. Despite this devastation, he rebuilt himself with prosthetics to pursue his attackers and protect Anna, bound by an agonizing promise.

Additional Information:
Not a UA student. Functions as a civilian combatant using firearms and prosthetics rather than Quirk abilities. Operates independently of Hero Society.

cardPool.title: Ginji Kurau
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Ginji Kurau

Alias: Ginji

Quirk Name: Mad Gluttony

Occupation/Role: Escaped Villain, Former Tartarus Inmate

Personality: Opportunistic and ruthless, Ginji prioritizes personal gain over all else. He shows no remorse for civilian casualties and readily betrays allies when it serves his interests. Prone to arrogance and boasting about his cunning, he views cooperation as mere stepping stones to greater power.

Appearance: Young adult with scruffy white hair and gold eyes set in an intimidating face marked by pronounced fangs. He possesses a muscular, strong-built frame. His most distinctive feature is a large, monstrous mouth centered on his stomach with serrated teeth—a manifestation of his Quirk. When modified by Overmodification, additional mouth-like appendages sprouted from his shoulders.

Backstory: A dangerous villain who rampaged across communities before being captured by Best Jeanist and imprisoned in Tartarus. Following All For One's prison break, Ginji escaped and allied with the Gollini Family. He deceived the Quirk user Anna Scervino into modifying his Mad Gluttony ability, promising to help her escape captivity. Upon receiving the enhanced power, he betrayed her and went on a destructive rampage through civilian areas, drawing the attention of Class 1-A.

Additional Information: Ginji is one of few individuals compatible with Overmodification. He currently holds Anna captive as leverage for her power. His enhanced Quirk makes him significantly more dangerous than his original form.

cardPool.title: Gigantomachia
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Gigantomachia

Alias:
Gig

Quirk Name:
Unknown (Multiple Quirks via modification)

Occupation/Role:
Villain, former bodyguard to All For One, servant of the Paranormal Liberation Front

Personality:
Polite but impatient, becoming aggressive toward the uncooperative. Fiercely devoted to his master, holding unwavering loyalty despite emotional turmoil. He respects only strength and will leave peacefully if shown cooperation. Initially dismissive of Tomura but acknowledged him as worthy after witnessing his power.

Appearance:
A colossal giant standing three building levels tall with a musclebound, rocky frame. Spiky brown hair crowns his massive head, with jagged protrusions covering his body like stone. His most distinctive feature is his prominently pointed teeth with lower canines protruding menacingly. He wears bright-black pants, a hooded cloak for public appearances, and carries a portable radio on a rope around his neck. Later sporting black armor across his frame.

Backstory:
Gigantomachia served All For One as a faithful bodyguard for years before receiving modifications that granted him multiple Quirks, becoming a walking calamity. When All For One went into hiding, he felt betrayed and abandoned. He transferred his loyalty to Tomura Shigaraki upon recognizing his strength, fighting alongside the Paranormal Liberation Front until his arrest.

Additional Information:
Possesses a "Mole mode" transformation with retractable jaw visor, elongated canines, and digging claws. His sole motivation is serving his master—hearing All For One's voice alone can calm his rages. Incredibly dangerous in direct combat, capable of defeating multiple opponents simultaneously.

cardPool.title: Giant Villain
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Giant Villain
Quirk Name: Gigantification
Occupation/Role: D-rank Villain
Personality: Selfish and reckless, willing to steal and challenge Pro Heroes despite repeated captures. Shows little regard for consequences or authority.
Appearance: Brutish and imposing with a bestial head resembling a horse or shark. Possesses a massive, heavily muscled frame. Long dark brown dreadlocks frame his face, complemented by a reddish-brown beard. Wears a tattered black sleeveless shirt with a ripped front and worn blue jeans.
Backstory: A low-ranking criminal who repeatedly commits petty crimes like theft, seemingly undeterred by confrontations with Pro Heroes. His selfish nature and compulsive thievery have made him a recurring nuisance for law enforcement.
Additional Information: Operates at D-rank criminal status. Has been cornered and defeated by multiple Pro Heroes including Kamui Woods, Death Arms, Backdraft, and most recently Mt. Lady at Tatooin Station. His Gigantification Quirk enables dramatic size increases, though he lacks the skill or power to overcome experienced heroes.

cardPool.title: Giant Palm
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Giant Palm
Quirk Name: Unknown
Occupation/Role: Low-ranking villain, League of Villains recruit
Personality: Aggressive and willing to engage heroes despite apparent weakness; acts as expendable foot soldier without distinguishing traits or leadership qualities.
Appearance: Skinny man with brown hair and disproportionately large, long hands and arms. Wears a gray v-neck shirt under an open blue collared shirt, dark pants, and a dark visor over his eyes. His lankiness contrasts sharply with his oversized hands.
Backstory: One of roughly seventy villains recruited by Tomura Shigaraki for the League of Villains' coordinated assault on the Unforeseen Simulation Joint. Participated in the invasion wave that attempted to overwhelm U.A. High School teachers during the facility attack.
Additional Information: Defeated by Hizashi Yamada's Voice Quirk during the U.S.J. Arc and subsequently arrested with the other League subordinates. Represents a common low-ranking villain archetype with no distinguishing combat abilities or personal significance to the conflict.

cardPool.title: Geten
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Himura Geten

Alias:
Iceman

Quirk Name:
Ice Ply

Occupation/Role:
Villain, Meta Liberation Army Member

Personality:
Fiercely loyal to Re-Destro and the Liberation Army's ideology of power-based hierarchy. Intensely prideful about his ice abilities and deeply devoted to constant self-improvement through combat training. Becomes enraged when his leader's plans are threatened. Views power as the sole measure of worth and grows despondent when unable to achieve victory.

Appearance:
Geten wears a thick light blue parka with seven brown buttons extending below his knees, paired with black baggy pants and lace-up winter boots. A fur-lined hood shadows most of his face, revealing only messy white hair of varying lengths and striking silver-grey eyes framed by long white eyelashes that glow even in darkness.

Backstory:
Geten never attended formal schooling, instead dedicating his life entirely to honing his ice abilities through relentless training. Recruited by the Meta Liberation Army, he became one of their most valued warriors after Re-Destro recognized his potential and granted him enhanced power. His unwavering belief in the organization's vision of strength-based supremacy shaped him into a devoted enforcer.

Additional Information:
Skilled tactical combatant with sophisticated ice manipulation, capable of creating complex constructs and infusing ice into water sources. Demonstrates exceptional strength—fought Dabi to stalemate and suppressed multiple Pro Heroes including Mt. Lady. Known for analyzing opponents' weaknesses and exploiting them strategically.

cardPool.title: Gashly Eijiju
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Gashly Eijiju

Alias: The Shadow Gentleman

Quirk Name: Infant Puppets

Occupation/Role: Villain, High-Level Tartarus Prisoner, All For One's Assassin

Personality: Sadistic and psychopathic, presenting a deceptively genteel demeanor with refined manners and scholarly interests. He maintains cold composure even in combat, reading during battles while his Quirk overwhelms opponents. Indebted to All For One for his prison escape, he has sworn allegiance to the villain's cause.

Appearance: A tall, slender man cloaked entirely in darkness—black top hat, black cloak, and dark clothing creating a silhouette-like presence. He wears a stark white mask with eye holes that conceal his actual eyes, giving him an eerie, featureless face. Beneath his shadow-like form he carries a black umbrella held perpetually overhead and an open book. Light-colored short hair is visible only when his hat is displaced.

Backstory: Imprisoned in the inescapable Tartarus for devastating entire cities with his Quirk, Gashly was freed during All For One's prison break orchestrated through Tomura Shigaraki's body. Grateful for his liberation, he pledged himself to All For One's vision of becoming the greatest Demon Lord and joined the Paranormal Liberation Front.

Additional Information: One of Tartarus's most dangerous inmates and All For One's deadliest operatives. His primary combat strength lies in psychological warfare and attrition tactics through overwhelming hordes of puppet infants rather than direct physical confrontation. Prefers intellectual pursuits and maintains aristocratic bearing despite his monstrous nature.

cardPool.title: Garvey
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Garvey

Alias: The Giant Toad Villain

Quirk Name: Stock

Occupation/Role: Villain

Personality: Acts purely on base instinct with no distinct personality traits, behaving like a wild animal driven by primal aggression. Operates mindlessly under Trigger drug influence.

Appearance: A colossal olive-green toad standing 10 meters tall on hind legs with a round, chunky body covered in numerous warts. Small, blank white eyes, short stubby tail, and a discolored tongue tip from Trigger use. The warts across his back serve as storage for absorbed attacks.

Backstory: Enhanced by the Trigger drug, Garvey was unleashed in Tasomiya Ward as a weapon by Kyudai Garaki and All For One. During his rampage, he absorbed multiple Quirks from heroes and caused massive destruction. He killed Oboro Shirakumo while the young student was saving children, though his true target was Shota Aizawa's Erasure Quirk. He was eventually defeated and captured by Aizawa.

Additional Information: Garvey possesses immense physical strength capable of destroying buildings through size and weight alone. His Stock Quirk allows him to absorb and redirect any offensive attacks launched against him, making him extremely dangerous. He appears in Vigilantes canon before UA's first-year timeline.

cardPool.title: Gantetsu
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Gantetsu

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Unknown

Occupation/Role: Soba restaurant owner

Personality: Stubborn and taciturn, but fair-minded and appreciative. Demands excellence in cooking and criticizes harshly, yet grants second chances to those who demonstrate genuine improvement. Grateful toward his helpers and resistant to intimidation or coercion.

Appearance: An elderly man of tall stature with a full, medium-sized beard and prominent mustache, both heavily whitened with dark striping. He has bushy eyebrows, short-cropped hair, and a prominent scar running from his right ear to his nose. He wears traditional Japanese chef's whites with kanji embroidery, a haramaki sash, a headband with kanji covering his left eye, and wooden geta sandals. He characteristically carries a long wooden pole.

Backstory: Gantetsu has owned and operated his soba restaurant for decades, building a reputation for quality and demanding standards. Recently, an individual has persistently pressured him to sell his business, but he has consistently refused. When four UA High School students mistakenly arrived at his restaurant seeking a hero named Gantetsu, he tested them through cooking. Though initially disappointed, he recognized their potential after a second attempt and welcomed them as guests.

Additional Information: Not a UA student. The four students who visited his restaurant—Shoto Todoroki, Denki Kaminari, Inasa Yoarashi, and Seiji Shishikura—defended him against villains sent by the would-be buyer, earning his lasting gratitude and respect.

cardPool.title: Ganma Asui
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Ganma Asui

Alias:
None

Quirk Name:
Frog Physiology

Occupation/Role:
Businessman; Father and Provider for the Asui Household

Personality:
A caring and devoted father figure, though his name suggests a stubborn disposition. He demonstrates responsibility by trusting his eldest daughter with household duties while he and his wife travel for work. Calm and supportive, evidenced by his pride in his family's accomplishments.

Appearance:
A tall, stocky middle-aged man with an distinctly frog-like appearance more pronounced than his children. He has short-cropped black hair, black eyes, and a toad-like head structure. He dresses professionally in a plain business suit with a blue-dotted tie, often adorned with a green frog clip at the center.

Backstory:
Ganma met and married Bell, and together they had three children: Tsuyu, Samidare, and Satsuki. Due to frequent work-related travel, he relies on his responsible eldest daughter to care for her younger siblings. He provides stability and safety for his family while balancing professional obligations.

Additional Information:
Not a UA High School student. Father of Class 1-A student Tsuyu Asui. His family's Quirk allows for frog-like abilities that manifest across all members with varying degrees of prominence. A supportive family man committed to his children's wellbeing and aspirations.

cardPool.title: Gang Orca's Sidekicks
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Gang Orca's Sidekick
Quirk Name: Unknown
Occupation/Role: Professional Sidekick to Gang Orca; Provisional Hero License Exam Antagonist
Personality: Loyal and disciplined, working seamlessly as a coordinated unit under Gang Orca's command. They demonstrate tactical awareness and willingness to adapt strategy, though they show deference to their leader's superior combat abilities.
Appearance: Black skin-tight bodysuit covering entire body including face and hands, decorated with thin white lines across the torso. Tan-colored armor pads protect key areas. Diamond-shaped eye holes arranged in a circular pattern form their mask design. Equipped with a blue and gray Cement Gun mounted on right arm.
Backstory: Enlisted by the Hero Public Safety Commission alongside Gang Orca to serve as mock villains during the Provisional Hero License Exam's second phase. Tasked with attacking and impeding UA students attempting rescue operations in a disaster zone scenario, they faced formidable opponents including Shoto Todoroki, Inasa Yoarashi, and Yo Shindo.
Additional Information: Operates as part of a coordinated team capable of combining attacks with Gang Orca for increased effectiveness. The sidekicks demonstrated concern for their leader's safety and expressed regret at their inability to provide adequate support during the exam's climactic moments.

cardPool.title: Gale Villain
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Unknown

Alias:
Gale Villain

Quirk Name:
Gale

Occupation/Role:
Professional Thief, Villain

Personality:
Greedy and mission-focused, prioritizing profit over confrontation. Displays arrogance when confident in his abilities, boasting about his Quirk's superiority. Becomes overconfident and careless when distracted.

Appearance:
A rugged man with thick eyebrows, prominent sideburns, and unkempt facial hair. His most striking feature is a large, long pompadour hairstyle. He wears a white and red coat emblazoned with a horned skull on the left side, a golden chain necklace, dark pants, and spike-studded shoes.

Backstory:
A skilled wind-manipulating villain who partners with the Bomb Villain for high-value heists. He operates with calculated precision, focusing on acquiring valuables rather than engaging heroes directly. His overconfidence in his Quirk's defensive capabilities has proven to be his downfall.

Additional Information:
His Quirk creates a protective vortex of wind around his body that can deflect incoming attacks and enable flight, but leaves his head exposed as a critical weakness. He carries a silver briefcase for transporting stolen goods.

cardPool.title: Fuyumi Todoroki
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Fuyumi Todoroki
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Ice
Occupation/Role: Elementary School Teacher
Personality: Kind-hearted and nurturing with a teasing streak, Fuyumi deeply cares for her family despite the trauma of their household. She is hopeful about familial reconciliation and worries constantly for those she loves, though she carries guilt about her inability to protect her younger brother Shoto. Brave and empathetic, she attempts to maintain peace within the fractured Todoroki family.
Appearance: A young woman of average height with shoulder-length white hair flecked with crimson traces, ear-length side bangs, and a short forelock. She has turquoise eyes framed by red-rimmed rectangular glasses. Typically dressed in a white dress shirt with a grayish peach cardigan rolled to the elbows, navy jeans, and brown dress shoes. She frequently wears various turtleneck sweaters.
Backstory: The only daughter of Enji and Rei Todoroki, Fuyumi assumed a maternal role for her younger brother Shoto during their mother's absence. Witnessing her father's abusive behavior toward her family left her unable to intervene, a guilt she carries regarding her eldest brother Toya's fate. Inspired by her helplessness to protect Shoto, she became an elementary school teacher to nurture and safeguard children.
Additional Information: Fuyumi possesses limited combat experience and untrained fighting techniques, but demonstrates proficient Quirk control. She maintains amicable relationships with both her brothers and visits her mother regularly at the hospital. Unlike her brothers, she does not harbor deep resentment toward her father, instead working toward family reconciliation and healing.

cardPool.title: Futo Nagashira
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Futo Nagashira

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Not specified

Occupation/Role: UA High School Student, Department of Management

Personality: Pragmatic and business-minded, focused on hero marketability and public relations. Beneath his commercial exterior lies genuine passion for heroism and society's perception of heroes. He advocates for transparency and documenting heroic achievements to shape public opinion positively.

Appearance: A young man of average height with a distinctive long blonde hair styled into a rounded, beehive-like shape. He has small, thin-set eyes and thick downward-pointing eyebrows that give him a serious expression. He is typically seen wearing his UA gym uniform.

Backstory: A student in UA High School's Department of Management, Futo specializes in the business side of heroics rather than combat. He analyzes hero marketability and public appeal, notably studying Izuku during the UA Sports Festival. He associates regularly with peers Ronaudo and Komako.

Additional Information: Department of Management student; not a combat-focused hero course member. His interests lean toward media, public relations, and how society perceives heroes. He values transparency in heroic narratives and regrets not promoting heroic achievements more actively during critical social moments.

cardPool.title: Funkman
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Funkman
Quirk Name: Unknown
Occupation/Role: Pro Hero
Personality: Dedicated and resolute, willing to stand against threats even in dire circumstances; demonstrates camaraderie with fellow heroes.
Appearance: Tall man with a prominent brown afro and black face mask. Wears a cowboy-style hero costume featuring a vest with an "F" emblazoned on his hat and belt buckle. Armed with a holstered gun at his waist, completing his frontier-themed aesthetic.
Backstory: An established Pro Hero who answered the call during the catastrophic Paranormal Liberation War. Despite the overwhelming odds and destruction of Jaku City, Funkman fought to the end against Tomura Shigaraki's forces. He was ultimately killed in combat, mourned by his fellow heroes who were forced to leave his body behind while evacuating civilians.
Additional Information: Funkman's specific Quirk ability remains undocumented; he relies primarily on marksmanship and combat training. His death marked one of many hero casualties during the war's final stages.

cardPool.title: Fumiko Noborizaka
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Fumiko Noborizaka

Alias: The Love Letter Villain

Quirk Name: Death Letter

Occupation/Role: Delivery Driver / Instant Villain

Personality: Insane and obsessively devoted, Fumiko expresses affection through dangerous means including kidnapping and violence. She becomes uncontrollable when under the influence of Trigger, her obsession amplified to destructive levels.

Appearance: A thin woman with a ghastly, gaunt face and an unnaturally long tongue. She has flowing light-colored hair and wears a dark shirt with shorts and loafers. As a delivery driver, she typically dons a bike helmet, fingerless gloves, and a backpack.

Backstory: Fumiko works as a delivery driver while secretly harboring dangerous romantic obsessions. Her unstable mental state and twisted expression of love through violence mark her as a threat to public safety, operating outside hero society.

Additional Information: Under the influence of Trigger, Fumiko transforms into a massive tornado composed entirely of her blood-written love letters, complete with enormous eyes and a gaping mouth. Her Quirk's power scales with emotional intensity, making her most dangerous when expressing strong feelings. She is not a UA student.

cardPool.title: Fumikage Tokoyami
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Fumikage Tokoyami

Alias: Jet-Black Hero: Tsukuyomi

Quirk Name: Dark Shadow

Occupation/Role: UA High School Student, Class 1-A

Personality: Reserved and serious yet noble, Fumikage embodies a dramatic chūnibyō aesthetic with archaic speech patterns. Though quiet, he becomes more sociable in team settings and is fiercely dependable in combat. He's insecure about his dark interests, easily embarrassed by them, but deeply cares for friends and mentors. Humble and aware of his limits, he struggles with controlling Dark Shadow's aggressive nature, fearing it may harm those close to him.

Appearance: A short young man with a crow-like black head featuring a slightly hooked yellow beak, thin red eyes with small black pupils, and a red choker. His body is average human with fair skin. At UA, he wears a light gray blazer with dark turquoise trimmings, white shirt, dark blue-green pants, red tie, and brown shoes. His hero costume is a black robe with dark purple tinting, knee-high black boots, and utility belt visible beneath.

Backstory: Fumikage is a dedicated UA student training to become a hero despite the challenges posed by his powerful but temperamental Quirk. His affinity for darkness and dramatic aesthetic stems from genuine passion rather than any villainous inclination, though he fears losing control to Dark Shadow during intense emotions or prolonged darkness exposure.

Additional Information: Dark Shadow is an aggressive Quirk sensitive to Fumikage's emotional state and darkness levels, making control difficult. He is working to master this weakness during his UA training.

cardPool.title: Fuji Fukiyose
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Fuji Fukiyose
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Not yet revealed
Occupation/Role: Third-year middle school student, prospective U.A. High School applicant
Personality: Jovial and lighthearted with frequent laughter and jokes, yet wears emotions openly on his sleeves. Despite his carefree demeanor, he is deeply serious about his future and dedicated to entering U.A.'s Hero Course.
Appearance: Dark-skinned boy with messy black hair and a constant shadow over his eyes. Wears a bandana to hold back his hair. Dresses in an open middle school jacket over a sweatshirt, giving him a casual, unkempt appearance.
Backstory: Fuji visited U.A. High School's Prospective Students Day with his friend Raito Sanda to explore the school. During the Hero Course's tag game, he was paired with Tsuyu Asui and quickly defeated. He witnessed Raito's decision to pursue the Business Course instead of the Hero Course, but supported his friend's choice while remaining committed to his own goal of becoming a hero.
Additional Information: Fuji is easily distracted but can refocus on his objectives. He demonstrates loyalty and emotional maturity by congratulating Raito despite initial confusion. His determination to enter U.A.'s Hero Course suggests significant potential despite his current inexperience.

cardPool.title: Four-Armed Zealot
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Unknown

Alias:
Four-Armed Zealot

Quirk Name:
Extra Arms

Occupation/Role:
F-rank Villain, League of Villains recruit

Personality:
Confident in combat abilities, willing to assault UA High School despite being a minor villain. Taciturn and focused on violence rather than dialogue.

Appearance:
Lean man with jet-black skin and four muscular arms protruding from his torso. Wears an insectoid mask with crimson lenses, sleeveless black tank top, brown cargo pants, and black combat boots. His extra arms are fully functional and equally developed.

Backstory:
Recruited by Tomura Shigaraki as one of roughly seventy villains for the assault on the Unforeseen Simulation Joint. Participated in the USJ invasion as part of the League of Villains' coordinated attack against UA High School.

Additional Information:
Encountered and defeated by UA Pro Heroes during the USJ invasion. His extra arms provide significant combat advantage in melee confrontations, though his confidence exceeded his actual threat level when facing professional heroes.

cardPool.title: Flect Turn
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Flect Turn

Alias: The Reflector, Prophet of Salvation

Quirk Name: Reflect

Occupation/Role: Cult Leader, Villain

Personality: Cold, calculated, and charismatic extremist driven by an obsessive hatred of Quirks. Flect is ruthless and remorseless, viewing mass violence as necessary for "humanity's salvation." He is capable of reason and compromise, but shows no mercy to traitors or those he deems beyond help. His self-righteousness masks deep hypocrisy regarding his own Quirk usage.

Appearance: Tall and slim man with luminescent light blue skin coating his body and a shaved head revealing dark blue hair beneath. He has a sharp goatee mustache, arrow-shaped earrings, and wears dark blue eye masks fitted into his sockets to prevent reflection-blindness. His costume consists of a red robe with golden belt, grey pants, combat boots, and special glove-like prosthetics with exposed fingertips. His villain outfit features a flowing white cloak with dark red interior lining, adorned with small energy-storage disks.

Backstory: Flect's powerful Quirk caused physical harm to anyone who touched him, isolating him completely from human connection. He watched his parents, friends, and loved ones abandon him due to his abilities. This isolation and rejection birthed his belief that Quirks are a disease destroying humanity, leading him to found the cult Humarise to eliminate all Quirks through the Quirk Singularity Doomsday Theory.

Additional Information: Leader of the global extremist cult Humarise. Kidnaps scientists and threatens their families to develop weapons. His reflective energy coating dissipates when his Quirk reaches its limit, revealing flesh-white skin beneath.

cardPool.title: Ethan Drive
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Ethan Drive

Alias:
None

Quirk Name:
None

Occupation/Role:
Fighter Pilot, U.S. Military Brigade Leader

Personality:
Disciplined and steadfast soldier with unwavering loyalty to his comrades. Supportive and encouraging, offering emotional strength to those around him. Carries self-sacrificial tendencies, willing to risk everything for the greater good. Proud mentor figure who values growth and perseverance in his team.

Appearance:
Tall, well-built man with military bearing. Wears a buzz cut and maintains a prominent moustache. Dresses in U.S. Army fighter pilot gear and uniform appropriate to his rank and role.

Backstory:
A seasoned American military fighter pilot who has faced death numerous times in combat operations. Developed a deep bond with Cathleen (Star and Stripe) and their brigade from their early days together, supporting her through doubt and celebrating her growth as a hero. Mourned her sacrifice against Tomura Shigaraki and honored her final wish by sharing critical military intelligence with Japanese heroes.

Additional Information:
Non-Quirk combatant of exceptional skill; defeated Star and Stripe repeatedly in hand-to-hand training before her Quirk awakening. Member of the United States Armed Forces with extensive military training in combat tactics and survival. Not affiliated with UA High School.

cardPool.title: Eri
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Eri
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Rewind
Occupation/Role: Student (U.A. High School resident)
Personality: Fearful and withdrawn from trauma, but gradually becoming more cheerful and trusting around those who show her kindness. She carries deep guilt over her Quirk's destructive potential, though she is learning to see its positive uses. Silent and accepting of hardship, yet determined to protect others despite her suffering.
Appearance: A small girl with long, messy bluish off-white hair parted down the middle, reaching nearly to her waist. She has wide, innocent bright red eyes and a small brown horn protruding from her right forehead that grows larger when activating her Quirk. Currently wears a white dress shirt with frilled collar, plain red pinafore with golden buttons, gray tights, and tan boots, paired with a small dark red messenger bag decorated with flowers. Her hair appears straighter and neater than before, reflecting better care.
Backstory: Eri was used as a living weapon by her grandfather's crime organization and experimented on by Kai Chisaki to create Quirk-Destroying drugs. Her mother disowned her after she accidentally erased her father with her Quirk. Rescued by U.A., she now lives in the dormitories, slowly healing from severe psychological trauma and learning that her existence has value beyond causing harm.
Additional Information: Her Quirk allows her to rewind events; she once sacrificed part of her horn to help save Izuku Midoriya. She experienced her first genuine kindness through Midoriya's touch.
