Recently smiled for the first time at the U.A. School Festival, marking a turning point in her recovery and emotional development.

cardPool.title: Enma Kannagi
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Enma Kannagi
Alias: Magic Hero: Majestic
Quirk Name: Unknown
Occupation/Role: Pro Hero
Personality: Noble and selfless, willing to sacrifice himself to protect others. Composed and professional in high-pressure situations, demonstrating leadership during dangerous missions.
Appearance: Slim adult man with a goatee. Wears a wizard-inspired hero costume featuring a short orange robe and scarlet pointy hat. Multiple colorful fabrics and sashes adorn his outfit, with one sash serving as a blindfold across his eyes.
Backstory: An established Pro Hero who mentors promising students during work-study programs. Participated in the international Humarise raid operation and the Villa Raid Team assault on the Paranormal Liberation Front, where he made the ultimate sacrifice protecting his students from Gigantomachia.
Additional Information: Served as a work-study mentor to Momo Yaoyorozu (Class 1-A) and Setsuna Tokage (Class 1-B) during Hero Work-Studies: Round 2. Operated under the World Heroes Association during major crisis operations.

cardPool.title: Enji Todoroki
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Enji Todoroki

Alias:
Flame Hero: Endeavor

Quirk Name:
Hellflame

Occupation/Role:
Pro Hero (No. 2 ranked)

Personality:
Prideful and intensely ambitious, Enji is driven by an obsessive goal to surpass All Might. His unwavering determination borders on obsession, making him stern and demanding. He views personal achievement as paramount, often prioritizing his ambitions over relationships.

Appearance:
A tall, sturdily-built man with a very muscular physique and short crimson hair spiked upward. He has sharp turquoise eyes and facial hair that appears as flames. His Hero Costume consists of a tight navy-turquoise bodysuit with streaming flames across his chest and upper body, white cage-patterned bracers on his forearms, and tall boots engulfed in flames. The costume includes a blue belt and serves as both armor and flame conduit.

Backstory:
One of the nation's top Pro Heroes for years, Enji married Rei Todoroki through a strategic Quirk Marriage to produce a powerful heir capable of surpassing All Might. This union produced four children: Toya, Fuyumi, Natsuo, and Shoto. His relentless pursuit of strength has defined both his heroic career and family life.

Additional Information:
Currently the No. 2 ranked Pro Hero by case resolution record. Father of Shoto Todoroki, a first-year student at UA High School. His rivalry with All Might fuels his competitive nature and aggressive hero work methodology.

cardPool.title: Enigma
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Fukakai Hatena

Alias: Enigma

Quirk Name: Gigantification

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero Sidekick of Ingenium, Team Idaten Member

Personality: Calm, friendly, and understanding. Enigma is forgiving and self-aware about her frightening appearance when using her Quirk. She gracefully accepts help and remains composed in crisis situations, able to assist others with reassurance and professionalism.

Appearance: A young woman with notably straight teeth and long, dark hair styled into two low plaits with a neat fringe. Her oval-shaped eyes are entirely blacked-out with no visible iris or pupil. When her Quirk activates, she transforms into a pitch-black blob-like mass with a white mask face featuring white circles arranged below, gaining elastic limbs.

Backstory: Enigma obtained her Hero License and was selected by Ingenium to join Team Idaten. While traveling to Tokyo for an interview, she was mistaken for a villain by local vigilantes but clarified her identity. She has since proven herself as a capable sidekick, assisting in rescue operations and public safety events alongside her team.

Additional Information: Enigma can control her body size at will, ranging from a few meters tall to the size of a residential building. Her rubber-like blob form allows stretching, contraction, and protection from attacks. She can create smaller clones from her giant form to use as drones. Her presence and composure make her valuable in both rescue and crowd-management scenarios.

cardPool.title: Ending
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Ending
Quirk Name: Whiteline
Occupation/Role: Villain
Personality: Mentally unstable and suicidal, obsessed with Endeavor to the point of stalking and kidnapping. Believes the only choice in life is how one dies, showing complete disregard for others' lives. Displays manic behavior with wide smiles and crazed eyes, viewing himself as a lifeless puppet.
Appearance: Muscular man of average height wearing horizontal black and white-striped pants and matching shirt beneath a blue hooded jacket with white striping. Full-face mask with white parallel lines on sides and horizontal crosswalk-like patterns, exposing only his mouth and eyes. Notable for his unnaturally wide smile and intense, wild eyes.
Backstory: Witnessed Endeavor apprehending a thief years ago, which pulled him from depression and sparked obsession with the hero. Later imprisoned after his own capture, then released seven years later. Orchestrated a highway attack with Dabi's help to provoke Endeavor into killing him, kidnapping Natsuo Todoroki to force confrontation.
Additional Information: Uses Quirk-boosting Trigger drug to enhance his abilities. Capable of manipulating multiple road lane lines simultaneously as binding tentacles. Defeated by Class 1-A interns during the highway incident and arrested by the Police Force.

cardPool.title: Emperor Yotsuura
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Emperor Yotsuura

Alias: Emperor Yotsuura

Quirk Name: Soccer

Occupation/Role: Villain, Thief

Personality: Cocky and showboating, with an obsessive fascination with soccer that drives his every action. He enjoys displaying his skills even during crimes, suggesting an arrogant streak beneath his criminal activities.

Appearance: A tall young man with tanned skin and a penguin-like facial structure. He wears a pale diver suit with a bold red "V" emblazoned on the chest, a baseball cap mostly concealed beneath a hood, knee-length shorts, gloves, tall sports socks, and soccer shoes with webbed-foot designs. His entire aesthetic mimics penguin features.

Backstory: A low-level criminal and thief operating in Naruhata, Emperor Yotsuura built his identity around his Quirk and soccer prowess. He targets civilians for theft while brazenly dribbling a soccer ball, treating crimes as performance art rather than serious villainy.

Additional Information: Emperor Yotsuura was apprehended by Ichimoku Samazu and Jube Namaru during a laptop theft. He later aligned with a loose collective of minor villains including Tommy S. Gordon, Willy Wanda, Rhino Man, and Horse Man to witness The Crawler's legendary battle against Number 6 during the Naruhata Lockdown.

cardPool.title: Emi Fukukado
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Emi Fukukado

Alias: Smile Hero: Ms. Joke

Quirk Name: Outburst

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero and Class 2 Teacher at Ketsubutsu Academy High School

Personality: Cheerful, outgoing, and relentlessly playful with a goofy sense of humor. She uses comedy as both a personal tool and combat strategy, enjoying teasing others—especially Shota Aizawa. Despite her obnoxious demeanor, she takes her duties as teacher and hero seriously, deeply valuing her students and their dreams.

Appearance: A young woman with a strong, athletic build and noticeably muscular arms. She has seafoam-green hair reaching past her shoulders with short, splayed-end fringe usually hidden beneath her orange bandana. Her dark green eyes have bright pupils and are framed by an unwavering joyous smile—her most striking feature. Her hero costume includes a sleeveless navy button-up shirt, green-and-orange pinstriped puffed shorts, a corset with yellow smiley-face pins, padded yellow gloves with golden knuckle plates, and orange-striped arm tubes with metal wrist-guards.

Backstory: A famous Pro Hero renowned for incapacitating opponents through unconventional and humorous methods. She now teaches at Ketsubutsu Academy, passing her combat and Quirk expertise to the next generation. She holds strong opinions about hero education and views U.A. High School's prestige with skepticism.

Additional Information: Her Quirk, Outburst, forces targets into uncontrollable laughter that impairs cognitive function, enabling her to subdue them. She wears a laugh mask in public settings to neutralize her Quirk. She is proficient in hand-to-hand combat and typically uses her Quirk to disable opponents before engaging physically.

cardPool.title: Eleph
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Eleph
Alias: Zō
Quirk Name: Arm Bulk Up
Occupation/Role: High-End Nomu, laboratory creation of Doctor Kyudai Garaki
Personality: Aggressive and combat-hungry, eager for battle upon awakening; follows the leadership of other Nomu without resistance; demonstrates singular focus on combat rather than strategy.
Appearance: A massive, obese humanoid elephant Nomu with gray, bulky musculature and a large trunk. Three glowing lines run vertically down the trunk from his brain. His angular eyes glow with three linear diamond patterns beneath each, containing tiny red feral pupils. Prominent vertebrae jut from his spine. When activating Arm Bulk Up, his already enormous arms swell further with thick, prominent veins.
Backstory: Created specifically by Doctor Kyudai Garaki to be a pure-power specialist Nomu, Eleph was kept dormant in the lab beneath Jaku General Hospital. During the hero raid on the facility, he was awakened and released alongside four other High-End Nomu to repel Pro Hero Mirko and protect the doctor's escape with Tomura Shigaraki.
Additional Information: Possesses Super Regeneration and an unnamed Elephant Quirk granting his distinctive form, enhanced strength, and a functional trunk for grasping. Demonstrated sufficient power to tear clumps of hair from a hero's head with a single grip before being overwhelmed by arriving Pro Heroes.

cardPool.title: Elecplant
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Elecplant
Quirk Name: Electricity Generation
Occupation/Role: Pro Hero
Personality: Dutiful and professional, committed to heroic service and international cooperation. Elecplant demonstrates competence in crisis situations and willingness to work alongside other heroes in coordinated operations.
Appearance: Tall figure clad entirely in a black bodysuit adorned with electric circuit patterns and golden lightning imagery. His face is completely obscured by the suit's full-face covering, leaving no discernible features visible. Two lightning-bolt shaped radio antennae protrude over his ears. A long flowing red cape with golden lightning decorations extends from his shoulders, creating an imposing silhouette.
Backstory: An American Pro Hero operating primarily in the United States, Elecplant has participated in major international incidents including casino robberies and large-scale counter-terrorism operations against Humarise. He served as part of the World Heroes Association's global task force and was dispatched to Japan during the Final War to assist in defending against Tomura Shigaraki.
Additional Information: Operates as part of international hero networks and coordinates with other heroes across borders. His specialized costume incorporates circuitry designed to channel and amplify his electrical Quirk. Currently engaged in post-war reconstruction efforts worldwide.

cardPool.title: Eizo Tanuma
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Eizo Tanuma

Alias:
Detective Tanuma

Quirk Name:
Free Walker

Occupation/Role:
Police Force Detective

Personality:
Calm, affable, and relaxed despite his serious dedication to detective work. Eizo possesses keen deductive abilities and often knows more than he reveals, maintaining a composed demeanor that contrasts sharply with his more intense colleagues.

Appearance:
An older man with short, dark hair receding at the hairline and a thin beard. He dresses professionally in a dark-colored suit, black waistcoat, and plain tie, presenting the appearance of a seasoned law enforcement officer.

Backstory:
A veteran detective in the Police Force and former partner of Naomasa Tsukauchi, Eizo has spent years honing his investigative skills. He is one of the few people aware of Knuckleduster's secret past as the hero O'Clock, indicating deep connections within the hero community.

Additional Information:
His Quirk, Free Walker, presumably allows his legs to move without fatigue, granting enhanced mobility and endurance during investigations. Eizo's accurate conjectures about criminal motives and villain plans make him a valuable asset to law enforcement operations.

cardPool.title: Eijiro Kirishima
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Eijiro Kirishima

Alias: Red Riot

Quirk Name: Hardening

Occupation/Role: UA High School Student, Class 1-A

Personality: Boisterous and outgoing with a strong sense of manliness and chivalry. Eijiro is determined, selfless, and easily moved to tears by displays of bravery or noble character. He values honesty and kindness, calling out cowardice while encouraging others. A devoted fan of the retro hero Crimson Riot, he aspires to live without regret and puts others' safety before his own.

Appearance: A muscular young man of average height with sharp red eyes pointed slightly inward and small eyebrows. His distinctive bright red hair is spiked dramatically in all directions with gel, featuring two pronounced horn-like tufts on his forehead. He has naturally sharp teeth and wears the standard UA uniform with dark red trainers. His hero costume includes dark red gear-shaped shoulder pads, a red belt with an "R" emblem, a jagged sash, baggy black pants, a red half cape with ripped hem, dark red boots, and a wired guard mask with spiked fangs around the mouth resembling an Oni.

Backstory: Eijiro changed his hair from natural black to bright red shortly after being accepted into UA High School, symbolizing his commitment to his hero dreams inspired by Crimson Riot. He adopts an uncompromising code of manliness to guide his path as a hero, believing in noble and determined action above all else.

Additional Information: His Hardening Quirk allows him to harden his body to extreme levels for defense. During rescues, he wears black sleeves to prevent his hardened body from injuring civilians. He is naturally charismatic and capable of befriending most people through his respectful and encouraging demeanor.

cardPool.title: Eiji Okameda
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Eiji Okameda
Alias: None known
Quirk Name: Gigantic Spinning Flying Turtle
Occupation/Role: Instant Villain (Trigger-enhanced)
Personality: Unknown; behavior only observed while under Trigger influence, appearing aggressive and destructive during the Naruhata invasion.
Appearance: True appearance unknown. When transformed by Trigger, becomes a colossal turtle resembling Gamera with a hard shell, capable of spinning. Possesses visible eyes beneath his armored carapace. Likely of average height and build in civilian form.
Backstory: An ordinary individual whose Quirk allows turtle-based transformations. Injected with Trigger drug and sent to invade Naruhata, where he was quickly defeated by Captain Celebrity. Subsequently returned to normal form and possibly arrested.
Additional Information: Eiji's baseline Quirk capabilities remain unclear, as he has only been observed while heavily enhanced by Trigger. His true personality and motivations are unknown. Not a UA student.

cardPool.title: Drill Criminal
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Unknown (Conjectural)

Alias:
Drill Criminal

Quirk Name:
Unnamed Drill Shooting Quirk

Occupation/Role:
Villain/Bank Robber

Personality:
Aggressive and easily annoyed, with a greedy streak. Quick to resort to violence when cornered, though lacks the skill to overcome seasoned heroes.

Appearance:
Lean and athletic build. Wears a distinctive red helmet adorned with spike-like drill bit protrusions on the sides. Black sleeveless tank top, blue pants, white boots with red accents, and metal gauntlets on both forearms designed to channel his Quirk.

Backstory:
A small-time villain who commits petty crimes for profit. Gained notoriety for a bank robbery interrupted by heroes Gang Orca and Shishido during a baseball game, where his lack of finesse against experienced combatants led to his swift capture.

Additional Information:
His Quirk enables him to launch sharp steel drills as projectiles, making him dangerous at range but vulnerable to close combat. Represents a low-tier threat in the villain ecosystem. Apprehended by multiple heroes and turned over to authorities.

cardPool.title: Eddie Soul
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Eddie Soul
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Unknown
Occupation/Role: Engineer, Forced Researcher for Humarise
Personality: Loving and devoted father despite prolonged absences; brave and self-sacrificing, willing to betray his captors to save millions. Demonstrated deep care for his children through thoughtful gifts and guidance, maintaining his humanity even under coercion.
Appearance: Tall adult man with short dark brown hair and gray eyes. Wears a white buttoned-up shirt beneath a dull blue overcoat, presenting a professional yet worn appearance befitting an engineer under duress.
Backstory: A renowned engineer from Otheon who raised three children—Rody, Roro, and Lala—after his wife's death. Kidnapped by the anti-Quirk terrorist cult Humarise and forced under threat of harming his children to help develop Trigger Bombs for mass genocide. Secretly created a deactivation key to sabotage their plans, prioritizing global safety over his own survival.
Additional Information: Executed by Humarise upon discovery of his betrayal. Initially blamed and stigmatized by his community for his forced affiliation, though his son Rody later uncovers the truth, vindicating his heroic sacrifice.

cardPool.title: Drunk Lee
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Drunk Lee
Alias: Drunk Lee
Quirk Name: Dragon Breath
Occupation/Role: Underground fighter
Personality: Aggressive and opportunistic, driven by the thrill of combat in illegal fighting circuits. He is cunning enough to weaponize his gear and relentless in pursuit of victory.
Appearance: Tall and muscular with prominent cheekbones and a distinctive two-tendril mustache. He wears a dark suit and dark cap, styled with a long Chinese ponytail. A dark domino mask conceals his upper face during matches.
Backstory: Operating outside legitimate channels, Drunk Lee earned his reputation through the Underground Masquerade's brutal fighting rings. His Quirk and combat experience make him a formidable opponent despite his illegal status.
Additional Information: Carries two alcohol-filled gourds linked by string—essential fuel for his Quirk and secondary weapons in combat. His reliance on alcohol to activate Dragon Breath is both his greatest asset and potential liability.

cardPool.title: Ectoplasm
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Ectoplasm

Alias: Pro Hero Ectoplasm

Quirk Name: Clones

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero and U.A. High School Mathematics Teacher

Personality: Steadfast and unrelenting, Ectoplasm is a demanding instructor who believes in pushing students to excel under pressure. He is analytical, intelligent, and popular among hero society for his unwavering commitment to heroism and education.

Appearance: A tall, slender man with short hair, completely blank inward-tilted eyes behind glasses, and a distinctive featureless face with full dentures. He wears tan and black hero costume with a high collar, golden striped neck detail, black helmet with jaw-guard, and lightweight prosthetic legs. His practical teaching attire complements his no-nonsense demeanor.

Backstory: Once a celebrated Pro Hero, Ectoplasm lost his legs during a villain encounter but continued his heroic career without hesitation. Now serving as a faculty member at U.A. High School, he channels his experience into shaping the next generation of heroes through rigorous instruction and personal mentorship.

Additional Information: Ectoplasm can generate up to thirty clones from ectoplasm streams from his mouth, acting as extensions of his consciousness. He excels in close-range combat despite his prosthetics and can create a single giant clone for overwhelming force. His analytical Quirk knowledge and combat prowess make him an ideal final exam proctor for testing students' abilities.

cardPool.title: Dragon (Villain)
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Dragon
Quirk Name: Dragon
Occupation/Role: Low-ranking villain, League of Villains member
Personality: Aggressive and combat-ready; demonstrates typical thug mentality as part of Shigaraki's horde. Shows no distinctive personality traits beyond willingness to follow orders.
Appearance: Muscular build with a reptilian snout, sharp teeth, and thick black spikes protruding along the back of his head. Wears a purple sleeveless tank top, black armbands on both wrists, and blue headphones around his neck. His dragon-like features give him an inherently menacing appearance.
Backstory: Recruited as one of approximately seventy low-ranking villains by Tomura Shigaraki for the coordinated assault on the Unforeseen Simulation Joint. Deployed to the Landslide Zone during the invasion but quickly subdued by Shoto Todoroki's ice quirk, resulting in his immediate arrest.
Additional Information: Dragon is a minor antagonist with minimal combat success. He serves as a disposable foot soldier in Shigaraki's invasion force, easily neutralized by professional hero trainees. His actual name and deeper background remain unknown.

cardPool.title: Dozaemon
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Dozaemon
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Water Control
Occupation/Role: E-rank Villain, League of Villains recruit
Personality: Impatient and aggressive despite tactical awareness; confident in combat ability and knowledgeable about his Quirk's advantages in aquatic environments; quick to act despite initial caution.
Appearance: Tall, muscular man wearing a black full-body wetsuit with grey gloves and armored boots. His face is pale and noseless with a skull-like visage: sunken eye sockets, grooved undereyes, protruding upper teeth, blue eyes with white pupils, and red cranial markings. A gold armor-like piece encircles his lower jaw, and he wears a matching face-design belt.
Backstory: Recruited by Tomura Shigaraki as part of the League of Villains' assault on the Unforeseen Simulation Joint, Dozaemon was deployed to the Flood Zone where his water-based Quirk provided tactical advantage. He was defeated by Class 1-A students using coordinated Quirk attacks and later arrested, eventually escaping during the Tartarus prison breaks.
Additional Information: Water Control Quirk enables manipulation of water into various attack forms including sharp claws and powerful torrents; strategically skilled in aquatic combat but impulsive in execution; operates primarily in water-based environments.

cardPool.title: Dolphin Villain
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Unknown

Alias:
Dolphin Villain

Quirk Name:
Dolphin

Occupation/Role:
Criminal/Bank Robber

Personality:
Greedy and chaotic, yet surprisingly confident in his criminality. He displays unexpected concern for environmental issues, demanding an eco-friendly getaway vehicle. Unfazed by Pro Hero intervention, willing to threaten hostages to achieve his goals. Speaks with occasional dolphin-like clicking sounds.

Appearance:
A humanoid figure with a bottlenose dolphin-like physiology. Smooth, dark teal skin covers the upper half of his head, transitioning to diamond blue from the chin downward. He wears a blue striped hoodie, tan pants, navy blue shoes, and olive-green headphones. His overall build suggests aquatic adaptation mixed with human characteristics.

Backstory:
A minor villain operating independently, the Dolphin Villain attempted a bank robbery to acquire funds and an eco-friendly vehicle. His motivations and background remain largely unknown. His crime spree was cut short by the intervention of Pro Hero Captain Celebrity, who swiftly apprehended him and turned him over to police.

Additional Information:
Wields a pump-action shotgun as his primary weapon. His Dolphin Quirk grants him his distinctive appearance and echolocation-based verbal tics, though the full extent of his Quirk's abilities remain unclear. Relatively low-level threat quickly neutralized by established Pro Heroes.

cardPool.title: Dictator
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Dictator
Quirk Name: Despot
Occupation/Role: Villain, Tartarus escapee serving All For One
Personality: Cunning and cautious, strategist who believes in overwhelming numbers over direct confrontation; cowardly, using human shields to avoid direct combat and targeting exhausted opponents.
Appearance: A short man with severe spinal curvature causing his head to protrude from his torso rather than neck; possesses lanky, disproportionately long arms and extremely short legs. His round face features a wide mouth with vertical grooves extending from lower lip to chin, small beady eyes marked with crosshair-like patterns, and a small triangular nose. Wears a large black coat over a dress shirt, with control wires stitched throughout the fabric.
Backstory: Defeated five years prior by hero Crust in the "Bloodless Surrender Case" and imprisoned in Tartarus. Freed during All For One's prison breakout and conscripted into service. Later confronted Izuku Midoriya in Kamino while controlling civilian puppets, but was defeated by Bakugo's AP Shot and apprehended by Todoroki and Yaoyorozu.
Additional Information: His Despot Quirk allows him to control dozens of people simultaneously via extruding threads; victims retain consciousness but cannot resist control. Control breaks if victims receive strong physical shock or if Dictator loses consciousness. Classified as capable enough to warrant Tartarus imprisonment.

cardPool.title: Denki Kaminari
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Denki Kaminari

Alias: Chargebolt, Stun Gun Hero

Quirk Name: Electrification

Occupation/Role: UA High School Student, Class 1-A

Personality: Friendly and energetic, Denki is a casual social butterfly who gets along with most classmates despite occasional recklessness. He's well-meaning but blunt, enjoys encouraging others, and has a flirtatious side that rarely succeeds. He craves appearing cool and trendy, sometimes following others into questionable schemes, though he's genuinely kind-hearted beneath his jokester exterior.

Appearance: Light-skinned boy with messy golden-blond hair parted right, featuring a distinctive black lightning-shaped streak on his left side fringe that partially obscures his eye. He has slanted golden eyes and small eyebrows, appearing slimmer than most male classmates with minimal visible muscle. At UA, he wears the standard uniform: light gray blazer with dark turquoise trim, white dress shirt, dark blue-green pants, red tie, and brown shoes.

Backstory: A first-year student at UA High School training to become a Pro Hero, Denki possesses natural electrical abilities he's learning to harness. His journey began like many aspiring heroes—driven by desire to make an impact and earn recognition, though his methods and motivations remain somewhat superficial.

Additional Information: Class 1-A student; his Electrification Quirk allows him to generate and control electrical discharge from his body. During training arcs, he'll develop sharpshooting gear and specialized equipment to aid his combat effectiveness.

cardPool.title: Deidoro Sakaki
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Deidoro Sakaki
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Sloshed
Occupation/Role: Eight Bullets member of Shie Hassaikai
Personality: Energetic and volatile, prone to irritability. Speaks with slurred words and elongates syllables due to constant intoxication. Displays eccentric behavior like crawling upside-down across ceilings. Remains focused on his duties despite his altered state.
Appearance: Extremely thin and bony yet muscular man with long, greasy black hair reaching below his shoulders. Deep-set, circular eyes and notably straight teeth. Wears a plain drainage mask fitted with tubes to channel alcohol through the eyeholes. Dressed minimally in only a furry vest, dark pants, and black shoes. Perpetually disheveled from alcohol dripping down his body.
Backstory: Deidoro is a member of the Shie Hassaikai's elite Eight Bullets, serving under Overhaul. His Quirk likely drove him toward alcoholism as a necessity to maintain combat effectiveness. He was deployed alongside Shin Nemoto to intercept heroes, where he engaged the formidable Mirio Togata before being defeated.
Additional Information: Sloshed grants him the ability to inflict severe dizziness and balance disruption on nearby enemies, mimicking intoxication effects. The Quirk's strength correlates with his blood alcohol content. He carries throwing daggers as secondary weapons. Currently arrested following Overhaul's defeat.

cardPool.title: Deborah Gollini
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Deborah Gollini
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Day Dream
Occupation/Role: Member of the Gollini Family mafia
Personality: Sadistic and snide, Deborah enjoys toying with victims and allies alike. She remains composed and confident in her power, but becomes fearful and hysterical when threatened or facing authority figures. She takes dark satisfaction in what she calls "nice dreams," oblivious or indifferent to the suffering of her controlled victims.
Appearance: A tall woman with a voluptuous build, long flowing black hair past her shoulders, and sharp green eyes accented with salmon eyeshadow and purple lipstick. She wears an elegant dark dress with a spider cobweb pattern across the neckline, feathered sleeves and hem, a large brown belt, and falu red heels. A signature large black-brimmed hat adorned with a single red rose and golden crescent earrings complete her outfit.
Backstory: Deborah operates as a trusted member of the Gollini Family criminal organization. She participates in the family's schemes with a cruel enthusiasm, particularly enjoying the psychological manipulation her Quirk provides. Her confidence in her power has made her a dangerous operative within the family's hierarchy.
Additional Information: Day Dream renders victims helpless by forcing them into controllable dream states through eye contact alone. Normally limited to one target, her Quirk's effectiveness increases dramatically when amplified by Quirk modification. The Quirk is ineffective against technology or multiple Quirk users with vestiges. Victims are freed if she sustains injury.

cardPool.title: Death Arms
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Death Arms, Punching Hero: Death Arms
Quirk Name: Arm Strength
Occupation/Role: Pro Hero
Personality: Serious and disciplined, Death Arms dislikes reckless behavior and maintains a stern demeanor. He is deeply affected by criticism, feeling negative comments outweigh positive ones, which led to his temporary retirement. Despite his tough exterior, he possesses a genuine hero's heart and will instinctively act to protect civilians.
Appearance: An exceptionally tall and muscular man with a wide build and slightly tanned skin. He has a prominent square jaw, small eyes, and short white hair spiked back. His hero costume features a yellow and black-striped caution headband, matching thick wrist-guards and belt with a square buckle. He wears a cyan cardigan exposing his chest and lower torso, dark blue baggy pants with white side stripes, and plain black shoes.
Backstory: Death Arms earned recognition as a respected Pro Hero through his powerful arm-based abilities. Following severe public criticism after the Paranormal Liberation War, he withdrew from hero work, overwhelmed by negative feedback. During the Final War, his instincts compelled him to save civilians from debris, rekindling his resolve and sense of purpose.
Additional Information: Death Arms is a Pro Hero, not a UA student. His Quirk grants him extraordinary arm strength capable of moving industrial-weight objects. He values genuine heroism over public perception and has proven capable of overcoming self-doubt to continue protecting others.

cardPool.title: David Shield
cardPool.value:
Real Name: David Shield

Alias: The Support Genius

Quirk Name: Squirmy Fingers

Occupation/Role: Scientist and Support Item Developer; Former Sidekick to All Might

Personality: Compassionate and altruistic, driven by a desire to help society. David is deeply supportive and loves his daughter unconditionally. His admiration for All Might borders on reverence, making him willing to bend ethical lines when he believes it serves a greater good. Despite his flaws, he demonstrates selfless courage and eventually accepts hard truths about change and legacy.

Appearance: A tall man of average build with aqua eyes and light brown hair styled short and messy with two prominent bangs. He has light wrinkles on his face and a short goatee. David wears wide-rimmed square glasses, a blue button-up shirt, pale pants, a dark belt with metal buckle, navy sneakers with red accents, a dark watch on his left arm, and a wedding ring.

Backstory: A genius inventor who chose to support heroes through costume and gadget design rather than pursue heroics himself, limited by his weak Quirk. He was All Might's trusted sidekick and confidant, privy to the hero's post-injury weakened state. His obsession with restoring All Might's former glory led him to create illegal schemes, including a Quirk Amplification Device he was willing to steal for his idol.

Additional Information: Not a UA student; operates as an independent scientist and engineer. His specialization in precision work stems from his Quirk's unique properties. Despite moral compromises, David ultimately learns to accept All Might's decline and find meaning in nurturing the next generation of heroes through his work and daughter's aspirations.

cardPool.title: Danjuro Tobita
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Danjuro Tobita

Alias: Gentle

Quirk Name: Elasticity

Occupation/Role: Independent Villain and Internet Celebrity

Personality: Polite and well-mannered despite criminal pursuits, with theatrical and eccentric mannerisms. Lacks genuine insight into consequences of his actions despite good intentions. Confident and calm even when facing multiple heroes. Chases fame and reputation rather than wealth or material gain.

Appearance: A refined man with slicked-back black hair featuring a curl at the front, a handlebar mustache, and well-kept medium beard. He wears thick black eyeliner lines around his eyes applied with marker. His villain costume is extravagant: a black jacket with enlarged collars and coattails, white pinstriped pants, brown laced dress shoes, two brown belts with golden buckles, white cuffs, purple gloves with lighter knuckles, and a woolly purple scarf. He carries a white cane with a golden tip.

Backstory: Once a high school student who consulted a life counselor about his struggles, Danjuro later became a freeter before turning to villainy as a means of gaining internet fame and recognition. He operates as a gentleman criminal, orchestrating elaborate crimes for their theatrical value and online appeal rather than profit.

Additional Information: Not a UA High School student. Operates primarily through social media and video documentation of his crimes. Works alongside La Brava, demonstrating genuine care for those close to him despite his criminal pursuits.

cardPool.title: Daikaku Miyagi
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Daikaku Miyagi

Alias:
None

Quirk Name:
Big Horn

Occupation/Role:
Professional Newscaster

Personality:
Fair, impartial, and professional in his reporting. Demonstrates thick-skinned resilience by continuing his work despite public controversy. Known for presenting complex information in accessible language that has earned widespread trust across Japanese households.

Appearance:
A middle-aged man with noticeable facial wrinkles and greenish, straw-colored hair slicked back. His most distinctive feature is a single sheep-like horn protruding from his left forehead (his right horn was removed). He wears square-shaped glasses and dresses formally in a dark blue blazer, pale pink shirt, and brown tie.

Backstory:
Daikaku built his reputation as a respected newscaster through fair reporting and clear communication. He made the controversial decision to remove one of his two horns to perform his duties with greater ease, demonstrating his commitment to his profession over his Quirk's natural appearance.

Additional Information:
Not a UA High School student. His Quirk, Big Horn, naturally produces sheep-like horns on his forehead, though he surgically modified it by removing one horn to reduce potential hindrances to his broadcasting career.

cardPool.title: Daigoro Banjo
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Daigoro Banjo

Alias: Lariat

Quirk Name: Blackwhip

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero

Personality: Energetic and "super funky" compared to his peers, Daigoro is proud and confident in his abilities. He enjoys teasing others good-naturedly and possesses an indomitable willpower that allows him to resist even the most powerful threats.

Appearance: A large, muscular man with a wide build and square jaw. He has small dull blue eyes, no eyebrows, a bald head, and a short beard. His hero costume consists of an open dark leather jacket with yellow shoulder pads, golden goggles, and a bandolier, leaving his powerful torso exposed.

Backstory: A seasoned Pro Hero and fifth wielder of One For All, Daigoro received the legendary Quirk from his predecessor Hikage Shinomori. He trained extensively to master both his native Blackwhip ability and the immense power granted by One For All, becoming a formidable force in heroic society.

Additional Information: Daigoro can create black energy tendrils from his arms for grappling and mobility. As a One For All user, he possesses superhuman strength, speed, agility, and durability. His exceptional willpower allowed him to resist All For One's attempts to steal his Quirks. He is not a current UA student but an established professional hero.

cardPool.title: Daigo
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Daigo
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Unnamed Beast Form
Occupation/Role: Wolfram's Minion
Personality: Loyal and battle-hungry, Daigo takes pride in his combat abilities and respects skilled fighters. However, his arrogance leads him to underestimate opponents, a flaw that proved costly against Katsuki Bakugo.
Appearance: A middle-aged man with lightly tanned skin, a round head that merges into a thick neck, and small closed black eyes set close together. He has a hooked nose, short dark hair styled in a round shape with two visible stripes around the back. He wears a black combat suit with a full-face mask featuring a pale X-shaped design.
Backstory: Daigo serves as one of Wolfram's loyal henchmen, participating in the invasion of I-Island. He helped restrain security and take control of the Central Tower before engaging U.A. students who attempted a rescue. He confronted Katsuki Bakugo and was ultimately defeated by the student's Howitzer Impact technique.
Additional Information: Daigo's Beast Form Quirk grants him dramatic physical transformation into a hulking purple gorilla-like creature with enhanced strength and exceptional durability, allowing him to break through ice and withstand explosions.

cardPool.title: Dai
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Dai
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Saucer
Occupation/Role: Middle School Student (Third Year)
Personality: Timid and self-doubting, yet inherently caring and brave when others need help. Admires Pro Heroes deeply and acts instinctively to aid those in trouble despite his insecurities about his Quirk's strength.
Appearance: A soft-featured boy with squarish dark gray eyes and black hair with gray spots styled in a bowl cut. Wears a beige and orange-brown middle school uniform with white dress shirt, green tie, and white loafers. His youthful face reflects both earnestness and anxiety.
Backstory: Since childhood, Dai dreamed of becoming a Pro Hero after seeing All Might's statue. As his third year begins, self-doubt creeps in when classmates mock his weak Quirk. At All Might's statue, he encounters his idol Deku and attempts to save a falling child. Though he stumbles, Deku's encouragement reignites his determination to pursue heroism.
Additional Information: Possesses an underestimated Quirk that produces stackable, combinable white saucers from his hair. The Quirk's size and power can be adjusted, making it more versatile than initially apparent. Dai's earnest nature and willingness to help others despite personal doubts make him a symbol of potential.

cardPool.title: Dadan Tadan
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Dadan Tadan
Alias: Lucky Strike
Quirk Name: Flash Bang Sweat
Occupation/Role: Student, Isami Academy High School
Personality: Meek and timid, often nervous and apologetic. Dislikes fighting but will act for his team's sake. Conscientious about others' behavior and quick to make peace.
Appearance: A short boy with light chestnut hair swept diagonally left, round nose, tiny black eyes, and cat-like mouth. His most striking feature is his disproportionate body: thin upper arms that widen dramatically into giant hands, wide hips contrasting narrow shoulders, and a chubby lower stomach. Wears standard Isami High uniform: white shirt, red tie, dark blue blazer, gray pants, and brown loafers, tailored to fit his unusual proportions.
Backstory: A student at Isami Academy High School who dreams of becoming a hero under the name Lucky Strike. Despite his gentle nature and aversion to combat, he recognizes his duty to use his abilities for good. He encountered Class 1-A during early school events and demonstrated both humility and team loyalty.
Additional Information: His hero costume is a multicolored mech suit with segmented metal plating (yellow shoulders, green torso, blue legs, red gloves) featuring missile launch ports on his chest, knees, and lower torso, plus elbow and shoulder-blade boosters. The suit includes a radar display over his left eye and frames his head without enclosing it, making him appear larger than he actually is.

cardPool.title: Dabi
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Toya Todoroki

Alias: Dabi

Quirk Name: Hellflame

Occupation/Role: Villain, League of Villains member

Personality: Cold, calculating, and driven by deep-seated resentment toward his father Endeavor. Dabi masks his emotional turmoil beneath a detached demeanor, speaking with measured precision. He is methodical in his approach to villainy, harboring intense hatred that fuels his vengeful ambitions.

Appearance: A tall, pale young man in his early twenties with a slim but muscular build. His most distinctive features are patches of gnarled, wrinkled purple scar tissue covering his lower face, neck, torso, arms, and legs—remnants of losing control of his Quirk. He has spiky white hair that doesn't pass his neck with heavy bangs obscuring his thin, turquoise, heavily-lidded eyes. Multiple silver cartilage piercings adorn both ears, and he wears a triple nostril piercing on his right side. He dresses in a dark blue jacket with high ripped collar, matching pants cut above the ankles, a white scoop-neck shirt, and dark dress shoes, with a gray patterned belt and brown leather satchel.

Backstory: The eldest son of Pro Hero Endeavor and Rei Todoroki, Toya was neglected and mistreated by his father's selfish ambitions. At age thirteen, he lost control of his Hellflame Quirk, suffering severe burn injuries that left him scarred and comatose for three years. His traumatic past and abandonment transformed him into a villain seeking revenge against his father and society.

Additional Information: Not a UA student. Possesses an exceptionally powerful fire-based Quirk inherited from his father. His white hair is natural, having turned from crimson due to his mother's genetics. Operates with calculated precision and holds deep psychological scars alongside physical ones.

cardPool.title: Curator
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown

Alias: Curator

Quirk Name: Whale

Occupation/Role: Villain

Personality: Cold, calculating, and singularly focused on his goals. Disrespectful and manipulative toward others, using brainwashing as a tool of control. Becomes uncontrollable and berserk if his containment helmet is damaged or removed.

Appearance: A stark two-faced figure split down the middle. His right side displays fair skin, short messy black hair, and a tired, bagged eye. His left side is dark blue-skinned with white hair, a grotesquely wide red eye, a prominent blowhole on his forehead, and razor-sharp teeth protruding from his lower jaw. He wears a gray diving helmet with barnacle protrusions and a large collar secured by a hanging lock, covering the left half of his face. Beneath this sits a plain black suit layered under a flamboyant light purple coat with a tall collar lined in white fur. Gold watches, matching bracelets, and numerous rings adorn his wrists and fingers.

Backstory: A dangerous mastermind villain operating outside typical hero society, Curator schemes to dominate humanity through his Quirk and manipulative abilities. He has successfully brainwashed allies like Zookeeper to serve his ambitions, demonstrating his cunning and ruthlessness.

Additional Information: His Whale Quirk allows full or partial body transformation into a sperm whale, enabling him to fire pressurized water streams. His containment helmet is critical to maintaining his sanity and control—damage to it triggers violent, indiscriminate rampages. He maintains a companionship with fellow villain Bearhead, whom he has also brainwashed into compliance.

cardPool.title: Crust
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Crust

Alias: Shield Hero

Quirk Name: Shield

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero (Rank No. 6)

Personality: Emotional and noble, prone to crying over significant events but unwavering in his sense of duty. Selfless and willing to sacrifice himself for others, maintaining courage and resolve even in the face of death.

Appearance: Well-built man with black hair slicked backward, featuring a distinctive grayish-white streak running from his hairline center. His right hand bears a crusty, stone-like layer from his Quirk. He wears a black eye mask, Spartan-inspired black armor with red stitching down the center, and a green hooded cape.

Backstory: One of Japan's top ten Pro Heroes, Crust earned his elite ranking through exceptional combat prowess and tactical expertise in team operations. He carried deep emotions about All Might's retirement and regretted missing the Kamino Incident, channeling these feelings into dedicated heroic service.

Additional Information: Specializes in team-based combat and defensive strategies. His Shield Quirk generates hexagonal stone barriers he can enlarge, redirect, sharpen into cutting weapons, and detach as projectiles. Capable of engaging multiple High-End Nomu simultaneously. Known for his encouraging demeanor even in dire circumstances.

cardPool.title: Crimson Riot
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Crimson Riot, Chivalrous Hero
Quirk Name: Hardening
Occupation/Role: Pro Hero
Personality: Unwavering in resolve despite inner fear, Crimson Riot believes willpower transcends Quirk ability. He defines "manly spirit" as determination and courage regardless of gender—a mindset of living without regret. Haunted by an early failure that cost civilian lives, he channels that trauma into fearless heroism, always charging forward to prevent repeating past mistakes.
Appearance: A sturdy, broad-shouldered man with striking spiky red hair jutting forward in one direction and backward in two others. He wears a distinctive metal three-piece mask covering his mouth and nose, paired with a crimson outfit and a long red cape featuring a high, wide collar with deliberately ripped edges. His overall aesthetic projects strength and heroic presence.
Backstory: An established Pro Hero whose reputation as a fearless daredevil masks a deeper truth. Early in his career, a moment of hesitation resulted in civilian deaths—a tragedy that fundamentally shaped his heroic philosophy. Rather than paralyzing him, this failure became his driving force to never abandon those within reach. His unwavering commitment and philosophy have inspired countless aspiring heroes.
Additional Information: Crimson Riot serves as an idol and philosophical mentor to UA student Eijiro Kirishima of Class 1-A, whose hero name "Red Riot" directly pays homage to him. Despite his old-school approach, his influence remains powerful among the current generation of heroes.

cardPool.title: Cow Lady
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown

Alias: Cow Lady

Quirk Name: Cow

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero

Personality: Dutiful and confident in her abilities, Cow Lady is a committed hero willing to collaborate with allies when needed. She maintains professional composure during crises and takes her responsibilities seriously.

Appearance: A tall woman with shoulder-length wavy blonde hair, prominent curved horns emerging from her temples, and pointed cow-like ears. She wears a cowgirl hero costume featuring a dark orange cropped laced top, sleeveless denim jacket with a rope tie, ripped denim shorts, western belt with cow-head buckle, leather gloves, and knee-high boots. A cowboy hat hangs around her neck, tasseled rings adorn her upper arms, and orange-tinted shades complete her look.

Backstory: An American Pro Hero operating out of Los Angeles, Cow Lady has built a reputation as a dependable combatant. She responded to a casino robbery alongside Elecplant but was outmatched by the villains, witnessing All Might's superior power firsthand. Later, she was dispatched to Japan as part of international reconstruction efforts, demonstrating her versatility beyond combat.

Additional Information: Cow Lady is a Pro Hero from the United States, not a UA student. Her Quirk allows her to transform into a minotaur-like form with drastically enhanced strength, making her invaluable for both combat and heavy construction work. She operates with professional discipline and international experience.

cardPool.title: Cow Cowboy
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Unknown

Alias:
Cow Cowboy

Quirk Name:
Control Horn

Occupation/Role:
Villain

Personality:
Ruthless and extortive, using threats and intimidation to achieve his goals. Shows little regard for the livelihoods of farmers or their communities when pursuing profit through blackmail.

Appearance:
A very short man with small, dark eyes hidden behind round glasses and notably thick eyebrows. He wears a large cow-patterned cowboy hat with horns protruding from each side, a tuxedo shirt under a plain overcoat, baggy pants, boots, and a pendant. His overall appearance is deliberately cow-themed and eccentric.

Backstory:
Cow Cowboy operated as a local villain targeting rural farming communities, using his Quirk to coerce farmers into meeting his demands. He was confronted by All Might while threatening to destroy multiple farms, resulting in his swift defeat and arrest. His sidekicks abandoned him upon his capture rather than intervening.

Additional Information:
His Quirk allows him to mind control cattle, which he weaponizes for extortion schemes. Despite employing sidekicks, little is known about his relationships with them beyond their employment arrangement. He represents the threat of Quirk-based crime in isolated communities.

cardPool.title: Composer Hero
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown (Conjectural)

Alias: Composer Hero

Quirk Name: Unnamed Music Quirk

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero

Personality: Professional and composed, performing his heroic duties with confidence. Demonstrates strong capability in team operations and remains calm under pressure during combat situations.

Appearance: Tall, well-built man with chin-length blond hair flowing downward and sharp green eyes. Wears an orange jacket designed to resemble a violin with dangling flaps, golden buttons on the collar, three belt straps across each upper arm, and white gloves. Carries a long yellow conductor's baton.

Backstory: An accomplished Pro Hero invited to prestigious events like I-Island, indicating high status within hero society. Selected for dangerous Humarise cult raids, suggesting exceptional combat experience and proven reliability among elite heroes.

Additional Information: His Quirk generates golden musical notes along staff lines that pacify and incapacitate enemies without lethal force, making them suitable for capture. Can also amplify his ability through musical instruments for large-scale effects. Primarily uses his Quirk for support roles and villain subdual rather than direct combat.

cardPool.title: Clair Voyance
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Clair Voyance

Alias:
None

Quirk Name:
Voyance

Occupation/Role:
Pro Hero, World Heroes Association member, Otheon Task Force operative

Personality:
Calm, resolved, and serious in demeanor. Dutiful and reliable, readily assisting others with information and support. Professional and composed under pressure, maintaining focus during crisis situations.

Appearance:
A curvy woman with bright blue eyes hidden behind a visor featuring two large blue-tinted lenses. She has straight blonde hair with a brown patch stemming from her roots. She wears a form-fitting royal blue suit with a wide chest opening filled by a high-collared white dress shirt, a dark magenta zipper down the middle, and short sleeves bearing the WHA logo. Black thigh-high boots with matching magenta lines complete her outfit, along with a brown holster on her right thigh containing a pulse gun.

Backstory:
An international pro hero recruited by the World Heroes Association for a global operation against the anti-Quirk terrorist organization Humarise. She joined the Otheon Task Force led by Endeavor to raid Humarise headquarters and locate Trigger Bombs following a devastating terrorist attack. During the raid, she used her Quirk to scan the entire building for the bombs, though her search proved fruitless.

Additional Information:
Not a UA student. Operates as part of international hero coordination efforts. Provides critical reconnaissance and evidence analysis to support investigations, demonstrating her value beyond her scanning abilities.

cardPool.title: Chuma Yakumaru
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Chuma Yakumaru
Alias: The Junkie
Quirk Name: Bruiser
Occupation/Role: Instant Villain
Personality: Antisocial and misanthropic, Chuma is volatile and hostile to everyone around him. Mentally unstable with severe drug dependency, he becomes increasingly aggressive and unpredictable when under the influence of Trigger, quickly turning violent without warning.
Appearance: A haggard man with greasy dark hair reaching his shoulders, sunken cheekbones, and stubble. He wears a dirty, open shirt with dark pants and shoes. When enhanced by Trigger, his body transforms dramatically—his physique becomes taller and bulkier, his skin turns veiny and reddish-purple, and his eyes enlarge with irises disappearing.
Backstory: Chuma was approached by Kuin Hachisuka, who supplied him with Trigger to manifest his Quirk into a dangerous form. Desperate for the drug's rush, he injected the capsules and became an Instant Villain, attacking both Kuin and innocent civilians. He was eventually defeated in a brutal confrontation with Knuckleduster despite his enhanced strength.
Additional Information: Chuma is not a UA student but a criminal element operating in Naruhata. His Quirk allows him to power up individual limbs for devastating attacks, with charging time increasing power. When amplified by Trigger, his entire body becomes supercharged, making him a formidable but ultimately beatable threat to heroes and vigilantes.

cardPool.title: Chubs
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown (formerly a glutton)
Alias: Chubs
Quirk Name: Super Regeneration, Body Expansion, Mouth, Metal Teeth
Occupation/Role: High-End Nomu, Doctor Garaki's bioengineered creation
Personality: Obedient to commands yet displays tactical awareness; prefers direct confrontation; recognizes and targets specific opponents; speaks with slight stuttering despite limited emotional range.
Appearance: Grotesquely bulbous body with excessive adipose tissue; robotic thrusters grafted where legs begin at the thighs; both hands fused into mouths filled with teeth and tongues; additional mouths line his torso; small vertebrae protrude from his back; metal grid grafted across head concealing his brain.
Backstory: Originally a glutton, carefully selected by Doctor Garaki and surgically transformed into a High-End Nomu through Quirk grafting and cybernetic enhancement. Created as a powerful combatant in Garaki's lab beneath Jaku General Hospital to serve the League of Villains' goals.
Additional Information: Deployed during the Paranormal Liberation War to defend Garaki's laboratory; successfully held passage against multiple Pro Heroes including Shield-user Crust until Eraser Head nullified his Quirks; destroyed alongside other High-Ends by Tomura Shigaraki's Decay.

cardPool.title: Christopher Skyline
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Christopher Skyline

Alias: Captain Celebrity, Playboy Hero

Quirk Name: Force Field

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero (American, currently operating in Japan)

Personality: Arrogant and attention-seeking with a bombastic personality, yet genuinely heroic in crises. Despite his flirtatiousness and poor judgment, he possesses an honest desire to make people smile. His lack of self-awareness regarding inappropriate behavior stems from obsession with his alpha male image rather than malice.

Appearance: Exceptionally tall and well-built with a chiseled jawline, cleft chin, and angular nose. Blonde hair styled in a swept-back mohawk with light blue, downward-tilting eyes and long eyelashes. He wears a cerulean skin-tight bodysuit trimmed in yellow with a red-starred chest logo, matching shin and shoulder-pads, yellow belt with large buckle, and a long red cape with dark blue visor.

Backstory: Once America's top-ranked hero, Christopher's controversial womanizing and poor public behavior forced him to relocate to Japan to rebuild his career. Under management and the prospect of fatherhood, he began genuine self-improvement, though his extravagant nature persists.

Additional Information: Christopher possesses immense physical strength and can achieve supersonic flight. His Force Field Quirk is highly versatile, making him one of the most powerful heroes despite his reputation issues. He is married to Pamela, who manages his numerous lawsuits.

cardPool.title: Chomper
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Chomper
Quirk Name: Plant
Occupation/Role: F-rank Villain, League of Villains member
Personality: Confident in combat abilities despite low rank; limited information available on deeper character traits, though his willingness to assault U.A. High School suggests boldness or recklessness.
Appearance: Average-height man wearing an orange sweater, magenta pants, and black boots. His head is replaced by a large venus flytrap that continuously oozes green fluid, creating an unsettling plant-like visage.
Backstory: Recruited by Tomura Shigaraki as one of approximately seventy villains for the U.S.J. assault. Little is known of his origins before joining the League of Villains' coordinated attack on U.A. High School.
Additional Information: Possesses the Plant Quirk, enabling transformation of body parts into plant structures with healing properties beneficial to allies. Defeated during the U.S.J. invasion and arrested upon Pro Hero arrival. Later appeared in manipulated footage from the Deika City battle alongside Victor.

cardPool.title: Chojuro Kon
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Chojuro Kon

Alias:
Chimera

Quirk Name:
Chimera

Occupation/Role:
Villain; member of Nine's criminal organization

Personality:
Driven by deep societal hatred stemming from lifelong ostracization for his appearance, Chojuro seeks to build a new power-based society with Nine. Despite his brutality, he shows occasional compassion toward his allies. He displays hypocrisy by mocking others' monstrous features while possessing animalistic traits himself.

Appearance:
An imposing man with blue fur covering his body and a wolf-like head. His hands and feet resemble eagle talons, and a long reptilian tail extends from his spine. He wears a brown trench coat over a blue dress shirt with jeans and belt, often smoking a cigar. Dark hair styled in dreadlocks frames his animalistic face.

Backstory:
Rejected by society for his inhuman appearance, Chojuro lived as an outcast until Nine discovered and recruited him. Viewing Nine as his savior, he devoted himself to the villain's vision of a new world ordered by power alone, believing this would finally grant him acceptance and purpose.

Additional Information:
Second-strongest member of Nine's team. Excels in hand-to-hand combat with tremendous physical strength. Commands fire-breath attacks effective against ranged opponents. His Quirk's full power transformation enlarges animal features, grows horns, manifests forearms of feathers, and dramatically increases size and muscle mass, overwhelming multiple skilled fighters simultaneously.

cardPool.title: Chizuo Magi
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Chizuo Magi
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Unknown
Occupation/Role: Retired; Grandfather and household resident
Personality: Loving and kind-hearted, deeply caring toward his family despite witnessing domestic abuse. He is compassionate and attempts to comfort his grandchildren, but struggles with confrontation and fear of confronting his abusive son-in-law. Eventually finds courage to stand against injustice, though too late to prevent tragedy.
Appearance: A relatively chubby and large elderly man with hair the same color as his daughter Nao. He has a gentle, grandfatherly demeanor befitting his age and caring nature.
Backstory: Chizuo lived in his daughter's home with his wife Mako, sharing daily life with his grandchildren Tenko and Hana. He witnessed years of abuse from his son-in-law Kotaro toward the children for admiring heroes, growing increasingly disgusted but fearful of intervention. When Kotaro physically punished Tenko excessively, Chizuo finally joined his family in confronting him. That same night, Tenko's Decay Quirk manifested uncontrollably, killing the family dog, Hana, and ultimately Chizuo himself along with his wife and daughter.
Additional Information: Deceased. His hands were recovered by All For One and later incorporated into Tomura Shigaraki's villain costume. He represents a tragedy of hesitation and too-little-too-late intervention against household cruelty.

cardPool.title: Chizome Akaguro
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Chizome Akaguro

Alias: Hero Killer: Stain, formerly Stendhal

Quirk Name: Bloodcurdle

Occupation/Role: Villain/Former Vigilante

Personality: A cruel, merciless ideologue obsessed with purging "false heroes" from society. Chizome possesses an indomitable sense of duty and uncompromising moral convictions, revering only All Might as a true hero. He justifies his murderous crusade as necessary cleansing, though he shows rare respect for those who fight with conviction. Willful, calculating, and utterly devoted to his twisted vision of justice.

Appearance: An intimidating, muscular man with a distinctive hunched posture and triangular face. His most striking features are his small red eyes with tiny irises, self-removed nose, and extraordinarily long tongue covered in papillae. He has long, messy black hair typically hidden beneath a blood-red headband and tattered cloth mask. His combat suit is dark with plated metal armor across his torso, sleeveless to reveal yellow bandages wrapping his forearms. He wears black wristbands, metal knee pads, black boots with steel armor, and his signature crimson scarf.

Backstory: Once a vigilante named Stendhal, Chizome became the Hero Killer after concluding that society's heroes were corrupt and unworthy. He has killed numerous Pro Heroes in his quest to "stain his own hands" and reform the heroic system. His radical ideology and willingness to collaborate with villains reveal a dangerous philosophy divorced from conventional morality.

Additional Information: An exceptionally dangerous combatant with a katana and multiple blades. His Quirk allows him to paralyze victims through blood contact. He represents a philosophical threat to hero society, not merely a physical one.

cardPool.title: Chiyo Shuzenji
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Chiyo Shuzenji

Alias: Recovery Girl, Youthful Heroine

Quirk Name: Heal

Occupation/Role: School Nurse at U.A. High School

Personality: Compassionate and kind, treating all patients with care and often offering sweets to counteract her Quirk's stamina-draining effects. However, she maintains a strict, reproaching attitude toward reckless behavior that causes injury, particularly toward students who misuse their Quirks. She can be harsh and critical when warranted, refusing to enable harmful patterns even when it means withholding aid.

Appearance: A short, elderly woman with gray hair styled into a netted bun with a large syringe protruding diagonally from it. She has a notably small nose, eyes depicted as tiny dashes, and a long mouth with deep nasolabial folds. She wears a white doctor's lab coat over a dress featuring yellow and red vest-like designs on either side with two yellow buttons and a pink "R"-shaped belt buckle. Pink boots complete her outfit, along with a helmet framing the sides of her head and a purple-tinted visor. She walks with a cane designed like a syringe.

Backstory: An experienced medical professional who serves U.A. High School as its primary nurse, maintaining offices both at the school and the Sports Festival Stadium. Her decades of experience combine formal medical knowledge with her powerful Quirk, making her invaluable to student safety.

Additional Information: Chiyo possesses genuine surgical expertise beyond her Quirk's capabilities. Her Heal Quirk amplifies the body's natural healing through a kiss, capable of mending broken bones and multiple limbs in seconds, though it cannot regrow lost body parts or heal catastrophic injuries. The process drains significant life energy from recipients, making her management of its use critical.

cardPool.title: Chitose Kizuki
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Chitose Kizuki

Alias: Curious

Quirk Name: Lacquering

Occupation/Role: Executive Director of Shoowaysha Publishing, Meta Liberation Army Leader

Personality: Intensely curious and obsessively driven by journalism, Chitose pursues stories above all else, even her own safety. She is callous and manipulative, willing to weaponize her subordinates and murder for the perfect narrative. Her obsessive nature causes her to lose all sense of danger and self-preservation, becoming entranced by compelling human drama even in life-threatening situations.

Appearance: Chitose is a striking woman with long, pale lilac hair parted to her right side. She has unusual eyes with completely black sclerae, green irises, and black pupils, framed by notably long eyelashes and small eyebrows. Her skin is pale blue, and she has full lips. She typically wears a navy blue, shoulderless dress with long sleeves, an X-shaped belt with a circular buckle, and light-colored laced high boots. She adorns herself with gold earrings and often wears an unbuttoned salmon-colored jacket with black fur collar and hem.

Backstory: A passionate journalist since her early career, Chitose built her reputation at Shoowaysha Publishing before being recruited into the Meta Liberation Army by Rikiya Yotsubashi. Inspired by his philosophy that face-to-face interviews capture human hearts and influence readers, she devoted herself to documenting stories that serve the Army's cause of liberating Quirk society.

Additional Information: Chitose is a high-ranking member of the Meta Liberation Army, not a UA student. She became obsessively interested in researching villain Himiko Toga's descent into madness, viewing her tragic backstory as the perfect narrative vehicle for the Army's ideology.

cardPool.title: Chikuchi Togeike
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Chikuchi Togeike

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Not specified

Occupation/Role: Student, U.A. High School General Department

Personality: Initially envious and critical of Class 1-A's popularity, viewing their success as undeserved. After witnessing their School Festival performance, she demonstrated capacity for remorse and honest appreciation, admitting she was wrong. Generally appears sullen and stern-faced but shows willingness to acknowledge others' achievements.

Appearance: Young woman of average build with dark, ear-length hair styled in low curved pigtails with upward-arching bangs. She has thin, stern-looking eyes with prominent lower eyelashes and typically wears a sullen expression. Dressed in standard U.A. High School uniform during school hours.

Backstory: A General Department student at U.A. High School who harbored resentment toward the Hero Course's Class 1-A, believing their celebrated status was unearned. She vocalized these criticisms with classmate Tsutsutaka Agoyamato until witnessing their impressive School Festival performance, which prompted genuine self-reflection and an apology. During the Final War, she demonstrated character growth by assisting civilians in the U.A. Underground Evacuation Bunkers to safety.

Additional Information: Attends U.A. High School as part of the General Department. Considers Nejire Hado an idol. Capable of growth and change when confronted with evidence contradicting her biases.

cardPool.title: Chikara Yotsubashi
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Chikara Yotsubashi

Alias: Destro

Quirk Name: Not specified in source

Occupation/Role: Infamous villain, founder and grand commander of the original Meta Liberation Army

Personality: Idealistic and revolutionary, Chikara believed Quirk use was a fundamental human right and viewed government regulation as oppressive perversion of his mother's legacy. Driven by tragedy and conviction, he inspired devoted followers despite being labeled a terrorist by opponents who saw only chaos and violence in his methods.

Appearance: Chikara had long, light brown hair worn in a simple ponytail. A distinctive black blotch marked the area around his eyes, functioning as a mask-like marking. He wore a military uniform consisting of a dark green jacket with a red-outlined patch on the right sleeve depicting a rat-like figure, paired with a gray shirt and red ascot tie.

Backstory: Born during an era of Meta Ability prejudice, Chikara endured social rejection from peers. His mother advocated for acceptance, coining the term "Quirk" in her plea for a prejudice-free society—earning her the title "Mother of Quirks." After her murder by anti-Meta opponents, Chikara founded the Meta Liberation Army under the alias Destro to fight government suppression. Defeated and imprisoned, he wrote a biographical manifesto before taking his own life.

Additional Information: Though long dead, his published writings continue inspiring new generations of villains and liberate ideology followers. He fathered an unknown son whose descendants continue his lineage into modern times.

cardPool.title: Cathleen Bate
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Cathleen Bate

Alias: Star and Stripe

Quirk Name: Amplification

Occupation/Role: No. 1 Pro Hero of the United States of America

Personality: Brash, selfless, and fiercely protective with an intense sense of justice. Deeply admires All Might and willingly defies rules to save others. Kind and sisterly toward her team, yet shows occasional ignorance outside her jurisdiction. Willing to sacrifice everything, including her career and life, for those she protects.

Appearance: A tall woman with an athletic, well-muscled build and elegant facial features. She has long flowing blonde hair styled in eight backward-swept tufts reminiscent of All Might's empowered form, narrow brown eyes, and a red domino mask. Her high-collared skin-tight bodysuit features striped patterns on the upper torso, metal-studded gauntlets and collar with star designs, and a long striped cape resembling the U.S. flag.

Backstory: Inspired by All Might saving her family years ago during his time abroad, Cathleen dedicated herself to heroism. Once insecure about her Quirk's limits as a young girl with brown hair and glasses, she was encouraged by her squadron to embrace her own strength rather than chase All Might's power. She rose to become America's No. 1 hero, earning the nickname "Star" from her close-knit team.

Additional Information: Not a UA student. Operating at the highest level of international heroism during the Quirk Apprehension Test arc timeline. Known for her reckless disregard of protocol when civilian lives are at stake.

cardPool.title: Cargirl
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Cargirl
Quirk Name: Car
Occupation/Role: Pro Hero
Personality: Amiable and approachable, willing to interact with admirers and sign autographs. Reserved about personal details, maintaining professional mystique.
Appearance: Slender young woman with blonde hair styled in a ponytail and two loose spirals framing her face. Wears a distinctive hero costume featuring a glossy purple beret with low-tilting visor, sleeveless white crop top with midriff exposed, sculpted armor-like purple hood, white sports shorts with purple side stripes, and dark knee-high boots. A purple skirt-shell resembling a racing car rear with functioning axle-mounted wheels completes the ensemble.
Backstory: An established Pro Hero specializing in automotive-themed heroics. Her quirk and costume design suggest a background in or passion for auto-racing culture, though her true origins remain obscure.
Additional Information: Not a UA High School student. Her exact quirk mechanics are ambiguous but clearly car-related. Active during the timeline of My Hero Academia: Two Heroes film.

cardPool.title: Camie Utsushimi
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Camie Utsushimi

Alias: Illus-o-Camie

Quirk Name: Glamour

Occupation/Role: Second-year student at Shiketsu High School

Personality: Bubbly, laid-back, and straightforward, Camie brushes off serious situations with ease. She's talkative and flirtatious, speaking in trendy gyaru-like slang that confuses many. Beneath her carefree demeanor lies genuine cleverness—she thinks strategically about creative solutions and offers insightful advice to others, though she appears naïve at first glance.

Appearance: Average height with straight, light brown hair reaching below her shoulders and large, dark brown eyes. She has plump, glossy lips and a curvaceous figure. In her Shiketsu uniform, she wears the standard white-collared shirt, dark skirt, and signature school hat. Her hero costume is a black catsuit with patterned lines and a central zipper, white wrist cuffs, white heeled knee-high boots with gray patterns, and a loose black collar with metallic plates.

Backstory: A prestigious second-year at Shiketsu High School, Camie trains to become a Pro Hero. Recently, she was impersonated by the villain Himiko Toga during the Provisional Hero License Exam, an incident she takes in stride despite its severity. Her easy-going nature masks her tactical mind and growing experience.

Additional Information: Camie prefers being called by her first name. She's clever with children and creative in problem-solving, favoring non-violent approaches. Her Quirk emits smoke-based visual and auditory illusions that cover large areas but last only briefly.

cardPool.title: Bye-Bites
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Bye-Bites

Alias:
Sharukinara

Quirk Name:
Unnamed Shark Quirk

Occupation/Role:
Low-ranking villain recruited by the League of Villains for the U.S.J. assault

Personality:
Cruel and sadistic, showing no remorse when attacking defenseless students. Exhibits caution regarding unknown Quirks but remains eager to eliminate targets quickly. Demonstrates patience in tactical situations.

Appearance:
Humanoid shark with light blue skin, dark blue hair, and yellow eyes. Possesses a prominent fin and sharp teeth with an elongated jaw. Wears a sleeveless diving suit with a diving mask and oxygen cylinder strapped to his back.

Backstory:
One of approximately seventy villains conscripted by Tomura Shigaraki to assault U.A. High School's Unforeseen Simulation Joint. Deployed to the Flood Zone where his shark physiology provides combat advantage. Engaged Class 1-A students during the attack but was ultimately defeated and arrested.

Additional Information:
His Quirk grants enhanced swimming speed and a powerful bite, but does not enable underwater breathing; he relies on his diving cylinder for oxygen. Lacks knowledge of his opponents' Quirks, making him cautious despite his aggressive nature. Was subdued when caught in Midoriya's whirlpool and trapped by Mineta's sticky spheres alongside other water-zone villains.

cardPool.title: Bruno Gollini
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Bruno Gollini

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Delay Spot

Occupation/Role: Member of the Gollini Family mafia

Personality: Sly and cunning, Bruno enjoys catching opponents off-guard and tormenting enemies through psychological games. His confidence quickly crumbles when outmatched, replaced by panic and desperation.

Appearance: A tall, slim middle-aged man with slicked greying hair, sharp black eyes, and a defined jawline. His hands are notably hairy and adorned with various rings and jewelry. He wears formal mafia attire—a black suit jacket with blue tuxedo shirt, gray pants, and a plum ascot tie, accented by a rose pinned to his tux.

Backstory: Bruno operates as a trusted member of the Gollini Family criminal organization, leveraging his Delay Spot Quirk to intimidate and control opponents during their operations.

Additional Information: Delay Spot creates a semi-spherical bubble that traps everything inside in slow motion, while Bruno remains unaffected and moves at normal speed. He can exempt people or objects from the effect by touching them. The Quirk's range was significantly expanded after receiving Anna's Overmodification boost. Despite its power, the ability fails against extremely fast attacks—fast-moving objects retain enough momentum to cause serious damage.

cardPool.title: Bruce Lee
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Bruce Lee
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Fa Jin
Occupation/Role: Resistance Member, One For All User
Personality: Serious and apathetic due to surviving society's collapse, with unwavering belief in justice. Views the world in stark black and white terms—victory equals life, defeat equals death. Initially skeptical of idealistic approaches, but capable of empathy and mentorship when convinced of a cause's merit. Fiercely loyal to his allies.
Appearance: Tall, athletic build with striking silver hair styled in an upward spiky ponytail. Dark eyes and sharp features reflect his hardened nature. Wears a black forehead bandana and green combat jacket signifying his resistance membership. No visible scars despite his veteran status.
Backstory: Bruce survived the chaotic early era when Quirks first emerged, becoming a battle-hardened combatant. He joined Toshitsugu Kudo's resistance against All For One, eventually becoming Kudo's trusted second-in-command. Kudo passed One For All to him as his successor in their fight against tyranny.
