Though initially refusing to help Izuku Midoriya due to doubts about the boy's optimism, Yoichi Shigaraki's persuasion and Bruce's own empathy led him to mentor the young hero in harnessing Fa Jin.
Additional Information: Bruce is the third user of One For All. His Fa Jin Quirk allows him to accumulate kinetic energy through repetitive movements and release it explosively. He fought and died alongside Kudo in their cause against All For One.

cardPool.title: Briareos
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Briareos

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Multiple Arm

Occupation/Role: Tartarus Prison Guard

Personality: Duty-bound and resolute, Briareos demonstrates unwavering commitment to his post despite overwhelming odds. He remains calm under pressure, issuing tactical orders even as catastrophic threats emerge.

Appearance: A imposing figure clad in crimson and black armor plating that covers most of his body. His helmet completely obscures his face, featuring a sleek, intimidating design. Most notably, his Quirk grants him ten arms total, which he wields with practiced efficiency in combat.

Backstory: Briareos served as a senior guard at Tartarus prison's Bronze Gate alongside his brother Gyges. When the Paranormal Liberation Front's assault breached the facility's defenses, he stood his ground against High-End Nomu despite the deaths of countless heroes and escape of dangerous villains, including Tomura Shigaraki.

Additional Information: Briareos possessed enhanced strength proportional to his multiple limbs, capable of wielding heavy military-grade miniguns effectively. He died defending Tartarus when a Nomu's spike barrage overwhelmed his position, demonstrating his steadfast dedication to containing superhuman threats.

cardPool.title: Bombers
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Bomber (Designation Unknown)
Alias: Bomber, Next-Level Villain
Quirk Name: Explosive Detonation (varies by specimen)
Occupation/Role: Mass-produced combat entity created by the Villain Factory
Personality: Lacks independent thought or personality; operates solely on programmed directives with absolute obedience. Completely devoid of self-preservation instinct or fear, making them ideal for suicide assault missions.
Appearance: Round, winged entity with jet-black skin, a serpentine head lacking facial features save a wide, oddly-lipped mouth. Two prominent bat wings protrude from the back, and a distinctive swollen belly contains explosive energy reserves. Specialized variants exist—such as the Captain Celebrity hunter, which stands significantly larger with six muscular arms.
Backstory: Manufactured en masse by the Villain Factory within the Bomber Warehouse at Onomura Pharma Corp., these creatures were engineered as expendable weapons. Deployed by the villain Number 6 as part of coordinated attacks against Pro Hero Captain Celebrity, they served as tactical instruments in a larger assassination plot targeting the American hero during the Tokyo Sky Egg incident.
Additional Information: These are not UA students but combat-oriented fabricated entities. Each Bomber possesses an explosive Quirk centered in its abdominal cavity, capable of devastating detonation. Some specimens feature specialized Quirks like Regeneration or EMP generation. They were nearly entirely destroyed by Pro Heroes and Detective Naomasa Tsukauchi's police force during a laboratory raid.

cardPool.title: Bomb Villain
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Bomb Villain
Quirk Name: Fire Cracker
Occupation/Role: Professional Villain, Jewelry Thief
Personality: Greedy and overconfident, focused on profit over confrontation. Shows arrogance in combat, smirking at opponents he believes defeated before acting rashly.
Appearance: Tall figure with a large afro covering most of his upper head. Thick lips, prominent facial hair, and a sharp nose. Wears a fringed blazer, belt with twinkle symbol, long pants, and high-heeled boots each spiked on the sole.
Backstory: A career criminal operating within organized villain networks, partnering with the Gale Villain in coordinated heists. His focus is material wealth acquisition rather than ideological villainy.
Additional Information: Fire Cracker Quirk rips chunks of his own hair to detonate as explosives—either hurled as bombs or detonated for propulsion bursts. Destructive power rivals building-level damage but remains inferior to similar Explosion-type Quirks. Underestimates opponents despite proven combat capability.

cardPool.title: Blackbelt
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Blackbelt, Martial Hero: Blackbelt
Quirk Name: Fast Fist
Occupation/Role: Pro Hero
Personality: Seeks recognition and popularity while maintaining genuine heroic duty. Attempts an affected, Shakespearean speech pattern but often lapses into normal dialogue. Creates unnecessarily complex martial arts techniques for show despite never using them in combat. Despite mockery nearly driving him to retirement, he prioritizes saving lives over fame when it matters.
Appearance: Young man with long, messy hair and a somewhat muscular build. Wears a martial artist-inspired hero costume featuring a metal headband, loose robes, and a large belt. Light facial makeup completes his stereotypical martial arts master image.
Backstory: Became a Pro Hero approximately 10 years ago with the goal of achieving fame and recognition. Faced relentless mockery from civilians who doubted his claims of superhuman speed, earning the derisive nickname "Hundo-Hit-Man." Nearly abandoned his hero career until UA students Momo Yaoyorozu, Denki Kaminari, and Mei Hatsume created a high-speed camera drone that finally captured evidence of his true abilities, vindicating him and restoring his motivation.
Additional Information: Fast Fist grants him the ability to deliver 100 consecutive punches in under one second, appearing as a single blur to normal observation. His performance during the Team-Up Missions program, streamed via Mei's drone technology, finally earned him the public acknowledgement he craved.

cardPool.title: Zookeeper
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Unknown

Alias:
Zookeeper

Quirk Name:
Cleaning

Occupation/Role:
Former Zookeeper, Villain (Brainwashed Companion of Curator)

Personality:
Once kind and cheerful with a deep love for animals, she is now under Curator's mental control and serves as his obedient companion, her original gentle nature suppressed by brainwashing.

Appearance:
A woman with shoulder-length white hair and white irises. She wears a black and red buttoned outfit with white gloves and black boots, presenting a striking contrast between her soft features and stern attire.

Backstory:
A dedicated zookeeper who found joy in caring for animals, she was captured and brainwashed by the villain Curator, who transformed her into his loyal subordinate and stripped her of her free will.

Additional Information:
Her Quirk secretes a dish soap-like substance that weakens enemies by "cleaning" them, and can also sanitize crime scenes. She wields a wooden push broom as her primary weapon. Not a UA student. Part of the Clash! Heroes Battle arcade game universe.

cardPool.title: Yuyu Haya
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Yuyu Haya

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Unknown

Occupation/Role: UA High School Student, Class 3-A

Personality: Friendly and fashionable with a defensive streak when protecting close friends. Levelheaded and diligent as a hero-in-training, though her protective nature can cause her to jump to conclusions. Highly loyal and supportive, especially toward her best friend Nejire Hado.

Appearance: Fair-skinned girl with cropped salmon-colored hair dyed a vibrant shade, reddish-brown eyes with notably long lower eyelashes. She wears multiple grey stud piercings in her ears. Her school uniform is slightly disheveled—crooked collar, loose tie, rolled-up sleeves—paired with tights and two pink bracelets on her right wrist. Her hero costume features a small black domino mask, purple tight suit with yellow markings, long purple boots with white and yellow accents, black arm sleeves, and a white belt with cylinder attachments.

Backstory: A third-year student at UA High School and best friend to Nejire Hado since their first year. Yuyu suggested Nejire enter the Miss Con Beauty Pageant, supporting her through multiple competitions despite two consecutive losses to rival Bibimi Kenranzaki. She remains Nejire's dedicated attendant and confidant throughout their time at UA.

Additional Information: Yuyu assists in powering UA's flying fortress through her Quirk and mentors junior students. She is diligent enough to be trusted with responsibility despite her emotional investment in her friendships.

cardPool.title: Yuga Aoyama
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Yuga Aoyama

Alias: Shining Hero: Can't Stop Twinkling

Quirk Name: Navel Laser

Occupation/Role: Class 1-A Student at UA High School

Personality: Vain and flamboyant with a closed smile, Yuga presents himself as superior and attention-seeking, often posing dramatically. He speaks with affected French mannerisms and ends sentences with stars (☆). Beneath this facade lies deep insecurity stemming from his Quirkless birth and complicated origins. He is prone to upset if interrupted or questioned.

Appearance: A slim young man with an effeminate face, long blonde hair spiked at the sides with a curved fringe, notably long eyelashes, and bright indigo eyes. His hero costume features a black bodysuit beneath metallic lavender armor with golden accents, including a high V-neck chest plate, spherical shoulder pads, elbow-length vambraces, and knee boots. A long glittery indigo cape flows from his golden ring-buckled belt with blue crystal. A red-tinted wing-shaped visor frames his eyes, with golden lines adorning his baggy pants and boots.

Backstory: Born Quirkless, Yuga faced discrimination and parental concern about his difference. His parents contacted All For One to grant him a Quirk, creating complicated circumstances surrounding his abilities and placing him in a position of hidden burden.

Additional Information: UA Class 1-A student in his first year. Despite his vain exterior, Yuga carries severe guilt and insecurity about his true nature and origins.

cardPool.title: Yui Kodai
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Yui Kodai

Alias:
Rule

Quirk Name:
Size

Occupation/Role:
UA High School Student, Class 1-B

Personality:
Quiet and emotionally reserved with a kūdere demeanor, rarely expressing feelings through words or facial expressions. Despite her silent nature, she genuinely cares for her classmates and shows warmth through subtle actions. She communicates happiness with soft "Mm!" sounds and displays particular enthusiasm for tomatoes.

Appearance:
A young girl with shoulder-length, bob-cut hair featuring side-swept bangs and fair skin. She has narrow cerulean eyes and an athletic build. Her hero costume consists of a red bodysuit with white-collar trim and a white "V" pattern across her chest and upper arms, paired with a short white skirt trimmed in red. She wears white vambraces with yellow accents, a red baseball-cap-style hat with white U-shaped lines and yellow dots, and carries pouches on her shoulder straps filled with small metal objects and components.

Backstory:
A first-year student at UA High School training to become a Pro Hero. Yui joined Class 1-B alongside her peers and has proven herself a reliable team player, particularly during training exercises and combat scenarios where her support abilities shine brightest.

Additional Information:
Her Quirk allows her to alter the size of any inanimate object she touches, returning them to normal size by pressing her fingertips together. She excels in collaborative tactics, using her power to enlarge weapons for allies or shrink items for surprise attacks. While lacking direct combat efficiency, her strategic support capability and excellent teamwork make her a valuable asset to any group.

cardPool.title: Yu Takeyama
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Yu Takeyama

Alias: Mt. Lady, Peak Hero: Mt. Lady

Quirk Name: Gigantification

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero (No. 23), UA High School Student, Class 1-A

Personality: Ambitious and egotistical, Yu thrives on attention and fame, unashamed of her vanity and use of sex appeal for popularity. She has a fierce temperament and lazy streak, but beneath her superficial nature lies genuine heroic courage—she protects civilians without hesitation and refuses to transform in confined spaces to prevent collateral damage.

Appearance: An above-average height young woman with fair skin and a curvaceous frame. She has striking magenta eyes with white pupils, long eyelashes, and voluminous creamy blonde hair reaching her waist with two shorter curled strands framing her face. Her hero costume consists of a purple and pale tan skin-tight bodysuit with orange stripe accents, purple gloves with orange cuffs, and thigh-cut purple boots. Three orange diamond-shaped marks sit beneath her chest, and she wears a purple domino mask with horn-like side protrusions.

Backstory: Yu discovered early that her Gigantification Quirk paired with her natural charisma could make her a star. She pursued heroics not out of pure altruism but for the glamour and fame the profession offers, becoming a rising hero who leverages her appearance as much as her powers.

Additional Information: Despite her self-serving attitude and tendency toward laziness during internships, Yu demonstrates authentic heroism when civilians are in danger. She is calculating enough to avoid destructive transformations in populated areas and bold enough to stand against major threats, suggesting her ambitions mask a capable and serious hero beneath the vanity.

cardPool.title: Yu Hojo
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Yu Hojo
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Crystallize
Occupation/Role: Eight Bullets member of the Shie Hassaikai yakuza organization
Personality: Serious and loyal to Overhaul, straightforward and brutish in combat. Yu harbors deep resentment from past abuse and views himself as worthless trash, but finds purpose and unwavering devotion through his yakuza family. He dismisses heroes as incapable of understanding the bonds between outcasts like himself.
Appearance: A tall, muscular man with a shaven head to maximize his Quirk efficiency and shadowed, intense eyes. He dresses in a dark dress shirt with the top buttons undone, plain pants, and black dress shoes. Unlike his fellow Eight Bullets, Yu wears a simple white medical mask over his mouth rather than their signature beaked masks.
Backstory: Yu was once employed to produce gems for a criminal, but when the minerals proved worthless, he was brutally beaten and left for dead in the streets. Overhaul discovered him and offered him a place in the Shie Hassaikai, giving the broken man a new purpose and family. Yu accepted without hesitation, transforming his despair into absolute loyalty.
Additional Information: Yu typically operates as part of a three-member combat unit with fellow Eight Bullets members Toya Setsuno and Soramitsu Tabe, employing devastating teamwork. His Crystallize Quirk allows him to manifest sharp crystalline structures across his body to enhance his melee attacks with tremendous force. He was eventually arrested after Overhaul's defeat.

cardPool.title: Yosetsu Awase
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Yosetsu Awase

Alias:
Welder

Quirk Name:
Weld

Occupation/Role:
Student, Class 1-B at U.A. High School

Personality:
Foul-mouthed and tense in everyday situations, but becomes startled and talkative during life-threatening crises. Very selfless and willing to put himself in danger for others. Proud and confident in his abilities, unbothered by class rivalries. Competent and strategic combatant with excellent tactical awareness.

Appearance:
Long black hair spiked upward and backward, with rounded gray eyes tilted inward. Wears a wide blue and white zig-zag patterned headband pulled low across his forehead. His hero costume is a burgundy, baggy full-body suit with collar extending past his chin, paired with dark brown shoulder pads, layered chest armor, white knee-high boots with brown accents, and two blue utility bags containing metal and wood blocks for Quirk support.

Backstory:
A talented student who ranked 10th in the U.A. Entrance Exam with the third-highest villain points. Yosetsu has trained rigorously to master his Quirk's potential as both an offensive and restraining tool, proving himself capable of outsmarting and subduing even Class 1-A's strongest students.

Additional Information:
Weld allows atomic-level fusion of objects he touches simultaneously, working on organic and inorganic material. Uses steel logs as extensions to bind distant targets without simultaneous contact. Demonstrates excellent stealth capabilities and tactical planning.

cardPool.title: Yoroi Musha
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Yoroi Musha

Alias: Equipped Hero: Yoroi Musha

Quirk Name: Unknown

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero (No. 9 ranking), mentor to UA Work-Study interns

Personality: Traditional and duty-bound, Yoroi Musha presents himself as a steadfast upholder of heroic ideals, though he struggles with conviction under pressure. He values the classical hero's role in society and initially claims his duties remain unchanged, yet later reveals his heroism was motivated by fame and respect rather than genuine altruism.

Appearance: An elderly man with a bald head and long white beard, distinguished by pale orange eyes with black sclera. He wears an imposing full suit of Japanese armor styled as his hero costume, complete with a prominent upward-pointing horn on his helmet and a crimson cape draped across his torso, giving him a formidable samurai-like presence.

Backstory: Yoroi Musha rose to prominence as the ninth-ranked Pro Hero through demonstrated skill and experience in combat. He mentored UA High School students during their Work-Study program, including Mina Ashido, Toru Hagakure, and Yuga Aoyama, establishing himself as a respected figure in the hero community before the Paranormal Liberation War shattered public confidence in heroes.

Additional Information: His Quirk remains unidentified but manifests as a white glow on his forehead. Despite his high ranking and capabilities, he lacks the resolve to withstand public scrutiny and controversy, ultimately retiring when heroic ideals are questioned.

cardPool.title: Yokumiru Mera
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Yokumiru Mera

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Unknown

Occupation/Role: Worker for the Hero Public Safety Commission; Acting President of the Commission

Personality: Perpetually sleep-deprived and blasé, Yokumiru complains frequently about exhaustion and overwork, maintaining a disinterested demeanor during duties. Despite his weariness, he occasionally demonstrates inspirational leadership and compassion, offering failed examinees remedial paths rather than dismissal. He maintains a mentor-like rapport with those he supervises, having successfully guided Hawks through morally complex training.

Appearance: A lanky, middle-aged man with chin-length, beige, and disheveled hair framing hollow, tired eyes marked by prominent under-eye bags from chronic sleep deprivation. He wears formal attire consisting of a black shirt over white undershirt, black pants, and a loose tie with black shoes. He carries a microphone for official announcements and speeches.

Backstory: A longtime Commission operative tasked with training promising hero candidates, Yokumiru earned respect through his successful mentorship of Hawks as a teenager. His competence led to his assignment supervising the Provisional Hero License Exam. Following the Paranormal Liberation Front's attack on Commission headquarters and the original President's death, Yokumiru assumed acting presidency before Hawks eventually succeeded him.

Additional Information: Known for his dry humor about exhaustion; supervises both formal licensing exams and remedial courses. Despite his tired demeanor, he demonstrates genuine interest in examining candidates' potential and providing second chances.

cardPool.title: Yoichi Shigaraki
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Yoichi Shigaraki

Alias: The First One For All User

Quirk Name: One For All

Occupation/Role: Historical figure; deceased hero whose will persists within the One For All Quirk

Personality: Principled and compassionate despite overwhelming hardship, Yoichi maintains unwavering moral conviction and hope for redemption even when betrayed. He refuses to use stolen power and advocates fiercely for justice, inspiring successive heroes through his embedded will within One For All. Though disgusted by his brother's cruelty, he never fully surrenders his love for him.

Appearance: A young man with sickly, malnourished features and a chronically weak physique. He has shoulder-length white messy hair with bangs that often obscure his bright green eyes. He typically wore simple clothing—a white shirt with dark pants and occasionally a light blue jacket. His frail build reflected lifelong physical frailty from birth.

Backstory: Born as the younger twin to Zen Shigaraki during the era of Quirk emergence, Yoichi was presumed Quirkless while watching his brother massacre innocents to steal their abilities. When forcibly given the Power Stock Quirk, it merged with his latent transfer ability, creating One For All. Too physically weak to effectively wield it, he was killed by his brother in a possessive rage—but his justice-driven will lived on within the Quirk, passing to rescuer Toshitsugu Kudo and countless successors sworn to stop All For One.

Additional Information: Yoichi's spirit within One For All actively guides his successors, particularly Izuku Midoriya, whom he deeply respects. He represents the antithesis to All For One's tyranny—proof that power rooted in compassion and sacrifice transcends stolen strength.

cardPool.title: X-Less
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: X-Less, Eye-Gun Hero: X-Less
Quirk Name: Laser
Occupation/Role: Pro Hero
Personality: Cautious and methodical, X-Less prioritizes safety and thorough investigation over rushing forward. He demonstrates tactical awareness by eliminating unknown threats before advancing, showing restraint and strategic thinking in dangerous situations.
Appearance: A lean man with an angular face featuring full lips and a distinctive undercut that extends from his neck to his forehead, with hair combed rightward. His right eye lacks a visible pupil, a defining feature of his Quirk. He wears a blue hero costume with contrasting light upper and dark lower sections, dark blue striped sleeves with three yellow accents, and a prominent red cape. A dark blue stripe wraps around his head over his right eye.
Backstory: X-Less rose through the ranks as a capable Pro Hero, earning recognition for his precision-based combat style. His cautious nature has served him well in field operations, though little is known of his personal origins or how he acquired his distinctive eye condition.
Additional Information: X-Less possesses the Laser Quirk, enabling him to fire concentrated energy beams from his right eye with significant destructive capability. His tactical mindset and combat experience make him a valuable member of hero raid teams. His cautious approach to unknown threats reflects his professional discipline and survival instinct.

cardPool.title: Yashamaru
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Yashamaru

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Unknown

Occupation/Role: Low-ranking villain, League of Villains recruit

Personality: Aggressive and direct, willing to charge headlong into combat without hesitation. Shows typical thug mentality, following orders from superiors like Tomura Shigaraki.

Appearance: Muscular build with spiky dark blond hair. Distinctive upward-curving horns protrude from his forehead. Sharp fangs visible in his mouth. Wears a black shirt and spiked bracelets on both wrists, giving him an intimidating appearance suited to villainy.

Backstory: A minor criminal recruited by the League of Villains to participate in the coordinated assault on the Unforeseen Simulation Joint. Among roughly seventy low-ranking villains assembled for the operation, Yashamaru served as disposable infantry in Tomura Shigaraki's plan to strike at UA High School.

Additional Information: Defeated during the U.S.J. incident by Ectoplasm's clones after being briefly stunned by Present Mic's Voice Quirk. Represents the expendable foot soldiers utilized by the League of Villains in their early operations.

cardPool.title: Wolfram
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Wolfram

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Metal Manipulation

Occupation/Role: Villain, Leader of Thief Troupe

Personality: Avaricious and manipulative, Wolfram cares only for himself and wealth. He enjoys taunting and tormenting others, mocking heroic ideals while inflating villainous ones. Cold and ruthless, he views people as tools to exploit or obstacles to crush.

Appearance: A tall, bulky man with dark red hair swept back and a central tuft. Yellow eyes, sharp features with a scar on his left cheek. Wears a large white coat with gray trimmings over dark combat gear, combat boots, and a metallic mask covering most of his face. Brown gloves conceal his hands. When powered by the Quirk Amplification Device, his eyes glow purple with blackened sclera.

Backstory: Wolfram leads a criminal organization posing as mercenaries. With backing from All For One, he orchestrated an elaborate scheme to gain David Shield's trust, steal his Quirk Amplification Device, and enslave him for further inventions. His ambition is to challenge and defeat All Might himself, armed with stolen technology and a second Quirk granted by All For One.

Additional Information: Wolfram possesses two Quirks: Metal Manipulation (his own) allows reshaping metal on contact for offense and defense; Muscle Augmentation (from All For One) drastically increases physical strength. He carries a handgun and the stolen Quirk Amplification Device that amplifies both Quirks' range and power. Even without amplification, he easily overpowered Class 1-A students.

cardPool.title: Woman
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Woman
Quirk Name: Multiple (Liquification, Rupture, and others absorbed)
Occupation/Role: High-End Nomu, Doctor Garaki's Combat Unit
Personality: Aggressive and bloodthirsty with surprising intelligence; analytical in combat, quickly deducing opponent abilities and testing their limits. Speaks coherently and strategically despite her monstrous nature.
Appearance: Feminine humanoid frame with exposed musculature, visible brain at crown of head with flayed scalp attached as fin-like structure at back. Two rows of long, jagged teeth hidden within her chin. Stitches along legs, protruding vertebrae down her spine, flayed skin structures on both elbows, dark hair at back of head.
Backstory: Once a combat-oriented villain, Woman was selected by Doctor Kyudai Garaki and transformed into a High-End Nomu through his experimentation. Released prematurely during Mirko's raid on Jaku General Hospital, she led the assault against pro heroes but was ultimately defeated by Endeavor when her regeneration was compromised.
Additional Information: High-End Nomu possess enhanced durability, multiple absorbed Quirks, and tactical intellect. Woman demonstrated ability to analyze and counter Eraser Head's Quirk-suppression by avoiding his line of sight, and combined Liquification and Rupture abilities for devastating attacks.

cardPool.title: Wolf Villain
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Wolf Villain
Quirk Name: Unnamed Wolf Quirk
Occupation/Role: Villain
Personality: Aggressive and predatory, targeting those he perceives as weaker. Shows sadistic tendencies, particularly toward children and small animals. Impulsive and easily distracted.
Appearance: Wolf-like humanoid with brown fur covering his body, yellow bloodshot eyes, and a black-tipped tongue from Trigger drug abuse. Wears a navy-blue vest over his fur and tan pants. His true appearance prior to drug use remains unknown.
Backstory: A villain addicted to Trigger, a performance-enhancing drug that likely exacerbates his aggressive nature. Encountered by The Crawler and Eraser Head while hunting a child and kitten. Apprehended by Eraser Head's Binding Cloth and arrested by police.
Additional Information: Confirmed Trigger user. His wolf-based Quirk grants him lupine appearance and presumably enhanced physical abilities, though the extent of Trigger's influence on his form and powers is unclear. Operates as a street-level threat.

cardPool.title: Willy Wanda
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Willy Wanda

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Diesel Engine

Occupation/Role: Former Next-Level Villain

Personality: Pragmatic and mechanical in demeanor, Willy operates with a utilitarian mindset befitting his locomotive nature. He demonstrates loyalty to his villain faction but lacks the charisma of a leader.

Appearance: Willy's head and upper body are transformed into a functioning diesel train engine, complete with metallic plating, smokestacks, and mechanical components. His lower body remains human. He stands imposingly due to his locomotive modifications, presenting an industrial and intimidating silhouette.

Backstory: A member of the Next-Level Villains, Willy Wanda used his Diesel Engine Quirk to enforce the group's will during their operations. His transformation marked him as both a tool and a soldier within the villain hierarchy, though he eventually moved away from active villainy.

Additional Information: As a former villain, Willy operates outside UA High School and conventional hero society. His Quirk grants enhanced strength and momentum-based offensive capabilities tied to his train-like form. He represents the dangerous intersection of Quirk modification and criminal intent within vigilante circles.

cardPool.title: Watchbird
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Watchbird
Quirk Name: Unknown
Occupation/Role: Pro Hero, Sidekick, Member of Ingenium's Team Idaten
Personality: Professional and communicative, focused on team coordination and tactical awareness during hero operations.
Appearance: Young woman with sleek, brown hair pulled into a tight ponytail. Wears a light blue bodysuit with white tactical gear, gloves, and boots. Her costume features a white chest piece with two drone-like mechanical wings attached at the back, and a blue visor with integrated communicator that displays a green heads-up display for tracking opponents.
Backstory: A sidekick working under the pro hero Ingenium as part of Team Idaten, Watchbird has honed her abilities for hero work through professional training and experience in the field.
Additional Information: Her equipment emphasizes reconnaissance and team communication, suggesting her role focuses on support and tactical coordination rather than direct combat engagement.

cardPool.title: Victor
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Victor

Alias:
None

Quirk Name:
Unnamed Finger Gun Quirk

Occupation/Role:
Villain, member of the League of Villains' Shooting Squad

Personality:
Confident in his combat abilities, willing to challenge professional heroes despite low rank. Limited personality data available; demonstrates obedience to Tomura Shigaraki's command structure.

Appearance:
A man with reddish-brown hair and matching eyes. His fingertips have mutated into gun muzzles as a result of his Quirk. He wears a gray tank top and matching pants, adorned with two gold chains on each wrist. A metallic helmet obscures most of his head, featuring two greenish-blue luminous eye holes for vision.

Backstory:
Victor was recruited as one of approximately seventy low-ranking villains by Tomura Shigaraki for the coordinated assault on the Unforeseen Simulation Joint. He served in the Shooting Squad alongside Stitched Giant and Needle Hair, positioned to ambush U.A. High School's first-year students during their Quirk Apprehension Test training exercise.

Additional Information:
Victor was swiftly incapacitated by Eraser Head during the U.S.J. invasion when his Quirk was disabled by the hero's Erasure ability. He briefly regained consciousness before being definitively defeated and arrested alongside other recruited villains. He was later included in manipulated footage of the Deika City battle as evidence against the League of Villains.

cardPool.title: Varanus
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Varanus

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Unknown

Occupation/Role: Low-ranking Villain, League of Villains member

Personality: Aggressive and combative; willing to follow orders from higher-ranking villains. Demonstrates typical henchman mentality with little individual initiative.

Appearance: A short man with a pronounced hunchback and elongated neck, creating a distinctly reptilian silhouette. He wears a bleached animal skull as a mask covering his face, has crimson lines tattooed or painted across his arms, and dons green pants with a black belt. His hunched posture and thin frame emphasize his lizard-like physiology.

Backstory: Varanus was recruited as one of approximately seventy low-ranking villains by Tomura Shigaraki for the coordinated assault on the Unforeseen Simulation Joint. He participated in the attack wave against Pro Hero Shota Aizawa but was swiftly subdued by Aizawa's Binding Cloth combat technique. He was subsequently apprehended along with the other recruited villains.

Additional Information: Varanus is a minor antagonist active during the U.S.J. Arc. His Quirk remains undocumented. He represents the expendable foot soldier tier of League of Villains operations, lacking the notoriety or combat prowess of named members.

cardPool.title: Valdo Gollini
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Valdo Gollini

Alias: Dark Might

Quirk Name: Alchemy

Occupation/Role: Villain Leader of the Gollini Family Mafia (Europe-based criminal organization)

Personality: Ruthless and power-obsessed, driven by obsessive admiration for All Might's physical strength while lacking understanding of true heroism. Calculative and willing to eliminate anyone, even family, to achieve his goals. Arrogant and vain, seeking to become the next Symbol of Peace through force rather than virtue.

Appearance: Naturally a lean Italian man with sunken green eyes, slicked-back black hair, and a thin stubble mustache. Typically wears dark formal attire—black blazers, vests, and bowties. His Dark Might form, achieved through his Quirk, transforms him into a muscular blond-haired figure resembling a younger All Might, though with bushier eyebrows, a larger hooked nose, and retaining green eyes with dark markings. He wears a white tuxedo suit with black accents, pale blue bowtie, red rose lapel pin, and eight golden All Might-emblazoned rings.

Backstory: Born into the Gollini Family mafia in Europe, Valdo rose through ruthlessness and ambition, eventually murdering his own father to seize control. A devoted admirer of All Might's overwhelming power, he became obsessed with replicating and surpassing that strength, failing to recognize that All Might's true heroism stemmed from his compassionate will to help others rather than mere physical dominance.

Additional Information: Uses his Alchemy Quirk to fundamentally alter his physical appearance and capabilities. His pursuit of power through his Quirk is potentially unlimited, capable of absorbing and integrating other Quirks to achieve increasingly destructive forms.

cardPool.title: Uwabami
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Uwabami
Alias: Snake Hero: Uwabami
Quirk Name: Serpentine
Occupation/Role: Pro Hero, Celebrity, Mentor
Personality: Celebrity-minded and vain, prioritizing modeling work over heroics, yet capable and level-headed in crisis situations. Charming but honest about her shallow motivations, she mentors based on appearance rather than pure merit, though she maintains professional obligations.
Appearance: Curvy woman with long, voluminous blonde hair styled in ringlets with a distinctive curved plate holding folded back curls. Golden eyes with vertically slit pupils. Three living snakes—a rattlesnake, yellow King cobra, and Japanese rat snake—protrude from her hair. Wears a maroon scale-patterned dress, matching high heels, and a choker with golden snake bracelets on wrists and ankles.
Backstory: A celebrated Pro Hero who leveraged her serpent-based Quirk into a lucrative celebrity career combining heroics with commercial modeling. She selected promising UA students Momo Yaoyorozu and Itsuka Kendo for internships based on their appearance while providing genuine professional guidance through patrol work and commercial appearances.
Additional Information: Uwabami demonstrates genuine heroic capability despite her superficial priorities, participating in major rescue operations following All Might's final battle and assisting in high-stakes missions. She openly acknowledges that heroes can pursue side careers while maintaining hero work obligations.

cardPool.title: Untenmaru Kurumada
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Untenmaru Kurumada
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Unknown
Occupation/Role: Endeavor's Personal Chauffeur
Personality: Stern and aggressive with a sharp tongue, unafraid to voice complaints or criticism even in his employer's presence. Despite his gruff demeanor, he demonstrates loyalty and concern for Endeavor's safety, offering practical advice after dangerous incidents.
Appearance: A middle-aged man with a rectangular face and narrow, furrowed eyes that give him a perpetually stern expression. He has short black hair swept upward at the crown, and sports a distinctive large white fluffy mustache that parts in the middle with matching facial hair lining his chin. He dresses professionally in a dark formal suit with black dress shirt and white tie, completing his look with white driving gloves.
Backstory: Long-serving chauffeur and trusted employee of the hero Endeavor, Untenmaru has earned enough standing in the household to speak frankly about his boss's decisions and associations. He serves as both driver and informal advisor, present during critical moments including villain encounters and family visits.
Additional Information: Not a UA High School student. Operates as support staff during Endeavor's internship program, responsible for transporting students and equipment. Demonstrates willingness to engage with volatile personalities like Bakugo despite their rudeness.

cardPool.title: Ugo Gollini
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Ugo Gollini

Alias:
None

Quirk Name:
Telekinesis

Occupation/Role:
Member of the Gollini Family mafia

Personality:
Despite his elderly appearance, Ugo is surprisingly energetic and crude, constantly mocking enemies with jokes and taunts. He enjoys toying with opponents but will abandon banter immediately when family objectives take priority, showing ruthless pragmatism beneath his playful demeanor.

Appearance:
A short, elderly man with disproportionately long arms and short legs. His most striking feature is his long, curved nose adorned with a thick grey moustache. He wears a dark tailored suit with jacket and gray bow-tie, a black fedora hat, and dark sunglasses that obscure his eyes. Grey sideburns frame his face, and a red rose corsage adorns his jacket lapel.

Backstory:
Ugo is a seasoned member of the Gollini Family crime organization, serving as an enforcer alongside other family operatives. His long tenure and powerful Quirk make him a valuable asset to the family's criminal enterprises.

Additional Information:
His Telekinesis Quirk grants him immense destructive power—capable of demolishing buildings and shattering ice with ease. When augmented by Anna's Overmodification technique, his ability to control multiple objects simultaneously increases dramatically. He demonstrates willingness to eliminate or dispose of family members without hesitation if mission objectives demand it.

cardPool.title: Tsuyoshi
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Tsuyoshi
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Bristle
Occupation/Role: Civilian Child
Personality: Confident in his abilities but easily intimidated by bullies despite his bravado; readily impressed by heroes yet quick to judge them harshly for unusual behavior. Passionate about football and willing to save money for what he wants.
Appearance: Young boy with dark, short hair spiked downward with a few upward spikes, notably one especially large spike. Wears a hooded shirt, shorts, and sneakers typical of a child his age.
Backstory: A civilian boy living in a world of heroes and villains, warned by his mother to be cautious of danger. He possesses confidence in his Quirk's protective capabilities despite his inexperience with actual threats.
Additional Information: Not a UA student. His Quirk allows him to harden his hair to superhuman density, making it a potential defensive or offensive tool. His overconfidence in his powers contrasts sharply with his fear response to social confrontation.

cardPool.title: Tsutsutaka Agoyamato
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Tsutsutaka Agoyamato

Alias:
None

Quirk Name:
Unknown

Occupation/Role:
U.A. High School General Department Student

Personality:
Initially critical and resentful of Class 1-A's prominence, believing their conflicts endanger the entire school. However, he is capable of humility and introspection—after witnessing their exceptional performance at the festival, he openly apologizes for his negativity. Shows civic responsibility by assisting civilians during crises and maintains respect for upperclassmen like Nejire Hado.

Appearance:
A tall young man with a distinctively large, prominent chin that mirrors the shape of his dark pompadour hairstyle. He wears the standard male U.A. High School uniform during school hours. His facial features are angular and imposing, giving him a stern appearance despite his youthful age.

Backstory:
A General Department student at U.A. who initially harbored resentment toward Class 1-A for drawing villainous attention to the school. His prejudice was challenged during the school festival when Class 1-A's performance exceeded all expectations, prompting genuine remorse. During the Final War, he demonstrated character by helping evacuate civilians from collapsing bunkers.

Additional Information:
Maintains friendships within the General Department, particularly with Chikuchi Togeike. Attends important school events and shows growth from his initial antagonism toward the Hero Course students. His quirk ability remains undisclosed.

cardPool.title: Tsunagu Hakamada
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Tsunagu Hakamada

Alias:
Fiber Hero: Best Jeanist

Quirk Name:
Fiber Master

Occupation/Role:
Pro Hero (currently No. 5 ranked)

Personality:
An elegant, flamboyant man who believes those with influence must maintain positive appearance and behavior. He is selfless, brave, and charismatic, using fabric-based metaphors to inspire others. Tsunagu takes heroism seriously and refuses to make excuses, though he dislikes brutish individuals and their lack of refinement.

Appearance:
Exceptionally tall and slim with an unnaturally long, flexible neck and dark, heavily-lashed eyes that tilt slightly inward. His long blonde hair is combed drastically to the left, covering his left eye. He wears a denim hero costume consisting of a high-collared shirt covering his face below the nose, denim waistcoat with large breast pockets, jeans, two belts, and short dark brown boots with gray shafts.

Backstory:
Once ranked No. 3 Hero and recipient of the "Best Jeanist" award for eight consecutive years, Tsunagu has maintained his position as one of Japan's elite defenders. He accepted the challenging task of mentoring young hero students to refine their character, believing that even the most difficult individuals can improve with proper guidance.

Additional Information:
His Quirk allows him to unravel and manipulate fabric from his denim-covered costume into controllable fiber strings for restraint and combat. He can also manipulate allies' clothing for defensive maneuvers. Tsunagu has proven capable of restraining multiple powerful opponents simultaneously.

cardPool.title: Tsumuji Kazetani
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Tsumuji Kazetani

Alias: Gust Boy

Quirk Name: Fan

Occupation/Role: Villain

Personality: Strategic and calculated, Tsumuji approaches combat with precision. He respects the limitations of his own power and plans accordingly, avoiding overuse despite the temptation to dominate through overwhelming force.

Appearance: Tsumuji is a lean man of average height with light brown skin and an elongated face with a protruding mouth. His grayish-blue hair is tied back in a ponytail. His mutated hands are oversized with bright orange, flexible fingers that function as fan blades. He wears a black sleeveless unitard with a purple belt, teal sneakers fitted with small fans, goggles for eye protection, and carries a desk fan attached to his back.

Backstory: Tsumuji's Quirk manifested as a mutation, transforming his hands into functional fan blades. He weaponized this ability and turned to villainy, becoming a threat during the early days of Class 1-A's emergence as heroes-in-training.

Additional Information: Fan Quirk allows wind generation and tornado creation but is limited to one-minute intervals; exceeding this causes Tenosynovitis in his hands. Carries multiple knives and a paper fan-shaped blade as backup weapons. Operates independently as a villain threat.

cardPool.title: Tsubasa
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Tsubasa

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Unnamed Wing Quirk

Occupation/Role: Civilian (formerly childhood friend of Bakugo)

Personality: Arrogant and callous bully who admired strength in others and readily participated in tormenting the weak, particularly those without Quirks. He was easily influenced by stronger personalities like Bakugo.

Appearance: A stocky youth with a rounded face and short brown hair that is nearly shaved. Two prominent red, draconic wings protrude from his back at will. In childhood he wore a simple tank top, green shorts, and geta sandals.

Backstory: Tsubasa grew up in the same neighborhood as Katsuki Bakugo and Izuku Midoriya. He idolized Bakugo's natural talent and joined him in bullying Midoriya after the boy was declared Quirkless. The three boys had once ventured into a forbidden forest area where Bakugo fell into a stream—an incident that deeply affected their friendships. As they entered middle school, Tsubasa drifted away from both Bakugo and Midoriya, parting ways entirely.

Additional Information: Tsubasa is the grandson of Dr. Tsubasa. He is not a UA High School student and has not pursued a hero career. His current whereabouts and activities remain unknown as of the Quirk Apprehension Test arc.

cardPool.title: Trapezius Headgear
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Unknown

Alias:
Trapezius Headgear

Quirk Name:
Trap Flex

Occupation/Role:
C-rank Villain

Personality:
Cruel and cowardly, prone to mocking opponents while relying on hostage threats rather than direct combat. Arrogant about his strength and quick to brag, yet demonstrates cowardice when facing genuine threats.

Appearance:
An enormous, muscular humanoid with pink skin and an unusual fleshy extension growing from his shoulders that curves up and over his head like a hood, concealing most of his face except for round white eyes and a large mouth. He wears an armored half-vest with a chain draped over his right shoulder and cargo pants with additional plating.

Backstory:
A minor criminal who terrorized towns while taking hostages. He was quickly defeated by All Might during a hostage situation involving Mt. Lady and Kamui Woods. Imprisoned after his capture, he was released when All For One escaped from Tartarus and subsequently assaulted prisons nationwide. Later conscripted into the Paranormal Liberation Front's Final War effort.

Additional Information:
His Quirk grants him enhanced strength and speed through extreme muscle flexion, though his power is significantly inferior to One For All. Demonstrates tactical cowardice by using hostages as shields rather than engaging heroes directly in combat.

cardPool.title: Toya Setsuno
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Toya Setsuno

Alias: Eight Bullets member

Quirk Name: Larceny

Occupation/Role: Subordinate of Kai Chisaki and member of the Shie Hassaikai criminal organization

Personality: Fanatic and outspoken, mentally unstable from past trauma. Devoted to his organization and unafraid of death, viewing himself and fellow members as "human garbage" bonded by shared despair. Bitter and cynical, yet capable of tactical thinking in combat situations.

Appearance: Tall, lean young man with light almond-shaped eyes featuring small irises and prominent dark circles. Chin-length bright golden-blond hair parted left to obscure his right eye. Wide mouth with straight teeth and thin upturned eyebrows giving him a crazed expression. Wears a gray dress shirt, light orange tie, dark pants, and a beak-shaped plague mask standard to the Eight Bullets.

Backstory: Once lived a normal life until betrayed by a lover, leaving him in crushing debt. Attempted suicide by jumping from a cliff but was rescued by a hero, deepening his despair. Found by Kai Chisaki on the streets, he accepted an offer to join the Shie Hassaikai, becoming an Eight Bullets member with nowhere else to turn.

Additional Information: Specializes in disarming opponents using Larceny to steal weapons, creating openings for teammates. Works effectively with Yu Hojo and Soramitsu Tabe through coordinated teamwork. Skilled at luring enemies into tactical disadvantages during combat.

cardPool.title: Toy-Toy
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Toy-Toy
Quirk Name: Unknown
Occupation/Role: Pro Hero
Personality: Spirited and vocal, Toy-Toy is quick to voice her opinions during combat, openly criticizing unsportsmanlike behavior. She demonstrates camaraderie with fellow heroes and maintains composure during high-stakes missions.
Appearance: Young woman with long, messy light brown hair and matching eyes. Wears a light pink fluffy sleeveless crop top with matching skirt, arm sleeves, and boots. Her distinctive costume includes grey gloves and a dog-headed hat with buggy eyes and a round black nose, featuring red eyes with green irises.
Backstory: An established Pro Hero known for her analytical capabilities in the field. Toy-Toy attended the U.A. Sports Festival as an observer and has participated in major hero operations including the Jaku Hospital Raid and the Final War against Tomura Shigaraki and All For One.
Additional Information: Her combat abilities remain largely undocumented, but she specializes in data analysis to accelerate search and reconnaissance efforts during hero missions. She has proven herself reliable in large-scale operations alongside other Pro Heroes.

cardPool.title: Toxic Chainsaw
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Toxic Chainsaw
Quirk Name: Unknown
Occupation/Role: Villain
Personality: Cruel and ruthless, implied to be arrogant given his confrontation with All Might; details remain sparse and enigmatic.
Appearance: Shoulder-length, slimy hair frames a sharp, angular face with prominent jawline and pointed chin. Heavily muscular and well-built physique with an outie belly button. Wears no shirt, baggy pants adorned with skull-shaped kneepads, and army boots.
Backstory: A formidable villain who engaged All Might in combat five years before the series began. Managed to land blows on the Number One Hero, earning infamy and speculation that he inflicted All Might's iconic chest scar, though All Might dismisses this possibility. His current whereabouts remain unknown.
Additional Information: Wields a chainsaw as a primary weapon. Possesses a powerful Quirk of unknown nature and name. Despite his notoriety, relatively little concrete information exists about his true capabilities or origins.

cardPool.title: Tough Grab
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Tough Grab
Quirk Name: Unknown
Occupation/Role: Pro Hero, Sidekick to Ingenium
Personality: Professional and duty-bound, displaying the demeanor of an experienced hero who works efficiently within a support role.
Appearance: A wide-framed, burly man with a chiseled jaw and pupilless eyes. He has short, flattop blonde hair. His hero costume includes black tank top over a pale brown sleeveless vest, jeans with a silver-buckled belt, brown shin-high work boots, and distinctive oversized armored gloves with cuffs extending to mid-forearm.
Backstory: An established pro hero operating as a trusted sidekick under Ingenium's command, Tough Grab has built a reputation as a reliable field operative in the hero society.
Additional Information: His Quirk and combat abilities remain largely undocumented. His armor-heavy glove design suggests a focus on grappling or physical restraint techniques. Active during the early period of hero society.

cardPool.title: Toshitsugu Kudo
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Toshitsugu Kudo

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Gearshift

Occupation/Role: Resistance leader and second user of One For All

Personality: Battle-hardened and serious with a stern sense of justice, holding rigid black-and-white moral views shaped by warfare. Initially cynical and uncompromising in his mission to defeat All For One, though capable of empathy—evident when he chose to save Yoichi rather than kill him. Prideful and fearless, showing no hesitation even facing death.

Appearance: Short, spiky ginger-salmon hair with slanted downward-gazing red eyes. Wears a green combat jacket with a large black collar and imposing gauntlets used to channel his Quirk offensively. Lean but muscular build suggesting years of combat experience.

Backstory: A veteran soldier who rose to lead a resistance movement against All For One during the chaotic early era of Meta Abilities. Devoted his entire life to one singular goal: eliminating the tyrannical villain. His pivotal act of mercy—saving Yoichi Shigaraki despite his allegiance to All For One—led him to become the second user of One For All, cementing his status as the person All For One despises most.

Additional Information: Deceased before the series begins. Represents the ideological predecessor to Izuku Midoriya, eventually learning to value Izuku's belief that good exists in everyone's heart despite initially dismissing it as naïve optimism.

cardPool.title: Toru Hagakure
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Toru Hagakure

Alias:
Stealth Hero: Invisible Girl

Quirk Name:
Invisibility

Occupation/Role:
Class 1-A Student, UA High School

Personality:
Bubbly, cheery, and easygoing with an upbeat attitude toward most situations. Socially eager and enjoys shopping and gossip with classmates. Romantically inclined and curious about others' interests. Energetic yet focused and reliable in battle, always ready to help teammates. Observant and perceptive despite her playful demeanor. Somewhat naive about the implications of her invisibility in social situations.

Appearance:
A reasonably short girl with a completely invisible body, identifiable only through worn clothing and accessories. When her Quirk glitches, she reveals a slim, curvy figure with long, wavy, multi-colored hair (chartreuse with lime, yellow, pink, turquoise, and light blue strands), bushy colorful eyelashes, and large round eyes with teal-yellow irises. At UA, she wears the standard female uniform: gray dress jacket with teal stripes, white shirt, red tie, teal pleated skirt, brown shoes, and knee-high socks. Her hero costume consists of simple pale pink-lined light blue gloves and beige lace-up shoes.

Backstory:
An aspiring pro hero training at UA High School alongside Class 1-A. Her invisibility Quirk makes her ideal for stealth operations, though she's still learning to master combat applications. She participates in school activities and forms strong bonds with her female classmates through shared interests and late-night conversations.

Additional Information:
Believes removing her clothes during combat is tactically advantageous. Maintains an optimistic outlook even when circumstances are grim. Possesses keen observational skills that occasionally reveal deeper truths about those around her.

cardPool.title: Tomoyasu Chikazoku
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Tomoyasu Chikazoku

Alias: Skeptic

Quirk Name: Puppet Master

Occupation/Role: Board member at Feel Good, Inc.; Leading member of the Meta Liberation Army; Lieutenant of the Paranormal Liberation Front

Personality: Steadfast ideologue devoted to Quirk liberation doctrine and deeply loyal to his commanders. Stern and condescending toward others, easily irritated by slow comprehension, yet capable of tactical camaraderie when serving shared goals. In combat, ruthless and calculating, employing psychological warfare without hesitation. Becomes unhinged and obsessive when facing failure, which he deeply fears.

Appearance: Tall and lanky with shoulder-length shiny black hair parted by a neat fringe obscuring his wide eyes with small gray irises. His face features a notably long nose and wide mouth with straight teeth. Typically wears a long-sleeved black turtleneck beneath a formal black jacket with dark pants, presenting an air of corporate professionalism.

Backstory: A brilliant technologist who built Feel Good, Inc.'s systems from scratch, Chikazoku secretly rose through the ranks of the Meta Liberation Army as a leading ideologue. He became instrumental in orchestrating operations for Quirk liberation, eventually securing a position as lieutenant when the Army merged with the League of Villains into the Paranormal Liberation Front.

Additional Information: Not a UA student. Highly intelligent strategist who commands from secure positions using puppet duplicates as expendable assets. Possesses deep-seated fear of failure that triggers psychological instability when facing defeat.

cardPool.title: Tomoko Shiretoko
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Tomoko Shiretoko

Alias: Ragdoll

Quirk Name: Search

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero No. 32, Member of the Wild, Wild Pussycats

Personality: Hyperactive and energetic with constant motion and wide-eyed enthusiasm, though capable of genuine concern for others. Highly motivated and unwilling to let obstacles prevent her from helping those in need.

Appearance: Young woman of medium height with long, flowing emerald green hair and large round yellow eyes with three small eyelashes on each. She wears a yellow version of the Pussycats hero costume adorned with pink whisker marks on her cheeks and a pink circle around her right eye.

Backstory: A powerful rescue and support hero known for her exceptional ability to locate disaster victims and monitor allies during dangerous operations. Recently kidnapped during a villain invasion, resulting in the loss of her Quirk at the hands of a powerful enemy.

Additional Information: Formerly capable of observing and monitoring up to 100 people simultaneously, tracking their locations and weak points with perfect memory recall. Now Quirkless, but remains dedicated to hero work and her Pussycats teammates through alternative means.

cardPool.title: Tommy S. Gordon
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Tommy S. Gordon

Alias:
Tank Engine

Quirk Name:
Tank Engine

Occupation/Role:
Former Next-Level Villain

Personality:
Aggressive and easily provoked, Tommy becomes enraged by opposition and continues attacking despite ineffective results. He demonstrates loyalty to allies, cheering for The Crawler during combat, suggesting underlying camaraderie among villain associates.

Appearance:
Tommy's head and upper torso are composed of a steam-powered locomotive with a large, cartoonish face emblazoned on the smokebox. His lower half is covered by a dark bodysuit with matching gloves and boots, accented by a decorative belt at the waist. His train-like construction gives him an imposing, mechanical silhouette.

Backstory:
Once part of the Next-Level Villains, Tommy operated in the Naruhata district before his arrest by Eraser Head. He was encountered by The Crawler while chasing civilians, leading to intervention by heroes including Midnight and Eraser Head. His defeat marked a turning point, though he later demonstrated continued association with other former villains.

Additional Information:
Not a UA student. Tommy's Quirk provides considerable physical mass and locomotive-based power, making him a dangerous combatant. His vulnerability to precise, coordinated hero action suggests his strength lies primarily in direct confrontation rather than tactical fighting.

cardPool.title: Tomie Takami
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Tomie Takami
Alias: Mrs. Takami
Quirk Name: Unknown
Occupation/Role: Homemaker, Mother
Personality: Emotionally withdrawn and deeply broken, Tomie is a woman haunted by her choices. She harbors conflicted feelings—deeply devoted to her husband yet resentful of their forced union, neglectful toward her son yet capable of regret. Cowardly and prone to avoidance, she struggles to confront difficult truths, though glimpses of maternal pride and remorse occasionally surface beneath her damaged exterior.
Appearance: A middle-aged woman of average height with thick, feathery copper-colored hair draping to her shoulders, resembling bird down. Her sunken gray-blue eyes are distinctive, with two additional floating eyeballs circling her head. She typically wears either a tight white dress with black horizontal stripes or a baggy gray-blue dress with long sleeves.
Backstory: Tomie met her husband years ago and harbored him after he committed murder, forcing them into isolation where their son Keigo was conceived. During his childhood, she provided minimal emotional support, watching passively as her husband abused the boy. When her husband was arrested by Endeavor, she and Keigo were left homeless and destitute. Though Keigo's rise with the Hero Public Safety Commission eventually provided them stability, Tomie's cowardice prevented her from truly reconciling with her son.
Additional Information: Not a UA student. Mother of Hawks/Keigo Takami. Her Quirk remains unspecified in available information. Deeply traumatized by her circumstances and choices.

cardPool.title: Togaru Kamakiri
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Togaru Kamakiri

Alias: Jack Mantis

Quirk Name: Razor Sharp

Occupation/Role: UA High School Student, Class 1-B

Personality: Hotblooded and aggressive with a passion for combat, yet surprisingly cordial and supportive of classmates. Competitive and eager in battle, viewing rivals like Bakugo with respect. Excitable during fights but level-headed enough to offer encouragement after defeats.

Appearance: Tall and slender with pale yellow-green skin and a bright, fluffy green mohawk. Pointed dark green eyes angled downward, two hooked blades protruding from his cheeks, and a mantis-like head shape with no visible nose. Wears a large dark green rugged cloak over a zigzag-patterned shirt, black trousers, dark green three-toed boots, and an eye mask.

Backstory: A dedicated hero student training at UA High School alongside Class 1-B. Serves as gym buddies with Tetsutetsu Tetsutetsu and has developed a rivalry with Bakugo's arrogance. Known for his sharp reflexes and combat prowess, particularly demonstrated when blocking Bakugo's point-blank explosion.

Additional Information: His Quirk produces blades from any body part, capable of cutting steel and iron while withstanding explosive force. Participated eagerly in Joint Training exercises and shows genuine care for teammates' growth and morale.

cardPool.title: Timothy Agpar
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Timothy Agpar

Alias: Commander Agpar

Quirk Name: Unknown

Occupation/Role: American Military Commander, U.S. Armed Forces

Personality: Calm, collected, and principled despite facing chaos; maintains composure in crisis while respecting reckless allies. Demonstrates strong moral conviction, opposing appeasement to villains and advocating for decisive action. Deeply respects heroism and places faith in heroes as inspirational figures for future generations.

Appearance: A man with distinctive turquoise skin, an elongated bald head, bushy whiskers, and large protruding eyes giving him an otherworldly appearance. He dresses formally in business suits and ties befitting his military command position, maintaining a professional demeanor.

Backstory: Timothy serves as a high-ranking commander in the U.S. military and trusted ally of the American hero Star and Stripe. Following the collapse of hero society in Japan during the Paranormal Liberation War, he coordinated international response efforts and authorized military strikes against the emerging global threat posed by Tomura Shigaraki, ultimately authorizing thermonuclear missiles in a desperate attempt to contain the villain.

Additional Information: Timothy is not a UA student but an American military official operating at the international level. He values heroic sacrifice and fiercely opposes political surrender to villainous forces. His character embodies principled leadership during unprecedented global crisis.

cardPool.title: Thousand Eyes
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Thousand Eyes
Quirk Name: Curse
Occupation/Role: Villain, League of Villains Associate
Personality: Confident in combat abilities despite limited demonstrated skill; willing to assault UA High School; motivations and deeper personality largely unknown.
Appearance: A humanoid figure composed entirely of paper runes with a pale, inscribed surface. Large red eyes mark his face, chest, and limbs—one on his face, two on each arm, one on each thigh, one at his chest center. He possesses five square fingers on each hand but featureless square feet lacking toes.
Backstory: A minor villain recruited by Tomura Shigaraki as one of approximately seventy combatants for the assault on the Unforeseen Simulation Joint. His origins and motivations remain obscure, though his willingness to face UA's faculty suggests either significant confidence or desperation.
Additional Information: E-rank villain; defeated by Eraser Head during the USJ invasion and subsequently arrested. His paper-composite body grants extreme lightness, allowing rapid movement and evasion tactics.

cardPool.title: The Realist
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: The Realist
Quirk Name: Truth Inducement
Occupation/Role: Villain
Personality: Bitter, disenchanted idealist consumed by rejection and resentment. Initially passionate about his causes, he has become manipulative and vengeful, seeking to spread misery to others as compensation for his own suffering. He rationalizes his cruelty as exposing truth.
Appearance: Bald man of average height wearing a black hoodie with a large white "R" emblazoned on the chest. Black makeup runs in straight lines down his face from beneath both eyes, giving him a striking, theatrical appearance befitting his obsession with the idol industry.
Backstory: Once an ardent idol fan, he was humiliated when rejected at a meet-and-greet and accidentally revealed his idol's true contempt for her fanbase. This rejection transformed him into a zealot determined to expose the idol industry's exploitation. He gathered similarly scorned fans and began systematically destroying idols' reputations at public events.
Additional Information: His Quirk forces victims to speak their true thoughts involuntarily upon physical contact; victims remain unaware they are being manipulated. He was captured by a Team-Up mission led by Mirko at an idol convention after attempting to use his Quirk on disguised Class 1-B heroes.

cardPool.title: The Mother of Quirks
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: The Mother of Quirks
Quirk Name: Unknown
Occupation/Role: Activist, Mother
Personality: Affectionate and protective toward her son, displaying remarkable willpower and idealism despite fierce social opposition. She was compassionate and vocal about her beliefs in equality for Quirk users, refusing to accept the hatred and discrimination of her era.
Appearance: A woman with long, brown hair. Details beyond this are sparse, as historical records of her are limited.
Backstory: Born during the chaotic early era when Meta Abilities (later called Quirks) were feared and their users violently persecuted, she gave birth to a son with a Quirk. Witnessing his marginalization and suffering, she became an outspoken advocate against discrimination, coining the term "Quirk" to reframe Meta Abilities as natural individual traits rather than monstrous powers. She was murdered by an Anti-Quirk faction for her activism, but her legacy endured—the government later adopted her terminology when establishing social order, unknowingly immortalizing her as "The Mother of Quirks."
Additional Information: Her son, Chikara Yotsubashi (Destro), later founded the Meta Liberation Army to reclaim what he believed was his mother's true vision of freedom, feeling the government had corrupted her ideals through restrictive Quirk regulations.

cardPool.title: The Fly
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: The Fly
Quirk Name: Fly
Occupation/Role: Pro Hero
Personality: Reserved and professional; limited information available, but demonstrates courage and teamwork when facing dangerous threats alongside other heroes.
Appearance: Tall man with long, light blond hair reaching his feet and long bangs covering the left side of his face. Wears a short-sleeved shirt, white shorts, dark boots, two large armbands on his biceps, and a thin red headband. Two long wing-like appendages protrude from his arms.
Backstory: An established Pro Hero operating in Japan's hero society. The Fly was present in Hosu City during a major Nomu attack orchestrated by Tomura Shigaraki, where he fought alongside fellow heroes to contain the creatures until Endeavor's arrival.
Additional Information: The Fly's wing-like appendages grant him aerial mobility and combat capabilities. He demonstrates competence in crisis situations and inter-hero cooperation, though the Nomu threat proved beyond his individual capacity to handle.

cardPool.title: Tetsutetsu Tetsutetsu
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Tetsutetsu Tetsutetsu

Alias: Real Steel

Quirk Name: Steel

Occupation/Role: UA High School Student, Class 1-B

Personality: Hotheaded, outspoken, and fiercely determined to prove Class 1-B's worth against Class 1-A. Confident and straightforward, though stubborn with a one-track mind. Despite his abrasiveness, he is loyal and protective of his peers, showing genuine care for classmates.

Appearance: A young man with chin-length messy gray hair and black inward-tilted eyes rimmed with thick, jagged tan-colored eyelashes. He has sharp, pointed teeth and no visible eyebrows. His hero costume features a dark pale green jumpsuit cut below the chest, black boots with metal plating, steel shoulder straps and arm bands connected by a red oval chest piece, a brown sash with pouches, and a gray container on his back. A thick metal jaw-guard stamped with "Fe" covers his face. He stands with an athletic, muscular build.

Backstory: A determined student at UA High School training to become a Pro Hero. Tetsutetsu burned with resentment toward Class 1-A's perceived superiority, particularly despising Bakugo's arrogance. He earned 8th place in the Entrance Exam through brute strength and perseverance, ranking fourth in villain points.

Additional Information: His Steel Quirk allows him to harden his body to withstand extreme damage, making him an effective shield for allies. He is competitive yet capable of friendship, as shown by his eventual bond with Eijiro Kirishima despite their rivalry.

cardPool.title: Tesla
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Tesla
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Electric Charge
Occupation/Role: E-rank Villain, League of Villains Member
Personality: Cruel and strategic, Tesla demonstrates intelligence in combat by exploiting opponent weaknesses. He possesses a peculiar sense of kinship with fellow electric Quirk users and shows reluctance to harm them. Despite his villainy, he operates with calculated precision rather than reckless aggression.
Appearance: Tesla is a tall, lean man with slanted grey eyes and beige skin marked by occasional pimples. He wears a dark green sleeveless bodysuit with a white belt and black boots. A distinctive skull-shaped mask covers his face, obscuring his features.
Backstory: Recruited by Tomura Shigaraki as one of roughly seventy villains for the U.S.J. assault, Tesla serves the League of Villains as a minor operative. During the invasion, he used his electrical abilities to jam communication signals and prevent faculty alerts, demonstrating his tactical value to the organization.
Additional Information: Tesla's Quirk allows him to harvest and manipulate electrical currents for attacks and to block electrical signals. He exploited Denki Kaminari's electrical nature by taking him hostage, recognizing his own immunity to electrification. He was arrested following the U.S.J. incident when UA teachers intervened.

cardPool.title: Teruo Unagisawa
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Teruo Unagisawa

Alias:
None

Quirk Name:
Eel

Occupation/Role:
Civilian/Pop☆Step Fan

Personality:
Naïve and self-deprecating, Teruo lacks confidence in his abilities and openly acknowledges his weakness. He is obsessively devoted to the idol Pop☆Step, often making reckless decisions driven by his fandom. Despite his meek demeanor, he maintains this obsession even under extreme circumstances.

Appearance:
A deceptively young-looking 19-year-old with a rounded face, large soft eyes, and a notably wide nose. He is nearly completely bald except for a tuft of black hair crowning his head, giving him a childlike appearance. His small stature makes him look no older than a middle schooler at first glance.

Backstory:
Teruo is an ordinary civilian and devoted fan of the idol Pop☆Step. His life took a dark turn when he was kidnapped by the Villain Factory and subjected to experimentation that transformed his Quirk. He later joins Hopper's Cafe, suggesting a path toward redemption or refuge from his traumatic experiences.

Additional Information:
Under Trigger's influence, Teruo transforms into a large eel-like creature with incredibly slimy skin. His modified form grants him the ability to discharge electrical surges, though doing so causes him to lose consciousness. He is not a UA High School student.

cardPool.title: Teruo Hazukashi
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Teruo Hazukashi
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Shame
Occupation/Role: Disgruntled Office Worker
Personality: Resentful and bitter toward authority, Teruo harbors deep grudges after three years of service under his company. He views himself as a "bootlicker" and seeks liberation through rebellion, inspired by Destro's philosophy. Despite his anger, he is willing to debase himself publicly to achieve his goals.
Appearance: An average-sized adult man with short, spiky brown hair. During his attempted uprising, he wore only a long coat and kneesocks, having stripped away his clothing to trigger his Quirk's effects.
Backstory: A three-year employee of a corporate company where he suffered unfair treatment or grew weary of subservience. After reading Destro's autobiography on liberation, Teruo became motivated to take violent action against his workplace and break free from what he perceived as oppressive employment.
Additional Information: Teruo's Quirk amplifies his physical power proportionally to his level of embarrassment. He activates it by publicly exposing himself to maximize his shame. His rebellion was swiftly ended when Hawks intercepted and defeated him before the full extent of his Quirk could be realized.

cardPool.title: Tenya Ida
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Tenya Ida

Alias: Turbo Hero: Ingenium

Quirk Name: Engine

Occupation/Role: Class 1-A Student, Class Representative at UA High School

Personality: Serious and disciplined with a strong sense of responsibility. Tenya is earnest and formal in demeanor, driven by duty to uphold his family's heroic legacy. He takes his role as class representative with utmost seriousness and maintains composure even under pressure.

Appearance: Tall and muscular young man with a wide frame. Short dark blue hair neatly parted on the right with a small shaved patch at the base. Sharp-featured with square blue eyes, pointed eyebrows, and a pointed jawline; he wears rectangular glasses. Most distinctively, his calves are thick and engine-shaped with six silver exhaust pipes protruding from each leg in columns of three. At UA, he wears the standard male uniform: light gray blazer with dark turquoise trim over white shirt, dark blue-green pants, and red tie.

Backstory: Born into the prestigious Ida Family of heroes, Tenya was raised to carry on their legacy. His older brother Tensei, the original Turbo Hero: Ingenium, inspired him to pursue heroics. Now a first-year student at UA High School, Tenya has earned the position of class representative through his dedication and leadership qualities, beginning his journey toward becoming a Pro Hero.

Additional Information: Tenya's Engine Quirk grants him extraordinary leg-based speed and propulsion. His hero costume is engineered for aerodynamic efficiency rather than protection, featuring lightweight armor with decorative engine pipes. His specialized white boots are designed specifically to accommodate and enhance his Quirk's capabilities.

cardPool.title: Tensei Ida
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Tensei Ida

Alias: Turbo Hero: Ingenium

Quirk Name: Engine

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero

Personality: Laid-back and easy-going, Tensei embodies a "cool" heroic ideal centered on rapid rescue and helping others in need. He values teamwork and quick response over strict rule adherence, often helping others develop their Quirks informally rather than scolding them. Joyful and supportive, he takes pride in inspiring those around him.

Appearance: Tensei has square facial features with short, spiky dark blue-black hair and distinctive arrow-shaped eyebrows. Unlike his younger brother, he lacks glasses. Gold-colored engine exhausts protrude from both his elbows as a result of his Quirk. He maintains a similar stocky build to his brother and typically wears his hero costume with airbags for aerodynamic adjustments during combat.

Backstory: The older brother of UA student Tenya Ida, Tensei established himself as a formidable Pro Hero under the Ingenium name. He built a reputation through relentless pursuit of dangerous villains, most notably the speed-based criminal Batto Yobayakawa across three intense encounters. His hero career and ability to walk were cut short when he suffered severe paralysis during a confrontation with the Hero Killer: Stain, forcing him into temporary retirement.

Additional Information: Tensei operates as a Pro Hero with his own agency and staff. He is known for his incredible fortitude and high-speed combat style powered by his Engine Quirk, making him formidable despite facing opponents with superior abilities. His philosophy prioritizes saving people quickly above all else.

cardPool.title: Tenma Nakaoji
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Tenma Nakaoji

Alias: His Purple Highness

Quirk Name: Not explicitly stated

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero

Personality: Extravagant and flamboyant with dramatic flair, yet deeply committed to heroics and public presentation. Takes his role seriously, recognizes talent in others, and prioritizes victim safety over villain capture. Possesses strong self-sacrifice and protective instincts, willing to risk his life for civilians.

Appearance: Tall man with slim build and tanned skin. Purple eyes, lengthy dark brown hair tied in a long ponytail with long bangs covering his right side.
