Wears a short trimmed mustache and beard with noticeable chest hair. Sports a two-piece suit featuring a frilled, open-chested jacket with epaulets and a belt adorned with P-emblazoned badges.

Backstory: An established Pro Hero who mentors UA High School students during their Work-Studies program. Recommended by student Nemuri, he trains both her and two male interns, emphasizing the importance of heroic presentation and proper conduct. Faces the rampaging villain Garvey to buy time for civilian evacuation, suffering severe injuries in the encounter.

Additional Information: Acts as a Work-Studies mentor to UA students during their first year. Values showmanship in heroics but proves his dedication through genuine sacrifice and courage when confronting dangerous threats.

cardPool.title: Tenko Tejina
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Tenko Tejina

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Conjure

Occupation/Role: Clerk at Got-It-All Mall

Personality: Earnest and overzealous, Tenko is a helpful and determined worker driven by gratitude and a need to prove his loyalty. He is prone to anxiety and self-doubt due to past employment rejections, yet remains bright and eager to assist others, sometimes to his own detriment.

Appearance: A young man with straight, medium-length hair and a perpetually cheerful grin. He wears a traditional mall clerk uniform with a matching hat as part of his job attire. His expression is typically friendly and welcoming.

Backstory: Repeatedly rejected from jobs because employers feared his Quirk could be used for theft, Tenko was finally hired by Got-It-All Mall. Grateful for the opportunity, he works with intense dedication to prove himself trustworthy and dispel the stigma surrounding his abilities.

Additional Information: Tenko's Quirk allows him to conjure objects into his hand, which directly explains the prejudice he faces in employment. He is not a UA student but works at Got-It-All Mall, a shopping center frequented by hero course students.

cardPool.title: Tech Villain
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Tech Villain
Quirk Name: Unknown
Occupation/Role: Villain, Wolfram's minion and tactical operator
Personality: Serious and no-nonsense, focused on completing objectives efficiently. Somewhat cowardly, prone to fear when directly confronted by powerful opponents. Attempts to take command despite his subordinate status, which creates friction with authority figures.
Appearance: Tall man with pale skin and long, shaggy white hair partially obscuring his left eye. Wears black combat suit with full-face mask featuring a pale X-shaped design. Sports technological headgear with a goggle scope resembling a monocle over his right eye, emphasizing his technical expertise.
Backstory: Recruited as one of Wolfram's elite minions for the I-Island infiltration operation. Served as the group's primary tactical operator, managing the tower's security systems and monitoring hero movements during the assault. Survived the helicopter crash caused by All Might's intervention, though rendered unconscious by the explosion.
Additional Information: Operates primarily in support and command roles rather than direct combat. Shows reluctance to engage skilled fighters one-on-one. More confident when confronting unpowered targets. His current status following I-Island remains unknown, though arrest is likely.

cardPool.title: Tatsuyuki Tokoname
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Tatsuyuki Tokoname

Alias: Slidin' Go

Quirk Name: Slide

Occupation/Role: Former Pro Hero, Member of the Meta Liberation Army

Personality: Affable and chipper on the surface, offering praise and assistance readily, but harbors a darker loyalty to Destro's ideals regarding Quirk freedom. Strict about proper etiquette and rank hierarchy, though willing to defer when confronted by superiors.

Appearance: A tall, well-built man with defined musculature and broad shoulders. He has small black eyes, a circular nose, and a prominently square jaw with protruding lower jaw. His hero costume consists of a purple skin-tight bodysuit with black arrow markings across the chest, waist, and thighs. He wears knee-high boots with arrow-shaped cavities, a black mask covering his head and eyes, elbow-length green gloves with golden scale patterns, and a short green scarf-like cape with golden aiguillettes around his torso. A thick black belt with a large buckle, green circles, and golden rectangle completes the ensemble.

Backstory: Once a legitimate Pro Hero, Tatsuyuki became a secret operative for the Meta Liberation Army, maintaining his hero facade while serving their ideology of absolute Quirk freedom. He assisted in integrating the League of Villains into their organization and operated in Deika City before his allegiance was exposed and he was arrested.

Additional Information: Not a UA student. His true allegiance to the Meta Liberation Army masks his public heroic persona, making him a dangerous double agent during this period.

cardPool.title: Tatami Nakagame
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Tatami Nakagame

Alias: Turtle Neck

Quirk Name: Shell

Occupation/Role: Third-year student at Ketsubutsu Academy High School

Personality: Cheerful and socially outgoing, Tatami is friendly with her peers and unafraid to ask rivals for autographs. She is fault-finding and direct, quick to call out others' shortcomings or personality quirks without hesitation. She works well in group settings despite her critical nature.

Appearance: A pale, curvaceous girl with a muscular build and notably large, pointed teeth displayed in a constant smile. She has wide rectangular eyes with small blue irises, thick upper lashes, and pronounced lower ones. Her short ash-blonde hair features two longer spikes resembling fish fins on either side and a single chin-length bang on her right. She wears turquoise fish-shaped earrings. Her hero costume is an aquamarine turtleneck bodysuit with a central zipper, salmon pink gloves and thigh-high boots decorated with hexagonal turtle-foot patterns, and a thin cyan belt with a pink circular buckle centered by a white turtle shell gem.

Backstory: A dedicated hero student at Ketsubutsu Academy, Tatami competed against Class 1-A during the U.A. Sports Festival. She encountered them again during the Provisional Hero License Exam at Takoba National Stadium, where Ketsubutsu's Class 2 attempted the traditional "Crushing of U.A." ambush. During combat with U.A. students, she demonstrated her Quirk's versatility by collapsing her torso to evade Tokoyami's attack, impressed by their growth since the festival.

Additional Information: Tatami is a student rival rather than a UA student, representing Ketsubutsu Academy's competitive spirit. Her aquatic-themed appearance and abilities complement her Shell Quirk's defensive and mobility applications.

cardPool.title: Taneo Tokuda
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Taneo Tokuda

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Not stated

Occupation/Role: Freelance journalist for Juzo News magazine publisher

Personality: Relaxed and laid-back with considerable charm and manipulative tendencies, using his good looks to gain access and information. Deceptively perceptive and analytical, yet deeply ethical and sentimental beneath his surface charm. A devoted All Might fan who respects heroism and hope above exclusive scoops.

Appearance: Tall and slender man with black wavy hair falling to one side and short sideburns. Angular face with high cheekbones, thin-framed circular glasses, and distinctive mismatched pupils—one white and one black. Wears a beige blazer over an untucked black dress shirt with dark slacks. Carries a black camera around his neck while reporting.

Backstory: Eighteen years ago as a child, Taneo witnessed All Might rescue his father and twenty-three others from an industrial complex bombing. His accidental photograph of the rescue, published in newspapers, inspired him to become a journalist. This life-changing event forged his lifelong admiration for All Might and his ideals.

Additional Information: Highly skilled investigator capable of deducing hidden truths from minimal evidence, including identifying All Might's successor through careful observation. Despite discovering Izuku Midoriya's connection to All Might, prioritized his ethical principles by keeping the secret until his planned book release. Charming but ultimately trustworthy.

cardPool.title: Tamashiro
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Tamashiro
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Binging Balls
Occupation/Role: Student, Masegaki Primary School
Personality: Arrogant and boisterous with a rebellious streak, yet genuinely aspires to be a hero. Pride in his Quirk's strength and speed inflates his ego, causing him to criticize others like Bakugo does. Beneath his stand-offish exterior lies playfulness and willingness to help others.
Appearance: Small elementary school boy with messy blonde hair, dark marks circling his brown eyes, and sharp, pointed teeth. His youthful features and diminutive stature contrast with his cocky demeanor.
Backstory: A primary school student from Masegaki who participated in a hero license exam trial alongside classmates, facing UA heroes Bakugo, Todoroki, Yoarashi, and Utsushimi. Despite initial arrogance, he demonstrated genuine heroic spirit and accepted Todoroki's praise for his potential in disaster rescue work.
Additional Information: Not a UA student; attends Masegaki Primary School. Uses Binging Balls Quirk offensively during the exam, successfully damaging Bakugo's equipment. Shows optimism and faith in heroes even after witnessing society's collapse and the evacuation to UA's Underground Center during the Final War.

cardPool.title: Tamao Oguro
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Tamao Oguro

Alias: Former Host of Queen Bee

Quirk Name: None (formerly shared Queen Bee while possessed)

Occupation/Role: Student (status unknown; hospitalized after possession)

Personality: Originally a confrontational but normal girl with a rebellious streak, frustrated by her father's control and desires to pursue music. She harbored resentment toward him, though this has largely faded. She craves his attention and approval despite their conflict.

Appearance: Young girl with green eyes and shoulder-length brown hair styled in a ponytail. She wears a black eyepatch over her left eye where she was permanently injured during possession. Slender build typical of her age, with a calm demeanor reflecting her recovery.

Backstory: Daughter of Iwao Oguro, Tamao was possessed by the villain Kuin Hachisuka, losing control of her body and left eye in the process. Her possession stemmed partly from her rebellious nature and defiance of her father's strict parenting, particularly his refusal to let her become a musician. After being freed from Kuin's control, she was hospitalized and has since begun recovering, though the trauma of possession and her damaged relationship with her father remain unresolved.

Additional Information: Her current Quirk status is unknown—she lost Queen Bee upon Kuin's removal and may possess her own latent Quirk. She is not confirmed as a UA student and remains in recovery during the current timeline.

cardPool.title: Tamao
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Tamao

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Tree Frog

Occupation/Role: Student at Masegaki Primary School, Aspiring Hero

Personality: Energetic and fearless with a dismissive attitude toward authority, Tamao is driven by ambition but initially doubted her own Quirk's combat potential. She sneaks away when rules inconvenience her and holds high standards for what constitutes an impressive hero. However, she is capable of changing her mind when shown compelling evidence and becomes inspired by those she admires.

Appearance: A young girl with short, light-colored hair that stands up from the back of her head in a tadpole-like silhouette. She has large, expressive eyes and full cheeks. She wears an oversized dark shirt with black shorts and simple running shoes, giving her a casual, youthful appearance appropriate for primary school.

Backstory: Tamao attended a school trip to Takoba National Stadium to observe hero training exercises. Disappointed by what she considered ordinary heroes, she snuck away from her class against her teacher's orders to explore the arena. After being rescued by Froppy during a near-fall, she witnessed the impressive versatility of frog-based Quirks and experienced a moment of terror when encountering what she believed was a dangerous snake. This encounter fundamentally changed her perspective on her own Tree Frog Quirk.

Additional Information: Tamao has an irrational fear of snakes. She initially disliked her Tree Frog Quirk and hoped to develop a stronger, combat-oriented ability through training, but meeting Froppy inspired her to embrace her frog-based abilities and work diligently to master them instead.

cardPool.title: Tamaki Amajiki
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Tamaki Amajiki

Alias: Suneater, Omnivore Hero

Quirk Name: Manifest

Occupation/Role: UA High School Student, Class 3-A

Personality: Extremely shy, anxious, and introverted with a pessimistic outlook. Despite crippling social anxiety and lack of self-confidence, Tamaki harbors a brave heart and unwavering moral convictions. He looks to Mirio Togata as inspiration and can push beyond his fears when duty calls. Quick to dismiss compliments and overlook his own achievements.

Appearance: Tall with pale skin and distinctly pointed, elf-like ears. Dark indigo hair is messy and sticks out behind his head, partially covering thin, tired eyes. His shoulders are hunched and posture withdrawn. Wears his school uniform with a loosened tie, partially tucked shirt, and large golden-buckled belt. His hero costume features a black bodysuit with beige shoulder plating, white tunic, white cape, and hooded scarf-collar. A silver front mask and thin beige mask with transparent purple lens cover his face; he wears a purple carrier vest with brown straps and multiple pouches. He fights barefoot.

Backstory: A member of UA's prestigious Big 3, Tamaki earned his ranking despite overwhelming self-doubt and social struggles. His partnership with Mirio Togata and mentorship under Fat Gum have shaped his moral code. Though plagued by anxiety, Tamaki demonstrates flashes of genuine courage when his convictions are tested.

Additional Information: Tamaki's Quirk allows him to manifest physical traits of consumed organisms, making him exceptionally powerful despite his timid demeanor. His pessimism directly contrasts with his mentor Fat Gum's optimism, creating tension he often misinterprets as mockery.

cardPool.title: Takuto
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Takuto
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Unknown
Occupation/Role: Student at Masegaki Primary School
Personality: Enthusiastic and excitable, especially about heroes, but emotionally sensitive and prone to crying when frightened or yelled at; displays childlike boldness without understanding consequences.
Appearance: Small elementary school boy with a bird-like protruding face, sharp teeth, and side-mounted eyes. Light, spiky hair frames his avian features, giving him a distinctive and somewhat awkward appearance typical of his age.
Backstory: A primary school student selected as a test subject during hero licensing exams alongside his classmates. Encounters Pro Hero Gang Orca and several hero license candidates, including the volatile Katsuki Bakugo, whose explosive personality frightens him.
Additional Information: Not a UA High School student; enrolled at Masegaki Primary School. His Quirk type remains unspecified in available records. Demonstrates typical childhood behavior—boldness mixed with emotional fragility.

cardPool.title: Takeshita
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Takeshita

Alias: Unknown

Quirk Name: Unknown (Bamboo-related)

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero

Personality: Friendly and polite, with a professional demeanor. He greets civilians courteously and works well with other heroes in coordinated operations.

Appearance: Spiky blond hair with stubble and a faint moustache, average build. Wears a green jacket with fur cuffs and shoulder pads over a black top. His hero costume features two vertically cut half-bamboo stalks over his ears, brown fingerless gloves, and two bamboo stalks crossed over his back.

Backstory: A prominent UA High School hero course student who received agency offers before graduation. He became an independent Pro Hero and gained recognition across Japan. Years later, he encountered his former classmate Danjuro Tobita, but failed to recognize him—an event that traumatized Danjuro and inadvertently set him on a villainous path.

Additional Information: Currently assigned to the Hospital Raid Team under Endeavor's command during operations against the Paranormal Liberation Front. His Quirk remains unknown but is presumed to relate to bamboo based on his costume design.

cardPool.title: Takeshi Bushijima
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Takeshi Bushijima
Alias: The Masked Man
Quirk Name: Poison Gas
Occupation/Role: Civilian
Personality: Kind and considerate, but isolated by his dangerous Quirk. He carries deep guilt about potentially harming others and struggles with envy toward Heroes who can use their abilities freely. Despite his cautious nature, he responds to genuine kindness and can be persuaded to trust others.
Appearance: A young man in his early-mid teens with short, scruffy hair and soft facial features. He wears a dark hoodie and mask that conceal most of his face. Before releasing his Quirk, he appeared pale and sickly due to accumulated poisonous gas in his body; after release, he looks noticeably healthier.
Backstory: Takeshi has suppressed his uncontrollable Poison Gas Quirk for years to avoid harming others, as using dangerous Quirks is prohibited by law. The constant suppression has taken a severe toll on his physical health. When he encounters UA students during a chance meeting, his condition worsens, forcing him to release his gas in a populated area—an incident that marks him as a potential villain despite his good intentions.
Additional Information: Not a UA student. His crisis becomes a turning point when Deku recognizes his desperation and convinces other Heroes to help him safely release his Quirk rather than capture him, demonstrating that he is a victim of circumstances rather than a true villain.

cardPool.title: Takami
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Takami

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Unnamed Feather Quirk

Occupation/Role: Fugitive Criminal/Villain

Personality: Cruel, paranoid, and volatile. A desperate thief prone to violent outbursts fueled by alcoholism and fear of capture. Shows no gratitude or empathy toward family members, viewing them as burdens rather than loved ones. Easily angered and quick to blame others for his failures.

Appearance: Tall, middle-aged man with brown hair swept messily backward and a gaunt, bearded face marked by gaps in his eyebrows and a missing piece of his front tooth. His golden-brown eyes hold a hardened, suspicious gleam. Small brown feathers line both his arms. He wears a dark jacket and dark pants, giving him an unkempt, weathered appearance befitting his years as a fugitive.

Backstory: A petty criminal from Kyushu, Fukuoka, Takami murdered someone over pocket change and became a fugitive hunted by Pro Heroes and police. He hid in a rundown house with his wife Tomie, relying on her Quirk to watch for authorities. When his son Keigo was born, Takami viewed him as a mistake that ruined his freedom. He kept his son imprisoned indoors, abused both his wife and child, and demanded Tomie find him criminal work. He attempted to flee by stealing a car but was captured by the No. 2 Pro Hero, Endeavor.

Additional Information: Reportedly dangerous enough that Endeavor personally warned police officers to remain vigilant around him. His Quirk granted combat-capable feathers, though his exact combat prowess remains largely unknown. Currently incarcerated following his capture by Endeavor.

cardPool.title: Takaie Kanigumo
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Takaie Kanigumo

Alias:
None

Quirk Name:
Unnamed Arthropod Meta Ability

Occupation/Role:
Second-ranked Adviser, Paranormal Liberation Front Vanguard Action Support Regiment: Brown

Personality:
Fanatically dedicated to heteromorph liberation through violence, viewing bloodshed as necessary for social change. Irritable and contemptuous toward those who oppose oppression through peaceful means, yet respects strong figures like Spinner who embody militant resistance. Acts as a preacher and propagandist to radicalize fellow heteromorphs.

Appearance:
Average height heteromorphic man with an arthropod-like form. Two spider legs protrude from his back, and two pairs of five spider-like teeth cover his actual mouth. Six wavy green marks traverse his forehead to the back of his head, with a scar on the left side. Wears a black long shirt with a large yellow fur collar and a black mask covering his face.

Backstory:
A committed member of the Meta Liberation Army who ascended to prominence in the Paranormal Liberation Front following the organizations' merger. Takaie became a vocal advocate for heteromorph uprising, viewing societal prejudice and rejection as justification for revolutionary violence. He participated in battles against heroes and continued spreading radicalization propaganda even after the Paranormal Liberation War.

Additional Information:
Estimated combat strength comparable to or exceeding an average Pro Hero. Participates in raids and recruitment efforts to sustain heteromorph resistance movements. Currently arrested following the Central Hospital raid conflict.

cardPool.title: Takahiro
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Takahiro
Alias: Eagle Hero (Professional Hero name unknown)
Quirk Name: Eagle
Occupation/Role: Pro Hero
Personality: Reserved and composed; demonstrates resilience when captured, suggesting mental fortitude befitting a professional hero.
Appearance: Bird-headed humanoid with brown spiked feathers covering his head like an eagle's plumage. Feather-like ruffles extend from neck down to chest. Massive wings protrude from his back. Bird-like clawed hands with long black talons on each finger. Wears a sleek hero costume featuring headphones, high-collared vest, baggy parachute pants with knee circles and downward buttons, utility belt with large buckle, and plain boots.
Backstory: An established Pro Hero who attended the I-Expo reception as a guest. He was apprehended by the villain Wolfram and his forces during the incident but was liberated when Melissa Shield restored I-Island's security systems.
Additional Information: Takahiro's Quirk grants him avian characteristics including enhanced aerial mobility via wings. The full extent of his abilities remains unexplored. He operates at professional hero level, indicating significant combat training and experience.

cardPool.title: Tajima
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Tajima

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Electrification

Occupation/Role: Villain/Spy (Infiltrator at U.A. High School)

Personality: Outwardly stern and composed when undercover, but internally prone to excitement or anxiety depending on circumstances. Driven by intense fear of All For One's judgment and elimination, leading to blind loyalty and willingness to harm innocents. Believes All For One's world domination is inevitable.

Appearance: Young man with short dark hair. Typically wears a dark sweater layered over a plaid shirt. Clean-faced with an overall unremarkable, unassuming appearance suited to blending in as a refugee.

Backstory: Sent by All For One alongside four other spies to infiltrate U.A. High School posing as a refugee. Tasked with relaying orders to create internal discord and pressure Izuku Midoriya into leaving the school. When learning Class 1-A would depart anyway, he reported this to All For One, believing it would accelerate their master's goals. During the Final War, he helped sabotage U.A.'s evacuation systems under Skeptic's command before being discovered by Gunhead and captured by Kendo, Tetsutetsu, and Gunhead.

Additional Information: His Quirk allows him to generate electricity from his thumbs, strong enough to interface with and disrupt U.A.'s digital systems. Arrested following the Final War and All For One's defeat.

cardPool.title: Taishiro Toyomitsu
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Taishiro Toyomitsu

Alias: BMI Hero: Fat Gum

Quirk Name: Fat Absorption

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero (currently No. 11), mentor to hero trainees

Personality: Constantly hungry and playful, yet earnest when duty calls. Friendly and carefree with civilians and allies, but becomes impulsive and determined when lives are threatened. Recognizes potential in others and cares deeply for those under his care. Knowledge of Japan's underworld makes him a shrewd operative who prioritizes saving lives above all.

Appearance: In fat form, a massive round man with a wide mouth and small nose, towering over most adults with odd proportions. Beneath the fat lies surprising muscularity that becomes visible when he burns through reserves. Wears a black and yellow zippered hood with white striped sleeves, red-orange gloves with black knuckles, matching boots with grey metallic knee guards, and a black mask covering his eyes and forehead.

Backstory: Once ranked No. 58 Pro Hero eight years prior, Taishiro has climbed to No. 11 through dedication and hero work alongside police investigations. He mentors promising young heroes, having employed Suneater as a trainee and later taking on Red Riot and Real Steel, recognizing their raw potential and determination.

Additional Information: Despite his size, Taishiro subdues targets with impressive speed. His Quirk allows him to absorb fat to cushion impacts and convert stored energy into powered counterattacks. He serves as a human shield for allies in combat and has proven his limits against powerful foes like the Eight Bullets.

cardPool.title: Swordkil
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Swordkil
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Unnamed Sword Quirk
Occupation/Role: Mercenary, Second-in-Command of Wolfram's crew
Personality: Arrogant and dedicated, Swordkil is a ruthless mercenary loyal only to Wolfram. He is quick to threaten, disdains those who "play hero," and despises being looked down upon. His pride often clouds his judgment, making him boastful and short-sighted in critical moments. He commands authority over other minions but respects only Wolfram's orders.
Appearance: A middle-aged man with lightly tanned skin and a long face, Swordkil has shoulder-length desaturated pink hair that flares outward with shorter bangs framing his eyes. His thin honey-brown eyes are marked by curved, dark purplish-pink linear tattoos running beneath them and down his cheeks. He wears a sleek black combat suit with a full-face mask featuring a pale X-shaped design across the front.
Backstory: Wolfram's trusted right hand and second-in-command, Swordkil has proven his combat prowess enough to earn authority over the mercenary crew. During the I-Island incident, his arrogance proved fatal when a moment of boasting during battle with Izuku Midoriya left him vulnerable to defeat.
Additional Information: Swordkil's Quirk allows him to instantly generate cone-shaped, collapsible blades that cover his forearms, making him a lethal melee combatant. He is not a UA student but operates as a professional villain for hire. His downfall demonstrates how overconfidence can undermine even capable fighters.

cardPool.title: Susugu Mitarai
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Susugu Mitarai

Alias: Laundry Hero: Wash

Quirk Name: Wash

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero (No. 8 ranked)

Personality: Maintains a cheerful, child-friendly public demeanor while taking his heroic duties with utmost seriousness. Despite his playful persona, he grows irritated when criticized and will drop his theatrical manner to address pressing situations directly.

Appearance: Wears a washing machine-themed hero costume with a top-loading design featuring two exaggerated eyes protruding from the lid. His arms emerge from thick grey hoses ending in yellow rubber gloves with green grips. He wears waterproof pants with a belt and large boots decorated with wave patterns and bubble-release circles on the soles.

Backstory: Ranked among Japan's elite Pro Heroes, Wash has built his reputation on using his Quirk for both rescue operations and public safety. He mentors younger heroes and takes an active role in community protection despite the pressures of the profession.

Additional Information: Not a UA student. His Quirk allows him to generate large cleansing bubbles capable of safely evacuating multiple people from danger and protecting them from environmental threats.

cardPool.title: Stitched Giant
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Stitched Giant
Quirk Name: Mutant Bovini
Occupation/Role: Villain, League of Villains recruit
Personality: Confident in combat abilities, willing to challenge professional heroes despite low rank; little else known about his demeanor.
Appearance: A hulking, obese man wearing a custom pale green stitched suit tailored to his massive frame. A dark grey gas mask with three bovine-like horns dominates his face; the respirator holes glow red when channeling his Quirk. Small black boots contrast with his imposing silhouette.
Backstory: Recruited by Tomura Shigaraki as one of roughly seventy villains for the U.S.J. assault, Stitched Giant was among those tasked with overwhelming U.A. staff. His confidence proved misplaced when he and fellow villains Needle Hair and Victor faced Eraser Head, whose Erasure Quirk disabled his powers and left him vulnerable to swift defeat.
Additional Information: F-rank villain; arrested following the U.S.J. incident. His Quirk enables laser fire projection from his face, making him a ranged combatant, though his reliance on Quirk power left him defenseless against Erasure users.

cardPool.title: Starservant
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Starservant
Quirk Name: Control Glass
Occupation/Role: Independent Villain, Street Preacher
Personality: Delusional and unstable, Starservant speaks in cryptic, apocalyptic prophecies about impending darkness and cosmic destruction. He genuinely believes himself chosen to prevent the end of the world, though his methods involve attacking innocent people. Cowardly in direct confrontation, he prefers orchestrating ambushes with devoted followers rather than facing stronger opponents alone.
Appearance: An elderly man with a gaunt, wrinkled face and blank, pupil-less eyes that enhance his eerie prophet-like demeanor. He sports a long, unkempt white beard and maintains a constant nosebleed. His attire blends monk and magician aesthetics: a dark, disheveled cloak over light robes, wrist bracelets, and a tall cylindrical cap with trailing cloth.
Backstory: Once a harmless street preacher warning of societal collapse, Starservant grew increasingly radical, convinced he alone could stop the approaching darkness. His deteriorating mental state drove him to violence against civilians while searching for the "herald of the dark lord." Dabi later enlisted him to harass Endeavor, leading to his capture after a failed ambush in an alley.
Additional Information: Starservant manipulates glass on massive scales, reshaping it into floating orbs for transportation and projectile attacks. His signature technique, "Enlightened Fallen King," involves absorbing glass from buildings. He has no confirmed affiliation with UA High School. His complete lack of pupil detail and constant nosebleed suggest possible Quirk side effects or existing medical conditions.

cardPool.title: Stanleyk
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Stanleyk

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Unknown

Occupation/Role: Bar owner and criminal informant in Otheon's Shanty Town

Personality: Shrewd and morally flexible, willing to facilitate criminal activities without hesitation. Stern when business goes wrong, yet capable of unexpected kindness—he offered Rody legitimate bartending work after recognizing his potential. Distrustful but maintains mutual trust with key contacts like Rody despite occasional friction over debts and stolen property.

Appearance: A stout, middle-aged man with a bald crown and curly dark brown hair on the sides, paired with thick eyebrows and visible arm and chest hair. Notable wrinkles line his weathered face, suggesting a hard life in the criminal circuit. He dresses pragmatically in a black shirt with rolled-up sleeves beneath a purple vest fastened with dull yellow buttons.

Backstory: Stanleyk built his reputation as a reliable middleman connecting Otheon's criminal underworld with street-level operatives like Rody Soul. His bar serves as a front for illicit job distribution while maintaining plausible deniability. Despite his shadowy dealings, he demonstrated capacity for legitimate business when he promoted Rody from street work to honest bartending.

Additional Information: Operates primarily in Otheon, a location not affiliated with UA High School. Possesses extensive connections throughout the criminal circuit and serves as a valuable information broker for various illegal factions.

cardPool.title: Spike
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Spike
Quirk Name: Unknown
Occupation/Role: League of Villains member, U.S.J. Incident participant
Personality: Aggressive and brutal, willing to kill assigned targets without hesitation. Demonstrates pack mentality as part of Shigaraki's horde.
Appearance: A large, bulky man with gold-yellow skin covered in prominent spikes protruding from both shoulders. His head is angular with two sloped planes meeting at a sharp apex, featuring a black crater-like depression in the center of his forehead. He has glowing red eyes and visible fangs, giving him an intimidating, otherworldly appearance.
Backstory: One of approximately seventy low-ranking villains recruited by Tomura Shigaraki for the coordinated assault on the Unforeseen Simulation Joint. Deployed to the Squall Zone zone where he was tasked with eliminating Class 1-A student Koji Koda. He was quickly subdued by Fumikage Tokoyami's Dark Shadow and subsequently apprehended by authorities following the incident's resolution.
Additional Information: Operates as a disposable foot soldier within the League of Villains hierarchy. His combat effectiveness is limited against trained opponents, as demonstrated by his swift defeat.

cardPool.title: Soramitsu Tabe
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Soramitsu Tabe

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Food

Occupation/Role: Eight Bullets member of the Shie Hassaikai yakuza organization

Personality: Unhinged and perpetually ravenous, driven by an insatiable hunger that dominates his behavior. Despite his apparent insanity, Soramitsu harbors genuine camaraderie with his fellow Eight Bullets, valuing them as true friends who understand his tragic rejection by society. He is utterly devoted to Overhaul and willing to sacrifice his life for the organization, though he draws a line at consuming those he considers friends.

Appearance: A gaunt, slim man with pale skin and notably large, boney hands with oversized fingers. His circular eyes feature pinprick pupils framed by heavy dark bags. Black, disheveled hair crowns his head. Most distinctive is his unnaturally large mouth filled with straight teeth—a result of his Quirk's nature. He wears a ragged burlap sack mask covering his entire head, secured by a rope around his neck, with eye holes and a stitched smile. Beneath the mask, he dons a purple dress shirt and grey pants.

Backstory: Once a societal outcast unable to conform due to his Quirk and fractured mind, Soramitsu was discovered by Overhaul and given purpose within the Shie Hassaikai. Having lost all dignity and sense of self-worth, he surrendered himself completely to the organization, finding belonging among the other Eight Bullets members who shared similarly tragic pasts.

Additional Information: His Food Quirk allows him to consume any solid material with ease, making him particularly effective against opponents who manifest physical constructs. He operates best as part of a coordinated team, exploiting openings created by allies like Toya Setsuno and Yu Hojo.

cardPool.title: Sorahiko Torino
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Sorahiko Torino

Alias: Gran Torino

Quirk Name: Jet

Occupation/Role: Retired Pro Hero, Former UA High School Teacher, Mentor

Personality: Deceptively senile in demeanor, Gran Torino masks his sharp intellect behind forgetfulness and name-mixing as a teaching tactic. He is brutally demanding with his students, employing harsh criticism and physical discipline to forge stronger heroes. Despite his gruff exterior, he genuinely cares for his proteges and readily praises genuine progress.

Appearance: An extremely short, elderly man with a scrawny, shriveled frame and heavy wrinkles. He has light complexion, brown eyes, grey spiky hair styled short with forward bangs, and a trimmed beard. His hero costume is a monochrome full-body suit with a yellow cape, thick yellow gloves and boots, a "G" belt buckle, and a dark diamond-shaped domino mask.

Backstory: Once a tall, handsome hero rivaling All Might's build, Gran Torino trained the Symbol of Peace himself and mentored countless heroes. Now retired and aging, he takes selective protégés under his wing, most notably Izuku Midoriya during the UA internship arc, recognizing untapped potential in the young hero-in-training.

Additional Information: Despite his age and frail appearance, Gran Torino remains exceptionally formidable in combat. His Jet Quirk allows rapid propulsion. He possesses an uncanny ability to read people and predict villain strategies through keen observation alone.

cardPool.title: Soji
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Soji
Alias: Soji the Hammer
Quirk Name: Unnamed Lightning Quirk
Occupation/Role: Yakuza member of the Abegawa Tenchu Kai
Personality: Aggressive and loyal to his organization; willing to engage threats directly with his fellow executives without hesitation.
Appearance: A muscular man with short black hair and a thick beard. He bears the kanji 雷 ("thunder") tattooed prominently on his left shoulder. He dresses in practical construction worker attire, reflecting his role as an enforcer.
Backstory: Soji serves as an enforcer for the Abegawa Tenchu Kai yakuza organization. During a sudden assault on their headquarters by the vigilante Stendhal, he fought alongside fellow executives Tetsu, Haruhisa, and Rojiya Yonenaga in a coordinated defense. The battle ended in his defeat and death at Stendhal's hands.
Additional Information: Soji wields a hammer as his primary weapon, using it in tandem with his lightning generation abilities for devastating close-range attacks. He was one of four executives present during the headquarters breach.

cardPool.title: Soga Kugisaki
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Soga Kugisaki
Alias: Spike
Quirk Name: Spike
Occupation/Role: Vigilante, ally to Naruhata Vigilantes, former criminal
Personality: Initially cruel and sadistic due to discrimination, but reformed into a principled vigilante with strong loyalty to those marginalized by society. Defiant, ideological, and fiercely protective of his allies. Shows mental instability stemming from being labeled a monster, yet demonstrates genuine care and solidarity.
Appearance: Tall, lean young man with wild, spiky turquoise hair and inward-slanting yellow eyes. Sharp pointed front teeth and small eyebrows. Wears a sleeveless vest over a tank top, jeans, and leather shoes. Later adopts a brown trench coat and hat similar to Knuckleduster's style. Under Trigger influence, his physique expands and spikes emerge across his back and arms.
Backstory: Discriminated against and labeled a villain due to his Quirk appearance, Soga turned to violence and cruelty as a coping mechanism with friends Moyuru and Rapt. Rescued by Naruhata Vigilantes from the murderous Stendhal, he underwent profound reformation. Now a devoted vigilante student of Knuckleduster, he fights for those society abandons.
Additional Information: Refuses to acknowledge legal definitions of villainy if he deems them undeserving. Harbors complicated views on law enforcement—cooperative when aligned but defiant against what he sees as institutional ego prioritizing budgeting over genuine justice. Values pragmatic officers over rigid bureaucrats.

cardPool.title: Snipe
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Snipe
Alias: Cowboy Hero
Quirk Name: Homing
Occupation/Role: Pro Hero and UA High School Teacher (Third Year Class Instructor)
Personality: Intelligent and levelheaded with strong moral convictions. Displays tactical expertise and rational judgment, though capable of flustering when caught in awkward social situations. Humble despite his considerable skill, acknowledging those who surpass him. Professional and measured in demeanor.
Appearance: A cowboy-themed figure with a tan gas mask covering his face, featuring triangular eye holes and silver ear-defenders. Dark bluish dreadlocks fall to his shoulders. He wears a brown cowboy hat with metallic front plate stamped with an "S," gray knee-high boots with silver trims and spurs, and a large red frayed cloak over a black tank top with white right-side torso armor. Black skin-tight armguards, tan gloves, baggy dark pants with light brown chaps, and a brown belt with gun holster complete his ensemble.
Backstory: An accomplished Pro Hero and skilled marksmanship specialist, Snipe earned his reputation as Japan's second-greatest long-range combatant. Recognized for tactical brilliance, he was selected to lead UA's third-year students, demonstrating commitment to proper hero education and mentorship.
Additional Information: Commands exceptional marksmanship and strategic thinking. Wields modified dual guns and smoke grenades. His Homing Quirk locks onto visible targets within 600 meters, making projectiles pursue them, though with limited impact force and no targeting precision beyond general pursuit.

cardPool.title: Slugger
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Slugger
Quirk Name: Unknown
Occupation/Role: Pro Hero
Personality: Professional and determined, though cautious in combat. Shows frustration when unable to act effectively against threats, particularly fluid-based villains that render his abilities useless. Respects established heroic protocol.
Appearance: Tall and lanky man with vibrant orange hair. Wears a white umpire-style mask covering his face. His hero costume consists of dark underclothing topped by a beige pinstriped baseball uniform with prominent shoulder pads, a wide belt, and large shin cuffs. White knee-high socks extend above oversized orange and green shoes. A massive gray, orange, and green gauntlet—roughly twice the size of his arm—dominates his right arm, likely connected to his Quirk.
Backstory: An established Pro Hero operating during the early days of the hero society. Slugger responded to the Sludge Villain incident threatening young Katsuki Bakugo alongside other heroes, though his abilities proved ineffective against the fluid villain. Witnessed All Might's intervention and subsequent cleanup efforts.
Additional Information: Slugger's Quirk remains undisclosed but is baseball-themed based on his hero name and equipment. He cannot engage fluid-based villains effectively. Not a UA student; a seasoned professional hero.

cardPool.title: Sludge Villain
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Unknown

Alias:
Sludge Villain, Hedoro Viran

Quirk Name:
Sludge Body

Occupation/Role:
D-rank Villain, Criminal

Personality:
Selfish, cruel, and sadistic with a cowardly streak. Bold enough to steal in broad daylight but quick to flee when outmatched. Shows no remorse for endangering innocent lives and values self-preservation above all else. Becomes gleeful when he believes victory is assured.

Appearance:
A humanoid figure composed entirely of dark green mud-like substance. Features sharp teeth and large, round eyes set within his gelatinous form. Has no fixed facial features beyond these defining characteristics, appearing as an amorphous sludge entity capable of shifting his body's shape.

Backstory:
A low-ranking villain operating in Tokyo who commits petty crimes without regard for civilian safety. First encountered by All Might while fleeing a bank robbery, leading to a confrontation that results in his temporary containment. Later freed during the Paranormal Liberation War's prison raids and conscripted into the villain alliance's final assault on Jaku City.

Additional Information:
His Sludge Body allows him to possess other individuals by absorbing them, suffocating victims in the process. His body is vulnerable to acidic substances that can damage or dissolve his sludge composition. Despite being a D-rank villain, he poses significant danger when controlling stronger Quirk users. Prefers evasion and coercion tactics over direct combat.

cardPool.title: Sirius
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Sirius
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Good Ear
Occupation/Role: Pro Hero Sidekick on the Oki Mariner
Personality: Friendly and approachable, with a keen interest in mentoring aspiring heroes like Tsuyu Asui. Highly respectful of her Captain despite frequent embarrassment at his antics. Selfless and determined, willing to sacrifice herself to prevent criminals from escaping.
Appearance: Young woman with smart blue eyes that slope inward and shoulder-length light blue hair swept to the right. Wears a sleeveless white sailor uniform with dark blue double-trimmed collar, short buttoned 3-piece skirt, loosely-tied red scarf, and blue gloves with white striped wrist guards. Thigh-high boots with wavy line patterns, and a flat hat with ribbon base. Large fin-shaped communication earpieces on ears.
Backstory: Sirius serves as a dedicated sidekick under Captain Selkie aboard the Oki Mariner, where her Quirk makes her invaluable for long-distance team coordination. She has developed strong professional bonds with her captain and teammates, and takes pride in supporting the next generation of heroes.
Additional Information: Proficient in Morse code interpretation. Carries a retractable steel baton concealed in her uniform for combat. Her fin-shaped earpieces are specialized equipment designed to amplify her Quirk's effectiveness in communication during maritime patrols and rescue operations.

cardPool.title: Simon Gollini
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Simon Gollini

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Monster Summon

Occupation/Role: Member of the Gollini Family mafia

Personality: Enthusiastic and playful, with a love for games and RPGs that borders on obsession. Simon enjoys tormenting enemies and prolonging confrontations for entertainment rather than quick victories. Despite his chill demeanor, he becomes flustered and bewildered when caught off-guard or when his monsters are defeated unexpectedly.

Appearance: A lanky young man with artichoke green hair featuring yellow streaks, kept long on one side with a curled end. He sports a matching green goatee and wears multiple finger rings and piercings adorned with jewels. His typical outfit consists of a mulberry pink tuxedo with blue floral suit jacket, navy tie, and tan oxford shoes, with a rose pinned to his tuxedo. He often dons elaborate wizard cosplay attire including staff, cloak, and crooked hat.

Backstory: Simon is an active member of the Gollini Family, a criminal organization that captures and places heroes in dungeon scenarios for entertainment. His fascination with games and dungeon-crawler mechanics has made him well-suited for orchestrating these twisted tournaments, where he monitors captured heroes' progress with sadistic glee.

Additional Information: Simon's Quirk can summon various monster types reminiscent of video game enemies. When his Quirk is enhanced through Anna's Overmodification, his summoning capacity becomes nearly limitless, making him a formidable opponent despite his lack of combat abilities.

cardPool.title: Sidero
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Sidero

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Iron Balls

Occupation/Role: Villain, Humarise member

Personality: Devoted to Humarise's anti-Quirk agenda but pragmatic and self-preserving; quick to betray his organization when facing capture, offering information to heroes to save himself. Suggests tactical improvements to allies in combat.

Appearance: Tall man with slicked-back brown and black hair, squarish stubbled jaw, and an extremely wide mouth. Wears a pale gold horned mask covering his upper face, gray combat suit with short sleeves, and cream-colored boots. Black iron balls protrude from his knuckles on all fingers except his thumbs.

Backstory: Joined Humarise under coercion to avoid execution for possessing a Quirk. Operates as an enforcer for Flect Turn's terrorist organization, pursuing targets across borders. Demonstrates willingness to abandon his cause when cornered, valuing self-preservation over ideological commitment.

Additional Information: Fights alongside Beros during helicopter pursuit. Capable of manipulating his iron ball projectiles to increase in mass and size before impact, causing significant destruction. Ultimately surrenders to Shoto Todoroki in exchange for information about Humarise operations before being punished by Beros for his betrayal.

cardPool.title: Shuichi Iguchi
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Shuichi Iguchi
Alias: Spinner
Quirk Name: Scales
Occupation/Role: Villain, League of Villains member, Vanguard Action Squad operative
Personality: Obsessively devoted to Stain's ideals and methods, displaying surprising moral restraint for a villain. Discriminated against his entire life, he questions the League's increasingly extreme actions and maintains unexpected compassion. Disrespects Heroes but holds himself to a code of honor inspired by his idol.
Appearance: A reptilian humanoid with bright green scales covering his skin and a lizard-shaped face. Pink eyes and long, swept-back desaturated pinkish-purple hair. Wears a white tattered cloth mask like Stain with goggles on his forehead, red scarf, arm bandages under black wristbands, sleeveless shirt, dark baggy pants with brown holsters, black boots, and pale metallic knee guards. Carries an enormous sword made of many smaller blades bound together and wears two belts with secondary blade and blue-white polka chest armor.
Backstory: Ostracized throughout his life due to his Mutant Quirk's appearance, Spinner found purpose and inspiration in Stain's ideals of hero reform. He joined the League of Villains, meticulously emulating his idol's aesthetic and philosophy while struggling with the group's increasingly destructive agenda that diverges from Stain's original vision.
Additional Information: Not a UA student. Member of the Vanguard Action Squad serving as antagonist during the Forest Training Camp Arc. Possesses deep reverence for Stain despite being a villain, creating internal moral conflict with his organization's methods.

cardPool.title: Shoto Todoroki
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Shoto Todoroki

Alias:
A.C. Hero: Shoto

Quirk Name:
Half-Cold Half-Hot

Occupation/Role:
UA High School Student, Class 1-A

Personality:
Serious and reserved with a calm demeanor, Shoto is a driven and determined individual. Despite his stoic appearance, he possesses hidden depth and is capable of forming genuine connections with his peers, though he initially struggles with emotional expression due to his traumatic upbringing.

Appearance:
A moderately tall and well-muscled young man with short neck-length hair distinctly split between white on his right side and red on his left. His heterochromatic eyes—turquoise left and dark gray right—are thin and sharp. A large burn scar runs from his left hairline to mid-cheek. He wears the standard UA blazer with turquoise trimmings, dark blue-green pants, and red tie, paired with pale cyan sneakers. His initial hero costume features an off-white bodysuit with beige tactical vest and ice-like covering on his left side.

Backstory:
Born as the youngest son of Endeavor and Rei Todoroki, Shoto was engineered as a Quirk marriage product designed to surpass All Might. Subjected to intense childhood training, he developed a complex relationship with his fire-based heritage, initially rejecting it entirely. Accepted into UA through official recommendation, he seeks to forge his own path independent of his father's shadow.

Additional Information:
One of only two students admitted to UA through official recommendations rather than the entrance exam. His Quirk grants him simultaneous control over ice and fire, though he initially favors only his ice abilities. Considered exceptionally handsome by his classmates and possesses natural talent that sets him apart among first-year students.

cardPool.title: Shota Aizawa
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Shota Aizawa

Alias:
Erasure Hero: Eraser Head

Quirk Name:
Erasure

Occupation/Role:
Homeroom Teacher of Class 1-A, UA High School

Personality:
Stern, reserved, and logic-driven with lofty expectations for his students. Appears cold and impatient, often preferring rest to unnecessary interaction. Despite his reserved demeanor, he is deeply committed to nurturing the next generation of heroes. Once a gloomy, introverted student plagued by self-doubt, his friendships transformed him into a determined educator.

Appearance:
Shota is a tall, slender man with pale skin and shoulder-length, messy black hair that partially obscures his face. His eyes are half-opened, dark, and typically bloodshot and fatigued-looking. He maintains a perpetually stubbled, unkempt appearance. His hero costume consists of a baggy black long-sleeved shirt and matching pants tucked into boots, paired with a utility belt and his signature wrap scarf. Beneath the scarf, he keeps bright yellow goggles for combat use. When groomed for formal occasions, he wears a black suit with blue tie and white shirt, his hair pulled back in a low bun.

Backstory:
As a UA student, Aizawa struggled with self-doubt regarding his Quirk's combat viability until his friendship with Oboro Shirakumo and Hizashi Yamada helped him recognize his potential. He became a Pro Hero and now serves as a dedicated teacher, shaping Class 1-A during the critical Quirk Apprehension Test arc.

Additional Information:
Prefers to conserve energy; often sleeps in his sleeping bag during downtime. Unmotivated by maintaining appearances or filtering his thoughts for others. His teaching philosophy emphasizes rigorous training and logical development of his students' Quirk abilities.

cardPool.title: Shoko Haimawari
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Shoko Haimawari
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Unknown Slapping Quirk
Occupation/Role: Mother, Civilian
Personality: Strict and domineering with a sharp tongue, though genuinely caring beneath her harsh exterior. She is protective of her son to the point of overcontrol, harboring deep skepticism toward Heroes due to past dangers. Capable of kindness and forming genuine friendships when she lowers her guard.
Appearance: Tall, fair-skinned, slim middle-aged woman with dark eyes and neck-length olive-brown hair styled in a bouffant. She wears a navy-blue blazer with cuffs over a dark brown high-neck top, a matching body-con skirt, dark magenta stockings, and black flats, accessorized with a gold necklace.
Backstory: Raised her son Koichi in the countryside, where she became overprotective after witnessing his Quirk manifest at infancy. She repeatedly struck him with her Quirk whenever he floated, eventually forcing him to suppress the ability entirely. Her fear stems from Koichi's reckless hero fantasies that endangered him and cost him his high school entrance exam. She struggles to balance her love for her son with her desire to keep him safe.
Additional Information: Not a UA student. Mother of Koichi Haimawari, protagonist of the Vigilantes spinoff series. Her pessimistic view of Heroes is rooted in legitimate parental concern, though her methods are counterproductive.

cardPool.title: Sho
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Sho

Alias:
None

Quirk Name:
Unknown

Occupation/Role:
Student at Masegaki Primary School

Personality:
Cheerful and popular among classmates, particularly with girls. Easily flustered and shy in unexpected situations. Displays typical rebellious behavior common to his school's student body.

Appearance:
A small boy with large round eyes and dark hair. Wears a collared long-sleeved red shirt and light brown shorts. Has a youthful, innocent appearance befitting his primary school age.

Backstory:
A student at Masegaki Primary School who gained brief notoriety when selected as part of a Provisional Hero License exam trial alongside his classmates. Used to test the social abilities of UA hero candidates Bakugo, Todoroki, Inasa, and Camie during their second licensing attempt.

Additional Information:
Not a UA student. Known for being exceptionally popular in his class. Was present during the Provisional Hero License examination where he became briefly acquainted with hero candidate Camie Utsushimi.

cardPool.title: Shishido
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Shishido

Alias: Lion Hero: Shishido

Quirk Name: (Not explicitly stated in source; inferred as lion-based enhancement quirk granting increased strength and physical prowess)

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero (No. 13 ranked), Hero Work-Study mentor

Personality: Fiery and hot-blooded, easily provoked and quick to anger, yet capable of surprising compassion when witnessing others' limits. Prideful but willing to set aside rivalries for the greater good and work seamlessly with former competitors.

Appearance: A powerfully muscular man of above-average height with long, spiky brown hair resembling a lion's mane. He wears a golden fur-covered hero costume with prominent spikes designed like fangs, featuring a black maw with exposed teeth. Beneath the coat: fitted black top, brown hide tied at waist with bear-paw clasp, turquoise knee-length jeans, tan spiky-cuffed gloves, and dark boots with golden fur trim.

Backstory: A decorated pro hero known for his leonine features and aggressive combat style, Shishido has risen to the No. 13 hero ranking through raw power and determination. He maintains a complex rivalry with Gang Orca yet proves capable of setting aside differences when duty calls, demonstrating hidden depths beneath his fierce exterior.

Additional Information: Mentors multiple UA students during hero work-studies. Participates in major hero operations including the Villa Raid Team and Final War against villains, commanding respect from both allies and younger heroes despite his volatile temperament.

cardPool.title: Shinya Kamihara
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Shinya Kamihara

Alias: Ninja Hero: Edgeshot

Quirk Name: Foldabody

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero (No. 4 ranked), Leader of The Lurkers

Personality: Calm and focused with unwavering composure in crisis. Intelligent strategist who quickly analyzes situations and discerns enemy tactics. Selfless and brave, willing to take great personal risks to protect others. Maintains composure of a true shinobi, consoling allies when panic sets in.

Appearance: Slim, muscular man of shorter stature than most top heroes. Gray hair styled into three sharp points covering the right side of his face, with dark gray eyes and thin moustache. Wears a blue mask over his lower face tied with red yarn. His ninja-inspired hero costume features red shinobi shozoku under a blue robe, dark arm cloth with white forearm sleeves, dark gloves, and a distinctive red scarf with white patch across his chest. Gold mask adorns his right shoulder; red straps extend from belt and robe. Completes look with blue socks and yellow zori sandals.

Backstory: One of Japan's elite Pro Heroes, Edgeshot rose to No. 4 rank through masterful control of his Quirk and ninja-style combat prowess. He leads The Lurkers as a trusted strategic operative, fighting alongside the greatest heroes against overwhelming threats.

Additional Information: Master of Foldabody technique—can flatten and reshape his body into razor-thin blades, drills, and flat forms to navigate tight spaces or pierce enemies. Capable of incapacitating opponents by cutting blood flow to the brain. Possesses an ultimate technique called Zenith that pushes his abilities to their absolute limit.

cardPool.title: Shinjiro Hohoemi
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Shinjiro Hohoemi

Alias:
Mr. Smiley

Quirk Name:
Smile

Occupation/Role:
Former Villain, Aspiring Artist

Personality:
Passionate and idealistic artist who became disillusioned after rejection, resorting to vandalism to gain recognition. Not inherently malicious but initially resistant to authority. Shows surprising bravery and empathy when confronted with greater threats, and proves capable of genuine remorse and self-reflection upon understanding his mistakes.

Appearance:
Lean yet muscular man with long blonde hair tied in a ponytail, light green tips at the ends. Large blue eyes and a wide, prominent grin. Notably disproportionate forearms and large rounded hands with normal-sized fingers. Wears a pink long-sleeved v-neck shirt with white frills at cuffs and collar, burgundy pants with gray cutaway at midsection and yellow buttons, yellow-buckled belt, black eye mask, and red cowboy hat adorned with two large paintbrushes bearing blue and magenta bristles.

Backstory:
Failed to gain acceptance to art school despite his talent, leading him to pursue art through vandalism and graffiti as a form of rebellion. Initially used his Quirk only to evade capture, believing himself justified in proving his critics wrong. Later recognized his true problem was running from failure rather than confronting it.

Additional Information:
Carries spring-loaded shoe attachments for enhanced mobility and evasion. Uses a holographic projector to activate his Quirk remotely. His Quirk forces victims into uncontrollable laughter for two hours when they see his teeth directly, via mirror, or video feed in real-time. Not suited for direct combat but proved willing to intervene against genuine threats to protect innocent lives.

cardPool.title: Shinji Nishiya
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Shinji Nishiya
Alias: Kamui Woods
Quirk Name: Arbor
Occupation/Role: Pro Hero (No. 7 ranked), Member of The Lurkers
Personality: Serious and focused during hero work, but emotionally sensitive and easily discouraged when others claim credit for his accomplishments. Deeply moved by recognition from respected heroes.
Appearance: Muscular young man of below-average height for a Pro Hero. Distinctive puffy red leaf-like hair visible beneath his dark blue bodysuit hero costume. Wears a helmet that conceals his face, along with a wooden belt, wooden knee pads, and wooden shoes. Two wooden rings with stumps and branches hang from his shoulders. A small bundle of roses decorates the left side of his belt.
Backstory: A remarkably talented hero who rose to No. 7 rank on the JP Billboard Charts through exceptional skill and dedication. Gained the respect of elite heroes like Edgeshot, who invited him to join The Lurkers, an honor that moved him to tears.
Additional Information: His Quirk allows enlargement and control of wooden body parts as strong tree branches, excellent for binding and restraint. Wood-based Quirk is inherently vulnerable to fire-based attacks. Considered by many to be a standout hero of the next generation.

cardPool.title: Shin Nemoto
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Shin Nemoto

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Confession

Occupation/Role: Eight Bullets member of the Shie Hassaikai criminal organization

Personality: Cynical and emotionally detached, viewing feelings as unnecessary obstacles. Exceptionally loyal to Overhaul, whom he considers the only trustworthy person he's met. Holds himself in high esteem among his peers and specializes in psychological manipulation and guerrilla tactics rather than direct combat.

Appearance: A slim man with short, light-colored hair parted with bangs falling across his forehead. He wears a black cape over baggy 3/4-length pants, pale sneakers, and a black bowler hat. Like all Eight Bullets, he sports a black plague mask across his face.

Backstory: A former con artist turned criminal operative, Shin joined the Shie Hassaikai and earned his position among the Eight Bullets through cunning intellect and unwavering devotion to Overhaul. His Quirk made genuine human connection impossible, leaving him isolated until meeting his boss, whom he views as uniquely worthy of trust.

Additional Information: Shin lacks direct combat prowess but excels at marksmanship and psychological warfare. His Confession Quirk forces victims to answer truthfully, which he combines with con artist techniques to demoralize opponents. He works effectively with fellow Eight Bullets member Deidoro Sakaki, who disrupts balance while Shin shoots exposed targets.

cardPool.title: Shikkui Makabe
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Shikkui Makabe

Alias: Mr. Smith

Quirk Name: Hardening

Occupation/Role: Third-year student at Ketsubutsu Academy High School, aspiring Pro Hero

Personality: Smooth and cool, popular heartthrob among his peers. Reserved and quiet but shares his classmates' determination to become heroes. Strategic thinker who believes in collective strength and trusts his class's abilities.

Appearance: Distinctly inhuman with entirely blue, rough, rock-like skin resembling a carapace. No visible hair, nose, or ears; wide jagged mouth with upward-protruding spikes flanking his face. Blue eyes with grooved patterns. Neck composed of stacked rings in darker blue. Wears a black puffed parka with high collar over a thin white shirt, gold chain necklace, baggy cyan pants, and thick dark blue ski boots with furred shafts.

Backstory: A dedicated third-year student at Ketsubutsu Academy training under Ms. Joke's guidance. Participates in the Provisional Hero License Exam against Class 1-A, employing strategic ambushes learned from the U.A. Sports Festival. Works alongside Yo Shindo in coordinated team operations, demonstrating professionalism in both combat and rescue operations during the exam's second phase.

Additional Information: Member of Ketsubutsu Second-Year Class 2. Uses his Hardening Quirk to strengthen projectiles for combat effectiveness. Known for tactical awareness and willingness to adapt strategies when plans encounter resistance.

cardPool.title: Shihai Kuroiro
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Shihai Kuroiro

Alias: Scheming Hero: Vantablack

Quirk Name: Black

Occupation/Role: UA High School Class 1-B Student

Personality: A sly, deceitful schemer who prefers catching opponents off guard with dramatic flair. He enjoys dark concepts and tends to be nervous around girls, often misinterpreting their friendliness as romantic interest. Despite his cunning nature, he shows genuine admiration for those he respects.

Appearance: A tall young man with fluffy white hair and long, thin black eyes that often hold an unsure or irritated expression. His most striking feature is his pitch-black skin, an unusual coloration tied to his Quirk. He wears a simple high-collared black jumpsuit with light shoes featuring dark collars, large silver wristbands with three rectangular indentations, and matching tongue designs.

Backstory: A UA High School student training to become a Pro Hero, Shihai has honed his abilities through rigorous combat experience. His mastery of stealth and tactical cunning make him the stealthiest member of Class 1-B, though his expertise lies in espionage and ambush tactics rather than direct confrontation.

Additional Information: Shihai excels at merging his body with dark-colored objects and moving through them at high speeds, even while carrying others. He demonstrates exceptional tactical intellect, devising complex strategies that exploit both his Quirk and environmental advantages. He is capable of briefly controlling other darkness-based Quirks when merged with them.

cardPool.title: Setsuna Tokage
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Setsuna Tokage

Alias: Lizardy

Quirk Name: Lizard Tail Splitter

Occupation/Role: UA High School Student, Class 1-B

Personality: Chatty, confident, and provocative with a sharp wit. Setsuna is thoughtful and strategic in combat, adopting a severe demeanor when fighting. She's reliable and trustworthy, commanding respect from teammates who willingly follow her lead. Naturally confident and strong-willed, she rarely hesitates or doubts herself, though she can underestimate opponents.

Appearance: Average height with striking large, upturned dusky green eyes and notably long pointed teeth. Dark moss green hair reaches just below her shoulders with a short center forelock, growing wavier toward the ends. Her first hero costume features a purple scaly mask, matching bodysuit with scaly design, black knee-high boots, black fingerless gloves with purple knuckle guards, pale orange wrist-guards, and a black belt with a yellow jewel centerpiece.

Backstory: Admitted to UA High School through recommendation, Setsuna entered Class 1-B with exceptional talent. Her Quirk's versatility and her natural leadership abilities quickly established her as one of the class's elite students. She has proven herself a polyvalent combatant capable of handling multiple objectives simultaneously.

Additional Information: Recommended student with high foundational skill. Her Quirk allows body separation for espionage and multi-angle reconnaissance. Autonomous parts are individually weak but difficult targets. Considered among Class 1-B's strongest despite losing to Bakugo in Joint Training Battle. One of few Class 1-B students without apparent animosity toward Class 1-A.

cardPool.title: Shie Hassaikai Boss
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown (Conjectural)
Alias: Shie Hassaikai Boss
Quirk Name: Unknown
Occupation/Role: Former Yakuza Leader, now imprisoned
Personality: A man of strong moral principles who upholds traditional yakuza code and honor over profit. Fatherly and nurturing despite his criminal past, he attempted to guide his wards toward righteousness even as they strayed. Dignified and resolute, accepting decline with grace rather than compromising his values.
Appearance: An elderly man with a deeply lined face and graying hair. Formerly wore formal black kuro montsuki kimono with dark gray hakama, white tabi, and sandals, signifying his adherence to tradition. Post-Final War, he is severely weakened and emaciated, now confined to a wheelchair for mobility.
Backstory: Once led the Shie Hassaikai yakuza organization during Japan's criminal underworld era. As Heroes rose to prominence and the yakuza declined, he refused to resort to cruelty or exploitation. He adopted orphaned Kai Chisaki and later took in his granddaughter Eri when she was abandoned. When Kai proposed using Eri to create a Quirk-Destroying Drug, the Boss refused and demanded Kai leave, leading Kai to put him in a coma. He was awakened after the Final War and now visits Kai in prison to admonish him and offer redemption.
Additional Information: Not a UA student. Operates under a strict code of honor that distinguishes yakuza from villains. Represents the old guard clinging to tradition as society modernizes. Deeply concerned with the suffering his wards caused, particularly to Eri.

cardPool.title: Sharp Blade
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Sharp Blade
Quirk Name: Unknown
Occupation/Role: Low-ranking villain, League of Villains recruit
Personality: Irritable and impatient, easily frustrated by evasive opponents. Lacks the composure of higher-ranking villains and shows tactical inexperience.
Appearance: Lean build with backward-swept brown hair. Wears a black bodysuit with a black half-mask covering the lower face, pointed dark shades, gray elbow-length gloves, a utility belt, and shoulder braces. Carries twin knives as primary weapons.
Backstory: Recruited by Tomura Shigaraki as part of a large force of expendable villains for the U.S.J. assault. Deployed to the Conflagration Zone where he engaged Class 1-A students, demonstrating minimal combat skill or discipline.
Additional Information: Defeated and captured by Mashirao Ojiro during the U.S.J. incident. Arrested with most other assault team members. His Quirk remains unidentified, suggesting he relied primarily on his knives and physical training rather than superhuman abilities.

cardPool.title: Sensoji

Alias: Mister Blaster

Occupation/Role: UA High School Student, Class 2-B
Personality: Arrogant and self-centered, viewing himself as superior to weaker Quirk users. He is a poor loser who harbors resentment toward those who defeat him, particularly Shota Aizawa. Hypocritical and prone to claiming others' ideas as his own while accusing them of copying him. Despite his flaws, he can acknowledge genuine heroic accomplishments from rivals.
Appearance: A large, muscular man with a prominent square jaw, sharp eyes, and no eyebrows. His short orange hair features long strands at the nape and a pointed pompadour with sideburns. He wears a dark sleeveless tank top with contrasting chest panel separated by white lines, dark trousers with knee pads, and fingerless gloves with forearm guards. Circular ring-like elements adorn his glove palms where his Quirk activates, mirrored as decorative rings on his shoulders, belt, and knee pads. He wears dark-lensed shades to manage his Quirk's blinding side effects.
Backstory: Sensoji is a Class 2-B student at UA High School with a powerful Quirk and an inflated ego to match. His dismissive attitude toward weaker Quirks has created friction with classmates, most notably Shota Aizawa, whom he deeply resents for defeating him in combat.
Additional Information: His Blast Quirk generates powerful energy bursts but produces a blinding flash that affects only him. He initially wore shades to compensate but destroyed them after losing to Aizawa, later adopting goggles as an alternative solution.

cardPool.title: Serpenters
cardPool.value:

Alias: The Serpenters
Quirk Name: Sword Kill
Occupation/Role: Humarise Terrorist Operatives
Personality: Identical twin brothers with erratic, excitable temperaments; devoted to Flect Turn's cause and eager to fight. Both are maniacal and gleeful in combat, laughing constantly while attacking. They joined Humarise seeking survival in the post-Quirk genocide world rather than from genuine ideological conviction, making them opportunistic cowards beneath their violent enthusiasm.
Appearance: Twin men of average build with fair skin, bowl-cut indigo hair, and distinctive yellow reptilian eyes with dark purple markings. They possess large fangs and wear matching simple red and white tunics with gray snake-skin boots. Their reptilian features hint at their serpentine Quirk nature.
Backstory: The Serpenters are twin brothers who gained their Quirks but chose to ally with the anti-Quirk terrorist organization Humarise. Rather than face the promised Quirk genocide, they agreed to serve Flect Turn in exchange for exemption from the planned massacre. They operate as devoted operatives, carrying out their leader's orders without question while indulging their violent impulses.
Additional Information: Their Quirk grants extendable blade weapons capable of cutting through explosive attacks. When enhanced by Trigger drugs, they become more vicious and snake-like, with stretched mouths, spiky hair, and sharper teeth. They operate in perfect synchronization as a duo, attacking from opposite directions to overwhelm opponents.

cardPool.title: Sen Kaibara

Alias: Spiral
Quirk Name: Gyrate
Occupation/Role: UA High School Student, Class 1-B
Personality: Levelheaded and calm, Sen maintains focus in most situations with a plain demeanor. He's open with his opinions and unafraid to disagree openly, showing maturity beyond his peers. Despite his serious nature, he warms up during combat and can be enthusiastic. Rather belligerent, he often gets drawn into his friends' antics but remains composed overall.
Appearance: A young man of average height with dark brown, shaggy hair and distinctive black eyes with white pupils that appear thin and lazy. He has a modest athletic build with a slight tan. His hero costume consists of a white windbreaker with four spiral tube grommets, dark blue undershirt with drill-patterned rings, white sweatpants with matching patterns, red holsters at the midsection, brown shoes, and spiral-patterned gloves covering only his fingers.
Backstory: Sen trains at UA High School to become a Pro Hero, currently in his first year during the Quirk Apprehension Test arc. He demonstrates capability with his Quirk and hand-to-hand combat, using gyrating techniques to augment his physical strikes. Bilingual and skilled, he's proven himself against talented martial artists and continues developing his abilities.
Additional Information: Sen is considered "ikemen" for his good looks. His drill gloves amplify his Quirk's cutting power, making physical defense against his attacks impractical. He shows proficiency in close-quarters combat combined with his rotation-based fighting style.

cardPool.title: Selkie

Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Selkie

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero and Captain of the Oki Mariner
Personality: Confident, kind, and professional with a stern side when needed. He prioritizes hero work and crew protection, with a quirky tendency to deliberately appear cute despite his intimidating appearance, much to his sidekicks' annoyance.
Appearance: A muscular humanoid spotted seal with gray beard, red eye markings, whiskers, and webbed hands. He wears a navy blue wetsuit with silver accents, yellow goggles, and a stylized "S" on the left shoulder, unzipped to reveal his chest. His costume features retractable flippers.
Backstory: A seasoned Pro Hero commanding the Oki Mariner rescue vessel, Selkie has earned his position through dedication to maritime rescue operations and crew leadership. His unique physiology and Quirk make him an invaluable asset for ocean-based heroics.
Additional Information: Proficient in Morse code communication. Quirk abilities include extended breath-holding, diving to 1500 meters depth, echolocation in dark waters, and above-human strength. Uses specialized retractable flipper footwear for amphibious combat.

Second-year student at Shiketsu High School

Personality:
Proud and dignified, valuing obligation and decorum above all else. Eloquent and formal in speech, standing with arms behind his back. Critical and prone to snap judgements of others. Insecure about his small eyes despite denying it. Believes Class 1-A students lack the dignity befitting U.A., particularly dislikes Bakugo. Shows hidden compassion beneath stern demeanor. Struggles with self-reflection and imposing his values on others.
