A young man of average height with thin, slanted eyes and tiny black pupils. Straight purple fringe parted on his right, covering his left eye, with fluffy tufts at the back of his head. Wears standard Shiketsu uniform: white collared shirt, dark pants, and signature Shiketsu hat. Hero costume features a black overcoat with red trimmings and high collar, red-rimmed flaps at the shoulders, elbow-length sleeves with large red cuffs, black apron reaching past knees with red strings, fingerless gloves covering only thumb and first two fingers, and black boots.

Backstory:
A Shiketsu High student training to become a Pro Hero under the school's rigorous teachings of dignity and obligation. Influenced by the Hero Killer's philosophy regarding hero reform, though he refuses to acknowledge this influence. Values heroic integrity above all else and judges others harshly by his own standards.

Additional Information:
Often referred to as "Senpai" due to his eloquent manner. Failed the Provisional Hero License Exam due to prioritizing judgment of others' worthiness over exam objectives. Competitive rival of U.A. Class 1-A students.

Inquisitive and curious, with a caring nature toward her family. She looks up to her older sister Tsuyu despite often being left in her care while their parents work.

Appearance:
A young girl with a tadpole-like appearance featuring large, round eyes with three upper eyelashes and notably small eyebrows. She has light-tanned skin, a naturally pout-like mouth, and dark green hair styled in low pigtails. Her features distinctly reflect her family's froggy theme.

The youngest daughter of the Asui family, Satsuki grew up primarily under her older sister Tsuyu's care while their parents traveled for work. Satsuki has a younger brother named Samidare. She idolizes her sister Tsuyu, who attends UA High School. The family later relocated to an evacuation center during the Paranormal Liberation War while Tsuyu joined the hero efforts in the final conflict.

cardPool.title: Sasori Nimaru

Her talent led to commissions from Pro Heroes, including designing costumes for rising hero students at UA High School such as Katsuki Bakugo and Ochaco Uraraka. Her work is so sought-after that industry professionals immediately recognize her designs.

He wears a pale blue button-up shirt beneath a protective police vest, accessorized with a golden bell at his neck. cardPool.title: Sankyaku Kamehara
cardPool.value:

Occupation/Role: Professional Photographer

Personality: Obsessive perfectionist devoted to capturing ideal moments through patient observation. Possesses crippling self-consciousness and inferiority complex, constantly assuming others resent his presence. Despite passivity, he is capable of growth—Izuku's sincerity inspired him to be more assertive in pursuing his craft.

Appearance: Young man with a distinctive third leg protruding from his body. Short, light-colored hair frames squinting eyes that perpetually suggest focused concentration. Wears a dark vest jacket over matching dark pants. Inseparable from his professional camera, which he carries at all times.

Backstory: A skilled professional photographer hired by Midnight to acclimate Class 1-A to public attention and heroic scrutiny. Spent a week documenting the class, successfully capturing "perfect shots" of every student except Izuku Midoriya. His inability to photograph Deku became an obsessive pursuit that lasted well beyond the initial assignment, testing his patience and methods.

Additional Information: Not a UA student. His pivotal moment came when scaffolding collapsed during one of Deku's rescue efforts—Izuku saved him from the falling debris, proving that involvement in another's work wasn't inherently burdensome. This experience fundamentally shifted Kamehara's perspective on passive observation versus active participation, allowing him to finally collaborate with Deku on staged heroic photography.

cardPool.title: Sanctum
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Sanctum
Alias: None known
Quirk Name: Unknown
Occupation/Role: Top-ranked adviser in the Vanguard Action Tactics Regiment: Black of the Paranormal Liberation Front; former Meta Liberation Army member
Personality: Ideologically devoted and unwavering in his beliefs, Sanctum is brave and steadfast. He serves as a mentor figure, lecturing younger members on organizational mission and values. He does not hesitate to defend his cause directly against opposition.
Appearance: Fair-skinned with dark-black eye irises and long dark-black hair marked by distinctive white stripes on both sides. A thin strand of black hair runs down his middle. He sports a long, thick dark-black mustache and wears thin-framed golden eyeglasses. His attire consists of a dark-blue overcoat with two golden rectangular bars and three button-like epaulettes on the collar.
Backstory: Sanctum is among the oldest members of the Meta Liberation Army, rising to prominence as a trusted adviser. He became deeply invested in the organization's ideology and was instrumental in mentoring newer recruits. When the Meta Liberation Army merged with the League of Villains to form the Paranormal Liberation Front, he retained his high position.
Additional Information: Sanctum's exact Quirk and full combat capabilities remain unknown, though his rank suggests strength exceeding average Pro Heroes. His fate following the Paranormal Liberation War at Gunga Mountain Villa is uncertain—he either was captured or escaped during Gigantomachia's rampage. He operates primarily as a strategist and ideological instructor rather than a frontline combatant.

cardPool.title: Samuel Abraham
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Samuel Abraham
Alias: Sam
Quirk Name: Unknown
Occupation/Role: Scientist and assistant to David Shield at I-Island
Personality: Initially appears goodhearted and dedicated to research, but becomes resentful and greedy when his efforts go unrecognized; willing to betray colleagues for monetary gain, yet capable of genuine surprise at selfless sacrifice.
Appearance: An older, heavyset man with short blonde hair and closed blue eyes; wears formal business attire including a dark suit, tie, suspenders, and dress shoes.
Backstory: Sam co-developed the Quirk Amplification Device with David Shield, a revolutionary headset capable of enhancing Quirks without side effects. When world governments pressured I-Island to confiscate the research, Sam grew bitter about lacking proper compensation for his contributions. During the I-Expo incident, he hired real villains and conspired with them to recover the device, planning to sell it to the criminal Wolfram for payment—a betrayal that nearly cost him his life until David shielded him from a bullet.
Additional Information: Sam represents the corruption that greed can introduce into scientific progress; his arc demonstrates how unrecognized effort can turn idealism into villainy, though redemption remains possible through witnessing genuine sacrifice.

cardPool.title: Samidare Asui
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Samidare Asui

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Frog

Occupation/Role: Student (youngest Asui sibling)

Personality: Laid-back and casual, with a carefree demeanor. He relies on his older sister Tsuyu for care and support, showing typical younger sibling behavior. Despite his relaxed nature, he displays familial affection and pride in his sister's accomplishments.

Appearance: A young boy with a frog-like appearance inherited from his family's quirk. He has black hair that falls across and obscures his right eye, dark green eyes typically half-closed in a sleepy expression, and distinctive blush marks on his cheeks. His overall presentation suggests a lethargic, unbothered youth.

Backstory: The youngest son of the Asui family, Samidare was primarily raised by his older sister Tsuyu after their parents frequently traveled for work. Despite the hardship this placed on Tsuyu, he grew up in a loving household. After the Paranormal Liberation War devastated society, his family relocated to an evacuation center for safety while Tsuyu joined the heroes in battle.

Additional Information: He is the second-youngest of Tsuyu's siblings, with an older sister Satsuki. He shares the frog-type quirk common to his family lineage. He watched the final war broadcast with his family, cheering for his sister's heroic efforts against All For One's forces.

cardPool.title: Sajin Higawara
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Sajin Higawara
Alias: Sand Hero: Snatch
Quirk Name: Sandstorm
Occupation/Role: Pro Hero and Police Force Bodyguard
Personality: Compassionate and justice-driven, deeply caring about crime victims and their families. Courageous in combat but principled, willing to abandon battles to save innocents. Easily angered by villains who revel in their crimes without remorse.
Appearance: Muscular man with turquoise eyes and light ash-blond hair tied in a long ponytail extending from his dark blue mask. Wears a green and silver combat vest with connected tubes running to his back. Distinguished by a long mustache.
Backstory: A dedicated Pro Hero known for his heroic principles and empathy toward victims. Stationed as a bodyguard during the transport of the defeated Overhaul, Snatch confronted the League of Villains during their ambush on the police convoy, fighting to protect both officers and prisoners.
Additional Information: His Sandstorm Quirk transforms his upper body into controllable sand, allowing him to form constructs and gaining immunity to Tomura's Decay due to his granular composition. While his sand body resists fire, his lower body remains vulnerable, a critical weakness exploited by enemies.

cardPool.title: Sameko
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Sameko
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Unnamed Shark Quirk
Occupation/Role: Hero School Student (Hiroshima)
Personality: Loyal and cautious friend who values her companions' safety, though often unable to prevent their reckless actions. Friendly and appreciative of kindness from strangers.
Appearance: Young woman with prominent shark characteristics including sharp teeth, a dorsal fin protruding from the top of her head, long dark hair, large rounded eyes, and an almost nonexistent nose. Her physique reflects her aquatic Quirk nature.
Backstory: Alumnus of a hero school in Hiroshima where she befriended Rumi Usagiyama and Kameko. During a school trip to Osaka, the trio became lost en route to Tsutenkaku Tower but received directions from a young Fat Gum. While preparing to continue their trip, Rumi sensed a nearby battle and leaped away before Sameko and Kameko could stop her.
Additional Information: Calls Rumi Usagiyama by the nickname "Ruko." Her shark Quirk grants her various shark-like attributes, though the full extent of her abilities remains unclear. She is not a UA High School student.

cardPool.title: Salaam
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Salaam
Alias: The Papyrus Hero
Quirk Name: Papyrus
Occupation/Role: Top Egyptian Pro Hero
Personality: Composed and motivating, Salaam projects a calming presence that puts citizens at ease. He is dependable and willing to aid allies internationally, though easily frustrated by bureaucratic delays.
Appearance: A brown-skinned man with a distinctly two-dimensional silhouette reminiscent of ancient Egyptian hieroglyphic art. He wears a pharaoh-inspired hero costume featuring a pleated linen top, wraparound shendyt skirt, striped nemes headcloth, ornamental jewelry, and a flowing cape. His form suggests both nobility and mystery.
Backstory: Salaam earned his reputation as Egypt's premier hero through exceptional skill and an almost supernatural ability to inspire confidence in those around him. He is noted for an enigmatic quality—no one has ever seen his back. During the Humarise crisis, he coordinated with international heroes to combat terrorism in Cairo and later assisted Japan during the Paranormal Liberation War's aftermath.
Additional Information: His Papyrus Quirk grants him extraordinary speed and mobility. Salaam is professional, internationally minded, and committed to protecting both Egypt and global security. His exact origins and the full nature of his mysterious aura remain unexplained.

cardPool.title: Saito
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Saito

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Unknown

Occupation/Role: Middle School Student

Personality: Popular and well-liked among his peers, though little else is known of his true character. He was unremarkable enough that his personal traits remain largely undocumented.

Appearance: A striking doppelgänger for Izuku Midoriya with the same wide eyes and fluffy, dark-shadowed hair, but with black hair and eyes instead of green, lacking freckles. He wore his school's official uniform of light dress shirt, tie, and dark blue blazer, occasionally switching to casual wear like a dark blue t-shirt printed with "Sometimes Tuesday."

Backstory: An ordinary middle school student who unknowingly became the catalyst for Himiko Toga's descent into villainy. After being injured in a fight, his bloodied appearance triggered Toga's Quirk influence, leading her to attack him with a box cutter and drink his blood. This incident forced her to flee, transforming her into a fugitive.

Additional Information: Saito was a classmate of Himiko Toga at an unnamed middle school. He was reportedly well-regarded socially but remains a largely peripheral figure, significant only for his role in Toga's origin story. His own Quirk and current whereabouts are unknown.

cardPool.title: Saiko Intelli
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Saiko Intelli

Alias:
None

Quirk Name:
IQ

Occupation/Role:
Second Year Student at Seiai Academy

Personality:
Arrogant and highly confident in her intellectual superiority, Saiko assumes leadership among her peers and formulates complex strategies with precision. However, she struggles to understand emotional reasoning and empathy-driven actions, viewing decisions through pure logic. She is capable of humility when defeated and can recognize the value of bonds beyond self-interest.

Appearance:
A pale girl of average height with thin, cat-like eyes featuring bluish-lilac irises framed by thick upper lashes. Her straight hair cascades to her waist in a hime cut with ear-length clumps and neat fringe, colored in pale blue-lavender-gray tones. She wears the Seiai Academy uniform: a white double-breasted blazer with gold trim, dark blue long-sleeved shirt, matching dress pants, white gloves and boots, and a white beret with black trim and royal insignia. A golden monocle adorns her left eye, suspended by a chain with a matching blue-tinted jewel.

Backstory:
A prodigy with a natural IQ of 150, Saiko relied on her intellect to dominate her academy. During the Provisional Hero License Exam, she led her classmates against Class 1-A students, devising an elaborate plan to neutralize their Quirks through environmental manipulation and strategic incapacitation. Her defeat exposed her blind spot regarding human connection and compassion.

Additional Information:
Saiko's Quirk temporarily amplifies her already exceptional intellect after consuming tea and closing her eyes, enabling complex tactical planning. Her greatest weakness is her inability to account for emotionally motivated decisions when formulating strategies.

cardPool.title: Saguri-chan
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Saguri

Alias: Explorer Hero: Saguri-chan

Quirk Name: Not specified

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero running the Saguri Agency

Personality: Curious, obsessive about insects with deep entomological knowledge, easily distracted by perceived specimens, somewhat absent-minded and prone to misidentification despite expertise, adventurous and willing to travel uncharted territories in pursuit of villainy and discovery.

Appearance: Young woman with long blonde hair in a ponytail and two face-framing bangs, wide pinkish-red eyes. Wears a light skintight bodysuit ending at the thighs, black belt with boots, black shoulder pads connected by chest belt, side satchels, and explorer goggles completing her adventurer aesthetic.

Backstory: An unconventional Pro Hero known for roaming uncharted lands and pursuing villains wherever curiosity leads. Her agency operates independently, allowing her the freedom to pursue her passion for insect collection and study. Her methods are unorthodox and sometimes dangerous.

Additional Information: Not a UA student. Participated in a Team-Up Mission with Class 1-A students Minoru Mineta and Hanta Sero, during which she mistakenly identified Mineta as an undiscovered insect species and attempted to preserve him in alcohol, causing him significant distress and psychological trauma.

cardPool.title: Ryuko Tatsuma
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Ryuko Tatsuma

Alias: Dragoon Hero: Ryukyu

Quirk Name: Dragon

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero (No. 10), Mentor

Personality: Humble and composed, Ryuko praises deserving talent without seeking gratitude. She maintains calm in combat and willingly delegates difficult tasks to capable individuals. She carries self-doubt despite her rank, feeling unworthy after failing to save someone. She displays a protective, nurturing side toward trainees and cares deeply for children's welfare.

Appearance: A woman with chin-length blonde hair swept back with a headband, long fringe covering her right eye. She has thin yellow eyes with reptilian slit pupils and sharp teeth. She wears a dark red qipao with yellow collar trim, pale green scale-textured shoulder trim, and side-slit skirt with claw-mark designs. Black knee-high boots, long white disconnected sleeves, and a green scale-textured headband with four silver claws adorn her face. Small black dragon wings protrude from the back of her head, with gold spiked ear piercings on her left ear.

Backstory: A seasoned Pro Hero who has mentored promising students through Hero Work-Studies. Once ranked No. 9, she dropped to No. 10, a decline she blames entirely on herself. She experienced trauma witnessing a child's exploitation and takes child welfare personally. Her long career has shaped her into a humble, self-reflective hero who values saving lives above accolades.

Additional Information: Not a UA student; an established professional hero. Her dragon transformation grants enhanced strength capable of overpowering yakuza members with superhuman power. She is detail-oriented about her responsibilities and mentees' growth.

cardPool.title: Ryuichi Gojiyama
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Ryuichi Gojiyama

Alias: The Kaiju

Quirk Name: Kaiju

Occupation/Role: Instant Villain

Personality: Wild and bestial, especially when under the influence of Trigger. Loses rational thought and becomes purely instinct-driven, acting as a destructive force rather than a thinking individual.

Appearance: When transformed by his Quirk, a 15-meter tall bipedal theropod creature with grey scales, jagged spikes running down his back, horns on his snout, digitigrade legs with clawed feet and fingers, and a large rounded mouth resembling a Tyrannosaurus rex. His entire tongue is blackened from Trigger use. His true human form remains unseen.

Backstory: Ryuichi's origins are mysterious, appearing suddenly in Naruhata city. He was administered Trigger by Kuin Hachisuka, transforming him into a rampaging kaiju that destroyed buildings and damaged the Marukane Department Store before being confronted and defeated by Pro Hero Captain Celebrity.

Additional Information: Not a UA student. His Quirk's normal capabilities are unknown, having only been observed under Trigger's influence. He was apprehended after reverting to human form following his confrontation with Captain Celebrity.

cardPool.title: Ryu Yoshida
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Ryu Yoshida
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Unknown
Occupation/Role: Doctor at Central Hospital
Personality: Professional, well-meaning, and remarkably brave; willing to stand against dangerous threats to protect patients and staff; develops a reputation for saving those considered beyond saving.
Appearance: Distinctive dinosaur-like features with teal skin, four dark blue plates atop his head, and a prominent white beak. Large interconnected eyes with small dull green pupils. Wears a white doctor's coat over a dark blue shirt. Tall and peculiar in frame, his quirk-based appearance makes him instantly recognizable.
Backstory: Ryu serves as head doctor at Central Hospital, treating severe injuries from major conflicts. He has witnessed Japan's darkest hours, from the Paranormal Liberation War through societal collapse, yet remained steadfast in his duty to heal. His courage was tested when he stood with hospital staff against rampaging mutant forces to protect vulnerable patients.
Additional Information: Not a UA student; established medical professional. Known for performing critical surgeries on high-profile patients including top Heroes. His calm demeanor and moral conviction make him a pillar of stability in crisis situations, despite the horrific injuries and grim diagnoses he must sometimes deliver.

cardPool.title: Ryo Inui
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Ryo Inui

Alias: Hound Dog

Quirk Name: Dog

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero and Head of Student Discipline at U.A. High School

Personality: Gruff and volatile, prone to aggressive outbursts when angered that manifest as incoherent growls and barks. Despite his rough demeanor, he possesses a sense of justice and can be fair—praising students when warranted but also holding them accountable for rule violations.

Appearance: Dog-like features including a scruffy mane of blond hair sticking straight out behind his head and a slightly pointed snout. He wears a black muzzle as part of his hero costume. His frame is muscular and bestial in nature due to his Quirk's influence.

Backstory: A seasoned Pro Hero known as the Hunting Dog Hero, Ryo was recruited to serve as Head of Student Discipline at U.A., where he oversees student conduct and safety. His role places him at odds with students who break rules, though he ultimately seeks to guide them toward becoming responsible heroes.

Additional Information: Ryo is a staff member and Pro Hero at U.A., not a student. His Quirk grants him dog-like abilities including enhanced smell and apparently the ability to manifest clones or duplicates. He struggles with emotional control, particularly when frustrated, causing his speech to devolve into animalistic sounds.

cardPool.title: Roro Soul
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Roro Soul

Alias:
None

Quirk Name:
Unknown

Occupation/Role:
Student (formerly); Resident of Otheon Shantytown

Personality:
Kind-hearted and cheerful despite severe hardship, Roro maintains unwavering loyalty and love for his older brother Rody. He demonstrates resilience and adaptability, accepting his circumstances without complaint while supporting his younger sister Lala emotionally.

Appearance:
A small young boy with flat, brown hair and gray eyes. He wears a patched cadet blue and white shirt with visible wear—the left sleeve and right side of the waist are sewn together with makeshift repairs, reflecting his impoverished life in the shantytown.

Backstory:
Born in Otheon to engineer Eddie Soul and a deceased mother, Roro's early childhood was happy until his father abandoned the family to join the anti-Quirk sect Humarise. Expelled from school and ostracized by their community, the Soul siblings were forced to abandon their vandalized home and relocate to a dilapidated caravan in the shantytown. Throughout this period of poverty and danger, Roro remained emotionally dependent on his eldest brother Rody for protection and care.

Additional Information:
Roro survived the Humarise crisis when Rody disarmed the Trigger Bombs worldwide. Following the resolution, he and Lala were able to re-enroll in school and rebuild their lives with restored social standing in Otheon.

cardPool.title: Ronaudo Keage
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Ronaudo Keage

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Not specified

Occupation/Role: UA High School Student, Department of Management

Personality: Enterprising and analytical, focused on hero marketing and public perception. He demonstrates business acumen by assessing hero marketability and recognizes the importance of media documentation. Shows pragmatic thinking about hero society's image management.

Appearance: Young man of average height with short, dark purple hair styled similarly to Kyoka's. He has small round eyes and distinctive counter-clockwise swirl-like blush marks on his cheeks. Typically wears his UA gym uniform.

Backstory: A Department of Management student at UA High School, Ronaudo pursues business courses specializing in heroic commerce. He analyzes hero marketability during events like the UA Sports Festival, particularly studying Izuku. His focus extends to media production and public relations for heroes.

Additional Information: Often associates with classmates Futo and Komako. Part of the business-focused track within UA's Management Department rather than the standard hero course. His work involves understanding how heroes are perceived and marketed to society.

cardPool.title: Romero Fujimi
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Romero Fujimi

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Zombie Virus

Occupation/Role: Isami Academy High School Student

Personality: Arrogant and condescending, Romero looks down on others and shows little regard for safety or consequences. He is gruff, unkind, and reckless with his abilities, though classmates claim he isn't truly malicious at heart. He idolizes All Might despite his abrasive demeanor.

Appearance: Romero has a slouched, unkempt appearance with desaturated bluish-gray hair messily spiked over his right eye, no eyebrows, and wide bug-like eyes. His nose is simplified as two dots with overly distinctive straight teeth. He wears the Isami High uniform: white dress shirt, red tie, dark blue blazer, gray pants, and brown loafers. His hero costume consists of a black double-breasted coat with high collar, thick gray cuffs extending past his knees, wires and nozzles around waist and limbs, pinstriped pants, and pointed shoes. A translucent purple-tinted mask covers his mouth.

Backstory: A student of Isami Academy, Romero developed an immediate rivalry with Katsuki Bakugo upon meeting Class 1-A, viewing UA as beneath him. His arrogance led him to carelessly deploy his Zombie Virus during the Quirk Apprehension Test, nearly incapacitating an entire class before becoming a victim of his own creation when Bakugo, transformed into a zombie, bit him.

Additional Information: Romero is vulnerable to his own Quirk and must wear a breathing mask at all times. The zombies he creates retain fragments of their original personalities while gaining enhanced strength and the ability to spread the virus through biting.

cardPool.title: Rojiya Yonenaga
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Rojiya Yonenaga

Alias:
None

Quirk Name:
Strength Enhancement

Occupation/Role:
Executive Member of Abegawa Tenchu Kai (Yakuza Organization)

Personality:
Serious and composed man with an unflinching demeanor. Shows indifference to external pressures and maintains philosophical detachment about circumstances beyond his control. Never displays signs of drunkenness and collects manhole covers as an unusual personal habit, weaponizing them in combat.

Appearance:
Tall man with strong physical bearing. Distinctive large scar marks his left eyebrow. Wears a white suit with blue blouse underneath, topped with an overcoat bearing a star logo. Dark hair, intimidating presence befitting his yakuza status.

Backstory:
A seasoned executive within the Abegawa Tenchu Kai, Rojiya has earned respect among his organization's ranks through composure and capability. His unconventional combat approach—collecting and throwing manhole covers—demonstrates both resourcefulness and eccentric character. He maintains philosophical acceptance of the criminal underworld's realities, unfazed even as his organization faces official designation as a villainous threat.

Additional Information:
Strength Enhancement Quirk activates with right arm glowing and emitting sparks, enabling him to throw manhole covers with devastating force and precision. Combat-tested executive with exceptional durability and throwing accuracy. Deceased during attack on Tenchu Kai headquarters by the vigilante Stendhal.

cardPool.title: Rikiya Yotsubashi
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Rikiya Yotsubashi

Alias: Re-Destro

Quirk Name: Stress

Occupation/Role: President and CEO of Detnerat Company; Grand Commander of the Meta Liberation Army

Personality: Outwardly affable and easygoing, Rikiya masks a ruthless, ideological fanatic devoted to his ancestor Destro's vision of uncontrolled Quirk liberation. He kills without hesitation when disrespected but shows genuine remorse afterward. Intelligent and manipulative, he uses society's flaws to recruit followers while viewing himself as a savior for outcasts.

Appearance: A tall, odd-looking middle-aged man with a prominently long, pointed nose and protruding chin. He has short orange-brownish hair swept back with a downward-pointing widow's peak, small dark eyes, no visible eyebrows, and two dark moles on his left forehead. Despite appearing slim, he is muscular. He always wears a black pinstriped suit with a green dress shirt and tie, often with a black hat and coat.

Backstory: Descendant of the infamous villain Destro, Rikiya inherited leadership of the modernized Meta Liberation Army while building Detnerat into a legitimate corporate front. He genuinely believes society oppresses those with unconventional Quirks and recruits disenfranchised individuals to his cause of total Quirk liberation through ideological manipulation and violence.

Additional Information: Not a UA student. Operates as a corporate villain-terrorist hybrid. His Quirk causes hair recession and manifests visually as dark fire-like stains around his eyes when emotionally activated, resembling a domino mask.

cardPool.title: Rogone
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Rogone
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Transformation
Occupation/Role: Humarise Terrorist Agent
Personality: Ruthless and devoted to Flect Turn's anti-Quirk ideology, Rogone shows no mercy even to surrendering targets. He is willing to kill without hesitation and dismisses pleas for compassion.
Appearance: A slim man with red skin, sunken eyes, and a thin mustache. He has two sharp teeth protruding from an underbite, a single pointed horn curving upward from his forehead, and sharp fingernails. He wears a dark costume similar to other Humarise operatives. In transformed state, he becomes massive and muscular with darker crimson skin, two large horns sprouting from his head sides, grotesque facial features, and iron clubs for arms.
Backstory: Rogone serves as an elite operative for the anti-Quirk terrorist organization Humarise under Flect Turn. He was deployed to capture Izuku Midoriya and Rody Soul after they obtained a classified briefcase. During this mission, he confronted Rody and transformed to eliminate him, but was defeated by Izuku's superior combat power and knocked unconscious.
Additional Information: Rogone's Transformation Quirk grants him immense strength and durability, allowing him to withstand direct impact from powerful air-based attacks. He was ultimately captured when Humarise's terrorist plot was foiled.

cardPool.title: Rody Soul
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Rody Soul

Alias:
None

Quirk Name:
Pino

Occupation/Role:
Resident of Otheon; Aspiring Pilot

Personality:
Carefree and charismatic smooth-talker who masks deeper insecurity through humor and exaggeration. Deeply protective of his younger siblings to the point of self-sacrifice. Cynical about fairness due to poverty and community ostracism, willing to steal or deceive for survival, yet capable of genuine trust and chivalry once earned. Embarrassed by his Quirk's emotional transparency.

Appearance:
Young man with auburn hair tied into a spiky ponytail and half-lidded gray eyes. Sun-kissed skin complements his casual style: red bandanna, pale blue patched shirt, tan-beige jacket with orange flower accent, blue-red striped tie, gray gloves, and black ankle-length pants with knee patches. Dark brown shoes with gray cloth wrapping complete his streetwear aesthetic.

Backstory:
Abandoned by his father as a child and shunned by his Otheon community for his father's ties to the terrorist cult Humarise, Rody became the sole provider for his younger siblings Roro and Lala. He survives through odd jobs, parkour skills, and morally gray means, developing a cynical worldview shaped by the slums' lack of hero presence and rampant inequality.

Additional Information:
Skilled acrobat and negotiator despite resource scarcity. His Quirk involuntarily reveals his true emotions, which he finds humiliating. Dreams of becoming a pilot to escape his circumstances and secure his siblings' futures.

cardPool.title: Robot
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Robot
Quirk Name: Spatial Distortion, Eye Beam, Super Regeneration
Occupation/Role: High-End Nomu, Doctor Kyudai Garaki's combat unit
Personality: Obedient to orders, prefers ranged combat, methodical and cold. Avoids close-quarters engagement when possible.
Appearance: Humanoid frame with extensive robotic augmentation. Mechanical legs and metallic plating across his body. Entire head encased in a sleek robotic helmet with no exposed brain. Eyes glow with energy capacity for beam attacks. Built for combat efficiency rather than aesthetics.
Backstory: Originally a combat-focused villain, Robot was handpicked by Doctor Garaki for conversion into a High-End Nomu due to his natural disposition for fighting. Enhanced with multiple Quirks and robotic enhancements, he served as a guardian in Garaki's lab beneath Jaku General Hospital. During the hero raid, he was unleashed alongside other High-Ends to defend Garaki and Tomura Shigaraki.
Additional Information: High-End Nomu classification grants enhanced durability and power beyond standard Nomu. Spatial distortion allows remote attacks via hand gestures. Eye beams serve as secondary offensive capability. Killed by hero Mirko during the Paranormal Liberation War Arc.

cardPool.title: Robber Villain
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown

Alias: Robber Villain

Quirk Name: Smoke

Occupation/Role: Petty criminal and fugitive

Personality: Fierce and moody with a quick temper, but strategically cautious. He avoids direct confrontation with heroes when possible, preferring escape over combat. Uses violence only as a last resort and maintains enough composure to execute planned robberies despite his volatile nature.

Appearance: A stout figure with dark blue skin, rounded noseless head with pointed ears, and striking green eyes. His most distinctive feature is a single antenna protruding from the crown of his head, with three smoke-emitting holes on each shoulder. He dresses in a black vest with yellow trim, white pants, brown boots, black armbands with yellow lining, and a green handkerchief around his neck. He perpetually smokes three cigarettes simultaneously.

Backstory: A small-time criminal who has committed multiple robberies across Tasomiya Ward, relying on his Quirk to evade law enforcement and pro heroes. He has clashed with several heroes including Midnight, Loud Cloud, His Purple Highness, and notably Eraser Head multiple times. Eventually apprehended after being defeated when Eraser Head equipped protective eyewear to neutralize his smoke-based evasion tactic.

Additional Information: Not a UA High School student. Operates as an independent criminal rather than part of any organized villain group. His Smoke Quirk makes him effective at escape and concealment but renders him vulnerable in direct combat against prepared opponents. Currently in police custody following his capture by Loud Cloud.

cardPool.title: Rin Yaritezawa
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Rin Yaritezawa

Alias:
None

Quirk Name:
Not specified

Occupation/Role:
Sophomore at Naruhata Women's College; Event Organizer

Personality:
Outwardly sociable and approachable, but privately bitter and resentful from being exploited for her organizational skills. Deeply appreciates genuine kindness and reciprocal warmth, as evidenced by her affection for those who treat her with care.

Appearance:
Sharp green eyes with short, dark brown hair parted from the right side of her forehead. She paints her fingernails pink and wears gold drop earrings with star-shaped charms. At social events, she dresses stylishly in loose V-neck sweaters and skirts with coordinating accessories like necklaces and gold bracelets.

Backstory:
A college student known for her knack at organizing mixers and social gatherings. Years of planning events while being taken advantage of by others has left her cynical about romance and human nature, despite her surface-level friendliness masking deeper emotional wounds.

Additional Information:
Not a UA High School student. Appears in My Hero Academia: Vigilantes. Prone to drinking at social events. Responds warmly to genuine acts of kindness and concern from others.

cardPool.title: Rikiya Katsukame
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Rikiya Katsukame

Alias:
Eight Bullets member

Quirk Name:
Energy Suck

Occupation/Role:
Member of the Shie Hassaikai yakuza organization under Overhaul

Personality:
Lazy and energy-dependent, requiring vitality to function effectively. Enjoys draining others' stamina, which invigorates him. Demonstrates obedience to Overhaul and a slightly perverted streak when stimulated by Trigger drug enhancement.

Appearance:
A tall, exceptionally muscular man with a large, imposing frame. He wears a black sleeveless tank top with a standby symbol, olive drab jeans, and an armored belt. Orange sneakers and blue socks complete his outfit. His most distinctive feature is a black plague mask covering his entire head, adorned with red lines, white eyes, and golden neck detailing. He wears massive gauntlets and knuckledusters on both fists. A metallic seat protrudes from his back, used to transport other Hassaikai members.

Backstory:
Rikiya met Overhaul at an unknown point in his past and became his loyal associate. Overhaul later recruited him as one of the Shie Hassaikai's Eight Bullets, making him a key enforcer for the yakuza organization. His role involves combat operations and serving as a first line of defense against threats to Hassaikai interests.

Additional Information:
Rikiya's Quirk allows him to absorb stamina and vitality from nearby individuals, which strengthens him while weakening opponents. When enhanced by the Trigger drug, his ability evolves to drain vitality through inhalation alone without physical contact. Despite his formidable strength and combat skills, he was eventually defeated and arrested during the Shie Hassaikai Raid.

cardPool.title: Ribby
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Ribby (formerly unnamed serial killer)
Alias: High-End Nomu Ribby
Quirk Name: Super Regeneration, Extendable Antennae, Rib Cage Manipulation
Occupation/Role: High-End Nomu under Doctor Kyudai Garaki
Personality: Unhinged and homicidal, driven by an immediate bloodlust to kill. Possesses genuine tactical intelligence, recognizing environments and opponents to exploit weaknesses. Capable of cunning strategy, as demonstrated by coordinating with other High-Ends and adapting to hero tactics mid-combat.
Appearance: Humanoid Nomu with a severely emaciated, shriveled frame lacking muscle definition. Distinctive protruding ribs visible through the chest cavity. Long, antenna-like protrusions extend from the head, capable of elongating to significant lengths. Gaunt and skeletal overall physiology compared to other High-Ends.
Backstory: Originally a psychotic serial killer, Ribby was deliberately selected by Doctor Garaki for conversion into a High-End Nomu due to his inherent violent nature. Awakened during the Paranormal Liberation War as part of Garaki's defense against the hero raid on Jaku General Hospital. Fought extensively against top-tier Pro Heroes including Mirko and Endeavor before being destroyed by Crust's sacrifice.
Additional Information: High-End Nomu classification grants enhanced combat capabilities and regenerative durability. Antennae capable of piercing through reinforced targets. Engages in extended battles against multiple Pro Heroes simultaneously. Operates under variable leadership during combat scenarios.

cardPool.title: Rikiya Eno
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Rikiya Eno

Alias:
The Instant Villain

Quirk Name:
Big Monkey

Occupation/Role:
Vigilante/Petty Criminal

Personality:
Reckless and easily influenced by external stimuli, prone to destructive behavior when chemically enhanced. Limited information on baseline personality due to brief appearances.

Appearance:
In normal form, unremarkable and unremarkable in stature. When transformed via Trigger, becomes a massive rotund ape with dark fur, standing several meters tall, wearing black shorts as his only clothing. His ape form is muscular yet barrel-chested.

Backstory:
A minor criminal who fell into the Trigger drug trade, using the substance to amplify his quirk for petty crimes and street chaos. Attempted to cause mayhem atop a city tower before being swiftly defeated by the hero Captain Celebrity in a single punch during an incident near the Naruhata Festival.

Additional Information:
Rikiya's quirk requires external chemical enhancement via Trigger to manifest meaningfully. His transformation is temporary and reversible. He operates outside official hero society as a street-level threat rather than a formal villain organization member.

cardPool.title: Rikido Sato
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Rikido Sato

Alias:
Sweets Hero: Sugarman

Quirk Name:
Sugar Rush

Occupation/Role:
UA High School Student, Class 1-A

Personality:
Optimistic and good-natured, Rikido is known for his genuine interest in baking and sharing sweets with classmates through weekly "Sugar Time" gatherings. He appears humble about his confectionery talents despite their quality, and maintains a straightforward, earnest demeanor in combat situations.

Appearance:
A tall, very muscular young man with a broad build and short, spiky brown hair. He has small square-shaped eyes with tiny pupils, bushy eyebrows, thick full lips, and a large round nose. At UA, he wears the standard male uniform: light gray blazer with turquoise trim, white dress shirt, dark blue-green pants, red tie, and brown shoes. His hero costume is a yellow full-body suit with openings for his mouth, eyes, and hair, paired with white gloves, white boots, and a utility belt containing sugar pouches.

Backstory:
Rikido developed his baking skills out of practical necessity—his Quirk requires sugar to function, and homemade sweets proved more economical than store-bought alternatives. His culinary talents have impressed his peers and contributed to his reputation as a reliable, community-oriented member of Class 1-A.

Additional Information:
Sugar Rush requires 10 grams of sugar to activate, granting five-fold strength increases for three minutes. Additional sugar extends duration by three minutes per 10 grams. Extended use causes cognitive decline and drowsiness. He has trained extensively with weightlifting while consuming large quantities of sweets to maximize his Quirk's effectiveness.

cardPool.title: Reiko Yanagi
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Reiko Yanagi

Alias:
Emily

Quirk Name:
Poltergeist

Occupation/Role:
Hero Course Student, Class 1-B, U.A. High School

Personality:
Quiet and emotionally reserved, with a fascination for horror and the macabre. Despite her timid nature and cryptic speech patterns, she demonstrates helpfulness and good fashion sense. She maintains an eerie, undead-like posture with elbows tucked and hands dangling.

Appearance:
A notably pallid, slender young woman with pale silver pin-straight hair in an unkempt pixie-bob that frames her chin. Her left face is partially obscured by a sharp side-swept patch of hair. She has dark prussian-blue half-lidded eyes with pointed lower lashes, thin brows, and plump lips. Her hero costume is a light periwinkle-blue kimono with a large puffy hood, long flared sleeves, white and navy striping across the abdomen, and matching boots with an off-piece neck mask.

Backstory:
A first-year student at U.A. High School's Hero Course, Reiko has honed her telekinetic abilities under professional guidance. Her analytical mind and strategic thinking have made her a valuable team member during cooperative training exercises.

Additional Information:
Her Poltergeist Quirk allows telekinetic control of nearby objects with significant weight capacity. She works effectively in team compositions, strategically identifying threats and coordinating long-range attacks without exposing her position. She hosts horror movie watch parties with her classmates and shows strong tactical intellect in combat analysis.

cardPool.title: Rei Todoroki
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Rei Todoroki

Alias:
Rei Himura (maiden name)

Quirk Name:
Frost

Occupation/Role:
Homemaker, Mother

Personality:
Rei is a kind, caring woman who endures hardship with quiet resilience. Once stoic and reserved, she has become mentally fragile due to years of abuse, though recovery has restored her compassionate nature. She maintains hope and smiles despite trauma, showing deep love for her children while struggling with lingering psychological wounds.

Appearance:
A middle-aged woman of average height and build with shoulder-length straight white hair, parted into three sections with long bangs framing her face. She has round, gentle features with tired-looking brown-gray eyes and reasonably long eyelashes. Her expression is typically mellow and kind. She favors plain civilian clothing in soft colors like yellow and orange.

Backstory:
Rei married Enji Todoroki in a arranged Quirk Marriage to help her family financially, accepting the proposal despite its nature. She bore four children while suffering escalating abuse from her husband. The psychological toll eventually caused a breakdown where she severely burned her youngest son Shoto. Currently institutionalized at Fujani Hospital, she has regained mental stability and reconciled with Shoto, receiving visits from her other children while remaining afraid to face Enji.

Additional Information:
Not a UA student. Rei is a victim of domestic abuse whose story explores the collateral damage of Quirk society's exploitation. She uses her Frost Quirk defensively and has demonstrated remarkable emotional strength despite trauma.

cardPool.title: Red
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Red
Alias: Aka
Quirk Name: Unknown
Occupation/Role: Top-ranked Adviser, Vanguard Action Intelligence Regiment: Carmine (Paranormal Liberation Front)
Personality: Casual and composed, able to maintain calm conversation even in tense situations. Unfazed by interruptions and unpredictability from allies.
Appearance: Tall, well-built young man with blonde hair styled in a ponytail, left eye mostly obscured by his hair. Wears military-style army green outfit with black vest, black boots, and brown pouch at waist.
Backstory: Originally a member of the Meta Liberation Army before its merger with the League of Villains. Rose through ranks to become a trusted top adviser in the reorganized Paranormal Liberation Front's intelligence regiment.
Additional Information: Exact Quirk ability remains undisclosed. Proven strength exceeds average Pro Hero level based on his high rank within the organization. Associates with high-level figures like Hawks and Twice.

cardPool.title: Raito Sanda
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Raito Sanda

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Unnamed Electricity Quirk

Occupation/Role: Third-year middle school student; prospective UA applicant

Personality: Serious and studious with exceptional analytical abilities. Dedicated to learning deeply rather than superficially, capable of sophisticated technical discussions. Initially follows others' expectations but demonstrates independence and self-awareness when reconsidering his true ambitions.

Appearance: Boy with wild, spiky hair and electricity-bundle-shaped eyebrows. Pitch-black eyes with white pupils. Wears standard male middle school uniform with a book bag slung over his right shoulder. Youthful, unblemished appearance typical of his age.

Backstory: A top-performing student at his middle school with a strong reputation as a promising candidate for UA's Hero Course. During UA's Prospective Students Day, Raito engaged with Support Course innovations and participated in a tag game against Hero Course student Katsuki Bakugo. Though his electrical Quirk proved effective defensively, Bakugo's aggressive tactics overwhelmed him. The encounter prompted Raito to reconsider his path, realizing he pursued heroics only due to external pressure. After a stimulating debate with Business Course students, he decided the Business Course better suited his true interests and intellectual inclinations.

Additional Information: Known for having a particularly strong memory and genuine curiosity about technical systems. Travels with fellow prospective student Fuji Fukiyose. His Quirk allows electrical shocks upon contact, granting defensive advantages but limited offensive range.

cardPool.title: Rapt Tokage
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Rapt Tokage

Alias: Instant Villain

Quirk Name: Lizard

Occupation/Role: Vigilante, Former Villain

Personality: A reformed bully with a humorous streak and self-deprecating sense of responsibility. Despite his cruel past of mocking others alongside friends, he demonstrates genuine concern for them and learns from consequences. Quick to joke and tease, but capable of making difficult choices for the greater good.

Appearance: A reptilian humanoid with turquoise scales covering his body, long oval head, and sharp-toothed mouth stretching across his face. Large reptilian eyes dominate his features, with only small nostrils for a nose. A muscular tail extends from his lower spine. He wears a casual hooded jacket, brown waistcoat, and simple shorts, presenting an unexpectedly casual aesthetic for his monstrous form.

Backstory: Originally part of a bullying clique at an unspecified institution, Rapt participated in humiliating classmates for entertainment. His involvement with Trigger dramatically altered his appearance and granted temporary flight, but hospitalization forced him to confront his drug use. He abandoned further Trigger consumption and transitioned from villain to vigilante, seeking redemption while maintaining his sardonic personality.

Additional Information: Lizard Quirk grants him enhanced reptilian traits; Trigger amplifies these into pterosaur-like wings and increased mutation but comes with severe health risks. His personal growth centers on resisting substance temptation and using his monstrous nature constructively rather than destructively.

cardPool.title: President Tanuki
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: President Tanuki
Quirk Name: Tanuki
Occupation/Role: Manager of Marukane Department Store
Personality: Jovial and community-minded, eager to promote his business through cultural events and festivities; generous with store incentives and willing to celebrate with employees.
Appearance: A rotund man with light brown fur covering his body, resembling a tanuki. He has a muzzle with four whiskers and a small black nose, with small round ears atop his head. Thinning black hair crowns his scalp. He wears a brown blazer, navy-blue vest, white dress shirt, and green tie, complemented by large oval-frame glasses and dress pants.
Backstory: President Tanuki manages the Marukane Department Store with a focus on community engagement and festive promotions. He actively seeks opportunities to increase the store's visibility through events like Narufest and celebrates alongside his business partners and employees during holiday gatherings.
Additional Information: Not a UA High School student. His Quirk's full capabilities beyond granting tanuki appearance are unknown. He demonstrates entrepreneurial acumen and a friendly disposition toward those in his professional circle.

cardPool.title: Pony Tsunotori
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Pony Tsunotori

Alias:
Rocketti

Quirk Name:
Horn Cannon

Occupation/Role:
UA High School Student, Class 1-B

Personality:
Friendly and somewhat naive, with innocent charm that makes her susceptible to manipulation. She is determined, observant in combat, and thoughtful—willing to settle for tactical draws rather than reckless victories. When angered or flustered, she reverts to English, her native tongue. She shares a passion for anime and manga with classmates.

Appearance:
A short girl with a round face and delicate equine muzzle framed by thick, wavy blonde hair reaching mid-back with shorter bangs. Her large, round Prussian blue eyes are distinctly expressive. Tall, lyre-shaped pale tan horns crown her head. Her calves are distinctly horse-like with brown hooves, and a short horse tail protrudes from her tailbone. Her hero costume is jockey-themed: orange skin-tight shirt with pale markings, matching pants, fingerless orange-tipped gloves, a horse halter with lead rope, and belted boots with stirrups designed for transporting allies.

Backstory:
Born and raised American of Japanese descent, Pony came to UA High School to train as a Pro Hero despite incomplete fluency in Japanese. Her unique physiology and Quirk grant her exceptional mobility and combat versatility, making her one of Class 1-B's fastest combatants.

Additional Information:
Horn Cannon allows rapid projectile fire and physical manipulation of her horns for piercing or pinning enemies. Her horns are strong enough to transport allies at high speeds. She excels in long-range combat and coordinated team strategies, seamlessly combining offense with support capabilities. Her Thunder Horn technique counters multi-ranged opponents effectively.

cardPool.title: Paulo Gollini
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Paulo Gollini

Alias:
None

Quirk Name:
Erasure Spot

Occupation/Role:
Member of the Gollini Family mafia

Personality:
Cautious and dutiful, Paulo is more direct and serious than his peers, preferring swift execution over prolonged torment. However, beneath his stern exterior lies cowardice—he panics and becomes desperate when cornered, quickly abandoning confidence to beg for mercy.

Appearance:
Paulo cuts an unsettling figure with purple skin, small black eyes, and no visible mouth. His face tapers to a pointed muzzle with jagged fin-shaped ears angling upward. He dresses formally in a black suit with leather tailcoat, white gloves, purple tie, and black pants paired with brown derby shoes. A black fedora with ear holes completes his ensemble, and a red rose adorns his tailcoat.

Backstory:
Paulo earned his place within the Gollini Family through diligent service, though he carries the shame of a previous failure allowing Ginji Kurau to escape with Anna Scervino. Seeking redemption, he took on the task of eliminating threats to the family's operations.

Additional Information:
Paulo's Erasure Spot Quirk creates a dome-shaped energy wave that deactivates Quirks within range, though he can form smaller bubbles where Quirks remain active. When his Quirk is artificially overmodified, its range expands to cover entire mountain ranges. He operates with tactical coordination but lacks the fortitude to withstand sustained pressure in actual combat.

cardPool.title: Pankration
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Pankration
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Power
Occupation/Role: Pro Hero
Personality: Friendly and approachable, greeting civilians warmly despite his imposing stature. Professional and reliable when called upon for heroic duties.
Appearance: Tall and heavily muscular man with long blonde hair flowing downward. Wears a red sleeveless breastplate with white chiton-style garment draped over shoulders and belted at waist, falling to knees like a skirt. Large metallic vambraces with frilled hems cover his arms. A thin silver circlet adorns his forehead. Greaves and sandals complete his ancient Greek-inspired hero costume.
Backstory: An established Greek Pro Hero known for his immense physical strength derived from his Power Quirk. He operates internationally and has been called upon for major operations, including rescue missions and criminal apprehension tasks.
Additional Information: Not a UA student. Pankration is a seasoned Pro Hero selected for specialized task forces. His Quirk allows him to absorb and unleash raw power, making him one of the physically strongest heroes available for dangerous operations.

cardPool.title: Pamela
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Pamela
Alias: Mrs. Captain Celebrity
Quirk Name: Unknown
Occupation/Role: Former wife of Pro Hero Captain Celebrity, mother, businesswoman
Personality: Gruff and unsociable with a sharp tongue, Pamela is quick to voice harsh opinions and dislikes being helped without permission. Beneath her perpetually frowning exterior lies a kind heart that softens for those she truly cares about, though she struggles with trust due to past betrayals.
Appearance: A short woman with a rounded face, long blonde hair, and small nose covered in freckles. Her large green eyes are often shadowed by a frown that makes her appear perpetually grumpy, giving her an intimidating demeanor despite her diminutive stature.
Backstory: Pamela met Christopher in American high school and was uniquely unmoved by his charm and popularity, seeing him as an attention-seeking clown. Over time, his genuine persistence won her over and they married, but his womanizing ways and extramarital affairs led to estrangement. She became pregnant with their son before Christopher left for Japan, enlisting a contact to monitor his behavior.
Additional Information: Currently raising her young son as a single mother while managing legal matters from infidelity lawsuits. She deeply loves Christopher despite his flaws and remains concerned for his wellbeing, though she expresses her worry through anger and harsh words rather than soft affection.

cardPool.title: Oxy-Man
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Oxy-Man
Quirk Name: Unnamed Oxygen Production Quirk
Occupation/Role: Low-ranking villain, League of Villains recruit
Personality: Cautious and tactical, willing to follow orders despite uncertainty. Demonstrates pack mentality with other villains, becoming bold only when numbers favor him.
Appearance: Young man of average height and build with ash blond hair. Wears a black jumpsuit with matching gloves, transparent blue goggles for underwater vision, and a wireless headset. Carries a spear as his weapon.
Backstory: Recruited by Tomura Shigaraki as one of roughly seventy low-ranking villains for the assault on the Unforeseen Simulation Joint. Deployed to the Flood Zone where his water-breathing ability provided tactical advantage against UA students.
Additional Information: His Quirk enables oxygen production, allowing extended underwater combat without drowning. Arrested following the U.S.J. incident when UA staff and police intervened. Defeated by Class 1-A students Midoriya, Asui, and Mineta through coordinated tactics that exploited his aquatic vulnerability.

cardPool.title: Ordinary Woman
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Ordinary Woman
Quirk Name: Mutant-type Quirk
Occupation/Role: Civilian Refugee
Personality: Compassionate and fearful, deeply affected by discrimination and war trauma. Despite her suffering, she remains grateful and emotionally vulnerable, seeking normalcy and safety while wrestling with the pain of being rejected and mistaken for a villain.
Appearance: A very tall woman with a foxlike quality, featuring pointed ears, green fur with white underbelly, and blonde shoulder-length hair with a strand framing her right face. Large blue eyes with bushy lashes give her an expressive look. She wears an orange buttoned shirt with yellow-orange accents, black pants with matching belt, orange headband resembling earmuffs, orange wristbands, and cream-colored slip-on shoes.
Backstory: During the Paranormal Liberation War's chaos, she attempted evacuation to find shelter but was attacked by panicked civilians who mistook her for a villain due to her mutant appearance. Saved by Izuku Midoriya, who showed her kindness amid the violence, she was subsequently rejected from multiple shelters because of her Quirk before finding refuge at UA High School, where she was reunited with her rescuer.
Additional Information: Not a UA student, but a civilian refugee. Her Mutant-type Quirk marks her as a heteromorph, subjecting her to societal discrimination. She later became involved in discussions about heteromorph solidarity and grievances regarding treatment during the war's aftermath.

cardPool.title: Onima
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Onima
Alias: Onima
Quirk Name: Not specified
Occupation/Role: Pro Hero Sidekick at Endeavor Agency
Personality: Dedicated and professional, friendly toward interns despite serious demeanor. Supportive colleague who balances work responsibilities with genuine care for team morale. Shows composure during crises and maintains focus on hero operations.
Appearance: Man of average build with dull purple slicked-back hair. Wears a horned happuri hat that frames his face, a flak jacket over a short-sleeved shirt marked with a white X-like symbol. Professional hero attire befitting an agency sidekick.
Backstory: A dedicated sidekick within Endeavor's agency, Onima works among over 30 staff members supporting the Pro Hero. He participated in major operations including the Hosu Incident response, global Humarise operations, and the devastating Paranormal Liberation War. Despite witnessing catastrophic events, he remains committed to hero work and mentoring newcomers.
Additional Information: Works alongside partner Kido at the Endeavor Agency. Interacted with Work Study interns Izuku Midoriya, Katsuki Bakugo, and Shoto Todoroki. Survived the Jaku Hospital Raid and subsequent Decay attack. Not a UA student; established Pro Hero.

cardPool.title: Onemu Shinya
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Onemu Shinya

Alias: None known

Quirk Name: Unknown

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero Sidekick of Ingenium's Team Idaten Agency

Personality: Perpetually drowsy and laid-back, Onemu maintains a calm demeanor even during high-stakes villain pursuits and rescue operations. Her sleepy nature doesn't impede her professional competence as a sidekick.

Appearance: A young woman with short, slightly curly blonde hair and distinctive ram horns protruding from her head. She possesses an inherently drowsy facial expression. Her hero costume consists of a Chinese Cheongsam mini dress in bold colors, long funnel-shaped sleeves that conceal her hands, a black domino mask, and high-heeled shoes. Her overall presentation balances elegance with quirky charm.

Backstory: Onemu serves as a dedicated sidekick under Ingenium's leadership at Team Idaten Agency in Naruhata. She participates in numerous operations ranging from villain apprehension to crowd control during emergencies, demonstrating reliable teamwork despite her sleepy disposition. Her career includes pursuing the Bat Villain, managing panicked civilians during a Quirk-induced incident, and coordinating blockade tactics against dangerous fugitives.

Additional Information: While her Quirk remains largely undocumented, Onemu proves capable enough to serve as an active field operative for a respected hero agency. She functions as both a combatant and support personnel depending on mission requirements.

cardPool.title: One-Eyed Green Dragon
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: One-Eyed Green Dragon
Quirk Name: Unknown
Occupation/Role: Low-ranking Villain, League of Villains Recruit
Personality: Aggressive and bold, willing to insult allies to maintain focus on objectives. Shows confidence even when outmatched, attempting to rally others during the U.S.J. invasion despite overwhelming odds.
Appearance: Muscular man with shoulder-length brown hair and patches of green skin covering his torso. The upper right side of his face is entirely black with a single white spot marking where his right eye would be. Strong angular jaw with a distinctive wide zigzag-shaped mouth.
Backstory: Recruited by Tomura Shigaraki as part of roughly seventy low-ranking villains for the assault on the Unforeseen Simulation Joint. Fought against Shota Aizawa's forces and attempted to maintain morale among villains during All Might's arrival, though his efforts proved futile against the Symbol of Peace.
Additional Information: Participated in the U.S.J. Arc invasion; knocked out by All Might and subsequently arrested with most of the invading villain force. Minor antagonist with no confirmed Quirk ability documented.

cardPool.title: Oboro Shirakumo
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Oboro Shirakumo

Alias: Loud Cloud

Quirk Name: Cloud

Occupation/Role: UA High School Student, Class 2-A, Hero-in-Training

Personality: Jovial and energetic with a penchant for jokes and witty banter, Oboro is casual and somewhat irreverent toward protocol. Despite his goofy exterior and lack of shame, his defining trait is selfless altruism—he readily goes the extra mile to help others in need.

Appearance: A tall young man with light blue, wavy hair swept back and flowing upward, framed by two shorter ear-length tufts. He has semicircular inward-tilting blue eyes often squeezed shut in an excited grin, and wears a small white rectangular bandage over his nose bridge. His hero costume consists of a closed blue martial arts gi with black obi, black fingerless gloves, and a dark brown aviator jacket with white fur lining. He sports a blue aviator hat with large mufflers, beige goggles with silver lenses, black boots with white accents, and carries a deep red quarterstaff in a red sheath on his back. An orange gourd-shaped speaker hangs from his belt, and his jacket back displays the kanji for "cloud" in white.

Backstory: A first-year student at UA High School alongside Shota Aizawa and Hizashi Yamada, Oboro trained diligently to become a Pro Hero. His promising future was cut short when he was killed during a Hero Work-Studies battle against a villain.

Additional Information: Oboro's Cloud Quirk allows him to generate solid, weightbearing clouds he can ride through the air and use for storage. He wields his quarterstaff with considerable skill and carries a speaker device as part of his equipment.

cardPool.title: Oji Harima
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Oji Harima

Alias:
The Peerless Thief

Quirk Name:
Unknown

Occupation/Role:
Infamous Villain, Robin Hood-like Thief

Personality:
Philosophical and idealistic, driven by a sense of justice against corrupt systems. Oji steals from wealthy heroes to redistribute wealth to the poor, embodying a revolutionary spirit that challenges the established hero system itself.

Appearance:
A striking figure with dark maroon hair spiked dramatically at the sides, adorned with an orange bandana across his forehead. Heavy clown-like makeup includes dark lipstick, eye shadow, and painted eyebrows. He wears a white male kimono shirt with a black symbol on the back, a wide black belt, and a blue striped shirt visible beneath. Light baggy pants with dark stripes lead into maroon calf-high tight boots. Two long bracelets encircle each forearm, completing his theatrical jester aesthetic.

Backstory:
Oji emerged during the early years of the modern hero system's establishment. Recognizing systemic corruption among heroes profiting from their positions, he became a legendary criminal redistributing stolen wealth to common people. His legacy earned him comparison to history's most infamous villains, including All For One and Destro, cementing his place among the world's greatest antagonists.

Additional Information:
His philosophical ideals of exposing injustice and fighting corruption were passed down through his entire lineage. His great-great-grandson, Atsuhiro Sako, inherited these revolutionary values. Oji's actual Quirk remains undocumented, though his legendary status suggests considerable power rivaling the most formidable villains.

cardPool.title: Omori Furiko
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Omori Furiko

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Weight Increasing

Occupation/Role: High School Student (Non-UA)

Personality: Flamboyant and romantic with an overactive imagination, prone to creating idealized versions of people in his mind. Despite his initial delusions, he demonstrates self-awareness and respect, recognizing his own flaws and the difference between fantasy and reality. Persistent and earnest, willing to endure physical hardship for his convictions.

Appearance: A teenage boy with short, blocky dark hair that appears naturally messy but can be neatly styled when he makes an effort. He has bushy eyebrows and large, pale eyes that give him a distinctive, wide-eyed expression. Typically dresses casually, though he owns a formal white suit which he had tailor-made for his confession attempt.

Backstory: Omori fell in love at first sight with the hero Uravity after witnessing her heroic actions during a train incident. Obsessed with confessing his feelings, he researched her identity, discovered she attended UA High School, and traveled there in his finest suit. His lovesickness caused him to collapse outside the school gates, where he was aided by Class 1-A students who helped him prepare for his confession. His climactic meeting with Ochaco resulted in her accidentally slamming him to the ground, which forced him to confront the reality that he had fallen in love with an imagined version of her.

Additional Information: Omori is not a UA student but attends another school. His Quirk—the inverse of Ochaco Uraraka's Zero Gravity—led him to believe their pairing was destined by fate, though his romantic pursuit ultimately proved one-sided.

cardPool.title: Odd-Eye
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Odd-Eye
Quirk Name: Mind Reaper
Occupation/Role: Pro Hero
Personality: Melodramatic and theatrical, Odd-Eye obsesses over darkness and the arcane with elaborate speeches about fate and the abyss. He enjoys acting mysteriously important but nervously cackles uncontrollably when genuinely panicked or uncertain, masking his insecurity beneath dramatic flair.
Appearance: A young man with neck-length, slightly messy mint green hair and yellow eyes. Scrawny with minimal muscle definition, he wears an all-dark costume featuring an oversized-collared jacket with skirts, dark pants, gloved hands decorated with magical symbols, and multiple belts adorning his waist, arms, and neck. A patch covers his right eye for effect, though the eye functions normally.
Backstory: Operating his own hero agency with sidekicks he calls "contracted familiars," Odd-Eye has built a reputation as an eccentric Pro Hero fascinated by darkness and the mystical. He recruits young heroes through cryptic invitations to test their resolve and worthiness.
Additional Information: His Mind Reaper Quirk forces targets to reveal hidden truths and secrets by touch. The eye-patch serves no actual purpose beyond his theatrical aesthetic. He panics easily despite his confident demeanor and relies on his sidekicks to explain or manage situations he cannot control.

cardPool.title: Number 6
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Rokuro Nomura

Alias: Number 6, Rock, High-Speed Hero: O'Clock II

Quirk Name: Overclock

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero (undercover), Villain Factory member

Personality: Confident and self-assured with a perpetual smirk, Number 6 remains eerily calm under pressure. He avoids unnecessary confrontation but employs violence without hesitation when needed. Vengeful and ruthless, he shows no remorse endangering innocents for his objectives.

Appearance: Athletic build with long, curly black hair tied in a ponytail. His most striking feature is a diagonal scar running across his face and over his nose, which he inflicted upon himself. His eyes are sharp and calculating. He wears a black full-body hero suit with blue and yellow accents, paired with a trench coat and black fedora hat.

Backstory: Experimented on by All For One since childhood, Number 6 suffered from agnosia that left him without self-awareness. All For One molded him into a confident operative. Now he operates as a covert Pro Hero while secretly working with villainous organizations, using his Quirk's deceptive capabilities to infiltrate and manipulate situations.

Additional Information: Number 6 possesses extraordinary disguise abilities through his Quirk, allowing him to perfectly mimic other people's appearances, even hiding his signature scar. He can merge Bomber cells with his body to enhance his transformation capabilities. Despite his Pro Hero status, his true allegiances remain deeply questionable.

cardPool.title: Nyikang
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Nyikang

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Spirit Possession

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero (Sudan)

Personality: Composed and professional, demonstrated by his calm demeanor during the I-Expo crisis. He works cooperatively with other heroes to neutralize threats.

Appearance: Tall and imposing figure clad in riveted metal armor with gauntlets on both wrists. A red and yellow sash wraps around his waist. Black branch-like protrusions extend from his head, and a riveted metal mask covers his face completely, giving him an otherworldly appearance.

Backstory: An accomplished Pro Hero from Sudan who was invited to the I-Expo preview as a distinguished guest. Captured by Wolfram's forces during the I-Expo incident, he was freed when security was restored and subsequently aided in locating the Trigger Bomb and combating Humarise operatives in Egypt.

Additional Information: Carries a large sword as his primary weapon. Spirit Possession grants him tactical flexibility by allowing remote consciousness projection to incapacitate or control targets, making him a strategic asset in combat situations.

cardPool.title: Nomu (U.S.J.)
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: U.S.J. Nomu
Quirk Name: Multiple Quirks (Shock Absorption, High-Density Muscle, Regeneration, possibly others)
Occupation/Role: Artificial Human Enforcer for the League of Villains
Personality: Mindless and obedient, incapable of independent thought or speech. Brutal and merciless in combat, following orders without question. Becomes docile when without command.
Appearance: A towering, muscular humanoid monster exceeding All Might's height with jet-black skin. His exposed brain sits atop his head surrounded by large, unblinking eyes. He has a prominent beak-like mouth filled with sharp teeth. Wears only beige pants and ornate skull-emblazoned metal knee-pads, leaving his torso and feet bare. Scars cover his muscular frame from experimental enhancement.
Backstory: Originally a small-time thug subjected to extreme body modification by Doctor Kyudai Garaki under All For One's direction. His body received DNA injections from four different individuals, granting him multiple Quirks and transforming him into an artificial human weapon designed to overpower even All Might through sheer power.
Additional Information: Deployed during the U.S.J. attack as a primary combatant. Demonstrates regeneration capabilities and extraordinary physical strength. Ultimately defeated by All Might's full-power punch and captured by authorities. Not a UA student.

cardPool.title: Nomu (Hosu)
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Hosu Nomu (Trio)
Alias: Lower-Tier White Nomu, Middle-Tier Winged Nomu, Upper-Tier Black Nomu
Quirk Name: Absorption and Release (White), Flight (Winged), Super Regeneration (Black)
Occupation/Role: Artificial combat creatures deployed by the League of Villains
Personality: Mindless, aggressive, and obedient; attack indiscriminately without mercy or hesitation
Appearance: Three distinct biomechanical entities—a bulky white humanoid with enhanced musculature, a skeletal winged creature capable of sustained flight, and a massive jet-black monstrosity with regenerative capabilities; all possess grotesque, asymmetrical features
Backstory: Created by All For One as part of an experimental Nomu development program, this trio was deployed by Tomura Shigaraki to terrorize Hosu City and eliminate the Hero Killer: Stain after recruitment negotiations failed
Additional Information: The white Nomu combines Muscle Augmentation and Tongue Web techniques; the black Nomu was ultimately destroyed by Endeavor's extreme heat; the winged Nomu proved most durable, later killed by Stain while attempting to capture Izuku Midoriya

cardPool.title: Nomu (Chainsaw)
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Chainsaw Nomu
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Tool Arms
Occupation/Role: Vanguard Action Squad Member
Personality: Emotionless and obedient; operates without independent thought, executing orders from superiors without hesitation or mercy.
Appearance: A massive, muscular humanoid with mint green skin and an exposed brain protected by a shiny purple helmet featuring two red visors and a metal gag. Black trousers ripped above the kneecaps and a brown belt. Six retractable arms protrude from its back, each wielding construction tools: four with chainsaws, one with a drill, and one with a claw hammer.
Backstory: Created as an artificial life form by the League of Villains, the Chainsaw Nomu was deployed to the U.A. Forest Training Camp as the tenth member of the Vanguard Action Squad under Dabi's command. It serves as an expendable instrument of destruction with no will of its own.
Additional Information: Not a U.A. student. Operates exclusively under villain command. Primary threat during the Forest Training Camp Arc, later apprehended by Mt. Lady during the Hideout Raid, though its subsequent fate remains unknown.

cardPool.title: Nobu
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Nobu
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Displacement
Occupation/Role: Wolfram's minion and henchman
Personality: Impatient and aggressive, Nobu enjoys conflict and shows little mercy even toward children. He is a loyal subordinate who follows orders without question and fights with ruthless determination.
Appearance: A skinny, pale yellow-skinned man with a goat-like face featuring two small triangular ears, slanted dark eyes, sharp teeth, and a small goatee. His dark green hair is styled in a mohawk that connects around his ears and cheekbones. He wears a black combat suit with a full-face mask featuring an X-shaped pale design.
Backstory: Nobu serves as one of Wolfram's trusted minions in a coordinated attack on I-Island. He helps restrain security and seize the Central Tower control room, then participates in hunting down UA High School students attempting to rescue hostages. His combat pairing with the transforming Daigo suggests he was chosen for his speed and displacement abilities to complement close-range fighters.
Additional Information: Not a UA student. Nobu's Quirk allows him to enlarge his hands into webbed claws that displace whatever they strike, essentially erasing matter from existence rather than simply moving it. His high footspeed makes him a mobile threat in combat, though he was ultimately defeated by Bakugo and Todoroki's combined strategy.

cardPool.title: Nirengeki Shoda
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Nirengeki Shoda

Alias: Mines

Quirk Name: Twin Impact

Occupation/Role: UA High School Class 1-B Vice Class Representative, Hero-in-Training

Personality: Humble and conscientious, Nirengeki refuses unearned credit and serves as his class's moral compass. He is reliable, collaborative, and mature—avoiding petty rivalries and holding no grudges. His classmates trust him implicitly, and he excels at reading situations and working in tactical unison with allies.

Appearance: A chubby young man of below-average height with short, ice-blue hair and a round, boyish face.
