Large, wide eyes with small pupils typically give him a sheepish, apologetic expression, with upward-pointing eyebrows. He wears a black high-collared hero costume trimmed with pale white lines, plain black pants, white knee-high boots, a blue scouter device over his left eye, and a connected radar on one gloved hand.

Backstory: A dedicated Class 1-B student at UA High School, Nirengeki earned his position as vice class representative through dependability and integrity. During the Quirk Apprehension Test, he demonstrated his potential as both a fighter and team asset, later impressing Pro Hero Shishido enough to secure an internship.

Additional Information: Twin Impact allows Nirengeki to remotely trigger a second, amplified repetition of any impact or attack. He can amplify his own strikes or magnify those of teammates, making him a pivotal supporting combatant. His power scales with the potency of the base attack. He excels at one-on-one combat and possesses strong tactical intellect and reaction time.

cardPool.title: Nezu
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Nezu

Alias: Mr. Principal

Quirk Name: High Specs

Occupation/Role: Principal of U.A. High School, Pro Hero

Personality: Eccentric, polite, and persistently educational, though his past abuse by humans reveals a darker side—he enjoys "toying" with opponents in combat and holds lingering grudges. Self-aware and verbose, he genuinely cares for student safety while harboring slight unpredictability in conflict.

Appearance: A small white-furred stoat-like creature with circular black eyes, one marked by a large scar, rectangular ears with pale pink insides, and an elongated muzzle. He wears a white dress shirt, dark red tie, black double-breasted waistcoat, matching pants, and oversized orange lace-up sneakers with thick soles.

Backstory: An extremely rare animal who manifested a Quirk, Nezu endured severe mistreatment and experimentation by humans before rising to prominence. He now leads U.A. High School as principal, dedicating himself to hero education and student protection while leveraging his vast wealth and strategic brilliance.

Additional Information: Possesses enhanced senses, exceptional strategic planning abilities, industrial crane operation skills, and extensive security management expertise. His combat prowess is formidable despite his small stature. Not a UA student—an adult authority figure and pro hero in an administrative role.

cardPool.title: NHA Reporter
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown (Conjectural)
Alias: NHA Reporter
Quirk Name: Unknown
Occupation/Role: News Reporter for NHA TV; UA High School Correspondent
Personality: Ambitious and ratings-driven, initially pursuing controversy for viewership, but gradually developing genuine compassion and journalistic integrity as she witnesses heroic sacrifice firsthand.
Appearance: Young woman with large black eyes and medium-length brown hair styled in a practical ponytail. She wears a formal dark suit with an NHA armband on her left arm and carries an NHA-labeled microphone. Professional and polished in demeanor.
Backstory: A determined reporter working for NHA TV who gained access to UA High School during the early hero education season. Initially motivated by ratings and scandal, she pursued interviews with All Might and Class 1-A following the USJ Incident, believing controversy would boost viewership numbers.
Additional Information: Not a UA student; civilian press correspondent. Frequently present at major hero events and incidents, including the Sports Festival and Hosu City coverage. Develops emotional investment in her subjects' stories over time, particularly regarding Izuku Midoriya's transformation.

cardPool.title: Nemuri Kayama
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Nemuri Kayama

Alias: Midnight, R-Rated Hero

Quirk Name: Somnambulist

Occupation/Role: UA High School Faculty, Modern Hero Art History Teacher

Personality: Playful, flirtatious, and perverted with an unpredictably serious temperament. Easily angered by interruptions or insults, particularly sensitive about her age. Acts on whims and shows no shame in sexual behavior around students. Genuinely excited by displays of youth and chivalry.

Appearance: Tall, curvaceous woman with sky-blue downward-tilting eyes framed by long lashes. Long, thick, spiky dark purple hair in layered lengths reaching her chin during UA years, split bangs with one section crossing diagonally. Small beauty mark below left eye, pink rectangular-frame glasses, and pink-painted nails. Wears a revealing hero costume: breastless black leather leotard over thin white bodysuit with red gemstone accessories down the center, light purple thigh-high garter stockings, burgundy utility belt with gold studs, black stiletto knee-boots, small red eye mask, wrist handcuffs, and carries a flogger-style whip.

Backstory: A Pro Hero and faculty member at UA High School during Class 1-A's first year. Known for her R-rated hero persona and unconventional teaching methods. Occasionally goes undercover on missions, demonstrating her commitment to hero work beyond classroom instruction.

Additional Information: Uses a tearable white bodysuit material to facilitate her Quirk's activation. Has participated in student tournaments and monitored matches. Maintains professional duties despite her provocative public persona.

cardPool.title: Nejire Hado
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Nejire Hado

Alias: Wonder Hero: Nejire Chan

Quirk Name: Wave Motion

Occupation/Role: UA High School Student, Class 3-A, Member of The Big 3

Personality: Naturally kind, talkative, and endlessly curious about others' physical features, though her bluntness can come across as invasive. Previously grew distant and cold due to misunderstandings in middle school, but regained her warm nature through friendships with Tamaki Amajiki and Mirio Togata at UA.

Appearance: Fair-skinned girl with a shapely, cute figure and wide, round light royal blue eyes with white pupils. Her distinctive periwinkle blue hair reaches past her knees with two spiral twists at the waist, side-swept bangs, and face-framing strands. She wears the standard UA female uniform. Her hero costume is a dark royal blue skin-tight bodysuit with pale mint green markings on her torso, turquoise accents, knee-high boots with turquoise spiral anklets, yellow gauntlets, and two spiraling hair-shaped protrusions behind her ears.

Backstory: A prodigious student whose powerful Quirk initially caused others to distance themselves, believing she looked down on them. Her isolation ended when fellow students Amajiki and Togata befriended her early in her UA career, allowing her to overcome her self-imposed emotional barriers.

Additional Information: Third-year student at the time of the Quirk Apprehension Test arc. Part of UA's elite trio known as The Big 3, indicating exceptional ability and status among her peers.

cardPool.title: Neito Monoma
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Neito Monoma

Alias: Phantom Thief

Quirk Name: Copy

Occupation/Role: UA High School Class 1-B Student

Personality: Loud, sarcastic, and mocking toward Class 1-A, driven by envy and inferiority complex. Calm and kind in other contexts, but prone to unhinged verbal tirades that often earn him strikes from Itsuka Kendo. Deliberately provocative to push his classmates forward, though his insensitivity sometimes crosses into cruelty.

Appearance: Average height with slick blonde hair parted right, shorter toward the ends with bangs hanging over his right eye. Periwinkle blue irises with white pupils, downward-slanting eyes usually half-closed, and a characteristic smirk and head tilt giving a contemptuous expression. Wears a black double-breasted tuxedo tailcoat with long tails, upturned collar, light and dark blue dotted tie, small blue handkerchief in breast pocket, plain black pants and white shoes. Three clocks on his belt track his Quirk's time limit.

Backstory: A student of Class 1-B at UA High School who harbors deep resentment toward Class 1-A after they became the center of attention following the USJ Incident. His envy masks genuine respect for his own classmates' abilities and a desire for Class 1-B to receive equal recognition.

Additional Information: Divides society into "main characters" (those with hero-suited Quirks) and "side characters." His Copy Quirk allows him to steal and use other Quirks for a limited duration. Known for his vocal provocations and deranged demeanor, making him seem mentally unstable to outsiders.

cardPool.title: Needle Hair
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Needle Hair
Quirk Name: Hair Control
Occupation/Role: F-rank Villain
Personality: Confident in her combat abilities despite her low ranking, willing to engage professional heroes directly. Little is known of her deeper character beyond her willingness to join dangerous operations.
Appearance: Young woman of average height and build with brown eyes and long gray dreadlocks. She wears a dark purple bodysuit with gray and light purple patterned sleeves and black boots, presenting a striking silhouette befitting her combat role.
Backstory: Recruited as one of approximately seventy villains by Tomura Shigaraki for the League of Villains' assault on the Unforeseen Simulation Joint. She served in the long-range combat contingent, positioning herself alongside Stitched Giant and Victor to challenge the pro heroes defending U.A. High School.
Additional Information: Her Quirk allows her to control and harden her hair while firing strands as projectiles, making her suited for ranged attacks. She was quickly neutralized by Eraser Head's Erasure ability during the U.S.J. incident and subsequently arrested.

cardPool.title: Natsuo Todoroki
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Natsuo Todoroki

Alias:
None

Quirk Name:
Ice

Occupation/Role:
College Student

Personality:
Easy-going and friendly on the surface, but harbors deep resentment toward his father Enji for past family trauma and neglect. Cares deeply for his siblings, particularly Shoto and the late Toya. Shows maturity when handling sensitive family matters, though struggles with forgiveness despite acknowledging his father's attempts at redemption.

Appearance:
A young man of above-average height with a well-built frame. He has distinctive white spiky hair with two short crimson-red streaks running down the middle of his forehead. Gray eyes with fairly long eyelashes give him a gentle appearance despite his athletic build. His casual demeanor is reflected in his relaxed posture and approachable features.

Backstory:
The second son of Enji Todoroki, Natsuo grew up in a fractured household marked by his father's obsessive hero pursuit and emotional neglect. Separated from his younger brother Shoto during childhood and witnessing his mother's hospitalization due to their father's cruelty shaped his worldview. The mysterious disappearance of his older brother Toya further scarred the family's bonds.

Additional Information:
Not a UA High School student; currently attending college. Possesses Ice Quirk but lacks formal combat training. Represents the collateral damage of Endeavor's ambitions—caught between duty to family and justified anger toward parental abuse.

cardPool.title: Native
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Native
Quirk Name: Unknown
Occupation/Role: Pro Hero
Personality: Easily irritated but fundamentally selfless and grateful, showing concern for others' safety even when in mortal danger. He demonstrates humility by acknowledging his limitations during combat.
Appearance: A muscular man wearing a feathered headgear and matching feathered cape over a dark jumpsuit emblazoned with the letter "N" on the chest. He wears open-toed sandals and carries himself with a professional hero's bearing. His costume draws inspiration from stereotypical Native American imagery.
Backstory: An established Pro Hero known for his compassionate nature, Native was attacked by the Hero Killer Stain in an alleyway and nearly executed before being saved by UA High School students Tenya Iida, Izuku Midoriya, and Shoto Todoroki. Grateful for their intervention, he rewarded them with theme park tickets. Native later participated in the hospital raid against the League of Villains during the war.
Additional Information: Native's Quirk details remain unspecified in available records. He is respected enough to be called upon for major hero operations despite being initially overpowered by Stain. His willingness to protect younger heroes despite his own peril demonstrates his heroic character.

cardPool.title: Naomasa Tsukauchi
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Naomasa Tsukauchi
Alias: Detective Tsukauchi
Quirk Name: Polygraph
Occupation/Role: Police Detective
Personality: Earnest and hardworking, Naomasa is strict about the law yet pragmatic when justice demands it. He maintains close confidences with All Might and values loyalty deeply, though he can be rigid about procedure. Despite his by-the-book nature, he shows willingness to work with unconventional allies if their intentions prove genuine.
Appearance: A tall man with short black hair and rectangular black eyes, Naomasa typically wears a tan trench coat with matching fedora over a white collared shirt and dark pale green tie, completed with brown dress shoes and white gloves. His formal bearing and composed expression reflect his professional detective status.
Backstory: A dedicated officer in the Police Force, Naomasa earned the trust of All Might through years of earnest service and discretion, becoming one of the few aware of the hero's true weakened form. His relationship with his sister Makoto, who possesses a Polygraph Quirk, shaped his understanding of both law and human complexity from childhood.
Additional Information: Naomasa possesses above-average deductive intellect suited to detective work. He is not a UA student but operates as a law enforcement contact. His pragmatism has led him to form strategic alliances with vigilantes and even villains when the greater good demands cooperation, demonstrating evolution beyond rigid legalism.

cardPool.title: Nao Shimura
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Nao Shimura

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Unknown

Occupation/Role: Homemaker, Mother

Personality: A kind and compassionate woman troubled by her family's dysfunction. Though gentle-natured, Nao possessed quiet strength and was willing to stand against her husband when he crossed the line into violence toward their children. She remained a loving, protective mother despite her inability to fully prevent her husband's harsh treatment of Tenko.

Appearance: A woman in her early thirties with light brown eyes and shoulder-length light brown hair parted in the middle with uneven waves and bangs. She had a curvaceous build and typically wore casual clothing such as black shirts with jeans or corduroy skirts. Her face often bore a worried expression reflecting her family's troubled state.

Backstory: Nao married Kotaro Shimura and had two children, Hana and Tenko. She lived in her husband's large house alongside her own parents. Understanding Kotaro's complicated past through his mother's abandonment, she respected his anti-hero household rules while privately supporting Tenko's heroic ambitions. When Kotaro's abuse of Tenko escalated, Nao finally confronted him alongside her parents, declaring she would no longer tolerate his violence toward their children.

Additional Information: Nao is deceased, killed when her son Tenko's Decay Quirk manifested and spiraled out of control. In her final moments, she reached toward her son despite the decay consuming her own body, demonstrating her enduring maternal love even in death.

cardPool.title: Nana Shimura
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Nana Shimura

Alias:
The Seventh One For All User

Quirk Name:
One For All

Occupation/Role:
Pro Hero and former mentor to All Might

Personality:
A kind woman with strong sense of justice who believes true heroes must smile to save both lives and hearts. Initially grounded and skeptical, she demonstrated remarkable openness and optimism about others' potential, even those at disadvantage. She valued bravery, emotional resilience, and self-sacrifice above all else.

Appearance:
A tall, fair-skinned woman with a curvaceous yet athletic build befitting a One For All user. She has dark, straight shoulder-length hair styled in a half-up-half-down bun with short bangs, sharp intelligent eyes with long eyelashes, and a small mole below her bottom lip. Her hero costume features a dark sleeveless bodysuit with high collar, yellow gloves, white knee-high boots, an angular golden belt buckle, a small cape to her knees, and longer buttoned capes over her shoulders.

Backstory:
Once the symbol of hope for her generation, Nana mentored the Quirkless Toshinori Yagi and instilled in him the philosophy of the smiling hero. She was a devoted mother to her son Kotaro, yet placed him in foster care to protect him from her dangerous hero life—a decision that would ripple devastatingly through generations, ultimately leading to her grandson Tenko's corruption into the villain Tomura Shigaraki.

Additional Information:
Deceased prior to the current timeline, killed in battle against All For One. She remains a legendary figure whose ideals shaped All Might's heroic philosophy and whose tragic family legacy continues to haunt the present.

cardPool.title: Nagamasa Mora
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Nagamasa Mora

Alias: Chewyee

Quirk Name: Not explicitly stated in source material

Occupation/Role: Second Year Student at Shiketsu High School, Class Representative

Personality: Polite, reasonable, and diplomatic—willing to build goodwill with rival schools unlike his peers. Maintains strict standards and reprimands reckless behavior. Deeply values his school's reputation and refuses to tolerate actions that shame Shiketsu.

Appearance: Entirely covered in light brown hair with no distinct facial features except his eyes, which rarely show through his fur-like covering. Wears Shiketsu's standard dark pants, belt, and signature peaked cap as part of his hero costume.

Backstory: A promising student at Shiketsu High School, one of the nation's most prestigious hero academies rivaling UA itself. Selected as his class's representative, Nagamasa demonstrates exceptional composure and maturity. During the Provisional Hero License Exam, he quietly passed the first phase without engaging in the unofficial "Crushing of UA" melee, earning his marks through skill and strategy rather than confrontation.

Additional Information: Represents Shiketsu High School's more measured approach to hero training. Known for apologizing on behalf of disruptive classmates like Seiji Shishikura and actively seeks peaceful coexistence with UA students. A natural leader who prioritizes institutional reputation over personal glory.

cardPool.title: Mustard
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Mustard
Alias: Mustard
Quirk Name: Gas
Occupation/Role: C-rank villain, member of the League of Villains Vanguard Action Squad
Personality: Pragmatic and merciless, valuing function over style. Highly intelligent and calculating, believing in striking at the opportune moment. Arrogant and boastful about his abilities, harboring deep jealousy and resentment toward UA students whom he views as "pampered" and undeserving of their reputation. Shows exceptional cruelty, willing to kill without hesitation.
Appearance: Skinny young man with short, wavy light brown hair and tan skin. Brown eyes peer from behind a green gas mask that completely covers his face, connected to two oxygen tanks strapped to his back. Dressed in a black gakuran school uniform with teal gloves and white shoes, presenting a stark contrast between student attire and villain equipment.
Backstory: A member of the League of Villains, Mustard participates in the organization's raids as part of the Vanguard Action Squad. His resentment toward UA High School and its students drives much of his motivation, viewing their success as unearned privilege rather than merit.
Additional Information: Lacks hand-to-hand combat skills and relies entirely on his Gas Quirk and marksmanship with his 38 revolver. Must continuously produce gas to maintain its effects; it dissipates quickly if he stops. Cannot survive his own gas without his mask and oxygen supply. Can sense enemy movement within his gas by detecting fluctuations.

cardPool.title: Muscle Man
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Muscle Man
Quirk Name: Charging Muscles
Occupation/Role: F-rank Villain
Personality: Confident in combat abilities, willing to challenge authority; limited information suggests a straightforward, aggressive demeanor driven by overconfidence in his strength.
Appearance: Tall and heavily muscular with tanned skin, spiky dark brown hair styled upward, and a full-face mask obscuring his features. Wears a simple green t-shirt, baggy jeans, and brown shoes.
Backstory: A low-ranking villain recruited by Tomura Shigaraki as part of the League of Villains' assault on the U.S.J. during the Unforeseen Simulation Joint attack. Confronted by Eraser Head during the raid, he attempted a sneak attack but was quickly defeated and arrested.
Additional Information: His Quirk allows him to charge and enhance muscle strength into devastating attacks, but overcharging causes severe muscle soreness, limiting sustained combat effectiveness. He operates as a foot soldier for the League of Villains rather than an independent threat.

cardPool.title: Mummy (U.S.J.)
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Mummy
Quirk Name: Unknown
Occupation/Role: Low-ranking villain, League of Villains recruit
Personality: Aggressive and violent, acting as part of a coordinated horde with minimal individual distinction. Follows orders without hesitation.
Appearance: A muscular man with gray bandages covering his entire face and body. His build suggests physical strength, though his bandaged appearance obscures most distinguishing features.
Backstory: Recruited by Tomura Shigaraki as one of approximately seventy low-ranking villains for the U.S.J. invasion. Participated in the coordinated assault on the facility as part of the League of Villains' larger operation.
Additional Information: Engaged Shota Aizawa during the U.S.J. Arc but was swiftly defeated when Aizawa used his Binding Cloth to drop Steel Bulwark on him. Apprehended by authorities following the invasion's failure. His Quirk remains unspecified in available records.

cardPool.title: Mr. Plastic
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Unknown

Alias:
Mr. Plastic

Quirk Name:
Plastic Transformation

Occupation/Role:
Pro Hero

Personality:
Confident and direct, willing to confront dangerous criminals despite risks. Professional and composed in crisis situations, dedicated to justice and hero work.

Appearance:
A built, muscular man with spiky grey hair and matching grey eyes. Wears a distinctive hero costume featuring two large mechanical arms with armored pauldrons that cover his real arms, bound to his chest with black cloth and brown straps. Equipped with a headset sporting dual blue visors over each eye and baggy tactical pants with a belt.

Backstory:
Mr. Plastic is an established Pro Hero known for his combat capabilities. He was invited to the prestigious I-Expo reception as a guest, where he was captured by the criminal Wolfram and his forces. He attempted to interrogate Wolfram about his plans but was overpowered and detained until the facility's security was restored by Melissa Shield.

Additional Information:
After his rescue, Mr. Plastic participated in raids against Humarise operatives at their Otheon base. His Quirk, Plastic Transformation, is poorly documented but is theorized to grant him body-stretching abilities. He remains active in hero operations despite limited public information about his identity.

cardPool.title: Mr. Brave
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Mr. Brave
Quirk Name: Hair-Raiser
Occupation/Role: Pro Hero
Personality: Reserved and professional; little is publicly known about his personal character, though his consistent participation in dangerous hero operations suggests steadfast dedication to heroic duty.
Appearance: A man of average height and build with messy black hair and light gray eyes. He wears a dark blue bodysuit with lighter gray patches on his forearms, hands, thighs, and a thin chest stripe. A belt cinches his waist, a cloth is loosely tied around his neck, and protective headgear completes his hero costume.
Backstory: Mr. Brave earned his Pro Hero license through rigorous training and has established himself as a reliable operative in large-scale hero missions. He participated in the assault against the Yakuza and was present during the Jaku General Hospital raid against Tomura Shigaraki.
Additional Information: Mr. Brave demonstrated combat capability during multiple high-risk operations. His Quirk grants him unique offensive potential through hair manipulation, though the physical toll of repeatedly plucking hair suggests strategic limitations in extended combat.

cardPool.title: Moyuru Tochi
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Moyuru Tochi

Alias:
None

Quirk Name:
Ignition

Occupation/Role:
Former Instant Villain, Reformed Vigilante

Personality:
Once a callous bully who enjoyed humiliating weaker individuals, Moyuru underwent a dramatic personality shift following his defeat and arrest. He is now calm, respectful, and genuinely remorseful. He shows unexpected kindness toward former victims, caring for the injured and demonstrating genuine camaraderie with his peers.

Appearance:
A large, portly young man with dark brown skin and a completely bald head. His most distinctive feature is a small flame that grows from the top of his head, serving as his hair and extinguishing when unconscious. He has rounded, pupilless eyes. He typically wears a purple open button-down shirt through which his prominent belly protrudes, along with shorts and slippers.

Backstory:
Moyuru was an Instant Villain who used the drug Trigger to enhance his abilities and terrorize weaker citizens alongside accomplices Soga and Rapt. His criminal career ended when he was defeated and arrested by Knuckleduster. This pivotal moment sparked genuine reformation, transforming him from a remorseless aggressor into a thoughtful individual.

Additional Information:
Under the influence of Trigger, Moyuru's physique expands dramatically, his skin develops a stony texture, and his flames spread across his entire upper body, significantly increasing his power. He now refers to Koichi, one of his former victims, respectfully as "Big Man."

cardPool.title: Moonfish
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Moonfish (true name unknown)
Alias: Moonfish
Quirk Name: Blade-Tooth
Occupation/Role: Villain, League of Villains Vanguard Action Squad member
Personality: Insane and laconic, Moonfish is consumed by an obsessive fascination with consuming flesh. He constantly mutters to himself, repeating information to maintain focus. Easily distracted by any source of flesh—living or severed—he prioritizes his hunger above ideology. Despite his madness, he demonstrates tactical capability and will work for others if it grants access to victims. He shows no mercy, willing to kill allies and enemies alike to satisfy his cravings.
Appearance: A reasonably tall man with fair skin and black eyes, Moonfish's true form is almost entirely obscured by his restraint gear. He wears a black straitjacket covering his body, held by black restraints decorated with red spikes. Metal clamps cover his head, forcing his lips perpetually open and causing constant drooling. Additional straps cross his torso, waist, and boots. His shaven head bears a large cut on his left ear. Only his mouth remains exposed, revealing his weapon.
Backstory: A member of the League of Villains' Vanguard Action Squad, Moonfish likely joined the organization less for ideological reasons and more for access to flesh-filled hunting grounds. He serves as a primary antagonist during the Forest Training Camp Arc, pursuing victims with single-minded determination. His violent nature eventually leads to imprisonment in Tartarus, where he awaits execution.
Additional Information: Moonfish is a formidable long-range combatant capable of dominating multiple opponents despite his physical restraints. His Blade-Tooth Quirk transforms his teeth into stretching blades, which he uses as additional limbs for mobility and devastating attacks. He is one of the League's strongest members.

cardPool.title: Monika Kaniyashiki
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Monika Kaniyashiki

Alias: Kaniko

Quirk Name: Snip Clip

Occupation/Role: Police Officer (Undercover)

Personality: Cheerful, outgoing, and laid-back with a goofy sense of humor that makes her easy to befriend. Despite her joking demeanor, she is intelligent and serious about her work, though her behavior often makes others unsure when she is joking versus being sincere. She willingly risks herself to protect others.

Appearance: A short, petite girl with a round face and semicircular orange-brown eyes. Her dull red hair is styled in two high crab-claw-shaped bunches with six tufts protruding from the sides like legs, and split bangs frame each eye. When undercover at Kanidoge, she wears a pinkish-red knee-length kimono over a black combat vest, pale green shorts, black 3/4 leggings, black fingerless gloves, geta sandals, and a yellow-black striped headband.

Backstory: A member of the Japanese Police Force who often works undercover to investigate criminal activity. Her friendly demeanor and joking nature make her ideal for covert operations, as people rarely take her seriously. She has demonstrated sharp investigative skills in uncovering major criminal operations.

Additional Information: Her Quirk allows her to transform her index and middle fingers into scissors that can cut through almost anything, and she can apply the same property to her legs for larger cuts. When upset, her face resembles a Heikegani shell. She prefers being called Kaniko rather than her formal name.

cardPool.title: Airjet
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Airjet, Buster Hero
Quirk Name: Air Blast
Occupation/Role: Pro Hero
Personality: Serious and dedicated to heroic duty, Airjet possesses an uncontrollable compulsion to apprehend villains whenever encountered. He is confident, respectful toward fellow heroes, and driven by an intrinsic sense of justice comparable to young Bakugo's combative nature.
Appearance: Airjet wears a crimson bodysuit with white armor plating on elbows, knees, and lower arms. He dons matching knee-high boots and a box-like helmet covering his entire face. A distinctive cannon mounted on his left arm and a twin-jet backpack define his silhouette, marking him as a specialized combat hero.
Backstory: A veteran Pro Hero known for his participation in major heroic operations and inter-agency meetings. Airjet has built a reputation for his unwavering commitment to villain apprehension, even earning admiration from civilians who witness his heroic feats. His agency once operated in residential neighborhoods, establishing him as a community presence.
Additional Information: Quirk allows him to discharge powerful air blasts in combat. His signature Ultimate Move is called Buster Shot. The jet pack on his back enables sustained aerial flight and pursuit of airborne threats. His equipment design has become influential enough that support heroes like Mei Hatsume base their innovations on his technology.

cardPool.title: Alan Kay
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Alan Kay

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Unknown

Occupation/Role: Scientist/Researcher

Personality: Brave and courageous despite his circumstances. Demonstrates unwavering determination and willingness for self-sacrifice to stop Humarise's genocidal plans. Maintains moral conviction even when forced to work for terrorists threatening his family.

Appearance: A disheveled adult man with dark brown hair and gray eyes. Wears an eye patch over his right eye, which bears a scar underneath. Typically dressed in a white shirt, brown pants, and brown shoes. Bears signs of physical and mental strain from his captivity.

Backstory: Kidnapped by Humarise along with other scientists, Alan was forced to develop Trigger Bombs under threat of his family's execution. When his colleague Eddie Soul created a deactivation key before being executed, Alan seized the opportunity to escape with it. Disguising himself as a masked Humarise member, he attempted to deliver the key to authorities via car, but was pursued and crashed on a highway by Humarise member Beros. The briefcase was lost in the wreck and swapped with stolen jewelry.

Additional Information: Currently hospitalized in critical condition following the highway crash. Otheon police guard him as he recovers. Left a recorded message in the suitcase expressing his determination to stop Humarise's plan to eradicate Quirk users worldwide. The deactivation key and microSD were secured in a puzzle box within a hidden compartment.

cardPool.title: Anan Kurose
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Anan Kurose

Alias: Space Hero: Thirteen

Quirk Name: Black Hole

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero and UA High School Faculty Member

Personality: Wise and well-mannered, deeply passionate about rescue work and saving lives. Advocates for using Quirks constructively rather than destructively, though she acknowledges her own Quirk's lethal potential. Brave and selfless, willing to engage in combat despite not being combat-oriented.

Appearance: Young woman with short navy blue hair and a distinctive blonde spiral patch at the roots. Hazel irises ringed like black holes. Black substance coating her hands and forearms from her Quirk. Wears a white puffy space suit-style jacket, black helmet with white eye markings, and yellow boots.

Backstory: A dedicated Pro Hero specializing in search and rescue operations. Passionate enough about hero training to develop her own facility, the Unforeseen Simulation Joint, to teach future heroes rescue tactics. Serves as a faculty member at UA High School, guiding the next generation of heroes.

Additional Information: Uses specialized gloves with flippable fingertips to control her Quirk's destructive output—more fingers open equals greater power. A non-combat teacher who uses high-density weight handicaps during student evaluations.

cardPool.title: Anna Scervino
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Anna Scervino

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Overmodification

Occupation/Role: Civilian (formerly imprisoned by the Gollini Family mafia)

Personality: Frightened and melancholic from trauma and Quirk-induced pain, but naturally joyful and childlike when given safety and comfort. Harbors deep PTSD from losing her family to the mafia and suffers from an aversion to violence. Desperate and willing to seek dark solutions to escape her suffering, yet capable of returning to optimism when freed from her burden.

Appearance: A young woman with waist-length light peach hair and blue eyes that darken from the roots outward each time her Quirk activates. She wears a long-sleeved dress in shades of pink and white with a red bow adorning her chest and head, and a pink choker around her neck. Her delicate, refined appearance contrasts sharply with the dangerous power she harbors.

Backstory: Anna grew up isolated due to her constantly-active, dangerous Quirk that causes excruciating pain to those incompatible with it. Only her butler Giulio Gandini could safely remain near her thanks to his Neutralization Quirk. After the Paranormal Liberation War, the Gollini Family mafia kidnapped her to exploit her power, forcing her into captivity and deepening her trauma. She was rescued by Class 1-A students and Giulio, whose enhanced Neutralization permanently deactivated her Quirk.

Additional Information: Not a UA student; a civilian victim of organized crime. Her Quirk reached Singularity levels, making her an uncontrollable weapon. Now functionally Quirkless and healing emotionally with Giulio's support.

cardPool.title: Bee☆Pop
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Kazuho Haneyama (possessed by Queen Bee parasitic Quirk)
Alias: Bee☆Pop
Quirk Name: Queen Bee
Occupation/Role: Villain/Performer (formerly Pop☆Step Vigilante)
Personality: Sadistic and charismatic performer who stages destructive attacks as "shows," masking deep psychological instability. Obsessed with Koichi Haimawari, confusing love and hate. Beneath cheerful enthusiasm lies inability to distinguish right from wrong and self-destructive despair. Uses Trigger drug to enhance abilities.
Appearance: When possessed, wears a bee-themed variant of Pop☆Step's vigilante costume with honey-colored stripes, bee wings instead of devil wings, red heart-shaped belt buckles, and thick black eyeshadow and lipstick. Hair swept over left eye. Carries trigger canisters at belt. When on Trigger, skin darkens and tongue blackens.
Backstory: Originally a remnant bee swarm from Kuin Hachisuka's control, cultivated by Number 6 for years before possessing Kazuho. The fusion creates a twisted entity driven by obsession with Koichi and desire for a memorable, self-destructive finale after losing hope for a peaceful future.
Additional Information: Highly dangerous minor villain who destroyed multiple buildings during performances. Registered as threat level requiring immediate intervention. Skilled singer who broadcasts her "performances" through hacked broadcasts.

cardPool.title: Boomerang Villain

Boomerang

Villain, Jailbreaker escaped by All For One

Extremely hostile and threatening toward civilians, greedy and willing to rob for supplies alongside his criminal partners. Cowardly when faced with genuine resistance, showing fear upon confrontation.

Appearance:
Bright orange messy hair. Dark purple jacket with ripped sleeves and matching dark purple pants over a white T-shirt. Black tactical boots, black knee pads, and grey arm guards with boomerangs attached. Wears a grey mask covering his face.

His destructive tendencies and reliance on his Quirk make him a minor threat to society, though his cowardice limits his effectiveness in direct conflict.

Additional Information:
His Quirk allows him to throw boomerangs that glow purple when activated and detonate on command. Defeated by Class 1-A students during a robbery attempt, captured by Uravity. Associated with the Truck Jailbreaker and Bouncy Jailbreaker.

cardPool.title: Eel Boy

He remains resolute even when facing dangerous villains, showing determination to apprehend threats regardless of their motivations.
Appearance: Average build and stature with a distinctive yellow bodysuit decorated with bold black lines. He wears a matching utility belt and yellow boots with tan rims and soles. Circular protrusions on the backs of his hands accommodate his Quirk manifestations. His mask features a torn-open mouth area that reveals somewhat jagged teeth, giving him a distinctive, intimidating visage.
Backstory: A dedicated hero operating within Japan's hero society who has earned public trust and support. Eel Boy was assigned to critical operations including high-stakes villain apprehensions, demonstrating his rank and reliability among the hero community.
Additional Information: Eel Boy's Quirk generates giant eel-like appendages from the backs of his hands capable of attacking, restraining, and swallowing opponents. The eels possess enhanced sensory abilities to track targets. He operates as a professional hero, not a UA student. His costume has evolved over time, with earlier versions featuring ring-pattern designs and a sealed mask.

cardPool.title: Fourth Kind
cardPool.value:

Alias: Fourth Kind

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero

Personality: Strict and professional disciplinarian who demands excellence from his interns. Fourth Kind is easily angered by minor infractions and quick to physically punish mistakes, yet hides a gruff sense of care beneath his harsh methods. He believes community service is integral to heroism.

Appearance: A large, wide-set man with four muscular arms as a result of his Quirk. He has buzzed grayish-brown hair, small but wide eyes without visible eyebrows, and notably heavy brow skin. His teeth are prominently straight. A distinctive stitched scar runs diagonally across his left eye. He wears a black suit tailored with four sleeves, a cyan tie with three yellow diamonds down the center, and thick gold rings on all twenty fingers. His jaw and neck appear encased in metal.

Backstory: Fourth Kind earned his reputation as a chivalrous hero through rigorous professionalism and unwavering standards. He selected interns Eijiro Kirishima and Tetsutetsu Tetsutetsu after being impressed by their performance at the UA Sports Festival, recognizing their potential despite their rough edges.

Additional Information: Fourth Kind is skilled in close quarters combat and uses his four arms to devastating effect. He participated in the major raid against the Paranormal Liberation Front at Gunga Mountain Villa and later assisted in prisoner transport operations. His katana appears decorative.

cardPool.title: Glutton God

Occupation/Role: Villain and gang leader
Personality: A brutal bully who exploits chaos and lawlessness for personal gain. He enjoys looting and dominating through force, with an insatiable appetite matching his villain moniker.
Appearance: A large, obese man with a magenta Mohawk protruding through a dark mask covering his upper face. He wears dark overalls emblazoned with kanji characters reading "Glutton God," heavy boots, and exudes an imposing physical presence.
Backstory: Glutton God emerged as a gang leader during Japan's hero society crisis following the Paranormal Liberation War. With prisons emptied and heroes stretched thin, he seized the opportunity to raid shopping districts and terrorize civilians, only to be swiftly defeated by Best Jeanist.
Additional Information: His Slime Quirk generates a yellow gelatinous substance from his arms with sufficient density to shatter wooden structures. He was apprehended by Best Jeanist's superior combat ability and Fiber Master Quirk before causing significant damage.

Black material wraps his limbs, and two armor-like pieces encircle each arm. He dons a white perforated mask and matching armor-plated kneecaps, giving him an eerie, skeletal appearance overall.

His exposed musculature displays defined abdominals, pectorals, and biceps. He wears only dark, skintight pants.

Additional Information: Operate as expendable shock troops rather than thinking strategists; possess multiple stolen Quirks grafted into their biology; lack individual regeneration capabilities, making them vulnerable to sustained damage despite their formidable strength; the Flying variant proved instrumental in All For One's assault on Tartarus and Star and Stripe operations before self-destructing as a tactical decoy

cardPool.title: Absorption and Release
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Absorption and Release

Description:
The user can absorb incoming emitter-type attacks and redirect them back at opponents with equal or greater force. This allows tactical repositioning of incoming energy-based assaults, turning enemy offense into counterattacks.

Functions/Applications:
Absorb fire, electricity, energy blasts, and similar projectile attacks; store absorbed energy briefly; release stored attacks in any direction; chain multiple absorptions for increased output; reflect ranged threats back at their source.

Limits:
The user takes full damage from the initial impact despite absorption—no damage mitigation occurs. Only works on emitter-type attacks; physical strikes and contact-based quirks cannot be absorbed. Absorbed energy degrades over time if not released quickly. Overwhelmingly powerful attacks may exceed storage capacity, damaging the user internally.

Additional Notes:
Most effective against ranged, energy-focused opponents. Vulnerable to direct melee combatants who close distance before attacks can be absorbed. Requires timing and positioning to redirect effectively. Weak against opponents who adapt their attack patterns after initial release.

cardPool.title: Assault Dust
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Assault Dust

Description:
The user generates and manipulates fine dust particles from their body, projecting them at high velocity as weapons or tools. The dust can be controlled mid-flight and shaped into various forms for offense or utility purposes.

Functions/Applications:
The user can fire concentrated dust bursts at targets with considerable force, suitable for striking enemies from distance. Dust clouds can obscure vision, create diversions, or be used to track movements. The user can shape dust into barriers or protective screens with enough density.

Limits:
Effectiveness decreases in wet or humid environments where dust becomes heavy and uncontrollable. The user must maintain line of sight to manipulate dust effectively. Large-scale dust generation drains stamina quickly. Wind and air currents can disperse the dust unpredictably, reducing accuracy.

Additional Notes:
Best suited for ranged combat and tactical situations. Requires creative thinking to maximize utility beyond direct attacks. Works poorly in enclosed spaces with poor ventilation or against water-based opponents.

cardPool.title: Tetsu
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Tetsu
Alias: Tetsu the Tank
Quirk Name: Unnamed Armor Quirk
Occupation/Role: Yakuza Executive, Abegawa Tenchu Kai
Personality: Hot-tempered and hot-headed, enjoys drinking and carousing with fellow yakuza members. Easily infuriated by perceived slights to his organization's honor, yet capable of camaraderie with his peers.
Appearance: Middle-aged man with dark hair and a full beard. Wears dark sunglasses, a light-colored fancy jacket with matching light-colored pants, and a scarf. Athletic build befitting a combat-capable executive.
