Additional Information: Tetsu's Quirk grants him control over metallic armor capable of firing powerful laser beams, making him a formidable combatant. He typically operates as part of a coordinated team with other yakuza executives, though their combined strength proved insufficient against the vigilante Stendhal.

cardPool.title: Navel Laser
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Navel Laser

Description:
A light-based offensive quirk that fires brilliant, sparkly laser beams from the user's navel. The beams can range from short to long-range and are powerful enough to pierce concrete and destroy metal. Originally stolen and implanted by All For One, this quirk was not naturally suited to the user's body, requiring external support to function properly.

Functions/Applications:
Beams can be reshaped into blades or razor-thin projectiles and manipulated in size. Strong recoil propels the user through the air for mobility. Intense brightness illuminates dark areas and serves as a beacon for allies or bait for enemies. With specialized equipment channeling the energy, beams can be fired from multiple body points. User can manipulate beam properties with technical precision, even writing with the light.

Limits:
Without the Sparkle Belt, the quirk cannot be controlled or aimed properly. Continuous firing causes internal damage; overuse risks loss of bowel control. User can only naturally fire in a straight line from the front, leaving rear exposure vulnerable. The implanted nature means constant energy leakage without equipment support. Extended activation causes stomach pain and leaves the user defenseless.

Additional Notes:
Training significantly increases duration, frequency, and power output. The user has developed an artistic, flamboyant fighting style with this quirk.

cardPool.title: Big Red Dot
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown

Alias: Big Red Dot

Quirk Name: Tidal Bore

Occupation/Role: Number 1 Pro Hero of Singapore

Personality: Caring and loyal, with a strong sense of justice and willingness to sacrifice for others. He demonstrates leadership qualities and maintains composure under pressure during high-stakes operations.

Appearance: A well-built man with the head of a lion and webbed feet. He wears a sleeveless light blue wetsuit with a water-design belt, elbow-length arm guards, and shoulder pads bearing the Singaporean flag. A small domino mask completes his costume.

Backstory: The top-ranked hero of Singapore, Big Red Dot is a trusted ally of All Might and the international hero community. He has proven his capability in coordinated multi-national operations against terrorist threats, including the Humarise organization's Trigger Bomb plot.

Additional Information: Operates as a leader in international task forces alongside other prominent heroes. His Quirk allows him to manipulate water with tremendous force, capable of lifting large objects to high altitudes. He maintains strong bonds with fellow heroes and expresses eagerness to aid allies in crisis situations.

cardPool.title: All For One
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Zen Shigaraki

Alias: All For One

Quirk Name: All For One

Occupation/Role: Founder and leader of the League of Villains; Japan's most powerful villain

Personality: Cold, calculating, and tyrannical with an unshakeable conviction in his vision of world domination. He is patient yet singularly obsessed, willing to orchestrate elaborate schemes across decades to achieve his goals. Beneath his menacing exterior lies a manipulative strategist who values power above all else.

Appearance: A towering man of imposing, muscular build with severe scarring covering his entire head and face from his battle with All Might. His features are almost entirely composed of scar tissue with no visible nose, ears, or hair; faded white eyes remain barely discernible. He typically wears a dark formal suit over a white collared shirt, paired with a dark navy skull-like gas mask featuring angular tubes and a wide life-support collar system with connecting pipes around his neck.

Backstory: Once Japan's most powerful villain and All Might's arch-nemesis, All For One sought to steal One For All—the Quirk belonging to his younger twin brother—as it alone could oppose him. He founded the League of Villains and adopted Tomura Shigaraki, grooming him as a successor and vessel to transfer his consciousness into, furthering his century-long plan for world conquest. He was imprisoned in Tartarus but escaped months later, determined to destroy Izuku Midoriya.

Additional Information: Blind from his injuries, he compensates using an Infrared Quirk and echolocation-like vibration sensing. He possesses small holes in each palm through which he steals and transfers Quirks. Not a UA student; operates as a top-tier villain antagonist.

cardPool.title: Toshinori Yagi
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Toshinori Yagi

Alias:
All Might

Quirk Name:
One For All

Occupation/Role:
Foundational Hero Studies Teacher, UA High School

Personality:
Charismatic and heroic with an unwavering sense of justice, though burdened by the weight of his title as Symbol of Peace. Dedicated mentor who inspires those around him through conviction and example.

Appearance:
In his empowered form, an imposingly muscular figure with chiseled features, strong jawline, and pronounced cheekbones. Short blond hair swept back with two distinctive front tufts. Deep blue eyes with shadowed eye sockets. Wears his iconic Golden Age costume: skin-tight blue bodysuit with a red "Y" symbol on the chest, white diamond at center, large white hip patches with red trim, yellow forearm sleeves, and yellow belt with silver buckle.

Backstory:
The eighth holder of One For All, passed the Quirk from Nana Shimura. Rose to become Japan's No. 1 Pro Hero and the world's Symbol of Peace. Now teaches at UA High School while training his successor, Izuku Midoriya, to carry on his legacy.

Additional Information:
Still active as a hero and teacher during Class 1-A's first year at UA. The shadowed appearance around his eyes marks the toll of his heroic battles, particularly his first confrontation with All For One.

cardPool.title: Yo Shindo
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Yo Shindo

Alias:
Grand

Quirk Name:
Vibrate

Occupation/Role:
Third-year student at Ketsubutsu Academy High School

Personality:
Polite and friendly on the surface, but calculating and sneaky beneath. He strategically lowers others' guards while remaining calm and rational in chaos. Competitive yet respectful of opponents' efforts, though willing to exploit weaknesses. His demeanor can shift instantly when angered, though he prefers the term "tactical" to describe his approach.

Appearance:
Tall and muscular with shaggy, dark brown hair nearly black, sticking up in all directions with low-hanging bangs. Warm brown, loosely diamond-shaped eyes and a frequent smile—whether friendly or sinister. Wears a gold jaw-guard covering his cheeks to protect from vibration damage, thick green shoulder straps, short black jacket with golden trimmings, black elbow pads, green wrist-guards, black baggy pants with green markings, and plain black boots.

Backstory:
A capable student and natural leader at Ketsubutsu Academy, Yo has risen to prominence through strategic brilliance and mastery of his Quirk. He demonstrated his tactical prowess during the Provisional Hero License Exam by dividing UA Class 1-A students with coordinated earthquake attacks and subduing multiple opponents in succession.

Additional Information:
Yo primarily uses vibrations to generate earthquakes that disrupt formations and weaken opponents' footing. His strategic mind and ability to remain composed during chaotic situations make him exceptionally effective in outnumbered scenarios. He possesses impressive fortitude that allows him to face far stronger opponents.

cardPool.title: Energy Suck
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Energy Suck

Description:
By making physical contact and inhaling, the user absorbs the vitality of others, gaining increased stamina, size, and strength. This simultaneously weakens the target. The user must maintain contact to activate the ability under normal circumstances.

Functions/Applications:
Drain enemy stamina while boosting your own physical prowess. Absorb multiple targets in succession to compound strength gains. Enhanced size provides tactical advantages in combat. When augmented by Trigger drug, the quirk activates at range through inhalation alone, bypassing the contact requirement and functioning even while unconscious.

Limits:
Requires physical contact for standard use, rendering it ineffective at range. Cannot absorb targets the user cannot touch. The range-enhancement effect only occurs under Trigger drug influence and is temporary. Overuse depletes available targets and leaves the user vulnerable when the drug wears off. Weakened targets can coordinate against the user once the enhancement fades.

Additional Notes:
This quirk excels at turning the tide of prolonged battles through cumulative power increases, but relies on close proximity and multiple opponents. Trigger drug transforms it into a devastating area effect, but creates dependency and crashes when the effect ends. Best utilized against groups rather than single, evasive opponents.

cardPool.title: Erasure Spot
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Erasure Spot

Description:
Paulo Gollini can manifest a large dome-shaped energy wave that deactivates all Quirks within its range indiscriminately. He can create a smaller protective bubble inside the dome where Quirks remain active. When artificially boosted, the range expands to cover entire mountain ranges.

Functions/Applications:
Creates a wide nullification field that strips enemies of their Quirk abilities, forcing them to rely on physical prowess alone. The inner bubble allows allies with non-Quirk combat skills (firearms, martial arts) to function while enemies outside remain powerless. Useful for disorienting opponents and controlling battlefield positioning.

Limits:
The outer dome nullifies Quirks indiscriminately, affecting the user's own allies if they venture outside the inner bubble. Fast or skilled opponents can bypass the field to reach the user's position and reactivate their Quirks. The strategy becomes predictable and Paulo becomes vulnerable once his support units are eliminated. The user cannot selectively disable only enemy Quirks.

Additional Notes:
Paulo relies heavily on minions with non-Quirk combat abilities or Quirks that function within the field. The Quirk excels at area denial and crowd control but requires careful positioning and team coordination. Without allies or defensive support, Paulo lacks direct offensive capability against Quirk-users who breach his defenses.

cardPool.title: En Tayutai
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
En Tayutai

Alias:
Smoke-Eater

Quirk Name:
Smokescreen

Occupation/Role:
Former Pro Hero, Sixth User of One For All

Personality:
Reserved but friendly, with strong willpower and proactive determination. Despite his generally composed nature, he allows emotions to surface when concerned for others' safety. He demonstrates self-deprecation regarding his Quirk's perceived weakness, yet shows genuine warmth when witnessing creative applications of his abilities.

Appearance:
A fairly short man with short, dark hair parted twice away from narrow eyes. His hero costume features a large red jacket with numerous straps and buttons, paired with a high collar obscuring his mouth and nose. He wears dark, baggy pants, large white hiking boots, and has his forearms wrapped in sports tape.

Backstory:
En received One For All from Daigoro after the previous user fell in battle against All For One. He resisted All For One's attempts to steal the Quirk twice, demonstrating exceptional willpower. He founded a resistance movement with other heroes to fight All For One, ultimately sacrificing himself in combat while transferring One For All to the next user.

Additional Information:
As a One For All user, En possessed superhuman strength, speed, agility, and durability. His Smokescreen Quirk generated purple smoke to obscure vision. He survived severe injuries long enough to fulfill his duty as a Quirk bearer, embodying the resolve required of One For All's guardians.

cardPool.title: Ground Beta
cardPool.value:
Name: Ground Beta

Location: Urban training facility with interconnected streets and multi-story buildings designed for combat exercises and surveillance.

Inhabitants: Security robots patrolling the grounds, occasional instructors and observers in basement monitoring rooms, student combatants during scheduled trials.

Appearance: A replica urban district featuring realistic street layouts and office-style buildings with reinforced construction. Basement levels contain observation decks with screens and communication systems for monitoring indoor exercises. The architecture is sturdy but functional, designed to withstand repeated combat training without permanent damage.

cardPool.title: Ground Gamma
cardPool.value:
Name:
Ground Gamma

Location:
An abandoned industrial complex featuring interconnected factories, heavy machinery, and a vertical labyrinth of cranes, pipelines, and metal structures that create multiple elevation levels and precarious pathways.

Inhabitants:
Pro Heroes conducting training exercises, students undergoing combat trials, and occasionally authority figures like Principal Nezu who oversee practical examinations and competitive battles.

Appearance:
A sprawling maze of rust-streaked factories and towering industrial equipment. Massive cranes loom overhead, pipelines crisscross at various heights, and metal catwalks offer unstable footing between jagged structures. The ground is littered with debris and fallen machinery. Vertical movement is heavily favored; certain areas feature treacherous, narrow passages while others offer crane-based traversal routes. The environment is designed to test agility, endurance, and adaptability under pressure.

cardPool.title: Ground Omega
cardPool.value:
Name:
Ground Omega

Location:
A vast walled training grounds enclosed by a single entrance marked with an omega symbol, containing dense woods interspersed with rocky hills. An observation post building stands adjacent to monitor activities from its rooftop.

Inhabitants:
Teachers including Shota Aizawa and All Might supervise training exercises. Student groups from multiple academies use the grounds for survival drills and joint practice sessions. Typically hosts twenty to thirty students during organized events.

Appearance:
A sprawling forest landscape with natural rocky outcroppings and uneven terrain suitable for combat training. The perimeter is secured by a great stone wall with a single guarded entrance. The observation post offers commanding views of the entire grounds from above.

cardPool.title: Beams From His Eyes
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Beams From His Eyes

Description:
A Quirk that allows the user to fire concentrated laser beams directly from their eyes. The intensity and size of the blast scales with the user's focus and concentration. Activation requires flipping a switch on a specialized visor worn by the user.

Functions/Applications:
Fire standard-intensity beams at targets within line of sight by activating the visor switch. Concentrate to channel larger, more powerful blasts for significant damage or area effect strikes. Useful for ranged combat, precision targeting, or tactical applications at distance.

Limits:
Requires manual activation via visor switch; cannot fire without it. Each blast demands the user maintain direct line of sight on the target. Larger blasts require sustained concentration, leaving the user vulnerable during charging. Unknown if the Quirk can be fully deactivated or if the visor is essential to prevent uncontrolled firing. Overuse may cause eye strain or fatigue.

Additional Notes:
The visor's switch mechanism suggests this Quirk has uncontrolled firing potential without safeguards. Ichimoku is entirely dependent on his visor equipment; loss or damage to it would severely compromise combat effectiveness. Works best in open environments with clear sightlines; obstructed vision limits utility.

cardPool.title: Air Walk
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Air Walk

Description:
The user can stand on and manipulate the air itself, creating invisible platforms beneath their feet that allow levitation and mid-air locomotion. This stolen quirk grants freedom of vertical movement and aerial positioning without physical support.

Functions/Applications:
Users can float upward, walk across invisible air platforms, and hover at varying heights. This enables superior tactical positioning for ranged attacks, evasion, and mobility across terrain. The quirk pairs well with ranged abilities, allowing users to attack from elevated vantage points while remaining airborne.

Limits:
The user must maintain active focus to keep the air platforms stable; loss of concentration causes immediate falling. The quirk cannot support movement while the user is unconscious or severely incapacitated. Aerial combat endurance depends on the user's stamina, as sustained flight exhausts energy over time.

Additional Notes:
Air Walk is not innate but a stolen quirk, suggesting it may be removable or transferable. Its primary advantage lies in vertical positioning rather than raw offensive power, making it best suited for tactical support, reconnaissance, and ranged combat rather than direct melee engagement.

cardPool.title: Air Cannon
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Air Cannon

Description:
A powerful ranged Quirk that releases devastating shockwaves of compressed air from the palms. The blast's form varies based on arm motion—from concentrated linear shots to wide crescent-shaped air blades. Versatile enough for offense and defense.

Functions/Applications:
Primary ranged attack capable of destroying buildings and overwhelming multiple opponents. Can be shaped into barriers to block incoming attacks. Combines effectively with other Quirks (Springlike Limbs, Kinetic Booster, Radio Waves, Heavy Payload) to amplify destructive power exponentially. Useful for initiating combat and wearing down enemies at range.

Limits:
Requires hand positioning and arm motion to execute—interrupting the user mid-attack prevents discharge. Raw power can be mitigated by sufficiently strong defensive abilities (All Might's durability, Heartbeat Wall, Cellophane restraints). Effectiveness diminishes against mobile or shielded targets. Each blast requires brief preparation, leaving the user momentarily vulnerable if repeated rapidly.

Additional Notes:
Originally stolen by All For One; later inherited by Tomura Shigaraki upon receiving All For One's collection Quirk. Becomes exponentially more dangerous when augmented by power-boosting Quirks in the user's arsenal. Most effective as an opening move to establish dominance and control battlefield distance.

cardPool.title: Air Wall
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Air Wall

Description:
The user generates circular shields of densely compressed air from their hands to defend against incoming attacks. These barriers can be layered for enhanced protection or expanded into a protective dome. The shields are potent enough to withstand devastating strikes, though their durability fluctuates based on the user's focus and physical condition.

Functions/Applications:
Create defensive barriers in any direction the user raises their hand. Stack multiple shields for cumulative defense. Expand into a full-body dome against multi-directional threats. Fire compressed air bursts as offensive blasts to knock back or stun enemies.

Limits:
Shields only manifest where the user directs their hand—agile foes can circle around unprotected areas. Durability degrades when the user is physically weakened, injured, or mentally unfocused; shields shatter more easily under these conditions. Cannot protect areas the user fails to anticipate. Sustained or layered barriers drain stamina over time.

Additional Notes:
Air Wall's true name remains unknown; this designation is conjectural. The quirk was stolen from an unnamed hero. Enhanced by quirk-amplifying drugs, the user can generate larger, rectangular barriers beyond normal capability.

cardPool.title: Big Horn
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Big Horn

Description:
The user manifests a pair of large, bull-like horns from their head. These horns are physical extensions of the user's body and can be severed, though this is irreversible and controversial. The horns appear to serve as a distinctive physical trait rather than a primary combat tool.

Functions/Applications:
The horns can be used for charging attacks or as weapons in direct combat. Severing a horn is rumored to improve communication or perception abilities, though the exact mechanism is debated. The horns mark the user as distinctive and may carry social or symbolic significance.

Limits:
Horns cannot be regrown once removed. The user cannot fully control horn growth or retraction. Severing a horn causes permanent disfigurement and may alter the quirk's effectiveness. The horns provide no defensive capability beyond their physical mass.

Additional Notes:
Big Horn is a relatively simple, appearance-based quirk with limited versatility. Users must carefully consider any modification to their horns, as the decision is irreversible and may affect their public image or quirk functionality.

cardPool.title: Big Fist
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Big Fist

Description:
Itsuka enlarges one or both hands to three times her body size with nearly instantaneous activation. Her physical strength scales proportionally, granting immense crushing and striking power without affecting her movement or balance despite the enlarged limbs' weight.

Functions/Applications:
Close-range combat with devastating striking force capable of shattering tungsten defenses. Hand expansion momentum amplifies attack power and surprises opponents. Enlarged hands serve as restraint tools, transport vessels for allies, and protective barriers against environmental hazards like poisonous gas. Fist-flapping generates wind to disperse gas traps and airborne threats.

Limits:
Exclusively short-range combat ability with no ranged application. Enlarged hands obstruct vision and fine manipulation. Cannot be maintained indefinitely (duration unstated). Wind generation from hand movement is limited in power and range. Protection offered by wrapped hands is temporary. Large size creates obvious visual tells, eliminating surprise against aware opponents.

Additional Notes:
Optimal for rescue missions, restraint operations, and defense-breaking scenarios. Versatile utility quirk combining offense, defense, and support functions. Strength scaling prevents user fatigue from enlarged limb weight, differentiating from pure size-based abilities.

cardPool.title: Blade-Tooth
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Blade-Tooth

Description:
The user can enlarge, reshape, and manipulate their teeth into sharpened, blade-like incisors of varying sizes and lengths. These dental weapons can be fired or extended at will with incredible speed and range, functioning as both melee and ranged attacks.

Functions/Applications:
Deploy torrents of tooth blades to barrage enemies and overwhelm defenses. Use elongated teeth as projectiles or stabbing weapons at distance. Employ teeth as extra limbs for mobility, climbing, or suspension in mid-air. Reshape teeth to suit tactical needs—piercing points for penetration or broader blades for cutting.

Limits:
Teeth can be shattered or broken under sufficient blunt force despite their durability. Extended dental blades require stamina to maintain and repeatedly generate. Physical restraints like straightjackets limit but do not fully prevent Quirk use. Opponents with hardened defenses (ice, armor) can resist or redirect tooth attacks if fast enough.

Additional Notes:
Moonfish demonstrates mastery through constant offensive pressure and creative mobility exploitation. The Quirk excels in sustained barrages rather than single devastating strikes. Users gain significant advantage in unprepared or confined combat scenarios due to the versatility of tooth manipulation.

cardPool.title: Blazing Hair
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Blazing Hair

Description:
The user's hair burns with controllable flames that can be shaped and weaponized at will. The fire originates from and remains anchored to the user's head, allowing dynamic combat applications and enhanced mobility through aerial propulsion.

Functions/Applications:
Detach flaming hair strands to hurl as fireballs or projectiles. Reshape flames into melee weapons like swords or blades. Generate thrust by manipulating hair flames downward for flight and increased speed. Combine multiple applications for complex aerial maneuvers and ranged-melee hybrid attacks.

Limits:
Hair regeneration and flame supply are finite; sustained combat depletes reserves. Flight requires active concentration and continuous flame manipulation. Flames cannot extend far from the user's body or persist independently. Close-range opponents can potentially smother or extinguish flames through overwhelming defense or water-based counters.

Additional Notes:
Most effective when the user maintains aerial advantage and distance. Hair-based attacks telegraph intentions slightly, requiring tactical timing. Synergizes well with speed-focused combat styles. Works best against ground-bound or slower opponents.

cardPool.title: Body Bulk
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Body Bulk

Description:
A transformation quirk that allows the user to expand and densify their entire body, dramatically increasing muscle mass, physical size, and raw strength. The quirk activates most powerfully during intense emotional states like rage, hatred, or fear, making the user stronger when experiencing strong negative emotions.

Functions/Applications:
Enhanced physical strength for combat and lifting heavy objects; increased durability from thickened muscle tissue; emotional triggers amplify the transformation for temporary power surges during confrontations. The user can control the degree of bulk to some extent, from partial enhancement to full transformation.

Limits:
Requires emotional intensity to reach peak effectiveness; prolonged use causes fatigue and muscle soreness; the transformation makes the user slower and less agile due to increased mass. Control becomes difficult during extreme emotional states, potentially making the user reckless or harder to direct in battle.

Additional Notes:
Originally stolen by All For One and gifted to the user. The quirk's reliance on negative emotions makes it difficult to use strategically in situations requiring calm judgment. Best suited for direct confrontation rather than finesse-based combat.

cardPool.title: Cell Activation
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Cell Activation

Description:
A touch-based Quirk that stimulates cellular activity in the user's own body or another person's body. This accelerates natural healing, speeds recovery, and temporarily enhances physical performance. The effect is immediate upon contact but drains the user's stamina with continued use.

Functions/Applications:
Rapidly heal wounds and injuries by accelerating tissue regeneration. Speed up physical recovery and reduce fatigue in allies. Temporarily boost physical performance and strength in oneself or others. Can be used in combat support or medical emergencies to restore wounded fighters to battle-ready condition.

Limits:
Incompatible with certain blood types; most variants only work on specific blood groups (Type A, O, and B documented; some versions restricted to Type A only). Cannot be used on incompatible blood types regardless of power level. Drains the user's stamina significantly with prolonged activation, causing fatigue and exhaustion if overused. Extended healing sessions require recovery time before the Quirk can be reliably activated again.

Additional Notes:
Different versions of this Quirk exist with varying blood-type compatibility; some users may have fewer restrictions than others. The Quirk functions through direct physical contact and cannot be used remotely. Effects are temporary enhancements rather than permanent stat increases, making repeated usage necessary for sustained benefits.

cardPool.title: Dark Shadow
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Dark Shadow

Description:
A sentient, shadowy entity that manifests from the user's body as a loyal, monster-like guardian. It remains tethered to the host through an umbilical connection and communicates telepathically. Dark Shadow is composed of dark energy—solid enough to interact with the physical world—and can extend its limbs and shift shape to limited degrees.

Functions/Applications:
Dark Shadow serves as both offensive weapon and defensive shield, stretching its arms to grapple or slam enemies while the user maintains distance. It can provide mobility support, aid climbing, and simulate flight when properly trained. The entity grows exponentially more powerful in darkness, becoming a large, ferocious beast capable of devastating physical attacks that cleave through multiple obstacles.

Limits:
Dark Shadow's dark energy depletes with extended distance from the host, rapid successive impacts, or when overused. Light exposure dramatically weakens it both physically and in power output, rendering it docile and small. In darkness, Dark Shadow becomes uncontrollable and may defy commands if the host's negative emotions intensify, potentially forcing the user's body to act against their will. The host and entity cannot share sensations, so one being incapacitated doesn't stop the other.

cardPool.title: Diesel Engine
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Diesel Engine

Description:
The user's head and upper body transform into a powerful diesel locomotive, granting enhanced speed and locomotive-like capabilities. This physical metamorphosis provides significant momentum and running velocity beyond normal human limits.

Functions/Applications:
Accelerated running speed for pursuit and evasion. Locomotive power enables forceful charging attacks. The hardened metal construction of the locomotive form provides defensive plating against impacts and strikes.

Limits:
Transformation is limited to head and upper body only; lower body remains human, creating balance and mobility issues. Locomotive form is heavy and cumbersome, reducing agility and turning speed. Requires fuel or energy consumption to maintain enhanced performance. Cannot operate effectively in tight spaces due to size.

Additional Notes:
The quirk creates a distinctive silhouette that sacrifices stealth for raw power. Most effective in open terrain where running speed can be fully utilized. The user requires practice to manage the weight distribution between transformed and untransformed body parts.

cardPool.title: Electric Charge
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Electric Charge

Description:
A Quirk that grants the user the ability to harvest, store, and manipulate electrical currents from their environment. The user can channel electricity for offensive attacks, defensive maneuvers, and signal disruption. Tesla demonstrates natural immunity to external electrical-based Quirks due to constant electrical saturation within his body.

Functions/Applications:
Electric attacks that deal direct damage to targets; jamming or disrupting electronic systems and wireless signals; creating electrical barriers for defense; powering mechanical devices; neutralizing opponent electricity Quirks through immunity.

Limits:
Requires continuous access to electrical sources to maintain efficiency—prolonged use without recharging rapidly depletes effectiveness. Cannot generate electricity independently; relies on harvesting existing currents. Overuse risks circuit burnout in the user's nervous system. Insulated or isolated environments severely hinder the Quirk's utility.

Additional Notes:
The Quirk's strength depends heavily on environmental electrical availability, making it situational in combat. Tesla's immunity to electrical attacks is a significant defensive advantage, but electrical-resistant opponents remain a vulnerability.

cardPool.title: Electrification
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Electrification

Description:
Denki stores electrical energy within his body and discharges it as a protective aura that shocks anyone through contact. Higher outputs create omnidirectional electrical bursts that illuminate the area. He can also absorb incoming electrical attacks and channel electricity to power electronics.

Functions/Applications:
Close-range electroshock defense that paralyzes on contact. Area-of-effect discharge when sufficient power is released. Acts as a lightning rod to absorb enemy electrical attacks. Can energize devices and electronics. Sharpshooting Gear equipment allows directing electricity through projectiles to avoid hitting allies.

Limits:
Highly ineffective at range without equipment support. Lacks innate directional control, risking friendly fire. Exceeding his wattage capacity causes complete brain short-circuit for one hour, leaving him incapacitated and vulnerable. Insulation and non-conductive Quirks negate effectiveness. Panic situations may trigger uncontrolled discharge. Holding back power limits his combat potential.

Additional Notes:
Denki frequently restrains himself in group combat to prevent harming teammates. Training with high-capacity batteries has improved his maximum output capacity. Non-conductive plant-based or alternative-type Quirks present significant tactical challenges.

cardPool.title: Electricity Generation
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Electricity Generation

Description:
The user produces and manipulates electricity within their body, releasing it as controlled bolts of lightning. Unlike uncontrolled electrification, this Quirk grants precision aiming and selective discharge, allowing the user to target specific enemies while avoiding allies.

Functions/Applications:
Fire lightning bolts at distant targets with accuracy. Electrify conductive surfaces or objects for tactical advantage. Provide illumination in dark environments. Stun or damage multiple foes if bolts chain between targets.

Limits:
Continuous use drains stamina rapidly. Range decreases with intensity of discharge. Wet environments amplify power but risk uncontrolled spread. User cannot electrify themselves without proper control, risking self-harm. Insulated or non-conductive targets resist damage.

Additional Notes:
This Quirk requires focus to aim; panic or distraction reduces accuracy. Overcharging risks explosive backfire. Most effective against metallic or organic targets with high conductivity.

cardPool.title: Energy Saver
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Energy Saver

Description:
The user's body operates with exceptional metabolic efficiency, requiring minimal nutrition, hydration, and sleep to function. This Quirk dramatically reduces biological needs while maintaining peak physical performance for extended periods.

Functions/Applications:
Sustain continuous high-intensity activity for 48+ hours without rest. Resume full functionality after only 3 hours of sleep. Survive on drastically reduced food and water intake while maintaining strength and endurance. Ideal for prolonged pursuits, sieges, or endurance-based combat scenarios.

Limits:
The user still requires some nutrition, hydration, and sleep—complete deprivation will eventually cause failure. Effectiveness scales with other stamina-based Quirks; synergizes poorly with energy-draining abilities. Does not enhance actual physical power, only sustainability. Mental fatigue may still accumulate despite physical resilience.

Additional Notes:
Energy Saver is a support Quirk best paired with high-endurance or strength-based abilities. Its primary advantage is operational longevity rather than raw combat power. Users become formidable through attrition, outlasting opponents through sheer persistence.

cardPool.title: Fast Fist
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Fast Fist

Description:
The user's hands and arms move at supernatural speed, capable of striking up to 100 times in less than a second. Strikes appear as a blur or single motion to observers. By repeatedly striking pressure points with precision, the user can render targets unconscious.

Functions/Applications:
Rapid hand combat allowing overwhelming offense through sheer strike frequency. Pressure point targeting enables knockout incapacitation without lethal force. Speed creates openings against slower opponents and allows defensive blocking.

Limits:
Confined to hands and arms only; legs and body cannot benefit from enhanced speed. User must still move their body normally, limiting pursuit capability. Requires precision targeting of pressure points for knockout effect; random strikes are less effective. Fatigue likely limits sustained use duration.

Additional Notes:
Most effective against unarmored or vulnerable targets. Close-range Quirk with minimal utility at distance. Control appears difficult; accidental injury risk exists. User relies on conventional movement for positioning despite hand speed advantage.

cardPool.title: Physical Enhancement
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Physical Enhancement

Description:
A transformation Quirk that envelops the user's body in a vibrant green flame-like aura, dramatically amplifying their physical capabilities including strength, speed, and durability. The user becomes a powerful close-combat fighter capable of battling high-tier threats.

Functions/Applications:
Activate the aura to boost muscle power and reflexes for enhanced striking force and mobility. The green flame provides both offensive striking power and defensive durability. Effective against multiple enemies or overwhelming single opponents through sheer physical dominance.

Limits:
Requires conscious activation and sustained focus to maintain the aura. Duration and intensity appear limited, suggesting stamina depletion with extended use. The enhancement is purely physical—offers no special mobility, flight, or ranged capabilities. Extremely powerful foes may still overwhelm even enhanced strength.

Additional Notes:
This Quirk was wielded by a Pro Hero who fell in combat against High-End Nomus, indicating its effectiveness against elite threats but also its vulnerability to sufficiently powerful opponents. The green flame aura makes the user highly visible, eliminating stealth advantages. Best suited for direct confrontation rather than tactical engagements.

cardPool.title: Rivet Stab
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Rivet Stab

Description:
The user generates black tendrils marked with red cracked lines that extend from their fingers, spine, palms, or other body parts. These tendrils are sharp, piercing weapons capable of impaling flesh and slicing through buildings with ease.

Functions/Applications:
Tendrils can be launched individually or spread into mesh-like webs for area attacks. They regenerate and can be deployed repeatedly. The user can control whether tendrils cause harm or simply make contact. Advanced users combine Rivet Stab with other Quirks—using tendrils as conduits to activate distant targets' abilities, or fusing them with mouth-based Quirks to create massive composite weapons like vine structures with monstrous heads.

Limits:
Tendrils can be destroyed through sufficient force or intensity. The Quirk appears to require the user's concentration to target accurately; synergy with tracking Quirks improves precision. Extended mesh deployments likely consume stamina, making them resource-intensive for prolonged combat.

Additional Notes:
This Quirk excels at both precision strikes and large-scale devastation. Its versatility increases dramatically when combined with complementary abilities. The non-lethal control option makes it useful for subdual or interrogation, though combat applications dominate its typical use.

cardPool.title: Self-Detonation
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Self-Detonation

Description:
The user's body accumulates explosive energy, causing targeted body parts to swell and glow before detonating in a powerful blast. The explosion's force scales with the user's size and bioengineered modifications. Most users perish or suffer severe mutilation upon detonation unless enhanced with regeneration abilities.

Functions/Applications:
Generate devastating area-of-effect explosions by concentrating energy in specific limbs. Concentrate detonative power into strikes for explosive melee attacks. With regeneration modifications, repeatedly perform explosive attacks without permanent injury. Can be remotely triggered through external devices, making users ideal for controlled demolition or suicide missions.

Limits:
Unmodified self-detonation results in death or permanent mutilation. Smaller or weaker users generate significantly reduced blast radius and damage compared to larger specimens. Requires external activation via device for automaton users; voluntary activation varies by individual. Cannot be partially contained—once initiated, the explosion occurs fully. Regeneration Quirk combination necessary for sustained combat use.

Additional Notes:
Primarily used by bioengineered warriors and specialized operatives. Most effective as a kamikaze weapon or final desperation tactic. Synergizes powerfully with Regeneration and Overclock Quirks for enhanced combat potential.

cardPool.title: Shock Absorption
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Shock Absorption

Description:
The user absorbs the kinetic energy and impact force from physical blows, dramatically reducing damage taken from strikes and collisions. This allows the bearer to withstand tremendous punishment that would normally incapacitate others, though it cannot completely nullify attacks—only diminish them.

Functions/Applications:
Reduces incoming physical damage by dispersing shock waves throughout the body. Effective against melee attacks, falls, and explosive force. Grants exceptional durability in direct combat, allowing the user to engage powerful opponents without sustaining critical injuries from their strikes.

Limits:
The Quirk has a cumulative threshold; continuous attacks will eventually overwhelm its capacity. Gradual, sustained damage (like repeated lacerations) bypasses its effectiveness more efficiently than single powerful blows. The user cannot absorb energy-based attacks or non-impact damage. Shock Absorption requires the user to actually withstand the force—it merely reduces harm rather than eliminating it entirely.

Additional Notes:
Best countered by either overwhelming force exceeding absorption capacity or through persistent, incremental damage rather than single catastrophic strikes. The Quirk was specifically designed to neutralize raw physical power but fails against creative attack strategies that don't rely on immediate impact shock.

cardPool.title: Slide and Glide
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Slide and Glide

Description:
Projects repulsive (blue) and attractive (green) force from hands and feet. The user can propel themselves across surfaces at high speed, cling to vertical surfaces, launch concentrated energy blasts, and achieve limited flight through mid-air momentum boosts. Mastery allows full-body force coating for protection and mobility.

Functions/Applications:
Slide rapidly across ground and walls at speeds rivaling vehicles; climb buildings and vertical surfaces by attraction; fire repulsion beams ranging from close-range blasts to piercing projectiles; perform mid-air jumps to gain altitude and achieve flight; project protective force fields across body parts or entire frame for damage mitigation and light levitation.

Limits:
No built-in braking mechanism—user must reverse acceleration to stop, risking collision. Extended high-speed travel is dangerous without control. Repulsion beams can cause lethal damage, limiting safe combat applications. Multiple mid-air jumps require significant willpower to execute; most users believe limited to two jumps before landing. User takes damage from their own Quirk if struck directly.

Additional Notes:
Initially required three-point contact to function; improves dramatically with training and confidence. Deadly potential requires moral restraint in combat. Reclassifies as "Flight" upon mastery. Synergizes well with acrobatic or precision-based combat styles.

cardPool.title: Tank Engine
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Tank Engine

Description:
The user's head and entire upper body transform into a functional steam locomotive. This mechanical conversion grants superhuman strength and durability while maintaining human consciousness and control. The transformation is permanent and always active.

Functions/Applications:
The user can generate tremendous locomotive power for ramming attacks and unstoppable forward momentum. The metal chassis provides enhanced physical defense against conventional strikes. Steam pressure can be vented for propulsion boosts or defensive bursts. The heavy weight and rigid structure allow the user to break through obstacles and barriers.

Limits:
The transformation severely restricts mobility and agility—the user cannot turn quickly or perform acrobatic movements. Overheating from excessive steam generation causes exhaustion and reduced performance. Water or coolant sources become critical for sustained use. The user's center of gravity is high and front-heavy, making them vulnerable to toppling or balance-disrupting attacks. Mechanical joints can jam or corrode if not maintained.

Additional Notes:
The Quirk is best suited for direct, powerful assaults rather than tactical combat. Users gain advantage in prolonged confrontations where raw force matters more than finesse. Environmental factors like terrain and weather directly impact operational effectiveness.

cardPool.title: Tool Arms
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Tool Arms

Description:
The user can manifest and retract limbs embedded with fully functional tools and weapons. These appendages grow directly from the body and include chainsaws, hammers, drills, and similar implements. The tools are organic components, not separate objects, making them difficult to disarm.

Functions/Applications:
Transform arms into devastating melee weapons for combat. Utilize specialized tools for environmental destruction or tactical advantage. Retract limbs instantly for defensive repositioning or to conceal the Quirk's nature.

Limits:
Each manifested tool limb reduces mobility and dexterity compared to normal arms. Tool selection appears limited to what the user has previously manifested—new tools cannot be spontaneously created mid-combat. Rapid transformation causes fatigue with extended use.

Additional Notes:
This Quirk excels in direct combat but sacrifices precision handling and delicate tasks. The grotesque nature of manifested limbs may disturb or intimidate opponents psychologically. The Quirk works best against singular targets or in confined spaces where tool-based weapons can be leveraged effectively.

cardPool.title: Fiber Master
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Fiber Master

Description:
Telekinetic control over all types of fiber and fabric. The user can manipulate threads, cloth, and fiber-based materials with precision, constraining enemies through their clothing or unraveling their own garments into controllable strands. Denim is easiest to control; sweats are most difficult. Works on synthetic fibers like carbon fiber as well.

Functions/Applications:
Restrain or immobilize targets by controlling their clothing. Unravel personal denim costume into whip-like strings for offense or defense. Redirect allies' movements by manipulating their garments. Requires concentration and readily available fabric sources to function effectively.

Limits:
Naked or fiber-free targets cannot be controlled. Strong-willed foes can resist the ability. User loses control if distracted or mentally unfocused. Effectiveness depends on quantity and type of available fabric—denim abundant, sweats scarce. Requires extensive training to master; among the few Quirks deemed too difficult even for All For One to steal.

Additional Notes:
Ideal users wear denim-heavy costumes to ensure constant fiber availability in combat. Applications vary widely based on enemy attire and environmental fabrics. Synergizes with high intelligence and tactical awareness to maximize control options during multi-target engagements.

cardPool.title: Half-Cold Half-Hot
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Half-Cold Half-Hot

Description:
The user generates ice and frost from their right side and fire and flames from their left side. Both elements originate internally and cannot be manipulated from external sources. The power is perfectly balanced between both halves, granting two distinct combat methods. Advanced mastery allows combining both elements into "cold fire" that simultaneously burns and freezes.

Functions/Applications:
Ice side: Freeze structures, create protective barriers, form stairs and platforms, generate waves for mobility, precision attacks to target specific body parts, ground skating. Fire side: Generate intense heat and flames, propel the user forward, provide warmth regulation. Combined technique: Merge both elements into a unified attack with enhanced properties and immunity to extreme temperatures.

Limits:
Overuse of either side without alternating causes fatal frostbite or overheating. Maximum output depletes temperature reserves almost immediately. Prolonged ice usage reduces body temperature dangerously, lowering attack effectiveness. The user instinctively favors their ice side, creating tactical predictability. Neither element can be manipulated once generated externally—only created from the body itself.

Additional Notes:
The quirk stems from a genetic fusion of Hellflame and Frost abilities. Effective training involves alternating between elements to regulate body temperature.

cardPool.title: Masaru Bakugo
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Masaru Bakugo

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Not specified (presumed Quirkless or minor Quirk)

Occupation/Role: Fashion designer; father of UA High School student Katsuki Bakugo

Personality: Calm and composed, serving as the voice of reason within his volatile family. He is loving and supportive, though often unsettled by conflict. He disapproves of his son's arrogance despite acknowledging Katsuki's abilities.

Appearance: Middle-aged man of average height and build with short brown hair styled similarly to his wife and son. He wears rectangular glasses and sports a short mustache. He dresses in casual civilian attire typical of a working professional.

Backstory: Once dreamed of becoming a Pro Hero but pursued a career in fashion design instead. He met his wife Mitsuki aggressively at a workplace, and their relationship progressed to marriage. He fathered Katsuki and has spent years balancing his son's gifted but arrogant nature with parental guidance and support.

Additional Information: He and his wife entrust Katsuki's education and development to UA High School, believing the institution and its staff can properly guide their son. Masaru represents the stabilizing parental influence in Katsuki's life, contrasting with his wife's more volatile personality.

cardPool.title: Mitsuki Bakugo
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Mitsuki Bakugo

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Glycerin

Occupation/Role: Housewife; Mother of UA Class 1-A student Katsuki Bakugo

Personality: Assertive and aggressive like her son, yet capable of remarkable composure, politeness, and respect. Recognizes Katsuki's flaws stem from his innate talent and childhood adoration; disapproves of his arrogance and occasionally disciplines him physically. Supportive of his hero aspirations and respectful toward UA staff.

Appearance: Spiky ash-blonde hair and sharp red eyes, maintained in youthful condition by her Quirk despite being in her late thirties. Typically wears a white blouse under a lavender cardigan, black skirt, and reddish-purple house slippers. Her appearance suggests a refined, put-together woman who takes pride in her presentation.

Backstory: Mother to the talented but arrogant Katsuki Bakugo and wife to Masaru Bakugo. She has watched her son's exceptional abilities and Quirk power earn constant praise, which she recognizes has cultivated his worst traits. Now that Katsuki attends UA High School, she remains invested in his development as a hero while maintaining her household.

Additional Information: Not a UA student or Pro Hero, but integral to understanding Katsuki's character development. Her Glycerin Quirk allows her to maintain youthful skin quality through natural moisturizing secretion. She demonstrates that aggressive temperament can be tempered with maturity and discipline—a lesson her son has yet to fully learn.

cardPool.title: Bakugo House
cardPool.value:
Name: Bakugo House

Location: A prosperous residential district in an urban settlement, set back from the street behind a protective stone wall.

Inhabitants: The Bakugo family—a household of merchants or nobility who value learning and refinement. Servants or family members may be present, though the master of the house commands respect.

Appearance: A large, well-maintained detached mansion featuring sturdy construction and elegant design. The front is framed by a manicured garden and bordered by a defensive wall with an ornamental window. The interior spacious living room showcases floor-to-ceiling bookshelves laden with leather-bound volumes, fine furnishings, and polished wood, suggesting both wealth and intellectual pursuits. The home exudes quiet authority and scholarly ambition.

cardPool.title: Brightman Air Force Base
cardPool.value:
Name: Brightman Air Force Base

Location: Military installation serving as a primary deployment hub for advanced fighter aircraft operations and hero training facilities.

Inhabitants: Military personnel, pilot trainees, combat officers, and the hero Star and Stripe who uses the base as her operational headquarters.

Appearance: A sprawling airfield dominated by concrete runways and hangars housing sleek X-66 fighter jets. Steel-reinforced facilities include barracks, command centers, and training grounds. Chain-link fences and guard posts secure the perimeter; the sky frequently fills with the roar of jet engines and aircraft in formation.

cardPool.title: Wooden Swords From His Hands
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name: Wooden Swords From His Hands

Description: The user manifests solid wooden swords that materialize from their wrists on demand. The swords are fully formed, durable weapons suitable for combat and can be generated repeatedly without apparent limit to quantity per manifestation cycle.

Functions/Applications: Create wooden swords for melee combat, dual-wield multiple swords simultaneously, generate weapons quickly in surprise encounters, or equip allies with melee weapons. The wooden construction makes them safer for sparring or controlled combat situations.

Limits: Swords are wooden rather than metal, reducing cutting power and durability against hardened materials or reinforced defenses. Generation appears to require conscious effort from the wrists, potentially limiting use if those limbs are restrained or injured. The swords cannot be customized beyond basic form.

Additional Notes: This Quirk prioritizes rapid weapon deployment over raw destructive power, making it tactically flexible but dependent on wielder skill. Best suited for close-quarters fighters with strong swordsmanship training.

cardPool.title: Quirk Bestowal
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Quirk Bestowal

Description:
A transfer-based Quirk with no combat function of its own. The user can pass their Quirk to another person through DNA contact (hair, blood, or saliva). Transfer requires the user's willing consent, but the recipient need not agree. This Quirk is immune to theft and cannot be stolen by All For One.

Functions/Applications:
Grants the ability to voluntarily transfer the Quirk itself and any absorbed Quirks to a chosen successor through biological material. The transfer can be selective—passing only certain components while retaining others. Intent during transfer affects the outcome; hostile transfer can weaponize the process against the recipient.

Limits:
The Quirk has no offensive or defensive capabilities independent of transfer. It manifested late in life and remained undetectable for years due to extreme weakness. Cannot be forced upon an unwilling user, and transfer requires direct physical/biological contact. The recipient must be capable of handling transferred power or may suffer rejection.

Additional Notes:
Quirk Bestowal has a unique property of assimilating with other Quirks, growing stronger through combination rather than individual strength. The original user's will can persist within transferred Quirks as spiritual remnants. This Quirk cannot be sensed or stolen, making it the only ability truly immune to All For One's power.

cardPool.title: Quirk Singularity
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Quirk Singularity (Theoretical Concept)

Description:
A postulated phenomenon where Quirks grow exponentially stronger and more complex across generations through genetic blending and evolution. However, human bodies cannot evolve quickly enough to control these increasingly powerful abilities, eventually reaching a critical point where Quirks become uncontrollable and dangerously unstable.

Functions/Applications:
Users can recognize signs of Quirk evolution in themselves or others—enhanced power, mutation of existing abilities, or involuntary manifestations. Those aware of the theory may attempt to manage or suppress their evolving Quirk before it reaches critical instability, or weaponize the knowledge to justify liberation or control of society.

Limits:
This is not a combat Quirk but a framework for understanding ability growth. It cannot be actively used in battle. The theory remains controversial and unproven to most; only those with multiple powerful Quirks or rapidly mutating abilities directly experience its effects. Control becomes impossible once Quirk evolution surpasses the user's physical and mental capacity.

Additional Notes:
Characters with combat-oriented or absorptive Quirks are most vulnerable to Singularity effects. Quirk Awakening events may trigger sudden evolutionary leaps.

cardPool.title: Quirkless
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Quirkless

Description:
A complete absence of superhuman abilities, Quirk Factor, or any meta-powers whatsoever. Quirkless individuals are born without superpowers in a world where 80% of humans possess them, making them genetic outliers and social minorities.

Functions/Applications:
Immunity to Quirk-targeted attacks including Trigger Bombs, Erasure-type Quirks, Quirk-Destroying Drugs, and Quirk Factor manipulation. Unaffected by Quirk Singularity phenomena and life-draining effects from multi-Quirk hosts. Can pursue careers outside heroics without significant disadvantage. Legally cannot be classified as villains since villainy requires Quirk use.

Limits:
Vulnerable to all conventional physical threats, weapons, and non-Quirk-based dangers. Prohibited from most hero work due to inability to combat dangerous situations effectively. Subject to severe social discrimination and prejudice. Immunities are negated if a Quirk Factor is ever acquired. Cannot legally become a Pro Hero in most societies.

Additional Notes:
Increasingly rare trait with recessive genetic inheritance. Immunity to Quirk-based threats is paradoxically the only advantage against a Quirk-dependent population. Some Quirkless individuals (like Melissa Shield) maintain positive social relationships despite discrimination, while others (like Izuku Midoriya) face mockery and prejudice based on perceived weakness.

cardPool.title: Humarise
cardPool.value:
[Humarise]

Type: Extremist Cult Organization

Humarise was a global cult-like organization led by Flect Turn. Originating from the nation of Otheon, the group based its ideology on the Quirk Singularity Doomsday Theory — the belief that Quirks will continue evolving until they eventually become uncontrollable and bring about humanity’s destruction.

Although the theory was never fully proven, Humarise treated it as absolute truth. Its members came to view Quirks as a disease that threatened the survival of mankind.

Within the organization, people with Quirks were labeled as “infected” or “diseased,” while Quirkless individuals were regarded as “pure humans.” Believing themselves to be humanity’s saviors, Humarise dedicated itself to eradicating Quirks from society by any means necessary.

Operating across multiple countries with hidden cells and loyal followers, Humarise grew into a dangerous extremist movement feared for its fanaticism, secrecy, and willingness to commit mass destruction in pursuit of its ideology.

cardPool.title: Fa Jin
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Fa Jin

Description:
Fa Jin allows the user to accumulate kinetic energy through repetitive movements, manifesting as red glowing energy that builds internally. When released, this stored energy grants explosive bursts of speed and power that can be applied through any body part. The user can deploy partial amounts of stored energy for multiple sequential bursts rather than expending everything at once.

Functions/Applications:
Fa Jin amplifies physical strikes and movement speed dramatically upon release. It synergizes powerfully with other Quirks—enhancing Blackwhip to create restraining chains, boosting Float for increased flight speed and maneuverability, and combining with Gearshift for devastating acceleration. The stored kinetic energy stacks with other power sources, allowing composite attacks of exceptional force without proportional bodily strain.

Limits:
Building kinetic energy requires significant time and repetitive motion—premature release drastically reduces power output efficiency. The Quirk demands sustained setup phases during combat, making it vulnerable to interruption. Synergy with other Quirks increases complexity but remains dependent on the user's ability to manage multiple Quirk interactions simultaneously.

Additional Notes:
Fa Jin's power scales dramatically when combined with high-tier Quirks or energy reserves.

cardPool.title: Yu

Quirk Name: Unknown

Occupation/Role: Underground idol performer, student at East Naruhata High School

Personality: Kind and sensitive, contrasting sharply with her twin sister Miu. Yu agrees with Miu's gossip but with restraint, occasionally telling her sister to moderate her offensive remarks. She possesses genuine empathy and a gentle demeanor.

Appearance: Short stature with straight, shoulder-length light hair pulled into a high ponytail on her right side, with side-swept bangs covering her left eye. Dark, softly tilted eyes give her an innocent expression. Her idol costume mirrors Miu's design but inverted—the bodice is darker while the skirt is paler, with a large feather accent. She wears knee-length sleeveless dresses, tights, and long gloves. During performances with FeatherHATS, she adds a small top hat on her left with a feather detail.

Backstory: Yu performs as part of Feathers, an underground idol duo with her twin sister Miu. Together they were invited to perform at the Marukane Department Store Live Event. She later joins FeatherHATS alongside Pop☆Step, East Naruhata High Dance Squad, and the Mad Hatters, expanding her performance career while maintaining her school life.

Additional Information: Yu possesses exceptional singing talent, noted to surpass even Pop☆Step in vocal skill. Her kind nature makes her the emotional anchor to Miu's sharper personality, creating dynamic balance in their partnership.

cardPool.title: Lizard Tail Splitter
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Lizard Tail Splitter

Description:
The user can detach and telekinetically control multiple body segments simultaneously. Each piece floats independently and moves at high speed. Any severed segment containing a vital organ (eyes, brain, mouth, heart) remains fully functional while separated, allowing remote sensory input or organ operation.

Functions/Applications:
Multi-angle reconnaissance by floating eye segments. Distributed melee attacks using numerous small, fast-moving pieces. Long-range combat harassment through hard-to-hit projectiles. Organ-based spying (speaking through a detached jaw, seeing through isolated eyes). Evasion through body dispersal across an area.

Limits:
Separated segments have a time limit before ceasing function entirely. The user can divide their body into maximum 50 pieces depending on segment length. Once regeneration capacity is exhausted, all scattered pieces must physically regroup—exposing the user's location. Individual body parts are individually weak and vulnerable to destruction. Maintaining control over many pieces simultaneously requires focus.

Additional Notes:
The user's distributed state creates strategic vulnerability; enemies can track position by locating regrouping segments. Small piece size and speed make defense difficult but offensive power per segment remains limited. Optimal use combines reconnaissance with coordinated multi-directional attacks.

cardPool.title: Tail
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Tail

Description:
A prehensile appendage extending from the lower posterior, longer and wider than a human limb. The tail is topped with a tuft of blonde hair and functions as a third, fully capable limb with considerable strength and durability.

Functions/Applications:
The tail serves as a weapon for close-range melee attacks, strong enough to break metal objects and restrain enemies. It assists mobility by launching the user upward when slapped against the ground, enables climbing by wrapping around poles or pipes, and supports acrobatic martial arts maneuvers. Can point directionally or perform simple gestures.

Limits:
The tail is as vulnerable to damage as any body part and cannot fully replicate hand complexity for intricate tasks. Its permanent nature restricts comfortable sitting and lying down, requiring tailor-made clothing. Predictable movement patterns emerge in combat as the tail tends to drive fighting in recognizable ways. Strength and durability increase only through continuous, intensive training against resistant opponents.

Additional Notes:
Most effective when combined with martial arts training and close-quarters combat knowledge. Best used for supplementing mobility, evasion, and directional pressure rather than as a primary ranged weapon. The quirk is most limited by its user's creativity and physical conditioning.

Class 1-A. Demonstrates frog-like mannerisms including hopping on all fours. Her Quirk causes hibernation in cold temperatures, managed by her hero costume equipment.

cardPool.title: Search
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Search

Description:
A surveillance Quirk that allows the user to monitor up to one hundred individuals simultaneously by targeting their Quirk Factor and DNA. Observed targets appear as star-like vestiges and their locations can be tracked from miles away. The Quirk's eyes glow rainbow-colored during activation and permanently stores all gathered data for future reference.

Functions/Applications:
Locate multiple targets across vast distances; identify weak points and vulnerabilities of observed individuals; distinguish between multiple Quirk Factors within a single person; maintain a permanent database of scanned subjects for later analysis; coordinate long-distance tactical operations.

Limits:
Vulnerable to deception through misdirection—users can be fooled if they over-rely on the Quirk's data without verification. Cannot distinguish between actual targets and false readings if the target's biological material (such as blood) is present elsewhere. Requires initial contact or proximity to store data on a subject.

All For One

Description:
Allows the user to steal Quirks from others, permanently removing them from the original owner and adding them to the user's own stockpile. Stolen Quirks can be used, combined, or transferred to other people.

Functions/Applications:
Steal Quirks through direct physical contact. Store many Quirks at once. Use several abilities simultaneously or combine compatible Quirks into stronger composite effects. Transfer selected Quirks into other people. Build specialized sets for combat, mobility, defense, sensory use, or support.

Limits:
Stealing and transferring require physical contact and deliberate activation. Complex Quirks may be difficult to understand or master. Some abilities strain a body not naturally suited to them. Carrying and operating many Quirks increases neurological and physical burden. Certain Quirks may resist theft or behave unpredictably after being taken.

Additional Notes:
All For One becomes stronger through accumulation rather than a single fixed power. Its true danger lies in combining stolen Quirks to cover weaknesses, amplify strengths, and create highly specialized ability sets.

Quirk Name: Blood Control

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero and homeroom teacher of Class 1-B at UA High School

Personality: Gruff and strict, but genuinely caring toward his students and protective of their safety. He encourages them to excel and shows comical bias favoring Class 1-B over Class 1-A. Quick to react in danger and values his fellow teachers' well-being.

Appearance: An exceptionally tall, wide-set man with a bulky, muscular build and lightly tanned skin. He has short pale gray hair spiked upward with one small clump over his left forehead. Very small thin eyes, a wide mouth with two prominent lower canines visible when closed. Wears a dark red skin-tight hero costume with low U-shaped collar exposing his pectoral muscles, lined with thick black Y-shaped trim, white over-the-knee boots, red gloves, and an orange eye mask.

cardPool.title: Sickle Claw
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Sickle Claw
Quirk Name: Iron Claws
Occupation/Role: F-rank Villain
Personality: Confident despite low rank; straightforward and aggressive like typical minor villains.
Appearance: Short man with severely deformed face, bald elongated head, widely spaced stalk eyes, and prominent teeth. Solid iron hands with four large metallic claws. Wears dark blue sleeveless gi and matching loafers.
Backstory: Recruited by Tomura Shigaraki for the U.S.J. assault. Engaged injured Shota Aizawa during the invasion but was defeated and arrested when Pro Heroes arrived.
Additional Information: F-rank villain with minimal history. Despite his confidence, he was overpowered by a weakened Aizawa, indicating relatively weak combat ability.

cardPool.title: Toshie Yagi
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Toshie Yagi

Alias: None

Quirk Name: None

Occupation/Role: Homemaker, Mother

Personality: Kind and patient, deeply devoted to her son Toshinori. She supported his heroic dreams despite his lack of a Quirk by reading superhero stories with him. Gentle and nurturing.

Appearance: A tall woman with bright golden blonde hair in two distinctive tufts parted at the sides, worn long and held back with a scrunchie. Soft grey eyes and thin eyebrows give her a gentle appearance.

Backstory: Mother of Toshinori Yagi, later All Might. She raised her Quirkless son with love and encouragement, reading superhero books to fuel his dreams. She was killed during civil unrest caused by All For One's influence, a tragedy that shaped her son's resolve to become a hero and protect others.

Additional Information: Deceased before the series begins.

cardPool.title: One For All
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
One For All

Description:
A transferable stockpiling Quirk born from the merger of a power accumulation ability and a Quirk transference ability. It allows the user to accumulate and store immense physical power within their body, which compounds with each successive user's training and can be transferred to another person via blood contact.

Functions/Applications:
Grants superhuman strength, speed, and durability that multiplies across generations of users. The user inherits all accumulated power from previous hosts and can add their own strength to the reservoir. Power transfers when blood mingles with a new host's body, passing both the Quirk and all stockpiled strength forward.

Limits:
Possession dramatically shortens the user's lifespan due to the strain of maintaining two Quirks simultaneously.

cardPool.title: Gearshift
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Gearshift

Description:
Gearshift manipulates acceleration and speed, allowing the user to alter how quickly objects or beings move through space while ignoring normal inertia laws. After merging with One For All, it became a devastating power enveloping targets in blue energy aura.

Functions/Applications:
Can drastically accelerate the user's body or external targets to sonic-boom-inducing speeds with massive impact force. Effective when combined with other abilities—enhancing combat moves, boosting projectiles, or launching allies at extreme velocities. Works at cellular levels when fully evolved.

Limits:
Initial use limited to five minutes before severe incapacitation. Prolonged use causes oxygen deprivation. Repeated activation stacks exponential damage and pain—second use doubles the blowback, risking paralysis.

cardPool.title: New Order
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
New Order

Description:
A reality-warping Quirk allowing the user to impose rules onto targets by touching them and speaking their name. Rules can redefine properties of physical objects, living beings, the environment, or other Quirks. Conditional rules based on cause-and-effect are possible, fundamentally altering how reality functions.

Functions/Applications:
Grant temporary abilities, manipulate bodily functions, affect intangible things like air and energy, suppress other Quirks, create conditional effects. Rules persist even if the Quirk transfers.

Limits:
User can only maintain two active rules simultaneously. Rules require direct physical contact and verbal naming. Strong-willed beings can resist if the user misunderstands their identity. Rules cannot affect targets indirectly through clever wording.

cardPool.title: Wave Motion
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Wave Motion

Description:
Wave Motion converts the user's vitality into golden spiral energy discharged as powerful blast waves. The user adjusts intensity at will, releasing energy from palms or feet. It drains stamina but training builds vitality reserves and stamina resilience.

Functions/Applications:
Offensive blasts for large or slow enemies; mobility enhancement through levitation and repositioning; close-range combat amplification; support for rescue and object manipulation; defensive mid to long-range protection.

Limits:
Spiraling energy travels slower than direct projectiles. Overuse causes significant fatigue. User cannot sustain prolonged discharge without exhaustion. Energy output requires conscious control to avoid harming allies or civilians.

Additional Notes:
True strength lies in battlefield control and versatility rather than raw speed.

cardPool.title: Accelerator Rings
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Accelerator Rings

Description:
The user generates yellow rings of energy from their hands and feet that release directional force bursts before dissipating. Originally manifested in infancy but stolen before full development, the Quirk has grown in strength through exposure to other Quirks.

Functions/Applications:
Launch self across distances and achieve rapid aerial maneuverability through multiple ring activations. Deliver swift, crushing blows using velocity bursts. Can scale to building-size rings when combined with other Quirks for continental-range flight and massive force delivery.

Limits:
Variable delay between ring generation and force release creates timing vulnerability. Rings dissipate after activation, requiring continuous generation for sustained movement.

cardPool.title: 2D-ify
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
2D-ify

Description:
A transformation Quirk that converts three-dimensional beings and objects into two-dimensional paintings trapped within picture frames. The user channels this power through specially prepared frames, absorbing targets into flat, painted forms that retain consciousness and limited mobility.

Functions/Applications:
The user can immobilize enemies by framing them as paintings, removing them from active combat while keeping them alive. Trapped victims remain aware and can move within their painted form, but cannot escape the frame's boundaries. This allows for non-lethal containment or strategic removal of threats.

Limits:
The Quirk deactivates and releases trapped subjects if the user becomes immobilized or incapacitated. Victims cannot be held indefinitely.

cardPool.title: Acid
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Acid

Description:
The user secretes corrosive gray acid from their skin and naturally resists its effects. Skin pigmentation turns purple-pink during activation. The user can generate acid in high quantities from any body part and manipulate its solubility and viscosity.

Functions/Applications:
Create protective barriers by raising viscosity. Burn holes through walls and barriers. Melt handholds into surfaces. Generate slippery acid pools for mobility. At maximum output, release acid with devastating force. Lower solubility to reduce lethality against living targets.

Limits:
Prolonged use causes skin to lose natural acid resistance, risking severe corrosion and dehydration. User struggles with precision control around living beings. Accidental self-dissolution of clothing occurs without careful focus.

cardPool.title: Acid Sweat
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Acid Sweat

Description:
The user secretes acidic sweat from their palms with explosive properties. Unlike stronger variants, the acid cannot be forced—it emerges passively like normal perspiration, limiting control and output.

Functions/Applications:
Rubbing hands together generates controlled explosions for combat or obstacle destruction. The acidic sweat corrodes materials over time. Better for sustained pressure than burst damage.

Limits:
Explosions are weaker than forced-secretion variants and depend on natural sweat production. Cannot trigger explosions without hand friction. Power scales with physical exertion and stress. Extended use causes hand fatigue and skin irritation.

Additional Notes:
This quirk is a genetic foundation for more potent explosion-type quirks when combined with compatible partners. Passive sweat secretion makes it unsuitable for stealth.

cardPool.title: Alchemy
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Alchemy

Description:
Valdo transmutes non-living matter he touches into nearly any object or energy form. He can reshape objects continuously while maintaining contact, create functional constructs that obey commands, manipulate his appearance with durability-enhancing bodysuits, and generate kinetic shockwave attacks by converting materials into glowing energy.

Functions/Applications:
Create weapons, tools, and complex devices from simple materials. Fashion protective bodysuits that alter appearance and enhance durability. Generate ranged kinetic energy attacks. Construct golems and constructs for combat or labor. Modify terrain through pillars, pitfalls, and doors. Repair and modify creations while touching them.

Limits:
Cannot transmute living organisms or create actual life.

cardPool.title: Anivoice
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Anivoice

Description:
