A sound-based Quirk allowing the user to communicate with and command animals through speech. The user's head progressively hardens and develops horns, amplifying range and eventually enabling telepathic animal communication. Humans and artificial creatures are immune.

Functions/Applications:
Command animals for tactical purposes—insects for infiltration, birds for reconnaissance, predators for combat. Vocal training and equipment amplification enable control over large groups across extended distances. Telepathic horns allow silent communication when fully developed.

Limits:
Range depends on vocal strength and equipment; requires speech (silencing disables the Quirk). Loud sounds disrupt commands and scatter animals. Animals understand only basic intent—no complex dialogue. Humans and artificial creatures cannot be influenced.

cardPool.title: Anthropomorph
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Anthropomorph

Description:
A Meta Ability allowing the user to transform human-sized objects into perfect lookalike puppets of any person. Multiple puppets can be created simultaneously and remotely controlled via earpiece devices. The puppets are formed from a liquid substance exuded from the user's hand and can be customized with clothing and altered appearances.

Functions/Applications:
Create decoys and duplicates for infiltration or reconnaissance. Overwhelm opponents through numerical superiority. Exploit psychological vulnerabilities by replicating traumatic figures. Control puppets from a safe distance.

Limits:
Requires human-sized physical objects as templates. Remote control range limited by earpiece signal. Puppets possess no independent intelligence and follow direct orders only. Transformation process takes time, creating vulnerability during execution.

cardPool.title: Antigen Swap
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Antigen Swap

Description:
The user can alter their blood type at will, changing their biochemical composition instantaneously. This allows them to evade identification through blood evidence.

Functions/Applications:
Eliminates forensic tracking via blood samples. Bypasses blood-type-specific effects or abilities. Can counteract blood-based restraints or curses.

Limits:
Does not affect physical injuries or wound closure. Cannot be used while severely blood-depleted or unconscious. Switching requires concentration; rapid changes are exhausting. Does not fool abilities that detect Quirk usage itself.

Additional Notes:
Primarily defensive and evasive. Most effective for espionage and countering blood-manipulation Quirks. Requires knowledge of compatible blood types to avoid biological incompatibility.

cardPool.title: Arbor
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Arbor

Description:
A wood-generation Quirk allowing the user to sprout and manipulate wooden tendrils from any part of their body. Tendrils extend over long distances with precise control, enabling multi-tasking and complex maneuvers.

Functions/Applications:
Restraint and binding of enemies. Rescue operations by wrapping tendrils around casualties and carrying them to safety. Evasion and locomotion by grasping structures and swinging through urban environments. Tendrils can be manipulated independently across the body.

Limits:
Highly vulnerable to fire and explosion-based attacks due to wood's combustibility. Ineffective against flame-wielding opponents. Tendrils require physical anchor points for swinging. Sustained control of multiple tendrils simultaneously causes fatigue.

cardPool.title: Attraction of Small Objects
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name: Attraction of Small Objects

Description: A gravity-based telekinetic ability allowing the user to pull lightweight objects toward themselves through deliberate hand gestures. Objects are drawn gradually, requiring sustained concentration and repeated hand movements to guide items across distance.

Functions/Applications: Retrieving distant items without moving, gathering scattered objects, pulling lightweight tools during combat, manipulating objects in puzzle-solving without physical contact.

Limits: Only affects objects lighter than a book; heavier items fail. Requires multiple hand movements rather than instant activation. Works within moderate room-range. Cannot function on living creatures or organic matter.

Additional Notes: The power manipulates localized gravity fields rather than pure telekinesis.

cardPool.title: Barrier
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name: Barrier

Description: Hekiji Tengai generates telekinetic protective domes around himself and nearby allies. The barriers manifest as invisible but tangible force fields with exceptional durability, comparable to steel. He can adjust barrier size and deployment speed with practiced control.

Functions/Applications: Deploy personal defense barriers instantly; expand barriers to protect additional allies within range; scale barrier radius strategically; react to incoming threats with rapid activation; maintain continuous protection during combat.

Limits: Purely defensive—cannot damage enemies offensively. Hekiji must remain at the barrier's center, preventing remote protection. Overwhelming force can shatter barriers. Physical exhaustion or injury prevents summoning new barriers. Effectiveness diminishes against sustained, concentrated attacks.

cardPool.title: Bat
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Bat

Description:
Grants bat-like physical features including wings, fangs, pointed ears, and enhanced sensory organs. User gains superhuman speed and flight capabilities that scale with Trigger enhancement.

Functions/Applications:
High-speed running and aerial flight at varying velocities. Enhanced olfactory tracking over long distances. Powerful claws for grappling and carrying targets mid-flight. Physical strength increases with Trigger modification.

Limits:
Base flight capabilities are minimal without Trigger enhancement. Olfactory tracking requires a scent source and is disrupted by competing odors. Wing structure restricts fine manipulation. Sustained high-speed flight drains stamina.

cardPool.title: Beast
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Beast

Description:
Jurota transforms into a massive, feral creature with thick fur, enlarged fangs and claws. His body grows larger and more animalistic, granting immense physical prowess. He retains partial intelligence despite heightened aggression during transformation.

Functions/Applications:
Superhuman strength and speed for combat; enhanced sense of smell for tracking and scouting; ability to maul with claws and fangs; temporary reversion to human form for evasion; carry additional weight while transformed; resistance to electrical damage.

Limits:
Increased size makes evasion difficult; user becomes reckless and overeager when transformed; sense of smell can be masked by strong odors; vulnerable to melee combat if opponent exploits larger frame; euphoria clouds judgment.

Additional Notes:
Beast excels in sustained confrontations and direct assault.

cardPool.title: Big Monkey
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Big Monkey

Description:
A transformation Quirk allowing the user to assume the form of a giant ape, granting immense size, strength, and durability. Typically dormant and only activates under Trigger drug influence.

Functions/Applications:
The user gains massive physical strength for devastating attacks and overwhelming opponents through force. The enlarged form provides increased durability and intimidation, allowing physical domination through size alone.

Limits:
Transformation requires Trigger drug stimulation; cannot activate naturally. Duration and control are limited by Trigger's effects. The enlarged form reduces mobility and agility. Mental control is compromised under Trigger influence, affecting tactical decision-making.

Additional Notes:
Heavily dependent on external substances, leaving the user vulnerable without Trigger.

cardPool.title: Binging Ball
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Binging Ball

Description:
The user generates small floating spheres with mouths that emerge from their body. These orbs act as independent projectiles capable of consuming various materials through their mouths, from ice to solid matter.

Functions/Applications:
Spheres launch at high velocity as effective ranged attacks. They can ingest and break down materials, useful for destroying obstacles, neutralizing ice-based attacks, or clearing debris. Multiple spheres can be deployed simultaneously for multi-directional offense.

Limits:
Spheres have limited range and durability. Unclear if consumed materials are stored or expelled. Spheres cannot be controlled once launched, moving only in set trajectories. Close-range combat capability is minimal.

Additional Notes:
Best utilized for mid-range combat and environmental destruction.

cardPool.title: Black
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Black

Description:
The user can merge their entire body into any dark-colored object or shadow, becoming one with it. They move freely through darkness at high speeds and can control the merged object's movements, even if it's naturally mobile like an animal or living thing.

Functions/Applications:
Ambush attacks from within shadows or dark objects. Transport through darkness while carrying others. Possession and control of dark-colored creatures or appendages. Evasion by merging into nearby dark environments. Manipulation of mobile dark objects to create distractions or barriers.

Limits:
Exposure to bright light forces instant ejection from the dark object. Only works with naturally dark colors or shadows—bright objects are inaccessible. Cannot merge if physically forced into a dark object against will. Ineffective in well-lit areas with minimal shadows.

cardPool.title: Black Hole
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Black Hole

Description:
A destructive ability that creates small black holes from the user's fingers, pulling in and atomizing matter and certain energy forms. The user's hands bear dark markings from prolonged use.

Functions/Applications:
Generate suction fields to pull enemies and disable attacks. Disintegrate debris for disaster cleanup. Create inescapable gravitational zones. Neutralize energy-based attacks.

Limits:
User is not immune to their own black holes. Must deactivate before targets reach disintegration range, creating vulnerability. Unsuitable for close-quarters combat. Enemies with spatial manipulation Quirks can redirect the suction. Loss of fingers eliminates functionality. Brief exposure leaves victims critically injured rather than dead.

Additional Notes:
Originally developed for rescue and disaster relief, not combat.

cardPool.title: Blackwhip
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Blackwhip

Description:
The user generates controllable energy tendrils from any body part, appearing black with teal luminescent outlines. Power scales with emotional intensity, particularly anger and hatred. Originally top-grade, it gains exponential potential when integrated with One For All.

Functions/Applications:
Offensive restraint and enemy binding; mobility via grappling and swinging; object manipulation and transport; internal reinforcement as protective bracing; puppeteering one's own body when paralyzed; creating protective armor coating.

Limits:
Control tied to emotional stability—uncontrolled anger causes loss of precision and self-harm risk. High-power usage causes severe numbness and pain; full strength causes user submission. Extended high-percentage duration risks injury.

cardPool.title: Blast
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Blast

Description:
A ranged energy projection quirk allowing continuous bursts of powerful energy from the body. Can be channeled through hands and legs via specialized gear. Each blast carries significant stopping power against most threats.

Functions/Applications:
Rapid-fire energy projectiles for combat suppression and villain neutralization. Energy can be focused through costume augmentations to strike from multiple angles. Sustained barrages provide overwhelming offensive pressure and crowd control.

Limits:
The user is temporarily blinded by intense flashes from their own blasts, causing severe aiming inaccuracy and unpredictable trajectories. Extended use risks self-inflicted blindness. Protective eyewear negates this effect and restores accuracy but requires constant wearing during combat.

cardPool.title: Blood Control
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Blood Control

Description:
Manipulate your own blood after it leaves your body, controlling its flow and hardening it into solid constructs. You can withstand massive blood loss and reabsorb expelled blood through specialized equipment.

Functions/Applications:
Harden blood into restraints or barriers. Release blood rapidly through gloves for offensive pressure attacks. Reabsorb blood to recover resources mid-combat. Create whip-like blood streams for striking or grappling.

Limits:
Blood must leave your body before you can control it. Requires specialized gloves and tubing system. Excessive blood loss causes weakness despite enhanced tolerance. Blood hardens slowly and can be destroyed before solidifying.

Additional Notes:
This Quirk trades health for combat utility—strategic blood management is essential. Works best in prolonged fights where reabsorption is possible.

cardPool.title: Bloodcurdle
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Bloodcurdle

Description:
A parasitic quirk granting an extraordinarily long, textured tongue covered in papillae. By making contact between their tongue and a target's blood, the user can ingest it and trigger temporary paralysis lasting up to 8 minutes, with duration varying by blood type.

Functions/Applications:
The user collects blood samples from wounds or surfaces, then licks the blood to activate paralysis and leave enemies vulnerable. This works on any opponent regardless of strength, making it effective for ambushes or one-on-one combat where the user obtains the first blood sample.

Limits:
Paralysis duration is unpredictable since blood types cannot be identified beforehand; type O causes shortest paralysis while type B causes longest. Maximum paralysis caps at 8 minutes. Quirks that expel or alter blood can break the effect.

cardPool.title: Bloodlet
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Bloodlet

Description:
A dangerous Quirk allowing the user to expel and absorb their own blood at will. The user can withstand extreme blood loss that would kill a normal person, making them difficult to incapacitate through bleeding tactics.

Functions/Applications:
Expel blood as a weapon or distraction; absorb expelled blood to recover fluids and maintain combat capability; survive injuries that rely on blood loss as a killing mechanism.

Limits:
Cannot manipulate others' blood, only the user's own. Expelling all blood leaves the user vulnerable during reabsorption. Does not heal wounds, only prevents death from blood loss. Requires access to expelled blood for recovery.

Additional Notes:
Most effective when paired with other Quirks for strategic advantage. Witnessing blood expulsion can disorient opponents. Extended use risks organ damage despite survival.

cardPool.title: Blueflame
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Blueflame

Description:
A fire-generation Quirk allowing the user to create intensely hot blue flames anywhere on their body. The flames burn at temperatures exceeding 2,000°C and ignite with near-instantaneous speed. Power scales with emotional state—greater anger produces hotter, more uncontrollable flames.

Functions/Applications:
Instantly combust objects and living creatures on contact. Deploy flames across the entire body or concentrated areas for offensive combat. Blue flame brightness proves effective against shadow-based opponents. At extreme emotional distress, can manifest secondary ice-based abilities.

Limits:
The user's body cannot withstand generated heat despite inherited cold-resistant genetics. Prolonged use causes severe burns, skin deterioration, and numbness. Emotional instability causes uncontrollable ignition, potentially self-harming.

cardPool.title: Body Morph
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Body Morph

Description:
A transformation quirk granting two additional arms beyond the natural pair, with significantly enhanced physical strength. The extra limbs are fully functional and controllable.

Functions/Applications:
Perform multiple tasks simultaneously, lift heavier objects, wield additional weapons, and gain superior grappling advantage. Enhanced strength amplifies striking power across all limbs.

Limits:
Extra arms require conscious control and coordination. Fatigue affects all four limbs equally, demanding more stamina. Additional limbs are vulnerable targets. Heavy armor or tight spaces hinder movement.

Additional Notes:
Excels in versatility and raw power but trades finesse for brute force. Always active, making stealth difficult.

cardPool.title: Bombify
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Bombify

Description:
The user mutates body parts to grow bombs of various sizes from their surface. This artificial Quirk uses specialized Bomber cells embedded in the body for rapid explosive manifestation.

Functions/Applications:
Create bombs on fists, arms, and other body parts for ranged or melee explosive attacks. Bombs vary in size and yield. Synergizes with Self-Detonation and Regeneration to restore damaged limbs after detonation.

Limits:
Requires Bomber cells to function. Larger explosives require longer manifestation time. Each detonation leaves the user temporarily limbless unless Regeneration is active. Overuse risks cellular exhaustion. Cannot create explosives faster than mutation speed allows.

Additional Notes:
Most effective paired with Self-Detonation and Regeneration. Standalone use requires external detonation or careful timing.

cardPool.title: Boomerang
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Boomerang

Description:
A trajectory-manipulation Quirk allowing the user to control thrown objects with precision, causing them to home in on targets and change direction mid-flight. The user's hands and affected projectiles glow purple during activation.

Functions/Applications:
The user can throw any object and redirect it multiple times before impact. Objects curve around obstacles, strike from unexpected angles, and return to the user. Effective for ranged combat, trapping opponents, or retrieving distant items.

Limits:
Projectiles remain subject to physics and can be stopped by sufficiently hard impacts or viscous substances that disrupt their trajectory. The Quirk requires direct contact or proximity to throw objects and cannot function without physical projectiles. Distance and object weight may affect control precision.

cardPool.title: Brainwashing
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Brainwashing

Description:
A mental control ability activated when a target verbally responds to the user's speech. The victim enters a fog-like state where their body obeys commands while their mind remains trapped and aware. Their eyes turn milky white until ordered otherwise.

Functions/Applications:
The user can control one target at a time through direct concentration and simple verbal commands. Advanced training allows controlled victims to speak while emotionally blocked. Multiple people can be controlled sequentially but not simultaneously. Works only on living beings capable of speech.

Limits:
Requires verbal response to activate—silence breaks the Quirk entirely. Victims cannot perform complex mental tasks. Physical trauma or strong pain breaks control instantly.

cardPool.title: Brawn Boost
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Brawn Boost

Description:
A stolen Quirk that amplifies physical strength beyond normal limits. Multiple copies compound the effect, granting exponentially greater power with each additional instance.

Functions/Applications:
Enhances striking force, lifting capacity, and physical durability. Multiple copies stack effects, allowing users to overpower opponents through sheer strength. Useful for combat, restraining targets, and demolishing barriers.

Limits:
Single copy provides modest enhancement. Does not grant speed, energy defense, or tactical advantages. Requires direct physical contact or proximity for application.

Additional Notes:
Originally stolen from an unknown source. All For One's three copies make this Quirk substantially potent. Duplicate copies are valuable for strength-focused users.

cardPool.title: Bristle
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Bristle

Description:
A hardening-type Quirk that allows the user to drastically increase the density and rigidity of their hair, transforming it into steel-like strands. The hair becomes an offensive and defensive tool comparable to hardened metal.

Functions/Applications:
The user can deploy hardened hair as weapons for striking and piercing attacks, create a protective barrier by stiffening hair around the body, or manipulate hardened strands for entanglement and restraint.

Limits:
The Quirk only affects the user's own hair and cannot be extended indefinitely. Maintaining the hardening state requires active concentration and stamina. The user's head remains vulnerable if hair defense is bypassed, and baldness would severely limit effectiveness.

Additional Notes:
The Quirk's power scales with hair length and density.

cardPool.title: Brown Bear
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Brown Bear

Description:
A transformation quirk granting bear-like physiology including enhanced musculature, thick fur, and animalistic instincts while retaining human cognition and speech.

Functions/Applications:
Grants superhuman strength for melee combat and grappling, increased durability against heavy impacts, acute smell and hearing for tracking, and sharp claws for slashing or climbing. Effective for close-quarters fighting and survival.

Limits:
Permanent transformation limits social interaction. Acute senses overwhelm in chaotic environments. Heavy build reduces agility and speed. Claws prevent fine manipulation.

Additional Notes:
Excels in direct confrontation and wilderness settings but struggles with precision tasks and stealth. The user's bestial nature may influence combat behavior.

cardPool.title: Bruiser
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Bruiser

Description:
A power-enhancement quirk allowing the user to concentrate strength into a single limb for devastating strikes. Charging time directly correlates to attack power. Chemical enhancement via external stimulants supercharges the entire body instead.

Functions/Applications:
Focus energy into arms or legs for powerful attacks. Charge duration ranges from instant to devastating blows. Can be used defensively to block or brace impact. External chemical enhancement expands the quirk to full-body augmentation.

Limits:
Cannot split power between multiple limbs simultaneously. Charging leaves user vulnerable and telegraphs intentions. Excessive charging creates tactical windows for counterattack. Chemical enhancement causes dependency and serious side effects.

Additional Notes:
Strength lies in raw power output and tactical flexibility of limb selection.

cardPool.title: Bubble
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Bubble

Description:
The user creates bubbles of varying sizes filled with any aroma they have previously smelled. These aromatic bubbles can be deployed offensively or defensively, ranging from pleasant fragrances to putrid stinks. When panicked or nervous, involuntary bubbles form with foul odors that detonate spontaneously.

Functions/Applications:
Deploy sweet-smelling bubbles to mask scents or create diversions. Produce foul-smelling bubbles to disorient or sicken enemies. Use bubbles for non-lethal crowd control or olfactory camouflage in stealth scenarios.

Limits:
User must have previously experienced an aroma to replicate it. Bubbles are vulnerable to destruction mid-creation. Panic triggers involuntary, uncontrollable foul bubbles that explode unpredictably, affecting the user and allies.

cardPool.title: Bull Head
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Bull Head

Description:
A transformation quirk granting large, sharp bull horns protruding from the user's head. The horns are durable and suited for ramming and goring attacks.

Functions/Applications:
Powerful charging tackles using horns as battering rams, devastating momentum-based charges, and close-combat goring strikes. The horns provide armor-piercing capability and can break through barriers.

Limits:
Horns cannot be retracted, limiting stealth and social situations. Damage to horns causes direct pain. Charging requires a running start; stationary strikes deal reduced damage. Rotation and twisting movements are slow due to head weight.

Additional Notes:
Best for aggressive, direct combat. Effective against rigid defenses but poor against evasive opponents. User trades mobility and finesse for raw power and intimidation.

cardPool.title: Bullet Laser
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Bullet Laser

Description:
The user fires purple-colored laser beams from their fingertips with precision and destructive force. These lasers travel in straight trajectories or curve mid-flight through deliberate manipulation, making them difficult to evade.

Functions/Applications:
Direct offensive blasts that pierce flesh and demolish structures; explosive impact upon contact; curved trajectory firing for striking targets behind cover; suitable for both close and distance combat.

Limits:
Requires line of sight from fingertips; energy expenditure increases with distance and power; curved beams require concentration and are slower; no defensive capabilities; reduced effectiveness against resistances or reflective surfaces.

Additional Notes:
This Quirk was stolen rather than naturally inherited, suggesting potential instability in some users.

cardPool.title: Bullhorn
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Bullhorn

Description:
The user's voice becomes unnaturally loud and powerful, amplifying sound output far beyond normal human limits without strain.

Functions/Applications:
Project voice across vast distances with clarity; intimidate or disorient enemies through sheer volume; disrupt concentration; communicate across battlefields or large crowds instantly.

Limits:
No directional control—amplification affects all sound equally in all directions; cannot modulate frequency or create focused sonic attacks; prolonged use may cause throat damage; ineffective in soundproofed environments; relies on base voice quality.

Additional Notes:
Primarily utility-focused with limited offensive potential. Works best for crowd control, psychological pressure, or tactical communication rather than direct combat damage.

cardPool.title: Burst
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name: Burst

Description: A destructive self-detonation ability that allows the user to explode their entire body in a violent burst of intense light and force. The explosion is catastrophic and consumes the user entirely, making it a final resort technique.

Functions/Applications: Creates a powerful area-of-effect explosion dealing massive damage to nearby targets. Generates blinding light that disorients enemies. Can be used as a tactical distraction for allies or escape.

Limits: One-time use only—activation destroys the user's body completely. Cannot be reversed or controlled once initiated. Requires close proximity to targets for maximum effectiveness. User dies upon activation.

Additional Notes: This Quirk is viable as a last-stand desperation move. Most effective when coordinated with ally tactics to capitalize on the confusion and blinding light.

cardPool.title: Cemedine
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Cemedine

Description:
The user secretes a versatile adhesive liquid from cranial orifices that can be sprayed at targets. This glue can harden into a rigid binding substance or remain tacky, with the user controlling solidification rate.

Functions/Applications:
Restrain opponents by spraying glue around limbs or bodies; create sticky traps that slow movement; adjust drying speed for fast targets; seal objects or wounds temporarily.

Limits:
Glue requires direct contact; excessive spraying depletes supply; hardened glue breaks with sufficient strength; the adhesive cannot affect the user's own body; drying adjustment has minimum and maximum thresholds; ranged application is less precise than melee contact.

Additional Notes:
Most effective in close-to-mid range combat. Environmental heat may accelerate drying unpredictably.

cardPool.title: Cement
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Cement

Description:
A manipulation Quirk allowing the user to reshape and control existing cement and concrete through physical contact. Cannot create cement from nothing, only mold what exists. Faint green glow emanates from hands when active.

Functions/Applications:
Reshape concrete into weapons, barriers, and structures for offense and defense. Create elaborate constructions within minutes. Trap and contain enemies with concrete walls. Dual-purpose combat tool for attack and protection. Exceptional utility in urban construction and infrastructure work.

Limits:
Requires direct contact with existing cement or concrete to function. Severely diminished effectiveness in rural or natural environments lacking concrete infrastructure. Users with sufficient destructive power can break through constructs, though skilled users can overwhelm opponents with proper strategy.

cardPool.title: Centipede
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Centipede

Description:
Grants elongated, segmented limbs resembling a centipede's body. The user's arms, legs, and head can extend dramatically. These limbs remain concealed within clothing until deployed.

Functions/Applications:
Extended reach for grappling and restraint. Venomous pincers deliver paralyzing toxin. Multi-limb coordination enables entanglement tactics. Concealment provides tactical advantage.

Limits:
Limbs constrained by clothing capacity when retracted. Venom requires time and direct pincer contact. Extended limbs difficult to control with precision at maximum range. Head extension exposes the user's vulnerable center.

Additional Notes:
Highly effective against unarmored foes. High stealth potential, but deployment speed determines combat effectiveness. Favors grappling and control over direct striking.

cardPool.title: Chameleon
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Chameleon

Description:
The user gains chameleon physiology including adhesive skin for climbing, independently rotating eyes, an extendable tongue, and color-changing camouflage. This enables seamless blending with surroundings and hybrid creature capabilities.

Functions/Applications:
Scale vertical surfaces with sticky limbs. Monitor multiple directions using independent eye rotation. Extend a prehensile tongue for attacks or utility. Activate full-body camouflage for invisibility, enabling ambushes, reconnaissance, or evasion. Enhanced agility and climbing speed.

Limits:
Camouflage is imperfect and detectable upon close inspection. Adhesive grip weakens on smooth surfaces. Tongue has limited reach and strength. Independent eye rotation may cause disorientation in combat. Camouflage breaks when moving quickly or attacking.

cardPool.title: Charging Muscles
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Charging Muscles

Description:
A power-enhancement Quirk that allows the user to accumulate strength in their muscles before releasing it in a powerful strike. Longer charge periods create greater force.

Functions/Applications:
Channeling energy into muscles to amplify punch or kick damage. Charging can occur mid-combat or beforehand. Creates explosive melee attacks with significant destructive force and knockback.

Limits:
Charging requires time and cannot be instant. Premature release wastes buildup. Overcharging causes severe muscle soreness and temporary loss of function. Sustained charging drains stamina rapidly. Works only with physical strikes.

Additional Notes:
Best used as a finishing move or against defensive opponents. User must balance charging duration against overexertion risk. Most effective when opponent cannot interrupt charging.

cardPool.title: Chart
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Chart

Description:
Chart enables the user to manifest a holographic page displaying real-time tracking data on designated targets, updating continuously with vital information.

Functions/Applications:
Creates a tangible holographic interface showing target location, distance, and vital status. Grants tactical awareness and surveillance capabilities useful for pursuit and coordination. Determines if targets remain alive.

Limits:
Requires initial target designation before tracking begins. Distance limited by user's sensory range or concentration. Cannot track multiple targets simultaneously without separate pages. Holographic display is visible to nearby observers, potentially compromising secrecy.

Additional Notes:
Chart grants reconnaissance advantages but relies on preparation. Effective for strategic encounters rather than direct combat.

cardPool.title: Chest Hair
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Chest Hair

Description:
A Quirk that enhances the user's masculine physical traits, granting increased strength and durability. Evidence suggests the user may project destructive purple energy beams from their chest, though this could be a secondary manifestation or visual representation of amplified virility.

Functions/Applications:
Enhanced physical strength for combat; increased resilience and muscle density; possible energy projection as offensive capability; psychological intimidation through exaggerated masculine appearance.

Limits:
Energy projection appears inconsistent or situational. No apparent ranged combat versatility beyond chest-based attacks. Strength enhancement alone may not overcome trained combat technique.

Additional Notes:
Tenma Nakaoji is the known user.

cardPool.title: Chimera
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Chimera

Description:
The user manifests animal characteristics, maintaining a permanent blue werewolf form as their base state. They can temporarily shift to gain traits of birds, lizards, dragons, and other creatures, enlarging these features to monstrous proportions for enhanced combat capability.

Functions/Applications:
Grants strength and durability scaling with the adopted form. Dragon form enables fire breath and concentrated energy beams. Bird traits provide flight or enhanced mobility; lizard traits offer climbing and flexibility. Each form stacks animal advantages—claws, teeth, wings, scales—making the user a versatile transformer.

Limits:
Transformations consume stamina; multiple forms drain energy quickly. Larger transformations reduce speed despite increased power. Only one primary form at a time.

cardPool.title: Chronostasis
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Chronostasis

Description:
The user's hair transforms into arrow-shaped projectiles that extend in straight lines and cut targets. Hair is divided into two sections: the "Minute Hand" on the forehead and the "Hour Hand" at the nape, each representing different time units. Upon impact, struck targets experience slowdown effects whose duration depends on which hand struck them.

Functions/Applications:
Launch hair arrows as offensive cutting weapons with varying slowdown durations. The Minute Hand inflicts shorter slowdown periods, while the Hour Hand inflicts longer ones. Use slowdown effects to immobilize or hamper enemy movement during combat. Position strategically before attacking to maximize effectiveness.

Limits:
The user must remain completely stationary to extend and fire hair arrows; any movement cancels the ability.

cardPool.title: Clean Bubbler
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Clean Bubbler

Description:
Susugu Mitarai generates pressurized soapy water and large soap bubbles from his body. The bubbles possess surprising strength and buoyancy, capable of lifting multiple people while remaining controllable. The solution carries disinfectant properties useful for medical aid.

Functions/Applications:
Create powerful streams of soapy water for offense or propulsion. Generate large bubbles to lift, transport, or contain targets. Use bubbles to cleanse wounds and provide medical treatment. Combine streams and bubbles for crowd control or rescue operations.

Limits:
Requires an internal tank of soapy solution with finite capacity. Bubbles are fragile and burst from sharp objects or excessive force. The Quirk is non-lethal and struggles against determined resistance. Extended use depletes reserves, requiring time to replenish.

cardPool.title: Cleaning
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Cleaning

Description:
The user secretes a potent dish soap-like substance from their body that weakens or temporarily negates the Quirks of others through direct contact. It also removes biological evidence like blood and fingerprints from surfaces.

Functions/Applications:
Apply the secreted soap by rubbing it on an opponent's skin to suppress their Quirk. Use it to cleanse crime scenes and eliminate forensic evidence. The soap works best on exposed skin and active Quirk manifestations.

Limits:
Requires direct physical contact; cannot affect Quirks from a distance. Effectiveness diminishes as the substance dries or washes away. Works better against external Quirks than internal ones. Overuse causes skin drying and irritation. The soap only temporarily weakens Quirks, not permanently destroys them.

cardPool.title: Clones
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Clones

Description:
Ectoplasm expels glowing viscous fluid from his mouth that he shapes into exact duplicates of himself. He can create up to thirty clones (thirty-six when in a good mood), each sharing his consciousness and capable of speech. All clones can be willfully dispersed.

Functions/Applications:
Deploy clones for numerical advantage in combat or to patrol vast areas. Use clones for surveillance and reconnaissance, as the user perceives through all duplicates regardless of distance. Redirect clones to individual tasks for teaching, search operations, or crowd control. Create a single massive clone capable of trapping enemies within its body, though this prevents spawning additional clones.

Limits:
Each clone is fragile and destroyed by a single strong blow. Creating the giant clone eliminates the ability to generate smaller clones simultaneously.

cardPool.title: Cloud
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Cloud

Description:
The user generates solid, touchable clouds of varying sizes and densities that support weight and float freely through air. Clouds grant exceptional aerial mobility and allow item storage.

Functions/Applications:
Cloud enables rapid vertical and horizontal movement for swift escapes or reconnaissance. Clouds shield allies from debris through density manipulation. Users can create diversionary clouds, hide for ambush tactics, or generate obscuring billows to block vision and create combat advantages.

Limits:
The Quirk is vulnerable to gas-dispersing or elemental attacks. Movement speed depends on cloud size—larger clouds are slower but sturdier. The user cannot generate clouds faster than once per few seconds. Clouds dissipate if the user loses concentration or becomes incapacitated.

Additional Notes:
Cloud is primarily a mobility and evasion Quirk.

cardPool.title: Comic
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Comic

Description:
The user materializes spoken onomatopoeia into giant Japanese letters with real-world effects matching their sound. The user's head transforms into a comic speech bubble. Overuse causes throat soreness, limiting performance.

Functions/Applications:
Create protective barriers, offensive blasts, and utility effects by speaking sound words. Examples include "BOOM" for explosions, "CRASH" for impacts, and "SPLASH" for water effects. Manifested letters are durable and can withstand laser attacks. Versatility allows adaptation to multiple combat situations.

Limits:
Rapid successive use causes throat strain, preventing further activation. The user must speak clearly and intentionally—casual speech doesn't trigger the Quirk. Each onomatopoeia has fixed effects, limiting creative freedom. Physical durability decreases with distance or scale.

cardPool.title: Compress
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Compress

Description:
Compress allows the user to shrink anything within a spherical area into a weightless marble by touching it with their hand. Compressed objects retain their properties but become pocket-sized and portable. Release is triggered by snapping fingers, restoring marbles to full size instantly.

Functions/Applications:
Capture and transport enemies, allies, or environmental objects. Create traps by releasing marbles to restore obstacles in enemy paths. Compress body parts to inflict damage. Combine with environmental hazards by compressing targets alongside fire or debris. Use marbles as decoys or launch platforms.

Limits:
Activation requires hand contact; user's own arm cannot be compressed. After losing the left arm, Compress functions only through the right arm. Selective compression of body parts risks mutilation.

cardPool.title: Confession
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Confession

Description:
After posing a question, the user compels the target to answer with absolute truthfulness. The victim cannot lie, resist, or refuse to respond, revealing their deepest secrets, intentions, and emotions. Answers reflect what the target believes to be true, not necessarily objective reality.

Functions/Applications:
Extract intelligence from enemies and allies. Expose hidden loyalties, fears, and shameful truths. Prevent betrayal by interrogating suspects. Verify honesty of subordinates.

Limits:
Completely non-offensive; cannot damage or fight directly. Ineffective if either party cannot speak or communicate. Answers are literal—loopholes exist if the target's understanding differs from reality. Requires specific questions; vague inquiries yield vague answers. Does not compel physical action, only verbal response.

cardPool.title: Conjure
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name: Conjure

Description: A warping ability that instantly teleports small objects directly into the user's hand from their line of sight. The user focuses on a target and the object materializes in their grasp.

Functions/Applications: Retrieve weapons and tools instantly from distance. Disarm opponents by conjuring their held objects away. Gather resources quickly in exploration. Snatch items mid-air or from secured locations.

Limits: Only works on small objects. Requires clear line of sight. Cannot conjure abstract things or items from sealed containers. Range is moderate. User must have hand capacity to receive the item.

Additional Notes: Useful for theft, procurement, and combat advantage. Effectiveness depends on environmental awareness and quick thinking.

cardPool.title: Control Glass
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Control Glass

Description:
The user commands and reshapes glass matter within their vicinity, altering its physical state between solid and liquid forms at will.

Functions/Applications:
Create levitating glass platforms for flight and movement. Absorb glass from environmental sources to augment available mass. Form glass projectiles for ranged attacks. Liquefy glass to trap foes, then resolidify to immobilize them. Construct barriers and shields.

Limits:
Requires existing glass sources within the user's area—cannot generate glass from nothing. Effectiveness diminishes in environments with scarce glass. Liquefied glass remains difficult to control with precision. The user must maintain concentration to sustain floating platforms. Large-scale reshaping consumes significant stamina.

Additional Notes:
This Quirk excels in urban environments with abundant glass.

cardPool.title: Control Horn
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Control Horn

Description:
The user possesses specialized horns that project psychic dominion over bovine creatures. By maintaining both horns intact, the user can establish mental command over cattle, forcing them to obey through direct neural influence.

Functions/Applications:
Control herds of cattle simultaneously for stampedes or mass intimidation. Redirect cattle movements to block passages, create diversions, or threaten populated areas. Compel cattle to attack or defend on command.

Limits:
Only functions on bovine animals. Requires both horns undamaged; loss of even one horn disables the Quirk. Control range and herd size limited by user focus and mental stamina. Cannot control already-trained attack animals with strong independent will.

Additional Notes:
The user is entirely dependent on nearby cattle to utilize this Quirk offensively.

cardPool.title: Copy
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Copy

Description:
Copy allows the user to replicate any Quirk after brief physical contact with its user. The user gains instinctive knowledge of how to use the copied Quirk at a basic level and can store multiple copied Quirks simultaneously, switching between them as needed.

Functions/Applications:
Instantly acquire an opponent's Quirk for tactical advantage in combat. Adapt to any situation by switching between stored Quirks. Preserve lingering effects of used Quirks even after switching to another power. Stack up to four or more Quirks through training.

Limits:
Active duration is 10 minutes per copied Quirk before it expires. Only one Quirk can be activated at a time. Requires physical contact to function. Cannot replicate Quirks dependent on accumulated resources or stockpiled power.

cardPool.title: Cow
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Cow

Description:
The user transforms portions of their body to gain bovine characteristics including hooves, horns, and hardened hide. This grants enhanced speed and strength comparable to large cattle, making them a formidable physical force.

Functions/Applications:
Transform legs into powerful hooves for rapid movement and enhanced kicking force. Grow hardened horns for goring attacks and charging strikes. Thicken hide for improved damage resistance. Stack multiple bovine traits for cumulative benefits.

Limits:
Transformations are partial rather than complete. Slower than dedicated speed-type quirks. Increased body mass may limit agility and precision. Sustained transformation drains stamina.

Additional Notes:
Optimal in direct combat and charging scenarios but struggles with finesse-based encounters. Visually obvious, limiting stealth applications.

cardPool.title: Creation
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Creation

Description:
Momo transmutes her body's fat cells into physical matter, materializing objects from her skin with a distinctive blue-pink glow. She can create virtually any non-living object if she understands its atomic structure, from simple weapons to complex machinery, limited only by her knowledge and lipid reserves.

Functions/Applications:
Creates melee weapons and cannons for combat. Can produce objects larger than her body by expending fat reserves. Partial materialization allows dual-tasking. Creations can be shared with allies. Her mastery of matryoshka dolls enables near-instantaneous production and storage of other items within them.

Limits:
Requires substantial food intake to replenish lipids; overuse causes weakness and exhaustion. Complex or large creations demand extended preparation time. Cannot create living beings.

cardPool.title: Crystallize
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name: Crystallize

Description: Yu Hojo rapidly grows durable crystals across his body, coating his skin in protective crystalline armor. Crystals form near-instantaneously and can be shaped into bladed weapons to extend his combat reach.

Functions/Applications: Deploy crystalline armor for defense and durability. Form crystal blades along arms for extended melee range. Layer crystals across vulnerable areas for targeted protection. Use rapid crystallization to counter attacks or break restraints.

Limits: Crystals shatter with sufficient force. Hair inhibits crystallization, requiring the user to remain shaved for optimal growth. Crystals destroy clothing during formation. Generated crystals have no monetary or structural value and cannot be salvaged or repurposed.

Additional Notes: Best suited for close-range combat and defensive strategies.

cardPool.title: Curse
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Curse

Description:
The user's body transforms into sentient paper runes, granting extreme lightness and malleability for unconventional combat and rapid repositioning.

Functions/Applications:
Launch razor-sharp paper strands as projectiles. Create temporary paper clones to confuse opponents. Exploit reduced weight for enhanced mobility and evasion. Fold or compress to fit tight spaces.

Limits:
Vulnerable to fire and water. Clone creation requires sustained focus and dissipates quickly. Ineffective against heavy armor. Transformation is total—cannot selectively paper-coat body parts.

Additional Notes:
Paper runes maintain cohesion through unknown means. Damage causes visible tears but doesn't permanently sever limbs. Best for hit-and-run tactics. Clones are decoys only and cannot perform independent complex actions.

cardPool.title: Danger Sense
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Danger Sense

Description:
A sixth sense detecting potential threats through sharp, stabbing sensations visualized as lightning strikes. Reads intent and negative emotions from individuals and threats, enabling anticipation of danger.

Functions/Applications:
Warns of hostile intentions and evaluates threat levels by sensing malice. Enables rapid dodging and evasion. Detects multiple simultaneous threats passively. Effectiveness scales with training, reducing physical toll.

Limits:
Fails against those with no true malice, even if dangerous. Overwhelmed by intense emotions in crowds. Ineffective against sufficiently fast attacks. Misdirected by aware opponents using decoys. Weakened when multiple weak threats converge. Does not function against perceived non-threats.

Additional Notes:
Initial use caused severe physical strain, mitigated through training.

cardPool.title: Dark Ball
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Dark Ball

Description:
The user generates and launches spherical projectiles of concentrated dark energy, manifesting as black orbs with purple outlines. These balls emit volatile dark energy that can be released in rapid succession or coordinated barrages.

Functions/Applications:
Dark Ball excels at ranged offensive attacks and area denial. The projectiles can be fired in multiple directions simultaneously, making it effective for overwhelming opponents. Works well in combination with other abilities for compound attacks.

Limits:
Individual projectiles have limited tracking capability and can be dodged or blocked. The Quirk requires concentration to aim; rapid-fire usage becomes less accurate. Sustained barrages drain stamina quickly.

Additional Notes:
Dark Ball relies on overwhelming force rather than precision. It pairs well with close-range or tanking abilities.

cardPool.title: Darkness
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Darkness

Description:
The user manifests a dark purple liquid substance from their fingers and soles of their feet. This misty, sludge-like material spreads across terrain, causing anything it contacts to sink as if in quicksand. The quirk emerged spontaneously in youth with no known family relation.

Functions/Applications:
Creates sinking terrain zones to trap or slow enemies. Can be released from hands for targeted attacks or feet for mobile hazard zones while moving. When fully unleashed, blankets wide areas including entire rooms or outdoor spaces.

Limits:
Full capabilities unknown. Difficult to control—initial manifestations were involuntary and uncontrollable. No clear information on duration, range limits, or reabsorption. Cannot be shaped with precision; spreads naturally through environment.

cardPool.title: Day Dream
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Day Dream

Description:
By making direct eye contact, the user traps a target's consciousness in a personalized dream world reflecting their deepest fantasies and desires. The victim's eyes turn pure white while the user's glow red. The user can telepathically perceive the victim's dreams and innermost secrets.

Functions/Applications:
Control and incapacitation of single targets through psychological imprisonment. Espionage and information gathering. With Quirk amplification, affects multiple targets simultaneously. Useful for interrogation and sustained mind control without physical force.

Limits:
Requires direct line of sight to activate. Limited to one conscious target at a time. Effects break if the user sustains significant injury. Victims escape if made aware the illusion is fake. Multiple consciousnesses within one body counter the ability entirely.

cardPool.title: Decay
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Decay

Description:
A destructive Quirk that disintegrates anything touched by the user's hands, reducing targets to dust. Disintegration spreads rapidly across organic and inorganic matter. Originally a reverse-engineered copy of Overhaul, stripped of restoration properties.

Functions/Applications:
Touch-based destruction of matter and living tissue through fingers. Spreads through victims' bodies unless the affected limb is severed or interrupted before completion. Can destroy entire structures and multiple enemies simultaneously.

Limits:
Requires direct finger contact to activate—gloves or distance negates the effect. Cannot affect fluid or particle-based matter. High-power usage causes severe recoil damage to the user's body. Loses effectiveness if the user loses their hands.

cardPool.title: Delay Spot
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Delay Spot

Description:
Bruno Gollini creates a semi-spherical bubble trapping everything inside in severe slow motion. The user moves normally within it, unaffected, while targets become nearly helpless. Others move normally if physically touching the user.

Functions/Applications:
Incapacitate enemies and slow projectiles. Retrieve hostages safely at full speed. Isolate opponents in temporal stasis. Extended range covers entire mansion yards after enhancement.

Limits:
Objects faster than bullets partially bypass the effect. Range limited to semi-sphere coverage. Requires line of effect. Cannot protect user from extreme velocity attacks exceeding the slowdown threshold.

Additional Notes:
User becomes overconfident when Delay Spot dominates, underestimating opponents. Ineffective against high-speed Quirks or enhancements exceeding bullet velocity.

cardPool.title: Despot
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Despot

Description:
The user extrudes thin, nearly invisible threads from their body that can penetrate and puppeteer other humans. Victims remain conscious but cannot resist commands, functioning as extensions of the user's will. Several dozen individuals can be controlled simultaneously.

Functions/Applications:
Create an army of controlled soldiers while maintaining their skills. Send puppets into danger without personal risk. Gather intelligence through multiple perspectives. Overwhelm opponents through coordinated numbers.

Limits:
Control breaks if victims receive sudden strong physical shock. Control ceases if the user loses consciousness. Victims cannot be forced to harm themselves fatally. Thread range is limited to moderate distances. Cannot control those with defensive Quirks or exceptional willpower without difficulty.

cardPool.title: Dog
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Dog

Description:
A canine-based transformation quirk granting enhanced smell and hearing alongside physical dog characteristics. Manifestations vary—some users develop full dog features while others display partial transformations. All users gain acute sensory perception capable of tracking targets across vast distances.

Functions/Applications:
Users detect and identify individuals by scent from miles away, track prey through forests, and perceive threats via heightened hearing. Physical dog traits like claws, paws, and fur provide combat advantages and climbing ability. The quirk enhances overall physical attributes including strength and agility.

Limits:
Sensory abilities can be overwhelmed by strong odors or noise pollution. Physical transformations are permanent and unchangeable, affecting social interactions.

cardPool.title: Double
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Double

Description:
Double allows the user to create up to two identical copies of any person or object by touching them with a viscous dark fluid secreted from their hands. The duplicates possess the original's memories, personalities, and abilities.

Functions/Applications:
Create clones for combat, labor, or infiltration. Self-duplication enables rapid multiplication. Clones retain all original abilities and knowledge. Can replicate objects with precise structural knowledge. Detect clone destruction regardless of distance.

Limits:
User can maintain only two active copies at a time. Creation requires flawless mental image of target. Clones possess full autonomy and may refuse orders or turn hostile. Copies are less durable than originals, dissolving into viscous liquid after damage equivalent to a broken bone. Clones of damaged individuals inherit their injuries.

cardPool.title: Dragon
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Dragon

Description:
The user transforms into a massive dragon form with reptilian features including wings, scales, powerful jaws, and sharp claws. The transformation grants extraordinary physical prowess and durability far exceeding normal human limits.

Functions/Applications:
Flight via wings, devastating melee attacks with claws and fangs, enhanced grappling using multiple limbs, blocking heavy impact damage, overpowering opponents with raw strength.

Limits:
Transformation has energy costs and duration constraints. Weakened by Quirks targeting physical capability. Reduced effectiveness against opponents with strength or durability counters.

Additional Notes:
The dragon form retains the user's fighting technique and combat intelligence for tactical grappling and submissions.

cardPool.title: Dragon Breath
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Dragon Breath

Description:
A fire-expulsion quirk enabling the user to exhale intense flames from their mouth. The quirk requires alcohol consumption to activate and function, with power scaling tied to intoxication level.

Functions/Applications:
The user projects streams or bursts of fire for offensive attacks, capable of scorching enemies and terrain. Power scales with alcohol intake, enabling ranged combat superiority. Can also destroy terrain or create flame barriers.

Limits:
Completely dependent on prior alcohol consumption; no fire without it. Accuracy and control diminish at high intoxication levels. Prolonged use causes fatigue. Cannot function if sober or after alcohol is metabolized.

Additional Notes:
This quirk creates a high-risk playstyle rewarding careful resource management. Users must balance intoxication for combat effectiveness without losing control.

cardPool.title: Dust
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name: Dust

Description: The user's body generates fine, ash-like particles that can be expelled at will. Konako Haizono weaponizes this dust by hurling it at opponents' sensory organs to blind, choke, or disorient them.

Functions/Applications: Creates obscuring clouds for evasion or escape; targets eyes to blind enemies; targets nose and mouth to cause respiratory distress; serves as tactical distraction during battles.

Limits: Overuse causes severe skin desiccation. Dust effectiveness diminishes in wet environments or against sealed sensory protection. Requires close range for maximum impact.

Additional Notes: Effective as support ability rather than direct damage. Best used in short bursts with recovery periods. Works well with speed-based tactics to exploit blind spots created by dust clouds.

cardPool.title: Eagle
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name: Eagle

Description: The user transforms into an eagle-like humanoid with feathered wings, sharp talons, and enhanced predatory senses comparable to a natural eagle.

Functions/Applications: Functional wings enable flight and aerial reconnaissance. Enhanced vision allows spotting distant targets. Sharp talons serve as melee weapons. The user gains eagle-level strength and agility.

Limits: Full extent remains unknown. Extended flight is limited by fatigue. Transformation restricts fine manual dexterity and prevents use of most human tools while transformed.

Additional Notes: A straightforward animalistic transformation with combat and mobility applications. Mastery level and partial transformation capability remain unclear.

cardPool.title: Earphone Jack
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Earphone Jack

Description:
The user possesses elongated, cable-like earlobes that stretch up to 6 meters and terminate in jack-shaped plugs. These prehensile earlobes can pierce hard materials and detect sound within 12 meters through barriers. The user channels heartbeat vibrations through the jacks to damage objects internally.

Functions/Applications:
Reconnaissance via sound detection through walls. Offensive combat by weaponizing heartbeat vibrations as internal damage or directional sound blasts. Utility function as actual headphone cables. The earlobes serve as extra limbs for gripping and manipulating objects.

Limits:
Stretch range limited to 6 meters, sound detection to 12 meters. Overuse causes ear bleeding and fatigue. Loud sounds cause sensory overload and incapacitation. Multiple simultaneous noise sources mask target sounds.

cardPool.title: Earth Flow
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Earth Flow

Description:
The user manipulates soil and earth with precise control, molding it into any form. Grants destructive and constructive power for avalanches, terrain shifts, and detailed earthen structures.

Functions/Applications:
Create animated earth golems for combat. Reshape terrain for rescue operations. Construct custom training grounds. Trigger geological hazards through remote manipulation.

Limits:
Ineffective without accessible soil; useless on barren stone, metal, or water. Range limited to manipulable earth within sight or sensory range. Requires sustained concentration for complex constructs.

Additional Notes:
Mastery allows earth golems to pass as natural creatures. Suited for mountain and forest environments. High skill ceiling for expert practitioners.

cardPool.title: Eel
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Eel

Description:
A transformation Quirk allowing the user to shift into a medium-sized eel form. When enhanced by Trigger, the user becomes a massive eel-like creature with intensely slick, mucous-covered skin that deflects physical attacks.

Functions/Applications:
User can transform partially or fully into an eel for aquatic mobility and combat. The slimy coating acts as a defensive barrier, causing strikes and projectiles to slide away harmlessly. The viscous slime aids swimming and evasion in water.

Limits:
The protective slime can be neutralized by moisture-draining substances such as flour or sand, leaving the user vulnerable. Transformation requires concentration and energy. The Quirk provides no enhanced strength or offensive capabilities beyond the defensive coating.

Additional Notes:
This Quirk evolved into Electric Eel through external experimentation.

cardPool.title: Elasticity
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Elasticity

Description:
A touch-based Quirk that grants elasticity to any object or surface the user contacts, transforming them into bouncy, flexible materials. The user can make floors into trampolines, structures into slingshots, and create invisible elastic barriers in midair. Effects persist for a set duration and cannot be manually deactivated early.

Functions/Applications:
Create springy surfaces for mobility and bouncing movement; launch objects or self across distances; generate aerial platforms for navigation and defense; weaken enemy footing by elasticizing ground; apply elasticity to personal clothing for protection against grappling.

Limits:
Effects automatically wear off after a time period with no early deactivation option. Opponents who adapt to the elastic environment can turn it against the user.

cardPool.title: Electric Eel
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Electric Eel

Description:
A mutated evolution of the Eel Quirk granting an eel-like humanoid form with slimy, frictionless skin and electrical discharge abilities. The user retains a permanent eel appearance.

Functions/Applications:
Generate and discharge electricity at varying intensities for combat or environmental manipulation. Slimy skin provides enhanced mobility and reduced friction in water. Electricity can be concentrated into powerful shocks or dispersed broadly. The Quirk's genetic material can transfer to other users.

Limits:
Excessive electrical discharge causes unconsciousness, making sustained combat dangerous. The permanent eel transformation cannot be reversed and affects social interaction. Electricity is reduced against insulated or grounded opponents. Water amplifies electrical range but increases uncontrolled discharge risk.

cardPool.title: Electromagnetic Bullets
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Electromagnetic Bullets

Description:
The user projects an electromagnetic field around thrown objects, accelerating them to high velocities and increasing destructive impact. This turns ordinary projectiles into potent weapons.

Functions/Applications:
Launch projectiles with devastating force and precision; create rapid-fire barrages by throwing multiple objects; make even small objects dangerous; useful for ranged combat and area denial.

Limits:
Requires objects to throw—cannot generate projectiles from nothing; effectiveness depends on throwing accuracy and arm strength; consumes stamina with repeated use; moderate effective range; cannot enhance objects already in flight.

Additional Notes:
Best suited for users with good aim and environmental ammunition access. Tactical and straightforward, rewarding clever use of surroundings. Vulnerable at close range.

cardPool.title: Endurance
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Endurance

Description:
Converts motivation and morale into physical stamina and resilience. The user becomes a tireless, durable combatant whose strength scales with emotional investment in goals or loyalty. An "extraordinarily durable body" allows simultaneous use of multiple Quirks without strain.

Functions/Applications:
Enhanced stamina for prolonged combat. Increased durability when emotionally driven. Ability to wield multiple Quirks simultaneously without bodily degradation. Strength surges when motivated by loyalty or determination.

Limits:
Energy depletes under sustained attacks without morale reinforcement. User weakens significantly without clear objectives or commands from their loyalty figure. Requires direct orders to function at full capacity; standby mode renders the user sluggish and vulnerable. Loss of motivation causes rapid power decline.

cardPool.title: Enfeeble
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name: Enfeeble

Description: A paralytic Quirk activated through eye contact that locks the target's muscles, rendering them immobile for three seconds while maintaining consciousness. The user can affect multiple targets simultaneously if all maintain visual contact.

Functions/Applications: Disable opponents by freezing them mid-action, create openings for allies to attack, restrain multiple enemies at once, escape by immobilizing pursuers.

Limits: Requires direct eye contact with each target; breaks if line of sight is lost. Duration is fixed at three seconds. Targets remain conscious and can plan counterattacks. Cannot be used while eyes are obscured or closed.

Additional Notes: Effective in one-on-one confrontations but harder to maintain against multiple mobile targets. Works best as a setup for follow-up attacks.

cardPool.title: Engine
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Engine

Description:
Engine grants the user mechanical exhaust ports on their body that function like actual engines, enabling extraordinary speed and momentum. The user's limbs gain engine-like protrusions with mufflers requiring regular fuel intake. The Quirk strengthens when enduring intense strain, generating more powerful mufflers over time.

Functions/Applications:
Users can dash vast distances at superhuman speed and escape threats. Leg engines enable powerful kicks and switching between speed gears. Arm engines allow vertical propulsion and wall-climbing. Both can execute Recipro Burst for devastating speed surges. Mufflers regenerate after removal and improve through training.

Limits:
Requires specific fuel types; carbonated drinks cause stalling. Without refueling, the Quirk loses power and fails. Muffler removal is extremely painful.

cardPool.title: Erasure
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Erasure

Description:
The user can nullify any target's Quirk Factor by maintaining eye contact. The Quirk affects multiple targets simultaneously and remains active as long as the user's eyes stay open. When deactivated, the user's hair returns to normal, signaling a brief cooldown before reactivation.

Functions/Applications:
Disable an opponent's Quirk to force hand-to-hand combat on equal footing. Effective against Quirk-dependent fighters and Transformation-type abilities. Can be combined with binding weapons and enhanced agility for restraint. Creates minor anti-gravity around the user's head for equipment manipulation.

Limits:
Requires direct line of sight; obstacles or illusions block activation. Has no effect on Quirkless individuals or physical enhancements. Mutant-type appendages remain functional but impaired.

cardPool.title: Eruption
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Eruption

Description:
The user metabolizes body fat into superheated magma and projects it from their body. The right hand disperses wide-range magma bursts while the left hand focuses concentrated lava lasers.

Functions/Applications:
Ranged magma attacks with varying areas of effect, precise lava laser strikes for targeted damage, area denial through magma dispersal, and sustained offensive pressure.

Limits:
Requires sufficient body fat reserves; prolonged use causes rapid depletion and exhaustion. Magma projections are limited by user control and equipment. Range and intensity scale with remaining fat stores.

Additional Notes:
Effectiveness diminishes as body fat depletes, making endurance management critical. Specialized suit modifications optimize attack patterns. The Quirk excels in direct combat but becomes unreliable during extended engagements without recovery.

cardPool.title: Explosion
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Explosion

Description:
The user excretes nitroglycerin-like sweat from their palms and ignites it at will to create devastating explosions of varying sizes. The user is immune to their own blasts except for minor recoil damage. Power scales with sweat production, growing stronger during physical activity and in warm conditions.

Functions/Applications:
Create fiery shockwaves that burn and shatter targets; propel self through air for mobility; blind opponents with flash; launch long-range blasts; fire multiple condensed explosions simultaneously after Quirk Awakening. Counters darkness-based abilities.

Limits:
Cold weather slows detonation time. Dual-palm simultaneous use disperses overall strength into weaker blasts. Repeated large explosions cause arm and shoulder pain. Loss of palms renders Quirk unusable. Requires conscious ignition effort.

cardPool.title: Extend-o-Hair
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Extend-o-Hair

Description:
The user manipulates their hair's growth and movement with precision control. Their hair is indestructible and cannot be damaged or cut. The user can extend hair to form protective armor, grapple enemies, or create barriers of woven strands.

Functions/Applications:
Deploy hair as offensive whips or restraints. Form full-body armor for defense. Create nets or cages to trap groups. Establish barriers or shields. Use hair as mobility aids or sensory extensions.

Limits:
Hair becomes easily tangled, restricting movement and requiring time to untangle. Extended hair requires concentration; distraction weakens control. Tangled hair reduces combat effectiveness. Range diminishes beyond 30 feet.

Additional Notes:
User typically maintains an unusually hairy appearance.

cardPool.title: Extra Arms
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Extra Arms

Description:
A mutation-type Quirk that grants the user an additional set of functional arms, doubling their limb count to four total. All arms possess equal strength and dexterity.

Functions/Applications:
The user can perform multiple actions simultaneously—wielding dual weapons, grappling while striking, or manipulating objects independently. Provides enhanced climbing, melee combat versatility, and complex physical tasks requiring more than two limbs.

Limits:
The extra arms do not grant superhuman strength. Coordination requires conscious effort initially, and simultaneous actions may diminish reflexes. Armor and clothing must be specially fitted.

Additional Notes:
This Quirk excels in close-quarters combat and grappling but offers no ranged advantage. Martial training maximizes the benefits of four-limb operation.

cardPool.title: Fan
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Fan

Description:
A wind-generation quirk activated by rapidly spinning the user's wrists. Wind scales from gentle breezes to destructive cyclones depending on rotation speed.

Functions/Applications:
Create directional wind attacks to knock back opponents. Generate tornadoes for area damage. Deflect projectiles, create barriers, or assist with mobility.

Limits:
Maximum one minute continuous use before risking tendon inflammation. Overuse causes severe wrist pain and joint damage. Immobilized wrists nullify the quirk.

Additional Notes:
Effective at range and against multiple opponents but requires strategic timing. Users must manage fatigue carefully to avoid permanent loss of combat effectiveness.

cardPool.title: Fat Absorption
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Fat Absorption

Description:
The user can adhere objects and living beings to their body upon contact, causing them to sink into accumulated body fat. This grants exceptional protection against blades, bullets, and conventional attacks. Maintaining this Quirk requires constant high body mass through regular food consumption.

Functions/Applications:
Absorbs impact force from enemy attacks and releases it in a devastating counterattack punch. Restrains opponents by enveloping them. Acts as a mobile shield, protecting allies from incoming damage.

Limits:
Requires substantial body fat to function; slim build renders it ineffective. Counterattack burns significant fat reserves, leaving the user vulnerable if it fails. Recovery takes three days. Quirks that consume flesh or fat rapidly deplete the user's mass and disable the ability mid-combat.

cardPool.title: Fierce Gains
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Fierce Gains

Description:
The user's muscles harden to exceptional toughness on command, creating an almost impenetrable defensive state. Muscular tissue becomes dense and rock-like, dramatically increasing physical durability against piercing and slashing attacks.

Functions/Applications:
Hardens muscles to deflect or absorb damage from weapons and impacts. Can be layered with other defensive abilities for exponential protection. Allows the user to withstand attacks that would normally pierce or cut through flesh.

Limits:
Requires conscious activation and cannot protect against blunt force trauma equally well. Hardened muscles still conduct kinetic energy, so crushing impacts transfer damage internally. Cannot be maintained indefinitely without exhaustion. Works only on the user's own musculature.

Additional Notes:
Most effective when combined with high pain tolerance.

cardPool.title: Fierce Wings
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Fierce Wings

Description:
A pair of large, crimson wings with dozens of individually controllable feathers. The user can detach feathers and maintain telepathic connection with each one. Feathers vary in size, strength, and sharpness, functioning as tools and weapons. The wings grant superhuman flight speed and enhanced sensory perception through vibration detection.

Functions/Applications:
Flight at superhuman velocities and precision aerial combat. Detached feathers can carry objects or people, act as cutting weapons, or serve as remote sensors. Feathers can be reattached if intact and regenerate within two days if destroyed. Wings can enhance allies' mobility and combat effectiveness.

Limits:
Fire severely damages feathers, crippling flight capability. Excessive feather detachment worsens flying ability and maneuverability.

cardPool.title: Fire Cracker
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Fire Cracker

Description:
The user can detach chunks of their hair and detonate them as explosive projectiles. These blasts are destructive enough to demolish structures, though weaker than similar explosion-based quirks. The user can harness explosions for limited propulsion and mobility.

Functions/Applications:
Hair chunks serve as ranged explosive weapons for combat and environmental destruction. Detonations can boost movement speed and distance for rapid repositioning or escape. Effective for area denial and creating chaos in confined spaces.

Limits:
Explosions are weaker than comparable quirks, limiting raw destructive power. Hair regeneration is necessary for sustained use, suggesting finite ammunition per encounter. Propulsion capability is inferior to specialized movement quirks. Close-range detonation poses risk to user if not carefully timed.

cardPool.title: Flash Bang Sweat
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Flash Bang Sweat

Description:
The user secretes a volatile substance through their sweat that detonates with brilliant light and sound upon impact. The substance can be collected and weaponized through specialized equipment.

Functions/Applications:
Launch explosive sweat projectiles via costume-mounted systems for area denial and crowd control. Create blinding flashes and deafening bursts to disorient enemies or signal allies. Deploy wide-pattern salvos to cover large areas.

Limits:
The Quirk produces no direct physical harm—only sensory disruption through light and sound. Effectiveness reduced against enemies with sound or light resistance. Requires specialized gear to deploy; the user cannot weaponize sweat without equipment. Continuous sweating may cause dehydration or exhaustion.

cardPool.title: Flight
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Flight

Description:
The user levitates and flies at high speeds while projecting an aerodynamic barrier around themselves and anything they touch. This barrier protects from heat, cold, and physical harm. The user can selectively control which targets receive protection and coverage amount.

Functions/Applications:
The user can carry massive objects or multiple people while flying, gaining superhuman strength proportional to barrier focus. Full focus on self grants maximum protection and strength, while dispersing across allies weakens personal defenses. Ideal for rescue operations, transport missions, and aerial combat.

Limits:
Protecting others reduces the user's barrier strength and durability. Spreading protection too thin leaves the user vulnerable. Flight speed and carrying capacity depend on barrier concentration.

cardPool.title: Float
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Float

Description:
Float grants the user the ability to levitate and suspend themselves in mid-air indefinitely. When amplified by stored energy, it transforms into high-speed flight, enabling aerial combat and rapid transportation.

Functions/Applications:
