The user can hover stationary or move through the air at controlled speeds. Enhanced versions enable sustained flight at considerable velocity for pursuing airborne opponents and evading ground threats. Can be combined with other movement abilities for greater speeds or aerial maneuvers.

Limits:
Requires active concentration to maintain levitation; user cannot fly faster than their physical conditioning allows without external enhancement. Cannot lift others without additional Quirks. Provides no defensive properties, leaving the user vulnerable while airborne. Sustained high-speed flight drains stamina.

cardPool.title: Fly Swatter
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Fly Swatter

Description:
The user generates kinetic energy waves by rapidly swinging their arms, projecting force at distant targets. The waves travel several meters with power equivalent to a standard melee strike.

Functions/Applications:
Rapid arm swings create multiple projectile waves in succession. Useful for striking distant enemies, hitting multiple targets, or creating distance from threats.

Limits:
Waves dissipate after a few meters. Force output matches normal physical strength. Requires visible arm movement—useless while restrained. Repeated swings cause fatigue.

Additional Notes:
A straightforward, everyday quirk with untested range potential. Works best in open spaces with unrestricted arm movement.

cardPool.title: Flying Squirrel
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Flying Squirrel

Description:
The user develops wing-like membranes between their arms and body, enabling gliding and aerial maneuverability. These membranes grant exceptional mobility for combat and reconnaissance.

Functions/Applications:
Gliding for transportation and tactical repositioning. Can carry one additional person during flight. Useful for infiltration, reconnaissance, and aerial support.

Limits:
Cannot achieve true powered flight—only gliding and short bursts of altitude gain. Weight capacity limited to one passenger plus user. Requires open space; cramped environments restrict mobility. Sustained flight causes fatigue.

Additional Notes:
Best utilized as support ability rather than direct combat. Effective for hit-and-run tactics and quick escapes.

cardPool.title: Foldabody
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Foldabody

Description:
Foldabody grants the ability to manipulate body thickness and stretch limbs into paper-thin forms. The user can flatten, fold, and reshape their entire body or individual sections at will, transforming into blades, drills, or threads while maintaining consciousness and control.

Functions/Applications:
The user can slip through narrow spaces, transform body parts into piercing weapons striking faster than sound, and incapacitate enemies by cutting blood flow to vital areas. Mid-air combat is possible by twisting into drill-like shapes. The Quirk allows slow body regeneration.

Limits:
Extreme thinning shortens lifespan and causes physical deterioration. The ultimate technique of thread-size transformation causes severe weakness, unconsciousness, and requires extended recovery. Overuse results in critical condition.

cardPool.title: Food
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Food

Description:
The user can bite, chew, and digest virtually any physical material from metal to stone to wood. Their jaw possesses supernatural strength and their digestive system processes consumed matter without filling them, creating a bottomless appetite.

Functions/Applications:
Consume and destroy barriers, walls, or obstacles. Break through locked doors or restraints. Neutralize thrown projectiles by eating them. Consume enemy equipment or weapons to disarm opponents.

Limits:
The user must be within biting range to activate the Quirk, making them vulnerable to ranged attackers. Toxic or poisonous substances still cause illness. The user cannot digest intangible things, magical constructs, or purely magical attacks. Extremely hard materials require extended time to chew through.

cardPool.title: Forced Quirk Activation
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Forced Quirk Activation

Description:
A control-based quirk that forcibly triggers another person's quirk against their will, bypassing mental resistance or physical incapacity. Works regardless of the target's consciousness or consent.

Functions/Applications:
Activate allied quirks remotely; trigger enemy quirks to exhaust them; self-activate additional quirks while paralyzed; combine with contact abilities for precision targeting.

Limits:
Requires knowledge of target's quirk; most effective with direct contact; cannot create or modify quirks, only force activation; drains stamina per use; useless on those without quirks; does not guarantee the activated quirk will function as intended.

Additional Notes:
Best for quirk collectors or multi-quirk users. Works equally on willing allies and unwilling enemies. Particularly dangerous combined with contact or control abilities.

cardPool.title: Foresight
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Foresight

Description:
A prediction Quirk that grants the user the ability to accurately perceive a target's future actions and movements for up to one hour after activation. The user witnesses events from a third-person perspective, including the target and their immediate surroundings. Activation requires physical touch followed by eye contact.

Functions/Applications:
Combat evasion becomes near-perfect when eye contact is maintained. Investigative work benefits greatly, as witnessing future actions reveals information about plans, locations, and associates. The Quirk can perceive events years into the future, though dating distant events requires rough estimation.

Limits:
A 24-hour cooldown period must pass before reactivating on any target. Breaking eye contact immediately halts prediction.

cardPool.title: Free Walker
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Free Walker

Description:
A mobility-based Quirk granting the user's legs exceptional freedom of movement and resistance to fatigue. Enables legs to move with unprecedented speed, agility, and endurance without typical muscular exhaustion.

Functions/Applications:
Enhanced sprinting and sustained running, rapid directional changes without momentum loss, extended physical activity without leg fatigue, superior footwork in combat or traversal.

Limits:
Unknown upper speed threshold; fatigue may affect other body parts; prolonged use duration unclear; does not grant strength enhancement or jumping ability beyond normal limits; affects only the legs.

Additional Notes:
Free Walker mechanics remain largely undocumented. Primarily a movement and endurance ability rather than offensive or defensive. Best suited for pursuits, escapes, and sustained physical exertion.

cardPool.title: Frog
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Frog

Description:
Tsuyu possesses frog-like anatomy with enhanced leg strength, wall-clinging grip, and an extensible tongue. She can camouflage, swim rapidly, secrete paralytic or scent-hiding mucus, and regurgitate with precision. Her cold-blooded body grants exceptional agility in aquatic environments and terrestrial acrobatics through hopping and climbing.

Functions/Applications:
Tsuyu excels in water-based combat and rescue operations. Her extendable tongue serves as a grappling tool, whip, or rescue line. She can hop to extreme heights, cling to vertical surfaces, camouflage for stealth, and deploy paralytic secretions defensively. Mucus masks her scent, aiding evasion and reconnaissance.

Limits:
Cold exposure weakens her Quirk and induces lethargy; prolonged cold triggers hibernation, rendering her immobilized until warmed.

cardPool.title: Frost
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Frost

Description:
The user generates and manipulates ice, coating their body in frozen armor and projecting ice blasts outward. This Quirk provides natural resistance to cold and freezing temperatures, making the user difficult to harm with ice-based attacks.

Functions/Applications:
Create protective ice armor; launch ice projectiles or waves; lower ambient temperature in a localized area; shield allies from heat or fire; sustain defensive positions through ice barriers.

Limits:
Prolonged use causes frostbite and hypothermia. Extended combat drains stamina quickly. Users with insufficient fire resistance risk severe burns when defending against extreme heat like Hellflame.

Additional Notes:
Most effective in defensive or support roles. Works best combined with other Quirks or used cooperatively with allies.

cardPool.title: Gale Gale
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Gale Gale

Description:
The user manipulates wind currents around their body, creating powerful vortexes that enable flight and act as a protective barrier. The winds deflect incoming attacks and projectiles with ease.

Functions/Applications:
Flight through wind manipulation, deflection of physical and ranged attacks, creating offensive wind blasts, enhanced mobility in combat. The user maintains a defensive wind shell while moving through the air.

Limits:
The user's head remains completely exposed, creating a critical vulnerability. The Quirk requires constant concentration; disruption weakens the wind shield. Maintaining it consumes stamina proportional to flight duration and deflection intensity.

Additional Notes:
The Gale Gale Quirk is deceptively powerful despite appearing non-threatening.

cardPool.title: Gas
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Gas

Description:
The user generates a massive, swirling cloud of purple, sleep-inducing poison gas from their body. Anyone inhaling it falls unconscious immediately until treated. The gas forms a typhoon centered on the user, weakening at the edges. The user can sense creatures within the gas through its fluctuations.

Functions/Applications:
Crowd control and area denial for trapping enemies and blocking escape routes. Detection of movement allows tracking targets without direct sight. Best used as support during ambushes rather than direct combat, keeping distance from threats.

Limits:
Gas masks or breathing apparatus grant immunity. The gas cannot be manipulated for precision attacks. Wind or physical force disperses it easily. The user is not immune and will fall unconscious if exposed, requiring a gas mask.

cardPool.title: Gatling
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Gatling

Description:
The user's arms transform into gun-like biological organs that launch rapid-fire, claw-like projectiles composed of keratin. These function as a natural ranged weapon system integrated into the body.

Functions/Applications:
Fire keratin claws in rapid bursts for suppressive fire and area control. Effective in close-quarters combat for forcing opponents back or creating distance. High volume of fire can penetrate soft targets and deter multiple enemies.

Limits:
Keratin projectiles have limited range and stopping power compared to firearms. Sustained firing depletes keratin reserves, requiring recovery time. The organs cannot be concealed and immediately reveal combat capabilities.

Additional Notes:
Best used as a defensive tool paired with hand-to-hand combat to maintain pressure. Keratin regeneration rate determines sustained firing duration.

cardPool.title: Gecko
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Gecko

Description:
Grants reptilian appearance and ability to cling to walls and sheer surfaces with exceptional adhesive power, including fast-moving vehicles.

Functions/Applications:
Scaling vertical surfaces in urban environments, evading pursuers through vertical movement, reconnaissance from elevated positions, clinging to moving targets.

Limits:
Severely limited outside urban areas with few suitable surfaces. Ineffective on rough terrain, natural rock, or open areas. Adhesion requires intact surfaces.

Additional Notes:
Best used as mobility and evasion tool in cities rather than direct combat. Limited effectiveness outside urban environments.

cardPool.title: Gigantification
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Gigantification

Description:
The user drastically increases their body size to colossal proportions, gaining immense mass and strength. Some users grow to fixed maximum heights while others adjust size fluidly. The transformation grants devastating physical power but demands substantial space to function effectively.

Functions/Applications:
Enables overpowering larger opponents through size-matched combat, destroying structures and obstacles with ease, intimidating enemies through sheer presence, and serving as mobile transportation. Some variants allow blob-like transformation with stretching capabilities or creation of smaller clones for tactical advantage.

Limits:
Most users cannot assume intermediate sizes between normal and maximum form. The Quirk demands open spaces—enclosed areas severely hamper mobility and combat effectiveness.

cardPool.title: Glamour
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Glamour

Description:
The user emits a mist-like substance from their mouth that materializes into vivid visual and auditory illusions. These illusions can fill entire rooms and are designed to deceive, distract, or misdirect opponents and allies alike.

Functions/Applications:
Create convincing illusions of people, monsters, or environments to confuse enemies in combat. Use illusions as decoys to protect allies from incoming attacks. Craft illusions based on real individuals by studying their appearance and personality traits. Illusions range from charming to horrifying depending on intent.

Limits:
Illusions are temporary and eventually dissipate; duration is unreliable. Illusions cannot cause physical damage. The user must expel mist from their mouth, creating a visible casting action. Large-scale illusions require more effort and cannot be maintained indefinitely.

cardPool.title: Glide and Slide
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Glide and Slide

Description:
A movement-based Quirk allowing users to glide across surfaces like roller skates. Skating gestures build momentum for enhanced speed beyond normal human capability. Only one foot needs ground contact to maintain the effect.

Functions/Applications:
Enables rapid pursuit and evasion across flat or sloped terrain. Users accelerate through momentum-building gestures with minimal exertion. Effective for quick ground coverage during combat or escape scenarios.

Limits:
Slower than comparable Quirks like Slide and Glide. Requires at least one foot on a surface—cannot function mid-air or on unstable terrain. Momentum needs active maintenance through skating gestures; sudden stops are difficult.

Additional Notes:
Favors hit-and-run tactics and mobility strategies over direct combat. Multiple users can coordinate for group pursuits.

cardPool.title: Glycerin
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name: Glycerin

Description: A secretion-type Quirk that allows the user to produce smooth, oily liquid from their skin. The glycerin maintains youthful appearance and skin health regardless of age. When genetically combined with an Explosion-type Quirk, it produces offspring with volatile sweat-based abilities.

Functions/Applications: Create slippery surfaces for evasion or mobility; maintain physical conditioning and appearance; use secretions for lubrication; enhance durability through skin conditioning.

Limits: Primarily cosmetic and defensive rather than offensive. Glycerin production is limited to natural skin secretion rates and cannot be weaponized. Effectiveness diminishes in dry environments. Overuse causes skin dehydration and fatigue.

Additional Notes: Demonstrates genetic combination potential with explosive abilities.

cardPool.title: Good Ear
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name: Good Ear

Description: A sensory enhancement Quirk granting the user perception of ultrasonic frequencies beyond normal human hearing range, detecting vibrations and high-frequency sounds for information gathering.

Functions/Applications: Long-distance communication with compatible allies through high-frequency signals, crowd assessment via acoustic signatures, area surveillance through sound analysis, and echolocation-like environmental mapping through frequency feedback.

Limits: Functions only with sound-based information; useless in silence or against sound-dampening effects. Long-distance communication requires recipients capable of compatible frequencies. Standard human speech requires concentration. Overexposure to high frequencies causes disorientation or discomfort.

Additional Notes: Best utilized in team settings with coordinated partners.

cardPool.title: Grasshopper
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Grasshopper

Description:
A transformation Quirk allowing the user to morph into a large humanoid grasshopper form, enhancing physical prowess. The Hotta Brothers typically activate this through Trigger injections, though baseline capabilities remain unexplored.

Functions/Applications:
Grants increases to strength, agility, and jumping height in grasshopper form. Users can perform synchronized combo attacks when coordinated. Primary application is close-quarters combat with enhanced mobility and striking force.

Limits:
True limitations unknown due to Trigger reliance. Independent functionality without external stimulants has never been tested. Transformation requires preparation or chemical activation rather than instantaneous deployment.

Additional Notes:
Most effective with coordinated users.

cardPool.title: Gyrate
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Gyrate

Description:
Sen Kaibara's Quirk allows him to rotate any part of his body at extreme speeds, transforming his limbs into spinning drill-like weapons. Combined with his spiral-patterned finger gloves, his strikes become devastating cutting and piercing attacks capable of grinding through defenses.

Functions/Applications:
Enhanced close-range melee combat with rotating limbs that drill and cut through armor and flesh. His gloved hands amplify offensive damage, making physical blocking ineffective. Gyrate excels at rapid rotational strikes and maintains combat effectiveness when grappled.

Limits:
Gyrate is purely close-range with no long-distance applications. The Quirk cannot prevent being grabbed or carried, limiting mobility. Effectiveness relies heavily on the spiral gloves for maximum damage output.

cardPool.title: Hair Control
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Hair Control

Description:
A Quirk allowing manipulation of one's own hair with precision and force. The user can harden, extend, and weaponize hair strands for offensive and defensive purposes.

Functions/Applications:
Hair can be fired as projectiles with bullet-like velocity. Hair can be shaped into solid weapons like whips, blades, or bludgeons for melee combat. Hair serves as an extension of the body for grappling, binding, or striking from range.

Limits:
Control is restricted to the user's own hair only. Hardened hair is vulnerable to sharp cuts and fire. Extended hair depletes stamina with prolonged use. Hair growth rate limits available material for combat. Short or thin hair reduces offensive potential.

Additional Notes:
Effectiveness scales with hair length and density. Training determines precision and speed of manipulation.

cardPool.title: Hair-Raiser
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Hair-Raiser

Description:
The user can extend, harden, and detach hair strands from their scalp at will. These strands become malleable weapons or tools shaped during combat or utility tasks.

Functions/Applications:
Hair strands harden into spears, whips, or cutting implements for offense. They serve as grappling hooks, restraints, or construction tools. The user maintains control over detached strands for dynamic repositioning.

Limits:
Effectiveness diminishes as hair depletes—excessive use leaves the user bald and vulnerable. Hardened hair can be cut or broken by sharp or strong forces. Hair regrows at normal human rates, creating a finite resource pool per engagement.

Additional Notes:
Best suited for creative, tactically-minded fighters. Hair-Raiser rewards resourcefulness but punishes wasteful approaches.

cardPool.title: Hardening
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Hardening

Description:
The user hardens any part or all of their body into rock-like material, transforming skin into an impenetrable, jagged surface. This grants extreme durability against physical trauma and increases offensive striking power through rough, cutting edges.

Functions/Applications:
Provides defense against bullets, blades, and blunt force trauma. Offensive applications include devastating close-range strikes and grazing cuts from hardened skin. Can shield allies. Hardness improves with repeated damage taken while activated.

Limits:
Requires close-range combat; no long-distance capability. Cannot protect against extreme temperatures. Stamina depletes under sustained damage. Eyes remain vulnerable if entire body is hardened. Effect weakens under psychological stress like fear or pain.

cardPool.title: Hardflame Fan
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Hardflame Fan

Description:
The user generates walls of solidified fire that harden into defensive barriers. Heat exceeding the Quirk's temperature can penetrate these defenses.

Functions/Applications:
Deploy layered fire walls to shield against physical and thermal attacks. Position barriers around vulnerable body parts. The hardened fire can absorb moderate-level heat-based strikes.

Limits:
Fire hotter than the user's flames passes through unimpeded. Cannot be used offensively—purely defensive. Requires continuous focus to maintain barriers; dissipates if concentration breaks. Each layer drains stamina progressively. Users with significantly higher heat output bypass this defense entirely.

Additional Notes:
This is a stolen Quirk, suggesting the original user was relatively unknown or weaker. Best used defensively as part of a layered tactical approach.

cardPool.title: Heal
keys: (No keywords remain after applying the instruction)
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Heal

Description:
The user accelerates a target's natural healing by kissing them. Injuries taking months to heal restore in seconds. User maintains fine control over healing intensity to manage stamina drain.

Functions/Applications:
Rapidly mend wounds, broken bones, and internal injuries. Heal severe trauma in multiple sessions. Works best combined with surgery for life-threatening conditions. User can refuse to heal certain injuries.

Limits:
Healing consumes receiver's stamina; severe healing causes exhaustion or death if stamina depleted. Cannot regrow lost limbs. Cannot fully heal extremely severe injuries or permanent scarring. Requires receiver alive and capable of natural healing. Most dangerous injuries need surgery before Heal application.

Additional Notes:
User must be in close proximity with willing contact to activate.

cardPool.title: Heavy Payload
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Heavy Payload

Description:
A stolen Quirk that amplifies the destructive force of attacks. When combined with offensive Quirks, it exponentially increases damage output, making it a powerful multiplier for energy-based or kinetic attacks.

Functions/Applications:
Heavy Payload enhances striking power and layers with complementary Quirks like Air Cannon or Radio Waves to create devastating combination attacks. A single beam boosted by Heavy Payload can rival the destructive capacity of multiple stacked combat Quirks.

Limits:
The Quirk provides no defensive capabilities and requires synergy with other offensive abilities to reach maximum potential. Power scales with the base strength of the paired Quirk. Solo use offers minimal advantage over raw physical force.

Additional Notes:
Heavy Payload is most effective when combined with ranged or energy-projection Quirks.

cardPool.title: Helical Scythe
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Helical Scythe

Description:
The user manifests large, crimson scythe-like tendrils on their fingers and head. These extensions can grow, contract, and rotate at high speeds, granting exceptional reach and piercing power capable of cutting through solid ice.

Functions/Applications:
Tendrils function as independent grappling tools for striking distant targets. The user can rotate appendages to manipulate environmental elements—redirecting water into typhoons, influencing fire patterns, or constructing solid forms for intimidation or structural purposes.

Limits:
Appendages require significant stamina to extend and maintain; prolonged use causes fatigue. Rotation-based elemental manipulation demands precise control and concentration. True strength appears dependent on external enhancement via Trigger drugs. Range is limited by appendage length.

cardPool.title: Hellflame
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Hellflame

Description:
An extremely powerful fire-based Quirk allowing the user to generate and control flames of varying temperatures, from low-heat warning shots to devastating blue-hot infernos. The user can cover their body in flames, project fire as blasts and rays, and achieve limited flight through controlled flame expulsion.

Functions/Applications:
Large-scale flamethrower attacks, precise heat rays, flame-wreathed melee strikes, aerial propulsion via jets, wall-running by creating molten footprints, cellular-level burning to bypass regeneration, and medical cauterization. Signature technique Flashfire Fist raises flames to maximum temperature for a vaporizing heat ray.

Limits:
Overuse causes dangerous body temperature buildup that impairs physical abilities; user requires external cooling assistance. Rain and wet conditions hinder performance.

cardPool.title: High Specs
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
High Specs

Description:
An intellect-enhancing quirk that elevates mind and body far beyond normal limits. Grants superhuman intelligence, perception, reaction speed, and comprehension. Users gain enhanced strength, dexterity, and growth, becoming fully sapient with human-level cognition and speech regardless of original species.

Functions/Applications:
Devise complex strategies instantly from minimal information. Execute intricate plans with precise calculations. Perfect recall of all experienced events and knowledge. Leadership and tactical command capability. Enhanced physical coordination for delicate or demanding tasks.

Limits:
Cannot increase physical power beyond enhanced baseline—depends on strategy over brute force. Perfect memory creates emotional baggage; past traumas and grudges persist with clarity, potentially clouding judgment.

cardPool.title: Hologram
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Hologram

Description:
Mahoro Shimano projects illusory holograms of any object or creature she visualizes. The projections scale from small decoys to massive constructs visible from great distances. They exist as pure light with no physical substance and cast no shadows.

Functions/Applications:
Create diversionary illusions to confuse opponents. Generate emergency signal constructs visible across wide areas. Stage elaborate pranks to mislead targets. Project multiple holograms simultaneously to overwhelm perception.

Limits:
Holograms cannot interact with physical matter, deal damage, or block attacks. Strong winds or physical force instantly disperses projections. Targets with keen perception easily see through deception. Requires active concentration; losing focus causes immediate dissipation. No offensive or defensive capabilities.

cardPool.title: Homing
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Homing

Description:
The user locks onto any visible target within 600 meters and launches projectiles that automatically chase their prey. Once released, the projectile homes in on the target with relentless accuracy. However, the strikes lack significant force, prioritizing tracking over impact damage.

Functions/Applications:
Lock onto distant enemies for guaranteed hit tracking; maintain pressure on mobile targets; suppress enemy movement; execute precise strikes from range without mid-flight adjustments; work effectively in open terrain.

Limits:
Requires visual line of sight at lock-on; effective range capped at 600 meters; projectiles deal minimal damage; user cannot dictate hit location; useless against invisible or obscured enemies; projectile speed allows skilled opponents time to react.

cardPool.title: Horn Cannon
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Horn Cannon

Description:
Pony can detach and launch her horns as independent projectiles with near-instant regeneration. She maintains remote telekinetic control over up to four horns simultaneously, allowing mid-air trajectory adjustments. The horns are dense and curved, ideal for piercing, restraining, or transporting targets.

Functions/Applications:
Launch horns in rapid succession for offensive strikes. Remotely steer horns around obstacles to bypass defenses. Restrain or pin enemies with horn strength. Transport allies and objects via horn carriers. Assist mobility and climbing.

Limits:
Only four horns controlled remotely at once. Horns weaken without regular keratin intake and are breakable. Transporting multiple people or objects reduces horn speed. Holding Pony's horns in place prevents detachment.

cardPool.title: Hula Hoop
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Hula Hoop

Description:
The user generates large hoops of concentrated energy by raising their arm, then hurls them as projectile weapons. The hoops are solid enough to impact with force.

Functions/Applications:
Primary offensive ranged attack through energy hoop projection. Can strike multiple targets in sequence. Useful for medium-range combat.

Limits:
Requires deliberate arm-raising motion before each hoop, telegraphing the attack. Energy hoops dissipate after moderate distance. Cannot be rapidly fired due to generation cooldown.

Additional Notes:
Best suited for direct combat rather than stealth. Effectiveness depends on aim and opponent distance. Most potent against stationary or slow-moving targets.

cardPool.title: Hydra
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Hydra

Description:
A stolen Quirk allowing the user to summon massive serpentine shark-like creatures from their back. These beasts possess immense strength and can crush humans in their jaws.

Functions/Applications:
Summon a single snake creature to attack enemies; the creature splits into two heads when damaged, multiplying offensive capability. Two heads can lift the user airborne for mobility. Enhancement drugs enable multiple simultaneous summons for overwhelming force.

Limits:
Initially limited to one creature; splitting occurs only when damaged. Multiple summons require enhancement drugs. Most effective as surprise attacks from behind; less effective in anticipated confrontations.

Additional Notes:
The stolen, unnamed Quirk is unstable in some conditions. Enhancement drugs expand combat potential but create dependency.

cardPool.title: Hypertrophy
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Hypertrophy

Description:
The user can enlarge their arm to massive proportions at will, increasing its size and mass dramatically. The enlarged limb retains full strength and control, allowing for devastating physical attacks and restraint capabilities.

Functions/Applications:
Deliver crushing blows with devastating force. Restrain opponents through overwhelming size. Break through obstacles and structures.

Limits:
Only affects the arm. Enlargement takes a moment to activate, making it unsuitable for surprise attacks. Requires physical strength to leverage the increased mass. Extended use causes fatigue.

Additional Notes:
Most effective in direct combat. The enlarged arm becomes a prominent target during use.

cardPool.title: Ice Ply
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Ice Ply

Description:
A manipulation quirk granting complete control over existing ice and water within a town-sized range. The user can gather, shape, and weaponize ice freely. After awakening, they gained the ability to lower ice temperature and freeze water, dramatically expanding their ice supply and combat potential.

Functions/Applications:
The user shapes ice into complex constructs like giant fists, platforms, and dragons for offense and defense. By freezing nearby water sources, they generate massive amounts of manipulable ice for large-scale attacks. They ride ice platforms for swift aerial movement and lower ice temperature to counter fire-based quirks.

Limits:
The quirk cannot create ice from nothing; it only manipulates existing ice and water. The user is severely weakened in dry environments lacking water or ice.

cardPool.title: Ignition
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Ignition

Description:
A fire-generation quirk allowing the user to produce and control flames. The user generates a small flame atop their head and can exhale powerful flares through their mouth. When enhanced by Trigger, flames spread across the upper body and intensify significantly.

Functions/Applications:
Ranged attacks via fire breath, close-range flame projection, and offensive combat support. Enhanced form enables wide-area fire generation across the torso for increased damage and area coverage.

Limits:
Base form produces modest flames requiring enhancement for combat effectiveness. Flames originate from the head and mouth, limiting directional versatility. Trigger dependency creates reliance on external substances. Overuse risks exhaustion or physical strain.

cardPool.title: Impact Recoil
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Impact Recoil

Description:
A defensive Quirk that reverses incoming physical force back upon the attacker, redirecting kinetic damage rather than absorbing it. The user becomes a conduit for impact, turning an opponent's own power against them.

Functions/Applications:
Reflects melee strikes, projectiles, and collision-based attacks back at their source with amplified force. Can chain with other abilities using objects or people as intermediary shields to redirect attacks or protect vulnerable moments.

Limits:
Does not fully negate impact; extremely powerful strikes still cause brief incapacitation. Cannot reflect indirect damage like energy, heat, or environmental hazards. Requires physical contact or proximity to active force; ranged non-kinetic attacks bypass it entirely.

Additional Notes:
Most effective against direct, forceful attackers.

cardPool.title: Impure Beam
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name: Impure Beam

Description: A devastating light-based Quirk that fires massive, destructive beams of concentrated luminous energy. The user channels intense light into catastrophic blasts capable of obliterating large targets and structures. This ranks among the most powerful offensive abilities.

Functions/Applications: Unleash massive beam attacks dealing extreme damage to single or multiple targets. The beam can be combined with other Quirks to amplify destructive output. Effective against most physical defenses and organic matter. Can be charged for increased potency.

Limits: At maximum output, the user's arm and body suffer severe recoil damage or explosive trauma. Light-based beams are vulnerable to refraction or redirection by light-manipulating Quirks. Extended use risks catastrophic self-injury.

cardPool.title: Incite
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Incite

Description:
The user's voice is laced with an electromagnetic pulse that physically and mentally enhances those who view them as a worthy leader. Power scales with volume—louder speech means stronger effects. Enhancement costs the recipient physically.

Functions/Applications:
Amplifies physical strength, speed, and mental fortitude of loyal followers. Can temporarily push recipients beyond normal limits. Works best through amplification devices or in crowded settings.

Limits:
Only functions on people with genuine loyalty to the user; wavering faith nullifies effects. Fear and conflicting emotions override the ability. Repeated use exhausts the recipient's body. Cannot compel unwilling targets or create loyalty where none exists.

Additional Notes:
The user must actively speak to activate Incite; silence negates it.

cardPool.title: Infrared
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Infrared

Description:
The user perceives surroundings through infrared radiation, gaining thermal vision similar to heat-sensing predators. This allows navigation independent of light, compensating for blindness. The quirk extends to sensing emotional states through thermal fluctuations in living beings.

Functions/Applications:
Navigate in darkness with perfect clarity. Detect living creatures by body heat signatures. Read emotional states through thermal changes in physiology. Bypass visual-based obstacles and camouflage.

Limits:
Effective range limited to nearby surroundings. Sensor technology and electromagnetic interference disrupt thermal perception. Cannot function against objects with uniform temperature or heat-isolated targets. Requires cognitive processing to interpret thermal data.

cardPool.title: Invisibility
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Invisibility

Description:
The user's body unconsciously refracts light, rendering them invisible. Physical features and presence cannot be detected visually. The Quirk is permanently active and cannot be toggled off. Clothing and carried objects remain visible, requiring complete nudity for effective use. Extreme temperatures directly affect exposed skin.

Functions/Applications:
Perfect stealth and infiltration for ambushes, reconnaissance, and evasion. With training, the user can manipulate refracted light to blind opponents or redirect light-based attacks through their prism-like body.

Limits:
Permanence leaves the user visible when clothed. Complete nudity exposes skin to environmental damage. Sensory-based detection methods like sound, thermal, touch, and scent bypass the Quirk entirely. Extremely powerful light sources can cause the Quirk to malfunction.

cardPool.title: IQ
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
IQ

Description:
A mental enhancement Quirk that multiplies intellectual capacity to genius levels. Activation requires consuming tea and closing one's eyes to enter deep thinking. Yellow equations and orange circuit diagrams materialize around the user's head during use.

Functions/Applications:
User can devise complex strategic plans, analyze enemy movements, predict behavior, and solve tactical problems with superhuman intelligence. Excels at information gathering, trap construction, and multi-target coordination. Different tea varieties produce varying enhancement effects.

Limits:
Activation depends entirely on tea consumption. Generated plans have exploitable flaws. Provides no physical combat, defensive, or reflexive advantage. Unpredictable opponents introduce variables that exceed calculation accuracy.

cardPool.title: Iron Ball
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Iron Ball

Description:
The user produces and launches iron spheres from their knuckles with considerable force. Projectiles vary from egg-sized to larger than the user's body, with fair control over mass and density.

Functions/Applications:
Primary ranged offensive weapon; generates ammunition for allies; larger projectiles create barriers or crush obstacles; variable sizing allows tactical flexibility.

Limits:
Sustained production drains stamina; larger spheres require more energy and slower generation; accuracy decreases with distance and extreme sizes; user needs knuckles available; projectiles cannot be remotely controlled once launched.

Additional Notes:
Best used in offensive or support roles; balances power with tactical versatility through size manipulation; effective in group combat when allies utilize generated ammunition.

cardPool.title: Iron Claws
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Iron Claws

Description:
The user's fingertips transform into hard metallic claws. Size, sharpness, and form vary by user—some develop large slashing weapons, others maintain dexterous claws for excavation and tunneling.

Functions/Applications:
Claws can pierce tough materials, slash opponents, or dig through earth and stone. Users can burrow underground for mobility, concealment, or surprise attacks. Claws retain precision for climbing and manipulation tasks.

Limits:
Claws are only as strong as the user's physical strength allows. Extended underground burrowing drains stamina. The quirk doesn't increase speed or reflexes. Claws can be damaged by superior materials or force.

Additional Notes:
Manifestation varies significantly. Bulky variants sacrifice dexterity for power, while refined versions maintain control.

cardPool.title: Iron Club
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Iron Club

Description:
The user transforms their arms into massive iron clubs covered in jagged spikes. The transformation increases body mass and height to 229cm, granting an imposing ogre-like appearance.

Functions/Applications:
Devastating melee strikes capable of crushing boulders and shattering fortifications. Spike-covered surfaces inflict additional trauma on impact. Useful for intimidation and demolition.

Limits:
Arms cannot be used for fine manipulation while transformed. Transformation requires significant stamina to maintain. Speed and agility decrease due to increased body mass. The transformation is permanent until deactivated.

Additional Notes:
Iron Club is an offensive-focused Quirk best suited for direct combat. The spike coverage prevents easy disarming. User relies on durability rather than evasion.

cardPool.title: Jet
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Jet

Description:
Jet allows the user to expel compressed air from holes in their feet soles, propelled by lung breath. This grants extreme speed in flight and ground movement, enabling superhuman acceleration and explosive direction changes.

Functions/Applications:
The user achieves short-range flight and rapid ground acceleration through air pulses. Each directional change requires new breath intake. Generated momentum amplifies physical strikes for devastating tackles and kicks. Useful for evasion, pursuit, high-impact blows, rescue operations, and combat repositioning.

Limits:
Flight duration is restricted by lung capacity—cannot sustain hover. Each direction shift costs breath, limiting extended maneuverability. Age and physical deterioration weaken stamina and bone integrity. Warping-type Quirks can negate the speed advantage.

cardPool.title: Kaiju
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Kaiju

Description:
A transformation Quirk that allows the user to metamorphose into a colossal dinosaur-like beast resembling Godzilla. The transformation grants massive size and power comparable to Gigantification Quirks.

Functions/Applications:
Grants enormous physical strength and size for combat. The beast form can devastate large areas through sheer mass and destructive capability.

Limits:
Transformation requires Trigger drug activation to manifest, suggesting the user cannot access this power naturally without chemical enhancement. The massive form likely reduces mobility and agility despite increased strength.

Additional Notes:
This Quirk's true capabilities and limitations remain mysterious due to limited observed usage. The dependency on Trigger presents significant vulnerability when unavailable.

cardPool.title: Kinetic Booster
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Kinetic Booster

Description:
A Quirk that amplifies kinetic energy from the user's movement and actions. Multiple copies compound the effect exponentially. All For One's four copies make him devastatingly powerful.

Functions/Applications:
Enhanced striking force, explosive speed, amplified jumping, and increased momentum. Multiple copies enable simultaneous bursts or sustained acceleration beyond normal limits.

Limits:
Requires active physical exertion; passive use yields minimal benefit. Energy depletes with repeated activation. Effectiveness depends on physical conditioning and control. Managing multiple copies requires mental focus to avoid backfire.

Additional Notes:
Originally stolen by All For One. True power emerges only when multiple copies combine, suggesting modest baseline strength.

cardPool.title: King Slam
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
King Slam

Description:
The user can manifest a massive hammer from thin air and wield it as a weapon for melee strikes or projectile attacks.

Functions/Applications:
Deploy the hammer for powerful close-range bludgeoning or launch it at opponents. The weapon can be summoned repeatedly for sustained offensive pressure.

Limits:
The hammer requires conscious summoning and dissipates after use. Physical strength determines impact force. Limited throwing range and recovery time between summons may exist.

Additional Notes:
A straightforward offensive Quirk favored by aggressive combatants, best suited for close-quarters or mid-range encounters.

cardPool.title: Landmine
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Landmine

Description:
Chitose infuses explosive properties into any object or being she touches, detonating them at will. Individual explosions are weak but devastating in numbers and through strategic placement. She can weaponize allies' bodies or blood as living mines.

Functions/Applications:
Plant trap networks to funnel enemies into kill zones. Detonate multiple charges simultaneously for cumulative damage. Infuse allies' blood as contingency explosives. Use the Curious Flattener chain weapon to detonate explosive pieces at close range.

Limits:
Individual explosions are relatively weak; effectiveness depends on quantity and tactical setup. Cannot detonate targets at extreme distances without direct line of sight. Requires physical contact to infuse objects initially. Detonating allies requires their willing cooperation or incapacitation.

cardPool.title: Larceny
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Larceny

Description:
Toya Setsuno can instantly steal any object from a target's person and bring it directly into his hands. This includes weapons, armor, and Quirk manifestations, giving him advantage against armed opponents.

Functions/Applications:
Disarm enemies by stealing weapons mid-combat. Steal Quirk manifestations to neutralize abilities. Works best in coordinated team fights where allies exploit the resulting vulnerability.

Limits:
Cannot steal objects beyond a certain size threshold. Requires direct line of sight to the target—blindness renders the Quirk unusable. Cannot steal from objects outside visual range. Ineffective against unarmed opponents or those with no portable items.

Additional Notes:
Toya relies on allies to capitalize on disarmed enemies. The Quirk's effectiveness depends entirely on maintaining vision; any sight obstruction is catastrophic.

cardPool.title: Laser
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name: Laser

Description: The user projects concentrated energy beams from their right eye with precise targeting. These beams can damage high-level threats and break down complex materials.

Functions/Applications: Fire energy beams for offensive attacks; destroy or disable targets from distance; breach material defenses and structures.

Limits: Beam originates only from right eye, creating a predictable attack vector; requires line of sight; unknown cooldown between shots; extended use may cause eye strain or fatigue.

Additional Notes: Effective against organic and synthetic targets. Precision makes it suitable for tactical combat but leaves the user vulnerable if the right eye is compromised or obscured.

cardPool.title: Leafipulation
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Leafipulation

Description:
The user manipulates leaves from nearby plant life, shaping and launching them as sharp projectiles. This Quirk grants control over vegetation in the immediate environment, turning natural foliage into weapons.

Functions/Applications:
Fire leaves as ranged attacks; create leaf shields for defense; strike multiple targets with dispersed projectiles; scout using leaves as extensions of sight.

Limits:
User cannot generate leaves from their own body—must rely on existing plant sources nearby. Ineffective in barren or urban environments lacking vegetation. Leaf projectiles lack stopping power. Range and potency depend on plant availability.

Additional Notes:
Best utilized in forests, gardens, or natural settings. Urban combat severely restricts effectiveness. Leaves deteriorate quickly once separated from plants.

cardPool.title: Leap
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Leap

Description:
A mobility quirk granting extraordinary jumping distance and height. Provides cushioning on landing when activated, negating fall damage from intentional jumps. Requires solid ground and does not protect against accidental falls.

Functions/Applications:
Execute massive jumps for traversal and evasion. Land safely from great heights when consciously activated. Clear obstacles and reach elevated positions in combat or exploration.

Limits:
Requires stable ground—soft surfaces reduce jump distance and height. Does not cushion unintended falls or passive drops. User remains vulnerable if knocked off a ledge without activating the quirk first.

Additional Notes:
Leap is a mobility tool with defensive applications, not flight. Success depends on environmental conditions and user awareness. Skilled use requires timing activation before impact.

cardPool.title: Life Force
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Life Force

Description:
Doubles natural lifespan and slows aging dramatically, allowing users to appear decades younger than their actual age. A 120-year-old may appear only sixty.

Functions/Applications:
Grants extended longevity and youthful appearance for centuries. Can be duplicated and transferred to others. Enables long-term planning and knowledge accumulation.

Limits:
If cancelled or removed, the user rapidly ages into severe decrepitude, potentially causing death. Naturally reduces physical mobility and reflexes, making combat difficult without supplementary abilities.

Additional Notes:
This Quirk trades vitality for duration. Users gain time but lose physical prowess. Rapid aging upon cancellation is dangerous mid-conflict. Duplication requires mastery of its mechanics.

cardPool.title: Lion
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Lion

Description:
A transformation quirk granting enhanced strength, speed, and a devastating roar. The user gains feline power and agility comparable to an apex predator.

Functions/Applications:
Enhanced strength for melee attacks, increased speed for pursuit or evasion, and a sonic roar that disrupts sensory-based attacks and creates defensive shockwaves. The roar counters high-frequency paralysis abilities.

Limits:
No full animal transformation, only attribute enhancement. The roar requires buildup and leaves the user vulnerable during recovery. Ineffective against sound-immune targets. Sustained use causes physical fatigue.

Additional Notes:
Most effective in direct combat with space to move freely. The roar serves as both offensive weapon and defensive countermeasure against ability-based opponents.

cardPool.title: Liquification
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Liquification

Description:
The user can transform their body into a liquid state at will, allowing them to flow and reshape themselves. This Quirk serves primarily as a defensive mechanism to avoid physical harm.

Functions/Applications:
Evasion of melee and projectile attacks by liquefying. Can be combined with other Quirks to launch liquefied body matter as projectile weapons. Grants mobility through confined spaces by flowing through gaps.

Limits:
The entire body must transform or remain solid—cannot liquify selectively. Liquified form is vulnerable to elemental attacks like fire or freezing. Stamina drains while liquified. Cannot interact with solid objects while liquefied. Concentration required to reform.

Additional Notes:
Most effective as a defensive tool rather than primary offense.

cardPool.title: Lizard
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Lizard

Description:
A reptilian transformation quirk granting scaled, lizard-like appearance with tail and forked tongue. Provides enhanced physical resilience and accelerated healing beyond normal human limits.

Functions/Applications:
Grants superior endurance for extended combat. Enhanced regeneration allows faster recovery from wounds. Under Trigger drug influence, transformation intensifies—arms morph into pterosaur-like wings enabling sustained flight.

Limits:
No superhuman strength or speed without Trigger. Flight requires Trigger dependency, unreliable for sustained aerial combat. Vulnerable to extreme temperatures affecting cold-blooded physiology. Trigger creates addiction hazards.

Additional Notes:
Forked tongue suggests enhanced sensory perception, unconfirmed. Trigger's long-term health consequences unknown.

cardPool.title: Lock Down
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Lock Down

Description:
A spatial locking ability that freezes touched objects into a fixed point in space, rendering them completely immobile. Activation requires key-tooth-like protrusions extending from fingertips to make direct contact with the target.

Functions/Applications:
Immobilize environmental hazards like falling debris or shifting terrain. Secure objects during combat or construction. Create barriers by locking structural elements. Neutralize dynamic threats through tactical positioning.

Limits:
Cannot affect living beings or organic matter. Effectiveness decreases with object size and force. Requires direct finger contact to activate. Duration and energy cost scale with object mass.

Additional Notes:
Most effective against environmental hazards and inanimate objects. Works defensively but lacks offensive capability.

cardPool.title: Longbow
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name: Longbow

Description: The user transforms their left hand's thumb and pinky finger into a functional bow. Arrows fired from this bio-weapon pierce vehicles and can actively pursue moving targets through the air.

Functions/Applications: Transform left hand into a ranged weapon. Fire guided arrows to track targets. Penetrate fortified positions and vehicles. Scavenge ammunition from the environment.

Limits: User cannot generate ammunition and must rely on found arrows or makeshift projectiles. Only the left hand forms the bow, limiting versatility if injured or restrained.

Additional Notes: Resource management makes this Quirk powerful in prepared engagements but vulnerable in prolonged conflicts. Guided arrow capability provides significant accuracy advantage, compensating for ammunition scarcity through precision.

cardPool.title: Longleg
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Longleg

Description:
A transformation Quirk that grants the ability to extend legs to extraordinary lengths. Limbs become elastic and elongated, allowing rapid travel and reaching otherwise inaccessible areas.

Functions/Applications:
Extended legs enable rapid travel, scaling structures, executing far-reaching kicks, and escaping confined spaces. The user can reach distant objects and traverse obstacles.

Limits:
Extension has maximum range before becoming unstable. Overextension causes loss of balance and reduced effectiveness. Cannot function if legs are immobilized. Speed decreases with extension distance.

Additional Notes:
Effective for theft and reconnaissance. Works best in open environments with space to maneuver. Usefulness diminishes in cramped spaces or against opponents who restrict movement.

cardPool.title: Love
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Love

Description:
The user empowers a target by confessing genuine romantic feelings for them. The confession transmits a surge of physical enhancement, with intensity scaling to emotional depth. The empowered state manifests as heart-shaped smoke surrounding the target, called "Lover Mode."

Functions/Applications:
Dramatically increases target's physical strength and speed for combat or critical tasks. Works across any distance if the user's voice reaches the target. Acts as a strategic trump card for high-stakes moments requiring a decisive power boost.

Limits:
Activates only once per 24 hours. Cannot empower the user themselves—only affects genuine romantic interests. Requires sincere emotional confession to function; false declarations fail. Enhanced state doesn't guarantee victory against skilled opponents.

cardPool.title: Luminescence
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Luminescence

Description:
The user emits bright light from their body, ranging from pure white to orange-yellow depending on the wielder. Light intensity and color are influenced by the user's state and circumstances. Activation is controlled at will.

Functions/Applications:
Emit blinding light to disorient opponents. Use as illumination in darkness. Create visual distraction or misdirection. Light output scales with user's development over time.

Limits:
No offensive or defensive properties beyond light emission; purely emission-based with no kinetic force. Effectiveness reduced against light-resistant opponents. Energy cost and duration unknown but likely taxing with extended use. Requires line of sight to affect targets.

Additional Notes:
Visual properties vary between users—original holder used pure white light while another produced orange-yellow luminescence.

cardPool.title: Mad Gluttony
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Mad Gluttony

Description:
A consumption-based Quirk granting a massive mouth in the stomach capable of rapidly inhaling, crushing, and destroying objects. When Overmodified, additional mouths sprout across the body as prehensile, biting tendrils for ranged attacks and restraint.

Functions/Applications:
Devour and destroy solid materials with extreme speed. Deploy mouth-tendrils for multi-directional offense, grappling, and ranged bites. Inhale to create suction for environmental manipulation. Enhanced form provides combat versatility and crowd control.

Limits:
The stomach mouth has finite capacity and requires processing time. Tendrils are destructible by concentrated impact damage. Primary mouth requires close proximity; enhanced form extends range but spreads defense thin. Overmodification is unstable without external modification.

cardPool.title: Magic
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Magic

Description:
The user creates glowing energy rings around their wrists that can ensnare people and objects, allowing telekinetic manipulation. Once trapped within a ring, the user gains complete control over its speed and trajectory, from gentle movement to explosive acceleration.

Functions/Applications:
Propel allies toward distant targets at high velocity. Rescue civilians or teammates from danger. Manipulate large objects or multiple targets simultaneously using multiple rings. Fine-tune speed for precision placement or raw power delivery.

Limits:
Rings have a fixed maximum size, preventing the user from moving objects or beings larger than the ring's circumference. Creating and maintaining multiple rings drains stamina with extended use. The user cannot manipulate ring speed if the target escapes the ring's boundary.

cardPool.title: Magnetism
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name: Magnetism

Description: The user magnetizes targets within a 4.5-meter radius, polarizing them by sex—men become south-aligned (blue aura), women north-aligned (red aura). Same-sex targets repel; opposite-sex targets attract. The user cannot be magnetized and cannot affect those outside range.

Functions/Applications: Launch allies between opposing polarities for momentum. Separate enemies by matching polarities to force repulsion. Pin or crush foes using attraction between opposite-polarized targets. Combine with external magnetic objects to amplify effects.

Limits: Only functions within 4.5 meters. User is immune to their own Quirk. Requires line of effect. Power scales with number of targets; multi-target coordination drains focus. Non-sentient metallic objects need external magnetism.

Additional Notes: Most effective in coordinated team settings.

cardPool.title: Manifest
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Manifest

Description:
The user can enhance their body parts with the characteristics of anything consumed, as long as it remains in their digestive system. Eaten food grants its physical properties—octopus tentacles, hardened shells, sharp talons, or reinforced muscle tissue—all manifested on command and dismissed at will.

Functions/Applications:
Offense: Tentacle fingers for binding, talons for cutting, reinforced striking limbs. Defense: Shell hardening, flexible absorption using octopus traits. Tactical: Multiple simultaneous manifestations allow combining traits. User can prepare specific foods before missions to counter known threats.

Limits:
Manifestation strength depends on quantity consumed. User must eat daily to maintain reserves; depleted stores render the Quirk unusable. Manifestations last only while food remains in the digestive system.

cardPool.title: Mantis
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Mantis

Description:
A transformation quirk granting mantis-based physiology and abilities. The user develops enhanced insectoid traits including sharpened claws, increased agility, and predatory instincts. With artificial enhancement through bio-engineering or chemical stimulants like Trigger, the transformation becomes more pronounced, enlarging the user into a humanoid mantis form with lethally honed blade-like hands.

Functions/Applications:
High-speed slashing attacks using razor-sharp claws capable of cutting through most materials. Enhanced reflexes and predatory awareness allow tracking of fast-moving targets. Increased strength proportional to size when fully manifested. Climbing and wall-adherence provides tactical mobility advantages.

Limits:
Without enhancement, the quirk provides only partial transformation with modest physical boosts.

cardPool.title: Meatball
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Meatball

Description:
The user manipulates raw human flesh with telekinetic precision, separating and controlling their own limbs independently while molding flesh into offensive and defensive shapes. Victims touched by flesh constructs are kneaded into immobilized meatballs, retaining full sensory awareness while trapped.

Functions/Applications:
Create levitating flesh projectiles for ranged attacks; form protective shields from compacted flesh; ensnare targets by rolling them into helpless spheres; separate limbs for independent combat maneuvers; expand and compress flesh for offense and defense.

Limits:
User must maintain constant focus to keep victims restrained. Physical damage breaks concentration and releases captives. Superior control over own flesh than others'; foreign flesh requires direct contact.

cardPool.title: Metal Manipulation
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Metal Manipulation

Description:
Wolfram controls and reshapes pre-existing metallic materials by touch, his hand glowing blue with electrical energy. He bends metal into offensive and defensive structures of any form or complexity.

Functions/Applications:
Creates iron pillars, walls, and cubes for attack or defense. Constructs large fortifications and barriers to trap opponents. Assembles metal pieces into massive structures. Excels in metal-rich environments.

Limits:
Requires pre-existing metal to function. Ineffective at close-range combat. Power scales with available metal quantity and quality. Remains stationary-focused.

Additional Notes:
Best utilized in industrial or metallic settings. Blue hand discharge marks activation. Defensive capabilities withstand powerful physical attacks when properly fortified.

cardPool.title: Mimicry
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Mimicry

Description:
The user transfers their consciousness into solid objects and controls them as physical forms. Without enhancement, objects are limited to refrigerator-size; with Trigger drug, manipulation extends to entire structures and landscapes.

Functions/Applications:
Inhabit and animate solid matter for combat and mobility; reshape environments by twisting corridors and repositioning terrain; manifest body parts externally to perceive and interact; launch attacks while hidden inside objects.

Limits:
Perception is severely limited without exposing body parts, creating weak points. Standard objects capped at refrigerator-size without Trigger enhancement. Emotional manipulation can force desperate moves exposing position. Quirk-negating abilities cannot affect hidden users, but direct environmental damage to inhabited objects remains a threat.

cardPool.title: Mind Reaper
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Mind Reaper

Description:
Upon physical contact, Mind Reaper forces victims to involuntarily expose their deepest secrets, embarrassing memories, and hidden truths through uncontrollable verbal disclosure.

Functions/Applications:
Extract concealed information through forced confession. Incapacitate targets psychologically by revealing shameful secrets. Interrogate prisoners without traditional torture. Humiliate opponents by exposing vulnerabilities.

Limits:
Requires direct physical touch to activate. Victims with strong willpower can resist full disclosure, though the Quirk will then reveal secrets itself—less accurately and with gaps. Exceptionally resolute individuals may resist entirely. Cannot force revelations the user doesn't suspect exist.

Additional Notes:
Effectiveness depends on victim's mental fortitude versus user's activation strength.

cardPool.title: Mole
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Mole

Description:
Grants elongated, razor-sharp claws, protective spines along the back, and a hardened facial visor. These features enable rapid excavation through earth and stone, enhanced underground mobility, camouflage, and eye protection from debris.

Functions/Applications:
Dig through mountains, soil, and rock at exceptional speed. Claws serve as melee weapons capable of shredding obstacles, structures, and enemies. Spines facilitate underground sliding and concealment. User can selectively activate different components independently. Ideal for infiltration, escape, terrain manipulation, and combat.

Limits:
Effectiveness depends on user's base strength and durability; the Quirk amplifies existing physical power. Claws cannot penetrate enchanted or magically-reinforced barriers. Navigation slowed by solid rock versus soil. Prolonged transformation causes fatigue.

cardPool.title: Monster Cat (Quirk)
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Monster Cat

Description:
Monster Cat allows the user to merge with and assume the shape of objects or machinery, gaining complete control over the merged form. The user can detach at will. When chemically boosted, it enables control of large vehicles like buses.

Functions/Applications:
Merge with objects or machinery to pilot them from within, assume their physical form, control movement and functions completely, detach at any time, infiltrate or commandeer vehicles and devices.

Limits:
Capacity restricted without enhancement; cannot merge with living beings; detachment requires time and concentration; merged form limited by host object's structural integrity; larger objects require power boost to control.

Additional Notes:
Monster Cat is non-humanoid and operates as a small animal user, making stealth integration easier but limiting independent combat ability.

cardPool.title: Monster Summon
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Monster Summon

Description:
Simon Gollini conjures blob-like creatures resembling dungeon monsters. These eyeless beings have large mouths and vary in form—some bulky, multi-headed, winged, or resembling wyverns, dinosaurs, and giant frogs. The mechanics are mysterious, possibly magical.

Functions/Applications:
Summon diverse monsters for combat, scouting, and overwhelming opponents. Each creature is tailored in appearance and capabilities. With Overmodification, production becomes nearly limitless for swarm tactics and sustained offensives.

Limits:
Creating monsters requires focus and energy; sustained summoning causes fatigue. Creatures lack intelligence and need direction. Quantity and power are inversely balanced. The true creation method remains unknown.

Additional Notes:
Effectiveness scales with Overmodification.

cardPool.title: Muddied
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Muddied

Description:
A contact-based Quirk that induces temporary memory disruption. When the user touches someone's head, they experience localized amnesia affecting approximately five minutes before and after contact, leaving memories vague and fragmented.

Functions/Applications:
Useful for disorienting opponents in combat, escaping pursuers by making them forget the chase, or extracting information by obscuring the target's sense of time. Applied to single opponents within arm's reach.

Limits:
Requires direct physical contact with the target's head. Effect duration is fixed at roughly ten minutes of memory interference. Does not affect long-term memories or knowledge, only recent events. Repeated use on the same person shows diminishing effectiveness. Cannot be applied from a distance.

cardPool.title: Multiplier
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Multiplier

Description:
A stolen Quirk allowing the user to rapidly generate and manifest multiple additional limbs from their body at will. The manifested limbs are fully functional and independent, granting extraordinary combat versatility and manipulation capabilities.

Functions/Applications:
The user can sprout multiple arms to perform complex actions, wield multiple weapons, grapple opponents, or execute coordinated multi-directional attacks. Each limb retains full strength and dexterity for simultaneous independent tasks or synchronized strikes.

Limits:
Excessive manifestation causes stamina drain and biological strain. Manifested limbs can be severed or destroyed individually and are vulnerable to damage during combat.

Additional Notes:
Originally stolen by All For One. The Quirk's full specifications remain poorly understood, suggesting untapped potential.

cardPool.title: Mummification
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Mummification

Description:
Hoyo animates red bandages to control inanimate objects, transforming them into humanoid mummy constructs. He can command dozens simultaneously.

Functions/Applications:
Transform objects into controllable mummy soldiers for combat. Indirectly control enemies by manipulating their clothing and equipment. Restrain targets through bandage entanglement.

Limits:
Cannot directly control living beings. Bandages break under force. Enemies can escape by discarding equipment. Quirk deactivates if Hoyo is unconscious. Each mummy requires sustained focus.

Additional Notes:
Hoyo relies on overwhelming numbers rather than raw power. Aware targets can strategically discard gear to escape. Bandage damage directly weakens his abilities.

cardPool.title: Muscle Augmentation
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Muscle Augmentation

Description:
The user amplifies and manipulates muscle fibers to achieve superhuman strength, speed, and durability. Muscle layers can protrude visibly or glow internally. Users can augment specific body parts and stack up to 12,000+ layers for maximum effect.

Functions/Applications:
Grants immense strength capable of shattering cliffs. Enhanced speed allows rapid movement and attack avoidance. Muscle fibers act as natural armor, absorbing impacts. Selective augmentation enables tactical flexibility—concentrating power in legs for speed or arms for striking. Can contend with top-tier power users.

Limits:
Depleted muscle fibers tear and weaken the user temporarily. Vibration-based attacks efficiently destroy multiple fibers. The Quirk can be overwhelmed by greater power.

cardPool.title: Muscle Expansion
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Muscle Expansion

Description:
The user can expand and strengthen their muscles at will, dramatically increasing physical power and size. This grants substantial boosts to strength for feats beyond normal human capability.

Functions/Applications:
Enhanced striking force and grappling power. Ability to lift heavy objects. Increased durability from muscle mass expansion. Can be applied selectively to specific body parts or full-body enhancement.

Limits:
Sustained expansion consumes stamina and causes fatigue. Overuse risks muscle strain or injury. Expanded form is slower and less agile. Cannot be maintained indefinitely without rest.

Additional Notes:
Best suited for close-range combat and heavy lifting. Works poorly against speed-based opponents. Requires time to activate, leaving user vulnerable during transformation.

cardPool.title: Mushroom
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Mushroom

Description:
Kinoko Komori generates and spreads fungus spores from her body that rapidly grow into full-sized mushrooms upon contact with solid surfaces. Spore dispersal accelerates in high-humidity environments. Mushrooms persist for two to three hours before withering.

Functions/Applications:
Terrain control via rapid mushroom proliferation to obstruct movement and vision. Asphyxiation attacks by forcing mushroom growth in an opponent's throat. Area denial when combined with humidity spray bottles. Provides allies with cover or hiding spots. Works synergistically with allies who manipulate humidity.

Limits:
Spores indiscriminately affect all organisms, including allies, requiring pre-treatment with anti-fungal sterilization spray. Fungicides and ethanol neutralize spores. Fire destroys airborne spores before germination.

cardPool.title: Mutant Bovini
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Mutant Bovini

Description:
A transformation quirk granting bovine-like facial features capable of emitting powerful directional energy beams from the face.

Functions/Applications:
The user fires sustained or burst lasers for ranged combat and crowd control. Beams vary in intensity and can be aimed by turning the head.

Limits:
Sustained firing causes facial strain and overheating. Accuracy decreases at range. Cannot fire while moving erratically. Eyes and face are vulnerable pressure points.

Additional Notes:
Best suited for strategic, offensive fighters. Requires recovery time between volleys. Close-range opponents pose tactical threats.

cardPool.title: Neutralization
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name: Neutralization

Description: A touch-based Quirk that temporarily nullifies a target's Quirk abilities through contact with the user's right hand, which glows bright light blue when activated. The glow's intensity correlates with the target Quirk's power level. Originally limited to the right arm but can spread throughout the body if modified by external Quirk factors.

Functions/Applications: Suppresses active Quirks temporarily, allowing treatment of harmful Quirk side effects. Effective for medical intervention rather than combat. Can render a target completely Quirkless with sufficient power. Works through gloved contact.

Limits: Taxing when neutralizing powerful Quirks; prolonged use risks severe injury or death. Originally required right arm contact, creating vulnerability if disabled. Cannot permanently destroy Quirks, only suppress them temporarily.

cardPool.title: Octopus
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Octopus

Description:
The user manifests eight elastic tentacle appendages with powerful suckers for gripping and climbing. They can expel ink clouds from a specialized mouth structure for concealment or offense.

Functions/Applications:
Tentacles provide exceptional reach, grappling strength, and dexterity. Suckers enable scaling vertical surfaces and restraining targets. Ink expulsion creates visual obstruction. Multiple appendages allow simultaneous actions impossible for typical humanoids.

Limits:
Tentacles require conscious control and tire with sustained exertion. Ink reserves are finite and must regenerate. Sucker adhesion weakens on dry surfaces. The quirk does not grant enhanced speed or durability beyond elastic tissue. Water environments may reduce ink effectiveness.

cardPool.title: Octopus (Squid)
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Octopus (Squid)

Description:
Transforms the user's body into a humanoid cephalopod form with eight total limbs. Six visible arms function as standard limbs, while two tentacle-like appendages remain concealed within the torso and emerge for surprise attacks.

Functions/Applications:
Multi-limb combat enables simultaneous attacks and grappling. Hidden tentacles provide ambush capabilities. Enhanced dexterity allows manipulation of multiple objects or opponents at once.

Limits:
Requires coordination and stamina to control all limbs effectively. Hidden tentacles have limited reach and concealment. Bulkier form may hinder agility or fitting through tight spaces. Sustained focus needed to manage all limbs in complex scenarios.

Additional Notes:
The Quirk fundamentally alters physiology, not merely granting extra limbs cosmetically.

cardPool.title: Orcinus
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Orcinus

Description:
A marine-mammal transformation quirk granting orca physiology and abilities. The user gains massive size, enhanced strength and speed, and can generate devastating ultrasonic waves that paralyze targets and shatter environmental hazards. Functions on land and water, with amplified effectiveness in water.

Functions/Applications:
Ultrasonic wave emission paralyzes targets at close range and serves as both offense and defense. Enhanced strength enables grappling and restraint. Can combine immobilization with paralysis for finishing moves. Extreme durability allows sustained combat against multiple opponents.

Limits:
Ultrasonic effectiveness decreases at range. Vulnerable to extreme heat and dehydration, which saps strength. Requires rehydration and water access for peak performance. Land-based combat is less efficient than aquatic engagements.

cardPool.title: Outburst
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Outburst

Description:
A comedic Quirk that forces nearby targets into uncontrollable, intense laughter. A distinctive blue aura surrounds the user when activated. The laughter impairs motor coordination and mental processing, rendering victims temporarily helpless.

Functions/Applications:
Incapacitates multiple enemies through involuntary laughter. Useful for crowd control and disarming dangerous situations. Affects all nearby targets indiscriminately.

Limits:
Activation method unclear. Duration and full power extent unknown. Likely ineffective against those immune to humor or mental manipulation.

Additional Notes:
Rarely used in combat despite tactical potential. The blue aura serves as a visible activation indicator.

cardPool.title: Overclock
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Overclock

Description:
A speedster Quirk that accelerates brain function and perception, making the world appear frozen. The user moves 3-10 times faster than normal, or dozens of times faster with adrenaline. Enhanced senses perceive ultra-fast input. A healing factor allows accelerated cellular growth to repair injuries and fuse biological material into the body.

Functions/Applications:
Sprint at supersonic speeds to evade attacks. Read subconscious reactions to predict behavior. Accelerate cell regeneration to heal wounds in seconds. Grow limbs or fuse biological material. Process hyper-accelerated sensory information to navigate frozen time.

Limits:
Severely limited by oxygen deprivation—only usable for seconds before mandatory cooldown. Brain injury or oxygen starvation seal the Quirk temporarily. Intense focus drains activation time.

cardPool.title: Overhaul
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Overhaul

Description:
A deconstruction and reconstruction ability activated by bare-handed touch. The user can instantly disassemble matter—living or non-living—and reassemble it into its original form, a new shape, or leave it destroyed.

Functions/Applications:
Reshape terrain for offense and defense. Merge separate objects or beings into hybrid entities. Heal injuries by reconstructing bodies. Extract components from targets. Dual-hand merging allows combining quirks from different subjects.

Limits:
