Requires physical contact. Short cooldown between uses. Fractured terrain reduces effectiveness. Cannot function if arms are destroyed. Disassembly causes extreme pain to living subjects.

Additional Notes:
Overhaul becomes deadlier when merged with others, gaining additional limbs and access to their quirks. The ability's versatility makes it dangerous at any range.

cardPool.title: Overmodification
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Overmodification

Description:
A perpetually active Quirk that amplifies other Quirks through physical contact. When activated, the user's hair turns black and rose petals bloom around them. Compatible recipients gain boosted abilities or new powers; incompatible ones suffer devastating pain and unconsciousness. Cannot be deactivated without a cancellation ability.

Functions/Applications:
Enhances compatible Quirks dramatically, sometimes granting entirely new functions. Transforms weak abilities into multi-target powerhouses. Works through skin contact; effects stack with repeated applications. Rose petals indicate compatibility or rejection.

Limits:
Compatibility is rare and unpredictable. Incompatible contact causes severe backlash pain. The Quirk is always active and uncontrollable, dangerous in social situations.

cardPool.title: Pain Blocker
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Pain Blocker

Description:
The user becomes completely unable to sense pain from any source. This allows them to sustain massive damage without distraction. The quirk can be toggled on and off with practice.

Functions/Applications:
The user can withstand extreme attacks, including intense heat and blunt force trauma, while continuing to fight at full capacity. When combined with high durability or endurance quirks, the user gains an overwhelming advantage in prolonged combat.

Limits:
Pain blocking does not prevent actual damage—the user still accumulates injuries and wounds, they simply cannot feel them. This creates risk of death from unnoticed critical damage. The quirk requires active concentration to maintain; sudden shocks may briefly reactivate pain sensation. Unconsciousness or severe trauma can force the quirk offline involuntarily.

cardPool.title: Papyrus
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Papyrus

Description:
The user can flatten their entire body to papyrus-like thinness, becoming two-dimensional and malleable. Their body can be stretched, folded, and manipulated at will in this state.

Functions/Applications:
Slip through narrow gaps and confined spaces. Stretch limbs to extreme lengths for reaching or grappling. Fold body parts for compact storage or evasion. Ride air currents for high-speed movement.

Limits:
Vulnerable to mold and degradation in humid environments. Flattened form is more fragile to certain attacks. Cannot maintain full body strength while compressed. Wind-riding ability depends on sufficient air currents.

Additional Notes:
Useful for infiltration, rescue operations, and urban traversal. Best deployed in dry climates. Requires practice to maintain balance while riding wind currents.

cardPool.title: Permeation
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Permeation

Description:
The user phases their body through all matter by rendering themselves intangible. They can selectively phase individual body parts or their entire form, allowing passage through obstacles and evasion of attacks.

Functions/Applications:
Phase through walls and solid objects. Dodge attacks by becoming intangible. Perform unpredictable combat maneuvers by phasing body parts independently. Navigate unrestricted by physical barriers.

Limits:
Clothing and carried objects slip off unless made from user's own hair. Full-body phasing negates all senses except falling sensation, causing disorientation and downward pull through solid ground. Cannot extend phasing to others. Ineffective against sudden attacks. Reactivating while phased inside solid matter repels user to surface, risking injury.

cardPool.title: Plant
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Plant

Description:
The user transforms body parts into living plant structures including vines, roots, and flora. These botanical forms have regenerative properties that mend wounds in allies through contact or proximity.

Functions/Applications:
Transform limbs into grasping vines for restraint or manipulation; sprout roots for stability and movement; generate healing flora that restores health to nearby allies; use plant barriers for defense.

Limits:
Transformations consume stamina and require concentration. Plant structures are vulnerable to fire, ice, and toxins. Healing output is limited by the user's own vitality. Extended transformation causes fatigue.

Additional Notes:
Most effective in natural environments with soil and sunlight. Works best supporting teammates rather than direct combat.

cardPool.title: Playtime
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Playtime

Description:
A transformation quirk that enlarges the user to gigantic proportions while altering their physiology and mental state. Skin darkens, an additional pair of arms manifests, and intellect regresses to childlike behavior, treating surroundings like toys.

Functions/Applications:
Grants immense size and strength for overwhelming physical force. Extra limbs enable multi-directional attacks. Regressed mental state removes inhibitions, making the user unpredictable and fearless in battle.

Limits:
Full capabilities poorly understood without Trigger enhancement. Intelligence regression removes tactical thinking and leaves user vulnerable to cunning opponents. Size may restrict mobility in confined spaces. Trigger dependency suggests instability.

Additional Notes:
True nature unclear—whether transformation is natural or Trigger-induced.

cardPool.title: Pliabody
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Pliabody

Description:
A transformation quirk that allows the user to stretch and flatten their body at will, granting superhuman flexibility and elasticity. The user's body becomes malleable, enabling them to compress, extend, and reshape themselves.

Functions/Applications:
Combat evasion through body deformation. Restraint of opponents by wrapping around limbs or torso. Navigation through tight spaces and confined areas. Enhanced grappling and unconventional positioning.

Limits:
Cannot stretch beyond 2-3 times normal body length before losing structural integrity. Extreme flattening reduces combat effectiveness and increases vulnerability. Requires conscious control—panic or unconsciousness reverts the body to normal. Sharp, piercing weapons bypass the flexibility advantage.

Additional Notes:
Most effective in rescue and reconnaissance scenarios.

cardPool.title: Pointer
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Pointer

Description:
A navigational quirk that allows the user to locate people, places, and things they're searching for. The user's limbs act as directional indicators, pointing toward the desired target with accuracy.

Functions/Applications:
The user must spin in place to activate the quirk. Once activated, their arms and legs point toward up to three different targets or directions. Useful for tracking, navigation, rescue operations, and locating objectives in combat or exploration.

Limits:
The user can only point toward three directions at once. Activation requires a full spin, making it vulnerable during combat. The quirk only works for things the user consciously seeks—vague searches won't function.

Additional Notes:
Best used for preparation and scouting rather than active combat. The spinning requirement makes this quirk tactically predictable.

cardPool.title: Poison Gas
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Poison Gas

Description:
Takeshi Bushijima continuously generates toxic fog from his body that causes illness in those who breathe it. If unreleased, poison accumulates dangerously within him, eventually poisoning his own body if buildup exceeds critical limits.

Functions/Applications:
Creates noxious clouds to incapacitate enemies through inhalation. Can be withheld temporarily to protect bystanders, though prolonged retention damages the user. The gas is highly flammable and ignites easily when exposed to combustion.

Limits:
Generates involuntarily with no on-off switch—the user must periodically release toxins or suffer severe health degradation. Unusable in crowded areas without harming innocents. Combustion destroys the gas entirely. Effectiveness depends on accumulated toxin levels.

cardPool.title: Poltergeist
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Poltergeist

Description:
A telekinetic Quirk that grants the user the ability to mentally manipulate objects and people within close proximity. The user can exert precise control over multiple targets simultaneously.

Functions/Applications:
The user can lift and move objects to barrage opponents, restrain or manipulate people through telekinetic force, and create coordinated movement patterns. This Quirk excels at area control and multi-target offense.

Limits:
The maximum weight the user can manipulate is approximately that of a single adult human (roughly 62 kg or 137 lbs). The Quirk only functions on objects and people in close proximity to the user. The precise range limitation and maximum object count remain unclear.

Additional Notes:
Poltergeist requires significant mental focus and control to manage multiple targets effectively.

cardPool.title: Polygraph
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Polygraph

Description:
Allows the user to detect truth and falsehood in a target's words through direct physical contact. Green-yellow lightning sparks from the user's hands and around the touched target, revealing speech authenticity.

Functions/Applications:
Interrogation and investigation of suspects or witnesses. Detection of deception in negotiations. Verification of claims during combat by maintaining contact with the target.

Limits:
Requires unbroken physical contact to function. Vulnerable to technicalities and precise wording; targets can bypass the Quirk by speaking truths from their perspective, even if factually incorrect. Cannot detect lies about intentions, only spoken falsehoods.

Additional Notes:
Most effective in controlled environments where physical contact can be maintained.

cardPool.title: Pop Off
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Pop Off

Description:
The user produces sticky spheres from their scalp that can be plucked painlessly and regrow instantly. These spheres adhere to any surface except the user's own body. Water does not diminish their adhesive properties.

Functions/Applications:
Launch spheres as projectiles to restrain opponents or bind weapons. Construct ground traps and obstacle courses. Use spheres as bouncing platforms to traverse terrain or scale surfaces. Chain spheres together as whip-like weapons for medium-range combat.

Limits:
Adhesive strength depends on the user's health and physical condition, lasting hours to a full day when well-rested but weakening when exhausted. Rapid sphere removal causes scalp bleeding and limits sustained output. Spheres do not stick to the user. The ability requires close proximity and is unsuitable for long-distance engagement.

cardPool.title: Power
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Power

Description:
Power allows the user to accumulate tremendous raw strength within their body, enabling feats of extraordinary physical force. The user can generate enough force to demolish reinforced concrete structures and overpower formidable opponents through sheer physical might.

Functions/Applications:
The user can deliver devastating melee attacks capable of destroying architecture and terrain. When combined with other Quirks, Power amplifies combat effectiveness, allowing users to manipulate or displace large objects and enemies with ease.

Limits:
Power is purely physical strength with no range or area-of-effect capabilities. It requires direct physical contact to be effective and offers no defensive properties beyond durability gained through muscle buildup. The Quirk provides no speed enhancement or special mobility advantages.

cardPool.title: Power Stock
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Power Stock

Description:
A meta ability that stockpiles raw power and speed through training and physical cultivation. The user can release accumulated energy in devastating bursts. Originally designed for users with fragile bodies, it grows exponentially stronger when transferred between users, with each successor building upon previous generations' stockpiled strength.

Functions/Applications:
Users channel accumulated power into explosive bursts of strength and speed beyond normal capability. The quirk strengthens with each transfer to a new user, creating a compounding effect. Users can apply power selectively to specific limbs or across their entire body. With training, users can combine Power Stock with other quirks to exceed normal limitations.

Limits:
Power Stock requires extensive training to safely control; excessive output causes severe injury.

cardPool.title: Propagation
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Propagation

Description:
The user can grow and duplicate body parts across their form, multiplying them at will. Power scales proportionally with duplicates—three duplicates yield triple strength. Pairs dangerously with regenerative abilities, allowing fusion of duplicate cells into smaller, independent entities.

Functions/Applications:
Duplicate limbs for enhanced striking force and combat versatility. Create fused composite forms by merging multiple body duplicates. Generate independent mini-entities from duplicate cells capable of autonomous action. Stack duplicates for exponential power increases.

Limits:
Power gain is linear and dependent on number of duplicates. Requires significant biological mass to sustain multiple duplicates; overextension causes resource depletion. Mini-entities are individually weaker and vulnerable to dispersal.

cardPool.title: Quad Arms
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Quad Arms

Description:
Grants the user a second pair of functional arms, creating four limbs total. The extra appendages are fully capable and proportional to the user's body, enabling simultaneous multi-tasking and enhanced physical combat capability.

Functions/Applications:
Wield multiple weapons or tools simultaneously; perform complex manual tasks at double speed; execute advanced grappling and striking combinations that single-armed opponents cannot defend against; gain positional advantage through increased attack angles.

Limits:
Requires conscious control of all four arms—divided attention reduces combat effectiveness. Strength is distributed across four limbs rather than concentrated. Standard armor and clothing become cumbersome or unusable.

Additional Notes:
Best utilized by users trained in hand-to-hand combat.

cardPool.title: Queen Beam
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Queen Beam

Description:
The user projects a straight-travelling beam of pure energy from their face, accompanied by a pink heart symbol. The beam travels in a direct line and can be consciously cancelled mid-flight after release.

Functions/Applications:
Offensive ranged attacks with reliable accuracy. The cancellation ability allows tactical repositioning or mercy strikes. Useful for combat at medium-to-long distances without physical contact.

Limits:
Beam travels only in straight lines with no homing capability. User must maintain line of sight to cancel the effect. Range and intensity appear modest compared to more destructive quirks.

Additional Notes:
Manifests at primary school age, suggesting relatively low power output. The heart symbol is a consistent visual marker of activation. Best suited for precise targeting rather than area damage or defense.

cardPool.title: Queen Bee
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Queen Bee

Description:
A parasitic bee colony invading a host's body through the eye socket, burrowing into the brain to seize control. The queen connects neurologically to her host, commanding their body, actions, and Quirk. A swarm nests behind a medical patch on the host's left eye.

Functions/Applications:
Host possession and puppet control; bee swarm surveillance; injectable substance delivery via stinger-syringes; temporary Quirk absorption through host blood; neural disruption and signal hijacking; mass area coverage with coordinated deployment. A fused personality emerges blending hive instinct with host consciousness.

Limits:
Destroys host's left eye permanently. Trigger drugs weaken the queen's mental grip, allowing host consciousness to resurface. A single bee can become new queen if original dies, requiring time to rebuild and find a fresh host.

cardPool.title: Rabbit
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Rabbit

Description:
A transformation quirk granting rabbit-like anatomy and heightened animal instincts. The user develops functional rabbit features including long ears, powerful hind legs, and a fluffy tail, along with enhanced sensory perception and survival awareness.

Functions/Applications:
Enhanced hearing and smell enable precise threat detection. Powerful leg muscles allow rapid bouncing movement and devastating kick/stomp attacks. A single ground stomp generates wind pressure strong enough to disperse fire. Rabbit instincts provide automatic danger awareness and tactical advantage in combat.

Limits:
Power is primarily lower-body focused, limiting upper-body combat versatility. Enhanced senses can be overwhelmed by sensory overload. Bouncing mobility is restricted in tight spaces or difficult terrain.

cardPool.title: Radio Waves
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Radio Waves

Description:
An electromagnetic quirk that emits radio wave pulses to disrupt electrical systems and communications. Black lightning with purple outlines crackles around the user's arms and palms when activated. Originally stolen by All For One, it grants control over technology, transmits waveforms for remote communication, and commands Nomu creatures.

Functions/Applications:
Disrupts and disables electrical appliances and communicators within range. Transmits waveforms to awaken and command Nomu creatures. Strong enough to parry attacks and push enemies back. Can combine with other quirks like Air Cannon for wide-range blasts that disable infrastructure and communications simultaneously.

Limits:
User requires knowledge and experience to issue precise commands through waveforms. Range and power scale with mastery.

cardPool.title: Razor Sharp
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Razor Sharp

Description:
The user generates sharp blades of varying shapes and sizes from any part of their body. These blades are composed of an unknown material strong enough to cut steel and withstand explosions, serving as both offensive and defensive tools.

Functions/Applications:
Blades can be produced from forearms for slashing, feet for ground combat, or any body part as needed. The user controls blade geometry and deployment in real-time, allowing simultaneous offense and defense.

Limits:
Blade generation requires conscious effort and energy expenditure; sustained combat depletes stamina. The user must remain within melee range. Blades cannot be thrown or separated from the body.

Additional Notes:
Best suited for close-quarters combat specialists. The quirk's strength lies in tactical flexibility and unpredictable blade placement.

cardPool.title: Reflect
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Reflect

Description:
An always-active Quirk that absorbs incoming energy—physical or ranged—and rebounds it back at the attacker in a spiraling wave. The user's skin glows blue during use. However, the Quirk reflects all contact indiscriminately, preventing any physical touch and rendering the user blind due to light reflection, necessitating special eye masks to see.

Functions/Applications:
Automatic defense against melee and ranged attacks without conscious effort. Can redirect reflected energy through technological augmentation to change trajectory or fuel flight. Works best when combined with stationary positioning and external firepower.

Limits:
Drains stamina proportionally to reflected energy strength; sustained barrages quickly deplete reserves. Cannot be disabled, making all physical contact impossible—eliminating emotional bonds and social connection.

cardPool.title: Rewind
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Rewind

Description:
A rare mutant Quirk allowing the user to reverse a living being's body to a previous physical state. Activation causes a small horn on the forehead to grow and glow brightly, affecting all living creatures in contact or nearby. The power can theoretically rewind targets back to non-existence, making it exceptionally dangerous.

Functions/Applications:
Restores injured bodies to pre-injury states, heals wounds and broken limbs, reverses genetic modifications, and can restore erased Quirks. User can consciously control which targets are affected through training. Effective range requires close proximity or physical contact.

Limits:
Only affects living things; cannot rewind objects or non-organic matter. Requires accumulation of "Rewind Energy" to activate; once used, the horn shrinks and must recharge.

cardPool.title: Rifle
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Rifle

Description:
Kaina extrudes a functional rifle from her right elbow that fires ammunition crafted from her own hair. The weapon operates silently using organic muscle and bone sinew propulsion rather than gunpowder. She manifests a flesh tendril scope for precision targeting and can increase output power at the cost of jamming risk.

Functions/Applications:
Fire custom hair-bullets up to 3km with superior penetration and no audible report. Mold hair into specialized rounds: hollow-point, tracking, or curved trajectory variants. Bullets are reusable, caseless, and maintain integrity through impact. Deploy flesh scope tendril for enhanced accuracy at range.

Limits:
Hair length determines ammunition capacity; short hair restricts sustained fire. Individual round loading creates reload delays exploitable by close-range opponents.

cardPool.title: Rivet
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Rivet

Description:
A transformation quirk that enables the user to generate metallic rivet-like growths from their arms. These hardened projectiles can be expelled with force or extended as a defensive barrier.

Functions/Applications:
The user can launch rivets as high-velocity projectiles for ranged attacks or extend them along their arms for melee enhancement. The growths provide armor-like protection and enable climbing or anchoring.

Limits:
Rivet generation is limited to the arms and requires physical exertion. The growths deplete stamina with each use and cannot be regenerated indefinitely. Once expelled, rivets take time to regrow. The quirk offers no protection against abilities that bypass physical defense.

Additional Notes:
This is a straightforward combat quirk suited for aggressive fighters.

cardPool.title: Rocket Thrust
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Rocket Thrust

Description:
A ranged combat quirk that enables the user to detach and launch their right fist as a projectile at extreme velocities. The fist travels straight toward its target before returning to reattach.

Functions/Applications:
The user can fire their right fist repeatedly to strike distant enemies, break obstacles, or perform surprise attacks. The fist launches at variable distances with considerable impact force.

Limits:
The user loses right arm functionality while the fist is in flight and cannot relaunch until it reattaches. The projectile travels only in straight lines with no mid-flight direction changes. Overuse causes arm fatigue and joint strain.

Additional Notes:
Most effective when combined with tactical positioning to prevent close-range vulnerability. Excels in one-on-one combat but becomes predictable in prolonged engagements.

cardPool.title: Rupture
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Rupture

Description:
Rupture grants the user the ability to detonate their own body or body parts at will, creating explosive force and sending fragments outward. The user controls the detonation's timing and intensity.

Functions/Applications:
The user can detonate localized body sections or their entire form to damage enemies in a radius around them. When combined with transformation Quirks like Liquification, Rupture becomes more lethal, transforming the user's body into explosive projectiles.

Limits:
Detonation causes severe self-damage and requires recovery time. The explosion radius is limited to the user's physical size, and repeated use drains stamina rapidly. The Quirk is purely offensive and cannot be used defensively.

cardPool.title: Saber
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Saber

Description:
The user can transform portions of their body into sharp, sword-shaped appendages at will. These bladed limbs are hard and durable, capable of cutting through most materials.

Functions/Applications:
Transform arms, legs, or other body parts into blade-like weapons for close combat; execute powerful slashing attacks; penetrate armor or barriers; position multiple bladed appendages offensively.

Limits:
Transformation is localized to specific body parts; transformed sections lose fine motor control; transformation takes a brief moment; extensive use causes fatigue; blades can be dulled by extremely hard materials.

Additional Notes:
This Quirk favors aggressive melee fighters and direct confrontation. The user sacrifices mobility and precision for raw cutting power.

cardPool.title: Sandstorm
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Sandstorm

Description:
The user transforms their upper body into manipulable sand, gaining a fluid, shapeshifting form. This grants enhanced physical adaptability and the ability to reform after damage, making them difficult to restrain or grapple with effectively.

Functions/Applications:
Transform limbs into sand constructs for attacking and defending. Manipulate sand to shield against strikes, create barriers, or restrain opponents. Swing sand densely to repel flames and projectiles. Exploit fluidity to slip free from contact-dependent Quirks.

Limits:
No defense against area-of-effect or wide-radius attacks. Cannot protect lower body or head. Sand form is vulnerable to blunt force trauma and may scatter under extreme pressure. Rapid shape-shifting drains stamina.

Additional Notes:
Most effective against contact-dependent Quirks and single-target attacks.

cardPool.title: Scalemail
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Scalemail

Description:
The user's body generates sharp, dark red armored scales covering their skin for enhanced defense and strength. Activation causes bleeding as scales rupture through skin, making each deployment painful.

Functions/Applications:
Deploy scales across the body for increased durability against strikes. Scales grant moderate strength enhancement for harder hits and impact resistance. Can be selectively activated on specific areas or full-body coverage.

Limits:
Scales shatter under sustained high-force impact, particularly powerful punches or combined attacks. Generating armor causes physical pain and bleeding each time activated. Repeated use risks severe blood loss and exhaustion from skin rupturing.

Additional Notes:
This Quirk was stolen and implanted by All For One, suggesting it may perform differently in its original owner's body.

cardPool.title: Scales
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Scales

Description:
The user generates hard, sharp reptilian scales across their body for protection and ranged attacks. Scale production requires adequate collagen and calcium intake. The scales are sharp enough to cut through vines and damage metal.

Functions/Applications:
Deploy scales as full-body armor for damage mitigation. Launch individual scales as cutting projectiles at medium to long range. Switch between melee and ranged combat based on threat level. Scales can be stored in specialized gauntlets for rapid-fire projectile attacks.

Limits:
Scales break or dislodge easily when struck with sufficient force, providing inferior protection compared to hardening-based quirks. Continuous production depletes collagen and calcium reserves, requiring dietary supplementation. Projectile accuracy depends on user skill and line of sight.

cardPool.title: Scanning
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Scanning

Description:
A detection-based Quirk that grants the user the ability to identify and analyze other individuals' Quirks and power levels. The user perceives targets through a heat signature-like visual overlay, revealing their Quirk nature and current strength output.

Functions/Applications:
Identify active Quirks in nearby targets. Measure relative power levels and detect power surges. Create tactical advantages in combat by understanding enemy abilities. Track multiple targets simultaneously.

Limits:
Cannot identify Quirks without line of sight. Effectiveness decreases with distance and obstructions. Cannot reveal Quirk limitations or mechanics, only general power tier. Sustained scanning causes mental fatigue.

Additional Notes:
Originally stolen from an unknown hero.

cardPool.title: Scatter
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Scatter

Description:
A stolen Quirk that splits and multiplies projectiles mid-flight, expanding coverage area and destructive potential. Transforms focused attacks into devastating dispersed barrages.

Functions/Applications:
Multiplies incoming or outgoing projectiles into numerous smaller ones across a wider radius. Increases effective range and impact area of long-range attacks. Can be combined with other Quirks like Reflect to redirect and amplify enemy fire. Effective for overwhelming defenses and area denial.

Limits:
Requires projectiles to function—cannot create attacks from nothing. Multiplied projectiles are individually weaker than the original. Does not enhance melee combat. Effectiveness diminishes against mobile targets. Cannot be used continuously without a source of projectiles to split.

cardPool.title: Serpentress
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Serpentress

Description:
The user possesses three living serpents integrated into their hair as biological extensions. These snakes possess heightened sensory perception, allowing detection of hidden targets and disaster victims beyond normal human limits.

Functions/Applications:
The snakes scout ahead and sense concealed individuals or survivors in dangerous environments. They enable rapid victim location during rescue operations and provide reconnaissance advantages in stealth situations. The snakes move independently under the user's control while remaining part of their body.

Limits:
The snakes cannot be separated from the user's body for extended periods. Their offensive capabilities remain unclear. Detection range is constrained by sensory reach and cannot pierce dense barriers. The user cannot operate effectively while unconscious or restrained at the head.

cardPool.title: Shame
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Shame

Description:
A transformation Quirk that amplifies physical power proportionally to the user's embarrassment level. Power peaks during extreme public humiliation or exposure.

Functions/Applications:
The user can strip and expose themselves to trigger maximum embarrassment and unlock full combat potential. Shame-induced boosts enhance strength, speed, and durability. Most effective in populated areas where witnesses amplify mortification.

Limits:
Requires public presence and audience to generate sufficient embarrassment; ineffective in isolation or without witnesses. Power weakens when the user feels no shame. Sustained use causes extreme psychological distress. Impractical for stealth or covert missions.

Additional Notes:
User must overcome natural inhibitions to activate effectively. Power scales with public observation and ridicule intensity.

cardPool.title: Shield
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Shield

Description:
The user manifests stone-like hexagonal shields from their body, constructed from rapidly multiplying geometric layers. These shields are exceptionally durable and can be wielded defensively or offensively with sharp, cutting edges. The user can detach and throw shields as ranged weapons or keep them anchored for defense.

Functions/Applications:
Create shields of variable size and shape by controlling hexagon multiplication; detach shields to throw as mid-to-long-range projectiles; stack small shields on legs and torso for passive armor; extend shield geometry to protect multiple allies; use shields offensively by driving sharpened edges into targets, then detach to cause internal damage.

Limits:
Shield durability can be overwhelmed by sufficiently powerful attacks.

cardPool.title: Shoulder-Mounted Jets
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Shoulder-Mounted Jets

Description:
Four retractable jet boosters on the upper back enable high-speed flight with powerful thrust for rapid acceleration and aerial movement, though sustained control requires significant effort.

Functions/Applications:
Grants speed-boosted flight for traversal and aerial combat positioning. Jets deploy or retract at will. Allows quick escapes or pursuit of airborne targets. Works with other physical quirks to stabilize mid-air maneuvers.

Limits:
Flight is difficult to maneuver precisely without support quirks. Requires arms or other abilities to maintain balance and directional control during extended flight. Consumes stamina with prolonged use. Cannot be used while fully restrained or immobilized.

Additional Notes:
Most effective when paired with stabilizing or manipulative abilities.

cardPool.title: Size
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Size

Description:
A transmutation quirk allowing the user to alter physical dimensions of inanimate objects through tactile contact. Activation requires pressing five fingertips together, causing targeted objects to glow pink and shift to desired sizes. The quirk is precise and reliable on non-living matter.

Functions/Applications:
Resize weapons, tools, or environmental objects for tactical advantage. Enlarge barriers for defense or shrink obstacles for passage. Create size disparities to confuse opponents or manipulate terrain. Conceal large items by reducing dimensions.

Limits:
Cannot affect living organisms, people, animals, or plants. Requires deliberate hand positioning, unsuitable for rapid-fire use. Objects return to original size when contact breaks. No stated limit on size range, though extreme changes require more concentration.

cardPool.title: Slice
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Slice

Description:
The user can move, harden, and sharpen their own hair at will, transforming it into a versatile weapon and tool. Hair can be weaponized as blades, fired as projectiles, or used defensively as shields and mobility aids.

Functions/Applications:
Offensive strikes using hardened hair as cutting blades; launching hair strands as high-speed piercing projectiles; defensive barriers by interweaving hair into shields; parrying attacks; mobility enhancement using hair locks as climbing aids.

Limits:
Hair is vulnerable to corrosive substances like acid. Reduced hair length decreases combat effectiveness and range. Hair cannot be regrown mid-combat. Requires conscious control to harden and shape, limiting reaction speed in surprise situations.

Additional Notes:
Slice excels in versatile close-to-mid-range combat with strong defensive utility.

cardPool.title: Sloshed
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Sloshed

Description:
An aura-based Quirk that induces severe vertigo and loss of equilibrium in nearby targets, simulating intoxication. Affected individuals struggle with balance and coordination.

Functions/Applications:
The user can selectively target chosen individuals while maintaining ally immunity. They can remain concealed while the Quirk manifests. The effect persists briefly even if the user loses consciousness.

Limits:
The Quirk requires proximity to function. Targets with prior exposure can gradually build resistance. Strong-willed individuals may resist through concentrated effort.

Additional Notes:
This Quirk excels at area denial and disrupting enemy coordination. It works best against unprepared opponents. Users should employ stealth and positioning before enemies adapt.

cardPool.title: Smile
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Smile

Description:
A vision-based incapacitation Quirk that forces targets into uncontrollable laughter lasting two hours. Activation requires displaying teeth directly to a victim or via real-time reflection. The laughter immobilizes targets, leaving them barely able to move or fight.

Functions/Applications:
Forces involuntary incapacitation through laughter; works on humans and machines. User can create distance advantage using holographic projectors. Some strong-willed individuals can partially resist but remain physically immobilized.

Limits:
Ineffective if target's vision is obscured or blocked; limited range without technological aid. Requires direct line of sight or real-time visual transmission. Does not work on those who cannot see the user's teeth display.

Additional Notes:
Two-hour duration enables escape or objective completion.

cardPool.title: Smoke
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Smoke

Description:
The user expels irritating pink smoke from holes across their body, creating dense screens that obscure vision and cause eye irritation. An antenna atop their head can fire concentrated smoke bursts directly at targets.

Functions/Applications:
Generate thick smoke barriers for concealment and escape; launch focused smoke attacks via antenna to distract or disorient enemies; exploit reduced visibility to mount surprise attacks or flee confrontations.

Limits:
Smoke disperses naturally over time and cannot persist indefinitely; ineffective against opponents who don't rely on sight; requires the antenna to be unobstructed for direct attacks; heavily dependent on environmental factors like wind.

Additional Notes:
Primarily a utility Quirk favored for evasion and misdirection rather than direct combat. Most effective in urban or enclosed environments.

cardPool.title: Smokescreen
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Smokescreen

Description:
The user generates thick purple smoke from their body that spreads across wide areas to obscure vision and disorient opponents. Enhanced through One For All's stockpiling, making it denser and more expansive than the original version.

Functions/Applications:
Creates visual obstruction to hide movements, catch enemies by surprise, or guide them toward desired locations. Can be combined with other abilities for tactical advantage. Useful for reconnaissance and escape.

Limits:
No offensive damage capability. Loses effectiveness in humid or rainy environments. Powerful shockwaves dispel the smoke quickly. Overuse obscures the user's own vision and movement.

Additional Notes:
Most effective when deployed strategically in combination with other Quirks. Requires experience to control output and prevent self-hindrance.

cardPool.title: Snip Clip
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Snip Clip

Description:
The user can cut through nearly any material by placing it between their index and middle fingers, then performing a scissor motion. The cutting force is proportional to the user's strength and can sever solid objects like reinforced exoskeletons. Larger cuts are possible when material is positioned between the user's legs.

Functions/Applications:
Precision cutting of objects, armor, and structural materials. Can disable mechanical suits by severing limbs or joints. Works on organic and inorganic matter alike.

Limits:
The space between the user's fingers restricts what can be cut to thin or narrow objects. Larger items require repositioning between the legs, leaving the user vulnerable. The Quirk cannot cut beyond the user's physical reach. Effectiveness depends on strength and leverage.

cardPool.title: Soccer
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Soccer

Description:
Emperor Yotsuura's quirk grants superhuman soccer mastery, enabling flawless ball control in chaotic environments while executing other actions simultaneously. The user can kick with devastating force, weaponizing the ball into a dangerous projectile.

Functions/Applications:
Dribble through crowds without obstruction; execute complex maneuvers while performing other tasks; deliver powerful kicks that transform the ball into a projectile; maintain perfect spatial awareness during play.

Limits:
May not be a true Quirk but exceptional skill. Requires a ball to function offensively; useless without one. Power scaling and distance limitations unknown. Cannot function if unable to move freely.

Additional Notes:
Analysts dispute whether this is a supernatural ability or trained expertise.

cardPool.title: Softening
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Softening

Description:
Juzo Honenuki transforms solid objects into semi-liquid mud through touch, then reverts them with a second touch. Works on ice, metal, stone, and structures but not living beings. Softened materials trap and sink caught objects into treacherous terrain.

Functions/Applications:
Creates environmental traps by softening ground or structures that collapse when stepped on. Restricts enemy mobility. Allows Juzo to swim through softened material for rapid traversal or escape. Neutralizes solid-based attacks. Controls battle flow and enemy positioning.

Limits:
Cannot affect living organisms. Targets with propulsion abilities can escape traps. All softened objects revert if Juzo loses consciousness. Requires direct physical contact to activate and deactivate. Works best against mobility-dependent enemies.

cardPool.title: Solid Air
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Solid Air

Description:
The user solidifies air through breath to create floating constructs—walls, platforms, and barriers—that remain suspended without support. These barriers are soundproof, blocking voice-based abilities and external noise. Durability scales with lung capacity and training.

Functions/Applications:
Create defensive walls and platforms for mobility or protection. Form soundproof enclosures to contain or isolate targets. Shape constructs into complex forms by hand-shaping exhaled air. Adapt barriers to counter sound-dependent quirks.

Limits:
Remains breakable by sufficient physical force. Maximum construct size limited by lung capacity; prolonged use causes fatigue. Cannot create animated or mobile constructs. Requires conscious breath control; suffocation disables the quirk.

cardPool.title: Somnambulist
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Somnambulist

Description:
The user exudes a sleep-inducing lavender-purple aroma that renders targets unconscious. The fragrance is more potent against males than females. Anyone breathing sufficient amounts falls into deep slumber, making close combat hazardous for opponents.

Functions/Applications:
Release aroma passively or actively to incapacitate enemies at medium range. Use fans to spread and direct the fragrance with greater accuracy and distance. Effective crowd control for subduing opponents. Can be concentrated for stronger effect on resistant targets.

Limits:
Requires exposed skin; tight clothing reduces effectiveness. Opponents with air-filtering masks avoid the aroma. Less effective against female targets unless concentrated. Low ventilation improves effectiveness; open spaces reduce potency. Breath-holding provides temporary resistance.

cardPool.title: Soul
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Soul

Description:
Soul manifests as Pino, a small pink bird-like creature bonded to the user's soul. Pino embodies the user's true thoughts and feelings, making deception impossible—lies create visible disconnects between words and actions, revealing genuine intent.

Functions/Applications:
Pino can perform independent tasks like retrieving objects or creating distractions. The user can exploit Soul's truth-telling nature through feints, where Pino's honest reactions contradict false statements to confuse opponents. Pino acts autonomously based on subconscious desires, even when the user is incapacitated.

Limits:
The user cannot lie effectively, limiting deception. Physical injury or blood loss weakens Pino temporarily. Pino's small size limits combat capability. The user's emotional state affects Pino's visibility and strength, creating vulnerability.

cardPool.title: Spatial Excursion
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Spatial Excursion

Description:
Allows the user to freely manipulate the position and movement of objects and people within a spatial field, bypassing gravitational constraints. Objects can be repositioned, suspended, or propelled without physical contact.

Functions/Applications:
Reposition allies and enemies in combat; suspend falling objects or people mid-air; create spatial puzzles by rearranging environmental elements; with Overmodification, control larger areas and heavier structures including fortifications.

Limits:
Range and control capacity are finite at baseline level. Overmodification expands these limits but requires significant power. Quirk deactivates if user is rendered unconscious or incapacitated. Cannot affect users with certain defensive Quirks that negate external manipulation.

cardPool.title: Spear Hand Missiles
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Spear Hand Missiles

Description:
The user's fingers are compact, reloadable missiles that detach and launch as projectiles, making them a living ranged weapon system with rapid-fire capability.

Functions/Applications:
Fire finger missiles in quick succession for suppressive fire or focused attacks. Projectiles stun targets or cause injury on direct hits. Effective for mid-range combat and covering retreats.

Limits:
Flight paths are erratic and unpredictable, making accuracy difficult without training. Projectiles are easily blocked by defensive barriers with minimal damage. User is vulnerable while reloading and cannot use hands for melee combat while firing. Fingers must regenerate between engagements.

Additional Notes:
Best suited for aggressive combatants who overwhelm opponents with volume of fire rather than precision.

cardPool.title: Spearlike Bones
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Spearlike Bones

Description:
The user generates cone-shaped bone spears from any part of their body, including the mouth, jaw, and limbs. These spears are sharp, hard, and capable of piercing flesh with ease. The user can control the size, length, and quantity of spears produced.

Functions/Applications:
Deploy spears as melee weapons or ranged projectiles. Generate multiple spears for area attacks. Manifest spears from unexpected body parts to bypass defenses. Scale spear dimensions for different tactical situations.

Limits:
Spear generation requires conscious activation and focus. Extended or massive production drains stamina. Separated spears are brittle and can be destroyed or caught. Ineffective against superior defensive abilities or projectile neutralization.

Additional Notes:
Initially manifests as uncontrolled hardened growths until mastered.

cardPool.title: Spotted Seal
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Spotted Seal

Description:
The user embodies physical and biological capabilities of a spotted seal, granting amphibious prowess. Enhanced strength and agility function equally on land and in water, while aquatic abilities far exceed human limits.

Functions/Applications:
Enhanced strength enables melee combat and environmental manipulation. Amphibious agility allows rapid evasion. Underwater echolocation maps areas and detects threats. Prolonged breath-holding and 1500-meter diving access deep locations. High-pitched vocalizations communicate across distances and water.

Limits:
Echolocation functions only underwater. Enhanced attributes diminish in extreme temperatures or toxic environments. Extended land use without water immersion causes strain. Sensitive hearing creates vulnerability to sound-based attacks. Cannot breathe underwater.

cardPool.title: Spray Art
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Spray Art

Description:
The user generates clouds of colorful spray paint that induce mild hallucinations in anyone caught within them. By wielding spray paint cans, they release massive paint clouds similar to smoke that linger until deliberately dispersed or the user is incapacitated.

Functions/Applications:
Create disorienting illusions to confuse enemies and obscure vision. Control cloud duration and deployment area. Use hallucinations to separate groups or create tactical advantages in combat. Useful for escape, misdirection, or area denial.

Limits:
The user must have spray paint cans available to activate the Quirk. Hallucinations are only mild, not complete mental incapacity. Clouds dissipate if the user is immobilized or unconscious. The Quirk affects allies as well as enemies. Effectiveness diminishes against those with strong mental resistance.

cardPool.title: Spring
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Spring

Description:
Spring grants the user the ability to imbue objects and surfaces with elasticity, making them bounce with enhanced recoil. The effect can be applied to inanimate objects and environmental terrain, creating unpredictable rebounds.

Functions/Applications:
The user can make floors, walls, weapons, or projectiles bounce with increased force. This allows for ricocheting attacks, creating springy platforms for mobility, or deflecting incoming strikes. The bouncy effect persists until the user chooses to revoke it.

Limits:
Spring cannot be applied to living beings or organic matter. The bouncy effect requires prior contact or proximity to activate. Overuse or applying the quirk to too many objects simultaneously may cause fatigue. Intensity and duration are limited by the user's concentration.

cardPool.title: Springlike Limbs
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Springlike Limbs

Description:
The user's muscles coil and contract like mechanical springs, storing kinetic force and releasing it explosively. Black lightning with red outlines may crackle around the limbs. This Quirk transforms the body into a living coil mechanism.

Functions/Applications:
Launch objects or people with devastating force at close range. Propel the user through the air for rapid movement. Amplify other Quirks when combined, particularly emitter-type abilities. Use as a solo combat tool or force multiplier.

Limits:
Requires close proximity for maximum effect. Stored force must be released deliberately and cannot be maintained indefinitely without fatigue. Effectiveness depends on muscle condition and stamina. Works best augmenting other attacks.

Additional Notes:
Originally stolen by All For One and used by Tomura Shigaraki.

cardPool.title: Squirmy Fingers
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Squirmy Fingers

Description:
The user gains supernatural control over their fingers, allowing them to bend and manipulate them in any direction with perfect precision. This grants exceptional dexterity and fine motor control far beyond normal human capability.

Functions/Applications:
Craft intricate mechanisms and detailed work with unmatched speed and accuracy. Manipulate small objects with flawless control. Create complex costumes and advanced equipment. Pick locks or perform delicate assembly tasks impossible for ordinary hands.

Limits:
Only affects the user's fingers and requires direct physical contact with objects. Provides no offensive combat capability. The user acknowledges it as "barely useful" in direct conflict situations.

Additional Notes:
Best suited for crafting, engineering, and support roles rather than combat.

cardPool.title: Static
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Static

Description:
By rubbing their body to generate friction, the user accumulates electrical charge similar to natural static electricity. This allows them to discharge electrical currents from their body in controlled bursts.

Functions/Applications:
The user builds up electrical energy through deliberate friction, then releases it as a shock for stunning, repelling, or disorienting targets. Useful for short-range combat and defense.

Limits:
Requires active charging time through rubbing—cannot generate charge instantly. Output damage is relatively weak and unsuitable for heavy combat or armored foes. Extended use causes fatigue. Wet conditions severely diminish effectiveness.

Additional Notes:
This quirk demands tactical patience and preparation. Most effective in dry environments against unarmored opponents.

cardPool.title: Steel
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Steel

Description:
The user transforms their entire body into steel, becoming a nigh-impenetrable living weapon. The steel form dramatically increases physical strength to superhuman levels while providing resistance to physical damage, extreme cold, and moderate heat. The user's body takes on a metallic sheen, turning reddish when exposed to flames.

Functions/Applications:
Steel allows the user to withstand bullets, blades, falling debris, and extreme cold without injury. Enhanced strength enables breaking through obstacles and delivering powerful strikes. The user can serve as a human shield for allies. Iron intake extends duration and potency of activation.

Limits:
Prolonged use causes iron fatigue, gradually reducing hardness until deactivation is necessary. Steel has a hardness ceiling that cannot be improved through training.

cardPool.title: Stiffening
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Stiffening

Description:
By touching and kneading objects with both hands, the user hardens any non-living material to extreme durability—transforming soft items like rubber into concrete-hard substances.

Functions/Applications:
Reinforces projectiles, tools, and structural materials for combat or construction. Works synergistically with boomerang-type attacks. Can harden multiple objects simultaneously through hand manipulation.

Limits:
Cannot affect living tissue. Hardened objects remain vulnerable to acids and corrosive substances. Requires direct physical contact and kneading motion. Viscous materials can trap hardened items.

Additional Notes:
Most effective when paired with throwing weapons or ranged combat. User must use both hands to activate the Quirk, limiting simultaneous actions. The harder the original material, the greater the end durability achieved.

cardPool.title: Stock
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Stock

Description:
A storage-based quirk that allows the user to absorb incoming attacks and convert them into physical lumps on their back. These stored attacks can be released at will during combat for counteroffensive capability.

Functions/Applications:
The user absorbs incoming attacks, which manifest as lumps on their back. When needed, a lump detaches and floats toward the user's face before releasing the absorbed attack at an opponent. This enables defense-turned-offense strategies using an enemy's own force.

Limits:
Storage capacity is limited by the number of lumps the user can grow on their back. The floating lump requires time to position before releasing, making it vulnerable to interruption. Attacks must make direct contact to be absorbed.

Additional Notes:
Stock excels at turning defensive situations into offensive advantages.

cardPool.title: Storage
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Storage

Description:
A containment-based Quirk allowing the user to store objects and living creatures inside their body in suspended state. Multiple specimens can be carried simultaneously and released at will as tactical reinforcements or distractions.

Functions/Applications:
Store inorganic objects, living creatures, and biological entities within body cavity without harm. Release stored contents instantly during combat for rapid reinforcements while engaging primary targets.

Limits:
Storage capacity has an upper threshold. Retrieving items requires conscious activation and cannot be forced or stolen. Storing living creatures risks alerting allies through sounds or movements. Size limitations likely restrict very large organisms.

Additional Notes:
Ideal for surprise tactics and overwhelming opponents through numerical advantage.

cardPool.title: Stress
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Stress

Description:
Converts negative emotions—anger, dread, frustration, and stress—into raw physical power. The user's body swells with black markings spreading across enhanced areas, granting increased strength, resilience, and size proportional to emotional intensity. Can enhance individual limbs or the entire body.

Functions/Applications:
Selective limb enhancement for precision strikes or full-body transformation for overwhelming power. At high intensity (80%+ "Liberation"), manifests as a hulking monster form capable of releasing concentrated stress energy projectiles. Scales with opponent threat level; user can modulate enhancement percentage for efficient power usage.

Limits:
Positive emotions—peace, relief, confidence—diminish stress levels and weaken the ability.

cardPool.title: Strongarm
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Strongarm

Description:
The user's shoulders rotate at superhuman speeds, enabling rapid, devastating punches in quick succession. Each strike carries immense force capable of wearing down defensive opponents through sheer impact.

Functions/Applications:
Rapid-fire punching combinations with extreme velocity and power. Penetrates defenses through accumulated strike trauma. Effective for close-range combat against armored or durable opponents.

Limits:
Usable for only seconds before muscle fatigue sets in. Cannot break absolute barrier-type Quirks. Shoulder joints require recovery time between uses.

Additional Notes:
Best suited for short, explosive engagements. User must manage stamina to avoid physical incapacity mid-combat.

cardPool.title: Sugar Rush
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Sugar Rush

Description:
By consuming sugar, Rikido multiplies his physical strength five-fold for three minutes per ten grams ingested. His body visibly bulks up during activation.

Functions/Applications:
Ideal for breaking through obstacles and overpowering opponents in direct combat. Rikido carries granulated sugar in belt pouches for quick activation mid-battle. His baking skills provide reliable sugar sources.

Limits:
Requires accessible sugar to activate. Activation causes severe hypoglycemia: lowered intelligence, reduced cognition, and lethargy during the boost. Cannot sustain beyond duration without additional sugar. Rikido becomes a straightforward brawler unable to execute complex strategies while empowered.

Additional Notes:
Rikido's weightlifting regimen maximizes his Quirk's potency.

cardPool.title: Suicide Bomb
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Suicide Bomb

Description:
A volatile Quirk that generates devastating explosions centered on the user's body. The ability creates massive destructive force capable of razing entire areas and can be triggered by will or external sources.

Functions/Applications:
Deploy large-scale area-denial explosions for combat. Functions as both offensive weapon and last-resort defensive measure. External triggers like intense heat can activate detonations involuntarily.

Limits:
The user is vulnerable to their own explosions and risks lethal self-damage. Fire-based Quirks that control external heat pose severe matchup disadvantages by risking accidental detonation. Outside-triggered detonations appear uncontrollable.

Additional Notes:
Extreme danger to user and environment. Most effective as last-stand tactic rather than sustained combat ability.

cardPool.title: Super Regeneration
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Super Regeneration

Description:
A rare artificially engineered Quirk enabling rapid regeneration of physical damage including severed limbs and catastrophic wounds at incredible speeds, making users exceptionally difficult to permanently disable through conventional injury.

Functions/Applications:
The user recovers from nearly any physical trauma—burns, lacerations, amputation, blunt force damage—as long as their brain remains active. Regeneration speed scales with physical condition. Allows survival from attacks that would instantly kill most combatants.

Limits:
Cannot heal pre-existing cauterized wounds, spiritual damage, or Quirk Factor damage. Requires active brain function; unconsciousness halts healing. Damage dealt faster than regeneration occurs will overwhelm the user. Complete incineration or molecular disintegration bypasses regeneration.

cardPool.title: Swan
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Swan

Description:
The user manifests two large, pristine white wings resembling those of a swan on their back. These wings enable aerial locomotion with grace and speed.

Functions/Applications:
Flight across distances and terrain. Enhanced mobility for escape, pursuit, or reconnaissance. Wings generate significant wind gusts when deployed.

Limits:
Flight requires the user to strip naked, as clothing weight prevents takeoff. Wings are vulnerable to damage during flight, leaving the user defenseless if injured mid-air.

Additional Notes:
The activation requirement makes the quirk impractical in combat or emergencies. Best suited for scouting or travel in private settings. The user's vulnerability while unclothed creates tactical disadvantages.

cardPool.title: Sword Kill
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Sword Kill

Description:
The user generates flexible, accordion-like swords from their arms and shoulders that extend and retract at will. When enhanced by Trigger, the Quirk produces up to six blades simultaneously, including from the mouth, and the user's face becomes serpentine and menacing.

Functions/Applications:
Deploy multiple melee weapons for combat versatility, defense, or crowd control. Extended blades allow mid-range strikes while maintaining close-quarters capability. Trigger enhancement multiplies offensive potential.

Limits:
Base form limited to two primary swords. Continuous blade generation taxes stamina. Trigger dependence creates vulnerability without enhancement and risk of addiction. Accordion flexibility reduces blade rigidity compared to solid weapons.

cardPool.title: Tape
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name: Tape

Description: The user's elbows function as biological tape dispensers, ejecting strong adhesive tape of variable length and thickness. The tape can support body weight and restrain opponents but remains breakable under extreme force. Continuous overuse causes dry skin irritation.

Functions/Applications: Fire tape strands for binding and immobilizing targets; swing or rappel using anchored tape; create traps and blockades; shoot multiple strands simultaneously; produce double-sided tape; craft improvised tools and masks; coordinate with allies for combos.

Limits: Tape supply is finite per cycle. Tape snaps under sufficient stress. Overuse causes skin degradation. User must manually cut tape to reset firing. Effectiveness reduced on non-adhesive surfaces.

Additional Notes: Most effective at medium range.

cardPool.title: Telekinesis
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Telekinesis

Description:
A mental power that allows the user to move and manipulate inanimate objects through force of will alone, without physical contact.

Functions/Applications:
Move objects across distances, create barriers or projectiles in combat, solve environmental puzzles, lift multiple items simultaneously.

Limits:
Only affects inanimate objects; cannot move living creatures or organic matter. Control weakens with larger or heavier objects. Requires concentration. Cannot be used while unconscious or mentally incapacitated.

Additional Notes:
Power scales significantly when enhanced through Overmodification. Versatility makes it effective in combat and utility, though output depends on user's mental fortitude and focus.

cardPool.title: Telepath
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Telepath

Description:
A one-way telepathic ability allowing the user to broadcast thoughts and messages directly into the minds of others. Can target single individuals or multiple people simultaneously across considerable distances.

Functions/Applications:
Send tactical instructions to allies during combat. Broadcast warnings or information across large areas. Distract enemies by projecting disorienting messages into their minds to create openings for attacks.

Limits:
Communication is strictly one-way; the user cannot hear thoughts or receive responses. Effective range is limited. Cannot force actions, only deliver messages. Overuse or contacting too many people simultaneously may cause mental strain.

Additional Notes:
Highly effective for battlefield coordination and psychological tactics. Useless against deaf or mentally shielded opponents.

cardPool.title: Teleportation
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Teleportation

Description:
Gil Gollini can instantly move himself and anything he touches to any location within his line of sight. Overmodification dramatically increases activation speed, making him difficult to predict or counter.

Functions/Applications:
Instantaneous repositioning in combat or exploration. Transport of allies and objects by physical contact. Rapid escape from danger or tactical repositioning. Enhanced speed allows near-instantaneous consecutive teleports when overmodified.

Limits:
User must maintain clear line of sight to destination. Cannot teleport outside visual range. Environmental hazards can force unsafe teleportation positions. Vision obstruction leaves user vulnerable.

Additional Notes:
Strength lies in mobility and unpredictability. Weakness exploitable through vision denial or environmental control.

cardPool.title: Telescopic
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Telescopic

Description:
The user rapidly retracts body parts into themselves like a turtle. Retraction is nearly instantaneous for evasion, but unretracting takes several seconds and creates vulnerability.

Functions/Applications:
Defensive evasion against projectiles and melee attacks; dodge-and-counter tactics; protection from piercing or cutting damage while retracted.

Limits:
Unretracting is slow and leaves the user exposed and immobile. Cannot retract selectively—must withdraw entire body or specific limbs at once. Ineffective against area-of-effect attacks or sustained pressure. User remains conscious but trapped during retraction, unable to act offensively.

Additional Notes:
Best suited for defensive combat roles requiring quick reflexes. Combines well with counterattack strategies. Requires spatial awareness to position safely before unretracting.

cardPool.title: Tidal Bore
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Tidal Bore

Description:
The user expels massive quantities of water from their mouth with tremendous force. This water can manipulate heavy objects and create destructive floods in the surrounding area.

Functions/Applications:
Generate powerful water jets to lift or push heavy objects. Create widespread flooding to disrupt terrain and enemies. Use water discharge as offensive blast or defensive barrier. Output scales with emotional state, intensifying when triggered by strong stimuli like hunger.

Limits:
Water generation drains stamina quickly with prolonged use. User cannot control direction once emotional—quirk activates involuntarily around favorite foods, causing indiscriminate flooding. Effectiveness reduces in arid environments. Water must originate from the user's mouth, limiting range.

cardPool.title: Toho
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name: Toho

Description: Grants the user kaiju-like attributes, transforming them into a massive reptilian creature with enormous size, superhuman strength, and scaled skin.

Functions/Applications: Devastating melee combat through size and strength; intimidation through monstrous appearance; crushing objects and structures; enhanced durability from scaled skin; use as a living siege weapon.

Limits: Extreme size prevents stealth and navigation of confined spaces; high energy consumption; slow movement speed; vulnerability to agility-based tactics; psychological strain from transformation.

Additional Notes: The transformation appears permanent or semi-permanent. Effectiveness scales with physical conditioning and combat experience. Best suited for direct assault roles.

cardPool.title: Tongue Tank
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Tongue Tank

Description:
The user's tongue transforms into a retractable tank cannon housed within their mouth. When the mouth opens, the tongue-cannon extends and fires hard, rock-like projectiles with considerable force. The mechanism of ammunition generation is unclear—whether the user must consume materials or produces them internally.

Functions/Applications:
Fires projectile attacks at moderate to long range. Deployed by opening the mouth. Useful for ranged combat, area denial, or breaking through obstacles. The cannon retracts for protection when not in use.

Limits:
Projectile capacity and firing rate are unknown. The user must open their mouth to fire, creating a predictable attack pattern. Close-quarters combat is severely hampered. Ammunition source is uncertain, potentially limiting sustained fire. The mouth remains vulnerable.

cardPool.title: Traject
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Traject

Description:
A trajectory manipulation quirk that allows the user to alter the path of objects and energy passing through their bandages. The user can redirect incoming attacks, projectiles, or elemental forces to shield themselves or turn threats into advantages.

Functions/Applications:
Redirect enemy attacks toward other targets or away from allies. Deflect high-temperature energy without absorbing damage. Alter the course of moving objects mid-flight. Channel dangerous forces through bandaged areas for protection.

Limits:
Only works on objects or energy actively passing through the bandages. Requires precise positioning and timing to intercept projectiles. Extremely intense heat can overwhelm the redirection without sufficient experience. Damaged or destroyed bandages disable the quirk.

Additional Notes:
Effectiveness increases with combat experience.

cardPool.title: Transform
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Transform

Description:
The user consumes blood to perfectly replicate another person's physical appearance, voice, and clothing. One cup of blood grants approximately one day of transformation. After awakening, the user can duplicate the quirk of emotionally close targets provided they've studied it thoroughly.

Functions/Applications:
Perfect physical disguise including facial features, voice replication, and copied attire. Rapid appearance-switching between multiple consumed blood sources. Post-awakening: Quirk duplication and blood type matching for safe transfusions with transformed individuals.

Limits:
Cannot copy personality, knowledge, or mannerisms—user must learn these separately or risk exposure. Transformation time and blood capacity are finite. Vulnerable to tainted or booby-trapped blood from other quirks.

cardPool.title: Transforming Arms
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Transforming Arms

Description:
The user reshapes their arms at will, extending them elastically for long-range strikes or splitting them to attack from multiple angles. Arms can enlarge, harden, or transform into different shapes for combat needs. This Quirk grants exceptional reach and versatility.

Functions/Applications:
Stretch arms to grab distant targets or objects. Enlarge fists for devastating close-range power. Split arms to strike from multiple directions. Transform arms into alternative shapes like wings for aerial mobility. Combine with other Quirks for hybrid combat.

Limits:
Effectiveness decreases if the user's natural fighting style conflicts with shapeshifting mechanics. Rigid martial artists experience lag between transformation and execution. Transformation speed and complexity drain stamina with extended use.

cardPool.title: Trap Flex
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Trap Flex

Description:
The user can flex their trapezius muscles to extraordinary degrees, allowing their shoulders to expand and envelop their head. This grants enhanced speed and strength beyond normal human capability.

Functions/Applications:
Provides boosts to physical speed and striking power. The expanded shoulder coverage offers partial defensive protection for the head and neck. Useful for close-quarters combat and quick evasive maneuvers.

Limits:
Strength output is modest compared to dedicated strength Quirks. Continuous flexing causes fatigue. Head protection is incomplete, leaving the back exposed to strikes.

Additional Notes:
Best suited for hit-and-run tactics rather than prolonged brawls. Works optimally with tactical positioning and speed-based strategies rather than direct power contests.

cardPool.title: Tree Frog
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Tree Frog

Description:
A frog-type Quirk granting an extended, curling tongue and webbed fingers. The user develops tadpole-like physical traits suited for climbing and aquatic environments.

Functions/Applications:
The extendable tongue enables grappling, object manipulation, and adhesive climbing. Webbed fingers enhance swimming and grip strength on wet surfaces. The user gains improved agility in arboreal and aquatic settings.

Limits:
Tongue extension is minimal, limiting reach and grappling power to close-range interactions. Effectiveness diminishes in dry environments; moisture is required for optimal performance. Cannot compete with specialized amphibian Quirks in combat.

Additional Notes:
Tree Frog is a utility-focused Quirk best suited for mobility and environmental adaptation. Users excel in jungle, swamp, or aquatic terrain but struggle in arid conditions.

cardPool.title: Tripod
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Tripod

Description:
The user manifests a fully functional third leg positioned centrally between their two natural legs. This additional limb grants enhanced stability and balance, allowing the user to maintain footing on precarious or uneven surfaces where others would falter.

Functions/Applications:
The third leg provides superior balance during combat, enables traversal of unstable terrain, and allows three-point stances for enhanced stability. It can anchor the body against knockback or offensive pressure.

Limits:
The third leg cannot move independently and does not grant increased speed or enhanced strength. The user must adapt their gait and coordination to utilize the extra limb effectively.

Additional Notes:
The third leg offers tactical advantages in balance-dependent scenarios.

cardPool.title: Twin Impact
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Twin Impact

Description:
Twin Impact allows the user to create a delayed secondary impact at the location of any initial strike or contact. The second impact detonates remotely at the user's command with amplified force, often several times stronger than the original blow.

Functions/Applications:
Effective against objects and living targets. User delivers a normal attack, then triggers a devastating secondary explosion at the impact point. Useful for surprise damage, environmental destruction, and unpredictable combat patterns. Can layer with physical strikes or thrown objects.

Limits:
Secondary impact only activates at the precise location of initial contact—moving targets escape if they leave the area. User must consciously trigger each impact, requiring focus and tactical awareness. Activation delay creates brief vulnerability.

cardPool.title: Vibrate
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name: Vibrate

Description: The user generates and controls shockwaves and vibrations through any medium they touch. By modulating frequency and intensity with their hands, they can create precise tremors or devastating seismic disturbances. Prolonged exposure grants natural resistance to vibration-based attacks.

Functions/Applications: Shatters objects through vigorous vibration. Creates controlled earthquakes that disrupt terrain and formations. Weakens structural integrity and muscle fibers from within. Disrupts multiple opponents by destroying footing and balance. Counters vibration-based Quirks defensively.

Limits: Excessive vibrations cause severe aftershock damage to the user's body, causing temporary paralysis. Vibrations beyond the user's control threshold cannot be stopped and must dissipate naturally.

cardPool.title: Vibration Detection
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Vibration Sense

Description:
The user perceives surroundings through detection of subtle vibrations in air and matter, functioning as a sensory replacement similar to echolocation. This compensates for visual impairment by mapping spatial awareness through vibration patterns.

Functions/Applications:
The user can navigate complex environments, detect nearby objects and beings, track movement through tremors, and identify threats in darkness. This allows combat awareness and spatial navigation without sight.

Limits:
The Quirk cannot penetrate vibration-dampening materials like thick stone or specialized surfaces. It requires environments where vibrations propagate; total silence or dampening fields severely limit effectiveness. It cannot discern fine details like facial features or colors.

cardPool.title: Vines
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Vines

Description:
The user's hair transforms into controllable, thorny vines that can be freely manipulated and detached from the head. The vines are durable, can pierce skin and cut concrete, and are non-conductive to electricity.

Functions/Applications:
Vines restrain opponents, grapple distant objects, form defensive barriers, and serve as independent weapons when severed. The thorns inflict cutting damage. The user gains resistance to electrical attacks.

Limits:
Sharp objects can cut or sever the vines, requiring time to regenerate. Growth depends on sunlight and water. Extended use without these resources weakens the vines. They remain anchored to the user's head.

Additional Notes:
The vines function as versatile offensive and defensive tools for middle-range combat. Users should position themselves in well-lit, moist environments for sustained effectiveness.

cardPool.title: Viral Cosmos
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Viral Cosmos

Description:
Two flowers grow from the user's head, generating endless petals that serve as projectile weapons. Petals inflict harm on impact and manifest naturally from the flora.

Functions/Applications:
Launch petals as ranged attacks with adjustable velocity and volume. Continuous generation provides sustained offense without ammunition limits.

Limits:
Petals have limited range and lose velocity over distance. Flowers can be targeted and damaged. Petal attacks deal moderate damage. User cannot control mid-flight trajectory, only initial launch force.

Additional Notes:
Best for ranged harassment and mid-range combat. Vulnerable to fire-type attacks and environmental hazards. Ineffective in confined spaces.

cardPool.title: Voice
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name: Voice

Description: A sonic amplification Quirk allowing the user to project their voice at devastating volumes and frequencies, generating high-pitched sounds capable of reaching extreme decibel levels sufficient to rupture eardrums and incapacitate targets through auditory trauma.

Functions/Applications: Create devastating sonic attacks that disorient and damage enemies; drown out competing sound-based Quirks; project commands across large distances; use directional speakers to shield nearby allies from sound effects.

Limits: Prolonged use causes sore throat and vocal strain, limiting sustained combat duration. Ineffective against underground opponents or those in soundproof environments. Requires close proximity or speaker equipment for directional control; uncontrolled use endangers allies.

cardPool.title: Voyance
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Voyance

Description:
