The user can see through solid objects and barriers within line of sight, gaining x-ray vision. Living organisms remain opaque and cannot be seen through. By peering through a finger-formed aperture, the user narrows their vision field, extending duration and reducing mental strain.

Functions/Applications:
Locate hidden objects, bombs, or contraband behind walls. Scout enemy positions behind cover. Detect structural weaknesses or hidden compartments. Track mechanical devices through barriers.

Limits:
Cannot see through living matter. Continuous use without the finger-aperture technique exhausts the user quickly. Only works on objects within direct line of sight. Cannot penetrate certain dense or specially designed materials.

Additional Notes:
The finger-aperture method is essential for sustained use.

cardPool.title: Warp Gate
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Warp Gate

Description:
The user generates dark purple and black mist that forms portals, transporting anything touching the fog to predetermined locations. The user can cloak themselves in mist for invisibility while channeling teleportation. This artificial Quirk is synthesized from multiple sources with Cloud Quirk as its base.

Functions/Applications:
Create coordinate-based portals for instant transportation across distances. Cloak the body to obscure form and location. Open portals from sight or memorized coordinates. Transport multiple targets simultaneously. Establish escape routes or ambush points during combat.

Limits:
The neck cannot be covered by mist, creating a critical weak point. Portals require precise coordinate knowledge—the user must see or know exact positions. Cannot locate missing persons without knowing their location.

cardPool.title: Warping
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Warping

Description:
A stolen teleportation quirk manifesting as black ooze erupting from a target's mouth, enveloping their body as a portal before they vanish and reappear elsewhere. The ooze carries a repugnant stench and can transport multiple people to separate locations.

Functions/Applications:
The user can summon targets to their location or banish them away, but only those they know well or those near someone they know. Works as a short-range teleportation tool for tactical repositioning, extraction, or enemy dispersal in combat.

Limits:
Range is restricted and targets must be within distance to activate. User cannot teleport themselves. Only functions on people with sufficient familiarity or proximity. Strong-willed individuals can resist by swallowing the ooze before full envelopment.

cardPool.title: Water Control
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Water Control

Description:
A water-manipulation Quirk granting command over nearby water. User shapes water into offensive constructs and projectiles with precision, from razor-sharp claws to devastating aqueous torrents. Power scales with available water supply.

Functions/Applications:
Form water into bladed weapons for melee combat. Launch pressurized water jets as ranged attacks. Create temporary barriers or shields from solidified water. Redirect or absorb incoming water-based attacks.

Limits:
Requires proximity to a water source; effectiveness diminishes in arid environments. Cannot generate water from nothing. Sustained constructs drain stamina proportionally to size and density. Water defenses are vulnerable to evaporation or freezing.

Additional Notes:
Most effective near bodies of water, rain, or humid conditions.

cardPool.title: Water Gun
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name: Water Gun

Description: The user projects pressurized streams of water from their hands with precision and force. A straightforward offensive and utility Quirk for combat and environmental solutions.

Functions/Applications: Fire suppression and water dispersal; tactical distraction by targeting faces or eyes; crowd control through water spray; assistance with environmental hazards.

Limits: Limited to water already present or internally stored—cannot create water from nothing. Pressure and range decrease with sustained use. Ineffective against water-resistant or aquatic opponents. Requires hand positioning and aim; cannot function if hands are restrained.

Additional Notes: Most effective in supporting roles rather than primary offense. Practical utility makes it valuable in rescue operations and disaster response.

cardPool.title: Water Pump
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Water Pump

Description:
The user's hands are replaced with functional water hose spigots capable of generating pressurized water on demand. Water can be shaped and controlled with precision into various forms, from barriers to implements.

Functions/Applications:
Create defensive barriers, generate hand-like water constructs for manipulation, deliver pressurized water attacks, and extinguish fires. The user maintains fine control over water flow rate and shape.

Limits:
Requires a water source or internal reserves to function; prolonged use depletes reserves. The hose-hand design limits fine manipulation tasks. Water constructs disperse if pressure is lost.

Additional Notes:
Best suited for defensive and utility roles. Highly effective in firefighting. The distinctive barriers serve protective and intimidation purposes.

cardPool.title: Weather Manipulation
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Weather Manipulation

Description:
The user freely controls all weather phenomena including storms, lightning, wind, and tornadoes on a massive scale. They can envelope entire islands in storm clouds and summon devastating weather events capable of destroying landscapes. The Quirk also grants flight via wind manipulation.

Functions/Applications:
Create massive storm systems and tornadoes for area denial or destruction. Summon precise lightning bolts for targeted offense. Generate powerful winds for propulsion and flight. Scale attacks from localized strikes to island-wide devastation.

Limits:
Using the Quirk causes severe cellular degeneration and excruciating pain, forcing conservative use. Overuse leads to loss of control and potential collapse. Lightning can be redirected or grounded by electricity-based Quirks.

cardPool.title: Weld
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Weld

Description:
Yosetsu can merge organic and inorganic matter at a subatomic level through physical contact. Objects, people, or his own body fuse seamlessly with targets, creating permanent bonds until consciously reversed.

Functions/Applications:
Restraint by fusing enemies to structures or each other. Equipment enhancement by welding armor to his body. Transport assistance by fusing limbs with allies. Steel logs in his costume bridge separate targets without simultaneous contact.

Limits:
Requires contact with at least two objects to activate. Cannot fuse only one item. Reversing requires conscious effort and time. Forced separation of organic matter risks injury to merged partners.

Additional Notes:
Weld excels as tactical restraint rather than direct combat. Yosetsu carries specialized steel logs and shields to maximize versatility.

cardPool.title: Whale
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Whale

Description:
A transformation Quirk allowing the user to convert parts or their entire body into that of a sperm whale, gaining immense size, strength, and aquatic capabilities.

Functions/Applications:
Enables partial or complete body transformation for enhanced physical power and aquatic mobility. Full transformation allows powerful water stream expulsion as an offensive weapon. Useful for underwater combat and overwhelming opponents through size and force.

Limits:
Transformation is taxing with unknown duration limits. Water attacks require full transformation and expend significant energy. Whale form is cumbersome on land and vulnerable to harpoon weapons or electricity. No enhanced intelligence or special senses beyond whale biology.

Additional Notes:
Most effective in aquatic environments.

cardPool.title: Whirlwind
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Whirlwind

Description:
Inasa commands the air itself, generating powerful gusts and tornadoes with minimal movement. He can manipulate multiple wind currents simultaneously with precise control, propelling objects, allies, and himself through the air.

Functions/Applications:
Offensive wind blasts that knock enemies away; defensive deflection of projectiles and evasive maneuverability; support abilities to amplify allies' attacks. Flight achieved through costume-enhanced tornadoes or ground-burst propulsion. Can combine with heat-based Quirks to create flame tornadoes.

Limits:
Weakened if limbs cannot move freely. High temperatures and large fire sources disrupt airflow and destabilize control. Initially incompatible with cold-heat manipulation Quirks.

Additional Notes:
Whirlwind excels in versatility across offense, defense, and support roles.

cardPool.title: Whiteline
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Whiteline

Description:
The user manipulates and controls painted lane lines on roads as flexible tentacles. These lines can extend, coil, and move with considerable force to ensnare targets or hurl objects.

Functions/Applications:
Entangle and immobilize enemies by wrapping animated lane lines around them. Lift and throw heavy objects like vehicles. Create barriers by manipulating road markings. Requires painted road surfaces to function.

Limits:
Only works on existing painted lane lines; bare pavement provides no material to manipulate. Raw power level unknown due to external enhancement during observation. Effectiveness diminishes in areas lacking road infrastructure or clear markings.

Additional Notes:
Best suited for urban or highway environments with abundant painted lines. True baseline strength untested.

cardPool.title: Whole-Body Lens
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Whole-Body Lens

Description:
The user's body functions as a living camera system, capable of generating lens-like apertures anywhere on their skin to capture images. Photographs can be printed from the user's chest at will with no apparent storage limit.

Functions/Applications:
Create optical lenses across body surfaces for surveillance and reconnaissance. Print physical photographs on demand from stored images. Useful for intelligence gathering and evidence creation without external equipment.

Limits:
Cannot modify or edit captured images. Printing consumes stamina and requires chest access. Active lenses are vulnerable. Cannot capture in complete darkness. Storage has unknown constraints.

Additional Notes:
Best suited for support and intelligence roles. True potential lies in information gathering rather than combat.

cardPool.title: Wing
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Wing

Description:
The user sprouts massive black wings, granting free-form flight at extreme speeds. Originally manifested by a Near High-End Nomu, later obtained by Tomura Shigaraki through Quirk absorption.

Functions/Applications:
The wings enable sustained aerial locomotion and rapid escape across distances. Users can carry passengers or objects while airborne. The Quirk facilitates tactical repositioning in combat and access to unreachable locations.

Limits:
Flight speed depends on physical condition and control. The wings are vulnerable to targeted attacks. Extended flight at maximum velocity causes fatigue. The Quirk does not grant enhanced strength or durability beyond mobility.

Additional Notes:
Whether extreme speeds derive solely from Wing or synergize with other Quirks remains unclear.

cardPool.title: Zero Gravity
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name: Zero Gravity

Description: By touching solid objects with her fingertips, the user removes gravitational effects, rendering targets weightless. Contact must be maintained by keeping fingers pressed; releasing cancels the effect. After Awakening, the user can generate anti-gravity bubbles at range and spread effects between connected objects.

Functions/Applications: Float objects and opponents up to three tons; disable enemies by removing footing; manipulate environmental wreckage as weapons; transport allies; increase personal agility by removing self-weight; create diversions with levitating decoys; generate shockwaves through bubble compression.

Limits: Activation requires direct hand contact pre-Awakening; user suffers nausea with prolonged use or multiple targets; loss of hands means total inability; vulnerable to distant ranged opponents; Awakened bubbles lack preci...

cardPool.title: Zombie Virus
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Zombie Virus

Description:
Romero Fujimi releases pinkish gas that temporarily transforms inhalers into zombies with enhanced strength and endurance. Infected gain bluish-gray skin, sunken eyes, and an urge to bite others to spread the virus. Zombified Quirk users lose control of their powers. The user must wear a mask to avoid self-infection.

Functions/Applications:
Creates temporary undead soldiers through viral gas dispersal. Zombified Quirk users become unpredictable weapons with compromised ability control. Victims may retain personality fragments, allowing friendships to override infection instinct. Zombie appearances enable infiltration or escape.

Limits:
The user is not immune and risks self-infection if bitten. Zombification reversal mechanics are unclear. Zombified Quirk users focus only on biting uninfected targets.

cardPool.title: Zoom
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Zoom

Description:
A vision enhancement Quirk that grants extraordinary magnification abilities. The user's eyes transform with distinctive crosshair-shaped irises and can focus on distant targets with perfect clarity up to 5 kilometers away.

Functions/Applications:
The user can zoom vision on specific points of interest to observe people, objects, and details from extreme distances. Exceptional for reconnaissance, surveying crowds, identifying individuals, or examining distant locations without being noticed.

Limits:
Requires active focus to magnify vision. Distances beyond 5 kilometers become blurry. Cannot zoom while moving quickly. Environmental obstructions like fog, darkness, or heavy rain impair effectiveness. Provides no combat advantage in direct confrontation.

Additional Notes:
The crosshair irises are permanent physical markers of this Quirk.

cardPool.title: Class 1-B

Security walls with ID-card authentication guard the entrance. Architecture blends modern institutional design with combat-training infrastructure, featuring transformation mechanisms and Decay-resistant reinforcement.

cardPool.title: Shiketsu High School

Shiketsu High School

Upper floors (2-5) contain eight individual student rooms per floor with air conditioning, private bathrooms, beds, refrigerators, closets, and balconies.

Musutafu

Diverse Japanese citizens, students, merchants, and travelers. Home to prestigious schools and training academies attracting scholars from across the nation.

Bustling streets blend neon-lit storefronts with historic wooden structures and temples. The harbor holds fishing vessels and merchant ships, while tree-lined avenues lead to educational districts. Mountains loom in the distance with shrines and observation points overlooking the glittering city.

cardPool.title: Ketsubutsu Academy High School

U.A. High School Conference Room

cardPool.title: Jaku City

cardPool.title: Jaku General Hospital

Jaku General Hospital

The atmosphere is tense and competitive, driven by the outlet's hunger for the next major story.

cardPool.title: Kamino, Yokohama

Kamino Ward, Yokohama

cardPool.title: Kiyashi Ward Shopping Mall

Lunch Rush Cafeteria

cardPool.title: Makeshift Fortress: Troy

cardPool.title: Marukane Department Store

A desolate, ash-covered mountain with charred rock and skeletal vegetation. The air shimmers with residual heat and the ground is cracked and blackened. A cold stream provides one of the few sources of water and life on the peak.

An elegant Japanese residence with refined architecture and gated courtyard featuring mature trees. The first floor mimics a standard Japanese office with tatami and wooden furnishings. cardPool.title: Symbol of Paradise

Features hidden doors, trapdoors, and pitfalls throughout with self-healing properties.

cardPool.title: Villain Factory
cardPool.value:
[Villain Factory]

Type: Criminal Organization

The Villain Factory is an underground organization conducting illegal Quirk-based experiments. Responsible for creating Instant Villains and Next-Level Villains, it poses a major threat to the Naruhata area.

Named by the Police Force for its mass production of artificial villains, the organization is led by All For One and Dr. Kyudai Garaki. Their goal is creating a perfect being powerful enough to rival All Might.

Using advanced Quirk manipulation, biological experimentation, and human testing, the Villain Factory operates in secrecy while expanding criminal influence.

cardPool.title: Shie Hassaikai
cardPool.value:
[Shie Hassaikai]

Type: Yakuza Organization

The Shie Hassaikai is a former Yakuza organization that once operated within Japan's criminal underworld. Originally led by The Boss, the group followed traditional Yakuza values centered around loyalty, discipline, and honor.

The Boss raised Kai Chisaki, who became known as Overhaul. Unlike the older generation, Chisaki sought to restore the Yakuza's power through ruthless methods and dangerous experimentation.

During the rise of All Might and Pro Heroes, the Yakuza lost much authority and influence. The Shie Hassaikai was forced into the shadows and placed under constant surveillance.

Under Overhaul's leadership, the organization became feared for its brutality, secrecy, and ambition to reclaim dominance over the criminal world.

cardPool.title: Paranormal Liberation Front
cardPool.value:
[Paranormal Liberation Front]

Type: Villain Organization

The Paranormal Liberation Front is a massive villain faction formed by merging the League of Villains and the Meta Liberation Army. Led by Grand Commander Tomura Shigaraki, it aims to destroy hero society and create a world of absolute freedom and power.

The organization is divided into color-coded regiments, each commanded by a Lieutenant who oversees specialized warfare and operations. Each Lieutenant is supported by three elite Advisers who manage operations and expand the organization's influence nationwide.

With vast manpower, resources, and military structure, the Paranormal Liberation Front is one of Japan's most dangerous villain organizations.

cardPool.title: Octo-Lover's Brigade
cardPool.value:
[Octo-Lover's Brigade]

Type: Animal Rights Organization

The Octo-Lover's Brigade is an animal rights group from Osaka that campaigns against capturing and consuming octopuses, believing them to be intelligent creatures deserving protection.

Members typically have sea-creature-like appearances with traits resembling fish, mollusks, cephalopods, and other aquatic lifeforms.

All members wear dark cloth accessories marked with white spots resembling octopus suckers as their identifying symbol.

While many engage in peaceful activism, extremist factions resort to intimidation, sabotage, and violence to enforce their beliefs, giving the Brigade a controversial reputation throughout Japan.

cardPool.title: Meta Liberation Army
cardPool.value:
[Meta Liberation Army]

Type: Villain Organization

The Meta Liberation Army, or M.L.A., is a large villain organization that believes unrestricted Quirk usage is a fundamental human right. Founded by Destro, the M.L.A. sought to free society from laws restricting Quirks. Years later, Destro's descendant Re-Destro revived and rebuilt the organization into a massive, well-organized force with political, financial, and military influence across Japan. Unlike groups driven by chaos, the M.L.A. pursues liberation through ideology and overwhelming power. After conflict with the League of Villains, the M.L.A. merged with them to form the Paranormal Liberation Front under Tomura Shigaraki's leadership.

cardPool.title: League of Villains
cardPool.value:
[League of Villains]

Type: Villain Organization

The League of Villains was a criminal organization of powerful villains united by their hatred of hero society. Founded by All For One, the group was groomed under Tomura Shigaraki's leadership to become one of Japan's greatest threats.

Unlike traditional criminal organizations, the League sought the complete collapse of the hero system. It attracted dangerous criminals, outcasts, and extremists with powerful Quirks and deep resentment toward heroes.

Following the Revival Celebration, the League merged with the Meta Liberation Army to form the Paranormal Liberation Front under Shigaraki's command.

cardPool.title: K3 Gang
cardPool.value:
[K3 Gang]

Type: Villain Group

The K3 Gang is a small villain group of three young men who idolize famous criminals and anti-heroes like Stain. Inspired by powerful villains, they attempt to imitate them through reckless acts of intimidation and public disturbance.

The group terrorizes residents in snowy mountain regions while riding snowmobiles. All three share a punk-inspired appearance and travel together as a unit.

Despite calling themselves villains, the K3 Gang is inexperienced and lacks power or influence. Most actions amount to harassment, vandalism, and public chaos rather than serious destruction.

The members chase the image of feared villains hoping to gain recognition and respect.

cardPool.title: Gollini Family
cardPool.value:
[Gollini Family]

Type: Mafia Crime Family

The Gollini Family is a powerful European mafia organization led by ruthless Valdo Gollini. The family established itself as one of the most feared criminal syndicates in the region long before All Might's rise.

The original leader valued honor, loyalty, and tradition, but was murdered by his own son, Valdo Gollini, who seized control. Under Valdo's ruthless leadership, the family transformed into a brutal, ambitious organization that expanded its influence across Europe through violence and intimidation while evading Heroes and law enforcement.

The Gollini Family became infamous for its wealth, secrecy, and deadly reputation within the criminal underworld.

cardPool.title: Creature Rejection Clan
cardPool.value:
[Creature Rejection Clan (CRC)]

Type: Extremist Religious Organization

The Creature Rejection Clan is a villainous cult-like organization driven by extreme ideology and religious fervor. Members wear signature skull-shaped masks that conceal identities and reinforce collective doctrine.

The CRC rejects individuals with physical "abnormalities," particularly those with Mutant-type Quirks. Despite modern superpowered society's stabilization, the group upholds deep-rooted prejudice and exclusionary beliefs.

Originally a protest movement, the organization became increasingly radical, escalating from public demonstrations to violence and targeted attacks. This shift damaged their reputation and public support significantly.

Due to their extremism, the CRC lost influence and membership, fragmenting into smaller scattered cells operating independently in secrecy.

cardPool.title: Avant-Garders
cardPool.value:
[The Avant-Garders]

Type: Artistic Extremist Group

The Avant-Garders is a villainous group of three young men who identify as artists. Each member embodies a different artistic stereotype and possesses a Quirk related to artistic expression.

The group believes explosions represent the highest form of art, with destruction as true beauty. They target art installations and creative works, destroying them explosively to "complete" the artwork.

They view themselves as artists rather than criminals and are fascinated by explosion-based Quirks, considering them the purest artistic medium.

cardPool.title: Abegawa Tenchu Kai
cardPool.value:
[Abegawa Tenchu Kai]

Type: Former Yakuza Organization

The Abegawa Tenchu Kai was a Yakuza syndicate operating in the criminal underworld. After law enforcement classified it as a villain organization, the group's influence weakened significantly.

During this decline, the vigilante Stendhal attacked the organization's headquarters, killing all high-ranking executives in combat. With its leadership destroyed and operations disrupted, the Tenchu Kai collapsed, ending as a functioning criminal group.

cardPool.title: Mad Hatters
cardPool.value:
[The Mad Hatters]

Type: Rock Music Group

The Mad Hatters is a four-member rock band based in Naruhata, Tokyo. The band developed their identity through shared musical vision and gained recognition for strong talent and energetic performances.

They performed at the Marukane Department Store Live Event, a notable public appearance. While skilled and charismatic on stage, it's unclear if they've performed at major venues like Narufest.

The Mad Hatters remain an emerging band, steadily building their reputation in the local music scene.

cardPool.title: World Heroes Association
cardPool.value:
[World Heroes Association]

Type: International Hero Governing Body

The World Heroes Association is a global organization responsible for overseeing and coordinating Hero activity across multiple nations. It comprises representatives from various countries working together to regulate Hero operations internationally.

The organization organizes cross-border missions, facilitates cooperation between Hero agencies, and responds to large-scale threats requiring global coordination. During crises, the Association can deploy Pro Heroes to assist nations in need.

Due to uneven distribution of Hero forces worldwide, some regions experience higher crime rates. This imbalance remains an ongoing challenge the Association seeks to address.

cardPool.title: Police Force
cardPool.value:
[Police Force]

Type: Law Enforcement Organization

The Police Force is the official law-enforcing body responsible for maintaining public order and handling criminal activity. Their primary role is to arrest, detain, and process Villains subdued by Pro Heroes.

In the early days of Quirks, the Police Force avoided recruiting Quirk users due to concerns about ability misuse. This gap led to the rise of Pro Heroes, who became licensed Quirk users fighting crime under strict regulations.

Today, the Police Force coordinates with Heroes but focuses on non-Quirk crimes and lower-level offenses. Heroes must transfer ordinary criminals to police custody, as such cases fall outside Hero jurisdiction.

The Police Force also handles interrogation, investigation, and incarceration of suspects and captured Villains within the legal system.

cardPool.title: Hero Public Safety Commission
cardPool.value:
[Hero Public Safety Commission]

Type: Government Law Enforcement Agency

The Hero Public Safety Commission is a national authority responsible for regulating Heroes and overseeing their role within society. It manages the relationship between Pro Heroes and the public, ensuring that Hero activity remains lawful, controlled, and effective.

The Commission is led by a committee of non-Hero officials to maintain balance and prevent excessive influence from Hero society over civilian governance. It serves as a major criminal investigative body, handling high-level cases involving serious threats.

A key responsibility is administering the Provisional Hero License Exam, held twice yearly in June and September. Those who pass receive official Hero licenses, allowing them to legally perform Hero duties.

cardPool.title: Feathers
cardPool.value:
[Feathers]

Type: Underground Idol Duo

Feathers is a twin-based underground idol duo composed of sisters Miu and Yu. They perform together under a shared stage identity, building their reputation through synchronized performances and strong stage presence.

They were invited to perform at the Marukane Department Store Live Event, marking a notable public appearance that gave them wider exposure beyond the underground idol circuit.

The sisters have gained attention for their twin chemistry and coordinated performance style, steadily growing their fanbase in smaller live venues and events.

cardPool.title: FeatherHATS
cardPool.value:
Type: Music Band

FeatherHATS is a music group formed by Makoto Tsukauchi and sponsored by the Marukane Department Store. The band brings together young musical talents from Naruhata to showcase rising performers from the local scene.

Supported by corporate sponsorship, FeatherHATS performs at organized events and promotional stages, introducing emerging artists to wider audiences.

The group blends different musical styles from its members while maintaining a cohesive, youthful performance identity.

cardPool.title: East Naruhata High Dance Squad
cardPool.value:
[East Naruhata High Dance Squad]

Type: School Dance Group

The East Naruhata High Dance Squad is a four-member dance team at East Naruhata High School. They perform at school events and local competitions, showcasing coordinated choreography and youthful energy. They were invited to perform at the Marukane Department Store Live Event, one of their most notable appearances outside school.

Leadership is informal, with the "president" role held by the member with the strongest stage presence. The squad focuses on synchronization, expression, and improving their performance skills through live events and competitions.

cardPool.title: Kanidoge
cardPool.value:
[Kanidoge]

Type: Food Distribution Company

Kanidoge is a food-products corporation based in Osaka specializing in importing and distributing crab products across Japan. The company supplies fresh seafood to markets and businesses nationwide.

Kanidoge is notable for its crab-shaped mechanical units designed to transport and handle goods while serving as mobile advertising displays for the company's brand.

Through logistics innovation and seafood specialization, Kanidoge has established a unique presence in Japan's food distribution industry.

cardPool.title: Help Us Company
cardPool.value:
[H.U.C. (Help Us Company)]

Type: Training & Simulation Organization

The Help Us Company, commonly abbreviated as H.U.C., is a professional organization specializing in rescue and disaster-response training simulations. Its members act as realistic "victims" in controlled scenarios so that Heroes and trainees can practice rescue operations.

H.U.C. fulfills the high demand for realistic training environments by staging scenarios that replicate disasters, accidents, and villain attacks with accuracy.

Members are skilled at simulating panic, injuries, and crisis conditions while observing and evaluating rescue methods. They provide feedback on whether response techniques were appropriate, efficient, and safe.

Through their work, H.U.C. improves Hero training standards and emergency response effectiveness across society.

cardPool.title: Heroes
cardPool.value:
[Heroes / Pro Heroes]

Type: Licensed Quirk Users / Public Protectors

Heroes are individuals legally authorized to use their Quirks to protect civilians from danger. Those pursuing heroism professionally are Pro Heroes, regulated by Japan's Hero Public Safety Commission and internationally by the World Heroes Association.

Most Heroes operate through Hero Agencies, which organize missions, training, and public safety operations. Hero work centers on three core responsibilities: rescue, evacuation, and combat. Depending on specialization, agencies may focus on one area or handle all three.

Heroes are widely respected and operate under public visibility, with civilians frequently witnessing their battles against Villains.

cardPool.title: Villains
cardPool.value:
[Villains]

Type: Criminal Individuals / Organizations

Villains are individuals who use their Quirks to commit crimes, cause destruction, and endanger innocent lives. They exist as thieves, murderers, extremist groups, and terrorist organizations.

Crime rates remain relatively low due to Pro Heroes, but Villains persist as a threat across society.

Motivations vary widely, including economic hardship, political ideology, social rejection, or personal tragedy. Quirks enable more complex and dangerous forms of crime.

Some become Villains after trauma, rejecting societal norms entirely. While some operate alone, others form organized groups with leadership hierarchies.

All Villains share one trait: illegal Quirk activity that endangers society.

cardPool.title: Vigilantes
cardPool.value:
[Vigilantes]

Type: Unauthorized Quirk Users / Civilian Protectors

Vigilantes are individuals who carry out Hero-like activities without legal authorization, often acting independently of Hero agencies. Due to strict Hero licensing laws, such actions are illegal.

Although unlawful, Vigilantes exist in a legal and moral gray area. When Pro Heroes are unavailable, their intervention can save lives, and they may cooperate with Heroes during emergencies.

This dual nature creates debate within law enforcement regarding how Vigilantes should be treated—as criminals or unofficial assets in crises.

Vigilantes remain a controversial presence, balancing public necessity against legal violation.

cardPool.title: Sidekicks
cardPool.value:
[Sidekicks]

Type: Hero Agency Support Staff

Sidekicks are licensed Hero assistants who work under Pro Hero supervision at Hero Agencies. They provide operational support during missions and emergencies, acting as backup for coordination, logistics, and on-site response while the Pro Hero leads field operations.

Agency heads hire Sidekicks based on experience, skills, or Quirk utility. Team sizes vary from small groups to large rosters, and some Pro Heroes operate without Sidekicks. Unlicensed Vigilantes may be recruited as Sidekicks, providing a legal pathway into Hero society.

cardPool.title: Todoroki Family
cardPool.value:
[Todoroki Family]

Type: Family

The Todoroki Family is a prominent Hero family consisting of Enji Todoroki (Endeavor), his wife Rei, and their four children: Toya, Fuyumi, Natsuo, and Shoto. Enji is a top-ranked Pro Hero known for his exceptional combat ability. Each child carries the family legacy with distinct paths and perspectives shaped by their upbringing and connection to Hero society.

cardPool.title: Shimura Family
cardPool.value:
[Shimura Family]

Type: Family

The Shimura Family was the birth family of Tomura Shigaraki before he became a Villain. They were an ordinary household whose history became tied to the origins of one of society's most dangerous criminals. The family is connected to the legacy of Nana Shimura, a former Pro Hero, whose lineage indirectly influenced later events involving Tomura Shigaraki. Very little is known about them.

cardPool.title: Ida Family
cardPool.value:
[Ida Family]

Type: Hero Family Lineage

The Ida Family is a prestigious hero family with generations of Pro Heroes serving in professional heroics. They have built a reputation rooted in discipline, responsibility, and service to society.

Most Ida Family members possess the Engine Quirk, characterized by engine-like exhaust pipes that grant enhanced speed and mobility. This Quirk defines the family lineage, particularly associated with Tenya Ida.

Tenya's grandfather developed a unique training method to enhance the Engine Quirk's performance. The process involves removing exhaust organs through intense training, followed by rigorous conditioning. Stronger, more efficient engine components regrow over time, resulting in improved speed and endurance.

cardPool.title: Wild, Wild Pussycats
cardPool.value:
========================================
STORYCARD — WILD WILD PUSSYCATS
========================================

[OVERVIEW]
The Wild, Wild Pussycats are a professional Hero team specializing in rescue operations, wilderness survival training, and disaster response. They excel in coordination, mobility, and field-based Hero work.

Members:
- Mandalay (strategic leader and communicator)
- Pixie-Bob (terrain manipulation through earth-based Quirk)
- Ragdoll (enhanced sensory tracking and Quirk analysis)
- Tiger (close-combat specialist and physical trainer)

----------------------------------------

[ROLE IN HERO SOCIETY]
The Pussycats prioritize survival training, evacuation strategy, and environmental adaptability rather than urban combat. They assist in U.A. student development programs, preparing students for real-world disaster scenarios.

cardPool.title: Kota Izumi
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Kota Izumi

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Water Control

Occupation/Role: UA High School Hero Course Student, Class 1-A

Personality: Initially withdrawn and cynical after his parents' deaths, Kota was cold toward heroes. After being rescued by Izuku Midoriya, he opened himself to others, though he remains somewhat indifferent and prideful. He is principled and refuses indecency, punishing rule-breakers without hesitation.

Appearance: A short boy with spiky black hair wearing a short-sleeved collared shirt with dark shorts and a distinctive red cap with golden spike-shaped horns. His hero costume features a dark green vest with a gray helmet matching his parents' design, complete with spike-shaped horns, and red high-top sneakers.

Backstory: Son of the pro hero team Water Hose, both deceased, Kota was raised by his aunt Shino Sosaki of the Wild Wild Pussycats.

cardPool.title: Arc 1
cardPool.value:
========================================
ARC 1 — U.A. ENTRANCE EXAM
========================================

Izuku Midoriya arrives at U.A. for the Hero Course entrance exam. Candidates enter a simulated city and earn points by destroying combat robots, with rescue points for saving others.

Unable to safely use One For All, Izuku notices Uraraka trapped under debris. He destroys a zero-point robot to save her, earning rescue points instead of pursuing combat points.

Despite a low combat score, Izuku is accepted into U.A. due to his rescue performance. Bakugo is accepted as a top scorer. Class 1-A is formed.

cardPool.title: Arc 2
cardPool.value:
========================================
ARC 2 — QUIRK APPREHENSION TEST
========================================

Class 1-A undergoes Aizawa's Quirk Apprehension Test on their first day, including sprinting, grip strength, ball throw, endurance, and agility measurements using Quirks.

Aizawa warns the lowest performer may be expelled, pressuring the class immediately.

Izuku breaks his fingers controlling One For All during the ball throw. Uraraka's zero-gravity sends the ball out of range. Bakugo dominates through explosive mobility.

Students are ranked by Quirk efficiency and physical output. Aizawa later reveals expulsion was a bluff to measure potential under pressure.

cardPool.title: Arc 3
cardPool.value:
========================================
ARC 3 — U.S.J. INCIDENT
========================================

Class 1-A arrives at U.S.J. for rescue training. Kurogiri warps the League of Villains inside, scattering students across disaster zones.

Shigaraki targets Aizawa and Izuku while villains attack multiple groups. A Nomu is deployed to kill All Might.

All Might arrives and defeats the Nomu in combat, forcing villains to retreat. The attack reveals organized villain coordination against Hero society.

cardPool.title: Arc 4
cardPool.value:
========================================
ARC 4 — U.A. SPORTS FESTIVAL
========================================

U.A. hosts a national sports festival broadcast across Japan. Students compete in obstacle races, cavalry battles, and elimination tournaments.

Izuku modifies One For All usage to avoid breaking his body. Todoroki refuses to use his fire Quirk due to family conflict. Bakugo advances through brute force.

During finals, Todoroki uses his fire against Izuku after emotional confrontation about his past. Bakugo defeats Todoroki in the final match and is declared overall winner.

Hero agencies recruit students for internships based on performance exposure.

cardPool.title: Arc 5
cardPool.value:
========================================
ARC 5 — HERO INTERNSHIPS & STAIN INCIDENT
========================================

Students begin internships at Hero agencies. Izuku trains under Gran Torino and learns advanced movement control. Iida joins Ingenium's agency.

In Hosu City, Stain attacks Pro Heroes, targeting those he deems unworthy. His Quirk allows paralysis through blood ingestion.

Nomu activity occurs simultaneously. Iida confronts Stain alone and is paralyzed. Izuku and Todoroki intervene during overlapping combat.

Endeavor defeats a Nomu while Stain is subdued after combined efforts. Stain is arrested, but his ideology spreads among Villain groups, causing wider instability in Hero perception.

cardPool.title: Arc 6
cardPool.value:
========================================
ARC 6 — FOREST TRAINING CAMP ARC
========================================

Class 1-A trains in wilderness survival and Quirk control at a remote camp.

The League of Villains Vanguard Action Squad attacks the facility.

Students are split across forest terrain in survival situations.

Bakugo is captured during chaos.

Multiple students are injured during escape.

Villains withdraw after achieving their objective.

cardPool.title: Arc 7
cardPool.value:
========================================
ARC 7 — KAMINO INCIDENT
========================================

League of Villains holds Bakugo in Kamino Ward.

Hero intelligence locates the hideout and launches a rescue operation.

All Might confronts All For One during the raid.

A large-scale battle unfolds across Kamino Ward.

All Might defeats All For One in his weakened state.

Bakugo is rescued.

All For One is critically injured and retreats.

All Might's final form is revealed, ending his era as Symbol of Peace.

cardPool.title: Arc 8
cardPool.value:
========================================
ARC 8 — PROVISIONAL HERO LICENSE EXAM
========================================

Students take the national Hero License Exam. Candidates complete large-scale rescue simulations with competing schools. Successful students gain legal authorization for supervised Hero work.

cardPool.title: Arc 9
cardPool.value:
========================================
ARC 9 — SHIE HASSAIKAI RAID ARC
========================================

Hero teams investigate Shie Hassaikai operations. Eri is identified as the source of Quirk-erasing bullets. A coordinated raid begins. Mirio fights Overhaul alone and is hit by a Quirk-erasing bullet, losing his Quirk permanently. Izuku reaches Eri and defeats Overhaul. Eri is rescued and placed under Hero protection.

cardPool.title: Arc 10
cardPool.value:
========================================
ARC 10 — CULTURAL FESTIVAL ARC
========================================

U.A. prepares a Cultural Festival performance.

Class 1-A builds stage and performs.

Gentle Criminal and La Brava infiltrate U.A.

Izuku intercepts and defeats Gentle Criminal.

La Brava surrenders.

Festival continues successfully.

Eri attends performance.

cardPool.title: Arc 11
cardPool.value:
========================================
ARC 11 — META LIBERATION ARMY ARC
========================================

League of Villains enters Deika City and clashes with Meta Liberation Army forces. Twice is killed in battle. Shigaraki fights Re-Destro as the city collapses. Shigaraki's Quirk fully awakens, destroying large areas. Re-Destro is defeated and MLA submits to Shigaraki. Paranormal Liberation Front is formed.

cardPool.title: Arc 13
cardPool.value:
========================================
ARC 13 — PARANORMAL LIBERATION WAR
========================================

Heroes attack Jaku Hospital and Gunga Mountain.

High-End Nomu engage Hero teams.

Shigaraki awakens and begins massive destruction.

Dabi reveals identity as Toya Todoroki.

Twice is killed, collapsing Villain coordination.

Gigantomachia advances across Japan.

Shigaraki expands decay across battlefield zones.

Heroes begin evacuation and containment operations.

cardPool.title: Arc 14
cardPool.value:
========================================
ARC 14 — DARK HERO ARC
========================================

Izuku Midoriya leaves U.A. and operates independently across Japan as a solo Hero, tracking Villain activity and protecting civilians without agency support.

He encounters multiple escaped prisoners in isolated urban battles while transporting civilians to safety zones.

Izuku is ambushed by Kaina Tsutsumi (Lady Nagant), a former Hero Public Safety Commission assassin deployed to capture him alive.

Nagant engages Izuku using long-range precision rifle Quirks, forcing him to adapt One For All usage with Blackwhip, Fa Jin, and Danger Sense in combination.

Nagant reveals information about the Hero Commission's internal corruption and her past role as an assassin executing covert eliminations of targets labeled threats to Hero society.

cardPool.title: Arc 15
cardPool.value:
========================================
ARC 15 — FINAL WAR ARC
========================================

Heroes launch coordinated final war against All For One and Shigaraki.

Bakugo engages Shigaraki.

Todoroki confronts Dabi.

Ochaco engages Toga.

All Might confronts All For One using armored support.

Izuku fights Shigaraki as One For All vestiges appear.

All For One is separated from Shigaraki.

Shigaraki collapses after final exchange.

Heroes win but at major cost.

cardPool.title: Momo Yaoyorozu

Wears UA female uniform: gray dress jacket with teal stripes and golden buttons over white dress shirt, red tie, and teal pleated skirt.

Backstory: Mon lived contentedly with the Shimura family, bonding closely with young Tenko. When Kotaro struck Tenko for sneaking into his study, Mon barked protectively. Later that night, Mon sat with the crying boy to comfort him, but Tenko's Quirk, Decay, manifested uncontrollably, killing Mon instantly. Mon became the first victim of the tragedy that claimed the entire family.
Additional Information: Non-combat character; significant to Tenko Shimura's tragic origin story and the pivotal moment of his Quirk manifestation.

Her Quirk grants her long white rabbit ears and a small tail. Appearance: Woman with sharp blue eyes and long blonde hair swept back with bangs. She wears a light blue Pussycats costume with pink-padded paw gloves and applies two blue dots on her cheeks during missions. A tinted visor aids her Quirk use.
Backstory: A highly skilled Pro Hero and the strongest member of the Wild, Wild Pussycats, Ryuko has mastered earth manipulation for mountain rescues and hero operations. Her confidence matches her eccentric personality, though beneath her wackiness lies genuine care for the next generation.

Personality: A charismatic showman who thrives on entertainment and spectacle with theatrical flair. Talkative and arrogant, though his showboating undermines his villainy. Despite his villainous nature, he mentors younger members and genuinely cares for his comrades.

Appearance: Tall and slim with pale skin, brown inward-slanted eyes, and a pointed nose. He has short black eyebrows and curly brown hair. His villain attire includes a dark orange upturned-collar shirt, green striped bolo tie with azure brooch, black waistcoat and dress pants, knee-high white boots with wedged heels, dark red gloves, and a tall brown top hat with red ribbon and pale feather.

cardPool.title: Aorio Kuraishisu
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Aorio Kuraishisu

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Unknown

Occupation/Role: Hero Expert

Personality: Reserved and analytical; presents himself as a thoughtful commentator on heroic society and its evolving standards.

Appearance: Pale-faced with dark hair, pointed ears, and two prominent horns. He has dull, penetrating eyes and wears simple business suits.

Backstory: A professional expert in heroic affairs with deep knowledge of the Pro Hero system. He gained prominence after events in Deika City, appearing on television to analyze shifts in society's perception of heroes.

Additional Information: A civilian expert and media personality who assesses the complexities of Pro Hero work. He is valued as an analyst in public discourse about heroism's changing role in society.

cardPool.title: Aoni
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Aoni

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Not specified

Occupation/Role: Clothes designer at Onigashima denim brand

Personality: Energetic and passionate about fashion design with deep admiration for Best Jeanist. Easily discouraged but driven to improve.

Appearance: Young man of below-average height with neat, light-colored hair, distinctive pointy ears, and two small horns on his head, giving him an otherworldly appearance typical of animal-type Quirk users.

Backstory: Aoni rose quickly at Onigashima and earned the opportunity to design an outfit for Best Jeanist's catwalk show. Villains attacked during the event and destroyed his creation. Jeanist repaired the outfit with his Quirk, inspiring Aoni to pursue excellence in fashion design.

Additional Information: Not a UA student; works professionally in the fashion industry.

cardPool.title: Anonymous
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Anonymous (Designation Unknown)
Alias: The Anonymous, Bio-Engineered Drone
Quirk Name: Hive Mind Command Protocol
Occupation/Role: Villain/Bio-Engineered Combat Drone
Personality: Emotionless and obedient to Number 6's commands. Mimic human emotion as tactical lures. Lack self-preservation instincts or fear.
Appearance: Humanoid figures with veiny skin in colored patches matching Number 6's costume. Facial scars like Number 6, defined lips, clawed hands and feet, glowing orbs on palms and chest. Wear hats and long sleeves to infiltrate civilian populations.
Backstory: Bio-engineered by the Villain Factory from Bomber cells as a hive mind collective serving Number 6. Deployed across Naruhata during Operation Anonymous to attack civilian infrastructure and spread paranoia through coordinated chaos.

cardPool.title: Amplivolt
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Amplivolt (Zōden)
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Amplivolt
Occupation/Role: Vice Commander of the Paranormal Liberation Front, Top-Ranked Adviser in Vanguard Action Support Regiment: Brown
Personality: Brash, confident, and combative with unwavering loyalty to the PLF. Eager for battle and dismissive of opposition. Single-minded in his devotion and enjoys smoking.
Appearance: A tall, heavily scarred man with a battle-hardened physique. Black hair with a yellow lightning bolt-shaped streak. Wears a dark suit with pink striped shirt and brown tie. Carries electrified gauntlets or taser weapons.
Backstory: Originally with the Meta Liberation Army before joining the Paranormal Liberation Front after its merger with the League of Villains. Rose as a top adviser and participated in the Gunga Mountain Villa raid, engaging Chargebolt and Edgeshot before capture.

cardPool.title: Akira Iwako
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Akira Iwako

Alias: Instant Villain

Quirk Name: Hardening

Occupation/Role: Villain/Drug User

Personality: Calm and cooperative when sober, but becomes violently aggressive under Trigger's influence. Shows fear and tactical retreat when outmatched, though typically reckless. Retains some awareness while enhanced.

Appearance: Medium-sized man with curly brown hair in street clothes. When enhanced by Trigger, his body swells—skin turns grayish, muscles bulge massively, and rock-like protrusions erupt across his head, shoulders, and knuckles.

Backstory: A street criminal supplied Trigger by Kuin Hachisuka. His Hardening Quirk became dangerously amplified by the drug, turning him into a rampaging force. Defeated by The Crawler and Knuckleduster, he was arrested but released as a victim. Upon release, he accepted more Trigger and resumed violent crime across Naruhata.

cardPool.title: Ochaco Uraraka
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Ochaco Uraraka

Alias: Uravity

Quirk Name: Zero Gravity

Occupation/Role: UA High School Student, Class 1-A

Personality: Cheerful and determined with a gentle demeanor, though she harbors deep resolve beneath her friendly exterior. Earnest and hardworking, driven by a desire to become a hero and support her family while remaining humble and considerate of others.

Appearance: A slender teenage girl with fair skin and shoulder-length auburn hair in a bob with long framing strands and short bangs. Large round eyes matching her hair color, thick upper lashes, and distinctive permanent pink blush marks on her cheeks. Small pink pads on her fingertips activate her Quirk. She wears the UA female uniform: gray dress jacket with teal stripes, white shirt, red tie, and teal pleated skirt with black tights and brown shoes.

cardPool.title: Tomura Shigaraki
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Tenko Shimura

Alias:
Tomura Shigaraki

Quirk Name:
Decay

Occupation/Role:
Leader of the League of Villains

Personality:
Impulsive and volatile with destructive rages. Deeply resentful of hero society and All Might. Intelligent but emotionally unstable, dependent on All For One for validation.

Appearance:
Pale-skinned young man with messy grayish-blue hair partially obscuring his face. Bright red irises and wrinkled skin around his eyes from chronic scratching. Visible scars on his right eyelid and left lip. Wears a black hoodie, black pants, and red sneakers. Carries a disembodied hand in his pocket.

Backstory:
Born Tenko Shimura, his Quirk manifested at age five during a traumatic family incident, disintegrating his entire family. Adopted by All For One, he was raised as a weapon to destroy hero society.

cardPool.title: Katsuki Bakugo
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Katsuki Bakugo

Alias: Kacchan, Great Explosion Murder God Dynamight

Quirk Name: Explosion

Occupation/Role: UA High School Student, Class 1-A

Personality: Aggressive, competitive, and intensely proud with fierce determination to become the strongest hero. Volatile and quick to anger, yet possesses unwavering drive that fuels relentless training.

Appearance: A young man of above-average height with slim, muscular build. Short, spiky sandy blond hair with sharp, bright red eyes. Wears standard UA uniform with undone collar buttons and loose-fitting pants. Hero costume features a black sleeveless tank top with orange "X", jagged black mask with orange-rimmed flares, armored gauntlets, neck brace, green-and-orange belt with grenades, metallic knee guards with orange bolts, and black combat boots with orange soles.

cardPool.title: Izuku Midoriya
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Izuku Midoriya

Alias:
Deku

Quirk Name:
One For All

Occupation/Role:
UA High School Student, Class 1-A

Personality:
Earnest and determined, driven by a desire to become a hero despite being born Quirkless. Energized with wide-eyed enthusiasm, yet capable of intense focus during combat. Respectful and analytical, often taking detailed notes on other heroes' abilities.

Appearance:
A short young man with fluffy dark-green curly hair, round face with large green eyes and four diamond-shaped freckles on his cheeks. Wears UA standard uniform: light gray blazer with dark turquoise trim, white dress shirt, dark blue-green pants, and short red tie. Signature bright red high-top boots with thick white soles. Lean but muscular from training. Right hand shows early deformation from combat strain.

cardPool.title: Moko Tamashi
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Moko Tamashi

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Unnamed Mass-Generation Quirk

Occupation/Role: Civilian

Personality: Grateful and faithful despite hardship. Moko maintains unwavering belief in heroes even after society's collapse, showing remarkable courage. She is determined and selfless, willing to risk danger for her convictions.

Appearance: Young woman with shoulder-length brown hair and brown eyes. She has an earnest, youthful face. Her build is slender and unremarkable, typical of an ordinary person.

Backstory: Moko was trapped in building rubble during the Kamino Incident clash between All Might and All For One. All Might sacrificed his heroic form to protect her from a killing blow before retirement. This act of salvation shaped her unwavering devotion to him.

cardPool.title: Moe Kamiji
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Moe Kamiji

Alias:
Burnin

Quirk Name:
Blazing Hair

Occupation/Role:
Pro Hero Sidekick at Endeavor Agency

Personality:
Passionate and fiery with an encouraging nature. Hard-working and dedicated in combat and civilian evacuation duties.

Appearance:
A curvaceous young woman with large red-orange eyes and pointy teeth. Her distinctive feature is long, flaming yellowish-green hair with side and center bangs. Pointed fingertips. Wears a light-gray double-breasted mini dress with orange and black lining, side slits, black collar and belt, silver screw buttons, and a temperature gauge belt with fire extinguisher. Black knee-high socks, short black boots, and a black mask connected to a red headband.

Backstory:
One of over thirty sidekicks at Endeavor's agency. Mentors and evaluates hero students during internships.

cardPool.title: Mocha
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Mocha
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Double
Occupation/Role: Experimented Nomu in Kyudai Garaki's Laboratory
Personality: Loyal and protective of his master Garaki, willing to sacrifice himself despite limited combat capability.
Appearance: A diminutive Nomu with light yellow skin and round eyes. His exposed brain sits atop his head. Distinctive cat-like ears are actually human noses, with a spinal tail extending from his body. He wears pale lace-up shoes on his upper limbs.
Backstory: Created in Garaki's secret laboratory as an experimental Nomu subject, Mocha developed genuine attachment to his captor despite his artificial origin.
Additional Information: Mocha's Double Quirk appears to duplicate Twice's ability, allowing creation of autonomous duplicates of individuals. As a small-scale Nomu, he poses minimal direct threat but serves as a loyal asset to Garaki's operations.

cardPool.title: Miyashita
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Miyashita
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Unknown
Occupation/Role: Detnerat Company Employee
Personality: Straightforward and honest, prone to casual joking, critical thinker who questions ideology.
Appearance: Middle-aged man with rodent-like features including circular ears, dark beady eyes, small nose and muzzle. Short dark hair swept forward. Professional business attire: white dress shirt, pale blazer, dark tie.
Backstory: Dedicated Detnerat Company employee in hero support gear division. Orphaned after mother's death with no remaining family. Known for candid rapport with boss Rikiya Yotsubashi, making light-hearted jabs about his appearance.
Additional Information: Killed by Yotsubashi after expressing moral opposition to Destro's ideology and the Meta Liberation Army. His death demonstrates Yotsubashi's ruthlessness toward dissenters. Not a UA student.

cardPool.title: Miu
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Miu

Alias: Feathers (with twin sister Yu)

Quirk Name: Unknown

Occupation/Role: Underground idol performer

Personality: Sharp-tongued and judgmental initially, but warms to others as bonds deepen. Competitive and observant.

Appearance: Short-statured girl with straight, shoulder-length light hair in a high left-side ponytail with side-swept bangs. Dark, stern eyes tilting slightly inward. Wears a sleeveless knee-length idol dress with pointed skirt, thick collar, feather accent, tights, and one long glove—mirror image of her twin's costume in reversed colors. Dark tracksuit with pale side stripes when not performing.

Backstory: Half of the underground idol duo Feathers, performing alongside her twin sister Yu at local festivals. Known as "the mean one," she judges others harshly initially but learns to see past first impressions through genuine connections.

cardPool.title: Mirio Togata
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Mirio Togata

Alias: Lemillion, The Comedy Hero

Quirk Name: Permeation

Occupation/Role: Class 3-B Student at UA High School, Member of The Big 3

Personality: Highly goofy and energetic with infectious optimism and constant smile. Known for corny humor and making a fool of himself for others' amusement. Despite his laid-back nature, he is extremely dedicated with serious determination to master his Quirk and become a symbol of peace.

Appearance: Tall with muscular build. Distinctive beady blue eyes with no visible sclera, rounded nose, and blond hair styled in a quiff. Wears standard UA uniform with large golden buckle belt shaped like a carnivorous mouth.

cardPool.title: Mirai Sasaki
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Mirai Sasaki

Alias: Sir Nighteye

Quirk Name: Foresight

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero

Personality: Stoic and intimidating with sharp, cold demeanor, yet values humor and requires those around him to make him laugh. Pragmatic, protective of subordinates, unafraid to admit mistakes. Fiercely devoted to All Might's ideals, though willing to disagree for the greater good.

Appearance: Tall and lean with sharp, angular features and stern yellow eyes behind triangular glasses. Dark green hair slicked back with three yellow streaks, parted left. Dresses in plain white suit with gold buttons, white dress shirt, and red tie with white dots—practical office wear that belies his combat capability.

Backstory: Former sidekick to All Might who served as the brains behind the Symbol of Peace. Became a respected Pro Hero and mentor figure.

cardPool.title: Minotaurus
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Minotaurus
Quirk Name: Bull Head
Occupation/Role: E-rank Villain, League of Villains recruit
Personality: Temperamental and violent with a quick temper. Easily intimidated by superior opponents and prone to unease.
Appearance: A hulking man with bluish skin and a single cyclopean eye. Two large horns protrude from his head. He wears a ripped black sleeveless shirt, grayish-brown pants, and a large white belt. His muscular build reflects his aggressive nature.
Backstory: Recruited by Tomura Shigaraki for the U.S.J. assault to eliminate All Might and strike fear into UA students. His confidence wavered against Eraser Head and was quickly subdued by All Might before arrest.
Additional Information: Minotaurus possesses no formal combat training beyond his Quirk's physical advantages. He relies on numerical superiority rather than individual skill.

cardPool.title: Minoru Mineta
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Minoru Mineta

Alias: Grape Juice

Quirk Name: Pop Off

Occupation/Role: UA High School Student, Class 1-A

Personality: Timid yet perverted with a reputation for lewd behavior. Easily jealous of cooler classmates and speaks with cynical harshness. Despite his crass exterior, he shows genuine kindness in danger, though he panics easily. Motivated by wanting popularity and attention from girls.

Appearance: A short teenage boy with an unusually large, round head and puffy cheeks. Dark purple hair forms four ball-shaped clumps resembling a mohawk. Small stubby upturned nose, oval eyes with large black pupils, and thin eyebrows. Wears the standard UA male uniform modified for his short stature: light gray blazer with dark turquoise trim, white dress shirt, dark blue-green pants, red tie, and brown shoes.

cardPool.title: Mina Ashido
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Mina Ashido

Alias:
Ridley Hero: Pinky

Quirk Name:
Acid

Occupation/Role:
UA High School Student, Class 1-A

Personality:
Cheerful, easygoing, and perpetually smiling. Highly social and excitable, Mina thrives in group settings with infectious enthusiasm that lifts those around her.

Appearance:
A girl of medium height with athletic build and light pink skin. She has short, fluffy darker pink hair, distinctive square-shaped eyes with black sclera and yellow irises, and two pale yellow hooked horns. At UA, she wears the standard female uniform: gray dress jacket with teal stripes, white shirt, red tie, teal pleated skirt, and brown shoes with knee-high socks.

Backstory:
A first-year student at UA High School training to become a Pro Hero. Mina joined Class 1-A to develop her Quirk and combat abilities after attending Mustafa Private Middle School.

cardPool.title: Mika Jiro
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Mika Jiro

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Earphone Jack

Occupation/Role: Musician; Mother

Personality: Kind-hearted and encouraging, Mika is a supportive parent who respects her daughter's autonomy. She maintains composure in tense situations and balances her husband's passionate nature with level-headed wisdom.

Appearance: A slender woman with short, straight dark purple hair with bangs. She wears black-framed glasses and professional casual attire—collared shell top, pencil skirt, and tights. Her distinctive plug-like earlobes are inherited by her daughter Kyoka.

Backstory: An accomplished musician, Mika married Kyotoku and had Kyoka. She passed her love of music to her daughter but readily accepted when Kyoka chose to pursue heroics instead, encouraging her to help others through her own path.

cardPool.title: Mihaera
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Mihaera
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Unknown
Occupation/Role: Villain/Spy Infiltrator at U.A. High School
Personality: Serious and obedient, following orders without question. Pragmatic and focused on securing her future through loyalty to All For One's cause.
Appearance: A young woman with long hair concealed beneath a beanie, wearing simple shirt and jacket. Deliberately unremarkable for blending in.
Backstory: One of five undercover spies sent by All For One to infiltrate U.A. High School as a refugee. Participated in psychological operations against Izuku Midoriya and disrupted U.A.'s evacuation systems during the Final War under Skeptic's command.
Additional Information: Captured by Itsuka Kendo and Tetsutetsu Tetsutetsu while pinned against a wall with a bomb. Experienced with explosives and sabotage. Current status following All For One's defeat unknown, presumed in custody.

cardPool.title: Mick
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Mick
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Unknown
Occupation/Role: Pro Hero Sidekick, Oki Mariner Crew Member
Personality: Responsible and dependable, capable of managing crew operations independently.
Appearance: Muscular build with blond close-cropped hair and beard. Wears a white sailor's uniform with blue stripes.
Backstory: A seasoned sidekick under Pro Hero Selkie, Mick serves as a trusted crew member. His competence has earned him command responsibilities when Selkie is absent.
Additional Information: Not a UA student; operates as a professional hero alongside Selkie and the Oki Mariner crew.

cardPool.title: Mezo Shoji
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Mezo Shoji

Alias: Tentacle Hero: Tentacole

Quirk Name: Dupli-Arms

Occupation/Role: UA High School Student, Class 1-A

Personality: Friendly, gentle, and selfless despite his intimidating appearance. Empathetic and mature, he avoids emotional impulses while protecting his classmates. Thick-skinned and unbothered by prejudice, he harbors no grudges and willingly risks himself for others.

Appearance: A tall, muscular young man with pale gray hair swept forward over his eye. Six arms connected by webbing—the front two have hands while the others end in thin stumps. An elongated face with side-set eyes, concealed by a light blue mask from below his eyes to his neck. He wears the standard UA male uniform with a sleeveless blazer and brown shoes.

cardPool.title: Meryl Hope
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Meryl Hope

Alias:
None

Quirk Name:
Unknown

Occupation/Role:
Weather Forecaster for BCD News

Personality:
Professional and bold with unwavering commitment to truth. Meryl is direct and courageous, opposing corruption publicly despite personal risk. She communicates efficiently while maintaining strong moral conviction.

Appearance:
A dark-skinned woman of average height with a curvaceous build, blue eyes, and thick eyebrows. Light blonde hair falls to shoulder length. She wears an all-white thigh-length dress with matching white shoes and a wristwatch, maintaining a professional broadcaster appearance.

Backstory:
Meryl works as a weather forecaster for BCD News in Washington State, known for accurate reporting and thorough research.

cardPool.title: Melissa Shield
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Melissa Shield
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Quirkless
Occupation/Role: Third-year student at I-Island Academy
Personality: Kindhearted and intelligent with unwavering determination to become a hero despite lacking a Quirk. Outgoing and curious, she quickly befriends others and remains calm under pressure. She deeply admires her father and All Might, believing indirect support through invention is a valid path to fighting for peace.
Appearance: A pale-skinned young woman with a round face, wavy blonde hair reaching midway down her back with side-swept bangs, aqua-blue eyes, and pink oval-framed glasses. She wears the I-Island Academy uniform: white short-sleeved dress shirt with plaid cuffs, large bow at neck, dark raspberry waistcoat, pale gray Capri pants, plaid pink socks, and heeled brown boots.

cardPool.title: Mei Hatsume
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Mei Hatsume
Alias: The Support Department's Genius
Quirk Name: Zoom
Occupation/Role: UA High School Support Department student, Class 1-H
Personality: Smart, assertive, and shameless; obsessively passionate about her inventions. Direct and opportunistic, often making others uncomfortable through personal space invasion. Shows no fear of failure and views setbacks as learning opportunities. Self-centered but genuinely driven to improve her craft. Poor at reading social cues.
Appearance: Reasonably short with mature build. Salmon pink shoulder-length dreadlocks swept right. Wide upward-sloped green-yellow eyes with cross-shaped irises like scope lenses and long upper lashes. Modified UA gym uniform (dark blue tracksuit) with red and gold steampunk goggles, utility belt, oversized speed-assisting boots, jet pack, and various self-made gadgets.

cardPool.title: Mawata Fuwa
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Mawata Fuwa

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Unknowable

Occupation/Role: UA High School Class 2-A Student, Pro Hero in Training

Personality: Cheerful and carefree with a lax demeanor, yet capable of serious responsibility when needed. Respects tough teaching methods and understands their value. Shows fondness for difficult experiences that foster growth.

Appearance: Girl with layered light pink shoulder-length hair, straight bangs parted left. Round gray eyes with long eyelashes and dark eye makeup featuring star or cloud-shaped pupils. Wears standard female UA uniform and distinctive puffy cotton ball-shaped earrings. Hero costume consists of a fluffy white sleeveless jacket with black arm bracers and enlarged cotton ball earrings.

Backstory: A first-year student under Eraser Head's instruction, Mawata initially feared his harsh training methods.

cardPool.title: Master Driller
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown

Alias: Master Driller

Quirk Name: Drill

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero

Personality: Courageous and resolute, Master Driller demonstrates unwavering determination to protect civilians and aid fellow heroes. He fights without hesitation against overwhelming odds, willing to sacrifice himself for the greater good.

Appearance: Master Driller wears a maroon combat suit with reinforced metal leg protectors and asymmetrical shoulder armor. His left arm features a metallic guard, while his right arm is replaced by a massive mechanical drill. A black helmet with a white facial plate and yellow star design covers his head, with a blue visor protecting his eyes.

Backstory: A dedicated Pro Hero who answered the call to evacuate Jaku City during the Paranormal Liberation Front crisis.

cardPool.title: Master Beast
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Master Beast
Quirk Name: Unnamed Werewolf Quirk
Occupation/Role: Underground fighter in the Underground Masquerade
Personality: Aggressive and brutal in combat, relying on natural physical advantages. Shows resilience by continuing to fight despite injuries and recovering alongside defeated opponents without animosity.
Appearance: Muscular werewolf-like humanoid with thick fur covering his body. Wears dark pants and leather shoulder pads with chest straps. A domino mask covers his eyes per Underground Masquerade dress code. Distinctive features include razor-sharp claws and feral, bestial physiology.
Backstory: An underground fighter competing in the illicit Underground Masquerade circuit. His origins and true identity remain mysterious, known only by his combat moniker.

cardPool.title: Mashirao Ojiro
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Mashirao Ojiro

Alias:
Tailman

Quirk Name:
Tail

Occupation/Role:
UA High School Student, Class 1-A

Personality:
Calm and noble with strong dignity, Mashirao is a hard worker who avoids the spotlight due to his sheepish nature. Despite his humble demeanor, he is reliable and focused during hero work. Sensitive about being perceived as "plain," he maintains composure in combat.

Appearance:
A muscular young man with short blond hair and thin eyes. His distinctive feature is a hairless, prehensile tail tinted like his hair with a tufted tip. He wears the standard male UA uniform with pale gray sneakers and a hero costume of a plain karate gi with black belt, blue accessories, fur-lined collar, and black boots with light blue accents.

Backstory:
Mashirao trained at UA High School to become a Pro Hero.

cardPool.title: Masaki Mizushima
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Masaki Mizushima

Alias: Normal Hero: Manual

Quirk Name: Water Control

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero (No. 222), based in Hosu City

Personality: Kind and attentive with keen observational skills. He aspires to be a role model for modern heroes and easily discerns others' motivations.

Appearance: A man with messy brown hair and black eyes. He wears a blue and white long-sleeved shirt tucked into orange gloves, dark pants, and white boots. His signature helmet features a fish-like fin and blue visor.

Backstory: Masaki rose to become the No. 222 Pro Hero in Hosu City. He mentored young hero hopefuls and earned respect through his reliable, straightforward approach to heroism.

Additional Information: His Quirk manipulates pre-existing water but weakens against air pressure. He selected his intern by recognizing similar qualities in them, demonstrating his perceptive nature.

cardPool.title: Martial Hair
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Martial Hair
Quirk Name: Hair Control
Occupation/Role: F-rank Villain
Personality: Aggressive and combat-ready, confident despite limited power.
Appearance: Young woman of average height with lean build. Light brown pigtails styled just above shoulders with side-swept bangs. Light brown oval eyes. Wears magenta boots, shorts, sports bra, and darker magenta armbands.
Backstory: Recruited by Tomura Shigaraki for the U.S.J. assault alongside seventy other villains. Quickly defeated by Eraser Head during the invasion and arrested.
Additional Information: F-rank villain whose Quirk allows her to shape ponytails into weapons like drills. Demonstrates willingness to confront pro heroes despite low ranking.

cardPool.title: Mario Kugutsu
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Mario Kugutsu

Alias: The Toy Man

Quirk Name: Playtime

Occupation/Role: Trigger Dealer and Instant Villain for the Villain Factory

Personality: Outwardly timid and apologetic with closed eyes, masking his true nature as a cunning predator. He targets vulnerable individuals with weak wills. When activated by Trigger, he regresses to childlike behavior, treating people as toys. He is manipulative, sinister, and obsessed with both toys and the drug.

Appearance: Average height with black hair and plain office clothing. His closed eyes give him a dull appearance, but when opened they look manic and unusual. His long protruding tongue adds to his creepy demeanor. Under Trigger's influence, his body becomes colossal and jet black with four arms, simplified features, and no body hair.

cardPool.title: Manga Fukidashi
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Manga Fukidashi

Alias: Comicman

Quirk Name: Comic

Occupation/Role: UA High School Class 1-B Student, Hero-in-Training

Personality: Expressive and dramatically enthusiastic with a soft spot for children. Strategic team player who excels at supporting allies in combat.

Appearance: A short young man with fair skin and a distinctive blank speech bubble for a head and neck that displays his thoughts in written form. He wears a blue shirt with red sleeves, ink bottle-patterned armor, a yellow manga panel belt, gloves, and a manga page-template mask.

Backstory: A UA student training to become a Pro Hero in Class 1-B. Despite his unusual quirk-based appearance, he demonstrates genuine compassion and tactical intelligence, making him a valued team member.

cardPool.title: Manami Aiba
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Manami Aiba

Alias: La Brava

Quirk Name: Love

Occupation/Role: Villain Associate / Hacker

Personality: Deeply devoted and loyal to those she admires, with intense love that borders on obsessive. Initially withdrawn after past rejection, she gains confidence through her admiration for Danjuro. Protective of her partner and prone to worry. Sensitive to rejection but fiercely committed once emotionally invested.

Appearance: A notably short young woman with a disproportionately large, round head and narrow body. She has distinctive raspberry pink hair in two high pigtails with a centered bang. Her striking features include large, pointed-down eyes with dark under-eye rings and oval pink irises with concentric circles.

cardPool.title: Makoto Tsukauchi
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Makoto Tsukauchi

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Polygraph

Occupation/Role: General Manager of Captain Celebrity Corporation

Personality: Intelligent, independent, and determined with a pleasant demeanor masking subtle manipulation. Skilled at organizing groups and getting cooperation, with a rebellious streak and willingness to bend rules. Charming and social, adept at talking through difficult situations.

Appearance: Attractive young woman of slim build and above-average height. Jet black hair to mid-lower back, parted right, with dark eyes hidden behind bright green contacts. Small mole on lower left corner of mouth. Dresses fashionably befitting her corporate position and wears gold hoop earrings.

Backstory: Younger sister of Detective Naomasa Tsukauchi.

cardPool.title: Mako Magi
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Mako Magi

Alias: None

Quirk Name: None

Occupation/Role: Homemaker, Grandmother

Personality: Caring and compassionate toward her grandchildren, but timid and conflict-averse. She witnessed abuse but feared confrontation. Despite her gentleness, she ultimately tried to protect her family by joining efforts to stop the violence, showing hidden courage.

Appearance: An elderly woman with a black bob-cut hairstyle and glasses. She has a soft, aging face reflecting decades of quiet domestic life. Her attire is simple and practical, befitting her role as a homemaker.

Backstory: Mako lived with her husband Chizuo in her daughter Nao's home, helping raise grandchildren Tenko and Hana. She grew distressed by her son-in-law Kotaro's violent abuse of the children, but remained silent out of fear.

cardPool.title: Maina Furasu
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Maina Furasu

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Not specified

Occupation/Role: UA High School Support Department student, Class 1-H

Personality: Timid and easily startled, yet dutiful and brave when called upon. Capable of recognizing absurdity even in desperate situations. Dedicated to her responsibilities despite her shy nature.

Appearance: Dark brown hair tied in a ponytail with a beige headband adorned with two blue bells. Average build with wide, expressive eyes. Wears standard UA Support Department plain beige workshop coveralls.
