Backstory: A talented support course student at UA High School with no combat experience. Maina proved her bravery by joining the Heroes during the Final War against All For One's villain army, maintaining critical fortress systems while under attack. Her technical aptitude earned her place among UA's support specialists.

cardPool.title: Mahoro Shimano
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Mahoro Shimano

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Hologram

Occupation/Role: Nabu Island resident; student

Personality: Stubborn and quick to judge, Mahoro is fiercely protective of her younger brother after their mother's death. Initially cynical about heroes, she tests Class 1-A's resolve through false emergencies. Through genuine heroism, she develops respect for those dedicated to saving others.

Appearance: A small girl with dark brown eyes and straight brown hair in pigtails with dark pink bands. She has freckles and wears a pink dress with dark pink overall straps over a black tank top, white sandals with pink accents, and a sun hat with a dark pink scarf and bow. On her left wrist is a handmade floral charm bracelet from her mother.

cardPool.title: Maguma Iwata
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Maguma Iwata

Alias:
Volcano

Quirk Name:
Eruption

Occupation/Role:
Villain, Leader of the Volcano Thieves

Personality:
Commanding and ruthless, Maguma leads his criminal organization with tactical confidence and overwhelming power.

Appearance:
A tall, heavily muscular man with large brown eyes and orange, flame-shaped hair. He wears a baggy navy blue bodysuit with rock-like boots, gauntlets, and shoulder pads lined with smoke-expelling pores. An orange belt and shoulder-mounted gas mask with mercury thermometer complete his look.

Backstory:
Maguma founded the Volcano Thieves, a criminal organization outside the law. His Quirk mastery and imposing physique command respect among subordinates and fear among enemies.

Additional Information:
His Eruption Quirk produces lava-like substance by burning fat cells.

cardPool.title: Madame Puppimil
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Madame Puppimil
Alias: The Dognapping Boss
Quirk Name: Trimming
Occupation/Role: Villain, Dognapper Leader
Personality: Callous and greed-driven, yet surprisingly affectionate and charismatic. She commands loyalty through charm and genuine warmth, though this masks her ruthless criminal nature.
Appearance: A moderately-built woman with waist-length, right-parted hair adorned with a flower. She wears a spotted mini-dress beneath a fur-lined cape with fur stole, matching bands, black tights, and high-heels.
Backstory: A cunning criminal entrepreneur leading a dog-trafficking operation. She recognizes value in her acquisitions and genuinely cares for them, viewing victims as both commodities and cherished possessions.
Additional Information: Operates a warehouse hideout with caged dogs awaiting sale.

cardPool.title: Madam President
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Madam President
Quirk Name: Unknown
Occupation/Role: Head of the Hero Public Safety Commission
Personality: Calm and steely, pragmatic and willing to make morally questionable decisions for perceived societal benefit. Balances ruthlessness with mercy, disagreeing with her predecessor's extreme methods while orchestrating manipulation and coercion.
Appearance: Middle-aged woman with turquoise eyes and ash-blonde hair slicked back. Black suit jacket and dress with purple shirt and necklace, projecting professional authority and control.
Backstory: Once Vice President under a brutal predecessor who used Lady Nagant as an assassin. After Nagant killed the previous president, she assumed leadership and imprisoned rather than executed her. She recruited young Keigo Takami and groomed him to replace Nagant as the commission's operative hero.

cardPool.title: Madam
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Unknown

Alias:
Madam

Quirk Name:
Unknown

Occupation/Role:
Professional Shopper

Personality:
Highly competitive and charismatic, Madam thrives on sale events. She is cunning and quick to exploit newcomers, yet respects those who outsmart her. Her passion for shopping borders on obsession—the threat of being banned deeply affected her. Despite aggressive tactics, she shows self-awareness and respect for clever opponents.

Appearance:
A short, plump woman with voluminous curly black hair. She wears a tight-fitted dress with sharp pointed shoulder pads, a prominent pearl necklace, and heavy makeup. Her style reflects her status as a veteran competitive shopper.

Backstory:
Madam is renowned for her legendary shopping prowess and ability to energize sale events at local department stores. Store staff recognize her value to their success.

cardPool.title: Luminescent Baby
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Unknown

Alias:
Luminescent Baby

Quirk Name:
Luminescence

Occupation/Role:
Peace Activist, Historical Figure

Personality:
Charismatic and idealistic with unwavering conviction in peaceful coexistence. Inspired millions through remarkable persuasive ability despite their young age.

Appearance:
An infant with luminous skin emitting brilliant light. Their distinctive glow drew worldwide attention and became instantly recognizable across continents.

Backstory:
Born in Qing Qing City, China, as the first officially recorded person with a Quirk. Their birth sparked global fascination and hope for a new era. They established a massive peace movement exceeding 10 million followers, advocating for safety and return to pre-Quirk society. All For One murdered them and seized their Luminescence Quirk, but their legacy endured.

cardPool.title: Leviathan
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Leviathan
Quirk Name: Helical Scythe
Occupation/Role: Humarise Villain
Personality: Devoted to Flect Turn's anti-Quirk cause, but consumed by violent rampage when under Trigger influence with minimal distinct personality due to chemical enhancement.
Appearance: Under Trigger, a massive muscular man with bleach-white skin, black facial and forearm markings, and a brown spine of spikes. Small head with beady orange-yellow eyes and wide teeth. Spiraling red appendages extend from fingers, toes, and back via tube-like structures. Torn black pants with brown belt. Without Trigger, fair-skinned and less muscular with smaller white spirals.
Backstory: A devoted Humarise member deployed as a front-line operative during Flect Turn's global Trigger Bomb plot to intercept heroes at headquarters.

cardPool.title: Lala Soul
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Lala Soul

Alias:
None

Quirk Name:
Unknown

Occupation/Role:
Student/Resident of Otheon Shantytown

Personality:
Kind-hearted and cheerful despite hardship, deeply devoted to her older brothers Rody and Roro. Resilient and hopeful even in poverty and ostracization. Obedient to Rody's protective instructions.

Appearance:
A small young girl with brown noodle-textured hair in a high side ponytail with a flower tie. Gray eyes and innocent expression. Wears a flower-decorated sundress over dark leggings and slip-on sneakers.

Backstory:
Born in Otheon to engineer Eddie Soul and a deceased mother, Lala was raised by her eldest brother Rody. When her father abandoned the family to join anti-Quirk sect Humarise, the Soul children faced ostracization, expulsion from school, and homelessness in the shantytown.

cardPool.title: L.A. Villains
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Red Villain (L.A. Villains)
Quirk Name: Rocket Launcher
Occupation/Role: Criminal/Villain
Personality: Selfish and greedy, willing to endanger lives for profit. Cunning and strategic in combat, creating escape opportunities for allies.
Appearance: Slim build with blonde hair and a long, pointed nose. Red skin-tight suit with white markings and large white "R" on face mask.
Backstory: Member of L.A. Villains, a criminal duo who robbed millions from a casino. Defeated by All Might while he studied abroad in America.
Additional Information: Works with a blue six-armed villain. Fires two simultaneous missiles from arm cannons. Arrested by Pro Heroes Elecplant and Cow Lady with All Might and David Shield's assistance.

cardPool.title: Kyudai Garaki
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Kyudai Garaki

Alias: Daruma Ujiko, Dr. Tsubasa, Doctor

Quirk Name: Life Force

Occupation/Role: Villain affiliated with the League of Villains; Chairman of Jaku General Hospital

Personality: Eccentric, deranged scientist devoted to All For One's will. Prideful of his Nomu creations, treating them as masterpieces. Overly cautious and secretive, communicating through electronics. Despite unethical practices, he shows genuine loyalty to those he deems worthy. Cowardly when threatened, prone to panic, yet capable of extreme joy over successful plans. Believes hatred strengthens individuals.

Appearance: Portly, short elderly man with a bald head and large bushy mustache. Wears gear-shaped goggles and white labcoat as a villain. As hospital chairman, he wears circular black-framed glasses, shirt and tie beneath a regular labcoat.

cardPool.title: Kyotoku Jiro
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Kyotoku Jiro

Alias:
None

Quirk Name:
Earphone Jack

Occupation/Role:
Music Composer, Father

Personality:
Emotional and easygoing with a stern exterior. Deeply supportive of his daughter's hero ambitions. Playful and theatrical, prone to concerned parent acts.

Appearance:
A man with wavy, shoulder-length light-gold hair and triangular eyes. Warm presence despite stern expressions.

Backstory:
A talented music composer who married Mika after falling in love with her musical abilities. He and his wife nurtured their daughter Kyoka's musical interests but embraced her dream of becoming a hero at UA High School.

Additional Information:
Kyotoku possesses deep knowledge of music theory and shares his daughter's love of rock music. A supporting parent figure rather than a combatant, appearing primarily during UA family interactions.

cardPool.title: Kyoka Jiro
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Kyoka Jiro

Alias: Hearing Hero: Earphone Jack

Quirk Name: Earphone Jack

Occupation/Role: UA High School Student, Class 1-A

Personality: Pragmatic and blunt with a teasing nature. Despite appearing cold, she is genuinely friendly with close classmates and surprisingly sensitive beneath her sarcasm. Prefers intelligent approaches during hero activities and uses physical punishment via her Quirk to keep troublemakers in line.

Appearance: Petite girl with slender build, black triangular eyes with long lower eyelashes, and dark-purple chin-length asymmetrical hair with sound-wave-shaped reflections. Her distinctive features are flexible, plug-like earphone jacks hanging from her earlobes that function as controllable limbs.

cardPool.title: Kurosagi
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Kurosagi
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Unknown
Occupation/Role: Former Assistant to Toy Company CEO
Personality: Greed-driven and opportunistic, willing to betray anyone for profit. Hypocritical—despises copying abilities despite producing bootlegs himself. Abandons loyalty when usefulness ends, prioritizing self-preservation.
Appearance: Adult man with short, light-colored hair and square jaw. Wears a business suit with a kendama-shaped tie and square-framed shaded glasses.
Backstory: Kurosagi stole toy blueprints from his position as CEO assistant to manufacture bootlegs. When the business suffered, he was tasked with investigating the theft he committed. During Hero intervention, he attempted to steal the master blueprint list and flee, but was apprehended by Phantom Thief.
Additional Information: Not a UA student.

cardPool.title: Kurogiri
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Oboro Shirakumo
Alias: Kurogiri
Quirk Name: Warp Gate
Occupation/Role: High-End Nomu and League of Villains member
Personality: Level-headed and polite, grounding Tomura's immaturity. Intensely loyal to his masters yet retains fragments of Oboro's caring nature, worrying about those he was programmed to protect.
Appearance: A humanoid figure of dark purple mist with glowing yellow eyes. Wears a dark suit, tie, and metal brace extending from collarbone to below his eyes. His form occasionally reveals human features.
Backstory: Originally a U.A. High School student named Oboro Shirakumo before being transformed by Doctor Kyudai Garaki into a High-End Nomu. Created to serve Tomura Shigaraki under All For One's command.
Additional Information: Programmed to obey select individuals and resist interrogation.

cardPool.title: Kuin Hachisuka
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Kuin Hachisuka

Alias: Queen Bee

Quirk Name: Queen Bee

Occupation/Role: Student (High School); Part-time Villain serving the Villain Factory

Personality: Deceptively cheerful on the surface, masking sadistic and ruthless cruelty. Manipulative and cunning, she enjoys causing harm through her Quirk. Finds entertainment in death and destruction while maintaining a carefree facade. Vengeful and possessive of her bee colony, calling them her "babies."

Appearance: While possessing Tamao Oguro, Kuin wears a dark green varsity jacket with white bee insignia and yellow "Queen Bee" logo, white dress shirt, and light orange bow tie. She has short orange-brown hair with small ahoge, green eyes, and sharp teeth. A medical patch covers her missing left eye. She wears a short blue skirt with black and orange knee-high socks and dark nail polish.

cardPool.title: Kunieda
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Kunieda

Alias: None known

Quirk Name: Not specified in source material

Occupation/Role: Villain, serial killer, assassin for All For One

Personality: Pragmatic and cunning, viewing trust and hope as meaningless. Deeply sadistic with no conscience, deriving pleasure from violence and collection. Dismissive toward those he deems weak, yet shows unwavering loyalty to All For One as repayment for his freedom.

Appearance: A tall, skeletal man with long limbs and broad shoulders. He wears a tattered cloth hood over a triangle-patterned poncho with tassels. His face features inverted eyes—black scleras with white irises—a wide rectangular nose bridge, and a long dark mask. Black rolled-sleeve shirt with leather vambraces, pinstriped pants, suit jacket worn around his hips like a skirt, white shirt and striped necktie-belt, completed with dress shoes.

cardPool.title: Kugo Sakamata
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Kugo Sakamata

Alias:
Aqua Hero: Gang Orca

Quirk Name:
Orcinus

Occupation/Role:
Pro Hero (No. 21), Director of Okuto Island Aquarium, Provisional License Exam Proctor

Personality:
A calm and serious hero with a menacing exterior who genuinely cares about aspiring heroes. Despite harsh teaching methods, he enjoys mentoring students. He's friendly with fellow Pro Heroes and unafraid to tease peers.

Appearance:
A tall, powerfully built man with killer whale features—white eyes with red pupils and dark skin. He wears a white high-collared hero suit with diamond-shaped tooth patterns, a pink tie like a tongue, and a whale-like cape. His imposing appearance ranks him third among heroes resembling villains.

Backstory:
A highly ranked Pro Hero who has served as No. 10, No. 12, and currently No. 21. He directs Okuto Island Aquarium while actively patrolling and teaching.

cardPool.title: Kotaro Shimura
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Kotaro Shimura
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Unknown (not manifested or undisclosed)
Occupation/Role: Civilian; Father and Husband
Personality: Resentful and controlling, harboring deep hatred for Heroes due to maternal abandonment in childhood. Emotionally and physically abusive toward his children to prevent them from pursuing Hero paths. Capable of remorse but rarely acts on doubts. Easily manipulated by those he trusts.
Appearance: Short dark hair with a small cowlick on the right side. Wears a striped polo shirt and black pants. Average build with a stern, troubled expression.
Backstory: Son of Pro Hero Nana Shimura, placed in foster care after his father's death. This abandonment bred lifelong resentment toward Heroes. He married Nao and had two children: Tenko and Hana. Unknown to him, villain All For One manipulated his hatred and encouraged his abusive parenting.

cardPool.title: Kotaba Honyakuji
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Kotoba Honyakuji
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Animal Communication
Occupation/Role: Zookeeper at Megalo-Safari
Personality: Energetic, passionate, and deeply caring about animal welfare. She shows genuine concern for both animals and people in her charge, though cautious about human interference with natural behavior.
Appearance: A woman with black hair wearing a zoo uniform, hoodie tied around her waist, work gloves, and a distinctive polka dot scarf. She maintains a practical yet approachable appearance suited to her outdoor profession.
Backstory: Kotoba works as a dedicated zookeeper at Megalo-Safari, where her Quirk allows her to understand and communicate with animals. She assists Gang Orca in guiding UA students through team-up missions at the zoo, teaching them about animal behavior and the park's topographical zones while mediating between humans and wildlife.

cardPool.title: Kosei Tsuburaba
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Kosei Tsuburaba
Alias: Tsuburaba
Quirk Name: Solid Air
Occupation/Role: UA High School Student, Class 1-B
Personality: Enthusiastic and competitive with high standards. A reliable support player, generally mild-mannered compared to classmates.
Appearance: Young man with short auburn hair spiked at odd angles. Large oval eyes with prominent pupils. Wears a light blue high-collared jacket with black undershirt, pale pants with grey kneepads, and large brown boots.
Backstory: First-year student at UA High School training to become a Pro Hero. One of Class 1-B's pragmatic voices.
Additional Information: Solid Air allows him to solidify exhaled air into invisible walls and platforms. His Ultimate Move, Air Prison, creates soundproof barriers effective against voice-based Quirks. Functions best as a support specialist in team scenarios.

cardPool.title: Konako Haizono
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Konako Haizono

Alias: Dusty Ash

Quirk Name: Dust

Occupation/Role: Villain

Personality: Reserved and enigmatic with cunning tactical thinking.

Appearance: A tall woman with wavy white hair in a ponytail, partially obscured right eye. She wears a black sports bra, light purple panties, purple gloves, arm pads, black ankle boots, face mask, and metal respirator around her neck with a utility belt.

Backstory: A dangerous villain who emerged with tactical mastery of her Dust Quirk. Her origins remain mysterious, though her equipment suggests long-term planning and awareness of her Quirk's limitations.

Additional Information: Her Quirk generates ash-like dust from her body, which she weaponizes by targeting sensory organs as distraction. Overuse causes dry, rough skin.

cardPool.title: Komari Ikoma
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Komari Ikoma

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Not specified

Occupation/Role: Elementary school teacher at Masegaki Primary School

Personality: Easily distressed and apologetic, struggling to maintain discipline. Despite her anxious nature, she is deeply committed to her students' development and inspired by their growth. She is empathetic and dedicated to helping children develop safe Quirk abilities through proper counseling.

Appearance: A young woman with straight, shoulder-length dark hair and large navy blue eyes that frequently tear up. She wears a white blouse beneath a tan jacket, a long green skirt, and heeled work shoes. Her appearance is neat and professional.

Backstory: Komari teaches a rowdy, undisciplined class at Masegaki Primary School lacking sufficient Quirk counseling. She believes their misbehavior stems from closed hearts and inadequate emotional guidance.

cardPool.title: Komako Masu
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Komako Masu

Alias:
None

Quirk Name:
Unknown

Occupation/Role:
UA High School Student, Department of Management

Personality:
Outgoing and charismatic with nerves of steel. A natural moodmaker who focuses on the business and marketability of heroism. Pragmatic and observant, analyzing how heroes can be effectively promoted to society.

Appearance:
A young girl of below-average height with short, dark green hair slicked back with a single strand hanging in front. Large, round eyes behind rounded glasses. Always wears her UA gym uniform in a neat, put-together appearance.

Backstory:
A first-year student in UA's Department of Management business course, Komako approaches heroism from an entrepreneurial angle. She gained attention during the UA Sports Festival for analyzing Izuku's marketability and potential as a hero brand.

cardPool.title: Koku Hanabata
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Koku Hanabata

Alias: Trumpet

Quirk Name: Incite

Occupation/Role: Politician and Top Commander of the Meta Liberation Army

Personality: Calm, calculating, and manipulative. Intelligent and pragmatic, yet arrogant and demanding of absolute respect. Becomes malicious toward those claiming equality. Fiercely loyal to his ideals while willing to accept new authority from those he respects.

Appearance: Man with long black hair swept back and one strand falling over his face. Thin eyebrows, small mustache, angular nose, and small feminine eyes with dark blue irises. Wears yellow glasses with purple-tinted lenses. Formal business attire: white dress shirt, black tie, black blazer.

Backstory: Rose to prominence as politician leading the Hearts and Mind Party while secretly commanding the Meta Liberation Army. His dual role influenced both government and underground forces.

cardPool.title: Kojiro Bondo
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Kojiro Bondo

Alias: Plamo

Quirk Name: Cemedine

Occupation/Role: UA High School Student, Class 1-B

Personality: A gentle giant and shrinking violet who stammers despite being easygoing and well-liked. He maintains a calm demeanor despite his imposing stature.

Appearance: Tall and heavily muscular with wide shoulders, slender waist, and oversized hands. Yellow straw-colored skin with a glue-dispenser-shaped head. Seven eye-holes dot his face as Quirk outlets. He wears a baggy yellow hero suit with red bottle-cap accessories at neck, wrists, waist, and ankles; white gloves and red-soled shoes; red-trimmed black squares on sleeves; and dual glue bottle emblems on his belt.

Backstory: A first-year UA student training to become a Pro Hero, Kojiro has managed his unusual appearance and learned to harness his adhesive Quirk despite initial social hesitation.

cardPool.title: Koji Koda
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Koji Koda

Alias: Petting Hero: Anima

Quirk Name: Anivoice

Occupation/Role: UA High School Student, Class 1-A

Personality: Timid and quiet, preferring sign language over speech. Kind-hearted and averse to violence, he enjoys animals and cute things. Deathly afraid of bugs despite commanding them. Growing more confident, inspired by his father's courage.

Appearance: Tall young man with broad, muscular build and peach-colored skin. Head resembles an unevenly shaped rock with a pointed crown and square jaw, with thick hair-like protrusions extending from the back. Wears standard UA male uniform: light gray blazer with dark turquoise trim, white shirt, dark blue-green pants, red tie, and brown shoes. Hero costume is a tight yellow suit with large red marking across torso and a mouth-like symbol on chest.

cardPool.title: Koichi Haimawari
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Koichi Haimawari

Alias:
The Crawler, Nice Guy

Quirk Name:
Slide and Glide

Occupation/Role:
Vigilante, University Student

Personality:
Easy-going and mild-mannered with a heroic nature. Socially awkward and prone to accidental insults, but remains calm under pressure and willing to reason with criminals. Dreams of becoming a recognized hero.

Appearance:
Slim young man with short brown hair and large round brown eyes. Wears All Might-themed hoodies over black tactical gear with knee and elbow pads. Black sneakers with red accents. During vigilante work: black medical mask and red-tinted shades. Casual wear: black gakuran uniform with yellow buttons.

Backstory:
Discovered his Quirk and began operating as a vigilante, helping citizens and fighting petty crime. Trained under Knuckleduster and gradually built confidence in his abilities. Has earned a mixed reputation.

cardPool.title: Koga Iga
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Koga Iga

Alias:
None

Quirk Name:
Unknown

Occupation/Role:
Aspiring Hero / Student

Personality:
Confident and cocky toward those he perceives as weak, but willing to change his opinion if impressed by genuine ability. Shows respect and gratitude when others prove themselves worthy.

Appearance:
A young boy with short black hair in two large bangs framing his face and a strand sticking up at the back. He typically wears jeans with suspenders and ninja-themed outfits for hero activities.

Backstory:
An aspiring hero who idolizes Pro Hero Edgeshot and dreams of becoming a ninja hero. At Hero Festa, Koga mocked another boy, Katsuma Shimano, for weakness. During Edgeshot's trap house display, Koga injured his ankle and was rescued by Katsuma, leading to mutual respect and a shared promise to become Heroes.

Additional Information:
Not confirmed as a UA High School student.

cardPool.title: Kodama
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Kodama

Alias: Priestess of Kamino-ga-fuchi

Quirk Name: Plant Healing

Occupation/Role: Village Priestess and Guardian of the Sacred Tree

Personality: Devoted and protective, Kodama is initially suspicious of outsiders but quick to cooperate once trust is established. She prioritizes her village and sacred tree above her own safety, displaying unwavering determination and quiet nobility.

Appearance: A young woman with short dark hair, side bangs, and center part, secured by a hairband with leaf decorations near her ears. She wears traditional white and red miko priestess clothing.

Backstory: Kodama serves as priestess of Kamino-ga-fuchi village, maintaining and healing the ancient Sacred Tree that is the spiritual heart of her community.

cardPool.title: Kiruka Hasaki
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Kiruka Hasaki
Alias: Slice
Quirk Name: Slice
Occupation/Role: Villain
Personality: Confident and ruthless in combat, willing to cause destruction for her goals. Shows concern for teammates, particularly Nine, and values cooperation. Yearns to create a world where power determines worth after being ostracized by society. Vain about her appearance, especially her hair.
Appearance: Fair-skinned young woman with inward-sloping blue eyes and full lips. Long, straight shiny red hair with chin-length bangs and front strands looping to her knees. Wears a pale purple blouse with frilled cuffs under a low-collared navy dress with brown belt, dark red gloves, purple frilled thigh-high socks, black knee-high boots with red binding, black choker with red center, and black domino mask.
Backstory: A powerful villain recruited by Nine to establish a new world order based on strength.

cardPool.title: Kirihito Kamachi
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Kirihito Kamachi

Alias: Kamayan

Quirk Name: Mantis

Occupation/Role: Manager at Hopper's Cafe

Personality: Surprisingly insightful about society's treatment of mutant Quirk users despite limited intelligence. Laments his transformation while enjoying refined tastes like tea and classical music. Values manners and privacy but hypocritically prejudges others with mutated bodies. Maintains genuine friendships despite exaggerated complaints.

Appearance: Humanoid mantis form with scythe-like arms, insectoid chest, mantis abdomen, four additional legs, chitinous protuberances, and antennae. Wears waiter's uniform at the cafe.

Backstory: Ordinary person kidnapped and bio-engineered by the Villain Factory, his Quirk artificially boosted to extreme levels. Became a Next-Level Villain through forced modification and Trigger drug use, struggling with his new identity.

cardPool.title: Kinoko Komori
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Kinoko Komori

Alias: Shemage

Quirk Name: Mushroom

Occupation/Role: UA High School Class 1-B Student, aspiring Pro Hero

Personality: Initially shy and reserved, Kinoko grows confident and cheerful around peers. She has a gleeful obsession with mushrooms and makes frequent puns. Despite her playful nature, she demonstrates genuine kindness and concern for others.

Appearance: A short girl with honey-brown mushroom-shaped bob hair and distinctive cat-like eyes with cross-shaped pupils. Her hero costume features a red and white fly agaric turtleneck dress, matching mushroom hat, furred sleeves, pale pink knee-high boots, and dark brown belt with golden buckle.

Backstory: A UA first-year student training to become a Pro Hero, Kinoko initially struggles with social anxiety but builds confidence through combat training and teamwork.

cardPool.title: Kesagiri Man
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown

Alias: Kesagiri Man

Quirk Name: Enhanced Speed

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero

Personality: Quiet and composed with commanding presence. Deep, authoritative voice. Shows empathy when consoling others, remains analytical during tactical discussions. Sharp critical thinking when questioning assumptions.

Appearance: Tall, imposing figure in full-body black fur suit covering everything except fingers. Sleek, predatory silhouette. Deep voice and measured demeanor suggest maturity and professionalism.

Backstory: Experienced Pro Hero known for quiet competence. Recruited by Sir Nighteye to investigate the Eight Bullets Yakuza organization and their League of Villains connection. Participated in strategic briefings and the assault on the Yakuza base.

Additional Information: Senior hero capable of independent field operations and tactical decision-making.

cardPool.title: Kido
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Kido
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Not specified in source material
Occupation/Role: Pro Hero Sidekick at Endeavor Agency
Personality: Reserved and logical, maintaining composure under pressure. Quietly proud of his role as a Flaming Sidekicker and follows orders dutifully. Fair-minded and treats all equally.
Appearance: Man of average build with gray eyes and brown hair. His entire face is covered in signature bandages, with wrapping on parts of his arms and hands. Wears a flak jacket over a short-sleeved shirt as his hero costume.
Backstory: Became a Pro Hero approximately ten years before the Paranormal Liberation War. Works as one of over thirty sidekicks under Endeavor, earning respect through reliable service and calm judgment.
Additional Information: Experienced in villain apprehension and containment.

cardPool.title: Kenji Tsuragamae
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Kenji Tsuragamae
Alias: Chief Tsuragamae
Quirk Name: Dog
Occupation/Role: Chief of the Police Force
Personality: Stern and rule-bound yet pragmatic, willing to bend enforcement for justice when warranted. Respectful of genuine heroism and carries official dignity, though dog-related speech tics undercut formality. Compassionate toward young heroes despite maintaining lawful order.
Appearance: Exceptionally tall, powerfully built man with beagle head featuring dark brown markings around eyes and ears, tan line down forehead widening toward muzzle. Large black nose, dark eyes, tan skin, human body. Wears formal black suit with dress shirt, waistcoat, black blazer, matching dress pants, large-buckled belt, and dalmatian-patterned tie.
Backstory: Rose through law enforcement to become Chief of Police after Quirks emerged.

cardPool.title: Kenji Hikiishi
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Kenji Hikiishi
Alias: Magne
Quirk Name: Magnetism
Occupation/Role: Villain, League of Villains Vanguard Action Squad member
Personality: Cruel and brutal, driven by desire for freedom. Quick-thinking in combat and tactically intelligent, refusing subjugation.
Appearance: Wide, muscular build with shoulder-length reddish-magenta hair, square jaw with light facial hair, and large pink-tinted lips. Wears triangular white-framed sunglasses, dark orange unbuttoned shirt over white v-neck undershirt, blue jeans with belt, and dark brown boots.
Backstory: Hardened criminal with a record of 9 armed robberies and multiple murders. Joined the League of Villains seeking freedom from societal constraints. Skilled combatant who uses her Quirk with brutal efficiency as part of the Vanguard Action Squad.
Additional Information: Magnetism Quirk polarizes targets within 4.

cardPool.title: Kendo Rappa
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Kendo Rappa

Alias: The Rapper

Quirk Name: Strongarm

Occupation/Role: Eight Bullets member of the Shie Hassaikai

Personality: Hot-blooded and violence-driven, Kendo lives for combat and respects only worthy challengers. He refuses weapons or allies when he can win alone, yet shows mercy to honorable opponents.

Appearance: A massive, heavily muscular man with long light brown hair and a plague mask. He wears a tattered t-shirt beneath a light blue tunic, dark pants, and dual belts. Metal-reinforced leather gloves cover his hands.

Backstory: An undefeated MMA fighter from the Underground Masquerade, Kendo's raw power attracted Kai Chisaki's attention. After seeking single combat to earn Chisaki's respect, he became an Eight Bullets member, endlessly pursuing the ultimate fight.

Additional Information: Expert hand-to-hand combatant with techniques from cage fighting.

cardPool.title: Ken Takagi
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Ken Takagi

Alias: Lock Hero: Rock Lock

Quirk Name: Lock Down

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero

Personality: Pragmatic and blunt, quick to judge others' competence. Critical of inexperienced students, viewing youth as a liability. Confident to arrogance in his abilities. Does not tolerate underestimation. Despite harsh snap judgments, he respects those who exceed expectations and revises opinions accordingly.

Appearance: Average height man with short dark coily hair in an afro. Pierced ears with padlock earrings. Key-shaped protrusions at fingertips. Wears small yellow eye mask, red necklace with dangling keys, and yellow and dark green short-sleeved bodysuit patterned with keyholes. Light gray shoulder pads with keyhole designs, white boots, and brown belt with keys complete his costume.

Backstory: Experienced Pro Hero with proven competence.

cardPool.title: Ken Ishiyama
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Ken Ishiyama
Alias: Cementoss
Quirk Name: Cement
Occupation/Role: Pro Hero and Modern Literature Teacher at UA High School
Personality: Serious yet pleasant, deeply caring about student wellbeing and safety. Brave and principled in combat, willing to sacrifice for those he protects. Respectful and devoted to his duties as educator and hero.
Appearance: A humanoid figure composed of gray cement with a blocky, proportioned body. Black closed eyes with tiny pupils when opened, gray hair in a short ponytail. Wears a sleeveless brown suit with yellow stripe accents, matching shorts, and gray shoes with yellow soles. Sturdy, imposing build befitting his cement nature.
Backstory: A seasoned Pro Hero serving on UA High's faculty, teaching Modern Literature to first-year students. Known for exceptional Quirk control and unwavering commitment to student safety and hero principles.

cardPool.title: Keigo Takami
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Keigo Takami

Alias: Wing Hero: Hawks

Quirk Name: Fierce Wings

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero (No. 2 on Hero Billboard Chart)

Personality: Highly intelligent with a deceptively carefree demeanor masking constant vigilance. Cocky and laid-back, he speaks bluntly while maintaining emotional control. Hawks follows orders with subtle cynicism, dislikes formalities, and acts unpredictably with joking submissiveness.

Appearance: Average height with slim build. Ash-blonde feathered hair swept back with front tufts standing in arcs. Golden-brown triangular eyes with black bird-like markings. Thick eyebrows, faint stubble, and square ear piercings. His costume features a black patterned shirt under a tan shearling jacket with shoulder slits for large bright red folded wings, black gloves, yellow visor, and yellow ear-protective headphones.

cardPool.title: Kazuho Haneyama
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Kazuho Haneyama

Alias: Pop☆Step

Quirk Name: Not explicitly stated in source material

Occupation/Role: Freelance idol and former vigilante; student

Personality: Logical strategist with enthusiasm for performance and vanity about appearance. Fierce and sharp-tongued, quick to berate allies. Secretive about vigilante activities but deeply cares for companions despite harsh demeanor.

Appearance: Pink messy hair concealed by round blue-framed glasses; blue eyes. Civilian form: black long-sleeved seifuku with white collar, red accents, red tie, white knee-high socks, blue sneakers. As Pop☆Step: black backless leotard with pink heart chest opening, high pigtails, black mask with pink eye makeup, red bow tie, fingerless gloves, mini-skirt with purple hearts, black boots with pink details.

cardPool.title: Katsuma Shimano
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Katsuma Shimano
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Cell Activation
Occupation/Role: UA High School Student, Hero Course, Class 1-A
Personality: Timid and soft-spoken, easily influenced by his older sister. Admires Pro Heroes deeply and shows genuine remorse for mistakes. Selfless and brave when protecting loved ones, willing to sacrifice his own Quirk for others' safety.
Appearance: Young boy with brown eyes, curly light brown hair, and freckles. Wears UA uniform, carries a yellow messenger bag with an Edgeshot enamel pin, wears a floral charm bracelet (handmade by his mother), and sports a large sun hat with a blue band.
Backstory: Originally from Nabu Island, Katsuma lived with his older sister Mahoro before enrolling at UA. He idolizes heroes and dreams of becoming one.

cardPool.title: Kashiko Sekigai
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Kashiko Sekigai
Alias: Sensor Girl
Quirk Name: Holographic Map
Occupation/Role: Isami Academy High School Student, Class President
Personality: Responsible and level-headed with strong leadership qualities; uninterested in casual romantic advances.
Appearance: Petite girl with periwinkle-blue shoulder-length hair, intelligent gray eyes behind thick-framed triangular glasses. Wears Isami High uniform: white shirt, dark red bow tie, dark blue blazer, pleated gray skirt, socks, and brown loafers.
Backstory: Trusted Class President at Isami Academy whose Quirk makes her invaluable for reconnaissance and coordination, shaping her responsible nature.
Additional Information: Hero costume features navy turtleneck bodysuit with geometric patterns, shoulder-pads marked with "S," visor, red gloves, wrist-mounted radar screens, and thigh-high boots.

cardPool.title: Kameko
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Kameko
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Unnamed Tortoise Quirk
Occupation/Role: Hero School Student (Hiroshima)
Personality: Loyal and cautious friend who restrains impulsive companion Rumi; level-headed despite her tortoise-like nature.
Appearance: Young woman with tortoise characteristics including a visible shell on her back, dark hair, small round eyes, and minimal nose. She maintains a humanoid form despite her reptilian features.
Backstory: A student at a hero school in Hiroshima who befriended Rumi Usagiyama and Sameko. During a school trip to Osaka's Tsutenkaku Tower, the trio became lost before encountering a young Fat Gum. Kameko witnessed Rumi's impulsive nature when she abandoned the group to investigate a nearby battle.
Additional Information: Not a UA High School student; attends a hero school in Hiroshima. Her Quirk grants tortoise attributes.

cardPool.title: Kashiko Kashi
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Kashiko Kashi

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Unknown

Occupation/Role: Prison Escapee, Criminal

Personality: Pragmatic and calculating, Kashiko chooses to lie low rather than cause chaos. He views himself as intellectually superior to attention-seeking criminals and possesses a cynical worldview. Despite his dark past, he finds contentment in quietude and smiles at the prospect of a peaceful suburban life.

Appearance: A young man with long, spiky orange hair extending above his face. He has small, piercing pupils and wears earrings. His casual attire is simple and unremarkable, reflecting his fugitive status.

Backstory: Imprisoned for robbery and murder, Kashiko was freed during the chaos following the Paranormal Liberation War. Rather than joining other escapees in wreaking havoc, he sought refuge in an abandoned suburban home.

cardPool.title: Kaoruko Awata
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Kaoruko Awata

Alias: Bubble Girl

Quirk Name: Bubble

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero Sidekick at Sir Nighteye's Hero Office

Personality: Serious and dedicated professional who remains composed under pressure. She demonstrates loyalty to her work despite frequent threats of dismissal.

Appearance: Fair-skinned young woman with light blue complexion and short, ruffled dark blue hair parted to the right. Wide yellow eyes with thick eyelashes. Hero costume includes dark blue crop top with white high collar and zipper, black tights with white shorts and yellow stripes, thick white boots with yellow rings, transparent visor with dual air filters, and dark blue gloves.

Backstory: Dedicated sidekick under renowned Pro Hero Sir Nighteye, Kaoruko has mastered her aromatic bubble abilities. She maintains her position despite her boss's temperamental management style.

cardPool.title: Kamile Gollini
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Kamile Gollini
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Spatial Excursion
Occupation/Role: Member of the Gollini Family mafia
Personality: Devious and sadistic with a wicked smile. He delights in tormenting enemies and shows no mercy, though he is somewhat lazy. Loyal to Dark Might but quick to abandon when facing defeat.
Appearance: A short, elderly man with pale wrinkled skin and a pronounced upper body. He has a large beaked nose, sharp chin, and white split-end hair. He dresses as a butler in a red tailcoat, white gloves, green neckcloth, navy-gray pants, and buckled shoes with a rose on his coat.
Backstory: A seasoned member of the Gollini Family serving as aide to Dark Might. He participated in schemes involving Symbol of Paradise and the capture of targets like Anna.
Additional Information: Not a UA student. His Quirk allows him to move objects and people freely without gravity.

cardPool.title: Kai Chisaki
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Kai Chisaki
Alias: Overhaul
Quirk Name: Overhaul
Occupation/Role: Villain, Leader of the Shie Hassaikai Yakuza organization
Personality: A mysophobic, antisocial sociopath with an enormous ego and no moral compass. Outwardly polite and strategic, but a manipulative mastermind convinced he alone understands Quirks as a plague on humanity. His calm demeanor masks profound disturbance and incapacity for empathy.
Appearance: A pale young man with short, shaggy auburn hair and small gold irises. He wears a distinctive magenta plague doctor mask embroidered with gold, white surgical gloves, a black dress shirt with pale gray tie, dark olive-green bomber jacket with purple fur collar, and white lace-up sneakers.
Backstory: Driven by mysophobia and a discredited theory linking Quirks to rats, Kai became obsessed with returning the world to its pre-Quirk state.

cardPool.title: Kagero Okuta
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Kagero Okuta

Alias: Giran

Quirk Name: Muddied

Occupation/Role: Villain broker and scout for the League of Villains

Personality: Indifferent and profit-driven with a calculating smirk. He refuses deals with those he dislikes and protects client confidentiality even under torture. He shows unexpected kindness to outcasts, offering genuine counsel when warranted. Eccentric tastes include a bunny-eared phone case and lighting cigarettes with gunfire.

Appearance: A middle-aged man of moderate height with squinted pink eyes and drawn-up eyebrows. Short gray hair parted right with side bangs, thin mustache, small goatee, and a gap-toothed grin. He wears matching dress pants and blazer over a partially unbuttoned black shirt with plain black shoes. A thick golden segmented tube necklace adorns his neck, sometimes with an intestine-shaped fluffy scarf.

cardPool.title: Juzo Moashi
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Juzo Moashi

Alias: Centipeder

Quirk Name: Centipede

Occupation/Role: Sidekick at Sir Nighteye's Hero Office

Personality: A gentleman of impeccable manners and refined conduct. He is disciplined and loyal to his mentor's ideals.

Appearance: A tall, lean man with a distinctive centipede-like face of brown coloration. His elongated centipede neck drapes elegantly across his shoulders. He dresses formally in a black tuxedo.

Backstory: Juzo serves as a dedicated sidekick under Sir Nighteye's mentorship, learning heroism within the agency and being groomed as a successor.

Additional Information: His centipede-like limbs grant exceptional reach and versatility in combat, allowing him to attack and restrain opponents from considerable distances. He is a capable and trustworthy member of Sir Nighteye's team.

cardPool.title: Juzo Honenuki
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Juzo Honenuki

Alias:
Mudman

Quirk Name:
Softening

Occupation/Role:
Class 1-B Student at U.A. High School

Personality:
Calm and understanding with excellent judgment. Dislikes losing but respects deserved victories. Demonstrates flexible thinking in strategy and cares about his classmates. Composed but acknowledges needing more stubbornness to overcome unfavorable conditions.

Appearance:
Pale-skinned young man with angular eyes, mid-length spiky beige hair, and a flat nose. Distinctive protruding teeth with no visible lips creating a skull-like appearance. Wears a dark bodysuit under orange and black armor plating, rounded black helmet with white visor lines, orange-accented vambraces, green boots with pipe shafts, and white gloves.

Backstory:
Earned his U.A. place through official recommendation, indicating exceptional aptitude.

cardPool.title: Jurota Shishida
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Jurota Shishida
Alias: Gevaudan
Quirk Name: Beast
Occupation/Role: UA High School Student, Class 1-B
Personality: Intellectually refined and formally polite due to his well-mannered upbringing. When transformed, he becomes boisterous and energetic. He admires Hound Dog's freedom but feels constrained by propriety. Despite his bestial nature, he retains sharp tactical thinking even in Beast form.
Appearance: A tall young man with shaggy brown hair and sharp, prominent teeth with two lower canines protruding. He wears small rectangular glasses with thick black lenses. His hero costume features dark brown fur-lined boots, a shirt collar, and stylized goggles.
Backstory: Raised in a doting, well-mannered family that instilled formality and propriety in him.

cardPool.title: Jube Namimaru
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Jube Namimaru
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Wooden Swords From His Hands
Occupation/Role: Middle School Student
Personality: Appears intimidating due to his delinquent look, but is genuinely kind to friends. Devoted Pop☆Step fan and willing to aid vigilantes against Trigger drug distribution.
Appearance: Short, stocky middle schooler with prominent chops. Wears a black jacket with torn sleeves over a white t-shirt, black pants, and sandals. Black cap with x-shaped buckle, torn at the back. Rough Yankii aesthetic.
Backstory: A middle school student in the underground hero world through vigilante associations. Inspired by Pop☆Step, he uses his combat abilities to fight Trigger drug proliferation.
Additional Information: Not a UA student; operates as a civilian vigilante supporter. His Quirk produces wooden swords from his wrists roughly the length of his arms.

cardPool.title: Joi Irinaka
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Joi Irinaka

Alias:
Mimic

Quirk Name:
Mimicry

Occupation/Role:
General Manager of Shie Hassaikai, Yakuza member

Personality:
Hot-tempered and emotionally volatile, allowing anger to override strategy. Fiercely loyal to Overhaul and quick to rage at disrespect. Despite aggression, he demonstrates cunning in combat and administrative competence managing finances and operations.

Appearance:
Tall, muscular man with pointed features including spiked nose, long square chin, and large mouth. Long spiky blonde hair and matching goatee. Wears black dress shirt with pinstriped pants and suspenders in Yakuza style. When using his Quirk, he inhabits a small black cloak-like bodysuit with short limb protrusions and white plague mask.

Backstory:
High-ranking Shie Hassaikai member risen to general manager, overseeing financial and administrative duties.

cardPool.title: Johnny
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Johnny

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Warping

Occupation/Role: Nomu experiment subject; teleportation device under Daruma Ujiko's control

Personality: Minimal documented personality; appears docile and content during supervised walks; behavior heavily influenced by external control mechanisms.

Appearance: A small Nomu with dark skin, round eyes, and exposed brain tissue. His lower body is replaced by a thick cable connecting to his torso. He wears pale lace-up shoes on his upper limbs and a transparent helmet with mechanical protrusions serving as a manual Quirk activator.

Backstory: Created by Daruma Ujiko and imprisoned in a secret laboratory, Johnny was engineered as a living teleportation apparatus under his creator's command.

cardPool.title: Jiro Hotta
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Jiro Hotta

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Grasshopper

Occupation/Role: Trigger dealer and manager of Hopper's Cafe

Personality: Pragmatic and morally ambiguous, Jiro maintains ethics within his criminal enterprise—refusing to deal adulterated Trigger despite its profitability. He is easily frustrated by unwanted interference but remains loyal to friends. He balances self-interest with genuine concern for those close to him.

Appearance: An average-height man with pale brown hair, tanned skin, sharp eyes with small black pupils, and a goatee. He wears an open white hoodie with hood up, grey pants, white sneakers, blue apron, and an orange-yellow bandanna around his neck—the only garment that survives his transformations.

Backstory: Jiro operates as a Trigger dealer with his brother Ichiro, managing distribution through Hopper's Cafe.

cardPool.title: Jin Bubaigawara
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Jin Bubaigawara

Alias: Twice

Quirk Name: Double

Occupation/Role: Villain, League of Villains member, Vanguard Action Squad operative

Personality: Explosively manic and contradictory, Jin shifts between opposing statements with chaotic energy. Beneath his dramatics lies severe dissociative disorder from a nine-day conflict with his own clones. He craves acceptance desperately, making him loyal but vulnerable to betrayal. Without his mask, his fractured personalities argue; with it, he appears unified. His instability drives him between humor and destructive aggression.

Appearance: A well-built man with shoulder-length blond hair and gray-blue eyes lacking eyebrows. Sparse facial hair above his mouth and chin. He wears a black-and-gray bodysuit with gray "T" and "W" patterns across his chest. Red wristbands with green accents store measuring tapes.

cardPool.title: Iyaro Tenba
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Iyaro Tenba

Alias:
None

Quirk Name:
Multiple Arms

Occupation/Role:
Villain/Criminal

Personality:
Ruthless and violent, willing to kill without hesitation. Shows no regard for human life, treating victims as obstacles.

Appearance:
Muscular man of average height with short brown hair and small round glasses. Wears a gray tank top and green pants. Two extra sets of arms sprout from his back due to his Quirk.

Backstory:
Released from prison, Iyaro went on a two-month spree of armed robberies and murders. His escalating violence made him a high-priority target for heroes.

Additional Information:
Eliminated by the Vigilante Stendhal before law enforcement could apprehend him. Represents a dangerous criminal element in the villain underworld.

cardPool.title: Iwao Oguro
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Iwao Oguro

Alias: Knuckleduster

Quirk Name: Overclock

Occupation/Role: Vigilante, former Pro Hero (High-Speed Hero: O'Clock)

Personality: Driven by justice, Knuckleduster is direct and aggressive, preferring action over deliberation. He thrives on challenging fights and grows bored easily. Reckless and violence-first, he possesses surprising intelligence and perceptiveness. He shows no resentment toward Quirkless individuals and admires Heroes despite operating outside the law.

Appearance: A tall, heavily muscled man with short black hair, thick eyebrows, and heavy stubble. He wears a loose black ragged wrap-around mask, tight black shirt, khaki military pants with black belt, black boots, and a long hunter green trench coat. Black gloves with silver knuckledusters complete his outfit.

cardPool.title: Itsuka Kendo
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Itsuka Kendo

Alias: Battle Fist

Quirk Name: Big Fist

Occupation/Role: UA High School Student, Class 1-B Representative

Personality: Spirited and thoughtful, Itsuka is Class 1-B's compassionate "big sister" who corrects others when needed. She's analytical in combat, friendly across class lines, and willing to sacrifice for teammates. Despite her stern discipline, she holds no ill-will toward rivals and shows genuine concern for others.

Appearance: Medium height with slim build, Itsuka has sharp teal eyes with white pupils and long orange hair in a high left-side ponytail with three-clump bangs. She wears a teal knee-length qipao with yellow accents over a black corset, black shorts, brown utility belt, black domino mask, and navy heeled boots with white trim.

Backstory: A natural leader and capable combatant, Itsuka earned 5th place in the UA Entrance Exam.

cardPool.title: Itejiro Toteki
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Itejiro Toteki

Alias: Boomerang Man

Quirk Name: Boomerang

Occupation/Role: Third-year student at Ketsubutsu Academy High School

Personality: Reserved and shy, but confident and talkative about his abilities. Maintains graceful composure during performances, though apologetic about his power usage.

Appearance: Young man with small black oval eyes, small mouth, and round nose. Wavy shoulder-length black hair pushed back at the forehead. Wears a black shirt with elbow-length sleeves, black capri pants with tights, and black sneakers. Accessorized with a wide red scarf, thin red wristbands, and dark red fingerless gloves.

Backstory: Training to become a Pro Hero at Ketsubutsu Academy. Participated in the Provisional Hero License Exam as a second-year, facing Class 1-A in the "Crushing of U.A." competition. Demonstrated exceptional accuracy with projectile-throwing.

cardPool.title: Invisible Wall
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown

Alias: Invisible Wall

Quirk Name: Chameleon

Occupation/Role: Villain, League of Villains recruit

Personality: Cunning and deceptive in combat, arrogant enough to mock foes mid-battle. Relies too heavily on camouflage advantage and underestimates opponents.

Appearance: Tall and scrawny with bright green, scaly skin. Reptilian head with prominent spikes, large bulbous eyes capable of independent rotation, and elongated tongue. Wears black bodysuit, black sneakers, and communications headset.

Backstory: Recruited by Tomura Shigaraki for the U.S.J. assault. Attempted to ambush Bakugo and Kirishima from the ceiling while camouflaged, but was immediately defeated by an explosion to the head. Arrested after Pro Heroes arrived.

Additional Information: Specializes in stealth attacks using camouflage and wall-climbing. Carries a knife as primary weapon.

cardPool.title: Innsmouth
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Innsmouth
Alias: None documented
Quirk Name: Octopus
Occupation/Role: Petty criminal and cargo smuggler
Personality: Greedy and ruthless, willing to use hostages and underhanded tactics. Highly aggressive when opposed, escalating to violence without hesitation.
Appearance: A semi-anthropomorphic octopus with reddish-dull bumpy skin. His head resembles an octopus mantle with ridges above his eyes and a trunk-like mouth with three suction cups on each side. Two prehensile tentacles flank the trunk while four boneless arms have suction cups at shoulder, elbow, and wrist. He wears grey baggy pants, red boots, a brown leather belt, a maroon sleeveless coat, and a red scarf-hood with various watches and bracelets.
Backstory: An independent villain operating as a smuggler in illegal drug trafficking.

cardPool.title: Inko Midoriya
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Inko Midoriya

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Object Attraction

Occupation/Role: Homemaker, Mother of UA Student Izuku Midoriya

Personality: Kind and supportive, prone to worry and panic that leads to fainting. She cries easily when emotional and shares her son's anxious nature. Inko is protective and selfless, feeling guilty about her son's hardships.

Appearance: A woman in her late thirties with shoulder-length dark green hair and a small spiky ponytail. She has large, circular dark green eyes like her son's. She has gained weight over the years and shows signs of maturity, with a gentle, motherly quality.

Backstory: Inko is the devoted wife of Hisashi Midoriya and mother to Izuku. When Izuku was diagnosed Quirkless, she felt overwhelming guilt.

cardPool.title: Inasa Yoarashi
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Inasa Yoarashi
Alias: Gale Force
Quirk Name: Whirlwind
Occupation/Role: First-year student at Shiketsu High School
Personality: Energetic and exuberant, Inasa expresses himself with loud vigor and formal politeness. He believes passion is the core of heroism and despises those with "cold eyes." Genuinely pure-hearted but headstrong, he holds deep grudges against those lacking passion, particularly Endeavor and Shoto Todoroki.
Appearance: A tall, well-built young man with buzzed dark brown hair and black eyes. He wears the Shiketsu uniform—white shirt and dark pants with the school's signature hat. His hero costume features a burgundy suit with yellow buttons, fur-collared cape, and jetpack-like propulsion on his back. His left arm is concealed in thick brown material with a tan glove featuring air pipes on the knuckles. His right arm wears a blue skintight sleeve.

cardPool.title: Ikkaku
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Ikkaku
Alias: Future Hero
Quirk Name: Horn
Occupation/Role: Student at Terakoya Private Hero School
Personality: Jovial, energetic prankster who craves attention and approval. Idolizes flashy heroes and masks inferiority complex about his own abilities. Impulsive and mischievous, seeking validation through grand gestures and boasts of becoming awesome.
Appearance: A boy with long spiky hair covering his right eye. A prominent horn grows from his head due to his Quirk. Wears a short-sleeved shirt layered over long-sleeved dark shirt, dark shorts, two small fanny packs at his waist, and a spotted neckerchief.
Backstory: A student at Terakoya hero school with dreams of becoming celebrated. Ikkaku harbors doubts about his Quirk, viewing it as unremarkable compared to classmates' powers.

cardPool.title: Ikajiro Takobe
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Ikajiro Takobe

Alias: Octoid

Quirk Name: Octopus

Occupation/Role: Former Next-Level Villain, currently reforming

Personality: Once a violent brute under Trigger influence, Ikajiro is now kind and educated, deeply regretting his past. He is apologetic, sensitive, and gentle—he loves cats and shows genuine remorse for the harm he caused.

Appearance: A tall, muscular humanoid with jet-black skin and no hair. Six powerful arms line his torso with suction cups; two additional tentacles remain hidden until deployed. His face is nearly featureless except for faint lines from mouth to forehead concealing tiny eyes. He wears tank tops, shorts, foam clogs, and various colored durags.

Backstory: Ikajiro was physically modified by the Villain Factory and enhanced with Trigger, becoming a mindless instrument of destruction.

cardPool.title: Ichimoku Samazu
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Ichimoku Samazu
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Beams From His Eyes
Occupation/Role: Middle School Student
Personality: Kind and polite despite intimidating appearance; devoted Pop☆Step fan; helps vigilantes combat crime and Trigger distribution.
Appearance: Tall middle schooler with short black hair in a pompadour and small moustache. Wears modified goggles with side mufflers and central slit visor to control his Quirk. Dresses in delinquent style: black gakuran, black shoes, and armlet.
Backstory: Adopted the delinquent lifestyle while maintaining a good heart. Inspired by hero Pop☆Step, he became involved in vigilante efforts against Trigger distribution.
Additional Information: Not a UA High School student. His visor goggles are essential for controlling eye beam output in combat.

cardPool.title: Ichi Anrakuki
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Ichi Anrakuki
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Static
Occupation/Role: Prisoner at Mikuzu Prison
Personality: Serious and embittered by betrayal, yet capable of kindness and fairness. Initially cynical about redemption, but gradually rekindled to hope through witnessing genuine selflessness. Polite and cooperative despite his despair.
Appearance: Adult man with short black hair and a perpetually scowling face. Wears standard blank prison clothing. His stern expression reflects years of hardship and disillusionment.
Backstory: Coerced into falsifying financial statements at a tech startup and framed by his trusted friend, Ichi was imprisoned for fraud. Unable to find employment as an ex-convict after release, he became homeless. Upon witnessing his former friend's wealth, Ichi attacked him in rage and was re-incarcerated for aggravated assault.

cardPool.title: Hoyo Makihara
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Hoyo Makihara

Alias: Mummy

Quirk Name: Mummification

Occupation/Role: Villain, member of Nine's criminal organization

Personality: Apathetic and merciless with no remorse. Highly cautious and tactical, preferring battlefield control through preparation rather than direct confrontation. Demonstrates calculated intelligence in attrition-based strategies.

Appearance: A tall, lanky man with pale orange baggy eyes and straight gray hair. His body is wrapped in burgundy bandages except for hands and eyes. He wears a dark gray combat vest, light gray skin-tight pants with beige knee guards, black fingerless gloves, and grey dress shoes. A brown garter belt holds pouches, and he carries a small sword on his left shoulder.

Backstory: A skilled villain recruited into Nine's organization for the Nabu Island operation.

cardPool.title: Hokuto Hario
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Hokuto Hario

Alias: Compass Kid

Quirk Name: Pointer

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero (Lower-class rank)

Personality: Optimistic and amicable, Hokuto values bringing peace to civilians and deeply loves his family. His trusting nature makes him vulnerable to deception, despite his positive outlook.

Appearance: A middle-aged man with small circular eyes, large chin, and short black hair parted left. His hero costume is a slightly-too-small bodysuit with exposed stomach, fastened by a C-shaped belt buckle. An eight-wind compass rose adorns the chest. He wears light gloves, a light cape, and dark boots decorated with arrows. A small domino mask with arrow eyebrows completes the look.

Backstory: Hokuto became a pro hero to protect civilians and be a role model for his children. During a patrol with hero Rock, he discovered Rock's villainous identity while investigating attacks.

cardPool.title: Hitoshi Shinso
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Hitoshi Shinso

Alias: Hypnosis Hero: NightHide

Quirk Name: Brainwashing

Occupation/Role: Student, Class 1-C Department of General Education at UA High School

Personality: Stoic and reserved with sharp wit, Hitoshi manipulates conversations to his advantage. Resentful toward those with naturally heroic Quirks, he masks his longing for acceptance behind a calculating demeanor. Despite claiming indifference to friendship, he secretly desires validation as a true hero.

Appearance: A tall young man with messy, indigo hair flaring outward in large tufts. His distinctive purple eyes are thin and triangular with white pupils, half-closed beneath dark eye bags. He wears the standard UA uniform; during combat training, he dons a dark blue PE uniform with white UA markings, a detachable artificial vocal cord device, a capturing weapon around his neck, and green-white sneakers.

cardPool.title: Hisashi Midoriya
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Hisashi Midoriya
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Fire Breath
Occupation/Role: Businessman (abroad)
Personality: Unknown; absent from his son's life, suggesting either work dedication or emotional distance.
Appearance: Adult male; presumed to share features with his son Izuku.
Backstory: Married Inko and fathered Izuku before taking a work post abroad. His whereabouts remain mysterious.
Additional Information: Not a UA student. His Fire Breath Quirk contrasts with his son's lack of a Quirk, creating family tension. His prolonged absence suggests minimal involvement in current UA events.

cardPool.title: Hiroshi Tameda
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Hiroshi Tameda

Alias:
"Can't You See?" Kid

Quirk Name:
Not specified

Occupation/Role:
Civilian/Endeavor Fan

Personality:
Passionate Endeavor fan who admires his determination. Initially naive but emotionally invested in hero society; prone to dramatic swings when beliefs are challenged. Despite setbacks, remains hopeful and supportive.

Appearance:
Young man of average height with spiky pink hair and large brown eyes. Plain-looking with youthful civilian clothing and no distinguishing marks.

Backstory:
Devoted to Pro Hero Endeavor and his pursuit of excellence. Became emotionally turbulent learning of Endeavor's abusive past through Dabi's broadcast. Experienced hero society's collapse from evacuation centers, testing his faith repeatedly.

Additional Information:
Not a UA student.

cardPool.title: Hiryu Rin

Alias: Long Weizi

Occupation/Role: UA High School Class 1-B Student
Personality: Collaborative fighter with severe demeanor in combat, diligent in academics and Quirk mastery, strong tactical intellect and quick reflexes.
Appearance: Lightly tanned skin with black hair in low braid; reptilian eyes with small irises. Wears high-collared black bodysuit with yellow clouds, white knee-high boots with yellow straps, red belt with pouches, large yellow gauntlets with black sleeves, and yellow visor.
Backstory: Class 1-B student training to become Pro Hero at UA High School. Distinguished through strategic thinking and combat versatility, earning respect through collaboration.
Additional Information: Excels in close and long-range combat through scale projection with terrific accuracy. Scale armor has durability limits against sufficient force.

cardPool.title: Hizashi Yamada
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Hizashi Yamada

Alias: Voice Hero: Present Mic

Quirk Name: Voice

Occupation/Role: English Teacher at UA High School / Pro Hero (No. 45)

Personality: An eccentric, high-energy entertainer with a radio host persona who maintains excitement regardless of situation. He engages crowds as "listeners" and exaggerates events for hype. Despite his jovial nature, he is deeply loyal to friends and capable of intense rage when betrayed. He suffers from entomophobia and prefers urban areas to forests.

Appearance: A tall, slim man with long blond hair spiked upward, small brown mustache, and rectangular eyes with greenish-yellow irises. He wears orange-tinted shades, black headphones labeled "HAGE," and maintains a large smile.

cardPool.title: Himiko Toga
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Himiko Toga

Alias:
Toga

Quirk Name:
Transform

Occupation/Role:
UA High School Student (Class 1-A); Member of the League of Villains

Personality:
Cheerful and sadistic with twisted views on love, seeing absorption of others as intimacy. Mentally unstable, prone to erratic mood shifts between playful affection and dangerous aggression.

Appearance:
Fair-skinned girl with distinctive inward-tilting yellow cat-like eyes, thin slit pupils, and dark bags. Sharp canines give her a vampiric look. Pale ash-blonde hair in messy buns with wild strands and chin-length side bangs. Wears dark blue seifuku with white trim, red scarf, oversized beige cardigan, black socks, and brown shoes.

Backstory:
A UA student with a secret life in the League of Villains. Her Quirk lets her copy others' appearances after consuming their blood, which she views as love rather than predation.

cardPool.title: Hime
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Hime

Alias:
None

Quirk Name:
Unknown

Occupation/Role:
Civilian Child

Personality:
Cheeky and demanding, Hime speaks her mind without hesitation. She develops crushes on attractive boys and expresses gratitude readily. Her romantic inclinations drive her actions.

Appearance:
A small girl with short, slightly curly light hair held back by a black headband with butterfly motifs. She dresses sophisticatedly and has a petite frame, though her personality suggests strength.

Backstory:
While walking in Osaka, Hime was attacked by the Octo-Lover's Brigade. A hero in slender form rescued her, and she became infatuated. Unable to identify him, she requested help from the Fat Gum Agency, involving UA students Tamaki Amajiki, Tenya Ida, and Momo Yaoyorozu.

Additional Information:
Hime discovered her "prince" was Fat Gum in his muscular form.

cardPool.title: Higari Maijima
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Higari Maijima

Alias: Excavation Hero: Power Loader

Quirk Name: Iron Claws

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero and Support Course faculty member at U.A. High School; manages the Costume Development Studio

Personality: Strict teacher who demands excellence and grows angry easily, yet respects talent and effort. A self-described loner preferring machinery to socializing, but genuinely cares for colleagues and students beneath his gruff exterior.

Appearance: Short, lean man with youthful face despite advanced age. Spiky ginger hair past shoulders; dull blue eyes and large mouth. Disproportionately large hands with orange L-shaped metallic claws. Wears a massive yellow rectangular excavator-claw helmet. Shirtless with large fingerless gray gloves and metal arm guards; cyan pants. In combat, pilots a large steel mecha with articulated metal arms.

cardPool.title: Hekiji Tengai
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Hekiji Tengai

Alias:
Shield of the Eight Bullets

Quirk Name:
Barrier

Occupation/Role:
Member of the Shie Hassaikai's Eight Bullets; Kendo Rappa's assigned partner

Personality:
Calm and composed with monk-like demeanor. Philosophically opposed to excessive violence, viewing fighting as a selfish desire. Analytical and observant with an enlightened perspective. Keeps his eyes closed while speaking, projecting wisdom and restraint.

Appearance:
Tall and slim man with pale, short spiky hair and straight dark eyebrows. Light-colored irises with thin closed eyes. Wears a traditional dark yukata with white cloth belt and wooden geta sandals. Bears the Shie Hassaikai's brown plague mask secured with three belts.

Backstory:
Former devout Buddhist recruited into the Shie Hassaikai to stabilize the volatile Kendo Rappa.

cardPool.title: Haruaki Sun-Sun
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Haruaki Sun-Sun

Alias: Mr. Sunny

Quirk Name: Unnamed Sunflower Quirk

Occupation/Role: Orphanage Caretaker

Personality: Cheerful and welcoming on the surface, though deceptive and loyal to darker forces; he raises children as potential vessels for All For One without visible mistreatment.

Appearance: A tall man with a yellow sunflower-like face, yellow ears and neck, brown hair, and tan hands. He wears a white hoodie with a pink apron and maintains a bright expression.

Backstory: Employed by Kyudai Garaki at a secret orphanage to cultivate spare vessels for All For One, Haruaki oversaw children including the burned Toya Todoroki. When Toya awoke and lashed out, Haruaki tried to restrain him but was burned. Toya set the orphanage ablaze and fled. Kyudai blamed Haruaki for the fire to protect the operation.

cardPool.title: Ibara Shiozaki
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Ibara Shiozaki
Alias: Vine
Quirk Name: Vines
Occupation/Role: UA High School Student, Class 1-B
Personality: Modest and courteous with deep religious conviction. She speaks softly but firmly about her pure intentions. Beneath her graceful demeanor lies a vindictive streak and rigid moral code—she judges others harshly for dishonesty and refuses underhanded tactics, even when strategic. She values fairness and truth above all else.
Appearance: Medium-height girl with dark green eyes and long lower eyelashes. Her distinctive feature is her hair of thorn-covered green vines kept just above her waist, with one set wrapped around her forehead in a cross pattern. She wears a plain white toga-like robe with dark brown knee-high boots, resembling an ancient Greek goddess.

cardPool.title: Horse Man
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Horse Man
Quirk Name: Horse Quirk
Occupation/Role: Petty Thug/Villain; Later Dishwasher at Hopper's Cafe
Personality: Brash and aggressive. Despite criminal inclinations, capable of rehabilitation when given legitimate opportunity. Shows enthusiasm cheering on heroes.
Appearance: Brown-skinned man with black hair styled like a horse's mane. Wears white tank top under black jacket, blue jeans, and green wristbands. Bear tattoo on left shoulder. Quirk gives him equine facial features.
Backstory: Small-time criminal in Naruhata's backstreets with Rhino Man, conducting petty robberies and extortion. Defeated by the Crawler and apprehended by Hopper's Cafe workers, who offered him employment as alternative to arrest. Accepted reformation.
Additional Information: Not a UA student. Quirk abilities remain unclear beyond physical appearance alterations.

cardPool.title: Hood
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Unknown (formerly an underground fighter)

Alias:
Hood, High-End

Muscle Augmentation, Super Regeneration

Occupation/Role:
Intelligent High-End Nomu, Doctor Kyudai Garaki's creation

Personality:
Obeys his master with unwavering loyalty. Speaks with a stutter and broken grammar. Displays eagerness for combat against strong opponents, growing bored once victory is achieved. Possesses tactical cunning, using diversions and protecting vulnerabilities strategically.

Appearance:
Extraordinarily muscular build with an unnaturally long neck lined with jutting vertebrae. Skin is dark purple-black. His head is shrouded by a hood of skin with only glowing yellow eyes visible beneath. Underneath the hood lies an exposed brain, distorted red eyes, and a mouth filled with jagged teeth.

cardPool.title: Hina
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Hina

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Unknown

Occupation/Role: Sophomore at Naruhata Women's College; Trigger drug dealer

Personality: Shy and withdrawn normally, struggling with social interaction especially around men. Becomes fiercely protective and hostile when perceiving threats to her best friend Rin. Views men as beasts and shows extreme jealousy of their interest in Rin. Willing to drug innocent people to protect her friend's interests.

Appearance: Young woman with plain, unremarkable appearance she maintains deliberately. Brown bob-cut hair with bangs concealing brown eyes. Wears drab clothing that blends into crowds. When manipulating targets, she adopts a cuter outfit, makeup, and attractive persona designed to deceive.

Backstory: College student bonded deeply with Rin Yaritezawa, her only genuine social connection.

cardPool.title: Hikage Shinomori
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Hikage Shinomori

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Danger Sense

Occupation/Role: One For All User, Hermit Warrior

Personality: Valiant and noble, driven to defeat All For One yet realistic about his limitations. Solitary by nature due to his Quirk's constant vigilance keeping him on edge. Selfless in strengthening One For All for the next user.

Appearance: Lean, muscular man with short beige hair and thin, downward-slanting green eyes. Wears a dark baggy bodysuit with torn shin-length pants, large sage-colored belt, and padded kneecaps. Light puffy jacket cut at chest with right sleeve worn separately.

Backstory: The fourth wielder of One For All, Hikage inherited the power from Bruce and spent his life in solitary training, aware he lacked the strength to defeat All For One alone.

cardPool.title: Harusaburo Nanboku
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Harusaburo Nanboku

Alias:
The Enka Master

Unknown

Occupation/Role:
Professional Enka Singer

Reserved and contemplative with deep affection for his hometown Naruhata. Carries himself with established performer dignity.

Appearance:
Middle-aged man with short curly brown hair and warm eyes. Wears a purple yukata casually. Weathered features reflect years in entertainment.

Backstory:
Rose to prominence as an Enka master renowned throughout Naruhata. His hit "Yearning for Naruhata" cemented his connection to the city ward.

Additional Information:
Featured as headlining artist at Narufest on the Marukane Department Store rooftop. His vocal mastery and emotional delivery make him a cultural fixture in Naruhata.

cardPool.title: Haruhisa

Alias: Haruhisa the Bare-Handed

Occupation/Role: Yakuza Executive, Abegawa Tenchu Kai
Personality: Stoic and composed, habitually calm even in combat. Disciplined and tactical in conflict.
Appearance: A large, imposing elderly man with defined jawline and prominent cheekbones. Dark hair swept back with whitened temples. Wears dark sunglasses, light yukata, and maintains a cigar in his mouth.
Backstory: A seasoned Abegawa Tenchu Kai member who rose to executive rank through combat prowess and loyalty. Known as "the Bare-Handed" for his formidable unarmed fighting ability.
Additional Information: His Quirk transforms him into a muscular gray hulk, increasing physical power in combat. He died defending yakuza headquarters against the vigilante Stendhal.

cardPool.title: Hari Kurono

Real Name: Hari Kurono

Backstory: A subordinate in the Shie Hassaikai, Hari serves as right-hand man to Kai Chisaki with unwavering loyalty and lacks independent judgment.
Additional Information: Expert marksman and espionage specialist. His Chronostasis Quirk slows target movements to near-immobility for up to one hour through hair contact. Relies on tactics and stealth rather than direct combat, but was defeated by U.A.

cardPool.title: Hard Head

Backstory: Recruited by Tomura Shigaraki as one of seventy villains to assault the Unforeseen Simulation Joint. Participated in the Mountain Zone ambush targeting Class 1-A, attacking Denki Kaminari but was quickly incapacitated by Denki's Electrification quirk and arrested.
Additional Information: F-rank villain with no criminal notoriety. Muscle expansion quirk provides raw strength but proved ineffective against electrical attacks. Defeated during the U.S.J. assault arc.

cardPool.title: Hanta Sero

Quirk Name: Tape
