Has a teasing side and speaks freely, sometimes unintentionally insulting others. Shows interest in girls and enjoys gossip among friends.

Appearance: Tall and lean young man with chin-length black hair spiked downward and jagged bangs. Large almond-shaped eyes with small pupils and a broad grin. His elbows are cylindrical tape dispenser-shaped, serving as his Quirk's source. Wears standard UA male uniform: light gray blazer with dark turquoise trim, white shirt, dark blue-green pants, red tie, and brown shoes.

cardPool.title: Hana Shimura
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Hana Shimura
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Unknown
Occupation/Role: Student
Personality: Carefree and loving toward her brother, Hana aspired to become a hero like her grandmother. Despite genuine affection, she could be selfish and cowardly when afraid of punishment, prioritizing self-preservation over honesty.

cardPool.title: Haishin

Habuko has a serpentine head with gray patterned scales, bright yellow eyes with slit pupils, and spiky shoulder-length red hair. Her petite body is fair-skinned with regular human proportions. She wears the Isami Academy uniform: white dress shirt with dark red bow, dark blue blazer, gray pleated skirt, black socks, and brown loafers.

Two years before Tsuyu entered UA, Habuko attended the same middle school and initially stalked and paralyzed her. Tsuyu's offer of friendship transformed Habuko's life, ending her isolation.

cardPool.title: Gyges

Additional Information: Possesses six functional arms providing significant combat advantage in melee and defensive operations. His Quirk is similar to Mezo Shoji's Dupli-Arms but with greater arm count.

Additional Information: Gunhead Martial Arts is his signature fighting technique.

cardPool.title: Goto Imasuji

Alias: Muscular
Quirk Name: Muscle Augmentation

Personality: Sadistic and bloodthirsty, Muscular craves violence and killing. He joined the League to indulge his brutal nature rather than follow ideology. He holds a strict code: worth is determined by accomplishing stated intentions. He respects worthy opponents and bears no grudge against those who defeat him fairly. His fatal flaw is overconfidence—he underestimates opponents, toys with them, and grows bored against weaker foes, dismissing tactics he deems cheap.
Appearance: An enormous, muscular man with broad shoulders, short spiky sandy-blond hair, and tiny black eyes. He has a large scar across his left face and a smaller one on his right forehead.

cardPool.title: Gorilla

Real Name: Unknown

Alias: Gorilla

Occupation/Role: League of Villains member, U.S.J. assault participant

Appearance: Adult woman with shoulder-length maroon hair and bangs obscuring her left eye. Indigo markings surround her right eye with diagonal lines extending toward her ear and cheek. Her arms are enlarged and covered in brown hair. She wears a short sleeveless purple dress with a v-neck and three diagonal light purple stripes on the right side.

Backstory: Recruited as one of roughly seventy low-ranking villains by Tomura Shigaraki for the U.S.J. assault. She attacked Pro Hero Shota Aizawa but was overwhelmed when the League's long-range squad fell to his power.

cardPool.title: Gori
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Gori
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Unknown
Occupation/Role: Police Force Officer
Personality: Firm yet fair, perceptive, and empathetic. Believes in redemption and second chances, reading people's intentions accurately. Strict with dangerous criminals but willing to listen and understand circumstances. Shows compassion through small gestures like offering tea.
Appearance: A bulky man with the head of a mountain gorilla, wearing a dark gray suit with a black tie. Dons armored police gear during combat. His imposing physique contrasts with his measured demeanor.
Backstory: Dedicated Police Force member handling interrogations and criminal intake. Gained notice interrogating Gentle Criminal after his UA School Festival infiltration attempt, recognizing his capacity for change.

cardPool.title: Godzillo
cardPool.value:

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero

Backstory: Originally from Japan, Godzillo relocated to the United States and rose to prominence as both a Pro Hero and film star. He appears at prestigious events like the I-Island expo.

cardPool.title: Gil Gollini

Appearance: A very large, muscular man with wide shoulders and burly arms. Buzzcut with Dutch-styled beard and large, rough nose. Stern, squinted eyes. Wears a well-tailored gray suit with black stripes, black coat, and scarf with a rose emblem.
Backstory: Gil serves as a loyal operative of the Gollini Family mafia under boss Valdo. Acts as transportation and backup for Ugo, using his Quirk to position himself strategically in conflicts.
Additional Information: Demonstrates exceptional combat coordination with fluid footwork during teleportation.

cardPool.title: Giulio Gandini

A stern, composed gentleman with fierce loyalty to those he serves. Once warmer, he has hardened from trauma and loss, though compassion surfaces his warm heart. He views Heroes with cynicism yet demonstrates restraint and respects honor. Relentless in pursuit of his goals, refusing to back down.

Appearance:
Average build with brownish-red hair in a short ponytail, thin greenish-blue eyes, sharp teeth, and a mole beneath his left eye. He wears a black tailcoat, grey vest, striped tie, and white undershirt with popped collar. His right arm and left leg are Support Item prosthetics with the right sleeve rolled up and left pant leg torn. Ammunition pouches and holster belts cross his torso and left leg.

cardPool.title: Ginji Kurau

Most distinctive feature is a large monstrous mouth on his stomach with serrated teeth—manifestation of his Quirk. When Overmodified, additional mouth-like appendages sprouted from his shoulders.

cardPool.title: Gigantomachia

Most distinctive are his prominently pointed teeth with protruding lower canines. He wears black pants, a hooded cloak, and carries a portable radio on a rope around his neck.

Gigantomachia served All For One as a faithful bodyguard before receiving modifications granting multiple Quirks.

Fiercely loyal to Re-Destro and the Liberation Army's ideology of power-based hierarchy. Intensely prideful about his ice abilities and devoted to constant self-improvement through combat. Becomes enraged when his leader's plans are threatened and grows despondent when unable to achieve victory.

Appearance:
Geten wears a thick light blue parka with seven brown buttons below his knees, black baggy pants, and lace-up winter boots. A fur-lined hood shadows most of his face, revealing messy white hair and striking silver-grey eyes framed by long white eyelashes.

Backstory:
Geten never attended formal schooling, dedicating his life entirely to honing his ice abilities through relentless training.

cardPool.title: Gashly Eijiju
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Gashly Eijiju

Alias: The Shadow Gentleman

Quirk Name: Infant Puppets

Occupation/Role: Villain, High-Level Tartarus Prisoner, All For One's Assassin

Personality: Sadistic and psychopathic with deceptively genteel manners. Maintains cold composure in combat, reading during battles while his Quirk overwhelms opponents. Indebted to All For One for his prison escape and sworn to his cause.

Appearance: A tall, slender man entirely cloaked in darkness—black top hat, cloak, and clothing creating a silhouette. White mask with eye holes conceals his actual eyes. Carries a black umbrella and open book. Light-colored short hair visible only when his hat is displaced.

Backstory: Imprisoned in Tartarus for devastating cities with his Quirk, Gashly was freed during All For One's prison break.

cardPool.title: Garvey
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Garvey

Alias: The Giant Toad Villain

Quirk Name: Stock

Occupation/Role: Villain

Personality: Acts on base instinct with no distinct personality, behaving like a wild animal driven by primal aggression under Trigger drug influence.

Appearance: A colossal olive-green toad standing 10 meters tall with a round body covered in warts. Small blank white eyes, short stubby tail, and a discolored tongue from Trigger use. Warts across his back store absorbed attacks.

Backstory: Enhanced by Trigger, Garvey was unleashed as a weapon by Kyudai Garaki and All For One. During his rampage he absorbed multiple Quirks and caused massive destruction. He killed Oboro Shirakumo while the student saved children, though he targeted Shota Aizawa's Erasure Quirk. Aizawa eventually defeated and captured him.

cardPool.title: Gantetsu
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Gantetsu

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Unknown

Occupation/Role: Soba restaurant owner

Personality: Stubborn and taciturn but fair-minded. Demands excellence in cooking and criticizes harshly, yet grants second chances to those who improve. Grateful toward helpers and resistant to intimidation.

Appearance: An elderly man of tall stature with a full, whitened beard and mustache with dark striping. He has bushy eyebrows, short-cropped hair, and a prominent scar from his right ear to his nose. He wears traditional Japanese chef's whites with kanji embroidery, a haramaki sash, a headband with kanji covering his left eye, and wooden geta sandals. He carries a long wooden pole.

Backstory: Gantetsu has owned his soba restaurant for decades, building a reputation for quality and demanding standards. An individual recently pressured him to sell, which he refused.

cardPool.title: Ganma Asui
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Ganma Asui

Alias:
None

Quirk Name:
Frog Physiology

Occupation/Role:
Businessman; Father and Provider for the Asui Household

Personality:
A caring, devoted father who demonstrates responsibility and trust in his eldest daughter. Calm, supportive, and proud of his family's accomplishments.

Appearance:
A tall, stocky middle-aged man with pronounced frog-like features. Short black hair, black eyes, and toad-like head structure. Dresses professionally in a business suit with a blue-dotted tie and green frog clip.

Backstory:
Ganma married Bell and had three children: Tsuyu, Samidare, and Satsuki. Frequent work travel leads him to rely on his responsible eldest daughter to care for her younger siblings while he provides stability for the family.

Additional Information:
Not a UA High School student. Father of Class 1-A student Tsuyu Asui.

cardPool.title: Gang Orca's Sidekicks
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Gang Orca's Sidekick
Quirk Name: Unknown
Occupation/Role: Professional Sidekick to Gang Orca; Provisional Hero License Exam Antagonist
Personality: Loyal and disciplined, working seamlessly under Gang Orca's command. They demonstrate tactical awareness and willingness to adapt strategy while showing deference to their leader's superior abilities.
Appearance: Black skin-tight bodysuit covering entire body including face and hands, decorated with thin white lines across the torso. Tan-colored armor pads protect key areas. Diamond-shaped eye holes arranged in a circular pattern form their mask design. Equipped with a blue and gray Cement Gun mounted on right arm.
Backstory: Enlisted by the Hero Public Safety Commission to serve as mock villains during the Provisional Hero License Exam's second phase.

cardPool.title: Gale Villain
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Unknown

Alias:
Gale Villain

Quirk Name:
Gale

Occupation/Role:
Professional Thief, Villain

Personality:
Greedy and mission-focused, prioritizing profit over confrontation. Arrogant about his Quirk's superiority, becoming overconfident and careless when distracted.

Appearance:
Rugged man with thick eyebrows, prominent sideburns, and unkempt facial hair. Striking large pompadour hairstyle. Wears a white and red coat with horned skull emblem, golden chain necklace, dark pants, and spike-studded shoes.

Backstory:
Skilled wind-manipulating villain who partners with the Bomb Villain for high-value heists. Operates with calculated precision, acquiring valuables rather than confronting heroes directly. Overconfidence in his Quirk's defensive capabilities has proven his downfall.

cardPool.title: Fuyumi Todoroki
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Fuyumi Todoroki
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Ice
Occupation/Role: Elementary School Teacher
Personality: Kind-hearted and nurturing with a teasing streak, Fuyumi deeply cares for her family despite household trauma. She is hopeful about reconciliation and worries constantly for loved ones, though she carries guilt about failing to protect Shoto. Brave and empathetic, she attempts to maintain peace within the fractured family.
Appearance: A young woman of average height with shoulder-length white hair flecked with crimson, ear-length side bangs, and short forelock. She has turquoise eyes framed by red-rimmed rectangular glasses. Typically wears a white dress shirt with grayish peach cardigan rolled to the elbows, navy jeans, and brown dress shoes. Frequently wears various turtleneck sweaters.

cardPool.title: Futo Nagashira
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Futo Nagashira

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Not specified

Occupation/Role: UA High School Student, Department of Management

Personality: Pragmatic and business-minded, focused on hero marketability and public relations. Genuine passion for heroism beneath commercial exterior. Advocates for transparency in documenting heroic achievements.

Appearance: Young man of average height with distinctive long blonde hair styled into a rounded, beehive-like shape. Small, thin-set eyes and thick downward-pointing eyebrows give him a serious expression. Typically wears UA gym uniform.

Backstory: Department of Management student specializing in the business side of heroics. Analyzes hero marketability and public appeal, studying figures like Izuku during the UA Sports Festival. Associates regularly with peers Ronaudo and Komako.

cardPool.title: Funkman
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Funkman
Quirk Name: Unknown
Occupation/Role: Pro Hero
Personality: Dedicated and resolute, willing to stand against threats even in dire circumstances; demonstrates camaraderie with fellow heroes.
Appearance: Tall man with a prominent brown afro and black face mask. Wears a cowboy-style hero costume with a vest, "F" on his hat and belt buckle, and a holstered gun.
Backstory: A Pro Hero who fought during the Paranormal Liberation War. Despite overwhelming odds, Funkman battled Tomura Shigaraki's forces until his death in combat. His body was left behind during civilian evacuation.
Additional Information: Funkman's Quirk remains undocumented. He relied on marksmanship and combat training. His death was one of many hero casualties in the war's final stages.

cardPool.title: Fumiko Noborizaka
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Fumiko Noborizaka

Alias: The Love Letter Villain

Quirk Name: Death Letter

Occupation/Role: Delivery Driver / Instant Villain

Personality: Insane and obsessively devoted, Fumiko expresses affection through dangerous means including kidnapping and violence. Under Trigger influence, her obsession becomes destructively uncontrollable.

Appearance: A thin woman with a gaunt face and unnaturally long tongue. She has light-colored flowing hair and wears a dark shirt with shorts and loafers. As a delivery driver, she wears a bike helmet, fingerless gloves, and backpack.

Backstory: Fumiko works as a delivery driver while harboring dangerous romantic obsessions. Her unstable mental state and violent expression of love mark her as a public safety threat, operating outside hero society.

cardPool.title: Fumikage Tokoyami
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Fumikage Tokoyami

Alias: Jet-Black Hero: Tsukuyomi

Quirk Name: Dark Shadow

Occupation/Role: UA High School Student, Class 1-A

Personality: Reserved and serious yet noble, Fumikage speaks with archaic flair. Quiet but sociable in teams, he's dependable in combat. He's insecure about dark interests and easily embarrassed, yet deeply cares for friends. Humble and aware of limits, he struggles controlling Dark Shadow's aggression, fearing harm to those close to him.

Appearance: A short young man with a crow-like black head, hooked yellow beak, thin red eyes, and red choker. Fair-skinned with average human body. At UA, he wears light gray blazer with turquoise trimmings, white shirt, dark blue-green pants, red tie, and brown shoes. His hero costume is a black robe with purple tinting, knee-high black boots, and utility belt.

cardPool.title: Fuji Fukiyose
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Fuji Fukiyose
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Not yet revealed
Occupation/Role: Third-year middle school student, U.A. High School applicant
Personality: Jovial and lighthearted with frequent laughter, yet wears emotions openly. Despite his carefree demeanor, he is deeply serious about entering U.A.'s Hero Course.
Appearance: Dark-skinned boy with messy black hair and shadow over his eyes. Wears a bandana to hold back his hair. Dresses in an open middle school jacket over a sweatshirt, giving him a casual appearance.
Backstory: Fuji visited U.A. High School's Prospective Students Day with friend Raito Sanda. During the Hero Course's tag game, he was paired with Tsuyu Asui and quickly defeated. He supported Raito's decision to pursue the Business Course while remaining committed to becoming a hero himself.

cardPool.title: Four-Armed Zealot
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Unknown

Alias:
Four-Armed Zealot

Quirk Name:
Extra Arms

Occupation/Role:
F-rank Villain, League of Villains recruit

Personality:
Confident in combat, taciturn, focused on violence over dialogue.

Appearance:
Lean man with jet-black skin and four muscular arms. Wears an insectoid mask with crimson lenses, sleeveless black tank top, brown cargo pants, and black combat boots.

Backstory:
Recruited by Tomura Shigaraki for the assault on the Unforeseen Simulation Joint. Participated in the USJ invasion as part of the League of Villains' coordinated attack against UA High School.

Additional Information:
Defeated by UA Pro Heroes during the USJ invasion. His extra arms provide combat advantage in melee confrontations, though his confidence exceeded his actual threat level against professional heroes.

cardPool.title: Flect Turn
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Flect Turn

Alias: The Reflector, Prophet of Salvation

Quirk Name: Reflect

Occupation/Role: Cult Leader, Villain

Personality: Cold, calculated, and charismatic extremist driven by obsessive hatred of Quirks. Ruthless and remorseless, viewing mass violence as necessary for "humanity's salvation." Shows no mercy to traitors. Self-righteous yet hypocritical about his own Quirk usage.

Appearance: Tall, slim man with luminescent light blue skin and shaved head revealing dark blue hair. Sharp goatee, arrow-shaped earrings, and dark blue eye masks fitted in sockets. Wears red robe with golden belt, grey pants, combat boots, and prosthetic gloves with exposed fingertips. Villain outfit features white cloak with dark red interior and energy-storage disks.

Backstory: Flect's powerful Quirk harmed anyone who touched him, isolating him completely.

cardPool.title: Ethan Drive
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Ethan Drive

Alias:
None

Quirk Name:
None

Occupation/Role:
Fighter Pilot, U.S. Military Brigade Leader

Personality:
Disciplined soldier with unwavering loyalty. Supportive and encouraging, offering emotional strength to teammates. Self-sacrificial, willing to risk everything for the greater good. Proud mentor who values growth and perseverance.

Appearance:
Tall, well-built man with military bearing. Buzz cut and prominent moustache. Wears U.S. Army fighter pilot gear and uniform.

Backstory:
Seasoned American military fighter pilot who faced death in combat. Developed deep bond with Cathleen and their brigade, supporting her growth as a hero. Mourned her sacrifice against Tomura Shigaraki and honored her final wish by sharing critical military intelligence with Japanese heroes.

cardPool.title: Eri
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Eri
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Rewind
Occupation/Role: Student (U.A. High School resident)
Personality: Fearful and withdrawn from trauma, but gradually becoming cheerful and trusting around kind people. She carries guilt over her Quirk's destructive potential while learning its positive uses. Silent and accepting, yet determined to protect others despite her suffering.
Appearance: A small girl with long, messy bluish off-white hair parted down the middle. She has wide bright red eyes and a small brown horn on her right forehead that grows larger when activating her Quirk. She wears a white frilled collar shirt, red pinafore with golden buttons, gray tights, tan boots, and a small dark red flower-decorated messenger bag.
Backstory: Eri was used as a living weapon by her grandfather's crime organization and experimented on by Kai Chisaki to create Quirk-Destroying drugs.

cardPool.title: Enma Kannagi
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Enma Kannagi
Alias: Magic Hero: Majestic
Quirk Name: Unknown
Occupation/Role: Pro Hero
Personality: Noble and selfless, willing to sacrifice himself for others. Composed and professional in high-pressure situations with strong leadership abilities.
Appearance: Slim adult man with a goatee wearing a wizard-inspired hero costume. Orange robe, scarlet pointy hat, colorful fabrics and sashes, with one sash as a blindfold across his eyes.
Backstory: Established Pro Hero who mentors students during work-study programs. Participated in the Humarise raid and Villa Raid Team assault on the Paranormal Liberation Front, where he sacrificed himself protecting students from Gigantomachia.
Additional Information: Served as work-study mentor to Momo Yaoyorozu and Setsuna Tokage during Hero Work-Studies: Round 2. Operated under the World Heroes Association during major crisis operations.

cardPool.title: Enji Todoroki
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Enji Todoroki

Alias:
Flame Hero: Endeavor

Quirk Name:
Hellflame

Occupation/Role:
Pro Hero (No. 2 ranked)

Personality:
Prideful and ambitious, driven by obsession to surpass All Might. Stern and demanding, he prioritizes personal achievement over relationships.

Appearance:
Tall, muscular man with short crimson spiky hair, sharp turquoise eyes, and flame-like facial hair. His navy-turquoise Hero Costume features streaming flames across the chest, white cage-patterned bracers, flame-engulfed boots, and a blue belt that serves as armor and flame conduit.

Backstory:
One of the nation's top Pro Heroes. Married Rei Todoroki through strategic Quirk Marriage to produce a powerful heir. Father of four children: Toya, Fuyumi, Natsuo, and Shoto.

Additional Information:
Currently No. 2 ranked Pro Hero by case resolution.

cardPool.title: Enigma
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Fukakai Hatena

Alias: Enigma

Quirk Name: Gigantification

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero Sidekick of Ingenium, Team Idaten Member

Personality: Calm, friendly, and understanding. Enigma is forgiving and self-aware about her frightening appearance when using her Quirk. She remains composed in crisis situations and assists others with reassurance and professionalism.

Appearance: A young woman with long, dark hair in two low plaits and a neat fringe. Her oval-shaped eyes are entirely blacked-out with no iris or pupil. When her Quirk activates, she transforms into a pitch-black blob-like mass with a white mask face and elastic limbs.

Backstory: Enigma obtained her Hero License and was selected by Ingenium to join Team Idaten. While traveling to Tokyo for an interview, she was mistaken for a villain but clarified her identity.

cardPool.title: Ending
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Ending
Quirk Name: Whiteline
Occupation/Role: Villain
Personality: Mentally unstable and suicidal, obsessed with Endeavor. Believes life is defined by choosing how one dies. Displays manic behavior with wide smiles and crazed eyes, viewing himself as a lifeless puppet.
Appearance: Muscular man wearing horizontal black and white-striped pants and shirt beneath a blue hooded jacket. Full-face mask with white parallel lines and crosswalk patterns, exposing only his mouth and eyes. Notable for unnaturally wide smile and wild eyes.
Backstory: Witnessed Endeavor apprehending a thief, which sparked his obsession with the hero. After imprisonment and release seven years later, he orchestrated a highway attack with Dabi to provoke Endeavor into killing him, kidnapping Natsuo Todoroki to force confrontation.

cardPool.title: Emperor Yotsuura
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Emperor Yotsuura

Alias: Emperor Yotsuura

Quirk Name: Soccer

Occupation/Role: Villain, Thief

Personality: Cocky and showboating with an obsessive fascination with soccer. He treats crimes as performance art, displaying his skills during thefts and suggesting an arrogant streak.

Appearance: A tall young man with tanned skin and penguin-like facial structure. He wears a pale diver suit with a red "V" on the chest, baseball cap beneath a hood, knee-length shorts, gloves, tall sports socks, and webbed-foot soccer shoes. His aesthetic mimics penguin features.

Backstory: A low-level criminal operating in Naruhata, Emperor Yotsuura built his identity around his Quirk and soccer prowess. He targets civilians while brazenly dribbling a soccer ball, treating theft as performance rather than serious crime.

cardPool.title: Emi Fukukado
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Emi Fukukado

Alias: Smile Hero: Ms. Joke

Quirk Name: Outburst

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero and Class 2 Teacher at Ketsubutsu Academy High School

Personality: Cheerful, outgoing, and relentlessly playful with a goofy sense of humor. She uses comedy as both personal tool and combat strategy, enjoying teasing others—especially Shota Aizawa. Despite her obnoxious demeanor, she takes her duties seriously, valuing her students and their dreams.

Appearance: A young woman with athletic build and muscular arms. She has seafoam-green hair past her shoulders with short fringe beneath her orange bandana. Dark green eyes with bright pupils frame her joyous smile. Her hero costume includes a sleeveless navy button-up shirt, green-and-orange pinstriped shorts, corset with yellow smiley-face pins, padded yellow gloves with golden knuckle plates, and orange-striped arm tubes with metal wr...

cardPool.title: Eleph
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Eleph
Alias: Zō
Quirk Name: Arm Bulk Up
Occupation/Role: High-End Nomu, laboratory creation of Doctor Kyudai Garaki
Personality: Aggressive and combat-hungry, eager for battle upon awakening; follows other Nomu without resistance; focuses singularly on combat rather than strategy.
Appearance: A massive, obese humanoid elephant Nomu with gray, bulky musculature and a large trunk. Three glowing lines run vertically down his trunk from his brain. Angular eyes glow with three linear diamond patterns beneath each, containing tiny red feral pupils. Prominent vertebrae jut from his spine. When activating Arm Bulk Up, his enormous arms swell further with thick, prominent veins.
Backstory: Created by Doctor Kyudai Garaki as a pure-power specialist Nomu, Eleph was kept dormant beneath Jaku General Hospital.

cardPool.title: Elecplant
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Elecplant
Quirk Name: Electricity Generation
Occupation/Role: Pro Hero
Personality: Dutiful and professional, committed to heroic service and international cooperation. Demonstrates competence in crisis situations and willingness to coordinate with other heroes.
Appearance: Tall figure in a black bodysuit with electric circuit patterns and golden lightning imagery. Face completely obscured by full-face covering. Lightning-bolt shaped radio antennae protrude over his ears. Long flowing red cape with golden lightning decorations extends from his shoulders.
Backstory: American Pro Hero operating primarily in the United States. Participated in major international incidents including casino robberies and counter-terrorism operations against Humarise.

cardPool.title: Eizo Tanuma
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Eizo Tanuma

Alias:
Detective Tanuma

Quirk Name:
Free Walker

Occupation/Role:
Police Force Detective

Personality:
Calm and affable despite serious dedication to detective work. Possesses keen deductive abilities and often knows more than he reveals, maintaining composure that contrasts with more intense colleagues.

Appearance:
An older man with short, dark receding hair and thin beard. Dresses professionally in dark suit, black waistcoat, and plain tie, presenting the appearance of a seasoned law enforcement officer.

Backstory:
A veteran detective and former partner of Naomasa Tsukauchi, Eizo has spent years honing investigative skills. One of the few aware of Knuckleduster's secret past as hero O'Clock, indicating deep connections within the hero community.

cardPool.title: Eijiro Kirishima
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Eijiro Kirishima

Alias: Red Riot

Quirk Name: Hardening

Occupation/Role: UA High School Student, Class 1-A

Personality: Boisterous and outgoing with a strong sense of manliness and chivalry. Determined and selfless, easily moved by displays of bravery. Values honesty and kindness, calling out cowardice while encouraging others. Devoted fan of Crimson Riot, aspires to live without regret and prioritizes others' safety.

Appearance: Muscular young man of average height with sharp red eyes and small eyebrows. Distinctive bright red spiked hair with two horn-like tufts on his forehead. Naturally sharp teeth. Wears standard UA uniform with dark red trainers. Hero costume includes dark red shoulder pads, red belt with "R" emblem, jagged sash, baggy black pants, red half cape with ripped hem, dark red boots, and wired guard mask with spiked fangs resembling an Oni.

cardPool.title: Eiji Okameda
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Eiji Okameda
Alias: None known
Quirk Name: Gigantic Spinning Flying Turtle
Occupation/Role: Instant Villain (Trigger-enhanced)
Personality: Unknown; observed only while under Trigger influence, appearing aggressive and destructive.
Appearance: True appearance unknown. When transformed by Trigger, becomes a colossal turtle resembling Gamera with a hard shell capable of spinning. Possesses visible eyes beneath armored carapace. Likely average height and build in civilian form.
Backstory: An individual with a turtle-based transformation Quirk. Injected with Trigger and sent to invade Naruhata, where he was quickly defeated by Captain Celebrity. Subsequently returned to normal form and possibly arrested.
Additional Information: Eiji's baseline Quirk capabilities remain unclear as he has only been observed while heavily enhanced by Trigger.

cardPool.title: Drill Criminal
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Unknown (Conjectural)

Alias:
Drill Criminal

Quirk Name:
Unnamed Drill Shooting Quirk

Occupation/Role:
Villain/Bank Robber

Personality:
Aggressive and greedy, quick to resort to violence but lacks skill against seasoned heroes.

Appearance:
Lean athletic build. Red helmet with spike-like drill protrusions. Black sleeveless tank top, blue pants, white boots with red accents, metal forearm gauntlets to channel his Quirk.

Backstory:
Small-time criminal who commits petty crimes for profit. Attempted a bank robbery interrupted by Gang Orca and Shishido, leading to swift capture due to his inexperience.

Additional Information:
His Quirk launches steel drill projectiles, making him dangerous at range but vulnerable in close combat. Low-tier villain threat. Apprehended and turned over to authorities.

cardPool.title: Eddie Soul
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Eddie Soul
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Unknown
Occupation/Role: Engineer, Forced Researcher for Humarise
Personality: Loving father despite absences; brave and self-sacrificing, willing to betray captors to save millions. Maintained humanity under coercion.
Appearance: Tall man with short dark brown hair and gray eyes. Wears white buttoned shirt beneath dull blue overcoat, presenting worn professional appearance.
Backstory: Renowned engineer from Otheon who raised three children after his wife's death. Kidnapped by anti-Quirk terrorist cult Humarise and forced to develop Trigger Bombs for mass genocide. Secretly created deactivation key to sabotage their plans, prioritizing global safety.
Additional Information: Executed by Humarise upon discovery of betrayal.

cardPool.title: Drunk Lee
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Drunk Lee
Alias: Drunk Lee
Quirk Name: Dragon Breath
Occupation/Role: Underground fighter
Personality: Aggressive and opportunistic, driven by combat thrills. Cunning enough to weaponize his gear and relentless in pursuit of victory.
Appearance: Tall and muscular with prominent cheekbones and distinctive two-tendril mustache. Wears a dark suit and cap with a long Chinese ponytail. Dark domino mask conceals his upper face during matches.
Backstory: Earned his reputation through Underground Masquerade's brutal fighting rings. His Quirk and combat experience make him formidable despite his illegal status.
Additional Information: Carries two alcohol-filled gourds linked by string—fuel for his Quirk and secondary weapons. His reliance on alcohol to activate Dragon Breath is both his greatest asset and potential liability.

cardPool.title: Ectoplasm
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Ectoplasm

Alias: Pro Hero Ectoplasm

Quirk Name: Clones

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero and U.A. High School Mathematics Teacher

Personality: Steadfast and demanding, Ectoplasm pushes students to excel under pressure. He is analytical, intelligent, and respected for his commitment to heroism and education.

Appearance: A tall, slender man with blank inward-tilted eyes behind glasses and a featureless face. He wears a tan and black hero costume with high collar, golden striped neck detail, black helmet with jaw-guard, and lightweight prosthetic legs.

Backstory: Once a celebrated Pro Hero, Ectoplasm lost his legs in a villain encounter but continued his heroic career. Now teaching at U.A. High School, he shapes the next generation of heroes through rigorous instruction and mentorship.

cardPool.title: Dragon (Villain)
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Dragon
Quirk Name: Dragon
Occupation/Role: Low-ranking villain, League of Villains member
Personality: Aggressive and combat-ready with typical thug mentality. Shows no distinctive traits beyond following orders.
Appearance: Muscular with reptilian snout, sharp teeth, and thick black spikes along his head. Wears purple sleeveless tank top, black wristbands, and blue headphones around his neck.
Backstory: Recruited by Tomura Shigaraki for the assault on the Unforeseen Simulation Joint. Deployed to the Landslide Zone but quickly subdued by Shoto Todoroki's ice quirk and arrested.
Additional Information: Minor antagonist serving as disposable foot soldier in Shigaraki's invasion force. Easily neutralized by professional hero trainees. Actual name and background unknown.

cardPool.title: Dozaemon
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Dozaemon
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Water Control
Occupation/Role: E-rank Villain, League of Villains recruit
Personality: Impatient and aggressive with tactical awareness; confident in combat and knowledgeable about his Quirk's aquatic advantages; quick to act despite initial caution.
Appearance: Tall, muscular man in black full-body wetsuit with grey gloves and armored boots. Pale, noseless face with skull-like features: sunken eye sockets, grooved undereyes, protruding teeth, blue eyes with white pupils, and red cranial markings. Gold armor-like piece encircles his lower jaw with matching face-design belt.
Backstory: Recruited by Tomura Shigaraki for the League of Villains' assault on the Unforeseen Simulation Joint, Dozaemon was deployed to the Flood Zone.

cardPool.title: Dolphin Villain
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Unknown

Alias:
Dolphin Villain

Quirk Name:
Dolphin

Occupation/Role:
Criminal/Bank Robber

Personality:
Greedy and chaotic with surprising confidence in crime. Shows concern for environmental issues and demands eco-friendly getaway vehicles. Unfazed by Pro Heroes, willing to threaten hostages. Speaks with dolphin-like clicking sounds.

Appearance:
Humanoid with bottlenose dolphin physiology. Dark teal skin on upper head, diamond blue from chin down. Wears blue striped hoodie, tan pants, navy shoes, and olive-green headphones. Mixed aquatic and human characteristics.

Backstory:
Minor independent villain who attempted bank robbery for funds and an eco-friendly vehicle. Background largely unknown. Apprehended by Pro Hero Captain Celebrity and turned over to police.

Additional Information:
Wields a pump-action shotgun.

cardPool.title: Dictator
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Dictator
Quirk Name: Despot
Occupation/Role: Villain, Tartarus escapee serving All For One
Personality: Cunning strategist who prefers overwhelming numbers to direct confrontation. Cowardly, using human shields and targeting exhausted opponents.
Appearance: Short man with severe spinal curvature, head protruding from torso. Lanky, disproportionately long arms and extremely short legs. Round face with wide mouth featuring vertical grooves, small beady eyes with crosshair patterns, and triangular nose. Wears large black coat over dress shirt with control wires stitched throughout.
Backstory: Defeated five years ago by hero Crust in the "Bloodless Surrender Case" and imprisoned in Tartarus. Freed during All For One's prison breakout.

cardPool.title: Denki Kaminari
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Denki Kaminari

Alias: Chargebolt, Stun Gun Hero

Quirk Name: Electrification

Occupation/Role: UA High School Student, Class 1-A

Personality: Friendly and energetic social butterfly who gets along with most classmates. Well-meaning but blunt, he enjoys encouraging others and has a flirtatious side. Craves appearing cool and trendy, sometimes following others into questionable schemes, though genuinely kind-hearted beneath his jokester exterior.

Appearance: Light-skinned boy with messy golden-blond hair featuring a distinctive black lightning-shaped streak on his left fringe. Slanted golden eyes, small eyebrows, and slimmer build. Wears UA standard uniform: light gray blazer with turquoise trim, white shirt, dark blue-green pants, red tie, and brown shoes.

Backstory: First-year UA student training to become a Pro Hero.

cardPool.title: Deidoro Sakaki
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Deidoro Sakaki
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Sloshed
Occupation/Role: Eight Bullets member of Shie Hassaikai
Personality: Energetic and volatile, prone to irritability. Speaks with slurred words due to constant intoxication. Remains focused on duties despite his altered state.
Appearance: Thin yet muscular man with long, greasy black hair. Deep-set circular eyes and straight teeth. Wears a drainage mask fitted with tubes channeling alcohol. Dressed in a furry vest, dark pants, and black shoes. Perpetually disheveled from alcohol.
Backstory: Member of Shie Hassaikai's Eight Bullets under Overhaul. His Quirk likely drove him to alcoholism. Deployed to intercept heroes, he engaged Mirio Togata before defeat.
Additional Information: Sloshed inflicts severe dizziness on nearby enemies, strength correlating with blood alcohol content. Carries throwing daggers as secondary weapons.

cardPool.title: Deborah Gollini
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Deborah Gollini
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Day Dream
Occupation/Role: Member of the Gollini Family mafia
Personality: Sadistic and snide, Deborah enjoys toying with victims and allies. She remains composed and confident but becomes fearful when threatened or facing authority. She takes dark satisfaction in controlling victims through her Quirk.
Appearance: A tall woman with a voluptuous build, long black hair, and sharp green eyes with salmon eyeshadow and purple lipstick. She wears an elegant dark dress with spider cobweb pattern at the neckline, feathered sleeves and hem, a large brown belt, and falu red heels. A large black-brimmed hat with a red rose and golden crescent earrings complete her outfit.
Backstory: Deborah operates as a trusted member of the Gollini Family criminal organization.

cardPool.title: Death Arms
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Death Arms, Punching Hero: Death Arms
Quirk Name: Arm Strength
Occupation/Role: Pro Hero
Personality: Serious and disciplined, Death Arms dislikes reckless behavior and maintains a stern demeanor. He is deeply affected by criticism but possesses a genuine hero's heart. He will instinctively act to protect civilians despite his tough exterior.
Appearance: An exceptionally tall and muscular man with a wide build and slightly tanned skin. He has a prominent square jaw, small eyes, and short white hair spiked back. His hero costume features a yellow and black-striped caution headband, matching wrist-guards and belt with a square buckle, cyan cardigan exposing his chest, dark blue baggy pants with white side stripes, and black shoes.
Backstory: Death Arms earned recognition as a respected Pro Hero through his powerful arm-based abilities.

cardPool.title: David Shield
cardPool.value:
Real Name: David Shield

Alias: The Support Genius

Quirk Name: Squirmy Fingers

Occupation/Role: Scientist and Support Item Developer; Former Sidekick to All Might

Personality: Compassionate and altruistic, driven to help society. Deeply supportive of his daughter. His admiration for All Might borders on reverence, making him willing to bend ethical lines for what he believes serves greater good. Despite flaws, he demonstrates selfless courage and eventually accepts hard truths about change and legacy.

Appearance: Tall man of average build with aqua eyes and light brown hair styled short and messy with two prominent bangs. Light wrinkles and short goatee. Wears wide-rimmed square glasses, blue button-up shirt, pale pants, dark belt with metal buckle, navy sneakers with red accents, dark watch on left arm, and wedding ring.

cardPool.title: Danjuro Tobita
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Danjuro Tobita

Alias: Gentle

Quirk Name: Elasticity

Occupation/Role: Independent Villain and Internet Celebrity

Personality: Polite and theatrical despite criminal pursuits. Lacks genuine insight into consequences of his actions. Confident and calm in confrontation. Chases fame and reputation rather than wealth.

Appearance: A refined man with slicked-back black hair, a curl at the front, handlebar mustache, and medium beard. Thick black eyeliner applied with marker. Villain costume: black jacket with enlarged collars and coattails, white pinstriped pants, brown laced shoes, two brown belts with golden buckles, white cuffs, purple gloves, and woolly purple scarf. Carries a white cane with golden tip.

Backstory: Once consulted a life counselor in high school about his struggles. Later became a freeter before turning to villainy for internet fame.

cardPool.title: Daikaku Miyagi
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Daikaku Miyagi

Alias:
None

Quirk Name:
Big Horn

Occupation/Role:
Professional Newscaster

Personality:
Fair, impartial, and professional. Thick-skinned and resilient despite controversy. Known for presenting complex information accessibly, earning widespread trust across Japanese households.

Appearance:
Middle-aged man with facial wrinkles and greenish, straw-colored hair slicked back. A single sheep-like horn protrudes from his left forehead. Wears square-shaped glasses, dark blue blazer, pale pink shirt, and brown tie.

Backstory:
Built his reputation through fair reporting and clear communication. Surgically removed one of his two horns to perform his duties with greater ease, demonstrating commitment to his profession over his Quirk's natural appearance.

Additional Information:
Not a UA High School student.

cardPool.title: Daigoro Banjo
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Daigoro Banjo

Alias: Lariat

Quirk Name: Blackwhip

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero

Personality: Energetic and confident, Daigoro enjoys good-natured teasing and possesses indomitable willpower that resists powerful threats.

Appearance: A large, muscular man with a square jaw, small dull blue eyes, no eyebrows, and a bald head. His hero costume features an open dark leather jacket with yellow shoulder pads, golden goggles, and a bandolier over his exposed torso.

Backstory: A seasoned Pro Hero and fifth wielder of One For All, Daigoro received the legendary Quirk from Hikage Shinomori and trained extensively to master both his native Blackwhip ability and One For All's immense power.

Additional Information: Daigoro creates black energy tendrils from his arms for grappling and mobility. As a One For All user, he possesses superhuman strength, speed, agility, and durability.

cardPool.title: Daigo
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Daigo
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Unnamed Beast Form
Occupation/Role: Wolfram's Minion
Personality: Loyal and battle-hungry, Daigo takes pride in combat and respects skilled fighters. However, his arrogance causes him to underestimate opponents, a flaw that proved costly against Katsuki Bakugo.
Appearance: A middle-aged man with tanned skin, round head, small closed black eyes, and a hooked nose. He wears a black combat suit with a full-face mask featuring a pale X-shaped design.
Backstory: Daigo serves as one of Wolfram's loyal henchmen in the I-Island invasion. He helped restrain security and control the Central Tower before engaging U.A. students. He confronted Katsuki Bakugo and was defeated by Howitzer Impact.

cardPool.title: Dai
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Dai
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Saucer
Occupation/Role: Middle School Student (Third Year)
Personality: Timid and self-doubting, yet caring and brave when others need help. Admires Pro Heroes and acts instinctively to aid those in trouble despite insecurities about his Quirk's strength.
Appearance: A soft-featured boy with squarish dark gray eyes and black hair with gray spots in a bowl cut. Wears a beige and orange-brown middle school uniform with white dress shirt, green tie, and white loafers. His youthful face reflects earnestness and anxiety.
Backstory: Since childhood, Dai dreamed of becoming a Pro Hero after seeing All Might's statue. As his third year begins, self-doubt creeps in when classmates mock his weak Quirk. At All Might's statue, he encounters Deku and attempts to save a falling child.

cardPool.title: Dadan Tadan
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Dadan Tadan
Alias: Lucky Strike
Quirk Name: Flash Bang Sweat
Occupation/Role: Student, Isami Academy High School
Personality: Meek and timid, often nervous and apologetic. Dislikes fighting but acts for his team. Conscientious and quick to make peace.
Appearance: A short boy with light chestnut hair swept left, round nose, tiny black eyes, and cat-like mouth. Striking features include thin upper arms that widen into giant hands, wide hips with narrow shoulders, and a chubby lower stomach. Wears standard Isami High uniform: white shirt, red tie, dark blue blazer, gray pants, and brown loafers, tailored to fit his unusual proportions.
Backstory: A student dreaming of becoming a hero named Lucky Strike. Despite his gentle nature and aversion to combat, he recognizes his duty to use his abilities for good. He demonstrated humility and team loyalty during school events.

cardPool.title: Dabi
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Toya Todoroki

Alias: Dabi

Quirk Name: Hellflame

Occupation/Role: Villain, League of Villains member

Personality: Cold and calculating, driven by deep-seated resentment toward his father Endeavor. Dabi masks emotional turmoil beneath a detached demeanor, speaking with measured precision. His intense hatred fuels vengeful ambitions.

Appearance: A tall, pale young man in his early twenties with a slim but muscular build. Gnarled purple scar tissue covers his lower face, neck, torso, arms, and legs from losing control of his Quirk. He has spiky white hair with heavy bangs obscuring turquoise eyes. Multiple silver cartilage piercings adorn both ears with triple nostril piercings on his right side. He wears a dark blue jacket with ripped collar, matching pants, white scoop-neck shirt, dark dress shoes, gray patterned belt, and brown leather satchel.

cardPool.title: Curator
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown

Alias: Curator

Quirk Name: Whale

Occupation/Role: Villain

Personality: Cold, calculating, and singularly focused on his goals. Disrespectful and manipulative, using brainwashing as a tool of control. Becomes uncontrollable and berserk if his containment helmet is damaged or removed.

Appearance: A stark two-faced figure split down the middle. His right side displays fair skin, short messy black hair, and a tired eye. His left side is dark blue-skinned with white hair, a grotesquely wide red eye, a prominent blowhole on his forehead, and razor-sharp teeth. He wears a gray diving helmet with barnacle protrusions and a large collar secured by a hanging lock, covering the left half of his face. Beneath this sits a black suit layered under a light purple coat with a tall collar lined in white fur. Gold watches, bracelets, and rings adorn his wrists and fingers.

cardPool.title: Crust
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Crust

Alias: Shield Hero

Quirk Name: Shield

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero (Rank No. 6)

Personality: Emotional and noble, prone to crying but unwavering in duty. Selfless and willing to sacrifice himself, maintaining courage even facing death.

Appearance: Well-built man with black hair slicked back and a grayish-white streak from his hairline. His right hand bears a crusty, stone-like layer. He wears a black eye mask, Spartan-inspired black armor with red stitching, and a green hooded cape.

Backstory: One of Japan's top ten Pro Heroes, Crust earned his elite ranking through exceptional combat prowess and tactical expertise. He felt deeply about All Might's retirement and regretted missing Kamino, channeling these emotions into dedicated service.

Additional Information: Specializes in team-based combat and defensive strategies.

cardPool.title: Crimson Riot
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Crimson Riot, Chivalrous Hero
Quirk Name: Hardening
Occupation/Role: Pro Hero
Personality: Unwavering despite inner fear, Crimson Riot believes willpower transcends Quirk ability. He defines "manly spirit" as determination and courage regardless of gender. Haunted by an early failure that cost civilian lives, he channels that trauma into fearless heroism, always charging forward to prevent repeating past mistakes.
Appearance: A sturdy, broad-shouldered man with striking spiky red hair. He wears a distinctive metal three-piece mask covering his mouth and nose, paired with a crimson outfit and long red cape with a high, wide collar and ripped edges.
Backstory: An established Pro Hero whose fearless reputation masks a deeper truth. Early in his career, hesitation resulted in civilian deaths—a tragedy that shaped his heroic philosophy.

cardPool.title: Cow Lady
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown

Alias: Cow Lady

Quirk Name: Cow

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero

Personality: Dutiful and confident, Cow Lady is a committed hero willing to collaborate with allies. She maintains professional composure during crises and takes her responsibilities seriously.

Appearance: A tall woman with shoulder-length wavy blonde hair, prominent curved horns from her temples, and pointed cow-like ears. She wears a dark orange cropped laced top, sleeveless denim jacket with rope tie, ripped denim shorts, western belt with cow-head buckle, leather gloves, and knee-high boots. A cowboy hat hangs around her neck, tasseled rings adorn her upper arms, and orange-tinted shades complete her look.

Backstory: An American Pro Hero from Los Angeles, Cow Lady has built a reputation as a dependable combatant.

cardPool.title: Cow Cowboy
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Unknown

Alias:
Cow Cowboy

Quirk Name:
Control Horn

Occupation/Role:
Villain

Personality:
Ruthless extortionist who uses threats and intimidation for profit, showing no regard for farmers or their communities.

Appearance:
A short man with small dark eyes behind round glasses and thick eyebrows. He wears a cow-patterned cowboy hat with protruding horns, tuxedo shirt, overcoat, baggy pants, boots, and a pendant.

Backstory:
Cow Cowboy targeted rural farming communities, using his Quirk to extort farmers. All Might defeated and arrested him while he threatened to destroy multiple farms. His sidekicks abandoned him upon capture.

Additional Information:
His Quirk allows him to mind control cattle, which he weaponizes for extortion. Little is known about his relationships with sidekicks beyond employment. He represents Quirk-based crime in isolated communities.

cardPool.title: Composer Hero
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown (Conjectural)

Alias: Composer Hero

Quirk Name: Unnamed Music Quirk

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero

Personality: Professional and composed, performing duties with confidence. Demonstrates strong capability in team operations and remains calm under pressure.

Appearance: Tall, well-built man with chin-length blond hair and sharp green eyes. Wears an orange jacket resembling a violin with dangling flaps, golden collar buttons, three belt straps on each upper arm, and white gloves. Carries a yellow conductor's baton.

Backstory: An accomplished Pro Hero invited to prestigious events like I-Island and selected for dangerous Humarise cult raids, indicating high status and exceptional combat experience.

Additional Information: His Quirk generates golden musical notes that pacify and incapacitate enemies without lethal force.

cardPool.title: Clair Voyance
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Clair Voyance

Alias:
None

Quirk Name:
Voyance

Occupation/Role:
Pro Hero, World Heroes Association member, Otheon Task Force operative

Personality:
Calm, resolved, and serious. Dutiful and reliable, readily assisting others with information and support. Professional and composed under pressure.

Appearance:
A curvy woman with bright blue eyes hidden behind a visor with large blue-tinted lenses. Straight blonde hair with brown roots. She wears a form-fitting royal blue suit with white high-collared shirt, dark magenta zipper down the middle, and short sleeves bearing the WHA logo. Black thigh-high boots with magenta lines and a brown holster on her right thigh containing a pulse gun.

Backstory:
International pro hero recruited by the World Heroes Association for a global operation against the anti-Quirk terrorist organization Humarise.

cardPool.title: Chuma Yakumaru
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Chuma Yakumaru
Alias: The Junkie
Quirk Name: Bruiser
Occupation/Role: Instant Villain
Personality: Antisocial and volatile, Chuma is hostile to everyone around him. Severely drug dependent, he becomes increasingly aggressive and unpredictable under Trigger's influence, turning violent without warning.
Appearance: A haggard man with greasy dark hair, sunken cheekbones, and stubble. He wears a dirty open shirt with dark pants. When enhanced by Trigger, his body transforms—taller and bulkier with veiny reddish-purple skin and enlarged eyes.
Backstory: Chuma was supplied Trigger by Kuin Hachisuka to manifest his Quirk dangerously. Desperate for the drug's rush, he became an Instant Villain, attacking both Kuin and civilians before being defeated by Knuckleduster.
Additional Information: Chuma is a criminal operating in Naruhata, not a UA student.

cardPool.title: Chubs
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown (formerly a glutton)
Alias: Chubs
Quirk Name: Super Regeneration, Body Expansion, Mouth, Metal Teeth
Occupation/Role: High-End Nomu, Doctor Garaki's bioengineered creation
Personality: Obedient yet tactically aware; prefers direct confrontation; recognizes specific opponents; speaks with slight stuttering.
Appearance: Grotesquely bulbous body with excessive adipose tissue; robotic thrusters grafted at thighs; hands fused into mouths with teeth and tongues; additional mouths line torso; small vertebrae protrude from back; metal grid grafted across head concealing brain.
Backstory: Originally a glutton, selected by Doctor Garaki and surgically transformed into a High-End Nomu through Quirk grafting and cybernetic enhancement. Created as a powerful combatant beneath Jaku General Hospital.

cardPool.title: Christopher Skyline
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Christopher Skyline

Alias: Captain Celebrity, Playboy Hero

Quirk Name: Force Field

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero (American, currently operating in Japan)

Personality: Arrogant and attention-seeking with a bombastic personality, yet genuinely heroic in crises. Despite flirtatiousness and poor judgment, he desires to make people smile. His lack of self-awareness stems from obsession with his alpha male image rather than malice.

Appearance: Exceptionally tall and well-built with a chiseled jawline, cleft chin, and angular nose. Blonde swept-back mohawk, light blue downward-tilting eyes, and long eyelashes. Cerulean skin-tight bodysuit trimmed in yellow with red-starred chest logo, matching shin and shoulder-pads, yellow belt with large buckle, and long red cape with dark blue visor.

cardPool.title: Chomper
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Chomper
Quirk Name: Plant
Occupation/Role: F-rank Villain, League of Villains member
Personality: Confident in combat despite low rank. Bold or reckless, willing to assault U.A. High School.
Appearance: Average-height man wearing an orange sweater, magenta pants, and black boots. His head is replaced by a large venus flytrap that continuously oozes green fluid.
Backstory: Recruited by Tomura Shigaraki for the U.S.J. assault on U.A. High School.
Additional Information: Plant Quirk allows transformation of body parts into plant structures with healing properties. Defeated during U.S.J. invasion and arrested. Later appeared in footage from Deika City battle alongside Victor.

cardPool.title: Chojuro Kon
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Chojuro Kon

Alias:
Chimera

Quirk Name:
Chimera

Occupation/Role:
Villain; member of Nine's criminal organization

Personality:
Driven by societal hatred from lifelong ostracization, Chojuro seeks a power-based society with Nine. Despite brutality, he shows occasional compassion toward allies. He displays hypocrisy mocking others' monstrous features while possessing animalistic traits himself.

Appearance:
An imposing man with blue fur, wolf-like head, eagle talon hands and feet, and a reptilian tail. He wears a brown trench coat over a blue dress shirt with jeans and belt, often smoking a cigar. Dark dreadlocks frame his animalistic face.

Backstory:
Rejected for his inhuman appearance, Chojuro lived as an outcast until Nine recruited him. Viewing Nine as his savior, he devoted himself to a vision of a new world ordered by power alone.

cardPool.title: Chizuo Magi
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Chizuo Magi
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Unknown
Occupation/Role: Retired; Grandfather and household resident
Personality: Loving and kind-hearted, deeply caring toward his family. Compassionate but struggles with confrontation and fear of his abusive son-in-law. Eventually finds courage to stand against injustice, though too late to prevent tragedy.
Appearance: A relatively chubby elderly man with hair the same color as his daughter Nao. He has a gentle, grandfatherly demeanor befitting his age and caring nature.
Backstory: Chizuo lived in his daughter's home with his wife Mako, sharing daily life with grandchildren Tenko and Hana. He witnessed years of abuse from son-in-law Kotaro toward the children for admiring heroes, growing disgusted but fearful of intervention. When Kotaro physically punished Tenko excessively, Chizuo finally joined his family in confronting him.

cardPool.title: Chizome Akaguro
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Chizome Akaguro

Alias: Hero Killer: Stain, formerly Stendhal

Quirk Name: Bloodcurdle

Occupation/Role: Villain/Former Vigilante

Personality: A cruel ideologue obsessed with purging "false heroes" from society. Possesses uncompromising moral convictions, revering only All Might as a true hero. Justifies his murderous crusade as necessary cleansing. Shows rare respect for those who fight with conviction. Willful, calculating, and utterly devoted to his twisted vision of justice.

Appearance: An intimidating, muscular man with a hunched posture and triangular face. Notable features include small red eyes with tiny irises, self-removed nose, and an extraordinarily long tongue. Long messy black hair hidden beneath a blood-red headband and tattered cloth mask. Dark combat suit with plated metal armor, sleeveless with yellow bandages on forearms.

cardPool.title: Chiyo Shuzenji
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Chiyo Shuzenji

Alias: Recovery Girl, Youthful Heroine

Quirk Name: Heal

Occupation/Role: School Nurse at U.A. High School

Personality: Compassionate and kind, offering sweets to counteract her Quirk's stamina drain. She maintains a strict attitude toward reckless behavior and refuses to enable harmful patterns, withholding aid when necessary.

Appearance: A short, elderly woman with gray hair in a netted bun with a large syringe protruding from it. She has a small nose, tiny dash eyes, and a long mouth with deep nasolabial folds. She wears a white lab coat over a dress with yellow and red vest-like designs, pink boots, and a helmet with purple visor. She carries a syringe-shaped cane.

Backstory: An experienced medical professional serving U.A. High School as its primary nurse with offices at the school and Sports Festival Stadium.

cardPool.title: Chitose Kizuki
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Chitose Kizuki

Alias: Curious

Quirk Name: Lacquering

Occupation/Role: Executive Director of Shoowaysha Publishing, Meta Liberation Army Leader

Personality: Intensely curious and obsessively driven by journalism, Chitose pursues stories above all else, even her own safety. She is callous and manipulative, willing to weaponize subordinates and murder for the perfect narrative. Her obsessive nature causes her to lose all sense of danger and self-preservation.

Appearance: Chitose is a striking woman with long, pale lilac hair parted to her right side. She has unusual eyes with black sclerae, green irises, and black pupils, framed by long eyelashes. Her skin is pale blue with full lips.

cardPool.title: Chikuchi Togeike
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Chikuchi Togeike

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Not specified

Occupation/Role: Student, U.A. High School General Department

Personality: Initially envious of Class 1-A's popularity but capable of remorse and honest appreciation. After witnessing their School Festival performance, she admitted she was wrong. Generally sullen and stern-faced but willing to acknowledge others' achievements.

Appearance: Young woman of average build with dark, ear-length hair in low curved pigtails with upward-arching bangs. Thin, stern-looking eyes with prominent lower eyelashes and a typically sullen expression. Wears standard U.A. High School uniform.

Backstory: A General Department student who resented Class 1-A's celebrated status until their School Festival performance prompted self-reflection and apology. During the Final War, she assisted civilians in the U.A.

cardPool.title: Chikara Yotsubashi
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Chikara Yotsubashi

Alias: Destro

Quirk Name: Not specified in source

Occupation/Role: Infamous villain, founder and grand commander of the original Meta Liberation Army

Personality: Idealistic revolutionary who believed Quirk use was a fundamental human right and viewed government regulation as oppressive. Driven by tragedy and conviction, he inspired devoted followers despite being labeled a terrorist.

Appearance: Long light brown hair in a ponytail with a distinctive black blotch around his eyes like a mask. He wore a dark green military jacket with a red-outlined rat patch on the right sleeve, gray shirt, and red ascot tie.

Backstory: Born during an era of Meta Ability prejudice, Chikara endured social rejection. His mother advocated for acceptance and coined the term "Quirk," earning her the title "Mother of Quirks.

cardPool.title: Cathleen Bate
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Cathleen Bate

Alias: Star and Stripe

Quirk Name: New Order

Occupation/Role: No. 1 Pro Hero of the United States of America

Personality: Brash, selfless, and fiercely protective with intense justice. Admires All Might and defies rules to save others. Kind and sisterly to her team, though sometimes ignorant outside her jurisdiction. Willing to sacrifice everything for those she protects.

Appearance: A tall woman with an athletic build and elegant features. Long flowing blonde hair styled in eight backward-swept tufts, narrow brown eyes, and a red domino mask. Her skin-tight bodysuit features striped patterns on the upper torso, metal-studded gauntlets and collar with star designs, and a long striped cape resembling the U.S. flag.

Backstory: Inspired by All Might saving her family during his time abroad, Cathleen dedicated herself to heroism.

cardPool.title: Cargirl
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Cargirl
Quirk Name: Car
Occupation/Role: Pro Hero
Personality: Amiable and approachable with fans. Reserved about personal details, maintaining professional mystique.
Appearance: Slender young woman with blonde hair in a ponytail and two loose spirals framing her face. Wears a purple beret with low-tilting visor, sleeveless white crop top, purple armor-like hood, white sports shorts with purple side stripes, and dark knee-high boots. A purple skirt-shell with functioning axle-mounted wheels completes the costume.
Backstory: An established Pro Hero specializing in automotive-themed heroics with a background in or passion for auto-racing culture. Her true origins remain obscure.
Additional Information: Not a UA High School student. Her quirk mechanics are car-related but ambiguous. Active during the timeline of My Hero Academia: Two Heroes film.

cardPool.title: Camie Utsushimi
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Camie Utsushimi

Alias: Illus-o-Camie

Quirk Name: Glamour

Occupation/Role: Second-year student at Shiketsu High School

Personality: Bubbly and laid-back with trendy gyaru-like slang. She brushes off serious situations easily but possesses genuine cleverness and strategic thinking beneath her carefree demeanor.

Appearance: Average height with straight light brown hair below her shoulders and large dark brown eyes. She wears her Shiketsu uniform with standard white-collared shirt and dark skirt. Her hero costume features a black catsuit with patterned lines, white wrist cuffs, white heeled knee-high boots with gray patterns, and a black collar with metallic plates.

Backstory: A prestigious second-year at Shiketsu High School training to become a Pro Hero.

cardPool.title: Bye-Bites
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Bye-Bites

Alias:
Sharukinara

Quirk Name:
Unnamed Shark Quirk

Occupation/Role:
Low-ranking villain in the League of Villains U.S.J. assault

Personality:
Cruel and sadistic with no remorse. Cautious of unknown Quirks but eager to eliminate targets. Patient in tactical situations.

Appearance:
Humanoid shark with light blue skin, dark blue hair, and yellow eyes. Prominent fin and sharp teeth with elongated jaw. Wears sleeveless diving suit, diving mask, and oxygen cylinder.

Backstory:
One of seventy villains recruited by Tomura Shigaraki to assault U.A. High School's Unforeseen Simulation Joint. Deployed to the Flood Zone where his shark physiology provided combat advantage. Engaged Class 1-A during the attack but was defeated and arrested.

cardPool.title: Bruno Gollini
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Bruno Gollini

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Delay Spot

Occupation/Role: Member of the Gollini Family mafia

Personality: Sly and cunning, Bruno enjoys catching opponents off-guard through psychological games. His confidence crumbles when outmatched, replaced by panic.

Appearance: A tall, slim middle-aged man with slicked greying hair, sharp black eyes, and defined jawline. His hairy hands are adorned with rings and jewelry. He wears formal mafia attire—black suit jacket with blue tuxedo shirt, gray pants, and plum ascot tie, accented by a rose pin.

Backstory: Bruno operates as a trusted member of the Gollini Family criminal organization, leveraging his Delay Spot Quirk to intimidate and control opponents.

Additional Information: Delay Spot creates a semi-spherical bubble trapping everything inside in slow motion while Bruno moves at normal speed.

cardPool.title: Bruce Lee
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Bruce Lee
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Fa Jin
Occupation/Role: Resistance Member, One For All User
Personality: Serious and apathetic from surviving society's collapse, with unwavering belief in justice. Views the world in stark black and white—victory or death. Initially skeptical of idealism, but capable of empathy and mentorship when convinced. Fiercely loyal to allies.
Appearance: Tall, athletic build with striking silver hair in an upward spiky ponytail. Dark eyes and sharp features reflect his hardened nature. Wears a black forehead bandana and green combat jacket. No visible scars despite veteran status.
Backstory: Bruce survived Quirks' chaotic emergence, becoming battle-hardened. He joined Toshitsugu Kudo's resistance against All For One, becoming Kudo's trusted second-in-command. Kudo passed One For All to him as successor.

cardPool.title: Briareos
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Briareos

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Multiple Arm

Occupation/Role: Tartarus Prison Guard

Personality: Duty-bound and resolute, Briareos demonstrates unwavering commitment to his post despite overwhelming odds. He remains calm under pressure, issuing tactical orders during catastrophic threats.

Appearance: An imposing figure in crimson and black armor plating. His helmet completely obscures his face with a sleek, intimidating design. His Quirk grants him ten arms, which he wields with practiced efficiency in combat.

Backstory: Briareos served as a senior guard at Tartarus prison's Bronze Gate alongside his brother Gyges. When the Paranormal Liberation Front assaulted the facility, he stood against High-End Nomu despite the deaths of heroes and escape of dangerous villains, including Tomura Shigaraki.

cardPool.title: Bombers
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Bomber (Designation Unknown)
Alias: Bomber, Next-Level Villain
Quirk Name: Explosive Detonation (varies by specimen)
Occupation/Role: Mass-produced combat entity created by the Villain Factory
Personality: Lacks independent thought; operates on programmed directives with absolute obedience. Devoid of self-preservation instinct or fear, ideal for suicide assault missions.
Appearance: Round, winged entity with jet-black skin and serpentine head lacking facial features save a wide mouth. Two bat wings protrude from the back. A swollen belly contains explosive energy reserves. Specialized variants exist, such as larger six-armed versions.
Backstory: Manufactured by the Villain Factory at the Bomber Warehouse within Onomura Pharma Corp., these creatures were engineered as expendable weapons.

cardPool.title: Bomb Villain
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Bomb Villain
Quirk Name: Fire Cracker
Occupation/Role: Professional Villain, Jewelry Thief
Personality: Greedy and overconfident. Shows arrogance in combat, smirking at opponents before acting rashly.
Appearance: Tall with large afro. Thick lips, prominent facial hair, sharp nose. Wears fringed blazer, twinkle-symbol belt, long pants, and spiked high-heeled boots.
Backstory: Career criminal in organized villain networks. Partners with Gale Villain on coordinated heists, prioritizing material wealth over ideology.
Additional Information: Fire Cracker Quirk rips hair chunks to detonate as explosives—hurled as bombs or used for propulsion. Building-level destructive power but inferior to similar Explosion-type Quirks. Underestimates opponents despite proven combat capability.

cardPool.title: Blackbelt
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Blackbelt, Martial Hero: Blackbelt
Quirk Name: Fast Fist
Occupation/Role: Pro Hero
Personality: Seeks recognition while maintaining heroic duty. Attempts affected Shakespearean speech but lapses into normal dialogue. Creates unnecessarily complex martial arts techniques for show. Prioritizes saving lives over fame when it matters.
Appearance: Young man with long, messy hair and muscular build. Wears martial artist-inspired hero costume with metal headband, loose robes, and large belt. Light facial makeup completes his martial arts master image.
Backstory: Became a Pro Hero 10 years ago seeking fame. Faced mockery from civilians doubting his speed, earning the nickname "Hundo-Hit-Man." Nearly retired until UA students Momo Yaoyorozu, Denki Kaminari, and Mei Hatsume created a high-speed camera drone capturing evidence of his abilities, vindicating him.

cardPool.title: Zookeeper
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Unknown

Alias:
Zookeeper

Quirk Name:
Cleaning

Occupation/Role:
Former Zookeeper, Villain (Brainwashed Companion of Curator)

Personality:
Once kind and cheerful with deep love for animals, now under Curator's mental control. Her gentle nature is suppressed by brainwashing.

Appearance:
Woman with shoulder-length white hair and white irises. Wears black and red buttoned outfit with white gloves and black boots.

Backstory:
A dedicated zookeeper captured and brainwashed by Curator, who transformed her into his loyal subordinate and stripped her of free will.

Additional Information:
Her Quirk secretes a dish soap-like substance that weakens enemies by "cleaning" them and sanitizes crime scenes. Wields a wooden push broom as primary weapon. Not a UA student. Part of the Clash! Heroes Battle arcade game universe.

cardPool.title: Yuyu Haya
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Yuyu Haya

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Unknown

Occupation/Role: UA High School Student, Class 3-A

Personality: Friendly and fashionable with a protective streak. Levelheaded as a hero-in-training, though her protective nature causes her to jump to conclusions. Highly loyal and supportive, especially toward best friend Nejire Hado.

Appearance: Fair-skinned girl with cropped salmon-colored hair, reddish-brown eyes with long lower eyelashes, and multiple grey ear piercings. School uniform is disheveled with crooked collar, loose tie, and rolled-up sleeves. Hero costume features a black domino mask, purple tight suit with yellow markings, long purple boots with white and yellow accents, black arm sleeves, and white belt with cylinders.

Backstory: Third-year UA student and best friend to Nejire Hado since first year.

cardPool.title: Yuga Aoyama
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Yuga Aoyama

Alias: Shining Hero: Can't Stop Twinkling

Quirk Name: Navel Laser

Occupation/Role: Class 1-A Student at UA High School

Personality: Vain and flamboyant with a closed smile, Yuga presents himself as superior and attention-seeking. He speaks with affected French mannerisms and ends sentences with stars (☆). Beneath this facade lies deep insecurity from his Quirkless birth and complicated origins. He is prone to upset if interrupted.

Appearance: A slim young man with an effeminate face, long blonde hair spiked at the sides with a curved fringe, long eyelashes, and bright indigo eyes. His hero costume features a black bodysuit beneath metallic lavender armor with golden accents, including a high V-neck chest plate, spherical shoulder pads, elbow-length vambraces, and knee boots. A glittery indigo cape flows from his golden ring-buckled belt.

cardPool.title: Yui Kodai
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Yui Kodai

Alias:
Rule

Quirk Name:
Size

Occupation/Role:
UA High School Student, Class 1-B

Personality:
Quiet and emotionally reserved with a kūdere demeanor. Despite her silent nature, she genuinely cares for her classmates and shows warmth through subtle actions. She communicates happiness with soft "Mm!" sounds and displays particular enthusiasm for tomatoes.

Appearance:
A young girl with shoulder-length bob-cut hair, side-swept bangs, and fair skin. She has narrow cerulean eyes and an athletic build. Her hero costume is a red bodysuit with white-collar trim, a white "V" pattern across her chest and upper arms, and a short white skirt trimmed in red. She wears white vambraces with yellow accents, a red baseball-cap-style hat with white U-shaped lines and yellow dots, and carries pouches with small metal objects and components.

cardPool.title: Yu Takeyama
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Yu Takeyama

Alias: Mt. Lady, Peak Hero: Mt. Lady

Quirk Name: Gigantification

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero (No. 23), UA High School Student, Class 1-A

Personality: Ambitious and egotistical, Yu thrives on attention and fame. Beneath her superficial nature lies genuine heroic courage—she protects civilians without hesitation and refuses to transform in confined spaces to prevent collateral damage.

Appearance: An above-average height young woman with fair skin and curvaceous frame. She has striking magenta eyes with white pupils, long eyelashes, and voluminous creamy blonde hair reaching her waist with two shorter curled strands framing her face. Her hero costume consists of a purple and pale tan skin-tight bodysuit with orange stripe accents, purple gloves with orange cuffs, and thigh-cut purple boots.

cardPool.title: Yu Hojo
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Yu Hojo
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Crystallize
Occupation/Role: Eight Bullets member of the Shie Hassaikai yakuza organization
Personality: Serious and loyal to Overhaul, brutish in combat. Yu harbors deep resentment from past abuse but finds purpose through his yakuza family. He dismisses heroes as incapable of understanding the bonds between outcasts.
Appearance: A tall, muscular man with a shaven head and intense eyes. He wears a dark dress shirt with undone top buttons, plain pants, and black dress shoes. Unlike other Eight Bullets, he wears a simple white medical mask rather than beaked masks.
Backstory: Yu was beaten and left for dead after producing worthless gems for a criminal. Overhaul discovered him and offered him a place in the Shie Hassaikai, giving him purpose and family. Yu accepted without hesitation, transforming his despair into absolute loyalty.

cardPool.title: Yosetsu Awase
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Yosetsu Awase

Alias:
Welder

Quirk Name:
Weld

Occupation/Role:
Student, Class 1-B at U.A. High School

Personality:
Foul-mouthed and tense normally, but becomes talkative during crises. Selfless and willing to risk himself for others. Proud and confident in his abilities. Competent and strategic combatant with excellent tactical awareness.

Appearance:
Long black hair spiked upward, with rounded gray eyes tilted inward. Wears a blue and white zig-zag patterned headband low across his forehead. Hero costume is a burgundy full-body suit with extended collar, dark brown shoulder pads, layered chest armor, white knee-high boots with brown accents, and two blue utility bags containing metal and wood blocks.

Backstory:
Ranked 10th in the U.A. Entrance Exam with the third-highest villain points. Trained rigorously to master his Quirk for offensive and restraining applications.

cardPool.title: Yoroi Musha
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Yoroi Musha

Alias: Equipped Hero: Yoroi Musha

Quirk Name: Unknown

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero (No. 9 ranking), mentor to UA Work-Study interns

Personality: Traditional and duty-bound, Yoroi Musha presents himself as a steadfast upholder of heroic ideals, though he struggles with conviction under pressure. His heroism was motivated by fame and respect rather than genuine altruism.

Appearance: An elderly man with a bald head and long white beard, distinguished by pale orange eyes with black sclera. He wears a full suit of Japanese armor styled as his hero costume, complete with an upward-pointing horn on his helmet and a crimson cape, giving him a formidable samurai-like presence.
