Backstory: Yoroi Musha rose to prominence as the ninth-ranked Pro Hero through demonstrated skill in combat.

cardPool.title: Yokumiru Mera
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Yokumiru Mera

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Unknown

Occupation/Role: Worker for the Hero Public Safety Commission; Acting President of the Commission

Personality: Sleep-deprived and blasé, Yokumiru complains about exhaustion while maintaining disinterested composure. Despite weariness, he demonstrates inspirational leadership and compassion, offering failed examinees remedial paths. He mentors effectively, having guided Hawks through morally complex training.

Appearance: A lanky, middle-aged man with chin-length beige disheveled hair, hollow tired eyes, and prominent under-eye bags. He wears a black shirt over white undershirt, black pants, loose tie, and black shoes. He carries a microphone for announcements.

Backstory: A longtime Commission operative who trained promising hero candidates, Yokumiru earned respect mentoring Hawks.

cardPool.title: Yoichi Shigaraki
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Yoichi Shigaraki

Alias: The First One For All User

Quirk Name: One For All

Occupation/Role: Historical figure; deceased hero whose will persists within One For All

Personality: Principled and compassionate, Yoichi maintains unwavering moral conviction and hope for redemption despite betrayal. He refuses stolen power and advocates for justice, inspiring successive heroes through his embedded will. Though disgusted by his brother's cruelty, he never fully surrenders his love for him.

Appearance: A young man with sickly, malnourished features and chronically weak physique. He has shoulder-length white messy hair with bangs obscuring bright green eyes. He typically wore a white shirt with dark pants and light blue jacket. His frail build reflected lifelong physical frailty.

cardPool.title: X-Less
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: X-Less, Eye-Gun Hero: X-Less
Quirk Name: Laser
Occupation/Role: Pro Hero
Personality: Cautious and methodical, X-Less prioritizes safety and thorough investigation over rushing forward. He eliminates unknown threats before advancing, showing restraint and strategic thinking.
Appearance: A lean man with an angular face, full lips, and a distinctive undercut extending from neck to forehead with hair combed rightward. His right eye lacks a visible pupil, a defining feature of his Quirk. He wears a blue hero costume with light upper and dark lower sections, dark blue striped sleeves with yellow accents, and a red cape. A dark blue stripe wraps around his head over his right eye.
Backstory: X-Less rose through the ranks as a capable Pro Hero, earning recognition for his precision-based combat style.

cardPool.title: Yashamaru
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Yashamaru

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Unknown

Occupation/Role: Low-ranking villain, League of Villains recruit

Personality: Aggressive and direct, charges into combat without hesitation. Follows orders from superiors like Tomura Shigaraki with typical thug mentality.

Appearance: Muscular build with spiky dark blond hair. Distinctive upward-curving horns protrude from his forehead. Sharp fangs visible in his mouth. Wears a black shirt and spiked bracelets on both wrists.

Backstory: A minor criminal recruited by the League of Villains for the coordinated assault on the Unforeseen Simulation Joint. Served as disposable infantry among roughly seventy low-ranking villains in Tomura Shigaraki's plan to strike at UA High School.

Additional Information: Defeated during the U.S.J. incident by Ectoplasm's clones after being stunned by Present Mic's Voice Quirk.

cardPool.title: Wolfram
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Wolfram

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Metal Manipulation

Occupation/Role: Villain, Leader of Thief Troupe

Personality: Avaricious and manipulative, caring only for himself and wealth. Enjoys taunting others while mocking heroic ideals. Cold and ruthless, viewing people as tools or obstacles.

Appearance: Tall, bulky man with dark red hair swept back and central tuft. Yellow eyes, sharp features with scar on left cheek. Wears large white coat with gray trimmings over dark combat gear, combat boots, and metallic mask covering most of his face. Brown gloves conceal his hands. When powered by the Quirk Amplification Device, his eyes glow purple with blackened sclera.

Backstory: Leads a criminal organization posing as mercenaries. With All For One's backing, orchestrated a scheme to gain David Shield's trust, steal his Quirk Amplification Device, and enslave him for inventions.

cardPool.title: Woman
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Woman
Quirk Name: Multiple (Liquification, Rupture, and others absorbed)
Occupation/Role: High-End Nomu, Doctor Garaki's Combat Unit
Personality: Aggressive and bloodthirsty with surprising intelligence; analytical in combat, quickly deducing opponent abilities. Speaks coherently and strategically despite her monstrous nature.
Appearance: Feminine humanoid frame with exposed musculature, visible brain at crown of head with flayed scalp fin-like structure at back. Two rows of long jagged teeth hidden within her chin. Stitches along legs, protruding vertebrae down spine, flayed skin structures on both elbows, dark hair at back of head.
Backstory: A combat-oriented villain transformed into a High-End Nomu by Doctor Kyudai Garaki.

cardPool.title: Wolf Villain
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Wolf Villain
Quirk Name: Unnamed Wolf Quirk
Occupation/Role: Villain
Personality: Aggressive and predatory, targeting weaker individuals. Sadistic, particularly toward children and animals. Impulsive and easily distracted.
Appearance: Wolf-like humanoid with brown fur, yellow bloodshot eyes, and black-tipped tongue from Trigger use. Wears navy-blue vest and tan pants over his fur.
Backstory: A Trigger-addicted villain encountered while hunting a child and kitten. Apprehended by Eraser Head and arrested.
Additional Information: Confirmed Trigger user with a wolf-based Quirk granting enhanced physical abilities. Operates as a street-level threat.

cardPool.title: Willy Wanda
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Willy Wanda

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Diesel Engine

Occupation/Role: Former Next-Level Villain

Personality: Pragmatic and mechanical in demeanor, operating with a utilitarian mindset. Loyal to his faction but lacks charisma.

Appearance: His head and upper body are a functioning diesel train engine with metallic plating, smokestacks, and mechanical components. Lower body remains human. An imposing industrial silhouette.

Backstory: A Next-Level Villains member who used his Quirk to enforce the group's operations. Marked as both tool and soldier in the villain hierarchy before leaving active villainy.

Additional Information: Operates outside UA and conventional hero society. His Quirk grants enhanced strength and momentum-based offensive capabilities. Represents the dangerous intersection of Quirk modification and criminal intent in vigilante circles.

cardPool.title: Watchbird
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Watchbird
Quirk Name: Unknown
Occupation/Role: Pro Hero, Sidekick, Member of Ingenium's Team Idaten
Personality: Professional and communicative, focused on team coordination and tactical awareness during hero operations.
Appearance: Young woman with sleek brown hair in a tight ponytail. Wears a light blue bodysuit with white tactical gear, gloves, and boots. Her costume features a white chest piece with drone-like mechanical wings attached at the back and a blue visor with integrated communicator displaying green heads-up display for tracking opponents.
Backstory: A sidekick under pro hero Ingenium as part of Team Idaten, Watchbird has honed her abilities through professional training and field experience.

cardPool.title: Victor
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Victor

Alias:
None

Quirk Name:
Unnamed Finger Gun Quirk

Occupation/Role:
Villain, member of the League of Villains' Shooting Squad

Personality:
Confident in combat abilities despite low rank. Obedient to Tomura Shigaraki's command.

Appearance:
A man with reddish-brown hair and matching eyes. His fingertips have mutated into gun muzzles. He wears a gray tank top and pants with two gold chains on each wrist. A metallic helmet with greenish-blue luminous eye holes covers most of his head.

Backstory:
Victor was recruited by Tomura Shigaraki for the assault on the Unforeseen Simulation Joint. He served in the Shooting Squad alongside Stitched Giant and Needle Hair to ambush U.A. High School students during their Quirk Apprehension Test.

Additional Information:
Victor was incapacitated by Eraser Head when his Quirk was disabled.

cardPool.title: Varanus
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Varanus

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Unknown

Occupation/Role: Low-ranking Villain, League of Villains member

Personality: Aggressive and combative; follows orders from higher-ranking villains. Demonstrates typical henchman mentality with little individual initiative.

Appearance: A short man with a pronounced hunchback and elongated neck creating a reptilian silhouette. He wears a bleached animal skull as a mask, has crimson lines tattooed across his arms, and wears green pants with a black belt.

Backstory: Varanus was recruited by Tomura Shigaraki for the assault on the Unforeseen Simulation Joint. He participated in the attack against Pro Hero Shota Aizawa but was quickly subdued by Aizawa's Binding Cloth technique and apprehended.

Additional Information: Varanus is a minor antagonist from the U.S.J. Arc. His Quirk remains undocumented.

cardPool.title: Valdo Gollini
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Valdo Gollini

Alias: Dark Might

Quirk Name: Alchemy

Occupation/Role: Villain Leader of the Gollini Family Mafia (Europe-based criminal organization)

Personality: Ruthless and power-obsessed, driven by obsessive admiration for All Might's strength while lacking understanding of true heroism. Calculative and willing to eliminate anyone to achieve his goals. Arrogant and vain, seeking to become Symbol of Peace through force rather than virtue.

Appearance: Naturally a lean Italian man with sunken green eyes, slicked-back black hair, and thin stubble mustache. Wears dark formal attire—black blazers, vests, and bowties. His Dark Might form transforms him into a muscular blond-haired figure resembling younger All Might, with bushier eyebrows, larger hooked nose, and green eyes with dark markings.

cardPool.title: Uwabami
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Uwabami
Alias: Snake Hero: Uwabami
Quirk Name: Serpentine
Occupation/Role: Pro Hero, Celebrity, Mentor
Personality: Vain and celebrity-minded, prioritizing modeling over heroics, yet capable and level-headed in crises. Charming but honest about shallow motivations. Mentors based on appearance rather than merit, though maintains professional obligations.
Appearance: Curvy woman with long blonde hair in ringlets held by a curved plate. Golden eyes with vertically slit pupils. Three living snakes—a rattlesnake, yellow King cobra, and Japanese rat snake—protrude from her hair. Wears maroon scale-patterned dress, matching heels, and a choker with golden snake bracelets on wrists and ankles.
Backstory: Celebrated Pro Hero who combined heroics with commercial modeling through her serpent Quirk.

cardPool.title: Untenmaru Kurumada
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Untenmaru Kurumada
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Unknown
Occupation/Role: Endeavor's Personal Chauffeur
Personality: Stern and aggressive with a sharp tongue, unafraid to voice criticism even to his employer. Despite his gruff demeanor, he demonstrates loyalty and concern for Endeavor's safety, offering practical advice after dangerous incidents.
Appearance: A middle-aged man with a rectangular face and narrow, furrowed eyes. He has short black hair swept upward at the crown and a distinctive large white fluffy mustache that parts in the middle. He dresses professionally in a dark formal suit with black dress shirt and white tie, completing his look with white driving gloves.
Backstory: Long-serving chauffeur and trusted employee of hero Endeavor, Untenmaru has earned standing in the household to speak frankly about his boss's decisions.

cardPool.title: Ugo Gollini
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Ugo Gollini

Alias:
None

Quirk Name:
Telekinesis

Occupation/Role:
Member of the Gollini Family mafia

Personality:
Energetic and crude despite his elderly appearance, Ugo mocks enemies with jokes and taunts. He abandons banter immediately when family objectives take priority, showing ruthless pragmatism beneath his playful demeanor.

Appearance:
A short, elderly man with disproportionately long arms and short legs. His striking features include a long, curved nose with thick grey moustache, dark tailored suit with gray bow-tie, black fedora, dark sunglasses, grey sideburns, and a red rose corsage on his jacket lapel.

Backstory:
Ugo is a seasoned member of the Gollini Family crime organization, serving as an enforcer. His powerful Quirk makes him a valuable asset to their criminal enterprises.

cardPool.title: Tsuyoshi
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Tsuyoshi
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Bristle
Occupation/Role: Civilian Child
Personality: Confident in his Quirk but easily intimidated by bullies. Impressed by heroes yet quick to judge them. Passionate about football.
Appearance: Young boy with dark, short hair spiked downward with one especially large spike. Wears a hooded shirt, shorts, and sneakers.
Backstory: A civilian boy warned by his mother to be cautious. He believes his Quirk protects him despite his inexperience with actual threats.
Additional Information: Not a UA student. His Quirk hardens his hair to superhuman density for defense or offense. His overconfidence in his powers contrasts with his fear of social confrontation.

cardPool.title: Tsutsutaka Agoyamato
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Tsutsutaka Agoyamato

Alias:
None

Quirk Name:
Unknown

Occupation/Role:
U.A. High School General Department Student

Personality:
Initially resentful of Class 1-A's prominence, believing their conflicts endanger the school. Capable of humility—after witnessing their exceptional festival performance, he genuinely apologizes for his negativity. Shows civic responsibility during crises and respects upperclassmen like Nejire Hado.

Appearance:
A tall young man with a distinctively large, prominent chin mirroring his dark pompadour hairstyle. Wears standard male U.A. uniform. Angular, imposing facial features give him a stern appearance despite his youthful age.

Backstory:
A General Department student who initially resented Class 1-A for drawing villainous attention to the school.

cardPool.title: Tsunagu Hakamada
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Tsunagu Hakamada

Alias:
Fiber Hero: Best Jeanist

Quirk Name:
Fiber Master

Occupation/Role:
Pro Hero (currently No. 5 ranked)

Personality:
An elegant, flamboyant man who believes those with influence must maintain positive appearance and behavior. Selfless, brave, and charismatic, he uses fabric-based metaphors to inspire others. Takes heroism seriously and dislikes brutish individuals lacking refinement.

Appearance:
Exceptionally tall and slim with an unnaturally long, flexible neck and dark, heavily-lashed eyes that tilt slightly inward. Long blonde hair combed drastically to the left, covering his left eye. Wears a denim hero costume: high-collared shirt covering his face below the nose, denim waistcoat with large breast pockets, jeans, two belts, and short dark brown boots with gray shafts.

Backstory:
Once ranked No.

cardPool.title: Tsumuji Kazetani
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Tsumuji Kazetani

Alias: Gust Boy

Quirk Name: Fan

Occupation/Role: Villain

Personality: Strategic and calculated, Tsumuji approaches combat with precision. He respects his power's limitations and plans accordingly, avoiding overuse.

Appearance: A lean man of average height with light brown skin, elongated face, and grayish-blue hair tied in a ponytail. His mutated hands are oversized with bright orange flexible fingers functioning as fan blades. He wears a black sleeveless unitard with purple belt, teal sneakers fitted with small fans, goggles, and carries a desk fan on his back.

Backstory: Tsumuji's Quirk manifested as a hand mutation into functional fan blades. He weaponized this ability and turned to villainy, becoming a threat during Class 1-A's emergence as heroes-in-training.

cardPool.title: Tsubasa
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Tsubasa

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Unnamed Wing Quirk

Occupation/Role: Civilian (formerly childhood friend of Bakugo)

Personality: Arrogant bully who admired strength and tormented the weak, especially those without Quirks. Easily influenced by stronger personalities like Bakugo.

Appearance: Stocky youth with rounded face and short brown hair. Two red draconic wings protrude from his back at will. Wore a simple tank top, green shorts, and geta sandals in childhood.

Backstory: Grew up with Bakugo and Midoriya. Idolized Bakugo and joined him in bullying Quirkless Midoriya. The three ventured into a forbidden forest where Bakugo fell into a stream, deeply affecting their friendships. Drifted away from both boys by middle school.

Additional Information: Grandson of Dr. Tsubasa. Not a UA student and did not pursue a hero career. Current whereabouts unknown.

cardPool.title: Trapezius Headgear
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Unknown

Alias:
Trapezius Headgear

Quirk Name:
Trap Flex

Occupation/Role:
C-rank Villain

Personality:
Cruel and cowardly, mocking opponents while relying on hostage threats. Arrogant about his strength yet cowardly when facing genuine threats.

Appearance:
An enormous, muscular humanoid with pink skin and a fleshy extension from his shoulders that curves over his head like a hood, concealing his face except for round white eyes and a large mouth. He wears an armored half-vest with a chain over his right shoulder and plated cargo pants.

Backstory:
A minor criminal who terrorized towns taking hostages. Quickly defeated by All Might during a hostage situation. Imprisoned after capture, he was released when All For One escaped Tartarus and assaults began nationwide. Later conscripted into the Paranormal Liberation Front's Final War.

cardPool.title: Toya Setsuno
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Toya Setsuno

Alias: Eight Bullets member

Quirk Name: Larceny

Occupation/Role: Subordinate of Kai Chisaki and member of the Shie Hassaikai criminal organization

Personality: Fanatic and unstable from past trauma. Devoted to his organization and unafraid of death, viewing himself as "human garbage." Bitter yet tactically sharp in combat.

Appearance: Tall, lean young man with light almond-shaped eyes and dark circles. Chin-length bright golden-blond hair parted left. Wide mouth and upturned eyebrows giving a crazed expression. Wears a gray dress shirt, light orange tie, dark pants, and a beak-shaped plague mask.

Backstory: Betrayed by a lover and trapped in debt, he attempted suicide but was rescued by a hero, deepening his despair. Found by Kai Chisaki on the streets, he joined the Shie Hassaikai with nowhere else to turn.

cardPool.title: Toy-Toy
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Toy-Toy
Quirk Name: Unknown
Occupation/Role: Pro Hero
Personality: Spirited and vocal, quick to voice opinions during combat and criticize unsportsmanlike behavior. Demonstrates camaraderie with fellow heroes and maintains composure in high-stakes situations.
Appearance: Young woman with long, messy light brown hair and matching eyes. Wears a light pink fluffy sleeveless crop top with matching skirt, arm sleeves, and boots. Grey gloves and a distinctive dog-headed hat with buggy eyes and round black nose, red eyes with green irises.
Backstory: Established Pro Hero known for analytical capabilities in the field. Attended the U.A. Sports Festival as an observer and participated in the Jaku Hospital Raid and Final War against Tomura Shigaraki and All For One.

cardPool.title: Toxic Chainsaw
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Toxic Chainsaw
Quirk Name: Unknown
Occupation/Role: Villain
Personality: Cruel and ruthless, arrogant.
Appearance: Shoulder-length slimy hair, sharp angular face with prominent jawline and pointed chin. Heavily muscular physique with outie belly button. Shirtless, baggy pants with skull-shaped kneepads, army boots.
Backstory: Formidable villain who fought All Might five years before the series began. Landed blows on the Number One Hero and earned infamy. Speculation suggests he caused All Might's chest scar, though All Might denies this. Current whereabouts unknown.
Additional Information: Wields a chainsaw as primary weapon. Possesses a powerful Quirk of unknown nature.

cardPool.title: Tough Grab
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Tough Grab
Quirk Name: Unknown
Occupation/Role: Pro Hero, Sidekick to Ingenium
Personality: Professional and duty-bound, working efficiently in a support role.
Appearance: A burly man with a chiseled jaw and pupilless eyes. Short blonde flattop hair. Wears a black tank top over a pale brown sleeveless vest, jeans with silver-buckled belt, brown work boots, and oversized armored gloves extending to mid-forearm.
Backstory: An established pro hero serving as Ingenium's trusted sidekick, known as a reliable field operative.
Additional Information: His Quirk remains undocumented. His armor-heavy gloves suggest focus on grappling and physical restraint. Active in early hero society.

cardPool.title: Toshitsugu Kudo
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Toshitsugu Kudo

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Gearshift

Occupation/Role: Resistance leader and second user of One For All

Personality: Battle-hardened and serious with a stern sense of justice. Initially cynical and uncompromising in his mission to defeat All For One, though capable of empathy—evident when he chose to save Yoichi rather than kill him. Prideful and fearless, showing no hesitation even facing death.

Appearance: Short, spiky ginger-salmon hair with slanted downward-gazing red eyes. Wears a green combat jacket with a large black collar and imposing gauntlets used to channel his Quirk offensively. Lean but muscular build suggesting years of combat experience.

Backstory: A veteran soldier who rose to lead a resistance movement against All For One during the early era of Meta Abilities. Devoted his life to eliminating the tyrant.

cardPool.title: Toru Hagakure
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Toru Hagakure

Alias:
Stealth Hero: Invisible Girl

Quirk Name:
Invisibility

Occupation/Role:
Class 1-A Student, UA High School

Personality:
Bubbly, cheery, and easygoing with an upbeat attitude. Socially eager, enjoys shopping and gossip. Romantically curious and energetic yet reliable in battle. Observant despite her playful demeanor. Somewhat naive about invisibility's social implications.

Appearance:
A short girl with a completely invisible body, identifiable only through clothing and accessories. When her Quirk glitches, she reveals a slim, curvy figure with long wavy rainbow hair (chartreuse, lime, yellow, pink, turquoise, light blue), bushy colorful eyelashes, and large round eyes with teal-yellow irises. At UA, she wears the standard female uniform: gray jacket with teal stripes, white shirt, red tie, teal pleated skirt, and brown shoes.

cardPool.title: Tomoyasu Chikazoku
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Tomoyasu Chikazoku

Alias: Skeptic

Quirk Name: Puppet Master

Occupation/Role: Board member at Feel Good, Inc.; Leading member of the Meta Liberation Army; Lieutenant of the Paranormal Liberation Front

Personality: Steadfast ideologue devoted to Quirk liberation. Stern and condescending, easily irritated, yet capable of tactical camaraderie. Ruthless in combat with psychological warfare tactics. Becomes unhinged when facing failure, which he deeply fears.

Appearance: Tall and lanky with shoulder-length shiny black hair parted by a neat fringe. Wide eyes with small gray irises, notably long nose, and wide mouth with straight teeth. Wears a long-sleeved black turtleneck beneath a formal black jacket with dark pants.

Backstory: A brilliant technologist who built Feel Good, Inc.

cardPool.title: Tomoko Shiretoko
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Tomoko Shiretoko

Alias: Ragdoll

Quirk Name: Search

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero No. 32, Member of the Wild, Wild Pussycats

Personality: Hyperactive and energetic with wide-eyed enthusiasm and constant motion. Capable of genuine concern and highly motivated to help those in need.

Appearance: Young woman of medium height with long emerald green hair and large round yellow eyes. Wears a yellow Pussycats costume with pink whisker marks and a pink circle around her right eye.

Backstory: Powerful rescue and support hero known for locating disaster victims. Kidnapped during a villain invasion and lost her Quirk to a powerful enemy.

Additional Information: Formerly observed and monitored up to 100 people simultaneously, tracking locations and weak points with perfect recall. Now Quirkless but remains dedicated to hero work and her teammates.

cardPool.title: Tommy S. Gordon
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Tommy S. Gordon

Alias:
Tank Engine

Quirk Name:
Tank Engine

Occupation/Role:
Former Next-Level Villain

Personality:
Aggressive and easily provoked, Tommy becomes enraged by opposition and continues attacking despite ineffective results. He demonstrates loyalty to allies, suggesting underlying camaraderie among villain associates.

Appearance:
Tommy's head and upper torso are a steam-powered locomotive with a large, cartoonish face on the smokebox. His lower half is covered by a dark bodysuit with matching gloves and boots, accented by a decorative belt. His train-like construction gives him an imposing, mechanical silhouette.

Backstory:
Once part of the Next-Level Villains in the Naruhata district, Tommy was arrested by Eraser Head after being encountered while chasing civilians.

cardPool.title: Tomie Takami
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Tomie Takami
Alias: Mrs. Takami
Quirk Name: Unknown
Occupation/Role: Homemaker, Mother
Personality: Emotionally withdrawn and deeply broken, Tomie is haunted by her choices. She is devoted to her husband yet resentful of their union, and neglectful toward her son yet capable of regret. Cowardly and prone to avoidance, she struggles to confront difficult truths, though glimpses of maternal pride occasionally surface.
Appearance: A middle-aged woman of average height with thick, feathery copper-colored hair to her shoulders. Her sunken gray-blue eyes are distinctive, with two additional floating eyeballs circling her head. She typically wears a tight white dress with black horizontal stripes or a baggy gray-blue dress with long sleeves.

cardPool.title: Togaru Kamakiri
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Togaru Kamakiri

Alias: Jack Mantis

Quirk Name: Razor Sharp

Occupation/Role: UA High School Student, Class 1-B

Personality: Hotblooded and aggressive with passion for combat, yet cordial and supportive of classmates. Competitive in battle with respect for rivals like Bakugo. Excitable during fights but level-headed enough to encourage others after defeats.

Appearance: Tall and slender with pale yellow-green skin and bright fluffy green mohawk. Pointed dark green eyes, two hooked blades protruding from cheeks, mantis-like head shape with no visible nose. Wears dark green rugged cloak over zigzag-patterned shirt, black trousers, dark green three-toed boots, and eye mask.

Backstory: Dedicated hero student at UA High School in Class 1-B. Gym buddies with Tetsutetsu Tetsutetsu with a rivalry toward Bakugo's arrogance.

cardPool.title: Timothy Agpar
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Timothy Agpar

Alias: Commander Agpar

Quirk Name: Unknown

Occupation/Role: American Military Commander, U.S. Armed Forces

Personality: Calm and principled despite chaos. Maintains composure in crisis while respecting allies. Demonstrates strong moral conviction, opposing appeasement to villains and advocating decisive action. Deeply respects heroism and places faith in heroes as inspirational figures.

Appearance: A man with turquoise skin, elongated bald head, bushy whiskers, and large protruding eyes. He dresses formally in business suits and ties befitting his military position, maintaining professional demeanor.

Backstory: Timothy serves as a high-ranking commander in the U.S. military and trusted ally of hero Star and Stripe.

cardPool.title: Thousand Eyes
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Thousand Eyes
Quirk Name: Curse
Occupation/Role: Villain, League of Villains Associate
Personality: Confident in combat despite limited skill; willing to assault UA High School.
Appearance: A humanoid figure composed entirely of paper runes with a pale, inscribed surface. Large red eyes mark his face, chest, and limbs. He possesses five square fingers on each hand and featureless square feet.
Backstory: A minor villain recruited by Tomura Shigaraki for the USJ assault. His origins remain obscure, though his willingness to face UA's faculty suggests significant confidence or desperation.
Additional Information: E-rank villain; defeated by Eraser Head during the USJ invasion and arrested. His paper-composite body grants extreme lightness for rapid movement and evasion.

cardPool.title: The Realist
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: The Realist
Quirk Name: Truth Inducement
Occupation/Role: Villain
Personality: Bitter, disenchanted idealist consumed by rejection and resentment. Once passionate, he became manipulative and vengeful, spreading misery to others. He rationalizes cruelty as exposing truth.
Appearance: Bald man of average height wearing a black hoodie with a large white "R" on the chest. Black makeup runs in straight lines down his face from beneath both eyes.
Backstory: An ardent idol fan humiliated by rejection at a meet-and-greet, he accidentally revealed his idol's contempt for fans. This transformed him into a zealot determined to expose the idol industry's exploitation. He gathered scorned fans and systematically destroyed idols' reputations at public events.

cardPool.title: The Mother of Quirks
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: The Mother of Quirks
Quirk Name: Unknown
Occupation/Role: Activist, Mother
Personality: Affectionate and protective toward her son with remarkable willpower and idealism. Compassionate and vocal advocate for equality of Quirk users, refusing to accept the discrimination of her era.
Appearance: A woman with long, brown hair. Historical records of her are limited.
Backstory: Born during the early era when Meta Abilities were feared and persecuted, she gave birth to a son with a Quirk. Witnessing his marginalization, she became an outspoken advocate against discrimination, coining the term "Quirk" to reframe Meta Abilities as natural traits rather than monstrous powers. She was murdered by an Anti-Quirk faction, but the government later adopted her terminology, unknowingly immortalizing her as "The Mother of Quirks.

cardPool.title: The Fly
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: The Fly
Quirk Name: Fly
Occupation/Role: Pro Hero
Personality: Reserved and professional; demonstrates courage and teamwork in dangerous situations.
Appearance: Tall man with long, light blond hair and long bangs covering his left side. Wears a short-sleeved shirt, white shorts, dark boots, two large armbands, and a thin red headband. Two long wing-like appendages protrude from his arms.
Backstory: An established Pro Hero in Japan's hero society. The Fly fought in Hosu City during a major Nomu attack orchestrated by Tomura Shigaraki, battling alongside other heroes until Endeavor arrived.
Additional Information: The Fly's wing appendages grant aerial mobility and combat capabilities. He demonstrates competence in crisis situations and inter-hero cooperation.

cardPool.title: Tetsutetsu Tetsutetsu
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Tetsutetsu Tetsutetsu

Alias: Real Steel

Quirk Name: Steel

Occupation/Role: UA High School Student, Class 1-B

Personality: Hotheaded and outspoken, driven to prove Class 1-B's worth. Confident but stubborn, loyal and protective of classmates despite his abrasiveness.

Appearance: Young man with chin-length messy gray hair, black inward-tilted eyes with thick jagged tan eyelashes, sharp pointed teeth, and no eyebrows. Athletic muscular build. Hero costume: dark pale green jumpsuit cut below chest, black boots with metal plating, steel shoulder straps and arm bands connected by red chest piece, brown sash with pouches, gray back container, and thick metal jaw-guard stamped with "Fe".

Backstory: UA student training to become a Pro Hero. Resented Class 1-A's superiority and Bakugo's arrogance.

cardPool.title: Tesla
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Tesla
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Electric Charge
Occupation/Role: E-rank Villain, League of Villains Member
Personality: Cruel and strategic, Tesla exploits opponent weaknesses with calculated precision. He shows kinship with fellow electric Quirk users and reluctance to harm them, despite his villainy.
Appearance: Tesla is a tall, lean man with slanted grey eyes and beige skin. He wears a dark green sleeveless bodysuit with a white belt and black boots, and a skull-shaped mask.
Backstory: Recruited by Tomura Shigaraki for the U.S.J. assault, Tesla jammed communication signals to prevent faculty alerts, demonstrating his tactical value to the League of Villains.
Additional Information: Tesla's Quirk allows him to harvest and manipulate electrical currents for attacks and block electrical signals.

cardPool.title: Teruo Unagisawa
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Teruo Unagisawa

Alias:
None

Quirk Name:
Eel

Occupation/Role:
Civilian/Pop☆Step Fan

Personality:
Naïve and self-deprecating, Teruo lacks confidence and is obsessively devoted to the idol Pop☆Step, often making reckless decisions. Despite his meek demeanor, he maintains this obsession even under extreme circumstances.

Appearance:
A deceptively young-looking 19-year-old with a rounded face, large soft eyes, and wide nose. Nearly completely bald except for a tuft of black hair, he has a childlike appearance and small stature.

Backstory:
An ordinary civilian and devoted Pop☆Step fan, Teruo was kidnapped by the Villain Factory and experimented on, which transformed his Quirk. He later joins Hopper's Cafe, suggesting a path toward redemption.

cardPool.title: Teruo Hazukashi
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Teruo Hazukashi
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Shame
Occupation/Role: Disgruntled Office Worker
Personality: Resentful toward authority after three years of service, Teruo views himself as a "bootlicker" and seeks liberation through rebellion inspired by Destro's philosophy. Despite his anger, he is willing to debase himself publicly to achieve his goals.
Appearance: An average-sized man with short, spiky brown hair. During his uprising, he wore only a long coat and kneesocks, having stripped away his clothing to trigger his Quirk.
Backstory: A three-year employee who suffered unfair treatment and grew weary of subservience. After reading Destro's autobiography on liberation, Teruo became motivated to take violent action against his workplace and break free from what he perceived as oppressive employment.

cardPool.title: Tenya Ida
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Tenya Ida

Alias: Turbo Hero: Ingenium

Quirk Name: Engine

Occupation/Role: Class 1-A Student, Class Representative at UA High School

Personality: Serious and disciplined with strong responsibility. Earnest and formal, driven by duty to his family's heroic legacy. Takes his class representative role with utmost seriousness and maintains composure under pressure.

Appearance: Tall muscular young man with short dark blue hair neatly parted, small shaved patch at base. Sharp-featured with square blue eyes, pointed eyebrows and jawline; wears rectangular glasses. Most distinctively, thick engine-shaped calves with six silver exhaust pipes protruding from each leg. Wears standard UA male uniform: light gray blazer with dark turquoise trim, white shirt, dark blue-green pants, and red tie.

cardPool.title: Tensei Ida
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Tensei Ida

Alias: Turbo Hero: Ingenium

Quirk Name: Engine

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero

Personality: Laid-back and supportive, Tensei embodies a "cool" heroic ideal centered on rapid rescue and helping others. He values teamwork and quick response, often helping others develop their Quirks informally. Joyful and inspiring, he takes pride in supporting those around him.

Appearance: Tensei has square facial features with short, spiky dark blue-black hair and distinctive arrow-shaped eyebrows. Gold-colored engine exhausts protrude from both his elbows as a result of his Quirk. He maintains a stocky build and typically wears his hero costume with airbags for aerodynamic adjustments during combat.

Backstory: The older brother of UA student Tenya Ida, Tensei established himself as a formidable Pro Hero under the Ingenium name.

cardPool.title: Tenma Nakaoji
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Tenma Nakaoji

Alias: His Purple Highness

Quirk Name: Not explicitly stated

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero

Personality: Extravagant and flamboyant yet deeply committed to heroics. Recognizes talent in others and prioritizes victim safety over villain capture. Possesses strong self-sacrifice and protective instincts, willing to risk his life for civilians.

Appearance: Tall man with slim build and tanned skin. Purple eyes, lengthy dark brown hair tied in a long ponytail with long bangs covering his right side. Wears a short trimmed mustache and beard. Sports a two-piece suit featuring a frilled, open-chested jacket with epaulets and a belt adorned with P-emblazoned badges.

Backstory: An established Pro Hero who mentors UA High School students during their Work-Studies program. Trains interns, emphasizing heroic presentation and proper conduct.

cardPool.title: Tenko Tejina
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Tenko Tejina

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Conjure

Occupation/Role: Clerk at Got-It-All Mall

Personality: Earnest and overzealous, Tenko is helpful and determined, driven by gratitude and loyalty. He struggles with anxiety and self-doubt from past job rejections, yet remains bright and eager to assist others.

Appearance: A young man with straight, medium-length hair and a cheerful grin. He wears a traditional mall clerk uniform with matching hat. His expression is friendly and welcoming.

Backstory: Repeatedly rejected from jobs due to employers fearing his Quirk could enable theft, Tenko was finally hired by Got-It-All Mall. Grateful for the opportunity, he works with intense dedication to prove himself trustworthy and dispel stigma around his abilities.

cardPool.title: Tech Villain
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Tech Villain
Quirk Name: Unknown
Occupation/Role: Villain, Wolfram's minion and tactical operator
Personality: Serious and efficient, but cowardly when confronted by powerful opponents. Attempts to take command despite subordinate status, creating friction with authority.
Appearance: Tall man with pale skin and long white hair partially obscuring his left eye. Wears black combat suit with full-face mask featuring a pale X design. Sports technological headgear with goggle scope over his right eye.
Backstory: Recruited as one of Wolfram's elite minions for the I-Island infiltration. Served as primary tactical operator managing security systems and monitoring hero movements. Survived the helicopter crash caused by All Might, though rendered unconscious.
Additional Information: Operates in support and command roles rather than direct combat.

cardPool.title: Tatsuyuki Tokoname
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Tatsuyuki Tokoname

Alias: Slidin' Go

Quirk Name: Slide

Occupation/Role: Former Pro Hero, Member of the Meta Liberation Army

Personality: Affable and chipper on the surface, readily offering praise and assistance. Harbors darker loyalty to Destro's ideals of Quirk freedom. Strict about etiquette and hierarchy, willing to defer to superiors.

Appearance: Tall, well-built man with small black eyes, circular nose, and prominently square jaw with protruding lower jaw. Hero costume consists of purple skin-tight bodysuit with black arrow markings, knee-high boots with arrow cavities, black mask, elbow-length green gloves with golden scale patterns, and short green scarf-like cape with golden aiguillettes. Thick black belt with large buckle completes the ensemble.

cardPool.title: Tatami Nakagame
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Tatami Nakagame

Alias: Turtle Neck

Quirk Name: Shell

Occupation/Role: Third-year student at Ketsubutsu Academy High School

Personality: Cheerful and socially outgoing, Tatami is friendly with peers and unafraid to ask rivals for autographs. She is direct and critical, quick to call out others' shortcomings. She works well in group settings despite her fault-finding nature.

Appearance: A pale, curvaceous girl with muscular build and large pointed teeth in a constant smile. She has wide rectangular eyes with small blue irises and thick lashes. Her short ash-blonde hair features two longer spikes on either side and a chin-length bang on her right. She wears turquoise fish-shaped earrings.

cardPool.title: Taneo Tokuda
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Taneo Tokuda

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Not stated

Occupation/Role: Freelance journalist for Juzo News magazine

Personality: Relaxed and charming with manipulative tendencies, using good looks to gain information. Deceptively perceptive yet deeply ethical. Devoted All Might fan who respects heroism above exclusive scoops.

Appearance: Tall, slender man with black wavy hair and short sideburns. Angular face with high cheekbones, thin-framed circular glasses, and mismatched pupils—one white and one black. Wears beige blazer over untucked black dress shirt with dark slacks. Carries black camera around his neck.

Backstory: Witnessed All Might rescue his father and others from an industrial bombing at age seven. His accidental photograph of the rescue was published and inspired him to become a journalist, forging lifelong admiration for All Might's ideals.

cardPool.title: Tamashiro
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Tamashiro
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Binging Balls
Occupation/Role: Student, Masegaki Primary School
Personality: Arrogant and boisterous with a rebellious streak, yet genuinely aspires to be a hero. Pride in his Quirk inflates his ego, causing him to criticize others. Beneath his stand-offish exterior lies playfulness and willingness to help.
Appearance: Small elementary school boy with messy blonde hair, dark marks circling his brown eyes, and sharp, pointed teeth. His youthful features contrast with his cocky demeanor.
Backstory: A primary school student who participated in a hero license exam trial facing UA heroes Bakugo, Todoroki, Yoarashi, and Utsushimi. Despite initial arrogance, he demonstrated genuine heroic spirit and accepted Todoroki's praise for his potential in disaster rescue work.
Additional Information: Not a UA student; attends Masegaki Primary School.

cardPool.title: Tamao Oguro
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Tamao Oguro

Alias: Former Host of Queen Bee

Quirk Name: None (formerly shared Queen Bee while possessed)

Occupation/Role: Student (status unknown; hospitalized after possession)

Personality: Originally confrontational with a rebellious streak, frustrated by her father's control over her music aspirations. She craves his attention and approval despite their conflict.

Appearance: Young girl with green eyes and shoulder-length brown hair in a ponytail. Black eyepatch over her left eye from permanent injury during possession. Slender build with calm demeanor reflecting her recovery.

Backstory: Daughter of Iwao Oguro, Tamao was possessed by villain Kuin Hachisuka, losing control of her body and left eye. Her possession stemmed from defiance of her father's strict parenting, particularly his refusal to let her become a musician.

cardPool.title: Tamao
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Tamao

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Tree Frog

Occupation/Role: Student at Masegaki Primary School, Aspiring Hero

Personality: Energetic and fearless with a dismissive attitude toward authority. Driven by ambition but initially doubted her Quirk's combat potential. She sneaks away when rules inconvenience her and holds high standards for heroes. However, she changes her mind when shown compelling evidence and becomes inspired by those she admires.

Appearance: A young girl with short, light-colored hair standing up from the back of her head in a tadpole-like silhouette. Large, expressive eyes and full cheeks. She wears an oversized dark shirt with black shorts and simple running shoes.

Backstory: During a school trip to Takoba National Stadium, Tamao snuck away from her class to explore the arena.

cardPool.title: Tamaki Amajiki
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Tamaki Amajiki

Alias: Suneater, Omnivore Hero

Quirk Name: Manifest

Occupation/Role: UA High School Student, Class 3-A

Personality: Extremely shy and anxious with pessimistic outlook. Despite crippling social anxiety and lack of self-confidence, he harbors a brave heart and unwavering moral convictions. Looks to Mirio Togata as inspiration and pushes beyond his fears when duty calls. Quick to dismiss compliments and overlook his own achievements.

Appearance: Tall with pale skin and pointed, elf-like ears. Dark indigo hair is messy and sticks out behind his head, partially covering thin, tired eyes. Shoulders are hunched and posture withdrawn. Wears school uniform with loosened tie and large golden-buckled belt.

cardPool.title: Takuto
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Takuto
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Unknown
Occupation/Role: Student at Masegaki Primary School
Personality: Enthusiastic about heroes but emotionally sensitive; cries when frightened or yelled at. Displays childlike boldness without understanding consequences.
Appearance: Small elementary school boy with bird-like protruding face, sharp teeth, and side-mounted eyes. Light spiky hair frames his avian features.
Backstory: A primary school student selected as a test subject during hero licensing exams. Encounters Pro Hero Gang Orca and hero license candidates including volatile Katsuki Bakugo, whose explosive personality frightens him.
Additional Information: Enrolled at Masegaki Primary School, not UA High. Quirk type unspecified. Displays typical childhood behavior—boldness mixed with emotional fragility.

cardPool.title: Takeshita
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Takeshita

Alias: Unknown

Quirk Name: Unknown (Bamboo-related)

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero

Personality: Friendly and polite with professional demeanor. Greets civilians courteously and works well with other heroes.

Appearance: Spiky blond hair with stubble and faint moustache, average build. Wears green jacket with fur cuffs and shoulder pads over black top. Hero costume features two half-bamboo stalks over ears, brown fingerless gloves, and crossed bamboo stalks on back.

Backstory: Prominent UA High School hero course student who received agency offers before graduation. Became independent Pro Hero with recognition across Japan. Failed to recognize former classmate Danjuro Tobita years later, an event that traumatized Danjuro and set him on a villainous path.

cardPool.title: Takeshi Bushijima
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Takeshi Bushijima
Alias: The Masked Man
Quirk Name: Poison Gas
Occupation/Role: Civilian
Personality: Kind but isolated by his dangerous Quirk. He carries guilt about harming others and envies Heroes who use abilities freely. Cautious yet responsive to genuine kindness.
Appearance: Early-mid teens with short, scruffy hair and soft features. Wears a dark hoodie and mask concealing his face. Appears pale and sickly from suppressed gas; looks healthier after release.
Backstory: Takeshi suppressed his uncontrollable Poison Gas Quirk for years to avoid harming others, as dangerous Quirks are prohibited by law. Constant suppression severely damaged his health. When meeting UA students, his condition worsens and he releases gas in a populated area, marking him as a potential villain despite good intentions.
Additional Information: Not a UA student.

cardPool.title: Takami
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Takami

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Unnamed Feather Quirk

Occupation/Role: Fugitive Criminal/Villain

Personality: Cruel, paranoid, and volatile. A desperate thief prone to violent outbursts fueled by alcoholism and fear of capture. Shows no empathy toward family, viewing them as burdens. Easily angered and quick to blame others.

Appearance: Tall, middle-aged man with brown hair swept back and a gaunt, bearded face marked by gaps in his eyebrows and a missing front tooth. Golden-brown eyes hold a hardened gleam. Small brown feathers line both arms. Wears a dark jacket and pants, giving him an unkempt appearance befitting his years as a fugitive.

Backstory: A petty criminal from Fukuoka, Takami murdered someone over pocket change and became a fugitive hunted by Pro Heroes. He hid in a rundown house with his wife Tomie, relying on her Quirk to watch for authorities.

cardPool.title: Takaie Kanigumo
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Takaie Kanigumo

Alias:
None

Quirk Name:
Unnamed Arthropod Meta Ability

Occupation/Role:
Second-ranked Adviser, Paranormal Liberation Front Vanguard Action Support Regiment: Brown

Personality:
Fanatically dedicated to heteromorph liberation through violence. Contemptuous of peaceful resistance, but respects strong militant figures like Spinner. Acts as preacher and propagandist to radicalize fellow heteromorphs.

Appearance:
Arthropod-like heteromorphic man with two spider legs protruding from his back and two pairs of spider-like teeth. Six wavy green marks cross his forehead to the back of his head, with a scar on his left side. Wears a black long shirt with yellow fur collar and black mask.

Backstory:
Committed Meta Liberation Army member who rose to prominence in the Paranormal Liberation Front after the merger.

cardPool.title: Takahiro
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Takahiro
Alias: Eagle Hero
Quirk Name: Eagle
Occupation/Role: Pro Hero
Personality: Reserved and composed with strong mental fortitude.
Appearance: Bird-headed humanoid with brown spiked feathers covering his head. Feather-like ruffles extend from neck to chest. Massive wings protrude from his back. Bird-like clawed hands with long black talons. Wears a sleek hero costume with headphones, high-collared vest, baggy parachute pants, utility belt, and boots.
Backstory: An established Pro Hero attending the I-Expo reception who was apprehended by villain Wolfram but liberated when Melissa Shield restored I-Island's security.
Additional Information: Takahiro's Quirk grants avian characteristics including enhanced aerial mobility via wings. He operates at professional hero level with significant combat training and experience.

cardPool.title: Tajima
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Tajima

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Electrification

Occupation/Role: Villain/Spy (Infiltrator at U.A. High School)

Personality: Outwardly stern and composed undercover, but internally anxious. Driven by intense fear of All For One's judgment, leading to blind loyalty. Believes All For One's world domination is inevitable.

Appearance: Young man with short dark hair wearing a dark sweater over a plaid shirt. Clean-faced with an unremarkable appearance suited to blending in as a refugee.

Backstory: Sent by All For One to infiltrate U.A. High School posing as a refugee. Tasked with creating internal discord and pressuring Izuku Midoriya to leave. When Class 1-A departed anyway, he reported this to All For One. During the Final War, he sabotaged U.A.'s evacuation systems under Skeptic's command before being discovered and captured by Gunhead, Kendo, and Tetsutetsu.

cardPool.title: Taishiro Toyomitsu
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Taishiro Toyomitsu

Alias: BMI Hero: Fat Gum

Quirk Name: Fat Absorption

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero (currently No. 11), mentor to hero trainees

Personality: Constantly hungry and playful, yet earnest when duty calls. Friendly with allies but becomes determined when lives are threatened. Recognizes potential in others and cares deeply for those under his care. Shrewd operative who prioritizes saving lives.

Appearance: A massive round man with small nose and odd proportions. Beneath fat lies surprising muscularity visible when reserves burn. Wears black and yellow zippered hood with white striped sleeves, red-orange gloves with black knuckles, matching boots with grey metallic knee guards, and black mask.

Backstory: Ranked No. 58 eight years prior, Taishiro has climbed to No. 11 through dedication and hero work alongside police investigations.

cardPool.title: Swordkil
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Swordkil
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Unnamed Sword Quirk
Occupation/Role: Mercenary, Second-in-Command of Wolfram's crew
Personality: Arrogant and dedicated, Swordkil is a ruthless mercenary loyal only to Wolfram. He is quick to threaten and despises being looked down upon. His pride clouds his judgment, making him boastful and short-sighted in critical moments.
Appearance: A middle-aged man with lightly tanned skin and shoulder-length desaturated pink hair with shorter bangs. His thin honey-brown eyes are marked by curved, dark purplish-pink linear tattoos running beneath them and down his cheeks. He wears a sleek black combat suit with a full-face mask featuring a pale X-shaped design.
Backstory: Wolfram's trusted right hand, Swordkil earned authority over the mercenary crew through combat prowess.

cardPool.title: Susugu Mitarai
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Susugu Mitarai

Alias: Laundry Hero: Wash

Quirk Name: Wash

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero (No. 8 ranked)

Personality: Maintains a cheerful, child-friendly public demeanor while taking heroic duties seriously. Grows irritated when criticized and drops his theatrical manner to address urgent situations directly.

Appearance: Wears a washing machine-themed hero costume with top-loading design and exaggerated eyes protruding from the lid. His arms emerge from thick grey hoses ending in yellow rubber gloves. He wears waterproof pants with belt and large boots decorated with wave patterns and bubble-release circles on the soles.

Backstory: Ranked among Japan's elite Pro Heroes, Wash built his reputation using his Quirk for rescue operations and public safety. He mentors younger heroes and takes an active role in community protection.

Additional Information: Not a UA student.

cardPool.title: Stitched Giant
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Stitched Giant
Quirk Name: Mutant Bovini
Occupation/Role: Villain, League of Villains recruit
Personality: Confident in combat abilities, willing to challenge professional heroes despite low rank.
Appearance: A hulking, obese man wearing a custom pale green stitched suit. A dark grey gas mask with three bovine-like horns dominates his face; the respirator holes glow red when channeling his Quirk. Small black boots contrast with his imposing silhouette.
Backstory: Recruited by Tomura Shigaraki for the U.S.J. assault, Stitched Giant was tasked with overwhelming U.A. staff. His confidence proved misplaced when he faced Eraser Head, whose Erasure Quirk disabled his powers and left him vulnerable to swift defeat.
Additional Information: F-rank villain; arrested following the U.S.J. incident.

cardPool.title: Starservant
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Starservant
Quirk Name: Control Glass
Occupation/Role: Independent Villain, Street Preacher
Personality: Delusional and unstable, Starservant speaks in cryptic apocalyptic prophecies about impending darkness. He believes himself chosen to prevent the end of the world, though his methods involve attacking innocents. Cowardly in confrontation, preferring ambushes with devoted followers over direct fights.
Appearance: An elderly man with a gaunt, wrinkled face and blank, pupil-less eyes. He has a long, unkempt white beard and constant nosebleed. His attire blends monk and magician: a dark, disheveled cloak over light robes, wrist bracelets, and a tall cylindrical cap with trailing cloth.
Backstory: Once a harmless street preacher, Starservant grew increasingly radical and violent.

cardPool.title: Stanleyk
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Stanleyk

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Unknown

Occupation/Role: Bar owner and criminal informant in Otheon's Shanty Town

Personality: Shrewd and morally flexible, willing to facilitate criminal activities. Stern when business fails, yet capable of unexpected kindness—he offered Rody legitimate bartending work. Distrustful but maintains mutual trust with key contacts despite friction over debts.

Appearance: A stout, middle-aged man with a bald crown and curly dark brown hair on the sides, thick eyebrows, and visible arm and chest hair. Wrinkles line his weathered face. He wears a black shirt with rolled-up sleeves beneath a purple vest with dull yellow buttons.

Backstory: Stanleyk serves as a reliable middleman connecting Otheon's criminal underworld with street operatives like Rody Soul. His bar fronts illicit job distribution while maintaining plausible deniability.

cardPool.title: Spike
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Spike
Quirk Name: Unknown
Occupation/Role: League of Villains member, U.S.J. Incident participant
Personality: Aggressive and brutal, willing to kill without hesitation. Demonstrates pack mentality as part of Shigaraki's forces.
Appearance: A large, bulky man with gold-yellow skin covered in prominent spikes on both shoulders. Angular head with a sharp apex and black crater-like depression in his forehead. Glowing red eyes and visible fangs.
Backstory: One of seventy low-ranking villains recruited by Tomura Shigaraki for the U.S.J. assault. Deployed to the Squall Zone to eliminate Koji Koda but was quickly subdued by Fumikage Tokoyami's Dark Shadow and apprehended.
Additional Information: Operates as a disposable foot soldier. Limited combat effectiveness against trained opponents.

cardPool.title: Soramitsu Tabe
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Soramitsu Tabe

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Food

Occupation/Role: Eight Bullets member of the Shie Hassaikai yakuza organization

Personality: Unhinged and perpetually ravenous, driven by insatiable hunger. Despite his apparent insanity, he values his fellow Eight Bullets as true friends and is utterly devoted to Overhaul, though he won't consume those he considers friends.

Appearance: A gaunt, pale man with large boney hands and oversized fingers. His circular eyes have pinprick pupils framed by heavy dark bags. Black, disheveled hair crowns his head. Most distinctive is his unnaturally large mouth filled with straight teeth. He wears a ragged burlap sack mask secured by rope, with eye holes and a stitched smile, over a purple dress shirt and grey pants.

cardPool.title: Sorahiko Torino
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Sorahiko Torino

Alias: Gran Torino

Quirk Name: Jet

Occupation/Role: Retired Pro Hero, Former UA High School Teacher, Mentor

Personality: Deceptively senile, Gran Torino masks his sharp intellect behind forgetfulness and name-mixing as a teaching tactic. He is brutally demanding, using harsh criticism and physical discipline to forge stronger heroes. Despite his gruff exterior, he genuinely cares for his proteges and praises genuine progress.

Appearance: An extremely short, elderly man with a scrawny frame and heavy wrinkles. He has light complexion, brown eyes, grey spiky hair with forward bangs, and a trimmed beard. His hero costume is a monochrome full-body suit with a yellow cape, yellow gloves and boots, a "G" belt buckle, and a dark diamond-shaped domino mask.

cardPool.title: Soji
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Soji
Alias: Soji the Hammer
Quirk Name: Unnamed Lightning Quirk
Occupation/Role: Yakuza enforcer for the Abegawa Tenchu Kai
Personality: Aggressive and loyal; willing to engage threats directly alongside fellow executives.
Appearance: Muscular man with short black hair and thick beard. Bears the kanji 雷 ("thunder") tattooed on his left shoulder. Dresses in practical construction worker attire.
Backstory: Enforcer for the Abegawa Tenchu Kai yakuza. Fought alongside executives Tetsu, Haruhisa, and Rojiya Yonenaga in a coordinated defense during an assault on headquarters by vigilante Stendhal. Defeated and killed by Stendhal.
Additional Information: Wields a hammer as primary weapon, combining it with lightning generation for devastating close-range attacks. One of four executives defending the headquarters breach.

cardPool.title: Soga Kugisaki
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Soga Kugisaki
Alias: Spike
Quirk Name: Spike
Occupation/Role: Vigilante, ally to Naruhata Vigilantes, former criminal
Personality: Reformed from cruelty into a principled vigilante with strong loyalty to the marginalized. Defiant, ideological, and fiercely protective. Shows mental instability from being labeled a monster, yet demonstrates genuine care for allies.
Appearance: Tall, lean young man with wild spiky turquoise hair and inward-slanting yellow eyes. Sharp pointed front teeth and small eyebrows. Wears a sleeveless vest over a tank top, jeans, and leather shoes. Later adopts a brown trench coat and hat. Under Trigger influence, his physique expands and spikes emerge across his back and arms.
Backstory: Discriminated against for his Quirk appearance, Soga turned to violence as a coping mechanism.

cardPool.title: Snipe
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Snipe
Alias: Cowboy Hero
Quirk Name: Homing
Occupation/Role: Pro Hero and UA High School Teacher (Third Year Class Instructor)
Personality: Intelligent and levelheaded with strong moral convictions. Displays tactical expertise and rational judgment, though flustered by awkward social situations. Humble despite considerable skill. Professional and measured.
Appearance: A cowboy-themed figure with a tan gas mask, dark bluish dreadlocks, brown cowboy hat with metallic "S" plate, gray knee-high boots with spurs, and large red frayed cloak. Black tank top with white right-side armor, black armguards, tan gloves, dark baggy pants with light brown chaps, and brown belt with gun holster.
Backstory: An accomplished Pro Hero and marksmanship specialist, Snipe earned his reputation as Japan's second-greatest long-range combatant.

cardPool.title: Slugger
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Slugger
Quirk Name: Unknown
Occupation/Role: Pro Hero
Personality: Professional and determined but cautious in combat. Shows frustration when unable to act effectively, particularly against fluid-based villains. Respects heroic protocol.
Appearance: Tall, lanky man with vibrant orange hair and a white umpire-style mask. Wears a beige pinstriped baseball uniform with dark underclothing, shoulder pads, wide belt, and shin cuffs. White knee-high socks and oversized orange and green shoes. A massive gray, orange, and green gauntlet dominates his right arm.
Backstory: An established Pro Hero who responded to the Sludge Villain incident threatening Katsuki Bakugo. His abilities proved ineffective against the fluid villain. Witnessed All Might's intervention.
Additional Information: Slugger's Quirk is baseball-themed but undisclosed.

cardPool.title: Sludge Villain
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Unknown

Alias:
Sludge Villain, Hedoro Viran

Quirk Name:
Sludge Body

Occupation/Role:
D-rank Villain, Criminal

Personality:
Selfish, cruel, and sadistic with a cowardly streak. Bold enough to steal in daylight but quick to flee when outmatched. Shows no remorse for endangering lives and values self-preservation above all else.

Appearance:
A humanoid figure composed of dark green mud-like substance with sharp teeth and large, round eyes. An amorphous sludge entity capable of shifting his body's shape.

Backstory:
A low-ranking Tokyo villain who commits petty crimes without regard for civilians. First encountered by All Might during a bank robbery. Later freed during prison raids and conscripted into the villain alliance's assault on Jaku City.

Additional Information:
His Sludge Body allows him to possess individuals by absorbing them.

cardPool.title: Sirius
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Sirius
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Good Ear
Occupation/Role: Pro Hero Sidekick on the Oki Mariner
Personality: Friendly and approachable with keen interest in mentoring aspiring heroes. Highly respectful of her Captain despite frequent embarrassment at his antics. Selfless and determined, willing to sacrifice herself to prevent criminals from escaping.
Appearance: Young woman with smart blue eyes and shoulder-length light blue hair swept right. Wears sleeveless white sailor uniform with dark blue collar, buttoned skirt, red scarf, and blue gloves with striped wrist guards. Thigh-high boots with wavy patterns and flat hat with ribbon base. Large fin-shaped communication earpieces.
Backstory: Sirius serves as a dedicated sidekick under Captain Selkie aboard the Oki Mariner. Her Quirk makes her invaluable for long-distance team coordination.

cardPool.title: Simon Gollini
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Simon Gollini

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Monster Summon

Occupation/Role: Member of the Gollini Family mafia

Personality: Enthusiastic and playful with an obsession for games and RPGs. Simon enjoys tormenting enemies and prolonging confrontations for entertainment. Despite his chill demeanor, he becomes flustered when caught off-guard or his monsters are defeated unexpectedly.

Appearance: A lanky young man with artichoke green hair and yellow streaks, kept long on one side with a curled end. He sports a matching green goatee and wears multiple jeweled rings and piercings. His typical outfit is a mulberry pink tuxedo with blue floral jacket, navy tie, and tan oxfords with a rose pinned to his chest. He often wears elaborate wizard cosplay.

cardPool.title: Sidero
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Sidero

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Iron Balls

Occupation/Role: Villain, Humarise member

Personality: Devoted to Humarise's anti-Quirk agenda but pragmatic and self-preserving. Quick to betray his organization when facing capture, offering information to heroes to save himself. Suggests tactical improvements in combat.

Appearance: Tall man with slicked-back brown and black hair, squarish stubbled jaw, and wide mouth. Wears a pale gold horned mask covering his upper face, gray combat suit with short sleeves, and cream-colored boots. Black iron balls protrude from his knuckles on all fingers except his thumbs.

Backstory: Joined Humarise under coercion to avoid execution for possessing a Quirk. Operates as an enforcer for Flect Turn's terrorist organization. Values self-preservation over ideological commitment.

cardPool.title: Shuichi Iguchi
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Shuichi Iguchi
Alias: Spinner
Quirk Name: Scales
Occupation/Role: Villain, League of Villains member, Vanguard Action Squad operative
Personality: Devoted to Stain's ideals with unexpected moral restraint. Discriminated against his entire life, he questions the League's extreme actions and maintains surprising compassion despite his villainy. Holds himself to a code of honor inspired by his idol.
Appearance: A reptilian humanoid with bright green scales, pink eyes, and long desaturated pinkish-purple hair. Wears a white tattered cloth mask like Stain with goggles on his forehead, red scarf, arm bandages, sleeveless shirt, dark baggy pants with holsters, black boots, and metallic knee guards. Carries an enormous sword made of bound smaller blades and wears multiple belts with secondary blades and chest armor.

cardPool.title: Shoto Todoroki
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Shoto Todoroki

Alias:
A.C. Hero: Shoto

Quirk Name:
Half-Cold Half-Hot

Occupation/Role:
UA High School Student, Class 1-A

Personality:
Serious and reserved with a calm demeanor. Despite his stoic appearance, he possesses hidden depth and can form genuine connections, though he struggles with emotional expression due to his traumatic upbringing.

Appearance:
A moderately tall, well-muscled young man with short hair split between white on his right side and red on his left. Heterochromatic eyes—turquoise left and dark gray right. A large burn scar runs from his left hairline to mid-cheek. He wears the standard UA blazer with turquoise trimmings, dark blue-green pants, and red tie with pale cyan sneakers.

Backstory:
Born as the youngest son of Endeavor and Rei Todoroki, Shoto was engineered through Quirk marriage to surpass All Might.

cardPool.title: Shota Aizawa
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Shota Aizawa

Alias:
Erasure Hero: Eraser Head

Quirk Name:
Erasure

Occupation/Role:
Homeroom Teacher of Class 1-A, UA High School

Personality:
Stern and logic-driven with high expectations for his students. Appears cold and impatient, but is deeply committed to nurturing heroes. Once plagued by self-doubt, his friendships transformed him into a determined educator.

Appearance:
Tall, slender man with pale skin and shoulder-length, messy black hair. Dark, bloodshot eyes and perpetually stubbled appearance. His hero costume consists of a baggy black long-sleeved shirt and pants tucked into boots, utility belt, and signature wrap scarf with bright yellow goggles beneath. For formal occasions, he wears a black suit with blue tie, hair pulled back in a low bun.

cardPool.title: Shoko Haimawari
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Shoko Haimawari
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Unknown Slapping Quirk
Occupation/Role: Mother, Civilian
Personality: Strict and domineering with a sharp tongue, though genuinely caring beneath her harsh exterior. Protective of her son to the point of overcontrol, with deep skepticism toward Heroes due to past dangers. Capable of kindness when she lowers her guard.
Appearance: Tall, fair-skinned, slim middle-aged woman with dark eyes and neck-length olive-brown hair in a bouffant. She wears a navy-blue blazer over a dark brown high-neck top, matching body-con skirt, dark magenta stockings, and black flats, with a gold necklace.
Backstory: Raised her son Koichi in the countryside and became overprotective after his Quirk manifested in infancy. She repeatedly struck him with her Quirk whenever he floated, forcing him to suppress it entirely.

cardPool.title: Sho
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Sho

Alias:
None

Quirk Name:
Unknown

Occupation/Role:
Student at Masegaki Primary School

Personality:
Cheerful and popular with classmates. Easily flustered in unexpected situations. Displays typical rebellious behavior.

Appearance:
A small boy with large round eyes and dark hair. Wears a red collared shirt and light brown shorts.

Backstory:
A Masegaki Primary School student selected for a Provisional Hero License exam trial. Tested the social abilities of UA candidates Bakugo, Todoroki, Inasa, and Camie during their second licensing attempt.

Additional Information:
Not a UA student. Exceptionally popular in his class. Briefly acquainted with hero candidate Camie Utsushimi.

cardPool.title: Shishido
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Shishido

Alias: Lion Hero: Shishido

Quirk Name: Lion-based enhancement quirk granting increased strength and physical prowess

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero (No. 13 ranked), Hero Work-Study mentor

Personality: Fiery and hot-blooded, easily provoked and quick to anger, yet capable of surprising compassion. Prideful but willing to set aside rivalries for the greater good and work with former competitors.

Appearance: A powerfully muscular man of above-average height with long, spiky brown hair resembling a lion's mane. He wears a golden fur-covered hero costume with prominent spikes like fangs, featuring a black maw with exposed teeth. Beneath: fitted black top, brown hide at waist with bear-paw clasp, turquoise jeans, tan spiky-cuffed gloves, and dark boots with golden fur trim.

cardPool.title: Shinya Kamihara
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Shinya Kamihara

Alias: Ninja Hero: Edgeshot

Quirk Name: Foldabody

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero (No. 4 ranked), Leader of The Lurkers

Personality: Calm and focused with unwavering composure in crisis. Intelligent strategist who analyzes situations and discerns enemy tactics. Selfless and brave, willing to take personal risks to protect others. Maintains shinobi composure and consoles panicked allies.

Appearance: Slim, muscular man of shorter stature. Gray hair styled into three sharp points covering the right side of his face, with dark gray eyes and thin moustache. Wears a blue mask over his lower face tied with red yarn. Ninja-inspired costume features red shinobi shozoku under a blue robe, dark arm cloth with white forearm sleeves, dark gloves, and red scarf with white patch across his chest.

cardPool.title: Shinjiro Hohoemi
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Shinjiro Hohoemi

Alias:
Mr. Smiley

Quirk Name:
Smile

Occupation/Role:
Former Villain, Aspiring Artist

Personality:
Passionate artist disillusioned by rejection who turned to vandalism for recognition. Not inherently malicious but initially resistant to authority. Shows bravery and empathy when facing greater threats, capable of genuine remorse and self-reflection.

Appearance:
Lean muscular man with long blonde hair in a ponytail, light green tips. Large blue eyes and wide prominent grin. Disproportionate forearms and large rounded hands. Wears pink long-sleeved v-neck shirt with white frills, burgundy pants with gray cutaway and yellow buttons, yellow-buckled belt, black eye mask, and red cowboy hat with two paintbrushes bearing blue and magenta bristles.

Backstory:
Failed to gain art school acceptance despite his talent, pursuing art through vandalism as rebellion.

cardPool.title: Shinji Nishiya
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Shinji Nishiya
Alias: Kamui Woods
Quirk Name: Arbor
Occupation/Role: Pro Hero (No. 7 ranked), Member of The Lurkers
Personality: Serious during hero work but emotionally sensitive and easily discouraged when others claim credit for his accomplishments. Deeply moved by recognition from respected heroes.
Appearance: Muscular young man of below-average height with distinctive puffy red leaf-like hair. Wears a dark blue bodysuit, face-concealing helmet, wooden belt, knee pads, and shoes. Two wooden rings with branches hang from his shoulders. A small bundle of roses decorates his belt.
Backstory: Talented hero who rose to No. 7 rank through exceptional skill and dedication. Gained respect from elite heroes like Edgeshot, who invited him to join The Lurkers, an honor that moved him deeply.

cardPool.title: Shin Nemoto
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Shin Nemoto

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Confession

Occupation/Role: Eight Bullets member of the Shie Hassaikai criminal organization

Personality: Cynical and emotionally detached, viewing feelings as obstacles. Exceptionally loyal to Overhaul, whom he considers trustworthy. Holds himself in high esteem and specializes in psychological manipulation and guerrilla tactics rather than direct combat.

Appearance: A slim man with short, light-colored hair with bangs. He wears a black cape over baggy 3/4-length pants, pale sneakers, and a black bowler hat. Like all Eight Bullets, he sports a black plague mask.

Backstory: A former con artist turned criminal operative, Shin joined the Shie Hassaikai and earned his position among the Eight Bullets through cunning intellect and devotion to Overhaul. His Quirk made genuine human connection impossible until meeting his boss.

cardPool.title: Shikkui Makabe
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Shikkui Makabe

Alias: Mr. Smith

Quirk Name: Hardening

Occupation/Role: Third-year student at Ketsubutsu Academy High School, aspiring Pro Hero

Personality: Smooth and cool heartthrob. Reserved but determined to become a hero. Strategic thinker who values collective strength and trusts his classmates.

Appearance: Blue, rough rock-like skin resembling a carapace. No visible hair, nose, or ears; wide jagged mouth with upward-protruding spikes. Blue eyes with grooved patterns. Neck of stacked darker blue rings. Wears black puffed parka with high collar, white shirt, gold chain necklace, baggy cyan pants, and dark blue ski boots with furred shafts.

Backstory: Third-year student at Ketsubutsu Academy trained by Ms. Joke. Participated in Provisional Hero License Exam against Class 1-A using strategic ambushes.

cardPool.title: Shihai Kuroiro
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Shihai Kuroiro

Alias: Scheming Hero: Vantablack

Quirk Name: Black

Occupation/Role: UA High School Class 1-B Student

Personality: A sly schemer who enjoys catching opponents off guard. He admires dark concepts and becomes nervous around girls, often misinterpreting friendliness as romance. Despite his cunning, he shows genuine respect for those he admires.

Appearance: A tall young man with fluffy white hair and long, thin black eyes that appear unsure or irritated. His pitch-black skin is his most striking feature, tied to his Quirk. He wears a high-collared black jumpsuit with light shoes, large silver wristbands with rectangular indentations, and matching tongue designs.

Backstory: A UA student training to become a Pro Hero, Shihai has mastered stealth and tactical cunning, making him Class 1-B's stealthiest member. He specializes in espionage and ambush tactics.

cardPool.title: Setsuna Tokage
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Setsuna Tokage

Alias: Lizardy

Quirk Name: Lizard Tail Splitter

Occupation/Role: UA High School Student, Class 1-B

Personality: Chatty, confident, and provocative with sharp wit. Thoughtful and strategic in combat with a severe demeanor when fighting. Reliable and trustworthy, commanding respect from teammates. Naturally confident and strong-willed, though she can underestimate opponents.

Appearance: Average height with striking large upturned dusky green eyes and notably long pointed teeth. Dark moss green hair reaches below her shoulders with a short center forelock. Her hero costume features a purple scaly mask, matching bodysuit, black knee-high boots, black fingerless gloves with purple knuckle guards, pale orange wrist-guards, and a black belt with yellow jewel centerpiece.

cardPool.title: Shie Hassaikai Boss
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown (Conjectural)
Alias: Shie Hassaikai Boss
Quirk Name: Unknown
Occupation/Role: Former Yakuza Leader, now imprisoned
Personality: A man of strong moral principles who upholds traditional yakuza code and honor over profit. Fatherly despite his criminal past, he attempted to guide his wards toward righteousness. Dignified and resolute, accepting decline with grace rather than compromising his values.
Appearance: An elderly man with a deeply lined face and graying hair. Formerly wore formal black kuro montsuki kimono with dark gray hakama and white tabi. Post-Final War, he is severely weakened and confined to a wheelchair.
Backstory: Once led the Shie Hassaikai yakuza organization during Japan's criminal underworld era. He refused to resort to cruelty as the yakuza declined. He adopted orphaned Kai Chisaki and took in his granddaughter Eri when abandoned.

cardPool.title: Sharp Blade
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Sharp Blade
Quirk Name: Unknown
Occupation/Role: Low-ranking villain, League of Villains recruit
Personality: Irritable and impatient, easily frustrated. Lacks composure and tactical experience.
Appearance: Lean build with backward-swept brown hair. Wears a black bodysuit with black half-mask, pointed dark shades, gray elbow-length gloves, utility belt, and shoulder braces. Carries twin knives.
Backstory: Recruited by Tomura Shigaraki for the U.S.J. assault. Deployed to the Conflagration Zone where he engaged Class 1-A students with minimal skill.
