Additional Information: Defeated and captured by Mashirao Ojiro during the U.S.J. incident. His Quirk remains unidentified, suggesting he relied on knives and physical training rather than superhuman abilities.

cardPool.title: Sensoji
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Sensoji
Alias: Mister Blaster
Quirk Name: Blast
Occupation/Role: UA High School Student, Class 2-B
Personality: Arrogant and self-centered, viewing himself as superior to weaker Quirk users. A poor loser who resents those who defeat him, especially Shota Aizawa. Hypocritical, claiming others' ideas as his own while accusing them of copying him. Can acknowledge genuine heroic accomplishments from rivals.
Appearance: A large, muscular man with a prominent square jaw, sharp eyes, and no eyebrows. Short orange hair with long strands at the nape and a pointed pompadour with sideburns. Wears a dark sleeveless tank top with contrasting chest panel, dark trousers with knee pads, and fingerless gloves with forearm guards. Circular ring-like elements on his glove palms where his Quirk activates, mirrored as decorative rings on shoulders, belt, and knee pads.

cardPool.title: Serpenters
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Ena and Dio (Twin Brothers)
Alias: The Serpenters
Quirk Name: Sword Kill
Occupation/Role: Humarise Terrorist Operatives
Personality: Identical twins with erratic, excitable temperaments devoted to Flect Turn's cause. Both are maniacal and gleeful in combat. They joined Humarise seeking survival rather than from ideological conviction, making them opportunistic cowards beneath their violent enthusiasm.
Appearance: Twin men of average build with fair skin, bowl-cut indigo hair, and yellow reptilian eyes with dark purple markings. They possess large fangs and wear matching red and white tunics with gray snake-skin boots.
Backstory: Twin brothers who gained Quirks but allied with anti-Quirk terrorist organization Humarise. They agreed to serve Flect Turn in exchange for exemption from the planned Quirk genocide, operating as devoted operatives without question.

cardPool.title: Sen Kaibara
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Sen Kaibara
Alias: Spiral
Quirk Name: Gyrate
Occupation/Role: UA High School Student, Class 1-B
Personality: Levelheaded and calm with a plain demeanor. Open with opinions and unafraid to disagree, showing maturity beyond his peers. Despite his serious nature, he warms up during combat and can be enthusiastic. Rather belligerent, he often gets drawn into his friends' antics but remains composed.
Appearance: Average height with dark brown shaggy hair and distinctive black eyes with white pupils. Modest athletic build with a slight tan. Hero costume consists of a white windbreaker with four spiral tube grommets, dark blue undershirt with drill-patterned rings, white sweatpants, red holsters at the midsection, brown shoes, and spiral-patterned finger gloves.
Backstory: Sen trains at UA High School to become a Pro Hero in his first year.

cardPool.title: Selkie
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Selkie
Quirk Name: Spotted Seal
Occupation/Role: Pro Hero and Captain of the Oki Mariner
Personality: Confident, kind, and professional with a stern side when needed. Prioritizes hero work and crew protection. Deliberately appears cute despite intimidating appearance, annoying his sidekicks.
Appearance: Muscular humanoid spotted seal with gray beard, red eye markings, and whiskers. Wears navy blue wetsuit with silver accents, yellow goggles, and stylized "S" on left shoulder. Chest exposed. Features retractable flippers.
Backstory: Seasoned Pro Hero commanding the Oki Mariner rescue vessel. Earned position through dedication to maritime rescue and crew leadership. Unique physiology makes him invaluable for ocean-based heroics.
Additional Information: Proficient in Morse code.

cardPool.title: Seiji Shishikura
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Seiji Shishikura

Alias:
Shishikross

Quirk Name:
Meatball

Occupation/Role:
Second-year student at Shiketsu High School

Personality:
Proud and dignified, valuing obligation and decorum. Eloquent and formal, critical of others. Insecure about his small eyes despite denial. Dislikes U.A. Class 1-A, particularly Bakugo. Shows hidden compassion beneath stern demeanor but struggles with self-reflection and imposing his values on others.

Appearance:
Young man of average height with thin, slanted eyes and tiny pupils. Straight purple fringe covering his left eye, fluffy tufts at back of head. Wears Shiketsu uniform with white collared shirt and signature hat. Hero costume features black overcoat with red trimmings, red-rimmed shoulder flaps, elbow-length sleeves with large red cuffs, black apron with red strings, fingerless gloves, and black boots.

cardPool.title: Satsuki Asui
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Satsuki Asui

Alias:
None

Quirk Name:
Unknown

Occupation/Role:
Student (younger sibling, not a UA student)

Personality:
Inquisitive and caring toward her family. She idolizes her older sister Tsuyu despite often being left in her care.

Appearance:
A young girl with a tadpole-like appearance featuring large round eyes, small eyebrows, light-tanned skin, and dark green hair in low pigtails. Her features reflect her family's froggy theme.

Backstory:
The youngest Asui daughter, raised primarily by her older sister Tsuyu while their parents worked. She developed a close bond with Tsuyu through their shared household responsibilities.

Additional Information:
Satsuki has a younger brother named Samidare. She idolizes Tsuyu, a UA High School student. The family relocated to an evacuation center during the Paranormal Liberation War.

cardPool.title: Sasori Nimaru
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Sasori Nimaru
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Unknown
Occupation/Role: Fashion Designer
Personality: Dedicated and detail-oriented, Sasori commands respect through innovative work and high standards. She approaches costume design with artistic vision.
Appearance: A young woman with shoulder-length red hair tied back with a purple rope. She wears a white top and skirt adorned with black dots, red spider-web fishnet stockings, and a black collar accent.
Backstory: Sasori rose to prominence as a fashion designer and earned recognition beyond the commercial world. Her talent led to commissions from Pro Heroes, including costumes for UA High School students like Katsuki Bakugo and Ochaco Uraraka. Her designs are industry-recognized.
Additional Information: Not a UA student. Her hero costume designs have become industry standard.

cardPool.title: Sansa Tamagawa
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Sansa Tamagawa

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Unknown

Occupation/Role: Police Force Member

Personality: Professional and duty-focused, maintaining composure in formal settings. Little is known of his personal nature beyond his dedication to law enforcement.

Appearance: A lean man with feline features—a ginger tabby cat's head and large yellow eyes. He wears a pale blue button-up shirt beneath a police vest, accessorized with a golden bell at his neck.

Backstory: Sansa serves as a dedicated member of the Police Force, working within Japan's law enforcement system. His role supports hero society through official channels.

Additional Information: Not a UA High School student. His professional demeanor suggests experience and rank within the Police Force hierarchy. The golden bell at his neck is a distinctive personal or official marker.

cardPool.title: Sankyaku Kamehara
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Sankyaku Kamehara

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Third Leg

Occupation/Role: Professional Photographer

Personality: Obsessive perfectionist devoted to capturing ideal moments. Self-conscious and assumes others resent his presence. Despite passivity, capable of growth when inspired by genuine sincerity.

Appearance: Young man with a distinctive third leg protruding from his body. Short, light-colored hair frames squinting eyes suggesting focused concentration. Wears a dark vest jacket over matching dark pants. Always carries his professional camera.

Backstory: Skilled photographer hired by Midnight to document Class 1-A and acclimate them to public attention. Successfully captured all students except Izuku Midoriya, whose image became an obsessive pursuit beyond the initial assignment.

Additional Information: Not a UA student.

cardPool.title: Sanctum
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Sanctum
Alias: None known
Quirk Name: Unknown
Occupation/Role: Top-ranked adviser in the Vanguard Action Tactics Regiment: Black of the Paranormal Liberation Front; former Meta Liberation Army member
Personality: Ideologically devoted and unwavering, Sanctum is brave and steadfast. He serves as a mentor figure, lecturing younger members on organizational mission and values. He defends his cause directly against opposition.
Appearance: Fair-skinned with dark-black eye irises and long dark-black hair marked by distinctive white stripes on both sides. A thin strand of black hair runs down his middle. He sports a long thick dark-black mustache and wears thin-framed golden eyeglasses. His attire consists of a dark-blue overcoat with two golden rectangular bars and three button-like epaulettes on the collar.
Backstory: Sanctum is among the oldest Meta Liberation Army members.

cardPool.title: Samuel Abraham
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Samuel Abraham
Alias: Sam
Quirk Name: Unknown
Occupation/Role: Scientist and assistant to David Shield at I-Island
Personality: Appears goodhearted but becomes resentful when unrecognized; willing to betray colleagues for money, yet capable of genuine surprise at selfless sacrifice.
Appearance: An older, heavyset man with short blonde hair and closed blue eyes; wears a dark suit, tie, suspenders, and dress shoes.
Backstory: Sam co-developed the Quirk Amplification Device with David Shield, a headset that enhances Quirks without side effects. When governments pressured I-Island to confiscate the research, Sam grew bitter about lacking proper compensation. During the I-Expo incident, he hired villains to recover the device and planned to sell it to criminal Wolfram for payment. David shielded him from a bullet, nearly costing his life.

cardPool.title: Samidare Asui
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Samidare Asui

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Frog

Occupation/Role: Student (youngest Asui sibling)

Personality: Laid-back and casual with a carefree demeanor. Relies on his older sister Tsuyu for care and support. Shows familial affection and pride in her accomplishments.

Appearance: A young boy with frog-like features inherited from his family's quirk. Black hair obscures his right eye, dark green half-closed eyes, and distinctive blush marks on his cheeks. His lethargic, unbothered presentation suggests a sleepy youth.

Backstory: The youngest son of the Asui family, primarily raised by his older sister Tsuyu while their parents traveled for work. After the Paranormal Liberation War, his family relocated to an evacuation center while Tsuyu joined the heroes in battle.

Additional Information: Second-youngest of Tsuyu's siblings, with an older sister Satsuki.

cardPool.title: Sajin Higawara
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Sajin Higawara
Alias: Sand Hero: Snatch
Quirk Name: Sandstorm
Occupation/Role: Pro Hero and Police Force Bodyguard
Personality: Compassionate and justice-driven, caring deeply about crime victims. Courageous in combat but principled. Easily angered by remorseless villains.
Appearance: Muscular man with turquoise eyes and light ash-blond hair in a long ponytail extending from his dark blue mask. Wears a green and silver combat vest with connected tubes running to his back. Distinguished by a long mustache.
Backstory: A dedicated Pro Hero known for his heroic principles and empathy. Stationed as a bodyguard during the transport of defeated Overhaul, Snatch confronted the League of Villains during their convoy ambush, fighting to protect officers and prisoners.

cardPool.title: Sameko
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Sameko
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Unnamed Shark Quirk
Occupation/Role: Hero School Student (Hiroshima)
Personality: Loyal and cautious friend who values her companions' safety but cannot always prevent their recklessness. Appreciates kindness from strangers.
Appearance: Young woman with shark characteristics including sharp teeth, a dorsal fin on her head, long dark hair, large rounded eyes, and an almost nonexistent nose.
Backstory: Befriended Rumi Usagiyama and Kameko at Hiroshima hero school. During a school trip to Osaka, the trio became lost near Tsutenkaku Tower. A young Fat Gum gave them directions before Rumi sensed a nearby battle and leaped away.
Additional Information: Calls Rumi Usagiyama "Ruko." Her shark Quirk grants shark-like attributes, though her full abilities remain unclear. Not a UA High School student.

cardPool.title: Salaam
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Salaam
Alias: The Papyrus Hero
Quirk Name: Papyrus
Occupation/Role: Top Egyptian Pro Hero
Personality: Composed and motivating, Salaam projects a calming presence that puts citizens at ease. He is dependable and willing to aid allies internationally, though frustrated by bureaucratic delays.
Appearance: A brown-skinned man with a two-dimensional silhouette reminiscent of ancient Egyptian hieroglyphics. He wears a pharaoh-inspired hero costume with pleated linen top, wraparound shendyt skirt, striped nemes headcloth, ornamental jewelry, and flowing cape.
Backstory: Salaam earned his reputation as Egypt's premier hero through exceptional skill and an almost supernatural ability to inspire confidence. No one has ever seen his back. He coordinated with international heroes during the Humarise crisis and assisted Japan after the Paranormal Liberation War.

cardPool.title: Saito
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Saito

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Unknown

Occupation/Role: Middle School Student

Personality: Popular and well-liked, though his true character remains largely undocumented and unremarkable.

Appearance: A striking doppelgänger for Izuku Midoriya with the same wide eyes and fluffy dark hair, but with black hair and eyes instead of green, lacking freckles. Wore his school uniform of light dress shirt, tie, and dark blue blazer.

Backstory: An ordinary middle school student whose bloodied appearance after an injury triggered Himiko Toga's Quirk influence. She attacked him with a box cutter and drank his blood, forcing her to flee and become a fugitive.

Additional Information: Saito was Himiko Toga's classmate at an unnamed middle school. He was socially well-regarded but remains peripheral, significant only for his role in Toga's origin story.

cardPool.title: Saiko Intelli
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Saiko Intelli

Alias:
None

Quirk Name:
IQ

Occupation/Role:
Second Year Student at Seiai Academy

Personality:
Arrogant and confident in her intellectual superiority, Saiko assumes leadership and formulates complex strategies with precision. She struggles to understand emotional reasoning and empathy, viewing decisions through pure logic. She shows humility when defeated and recognizes the value of bonds beyond self-interest.

Appearance:
A pale girl of average height with thin, cat-like eyes featuring bluish-lilac irises. Her straight hair cascades to her waist in a hime cut, colored in pale blue-lavender-gray tones. She wears the Seiai Academy uniform: white double-breasted blazer with gold trim, dark blue long-sleeved shirt, matching dress pants, white gloves and boots, and a white beret with black trim.

cardPool.title: Saguri-chan
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Saguri

Alias: Explorer Hero: Saguri-chan

Quirk Name: Not specified

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero running the Saguri Agency

Personality: Curious and obsessive about insects with deep entomological knowledge, easily distracted by perceived specimens, somewhat absent-minded and prone to misidentification despite expertise. Adventurous and willing to travel uncharted territories in pursuit of villainy and discovery.

Appearance: Young woman with long blonde hair in a ponytail and face-framing bangs, wide pinkish-red eyes. Wears a light skintight bodysuit ending at the thighs, black belt with boots, black shoulder pads connected by chest belt, side satchels, and explorer goggles.

Backstory: An unconventional Pro Hero known for roaming uncharted lands pursuing villains wherever curiosity leads.

cardPool.title: Ryuko Tatsuma
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Ryuko Tatsuma

Alias: Dragoon Hero: Ryukyu

Quirk Name: Dragon

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero (No. 10), Mentor

Personality: Humble and composed, Ryuko praises deserving talent without seeking gratitude. She maintains calm in combat and delegates to capable individuals. Despite her rank, she carries self-doubt from failing to save someone. She displays protective, nurturing care toward trainees.

Appearance: A woman with chin-length blonde hair swept back with a headband, long fringe covering her right eye. Thin yellow eyes with reptilian slit pupils and sharp teeth. She wears a dark red qipao with yellow collar trim, pale green scale-textured shoulder trim, and side-slit skirt with claw-mark designs. Black knee-high boots, long white disconnected sleeves, and a green scale-textured headband with four silver claws.

cardPool.title: Ryuichi Gojiyama
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Ryuichi Gojiyama

Alias: The Kaiju

Quirk Name: Kaiju

Occupation/Role: Instant Villain

Personality: Wild and bestial under Trigger influence. Loses rational thought and becomes purely instinct-driven, acting as a destructive force.

Appearance: When transformed, a 15-meter tall bipedal theropod with grey scales, jagged spikes down his back, horns on his snout, digitigrade legs with clawed feet, and a large rounded mouth resembling a Tyrannosaurus rex. His tongue is blackened from Trigger use. His human form remains unseen.

Backstory: Ryuichi appeared suddenly in Naruhata city. Administered Trigger by Kuin Hachisuka, he transformed into a rampaging kaiju that destroyed buildings and damaged the Marukane Department Store before being defeated by Pro Hero Captain Celebrity.

Additional Information: Not a UA student.

cardPool.title: Ryu Yoshida
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Ryu Yoshida
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Unknown
Occupation/Role: Doctor at Central Hospital
Personality: Professional, brave, and well-meaning; stands against dangerous threats to protect patients; reputation for saving those considered beyond saving.
Appearance: Dinosaur-like features with teal skin, four dark blue plates atop his head, and white beak. Large interconnected eyes with small green pupils. Wears white doctor's coat over dark blue shirt. Tall and peculiar frame, instantly recognizable.
Backstory: Head doctor at Central Hospital treating severe injuries from major conflicts. Witnessed Japan's darkest hours from the Paranormal Liberation War through societal collapse, yet remained steadfast in his duty to heal. Stood with hospital staff against mutant forces to protect vulnerable patients.
Additional Information: Established medical professional, not a UA student.

cardPool.title: Ryo Inui
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Ryo Inui

Alias: Hound Dog

Quirk Name: Dog

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero and Head of Student Discipline at U.A. High School

Personality: Gruff and volatile, prone to aggressive outbursts manifesting as growls and barks. Despite his rough demeanor, he possesses justice and fairness, praising students when warranted and holding them accountable for violations.

Appearance: Dog-like features including a scruffy blond mane sticking straight out and a pointed snout. He wears a black muzzle as part of his costume. His frame is muscular and bestial due to his Quirk.

Backstory: A seasoned Pro Hero known as the Hunting Dog Hero, Ryo was recruited to head student discipline at U.A., where he oversees conduct and safety. His role places him at odds with rule-breaking students, though he seeks to guide them toward responsible heroism.

cardPool.title: Roro Soul
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Roro Soul

Alias:
None

Quirk Name:
Unknown

Occupation/Role:
Student (formerly); Resident of Otheon Shantytown

Personality:
Kind-hearted and cheerful despite hardship, with unwavering loyalty to his older brother Rody. He demonstrates resilience and adaptability, accepting his circumstances while supporting his younger sister emotionally.

Appearance:
A small young boy with flat brown hair and gray eyes. He wears a patched cadet blue and white shirt with visible wear and makeshift repairs, reflecting his impoverished life in the shantytown.

Backstory:
Born in Otheon to engineer Eddie Soul and a deceased mother, Roro's childhood was happy until his father abandoned the family to join the anti-Quirk sect Humarise. Expelled from school and ostracized, the Soul siblings lost their home and relocated to a caravan in the shantytown.

cardPool.title: Ronaudo Keage
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Ronaudo Keage

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Not specified

Occupation/Role: UA High School Student, Department of Management

Personality: Enterprising and analytical, focused on hero marketing and public perception. Demonstrates business acumen and pragmatic thinking about hero society's image management.

Appearance: Young man of average height with short dark purple hair. Small round eyes and distinctive counter-clockwise swirl-like blush marks on his cheeks. Typically wears his UA gym uniform.

Backstory: A Department of Management student at UA High School specializing in heroic commerce. Analyzes hero marketability during events like the UA Sports Festival, studying heroes like Izuku. Focuses on media production and public relations for heroes.

Additional Information: Associates with classmates Futo and Komako.

cardPool.title: Romero Fujimi
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Romero Fujimi

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Zombie Virus

Occupation/Role: Isami Academy High School Student

Personality: Arrogant and condescending, looking down on others with little regard for consequences. Gruff and reckless with his abilities, though classmates claim he isn't truly malicious. He idolizes All Might despite his abrasive demeanor.

Appearance: Slouched and unkempt with desaturated bluish-gray spiked hair, no eyebrows, and wide bug-like eyes. Wears the Isami High uniform: white shirt, red tie, dark blazer, gray pants, and brown loafers. His hero costume features a black double-breasted coat with high collar, gray cuffs, waist wires, pinstriped pants, and a translucent purple mouth mask.

Backstory: A student of Isami Academy, Romero developed rivalry with Katsuki Bakugo, viewing UA as beneath him.

cardPool.title: Rojiya Yonenaga
cardPool.value:

Rojiya Yonenaga

None

Strength Enhancement

Occupation/Role:
Executive Member of Abegawa Tenchu Kai (Yakuza Organization)

Personality:
Serious and composed man with unflinching demeanor. Shows indifference to external pressures and philosophical detachment. Never displays signs of drunkenness. Collects and weaponizes manhole covers in combat.

Appearance:
Tall man with strong physical bearing. Large scar marks his left eyebrow. Wears a white suit with blue blouse and star-logo overcoat. Dark hair, intimidating presence befitting yakuza status.

Backstory:
Seasoned executive within the Abegawa Tenchu Kai earning respect through composure and capability. Uses unconventional combat approach by throwing manhole covers. Maintains philosophical acceptance of criminal underworld realities. Deceased during vigilante attack on Tenchu Kai headquarters.

cardPool.title: Rikiya Yotsubashi
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Rikiya Yotsubashi

Alias: Re-Destro

Quirk Name: Stress

Occupation/Role: President and CEO of Detnerat Company; Grand Commander of the Meta Liberation Army

Personality: Outwardly affable but ruthlessly devoted to Destro's vision of Quirk liberation. Kills without hesitation when disrespected, showing remorse afterward. Intelligent manipulator who exploits society's flaws to recruit followers while viewing himself as a savior.

Appearance: Tall, odd-looking middle-aged man with a prominent pointed nose and protruding chin. Short orange-brownish hair swept back with a widow's peak, small dark eyes, no eyebrows, and two dark moles on his left forehead. Muscular despite appearing slim. Wears a black pinstriped suit with green dress shirt and tie, often with a black hat and coat.

cardPool.title: Rogone
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Rogone
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Transformation
Occupation/Role: Humarise Terrorist Agent
Personality: Ruthless and devoted to Flect Turn's anti-Quirk ideology, showing no mercy to even surrendering targets. He kills without hesitation and dismisses compassion.
Appearance: A slim man with red skin, sunken eyes, thin mustache, two sharp protruding teeth, and a single pointed horn on his forehead. Sharp fingernails and dark operative costume. Transformed state: massive and muscular with darker crimson skin, two large horns, grotesque features, and iron clubs for arms.
Backstory: Elite operative for Humarise deployed to capture Izuku Midoriya and Rody Soul after they obtained a classified briefcase. He confronted Rody and transformed to eliminate him but was defeated by Izuku's superior combat power and knocked unconscious.

cardPool.title: Rody Soul
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Rody Soul

Alias:
None

Quirk Name:
Pino

Occupation/Role:
Resident of Otheon; Aspiring Pilot

Personality:
Carefree charismatic talker masking insecurity through humor. Deeply protective of his younger siblings. Cynical about fairness due to poverty, willing to steal for survival, yet capable of genuine trust when earned. Embarrassed by his Quirk's emotional transparency.

Appearance:
Young man with auburn hair in a spiky ponytail and half-lidded gray eyes. Sun-kissed skin, red bandanna, pale blue patched shirt, tan-beige jacket with orange flower accent, blue-red striped tie, gray gloves, black pants with knee patches, and dark brown shoes.

Backstory:
Abandoned by his father and shunned by his community for his father's ties to the terrorist cult Humarise, Rody became sole provider for his younger siblings Roro and Lala.

cardPool.title: Robot
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Robot
Quirk Name: Spatial Distortion, Eye Beam, Super Regeneration
Occupation/Role: High-End Nomu, Doctor Kyudai Garaki's combat unit
Personality: Obedient to orders, prefers ranged combat, methodical and cold.
Appearance: Humanoid frame with robotic augmentation. Mechanical legs and metallic plating. Head encased in sleek robotic helmet. Eyes glow with energy for beam attacks.
Backstory: Originally a combat villain, Robot was selected by Doctor Garaki for conversion into a High-End Nomu. Enhanced with multiple Quirks and robotic upgrades, he guarded Garaki's lab beneath Jaku General Hospital. During the hero raid, he was unleashed with other High-Ends to defend Garaki and Tomura Shigaraki.
Additional Information: High-End Nomu classification grants enhanced durability and power. Spatial distortion enables remote attacks via hand gestures.

cardPool.title: Robber Villain
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown

Alias: Robber Villain

Quirk Name: Smoke

Occupation/Role: Petty criminal and fugitive

Personality: Fierce and moody with a quick temper, but strategically cautious. He prefers escape over combat and uses violence only as a last resort.

Appearance: A stout figure with dark blue skin, rounded noseless head with pointed ears, and green eyes. He has a single antenna on his crown and three smoke-emitting holes on each shoulder. He wears a black vest with yellow trim, white pants, brown boots, black armbands with yellow lining, and a green handkerchief around his neck. He perpetually smokes three cigarettes simultaneously.

Backstory: A small-time criminal who committed multiple robberies across Tasomiya Ward using his Quirk to evade law enforcement and pro heroes. He clashed with Midnight, Loud Cloud, His Purple Highness, and Eraser Head multiple times.

cardPool.title: Rin Yaritezawa
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Rin Yaritezawa

Alias:
None

Quirk Name:
Not specified

Occupation/Role:
Sophomore at Naruhata Women's College; Event Organizer

Personality:
Outwardly sociable but privately bitter from being exploited for her organizational skills. Deeply appreciates genuine kindness and reciprocal warmth.

Appearance:
Sharp green eyes with short dark brown hair parted right. Pink fingernails, gold star-shaped drop earrings. At events, she wears stylish V-neck sweaters and skirts with coordinating necklaces and gold bracelets.

Backstory:
Known for organizing mixers and social gatherings. Years of planning events while being taken advantage of has left her cynical about romance and human nature, masking deeper emotional wounds beneath surface friendliness.

Additional Information:
Not a UA High School student. Appears in My Hero Academia: Vigilantes. Prone to drinking at social events.

cardPool.title: Rikiya Katsukame
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Rikiya Katsukame

Alias:
Eight Bullets member

Quirk Name:
Energy Suck

Occupation/Role:
Member of the Shie Hassaikai yakuza organization under Overhaul

Personality:
Lazy and energy-dependent, requiring vitality to function. Enjoys draining stamina from others. Obedient to Overhaul with a perverted streak when enhanced by Trigger drug.

Appearance:
A tall, muscular man wearing a black sleeveless tank top, olive drab jeans, and armored belt. Orange sneakers and blue socks complete his outfit. His most distinctive feature is a black plague mask with red lines, white eyes, and golden neck detailing. He wears massive gauntlets and knuckledusters on both fists. A metallic seat protrudes from his back for transporting other members.

cardPool.title: Ribby
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Ribby (formerly unnamed serial killer)
Alias: High-End Nomu Ribby
Quirk Name: Super Regeneration, Extendable Antennae, Rib Cage Manipulation
Occupation/Role: High-End Nomu under Doctor Kyudai Garaki
Personality: Unhinged and homicidal with immediate bloodlust. Possesses tactical intelligence, recognizing environments and opponent weaknesses. Capable of cunning strategy and mid-combat adaptation.
Appearance: Humanoid Nomu with emaciated, shriveled frame. Distinctive protruding ribs visible through chest cavity. Long antenna-like protrusions extend from head, capable of elongating significantly. Gaunt and skeletal physiology.
Backstory: Originally a psychotic serial killer, Ribby was selected by Doctor Garaki for conversion into a High-End Nomu due to his violent nature. Awakened during the Paranormal Liberation War.

cardPool.title: Rikiya Eno
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Rikiya Eno

Alias:
The Instant Villain

Quirk Name:
Big Monkey

Occupation/Role:
Vigilante/Petty Criminal

Personality:
Reckless and easily influenced. Prone to destructive behavior when chemically enhanced. Limited baseline personality information due to brief appearances.

Appearance:
Unremarkable in normal form. When transformed via Trigger, becomes a massive rotund ape with dark fur, several meters tall, wearing only black shorts. Muscular yet barrel-chested.

Backstory:
A minor criminal who fell into the Trigger drug trade, using it to amplify his quirk for petty crimes and street chaos. Defeated by hero Captain Celebrity in a single punch during an incident near the Naruhata Festival.

Additional Information:
Rikiya's quirk requires external chemical enhancement via Trigger to manifest. His transformation is temporary and reversible.

cardPool.title: Rikido Sato
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Rikido Sato

Alias:
Sweets Hero: Sugarman

Quirk Name:
Sugar Rush

Occupation/Role:
UA High School Student, Class 1-A

Personality:
Optimistic and good-natured, Rikido enjoys baking and sharing sweets with classmates. He remains humble about his talents despite their quality and maintains an earnest demeanor in combat.

Appearance:
A tall, muscular young man with short spiky brown hair, small square eyes, bushy eyebrows, thick lips, and a large round nose. He wears the standard UA male uniform: light gray blazer with turquoise trim, white shirt, dark blue-green pants, red tie, and brown shoes. His hero costume is a yellow full-body suit with openings for mouth, eyes, and hair, white gloves and boots, and a utility belt containing sugar pouches.

cardPool.title: Reiko Yanagi
cardPool.value:

Reiko Yanagi

Alias:
Emily

Poltergeist

Occupation/Role:
Hero Course Student, Class 1-B, U.A. High School

Personality:
Quiet and emotionally reserved with a fascination for horror. Despite her timid nature and cryptic speech, she is helpful and fashionable. She maintains an eerie posture with elbows tucked and hands dangling.

Appearance:
A pallid, slender young woman with pale silver pin-straight hair in an unkempt pixie-bob. Her left face is partially obscured by a sharp side-swept patch. She has dark prussian-blue half-lidded eyes with pointed lower lashes and plump lips. Her hero costume is a light periwinkle-blue kimono with a puffy hood, long flared sleeves, white and navy striping, and matching boots with a neck mask.

Backstory:
A first-year student at U.A. High School's Hero Course, Reiko has honed her telekinetic abilities professionally.

cardPool.title: Rei Todoroki

Rei Todoroki

Rei Himura (maiden name)

Frost

Homemaker, Mother

Rei is kind and caring, enduring hardship with quiet resilience. Years of abuse left her mentally fragile, but recovery has restored her compassionate nature. She maintains hope and smiles despite trauma, showing deep love for her children while struggling with lingering psychological wounds.

Appearance:
A middle-aged woman of average height with shoulder-length white hair parted into three sections with long bangs. She has round, gentle features with tired brown-gray eyes and long eyelashes. Her expression is mellow and kind. She favors plain civilian clothing in soft colors.

Backstory:
Rei married Enji Todoroki in an arranged Quirk Marriage to help her family financially. She bore four children while suffering escalating abuse from her husband.

cardPool.title: Red
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Red
Alias: Aka
Quirk Name: Unknown
Occupation/Role: Top-ranked Adviser, Vanguard Action Intelligence Regiment: Carmine (Paranormal Liberation Front)
Personality: Casual and composed, maintaining calm even in tense situations. Unfazed by interruptions from allies.
Appearance: Tall, well-built young man with blonde hair in a ponytail, left eye obscured by hair. Wears army green military outfit with black vest and boots, brown waist pouch.
Backstory: Originally Meta Liberation Army member before merger with League of Villains. Rose through ranks to become trusted adviser in the Paranormal Liberation Front's intelligence regiment.
Additional Information: Quirk ability undisclosed. Proven strength exceeds Pro Hero level. Associates with high-level figures like Hawks and Twice.

cardPool.title: Raito Sanda
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Raito Sanda

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Unnamed Electricity Quirk

Occupation/Role: Third-year middle school student; prospective UA applicant

Personality: Serious and studious with exceptional analytical abilities. Capable of sophisticated technical discussions. Initially follows others' expectations but demonstrates independence when reconsidering his true ambitions.

Appearance: Boy with wild, spiky hair and electricity-bundle-shaped eyebrows. Pitch-black eyes with white pupils. Wears standard male middle school uniform with book bag. Youthful appearance typical of his age.

Backstory: Top-performing student at his middle school and promising UA Hero Course candidate. During UA's Prospective Students Day, he engaged with Support Course innovations and faced Hero Course student Katsuki Bakugo in a tag game.

cardPool.title: Rapt Tokage
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Rapt Tokage

Alias: Instant Villain

Quirk Name: Lizard

Occupation/Role: Vigilante, Former Villain

Personality: A reformed bully with humor and self-deprecating responsibility. Despite his cruel past mocking others, he shows genuine concern and learns from consequences. Quick to joke but capable of difficult choices for the greater good.

Appearance: A reptilian humanoid with turquoise scales, long oval head, and sharp-toothed mouth. Large reptilian eyes dominate his features with small nostrils. A muscular tail extends from his lower spine. He wears a casual hooded jacket, brown waistcoat, and shorts.

Backstory: Originally a member of a bullying clique who humiliated classmates for entertainment. Trigger use granted temporary flight but hospitalized him, forcing confrontation with drug addiction.

cardPool.title: President Tanuki

Real Name: Unknown

Personality: Jovial and community-minded, eager to promote his business through cultural events; generous with store incentives.
Appearance: A rotund man with light brown fur resembling a tanuki. He has a muzzle with whiskers, small black nose, and round ears. Thinning black hair, brown blazer, navy vest, white shirt, green tie, oval-frame glasses, and dress pants.
Backstory: President Tanuki manages Marukane Department Store with focus on community engagement and festive promotions, organizing events like Narufest and holiday celebrations.
Additional Information: Not a UA High School student. His Quirk grants tanuki appearance; full capabilities unknown. He demonstrates entrepreneurial skill and friendly disposition.

cardPool.title: Pony Tsunotori
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Pony Tsunotori

Alias:
Rocketti

Horn Cannon

Occupation/Role:
UA High School Student, Class 1-B

Personality:
Friendly and naive with innocent charm. Determined and observant in combat, preferring tactical draws to reckless victories. Reverts to English when angered or flustered. Shares passion for anime and manga with classmates.

Appearance:
Short girl with round face, equine muzzle, and thick wavy blonde hair to mid-back with bangs. Large round Prussian blue eyes. Tall lyre-shaped pale tan horns. Horse-like calves with brown hooves and short tail. Hero costume is jockey-themed: orange skin-tight shirt with markings, matching pants, fingerless orange-tipped gloves, horse halter with lead rope, and belted boots with stirrups.

Backstory:
American of Japanese descent raised in the US.

cardPool.title: Paulo Gollini
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Paulo Gollini

Alias:
None

Quirk Name:
Erasure Spot

Occupation/Role:
Member of the Gollini Family mafia

Personality:
Cautious and dutiful, Paulo prefers swift execution over prolonged torment. However, beneath his stern exterior lies cowardice—he panics when cornered, abandoning confidence to beg for mercy.

Appearance:
Paulo has purple skin, small black eyes, and no visible mouth. His face tapers to a pointed muzzle with jagged fin-shaped ears. He dresses formally in a black suit with leather tailcoat, white gloves, purple tie, and brown derby shoes. A black fedora with ear holes and a red rose on his tailcoat complete his ensemble.

Backstory:
Paulo earned his place in the Gollini Family through diligent service, though he carries shame from allowing Ginji Kurau to escape with Anna Scervino. Seeking redemption, he took on eliminating threats to the family's operations.

cardPool.title: Pankration
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Pankration
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Power
Occupation/Role: Pro Hero
Personality: Friendly and approachable despite his imposing stature. Professional and reliable in heroic duties.
Appearance: Tall, heavily muscular man with long blonde hair. Wears a red sleeveless breastplate with white chiton-style garment draped over shoulders and belted at waist. Large metallic vambraces with frilled hems cover his arms. A silver circlet adorns his forehead. Greaves and sandals complete his ancient Greek-inspired costume.
Backstory: An established Greek Pro Hero known for immense physical strength derived from his Power Quirk. He operates internationally on major operations including rescue missions and criminal apprehension.
Additional Information: A seasoned Pro Hero selected for specialized task forces.

cardPool.title: Pamela
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Pamela
Alias: Mrs. Captain Celebrity
Quirk Name: Unknown
Occupation/Role: Former wife of Pro Hero Captain Celebrity, mother, businesswoman
Personality: Gruff and sharp-tongued, Pamela dislikes unsolicited help but hides a kind heart beneath her perpetual frown. She struggles with trust due to past betrayals.
Appearance: A short woman with a rounded face, long blonde hair, freckles, and large green eyes shadowed by a constant frown that makes her appear intimidating despite her diminutive stature.
Backstory: Pamela met Christopher in high school and was unmoved by his charm, seeing him as an attention-seeking clown. His persistence won her over and they married, but his infidelities led to estrangement. She became pregnant with their son before Christopher left for Japan.

cardPool.title: Oxy-Man
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Oxy-Man
Quirk Name: Unnamed Oxygen Production Quirk
Occupation/Role: Low-ranking villain, League of Villains recruit
Personality: Cautious and tactical, willing to follow orders. Becomes bold only when numbers favor him.
Appearance: Young man of average height with ash blond hair. Wears a black jumpsuit with matching gloves, transparent blue goggles, and a wireless headset. Carries a spear.
Backstory: Recruited by Tomura Shigaraki for the U.S.J. assault. Deployed to the Flood Zone where his water-breathing ability provided tactical advantage.
Additional Information: His Quirk enables oxygen production for extended underwater combat. Arrested after the U.S.J. incident. Defeated by Class 1-A students Midoriya, Asui, and Mineta through coordinated tactics.

cardPool.title: Ordinary Woman
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Ordinary Woman
Quirk Name: Mutant-type Quirk
Occupation/Role: Civilian Refugee
Personality: Compassionate and fearful, deeply affected by discrimination and trauma. Despite suffering, she remains grateful yet emotionally vulnerable, seeking safety while wrestling with rejection and mistaken identity.
Appearance: A tall woman with foxlike features including pointed ears, green fur with white underbelly, and blonde shoulder-length hair. Large blue eyes with bushy lashes. She wears an orange buttoned shirt, black pants with belt, orange headband, orange wristbands, and cream slip-on shoes.
Backstory: During the Paranormal Liberation War, she was attacked by panicking civilians who mistook her for a villain. Saved by Izuku Midoriya, she was rejected from shelters due to her Quirk before finding refuge at UA High School, where she reunited with her rescuer.

cardPool.title: Onima
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Onima
Alias: Onima
Quirk Name: Not specified
Occupation/Role: Pro Hero Sidekick at Endeavor Agency
Personality: Dedicated and professional with a serious demeanor. Supportive colleague who maintains focus during crises while showing genuine care for team morale.
Appearance: Man of average build with dull purple slicked-back hair. Wears a horned happuri hat, flak jacket over a short-sleeved shirt marked with a white X symbol.
Backstory: A dedicated sidekick at Endeavor's agency, Onima participated in major operations including the Hosu Incident, global Humarise operations, and the Paranormal Liberation War. He remains committed to hero work despite witnessing catastrophic events.
Additional Information: Works alongside partner Kido. Interacted with Work Study interns Izuku Midoriya, Katsuki Bakugo, and Shoto Todoroki. Survived the Jaku Hospital Raid.

cardPool.title: Onemu Shinya
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Onemu Shinya

Alias: None known

Quirk Name: Unknown

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero Sidekick of Ingenium's Team Idaten Agency

Personality: Perpetually drowsy and laid-back, Onemu maintains a calm demeanor during high-stakes operations. Her sleepy nature doesn't impede her professional competence.

Appearance: A young woman with short, slightly curly blonde hair and distinctive ram horns. She wears a Chinese Cheongsam mini dress in bold colors, long funnel-shaped sleeves, a black domino mask, and high-heeled shoes.

Backstory: Onemu serves as a dedicated sidekick under Ingenium at Team Idaten Agency in Naruhata. She participates in villain apprehension, crowd control, and rescue operations, demonstrating reliable teamwork despite her drowsy disposition.

cardPool.title: One-Eyed Green Dragon
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: One-Eyed Green Dragon
Quirk Name: Unknown
Occupation/Role: Low-ranking Villain, League of Villains Recruit
Personality: Aggressive and bold, willing to insult allies to maintain focus. Shows confidence even when outmatched, attempting to rally others during conflict.
Appearance: Muscular man with shoulder-length brown hair and green skin patches on torso. Upper right face entirely black with single white spot where right eye would be. Angular jaw with distinctive wide zigzag mouth.
Backstory: Recruited by Tomura Shigaraki for the U.S.J. invasion assault. Fought against Shota Aizawa's forces and attempted to maintain morale among villains during All Might's arrival.
Additional Information: Participated in U.S.J. Arc invasion; knocked out by All Might and arrested. Minor antagonist with no confirmed Quirk ability documented.

cardPool.title: Oboro Shirakumo
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Oboro Shirakumo

Alias: Loud Cloud

Quirk Name: Cloud

Occupation/Role: UA High School Student, Class 2-A, Hero-in-Training

Personality: Jovial and energetic with a penchant for jokes and witty banter. Despite his goofy exterior, his defining trait is selfless altruism—he readily goes the extra mile to help others.

Appearance: A tall young man with light blue wavy hair swept back, framed by shorter ear-length tufts. He has semicircular blue eyes often squeezed shut in an excited grin and wears a small white bandage over his nose bridge. His hero costume consists of a blue martial arts gi with black obi, black fingerless gloves, and a dark brown aviator jacket with white fur lining. He wears a blue aviator hat with large mufflers, beige goggles with silver lenses, black boots with white accents, and carries a red quarterstaff.

cardPool.title: Oji Harima
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Oji Harima

Alias:
The Peerless Thief

Quirk Name:
Unknown

Occupation/Role:
Infamous Villain, Robin Hood-like Thief

Personality:
Philosophical idealist driven by justice. Oji steals from wealthy heroes to redistribute to the poor, challenging the corrupt hero system through revolutionary action.

Appearance:
Dark maroon hair spiked at the sides with orange bandana across forehead. Heavy clown-like makeup with dark lipstick and eye shadow. White male kimono shirt with black symbol on back, wide black belt, blue striped shirt beneath. Light baggy pants with dark stripes, maroon calf-high boots, and two long bracelets per forearm creating a theatrical jester aesthetic.

Backstory:
Oji emerged during the early hero system's establishment. Recognizing systemic corruption among heroes, he became a legendary criminal redistributing stolen wealth to common people.

cardPool.title: Omori Furiko
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Omori Furiko

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Weight Increasing

Occupation/Role: High School Student (Non-UA)

Personality: Flamboyant and romantic with an overactive imagination. Despite his delusions, he shows self-awareness and respect for others, recognizing his flaws and the difference between fantasy and reality. Persistent and earnest, willing to endure hardship for his convictions.

Appearance: A teenage boy with short, blocky dark hair that appears naturally messy. He has bushy eyebrows and large, pale eyes giving him a distinctive wide-eyed expression. Dresses casually, though he owns a formal white suit made for his confession attempt.

Backstory: Omori fell in love at first sight with hero Uravity after witnessing her heroic actions during a train incident.

cardPool.title: Odd-Eye
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Odd-Eye
Quirk Name: Mind Reaper
Occupation/Role: Pro Hero
Personality: Melodramatic and theatrical, obsessed with darkness and the arcane. Enjoys acting mysteriously important but nervously cackles when genuinely panicked, masking insecurity beneath dramatic flair.
Appearance: Young man with neck-length mint green hair and yellow eyes. Scrawny, wearing an all-dark costume with oversized-collared jacket, dark pants, gloved hands with magical symbols, and multiple belts. An eye-patch covers his right eye for effect, though it functions normally.
Backstory: Operates his own hero agency with sidekicks called "contracted familiars." Built a reputation as an eccentric Pro Hero fascinated by darkness and the mystical. Recruits young heroes through cryptic invitations to test their worthiness.

cardPool.title: Number 6
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Rokuro Nomura

Alias: Number 6, Rock, High-Speed Hero: O'Clock II

Quirk Name: Overclock

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero (undercover), Villain Factory member

Personality: Confident with a perpetual smirk, Number 6 remains calm under pressure. He avoids unnecessary confrontation but uses violence without hesitation when needed. Vengeful and ruthless, he shows no remorse endangering innocents.

Appearance: Athletic build with long, curly black hair in a ponytail. A diagonal scar runs across his face and nose, self-inflicted. Sharp, calculating eyes. He wears a black full-body hero suit with blue and yellow accents, trench coat, and black fedora.

Backstory: Experimented on by All For One since childhood, Number 6 suffered agnosia leaving him without self-awareness. All For One molded him into a confident operative.

cardPool.title: Nyikang
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Nyikang

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Spirit Possession

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero (Sudan)

Personality: Composed and professional with a calm demeanor. Works cooperatively with other heroes to neutralize threats.

Appearance: Tall figure in riveted metal armor with gauntlets, a red and yellow sash, black branch-like head protrusions, and a riveted metal mask.

Backstory: A distinguished Pro Hero from Sudan invited to the I-Expo preview. Captured by Wolfram's forces, he was freed when security was restored and helped locate the Trigger Bomb and combat Humarise operatives in Egypt.

Additional Information: Carries a large sword as his primary weapon. Spirit Possession allows remote consciousness projection to incapacitate or control targets, making him a strategic combat asset.

cardPool.title: Nomu (U.S.J.)
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: U.S.J. Nomu
Quirk Name: Multiple Quirks (Shock Absorption, High-Density Muscle, Regeneration, possibly others)
Occupation/Role: Artificial Human Enforcer for the League of Villains
Personality: Mindless and obedient, incapable of independent thought or speech. Brutal in combat, following orders without question. Becomes docile when without command.
Appearance: A towering, muscular humanoid monster exceeding All Might's height with jet-black skin. Exposed brain atop his head surrounded by large eyes. Beak-like mouth with sharp teeth. Wears only beige pants and ornate skull-emblazoned metal knee-pads. Scars cover his frame from enhancement.
Backstory: Originally a small-time thug subjected to extreme modification by Doctor Kyudai Garaki under All For One's direction.

cardPool.title: Nomu (Hosu)
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Hosu Nomu (Trio)
Alias: Lower-Tier White Nomu, Middle-Tier Winged Nomu, Upper-Tier Black Nomu
Quirk Name: Absorption and Release (White), Flight (Winged), Super Regeneration (Black)
Occupation/Role: Artificial combat creatures deployed by the League of Villains
Personality: Mindless, aggressive, and obedient; attack indiscriminately without mercy
Appearance: Three biomechanical entities—a bulky white humanoid with enhanced musculature, a skeletal winged creature, and a massive jet-black monstrosity with regenerative capabilities; all possess grotesque features
Backstory: Created by All For One and deployed by Tomura Shigaraki to terrorize Hosu City and eliminate the Hero Killer: Stain
Additional Information: The white Nomu combines Muscle Augmentation and Tongue Web techniques; the black Nomu was destroyed by Endeavor's heat; the winged Nomu was killed by Stain

cardPool.title: Nomu (Chainsaw)
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Chainsaw Nomu
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Tool Arms
Occupation/Role: Vanguard Action Squad Member
Personality: Emotionless and obedient; executes orders without hesitation or mercy.
Appearance: Massive humanoid with mint green skin and exposed brain in purple helmet with red visors and metal gag. Black ripped trousers, brown belt. Six retractable arms from back wielding four chainsaws, one drill, and one claw hammer.
Backstory: Artificial life form created by the League of Villains. Deployed to U.A. Forest Training Camp as Vanguard member under Dabi's command.
Additional Information: Not a U.A. student. Operates under villain command. Primary threat during Forest Training Camp Arc. Later apprehended by Mt. Lady; subsequent fate unknown.

cardPool.title: Nobu
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Nobu
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Displacement
Occupation/Role: Wolfram's minion
Personality: Impatient and aggressive, Nobu enjoys conflict and shows little mercy. He is a loyal subordinate who follows orders without question.
Appearance: A skinny, pale yellow-skinned man with a goat-like face featuring two small triangular ears, slanted dark eyes, sharp teeth, and a small goatee. His dark green mohawk connects around his ears and cheekbones. He wears a black combat suit with a full-face mask featuring an X-shaped pale design.
Backstory: Nobu serves as one of Wolfram's minions in a coordinated attack on I-Island. He helps seize the Central Tower control room and hunts UA High School students. His speed and displacement abilities complement close-range fighters.
Additional Information: Not a UA student.

cardPool.title: Nirengeki Shoda
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Nirengeki Shoda

Alias: Mines

Quirk Name: Twin Impact

Occupation/Role: UA High School Class 1-B Vice Class Representative, Hero-in-Training

Personality: Humble and conscientious, Nirengeki refuses unearned credit and serves as his class's moral compass. He is reliable, collaborative, and mature. His classmates trust him implicitly, and he excels at reading situations and working tactically with allies.

Appearance: A chubby young man of below-average height with short, ice-blue hair and a round, boyish face. Large, wide eyes with small pupils give him a sheepish expression. He wears a black high-collared hero costume trimmed with pale white lines, black pants, white knee-high boots, a blue scouter device over his left eye, and a connected radar on one gloved hand.

cardPool.title: Nezu
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Nezu

Alias: Mr. Principal

Quirk Name: High Specs

Occupation/Role: Principal of U.A. High School, Pro Hero

Personality: Eccentric and polite but darkly unpredictable. Enjoys toying with opponents in combat and holds grudges from past human abuse. Self-aware and verbose, he genuinely cares for student safety despite his occasional cruelty.

Appearance: A small white-furred stoat with circular black eyes, one marked by a large scar, rectangular ears with pale pink insides, and an elongated muzzle. He wears a white dress shirt, dark red tie, black double-breasted waistcoat, matching pants, and oversized orange sneakers.

Backstory: A rare animal who manifested a Quirk, Nezu endured severe mistreatment and experimentation by humans. He now leads U.A. High School, dedicating himself to hero education and student protection while leveraging his wealth and strategic brilliance.

cardPool.title: NHA Reporter
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown (Conjectural)
Alias: NHA Reporter
Quirk Name: Unknown
Occupation/Role: News Reporter for NHA TV; UA High School Correspondent
Personality: Ambitious and ratings-driven, initially pursuing controversy for viewership, but gradually developing genuine compassion and journalistic integrity through witnessing heroic sacrifice.
Appearance: Young woman with large black eyes and medium-length brown hair in a ponytail. She wears a formal dark suit with an NHA armband and carries an NHA-labeled microphone.
Backstory: A determined reporter for NHA TV who gained access to UA High School during hero education season. Initially motivated by ratings and scandal, she pursued interviews with All Might and Class 1-A following the USJ Incident, seeking controversy to boost viewership.
Additional Information: Civilian press correspondent, not a UA student.

cardPool.title: Nemuri Kayama
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Nemuri Kayama

Alias: Midnight, R-Rated Hero

Quirk Name: Somnambulist

Occupation/Role: UA High School Faculty, Modern Hero Art History Teacher

Personality: Playful, flirtatious, and perverted with unpredictably serious temperament. Easily angered by interruptions or insults, sensitive about her age. Acts on whims with no shame in sexual behavior around students. Genuinely excited by displays of youth and chivalry.

Appearance: Tall, curvaceous woman with sky-blue eyes, long lashes, and long spiky dark purple layered hair with split bangs. Small beauty mark below left eye, pink glasses, and pink nails. Wears a revealing black leather leotard over white bodysuit with red gemstones down the center, purple thigh-high stockings, burgundy utility belt, black knee-boots, red eye mask, wrist handcuffs, and carries a flogger whip.

cardPool.title: Nejire Hado
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Nejire Hado

Alias: Wonder Hero: Nejire Chan

Quirk Name: Wave Motion

Occupation/Role: UA High School Student, Class 3-A, Member of The Big 3

Personality: Naturally kind and talkative with endless curiosity about others, though her bluntness can seem invasive. She grew distant in middle school but regained warmth through friendships with Tamaki Amajiki and Mirio Togata at UA.

Appearance: Fair-skinned girl with wide, round light royal blue eyes and distinctive periwinkle blue hair reaching past her knees with spiral twists, side-swept bangs, and face-framing strands. She wears the standard UA female uniform. Her hero costume is a dark royal blue skin-tight bodysuit with pale mint green torso markings, turquoise accents, knee-high boots with spiral anklets, yellow gauntlets, and spiral hair-shaped protrusions behind her ears.

cardPool.title: Neito Monoma
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Neito Monoma

Alias: Phantom Thief

Quirk Name: Copy

Occupation/Role: UA High School Class 1-B Student

Personality: Loud, sarcastic, and mocking toward Class 1-A, driven by envy and inferiority complex. Calm and kind otherwise, but prone to unhinged verbal tirades earning strikes from Itsuka Kendo. Deliberately provocative to push classmates forward, though sometimes crosses into cruelty through insensitivity.

Appearance: Average height with slick blonde hair parted right, shorter at ends with bangs over right eye. Periwinkle blue irises with white pupils, downward-slanting eyes half-closed, characteristic smirk and head tilt. Black double-breasted tuxedo tailcoat with long tails, upturned collar, light and dark blue dotted tie, small blue handkerchief in breast pocket, black pants and white shoes. Three clocks on belt track Quirk time limit.

cardPool.title: Needle Hair
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Needle Hair
Quirk Name: Hair Control
Occupation/Role: F-rank Villain
Personality: Confident in combat despite low ranking. Little known of her beyond willingness to join dangerous operations.
Appearance: Young woman of average height with brown eyes and long gray dreadlocks. Wears dark purple bodysuit with gray and light purple patterned sleeves and black boots.
Backstory: Recruited by Tomura Shigaraki for the League of Villains' assault on the Unforeseen Simulation Joint. Served in long-range combat alongside Stitched Giant and Victor against U.A. High School pro heroes.
Additional Information: Her Quirk allows her to control and harden her hair while firing strands as projectiles for ranged attacks. Neutralized by Eraser Head's Erasure ability during the U.S.J. incident and arrested.

cardPool.title: Natsuo Todoroki
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Natsuo Todoroki

Alias:
None

Quirk Name:
Ice

Occupation/Role:
College Student

Personality:
Friendly on the surface but harbors deep resentment toward his father Enji for family trauma and neglect. Cares deeply for his siblings, particularly Shoto. Shows maturity handling sensitive matters, though struggles with forgiveness despite acknowledging his father's redemption attempts.

Appearance:
A young man of above-average height with a well-built frame. He has distinctive white spiky hair with two short crimson-red streaks down the middle of his forehead. Gray eyes with long eyelashes give him a gentle appearance despite his athletic build.

Backstory:
The second son of Enji Todoroki, Natsuo grew up in a fractured household marked by his father's obsessive hero pursuit and emotional neglect.

cardPool.title: Native
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Native
Quirk Name: Unknown
Occupation/Role: Pro Hero
Personality: Easily irritated but fundamentally selfless and grateful, showing concern for others' safety even in mortal danger. Demonstrates humility by acknowledging his combat limitations.
Appearance: A muscular man wearing feathered headgear and matching cape over a dark jumpsuit with the letter "N" on the chest. Wears open-toed sandals and carries himself with professional bearing. Costume draws from stereotypical Native American imagery.
Backstory: Established Pro Hero attacked by Hero Killer Stain in an alleyway and nearly executed before being saved by UA High School students Tenya Iida, Izuku Midoriya, and Shoto Todoroki. Grateful for their intervention, he rewarded them with theme park tickets. Later participated in the hospital raid against the League of Villains.

cardPool.title: Naomasa Tsukauchi
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Naomasa Tsukauchi
Alias: Detective Tsukauchi
Quirk Name: Polygraph
Occupation/Role: Police Detective
Personality: Earnest and hardworking, Naomasa is strict about the law yet pragmatic when justice demands it. He maintains close confidences with All Might and values loyalty deeply. Despite his by-the-book nature, he shows willingness to work with unconventional allies if their intentions prove genuine.
Appearance: A tall man with short black hair and rectangular black eyes, Naomasa typically wears a tan trench coat with matching fedora over a white collared shirt and dark pale green tie, completed with brown dress shoes and white gloves. His formal bearing reflects his professional detective status.

cardPool.title: Nao Shimura
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Nao Shimura

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Unknown

Occupation/Role: Homemaker, Mother

Personality: A kind and compassionate woman troubled by her family's dysfunction. Though gentle-natured, she possessed quiet strength and stood against her husband's violence toward their children. She remained a loving, protective mother despite her inability to fully prevent her husband's harsh treatment of Tenko.

Appearance: A woman in her early thirties with light brown eyes and shoulder-length light brown hair parted in the middle with uneven waves and bangs. She had a curvaceous build and typically wore casual clothing such as black shirts with jeans or corduroy skirts. Her face often bore a worried expression reflecting her family's troubled state.

Backstory: Nao married Kotaro Shimura and had two children, Hana and Tenko.

cardPool.title: Nana Shimura
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Nana Shimura

Alias:
The Seventh One For All User

Quirk Name:
One For All

Occupation/Role:
Pro Hero and former mentor to All Might

Personality:
A kind woman with strong sense of justice who believes true heroes must smile to save both lives and hearts. She valued bravery, emotional resilience, and self-sacrifice above all else.

Appearance:
A tall, fair-skinned woman with dark, straight shoulder-length hair styled in a half-up-half-down bun with short bangs, sharp intelligent eyes with long eyelashes, and a small mole below her bottom lip. Her hero costume features a dark sleeveless bodysuit with high collar, yellow gloves, white knee-high boots, an angular golden belt buckle, and a small cape to her knees.

Backstory:
Once the symbol of hope for her generation, Nana mentored the Quirkless Toshinori Yagi and instilled in him the philosophy of the smiling hero.

cardPool.title: Nagamasa Mora
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Nagamasa Mora

Alias: Chewyee

Quirk Name: Not explicitly stated in source material

Occupation/Role: Second Year Student at Shiketsu High School, Class Representative

Personality: Polite, reasonable, and diplomatic. Maintains strict standards and reprimands reckless behavior. Deeply values his school's reputation and refuses to tolerate shameful actions.

Appearance: Entirely covered in light brown hair with no distinct facial features except his eyes. Wears Shiketsu's standard dark pants, belt, and signature peaked cap as part of his hero costume.

Backstory: A promising student at Shiketsu High School, one of the nation's most prestigious hero academies. Selected as class representative, demonstrating exceptional composure. During the Provisional Hero License Exam, he passed the first phase through skill and strategy rather than confrontation.

cardPool.title: Mustard
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Mustard
Alias: Mustard
Quirk Name: Gas
Occupation/Role: C-rank villain, member of the League of Villains Vanguard Action Squad
Personality: Pragmatic and merciless, highly intelligent and calculating. Arrogant about his abilities, harboring jealousy toward UA students whom he views as undeserving. Shows exceptional cruelty and willingness to kill without hesitation.
Appearance: Skinny young man with short wavy light brown hair and tan skin. Brown eyes hidden behind a green gas mask connected to two oxygen tanks on his back. Wears a black gakuran school uniform with teal gloves and white shoes.
Backstory: A League of Villains member in the Vanguard Action Squad. His deep resentment toward UA High School and its students drives his motivation, viewing their success as unearned privilege.

cardPool.title: Muscle Man
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Muscle Man
Quirk Name: Charging Muscles
Occupation/Role: F-rank Villain
Personality: Confident in combat abilities, aggressive, and overconfident in his strength.
Appearance: Tall and heavily muscular with tanned skin, spiky dark brown hair, and a full-face mask. Wears a green t-shirt, baggy jeans, and brown shoes.
Backstory: A low-ranking villain recruited by Tomura Shigaraki for the League of Villains' U.S.J. assault. He was defeated and arrested by Eraser Head during the raid.
Additional Information: His Quirk charges muscle strength into devastating attacks, but overcharging causes severe soreness, limiting sustained combat. He serves as a foot soldier for the League of Villains.

cardPool.title: Mummy (U.S.J.)
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Mummy
Quirk Name: Unknown
Occupation/Role: Low-ranking villain, League of Villains recruit
Personality: Aggressive and violent, follows orders without hesitation as part of coordinated horde operations.
Appearance: A muscular man with gray bandages covering his entire face and body, obscuring distinguishing features.
Backstory: Recruited by Tomura Shigaraki as one of seventy low-ranking villains for the U.S.J. invasion.
Additional Information: Engaged Shota Aizawa during the U.S.J. Arc but was quickly defeated when Aizawa used his Binding Cloth. Apprehended following the invasion's failure. His Quirk remains unspecified.

cardPool.title: Mr. Plastic
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Unknown

Alias:
Mr. Plastic

Quirk Name:
Plastic Transformation

Occupation/Role:
Pro Hero

Personality:
Confident and direct, willing to confront dangerous criminals. Professional and composed in crises, dedicated to justice.

Appearance:
Built man with spiky grey hair and grey eyes. Wears hero costume with two large mechanical arms featuring armored pauldrons, bound to chest with black cloth and brown straps. Equipped with headset sporting dual blue visors and tactical pants with belt.

Backstory:
Established Pro Hero known for combat capabilities. Captured by criminal Wolfram at the I-Expo reception and detained until Melissa Shield restored facility security. Later participated in raids against Humarise operatives at their Otheon base.

Additional Information:
Quirk Plastic Transformation is poorly documented but theorized to grant body-stretching abilities.

cardPool.title: Mr. Brave
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Mr. Brave
Quirk Name: Hair-Raiser
Occupation/Role: Pro Hero
Personality: Reserved and professional with steadfast dedication to heroic duty.
Appearance: Average height and build with messy black hair and light gray eyes. Wears a dark blue bodysuit with gray patches on forearms and thighs, chest stripe, belt, neck cloth, and protective headgear.
Backstory: Earned Pro Hero license through rigorous training. Participated in major operations including the Yakuza assault and Jaku General Hospital raid against Tomura Shigaraki.
Additional Information: Demonstrates solid combat capability in high-risk operations. His Quirk enables hair manipulation for offense, though repeated use causes physical strain limiting extended combat effectiveness.

cardPool.title: Moyuru Tochi
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Moyuru Tochi

Alias:
None

Quirk Name:
Ignition

Occupation/Role:
Former Instant Villain, Reformed Vigilante

Personality:
Once a callous bully, Moyuru underwent dramatic personality shift after his defeat and arrest. He is now calm, respectful, and genuinely remorseful. He shows unexpected kindness toward former victims and demonstrates genuine camaraderie with his peers.

Appearance:
A large, portly young man with dark brown skin and a bald head. His distinctive feature is a small flame growing from the top of his head that serves as his hair and extinguishes when unconscious. He has rounded, pupilless eyes. He typically wears a purple open button-down shirt with prominent belly exposed, along with shorts and slippers.

Backstory:
Moyuru was an Instant Villain who used Trigger to enhance his abilities and terrorize weaker citizens alongside Soga and Rapt.

cardPool.title: Moonfish
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Moonfish (true name unknown)
Alias: Moonfish
Quirk Name: Blade-Tooth
Occupation/Role: Villain, League of Villains Vanguard Action Squad member
Personality: Insane and laconic, obsessed with consuming flesh. Mutters constantly to maintain focus, easily distracted by any source of flesh. Prioritizes hunger above ideology. Despite madness, demonstrates tactical capability and will work with others for access to victims. Shows no mercy.
Appearance: Tall man with fair skin and black eyes. Entirely obscured by restraint gear—black straitjacket with black restraints decorated with red spikes. Metal clamps on head force lips open, causing constant drooling. Additional straps cross torso, waist, and boots. Shaven head bears large cut on left ear. Only mouth exposed, revealing his weapon.

cardPool.title: Monika Kaniyashiki
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Monika Kaniyashiki

Alias: Kaniko

Quirk Name: Snip Clip

Occupation/Role: Police Officer (Undercover)

Personality: Cheerful and goofy with humor that masks her intelligence and serious work ethic. Her joking manner makes it unclear when she is sincere. She willingly risks herself to protect others.

Appearance: A short, petite girl with round face and semicircular orange-brown eyes. Dull red hair styled in two high crab-claw bunches with six side tufts and split bangs. At Kanidoge, she wears a pinkish-red knee-length kimono over black combat vest, pale green shorts, black 3/4 leggings, black fingerless gloves, geta sandals, and yellow-black striped headband.

Backstory: A Japanese Police Force member who works undercover investigating criminal activity. Her friendly demeanor makes her ideal for covert operations as people underestimate her.

cardPool.title: Alan Kay
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Alan Kay

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Unknown

Occupation/Role: Scientist/Researcher

Personality: Brave and determined despite his circumstances. Demonstrates unwavering conviction and willingness for self-sacrifice to stop Humarise's genocidal plans. Maintains moral conviction even when forced to work for terrorists threatening his family.

Appearance: A disheveled adult man with dark brown hair and gray eyes. Wears an eye patch over his right eye, which bears a scar underneath. Typically dressed in a white shirt, brown pants, and brown shoes. Shows signs of physical and mental strain from captivity.

Backstory: Kidnapped by Humarise along with other scientists, Alan was forced to develop Trigger Bombs under threat of his family's execution.

cardPool.title: Anan Kurose
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Anan Kurose

Alias: Space Hero: Thirteen

Quirk Name: Black Hole

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero and UA High School Faculty Member

Personality: Wise and well-mannered, deeply passionate about rescue work. Advocates for constructive Quirk use while acknowledging her own Quirk's lethal potential. Brave and selfless, willing to engage in combat despite not being combat-oriented.

Appearance: Young woman with short navy blue hair and a blonde spiral patch at the roots. Hazel irises ringed like black holes. Black substance coating her hands and forearms. Wears a white puffy space suit-style jacket, black helmet with white eye markings, and yellow boots.

Backstory: Dedicated Pro Hero specializing in search and rescue. Passionate about hero training, she developed the Unforeseen Simulation Joint to teach rescue tactics. Serves as a faculty member at UA High School.

cardPool.title: Anna Scervino
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Anna Scervino

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Overmodification

Occupation/Role: Civilian (formerly imprisoned by the Gollini Family mafia)

Personality: Traumatized and melancholic, but naturally joyful when safe. Harbors deep PTSD from losing her family to the mafia and suffers from aversion to violence. Desperate enough to seek dark solutions, yet capable of returning to optimism when freed from her burden.

Appearance: A young woman with waist-length light peach hair and blue eyes that darken when her Quirk activates. She wears a long-sleeved pink and white dress with a red bow on her chest and head, and a pink choker. Her delicate appearance contrasts with her dangerous power.

Backstory: Anna grew up isolated due to her constantly-active Quirk causing excruciating pain to incompatible people. Only her butler Giulio Gandini could safely remain near her.

cardPool.title: Bee☆Pop
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Kazuho Haneyama (possessed by Queen Bee parasitic Quirk)
Alias: Bee☆Pop
Quirk Name: Queen Bee
Occupation/Role: Villain/Performer (formerly Pop☆Step Vigilante)
Personality: Sadistic charismatic performer who stages destructive attacks as shows. Obsessed with Koichi Haimawari, confusing love and hate. Unable to distinguish right from wrong. Uses Trigger drug to enhance abilities.
Appearance: Wears bee-themed variant of Pop☆Step costume with honey-colored stripes, bee wings, red heart-shaped belt buckles, thick black eyeshadow and lipstick. Hair swept over left eye. Carries trigger canisters at belt. On Trigger, skin darkens and tongue blackens.
Backstory: Originally a bee swarm from Kuin Hachisuka's control, cultivated by Number 6 before possessing Kazuho. The fusion creates an entity driven by obsession with Koichi and desire for a self-destructive finale.

cardPool.title: Boomerang Villain

Unknown

Boomerang

Villain, escaped convict freed by All For One

Hostile and greedy, willing to rob for supplies. Cowardly when facing resistance.

Appearance:
Bright orange messy hair. Dark purple jacket with ripped sleeves and matching pants over white T-shirt. Black tactical boots, black knee pads, and grey arm guards with boomerangs attached. Grey mask covering his face.

Backstory:
A convict freed by All For One who operates in criminal gangs, targeting civilians and shelters for food and supplies. Minor threat despite destructive tendencies, limited by cowardice in direct conflict.

Additional Information:
His Quirk allows him to throw purple-glowing boomerangs that detonate on command. Defeated by Class 1-A students during a robbery attempt and captured by Uravity.

cardPool.title: Eel Boy

Alias: Eel Boy

Backstory: A dedicated hero in Japan's hero society who has earned public trust. Assigned to critical operations and high-stakes villain apprehensions, demonstrating his rank and reliability.

cardPool.title: Fourth Kind

Alias: Fourth Kind

Wears black four-sleeved suit, cyan tie with yellow diamonds, and thick gold rings on all fingers. Metal encases jaw and neck.

Backstory: Earned reputation as chivalrous hero through rigorous professionalism and unwavering standards. Selected interns Eijiro Kirishima and Tetsutetsu Tetsutetsu after their impressive UA Sports Festival performance.

cardPool.title: Glutton God

Alias: Glutton God

Appearance: A large, obese man with a magenta Mohawk protruding through a dark mask covering his upper face. He wears dark overalls with "Glutton God" kanji, heavy boots, and an imposing physical presence.
Backstory: Glutton God emerged as a gang leader during Japan's hero society crisis following the Paranormal Liberation War. He raided shopping districts and terrorized civilians before being swiftly defeated by Best Jeanist.
Additional Information: His Slime Quirk generates yellow gelatinous substance from his arms with sufficient density to shatter wooden structures.

cardPool.title: Gravitational Spring
cardPool.value:

Alias: Gravitational Spring

Occupation/Role: Low-ranking villain, League of Villains recruit
Personality: Volatile and easily agitated when situations turn against him; becomes aggressive when pressured.
Appearance: A skeletal man with spiky brown hair and extraordinarily long, thin arms. He wears a yellow sleeveless shirt with matching pants. Black material wraps his limbs with armor-like pieces on each arm. He wears a white perforated mask and armor-plated kneecaps.
Backstory: A minor villain recruited by Tomura Shigaraki for the League of Villains' assault on the Unforeseen Simulation Joint. He ambushed Class 1-A students before being apprehended.
Additional Information: His Quirk enables extreme arm extension for manipulating objects and distant attacks.

cardPool.title: Greedy Gaping Jaw
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Greedy Gaping Jaw

Personality: Overconfident in combat despite limited strength; reckless and willing to assault U.A. High School.
Appearance: Obese villain with gray skin wearing a blue shirt, black pants, and brown boots. His head resembles a worm's mouth filled with sharp teeth, giving him a grotesque, predatory appearance.
Backstory: Recruited by Tomura Shigaraki as one of seventy low-ranking villains for the U.S.J. assault on U.A. High School's training facility.
Additional Information: Quickly defeated by Shota Aizawa during the invasion and arrested. His Quirk fires lasers from his mouth with limited combat effectiveness.

cardPool.title: Lunch Rush

Real Name: Unknown
