Quirk Name: Unknown
Occupation/Role: Pro Hero and U.A. High School cafeteria chef
Personality: Upbeat and enthusiastic, communicates through thumbs-up gestures and nonverbal cues. Dedicated and supportive of students.
Appearance: Wears a white chef hat, cooking apron, white gloves, and white shoes. A tube extends from his mouth to his back. Face mask obscures his features. Medium build.
Backstory: A Pro Hero who dedicated himself to feeding U.A. students. Six years prior, he single-handedly prepared full-course French meals for ten thousand typhoon victims. Now serves as primary chef for Class 1-A and the entire student body.
Additional Information: Renowned for exceptional cuisine quality and variety. Students never tire of his meals. Supports critical missions by providing sustenance for high-endurance operations.

cardPool.title: Master of the Waves
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Master of the Waves

Occupation/Role: Villain
Personality: Aggressive and tyrannical, driven by resentment toward land society. Ruthless and opportunistic, exploiting sea creatures as tools without regard for their welfare.
Appearance: A lean, muscular man whose head is replaced by a squid's body and tentacles. He has fin-like appendages on his wrists, webbed hands and feet, a pointed nose, and sunken beady eyes. He wears only dark, skintight pants.
Backstory: An aquatic villain embittered when land society rejected his demands for obedience. He seized control of sea animals from Takoba Aquarium and attacked UA High School students investigating the disappearances.
Additional Information: His Quirk grants control over nearby sea life, with strength sufficient to command whales.

cardPool.title: Midnight Boys
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown

Personality: Devoted and protective of his employer with intense loyalty bordering on obsession. Shows professional competence and jealousy toward threats to Midnight's reputation.

Backstory: One of four sidekicks employed by Pro Hero Midnight after she established her own Hero Office. Works alongside his three identical-looking teammates in hero operations across Japan.
Additional Information: Operates as part of a coordinated four-man team under Midnight's direction. Participates in criminal apprehension, emergency response, and public safety events.

Additional Information: Expendable shock troops with multiple stolen Quirks grafted ...

cardPool.title: Nine
cardPool.value:

Appearance: A tall man with fair skin, thin rectangular gray eyes with white pupils, and shoulder-length white hair. He wears a form-fitting black bodysuit with armored plating outlined by dark violet grooves. Two large canisters of glowing purple liquid are mounted at his shoulders. A lilac blazer and dress pants overlay the suit, with a large mask-corset covering his chest to nose area, featuring nine gray plugs and metal bindings.

cardPool.title: Nomu

Occupation/Role: Bio-engineered Super-Soldier for the League of Villains
Personality: Mindless and obedient; operates without higher brain function or independent will. Displays no emotion or resistance.
Appearance: A grotesquely modified humanoid creature with heavily muscled, pale flesh and an elongated head with visible brain cavity. Bulging muscles and unnatural gait. Vacant, unfocused eyes reflecting lack of consciousness.
Backstory: Originally a deceased small-time thug whose corpse was stolen and subjected to radical bio-engineering by Doctor Kyudai Garaki. Reconstructed to hold multiple Quirks and rival All Might's power. Deployed during the U.S.J. assault alongside Tomura Shigaraki and Kurogiri.

cardPool.title: Sisters of Saint Lila's Academy

Personality: Innocent and enthusiastic young girls who readily ask adults for explanations. Devoted fans of Captain Celebrity who find joy in simple entertainment. Despite naivety, they show genuine appreciation and emotional connection.
Appearance: Three identical-height girls with youthful physiques and luminescent blushes. Each has distinct hairstyle and subtle variations in face and hair color. They wear matching sailor fuku uniforms with flower-decorated berets on the right side.

cardPool.title: Steel Bulwark

Personality: Brash and overconfident, prone to underestimating opponents. He charges recklessly into combat assuming his mutant-type Quirk makes him invulnerable. Lacks strategic thinking and experience against seasoned combatants.

Backstory: Recruited by Tomura Shigaraki for the assault on the Unforeseen Simulation Joint, Steel Bulwark attempted to overwhelm Eraser Head. The hero dodged his attacks and incapacitated him with a single punch before binding him with his Capturing Weapon.

cardPool.title: Suicide Bomber

Appearance: A massive man with a spherical black head resembling a cartoon bomb with a protruding fuse. Large eyes and gaping mouth, no visible nose or ears. "Suicide Bomber" written across his forehead. Fingers resemble dynamite sticks. Wears blue-collar worker outfit, jeans, boots, explosives belt, and bomb packages on his chest.

Additional Information: His Quirk allows self-detonation with destructive force capable of leveling buildings.

cardPool.title: Absorption and Release
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Absorption and Release

Description:
The user absorbs incoming emitter-type attacks and redirects them back at opponents with equal or greater force, turning enemy offense into counterattacks.

Functions/Applications:
Absorb fire, electricity, and energy blasts; store energy briefly; release in any direction; chain absorptions for increased output; reflect attacks at their source.

Limits:
User takes full damage from initial impact despite absorption. Only works on emitter-type attacks, not physical strikes. Absorbed energy degrades over time if not released quickly. Overwhelmingly powerful attacks may exceed storage capacity and cause internal damage.

Additional Notes:
Most effective against ranged, energy-focused opponents. Vulnerable to melee combatants who close distance quickly. Requires timing and positioning to redirect effectively.

cardPool.title: Assault Dust
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Assault Dust

Description:
The user generates and manipulates fine dust particles from their body, projecting them at high velocity as weapons or tools. The dust can be controlled mid-flight and shaped into various forms for offense or utility.

Functions/Applications:
Fire concentrated dust bursts at targets with considerable force. Dust clouds obscure vision and create diversions. The user can shape dust into protective barriers or screens with sufficient density.

Limits:
Effectiveness decreases in wet or humid environments. User must maintain line of sight to manipulate dust. Large-scale generation drains stamina quickly. Wind and air currents reduce accuracy.

Additional Notes:
Best suited for ranged combat and tactical situations. Works poorly in enclosed spaces or against water-based opponents.

cardPool.title: Tetsu
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Tetsu
Alias: Tetsu the Tank
Quirk Name: Unnamed Armor Quirk
Occupation/Role: Yakuza Executive, Abegawa Tenchu Kai
Personality: Hot-tempered, enjoys drinking with fellow yakuza. Easily infuriated by slights to his organization's honor, yet capable of camaraderie with peers.
Appearance: Middle-aged man with dark hair and full beard. Wears dark sunglasses, light-colored fancy jacket and pants, and a scarf. Athletic build.
Backstory: A ruthless yakuza member who rose to executive rank through formidable combat abilities and Quirk mastery. Often found in bars debating organizational matters with fellow executives.
Additional Information: Tetsu's Quirk grants him control over metallic armor capable of firing powerful laser beams. He typically operates as part of coordinated yakuza teams, though their combined strength proved insufficient against the vigilante Stendhal.

cardPool.title: Navel Laser
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Navel Laser

Description:
A light-based offensive quirk firing brilliant laser beams from the user's navel. Beams range from short to long-range and pierce concrete and metal. Originally stolen and implanted by All For One, this quirk requires external support to function properly.

Functions/Applications:
Beams can be reshaped into blades or razor-thin projectiles and manipulated in size. Strong recoil propels the user through the air for mobility. Intense brightness illuminates dark areas and serves as a beacon or bait. With specialized equipment, beams can be fired from multiple body points. User can manipulate beam properties with precision.

Limits:
Without the Sparkle Belt, the quirk cannot be controlled or aimed. Continuous firing causes internal damage and risk of loss of bowel control.

cardPool.title: Big Red Dot

Appearance: Well-built man with lion head and webbed feet. Wears sleeveless light blue wetsuit with water-design belt, elbow-length arm guards, and shoulder pads bearing the Singaporean flag. Small domino mask completes his costume.

Backstory: Top-ranked hero of Singapore and trusted ally of All Might. Proven capability in multi-national operations against terrorist threats including Humarise's Trigger Bomb plot.

Additional Information: Leads international task forces with other prominent heroes. Quirk allows water manipulation with tremendous force, capable of lifting large objects to high altitudes.

cardPool.title: All For One

Real Name: Zen Shigaraki

Occupation/Role: Founder and leader of the League of Villains; Japan's most powerful villain

Personality: Cold, calculating, and tyrannical with unwavering conviction in world domination. Patient yet obsessed, willing to orchestrate elaborate schemes across decades. Manipulative strategist who values power above all else.

Appearance: Towering man with severe scarring covering his head and face from his battle with All Might. Features composed almost entirely of scar tissue with no visible nose, ears, or hair; faded white eyes barely discernible. Wears a dark formal suit, white collared shirt, and a dark navy skull-like gas mask with angular tubes and life-support collar system.

cardPool.title: Toshinori Yagi

Toshinori Yagi

Alias:
All Might

Quirk Name:
One For All

Occupation/Role:
Foundational Hero Studies Teacher, UA High School

Personality:
Charismatic and heroic with unwavering justice, though burdened as Symbol of Peace. Dedicated mentor who inspires through conviction and example.

Appearance:
Imposingly muscular with chiseled features and strong jawline. Short blond hair swept back with two front tufts. Deep blue eyes with shadowed sockets. Wears iconic Golden Age costume: skin-tight blue bodysuit with red "Y" symbol on chest, white diamond at center, large white hip patches with red trim, yellow forearm sleeves, and yellow belt with silver buckle.

Backstory:
Eighth holder of One For All, inherited from Nana Shimura. Japan's No. 1 Pro Hero and world's Symbol of Peace. Now teaches at UA High School while training successor Izuku Midoriya.

cardPool.title: Yo Shindo
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Yo Shindo

Alias:
Grand

Quirk Name:
Vibrate

Occupation/Role:
Third-year student at Ketsubutsu Academy High School

Personality:
Polite and friendly on the surface, but calculating beneath. He lowers others' guards while remaining calm in chaos. Competitive and respectful, though willing to exploit weaknesses. His demeanor shifts instantly when angered.

Appearance:
Tall and muscular with shaggy dark brown hair sticking up with low-hanging bangs. Warm brown eyes and a frequent smile. Wears a gold jaw-guard, thick green shoulder straps, short black jacket with golden trimmings, black elbow pads, green wrist-guards, black baggy pants with green markings, and black boots.

Backstory:
A capable student and natural leader at Ketsubutsu Academy, Yo rose to prominence through strategic brilliance and Quirk mastery.

cardPool.title: Energy Suck
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Energy Suck

Description:
By making physical contact and inhaling, the user absorbs the vitality of others, gaining increased stamina, size, and strength. This weakens the target. The user must maintain contact to activate the ability.

Functions/Applications:
Drain enemy stamina while boosting physical prowess. Absorb multiple targets in succession to compound strength gains. Enhanced size provides combat advantages. When augmented by Trigger drug, the quirk activates at range through inhalation alone, bypassing contact and functioning while unconscious.

Limits:
Requires physical contact for standard use, rendering it ineffective at range. Cannot absorb targets the user cannot touch. Range-enhancement from Trigger drug is temporary. Overuse depletes available targets and leaves the user vulnerable when the drug wears off.

cardPool.title: Erasure Spot
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Erasure Spot

Description:
Paulo Gollini manifests a dome-shaped energy wave that deactivates all Quirks within its range. He can create a smaller protective bubble inside where Quirks remain active. When boosted, the range expands to cover entire mountain ranges.

Functions/Applications:
Creates a nullification field that strips enemies of their Quirk abilities, forcing reliance on physical combat. The inner bubble allows allies with non-Quirk skills to function while enemies outside remain powerless. Useful for disorienting opponents and controlling battlefield positioning.

Limits:
The outer dome nullifies Quirks indiscriminately, affecting allies outside the inner bubble. Fast opponents can bypass the field to reach the user and reactivate their Quirks. The strategy becomes predictable once support units are eliminated. Cannot selectively disable only enemy Quirks.

cardPool.title: En Tayutai
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
En Tayutai

Alias:
Smoke-Eater

Quirk Name:
Smokescreen

Occupation/Role:
Former Pro Hero, Sixth User of One For All

Personality:
Reserved but friendly with strong willpower. Generally composed, but emotional when concerned for others. Self-deprecating about his Quirk's weakness, yet warm toward creative applications of his abilities.

Appearance:
A short man with short, dark hair parted twice and narrow eyes. His hero costume features a large red jacket with straps and buttons, high collar obscuring his mouth and nose, dark baggy pants, large white hiking boots, and sports tape around his forearms.

Backstory:
En received One For All from Daigoro after the previous user fell to All For One. He resisted All For One's attempts to steal the Quirk twice.

cardPool.title: Ground Beta
cardPool.value:
Name: Ground Beta

Location: Urban training facility with interconnected streets and multi-story buildings for combat exercises and surveillance.

Inhabitants: Security robots, instructors in basement monitoring rooms, student combatants during trials.

Appearance: A replica urban district with realistic streets and reinforced office buildings. Basement levels contain observation decks with monitoring screens and communication systems. Sturdy functional architecture designed to withstand combat training.

cardPool.title: Ground Gamma
cardPool.value:
Name:
Ground Gamma

Location:
An abandoned industrial complex with interconnected factories, heavy machinery, cranes, pipelines, and metal structures creating multiple elevation levels and precarious pathways.

Inhabitants:
Pro Heroes conducting training exercises, students undergoing combat trials, and authority figures like Principal Nezu overseeing practical examinations.

Appearance:
A sprawling maze of rust-streaked factories and towering industrial equipment. Massive cranes loom overhead, pipelines crisscross at various heights, and metal catwalks offer unstable footing. The ground is littered with debris and fallen machinery. Vertical movement is heavily favored through treacherous passages and crane-based traversal routes. The environment tests agility, endurance, and adaptability under pressure.

cardPool.title: Ground Omega
cardPool.value:
Name:
Ground Omega

Location:
A vast walled training grounds with a single entrance marked by an omega symbol. Contains dense woods, rocky hills, and an observation post building for monitoring activities.

Inhabitants:
Teachers including Shota Aizawa and All Might supervise training exercises. Student groups from multiple academies use the grounds for survival drills and joint practice. Typically hosts twenty to thirty students during events.

Appearance:
A sprawling forest landscape with rocky outcroppings and uneven terrain for combat training. Secured by a great stone wall with a single guarded entrance. The observation post commands views of the entire grounds.

cardPool.title: Beams From His Eyes
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Beams From His Eyes

Description:
A Quirk that allows the user to fire concentrated laser beams from their eyes. Blast intensity and size scale with the user's focus and concentration. Activation requires a specialized visor with a manual switch.

Functions/Applications:
Fire standard-intensity beams at targets within line of sight using the visor switch. Concentrate for larger, more powerful blasts. Useful for ranged combat, precision targeting, and tactical strikes.

Limits:
Requires manual visor activation; cannot fire without it. Demands direct line of sight on targets. Larger blasts require sustained concentration, leaving the user vulnerable. Overuse may cause eye strain or fatigue.

Additional Notes:
The visor prevents uncontrolled firing. User is entirely dependent on the equipment; loss or damage severely compromises combat effectiveness.

cardPool.title: Air Walk
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Air Walk

Description:
The user can stand on and manipulate air, creating invisible platforms for levitation and mid-air movement. This stolen quirk grants freedom of vertical mobility without physical support.

Functions/Applications:
Users float upward, walk on invisible air platforms, and hover at varying heights. This enables superior tactical positioning for ranged attacks, evasion, and terrain crossing. The quirk pairs well with ranged abilities for elevated vantage points while airborne.

Limits:
The user must maintain focus to keep platforms stable; lost concentration causes falling. The quirk cannot support movement while unconscious or severely incapacitated. Sustained flight exhausts stamina over time.

Additional Notes:
Air Walk is a stolen quirk, suggesting it may be removable or transferable.

cardPool.title: Air Cannon
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Air Cannon

Description:
A powerful ranged Quirk releasing devastating shockwaves of compressed air from the palms. Blasts vary based on arm motion—from concentrated linear shots to wide crescent air blades. Versatile for offense and defense.

Functions/Applications:
Primary ranged attack capable of destroying buildings and overwhelming multiple opponents. Can form barriers to block incoming attacks. Combines with other Quirks to amplify destructive power. Useful for initiating combat and wearing down enemies at range.

Limits:
Requires hand positioning and arm motion to execute. Interrupting the user mid-attack prevents discharge. Raw power mitigated by sufficiently strong defensive abilities. Less effective against mobile or shielded targets. Each blast requires brief preparation, leaving momentary vulnerability if repeated rapidly.

cardPool.title: Air Wall
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Air Wall

Description:
The user generates circular shields of densely compressed air from their hands to defend against incoming attacks. These barriers can be layered for enhanced protection or expanded into a protective dome. Shield durability fluctuates based on the user's focus and physical condition.

Functions/Applications:
Create defensive barriers where the user raises their hand. Stack multiple shields for cumulative defense. Expand into a full-body dome against multi-directional threats. Fire compressed air bursts as offensive blasts to knock back or stun enemies.

Limits:
Shields only manifest where the user directs their hand—agile foes can circle around unprotected areas. Durability degrades when the user is physically weakened, injured, or mentally unfocused. Cannot protect areas the user fails to anticipate.

cardPool.title: Big Horn
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Big Horn

Description:
The user manifests a pair of large, bull-like horns from their head. These physical extensions cannot be regrown once severed. The horns serve as a distinctive physical trait with potential social significance.

Functions/Applications:
The horns can be used for charging attacks or as weapons in direct combat. Severing a horn is rumored to enhance communication or perception abilities, though the mechanism remains debated.

Limits:
Horns cannot be regrown. The user cannot fully control horn growth or retraction. Severing causes permanent disfigurement and may alter the quirk's effectiveness. The horns provide no defensive capability beyond physical mass.

Additional Notes:
Big Horn is a simple appearance-based quirk with limited versatility.

cardPool.title: Big Fist
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Big Fist

Description:
Itsuka enlarges one or both hands to three times her body size with near-instant activation. Physical strength scales proportionally, granting immense crushing and striking power without affecting movement or balance.

Functions/Applications:
Close-range combat with devastating striking force. Enlarged hands serve as restraint tools, transport vessels for allies, protective barriers against hazards, and can generate wind to disperse gas traps. Hand momentum amplifies attack power.

Limits:
Short-range only with no ranged application. Enlarged hands obstruct vision and fine manipulation. Cannot be maintained indefinitely. Wind generation is limited in power and range. Large size eliminates surprise against aware opponents.

Additional Notes:
Optimal for rescue missions, restraint operations, and defense-breaking scenarios.

cardPool.title: Blade-Tooth
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Blade-Tooth

Description:
The user can enlarge, reshape, and manipulate their teeth into sharpened, blade-like incisors. These dental weapons can be fired or extended at will with speed and range, functioning as both melee and ranged attacks.

Functions/Applications:
Deploy tooth blades to barrage enemies. Use elongated teeth as projectiles or stabbing weapons at distance. Employ teeth as extra limbs for mobility and climbing. Reshape teeth to suit tactical needs—piercing points or broader blades for cutting.

Limits:
Teeth can shatter under sufficient blunt force. Extended dental blades require stamina to maintain and regenerate. Physical restraints limit but do not fully prevent Quirk use. Hardened defenses can resist or redirect tooth attacks if fast enough.

Additional Notes:
Users demonstrate mastery through constant offensive pressure and creative mobility.

cardPool.title: Blazing Hair
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Blazing Hair

Description:
The user's hair burns with controllable flames that can be shaped and weaponized at will. The fire originates from the user's head, allowing combat applications and enhanced mobility through aerial propulsion.

Functions/Applications:
Detach flaming hair strands to hurl as fireballs. Reshape flames into melee weapons like swords or blades. Generate thrust by manipulating hair flames downward for flight and speed. Combine applications for aerial maneuvers and ranged-melee hybrid attacks.

Limits:
Hair regeneration and flame supply are finite; sustained combat depletes reserves. Flight requires active concentration and continuous flame manipulation. Flames cannot extend far from the user's body or persist independently. Close-range opponents can extinguish flames through water-based counters or overwhelming defense.

cardPool.title: Body Bulk
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Body Bulk

Description:
A transformation quirk that expands and densifies the user's body, increasing muscle mass, size, and strength. It activates most powerfully during intense negative emotions like rage, hatred, or fear.

Functions/Applications:
Enhanced physical strength for combat and lifting; increased durability from thickened muscle tissue; emotional intensity amplifies transformation for temporary power surges. The user can control the degree of bulk from partial to full transformation.

Limits:
Requires emotional intensity for peak effectiveness; prolonged use causes fatigue and muscle soreness; increased mass reduces speed and agility. Control becomes difficult during extreme emotions, potentially causing recklessness in battle.

Additional Notes:
Originally stolen by All For One and gifted to the user.

cardPool.title: Cell Activation
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Cell Activation

Description:
A touch-based Quirk that stimulates cellular activity to accelerate natural healing, speed recovery, and temporarily enhance physical performance. Effects are immediate upon contact but drain the user's stamina with continued use.

Functions/Applications:
Rapidly heal wounds by accelerating tissue regeneration. Speed recovery and reduce fatigue in allies. Temporarily boost physical performance and strength. Useful in combat support or medical emergencies to restore wounded fighters.

Limits:
Incompatible with certain blood types; most variants work only on specific blood groups (Type A, O, and B documented; some restricted to Type A only). Drains user stamina significantly with prolonged activation, causing fatigue if overused. Extended healing requires recovery time before reliable reactivation.

cardPool.title: Dark Shadow
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Dark Shadow

Description:
A sentient shadowy entity manifesting from the user's body as a loyal, monster-like guardian. Tethered through an umbilical connection, it communicates telepathically. Dark Shadow is composed of dark energy—solid enough to interact physically—and can extend limbs and shift shape limitedly.

Functions/Applications:
Dark Shadow serves as both offensive weapon and defensive shield, stretching arms to grapple or slam enemies while the user maintains distance. It aids climbing, mobility, and simulated flight when trained. The entity grows exponentially more powerful in darkness, becoming a large, ferocious beast capable of devastating attacks that cleave through obstacles.

Limits:
Dark Shadow's energy depletes with extended distance from the host, rapid successive impacts, or overuse.

cardPool.title: Diesel Engine
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Diesel Engine

Description:
The user's head and upper body transform into a powerful diesel locomotive, granting enhanced speed and locomotive-like capabilities beyond normal human limits.

Functions/Applications:
Accelerated running speed for pursuit and evasion. Forceful charging attacks. Hardened metal construction provides defensive plating against impacts.

Limits:
Transformation limited to head and upper body; lower body remains human, causing balance and mobility issues. Heavy and cumbersome form reduces agility and turning speed. Requires fuel or energy consumption to maintain performance. Ineffective in tight spaces.

Additional Notes:
Creates distinctive silhouette that sacrifices stealth for raw power. Most effective in open terrain. User requires practice managing weight distribution between transformed and untransformed body parts.

cardPool.title: Electric Charge
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Electric Charge

Description:
A Quirk that grants the ability to harvest, store, and manipulate electrical currents. The user can channel electricity for offensive attacks, defensive maneuvers, and signal disruption. Tesla has natural immunity to external electrical-based Quirks due to constant electrical saturation within his body.

Functions/Applications:
Electric attacks for direct damage; jamming electronic systems and wireless signals; creating electrical barriers for defense; powering mechanical devices; neutralizing opponent electricity Quirks through immunity.

Limits:
Requires continuous access to electrical sources to maintain efficiency. Cannot generate electricity independently; relies on harvesting existing currents. Overuse risks circuit burnout in the nervous system. Insulated or isolated environments severely hinder utility.

cardPool.title: Electrification
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Electrification

Description:
Denki stores electrical energy and discharges it as a protective aura that shocks on contact. Higher outputs create omnidirectional bursts that illuminate areas. He can absorb incoming electrical attacks and power electronics.

Functions/Applications:
Close-range electroshock defense that paralyzes on contact. Area-of-effect discharge at high power. Absorbs enemy electrical attacks. Energizes devices. Sharpshooting Gear allows directing electricity through projectiles.

Limits:
Ineffective at range without equipment. Lacks directional control, risking friendly fire. Exceeding capacity causes hour-long brain short-circuit incapacitation. Insulation and non-conductive Quirks negate effectiveness. Panic triggers uncontrolled discharge. Restraint limits combat potential.

cardPool.title: Electricity Generation
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Electricity Generation

Description:
The user produces and manipulates electricity, releasing controlled lightning bolts with precision aiming and selective discharge to target enemies while avoiding allies.

Functions/Applications:
Fire lightning bolts at distant targets. Electrify conductive surfaces for tactical advantage. Provide illumination. Stun or damage multiple foes through chain reactions.

Limits:
Continuous use drains stamina rapidly. Range decreases with discharge intensity. Wet environments amplify power but risk uncontrolled spread. User cannot self-electrify without control, risking harm. Insulated targets resist damage.

Additional Notes:
Requires focus to aim; panic reduces accuracy. Overcharging risks explosive backfire. Most effective against metallic or conductive targets.

cardPool.title: Energy Saver
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Energy Saver

Description:
The user's body operates with exceptional metabolic efficiency, requiring minimal nutrition, hydration, and sleep while maintaining peak physical performance for extended periods.

Functions/Applications:
Sustain continuous high-intensity activity for 48+ hours without rest. Resume full functionality after only 3 hours of sleep. Survive on drastically reduced food and water intake while maintaining strength and endurance.

Limits:
The user still requires some nutrition, hydration, and sleep—complete deprivation will cause failure. Effectiveness scales with stamina-based Quirks. Does not enhance actual physical power, only sustainability. Mental fatigue may still accumulate despite physical resilience.

Additional Notes:
Energy Saver is a support Quirk best paired with high-endurance or strength-based abilities.

cardPool.title: Fast Fist
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Fast Fist

Description:
The user's hands and arms move at supernatural speed, striking up to 100 times per second in a blurred motion. By targeting pressure points with precision, the user can render targets unconscious.

Functions/Applications:
Rapid hand combat for overwhelming offense. Pressure point targeting enables knockout incapacitation without lethal force. Speed creates openings against slower opponents and allows defensive blocking.

Limits:
Confined to hands and arms only. User must move their body normally, limiting pursuit. Requires precision targeting for knockout effect. Fatigue limits sustained use.

Additional Notes:
Most effective against unarmored targets. Close-range Quirk with minimal distance utility. Control is difficult with accidental injury risk. User relies on conventional movement for positioning.

cardPool.title: Physical Enhancement
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Physical Enhancement

Description:
A transformation Quirk that envelops the user's body in a vibrant green flame-like aura, dramatically amplifying physical capabilities including strength, speed, and durability for powerful close-combat fighting.

Functions/Applications:
Activate the aura to boost muscle power and reflexes for enhanced striking force and mobility. The green flame provides offensive and defensive capabilities, effective against multiple enemies or single powerful opponents through sheer dominance.

Limits:
Requires conscious activation and sustained focus to maintain. Duration and intensity are limited, causing stamina depletion with extended use. Purely physical—no special mobility, flight, or ranged capabilities. Extremely powerful foes may still overwhelm enhanced strength.

cardPool.title: Rivet Stab
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Rivet Stab

Description:
The user generates black tendrils marked with red cracked lines extending from fingers, spine, palms, or other body parts. These tendrils are sharp, piercing weapons capable of impaling flesh and slicing through buildings.

Functions/Applications:
Tendrils can be launched individually or spread into mesh-like webs for area attacks. They regenerate and deploy repeatedly. The user controls whether tendrils cause harm or merely make contact. Advanced users combine Rivet Stab with other Quirks—using tendrils as conduits to activate distant targets' abilities, or fusing them with mouth-based Quirks to create composite weapons like vine structures with monstrous heads.

Limits:
Tendrils can be destroyed through sufficient force. The Quirk requires concentration for accurate targeting; synergy with tracking Quirks improves precision.

cardPool.title: Self-Detonation
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Self-Detonation

Description:
The user's body accumulates explosive energy, causing targeted body parts to swell and glow before detonating in a powerful blast. The explosion's force scales with the user's size and bioengineered modifications. Most users perish or suffer severe mutilation upon detonation unless enhanced with regeneration abilities.

Functions/Applications:
Generate devastating area-of-effect explosions by concentrating energy in specific limbs. Concentrate detonative power into strikes for explosive melee attacks. With regeneration modifications, repeatedly perform explosive attacks without permanent injury. Can be remotely triggered through external devices for controlled demolition or suicide missions.

Limits:
Unmodified self-detonation results in death or permanent mutilation.

cardPool.title: Shock Absorption
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Shock Absorption

Description:
The user absorbs kinetic energy and impact force from physical blows, reducing damage taken from strikes and collisions. Allows the bearer to withstand tremendous punishment, though it cannot completely nullify attacks—only diminish them.

Functions/Applications:
Reduces incoming physical damage by dispersing shock waves throughout the body. Effective against melee attacks, falls, and explosive force. Grants exceptional durability in direct combat without sustaining critical injuries from strikes.

Limits:
Has a cumulative threshold; continuous attacks will eventually overwhelm its capacity. Gradual, sustained damage bypasses effectiveness more efficiently than single powerful blows. Cannot absorb energy-based attacks or non-impact damage. Only reduces harm rather than eliminating it entirely.

cardPool.title: Slide and Glide
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Slide and Glide

Description:
Projects repulsive (blue) and attractive (green) force from hands and feet. User can propel across surfaces at high speed, cling to vertical surfaces, launch energy blasts, and achieve limited flight through momentum boosts. Mastery allows full-body force coating for protection and mobility.

Functions/Applications:
Rapid travel across ground and walls at vehicular speeds; climb vertical surfaces by attraction; fire repulsion beams from close-range to piercing projectiles; perform mid-air jumps for altitude and flight; project protective force fields for damage mitigation and light levitation.

Limits:
No built-in braking—user must reverse acceleration to stop, risking collision. Repulsion beams cause lethal damage, limiting safe combat. Multiple mid-air jumps require significant willpower; most users believe limited to two jumps.

cardPool.title: Tank Engine
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Tank Engine

Description:
The user's head and upper body transform into a functional steam locomotive. This grants superhuman strength and durability while maintaining consciousness and control. The transformation is permanent and always active.

Functions/Applications:
The user generates tremendous power for ramming attacks and unstoppable forward momentum. The metal chassis provides enhanced defense against conventional strikes. Steam pressure can be vented for propulsion boosts or defensive bursts. Heavy weight allows breaking through obstacles and barriers.

Limits:
Transformation severely restricts mobility and agility. The user cannot turn quickly or perform acrobatic movements. Overheating from excessive steam generation causes exhaustion. Water or coolant sources become critical for sustained use.

cardPool.title: Tool Arms
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Tool Arms

Description:
The user manifests and retracts limbs embedded with functional tools and weapons like chainsaws, hammers, and drills. These organic components grow from the body, making them difficult to disarm.

Functions/Applications:
Transform arms into melee weapons for combat. Utilize tools for environmental destruction or tactical advantage. Retract limbs instantly for defense or concealment.

Limits:
Manifested tool limbs reduce mobility and dexterity. Tool selection is limited to previously manifested forms. Rapid transformation causes fatigue with extended use.

Additional Notes:
Excels in direct combat but sacrifices precision and delicate tasks. The grotesque limbs may psychologically intimidate opponents. Works best against singular targets or in confined spaces.

cardPool.title: Fiber Master
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Fiber Master

Description:
Telekinetic control over fibers and fabrics. User can manipulate threads, cloth, and fiber materials to restrain enemies or transform their own denim into controllable strands. Denim is easiest to control; sweats most difficult. Works on synthetic fibers like carbon fiber.

Functions/Applications:
Restrain targets through their clothing. Unravel denim costume into whip-like strings for offense or defense. Redirect allies by manipulating garments. Requires concentration and available fabric sources.

Limits:
Cannot control naked or fiber-free targets. Strong-willed foes can resist. User loses control if distracted. Effectiveness depends on fabric quantity and type. Requires extensive training; deemed too difficult even for All For One to steal.

Additional Notes:
Ideal users wear denim-heavy costumes for constant fiber availability.

cardPool.title: Half-Cold Half-Hot
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Half-Cold Half-Hot

Description:
The user generates ice from their right side and fire from their left side, both originating internally. The power is perfectly balanced, granting two distinct combat methods. Advanced mastery allows combining both elements into "cold fire" that simultaneously burns and freezes.

Functions/Applications:
Ice side: Freeze structures, create barriers, form platforms and stairs, generate mobility waves, precision attacks, ground skating. Fire side: Generate intense heat and flames, propel forward, regulate warmth. Combined technique: Merge both elements for enhanced attacks with immunity to extreme temperatures.

Limits:
Overuse of either side without alternating causes fatal frostbite or overheating. Maximum output depletes reserves almost immediately. Prolonged ice usage lowers body temperature and attack effectiveness.

cardPool.title: Masaru Bakugo
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Masaru Bakugo

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Not specified (presumed Quirkless or minor Quirk)

Occupation/Role: Fashion designer; father of UA High School student Katsuki Bakugo

Personality: Calm and composed voice of reason in his volatile family. Loving and supportive yet often unsettled by conflict. Disapproves of his son's arrogance while acknowledging his abilities.

Appearance: Middle-aged man of average height with short brown hair, rectangular glasses, and a short mustache. Dresses in casual professional civilian attire.

Backstory: Once dreamed of becoming a Pro Hero but pursued fashion design instead. Met his wife Mitsuki at work and married her. Fathered Katsuki and has spent years balancing his son's gifted but arrogant nature with parental guidance.

Additional Information: Entrusts Katsuki's education to UA High School.

cardPool.title: Mitsuki Bakugo
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Mitsuki Bakugo

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Glycerin

Occupation/Role: Housewife; Mother of UA Class 1-A student Katsuki Bakugo

Personality: Assertive and aggressive like her son, yet capable of composure and respect. Recognizes Katsuki's flaws stem from innate talent and childhood praise; disapproves of his arrogance and occasionally disciplines him physically. Supportive of his hero aspirations.

Appearance: Spiky ash-blonde hair and sharp red eyes, youthful despite being in her late thirties due to her Quirk. Typically wears a white blouse under a lavender cardigan, black skirt, and reddish-purple house slippers.

Backstory: Mother to talented but arrogant Katsuki and wife to Masaru Bakugo. She has watched her son's exceptional abilities earn constant praise, cultivating his worst traits.

cardPool.title: Bakugo House
cardPool.value:
Name: Bakugo House

Location: A prosperous residential district in an urban settlement, set back from the street behind a protective stone wall.

Inhabitants: The Bakugo family—merchants or nobility who value learning and refinement. The master commands respect.

Appearance: A large, well-maintained detached mansion with sturdy construction and elegant design. The front features a manicured garden and defensive wall with an ornamental window. The spacious interior showcases floor-to-ceiling bookshelves filled with leather-bound volumes, fine furnishings, and polished wood. The home exudes quiet authority and scholarly ambition.

cardPool.title: Brightman Air Force Base
cardPool.value:
Name: Brightman Air Force Base

Location: Military installation serving as a deployment hub for advanced fighter aircraft operations and hero training.

Inhabitants: Military personnel, pilot trainees, combat officers, and hero Star and Stripe.

Appearance: A sprawling airfield with concrete runways and hangars housing X-66 fighter jets. Steel-reinforced facilities include barracks, command centers, and training grounds. Chain-link fences and guard posts secure the perimeter. Jet engines roar overhead as aircraft fly in formation.

cardPool.title: Wooden Swords From His Hands
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name: Wooden Swords From His Hands

Description: The user manifests solid wooden swords that materialize from their wrists on demand. The swords are fully formed, durable weapons suitable for combat and can be generated repeatedly without apparent limit.

Functions/Applications: Create wooden swords for melee combat, dual-wield multiple swords simultaneously, generate weapons quickly in surprise encounters, or equip allies with melee weapons. The wooden construction makes them safer for sparring or controlled combat.

Limits: Swords are wooden rather than metal, reducing cutting power and durability against hardened materials or reinforced defenses. Generation requires conscious effort from the wrists, potentially limiting use if those limbs are restrained or injured. The swords cannot be customized beyond basic form.

cardPool.title: Quirk Bestowal
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Quirk Bestowal

Description:
A transfer-based Quirk with no combat function. The user can pass their Quirk to another person through DNA contact. Transfer requires the user's consent but not the recipient's. This Quirk is immune to theft and cannot be stolen by All For One.

Functions/Applications:
Grants the ability to voluntarily transfer the Quirk and any absorbed Quirks to a successor through biological material. The transfer can be selective—passing only certain components while retaining others. Hostile transfer can weaponize the process against the recipient.

Limits:
The Quirk has no offensive or defensive capabilities independent of transfer. It manifested late and remained undetectable due to weakness. Cannot be forced upon an unwilling user and requires direct biological contact.

cardPool.title: Quirk Singularity
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Quirk Singularity (Theoretical Concept)

Description:
A postulated phenomenon where Quirks grow exponentially stronger across generations through genetic blending. Human bodies cannot evolve quickly enough to control these increasingly powerful abilities, eventually reaching a critical point where they become uncontrollable and unstable.

Functions/Applications:
Users can recognize signs of Quirk evolution in themselves or others through enhanced power, mutation of existing abilities, or involuntary manifestations. Those aware of the theory may attempt to manage or suppress their evolving Quirk before critical instability, or weaponize the knowledge to justify control of society.

Limits:
This is not a combat Quirk but a framework for understanding ability growth. It cannot be used in battle.

cardPool.title: Quirkless
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Quirkless

Description:
A complete absence of superhuman abilities or meta-powers. Quirkless individuals are born without superpowers in a world where 80% of humans possess them, making them genetic outliers and social minorities.

Functions/Applications:
Immunity to Quirk-targeted attacks including Trigger Bombs, Erasure-type Quirks, and Quirk Factor manipulation. Unaffected by Quirk Singularity phenomena. Can pursue non-heroic careers without disadvantage. Cannot be classified as villains since villainy requires Quirk use.

Limits:
Vulnerable to all conventional physical threats and weapons. Prohibited from most hero work due to inability to combat dangerous situations. Subject to severe social discrimination. Cannot legally become a Pro Hero in most societies.

Additional Notes:
Increasingly rare trait with recessive genetic inheritance.

cardPool.title: Humarise
cardPool.value:
[Humarise]

Type: Extremist Cult Organization

Humarise was a global cult-like organization led by Flect Turn. Originating from Otheon, the group based its ideology on the Quirk Singularity Doomsday Theory — the belief that Quirks will evolve until they become uncontrollable and destroy humanity. Although never fully proven, Humarise treated it as absolute truth.

Members viewed Quirks as a disease threatening mankind. People with Quirks were labeled "infected" or "diseased," while Quirkless individuals were regarded as "pure humans." Believing themselves humanity's saviors, Humarise dedicated itself to eradicating Quirks by any means necessary.

Operating across multiple countries with hidden cells and loyal followers, Humarise grew into a dangerous extremist movement feared for its fanaticism, secrecy, and willingness to commit mass destruction.

cardPool.title: Fa Jin
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Fa Jin

Description:
Fa Jin allows the user to accumulate kinetic energy through repetitive movements, manifesting as red glowing energy. When released, this stored energy grants explosive bursts of speed and power through any body part. The user can deploy partial amounts for sequential bursts rather than expending everything at once.

Functions/Applications:
Fa Jin amplifies physical strikes and movement speed upon release. It synergizes with other Quirks—enhancing Blackwhip for restraints, boosting Float for increased flight speed, and combining with Gearshift for devastating acceleration. The stored kinetic energy stacks with other power sources for composite attacks of exceptional force.

Limits:
Building kinetic energy requires significant time and repetitive motion. Premature release reduces power output efficiency.

cardPool.title: Yu
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Yu

Alias: Member of Feathers idol duo

Quirk Name: Unknown

Occupation/Role: Underground idol performer, student at East Naruhata High School

Personality: Kind and sensitive, contrasting with her twin sister Miu. Yu agrees with Miu's gossip but with restraint, occasionally telling her to moderate offensive remarks. She possesses genuine empathy and gentle demeanor.

Appearance: Short stature with straight, shoulder-length light hair in a high ponytail on her right side with side-swept bangs covering her left eye. Dark, softly tilted eyes give her an innocent expression. Her idol costume mirrors Miu's design but inverted—darker bodice, paler skirt, with large feather accent. She wears knee-length sleeveless dresses, tights, and long gloves. During FeatherHATS performances, she adds a small top hat with feather detail.

cardPool.title: Lizard Tail Splitter
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Lizard Tail Splitter

Description:
The user detaches and telekinetically controls multiple body segments simultaneously. Severed segments with vital organs (eyes, brain, mouth, heart) remain functional while separated, allowing remote sensory input and organ operation.

Functions/Applications:
Multi-angle reconnaissance using floating eye segments. Distributed melee attacks with numerous fast pieces. Long-range harassment through hard-to-hit projectiles. Organ-based spying through detached jaws or eyes. Evasion via body dispersal.

Limits:
Segments have limited time before losing function. Maximum 50 pieces depending on segment length. Exhausted regeneration forces physical regrouping, exposing location. Individual pieces are weak and vulnerable. Controlling many pieces simultaneously requires intense focus.

cardPool.title: Tail
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Tail

Description:
A prehensile appendage extending from the lower posterior, longer and wider than a human limb. The tail is topped with blonde hair and functions as a third, fully capable limb with considerable strength and durability.

Functions/Applications:
The tail serves as a melee weapon strong enough to break metal and restrain enemies. It launches the user upward when slapped against the ground, enables climbing by wrapping around poles, and supports acrobatic martial arts. Can point directionally or perform simple gestures.

Limits:
The tail is as vulnerable to damage as any body part and cannot replicate hand complexity for intricate tasks. Its permanent nature restricts comfortable sitting and lying, requiring tailor-made clothing. Combat patterns become predictable as the tail drives fighting in recognizable ways.

cardPool.title: Search
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Search

Description:
A surveillance Quirk allowing the user to monitor up to one hundred individuals by targeting their Quirk Factor and DNA. Targets appear as star-like vestiges trackable from miles away. The Quirk's eyes glow rainbow-colored during activation and permanently store gathered data.

Functions/Applications:
Locate multiple targets across vast distances; identify weak points of observed individuals; distinguish between multiple Quirk Factors in one person; maintain a permanent database of scanned subjects; coordinate long-distance tactical operations.

Limits:
Vulnerable to misdirection and deception if users over-rely on data without verification. Cannot distinguish actual targets from false readings if the target's biological material is present elsewhere. Requires initial contact or proximity to store data on a subject.

Personality: Brash, selfless, and fiercely protective with intense justice. Admires All Might and defies rules to save others. Kind and sisterly to her team, though sometimes ignorant outside her jurisdiction. Willing to sacrifice everything for those she protects.

Appearance: A tall woman with an athletic build and elegant features. Long flowing blonde hair styled in eight backward-swept tufts, narrow brown eyes, and a red domino mask. Her skin-tight bodysuit features striped patterns on the upper torso, metal-studded gauntlets and collar with star designs, and a long striped cape resembling the U.S. flag.

Backstory: Inspired by All Might saving her family during his time abroad, Cathleen dedicated herself to heroism.

cardPool.title: Sekijiro Kan
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Sekijiro Kan

Alias: Blood Hero: Vlad King

Quirk Name: Blood Control

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero and homeroom teacher of Class 1-B at UA High School

Personality: Gruff and strict but genuinely caring toward his students. He encourages excellence and uses Class 1-A as motivation, showing comedic bias for Class 1-B. Quick to react in danger and values fellow teachers' well-being.

Appearance: Exceptionally tall and muscular with lightly tanned skin. Short pale gray hair spiked upward with one clump over his left forehead. Very small thin eyes, wide mouth with prominent lower canines. Dark red skin-tight hero costume with low U-shaped collar, black Y-shaped trim, white over-the-knee boots, red gloves, and orange eye mask. Wire connects left vambrace to back of neck.

Backstory: Experienced Pro Hero at UA High School for years. Knew All Might's true form and regretted not supporting him more as Symbol of Peace. Maintains close friendship with teacher Hound Dog.

Additional Information: Blood Ejecting Gauntlet allows ejecting and reabsorbing large blood quantities. Quirk grants enhanced strength and speed with tolerance for fatal blood loss.

cardPool.title: Sickle Claw
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Sickle Claw
Quirk Name: Iron Claws
Occupation/Role: F-rank Villain
Personality: Confident despite low rank, aggressive and straightforward; willing to challenge professional heroes.
Appearance: Short man with severely deformed face, bald elongated head, and widely spaced stalked eyes. Wide mouth with prominent teeth. Solid iron hands with four large metallic claws. Wears dark blue sleeveless gi and matching loafers.
Backstory: Recruited by Tomura Shigaraki for the U.S.J. assault. Engaged the injured Shota Aizawa during the invasion but was defeated and arrested when Pro Heroes arrived.
Additional Information: F-rank villain with minimal history. His weak combat ability became apparent when overpowered by an injured Aizawa despite his overconfidence.

cardPool.title: Toshie Yagi
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Toshie Yagi

Alias: None

Quirk Name: None

Occupation/Role: Homemaker, Mother

Personality: Kind and patient, deeply devoted to her son Toshinori. She supported his heroic dreams despite his lack of a Quirk, reading superhero stories with him regularly. Gentle and nurturing.

Appearance: A tall woman with bright golden blonde hair in two distinctive tufts at the sides, worn long and held back with a scrunchie. Soft grey eyes and thin eyebrows give her a gentle appearance.

Backstory: Mother of Toshinori Yagi, later All Might. She raised her Quirkless son with love and encouragement, reading superhero books to fuel his dreams. Toshie was killed during civil unrest caused by All For One's influence, profoundly shaping her son's resolve to become a hero.

Additional Information: Deceased before the series begins. Her legacy directly inspired All Might's heroic path and his later adoption by Nana Shimura. She represents the foundational love that shaped the world's greatest hero.

cardPool.title: One For All
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
One For All

Description:
A transferable stockpiling Quirk formed from merging a power accumulation ability with a Quirk transference ability. It allows the user to accumulate immense physical power that compounds with each user's training and can be transferred to another person via blood contact.

Functions/Applications:
Grants superhuman strength, speed, and durability that multiplies across generations. The user inherits all accumulated power from previous hosts and adds their own strength to the reservoir. Power transfers through direct blood contact, passing both the Quirk and stockpiled strength to a new host.

Limits:
Possession dramatically shortens the user's lifespan due to strain from maintaining two Quirks simultaneously. Transfer requires direct blood contact and willing acceptance or forced biological integration. If transferred to someone with All For One's Quirk, it becomes permanently destroyed.

Additional Notes:
Created when All For One gave his younger brother Yoichi a stockpiling Quirk, unknowingly uniting it with Yoichi's hidden transference ability. Each user must actively train to unlock full potential.

cardPool.title: Gearshift
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Gearshift

Description:
Gearshift manipulates acceleration and speed, allowing the user to alter how quickly objects or beings move through space while ignoring normal inertia laws. After merging with One For All, it became a devastating power that envelops targets in blue energy aura.

Functions/Applications:
Can drastically accelerate the user's body or external targets to sonic-boom-inducing speeds with massive impact force. Effective when combined with other abilities—enhancing combat moves, boosting projectiles, or launching allies at extreme velocities. Works at cellular levels when fully evolved.

Limits:
Initial use limited to five minutes before severe incapacitation. Prolonged use causes oxygen deprivation. Repeated activation stacks exponential damage and pain—second use doubles the blowback, risking paralysis. If transferred during recoil recovery, the backlash affects the new user.

Additional Notes:
Primary user managed bullet trajectories through arm gauntlets. Most effective as a last resort due to control difficulty and severe physical toll.

cardPool.title: New Order
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
New Order

Description:
A reality-warping Quirk allowing the user to impose rules onto targets by touching them and speaking their name. Rules can redefine properties of physical objects, living beings, the environment, or other Quirks. Conditional rules based on cause-and-effect are possible, fundamentally altering how reality functions within the user's influence.

Functions/Applications:
Grant temporary abilities, manipulate bodily functions, affect intangible things like air and energy, suppress other Quirks, create conditional effects. Rules persist even if the Quirk transfers to another user.

Limits:
User can only maintain two active rules simultaneously. Rules require direct physical contact and verbal naming. Living beings with strong self-awareness can resist if the user's understanding of their identity doesn't match reality. Rules cannot affect targets indirectly through clever wording. Power enhancement has a hard ceiling—cannot become invincible or match All Might's strength. Inanimate objects are far easier to affect than conscious beings.

cardPool.title: Wave Motion
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Wave Motion

Description:
Wave Motion converts the user's vitality into golden spiral energy discharged as powerful blast waves. The user can adjust intensity and release energy from their palms or feet. This Quirk drains stamina with each use, but training builds massive vitality reserves and stamina resilience.

Functions/Applications:
Offensive blasts against large or slow enemies; mobility enhancement through levitation and rapid repositioning; close-range combat amplification; support applications including civilian rescue and object manipulation; defensive mid to long-range protection.

Limits:
The spiraling energy travels slower than direct projectiles. Overuse causes significant fatigue and stamina depletion. The user cannot sustain prolonged discharge without exhaustion. Energy output requires conscious control to avoid harming allies or civilians.

Additional Notes:
The Quirk's true strength lies in battlefield control and versatility rather than raw speed. Users benefit from combining mobility and close-range tactics to compensate for slow projectile travel. Extensive training increases available vitality and fatigue resistance.

cardPool.title: Accelerator Rings
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Accelerator Rings

Description:
The user generates yellow rings of energy from their hands and feet that release directional bursts of force before dissipating. Originally manifested in infancy but stolen before full development, the Quirk has grown dramatically in strength through exposure to other Quirks.

Functions/Applications:
Launch self across great distances and achieve rapid aerial maneuverability through multiple simultaneous ring activations. Deliver swift, crushing blows using velocity bursts. Can scale to building-size rings when combined with other Quirks, enabling continental-range flight and massive force delivery.

Limits:
The variable delay between ring generation and force release creates timing vulnerability. Rings dissipate after activation, requiring continuous generation for sustained movement. Current power level is inflated by mingling with stolen Quirks rather than reflecting true baseline. Requires precise control for delicate aerial maneuvering versus raw acceleration.

Additional Notes:
Effectiveness varies dramatically depending on user's control and whether operating independently or alongside other Quirks.

cardPool.title: 2D-ify
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
2D-ify

Description:
A transformation Quirk that converts three-dimensional beings and objects into two-dimensional paintings trapped within picture frames. The user channels this power through specially prepared frames, absorbing targets into flat, painted forms that retain consciousness and limited mobility.

Functions/Applications:
The user can immobilize enemies by framing them as paintings, removing them from active combat while keeping them alive. Trapped victims remain aware and can move within their painted form, but cannot escape the frame's boundaries. This allows for non-lethal containment or strategic removal of threats.

Limits:
The Quirk deactivates and releases trapped subjects if the user becomes immobilized or incapacitated. The user requires a physical picture frame to activate the ability and likely has limits on simultaneous containment.

Additional Notes:
This Quirk excels at crowd control and capture but fails against swift opponents who can disable the user before frames are deployed. The exact mechanics of how consciousness persists in painted form remain mysterious, suggesting untapped potential or hidden weaknesses.

cardPool.title: Acid
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Acid

Description:
The user secretes corrosive gray acid from their skin, which naturally resists its effects. Skin pigmentation turns purple-pink during activation. The user generates acid in high quantities from any body part and manipulates its solubility and viscosity.

Functions/Applications:
Create corrosive barriers by raising viscosity. Burn through walls and barriers. Melt handholds into vertical surfaces. Generate slippery acid pools for mobility. At maximum output, condense and release acid with devastating force. Lower solubility to reduce harm to living targets.

Limits:
Prolonged use causes skin to lose acid resistance, risking severe corrosion and dehydration. User struggles with precision control around living beings. Accidental self-dissolution of clothing occurs without careful focus. Endurance is limited by stamina and the body's tolerance.

Additional Notes:
User wears acid-proof footwear with ventilation holes. Constant training builds skin durability.

cardPool.title: Acid Sweat
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Acid Sweat

Description:
The user secretes acidic sweat from their palms with explosive properties. Unlike stronger variants, the acid cannot be forced—it emerges passively like normal perspiration, limiting control and output intensity.

Functions/Applications:
Rubbing hands together generates controlled explosions for combat or obstacle destruction. The acidic sweat corrodes materials over time. Better for sustained pressure than burst damage.

Limits:
Explosions are weaker than forced-secretion variants and depend on natural sweat production rates. Cannot trigger explosions without hand friction. Power scales with physical exertion and stress levels. Extended use causes hand fatigue and skin irritation.

Additional Notes:
This quirk serves as a genetic foundation for potent explosion-type quirks when combined with compatible partner quirks. The passive sweat secretion makes it unsuitable for stealth applications.

cardPool.title: Alchemy
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Alchemy

Description:
Valdo transmutes non-living matter into objects or energy. He reshapes while maintaining contact, creates functional constructs, manipulates appearance with durable bodysuits, and generates kinetic shockwave attacks through energy conversion.

Functions/Applications:
Create weapons, tools, and devices from materials. Fashion protective bodysuits for appearance alteration and durability. Generate ranged kinetic energy attacks. Construct golems for combat or labor. Modify terrain through pillars and pitfalls. Repair and modify creations while touching them.

Limits:
Cannot transmute living organisms. Bodysuits are hollow—tear to reveal weaker true form. Constructs collapse if user is incapacitated. Kinetic shockwaves require focus. Constructs can be destroyed or bypassed. Requires physical contact to initiate transmutation.

Additional Notes:
Valdo commonly converts gold coins into kinetic energy projectiles.

cardPool.title: Anivoice
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Anivoice

Description:
A sound-based Quirk enabling communication and command of animals through speech. The user's head progressively hardens and develops horns, amplifying range and eventually enabling telepathic animal communication. Humans and artificial creatures are immune.

Functions/Applications:
Command animals for tactical purposes—insects for infiltration, birds for reconnaissance, predators for combat. With vocal training and amplification equipment, control large animal groups across distances. Telepathic horns enable silent communication when developed.

Limits:
Range depends on vocal strength and equipment; requires speech (silence disables the Quirk). Loud sounds disrupt commands and scare animals. Animals understand only basic intent—no complex dialogue. Humans and artificial creatures unaffected. User's personal fears can create psychological friction despite normal function.

Additional Notes:
The Quirk appears to foster genuine animal cooperation. Voice amplifiers significantly expand range. Development is gradual but stress or conflict accelerates horn growth and capability upgrades.

cardPool.title: Anthropomorph
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Anthropomorph

Description:
A Meta Ability allowing the user to transform human-sized objects into perfect lookalike puppets of any person. Multiple puppets can be created simultaneously and remotely controlled via earpiece devices with letter codes. The puppets are formed from liquid substance exuded from the user's hand and can be customized with clothing and altered appearances.

Functions/Applications:
Create decoys for infiltration and reconnaissance. Overwhelm opponents through numerical superiority. Exploit psychological vulnerabilities by replicating traumatic figures. Control puppets from a distance while maintaining battlefield awareness.

Limits:
Requires human-sized physical objects as templates. Remote control range limited by earpiece signal. Puppets possess no independent intelligence and follow direct orders only. Transformation takes time, creating vulnerability during execution. Puppets can be damaged or destroyed through sufficient force.

Additional Notes:
Most effective for commanders or manipulators excelling at long-range strategy. The psychological impact of seeing duplicated loved ones or enemies can be weaponized.

cardPool.title: Antigen Swap
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Antigen Swap

Description:
The user can alter their blood type at will, changing their biochemical composition instantaneously to leave no biological trace and evade blood-based identification.

Functions/Applications:
Eliminates forensic tracking via blood samples. Bypasses blood-type-specific effects or abilities. Can counter blood-based restraints or curses when combined with other Quirks.

Limits:
Does not affect physical injuries or wound closure. Cannot be used while severely blood-depleted or unconscious. Switching requires concentration and rapid changes are exhausting. Does not fool abilities that detect Quirk usage itself.

Additional Notes:
Primarily defensive and evasive rather than offensive. Most effective for espionage, investigation avoidance, and countering blood-manipulation Quirks.

cardPool.title: Arbor
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Arbor

Description:
A wood-generation Quirk allowing the user to sprout and manipulate wooden tendrils from any part of their body. These tendrils extend over long distances with precise control, enabling multi-tasking and complex maneuvers.

Functions/Applications:
Restraint and binding of enemies. Rescue operations by wrapping tendrils around casualties. Evasion and locomotion by grasping structures and swinging through urban environments. Can manipulate tendrils independently across the body.

Limits:
Highly vulnerable to fire and explosion-based attacks due to wood's combustibility. Tendrils require physical anchor points for swinging. Sustained control of multiple tendrils simultaneously causes fatigue.

Additional Notes:
Arbor excels in rescue scenarios and crowd control but struggles against fire-type Quirks. Best used defensively or for non-lethal subdual. Works well in urban environments with tall structures for mobility.

cardPool.title: Attraction of Small Objects
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name: Attraction of Small Objects

Description: A gravity-based telekinetic ability allowing the user to pull lightweight objects toward themselves through hand gestures. Objects are drawn gradually, requiring sustained concentration and repeated hand movements to guide items across distance.

Functions/Applications: Retrieving distant items without moving, gathering scattered objects, pulling lightweight tools or weapons closer during combat, manipulating small objects in puzzles without physical contact.

Limits: Only affects objects lighter than a book; heavier items cannot be moved. Requires multiple hand movements rather than instant activation. Works within moderate room-range. Cannot function on living creatures or organic matter.

Additional Notes: Operates on gravitational principles rather than pure telekinesis, suggesting localized gravity field manipulation. Effectiveness depends on hand gesture precision and user concentration. Best suited for utility and support rather than direct combat.

cardPool.title: Barrier
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name: Barrier

Description: Hekiji Tengai generates telekinetic protective domes around himself and nearby allies. The barriers manifest as invisible but tangible force fields with exceptional durability, comparable to striking steel. He can adjust barrier size and deployment speed with practiced control.

Functions/Applications: Deploy personal defense barriers instantly; expand barriers to protect additional allies within range; scale barrier radius strategically; react to incoming threats with rapid activation; maintain continuous protection during combat.

Limits: Purely defensive—cannot damage or repel enemies offensively. Hekiji must remain at the barrier's center, preventing remote protection. Extreme overwhelming force can shatter barriers. Physical exhaustion or injury prevents summoning new barriers. Effectiveness diminishes against sustained, concentrated attacks.

Additional Notes: Ideal for tanking and protecting teammates. The Quirk's strength depends on Hekiji's stamina and health condition. Smaller barriers may be more durable than larger ones.

cardPool.title: Bat
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Bat

Description:
Grants bat-like features including wings, fangs, pointed ears, and enhanced sensory organs. User gains superhuman speed and flight that scales with Trigger enhancement.

Functions/Applications:
High-speed running and aerial flight. Enhanced olfactory tracking over long distances. Powerful claws for grappling and carrying targets. Physical strength increases with Trigger modification.

Limits:
Base flight is minimal without Trigger enhancement. Olfactory tracking requires scent sources and can be disrupted by competing odors. Wings restrict fine manipulation. Sustained high-speed flight drains stamina.

Additional Notes:
Trigger enhancement transforms user into monstrous bat-humanoid with exponentially improved physical prowess and sensory range. Combat effectiveness increases substantially under Trigger but risks loss of control.

cardPool.title: Beast
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Beast

Description:
Jurota transforms into a massive, feral creature covered in thick fur with enlarged fangs and claws. His body grows significantly larger and more animalistic, granting immense physical prowess. He retains partial intelligence despite heightened aggression.

Functions/Applications:
Superhuman strength and speed for combat; enhanced sense of smell with impressive range for tracking and scouting; ability to maul opponents with claws and fangs; temporary reversion to human form for evasion; capable of carrying additional weight while transformed; resistance to electrical damage.

Limits:
Transformation increases target size, making evasion more difficult; user becomes reckless and overeager when transformed, leading to poor tactical decisions; sense of smell can be masked or confused by strong odors; straight melee combat vulnerability if opponent exploits his larger frame.

Additional Notes:
Beast is optimal for sustained confrontations and direct assault. Jurota's greatest weakness is sensory deception. Switching between forms grants tactical flexibility but requires conscious effort.

cardPool.title: Big Monkey
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Big Monkey

Description:
A transformation Quirk that allows the user to assume the form of a giant ape, granting immense size, strength, and durability. Typically dormant and only activates under Trigger drug influence.

Functions/Applications:
The user gains massive physical strength for devastating attacks. The enlarged form provides increased durability and allows physical domination through size alone.

Limits:
Transformation requires Trigger drug stimulation; cannot activate naturally. Duration and control are limited by Trigger's effects. The enlarged form reduces mobility and agility. Mental control is compromised under Trigger influence, affecting decision-making.

Additional Notes:
This Quirk is heavily dependent on external substances, making the user vulnerable without Trigger. Long-term use carries significant health and addiction risks.

cardPool.title: Binging Ball
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Binging Ball

Description:
The user generates small floating spheres with mouths that emerge from their body. These orbs act as independent projectiles capable of consuming various materials through their mouths.

Functions/Applications:
Spheres launch at high velocity as ranged attacks and can ingest materials to destroy obstacles or clear debris. Multiple spheres can be deployed simultaneously for multi-directional offense.

Limits:
Spheres have limited range and durability. Sustained consumption likely drains stamina. Spheres cannot be controlled once launched, moving only in set trajectories. Close-range combat capability is minimal.

Additional Notes:
Best utilized for mid-range combat and environmental destruction. Effectiveness depends on sphere generation speed and material hardness limits.

cardPool.title: Black
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Black

Description:
The user can merge their entire body into any dark-colored object or shadow, becoming one with it. They move freely through darkness at high speeds and can control the merged object's movements, even if it's naturally mobile like an animal or living thing.

Functions/Applications:
Ambush attacks from within shadows or dark objects. Transport through darkness while carrying others. Possession and control of dark-colored creatures or appendages. Evasion by merging into nearby dark environments. Manipulation of mobile dark objects to create distractions or barriers.

Limits:
Exposure to bright light forces instant ejection from the dark object. Only works with naturally dark colors or shadows—bright objects are inaccessible. Cannot merge if physically forced into a dark object against will. Ineffective in well-lit areas with minimal shadows. Does not account for mass, so tiny dark objects may prove unstable for extended use.

Additional Notes:
Most powerful in cramped, shadowy spaces where opponents have limited mobility. Light-based Quirks are direct counters.

cardPool.title: Black Hole
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Black Hole

Description:
A destructive ability that creates small black holes from the user's fingers, pulling in and atomizing matter and energy like light. The user's hands bear dark markings from prolonged use.

Functions/Applications:
Generate suction fields to pull enemies and disable attacks. Disintegrate debris for cleanup. Create inescapable gravitational zones. Neutralize energy-based attacks.

Limits:
User is not immune and will disintegrate if caught in their own black hole. Must deactivate before targets reach atomic disintegration range, leaving user vulnerable. Unsuitable for close-quarters combat. Enemies with redirection or spatial manipulation Quirks can turn suction against the user. Loss of fingers or hands eliminates functionality. Brief exposure leaves victims in critical condition.

Additional Notes:
Originally developed for rescue and disaster relief, not combat. User typically employs it defensively to halt advances rather than offensively. The Quirk's destructive potential is offset by ethical restraint and inexperience in battle. Highly volatile if not carefully controlled.

cardPool.title: Blackwhip
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Blackwhip

Description:
The user generates controllable energy tendrils from any body part, appearing black with teal luminescent outlines. Power scales with emotional intensity, particularly anger and hatred. Originally top-grade, it gains exponential potential when integrated with One For All.

Functions/Applications:
Offensive restraint and enemy binding; mobility via grappling and swinging; object manipulation; internal reinforcement for limbs and muscles; puppeteering one's own body when paralyzed; protective armor coating.

Limits:
Control tied to emotional stability—uncontrolled anger causes loss of precision and potential self-harm. High-power usage causes severe numbness and pain; full strength causes user submission. Extended high-percentage duration risks injury. Safe operation requires staying calm and remaining below 5% power output for sustained use.

Additional Notes:
Mastery develops through practice; low-power versions enable support techniques. Emotional regulation is critical—careless use risks catastrophic loss of control.

cardPool.title: Blast
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Blast

Description:
A ranged energy projection quirk allowing the user to fire continuous bursts of powerful energy from their body. Energy can be channeled through hands and legs via specialized hero gear. Each blast carries significant stopping power.

Functions/Applications:
