Rapid-fire energy projectiles for combat suppression and villain neutralization. Energy can be redirected through costume augmentations to strike multiple angles. Sustained barrages provide overwhelming offensive pressure and crowd control.

Limits:
The user is temporarily blinded by intense flashes from their own blasts, causing severe aiming inaccuracy. Extended use risks self-inflicted blindness. Protective eyewear negates the blinding effect and restores accuracy but requires constant wearing during combat.

Additional Notes:
Blast is effective for straightforward combat but demands tactical awareness to compensate for accuracy problems without eye protection. The quirk's true strength emerges with proper countermeasures, making gear customization critical to performance.

cardPool.title: Blood Control
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Blood Control

Description:
Manipulate your own blood after it leaves your body, controlling its flow and hardening it into solid constructs. You can withstand massive blood loss and reabsorb expelled blood through specialized equipment.

Functions/Applications:
Harden blood into restraints or barriers. Release blood through gloves for offensive pressure attacks. Reabsorb blood to recover resources mid-combat. Create whip-like blood streams for striking or grappling.

Limits:
Blood must leave your body before you can control it. Requires specialized gloves and tubing system. Excessive blood loss causes weakness despite enhanced tolerance. Blood hardens slowly and can be destroyed before solidifying.

Additional Notes:
This Quirk trades health for combat utility—strategic blood management is essential. Works best in prolonged fights where reabsorption is possible. Psychological impact of self-inflicted bleeding may affect morale. Ineffective against opponents who prevent blood from leaving the body or contaminate it.

cardPool.title: Bloodcurdle
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Bloodcurdle

Description:
A parasitic quirk granting an extraordinarily long, textured tongue covered in papillae. By making contact between their tongue and a target's blood, the user can ingest it and trigger temporary paralysis lasting up to 8 minutes, with duration varying by blood type.

Functions/Applications:
The user collects blood samples from wounds or surfaces, then licks the blood to paralyze their target, leaving them vulnerable for finishing moves. Works on any opponent regardless of strength, making it effective for ambushes or one-on-one combat.

Limits:
Paralysis duration is unpredictable since blood type cannot be identified beforehand; type O causes shortest paralysis while type B causes longest. Maximum paralysis caps at 8 minutes. Quirks that expel or alter blood can break the effect. The user requires physical access to the target's blood and must wound their opponent first.

Additional Notes:
This quirk demands cunning strategy and battlefield control rather than raw power. Users benefit from weapons, stealth tactics, and combat skill to obtain initial blood samples.

cardPool.title: Bloodlet
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Bloodlet

Description:
A dangerous Quirk allowing the user to expel and absorb their own blood at will. The user can withstand extreme blood loss that would kill a normal person, making them difficult to incapacitate through bleeding.

Functions/Applications:
Expel blood as a weapon or distraction; absorb expelled blood to recover fluids and maintain combat capability; counter blood-based Quirks; survive injuries that rely on blood loss.

Limits:
Cannot manipulate others' blood, only the user's own. Expelling all blood leaves the user vulnerable during reabsorption. Does not heal wounds, only prevents death from blood loss. Requires access to expelled blood for recovery.

Additional Notes:
Most effective when paired with other Quirks. The psychological impact of blood expulsion can disorient opponents. Extended use risks organ damage.

cardPool.title: Blueflame
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Blueflame

Description:
A fire-generation Quirk allowing the user to create intensely hot blue flames on their body with minimal effort. Flames burn at temperatures exceeding 2,000°C and ignite with near-instantaneous speed. Power scales with emotional state—greater anger produces hotter, more uncontrollable flames.

Functions/Applications:
Instantly combust objects and living creatures on contact. Deploy flames across the entire body or concentrated areas for offensive combat. Blue flames prove effective against shadow-based opponents. At extreme emotional distress, the Quirk can manifest secondary ice-based abilities.

Limits:
The user's body cannot withstand the heat generated due to inherited cold-resistant genetics. Prolonged use causes severe burns, skin deterioration, and numbness. Emotional instability causes uncontrollable ignition, potentially harming the user. Extended combat is impossible—the Quirk severely limits endurance without catastrophic self-injury.

Additional Notes:
Blueflame is a double-edged power; tremendous offensive capability is offset by devastating physical consequences. The user must maintain emotional control to prevent self-immolation.

cardPool.title: Body Morph
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Body Morph

Description:
A transformation quirk that grants two additional arms beyond the natural pair, along with enhanced physical strength. All limbs are fully functional and controllable.

Functions/Applications:
Perform multiple tasks simultaneously, lift heavier objects, wield additional weapons or tools, and gain superior grappling advantage. Enhanced strength amplifies striking power across all limbs.

Limits:
Extra arms require conscious coordination; sudden growth is disorienting. Fatigue affects all four limbs equally and increases stamina demands. Opponents can target additional limbs as weak points.

Additional Notes:
Excels in versatility and raw power but trades finesse for brute force. Heavy armor or tight spaces hinder movement. The quirk is always active, making stealth difficult.

cardPool.title: Bombify
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Bombify

Description:
The user mutates body parts to grow bombs of various sizes from their surface. Specialized Bomber cells embedded in the user's body allow rapid manifestation of explosive ordnance across multiple limbs.

Functions/Applications:
Create bombs on fists, arms, and other body parts for ranged or melee explosive attacks. Bombs vary in size and yield. Synergizes with Self-Detonation to trigger explosives and Regeneration to restore damaged limbs.

Limits:
Requires Bomber cells to function. Larger bombs require longer manifestation time. Each detonation leaves the user temporarily limbless unless Regeneration is active. Overuse risks cellular exhaustion. Cannot create explosives faster than mutation speed allows.

Additional Notes:
Most effective paired with Self-Detonation and Regeneration. Standalone, requires external detonation methods or careful timing. Bomber cells appear unique to artificial Quirk creation.

cardPool.title: Boomerang
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Boomerang

Description:
A trajectory-manipulation Quirk allowing the user to control thrown objects with precision, causing them to home in on targets and change direction mid-flight. The user's hands and affected projectiles glow purple during activation.

Functions/Applications:
The user can throw objects and redirect them multiple times before impact. Objects curve around obstacles, strike from unexpected angles, and return to the user. Effective for ranged combat, trapping opponents, or retrieving distant items.

Limits:
Projectiles remain subject to physics and can be stopped by hard impacts or viscous substances that disrupt trajectory. The Quirk requires direct contact to throw objects and cannot function without physical projectiles. Distance and object weight affect control precision.

Additional Notes:
The purple glow indicates active Quirk usage and may serve as a visual tell. Most effective against dodging-focused opponents rather than those using defensive barriers. Users benefit from carrying varied ammunition types.

cardPool.title: Brainwashing
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Brainwashing

Description:
A mental control ability activated when a target verbally responds to the user's speech. Once triggered, the victim enters a fog-like state where their body obeys all commands while their mind remains trapped and aware. Their eyes turn milky white.

Functions/Applications:
The user can control one target at a time through direct concentration and simple verbal commands. Advanced training allows brainwashed victims to speak while emotionally blocked. Multiple people can be controlled sequentially but not simultaneously. Works only on living beings capable of speech.

Limits:
Requires verbal response to activate—silence breaks the Quirk entirely. Victims cannot perform complex mental tasks. Physical trauma or sufficiently strong pain breaks control instantly. Electronic voice transmission negates the effect. Bright flashing lights can disrupt the hold. The Quirk controls actions only, not thoughts or emotions, allowing victims to potentially use their own Quirks to escape.

Additional Notes:
Lacks offensive or defensive capabilities but can instantly win encounters by commanding opponents to forfeit or disable themselves.

cardPool.title: Brawn Boost
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Brawn Boost

Description:
A stolen Quirk that amplifies physical strength beyond normal limits. Multiple copies compound the effect exponentially.

Functions/Applications:
Enhanced striking force, lifting capacity, and durability. Multiple copies stack effects for greater power. Useful for direct combat, restraining targets, and demolishing barriers.

Limits:
Modest enhancement from single copy. Does not grant speed or protect against energy attacks. Requires direct physical contact.

Additional Notes:
Originally stolen from unknown source. All For One possesses three copies, making it substantially more potent. Duplicate copies are valuable for strength-focused users.

cardPool.title: Bristle
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Bristle

Description:
A hardening-type Quirk that allows the user to drastically increase the density and rigidity of their hair, transforming it into steel-like strands for offense and defense.

Functions/Applications:
The user can deploy hardened hair as weapons for striking and piercing attacks, create protective barriers by stiffening hair around the body, or manipulate hardened strands for entanglement and restraint.

Limits:
The Quirk only affects the user's own hair and cannot be extended indefinitely. Maintaining the hardening state requires active concentration and stamina. The user's head remains vulnerable to attacks bypassing the hair defense, and baldness would severely limit effectiveness.

Additional Notes:
The Quirk's power scales with hair length and density. Advanced combat applications remain unexplored. Situational disadvantages emerge in confined spaces where hair manipulation becomes restricted.

cardPool.title: Brown Bear
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Brown Bear

Description:
A transformation quirk granting bear-like physiology with enhanced musculature, thick fur, and animalistic instincts. The user gains a bestial appearance while retaining human cognition and speech.

Functions/Applications:
Grants superhuman strength for melee combat, increased durability against impacts, acute smell and hearing for tracking, and sharp claws for slashing or climbing. Useful for close-quarters fighting and survival scenarios.

Limits:
The transformation is permanent, limiting social interaction. Acute senses overwhelm in chaotic environments. Heavy build reduces agility and speed. Claws prevent fine manipulation.

Additional Notes:
Excels in direct confrontation and wilderness settings but struggles with precision tasks and stealth. The user's bestial nature may influence combat behavior.

cardPool.title: Bruiser
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Bruiser

Description:
A power-enhancement quirk allowing the user to concentrate strength into a single limb for devastating strikes. Charging time correlates to attack power—longer preparation yields stronger blows. Chemical enhancement via external stimulants supercharges the entire body instead.

Functions/Applications:
Focus energy into arms or legs for powerful attacks with variable charge duration. Use defensively by powering limbs to block impact. External chemical enhancement expands the quirk to full-body augmentation for overwhelming force.

Limits:
Cannot split power between multiple limbs simultaneously. Charging leaves user vulnerable and telegraphs intentions. Excessive charging creates tactical windows for counterattack. Chemical enhancement causes dependency and serious side effects with prolonged use.

Additional Notes:
Strength lies in raw power output and tactical limb selection flexibility. Requires disciplined timing and positioning to maximize combat effectiveness. Best suited for direct confrontation rather than ranged or evasive fighting styles.

cardPool.title: Bubble
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Bubble

Description:
The user creates bubbles of varying sizes filled with any aroma they have previously smelled. These aromatic bubbles can be deployed offensively or defensively, ranging from pleasant fragrances to putrid stinks. When panicked or nervous, involuntary bubbles form with foul odors that detonate spontaneously.

Functions/Applications:
Deploy sweet-smelling bubbles to mask scents or create diversions. Produce foul-smelling bubbles to disorient or sicken enemies. Use bubbles for non-lethal crowd control or olfactory camouflage in stealth scenarios.

Limits:
User must have previously experienced an aroma to replicate it. Bubbles require time to form and are vulnerable to destruction mid-creation. Panic triggers involuntary foul bubbles that explode unpredictably, potentially affecting allies. Ineffective against foes immune to olfactory distraction or wearing scent-blocking gear.

Additional Notes:
This Quirk excels at non-lethal incapacitation and tactical support but lacks direct damage output. Success depends on target psychology and environmental factors. User must maintain composure during combat.

cardPool.title: Bull Head
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Bull Head

Description:
A transformation quirk granting large, sharp, durable bull-like horns from the head suited for ramming and goring attacks.

Functions/Applications:
Powerful charging tackles using horns as battering rams, devastating momentum-based charges, and close-combat goring strikes. Horns provide armor-piercing capability and break through barriers.

Limits:
Horns cannot retract, limiting stealth and social situations. Damage to horns causes direct pain. Maximum charging impact requires a running start; stationary strikes deal reduced damage. Twisting movements are awkward with extra head weight.

Additional Notes:
Best for aggressive, direct combat. Effective against rigid defenses but poor against evasive opponents. User trades mobility and finesse for raw power and intimidation.

cardPool.title: Bullet Laser
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Bullet Laser

Description:
The user fires purple laser beams from their fingertips with precision and destructive force. These lasers can travel in straight trajectories or curve mid-flight through deliberate manipulation.

Functions/Applications:
Direct offensive blasts that pierce flesh and demolish structures; explosive impact on contact; curved trajectory firing for striking targets behind cover; suitable for close-range and distance combat.

Limits:
Requires line of sight from fingertips; energy expenditure increases with distance and power; curved beams require concentration and are slower; no defensive capabilities; reduced effectiveness against reflective surfaces.

Additional Notes:
This Quirk was stolen rather than naturally inherited, suggesting potential instability in some users. Considerable destructive power but demands precise aim and tactical awareness.

cardPool.title: Bullhorn
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Bullhorn

Description:
The user's voice becomes unnaturally loud and powerful, amplifying sound far beyond normal human limits without strain.

Functions/Applications:
Project voice across vast distances with clarity; intimidate or disorient enemies through volume; disrupt concentration; communicate across battlefields instantly.

Limits:
No directional control—amplification affects all sound equally in all directions; cannot modulate frequency or create focused sonic attacks; prolonged use may cause throat damage; effectiveness diminishes in soundproofed environments; relies on base voice quality.

Additional Notes:
Primarily utility-focused with limited offensive potential. Works best for crowd control, psychological pressure, or tactical communication rather than direct combat damage.

cardPool.title: Burst
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name: Burst

Description: A destructive self-detonation ability that explodes the user's entire body in violent light and force, consuming them entirely as a final resort technique.

Functions/Applications: Creates a powerful area-of-effect explosion dealing massive damage to nearby targets. Generates blinding light that disorients enemies. Can be used as a tactical distraction for allies or escape.

Limits: One-time use only—activation destroys the user's body completely. Cannot be reversed or controlled once initiated. Requires close proximity to targets for maximum effectiveness. User dies upon activation.

Additional Notes: Viable only for expendable combatants or last-stand desperation moves. Most effective when coordinated with allies to capitalize on the resulting confusion and blindness.

cardPool.title: Cemedine
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Cemedine

Description:
The user secretes a versatile adhesive liquid from cranial orifices that can be sprayed at targets. The glue can harden into rigid binding or remain tacky, with the user controlling solidification rate.

Functions/Applications:
Restrain opponents by spraying hardening glue around limbs; create sticky traps that slow movement; adjust drying speed for fast targets; seal objects or wounds temporarily.

Limits:
Glue requires direct contact; excessive spraying depletes supply; hardened glue breaks with sufficient strength; cannot affect user's own body; drying adjustment has minimum and maximum thresholds; ranged application less precise than melee contact.

Additional Notes:
Most effective in close-to-mid range combat. High heat may accelerate drying unpredictably. User requires clear line of sight to spray effectively.

cardPool.title: Cement
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Cement

Description:
A manipulation Quirk allowing the user to reshape and control existing cement and concrete through physical contact. Cannot create cement from nothing, only mold what exists. A faint green glow emanates from the user's hands when actively using this ability.

Functions/Applications:
Reshape concrete into weapons, barriers, and structures for offense and defense. Create buildings and arenas within minutes. Trap and contain enemies with concrete walls. Dual-purpose combat and construction tool.

Limits:
Requires direct contact with existing cement or concrete to function. Severely diminished in rural or natural environments. Users with sufficient destructive power can break through constructs. Range limited to areas where the user maintains physical contact with the material.

Additional Notes:
Provides overwhelming advantage in urban combat but becomes nearly useless in countryside or wilderness. Requires expert skill and quick thinking to maximize effectiveness. Best suited for defensive and trap-based tactics.

cardPool.title: Centipede
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Centipede

Description:
Grants elongated, segmented limbs resembling a centipede's body. The user's arms, legs, and head can extend dramatically from their body, remaining concealed within clothing until deployed for surprise attacks.

Functions/Applications:
Extended reach for grappling and restraint. Venomous pincers deliver paralyzing toxin causing severe pain. Multi-limb coordination enables complex entanglement. Concealment provides tactical advantage in combat initiation.

Limits:
Limbs constrained by clothing capacity when retracted, limiting sudden extensions. Venom requires time to take effect and direct pincer contact. Extended limbs difficult to control with precision at maximum range. Head extension exposes user's vulnerable center point.

Additional Notes:
Effective against unarmored foes due to venomous nature. High stealth potential from concealment, but deployment speed determines combat effectiveness. Favors grappling and control over direct striking power.

cardPool.title: Chameleon
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Chameleon

Description:
The user gains chameleon physiology including adhesive skin for climbing, independently rotating eyes, an extendable tongue, and color-changing camouflage. This Quirk enables seamless blending with surroundings and enhanced mobility.

Functions/Applications:
Scale vertical surfaces with sticky limbs. Monitor multiple directions using independent eye rotation. Extend a prehensile tongue for attacks or utility. Activate full-body camouflage for invisibility, ambushes, reconnaissance, or evasion. Enhanced agility and climbing speed.

Limits:
Camouflage is imperfect and detectable upon close inspection. Adhesive grip weakens on smooth surfaces. Tongue has limited reach and strength. Independent eye rotation can be disorienting. Camouflage breaks when moving quickly or attacking.

Additional Notes:
Chameleon excels at hit-and-run tactics, infiltration, and defensive positioning. Most effective in varied terrain and colors. Direct confrontation is disadvantageous; user should rely on surprise and mobility rather than brute strength.

cardPool.title: Charging Muscles
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Charging Muscles

Description:
A power-enhancement Quirk allowing the user to accumulate and concentrate strength in their musculature before releasing it in a powerful strike. Longer charge periods increase the force of the resulting attack.

Functions/Applications:
Channeling energy into muscles to amplify punch or kick damage. Can charge mid-combat or before engagement. Creates explosive melee attacks with significant destructive force and knockback.

Limits:
Charging requires time and cannot be instant. Premature release wastes buildup. Overcharging causes muscle soreness and temporary loss of function. Sustained charging drains stamina rapidly. Works only with physical strikes, not ranged attacks.

Additional Notes:
Best used as a finishing move or against defensive opponents. User must balance charging duration against overexertion risk. Most effective when opponent cannot interrupt charging. Muscle recovery time needed after maximum-power charges.

cardPool.title: Chart
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Chart

Description:
Chart enables the user to manifest a holographic page displaying real-time tracking data on designated targets, updating continuously with vital information.

Functions/Applications:
Creates a tangible holographic interface showing target location, distance, and vital status. User gains tactical awareness by observing tracked enemies from afar. Useful for surveillance, pursuit, coordination in combat, and determining if targets remain alive.

Limits:
Requires initial target designation before tracking begins. Distance limited by user's sensory range or concentration. Cannot track multiple targets simultaneously without creating separate pages. Holographic display is visible to others, potentially compromising secrecy.

Additional Notes:
Chart grants reconnaissance advantages but relies on preparation. Effective for strategic encounters rather than direct combat. Tracking may be disrupted by interference with user concentration or proximity to target.

cardPool.title: Chest Hair
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Chest Hair

Description:
A Quirk that enhances the user's masculine physical traits. It grants notably increased strength and durability. Some evidence suggests the user may project destructive purple energy beams from their chest, though this could be a secondary manifestation.

Functions/Applications:
Enhanced physical strength for combat and labor; increased resilience and muscle density; possible energy projection as offensive capability; psychological intimidation through exaggerated masculine appearance.

Limits:
Energy projection appears inconsistent or situational. No apparent ranged combat versatility beyond chest-based attacks. Strength enhancement alone may not overcome trained combat technique.

Additional Notes:
Tenma Nakaoji is the known user. The Quirk's true nature is ambiguous—whether laser emission is a core ability or merely aesthetic exaggeration requires further investigation. The most reliable aspect is physical augmentation.

cardPool.title: Chimera
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Chimera

Description:
The user manifests characteristics of various animals, permanently adopting a blue werewolf form as their base state. They can temporarily shift to gain traits of birds, lizards, dragons, and other creatures, enlarging these features to monstrous proportions for enhanced combat capability.

Functions/Applications:
Grants strength and durability scaling with the animal form adopted. Dragon form enables fire breath and energy beams. Bird traits provide flight or enhanced mobility; lizard traits offer climbing and flexibility. Each form stacks its animal advantages—claws, teeth, wings, scales—making the user a versatile transformer.

Limits:
Transformations consume stamina; extended use drains energy quickly. Larger transformations reduce speed despite increased power. Only one primary form at a time. Dragon-form beam attacks exhaust the user and have cooldown periods.

Additional Notes:
The permanent werewolf state makes the user a hybrid fighter by default. This Quirk excels in prolonged battles through form versatility but requires tactical switching to avoid fatigue. Opponents familiar with specific animal weaknesses can exploit individual forms.

cardPool.title: Chronostasis
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Chronostasis

Description:
The user's hair transforms into arrow-shaped projectiles that extend in straight lines and cut targets. Hair is divided into two sections: the "Minute Hand" on the forehead and the "Hour Hand" at the nape, each representing different time units. Upon impact, targets experience slowdown effects whose duration depends on which hand struck them.

Functions/Applications:
Launch hair arrows as offensive cutting weapons with varying slowdown durations. The Minute Hand inflicts shorter slowdown periods, while the Hour Hand inflicts longer ones. Use slowdown effects to immobilize enemies during combat. Position strategically before attacking to maximize effectiveness.

Limits:
The user must remain completely stationary to fire hair arrows; any movement cancels the ability. This creates vulnerability windows where the user cannot attack and defend simultaneously. Hair regenerates but has a recharge time between uses. Slowdown effects have finite duration and do not permanently disable targets.

Additional Notes:
Chronostasis rewards patient, tactical gameplay over aggressive rushing.

cardPool.title: Clean Bubbler
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Clean Bubbler

Description:
Susugu Mitarai generates pressurized soapy water and large soap bubbles from his body. The bubbles possess surprising strength and buoyancy, capable of lifting multiple people while remaining controllable. The solution carries disinfectant properties useful for medical aid.

Functions/Applications:
Create powerful streams of soapy water for offense or propulsion. Generate large bubbles to lift, transport, or contain targets. Use bubbles to cleanse wounds and provide basic medical treatment. Combine streams and bubbles for crowd control or rescue operations.

Limits:
Requires finite internal reserves of soapy solution. Bubbles are fragile and burst from sharp objects or excessive force. Non-lethal and struggles against determined resistance. Extended use depletes reserves, requiring time to replenish.

Additional Notes:
Clean Bubbler excels in support and utility roles rather than direct combat. The disinfectant quality makes Mitarai valuable in humanitarian situations. Opponents with piercing weapons or ranged attacks gain significant advantage. Water-based Quirks may interact unpredictably with the soapy medium.

cardPool.title: Cleaning
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Cleaning

Description:
The user secretes a potent dish soap-like substance that weakens or temporarily negates others' Quirks through direct contact. It also removes biological evidence from surfaces.

Functions/Applications:
Apply the soap by brushing or rubbing it onto an opponent's skin to suppress their Quirk. Use it to cleanse crime scenes and eliminate forensic evidence. Works best on exposed skin and active Quirk manifestations.

Limits:
Requires direct physical contact; cannot affect Quirks from a distance. Effectiveness diminishes as the substance dries or washes away. Works better against external Quirks than internal ones. Overuse causes skin dryness and irritation. Does not permanently destroy Quirks, only temporarily weakens them.

Additional Notes:
This Quirk is utility-focused rather than combat-oriented, making the user valuable for law enforcement and reconnaissance. The user must be close enough for contact, creating personal risk. The substance has a limited supply per secretion cycle.

cardPool.title: Clones
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Clones

Description:
Ectoplasm expels glowing viscous fluid from his mouth that he shapes into exact duplicates of himself. He can create up to thirty clones (thirty-six when in a good mood), each sharing his consciousness and capable of speech. All clones can be willfully dispersed at any time.

Functions/Applications:
Deploy clones for numerical advantage in combat or to patrol vast areas simultaneously. Use clones for surveillance and reconnaissance, as the user perceives through all duplicates regardless of distance. Redirect clones to individual tasks for teaching, search operations, or crowd control. Create a single massive clone capable of trapping enemies within or on its body, though this prevents spawning additional clones.

Limits:
Each clone is fragile and destroyed by a single strong blow. The giant clone eliminates the ability to generate smaller clones simultaneously. The Quirk requires oral expulsion, making it vulnerable during channeling. Clones cannot exceed the user's physical capabilities or knowledge.

Additional Notes:
This Quirk excels at force multiplication and surveillance rather than raw power.

cardPool.title: Cloud
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Cloud

Description:
The user generates solid, touchable clouds of varying sizes and densities that support weight and grant exceptional aerial mobility. Items can be stored within the clouds.

Functions/Applications:
Cloud enables rapid vertical and horizontal movement for swift escapes or reconnaissance. Clouds can shield allies from falling debris through density manipulation. Users can create diversionary clouds to confuse enemies, hide within them for ambush tactics, or generate obscuring billows to block vision in combat.

Limits:
The Quirk is vulnerable to gas-dispersing or liquid-based abilities. Movement speed depends on cloud size—larger clouds are slower but sturdier. Users cannot generate clouds faster than once per few seconds. Clouds dissipate if the user loses concentration or becomes incapacitated.

Additional Notes:
Cloud is primarily a mobility and evasion Quirk. Its greatest strength lies in tactical positioning and escape routes.

cardPool.title: Comic
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Comic

Description:
The user materializes spoken onomatopoeia into giant Japanese letters with real-world effects matching their sound. The user's head transforms into a comic speech bubble. Overuse causes throat soreness, limiting performance.

Functions/Applications:
Create protective barriers, offensive blasts, and utility effects by speaking sound words. Examples include "BOOM" for explosions, "CRASH" for impacts, and "SPLASH" for water effects. The manifested letters are durable and can withstand laser attacks. Versatility allows adaptation to multiple combat situations through creative wording.

Limits:
Rapid successive use causes throat strain, preventing further activation. The user must speak clearly and intentionally—casual speech doesn't trigger the Quirk. Each onomatopoeia has a fixed effect based on its sound, limiting creative freedom. Physical durability decreases with distance or scale.

Additional Notes:
The comic bubble head makes the user visually recognizable and hinders stealth. Black-ink blood suggests biological integration with the Quirk. Best suited for versatile support roles requiring creative problem-solving in combat.

cardPool.title: Compress
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Compress

Description:
Compress allows the user to shrink anything within a spherical area into a small, weightless marble by touching it with their hand. Compressed objects retain their properties but become pocket-sized. Release is triggered by snapping fingers, restoring marbles to full size instantly.

Functions/Applications:
Capture and transport enemies, allies, or objects. Create traps by releasing marbles to restore obstacles in enemy paths. Selectively compress body parts to inflict damage. Combine with environmental hazards by compressing targets alongside fire or debris. Use marbles as decoys or launch platforms.

Limits:
Activation requires hand contact; user's own arm cannot be compressed. After losing the left arm, Compress functions only through the right arm. Selective compression risks mutilation. User cannot compress themselves unless within the area being compressed. Large-scale compression drains focus.

Additional Notes:
Background in stage magic enhances this Quirk through illusion tactics and decoy creation. Compress is silent, allowing covert capture. Weight reduction aids escape scenarios and breaking through obstacles.

cardPool.title: Confession
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Confession

Description:
After posing a question, the user compels the target to answer with absolute truthfulness. The victim cannot lie, resist, or refuse to respond, revealing their deepest secrets and intentions. Answers reflect exactly what the target believes to be true, not necessarily objective reality.

Functions/Applications:
Extract intelligence from enemies and allies. Expose hidden loyalties and fears. Prevent betrayal by interrogating suspects. Verify the honesty of subordinates.

Limits:
Completely non-offensive; the user cannot damage or fight directly. Ineffective if either party cannot speak or communicate. The Quirk interprets answers literally—loopholes exist if the target's understanding differs from reality. Requires specific questions; vague inquiries yield vague answers. Does not compel physical action, only verbal response.

Additional Notes:
Most effective during interrogation or investigation rather than combat. Users should prepare targeted questions in advance for maximum utility. The Quirk's greatest strength lies in information gathering and organizational security, not direct confrontation.

cardPool.title: Conjure
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name: Conjure

Description: A warping ability that instantly teleports small objects directly into the user's hand from their line of sight. The user focuses on a target and the object materializes in their grasp.

Functions/Applications: Retrieve weapons and tools from distance instantly. Disarm opponents by conjuring their held objects away. Gather resources quickly in exploration. Snatch items mid-air or from secured locations within range.

Limits: Only works on relatively small objects. Requires clear line of sight to the target. Cannot conjure abstract things or pull from sealed containers. Range is moderate, not unlimited. User must have hand capacity to receive the item.

Additional Notes: Highly useful for theft, procurement, and tactical advantage in combat. Effectiveness depends on environmental awareness and quick thinking. Works best against unprepared opponents or in cluttered environments.

cardPool.title: Control Glass
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Control Glass

Description:
The user commands and reshapes glass within their vicinity, altering its physical state between solid and liquid forms at will. They can reshape existing glass structures and transmute their properties instantaneously.

Functions/Applications:
Create levitating glass platforms for flight and movement. Absorb glass from windows and structures to augment available mass. Form glass projectiles for ranged attacks. Liquefy glass to trap foes, then resolidify to immobilize them. Construct barriers and shields by consolidating nearby glass.

Limits:
Requires existing glass sources within the user's area. Effectiveness diminishes in glass-scarce environments. Liquefied glass is difficult to control with precision. The user must maintain concentration to sustain floating platforms. Large-scale reshaping consumes significant stamina.

Additional Notes:
This Quirk excels in urban environments with abundant glass. The user can sense glass composition and location within their operational radius. Mobility depends on available glass reserves; rural or stone-heavy areas severely limit capability. Offensive power scales with gathered glass amount.

cardPool.title: Control Horn
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Control Horn

Description:
The user possesses specialized horns that project psychic dominion over bovine creatures. By maintaining both horns intact, the user can establish mental command over cattle, forcing them to obey through direct neural influence.

Functions/Applications:
Control herds of cattle simultaneously for stampedes or mass intimidation. Redirect cattle movements to block passages or create diversions. Compel cattle to attack or defend on command. Useful for agriculture, siege tactics, or extortion involving livestock.

Limits:
Only functions on bovine animals; ineffective against humans, horses, or other species. Requires both horns to be undamaged and intact; loss of even one horn completely disables the Quirk. Control range and herd size limited by user focus and mental stamina. Cannot control already-trained attack animals with strong independent will.

Additional Notes:
The user is entirely dependent on nearby cattle to utilize this Quirk offensively. Opponents can strategically target or destroy the horns to neutralize the ability instantly. Most effective as a threat or area-control tool rather than direct combat.

cardPool.title: Copy
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Copy

Description:
Copy allows the user to replicate any Quirk after physical contact with its user, even brief contact like touching hair. The user gains instinctive knowledge of how to use the copied Quirk at a basic level and can store multiple copied Quirks simultaneously, switching between them as needed.

Functions/Applications:
Instantly acquire an opponent's Quirk for tactical advantage in combat. Adapt to situations by switching between stored Quirks on the fly. Preserve lingering effects of used Quirks even after switching to another power. Stack up to four or more Quirks within the body through training.

Limits:
Active duration is 10 minutes per copied Quirk before it expires and must be re-copied. Only one Quirk can be activated at a time; switching requires active management. Requires physical contact to function. Cannot replicate Quirks dependent on accumulated resources or stockpiled power. User lacks the physical conditioning of the original Quirk wielder and may sustain injury using powerful Quirks without proper training. Mastery requires repeated copying and practice; initial use is basic.

cardPool.title: Cow
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Cow

Description:
The user transforms portions of their body to gain bovine characteristics including hooves, horns, and hardened hide. This grants enhanced speed and strength comparable to large cattle, making them a formidable physical force.

Functions/Applications:
Transform legs into powerful hooves for rapid movement and enhanced kicking force. Grow hardened horns for goring and charging attacks. Thicken hide for damage resistance. Stack multiple traits simultaneously for cumulative benefits.

Limits:
Transformations are partial rather than complete. Bovine form is slower than dedicated speed-type quirks. Increased body mass limits agility and precision. Sustained transformation drains stamina.

Additional Notes:
Optimal in direct combat and charging scenarios but struggles with finesse-based encounters. Transformation is visually obvious, limiting stealth. Works best against speed-reliant opponents rather than those with raw power.

cardPool.title: Creation
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Creation

Description:
Momo transmutes her body's fat cells into physical matter, materializing objects from her skin with a blue-pink glow. She can create virtually any non-living object if she understands its atomic structure, limited only by her knowledge and lipid reserves.

Functions/Applications:
Creates melee weapons and cannons for combat. Can produce objects larger than her body by expending fat reserves. Partial materialization allows dual-tasking. Creations can be shared with allies. Mastery of matryoshka dolls enables near-instantaneous production and storage of items within them.

Limits:
Requires substantial food intake to replenish lipids; overuse causes weakness and exhaustion. Complex or large creations demand extended preparation time, leaving her vulnerable. Cannot create living beings. Requires atomic-level knowledge of any object before creation. Relentless pressure forces defensive positioning.

Additional Notes:
Momo's high intelligence enables creative problem-solving through fabricated tools. Close-range combat suits her best; long-range engagements require pre-planned cannons.

cardPool.title: Crystallize
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name: Crystallize

Description: Yu Hojo rapidly grows durable crystals across his body, coating his skin in protective crystalline armor. The crystals form near-instantaneously and can be shaped into weapons like bladed gauntlets for extended melee reach.

Functions/Applications: Deploy crystalline armor for defense and durability. Form crystal blades along the arms for extended range. Layer crystals for targeted protection. Use rapid crystallization to counter attacks or break restraints.

Limits: Crystals shatter with sufficient force. Hair inhibits crystallization, requiring the user to remain shaved. Crystals destroy clothing during formation. Generated crystals have no monetary or structural value outside combat use.

Additional Notes: Best suited for close-range combat and defensive strategies. Rapid deployment is effective for surprise blocking or counterattacks. Maintains visual distinctiveness, eliminating stealth options.

cardPool.title: Cubism
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Cubism

Description:
A transformation Quirk that converts touched targets into three-dimensional cubist artwork. Contact triggers instant crystallization into geometric, fragmented forms. Victims remain conscious but permanently locked in their cubist state.

Functions/Applications:
The user can incapacitate enemies by transforming them into immobile sculptural forms. Transformed targets retain awareness but lose combat effectiveness. The Quirk deactivates if the user is restrained, potentially reversing transformations.

Limits:
Requires direct physical contact to activate. Transformed individuals cannot revert on their own—reversal depends on the user's consciousness and freedom. The user must avoid capture or the Quirk's effects may fail.

Additional Notes:
A control Quirk best suited for leaders who maintain positioning. The permanent nature of transformation is psychologically potent but creates moral complications. Effectiveness depends on the user avoiding capture.

cardPool.title: Curse
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Curse

Description:
The user's body transforms into sentient paper runes, granting extreme lightness and malleability for unconventional combat and rapid repositioning.

Functions/Applications:
Launch razor-sharp paper strands as projectiles. Create temporary paper clones to confuse opponents. Exploit reduced weight for enhanced mobility and evasion. Fold or compress to fit tight spaces.

Limits:
Vulnerable to fire and water. Clone creation requires sustained focus and dissipates quickly. Sharp attacks ineffective against heavy armor. Transformation is total—cannot paper-coat only parts of the body.

Additional Notes:
Paper runes maintain cohesion through unknown means; damage causes tears but doesn't permanently sever limbs. Best for hit-and-run tactics. Clones are decoys only and cannot perform independent complex actions.

cardPool.title: Danger Sense
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Danger Sense

Description:
A sixth sense that detects potential threats through a sharp, stabbing sensation visualized as lightning striking the mind. The Quirk reads intent and negative emotions from individuals and threats in the surrounding area, allowing the user to anticipate danger and react accordingly.

Functions/Applications:
Warns of hostile intentions and evaluates threat levels by sensing malice. Enables rapid dodging and evasion. Can detect multiple sources simultaneously. Works passively without conscious activation. Effectiveness scales with training.

Limits:
Fails against those with no true malice, even if objectively dangerous. Overwhelmed by high concentrations of negative emotions in crowds. Ineffective against sufficiently fast attacks allowing no reaction time. Misdirected by aware opponents using decoys. Weakened when multiple weaker threats converge. Does not function against those perceived as non-threats.

Additional Notes:
Initial use caused severe physical strain, though training mitigates this. Reads emotional intent rather than objective danger, making it unreliable against emotionally complex attackers.

cardPool.title: Dark Ball
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Dark Ball

Description:
The user generates and launches spherical projectiles of concentrated dark energy as black orbs with purple outlines. These balls emit volatile dark energy and can be released in rapid succession or coordinated barrages.

Functions/Applications:
Dark Ball excels at ranged offensive attacks and area denial. Projectiles can be fired in multiple directions simultaneously, overwhelming opponents or creating chaotic combat scenarios. Works well combined with other abilities for compound attacks.

Limits:
Individual projectiles have limited tracking and can be dodged or blocked by agile opponents or defensive barriers. Aiming requires concentration; rapid-fire usage becomes less accurate. Sustained barrages drain stamina quickly, limiting prolonged offensive pressure.

Additional Notes:
Dark Ball relies on overwhelming force rather than precision. It pairs well with close-range or tanking abilities. Most effective when the user controls battlefield space and prevents enemies from closing distance rapidly.

cardPool.title: Darkness
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Darkness

Description:
The user manifests a dark purple liquid substance from their fingers and soles of their feet. This sludge-like material spreads across terrain, causing anything it contacts to sink as if in quicksand. The quirk emerged spontaneously in youth with no known family relation.

Functions/Applications:
Creates sinking terrain zones to trap or slow enemies. Can be released from hands for targeted attacks or from feet to create mobile hazard zones. The substance can blanket wide areas when fully unleashed.

Limits:
Full capabilities unknown. Difficult to control with involuntary manifestations. No clear information on duration, range, or reabsorption. Cannot be shaped with precision; spreads naturally through environment.

Additional Notes:
A rare variant quirk with no family precedent, suggesting unique or unstable origins. Extremely powerful but dangerous to user and surroundings, making it difficult to master safely.

cardPool.title: Day Dream
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Day Dream

Description:
By making direct eye contact, the user traps a target's consciousness in a personalized dream world reflecting their deepest fantasies, rendering their body nearly comatose. The victim's eyes turn pure white while the user's glow red. The user can telepathically perceive the victim's dreams and secrets.

Functions/Applications:
Control and incapacitation of single targets through psychological imprisonment. Espionage and information gathering by reading victims' fantasies. With Quirk amplification, affects multiple targets simultaneously. Useful for interrogation and sustained mind control.

Limits:
Requires direct line of sight to activate. Limited to one conscious target at a time. Effects break if the user sustains significant injury. Victims can escape if made aware the experience is an illusion. Multiple consciousnesses within one body counter the ability. Artificial body parts operate independently and may act against the user.

Additional Notes:
Day Dream prioritizes psychological domination over combat. Its greatest weakness is awareness—once victims know they dream, they regain agency.

cardPool.title: Decay
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Decay

Description:
A destructive Quirk that disintegrates anything touched by the user's hands, reducing targets to dust. A reverse-engineered copy of Overhaul, stripped of restoration properties.

Functions/Applications:
Touch-based destruction of matter and living tissue. Spreads through victims' bodies unless the affected limb is severed or interrupted. Can destroy structures and multiple enemies simultaneously at full power.

Limits:
Requires direct finger contact—gloves or distance negates the effect. Cannot affect fluid or particle-based matter. High-power usage causes severe recoil damage to the user. Disintegration can be interrupted by destroying the affected area or erasing the Quirk effect itself.

Additional Notes:
Manifests as cracks on the user's body over prolonged use. Quirk factor is localized in the hands, making hand-loss a critical vulnerability.

cardPool.title: Delay Spot
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Delay Spot

Description:
Bruno Gollini creates a semi-spherical bubble that traps everything inside in severe slow motion. The user moves at normal speed within the bubble, remaining unaffected while targets become nearly helpless. Others can move normally if physically touching the user.

Functions/Applications:
Incapacitate enemies and slow projectiles. Retrieve hostages safely by entering the bubble at full speed. Isolate opponents in temporal stasis. Extended range covers entire mansion yards after enhancement.

Limits:
Objects faster than bullets can partially bypass the effect. Range limited to semi-sphere coverage. Requires line of effect to establish the bubble. Cannot protect against extreme velocity attacks exceeding the slowdown threshold.

Additional Notes:
User becomes overconfident when Delay Spot dominates combat, underestimating opponents. Effectiveness drops against high-speed Quirks exceeding bullet velocity. Physical contact with the user allows allies to bypass slowdown effects.

cardPool.title: Despot
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Despot

Description:
The user extrudes thin, nearly invisible threads from their body that can penetrate and puppeteer other humans. Victims remain conscious but cannot resist commands, functioning as extensions of the user's will. Several dozen individuals can be controlled simultaneously.

Functions/Applications:
Create an army of controlled soldiers while maintaining their skills. Send puppets into danger without personal risk. Gather intelligence through multiple perspectives. Overwhelm opponents through coordinated numbers.

Limits:
Control breaks if victims receive sudden physical shock. Control ceases if the user loses consciousness. Victims cannot be forced to harm themselves fatally. Thread range is limited to moderate distances. Cannot control those with defensive Quirks or exceptional willpower without difficulty.

Additional Notes:
Victims retain muscle memory and combat training but execute only the user's tactical decisions. The psychological toll on controlled individuals creates moral complications. Power scales with the user's ability to coordinate multiple bodies effectively.

cardPool.title: Dog
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Dog

Description:
A canine-based transformation quirk granting enhanced senses of smell and hearing with dog-like physical characteristics. Manifestation varies between users—some develop full dog features while others display partial transformations. All users gain acute sensory perception for tracking across vast distances.

Functions/Applications:
Users detect and identify individuals by scent from miles away, track through forests, and perceive threats via heightened hearing. Physical traits like claws, paws, and fur provide combat advantages and climbing ability. The quirk enhances overall strength and agility.

Limits:
Sensory abilities are overwhelmed by strong odors or noise pollution. Physical transformations are permanent and unchangeable, affecting social interactions. The quirk does not grant animal control or communication. Tracking effectiveness diminishes in heavily scented environments or storms.

Additional Notes:
Manifestation varies significantly between users. The quirk scales with user strength; more powerful individuals demonstrate greater sensory range. Dog-like behavioral quirks may emerge involuntarily.

cardPool.title: Double
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Double

Description:
Double allows the user to create up to two identical copies of any person or object by touching them with viscous dark fluid from their hands. Duplicates possess the original's memories, personalities, and full abilities, making them nearly indistinguishable.

Functions/Applications:
Create perfect clones for combat, labor, or infiltration. Self-duplication enables exponential multiplication if copies duplicate themselves. Clones retain all original abilities and knowledge. Can replicate objects with precise structural knowledge. Clone destruction is detectable regardless of distance.

Limits:
User can maintain only two active copies at a time. Creation requires a flawless mental image of target—physical changes to original require new measurements or clone will be malformed. Clones possess full autonomy and may refuse orders or turn hostile. Copies are less durable than originals, dissolving into viscous liquid after major damage. Clones of damaged individuals inherit their injuries. Objects without precise compositional data decompose quickly. Second copies are notably more fragile than first duplicates.

cardPool.title: Dragon
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Dragon

Description:
The user transforms into a massive dragon form with wings, scales, powerful jaws, and sharp claws. Grants extraordinary physical prowess and durability far exceeding human limits.

Functions/Applications:
Flight via wings, devastating melee attacks with claws and fangs, powerful biting force, enhanced grappling using multiple limbs, blocking heavy impacts, overpowering opponents with raw strength.

Limits:
Transformation has energy costs or duration constraints. Weakened by Quirks targeting physical capability. Reduced effectiveness against opponents with Quirks countering strength or durability.

Additional Notes:
Retains user's fighting technique and combat intelligence for tactical grappling and holds. Excels in direct confrontation but vulnerable to ranged attacks, speed-based tactics, or mental/environmental manipulation.

cardPool.title: Dragon Breath
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Dragon Breath

Description:
A fire-expulsion quirk enabling the user to exhale intense flames from their mouth. Requires alcohol consumption to activate and function, with combat capability directly tied to intoxication level.

Functions/Applications:
The user can project streams or bursts of fire for offensive attacks, scorching enemies and terrain. Power scales with alcohol intake. Can be used for environmental destruction or creating flame barriers.

Limits:
Completely dependent on prior alcohol consumption; no fire can be produced while sober. Accuracy and control diminish as intoxication exceeds optimal levels. Prolonged use causes fatigue. Quirk cannot function once all alcohol is metabolized.

Additional Notes:
Creates a high-risk playstyle rewarding careful resource management. Users must balance intoxication to maintain combat effectiveness without losing control.

cardPool.title: Dupli-Arms
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Dupli-Arms

Description:
Mezo manifests arm-like tentacles that transform into duplicates of any body part. Replicated organs are enhanced versions, emerging from pods at each tentacle's tip. Multiple different parts can manifest simultaneously, stacking benefits.

Functions/Applications:
Enhanced sensory reconnaissance through eye duplicates granting 360° vision and ear duplicates detecting distant sounds. Combat multiplier with replicated arms generating half-ton force per set. Mobility via webbed tentacles for wall-climbing, gliding, and carrying multiple people. Communication through mouth replicas. Scalability through pod self-replication to extend tentacle length indefinitely.

Limits:
Tentacles and duplicated parts are vulnerable to injury. Regrowing severed duplicates is painful and time-consuming. Manifesting multiple organs from single pods reduces control. Gliding duration is limited. Tentacles lack precision for fine manipulation.

Additional Notes:
Dupli-Arms excels in reconnaissance, defense, and strength-based tasks but struggles in close-quarters combat requiring dexterity. Extended tentacles via pod self-replication risk uncontrolled growth if overused.

cardPool.title: Dust
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name: Dust

Description: The user's body generates fine, ash-like particles that can be expelled at will. Konako Haizono weaponizes this dust by hurling it at opponents' sensory organs to blind, choke, or disorient them.

Functions/Applications: Creates obscuring clouds for evasion or escape; targets eyes to blind enemies; targets nose and mouth to cause respiratory distress; serves as tactical distraction.

Limits: Overuse causes severe skin desiccation. Dust effectiveness diminishes in wet environments or against sealed sensory protection. Requires close range for maximum impact.

Additional Notes: Effective as support ability rather than direct damage. Best used in short bursts with recovery periods. Works well combined with speed-based tactics to exploit blind spots created by dust clouds.

cardPool.title: Eagle
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name: Eagle

Description: The user transforms into an eagle-like humanoid with feathered wings, sharp talons, and enhanced predatory senses comparable to a natural eagle.

Functions/Applications: Functional wings enable flight and aerial reconnaissance. Enhanced vision allows spotting distant targets. Sharp talons serve as melee weapons. The user gains eagle-level strength and agility.

Limits: Full extent unknown. Extended flight limited by fatigue. Talons restrict fine manual dexterity and tool use while transformed.

Additional Notes: A straightforward animalistic transformation with combat and mobility applications. Mastery level and partial transformation capability remain unclear.

cardPool.title: Earphone Jack
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Earphone Jack

Description:
The user possesses elongated, cable-like earlobes that stretch up to 6 meters and terminate in jack-shaped plugs. These prehensile earlobes can pierce hard materials and detect sound across 12 meters through barriers. The user can channel heartbeat vibrations through the jacks to damage objects internally.

Functions/Applications:
Reconnaissance via sound detection through walls. Offensive combat by weaponizing heartbeat vibrations as internal damage or directional sound blasts. Utility function as actual headphone cables. The earlobes function as extra limbs for gripping and manipulating objects.

Limits:
Range extends 6 meters for stretching and 12 meters for sound detection. Overuse causes ear bleeding and fatigue. Loud sounds cause sensory overload and incapacitation. Multiple noise sources mask target sounds. Losing an ear severely reduces effectiveness. Sound-based counterattacks of equal or greater volume neutralize offensive applications.

Additional Notes:
Originally a dual-ear ability, now limited to single-ear operation. A prosthetic jack replacement exists but effectiveness remains uncertain.

cardPool.title: Earth Flow
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Earth Flow

Description:
The user manipulates soil and earth with precise control, molding it into desired forms. This Quirk grants destructive and constructive power, enabling avalanches, terrain shifts, and detailed earthen structures.

Functions/Applications:
Create animated earth golems capable of independent combat. Reshape terrain for rescue operations in mountainous regions. Construct custom training grounds and obstacles. Trigger geological hazards like avalanches through remote manipulation.

Limits:
Ineffective without accessible soil or earth; useless on barren stone, metal surfaces, or open water. Range is extensive but limited to manipulable earth within sight or sensory range. Requires sustained concentration; complexity demands mental effort.

Additional Notes:
Mastery allows earth golems to pass as natural creatures. Primarily suited for mountain and forest environments. High skill ceiling with expert practitioners achieving remarkable precision and scale.

cardPool.title: Eel
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Eel

Description:
A transformation Quirk allowing the user to shift into a medium-sized eel form. Enhanced by Trigger, the user becomes a massive eel-like creature with slick, mucous-covered skin that deflects physical attacks.

Functions/Applications:
User transforms partially or fully into an eel for aquatic mobility and combat. The slimy coating deflects strikes and projectiles while aiding swimming and evasion in water environments.

Limits:
The protective slime is neutralized by moisture-draining substances like flour or sand. Transformation requires concentration and energy. The Quirk provides no enhanced strength or offensive capabilities beyond the defensive coating.

Additional Notes:
This Quirk evolved into Electric Eel through external experimentation. Slime effectiveness depends on maintaining moisture. Best utilized in wet or aquatic settings.

cardPool.title: Elasticity
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Elasticity

Description:
A touch-based Quirk that grants elasticity to any object or surface the user contacts, transforming them into bouncy, flexible materials. The user can make floors into trampolines, structures into slingshots, and create invisible elastic barriers in midair. Effects persist for a set duration and cannot be manually deactivated early.

Functions/Applications:
Create springy surfaces for mobility and bouncing; launch objects or self across distances; generate aerial platforms for navigation and defense; weaken enemy footing by elasticizing ground; apply elasticity to personal clothing for protection against grappling.

Limits:
Effects automatically wear off after a time period with no early deactivation option. Opponents who adapt to the elastic environment can turn it against the user. Requires direct physical contact to activate. Overuse risks telegraphing intentions or exhausting the user.

Additional Notes:
Most effective for escape and evasion tactics. User's dramatic fighting style conceals Quirk activation, catching enemies off-guard.

cardPool.title: Electric Eel
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Electric Eel

Description:
A mutated evolution of the Eel Quirk, granting an eel-like humanoid form with slimy, frictionless skin and electrical discharge abilities. The permanent eel appearance persists even when not using the Quirk's powers.

Functions/Applications:
Generate and discharge electricity of varying intensities for combat and environmental manipulation. The slimy skin provides enhanced mobility and reduced friction. Electricity can be concentrated into powerful shocks or dispersed broadly. The genetic material can theoretically be transferred to other users.

Limits:
Excessive electrical discharge causes unconsciousness, making sustained combat dangerous. The permanent eel transformation cannot be reversed and affects social interaction. Electricity is less effective against insulated or grounded opponents. Water amplifies electrical range but increases risk of uncontrolled discharge.

Additional Notes:
This Quirk represents forced evolution from captivity rather than natural development, suggesting potential instability. The user's weaknesses remain tied to the original Eel Quirk despite enhancement.

cardPool.title: Electromagnetic Bullets
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Electromagnetic Bullets

Description:
The user projects an electromagnetic field around thrown objects, accelerating them to high velocities and increasing their destructive impact. Ordinary projectiles like pebbles or coins become potent weapons.

Functions/Applications:
Launch projectiles with devastating force and precision; create rapid-fire barrages by throwing multiple objects in succession; useful for ranged combat and area denial.

Limits:
Requires objects to throw—cannot generate projectiles from nothing; effectiveness depends on throwing accuracy and arm strength; consumes stamina with repeated use; vulnerable at close range.

Additional Notes:
Best suited for users with good aim and access to environmental ammunition. The Quirk rewards clever use of surroundings.

cardPool.title: Endurance
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Endurance

Description:
Converts motivation and morale into physical stamina and resilience. The user becomes a tireless combatant whose strength scales with emotional investment in goals or loyalty. An "extraordinarily durable body" allows simultaneous use of multiple Quirks without strain.

Functions/Applications:
Enhanced stamina for prolonged combat. Increased durability when emotionally driven. Ability to wield multiple Quirks simultaneously without degradation. Strength surges when motivated by loyalty or determination.

Limits:
Energy depletes under sustained attacks without morale reinforcement. User weakens significantly without clear objectives or commands from their loyalty figure. Requires direct motivation to function at full capacity; standby mode renders the user sluggish. Emotional state directly impacts effectiveness—loss of motivation causes rapid power decline.

Additional Notes:
This Quirk excels for loyal bodyguards but falters without psychological reinforcement. The user's greatest strength becomes their greatest weakness: dependency on external motivation makes them unreliable without clear direction or a person to serve.

cardPool.title: Enfeeble
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name: Enfeeble

Description: A paralytic Quirk activated through eye contact that temporarily locks the target's muscles, rendering them immobile for three seconds while maintaining full consciousness. The user can affect multiple targets simultaneously if all maintain visual contact.

Functions/Applications: Disable opponents in combat, create openings for allies to attack, restrain multiple enemies, escape dangerous situations by immobilizing pursuers.

Limits: Requires direct eye contact with each target; breaks if line of sight is lost. Duration is fixed at three seconds with no extension possible. Targets remain conscious and aware. Cannot be used while the user's eyes are obscured or closed.

Additional Notes: Effective in one-on-one confrontations but harder to maintain against multiple mobile targets. Works best as a setup for follow-up attacks rather than standalone ability.

cardPool.title: Engine
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Engine

Description:
Engine grants the user mechanical exhaust ports on their body that function like actual engines, enabling extraordinary speed and momentum. The user's limbs gain engine-like protrusions with mufflers requiring regular fuel intake to maintain functionality. The Quirk adapts and strengthens when the user endures intense strain.

Functions/Applications:
Users can dash vast distances at superhuman speed and chase fast-moving targets or escape threats. Leg engines enable powerful kicks capable of crushing metal and switching between speed gears. Arm engines allow vertical propulsion, wall-climbing, and hovering. Both can execute Recipro Burst for a devastating speed surge. Mufflers regenerate after removal and improve through training.

Limits:
Requires specific fuel types; carbonated drinks cause stalling. Without refueling, the Quirk gradually loses power until it fails. Muffler removal is extremely painful. Overheating mufflers beyond safe limits causes explosions and injury. Mufflers clog when blocked by ice or foreign substances. Loss of the limbs housing the engines renders the Quirk unusable. Recipro Burst causes mandatory cooldown after use.

cardPool.title: Erasure
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Erasure

Description:
The user can nullify any target's Quirk Factor by maintaining eye contact with them. The Quirk remains active as long as the user's eyes stay open, affecting multiple targets simultaneously. When deactivated, the user's hair returns to its normal position, signaling a brief cooldown before reactivation.

Functions/Applications:
Disable an opponent's Quirk to force hand-to-hand combat on equal footing. Effective against Quirk-dependent fighters and Transformation-type abilities. Can be combined with binding weapons and enhanced agility for restraint. Creates a minor anti-gravity effect around the user's head for equipment manipulation.

Limits:
Requires direct line of sight to the target's physical body; obstacles or illusions block activation. Has no effect on Quirkless individuals or physical enhancements unrelated to Quirks. Mutant-type Quirk appendages remain impaired but functional. Causes severe dry eye syndrome, limiting sustained use. Requires a recharge interval between deactivations, creating openings for counterattack.

cardPool.title: Eruption
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Eruption

Description:
The user metabolizes body fat into superheated lava-like magma and projects it from their body. The right hand disperses wide-range magma bursts while the left hand focuses energy into concentrated lava lasers.

Functions/Applications:
Ranged magma attacks with varying areas of effect, precise lava laser strikes for targeted damage, area denial through magma dispersal, and sustained offensive pressure through continuous fat conversion.

Limits:
Requires sufficient body fat reserves to fuel the Quirk. Prolonged use causes rapid depletion and physical exhaustion. Range and intensity scale with remaining fat stores.

Additional Notes:
Effectiveness diminishes as body fat depletes, making endurance management critical. Specialized suit modifications optimize attack patterns. The Quirk excels in direct combat but becomes unreliable during extended engagements without recovery time.

cardPool.title: Explosion
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Explosion

Description:
The user excretes nitroglycerin-like sweat from their palms and ignites it at will to create devastating explosions of varying sizes. The user is immune to their own blasts except for minor recoil damage. Power scales with sweat production, growing stronger during physical activity and in warm conditions.

Functions/Applications:
Create fiery shockwaves that burn and shatter targets; propel self through air for mobility; blind opponents with flash; launch long-range blasts; fire multiple condensed explosions simultaneously after Quirk Awakening. Counters darkness-based abilities.

Limits:
Cold weather slows detonation time. Dual-palm use disperses overall strength into weaker blasts. Repeated large explosions cause arm and shoulder pain. Loss of palms renders Quirk unusable. Requires conscious ignition effort.

Additional Notes:
User employs all-out offensive strategy, closing distance before unleashing close-range bombardments. Grenadier bracers reduce physical strain from overuse. Versatile for creative combat applications when paired with tactical intelligence. User's historical arrogance regarding this Quirk has tempered over time.

cardPool.title: Extend-o-Hair
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Extend-o-Hair

Description:
The user manipulates their hair's growth and movement with precision control. Their hair is indestructible and cannot be damaged or cut. They can extend hair to form protective armor, grapple enemies, or create barriers.

Functions/Applications:
Deploy hair as whips or restraints. Form full-body armor for defense. Create nets or cages to trap groups. Establish barriers or shields. Use hair for mobility or sensory extension.

Limits:
Hair tangles easily, restricting movement. Extended hair requires concentration; distraction weakens control. Tangled hair reduces combat effectiveness. Control range is limited to 30 feet.

Additional Notes:
User typically maintains an unusually hairy appearance. Quirk excels in group combat and defense but falters when tangled. Best suited for users with patience and tactical thinking.

cardPool.title: Extra Arms
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Extra Arms

Description:
A mutation-type Quirk that grants the user an additional set of functional arms, totaling four limbs with equal strength and dexterity.

Functions/Applications:
The user can perform multiple actions simultaneously—wielding dual weapons, grappling while striking, or manipulating objects independently. Provides enhanced climbing, melee combat versatility, and the ability to execute complex physical tasks requiring more than two limbs.

Limits:
The extra arms do not grant superhuman strength and match baseline physical capability. Coordination requires conscious effort, and simultaneous actions may diminish reflexes. Armor and clothing must be specially fitted to accommodate the extra limbs.

Additional Notes:
This Quirk excels in close-quarters combat and grappling but offers no ranged advantage. Martial training maximizes the benefits of enhanced mobility and tactical positioning.

cardPool.title: Fan
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Fan

Description:
A wind-generation quirk activated by rapidly spinning the user's wrists. Wind scales from gentle breeze to destructive cyclone force depending on rotation speed.

Functions/Applications:
Create directional wind attacks to knock back opponents. Generate tornadoes for area-of-effect damage. Deflect projectiles, create barriers, or assist with mobility.

Limits:
Maximum continuous use of one minute before risking tendon inflammation. Overuse causes severe wrist pain and potential joint damage. Cannot generate wind without active wrist rotation.

Additional Notes:
Effective at range and against multiple opponents, but requires strategic timing due to strict time constraints. Users must manage fatigue to avoid debilitating injury.

cardPool.title: Fat Absorption
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Fat Absorption

Description:
The user can adhere objects and living beings to their body upon contact, causing them to sink into accumulated body fat. This grants exceptional protection against blades, bullets, and conventional attacks. Maintaining this Quirk requires constant high body mass through regular food consumption.

Functions/Applications:
Absorbs impact force from attacks and releases it in a devastating counterattack punch. Restrains opponents by enveloping them with the user's large frame. Acts as a mobile shield, protecting allies from incoming damage.

Limits:
Requires substantial body fat to function; a slim build renders the Quirk ineffective. Counterattack technique burns significant fat reserves, leaving the user vulnerable if it fails. Recovery of lost body mass takes three days. Quirks that consume flesh or fat rapidly deplete the user's mass and disable the ability mid-combat.

Additional Notes:
Best suited for defensive roles and restraint operations. Users must maintain a disciplined eating regimen. Physical speed and agility are compromised due to large body mass, making this Quirk dependent on positioning and anticipation rather than evasion.

cardPool.title: Fierce Gains
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Fierce Gains

Description:
The user's muscles harden to exceptional toughness on command, creating an almost impenetrable defensive state. Muscular tissue becomes dense and rock-like, dramatically increasing durability against piercing and slashing attacks.

Functions/Applications:
Hardens muscles to deflect or absorb damage from weapons and impacts. Can be layered with other defensive abilities for exponential protection. Allows the user to withstand attacks that would normally pierce or cut through flesh.

Limits:
Requires conscious activation and cannot protect against blunt force trauma equally well. Hardened muscles still conduct kinetic energy, so crushing impacts transfer damage internally. Cannot be maintained indefinitely without exhaustion. Works only on the user's own musculature.

Additional Notes:
Most effective when combined with high pain tolerance. Works best on users with naturally large muscle mass. Does not enhance strength or speed, only defensive capability.

cardPool.title: Fierce Wings
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Fierce Wings

Description:
A pair of large, crimson wings with individually controllable feathers. The user can detach feathers and maintain telepathic connection with each one. Feathers vary in size and sharpness, functioning as tools and weapons. The wings grant flight and enhanced sensory perception through vibration detection.

Functions/Applications:
Flight at superhuman velocities; aerial combat and evasion. Detached feathers can carry objects, cut, or serve as remote sensors. Feathers can be reattached if intact. Regeneration occurs within two days. Supports allies by enhancing their mobility.

Limits:
Fire severely damages feathers, crippling flight. Excessive detachment worsens flying ability. Wings require extended healing after major damage. Quirk does not enhance physical strength. Damaged feathers cannot be instantly restored. Severe burns may permanently reduce flight capacity.

Additional Notes:
Best used by speed-focused fighters with tactical awareness. User must strategically manage feather expenditure to maintain mobility. Effective in support roles.

cardPool.title: Fire Cracker
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Fire Cracker

Description:
The user can detach chunks of their hair and detonate them as explosive projectiles. These blasts are destructive enough to demolish structures, though weaker than similar explosion-based quirks. The user can also harness explosions for limited propulsion and mobility.

Functions/Applications:
Hair chunks serve as ranged explosive weapons for combat and environmental destruction. Detonations can boost movement speed and distance for rapid repositioning or escape. Effective for area denial and creating chaos in confined spaces.

Limits:
