Explosions are notably weaker than comparable quirks. Hair regeneration appears necessary for sustained use, suggesting finite ammunition per encounter. Propulsion capability is unreliable as primary mobility. Close-range detonation poses risk to user if not carefully timed.

Additional Notes:
Quirk is most effective at medium range. User requires tactical placement rather than overwhelming force. Hair-based mechanics suggest vulnerability to abilities targeting hair or head. Works best in combination with other strategies.

cardPool.title: Flash Bang Sweat
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Flash Bang Sweat

Description:
The user secretes a volatile substance through sweat that detonates with brilliant light and sound upon impact. The substance can be collected and weaponized through specialized equipment for offensive and supportive applications.

Functions/Applications:
Launch explosive sweat projectiles via costume-mounted systems for area denial and crowd control. Create blinding flashes and deafening bursts to disorient enemies or signal allies. Deploy wide-pattern salvos to cover large areas.

Limits:
The Quirk produces no direct physical harm—only sensory disruption. Effectiveness reduced against enemies with sound/light resistance or protection. Requires specialized gear; the user cannot weaponize sweat without equipment. Continuous sweating may cause dehydration or exhaustion.

Additional Notes:
The constant perspiration may be inherent or unrelated. The Quirk's strength lies in tactical applications rather than direct combat. Lacks lethal stopping power, limiting value in life-threatening situations.

cardPool.title: Flight
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Flight

Description:
The user levitates and flies at high speeds while projecting an aerodynamic barrier around themselves and anything they touch. This barrier protects from heat, cold, and physical harm. The user can selectively control which targets receive protection and coverage amounts.

Functions/Applications:
The user can carry massive objects or multiple people while flying, gaining superhuman strength proportional to barrier focus. Full self-focus grants maximum protection and strength, while dispersing it weakens personal defenses. Ideal for rescue operations, transport missions, and aerial combat.

Limits:
Protecting others reduces the user's own barrier strength. Spreading protection too thin leaves the user vulnerable. Flight speed and carrying capacity depend on barrier concentration. The user cannot fly without maintaining the barrier, becoming immobile if exhausted.

Additional Notes:
This Quirk grants mobility and utility for team scenarios. However, the protection trade-off creates tactical decisions between heroism and self-preservation.

cardPool.title: Float
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Float

Description:
Float grants the user the ability to levitate and suspend themselves in mid-air indefinitely. When amplified by stored energy, it transforms into high-speed flight for aerial combat and rapid transportation.

Functions/Applications:
The user can hover stationary or move through the air at controlled speeds. Enhanced versions enable sustained flight at considerable velocity. Can be combined with other movement-based abilities to achieve greater speeds or perform aerial maneuvers.

Limits:
Requires active concentration to maintain levitation; user cannot fly faster than their physical conditioning allows without external enhancement. Cannot lift others without additional Quirks. Provides no defensive properties and leaves the user vulnerable while airborne. High-speed flight drains stamina over extended use.

Additional Notes:
Float is a foundational mobility Quirk suited for hit-and-run tactics, positioning, and transportation. Its true power emerges when paired with energy amplification or complementary Quirks.

cardPool.title: Fly Swatter
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Fly Swatter

Description:
The user generates kinetic energy waves by rapidly swinging their arms, projecting force at distant targets as if struck directly. Waves travel several meters with power equivalent to a close-range melee strike.

Functions/Applications:
Rapid successive swings create multiple projectile waves. Useful for striking distant enemies, hitting multiple targets, or creating distance from threats.

Limits:
Waves dissipate after a few meters. Force cannot exceed normal physical contact strength. Requires visible arm movement—useless when restrained. Rapid swings cause fatigue.

Additional Notes:
Straightforward quirk suitable for everyday utility. Works best in open spaces with unrestricted arm movement.

cardPool.title: Flying Squirrel
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Flying Squirrel

Description:
The user develops wing-like membranes of skin stretched between their arms and body, allowing them to glide through the air like a flying squirrel. These membranes enable sustained flight and aerial maneuverability.

Functions/Applications:
Gliding and sustained flight for transportation and tactical repositioning. Can carry one additional person during flight. Useful for infiltration, reconnaissance, and aerial support.

Limits:
Cannot achieve true powered flight—only gliding and short bursts of altitude gain. Weight capacity limited to one passenger plus the user. Requires open space to maneuver effectively. Sustained flight causes fatigue.

Additional Notes:
Best utilized as a support ability for allies rather than direct combat. Ideal for hit-and-run tactics and quick escapes.

cardPool.title: Foldabody
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Foldabody

Description:
Foldabody grants the ability to manipulate body thickness and stretch limbs into paper-thin forms. The user can flatten, fold, and reshape their entire body or sections at will, transforming into blades, drills, or threads while maintaining consciousness and control.

Functions/Applications:
The user can slip through narrow spaces, transform body parts into piercing weapons striking faster than sound, and cut vital points to incapacitate enemies. Mid-air combat is possible through drill-like twisting. The Quirk allows slow body regeneration.

Limits:
Extreme thinning shortens lifespan and causes physical deterioration. The ultimate technique of thread-size reduction causes severe weakness and requires extended recovery. Overuse leaves the user critically weakened. Regeneration is slow, taking years to restore damaged parts.

Additional Notes:
Mastery allows transformation at supersonic speeds. The user employs ninja combat style, exploiting speed and precision. Even severely weakened, the user retains tiny functional forms with reduced regenerative capacity.

cardPool.title: Food
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Food

Description:
The user can bite, chew, and digest virtually any physical material from metal to stone to wood. Their jaw possesses supernatural strength and their digestive system processes consumed matter without filling them, creating a seemingly bottomless appetite.

Functions/Applications:
Consume and destroy barriers, walls, or obstacles. Break through locked doors or restraints. Neutralize thrown projectiles or incoming attacks by eating them. Consume enemy equipment or weapons to disarm opponents.

Limits:
The user must be within biting range to activate the Quirk, making them vulnerable to ranged attackers. Toxic or poisonous substances still cause illness if consumed. The user cannot digest intangible things, magical constructs, or purely magical attacks. Extremely hard materials may require extended time to chew through.

Additional Notes:
The Quirk's main tactical weakness is its close-range requirement, forcing dangerous proximity with enemies. Best used defensively for obstacle removal or as a last resort for disarming. The "bottomless" nature means no satiation, which could create psychological complications.

cardPool.title: Forced Quirk Activation
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Forced Quirk Activation

Description:
A control-based quirk that forcibly triggers another person's quirk against their will, bypassing mental resistance or physical incapacity. Activation works regardless of target consciousness or consent.

Functions/Applications:
Activate allied quirks remotely; trigger enemy quirks to exhaust them; self-activate additional quirks while paralyzed; combine with contact abilities for precision targeting.

Limits:
Requires knowledge of target's quirk; most effective with direct contact; cannot create or modify quirks, only force activation; drains stamina per use; useless on those without quirks; does not guarantee the activated quirk will behave as intended.

Additional Notes:
Best utilized by quirk collectors or multi-quirk users. Works equally on willing allies and unwilling enemies. Particularly dangerous combined with contact or control quirks.

cardPool.title: Foresight
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Foresight

Description:
A prediction Quirk granting the ability to perceive a target's future actions and movements up to one hour ahead. The user witnesses events from a third-person perspective, including the target and surroundings. Activation requires physical touch followed by eye contact.

Functions/Applications:
Combat evasion becomes near-perfect during eye contact, allowing prediction of every opponent move. Investigative work reveals targets' plans, locations, and associates through witnessing future actions. The Quirk can perceive events years into the future, though distant events require rough estimation.

Limits:
A 24-hour cooldown must pass before reactivating on any target. Breaking eye contact halts prediction immediately. The Quirk is purely visual—no dialogue or actions lacking visual context can be understood. The foreseen future cannot be changed through normal means, though strong collective will may alter outcomes. Both touch and eye contact required for activation.

Additional Notes:
Users tend toward fatalistic thinking, believing foreseen outcomes are inevitable.

cardPool.title: Free Walker
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Free Walker

Description:
A mobility-based Quirk granting exceptional leg freedom of movement and fatigue resistance. Users move their legs with unprecedented speed, agility, and endurance without typical muscular exhaustion.

Functions/Applications:
Enhanced sprinting and sustained running, rapid directional changes without momentum loss, extended activity without leg fatigue, superior footwork in combat or traversal.

Limits:
Unknown upper speed threshold; fatigue affects other body parts; prolonged use duration unclear; no strength or jumping enhancement; affects only the legs.

Additional Notes:
Free Walker mechanics remain largely undocumented. It is movement and endurance-focused rather than offensive or defensive. Best suited for pursuits, escapes, and sustained physical exertion.

cardPool.title: Frog
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Frog

Description:
Tsuyu possesses the collective abilities of all frog species, granting her frog-like anatomy, enhanced leg strength, wall-clinging grip, and an extensible tongue. She can camouflage, swim rapidly, secrete paralytic or scent-hiding mucus, and regurgitate with precision. Her cold-blooded physiology makes her exceptionally agile in aquatic environments and proficient in terrestrial acrobatics.

Functions/Applications:
Tsuyu excels in water-based combat and rescue operations. Her extendable tongue serves as a grappling tool, whip, or rescue line. She can hop to extreme heights, cling to vertical surfaces, camouflage for stealth, and deploy paralytic secretions defensively. Mucus production masks her scent for evasion and reconnaissance.

Limits:
Cold exposure severely weakens her Quirk and induces lethargy; prolonged cold triggers hibernation. High temperatures and fire threaten to dehydrate her aquatic biology, causing vulnerability. Her strength is directly tied to ambient temperature.

Additional Notes:
Tsuyu trained extensively through rock-climbing to build muscle, suggesting her abilities scale with physical conditioning.

cardPool.title: Frost
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Frost

Description:
The user generates and manipulates ice, coating their body in frozen armor and projecting ice blasts outward. This Quirk provides natural resistance to cold and freezing temperatures, making the user difficult to harm with ice-based attacks.

Functions/Applications:
Create protective ice armor; launch ice projectiles or waves; lower ambient temperature in localized areas; shield allies from heat or fire; sustain defensive positions through ice barriers.

Limits:
Prolonged use causes frostbite and hypothermia. Extended combat drains stamina quickly. Users with insufficient fire resistance risk severe burns against extreme heat.

Additional Notes:
Most effective in defensive or support roles rather than sustained offense. Works best when combined with other Quirks or used cooperatively with allies.

cardPool.title: Gale Gale
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Gale Gale

Description:
The user manipulates wind currents around their body, creating whirling vortexes for flight and protection. The winds deflect attacks and projectiles with ease.

Functions/Applications:
Flight, deflection of physical and ranged attacks, offensive wind blasts, enhanced combat mobility. The user maintains a defensive wind shell while moving freely through the air.

Limits:
The user's head remains completely exposed, creating a critical vulnerability. Maintaining the Quirk requires constant concentration; disruption weakens the wind shield. High stamina consumption during flight and intense deflection.

Additional Notes:
Despite appearing non-threatening, Gale Gale is deceptively powerful defensively. Opponents must exploit the head vulnerability through elevated angles or coordinated attacks to overcome the wind shield.

cardPool.title: Gas
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Gas

Description:
The user generates a massive, swirling cloud of purple, sleep-inducing poison gas from their body. Anyone inhaling it falls unconscious immediately. The gas forms a typhoon centered on the user, strongest nearby and weakening at edges. The user senses creatures within the gas through its fluctuations.

Functions/Applications:
Crowd control and area denial for trapping enemies and blocking escape routes. Detects movement within the cloud for tracking without sight. Best used as support during ambushes rather than direct combat, keeping distance from threats.

Limits:
Gas masks and breathing apparatus grant immunity. Gas cannot be manipulated for precision attacks. Wind or physical force easily disperses it. The user is not immune and must wear a gas mask to avoid unconsciousness. If the user loses consciousness, the gas immediately dissipates. Range is limited despite its area effect.

Additional Notes:
The user must remain vigilant against masked opponents and typically carries a handgun as backup. Success depends on maintaining distance and reading gas movements.

cardPool.title: Gatling
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Gatling

Description:
The user's arms transform into gun-like biological organs that fire keratin claw projectiles in rapid bursts. These organic weapons integrate seamlessly into the user's body as a natural ranged system.

Functions/Applications:
Fire keratin claws rapidly for suppressive fire and area control. Effective in close combat for forcing opponents back and creating distance. High volume of fire can deter multiple enemies simultaneously.

Limits:
Projectiles have limited range and stopping power. Sustained firing depletes keratin reserves and requires recovery time. The visible organs cannot be concealed, immediately revealing combat capabilities.

Additional Notes:
Best used defensively paired with hand-to-hand combat. Keratin regeneration rate determines firing duration.

cardPool.title: Gecko
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Gecko

Description:
Grants reptilian appearance and ability to cling to walls and sheer surfaces with adhesive power, even on fast-moving vehicles.

Functions/Applications:
Scaling vertical surfaces in cities, evading pursuers through vertical movement, reconnaissance from elevated positions, clinging to moving targets. Most effective in built-up areas.

Limits:
Severely limited outside urban environments. Weak Quirk even among reptilian families. Ineffective on rough terrain, natural rock faces, or open areas. Requires intact surfaces to function.

Additional Notes:
Best used for mobility and evasion in cities rather than direct combat. Users should develop strategies for non-urban scenarios.

cardPool.title: Gigantification
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Gigantification

Description:
The user drastically increases their body size to colossal proportions, gaining immense mass and strength. Control and maximum height vary by user. The transformation grants devastating physical power but demands substantial space to function effectively.

Functions/Applications:
Enables overpowering larger opponents, destroying structures and obstacles, intimidating enemies, and serving as mobile transportation. Some variants allow blob-like transformation with stretching capabilities or creation of smaller clones for reconnaissance.

Limits:
Most users cannot assume intermediate sizes, requiring full commitment to transformation. The Quirk demands open spaces—enclosed areas severely hamper mobility. Some variants force automatic shrinkage after prolonged activation. Emotional instability may trigger uncontrolled transformation. Maximum size varies by user, ranging from ~67 feet to over 82 feet, with some users subject to mandatory time restrictions.

Additional Notes:
Exceptionally effective against giant-class villains and in urban combat where space permits. The Quirk often causes substantial collateral damage and property destruction.

cardPool.title: Glamour
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Glamour

Description:
The user emits mist from their mouth that materializes into vivid visual and auditory illusions. These illusions can fill entire rooms and are designed to deceive, distract, or misdirect opponents and allies alike.

Functions/Applications:
Create convincing illusions of people, monsters, or environments to confuse enemies. Use illusions as decoys to protect allies. Craft illusions based on real individuals by studying their appearance and personality. Illusions can range from charming to horrifying depending on intent.

Limits:
Illusions are temporary and dissipate unreliably. They cannot cause physical damage. The user must expel mist from their mouth, creating a visible casting action. Large-scale illusions require more effort and cannot be maintained indefinitely. Illusions may fail against opponents with heightened awareness or sensory resistance.

Additional Notes:
Effectiveness relies on the user's creativity and knowledge of what they're mimicking. Training involves studying others to improve quality and versatility. Best used in supportive roles or tactical situations rather than direct combat.

cardPool.title: Glide and Slide
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Glide and Slide

Description:
A movement-based Quirk allowing users to glide across surfaces like roller skates. Skating gestures build momentum for enhanced speed beyond normal human capability. Only one foot needs ground contact.

Functions/Applications:
Enables rapid pursuit and evasion across flat or sloped terrain. Users accelerate through momentum-building gestures with minimal physical exertion, ideal for ground coverage during combat or escape.

Limits:
Slower than comparable Quirks. Requires at least one foot on a surface—cannot function mid-air or on unstable terrain. Momentum needs active maintenance through skating gestures; sudden stops are difficult.

Additional Notes:
Favors hit-and-run tactics and mobility strategies over direct combat. Multiple users can coordinate for group pursuits. Effectiveness varies by surface quality and available space.

cardPool.title: Glycerin
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name: Glycerin

Description: A secretion-type Quirk allowing the user to produce smooth, oily liquid from their skin. The glycerin maintains youthful appearance and skin health regardless of age. When combined with Explosion-type Quirks, it produces volatile sweat-based abilities in offspring.

Functions/Applications: Create slippery surfaces for evasion or mobility; maintain physical conditioning and appearance; provide lubrication for utility; enhance durability through skin conditioning.

Limits: Primarily cosmetic and defensive rather than offensive. Glycerin production limited to natural skin secretion rates and cannot be weaponized into projectiles. Effectiveness diminishes in dry environments. Overuse causes skin dehydration and fatigue.

Additional Notes: Demonstrates genetic combination potential with explosive abilities. Best suited for support roles, infiltration, or defensive strategies. User's youthful appearance may create tactical advantages through misdirection.

cardPool.title: Good Ear
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name: Good Ear

Description: A sensory enhancement Quirk that grants the user the ability to perceive and process ultrasonic frequencies far beyond normal human hearing range. The user can detect vibrations and sounds in the high-frequency spectrum for information gathering.

Functions/Applications: Long-distance communication through high-frequency signals, crowd assessment by detecting acoustic signatures, surveillance through sound analysis, and echolocation-like environmental mapping.

Limits: Only functions with sound-based information; useless in complete silence or against sound-dampening effects. Long-distance communication requires compatible recipients. Standard human speech requires concentration to hear clearly. Overexposure to high frequencies causes disorientation.

Additional Notes: Best utilized in team settings with coordinated partners. Effectiveness increases with familiarity of specific sound patterns. Environmental noise can interfere with precision detection.

cardPool.title: Grasshopper
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Grasshopper

Description:
A transformation Quirk that allows the user to morph into a large humanoid grasshopper form, enhancing physical prowess. The Hotta Brothers activate this through Trigger injections, though baseline capabilities remain unexplored.

Functions/Applications:
Grants increases to strength, agility, and jumping height in grasshopper form. Users can perform synchronized combo attacks when coordinated. Primary application is close-quarters combat with enhanced mobility and striking force.

Limits:
True limitations unknown due to Trigger reliance. The Quirk's independent functionality without stimulants has never been tested. Transformation requires preparation or chemical activation.

Additional Notes:
Most effective with coordinated users. Trigger dependency suggests potential artificial modification or suppression. Full potential awaits discovery without chemical enhancement.

cardPool.title: Gyrate
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Gyrate

Description:
Sen Kaibara's Quirk allows him to rotate any part of his body at extreme speeds, transforming his limbs into spinning drill-like weapons. His spiral-patterned finger gloves amplify strikes into devastating cutting and piercing attacks capable of grinding through defenses.

Functions/Applications:
Enhanced close-range melee combat with rotating limbs that drill and cut through armor and flesh. His gloved hands amplify offensive damage significantly, making physical blocking ineffective. Gyrate excels at rapid rotational strikes and maintains combat effectiveness when grappled or restrained.

Limits:
Purely close-range with no long-distance applications. Cannot prevent being grabbed or carried, limiting mobility. Effectiveness relies heavily on spiral gloves for maximum damage output.

Additional Notes:
Sen's Quirk transforms hand-to-hand combat into a dangerous engagement zone where rotation speed and angular momentum become lethal. The gloves are essential equipment functioning as force multipliers that activate the Quirk's true potential.

cardPool.title: Hair Control
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Hair Control

Description:
A Quirk allowing manipulation of one's own hair with precision and force. The user can harden, extend, and weaponize hair strands for offensive and defensive purposes. Effectiveness varies based on hair length, density, and training.

Functions/Applications:
Hair can be fired as projectiles with bullet-like velocity. Hair can be shaped into weapons like whips, blades, or bludgeons for melee combat. Hair serves as an extension of the body for grappling, binding, or striking from range.

Limits:
Control is restricted to the user's own hair only. Hardened hair is vulnerable to sharp cuts and fire-based attacks. Extended hair depletes stamina with prolonged use. Hair growth limits available material for sustained combat. Short or thin hair significantly reduces offensive potential.

Additional Notes:
Longer hair provides tactical advantages. Training determines precision and speed of manipulation. Overextended hair leaves the user's head exposed. Works best in close-to-mid range combat.

cardPool.title: Hair-Raiser
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Hair-Raiser

Description:
The user can extend, harden, and detach hair strands from their scalp at will. These strands become malleable weapons or tools shaped and manipulated during combat or utility tasks.

Functions/Applications:
Hair strands harden into spears, whips, or cutting implements for offense. They serve as grappling hooks, restraints, or construction tools. The user maintains control over detached strands for dynamic repositioning mid-combat.

Limits:
Effectiveness diminishes as hair depletes—excessive use leaves the user bald and vulnerable. Hardened hair can be cut or broken by sharp or strong forces. The user cannot regrow hair faster than normal, creating a finite resource pool per engagement.

Additional Notes:
Best suited for creative, adaptable fighters who think tactically. Hair-Raiser rewards resourcefulness but punishes wasteful approaches. The Quirk's versatility applies to both combat and non-combat scenarios.

cardPool.title: Hardening
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Hardening

Description:
The user hardens any part or all of their body into rock-like material, transforming skin into an impenetrable, jagged surface. This grants extreme durability against physical trauma and increases striking power through rough, cutting edges.

Functions/Applications:
Provides defense against bullets, blades, and blunt force trauma. Offensive applications include devastating close-range strikes and grazing cuts from hardened skin. Can serve as a human shield for allies. Hardness improves with repeated damage taken while activated.

Limits:
Requires close-range combat; no long-distance capability. Cannot protect against extreme temperatures. Stamina depletes under sustained damage. Eyes remain vulnerable. Effect weakens under psychological stress like fear or pain.

Additional Notes:
Maximum hardness state ("Unbreakable") provides temporary near-invulnerability but demands significant stamina. Manifests early in life but requires intense training to reach peak effectiveness. Dangerous in rescue situations due to rough texture causing accidental injury. Comparable to Steel-type Quirks but distinctly adaptive through damage accumulation.

cardPool.title: Hardflame Fan
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Hardflame Fan

Description:
The user generates walls of solidified fire for defensive protection. The fire appears as shiny, viscous liquid that hardens into barriers. Heat exceeding the Quirk's temperature can penetrate these defenses.

Functions/Applications:
Deploy layered fire walls to shield against physical and thermal attacks. Position barriers around vulnerable body parts. Create multiple defensive layers for increased protection. Hardened fire absorbs moderate-level heat strikes.

Limits:
Fire hotter than the user's generated flames passes through unimpeded. Cannot be used offensively. Requires continuous focus to maintain barriers; dissipates if concentration breaks. Each additional layer progressively drains stamina. High-tier fire Quirk users bypass this defense entirely.

Additional Notes:
This is a stolen Quirk from a relatively unknown or weaker user. Best used defensively as part of a layered tactical approach. Most effective against opponents with moderate fire power or physical attackers.

cardPool.title: Heal
keys:
(empty result)

"Heal" is a common English verb and should be removed according to the instruction to remove common words.
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Heal

Description:
The user accelerates a target's natural healing by kissing them. Injuries taking months to heal can fully restore in seconds. The user maintains fine control over healing intensity to manage stamina drain.

Functions/Applications:
Rapidly mend wounds, broken bones, and internal injuries. Heal severe trauma in multiple sessions. Works best combined with conventional surgery for life-threatening conditions. User can selectively refuse to heal certain injuries.

Limits:
Healing consumes the receiver's stamina; severe healing can cause exhaustion or death if insufficient reserves. Cannot regrow lost limbs. Cannot fully heal extremely severe injuries or permanent scarring. Requires the receiver alive and capable of natural healing. Most dangerous injuries need surgical intervention before Heal can be safely applied.

Additional Notes:
User must be in close physical proximity with willing contact to activate the Quirk. Repeated overuse of self-damaging Quirks may result in refusal to heal. User's medical knowledge and surgical skill are vital for critical situations. Stamina depletion is the primary risk factor.

cardPool.title: Heavy Payload
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Heavy Payload

Description:
A stolen Quirk that amplifies the destructive force of attacks. When combined with offensive Quirks, Heavy Payload exponentially increases damage output, making it a powerful multiplier for energy-based or kinetic attacks.

Functions/Applications:
Heavy Payload enhances striking power and layers with complementary Quirks like Air Cannon or Radio Waves to create devastating combination attacks. A single boosted beam can rival multiple stacked combat Quirks.

Limits:
Provides no defensive capabilities and requires synergy with other offensive abilities. Power scales with the base strength of paired Quirks. Solo use offers minimal advantage over raw physical force.

Additional Notes:
Most effective when combined with ranged or energy-projection Quirks. True strength emerges in coordinated multi-Quirk strategies, making it a tactical asset rather than standalone power.

cardPool.title: Helical Scythe
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Helical Scythe

Description:
The user manifests large, crimson scythe-like tendrils on their fingers and head. These extensions can grow, contract, and rotate at high speeds, granting exceptional reach and piercing power capable of cutting through solid ice.

Functions/Applications:
Tendrils function as independent grappling tools for ensnaring or striking distant targets. The user can rotate appendages to manipulate environmental elements—redirecting water into typhoons, influencing fire patterns, or constructing solid forms for intimidation or structural purposes.

Limits:
Appendages require significant stamina to extend and maintain; prolonged use causes fatigue. Rotation-based elemental manipulation demands precise control and concentration. The Quirk's true strength appears dependent on external enhancement via Trigger drugs; baseline functionality remains unclear. Range is limited by appendage length.

Additional Notes:
This Quirk excels at mid-to-long-range combat and environmental control but struggles against opponents who close distance rapidly or disrupt concentration. The user's reliance on enhancement drugs suggests vulnerability when unstimulated.

cardPool.title: High Specs
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
High Specs

Description:
An intellect-enhancing quirk that elevates the user's mind and body far beyond normal limits. Grants superhuman intelligence, perception, reaction speed, and comprehension. The user gains enhanced physical attributes and becomes fully sapient with human-level cognition and speech regardless of original species.

Functions/Applications:
Devise complex strategies instantly from minimal information. Execute intricate plans with precise calculations. Perfect recall of all experienced events and knowledge. Leadership and tactical command at the highest level. Enhanced physical coordination for delicate tasks.

Limits:
Cannot increase physical power beyond enhanced baseline—remains dependent on strategy over brute force. Perfect memory creates emotional baggage; past traumas persist with perfect clarity, potentially clouding judgment. Intelligence does not grant invulnerability or precognition. Requires time to formulate strategies in novel situations. Physical body remains limited by biological constraints.

cardPool.title: Hologram
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Hologram

Description:
Mahoro Shimano projects illusory holograms of any object or creature she visualizes. The projections scale from small decoys to massive constructs visible from great distances. They exist as pure light with no physical substance.

Functions/Applications:
Create diversionary illusions to confuse opponents. Generate emergency signal constructs visible across wide areas. Project multiple holograms simultaneously to overwhelm perception.

Limits:
Holograms possess zero tangibility and cannot interact with physical matter or deal damage. Strong winds disperse projections instantly. Keen-eyed or analytical targets easily see through the deception. Requires active concentration; losing focus causes immediate dissipation. No offensive or defensive capabilities.

Additional Notes:
Best suited for psychological warfare, tactical misdirection, and non-combat scenarios. Pairs well with escape strategies. Useless in direct confrontation against determined foes.

cardPool.title: Homing
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Homing

Description:
The user locks onto any visible target within 600 meters and launches projectiles that automatically chase their prey. Projectiles home in with relentless accuracy, but strikes lack significant force, prioritizing tracking over impact damage.

Functions/Applications:
Lock onto distant enemies for guaranteed hit tracking; maintain pressure on mobile targets; suppress enemy movement; execute precise strikes from range without mid-flight adjustments; work effectively in open terrain.

Limits:
Requires visual line of sight at lock-on; effective range capped at 600 meters; projectiles deal minimal damage; user cannot dictate hit location; useless against invisible or obscured enemies; standard projectile speed allows brief reaction time.

Additional Notes:
Best suited for harassment, area denial, and target tracking rather than direct combat. Pairs well with sustained volleys. Ineffective against heavily armored opponents who can endure repeated low-impact strikes.

cardPool.title: Horn Cannon
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Horn Cannon

Description:
Pony can detach and launch her horns as independent projectiles, with new horns regenerating almost instantly. She maintains remote telekinetic control over up to four horns simultaneously, allowing mid-air trajectory adjustments. The horns are dense and curved, ideal for piercing, restraining, or transporting targets.

Functions/Applications:
Launch multiple horns in rapid succession for offensive strikes. Remotely steer horns around obstacles to bypass defenses. Use horns to restrain or pin enemies. Transport allies and objects via horns. Assist mobility and climbing in navigation.

Limits:
Only four horns can be controlled remotely at once. Horns are breakable and weaken without regular keratin intake. Transporting multiple people or objects reduces horn speed. Holding Pony's horns in place prevents detachment and negates the Quirk. Horns require time to regenerate if destroyed faster than production rate.

Additional Notes:
Best suited for long-range and mid-range combat. Control requires hand gestures mimicking horn positions. Curved horn shape enables precision targeting but may limit damage against heavily armored foes.

cardPool.title: Hula Hoop
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Hula Hoop

Description:
The user generates large hoops of concentrated energy by raising their arm, then hurls them as projectile weapons. The hoops are solid enough to impact with force.

Functions/Applications:
Primary offensive ranged attack through energy hoop projection. Can strike multiple targets in sequence. Useful for medium-range combat.

Limits:
Requires arm-raising motion before generating each hoop, creating a telegraphed attack. Energy hoops dissipate after moderate distance. Cannot be rapidly fired due to generation cooldown.

Additional Notes:
Best suited for direct combat rather than stealth. Effectiveness depends on aim and opponent distance. Most potent against stationary or slow-moving targets.

cardPool.title: Hydra
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Hydra

Description:
A stolen Quirk allowing the user to summon massive serpentine shark-like creatures from their back. These beasts possess immense strength, can be controlled at will, and are large enough to crush humans.

Functions/Applications:
Summon a creature to attack enemies; when damaged, it splits into two separate heads, multiplying offensive capability. Two heads can lift the user airborne for mobility. Enhancement drugs enable multiple simultaneous summons.

Limits:
Initially limited to one creature; splitting occurs only when damaged. Multiple summons require enhancement drugs. Most effective as surprise attacks; less effective in anticipated confrontations.

Additional Notes:
The stolen, unnamed Quirk is unstable and unreliable. Enhancement drugs expand combat potential but create dependency. Large creature size is a liability in confined spaces.

cardPool.title: Hypertrophy
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Hypertrophy

Description:
The user can enlarge their arm to massive proportions at will, increasing its size and mass dramatically. The enlarged limb retains full strength and control, allowing for devastating attacks and restraint capabilities.

Functions/Applications:
Deliver crushing blows with force. Restrain opponents through overwhelming size. Break through obstacles and structures.

Limits:
Only affects the arm. Enlargement takes a moment to activate, making it unsuitable for surprise attacks. Requires physical strength to leverage the increased mass. Extended use causes fatigue.

Additional Notes:
Most effective in direct combat. The enlarged arm becomes a prominent target during use.

cardPool.title: Ice Ply
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Ice Ply

Description:
A manipulation quirk granting complete control over existing ice and water. The user gathers, shapes, and weaponizes ice freely within town-sized range. After awakening, the user gained ability to lower ice temperature and freeze water, expanding available ice supply and combat potential.

Functions/Applications:
The user shapes ice into constructs—fists, platforms, dragons—for offense and defense. By freezing nearby water sources, they generate massive manipulable ice for large-scale attacks. They ride ice platforms for swift movement and lower ice temperature to counter fire-based attacks.

Limits:
Cannot create ice from nothing; only manipulates existing ice and water. Severely weakened in dry environments lacking water or ice. Control range limited to town-sized areas. Extended large-scale attacks drain stamina significantly.

Additional Notes:
Raw power scales with environmental resources. Excels in wet climates and urban areas with water infrastructure but becomes nearly useless in deserts. Mastery requires years of training for complex constructions and temperature precision.

cardPool.title: Ignition
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Ignition

Description:
A fire-generation quirk allowing the user to produce and control flames. The user generates a small flame atop their head as a baseline and can exhale powerful flares through their mouth. When enhanced by external stimulants like Trigger, flames spread across the upper body and intensify significantly.

Functions/Applications:
Ranged attacks via fire breath, close-range flame projection, and offensive combat support. Enhanced form enables wide-area fire generation across the torso for increased damage output and coverage.

Limits:
Base form produces only modest flames and requires enhancement to reach combat effectiveness. Flames originate primarily from the head and mouth, limiting directional versatility. Trigger dependency creates reliance on external substances. Overuse risks exhaustion or physical strain.

Additional Notes:
The upper body becomes the focal point for power amplification, suggesting potential durability concerns in that region when active. Enhanced form is temporary, indicating Trigger's effects are not permanent.

cardPool.title: Impact Recoil
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Impact Recoil

Description:
A defensive Quirk that reverses incoming physical force back upon the attacker, redirecting kinetic damage rather than absorbing it.

Functions/Applications:
Reflects melee strikes, projectiles, and collision attacks back at their source with amplified force. Can redirect attacks indirectly through intermediary shields to protect vulnerable moments.

Limits:
Does not fully negate impact; the user experiences brief incapacitation from extremely powerful strikes. Cannot reflect indirect damage like energy, heat, or environmental hazards. Requires physical contact or proximity to active force; ranged non-kinetic attacks bypass it entirely.

Additional Notes:
Most effective against direct, forceful attackers. Less reliable against opponents using heat-based, elemental, or ranged abilities. Timing is critical—a well-timed reversal turns overwhelming offense into liability.

cardPool.title: Impure Beam
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name: Impure Beam

Description: A devastating light-based Quirk that fires massive beams of concentrated luminous energy. The user channels intense light into catastrophic blasts capable of obliterating large targets and structures. Among the most powerful offensive abilities.

Functions/Applications: Unleash massive beam attacks dealing extreme damage to single or multiple targets. Beams can be combined with other Quirks to amplify destructive output. Effective against most physical defenses and organic matter. Can be charged for increased potency.

Limits: At maximum output, especially when boosted, the user suffers severe recoil damage or explosive trauma. Vulnerable to refraction or redirection by light-manipulating Quirks. Extended use risks catastrophic self-injury. Requires enhanced durability or regenerative ability for safe use at full power.

Additional Notes: Best suited for users with enhanced durability or healing factors. Most effective as a finishing move. Combinations with complementary Quirks increase potency but also increase recoil risk. Vulnerable to defensive light-manipulation abilities.

cardPool.title: Incite
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Incite

Description:
The user's voice is laced with an electromagnetic pulse that physically and mentally enhances loyal followers. Power scales with volume—louder speech means stronger effects. Enhancement comes at physical cost to recipients.

Functions/Applications:
Amplifies physical strength, speed, and mental fortitude of loyal followers. Can temporarily push recipients beyond normal limits. Works best through amplification devices or in crowded settings.

Limits:
Only functions on people with genuine loyalty to the user; wavering faith nullifies effects. Fear and conflicting emotions override the ability. Repeated use exhausts recipients. Cannot compel unwilling targets or create loyalty where none exists.

Additional Notes:
The user must actively speak to activate Incite; silence negates it. External amplification dramatically increases effectiveness. Best suited for rallying groups rather than enhancing individuals. Followers develop dependency on enhancement, making them vulnerable if separated from the user.

cardPool.title: Infrared
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Infrared

Description:
The user perceives surroundings through infrared radiation, gaining thermal vision like heat-sensing predators. This enables navigation independent of light, fully compensating for blindness. The quirk senses emotional states through thermal fluctuations in living beings.

Functions/Applications:
Navigate in darkness with clarity. Detect creatures by body heat. Read emotional states through thermal changes. Bypass visual obstacles and camouflage.

Limits:
Limited to nearby range, not long-distance. Disrupted by sensor technology and electromagnetic interference. Ineffective against uniform temperature or heat-isolated targets. Requires cognitive processing to interpret thermal data.

Additional Notes:
This stolen quirk shows moderate compatibility. Most effective defensively and for navigation rather than offense. Extreme heat or cold impairs accuracy.

cardPool.title: Invisibility
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Invisibility

Description:
The user's body unconsciously refracts light, rendering them completely invisible. The Quirk is permanently active and cannot be toggled off. Clothing and carried objects remain visible, requiring complete nudity for effective stealth. Exposed skin is vulnerable to extreme temperatures and environmental damage.

Functions/Applications:
Perfect stealth and infiltration for ambushes, reconnaissance, and evasion. With training, the user can manipulate refracted light to blind opponents or redirect light-based attacks through their prism-like body. Enhanced light control allows tactical repositioning of enemy attacks.

Limits:
Permanence means the user remains visible when clothed. Complete nudity exposes skin to cold, heat, and environmental damage. Sensory-based detection methods bypass the Quirk entirely. Extremely powerful light sources can cause malfunction, potentially revealing the user's silhouette. The user cannot turn the ability off.

Additional Notes:
Ideal for hit-and-run tactics and information gathering.

cardPool.title: IQ
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
IQ

Description:
A mental enhancement Quirk that multiplies intellectual capacity to genius levels. Activation requires consuming tea and closing one's eyes to enter deep thinking. Yellow equations and orange circuit diagrams materialize visually around the user's head during activation, reflecting rapid calculations.

Functions/Applications:
Enables devising complex strategic plans, analyzing enemy movements, predicting opponent behavior, and solving tactical problems with superhuman intelligence. Excels at information gathering, trap construction, and coordinating multi-target containment. Different tea varieties produce varying enhancement effects.

Limits:
Activation depends entirely on tea consumption. Generated plans are never perfect and have exploitable flaws. Provides no physical combat enhancement, defensive capability, or reflexive advantage. Highly versatile or unpredictable opponents introduce variables that exceed calculation accuracy, causing strategic failure.

Additional Notes:
IQ is purely cerebral and unsuitable for direct confrontation. Users require physical support or allies to execute plans.

cardPool.title: Iron Ball
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Iron Ball

Description:
The user produces and launches iron spheres from their knuckles with considerable force. Projectiles vary in size from egg-sized to larger than the user's body, with fair control over mass and density.

Functions/Applications:
Primary offensive weapon for ranged attacks; generates ammunition for allies; larger projectiles create barriers or crush obstacles; variable sizing allows tactical flexibility.

Limits:
Sustained production drains stamina; larger spheres require more energy and slower generation; accuracy decreases with distance and extreme sizes; user must have knuckles available; projectiles cannot be remotely controlled once launched.

Additional Notes:
Best used in offensive or support roles; balances power with tactical versatility through size manipulation; effective in group combat when allies utilize generated ammunition.

cardPool.title: Iron Claws
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Iron Claws

Description:
The user's fingertips transform into hard metallic claws. Size, sharpness, and application vary by user—some develop large slashing weapons, others maintain dexterous claws for excavation and tunneling.

Functions/Applications:
Metallic claws can pierce tough materials, slash opponents, or dig through earth and stone. Users can burrow underground for mobility, concealment, or surprise attacks. Claws retain enough precision for climbing and manipulation.

Limits:
Claws are only as strong as the user's physical strength and durability allow. Extended burrowing drains stamina. The quirk doesn't increase speed or reflexes. Claws can be damaged or broken by superior materials or force.

Additional Notes:
Manifestation varies between users. Bulky variants sacrifice dexterity for power, while refined versions maintain control. Underground movement leaves obvious tunnels, potentially revealing position or intentions.

cardPool.title: Iron Club
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Iron Club

Description:
The user transforms their arms into massive iron clubs covered in jagged spikes. The transformation increases body mass and height to 229cm, granting an imposing ogre-like appearance.

Functions/Applications:
Devastating melee strikes capable of crushing boulders and shattering fortifications. Spike-covered surfaces inflict additional trauma on impact. Useful for intimidation and demolition.

Limits:
Arms cannot be used for fine manipulation while transformed. Requires significant stamina to maintain. Speed and agility decrease due to increased mass. Transformation leaves user vulnerable during activation or deactivation.

Additional Notes:
An offensive-focused Quirk best suited for direct combat. Spike coverage prevents disarming or grappling. Limited defensive capability; user relies on durability rather than evasion.

cardPool.title: Jet
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Jet

Description:
Jet allows the user to expel compressed air from holes in the soles of their feet, propelled by breath from their lungs. This grants extreme speed in flight and ground movement, enabling superhuman acceleration and direction changes with explosive bursts.

Functions/Applications:
The user achieves short-range flight and ground acceleration by releasing pulses of air. Each directional change requires a new breath intake. The momentum amplifies physical strikes, allowing devastating tackles and kicks. Excellent for evasion, pursuit, and rapid repositioning in combat.

Limits:
Flight duration is restricted by lung capacity—cannot sustain hover. Each direction shift costs breath, limiting maneuverability in prolonged engagements. Advanced age or physical deterioration weakens stamina and bone integrity. Warping-type Quirks can bypass the speed advantage.

Additional Notes:
Peak effectiveness requires mastery of impact timing and momentum control. Users develop exceptional combat instinct and spatial awareness.

cardPool.title: Kaiju
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Kaiju

Description:
A transformation Quirk that allows the user to metamorphose into a colossal dinosaur-like beast resembling Godzilla. The transformation grants massive size and power comparable to Gigantification Quirks, though its full scope remains largely unknown.

Functions/Applications:
Grants enormous physical strength and size for combat. The beast form can devastate large areas through sheer mass and destructive capability, overwhelming opponents through scale advantage and raw power output.

Limits:
Transformation requires Trigger drug activation to manifest, suggesting the user cannot access this power naturally. The massive form likely reduces mobility and agility despite increased strength. Normal state abilities are unknown.

Additional Notes:
True capabilities and limitations remain mysterious due to limited observed usage. Dependency on Trigger presents significant vulnerability when the drug is unavailable. Long-term effects of repeated transformations are unknown.

cardPool.title: Kinetic Booster
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Kinetic Booster

Description:
A Quirk that amplifies kinetic energy generated during movement and actions. Multiple copies multiply the effect exponentially. All For One holds four copies, making him devastatingly powerful.

Functions/Applications:
Enhanced striking force, explosive speed, amplified jumping distance, and increased momentum. Multiple copies compound effects, enabling simultaneous bursts or sustained acceleration beyond normal limits.

Limits:
Requires active physical exertion; passive use offers minimal benefit. Energy depletes with repeated activation. Effectiveness depends on physical conditioning and control. Managing multiple copies demands mental focus to prevent backfire.

Additional Notes:
Originally stolen by All For One. True power emerges only when copies are combined. Control and technique are essential—raw power risks self-injury or collateral damage.

cardPool.title: King Slam
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
King Slam

Description:
The user can manifest a massive hammer from thin air and wield it as a weapon for melee strikes or projectile attacks.

Functions/Applications:
Deploy the hammer for powerful close-range bludgeoning attacks or hurl it at opponents. The weapon can be summoned repeatedly for sustained offensive pressure.

Limits:
The hammer requires conscious summoning and dissipates after use. Physical strength determines impact force. Range is limited when throwing, and recovery time between summons may exist.

Additional Notes:
A straightforward offensive Quirk favored by aggressive combatants. Best suited for close-quarters or mid-range encounters.

cardPool.title: Landmine
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Landmine

Description:
Chitose infuses explosive properties into objects or beings she touches, detonating them at will. Individual explosions are weak but devastating in numbers. She can weaponize allies' bodies or blood as living mines.

Functions/Applications:
Plant trap networks to funnel enemies into kill zones. Detonate multiple charges simultaneously for cumulative damage. Infuse allies' blood as contingency explosives. Use the Curious Flattener chain weapon to detonate explosive pieces at close range.

Limits:
Individual explosions are weak; effectiveness depends on quantity and placement. Cannot detonate targets at extreme distances without direct line of sight. Requires physical contact to infuse objects. Detonating allies requires cooperation or incapacitation.

Additional Notes:
Chitose's strength lies in battlefield preparation and control rather than raw power. She excels in coordinated group combat. The Quirk works on any material and living tissue, making it versatile but ethically questionable when used on people.

cardPool.title: Larceny
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Larceny

Description:
Toya Setsuno can instantly steal any object from a target's person and bring it directly into his hands. This includes weapons, armor, and even Quirk manifestations, giving him advantage against armed opponents.

Functions/Applications:
Disarm enemies by stealing weapons mid-combat. Steal Quirk manifestations to neutralize abilities. Works best in coordinated team fights where allies exploit vulnerability. Primary use is forcing opponents into disadvantageous positions.

Limits:
Cannot steal objects beyond a certain size threshold. Requires direct line of sight to target and possessions—blindness renders the Quirk unusable. Cannot steal from objects outside visual range. Ineffective against unarmed opponents or those with no portable items.

Additional Notes:
Toya relies on allies to capitalize on disarmed enemies. Effectiveness depends entirely on maintaining vision; sight obstruction is catastrophic to combat capability. Best paired with aggressive team members who exploit openings from successful thefts.

cardPool.title: Laser
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name: Laser

Description: The user projects concentrated energy beams from their right eye with precise targeting. These beams possess destructive force capable of damaging high-level threats and breaking down complex materials.

Functions/Applications: Fire focused energy beams for offensive attacks; destroy or disable targets from distance; breach material defenses and structural integrity.

Limits: Beam originates only from the right eye, creating a predictable attack vector; requires line of sight; unknown cooldown between shots; extended use may cause eye strain or fatigue.

Additional Notes: Effective against organic and synthetic targets. The Quirk's precision suits tactical combat but leaves the user vulnerable if the right eye is compromised or obscured.

cardPool.title: Leafipulation
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Leafipulation

Description:
The user manipulates leaves from nearby plant life, shaping and launching them as sharp projectiles. This Quirk grants control over vegetation in the immediate environment, turning natural foliage into weapons.

Functions/Applications:
Fire leaves as ranged attacks; create leaf shields for defense; strike multiple targets with projectile patterns; scout using leaves as extensions of sight.

Limits:
User cannot generate leaves from their own body—must rely on existing plant sources nearby. Ineffective in barren or urban environments lacking vegetation. Leaf projectiles lack stopping power compared to harder materials. Range and potency depend on plant availability.

Additional Notes:
Most effective in forests, gardens, or natural settings. Urban combat severely restricts effectiveness. Leaves deteriorate quickly once separated from plants, limiting sustained offense.

cardPool.title: Leap
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Leap

Description:
A mobility quirk granting extraordinary jumping distance and height. Provides landing cushioning on intentional jumps, negating fall damage. Requires solid ground and only protects conscious leaps, not accidental falls.

Functions/Applications:
Execute massive jumps for traversal and evasion. Land safely from great heights when activated. Clear obstacles and reach elevated positions quickly.

Limits:
Requires solid, stable ground—soft surfaces reduce effectiveness. Does not protect accidental falls or passive drops. User remains vulnerable if knocked off ledges without activating the quirk first.

Additional Notes:
Leap is a mobility tool with defensive applications, not flight. Success depends on environment and user awareness. Requires timing activation before impact for maximum protection.

cardPool.title: Life Force
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Life Force

Description:
Doubles the user's natural lifespan and slows aging dramatically, allowing them to appear decades younger than their actual age.

Functions/Applications:
Grants extended longevity and youthful appearance. Can be duplicated and transferred to another person. Enables long-term planning and knowledge accumulation.

Limits:
If cancelled or removed, the user rapidly ages into severe decrepitude, potentially causing death. Naturally reduces physical mobility and reflexes, making combat difficult without supplementary abilities.

Additional Notes:
This Quirk trades vitality for duration. Rapid aging upon cancellation makes it dangerous to lose mid-conflict. Duplication requires mastery of its mechanics.

cardPool.title: Lion
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Lion

Description:
A transformation quirk granting physical attributes of a lion, including enhanced strength, speed, and a devastating roar. The user gains feline power and agility comparable to an apex predator.

Functions/Applications:
Enhanced strength for melee attacks, increased running speed for pursuit or evasion, and a sonic roar capable of disrupting sensory-based attacks or creating defensive shockwaves. The roar counters high-frequency paralysis abilities.

Limits:
Does not grant full animal transformation, only attribute enhancement. The roar requires buildup and leaves the user vulnerable during recovery. Ineffective against sound-immune targets. Sustained use causes physical fatigue.

Additional Notes:
Most effective in direct combat where raw power and speed provide advantage. The roar serves as both offensive weapon and defensive countermeasure against ability-based opponents. Works best with freedom of movement.

cardPool.title: Liquification
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Liquification

Description:
The user transforms their body into liquid at will, becoming intangible to solid attacks. Primarily a defensive Quirk that allows evasion of physical harm.

Functions/Applications:
Evade melee and projectile attacks by liquefying. Flow through confined spaces. Can combine with other Quirks to weaponize liquified form as projectiles.

Limits:
Cannot liquify selectively—entire body must transform or remain solid. Liquified form is vulnerable to fire and freezing. Drains stamina in liquid state. Cannot interact with solid objects while liquefied. Requires concentration to reform.

Additional Notes:
Most effective as defense rather than offense. Works best with complementary Quirks. Evasive nature limits aggressive combat options.

cardPool.title: Lizard
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Lizard

Description:
A reptilian transformation quirk granting scaled, lizard-like appearance with tail and forked tongue. Provides enhanced physical resilience and accelerated healing beyond normal human limits.

Functions/Applications:
Superior endurance for extended combat and exertion. Faster wound recovery than baseline humans. Under Trigger drug influence, transformation intensifies—arms morph into pterosaur-like wings enabling sustained flight.

Limits:
No superhuman strength or speed without Trigger enhancement. Flight requires Trigger, making sustained aerial combat unreliable. Vulnerability to extreme temperatures. High Trigger dependency and addiction risk.

Additional Notes:
Full capabilities partially unexplored. Forked tongue suggests enhanced sensory perception but unconfirmed. Trigger causes dramatic physiological changes with unknown long-term health consequences.

cardPool.title: Lock Down
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Lock Down

Description:
A spatial locking ability that freezes touched objects into a fixed point in space, rendering them immobile. The user activates this through key-tooth-like protrusions extending from their fingertips, which must make direct contact with the target.

Functions/Applications:
Immobilize environmental hazards like falling debris or moving obstacles. Secure objects during combat or construction. Create barriers by locking structural elements. Neutralize dynamic threats through tactical positioning.

Limits:
Cannot affect living beings or organic matter. Effectiveness decreases with object size and force. Requires direct finger contact to activate. Duration and energy cost scale with object mass.

Additional Notes:
Most effective against environmental hazards and inanimate objects. Works defensively but lacks offensive capability. Synergizes with battlefield manipulation strategies rather than direct damage.

cardPool.title: Longbow
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name: Longbow

Description: The user transforms their left hand's thumb and pinky finger into a functional bow. Arrows fired from this bio-weapon possess absolute trajectory control and pierce-through power capable of penetrating vehicles. Projectiles can actively pursue moving targets.

Functions/Applications: Transform left hand into a ranged weapon for combat. Fire guided arrows to track fleeing opponents. Penetrate fortified positions and vehicles. Use scavenged ammunition from the environment.

Limits: User cannot generate ammunition independently and must rely on found arrows or makeshift projectiles. Once ammunition runs out, the Quirk becomes useless. Only the left hand can form the bow, limiting versatility if injured or restrained.

Additional Notes: Strategic dependency on resource management makes this Quirk powerful in prepared engagements but vulnerable in prolonged conflicts. The guided arrow capability provides significant accuracy advantage, compensating for ammunition scarcity through precision.

cardPool.title: Longleg
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Longleg

Description:
A transformation Quirk that grants the ability to extend legs to extraordinary lengths. The limbs become elastic and elongated, allowing vast distance coverage and access to unreachable areas.

Functions/Applications:
Extended legs enable rapid travel, wall scaling, far-reaching kicks, escape from confinement, and retrieval of distant objects. The user can traverse obstacles that impede others.

Limits:
Extension has a maximum range before instability occurs. Overextension causes loss of balance and reduced combat effectiveness. The Quirk fails if legs are immobilized or restrained. Speed decreases with extension distance.

Additional Notes:
Effective for theft and reconnaissance due to mobility advantages. Works best in open environments with maneuvering space. Usefulness diminishes in cramped indoor spaces or against opponents who restrict movement.

cardPool.title: Love
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Love

Description:
The user empowers a target by confessing genuine romantic feelings for them. The confession transmits a surge of physical enhancement, with intensity scaling to emotional depth. The empowered state manifests as heart-shaped smoke, called "Lover Mode."

Functions/Applications:
Dramatically increases target's physical strength and speed for combat. Works across any distance if the user's voice reaches the target. Acts as a strategic trump card for high-stakes moments requiring a decisive power boost.

Limits:
Activates only once per 24 hours. Cannot empower the user themselves—only genuine romantic interests. Requires sincere emotional confession to function; false declarations fail. Enhanced state doesn't guarantee victory against skilled opponents.

Additional Notes:
The user must consciously choose their target based on authentic feelings. Lover Mode is most effective when the user's love is most intense. Best employed as a last-resort tactic due to its severe cooldown. Strategic value lies in timing rather than raw power output.

cardPool.title: Luminescence
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Luminescence

Description:
The user emits bright light from their body, ranging from pure white to orange-yellow depending on the wielder. Light intensity and color are influenced by the user's state and circumstances. Activation is controlled at will.

Functions/Applications:
Emit blinding light to disorient opponents in combat. Use as an illumination source in darkness. Create visual distraction or misdirection tactics. Light output scales with the user's growth over time.

Limits:
No offensive or defensive properties beyond light emission; purely emission-based with no kinetic force. Effectiveness reduced against light-resistant opponents. Energy cost and duration unknown but likely taxing during extended use. Requires line of sight to affect targets.

Additional Notes:
Visual properties vary between users—original holder used pure white light while a later user produced orange-yellow luminescence. Full potential remains unclear. Most effective in dark environments or as a surprise tactic rather than sustained combat ability.

cardPool.title: Mad Gluttony
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Mad Gluttony

Description:
A consumption-based Quirk granting a massive mouth in the stomach capable of rapidly inhaling, crushing, and destroying objects. When artificially enhanced, additional mouths sprout across the body as prehensile, biting tendrils for ranged attacks and restraint.

Functions/Applications:
Devour and destroy solid materials with extreme speed. Deploy mouth-tendrils for multi-directional offense, grappling, and ranged bites. Inhale to create suction for environmental manipulation. Enhanced form provides combat versatility and crowd control.

Limits:
The stomach mouth has finite capacity and requires processing time. Tendrils are destructible by concentrated attacks, particularly kinetic or impact damage. Primary mouth requires close proximity; enhanced form extends range but weakens defenses. Overmodification is unstable without external modification.

Additional Notes:
Mad Gluttony becomes a multi-vector threat when enhanced, making it formidable but vulnerable to focused strikes on individual tendrils.

cardPool.title: Magic
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Magic

Description:
The user creates glowing energy rings around their wrists that can ensnare people and objects, allowing telekinetic manipulation. Once trapped within a ring, the user gains complete control over its speed and trajectory, from gentle movement to explosive acceleration.

Functions/Applications:
Propel allies toward distant targets at high velocity. Rescue civilians or teammates from danger. Manipulate large objects or multiple targets simultaneously using multiple rings. Fine-tune speed for precision placement or raw power delivery.

Limits:
Rings have a fixed maximum size, preventing movement of objects or beings larger than the ring's circumference. Creating and maintaining multiple rings drains stamina with extended use. The user cannot manipulate ring speed if the target escapes the ring's boundary. Requires direct line of sight and proximity to generate rings effectively.

Additional Notes:
This Quirk excels at rescue and repositioning allies in combat. Its greatest weakness is rigid size constraints—massive threats cannot be moved regardless of power level. Best used tactically rather than as primary offense.

cardPool.title: Magnetism
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name: Magnetism

Description: The user magnetizes targets within a 4.5-meter radius, polarizing them by sex—men become south-aligned (blue aura), women north-aligned (red aura). Same-sex targets repel; opposite-sex targets attract. The user cannot be magnetized and cannot affect those outside range.

Functions/Applications: Launch allies by positioning them between opposing polarities. Separate enemies by matching polarities to force repulsion. Pin or crush foes using attraction between opposite-polarized targets. Combine with external magnetic objects to amplify effects.

Limits: Only functions within 4.5 meters. User is immune to their own Quirk. Requires line of effect. Power scales with number of targets; multi-target coordination drains focus. Metallic objects need external magnetism to interact with effects.

Additional Notes: Most effective in coordinated team settings. Useless against solo opponents outside radius. Environmental factors limit tactical options. Works best combined with ranged or mobility-based allies.

cardPool.title: Manifest
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Manifest

Description:
The user can enhance their body parts with the characteristics of anything consumed, as long as it remains in their digestive system. Eaten food grants its physical properties—octopus tentacles, hardened shells, sharp talons, or reinforced muscle tissue—all manifested on command and dismissed at will.

Functions/Applications:
Offense: Tentacle fingers for binding, sharp talons for cutting, reinforced striking limbs. Defense: Shell hardening, flexible absorption using octopus traits. Tactical: Multiple simultaneous manifestations allow combining traits. User can prepare specific foods before missions to counter known threats.

Limits:
Manifestation strength depends on quantity consumed. User must eat daily to maintain reserves; depleted digestive stores render the Quirk unusable. Manifestations last only while food remains in the system. Non-food items rarely work if digestible.

Additional Notes:
This Quirk rewards strategic preparation and creative thinking. Users benefit from routine consumption of reliable foods and scouting enemy weaknesses beforehand.

cardPool.title: Mantis
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Mantis

Description:
A transformation quirk granting mantis-based physiology including sharpened claws, enhanced agility, and predatory instincts. Chemical enhancement through Trigger intensifies the transformation into a humanoid mantis form with lethal blade-like hands.

Functions/Applications:
High-speed slashing attacks with razor-sharp claws capable of cutting most materials. Enhanced reflexes and predatory awareness for tracking fast-moving targets. Increased strength proportional to size during full transformation. Climbing and wall-adherence provides tactical mobility.

Limits:
Without enhancement, only partial transformation with modest boosts. Trigger dependence causes instability and loss of control. Enlarged form loses agility in confined spaces and drains stamina. Extended use risks permanent biological changes or addiction.

Additional Notes:
Effective for hit-and-run combat and ambush tactics. User may have psychological vulnerabilities related to insect predator weaknesses.

cardPool.title: Meatball
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Meatball

Description:
The user manipulates raw human flesh with telekinetic precision, controlling their own limbs independently and molding flesh into offensive and defensive shapes. Victims touched by flesh constructs can be kneaded into immobilized meatballs, retaining full sensory awareness while trapped.

Functions/Applications:
Create levitating flesh projectiles for ranged attacks; form protective shields from compacted flesh; ensnare targets by rolling them into helpless spheres; separate limbs for independent combat; expand and compress flesh for offense and defense.

Limits:
User must maintain constant focus to keep victims restrained—sufficient damage breaks concentration and releases captives. User has vastly superior control over their own flesh than others'; manipulating foreign flesh requires direct contact. Meatball form restricts mobility but doesn't cause unconsciousness, leaving victims aware and potentially dangerous if restraint fails.

Additional Notes:
Most effective at mid-to-long range, using flesh bullets to weaken opponents before close-range capture.

cardPool.title: Metal Manipulation
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Metal Manipulation

Description:
Wolfram can control and reshape pre-existing metallic materials by touching them, causing his hand to glow with blue electrical energy. He bends metal freely into offensive and defensive structures.

Functions/Applications:
Creates iron pillars, walls, and cubes to attack or defend. Can construct large fortifications and barriers to trap opponents. Excels in metal-rich environments where abundant materials amplify his power.

Limits:
Requires pre-existing metal to function—useless in metal-scarce environments. Ineffective at close-range combat. Strength depends on available metal quantity and quality.

Additional Notes:
Best utilized in industrial or metallic settings. Creates visual tell through blue hand discharge when activating. Defensive capabilities proven capable of withstanding powerful physical attacks when properly fortified.

cardPool.title: Mimicry
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Mimicry

Description:
The user transfers their consciousness into solid objects and controls them as physical forms. Without enhancement, objects are limited to refrigerator-size; with Trigger drug, manipulation extends to entire structures and landscapes.

Functions/Applications:
Inhabit and animate solid matter for combat and mobility; reshape environments by twisting corridors and creating barriers; manifest body parts externally to perceive and interact; launch attacks while hidden inside objects.

Limits:
Perception severely limited without exposing body parts, creating exploitable weak points. Standard objects capped at refrigerator-size without Trigger. Emotional manipulation can force desperate moves. Direct environmental damage to inhabited objects remains a threat.

Additional Notes:
User Joi Irinaka typically inhabits a small black cloak. Most effective in structured environments with manipulable terrain. Requires Trigger drug for large-scale reality warping.

cardPool.title: Mind Reaper
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Mind Reaper

Description:
Upon physical contact with a target, Mind Reaper forces the victim to involuntarily expose their deepest secrets, embarrassing memories, and hidden truths through uncontrollable verbal disclosure.

Functions/Applications:
Extract concealed information through forced confession. Incapacitate targets psychologically by revealing shameful secrets. Interrogate prisoners or suspects without traditional torture. Humiliate opponents by exposing their vulnerabilities.

Limits:
Requires direct physical touch to activate. Victims with strong willpower can resist full disclosure, though Mind Reaper will then reveal secrets itself—less accurately and with gaps. Exceptionally resolute individuals may resist entirely. Cannot force revelations the user doesn't suspect exist.

Additional Notes:
Effectiveness depends on the victim's mental fortitude versus the user's activation strength. Works best on psychologically vulnerable or guilt-ridden individuals.

cardPool.title: Mole
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Mole

Description:
Grants elongated, razor-sharp claws, protective spines along the back, and a hardened facial visor. These features mimic a mole's digging anatomy, enabling rapid excavation through earth and stone. The spines enhance underground mobility and camouflage, while the visor shields eyes from debris.

Functions/Applications:
Dig through mountains, soil, and rock with exceptional speed. Claws serve as melee weapons capable of shredding obstacles, vegetation, structures, and enemies. Spines enable sliding underground and concealment. User can selectively activate different components. Ideal for infiltration, escape, terrain manipulation, and combat.

Limits:
Effectiveness depends on user's base strength and durability; the Quirk amplifies existing power rather than granting independent might. Claws cannot penetrate enchanted or magically-reinforced barriers. Underground navigation is slowed by solid rock. Prolonged transformation causes fatigue. Visor reduces peripheral vision slightly.

Additional Notes:
Best suited for large, powerful users who can exploit the Quirk's terraforming potential. Originally stolen by All For One.

cardPool.title: Monster Cat (Quirk)
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Monster Cat

Description:
Monster Cat allows the user to merge with and assume the shape of objects or machinery, gaining complete control over the merged form. The user can detach at will. Without enhancement, capacity remains unknown, but chemical boost enables control of large vehicles like buses.

Functions/Applications:
Merge with objects to pilot them, assume their physical form, control movement and functions completely, detach at any time, infiltrate or commandeer vehicles and devices.

Limits:
Capacity restricted without enhancement; cannot merge with living beings; detachment requires time and concentration; merged form limited by host object's structural integrity; larger objects require significant power boost.

Additional Notes:
