Monster Cat is non-humanoid and operates as a small animal user, making stealth easier but limiting independent combat. True potential under natural conditions remains unexplored. Chemical enhancement increases control range and object size capacity.

cardPool.title: Monster Summon
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Monster Summon

Description:
Simon Gollini conjures blob-like creatures resembling dungeon monsters. These eyeless beings have large mouths and vary in form—bulky, multi-headed, winged, or resembling wyverns, dinosaurs, and giant frogs. The mechanics are mysterious, possibly magical.

Functions/Applications:
Summon diverse monsters for combat, scouting, and overwhelming opponents through numbers. Each creature can be tailored in appearance and capabilities. With Overmodification, production becomes nearly limitless, enabling swarm tactics and sustained offensives.

Limits:
Creating monsters requires focus and energy; sustained summoning causes fatigue. Creatures lack intelligence and need direction. Quantity and power are inversely balanced—more summons weaken each monster. The true creation method remains unknown, limiting improvements.

Additional Notes:
Effectiveness scales with Overmodification. Best in open terrain where swarms maneuver freely. Against single powerful opponents or in confined spaces, this Quirk struggles despite numerical advantage.

cardPool.title: Muddied
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Muddied

Description:
A contact-based Quirk that induces temporary memory disruption. When the user touches someone's head, they experience localized amnesia affecting approximately five minutes before and after contact, leaving memories vague and fragmented.

Functions/Applications:
Useful for disorienting opponents in combat, escaping pursuers by making them forget the chase, or extracting information by obscuring time perception. Can be applied tactically to single opponents within arm's reach.

Limits:
Requires direct physical contact with the target's head. Effect duration is fixed at roughly ten minutes of memory interference. Does not affect long-term memories or knowledge, only recent events. Repeated use on the same person shows diminishing effectiveness. Cannot be applied from a distance.

Additional Notes:
Affected memories become vague rather than absent, leaving targets confused but potentially dangerous. Works best in surprise situations or close-quarters scenarios. No apparent physical toll on the user.

cardPool.title: Multiplier
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Multiplier

Description:
A stolen Quirk allowing the user to rapidly generate and manifest multiple additional limbs from their body at will. The manifested limbs are fully functional and independent, granting extraordinary combat versatility and manipulation capabilities.

Functions/Applications:
The user can sprout multiple arms simultaneously to perform complex actions, wield multiple weapons, grapple opponents, or execute coordinated multi-directional attacks. Each manifested limb retains full strength and dexterity for simultaneous independent tasks or synchronized strikes.

Limits:
Excessive manifestation causes stamina drain and biological strain. Manifested limbs can be severed or destroyed individually and lack inherent defense against damage, making them vulnerable targets during combat.

Additional Notes:
Originally stolen from an unknown person by All For One. The Quirk's full specifications remain poorly understood, suggesting untapped potential. Most effective when combined with other Quirks for enhanced destructive capability.

cardPool.title: Mummification
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Mummification

Description:
Hoyo animates and controls red bandages wrapped around his body, ensnaring objects and transforming them into humanoid mummy constructs that obey his commands. He can control dozens simultaneously.

Functions/Applications:
Animate objects into controllable mummy soldiers for combat. Indirectly control living enemies by manipulating their clothing or equipment. Restrain targets through bandage entanglement.

Limits:
Cannot directly control living beings—only inanimate objects. Bandages break under sufficient force. Targets can discard equipment to escape wrapping. Quirk deactivates if Hoyo is unconscious. Each mummy requires sustained focus to maintain.

Additional Notes:
Hoyo relies on overwhelming numbers rather than raw power. Aware targets can strategically discard gear to break free. Bandage damage directly weakens his abilities.

cardPool.title: Muscle Augmentation
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Muscle Augmentation

Description:
The user amplifies and manipulates muscle fibers to achieve superhuman strength, speed, and durability. Muscle layers can protrude visibly or glow internally. Users can augment specific body parts and stack up to 12,000+ muscle layers for maximum effect.

Functions/Applications:
Grants immense strength capable of shattering cliffs. Enhanced speed allows blurred movement and attack avoidance. Muscle fibers act as natural armor, absorbing impacts. Selective augmentation enables tactical flexibility—concentrating power in legs for speed or arms for striking force. Can contend with top-tier power users.

Limits:
Depleted muscle fibers tear away, leaving users vulnerable and weakened. Vibration-based attacks efficiently destroy fiber strands. The Quirk can be overwhelmed by greater power levels. Exposed muscle architecture creates exploitable weak points if fibers are damaged strategically. Regeneration is not inherent without healing Quirks.

Additional Notes:
Different users display variations: some manifest visible muscle bulges, others show internal glowing. Effectiveness scales with physical conditioning and control.

cardPool.title: Muscle Expansion
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Muscle Expansion

Description:
The user can expand and strengthen their muscles at will, dramatically increasing physical power and size for substantial strength boosts beyond normal human capability.

Functions/Applications:
Enhanced striking force and grappling power. Ability to lift heavy objects. Increased durability from muscle mass. Can be applied to specific body parts or full-body enhancement.

Limits:
Sustained expansion consumes stamina and causes fatigue. Overuse risks muscle strain or injury. Expanded form is slower and less agile. Cannot be maintained indefinitely without rest.

Additional Notes:
Best suited for close-range combat and heavy lifting. Works poorly against speed-based opponents. Requires time to activate, leaving user vulnerable during transformation.

cardPool.title: Mushroom
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Mushroom

Description:
Kinoko Komori generates and spreads fungus spores from her body that rapidly grow into full-sized mushrooms upon contact with solid surfaces. Spore dispersal accelerates in high-humidity environments. Mushrooms persist for two to three hours before withering.

Functions/Applications:
Terrain control via rapid mushroom proliferation to obstruct movement and vision. Asphyxiation attacks by forcing mushroom growth in throats. Area denial when combined with humidity spray. Provides allies with cover or hiding spots. Synergizes with allies who manipulate humidity or exploit mushroom clusters.

Limits:
Spores indiscriminately affect all organisms, including allies, requiring anti-fungal sterilization spray beforehand. Fungicides and ethanol neutralize spores. Fire destroys airborne spores before germination. Dry environments severely reduce effectiveness. Mushroom lifespan is only two to three hours.

Additional Notes:
Kinoko must sterilize teammates before deployment. Asphyxiation application is a high-risk, last-resort tactic. Humidity-control allies exponentially amplify her capability.

cardPool.title: Mutant Bovini
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Mutant Bovini

Description:
A transformation quirk granting bovine facial features that emit powerful directional energy beams from the face.

Functions/Applications:
The user fires lasers in sustained or burst patterns for ranged combat and crowd control. Beams vary in intensity and can be aimed by turning the head.

Limits:
Sustained firing causes facial strain and overheating. Accuracy decreases at extreme ranges. Erratic movement reduces precision. The face becomes a vulnerable pressure point.

Additional Notes:
Suits offensive fighters who position strategically. Recovery time between volleys prevents overload. Close-range opponents pose tactical threats.

cardPool.title: Octopus
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Octopus

Description:
The user manifests octopus-like physiology with eight elastic tentacle appendages. These tentacles possess powerful suckers for gripping and climbing, and the user can expel ink clouds from a specialized mouth structure for concealment or offense.

Functions/Applications:
Tentacles provide exceptional reach, grappling strength, and dexterity. Suckers enable scaling surfaces and restraining targets. Ink expulsion creates visual obstruction for escape or tactical advantage. Multiple appendages allow simultaneous actions impossible for humanoids.

Limits:
Tentacles require conscious control and tire with sustained use. Ink reserves are finite and regenerate slowly. Sucker adhesion weakens on dry surfaces. The quirk grants no enhanced speed or durability beyond elastic tissue properties. Water environments may reduce ink effectiveness.

Additional Notes:
Best suited for close-quarters combat, reconnaissance, and environmental navigation. The elasticity offers creative problem-solving but lacks cutting power of harder-bodied quirks. Works well in aquatic or confined spaces.

cardPool.title: Octopus (Squid)
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Octopus (Squid)

Description:
Transforms the user's body into a humanoid cephalopod form with eight total limbs. Six visible arms function as standard limbs, while two tentacle-like appendages remain concealed within the torso and can emerge for surprise attacks.

Functions/Applications:
Multi-limb combat enables simultaneous attacks and grappling. Hidden tentacles provide ambush capabilities. Enhanced dexterity allows manipulation of multiple objects or opponents at once.

Limits:
Increased limb count requires coordination and stamina. Hidden tentacles have limited reach and concealment. Bulkier form may hinder agility or fitting through tight spaces. Requires sustained focus to manage all limbs in complex scenarios.

Additional Notes:
The Quirk fundamentally alters physiology rather than merely adding limbs cosmetically. The distinction between visible and hidden appendages creates tactical depth. Best suited for users with high coordination and spatial awareness.

cardPool.title: Orcinus
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Orcinus

Description:
A marine-mammal transformation quirk granting orca physiology and abilities. The user gains massive size, enhanced strength and speed, and generates devastating ultrasonic waves that paralyze targets and shatter environmental hazards. Functions equally on land and water, though water amplifies effectiveness.

Functions/Applications:
Ultrasonic wave emission for instant paralysis; effectiveness diminishes with distance. Waves serve as offensive and defensive tools. Enhanced strength enables grappling and restraint. Extreme durability allows sustained combat against multiple opponents.

Limits:
Ultrasonic effectiveness decreases at range. Vulnerable to extreme heat and dehydration, which saps strength. Requires rehydration for peak performance. Land combat is less efficient than aquatic engagement.

Additional Notes:
User becomes a top-tier combatant for multiple high-level opponents. Requires tactical awareness of heat sources and hydration availability. Best utilized in water-rich environments.

cardPool.title: Outburst
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Outburst

Description:
A comedic Quirk that forces nearby targets into uncontrollable, intense laughter. A distinctive blue aura surrounds the user when activated. The laughter impairs motor coordination and mental processing, rendering victims temporarily helpless.

Functions/Applications:
Incapacitate multiple enemies through involuntary laughter. Useful for crowd control and disarming dangerous situations. Affects all nearby targets indiscriminately when triggered.

Limits:
Activation method unclear. Duration and full power extent unknown. Likely ineffective against those immune to humor or mental manipulation.

Additional Notes:
Rarely used in combat despite tactical potential. The blue aura indicates activation. Effectiveness varies by target psychology and environment.

cardPool.title: Overclock
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Overclock

Description:
A speedster Quirk that accelerates brain function and perception, making the world appear frozen. The user moves 3-10 times faster normally, or dozens of times faster under adrenaline. Heightened senses perceive ultra-fast audio and visual input. A healing factor allows accelerated cellular growth to repair injuries or integrate biological material.

Functions/Applications:
Sprint at supersonic speeds to evade attacks and outpace projectiles. Read subconscious reactions to predict behavior. Accelerate cell regeneration to heal severe wounds in seconds. Grow limbs or fuse biological material into the body. Process hyper-accelerated sensory information to react in frozen time.

Limits:
Severely limited by oxygen deprivation—usable only seconds before mandatory cooldown. Brain injury or oxygen starvation seals the Quirk temporarily. Intense focus drains activation time. Sustained focused use risks permanent lockout. Useless if airborne or knocked into the air. Extensive trauma beyond the head can seal access.

Additional Notes:
True power lies in perception acceleration rather than pure speed. Synergizes dangerously with regenerative abilities.

cardPool.title: Overhaul
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Overhaul

Description:
A deconstruction and reconstruction ability activated by bare-handed touch. The user can instantly disassemble matter—living or non-living—and reassemble it into new forms or destroy it. A single finger contact triggers the effect.

Functions/Applications:
Reshape terrain into walls, spikes, and platforms for offense and defense. Merge separate objects or beings into hybrid entities. Heal injuries by reconstructing bodies. Extract components from targets. Dual-hand merging combines quirks from different subjects.

Limits:
Requires physical contact. Short cooldown between uses. Fractured terrain reduces effectiveness. Cannot function if arms are destroyed. Disassembly causes extreme pain to living subjects.

Additional Notes:
Overhaul becomes deadlier when merged with others, gaining additional limbs and quirks. The ability's versatility works at any combat range, though terrain control is most effective on solid ground. Perfect reconstruction leaves no evidence, ideal for clandestine operations.

cardPool.title: Overmodification
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Overmodification

Description:
A perpetually active Quirk that amplifies other Quirks through physical contact. When activated, the user's hair turns black and rose petals bloom around them. Compatible recipients gain boosted abilities or new powers; incompatible ones suffer severe pain and unconsciousness. The Quirk cannot be controlled or deactivated without a cancellation ability.

Functions/Applications:
Enhances compatible Quirks dramatically, sometimes granting new functions. Can transform weak single-target abilities into multi-target powerhouses. Works through skin contact; effects persist and stack with repeated applications. Rose petals indicate compatibility or rejection.

Limits:
Compatibility is rare and unpredictable. Incompatible contact causes severe backlash pain. The Quirk is always active and uncontrollable, dangerous in social situations. Undischarged buildup causes agonizing seizures. Overcharging causes exponential range expansion and spawns destructive plant life. Multiple-Quirk users nearby trigger negative feedback. Enhanced abilities fade if the modified user sustains overwhelming damage.

cardPool.title: Pain Blocker
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Pain Blocker

Description:
The user becomes completely unable to sense pain from any source. This allows them to sustain massive damage without distraction. The quirk can be toggled on and off with practice.

Functions/Applications:
The user can withstand extreme attacks, including intense heat and blunt force trauma, while continuing to fight at full capacity. When combined with high durability or endurance quirks, the user gains an overwhelming advantage in prolonged combat.

Limits:
Pain blocking does not prevent actual damage—injuries still accumulate. The quirk requires active concentration to maintain; sudden shocks may briefly reactivate pain sensation. Unconsciousness or severe trauma can force the quirk offline involuntarily.

Additional Notes:
Most effective when paired with superhuman durability or strength quirks. The user must rely on visual and tactical awareness to judge their condition. Long-term use without monitoring injuries can lead to catastrophic hidden damage.

cardPool.title: Papyrus
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Papyrus

Description:
The user can flatten their entire body to papyrus-like thinness, becoming two-dimensional and malleable. They can stretch, fold, and manipulate their body at will in this state.

Functions/Applications:
Slip through narrow gaps. Stretch limbs to extreme lengths for reaching or grappling. Fold body parts for compact storage or evasion. Ride air currents for high-speed movement.

Limits:
Vulnerable to mold and degradation in humid environments. Flattened form is more fragile to certain attacks. Cannot maintain full body strength while compressed. Wind-riding requires sufficient air currents.

Additional Notes:
Useful for infiltration, rescue operations, and urban traversal. Best in dry climates. Requires practice for wind-riding control.

cardPool.title: Permeation
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Permeation

Description:
The user phases their body through all matter by rendering themselves intangible. They can selectively phase individual body parts or their entire form, allowing passage through obstacles and evasion of attacks.

Functions/Applications:
Phase through walls and solid objects. Dodge attacks by becoming intangible. Perform combat maneuvers by phasing body parts independently. Navigate environments unrestricted by physical barriers.

Limits:
Clothing and carried objects slip off unless made from user's hair. Full-body phasing negates all senses except falling sensation, causing disorientation and downward pull through ground. Cannot extend phasing to others. Ineffective against sudden attacks. Reactivating while phased inside solid matter instantly repels user to surface, risking injury. Requires precise footwork and concentration; fails under time pressure without extensive training.

Additional Notes:
Extremely difficult to master with fatal consequences for improper use. Mastery demands rigorous training to develop muscle memory and mental discipline for split-second activation control.

cardPool.title: Plant
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Plant

Description:
The user transforms body parts into living plant structures including vines, roots, and flora with regenerative properties capable of mending wounds in allies through contact or proximity.

Functions/Applications:
Transform limbs into grasping vines for restraint; sprout roots for stability and subterranean movement; generate healing flora that restores ally health; use plant barriers for defense.

Limits:
Transformations consume stamina and require concentration. Plant structures are vulnerable to fire, ice, and toxins. Healing output is limited by the user's own vitality. Extended transformation causes fatigue.

Additional Notes:
Most effective in natural environments with soil and sunlight. Works best supporting allies rather than direct combat. User must remain conscious to sustain plant growth; unconsciousness ends all active transformations immediately.

cardPool.title: Playtime
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Playtime

Description:
A transformation quirk that enlarges the user to gigantic proportions while altering physiology and mental state. The user's skin darkens, an additional pair of arms manifests, and their intellect regresses to childlike behavior, treating surroundings like toys.

Functions/Applications:
Grants immense size and strength for overwhelming force. Extra limbs enable multi-directional attacks. Regressed mental state removes inhibitions, making the user unpredictable and fearless.

Limits:
Full capabilities poorly understood. Intelligence regression removes tactical thinking, leaving the user vulnerable to cunning opponents. Size increase restricts mobility in confined spaces. Trigger dependency suggests instability.

Additional Notes:
Whether the transformation is natural or Trigger-induced remains unclear. The childlike mentality makes combat "play," potentially increasing destructiveness but reducing strategy. Duration and exhaustion effects unknown.

cardPool.title: Pliabody
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Pliabody

Description:
A transformation quirk allowing the user to stretch and flatten their body at will. The user's body becomes malleable like clay, enabling compression, extension, and reshaping for various purposes.

Functions/Applications:
Combat evasion through body deformation. Physical restraint by wrapping around opponents. Navigation through tight spaces during rescue operations. Enhanced grappling and unconventional combat positioning.

Limits:
Cannot stretch beyond 2-3 times normal body length before losing structural integrity. Extreme flattening reduces combat effectiveness. Requires conscious control—panic or unconsciousness reverts the body to normal form. Sharp, piercing weapons can still cause injury despite flexibility.

Additional Notes:
Most effective in rescue and reconnaissance scenarios. In direct combat, works best against unprepared opponents. Requires significant stamina for extended extreme deformations.

cardPool.title: Pointer
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Pointer

Description:
A navigational quirk allowing the user to locate people, places, and things they seek. The user's limbs act as directional indicators pointing toward desired targets with accuracy.

Functions/Applications:
The user must spin in place to activate the quirk. Once activated, their arms and legs point simultaneously toward up to three different targets or directions. Useful for tracking, navigation, rescue operations, and locating objectives in combat or exploration.

Limits:
The user can only point toward three directions simultaneously. Activation requires a full spin, creating vulnerability during combat. The quirk only works for consciously sought targets—vague searches won't function.

Additional Notes:
Best used for preparation and scouting rather than active combat. The spinning activation makes this quirk tactically predictable. Works as support for team operations and navigation challenges.

cardPool.title: Poison Gas
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Poison Gas

Description:
Takeshi Bushijima continuously generates toxic fog from his body. The gas causes illness in those who breathe it. Unreleased poison accumulates dangerously within him, eventually poisoning his own body if buildup exceeds critical limits.

Functions/Applications:
Creates noxious clouds to incapacitate enemies through inhalation. Can be withheld temporarily to protect bystanders, though prolonged retention damages the user. The gas is highly flammable and ignites easily when exposed to combustion or explosives.

Limits:
Generates involuntarily with no on-off switch. User must periodically release toxins or suffer severe health degradation. Unusable in crowded areas without harming innocents. Combustion destroys the gas entirely. Effectiveness depends on accumulation duration.

Additional Notes:
Takeshi must balance offense with self-preservation. Holding poison too long becomes counterproductive. Potency increases with prolonged accumulation but creates a dangerous threshold beyond which his own health fails. Strategic release timing is crucial for both combat effectiveness and survival.

cardPool.title: Poltergeist
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Poltergeist

Description:
A telekinetic Quirk that grants the user the ability to mentally manipulate objects and people within close proximity. The user can exert precise control over multiple targets simultaneously.

Functions/Applications:
The user can lift and move objects to barrage opponents, restrain or manipulate people through telekinetic force, and create coordinated movement patterns. This Quirk excels at area control and multi-target offense.

Limits:
The maximum weight the user can manipulate is approximately that of a single adult human (roughly 62 kg or 137 lbs). The Quirk only functions on objects and people in close proximity to the user.

Additional Notes:
Poltergeist requires significant mental focus and control to manage multiple targets. Fatigue from sustained use impacts performance. The Quirk's effectiveness depends on the user's concentration and tactical awareness.

cardPool.title: Polygraph
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Polygraph

Description:
Allows the user to detect truth and falsehood in a target's words through direct physical contact. Green-yellow lightning sparks from the user's hands and around the touched target, revealing speech authenticity.

Functions/Applications:
Interrogation and investigation of suspects or witnesses. Detection of deception in negotiations. Verification of claims during combat by maintaining contact with the target.

Limits:
Requires unbroken physical contact to function. Vulnerable to technicalities and precise wording; targets can bypass the Quirk by speaking truths from their perspective, even if factually incorrect. Cannot detect lies about intentions, only spoken falsehoods.

Additional Notes:
Most effective in controlled environments where physical contact can be maintained. Unreliable against cunning opponents who exploit semantic loopholes or those speaking subjective truths. The sparking effect may alert the target they're being scanned.

cardPool.title: Pop Off
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Pop Off

Description:
The user produces sticky spheres from their scalp that can be plucked painlessly and regrow instantly. These spheres adhere to any surface except the user's own body. Water does not diminish their adhesive properties.

Functions/Applications:
Launch spheres as projectiles to restrain opponents or bind weapons. Construct ground traps and obstacle courses. Use spheres as bouncing platforms to traverse terrain or scale surfaces. Chain spheres together as whip-like weapons for medium-range combat.

Limits:
Adhesive strength depends on the user's health and physical condition, lasting hours to a full day when well-rested but weakening when exhausted. Rapid sphere removal causes scalp bleeding and limits sustained output. Spheres do not stick to the user. The ability requires close proximity and is unsuitable for long-distance engagement.

Additional Notes:
This quirk is often underestimated, granting users tactical advantage against overconfident opponents. Effective users should focus on trap-setting and environmental manipulation rather than direct combat.

cardPool.title: Power
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Power

Description:
Power allows the user to accumulate tremendous raw strength, enabling feats of extraordinary physical force. The user can generate enough force to demolish reinforced concrete structures and overpower formidable opponents.

Functions/Applications:
The user can deliver devastating melee attacks capable of destroying architecture and terrain. When combined with other Quirks, Power amplifies combat effectiveness and allows users to manipulate or displace large objects and enemies.

Limits:
Power is purely physical strength with no range or area-of-effect capabilities. It requires direct physical contact and offers no defensive properties beyond durability from muscle buildup. The Quirk provides no speed enhancement or mobility advantages.

Additional Notes:
Power is most effective when paired with complementary Quirks for utility or defense. Users gain no resistance to non-physical damage and must rely on positioning and other abilities to handle ranged threats.

cardPool.title: Power Stock
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Power Stock

Description:
A meta ability that stockpiles raw power and speed through training and physical cultivation. Users can release accumulated energy in devastating bursts. Originally designed for users with fragile bodies, it grows exponentially stronger when transferred between users, with each successor building upon previous generations' stockpiled strength.

Functions/Applications:
Users channel accumulated power into explosive bursts of strength and speed far beyond normal capability. The quirk compounds with each transfer to a new user. Users can apply power selectively to specific limbs or across their entire body. With sufficient training, users can combine Power Stock with other quirks to exceed normal limitations.

Limits:
Power Stock requires extensive training to safely control; excessive output causes severe injury. As power accumulates across generations, it eventually exceeds what a single user can safely handle without specialized training. Rapid or forced transfer between incompatible users destabilizes the quirk. Users must gradually increase capacity over time or risk permanent damage to their body.

cardPool.title: Propagation
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Propagation

Description:
The user can grow and duplicate body parts across their form, multiplying them at will. Power scales proportionally with duplicates—three duplicates yield triple strength. Pairs dangerously with regenerative abilities.

Functions/Applications:
Duplicate limbs for enhanced striking force. Create composite forms by merging duplicates into larger mass. Generate independent mini-entities from duplicate cells. Stack duplicates for exponential power increases.

Limits:
Power gain is linear and dependent on number of duplicates. Requires significant biological mass; overextension causes resource depletion. Mini-entities are individually weaker and vulnerable to dispersal. Practical constraints from user stamina and durability apply.

Additional Notes:
Most effective when combined with regeneration or self-detonation abilities. Duplication quality and control may degrade with quantity. Emphasizes quantity-over-quality tactics rather than precision combat.

cardPool.title: Quad Arms
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Quad Arms

Description:
Grants the user a second pair of functional arms for four limbs total. The extra appendages are fully capable and proportional, enabling simultaneous multi-tasking and enhanced physical combat.

Functions/Applications:
Wield multiple weapons or tools simultaneously; perform complex manual tasks at double speed; execute advanced grappling and striking combinations that single-armed opponents cannot defend against; gain positional advantage through increased attack angles.

Limits:
Requires conscious control of all four arms—divided attention reduces effectiveness. Strength is distributed across four limbs rather than concentrated, preventing superhuman individual power. Standard armor and clothing become cumbersome or unusable.

Additional Notes:
Best utilized by trained hand-to-hand combatants who can leverage extra limbs tactically. Requires psychological adjustment to avoid arm interference during movement. Most effective in close-range engagements with simultaneous attacks or defensive positions.

cardPool.title: Queen Beam
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Queen Beam

Description:
The user projects a straight-travelling beam of pure energy from their face, accompanied by a pink heart symbol that manifests over their features. The beam travels in a direct line and can be consciously cancelled mid-flight after release.

Functions/Applications:
Offensive ranged attacks with reliable accuracy; beam can be directed by facing the target. The cancellation ability allows tactical repositioning or mercy strikes. Useful for combat at medium-to-long distances without physical contact.

Limits:
Beam travels only in straight lines with no homing capability. User must maintain line of sight to cancel the effect. Limited information on beam power or energy consumption prevents sustained multi-fire. Range and intensity appear modest compared to more destructive quirks.

Additional Notes:
Manifests at primary school age, suggesting relatively low power output. The heart symbol is a consistent visual marker of activation. Best suited for precise targeting rather than area damage or defense.

cardPool.title: Queen Bee
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Queen Bee

Description:
A parasitic bee colony that invades a host's body through the eye socket and burrows into the brain for complete control. The queen bee connects neurologically to her host, commanding their body, actions, and Quirk. A swarm nests behind a medical patch on the host's left eye, destroyed upon possession.

Functions/Applications:
Host possession and puppet control; bee swarm surveillance; injectable substance delivery via stinger-syringes for drugs or toxins; temporary Quirk absorption through host blood; neural disruption and signal hijacking; mass area coverage with coordinated bee deployment. Fused personality blends hive instinct with host consciousness.

Limits:
Destroys host's left eye permanently. Trigger drugs weaken the queen's grip, allowing host consciousness to resurface. A single bee can become new queen if the original dies, but requires time to rebuild and find a fresh host. Strong-willed individuals resist possession. Bee☆Pop variant loses direct control—bees follow instinct and only activate when she sings.

Additional Notes:
The quirk survives by maintaining hosts; one surviving bee can perpetuate the colony.

cardPool.title: Rabbit
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Rabbit

Description:
A transformation quirk granting rabbit-like anatomy and heightened animal instincts. The user develops functional rabbit features including long ears, powerful hind legs, and a fluffy tail, along with enhanced sensory perception and survival awareness.

Functions/Applications:
Enhanced hearing and smell detect distant threats. Powerful leg muscles enable rapid bouncing and devastating kick attacks. A ground stomp generates wind pressure strong enough to disperse fire. Rabbit instincts provide automatic danger awareness in combat.

Limits:
Power is primarily lower-body focused, limiting upper-body versatility. Enhanced senses can be overwhelmed by sensory overload. Bouncing mobility is restricted in tight spaces or difficult terrain. The user remains vulnerable to attacks targeting the ears or tail.

Additional Notes:
Combat-oriented quirk suited for aggressive, mobile fighting styles. Wind pressure from stomps allows engagement with multiple enemies simultaneously. Survival instinct provides defensive awareness and tactical positioning in prolonged engagements.

cardPool.title: Radio Waves
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Radio Waves

Description:
An electromagnetic quirk that emits pulses of radio waves to disrupt electrical systems and communications. Black lightning with purple outlines crackles around the user's arms and palms when activated. Grants control over technology and can transmit waveforms for remote communication and command.

Functions/Applications:
Disrupts and disables electrical appliances and communicators within range. Transmits waveforms through induced currents to command targets. The electromagnetic force can parry attacks and push enemies back. Can combine with other quirks for wide-range blasts that disable infrastructure.

Limits:
User requires knowledge and experience to issue precise commands; inexperienced users lack control. Range and power scale with mastery. Cannot function against non-electronic targets or purely mechanical systems without electrical components.

Additional Notes:
Most effective when paired with offensive quirks for area denial. Works at both close and long range.

cardPool.title: Razor Sharp
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Razor Sharp

Description:
The user generates sharp blades of varying shapes and sizes from any part of their body. These blades are composed of an unknown material strong enough to cut steel and withstand explosions.

Functions/Applications:
Blades can be produced from forearms for slashing, feet for stability, or any body part as needed. The user controls blade geometry and deployment in real-time for simultaneous offense and defense.

Limits:
Blade generation requires conscious effort and energy expenditure; sustained combat depletes stamina. The user must be within melee range. Blades cannot be thrown or separated from the body.

Additional Notes:
Best suited for close-quarters combat. The quirk's strength lies in tactical flexibility and unpredictable blade placement rather than raw power alone.

cardPool.title: Reflect
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Reflect

Description:
An always-active Quirk that absorbs incoming energy—physical or ranged—and rebounds it back at the attacker in a spiraling wave. The user's skin glows blue during use. However, the Quirk reflects all contact indiscriminately, preventing any physical touch and rendering the user blind due to light reflection from their eyes, necessitating special eye masks to see.

Functions/Applications:
Automatic defense against melee and ranged attacks without conscious effort. Can redirect reflected energy through technological augmentation to change trajectory or fuel flight. Works best when combined with stationary positioning and external firepower.

Limits:
Drains stamina proportionally to reflected energy strength; sustained barrages quickly deplete reserves and overwhelm the Quirk. Cannot be disabled, making all physical contact impossible—eliminating emotional bonds and social connection. The constant light reflection blinds the user without protective gear. Overloads under relentless, powerful multi-hit attacks.

Additional Notes:
The inability to touch others created severe social ostracization and psychological trauma for the user.

cardPool.title: Rewind
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Rewind

Description:
A rare mutant Quirk allowing the user to reverse a living being's body to a previous physical state. Activation causes a small horn on the forehead to grow and glow brightly, affecting all living creatures in contact or nearby. The power can theoretically rewind a target to non-existence, making it exceptionally dangerous.

Functions/Applications:
Restores injured bodies to pre-injury states, heals wounds and broken limbs, reverses genetic modifications, and restores erased Quirks. User can consciously control which targets are affected through training. Effective range requires close proximity or physical contact.

Limits:
Only affects living things; cannot rewind objects or non-organic matter. Requires accumulation of "Rewind Energy" to activate; horn must recharge before next use. User lacks innate control and risks catastrophic consequences without proper training. Emotional state influences potency.

Additional Notes:
Manifests as a small brown horn on the right forehead that grows during activation. Emotional determination and hope amplify Quirk strength. User is young and inexperienced; control improves through training on small organisms.

cardPool.title: Rifle
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Rifle

Description:
Kaina can extrude a functional rifle from her right elbow that fires ammunition crafted from her own hair. The weapon operates silently using organic muscle and bone sinew propulsion rather than gunpowder. She manifests a flesh tendril scope for precision targeting and can increase output power at the cost of jamming risk.

Functions/Applications:
Fire custom hair-bullets up to 3km with superior penetration and no audible report. Mold hair into specialized rounds: hollow-point, tracking, or curved trajectory variants. Bullets are reusable and caseless. Deploy flesh scope tendril for enhanced accuracy at range.

Limits:
Hair length determines ammunition capacity; short hair restricts sustained fire. Individual round loading creates reload delays. Rifle is fragile in close combat and requires manual maintenance. Bullets are identifiable by distinctive dark blue and pink coloring. Using the Quirk while injured reopens wounds and strains her body.

Additional Notes:
Ideal for assassins and snipers. Vulnerability to close-range combatants makes positioning critical.

cardPool.title: Rivet
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Rivet

Description:
A transformation quirk that enables the user to generate metallic rivet-like growths from their arms. These hardened projectiles can be expelled with force or extended as defensive barriers.

Functions/Applications:
The user can launch rivets as high-velocity projectiles for ranged attacks or extend them along their arms for melee enhancement. The growths provide armor-like protection and aid in climbing or anchoring surfaces.

Limits:
Rivet generation is limited to the arms and requires physical exertion. The growths deplete stamina with each use and cannot be regenerated indefinitely. Expelled rivets take time to regrow. The quirk offers no protection against quirks that bypass physical defense.

Additional Notes:
A straightforward combat quirk suited for aggressive, direct fighters. Effectiveness diminishes in prolonged battles due to stamina drain. Pairs well with close-range combat but is vulnerable to speed-based or energy-type quirks.

cardPool.title: Rocket Thrust
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Rocket Thrust

Description:
A ranged combat quirk enabling the user to detach and launch their right fist as a projectile at extreme velocities. The fist travels in a straight line before returning to reattach.

Functions/Applications:
The user fires their right fist repeatedly at high speed to strike distant enemies, break obstacles, or perform surprise attacks. The fist maintains considerable impact force upon contact.

Limits:
The user loses right arm functionality while the fist is in flight and cannot relaunch until reattachment. The projectile travels only in straight lines and cannot change direction mid-flight. Overuse causes arm fatigue and joint strain.

Additional Notes:
Most effective with tactical positioning to prevent close-range vulnerability. Excels in one-on-one combat but becomes predictable in prolonged engagements. Compatible users need above-average durability to withstand recoil forces.

cardPool.title: Rupture
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Rupture

Description:
Rupture grants the user the ability to detonate their own body or body parts at will, creating explosive force and sending fragments outward. The user controls the detonation's timing and intensity.

Functions/Applications:
The user can detonate localized body sections or their entire form to damage enemies in a radius. When combined with transformation Quirks like Liquification, Rupture becomes more lethal—transforming the user's liquefied body into a projectile spray of explosive matter.

Limits:
Detonating the body causes severe self-damage and requires recovery time. The explosion radius is limited to the user's physical size, and repeated use drains stamina rapidly. The Quirk cannot be used defensively.

Additional Notes:
Rupture is most effective when paired with regenerative or transformation-type Quirks. Predictable timing makes it vulnerable to fast-moving opponents who can escape the blast zone.

cardPool.title: Saber
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Saber

Description:
The user can transform portions of their body into sharp, sword-shaped appendages at will. These bladed limbs are hard and durable, capable of cutting through most materials with ease.

Functions/Applications:
Transform arms, legs, or other body parts into blade-like weapons for close combat; execute powerful slashing attacks; penetrate armor or barriers; position multiple bladed appendages offensively.

Limits:
Transformation is localized to specific body parts; transformed sections lose fine motor control; transformation takes a brief moment; extensive use causes fatigue; blades can be dulled by extremely hard materials.

Additional Notes:
This Quirk favors aggressive melee fighters. The user sacrifices mobility and precision for raw cutting power. Ideal for Pro Heroes who rely on physical strength and battlefield control.

cardPool.title: Sandstorm
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Sandstorm

Description:
The user transforms their upper body into manipulable sand, gaining a fluid, shapeshifting form. This grants enhanced physical adaptability and the ability to reform after damage, making them difficult to restrain or grapple with.

Functions/Applications:
Transform limbs into sand constructs for attacking and defending. Manipulate sand to shield against strikes, create barriers, or restrain opponents. Swing sand densely to repel flames and projectiles. Exploit fluidity to slip free from grapple-type Quirks requiring direct contact.

Limits:
Provides no defense against area-of-effect or wide-radius attacks. Cannot protect the lower body or head, leaving those areas vulnerable. Sand form is vulnerable to blunt force trauma and may scatter under extreme pressure. Requires concentration to maintain shapes; rapid shape-shifting drains stamina.

Additional Notes:
Most effective against contact-dependent Quirks and single-target attacks. Strategic weakness to elemental or crowd-control abilities. User's combat skill and creativity determine sand manipulation effectiveness in battle.

cardPool.title: Scalemail
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Scalemail

Description:
The user's body generates sharp, dark red armored scales that cover their skin, providing enhanced physical defense and strength. Activating the scales causes bleeding as they rupture through the skin, making each deployment painful.

Functions/Applications:
Deploy scales across the body for increased durability against strikes and physical attacks. The scales grant moderate strength enhancement. Can be selectively activated on specific body areas or full-body coverage.

Limits:
The scales shatter under sustained high-force impact. Generating the armor causes physical pain and bleeding each time activated. Repeated use risks severe blood loss and exhaustion from rupturing skin.

Additional Notes:
This Quirk was stolen and implanted by All For One, suggesting it may perform differently in its original owner's body. Durability is significant against standard attacks but fails against concentrated power.

cardPool.title: Scales
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Scales

Description:
The user generates hard, sharp reptilian scales across their body for protective armor and ranged ammunition. Scale production requires adequate collagen and calcium intake. The scales are sharp enough to cut through vines and damage metal, making them effective for both defense and offense.

Functions/Applications:
Deploy scales as full-body armor for damage mitigation during close combat. Launch individual scales as cutting projectiles at medium to long range. Switch between melee and ranged combat depending on enemy distance. Scales can be stored in specialized gauntlets for rapid-fire projectile attacks.

Limits:
Scales break or dislodge easily when struck with sufficient force, providing inferior protection compared to hardening-based quirks. Continuous production depletes collagen and calcium reserves, requiring dietary supplementation. Projectile accuracy depends on user skill and line of sight. Gauntlets have limited storage capacity before requiring regeneration time.

Additional Notes:
Hiryu Rin demonstrates remarkable accuracy with small targets and minimal collateral damage.

cardPool.title: Scanning
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Scanning

Description:
A detection-based Quirk that grants the user the ability to identify and analyze other individuals' Quirks and power levels. The user perceives targets through a heat signature-like visual overlay, revealing their Quirk nature and current strength output.

Functions/Applications:
Identify active Quirks in nearby targets. Measure relative power levels and detect power surges. Create tactical advantages by understanding enemy abilities before engagement. Track multiple targets simultaneously.

Limits:
Cannot identify Quirks if the user cannot see the target. Effectiveness decreases with distance and obstructions. Cannot reveal Quirk limitations or specific mechanics, only general power tier. Sustained scanning causes mental fatigue.

Additional Notes:
Originally stolen from an unknown hero, this Quirk is invaluable for reconnaissance and team coordination. The heat signature visualization requires active concentration and is disrupted by sensory interference or environmental distortions.

cardPool.title: Scatter
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Scatter

Description:
A stolen Quirk that splits and multiplies projectiles mid-flight, expanding coverage area and destructive potential. Transforms focused attacks into dispersed barrages.

Functions/Applications:
Multiplies incoming or outgoing projectiles into numerous smaller ones across a wider radius. Increases range and impact area of long-range attacks. Can combine with reflection abilities to redirect and amplify enemy fire. Effective for overwhelming defenses and area denial.

Limits:
Requires projectiles to function—cannot create attacks from nothing. Multiplied projectiles are individually weaker than the original. Does not enhance melee combat. Effectiveness diminishes against mobile targets. Cannot be used continuously without a projectile source.

Additional Notes:
This is a stolen Quirk, suggesting the user lacks innate mastery and may face unpredictable limitations. Best utilized in mid-to-long range engagements. Synergizes well with reflection or projectile-generating abilities. Strategic timing is crucial for maximum impact.

cardPool.title: Serpentress
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Serpentress

Description:
The user possesses three living serpents integrated into their hair as biological extensions with heightened sensory perception, allowing detection of hidden targets and disaster victims beyond normal human limits.

Functions/Applications:
The snakes scout ahead and sense concealed individuals or survivors in dangerous environments. They enable rapid victim location during rescue operations and provide reconnaissance advantages in stealth situations, moving independently under the user's control.

Limits:
The snakes cannot be separated from the user's body for extended periods. Offensive capabilities remain unclear and possibly limited. Detection range is constrained by sensory reach and they cannot pierce dense earth or sealed structures. The user cannot operate effectively while unconscious or restrained at the head.

Additional Notes:
Serpentress is primarily a utility Quirk for reconnaissance and rescue rather than direct combat. The snakes' exact offensive potential and maximum sensory range should be determined by campaign context.

cardPool.title: Shame
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Shame

Description:
A transformation Quirk that amplifies physical power proportionally to embarrassment level. Peak power achieved through extreme public humiliation or exposure.

Functions/Applications:
The user can strip and expose themselves to trigger maximum embarrassment and unlock combat potential. Shame-induced power boost enhances strength, speed, and durability. Works best in populated areas where witnesses amplify mortification.

Limits:
Requires public presence and audience to generate sufficient embarrassment; ineffective in isolation or with no witnesses. Power is weak when the user feels no shame. Sustained use causes extreme psychological distress. Impractical for stealth or covert missions.

Additional Notes:
Power scales with intensity of public observation and ridicule. Combat effectiveness depends on willingness to endure social humiliation. Best suited for direct confrontation rather than tactical engagements.

cardPool.title: Shield
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Shield

Description:
The user manifests stone-like hexagonal shields from their body, constructed from rapidly multiplying geometric layers. These shields are exceptionally durable and can be wielded defensively or offensively with sharp, cutting edges. The user can detach and throw shields as ranged weapons or keep them anchored for defense.

Functions/Applications:
Create shields of variable size and shape; detach shields to throw as mid-to-long-range projectiles; stack multiple small shields on legs and torso for passive armor; extend shield geometry to protect multiple allies; use shields offensively by driving sharpened edges into targets before detaching.

Limits:
Shield durability can be overwhelmed by sufficiently powerful attacks. Creating oversized or complex configurations requires greater concentration and energy. The user cannot generate shields faster than their hexagon multiplication rate allows. Detached shields cannot be remotely controlled after throwing.

Additional Notes:
This Quirk excels at supporting group combat through defensive coverage and tactical positioning.

cardPool.title: Shoulder-Mounted Jets
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Shoulder-Mounted Jets

Description:
Four retractable jet boosters on the upper back enable high-speed flight with powerful thrust for rapid acceleration and aerial movement. Sustained control requires significant effort and coordination.

Functions/Applications:
Grants speed-boosted flight for traversal and aerial combat positioning. Jets deploy or retract at will. Enables quick escapes and pursuit of airborne targets. Works with other physical quirks to stabilize mid-air maneuvers.

Limits:
Flight lacks precise maneuverability without support quirks. Requires arms or other abilities for balance and directional control during extended flight. Consumes stamina with prolonged use. Ineffective when fully restrained or immobilized.

Additional Notes:
Most effective paired with stabilizing or manipulative abilities. Requires assist from other quirks like Transforming Arms to control trajectory mid-flight. Jet boosters are durable for combat but vulnerable to direct damage.

cardPool.title: Size
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Size

Description:
A transmutation quirk allowing the user to alter physical dimensions of inanimate objects through tactile contact. Pressing five fingertips together activates the quirk, causing targeted objects to glow pink and shift to desired sizes—larger or smaller. The quirk is precise and reliable on non-living matter.

Functions/Applications:
Resize weapons, tools, or environmental objects for tactical advantage. Enlarge barriers for defense or shrink obstacles for passage. Create size disparities to confuse opponents or manipulate terrain. Conceal or transport large items by reducing dimensions.

Limits:
Cannot affect living organisms, people, animals, or plants. Activation requires deliberate hand positioning—all five fingertips pressed together—making rapid use difficult. Objects return to original size when contact breaks. Extreme size changes may require increased concentration.

Additional Notes:
The pink glow serves as a visible tell of activation, removing surprise factor. Best suited for strategic rather than direct combat. Works only on matter the user can physically touch.

cardPool.title: Slice
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Slice

Description:
The user can move, harden, and sharpen their own hair at will, transforming it into a versatile weapon and tool. Hair can be weaponized as blades, fired as needle-like projectiles, or used defensively as shields and mobility aids.

Functions/Applications:
Offensive strikes using hardened hair as cutting blades; launching hair strands as high-speed piercing projectiles; defensive barriers by interweaving hair into shields; parrying attacks; mobility enhancement using hair locks as climbing aids.

Limits:
Hair retains natural chemical vulnerability to corrosive substances like acid. Reduced hair length decreases combat effectiveness and range. Hair cannot be regrown mid-combat. Requires conscious control to harden, limiting reaction speed in surprise situations.

Additional Notes:
Slice excels in versatile close-to-mid-range combat with strong defensive utility. Effectiveness depends on hair maintenance and length preservation, making it vulnerable to caustic agents or extreme heat. Best used by strategic fighters who manage resources carefully.

cardPool.title: Sloshed
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Sloshed

Description:
An aura-based Quirk that induces severe vertigo and loss of equilibrium in nearby targets, simulating acute intoxication. Affected individuals struggle with balance and coordination.

Functions/Applications:
The user can selectively activate the effect on chosen targets while maintaining immunity for allies. They can conceal themselves while the Quirk manifests. The effect persists briefly even if the user loses consciousness.

Limits:
The Quirk requires proximity to function. Targets with prior exposure can gradually resist the effect. Strong-willed individuals may overcome it with concentrated effort.

Additional Notes:
This Quirk excels at area denial and disrupting enemy coordination rather than direct damage. Users should employ stealth and positioning to maximize effectiveness before enemies adjust to the sensation.

cardPool.title: Smile
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Smile

Description:
A vision-based incapacitation Quirk that forces targets into uncontrollable laughter lasting two hours. Activation requires displaying teeth directly to a victim or via real-time reflection (mirror, video, holographic projection). The laughter immobilizes targets, leaving them barely able to move or fight.

Functions/Applications:
Forces involuntary incapacitation through laughter; works on humans and machines (causing short circuits). User can create distance advantage using holographic tooth projectors. Victims may lose Quirk control during the effect. Strong-willed individuals can partially resist but remain physically immobilized.

Limits:
Ineffective if target's vision is obscured or blocked. Limited effective range without technological aid. Requires direct line of sight or real-time visual transmission. Does not work on those who cannot see the user's teeth display. Ice-users and highly resistant individuals can partially resist compulsion but still suffer physical incapacity.

Additional Notes:
Two-hour duration enables escape or objective completion. Powerful against law enforcement and multiple opponents simultaneously.

cardPool.title: Smoke
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Smoke

Description:
The user expels irritating pink smoke from holes across their body to create concealing screens. An antenna atop their head fires concentrated smoke bursts at targets.

Functions/Applications:
Generate thick smoke barriers for concealment and escape; launch focused smoke attacks via antenna to distract enemies; exploit reduced visibility for surprise attacks or evasion; cause eye irritation for tactical advantage.

Limits:
Smoke disperses over time and cannot persist indefinitely; ineffective against sightless opponents or those who navigate smoke; antenna requires clear obstruction-free positioning; user remains vulnerable when smoke clears; dependent on environmental factors like wind.

Additional Notes:
Primarily a utility Quirk for evasion and misdirection rather than direct combat. Most effective in urban or enclosed environments where smoke accumulates. User's mobility and cunning are essential to maximize potential.

cardPool.title: Smokescreen
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Smokescreen

Description:
The user generates thick purple smoke from their body that spreads across wide areas to obscure vision and disorient opponents. The smoke can be emitted from the mouth as a breath weapon. Enhanced through One For All's stockpiling, making it denser and more expansive than the original user's version.

Functions/Applications:
Creates visual obstruction to hide movements, catch enemies by surprise, or guide them toward desired locations. Can be combined with other abilities for tactical advantage. Useful for reconnaissance and escape.

Limits:
No offensive damage capability. Loses effectiveness in humid or rainy environments where it dissipates rapidly. Powerful shockwaves dispel the smoke quickly. User can become disoriented if releasing excessive amounts without preparation. Overuse obscures the user's own vision and movement.

Additional Notes:
Most effective when deployed strategically and combined with other Quirks. Requires experience to control output and prevent self-hindrance. Environmental conditions significantly impact reliability and coverage duration.

cardPool.title: Snip Clip
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Snip Clip

Description:
The user can cut through nearly any material by placing it between their index and middle fingers and performing a scissor motion. Cutting force is proportional to the user's strength and can sever solid objects like reinforced exoskeletons. Larger cuts are possible with material positioned between the legs.

Functions/Applications:
Precision cutting of objects, armor, and structural materials. Can disable mechanical suits by severing limbs or joints. Useful for environmental manipulation and disarming opponents. Works on organic and inorganic matter.

Limits:
The space between the user's fingers restricts cutting to thin or narrow objects. Larger items require repositioning between the legs, leaving the user vulnerable. The Quirk cannot cut beyond the user's physical reach. Effectiveness depends on user strength and leverage.

Additional Notes:
Excels at tactical dismantling but struggles against very thick or wide objects. User must maintain contact and positioning to execute cuts, making it ineffective at range. Most useful against armored or mechanical opponents rather than highly mobile targets.

cardPool.title: Soccer
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Soccer

Description:
Emperor Yotsuura's quirk grants superhuman soccer mastery, enabling flawless ball control while executing other actions simultaneously. The user can kick with devastating force, weaponizing the ball into a dangerous projectile.

Functions/Applications:
Dribble through crowds without obstruction; execute complex maneuvers while performing other tasks; deliver powerful kicks that transform the ball into a projectile; maintain perfect spatial awareness during play.

Limits:
May not be a true Quirk but exceptional skill. Requires a ball to function offensively. Power scaling and distance limitations unknown. Cannot function if unable to move freely.

Additional Notes:
The nature of this Quirk remains disputed among analysts. Best suited for misdirection, crowd navigation, and ranged attacks during chaotic situations.

cardPool.title: Softening
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Softening

Description:
Juzo Honenuki transforms solid objects into semi-liquid mud through touch, then reverts them with a second touch. Works on ice, metal, stone, and structures but not living beings. Softened materials trap and sink objects, creating treacherous terrain.

Functions/Applications:
Creates environmental traps that collapse under weight. Restricts enemy mobility and movement. Allows swimming through softened material for rapid traversal or escape. Neutralizes solid attacks. Controls battle flow and enemy positioning.

Limits:
Cannot affect living organisms. Targets with propulsion abilities can escape traps. Effects revert if Juzo loses consciousness. Requires direct physical contact to activate and deactivate. Less effective against opponents unaffected by terrain changes.

Additional Notes:
Pairs with Juzo's reflexes for defensive countering. Functions as both offensive trap-laying tool and defensive escape mechanism. Range depends on available solid materials in environment.

cardPool.title: Solid Air
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Solid Air

Description:
The user solidifies air through breath to create floating constructs—walls, platforms, and barriers—that remain suspended without support. These barriers are soundproof, blocking voice-based abilities and external noise. Durability scales with lung capacity and training.

Functions/Applications:
Create defensive walls and platforms for mobility or protection. Form soundproof enclosures to isolate targets and silence voices. Shape constructs into complex forms by hand-shaping exhaled air. Counter sound-dependent quirks with adaptive barriers.

Limits:
Breakable by sufficient physical force. Maximum construct size limited by lung capacity; prolonged use causes fatigue. Cannot create animated or mobile constructs. Requires conscious breath control; suffocation disables the quirk.

Additional Notes:
Early barriers are fragile but become resilient with training. Soundproofing makes this quirk effective against vocally-dependent opponents. Transparent constructs provide tactical advantage through visual obscurity.

cardPool.title: Somnambulist
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Somnambulist

Description:
The user emits a sleep-inducing lavender-purple aroma from their skin that renders targets unconscious. The fragrance is more potent against males than females. Sufficient inhalation causes deep slumber, making close-range combat hazardous for opponents.

Functions/Applications:
Release aroma passively or actively to incapacitate enemies at medium range. Use fans or support items to spread and direct the fragrance with greater accuracy and distance. Effective crowd control for subduing opponents. Can be concentrated for stronger effect on resistant targets.

Limits:
Requires exposed skin; tight clothing reduces effectiveness. Opponents with air-filtering masks avoid the aroma entirely. Significantly less effective against female targets unless concentrated. Low ventilation improves effectiveness; open spaces reduce potency. Breath-holding provides temporary resistance.

Additional Notes:
The Quirk makes the user an excellent referee or law enforcement officer due to non-lethal incapacitation. Support items like fans enhance range and control. Legal costume restrictions can paradoxically hinder effectiveness.

cardPool.title: Soul
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Soul

Description:
Soul manifests as Pino, a small pink bird-like creature bonded to the user's soul. Pino embodies the user's true thoughts and feelings, making deception impossible—lies create visible disconnect between words and Pino's actions, revealing genuine intent.

Functions/Applications:
Pino performs tasks independently like retrieving objects or creating distractions. The user can exploit Soul's truth-telling nature through feints, where Pino's honest reactions contradict false statements to confuse opponents. Pino acts autonomously based on subconscious desires, even when the user is incapacitated.

Limits:
The user cannot lie effectively, limiting deception tactics. Physical injury or blood loss weakens or fades Pino temporarily. Pino's small size and fragility limit combat capability. The user's emotional state affects Pino's visibility and strength.

Additional Notes:
Soul functions as both a powerful truth-detector and tool for reading unconscious intent. The Quirk's strength lies in its paradox—inability to hide thoughts becomes a tactical advantage when weaponized through calculated feints and misdirection.

cardPool.title: Spatial Excursion
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Spatial Excursion

Description:
Allows the user to freely manipulate the position and movement of objects and people within a spatial field, bypassing gravitational constraints. Objects can be repositioned, suspended, or propelled without physical contact.

Functions/Applications:
Reposition allies and enemies in combat; suspend falling objects or people mid-air; create spatial puzzles by rearranging environmental elements; with Overmodification, control vastly larger areas and heavier structures.

Limits:
Range and control capacity are finite—baseline ability limited to moderate distances and weights. Overmodification expands these limits but requires significant power. Quirk deactivates if user is rendered unconscious. Cannot affect users with certain defensive Quirks that negate external manipulation.

Additional Notes:
Most effective when user maintains consciousness and focus. Overmodification enables large-scale environmental control suitable for tactical warfare. Enemies should prioritize incapacitating the user to neutralize the threat.

cardPool.title: Spear Hand Missiles
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Spear Hand Missiles

Description:
The user's fingers are compact, reloadable missiles that detach and launch as projectiles, making them a living ranged weapon system with rapid-fire capability.

Functions/Applications:
Fire individual finger missiles in succession for suppressive fire or focused attacks. Projectiles can stun targets or cause injury on direct hits. Effective for mid-range combat and covering retreats.

Limits:
Flight paths are erratic and unpredictable, making accuracy difficult. Projectiles are easily blocked by objects or defensive Quirks. User is vulnerable while reloading and cannot use hands for melee combat while firing. Limited ammunition—fingers must regenerate between engagements.

Additional Notes:
Best suited for aggressive combatants who overwhelm opponents with volume of fire rather than precision. Requires tactical positioning to maximize effectiveness. Works poorly against agile or defensive opponents.

cardPool.title: Spearlike Bones
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Spearlike Bones

Description:
The user generates cone-shaped bone spears from any body part, including the mouth, jaw, and limbs. These spears are sharp, hard, and pierce flesh easily. The user controls size, length, and quantity.

Functions/Applications:
Deploy spears as melee weapons or ranged projectiles. Generate multiple spears for area attacks. Manifest from unexpected body parts to bypass defenses. Scale dimensions for different tactical situations.

Limits:
Requires conscious activation and focus. Cannot generate faster than consciously directing. Extended production drains stamina. Separated spears are brittle and destructible. Ineffective against superior defenses or projectile neutralization.

Additional Notes:
Initially manifests as uncontrolled growths until mastered. Works well combined with other Quirks. Spears are finite per activation cycle. Most effective at close to mid-range distances.

cardPool.title: Spotted Seal
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Spotted Seal

Description:
The user embodies physical and biological capabilities of a spotted seal, granting amphibious prowess. Enhanced strength and agility function equally on land and in water, with aquatic abilities exceeding human limits.

Functions/Applications:
Enhanced strength enables melee combat and environmental manipulation. Amphibious agility allows rapid evasion. Underwater echolocation maps areas and detects threats. Prolonged breath-holding permits 1500-meter dives. High-pitched vocalizations communicate across distances and water.

Limits:
Echolocation functions only underwater. Enhanced attributes diminish in extreme temperatures or toxic environments. Prolonged land use without water causes strain. Sensitive hearing creates vulnerability to sound attacks. Cannot breathe underwater despite seal physiology.

Additional Notes:
Best for reconnaissance, rescue operations, and aquatic combat. Synergizes with hearing-based allies. Primary weakness is extended dry-land engagement where seal physiology becomes disadvantageous.

cardPool.title: Spray Art
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Spray Art

Description:
The user generates clouds of colorful spray paint that induce mild hallucinations. By wielding spray paint cans, they release massive paint clouds similar to smoke that linger until deliberately dispersed or the user is incapacitated.

Functions/Applications:
Create disorienting illusions to confuse enemies and obscure vision. Control cloud duration and deployment area. Use hallucinations to separate groups or create tactical advantages. Useful for escape, misdirection, or area denial.

Limits:
The user must have spray paint cans to activate the Quirk. Hallucinations are only mild. Clouds dissipate if the user is immobilized or unconscious. The Quirk affects allies and enemies alike. Effectiveness diminishes against those with strong mental resistance.

Additional Notes:
This Quirk emphasizes battlefield control and confusion tactics over direct damage. The user retains awareness within their own clouds, making positioning critical. Duration is indefinite while active, granting sustained pressure if mobile.

cardPool.title: Spring
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Spring

Description:
Spring grants the ability to imbue objects and surfaces with elasticity, making them bounce with enhanced recoil. The effect applies to inanimate objects and environmental terrain, creating unpredictable rebounds.

Functions/Applications:
The user can make floors, walls, weapons, or projectiles bounce with increased force. This enables ricocheting attacks, creating springy platforms for mobility, and deflecting strikes. The bouncy effect persists until revoked.

Limits:
Spring cannot be applied to living beings or organic matter. The effect requires prior contact or proximity to activate. Overuse or applying to multiple objects simultaneously causes fatigue. Bounce intensity and duration depend on user concentration.

Additional Notes:
Spring is obscure and rarely documented in combat. While useful for creative problem-solving, it lacks offensive power compared to combat-specialized quirks. Its true potential remains largely unexplored.

cardPool.title: Springlike Limbs
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Springlike Limbs

Description:
The user's muscles coil and contract like springs, storing kinetic force and releasing it explosively. Black lightning with red outlines may crackle around the limbs during activation. The body becomes a living coil mechanism.

Functions/Applications:
Launch objects or people with devastating force at close range. Propel the user through the air for rapid movement. Amplify other Quirks when combined, particularly emitter-type abilities. Serve as a solo combat tool or force multiplier.

Limits:
Requires close proximity for maximum effect. Stored force must be released deliberately and cannot be maintained indefinitely without fatigue. Effectiveness depends on muscle condition and stamina. Works best when augmenting other attacks.

Additional Notes:
Originally stolen by All For One and used by Tomura Shigaraki. Black lightning manifestation appears inconsistently between users. Most powerful when paired with complementary Quirks.

cardPool.title: Squirmy Fingers
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Squirmy Fingers

Description:
The user gains supernatural control over their fingers, allowing them to bend and manipulate them in any direction with perfect precision. This grants exceptional dexterity and fine motor control far beyond normal human capability.

Functions/Applications:
Craft intricate mechanisms and detailed work with exceptional speed and accuracy. Manipulate small objects with flawless control. Create complex costumes and advanced equipment. Pick locks and perform delicate assembly tasks.

Limits:
Only affects the user's fingers and requires direct physical contact with objects. Provides no offensive combat capability and is acknowledged as barely useful in direct conflict.

Additional Notes:
Best suited for crafting and engineering roles rather than direct combat. The Quirk's true value lies in creation and construction. User is non-combatant despite the Quirk's practical utility.

cardPool.title: Static
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Static

Description:
By rubbing their body to generate friction, the user accumulates electrical charge similar to natural static electricity. This allows them to discharge electrical currents from their body in controlled bursts.

Functions/Applications:
The user builds up electrical energy through deliberate friction, then releases it as a shock for stunning or disorienting targets. Useful for short-range combat and incapacitating nearby opponents.

Limits:
Requires active charging time through rubbing—cannot generate charge instantly. Output damage is weak and unsuitable for heavy combat or armored foes. Extended use causes fatigue. Wet conditions neutralize the quirk's effectiveness.

Additional Notes:
This quirk demands tactical patience and preparation. Most effective in dry environments against unarmored opponents. The user must remain mobile during charging to avoid interruption.

cardPool.title: Steel
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Steel

Description:
The user transforms their entire body into steel, becoming a nigh-impenetrable living weapon. This dramatically increases physical strength to superhuman levels while providing exceptional resistance to physical damage, extreme cold, and moderate heat. The body takes on a metallic sheen, turning reddish when exposed to flames.

Functions/Applications:
Steel allows the user to withstand bullets, blades, falling debris, and extreme cold without injury. Enhanced strength enables breaking through obstacles and delivering powerful strikes. The user can serve as a human shield. Iron intake from food extends duration and potency.

Limits:
Prolonged use causes iron fatigue, gradually reducing hardness until deactivation is necessary. Steel has a hardness ceiling that cannot be improved through training. Poisonous gas and toxic vapors remain effective since breathing is required. Extreme heat can melt the form without sufficient training. The quirk does not protect against all damage types.

Additional Notes:
Steel functions similarly to hardening-type quirks but lacks unlimited improvement potential.

cardPool.title: Stiffening
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Stiffening

Description:
By touching and kneading objects with both hands, the user hardens any non-living material to extreme durability—transforming soft items like rubber into concrete-hard substances capable of shattering rock when thrown.

Functions/Applications:
Reinforces projectiles, tools, and structural materials for combat or construction. Works well with ranged attacks. Can strengthen multiple objects simultaneously through hand manipulation.

Limits:
Cannot affect living tissue. Hardened objects remain vulnerable to acids and corrosive substances. Requires direct physical contact and kneading motion. Viscous or sticky materials can trap hardened items.

Additional Notes:
Most effective paired with throwing weapons or ranged combat. User must use both hands to activate, limiting simultaneous actions. The harder the original material, the greater the end durability achieved.

cardPool.title: Stock
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Stock

Description:
A storage-based quirk that allows the user to absorb incoming attacks and convert them into physical lumps on their back. These stored attacks can be released at will during combat for tactical flexibility and counteroffensive capability.

Functions/Applications:
