The user absorbs incoming attacks, which manifest as lumps on their back. When needed, a lump detaches and floats toward the user's face before releasing the absorbed attack at an opponent. This enables defense-turned-offense strategies using an enemy's own force.

Limits:
Storage capacity is limited by the number of lumps the user can grow on their back. Each attack requires time to position before releasing, making it vulnerable to interruption. Attacks must make direct contact to be absorbed.

Additional Notes:
Stock excels at turning defensive situations into offensive advantages. The quirk's effectiveness depends on absorbing powerful attacks; weak strikes provide minimal benefit. The user must maintain awareness of their back's storage capacity during prolonged combat.

cardPool.title: Storage
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Storage

Description:
A containment-based Quirk allowing the user to store objects and living creatures inside their body in a suspended state. The user can carry multiple specimens and release them at will as tactical reinforcements or distractions.

Functions/Applications:
Store inorganic objects, living creatures, and biological entities within body cavity without harm. Release stored contents instantly during combat. Deploy multiple reinforcements in rapid succession while engaging primary targets.

Limits:
Storage capacity has an upper threshold. Retrieving items requires conscious activation and cannot be forced or stolen. Storing living creatures risks alerting allies through sounds or movements. Size limitations likely restrict very large organisms.

Additional Notes:
Ideal for surprise tactics and overwhelming opponents through numerical advantage. User remains mobile despite carrying cargo. Effectiveness depends on what is stored and tactical deployment timing.

cardPool.title: Stress
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Stress

Description:
Converts negative emotions—anger, dread, frustration, and stress—into raw physical power. The user's body swells with black markings spreading across enhanced areas, granting increased strength, resilience, and size proportional to emotional intensity. Can enhance individual limbs or the entire body.

Functions/Applications:
Selective limb enhancement for precision strikes or full-body transformation for overwhelming power. At high intensity (80%+ "Liberation"), manifests as a hulking monster form capable of releasing concentrated stress energy projectiles. Scales with opponent threat level; user can modulate enhancement percentage.

Limits:
Positive emotions—peace, relief, confidence—diminish stress levels and weaken the ability. Requires constant negative emotional state for peak performance, causing psychological strain. Physical anchors like prosthetics can restrict full potential by failing to support increased mass and power.

Additional Notes:
Prolonged reliance causes severe side effects including male pattern baldness and emotional instability. User must balance power needs against mental health deterioration.

cardPool.title: Strongarm
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Strongarm

Description:
The user's shoulders rotate at superhuman speeds, enabling rapid, powerful punches in quick succession. Each strike carries immense force capable of wearing down defensive opponents through accumulated impact.

Functions/Applications:
Rapid-fire punching combinations with extreme velocity and power. Penetrates defenses through strike trauma. Effective for close-range combat against armored or durable opponents.

Limits:
Usable for only a few seconds before muscle fatigue sets in. Cannot break through absolute barrier-type Quirks. Shoulder joints require recovery time between uses.

Additional Notes:
Best suited for short, explosive engagements rather than prolonged battles. User must manage stamina carefully to avoid physical incapacity mid-combat.

cardPool.title: Sugar Rush
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Sugar Rush

Description:
By consuming sugar, Rikido multiplies his physical strength five-fold for three minutes per ten grams ingested. His body visibly bulks up during activation.

Functions/Applications:
Ideal for breaking through obstacles and overpowering opponents in direct combat. Rikido carries granulated sugar in belt pouches for quick activation mid-battle.

Limits:
Requires accessible sugar to activate. Activation causes severe hypoglycemia: lowered intelligence and lethargy during the boost. Cannot be sustained beyond three minutes without additional sugar. Rikido becomes a straightforward brawler unable to execute complex strategies while empowered.

Additional Notes:
The effect duration and strength multiplier scale directly with sugar quantity consumed, making careful rationing essential for prolonged conflicts.

cardPool.title: Suicide Bomb
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Suicide Bomb

Description:
A volatile Quirk that generates devastating explosions centered on the user's body. The ability creates massive destructive force capable of razing large areas and can be triggered by the user's will or external heat sources.

Functions/Applications:
Deploy large-scale area-denial explosions for combat or destruction. Functions as both offensive weapon and last-resort defensive measure.

Limits:
The user is vulnerable to their own explosions and can suffer lethal damage. Fire-based Quirks that control external heat pose severe matchup disadvantages by risking accidental detonation. Once triggered externally, the Quirk appears uncontrollable.

Additional Notes:
Represents extreme danger to both user and environment. Most effective as a last-stand tactic rather than sustained combat ability.

cardPool.title: Super Regeneration
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Super Regeneration

Description:
A rare artificially engineered Quirk enabling rapid regeneration of physical damage including severed limbs and catastrophic wounds at incredible speeds, making users exceptionally difficult to permanently disable through conventional injury.

Functions/Applications:
The user recovers from nearly any physical trauma—burns, lacerations, amputation, blunt force damage—as long as their brain remains active. Regeneration speed scales with physical condition; a fully prepared body regenerates faster than an unprepared one. Allows survival from attacks that would instantly kill most combatants.

Limits:
Cannot heal cauterized wounds, spiritual damage, or damage to Quirk Factors. Requires active brain function; unconsciousness or brain destruction halts healing. Damage dealt faster than regeneration can occur will overwhelm the user. Complete incineration or molecular disintegration bypasses regeneration. Non-physical killing methods like heart stoppage or suffocation circumvent the Quirk. Incompletely prepared bodies experience dramatically slower regeneration rates.

cardPool.title: Swan
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Swan

Description:
The user manifests two large, pristine white wings resembling those of a swan on their back. These wings enable aerial locomotion, granting the ability to soar through the skies with grace and speed.

Functions/Applications:
Flight across distances and terrain. Enhanced mobility for escape, pursuit, or reconnaissance. Wings generate significant wind gusts when deployed.

Limits:
Flight requires the user to strip naked first, as clothing weight prevents takeoff. Wings are vulnerable to damage during flight, leaving the user defenseless mid-air if injured.

Additional Notes:
The quirk's awkward activation requirement makes it impractical in combat or emergencies. Best suited for scouting or travel in private settings.

cardPool.title: Sword Kill
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Sword Kill

Description:
The user generates flexible, accordion-like swords from their arms and shoulders that extend and retract at will. When enhanced by Trigger, the Quirk produces up to six blades simultaneously, including from the mouth, and the user's face becomes serpentine and menacing.

Functions/Applications:
Deploy multiple melee weapons for combat versatility, defense, or crowd control. Extended blades allow mid-range strikes while maintaining close-quarters capability. Trigger enhancement multiplies offensive potential.

Limits:
Base form limited to two primary swords. Continuous blade generation taxes stamina. Trigger dependence creates vulnerability and potential addiction. Accordion flexibility reduces blade rigidity.

Additional Notes:
Blade speed and range scale with user experience. Trigger enhancement is temporary and may alter judgment. The serpentine transformation suggests psychological side effects from prolonged use.

cardPool.title: Tape
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name: Tape

Description: The user's elbows function as biological tape dispensers, ejecting strong adhesive tape of variable length and thickness. The tape supports body weight and restrains opponents but breaks under extreme force. Continuous overuse causes dry skin irritation.

Functions/Applications: Fire tape strands for binding and immobilizing targets; swing or rappel using anchored tape; create traps and blockades; shoot multiple strands simultaneously; produce double-sided tape; craft tools and masks; coordinate combo effects with allies.

Limits: Tape supply is finite per cycle. Not unbreakable and snaps under stress. Overuse causes dry skin degradation. User must manually cut tape to reset firing. Ineffective against non-adhesive surfaces.

Additional Notes: Most effective at medium range. Versatile support Quirk enabling mobility, restraint, and environmental control. Synergizes with mobility or levitation Quirks. Physical conditioning increases capacity and firing speed.

cardPool.title: Telepath
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Telepath

Description:
A one-way telepathic ability allowing the user to broadcast thoughts and messages directly into the minds of others. Can target single individuals or multiple people simultaneously across considerable distances.

Functions/Applications:
Send tactical instructions to allies during combat. Broadcast warnings or information across large areas. Distract enemies by projecting disorienting messages into their minds.

Limits:
Communication is one-way; the user cannot hear thoughts or receive responses. Range is limited. Cannot force actions, only deliver messages. Overuse or contacting too many people simultaneously may cause mental strain.

Additional Notes:
Effective for battlefield coordination and psychological tactics. Useless against deaf or mentally shielded opponents. Works best when paired with direct combat abilities or team strategies.

cardPool.title: Teleportation
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Teleportation

Description:
Gil Gollini can instantly move himself and anything he touches to any location within his line of sight. Overmodified enhancement dramatically increases activation speed, making him difficult to predict or counter.

Functions/Applications:
Instantaneous repositioning in combat or exploration. Transport of allies and objects through physical contact. Rapid escape from danger or tactical repositioning. Enhanced speed allows near-instantaneous consecutive teleports when overmodified.

Limits:
Requires clear line of sight to destination; obstructed vision prevents teleportation. Cannot teleport beyond visual range. Environmental hazards can force unsafe teleportation positions. Vision obstruction leaves user vulnerable.

Additional Notes:
Strength lies in mobility and unpredictability. Weakness exploitable through vision denial or environmental control. Overmodification increases combat effectiveness but strains the user.

cardPool.title: Telescopic
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Telescopic

Description:
The user can rapidly retract their body parts into themselves like a turtle. Retraction is nearly instantaneous for quick evasion, but unretracting takes several seconds and leaves them vulnerable.

Functions/Applications:
Defensive evasion against projectiles and melee attacks; quick dodge-and-counter tactics; protection from piercing or cutting damage while retracted.

Limits:
Unretracting is slow and leaves the user exposed and immobile. Cannot retract selectively—must withdraw entire body or specific limbs at once. Ineffective against area-of-effect attacks or sustained pressure. User remains conscious but trapped during retraction, unable to act offensively.

Additional Notes:
Best suited for defensive combat roles requiring quick reflexes. Combines well with counterattack strategies that exploit opponent momentum. Requires spatial awareness before unretracting.

cardPool.title: Tidal Bore
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Tidal Bore

Description:
The user expels massive quantities of water from their mouth with tremendous force. This water can be generated rapidly in overwhelming volumes, capable of manipulating heavy objects and creating destructive floods.

Functions/Applications:
Generate powerful water jets to lift or push heavy objects. Create widespread flooding to disrupt terrain and enemies. Use water discharge as offensive blast or defensive barrier. Output scales with emotional state, intensifying when triggered by strong stimuli like hunger.

Limits:
Water generation drains stamina quickly with prolonged use. The quirk activates involuntarily around favorite foods, causing indiscriminate flooding. Effectiveness reduces in arid environments. Water must originate from the user's mouth, limiting range.

Additional Notes:
Best suited for large-scale environmental control rather than precise combat. Involuntary activation is both weakness and liability in social situations. Most effective near bodies of water or in wet climates.

cardPool.title: Toho
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name: Toho

Description: Grants the user kaiju-like attributes, transforming them into a massive reptilian creature with enormous size, superhuman strength, and scaled skin.

Functions/Applications: Devastating melee combat through size and strength; intimidation; crushing objects and structures; enhanced durability from scaled skin; use as a living siege weapon.

Limits: Extreme size prevents stealth and navigation of confined spaces; high energy consumption; slow movement speed; vulnerability to tactics exploiting lack of agility; psychological strain from transformation.

Additional Notes: Transformation appears permanent or semi-permanent. Effectiveness scales with physical conditioning and combat experience. Best suited for direct assault roles.

cardPool.title: Tongue Tank
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Tongue Tank

Description:
The user's tongue transforms into a retractable tank cannon housed within their mouth. When the mouth opens, the tongue-cannon extends and fires hard, rock-like projectiles with considerable force. The mechanism of ammunition generation is unclear—whether the user must consume materials or produces them internally.

Functions/Applications:
Fires projectiles at moderate to long range. Deploys quickly by opening the mouth. Useful for ranged combat, area denial, and breaking obstacles. The cannon retracts for protection when not in use.

Limits:
Projectile capacity and firing rate are unknown. The user must open their mouth to fire, creating a predictable attack pattern. Close-quarters combat is severely hampered. Ammunition source is uncertain, potentially limiting sustained fire. The mouth remains vulnerable.

Additional Notes:
Quirk manifests in young users with development potential. Practical applications depend on whether ammunition is finite or self-regenerating. Users require tactical positioning to maximize effectiveness while maintaining defense.

cardPool.title: Traject
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Traject

Description:
A trajectory manipulation quirk that allows the user to alter the path of objects or energy passing through their bandages. By redirecting incoming attacks, projectiles, or elemental forces, the user can turn threats into advantages or shield themselves from harm.

Functions/Applications:
Redirect enemy attacks toward other targets or away from allies. Deflect high-temperature energy like fire or plasma without absorbing damage. Alter the course of moving objects mid-flight. Protect self during combat by channeling dangerous forces through bandaged areas.

Limits:
The quirk only works on objects or energy actively passing through the bandages. Requires precise positioning and timing to intercept projectiles. Extremely intense heat can overwhelm the redirection without sufficient experience. The bandages themselves can be damaged or destroyed, disabling the quirk entirely.

Additional Notes:
Effectiveness increases with combat experience. Best suited for defensive or tactical support roles rather than direct offense. Works best against ranged attacks or elemental projectiles rather than melee strikes.

cardPool.title: Transform
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Transform

Description:
The user consumes blood to perfectly replicate another person's physical appearance, voice, and clothing. One cup of blood grants approximately one day of transformation. After awakening, the user can duplicate the quirk of emotionally close targets provided they've studied it thoroughly.

Functions/Applications:
Perfect physical disguise including facial features, voice replication, and copied attire. Rapid appearance-switching between multiple consumed blood sources. Post-awakening: Quirk duplication and blood type matching for safe transfusions with transformed individuals.

Limits:
Cannot copy personality, knowledge, or mannerisms. Transformation time and blood capacity are finite. Vulnerable to tainted or booby-trapped blood. Serious damage causes partial transformation failure. Quirk copying requires emotional closeness and extensive study. No inherent offensive or defensive capabilities without copied quirks. User suffers compulsive blood-drinking urges with dangerous psychological consequences if suppressed.

Additional Notes:
This quirk prioritizes deception and infiltration over combat.

cardPool.title: Transforming Arms
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Transforming Arms

Description:
The user reshapes their arms at will, extending them elastically for long-range strikes or splitting them to attack simultaneously. Arms can enlarge, harden, or transform into different shapes for combat needs. This Quirk grants exceptional reach and versatility.

Functions/Applications:
Stretch arms to grab distant targets. Enlarge fists for close-range power. Split arms to strike from multiple directions. Transform arms into alternative shapes like wings for mobility. Combine with other Quirks for hybrid combat.

Limits:
Effectiveness decreases if the user's natural fighting style conflicts with shapeshifting mechanics. Rigid martial artists experience lag between transformation and execution. Transformation speed and complexity drain stamina with extended use. Arm durability depends on how thin or spread the user stretches them.

Additional Notes:
Most effective when paired with flexible and unconventional fighting styles. Users favoring pure hand-to-hand combat may find the Quirk burdensome, reducing overall efficiency despite raw power potential.

cardPool.title: Trap Flex
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Trap Flex

Description:
The user can flex their trapezius muscles to extraordinary degrees, allowing their shoulders to expand and envelop their head. This grants enhanced speed and strength beyond normal human capability.

Functions/Applications:
Provides boosts to physical speed and striking power. The expanded shoulders offer partial defensive protection for the head and neck. Useful for close-quarters combat, grappling, and evasive maneuvers.

Limits:
Strength output is modest compared to dedicated strength Quirks. Continuous flexing causes fatigue. Head protection is incomplete, vulnerable to direct strikes on exposed areas, particularly the back of the head.

Additional Notes:
Best suited for hit-and-run tactics rather than prolonged brawls. Effectiveness diminishes against significantly stronger opponents. Works optimally with tactical positioning and speed-based strategies.

cardPool.title: Tree Frog
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Tree Frog

Description:
A frog-type Quirk granting an extended, curling tongue and webbed fingers. The user develops amphibian traits suited for climbing and aquatic environments.

Functions/Applications:
The extendable tongue enables grappling, object manipulation, and adhesive climbing. Webbed fingers enhance swimming and grip strength on wet surfaces. The user gains improved agility in arboreal and aquatic settings.

Limits:
Tongue extension is minimal, limiting reach and grappling power. Primarily useful for close-range interactions. Effectiveness diminishes in dry environments; moisture is required for optimal performance. Cannot match specialized amphibian Quirks in combat.

Additional Notes:
Tree Frog is a utility-focused Quirk suited for mobility and environmental adaptation rather than direct confrontation. Users excel in jungle, swamp, and aquatic terrains but struggle in arid conditions.

cardPool.title: Tripod
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Tripod

Description:
The user manifests a fully functional third leg positioned centrally between their two natural legs. This additional limb grants enhanced stability and balance, allowing the user to maintain footing on precarious or uneven surfaces where others would falter.

Functions/Applications:
The third leg provides superior balance during combat, enables traversal of unstable terrain, and allows three-point stances for enhanced stability. It can anchor the body against knockback or offensive pressure.

Limits:
The third leg cannot move independently and does not grant increased speed or enhanced strength. The user must adapt their gait and coordination to effectively utilize the extra limb.

Additional Notes:
The third leg's positioning offers tactical advantages in balance-dependent scenarios. Its effectiveness is nullified on surfaces where no footing is possible and provides minimal benefit against aerial opponents.

cardPool.title: Twin Impact
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Twin Impact

Description:
Twin Impact allows the user to create a delayed secondary impact at the location of any initial strike or contact. The second impact detonates remotely at the user's command with amplified force, often several times stronger than the original blow.

Functions/Applications:
Effective against objects and living targets. User delivers a normal attack, then triggers a devastating secondary explosion at the exact impact point. Useful for surprise damage, environmental destruction, and unpredictable combat. Can be layered with physical strikes or thrown objects.

Limits:
Secondary impact only activates at the precise location of initial contact—moving targets escape if they leave the area. User must consciously trigger each second impact, requiring focus and tactical awareness. Activation delay creates a brief vulnerability window. No effect on ethereal or intangible matter.

Additional Notes:
Ideal for tactical fighters who predict opponent movement and position strategically. Combines well with speed-based combat. Less effective against fast, mobile enemies who rapidly relocate. Requires physical contact or projectile impact to initiate.

cardPool.title: Vibrate
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name: Vibrate

Description: The user generates and controls shockwaves and vibrations through any medium they touch. By modulating frequency and intensity with their hands, they can create precise tremors or devastating seismic disturbances. Prolonged exposure grants natural resistance to vibration-based attacks.

Functions/Applications: Shatters objects through vigorous vibration. Creates controlled earthquakes that disrupt terrain and formations. Weakens structural integrity of materials and muscle fibers. Works against groups by destroying footing and balance. Can counter vibration-based Quirks defensively.

Limits: Excessively fast or powerful vibrations cause severe aftershock damage to the user's body, temporarily paralyzing them. Vibrations exceeding the control threshold cannot be stopped and must dissipate naturally. The user cannot match raw physical strength and relies on weakening opponents. Overuse risks neurological strain despite built-in resistance.

Additional Notes: The user develops vibration resistance through repeated exposure to their own Quirk's aftereffects.

cardPool.title: Vibration Detection
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Vibration Sense

Description:
The user perceives surroundings through detection of subtle vibrations in air and matter, functioning as sensory replacement similar to echolocation. This compensates for visual impairment by mapping spatial awareness through vibration patterns.

Functions/Applications:
The user can navigate complex environments, detect nearby objects and beings, track movement through tremors, and identify threats in darkness. This allows combat awareness and spatial navigation without sight.

Limits:
Cannot penetrate vibration-dampening materials like thick stone. Requires environments where vibrations propagate; total silence or dampening fields severely limit effectiveness. Cannot discern fine details like facial features or colors.

Additional Notes:
Primary strength lies in adapting to sensory loss, valuable for visually impaired users. Works best in environments with active movement or sound; still environments reduce range and clarity. Pairs well with other compensatory sensory abilities.

cardPool.title: Vines
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Vines

Description:
The user's hair transforms into controllable, thorny vines that can be manipulated and detached from the head. The vines are durable, capable of piercing skin and cutting concrete, while remaining non-conductive to electricity.

Functions/Applications:
Vines can restrain opponents, grapple distant objects, form defensive barriers, and be severed as weapons. The thorns inflict cutting damage on contact. The user gains resistance to electrical attacks.

Limits:
The vines can be cut or severed, requiring time to regenerate. Growth depends on sunlight and water. Extended use without these resources diminishes vine strength and length. The vines remain anchored to the user's head.

Additional Notes:
The vines function as both offensive and defensive tools, making this a versatile middle-range Quirk. Users should position themselves in well-lit, moist environments for sustained effectiveness.

cardPool.title: Viral Cosmos
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Viral Cosmos

Description:
Two distinctive flowers grow from the user's head and generate an endless supply of petals. These petals can be hurled as projectile weapons that inflict harm upon impact.

Functions/Applications:
Throw petals as ranged attacks to damage enemies from distance. Adjust petal velocity and volume for different combat situations. Continuous petal generation allows sustained offensive pressure without ammunition limitation.

Limits:
Petals have limited effective range and lose velocity over distance. The flowers can be targeted and damaged by opponents. Petal attacks deal moderate damage. User cannot control petal trajectory mid-flight, only initial launch force.

Additional Notes:
Best suited for ranged harassment and mid-range combat. Vulnerable to fire-type attacks and environmental hazards. Effectiveness decreases in confined spaces.

cardPool.title: Voice
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name: Voice

Description: A sonic amplification Quirk that allows the user to project their voice at devastating volumes and frequencies. The user can generate high-pitched sounds capable of reaching extreme decibel levels, sufficient to rupture eardrums and incapacitate targets through auditory trauma.

Functions/Applications: Create sonic attacks that disorient and damage enemies; drown out competing sound-based Quirks; project commands across large distances; use directional speakers to shield nearby allies.

Limits: Prolonged use causes vocal strain, limiting sustained combat duration. Ineffective against underground opponents or those in soundproof environments. Requires close proximity or speaker equipment for directional control; uncontrolled use endangers allies.

Additional Notes: The user typically wears a directional speaker support item around the neck to control sound propagation and protect nearby companions. Most effective in open terrain and against multiple opponents.

cardPool.title: Voyance
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Voyance

Description:
The user can see through solid objects and barriers within their line of sight. Living organisms remain opaque and cannot be seen through. By peering through a finger-formed aperture, the user extends duration and reduces mental strain.

Functions/Applications:
Locate hidden objects, bombs, or contraband behind walls. Scout enemy positions without exposure. Detect structural weaknesses or hidden compartments. Track devices through barriers.

Limits:
Cannot see through living matter. Continuous use without finger-aperture exhausts the user quickly. Only works within direct line of sight. Cannot penetrate certain dense materials.

Additional Notes:
The finger-aperture technique is essential for sustained use. Best for reconnaissance and bomb-detection. Ineffective against hidden enemies in combat.

cardPool.title: Warp Gate
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Warp Gate

Description:
The user generates dark purple and black mist that forms portals, transporting anything touching the fog to predetermined locations. The user can cloak themselves in mist, becoming nearly invisible while channeling teleportation. This artificial Quirk is synthesized from multiple sources with Cloud Quirk as its base.

Functions/Applications:
Create coordinate-based portals for instant transportation across vast distances. Cloak the user's body to obscure their form and location. Open portals from sight-based locations or memorized coordinates. Transport multiple targets simultaneously. Establish escape routes or ambush points during combat.

Limits:
The user's neck cannot be covered by mist, creating a critical weak point. Portals require precise coordinate knowledge—the user must see or know exact positions to open unseen gates. Cannot locate missing persons without knowing their exact location. Closing a portal while someone is partially inside causes severe bisection. Overuse causes physical exhaustion and deterioration. Coordinate-based nature makes it slower than instinctive warping.

cardPool.title: Warping
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Warping

Description:
A stolen teleportation quirk manifesting as black ooze erupting from a target's mouth, enveloping their body as a portal before they vanish and reappear elsewhere. The ooze carries a repugnant stench and can transport multiple people to separate locations.

Functions/Applications:
The user can summon targets to their location or banish them away, but only those they know well or those near someone they know. Works as a short-range teleportation tool for tactical repositioning, extraction, or dispersal of enemies.

Limits:
Range is restricted—targets must be within a certain distance. User cannot teleport themselves. Only functions on people the user knows well or those in proximity to them. Strong-willed individuals can resist by swallowing the ooze before full envelopment. Cannot function as coordinate-based warping; requires specific people as anchors. Repeated use causes severe physical strain.

Additional Notes:
This quirk requires personal connection or proximity to function, making it less versatile but more controllable than coordinate-based teleportation.

cardPool.title: Water Control
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Water Control

Description:
A water-manipulation Quirk granting command over nearby water. The user shapes water into offensive constructs and projectiles with precision, from razor-sharp claws to devastating torrents. Power scales with available water supply.

Functions/Applications:
Form water into bladed weapons for melee combat. Launch pressurized water jets as ranged attacks. Create barriers or shields from solidified water. Redirect or absorb incoming water-based attacks.

Limits:
Requires proximity to a water source; effectiveness diminishes in arid environments. Cannot generate water from nothing. Sustained constructs drain stamina proportionally to size and density. Water defenses are vulnerable to evaporation or freezing.

Additional Notes:
Most effective near bodies of water, rain, or humid conditions. User skill determines attack precision and construct complexity. Dehydrated opponents are harder targets but don't negate the Quirk if environmental water remains available.

cardPool.title: Water Gun
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name: Water Gun

Description: The user projects pressurized streams of water from their hands with precision and force. A straightforward offensive and utility Quirk using liquid projectiles as a combat tool or environmental solution.

Functions/Applications: Fire suppression and water dispersal; tactical distraction by targeting faces or eyes; crowd control through water spray; assistance with environmental hazards.

Limits: Limited to water already present or internally stored—cannot create water from nothing. Pressure and range decrease with sustained use. Ineffective against water-resistant or aquatic opponents. Requires hand positioning and aim; cannot function if hands are restrained.

Additional Notes: Most effective in supporting roles rather than primary offense. Practical utility makes it valuable in rescue operations and disaster response. Strength lies in versatility and non-lethal control rather than raw damage.

cardPool.title: Water Pump
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Water Pump

Description:
The user's hands are replaced with functional water hose spigots capable of generating pressurized water on demand. Water can be shaped and controlled with precision into various forms, from barriers to implements.

Functions/Applications:
Create defensive barriers, generate hand-like water constructs for manipulation, deliver pressurized water attacks, and extinguish fires. The user maintains fine control over water flow rate and shape.

Limits:
Requires a water source or internal reserves to function; prolonged use depletes reserves. The hose-hand design limits fine manipulation tasks. Water constructs disperse if pressure is lost.

Additional Notes:
Best suited for defensive and utility roles. Highly effective in firefighting. User must manage water reserves carefully during extended engagements.

cardPool.title: Weather Manipulation
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Weather Manipulation

Description:
The user controls all weather phenomena including storms, lightning, wind, and tornadoes on massive scale. Can envelope entire islands in storm clouds and summon devastating weather capable of destroying landscapes. The Quirk grants flight via wind manipulation.

Functions/Applications:
Create massive storm systems and tornadoes for area denial. Summon precise lightning bolts for targeted offense. Generate powerful winds for propulsion and flight. Scale attacks from localized strikes to island-wide devastation depending on intent and energy.

Limits:
Using the Quirk causes severe cellular degeneration and excruciating pain, forcing conservative use. Overuse leads to loss of control and collapse. Lightning can be redirected or grounded by electricity-based Quirks. Continuous simultaneous power application accelerates deterioration and risks fatal exhaustion.

Additional Notes:
This Quirk's immense power isolates users socially and psychologically. The user cannot sustain full-power weather manipulation without external aid like cell regeneration abilities. Rage or desperation can trigger uncontrolled massive storms.

cardPool.title: Weld
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Weld

Description:
Yosetsu can merge organic and inorganic matter at a subatomic level through physical contact. Objects, people, or his own body fuse seamlessly with targets, creating permanent bonds until he consciously reverses the effect.

Functions/Applications:
Restraint by fusing enemies to structures or each other. Equipment enhancement by welding armor to his body. Transport by fusing limbs with allies. Steel logs in his costume bridge separate targets without simultaneous contact.

Limits:
Requires contact with at least two objects to activate. Cannot fuse single items. Reversing requires conscious effort and time. Forced separation risks injury to merged organic matter.

Additional Notes:
Excels as tactical restraint rather than direct combat. Yosetsu carries specialized steel logs and shields for versatility. Works on willing allies, valuable for rescue operations and cooperative strategies.

cardPool.title: Whale
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Whale

Description:
A transformation Quirk allowing the user to convert parts or their entire body into that of a sperm whale. When fully transformed, the user gains immense size, strength, and aquatic capabilities.

Functions/Applications:
Enables partial or complete body transformation into whale form for enhanced physical power and aquatic capability. In full transformation, the user can expel powerful water streams from their mouth as an offensive weapon. Useful for underwater combat and overwhelming opponents through sheer force.

Limits:
Transformation is taxing on the body. Water attacks require full transformation and expend significant energy. Whale form is cumbersome on land and vulnerable to harpoon-type weapons or electricity in water. The Quirk does not grant enhanced intelligence or special senses.

Additional Notes:
Most effective in aquatic environments. Partial transformations may allow tactical flexibility but are weaker than full conversion. Water projection requires the user's throat and mouth to function as whale anatomy dictates.

cardPool.title: Whirlwind
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Whirlwind

Description:
Inasa commands the air itself, generating powerful gusts and tornadoes with minimal physical movement. He can manipulate multiple wind currents simultaneously with precise control, propelling objects, allies, and himself through the air.

Functions/Applications:
Offensive wind blasts that knock enemies away; defensive deflection of projectiles and evasive maneuverability; support abilities to amplify allies' attacks. Flight through costume-enhanced tornadoes or ground-burst propulsion. Can combine with heat-based Quirks to create flame tornadoes.

Limits:
Significantly weakened if limbs cannot move freely. High temperatures and large fire sources disrupt airflow and destabilize control. Initially incompatible with cold-heat manipulation Quirks.

Additional Notes:
Whirlwind excels in versatility across offense, defense, and support roles. Effectiveness scales with Inasa's physical freedom and environmental conditions. Synergizes well with complementary Quirks when users coordinate tactically.

cardPool.title: Whiteline
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Whiteline

Description:
The user manipulates painted lane lines on roads as flexible tentacles. These white lines extend, coil, and move with considerable force to ensnare targets or hurl objects.

Functions/Applications:
Entangle and immobilize enemies by wrapping animated lane lines around them. Lift and throw heavy objects like vehicles. Create barriers using road markings. Requires painted road surfaces to function.

Limits:
Only works on existing painted lines; bare pavement provides no material to manipulate. True power level unknown due to prior enhancement. Effectiveness diminishes in areas lacking road infrastructure.

Additional Notes:
Best suited for urban or highway environments with abundant painted lines. True baseline strength untested, limiting combat potential assessment. Primarily a tactical tool for restraint and object manipulation.

cardPool.title: Whole-Body Lens
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Whole-Body Lens

Description:
The user's body functions as a living camera, generating lens-like apertures on their skin to capture images. Photographs print from the user's chest at will with unlimited storage capacity.

Functions/Applications:
Create optical lenses across any body surface for surveillance and reconnaissance. Print physical photographs on demand from stored images. Useful for intelligence gathering and evidence documentation without external equipment.

Limits:
Cannot modify captured images—only reproduce them as-is. Printing consumes stamina and requires chest access. Lenses are vulnerable while active. Cannot capture in complete darkness. Storage has unknown psychological constraints.

Additional Notes:
Best suited for support and intelligence roles. The quirk's true potential lies in information gathering rather than direct combat. Weakness to chest or eye damage may hinder performance.

cardPool.title: Wing
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Wing

Description:
The user sprouts massive black wings, granting the ability to achieve free-form flight at extreme speeds. Originally manifested by a Near High-End Nomu, this Quirk was later obtained by Tomura Shigaraki through Quirk absorption.

Functions/Applications:
The wings enable sustained aerial locomotion and rapid escape across long distances. Users can carry passengers or objects while airborne and reposition tactically in combat.

Limits:
Flight speed depends on the user's physical condition and control. The wings are vulnerable to targeted attacks. Extended maximum-velocity flight causes fatigue. The Quirk grants no enhanced strength or durability beyond mobility.

Additional Notes:
Whether extreme speeds derive solely from Wing or synergize with other Quirks is unclear. Power scales with the user's capabilities and combat experience. Wing serves primarily as a mobility and evasion tool.

cardPool.title: Zero Gravity
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name: Zero Gravity

Description: The user removes gravitational effects by touching solid objects with their fingertips, rendering targets weightless. Contact must be maintained to sustain the effect. After Awakening, the user can generate anti-gravity bubbles at range and spread effects between connected objects.

Functions/Applications: Float objects and opponents up to three tons; disable enemies by removing footing; manipulate environmental objects as weapons; transport allies; increase personal agility; create diversions with levitating decoys; generate repelling shockwaves through bubble compression.

Limits: Activation requires direct hand contact pre-Awakening; prolonged use causes nausea and vomiting; loss of hands means total inability; vulnerable to ranged opponents; Awakened bubbles lack precise control and affect indiscriminately; three-ton weight limit applies pre-Awakening only.

Additional Notes: Training reduces nausea. Awakened form removes weight restrictions and enables remote bubble generation, but control difficulties persist.

cardPool.title: Zombie Virus
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Zombie Virus

Description:
Romero Fujimi releases pinkish gas that temporarily transforms inhalers into zombies with enhanced strength and endurance. Infected victims gain bluish-gray skin, sunken eyes, and an urge to bite uninfected to spread the virus. The user must wear a mask to avoid self-infection.

Functions/Applications:
Creates temporary undead soldiers through viral gas dispersal. Zombified individuals retain fragmented personality, sometimes allowing friendships to override infection instinct. Zombie appearances enable infiltration or escape.

Limits:
The user is not immune to their own virus. Zombification is temporary but reversal mechanics are unclear. Victims with retained personality may resist infection compulsions. The virus spreads only through gas inhalation or bites, not touch alone.

Additional Notes:
Highly contagious but requires proximity for gas dispersal. Zombified individuals maintain some self-awareness, making control unreliable. Requires strategic mask management to prevent self-infection during combat.
