cardPool.title: Masegaki Primary School
cardPool.value:
Name: Masegaki Primary School

Location: An urban educational institution serving gifted but undisciplined young students with powerful supernatural abilities.

Inhabitants: Unruly primary school children with exceptional Quirks led by a smug blond-haired boy. Their stressed teacher Komari Ikoma struggles to maintain order. Remedial course students Bakugo and Todoroki serve as mentors and frequent visitors.

Appearance: A classroom and recreational space transformed by student Quirks into dynamic play environments with ice sculptures, slides, and castles. The grounds host an annual "Summer Cool-Off Five Weenies Festival" celebrating student growth and Shoto's ice-crafting skills. Despite its chaotic reputation, the school has evolved into a place of camaraderie between gifted children and their hero student guides.

cardPool.title: Midoriya Apartment
cardPool.value:
Name: Midoriya Apartment

Location: Urban residential district, five-story danchi complex marked with a large "2", surrounded by similar apartment buildings with power lines overhead.

Inhabitants: A modest family dwelling in a densely populated neighborhood; typical of middle-class urban residents.

Appearance: Cramped but functional interior with a simple dining table, wall-mounted cabinets, and minimal furnishings. Weathered exterior blends with surrounding gray concrete; power lines crisscross the skyline.

cardPool.title: Might Tower
cardPool.value:
Name:
Might Tower

Location:
A towering skyscraper crowned with a massive dual-ringed planet sculpture, rising above the city as a beacon of heroic authority.

Inhabitants:
All Might in both forms, his staff, administrative personnel, Detective Naomasa, and official visitors.

Appearance:
A steel and glass structure featuring a top-floor All Might statue, mechanized rooftop gate for heroic arrivals, the impenetrable Might Gate guarding his personal department, a mid-level cafeteria with expansive windows overlooking the city, and upper-floor meeting rooms for strategy discussions. The tower exudes grandeur and institutional purpose.

cardPool.title: Mt. Agency
cardPool.value:
Name:
Mt. Agency

Location:
A multi-story office building in the urban district with a prominent sign and distinctive twin horn-like structures on its roof, mirroring Mt. Lady's domino mask design.

Inhabitants:
Mt. Lady and her staff of administrative workers, sidekicks, and support personnel managing her hero agency operations.

Appearance:
A modern office structure showing reconstruction marks from accidental demolition damage caused by Mt. Lady's gigantification Quirk. Despite architectural compromises, it's positioned to maximize public visibility and maintain the agency's prominent profile.

cardPool.title: Mustafa Private Middle School
cardPool.value:
Name: Mustafa Academy
Location: A sprawling compound in a temperate urban district, surrounded by stone walls and iron gates with interconnected buildings arranged around a central courtyard.
Inhabitants: Dozens of scholars, instructors, and administrative staff oversee 200+ students aged 11-14. A headmaster governs the institution with specialized teachers and maintenance workers.
Appearance: Classical architecture features arched doorways and columned halls in cream and rust tones. Classrooms occupy upper floors with tall windows. A library, assembly hall, and dormitory annexes are in separate wings. The courtyard contains a fountain, flowering gardens, and stone benches beneath spreading trees.

cardPool.title: Nabu Island
cardPool.value:
Name: Nabu Island

Location: A subtropical island in southern Japan (29°24'N 125°54'E), isolated from the main archipelago. The main settlement sits in the south, with agricultural fields to the east and northwest, subtropical forests covering most terrain, and a smaller neighboring island to the northwest connected by a narrow sea-crossing path.

Inhabitants: Approximately 1,000 residents in a tight-knit community. Few Heroes are stationed here due to remoteness from villain activity; those present handle minor tasks like finding lost items and odd jobs.

Appearance: A peaceful island with sandy beaches featuring beach bars and rocky no-swim zones, a small wind farm with seven turbines, a commercial district with a hospital and school, a working harbor for fishing boats, agricultural fields and a nearby factory, and a northwestern mountain (Mount Shiroyama) crowned with ancient fortress ruins built atop natural caves large enough to shelter the entire population.

cardPool.title: Nabu Middle School
cardPool.value:
Name:
Nabu Middle School

Location:
An unnamed Japanese city in an unremarkable district far from U.A. High School

Inhabitants:
Middle school students, teachers, and faculty; a place for the quirkless or those with lesser-known abilities before elite academy entrance exams

Appearance:
A standard institutional building with typical Japanese school architecture—concrete walls, multiple floors, plain corridors, and modest classrooms. The atmosphere lacks prestige and advanced facilities, with worn furniture and basic training grounds.

cardPool.title: Naruhata
cardPool.value:
Name: Naruhata District

Location: Tokyo metropolitan area; bordered by NR Naruhata Station shopping district to the west and old Higashi Naruhata town to the east

Inhabitants: Sparse residents; delivery workers frequent early mornings; occasional spontaneous villains and vigilantes

Appearance: Aging buildings and forgotten infrastructure; maze-like abandoned roads rarely traveled since the expressway bypass; crumbling residential structures contrasting with the busier shopping district; early morning fog and delivery truck sounds

cardPool.title: Naruhata Disaster Medical Center
cardPool.value:
Name: Naruhata Disaster Medical Center

Location: Urban medical district with large landscaped parking lot

Inhabitants: Hospital staff, physicians, nurses, patients, emergency responders

Appearance: Large white building with blue Japanese and English signage. Brown and beige corridors lead to gray patient rooms with two beds each, separated by curtains. Smoke detectors throughout enforce fire safety protocols.

cardPool.title: Nighteye Agency
cardPool.value:
Name:
Nighteye Agency

Location:
A five-story professional hero office building in Japan serving as headquarters and training facility for Sir Nighteye's hero operation.

Inhabitants:
Sir Nighteye (agency director with Foresight quirk), sidekicks Bubble Girl and Centipeder, U.A. student interns including Izuku Midoriya and Mirio Togata, and support staff.

Appearance:
The building features a large meeting room on the second floor and Sir Nighteye's office decorated with All Might memorabilia and a desk overlooking bookshelves of case files. The agency functions as a strategic operations center for hero work, investigations, and quirk training.

cardPool.title: Okuto Island
cardPool.value:
Name: Okuto Island

Location: A tropical island with expansive sandy shoals and ocean vistas, featuring luxury resorts and vacation lodges.

Inhabitants: Gang Orca, the aquarium director, oversees the island's primary attraction and coordinates with military forces. Resort staff, tourists, and soldiers occupy the island seasonally.

Appearance: The island has pristine beaches with shallow waters, dense tropical vegetation, and a prominent aquarium complex. Military fortifications and containment barriers surround the aquarium, blending vacation destination with wartime stronghold.

cardPool.title: Onomura Pharma Corp.
cardPool.value:
Name:
Onomura Pharma Corp. Kanto R&D Center

Location:
Tokyo, operating as a legitimate pharmaceutical manufacturer with a hidden criminal division

Inhabitants:
Researchers and staff in public areas; Villain Factory operatives, mad scientists, and kidnapped test subjects in the isolated research wing

Appearance:
A nondescript corporate facility with sterile white corridors and standard laboratories. One corner wing is deliberately segregated with restricted, unmarked entrance. Inside: experimental chambers, containment cells, illicit Trigger synthesis equipment, and shadowy figures moving between reinforced doors.

cardPool.title: Otheon
cardPool.value:
Name: Otheon

Location: Southwestern Celtic Sea island, egg-shaped and larger than Ireland; capital city bisected by river and connected by suspension bridge

Inhabitants: Multilingual Europeans influenced by French, Spanish, and Portuguese cultures; wealthy downtown dwellers and tourists contrast with impoverished riverside slum communities plagued by crime and neglect

Appearance: Mountainous terrain with grasslands and forests. Capital features elegant European architecture, four distinctive wavy skyscrapers (Otheon Towers), tree-lined boulevards, and modern transit on prosperous north bank; south bank sprawls with densely packed shacks and deteriorating housing near the airport

cardPool.title: Purple Revolution Agency
cardPool.value:
Name: Purple Revolution Agency

Location: Urban district with palm-lined streets, a sleek contemporary structure overlooking the city.

Inhabitants: Operatives, agents, support staff managing missions, and administrative personnel directing operations.

Appearance: Modern building with clean lines and expansive windows, flanked by tropical palms. Interior includes decontamination facilities, polished corridors, mission-briefing rooms, tactical centers, and administrative offices.

cardPool.title: Pussycats Agency
cardPool.value:
Name: Pussycats Agency

Location: A mountainous region with a pink headquarters building and The Beast's Forest training facility nearby.

Inhabitants: The Wild Wild Pussycats team members at personalized, color-coded desks. Seasonal trainees occupy Beast's Forest cabins.

Appearance: The main agency is a striking pink structure designed as a giant cat's face with a grinning mouth door, round eye windows, and pointed ear roof with paw pad decorations. "Pussycats" lettering adorns the facade. Interior features cat-themed furniture. The Beast's Forest contains dense woodland with rustic cabins, a dining hall, natural hot springs, and dormitory buildings.

cardPool.title: Qing Qing City, China
cardPool.value:
Name: Qing Qing City Hospital

Location: Qing Qing City, China—the birthplace of documented Quirk manifestation.

Inhabitants: Medical staff, researchers investigating Quirk origins, and occasional pilgrims.

Appearance: A weathered institutional building with sterile white corridors and dim fluorescent lighting. The maternity ward glows faintly where the luminous child was born. Faded plaques document the historic event, and certain rooms retain subtle phosphorescence at night.

cardPool.title: Recovery Girl's Nurse's Office
cardPool.value:
Name: Recovery Girl's Nurse's Office

Location: U.A. High School Campus, with branch offices throughout the school and temporary stations at event venues

Inhabitants: Recovery Girl, school nurse and skilled healer; injured students seeking treatment

Appearance: A clean, clinical room with wooden work desk, computer, medicine drawer, two patient beds, medicinal posters, and consultation chairs. Branch offices maintain similar layouts across campus, with portable tent versions deployed during major events for emergency care.

cardPool.title: Recycle Shop: Hoppers
cardPool.value:
Name: Hoppers Recycle Shop

Location: Naruhata district, with a secondary warehouse on the outskirts (now destroyed)

Inhabitants: The Hotta Brothers—eccentric shop owners with grasshopper-based Quirks who deal in second-hand goods and supplements. Eraser Head uses the shop as a covert investigation base. Local residents and customers browse the aisles.

Appearance: A cluttered recycle shop with a storefront sign featuring two grasshopper emblems. Shelves overflow with second-hand furniture, appliances, and utensils. The interior is cramped and worn with exposed wooden beams and dim fluorescent lighting. Pharmaceutical supplies sit behind the counter. The air smells of dust, old wood, and coffee. The owners are converting a section into a modest cafe to recover from warehouse destruction.

cardPool.title: Ryukyu Agency
cardPool.value:
Name:
Ryukyu Agency

Location:
A sprawling open-plan office in a brown building with dark glass windows and a Dragoir clothing line billboard.

Inhabitants:
Agency staff and clients visiting for representation or fashion matters.

Appearance:
Warm reddish tones with ornate Chinese aesthetic featuring golden dragon columns, guardian lion statues, and decorative elements. Office tables, shelving units between columns, and a plasma TV displaying news occupy the spacious layout.

cardPool.title: Salty Banks Middle School
cardPool.value:
Name: Salty Banks Middle School
Location: A sprawling academic compound on the outskirts of a coastal town, bordered by salt marshes and accessible via a tree-lined drive.
Inhabitants: Hundreds of students aged 11-14, teachers, administrative staff, custodial workers, and occasional visitors and parents.
Appearance: A cluster of single-story brick and concrete buildings arranged around courtyards with wide corridors, lockers, fluorescent-lit classrooms, a cafeteria, gymnasium with bleachers, athletic fields, a small library, and playground equipment near the marsh's edge.

cardPool.title: Seiai Academy
cardPool.value:
Name: Seiai Academy

Location: High school campus in a major metropolitan area serving as a training ground for aspiring Heroes during the Provisional Hero License Exam.

Inhabitants: Ambitious students training to become Heroes, led by calculating Saiko Intelli and her strategically-minded cohort. Faculty overseeing Hero development and exam administration. Currently rivals with U.A. High School Class 1-A.

Appearance: A structured academic institution with training facilities for Quirk development and combat scenarios. Classrooms and halls reflect a competitive, militaristic atmosphere with examination arenas where students demonstrate Hero potential through tactical combat.

cardPool.title: Seijin High School
cardPool.value:
Name: Seijin High School

Location: Industrial area near Takoba National Stadium, a hero training institution in an urban industrial district

Inhabitants: Ten unnamed students with diverse combat Quirks including Gigantification, Landslide, Torrent, and Bulk; staff and instructors

Appearance: A modern academic facility with training grounds equipped for combat simulation and Quirk practice. The grounds contain open areas for large-scale tactical exercises and access to an industrial landscape suitable for hero license examinations.

cardPool.title: Sekoto Peak
cardPool.value:
Name:
Sekoto Peak

Location:
A remote mountain training ground visible from the city. Once a natural landscape, it is now largely barren and blackened from a catastrophic wildfire. A stream runs nearby.

Inhabitants:
Rarely visited now. Once frequented by skilled fire-wielders seeking solitude for Quirk training. Occasional adventurers explore the ruins searching for artifacts or answers about the conflagration.

Appearance:
A desolate, ash-covered mountain with exposed charred rock and skeletal vegetation. The air shimmers with residual heat and the ground is cracked and blackened. A cold stream cuts through the burned landscape, one of the few sources of water and life remaining.

cardPool.title: Shie Hassaikai Compound
cardPool.value:
Name:
Shie Hassaikai Compound

Location:
A fortified yakuza stronghold disguised as traditional Japanese office buildings, gated with a tree-filled courtyard. The structure conceals a vast underground labyrinth beneath the surface.

Inhabitants:
Members of the Eight Precepts of Death yakuza organization, including leadership, soldiers, and support staff in both surface offices and hidden underground chambers.

Appearance:
An elegant Japanese residence with refined architecture and formal entrance. The first floor mimics a standard Japanese office with tatami and wooden furnishings. A concealed switch beneath a vase reveals stone stairs descending into a sprawling underground maze of passages, meeting rooms, and an infirmary designed for covert movement and escape routes.

cardPool.title: Sports Festival Stadium
cardPool.value:
Name: Sports Festival Stadium

Location: Urban arena district; oval-shaped open-air structure with three-tiered stands, multiple entry gates, and staff facilities.

Inhabitants: Tournament judges, medical staff, security Pro Heroes (Mt. Lady, Death Arms, Kamui Woods), competing athletes, spectators, and Cementoss who constructs the arena platform.

Appearance: A massive concrete and grass arena with tiered seating overlooking a central circular field. The competition floor features a flat concrete square surrounded by grass with multiple gates. During tournaments, a concrete platform rises in the center, ringed by torches and topped by a judge's throne. Large screens display action to spectators. Beneath the stands lie medical offices, participant waiting rooms, and staff break areas.

cardPool.title: Symbol of Paradise
cardPool.value:
Name: Symbol of Paradise

Location: A massive transmuted fortress hovering over Japan, created from Dark Might's flying yacht through alchemical modification. Multiple biomes connected by corridors and tunnels with spatial transportation and self-repair capabilities.

Inhabitants: Dark Might the alchemist tyrant, the Gollini Family, brainwashed henchmen, kidnapped Japanese civilians being converted into weapons, and various hostile forces.

Appearance: A sprawling megastructure divided into five zones: a deceptive jungle with illusory walls, an amusement park with Ferris wheel and haunted mansion, a European walled city with an All Might statue, a snowy mountain region with concealed lake and forest, and a coastal beach area with cliff walls. Hidden doors, trapdoors, and pitfalls throughout provide Dark Might's protection. Self-healing properties allow rapid reconstruction after damage. The environment is a shifting labyrinth of hazards and chokepoints.

cardPool.title: Takoba Municipal Beach Park
cardPool.value:
Name:
Takoba Municipal Beach Park

Location:
A coastal beach with a wooden pier extending into the water and a small gazebo pavilion. Recently restored and cleared of sea debris.

Inhabitants:
All Might trains worthy students here in secret. Young heroes and civilians visit as it has become a popular dating destination.

Appearance:
Sandy shores stretch beneath open sky, cleared of trash. The weathered pier and gazebo stand as focal points. The beach carries the scent of salt water and renewal, contrasting its reclaimed state with memories of ruin. Gentle waves lap the shore while the open expanse invites training and reflection.

cardPool.title: Takoba National Stadium
cardPool.value:
Name: Takoba National Stadium

Location: A massive modern arena facility designed for large-scale hero training exams and combat scenarios, holding over one thousand participants simultaneously.

Inhabitants: Hero students undergoing licensing exams, exam organizers and judges, professional stuntmen acting as disaster victims, occasional heroes deployed during conflicts.

Appearance: A sprawling complex featuring multiple destructible environmental zones including forests, urban cityscapes, highway bridges, mountain terrain, and industrial sections. Foldable briefing and rest chambers open during exam phases. During second-phase exams, explosives simulate disasters, reducing environments to rubble for rescue training.

cardPool.title: Tatooin Station
cardPool.value:
Name:
Tatooin Station

Location:
A bullet train station on an overpass crossing a major street in an urban district, adjacent to the Tatooin Shopping District. Features billboards and screens displaying hero advertisements.

Inhabitants:
Currently abandoned due to the Final War with all residents evacuated. Pro Heroes occasionally respond to incidents in the area.

Appearance:
Significant battle damage from villain encounters—crumbling structures, collapsed sections, and debris litter the platforms. Abandoned trains sit dormant at loading areas while flickering screens cast eerie light across the overpass. The shopping district below features alleys where dangerous confrontations have occurred, creating a contrast of commercial signage against urban decay.

cardPool.title: Teachers Lounge
cardPool.value:
Name: Teachers Lounge

Location: Unforeseen Simulation Joint, administrative wing

Inhabitants: School faculty and staff; occasionally All Might when recovering from Quirk usage

Appearance: A modest rest chamber with gray tile floors and tan walls. Two sofas flank a low coffee table, with a coffee machine in the corner. Simple, functional furnishings for brief respites between duties.

cardPool.title: Terakoya
cardPool.value:
Name: Terakoya
Location: Oku Island, a remote private hero academy among coastal ruins and ancient stone structures
Inhabitants: Ikkaku and dozens of rowdy students training to become heroes, overseen by a patient teacher; occasional grave robbers and treasure hunters
Appearance: A modest schoolhouse with weathered wooden buildings where students practice their Quirks, surrounded by dense vegetation and crumbling stone ruins with concealed trap systems in underground passages

cardPool.title: The Beast's Forest
cardPool.value:
Name: Beast's Forest

Location: Dense woodland adjacent to a mountain range, home to the Wild Wild Pussycats' training headquarters

Inhabitants: Wild Wild Pussycats, student trainees, Earth Flow monsters, League of Villains operatives

Appearance: Towering trees form an impenetrable canopy with scorched clearings and gas-poisoned areas. The forest contains the Pussycats' hidden office building with adjoining cabins, dining hall, hot springs, and dormitories. Rocky terrain and varying elevations create natural obstacles. Patches of charred wood and withered vegetation mark past destruction.

cardPool.title: Todoroki Abode
cardPool.value:
Name: Todoroki Abode
Location: A traditional Japanese estate in a quiet residential district, accessible by stone pathways with maintained gardens.
Inhabitants: The prestigious Todoroki family—warriors and mages including Enji and his elemental-powered children, along with household servants.
Appearance: Classic Japanese architecture with shoji doors, paper screens, and tatami mats. A central garden courtyard provides light and tranquility. Dark timber frames contrast white plaster walls beneath a traditional sloped tile roof. Exterior walkways offer scenic views of manicured grounds, creating elegance and strategic defensibility.

cardPool.title: Tokyo Sky Egg
cardPool.value:
Name: Tokyo Sky Egg

Location: Tokyo, a massive dome-shaped auditorium tower in the heart of the city

Inhabitants: Thousands of spectators during events, security personnel, venue staff, and occasional heroes responding to threats

Appearance: A colossal domed structure with seating for 50,000, featuring reinforced security systems, emergency staircases, and automated elevator shutdowns. The grand modern interior is designed for large-scale shows. Emergency lighting and structural supports are visible. Bears scars from a catastrophic attack—nearly destroyed but saved from collapse, with visible damage and ongoing repairs.

cardPool.title: Unforeseen Simulation Joint
cardPool.value:
Name: Unforeseen Simulation Joint

Location: A specialized training facility dome situated within hero academy grounds, divided into eight main sections.

Inhabitants: Pro Hero Thirteen (facility designer and instructor), Class 1-A students, security personnel, and minor villains during scenarios.

Appearance: A dome structure with eight interconnected sections simulating disaster scenarios including urban collapse, flooding, and fire. Advanced sensor arrays line the walls. The interior features varied terrain and hazard conditions that shift between training modes, from flooded areas to unstable rubble fields.

cardPool.title: Uraraka Apartment
cardPool.value:
Name:
Uraraka Apartment

Location:
A modest white three-story residential building in an urban neighborhood with open hallways on each level.

Inhabitants:
Working-class residents occupying small private units.

Appearance:
A compact, utilitarian structure with minimalist design. Each apartment contains essential furniture and fixtures. The white exterior shows practical wear; open hallways allow sounds and light to carry between units.

cardPool.title: Verize Islands
cardPool.value:
Name: Verize Islands

Location: A sprawling archipelago of dozens of islands, rocky islets, and sea stacks scattered across treacherous waters. Maze-like geography with countless coves and hidden passages ideal for concealment.

Inhabitants: An established settlement on the largest island supported by trade and maritime activity. Smugglers and traders operate throughout hidden anchorages.

Appearance: Wind-carved rocky terrain with dense coastal vegetation clinging to cliff faces. A functioning airfield marks the main settlement. Secluded harbors, underwater reefs, weathered driftwood, and constant crashing waves characterize the harsh seascape.

cardPool.title: Class 1-A
cardPool.value:
Name: Class 1-A Homeroom
Location: U.A. High School, Hero Course Wing
Inhabitants: Twenty elite hero students including Izuku Midoriya, Katsuki Bakugo, Shoto Todoroki, and Ochaco Uraraka, taught by Pro Heroes. Forged through villain attacks and internships, they share unbreakable loyalty.
Appearance: A Japanese classroom transformed into a nexus of heroic potential. Desks bear marks of passionate students. Walls display evidence of victories and hardships. The space radiates the energy of young heroes who survived impossible odds together.

cardPool.title: Endeavor Agency
cardPool.value:
Name: Endeavor's Hero Agency

Location: Luxurious skyscraper in a major metropolitan city with satellite operations in Hosu City and beyond.

Inhabitants: Over thirty sidekicks called the "Flaming Sidekickers" (including Burnin), most with fire and heat-type Quirks. Endeavor, the No. 1 Pro Hero, commands from his sparse personal office. Interns and visiting heroes rotate through constantly.

Appearance: A gleaming high-rise with a stylized flaming "E" at the entrance. The main floor features an open office with multiple desks, computers, and request boards. Endeavor's cavernous, minimalist personal office contains a large desk and small table. The building hums with constant activity—patrols depart hourly and sidekicks manage hero requests around the clock.

cardPool.title: P.E. Grounds
cardPool.value:
Name: P.E. Grounds

Location: U.A. High School campus, outdoor training facility with specialized test zones

Inhabitants: Robotic proctors, student athletes, instructors like Shota Aizawa

Appearance: Multiple athletic areas including a 50-meter running track, sand-filled long jump pit, and pitching circle. Each zone has a robotic proctor with measurement systems. Open-air and well-maintained, designed for Quirk usage during physical assessments.

cardPool.title: Principal's Office
cardPool.value:
Name: Principal's Office

Location: U.A. High School, administrative wing

Inhabitants: Nezu (Principal), faculty including All Might and Aizawa, parents and officials

Appearance: Professional executive space with blue-gray floors and gray walls. Large back window overlooks campus. Massive wooden desk with custom swivel chair, file cabinets, and two black sofas with coffee table. The administrative heart of U.A. where critical decisions are made.

cardPool.title: Marvelous Central University
cardPool.value:
Name: Marvelous Central University

Location: A sprawling academic institution in a major metropolitan district, accessible by grand stone archways and tree-lined boulevards.

Inhabitants: Scholars, mages, clerics, and students; aged professors, ambitious apprentices, library keepers, and administrative officials.

Appearance: Gothic and classical architecture with towering spires, domed libraries, and interconnected stone buildings adorned with arcane symbols. Courtyards feature fountains and bronze statues; interior halls glow with enchanted lanterns and contain endless shelves of leather-bound tomes, lecture halls, and study chambers.

cardPool.title: Villain Factory
cardPool.value:
[Villain Factory]

Type: Criminal Organization

The Villain Factory is an underground organization conducting illegal Quirk-based experiments. Responsible for creating Instant Villains and Next-Level Villains, it poses a major threat in the Naruhata area.

The Police Force named it "Villain Factory" due to its mass production of artificial villains and experimental subjects.

True leaders are All For One and Dr. Kyudai Garaki. Their goal is creating a perfect being — a weapon to rival or surpass All Might.

Using advanced Quirk manipulation, biological experimentation, and human testing, the organization operates in secrecy while expanding influence throughout the criminal underworld.

cardPool.title: Shie Hassaikai
cardPool.value:
[Shie Hassaikai]

Type: Yakuza Organization

The Shie Hassaikai is a former Yakuza organization that operated within Japan's criminal underworld. Originally led by The Boss, the group followed traditional Yakuza values of loyalty, discipline, and honor.

The Boss raised Kai Chisaki, who became known as Overhaul. Unlike the older generation, Chisaki sought to restore the Yakuza's power through ruthless methods and dangerous experimentation.

During All Might's rise and the growing influence of Pro Heroes, the Yakuza lost much authority. The Shie Hassaikai was forced into the shadows and placed under constant surveillance.

Under Overhaul's leadership, the organization became feared for its brutality, secrecy, and ambition to reclaim dominance over the criminal world.

cardPool.title: Paranormal Liberation Front
cardPool.value:
[Paranormal Liberation Front]

Type: Villain Organization

The Paranormal Liberation Front is a massive villain faction created through the merger of the League of Villains and the Meta Liberation Army. Led by Grand Commander Tomura Shigaraki, it aims to destroy hero society and create a world of absolute freedom and power.

The organization is divided into color-coded regiments, each commanded by a Lieutenant. Three elite Advisers support each Lieutenant, overseeing operations and spreading the organization's influence nationwide.

With immense manpower, resources, and military structure, the Paranormal Liberation Front is one of Japan's most dangerous villain organizations.

cardPool.title: Octo-Lover's Brigade
cardPool.value:
[Octo-Lover's Brigade]

Type: Animal Rights Organization

The Octo-Lover's Brigade is an animal rights group from Osaka that campaigns against the capture and consumption of octopuses, believing them to be intelligent creatures deserving protection.

Members typically have sea-creature-like appearances and mutations, including fish, mollusk, cephalopod, and aquatic traits.

All members wear dark cloth accessories marked with white spots resembling octopus suckers as the organization's identifying symbol.

While many engage in peaceful activism, extremist factions resort to intimidation, sabotage, and violence to enforce their beliefs.

The organization has gained a controversial reputation throughout Japan due to these radical elements.

cardPool.title: Meta Liberation Army
cardPool.value:
[Meta Liberation Army]

Type: Villain Organization

The Meta Liberation Army, shortened to M.L.A., is a large villain organization built around the belief that unrestricted Quirk usage is a fundamental human right.

Founded by the infamous Destro, the M.L.A. sought to free society from laws restricting Quirk usage. His ideology inspired countless followers and a powerful liberation movement.

Years later, Destro's descendant Re-Destro revived the organization, rebuilding it into a massive, well-organized force with political, financial, and military influence across Japan.

Unlike many villain groups driven by chaos, the M.L.A. focuses on achieving total liberation through ideology, propaganda, and overwhelming power.

Following conflict with the League of Villains, the Meta Liberation Army merged with them to create the Paranormal Liberation Front under Tomura Shigaraki's leadership.

cardPool.title: League of Villains
cardPool.value:
[League of Villains]

Type: Villain Organization

The League of Villains was a notorious criminal organization of powerful villains united by hatred of hero society. Originally founded by All For One, it was groomed under Tomura Shigaraki's leadership into one of Japan's greatest threats.

Unlike traditional criminal organizations, the League sought the complete collapse of the hero system and society built around it. It attracted criminals, outcasts, and extremists with dangerous Quirks and deep resentment toward heroes.

Following the Revival Celebration, the League merged with the Meta Liberation Army to form the Paranormal Liberation Front under Shigaraki's command.

cardPool.title: K3 Gang
cardPool.value:
[K3 Gang]

Type: Villain Group

The K3 Gang is a small villain group of three young men who idolize famous criminals and anti-heroes like Stain. They attempt to imitate these figures through reckless acts of intimidation and public disturbance.

The group terrorizes residents in snowy mountain regions on snowmobiles. All members share a punk-inspired appearance and travel together as a unit.

Despite calling themselves villains, the K3 Gang is inexperienced and lacks power or influence. Their actions consist mainly of harassment, vandalism, and public chaos rather than serious destruction.

The members chase the image of feared villains in hopes of gaining recognition and respect.

cardPool.title: Gollini Family
cardPool.value:
[Gollini Family]

Type: Mafia Crime Family

The Gollini Family is a powerful European mafia organization led by ruthless Valdo Gollini. The family established itself as one of the most feared criminal syndicates in the region.

The original leader valued honor and loyalty, but was murdered by his own son, Valdo Gollini, who seized control.

Under Valdo's leadership, the family transformed into a brutal and ambitious organization. Through violence and intimidation, it expanded its influence across Europe while evading Heroes and law enforcement.

The Gollini Family became infamous for its wealth, secrecy, and deadly reputation within the criminal underworld.

cardPool.title: Creature Rejection Clan
cardPool.value:
[Creature Rejection Clan (CRC)]

Type: Extremist Religious Organization

The Creature Rejection Clan is a villainous cult-like organization driven by extreme ideology and religious fervor. Members wear signature skull-shaped masks that conceal identities and reinforce collective doctrine.

The CRC rejects individuals with physical "abnormalities," particularly those with Mutant-type Quirks. Despite modern superpowered society's stabilization, the group upholds deep prejudice and exclusionary beliefs.

Originally a protest movement, the organization became increasingly radical, escalating from public demonstrations to violence and targeted attacks. This extremist shift damaged their reputation and public support significantly.

The CRC lost much influence and membership, fragmenting into scattered cells that operate independently in secrecy.

cardPool.title: Avant-Garders
cardPool.value:
[The Avant-Garders]

Type: Artistic Extremist Group

The Avant-Garders is a small villainous group of three young men who identify as artists. Each embodies a different artistic persona and possesses Quirk abilities related to artistic expression.

The group follows a radical philosophy viewing explosions as the highest form of art, believing beauty lies in the moment of destruction. This defines their creative worldview.

They target art installations, studios, and creative works, destroying them explosively to "complete" the artwork. They view themselves as artists rather than criminals and are fascinated by explosion-based Quirks, considering them the purest medium of artistic expression.

cardPool.title: Abegawa Tenchu Kai
cardPool.value:
[Abegawa Tenchu Kai]

Type: Former Yakuza Organization

The Abegawa Tenchu Kai was a Yakuza syndicate operating in the criminal underworld until law enforcement classified it as a villain organization. This designation weakened its structure significantly.

The vigilante Stendhal launched an assault on the organization's headquarters, killing all high-ranking executives in direct combat. With its leadership destroyed and operations disrupted, the organization collapsed, ending the Abegawa Tenchu Kai as a functioning criminal group.

cardPool.title: Mad Hatters
cardPool.value:
[The Mad Hatters]

Type: Rock Music Group

The Mad Hatters is a four-member rock band based in Naruhata, Tokyo. Originally formed by young musicians, they developed a shared identity and built a reputation for strong musical talent and energetic performances. They performed at the Marukane Department Store Live Event and are recognized for their skill and stage presence. The band is still emerging, steadily building their reputation within the local music scene.

cardPool.title: World Heroes Association
cardPool.value:
[World Heroes Association]

Type: International Hero Governing Body

The World Heroes Association is a global organization overseeing Hero activity across multiple nations. It coordinates cross-border missions, facilitates cooperation between Hero agencies, and responds to large-scale threats requiring global coordination.

The organization's primary role is organizing international operations and deploying Pro Heroes to assist nations in crisis. However, uneven distribution of Hero forces worldwide creates regional imbalances in crime rates, which remains an ongoing challenge the Association seeks to address.

cardPool.title: Police Force
cardPool.value:
[Police Force]

Type: Law Enforcement Organization

The Police Force is the official law-enforcing body responsible for maintaining public order and handling criminal activity. They arrest, detain, and process subdued Villains.

In the early days of Quirks, the Police Force avoided recruiting officers with Quirks due to concerns about misuse. This gap led to the rise of Pro Heroes, who became licensed Quirk users fighting crime under strict regulations.

Today, the Police Force coordinates with Heroes but focuses on non-Quirk crimes and lower-level offenses. Heroes must transfer ordinary criminals to police custody.

The Police Force handles interrogation, investigation, and incarceration of suspects and captured Villains, ensuring due process within the legal system.

cardPool.title: Hero Public Safety Commission
cardPool.value:
[Hero Public Safety Commission]

Type: Government Law Enforcement Agency

The Hero Public Safety Commission is a national authority responsible for regulating Heroes and overseeing their role within society. It manages the relationship between Pro Heroes and the public, ensuring Hero activity remains lawful and effective.

The Commission is led by non-Hero officials to maintain balance and prevent excessive Hero influence over civilian governance. It handles high-level criminal investigations involving serious threats.

Key responsibilities include administering the Provisional Hero License Exam twice yearly in June and September. Those who pass receive official Hero licenses to legally perform Hero duties.

The Commission coordinates with the Police Force on operations, team assignments, and emergencies requiring cooperation between law enforcement and Heroes.

cardPool.title: Feathers
cardPool.value:
[Feathers]

Type: Underground Idol Duo

Feathers is a twin-based underground idol duo composed of sisters Miu and Yu. They perform together under a shared stage identity, building their reputation through synchronized performances and strong stage presence.

They were invited to perform at the Marukane Department Store Live Event, marking a notable public appearance that gave them wider exposure beyond the underground circuit.

Known for their chemistry as twins and coordinated performance style, Feathers have steadily grown their fanbase in smaller venues and events.

cardPool.title: FeatherHATS
cardPool.value:
Type: Music Band

FeatherHATS is a music group formed by Makoto Tsukauchi and sponsored by the Marukane Department Store. The band showcases young musical talents from Naruhata, introducing emerging artists to wider audiences through organized events and promotional stages.

Known for its collaborative structure, FeatherHATS blends different musical styles while maintaining a cohesive, youthful performance identity.

cardPool.title: East Naruhata High Dance Squad
cardPool.value:
[East Naruhata High Dance Squad]

Type: School Dance Group

The East Naruhata High Dance Squad is a four-member dance team from East Naruhata High School. They represent the school at public performances and local events with coordinated choreography and youthful energy.

They performed at the Marukane Department Store Live Event, one of their most notable appearances outside school activities.

Leadership is informal, with the "president" role given to the member with the strongest stage presence. The squad focuses on synchronization, expression, and improving their skills through live events and competitions.

cardPool.title: Kanidoge
cardPool.value:
[Kanidoge]

Type: Food Distribution Company

Kanidoge is an Osaka-based corporation specializing in crab import and distribution across Japan. It supplies fresh seafood and processed crab products to markets and businesses nationwide.

The company is notable for its crab-shaped mechanical units designed to transport and handle goods while serving as mobile advertising displays for the brand.

cardPool.title: Help Us Company
cardPool.value:
[H.U.C. (Help Us Company)]

Type: Training & Simulation Organization

The Help Us Company, abbreviated as H.U.C., specializes in rescue and disaster-response training simulations. Members act as realistic "victims" in controlled scenarios, allowing Heroes and trainees to practice rescue operations.

H.U.C. fulfills the high demand for realistic training by staging scenarios that replicate disasters, accidents, and villain attacks. Members simulate panic, injuries, and crisis conditions while evaluating rescue techniques and providing feedback on response effectiveness and safety.

Through their work, H.U.C. improves Hero training standards and emergency response effectiveness across society.

cardPool.title: Heroes
cardPool.value:
[Heroes / Pro Heroes]

Type: Licensed Quirk Users / Public Protectors

Heroes are individuals legally authorized to use their Quirks to protect civilians from danger. Those pursuing heroism professionally are Pro Heroes.

In Japan, Heroes are regulated by the Hero Public Safety Commission. International oversight is handled by the World Heroes Association. Most Heroes operate through Hero Agencies, which organize missions, training, and public safety operations.

Hero work centers on three core responsibilities: rescue, evacuation, and combat. Agencies may specialize in one area or handle all three roles.

Heroes are widely respected and often operate under public visibility, with civilians witnessing and supporting their battles against Villains.

cardPool.title: Villains
cardPool.value:
[Villains]

Type: Criminal Individuals / Organizations

Villains are individuals who use their Quirks to commit crimes, cause destruction, and endanger innocent lives. They exist as thieves, murderers, extremist groups, and terrorist organizations.

Crime rates remain relatively low due to Pro Hero presence, but Villains persist as a threat. Motivations vary widely: economic hardship, political ideology, social rejection, or personal tragedy. Quirks enable complex and dangerous criminal activity.

Some become Villains after trauma, rejecting societal norms. While some operate alone, others form organized groups with clear hierarchies.

All Villains share one trait: illegal Quirk activity that endangers society.

cardPool.title: Vigilantes
cardPool.value:
[Vigilantes]

Type: Unauthorized Quirk Users / Civilian Protectors

Vigilantes are individuals who carry out Hero-like activities without legal authorization, operating independently of Hero agencies and law enforcement. Due to strict Hero licensing laws, such actions are illegal.

Although unlawful, Vigilantes exist in a moral gray area. When Pro Heroes are unavailable, their intervention can save lives. They may cooperate with Heroes during emergencies.

This dual nature creates debate within law enforcement on whether Vigilantes should be punished as criminals or treated as unofficial assets during crises. They remain controversial, balancing public necessity against legal violation.

cardPool.title: Sidekicks
cardPool.value:
[Sidekicks]

Type: Hero Agency Support Staff

Sidekicks are licensed Hero assistants who work under a Pro Hero's supervision at a Hero Agency. They provide operational support during missions and emergencies, acting as backup for coordination, logistics, and on-site response while the Pro Hero serves as the primary field operative.

Agency heads hire Sidekicks based on experience, skills, or Quirk utility. Team sizes vary widely, and some Pro Heroes operate without Sidekicks. Unlicensed Vigilantes may be recruited as Sidekicks, offering a legal pathway into Hero society.

cardPool.title: Todoroki Family
cardPool.value:
[Todoroki Family]

Type: Family

The Todoroki Family is a prominent Hero family consisting of Enji Todoroki (Endeavor), his wife Rei, and their four children: Toya, Fuyumi, Natsuo, and Shoto. Enji is a top-ranked Pro Hero known for his exceptional combat ability. Each child carries the Todoroki legacy with distinct paths shaped by their complex family history and connection to Hero society.

cardPool.title: Shimura Family
cardPool.value:
[Shimura Family]

Type: Family

The Shimura Family was the birth family of Tomura Shigaraki before he became a Villain. They were an ordinary household whose history became tied to the origins of one of society's most dangerous criminals. The family is notably connected to Nana Shimura, a former Pro Hero whose lineage indirectly influenced events involving Tomura Shigaraki. Very little is known about them.

cardPool.title: Ida Family
cardPool.value:
[Ida Family]

Type: Hero Family Lineage

The Ida Family is a prestigious hero family with generations of Pro Heroes building a reputation rooted in discipline, responsibility, and service to society.

Most members possess the Engine Quirk, characterized by engine-like exhaust pipes granting enhanced speed and mobility. This defines the family lineage, particularly associated with Tenya Ida.

Tenya's grandfather developed a unique training method to enhance the Engine Quirk's performance. The process involves removing exhaust organs through intense means, followed by rigorous training. Over time, stronger engine components regrow, resulting in improved speed and endurance.

Through this tradition, the Ida Family has maintained and refined their Quirk abilities, passing down both their hero legacy and specialized training methods.

cardPool.title: Wild, Wild Pussycats
cardPool.value:
========================================
STORYCARD — WILD WILD PUSSYCATS
========================================

[OVERVIEW]
The Wild, Wild Pussycats are a professional Hero team specializing in rescue operations, wilderness survival, and disaster response. Known for strong coordination and field-based Hero work, they consist of Mandalay (strategic leader), Pixie-Bob (terrain manipulation), Ragdoll (sensory tracking), and Tiger (close-combat specialist).

Members:
- Shino Sosaki (Mandalay)
- Ryuko Tsuchikawa (Pixie-Bob)
- Tomoko (Ragdoll)
- Tiger

----------------------------------------

[ROLE IN HERO SOCIETY]
The Pussycats prioritize survival training, evacuation strategy, and environmental adaptability rather than urban combat. They assist U.A. student development, preparing students for real-world disaster scenarios. Ragdoll's Quirk enables simultaneous tracking of multiple individuals, making the team highly effective in rescue operations and locating missing persons across large territories.

cardPool.title: Kota Izumi
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Kota Izumi

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Water Control

Occupation/Role: UA High School Hero Course Student, Class 1-A

Personality: Initially withdrawn and cynical after his parents' deaths, Kota was cold toward heroes. After being rescued by Izuku Midoriya, he slowly opened to others, though remains somewhat indifferent and prideful. He is principled and punishes rule-breakers without hesitation.

Appearance: A short boy with spiky black hair, roughly Mineta's height. He wears a short-sleeved collared shirt with dark shorts and a red cap with golden spike-shaped horns. His hero costume features a dark green vest with gray helmet matching his parents' design, complete with large spike horns. He wears red high-top sneakers.

Backstory: Son of pro hero team Water Hose, both deceased. Raised by his aunt Shino Sosaki of the Wild Wild Pussycats, Kota initially despised heroes, believing they abandoned him. Being rescued by Izuku Midoriya from villain Muscular proved transformative, allowing him to understand his parents' noble sacrifice and that heroes prioritize others' lives.

cardPool.title: Arc 1
cardPool.value:
========================================
ARC 1 — U.A. ENTRANCE EXAM
========================================

Izuku Midoriya arrives at U.A. for the Hero Course entrance exam. Candidates enter a simulated city and earn points by destroying combat robots, with bonus rescue points for saving others.

Unable to safely use One For All, Izuku notices Uraraka trapped under falling debris. He abandons point pursuit to save her, destroying a zero-point robot to prevent her death and earning rescue points.

Despite a low combat score, Izuku is accepted based on his rescue performance. Bakugo is accepted as a top scorer. Class 1-A is formed.

cardPool.title: Arc 2
cardPool.value:
========================================
ARC 2 — QUIRK APPREHENSION TEST
========================================

Class 1-A undergoes Aizawa's Quirk Apprehension Test on their first day, including sprinting, grip strength, ball throw, endurance, and agility measurements. Aizawa threatens expulsion for the lowest performer to pressure the class.

Izuku breaks his fingers controlling One For All during the ball throw. Uraraka's zero-gravity sends her ball out of range. Bakugo dominates through explosive mobility.

Students are ranked by Quirk efficiency and output. Aizawa later reveals the expulsion threat was a bluff to test their performance under pressure.

cardPool.title: Arc 3
cardPool.value:
========================================
ARC 3 — U.S.J. INCIDENT
========================================

Class 1-A arrives at U.S.J. for rescue training. Kurogiri opens a warp gate, scattering students across disaster simulation zones.

Shigaraki targets Aizawa and Izuku while villains coordinate attacks. A Nomu is deployed to kill All Might.

All Might arrives and defeats the Nomu in combat, forcing villains to retreat. The attack reveals organized villain coordination against Hero society.

cardPool.title: Arc 4
cardPool.value:
========================================
ARC 4 — U.A. SPORTS FESTIVAL
========================================

U.A. hosts a national sports festival broadcast across Japan. Students compete in obstacle races, cavalry battles, and elimination tournaments.

Izuku modifies One For All usage to avoid breaking his body. Todoroki refuses to use his fire Quirk due to family conflict. Bakugo advances through brute force and aggression.

During final rounds, Todoroki uses his fire against Izuku after emotional confrontation about his past. Bakugo defeats Todoroki in the final match.

Bakugo is declared overall winner. Hero agencies recruit students for internships based on performance exposure.

cardPool.title: Arc 5
cardPool.value:
========================================
ARC 5 — HERO INTERNSHIPS & STAIN INCIDENT
========================================

Students begin internships at Hero agencies. Izuku trains under Gran Torino learning advanced movement control. Iida joins Ingenium's agency.

In Hosu City, Stain attacks Pro Heroes targeting those he deems unworthy. His Quirk allows paralysis through blood ingestion.

Nomu activity occurs simultaneously. Iida confronts Stain alone and is paralyzed. Izuku and Todoroki intervene in overlapping combat.

Endeavor defeats a Nomu while Stain is subdued after combined efforts and arrested. His ideology spreads among Villain groups, destabilizing Hero perception.

cardPool.title: Arc 6
cardPool.value:
ARC 6 — FOREST TRAINING CAMP ARC
========================================

Class 1-A trains in wilderness survival and Quirk control at a remote camp.

The League of Villains Vanguard Action Squad attacks the facility.

Students scatter across forest terrain in survival situations.

Bakugo is captured during the chaos.

Multiple students sustain injuries during escape and regrouping.

Villains withdraw after capturing Bakugo.

cardPool.title: Arc 7
cardPool.value:
ARC 7 — KAMINO INCIDENT
========================================

League of Villains holds Bakugo in Kamino Ward. Hero intelligence locates the hideout and launches a rescue operation with multiple Pro Heroes. All Might confronts All For One during the raid. A large-scale battle erupts across Kamino Ward. All Might defeats All For One in his weakened state using his remaining power. Bakugo is rescued. All For One is critically injured and retreats. All Might's final Hero form is revealed, ending his era as Symbol of Peace.

cardPool.title: Arc 9
cardPool.value:
========================================
ARC 9 — SHIE HASSAIKAI RAID ARC
========================================

Hero teams investigate Shie Hassaikai operations.

Eri identified as source of Quirk-erasing bullets.

Underground raid begins.

Mirio fights Overhaul alone and loses his Quirk to a bullet.

Izuku reaches Eri and defeats Overhaul.

Eri rescued and placed under Hero protection.

cardPool.title: Arc 11
cardPool.value:
========================================
ARC 11 — META LIBERATION ARMY ARC
========================================

League of Villains enters Deika City and engages the Meta Liberation Army.

Twice is killed in early battle.

Shigaraki fights Re-Destro across the collapsing city.

Shigaraki's Quirk fully awakens, destroying large areas.

Re-Destro is defeated.

MLA submits to Shigaraki.

Paranormal Liberation Front is formed.

cardPool.title: Arc 12
cardPool.value:
========================================
ARC 12 — WAR PREPARATION ARC
========================================

Hero Commission confirms PLF as nationwide threat.

Heroes assemble multi-agency strike teams.

U.A. students receive operational briefing.

Shigaraki undergoes stabilization procedure under AFO influence.

Both sides prepare for large-scale operations.

Hero forces deploy across multiple targets.

cardPool.title: Arc 13
cardPool.value:
========================================
ARC 13 — PARANORMAL LIBERATION WAR
========================================

Heroes attack Jaku Hospital and Gunga Mountain.

High-End Nomu engage Hero teams.

Shigaraki awakens and begins massive destruction.

Dabi reveals identity as Toya Todoroki.

Twice is killed, collapsing Villain coordination.

Gigantomachia advances across Japan.

Shigaraki expands decay across battlefield zones.

Heroes begin evacuation and containment operations nationwide.

cardPool.title: Arc 14
cardPool.value:
ARC 14 — DARK HERO ARC
========================================

Izuku Midoriya leaves U.A. and operates independently across Japan as a solo Hero, tracking Villain activity and protecting civilians without agency support.

He engages multiple escaped prisoners in isolated urban battles while transporting civilians to safety zones.

Izuku is ambushed by Kaina Tsutsumi (Lady Nagant), a former Hero Public Safety Commission assassin deployed to capture him alive.

Nagant uses long-range precision rifle Quirks across extreme distances, forcing Izuku to adapt One For All usage with Blackwhip, Fa Jin, and Danger Sense in combination.

Nagant reveals the Hero Commission's internal corruption and her past role executing covert eliminations of targets deemed threats to Hero society.

Izuku refuses to kill her and attempts to break her resolve while avoiding lethal retaliation.

Izuku closes distance despite repeated sniper suppression and defeats Nagant without killing her.

Nagant suffers Quirk overload collapse and is captured alive rather than eliminated.

She provides intelligence on Hero Commission operations and deeper control structures influencing Hero society.

cardPool.title: Arc 15
cardPool.value:
========================================
ARC 15 — FINAL WAR ARC
========================================

Heroes launch coordinated final war against All For One and Shigaraki.

Bakugo engages Shigaraki.

Todoroki confronts Dabi.

Ochaco engages Toga.

All Might confronts All For One using armored support.

Izuku fights Shigaraki as One For All vestiges appear.

All For One is separated from Shigaraki.

Shigaraki collapses after final exchange.

Major battles conclude across all fronts.

Heroes win but at great cost.

cardPool.title: Momo Yaoyorozu
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Momo Yaoyorozu

Alias: Everything Hero: Creati, Yaomomo

Quirk Name: Creation

Occupation/Role: UA High School Student, Class 1-A Vice Class Representative

Personality: Prudent and dedicated natural leader who remains levelheaded in danger. Kind and polite yet blunt about others' mistakes; she seeks to help peers improve. Her wealthy upbringing instilled sensible respect for others, though she finds crude behavior discouraging. Despite her revealing costume, she maintains an innocent view of nudity and is sensitive to vulgarity.

Appearance: Tall young girl with mature, curvaceous physique and light skin tone. Long black hair tied in a spiky ponytail with a strand falling down her right side; sharp onyx eyes. Wears UA female uniform: gray dress jacket with teal stripes and golden buttons over white dress shirt, red tie, and teal pleated skirt with brown shoes and black socks. Her hero costume is a high-collared crimson sleeveless leotard with white trim, open from neck to navel for her Quirk use, red heeled boots, and two beige utility belts.

Backstory: A recommendation student at UA High School training to become a Pro Hero.

cardPool.title: Mon
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Mon
Alias: None
Quirk Name: None
Occupation/Role: Pet dog of the Shimura Family
Personality: Friendly, protective, and compassionate; enjoys play and walks; demonstrates loyalty by comforting distressed loved ones.
Appearance: Small Welsh Corgi with ginger and white fur; warm, approachable demeanor.
Backstory: Mon lived as a beloved family pet bonded closely with young Tenko. When Kotaro struck Tenko for entering his study, Mon barked protectively. Later that night, Mon comforted the crying boy, but Tenko's Quirk, Decay, manifested uncontrollably and killed Mon instantly. Mon became the first victim of the tragedy that would claim the entire family.
Additional Information: Non-combat character; significant to Tenko Shimura's tragic origin story; his death marks the pivotal moment of Tenko's Quirk manifestation.

Kaina Tsutsumi

Lady Nagant

Quirk Name:
Rifle

Former Pro Hero and Villain operative

Personality:
Serious and disciplined with a ruthless approach to objectives. Capable of displaying a lighter side beneath her stoic exterior. Direct and fearless, willing to use force when necessary but open to change and redemption.

Appearance:
A muscular, curvaceous woman with short deep indigo hair streaked with pink, cut to chin level with crookedly-shaped middle-parted bangs extending to her shoulders. Fair skin, gradient light purple eyes with white pupils, thick brows. Smoke emits from her right elbow during Quirk use. She wears a sleeveless two-tone dark violet turtleneck dress with long flowing skirt, dark yellow vertical studs along her armpits, garnet utility belt with dark yellow ammunition canisters, and tall pointed zip-up boots with black pinstripes.

Backstory:
A bright student shaped by the Hero Public Safety Commission into a capable pro hero. Her path led to darker work and imprisonment in Tartarus.

cardPool.title: Rumi Usagiyama
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Rumi Usagiyama

Alias: Rabbit Hero: Mirko

Quirk Name: Rabbit

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero (Current No. 6)

Personality: Tough, blunt, and fearless with an independent streak. Rumi respects those who speak their mind and disdains team-based heroism. Despite her brash demeanor, she will assist others when needed and isn't afraid to ask for help in genuine danger.

Appearance: Dark-skinned woman of average height with a lean, athletic build. She has narrow red eyes, straight white hair reaching her thighs with right-parted bangs, long white rabbit ears, and a small round tail. She wears a sleeveless white leotard with dark purple trim, yellow crescent moon design across her chest, purple thigh-high boots, thick white gloves with triangular protrusions, and a metal plate around her midriff resembling rabbit feet.

Backstory: A former middle school hooligan expelled for fighting, Rumi channeled her love of combat into the Underground Masquerade fight rings during high school. She earned respect as a formidable future Pro Hero, refusing compensation and vowing to make it big independently through raw strength alone.

cardPool.title: Ryuko Tsuchikawa
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Ryuko Tsuchikawa
Alias: Pixie-Bob
Quirk Name: Earth Flow
Occupation/Role: Pro Hero, Wild, Wild Pussycats Member
Personality: Hyperactive and loud with little social filter, self-conscious about her age despite claiming to be eighteen at heart. Shows genuine fondness for promising young heroes and can shift to serious, empathetic communication when needed. Impatient in personal life and romance.
Appearance: Woman with sharp blue eyes and long blonde hair swept back except for bangs. Wears a light blue Pussycats hero costume with pink-padded paw gloves and two blue dots on her cheeks during missions. Wears a tinted visor to aid her Quirk use.
Backstory: Highly skilled Pro Hero and strongest member of the Wild, Wild Pussycats. Built her reputation mastering earth manipulation for mountain rescues and hero operations. Her confidence matches her eccentric personality, though beneath her wackiness lies genuine care for the next generation of heroes.
Additional Information: During the Quirk Apprehension Test arc, Ryuko demonstrates her combat prowess by overwhelming Class 1-A students with her Quirk.

Personality:
Macho and intimidating with a fear-inducing presence, but maintains silly eccentricity with teammates. Takes training seriously with no tolerance for slacking. Physically pushes students to their limits, though genuine care underlies his stern exterior with fierce protective instincts.

Tall, muscular man with short brown hair and small triangle beard. Distinctive blank white eyes ringed with black markings. Wears a brown Wild, Wild Pussycats hero costume emphasizing his athletic build.

Seasoned pro hero with a reputation for apprehending dangerous criminals. Serves as UA High School instructor, bringing combat expertise and uncompromising philosophy to students during training camps.

Additional Information:
Possesses enhanced physical strength capable of knocking back powerful opponents. Pliabody Quirk enables extraordinary flexibility—stretching, flattening, and contorting his body for combat advantages. Known for unforgiving training methods that push students beyond conventional limits.

Personality: Cheerful and composed in combat, maintains positive demeanor during dangerous situations. Demonstrates professionalism and teamwork with other heroes.
Appearance: Petite young woman with tan skin, long straight blonde hair, large almond-shaped green compound eyes, and two short antennae on her forehead. Wears a black off-the-shoulder bodice with white faux-fur collar, black-and-white paneled skirt, yellow-and-black striped forearm gauntlets, and white thigh-high boots with honeycomb emblems at the knees.
Backstory: Established Brazilian Pro Hero with insectoid appearance. Captured during I-Expo security breach but freed when Melissa Shield restored systems. Participated in raid on Humarise base.
Additional Information: Quirk enables her to elongate and morph fingernails into red stinger-like spikes that detach and launch as projectiles. Spikes are durable, pierce walls, and restrain targets. They regrow quickly.

cardPool.title: Bearhead
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Bearhead
Quirk Name: Brown Bear
Occupation/Role: Villain (Wild Villains)
Personality: Loyal and dependable to allies, particularly Curator; straightforward and combat-focused with strong camaraderie despite his brutal nature.
Appearance: Heavily muscled humanoid with bear-like features; half his body covered in thick brown fur with a bear-like face and prominent snout. Large sharp claws replace normal fingers. Wears pale orange pants, dark green wrist guards with metal hand plates, short brown boots, armored utility belt, and a ball chain with bell around his neck.
Backstory: Origins unknown. Formed close friendship with villain Curator, leading him to join the Wild Villains organization.
Additional Information: Brown Bear Quirk grants enhanced strength, exceptional durability, acute animal senses, and formidable claw weapons for dangerous close-combat fighting. Serves as reliable Wild Villains member with strong bond to Curator, valuing loyalty above all.

cardPool.title: Batto Yobayakawa
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Batto Yobayakawa

Alias: Bat Villain

Quirk Name: Bat

Occupation/Role: Independent villain, enhanced by the Villain Factory

Personality: Arrogant and boastful about his speed. Vengeful and obsessive toward those who defeated him. Prideful to the point of recklessness.

Appearance: Tall man with pointed ears, sharp teeth, and swept-back black hair with shaved sides. Dark-toned arms with large bat wings beneath them. Clawed feet. Wears a sleeveless full-body suit, belt with central buckle, and dark translucent visor. After enhancement: completely dark skin, enlarged ears, shortened hair, fur covering lower body from waist down.

Backstory: A speedster villain who caused highway incidents in Naruhata using Trigger, evading heroes easily. Defeated by Koichi and Knuckleduster, he was kidnapped and experimented on by the Villain Factory, becoming a more powerful Next-Level Villain. Now enhanced and seeking revenge.

Additional Information: Possesses superhuman speed and flight via bat wings. Consumed Trigger multiple times before enhancement. Operates in Naruhata, pursuing vengeance against Koichi Haimawari and Knuckleduster.

cardPool.title: Backdraft
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Backdraft
Quirk Name: Water Pump
Occupation/Role: Pro Hero, Musutafu Fire Department
Personality: Professional and duty-focused, prioritizing firefighting and public safety. Direct communicator who delegates efficiently.
Appearance: Tall firefighter in yellow jacket with reflective lines, red fireman hat, white mask with orange center-point, metallic tap-hands with red valve actuators, red kneepads, yellow sneakers, and water tank rig with shoulder-mounted cannon.
Backstory: Dedicated Pro Hero with the Musutafu Fire Department using water-control abilities in emergencies. Witnessed the Sludge Villain incident and participated in the Hospital Raid Team operation.
Additional Information: Demonstrates exceptional water manipulation precision, forming complex barriers with warning symbols. Shows resilience in extreme situations. Operates within organized hero-team frameworks.

cardPool.title: Axer
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Axer
Quirk Name: Unknown
Occupation/Role: Villain, League of Villains recruit
Personality: Aggressive and opportunistic, using ambush tactics; typical low-ranking villain without notable intelligence.
Appearance: Well-built man with dark skin and long dark hair. Wears black pants, brown belt with gold buckle, white round mask, gold bracelets, and gold T-shaped pendant.
Backstory: Minor criminal recruited by Tomura Shigaraki for a seventy-villain assault on the U.S.J. training facility, positioned in the Mountain Zone to intercept Class 1-A students.
Additional Information: Fought Kaminari, Jiro, and Yaoyorozu but was defeated by Yaoyorozu's kick. Apprehended after the invasion failed. His Quirk remains unspecified.

cardPool.title: Astro
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Astro
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Unknown Orgue
Occupation/Role: Pro Hero
Personality: Eager and selfless, willing to help others despite lacking fame. Demonstrates genuine heroic spirit and humility.
Appearance: Young man with spiky dark blue hair and large baggy grayish-blue eyes. Wears a white shirt with metal-hole collar detailing, orange undershirt, dark blue vest, and red gloves with gray knuckles.
Backstory: A lesser-known Pro Hero who answered Eraser Head's call during the Final War, volunteering to fight Tomura Shigaraki without seeking recognition. His selflessness demonstrated true heroic character.
Additional Information: Astro's Quirk allows him to summon large metal spears from his hands. After the Final War, he gained significant popularity and became recognizable enough for advertising billboards.

cardPool.title: Atsuhiro Sako
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Atsuhiro Sako

Alias: Mr. Compress

Quirk Name: Compress

Occupation/Role: Villain, Member of the League of Villains Vanguard Action Squad

Personality: A charismatic showman who thrives on entertainment and spectacle with theatrical flair. Talkative, humorous, and arrogant, though his showboating often undermines his villainy. Despite his villainous nature, he serves as a voice of reason, mentoring younger members and genuinely caring for his comrades.

Appearance: Tall and slim with pale skin, brown semicircular eyes, and a pointed nose. Short black eyebrows and curly brown hair. Wears dark orange upturned-collar shirt, green striped bolo tie with azure brooch, black waistcoat and dress pants, knee-high white boots with wedged heels, dark red gloves, and tall brown top hat with red ribbon and pale feather. Black balaclava and white geometric mask. Carries a silver walking stick with gold handle.

Backstory: Great-great-grandson of the Peerless Thief Oji Harima, who stole from wealthy heroes to aid common people. Atsuhiro became a nationwide wanted thief following his ancestor's legacy.

cardPool.title: Aorio Kuraishisu
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Aorio Kuraishisu

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Unknown

Occupation/Role: Hero Expert

Personality: Reserved and analytical; presents himself as a thoughtful commentator on heroic society and its standards.

Appearance: Pale-faced with dark hair, pointed ears, and two prominent horns. He has dull, penetrating eyes and wears simple business suits.

Backstory: A professional expert in heroic affairs with deep knowledge of the Pro Hero system. He gained prominence after events in Deika City, appearing on television to analyze society's changing perception of heroes.

Additional Information: Not a UA student; operates as a civilian expert and media personality. His ability to assess the complexities of Pro Hero work makes him a valued analyst in public discourse about heroism.

cardPool.title: Aoni
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Aoni

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Not specified

Occupation/Role: Clothes designer at Onigashima denim brand

Personality: Energetic and passionate about fashion design with deep admiration for Best Jeanist. Easily discouraged but driven to improve.

Appearance: Young man of slightly below-average height with neat, light-colored hair, distinctive pointy ears, and two small horns protruding from his head, giving him an otherworldly appearance typical of animal-type Quirks.

Backstory: Aoni rose quickly through ranks at Onigashima and earned the opportunity to design an outfit for Best Jeanist's catwalk show. Villains attacked and destroyed his creation, devastating him. However, Jeanist repaired the outfit using his Quirk, inspiring Aoni to pursue excellence in fashion design.

Additional Information: Not a UA student; works professionally in the fashion industry. His Quirk type remains unknown, though physical traits suggest an animal-based ability. He is a civilian caught up in hero activity rather than a combatant.

cardPool.title: Anonymous
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Anonymous (Designation Unknown)
Alias: The Anonymous, Bio-Engineered Drone
Quirk Name: Hive Mind Command Protocol
Occupation/Role: Villain/Bio-Engineered Combat Drone
Personality: Emotionless and obedient to Number 6's commands. Mimic human emotion as tactical lures. Lack self-preservation instincts or fear.
Appearance: Humanoid figures with veiny skin in colored patches matching Number 6's costume. Facial scars, defined lips, clawed hands and feet, and glowing orbs on palms and chest. Wear hats and long sleeves to infiltrate as civilians.
Backstory: Bio-engineered by the Villain Factory from Bomber cells as a hive mind collective serving Number 6. Deployed across Naruhata during Operation Anonymous to attack civilian infrastructure and create chaos and paranoia.
Additional Information: Possess superior intelligence to Bombers; capable of complex tactics and EMP generation through controlled detonation. Serve as expendable frontline forces and can be remotely detonated for maximum damage.

cardPool.title: Amplivolt
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Amplivolt (Zōden)
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Amplivolt
Occupation/Role: Vice Commander of the Paranormal Liberation Front, Top-Ranked Adviser in Vanguard Action Support Regiment: Brown
Personality: Brash, confident, and combative with unwavering loyalty to the PLF. Eager for battle and dismissive of opposition. Single-minded in his devotion and enjoys smoking.
Appearance: A tall, heavily scarred man with a rugged physique. Black hair with a distinctive yellow lightning bolt-shaped streak. Dresses in a dark suit with a pink striped shirt and brown tie. Carries electrified gauntlets or taser weapons.
Backstory: Originally with the Meta Liberation Army before joining the Paranormal Liberation Front following the merger with the League of Villains. Rose to prominence as a top-ranked adviser, participating in the raid on Gunga Mountain Villa where he engaged heroes including Chargebolt and Edgeshot before being captured.
Additional Information: His Amplivolt Quirk requires external electrical sources; he cannot generate electricity independently. Uses tasers to power his Ultimate Move, Supreme Discharge: Thundernet, a devastating wide-area electrical attack.

cardPool.title: Akira Iwako
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Akira Iwako

Alias: Instant Villain

Quirk Name: Hardening

Occupation/Role: Villain/Drug User

Personality: Calm and cooperative when sober, but aggressive and violent under Trigger's influence. Shows tactical retreat when outmatched, though typically reckless and destructive.

Appearance: Medium-sized man with curly brown hair in ordinary street clothes. When enhanced by Trigger, his body swells—skin turns grayish, muscles bulge massively, and rock-like protrusions erupt across his head, shoulders, and knuckles.

Backstory: A street criminal supplied Trigger by Kuin Hachisuka. His Hardening Quirk became dangerously amplified by the drug, turning him into a rampaging force. Defeated by The Crawler and Knuckleduster, he was arrested but released as a victim. Upon release, he immediately accepted more Trigger and resumed violent crime across Naruhata.

Additional Information: Recognizes The Crawler by name. Has faced heroes including Stendhal, whose sword attacks penetrated his defense. Shows vulnerability to overexertion—excessive rage causes sluggish movements and weakened Quirk focus.

cardPool.title: Ochaco Uraraka
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Ochaco Uraraka

Alias: Uravity

Quirk Name: Zero Gravity

Occupation/Role: UA High School Student, Class 1-A

Personality: Cheerful and determined with a gentle demeanor, though she harbors deep resolve beneath her friendly exterior. Ochaco is earnest and hardworking, driven by a desire to become a hero and support her family, yet remains humble and considerate of others.

Appearance: A slender teenage girl with fair skin and shoulder-length auburn bob with bangs. She has large round eyes, thick upper lashes, and distinctive permanent pink blush marks on her cheeks. Her fingertips bear small pink pads used to activate her Quirk. She wears the UA female uniform: gray dress jacket with teal stripes, white shirt, red tie, and teal pleated skirt with black tights and brown shoes. Her hero costume features a black full-body suit with pale pink accents, deep pink choker, two-toned pink sleeves, pale pink gauntlets and boots with shock-absorbent soles, and optional headgear with tinted visor.

cardPool.title: Tomura Shigaraki
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Tenko Shimura

Alias:
Tomura Shigaraki

Quirk Name:
Decay

Occupation/Role:
Leader of the League of Villains

Personality:
Impulsive and volatile with destructive rages. Driven by resentment toward hero society and All Might. Intelligent but emotionally unstable, dependent on All For One for validation.

Appearance:
Pale young man with messy grayish-blue hair falling unevenly to his shoulders. Bright red irises and wrinkled skin around his eyes from chronic scratching. Scarring on his right eyelid and left lip. Wears a black hoodie, black pants, and red sneakers. Carries a disembodied hand in his pocket.

Backstory:
Born Tenko Shimura, his Quirk manifested at age five, causing him to accidentally disintegrate his entire family. Traumatized and alone, he was adopted by All For One, who raised him as a weapon to destroy All Might and hero society. Now leads the League of Villains as the primary antagonist threatening UA High School.

Additional Information:
Wears a villain costume adorned with fourteen embalmed hands from his victims. Highly motivated by hatred of the hero system and desperate for his master's approval. Dangerously unpredictable.

cardPool.title: Katsuki Bakugo
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Katsuki Bakugo

Alias: Kacchan, Great Explosion Murder God Dynamight

Quirk Name: Explosion

Occupation/Role: UA High School Student, Class 1-A

Personality: Aggressive, competitive, and intensely proud with fierce determination to become the strongest hero. Volatile and quick to anger, dismissive of others, yet possesses unwavering drive and ambition fueling relentless training.

Appearance: Young man of above-average height with slim, muscular build. Short, spiky sandy blond hair with choppy bangs and sharp, bright red eyes. At UA, wears standard uniform with several undone collar buttons and loose pants. Hero costume features black sleeveless tank top with orange "X", jagged black mask with orange-rimmed flares, armored gauntlets, neck brace, green-and-orange belt with grenades, metallic knee guards, and black combat boots with orange soles.

Backstory: Standout student from Aldera Junior High with natural combat talent, accustomed to superiority until Izuku Midoriya challenged his dominance.
