Now a first-year at UA High School, he channels arrogance and competitive nature into becoming a pro hero, driven by obsession with surpassing rivals.

cardPool.title: Izuku Midoriya
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Izuku Midoriya

Alias:
Deku

Quirk Name:
One For All

Occupation/Role:
UA High School Student, Class 1-A

Personality:
Earnest and determined, driven to become a hero despite being born Quirkless. Enthusiastic yet capable of intense focus in combat. Respectful and analytical, taking detailed notes on hero abilities.

Appearance:
A short young man with fluffy dark-green hair, round face, large green eyes, and four diamond-shaped freckles on his cheeks. Wears the UA standard male uniform: light gray blazer with dark turquoise trim, white shirt, dark blue-green pants, and red tie. Signature bright red high-top boots with thick white soles. Developed lean muscle from training. Right hand shows early deformation from combat strain.

Backstory:
Born without a Quirk in a world where they define one's worth, Izuku trained relentlessly. All Might recognized his heroic spirit and became his mentor, transferring his legendary transferable Quirk to him, making Izuku the ninth wielder of One For All.

Additional Information:
Carries a notebook with observations on hero abilities and strategies.

cardPool.title: Moko Tamashi
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Moko Tamashi

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Unnamed Mass-Generation Quirk

Occupation/Role: Civilian

Personality: Grateful and faithful despite hardship. Moko maintains unwavering belief in heroes even after society's collapse, showing courage and resilience. She is determined and selfless, willing to risk danger for her convictions.

Appearance: Young woman with shoulder-length brown hair and matching brown eyes. Earnest, youthful face. Slender build, typical of an ordinary person.

Backstory: Moko was trapped in building rubble during the Kamino Incident clash between All Might and All For One. All Might sacrificed his heroic form to protect her from a killing blow in his final act before retirement. This fundamentally shaped her unwavering devotion to him.

Additional Information: Despite societal despair and hero vandalism, Moko dedicates herself to daily cleaning of All Might's defaced statue, risking danger to maintain faith in heroes. Her Quirk generates spherical masses from her feet that stack to reach elevated places—a humble ability she uses for her noble purpose rather than combat.

cardPool.title: Moe Kamiji
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Moe Kamiji

Alias:
Burnin

Quirk Name:
Blazing Hair

Occupation/Role:
Pro Hero Sidekick at Endeavor Agency

Personality:
Passionate, enthusiastic, and fiery. Encouraging and supportive of fellow heroes. Hard-working and dedicated in combat and civilian evacuation duties.

Appearance:
A curvaceous young woman with large red-orange eyes and pointy teeth. Her distinctive feature is long, flaming yellowish-green hair with side and center bangs. She wears a light-gray double-breasted mini dress with orange and black lining, black collar and belt, silver screw buttons, and a temperature gauge belt with fire extinguisher attachment. Black knee-high socks, short black boots, and a black mask connected to a red headband complete her outfit.

Backstory:
One of over thirty sidekicks at Endeavor's agency. She mentors and evaluates hero students during internships, demonstrating her experience and dedication.

Additional Information:
An established Pro Hero working in the field. Her Blazing Hair Quirk allows her to detach and throw fire-like hair as projectiles and enables flight. Her bold personality sometimes clashes with strong-willed heroes like Bakugo.

cardPool.title: Mocha
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Mocha
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Double
Occupation/Role: Experimented Nomu in Kyudai Garaki's Laboratory
Personality: Loyal and protective of his master Kyudai Garaki, willing to sacrifice himself despite limited combat capability.
Appearance: A diminutive Nomu with light yellow skin, round eyes, and exposed brain. Cat-like ears are human noses, and a spinal tail extends from his body. He wears pale lace-up shoes on his upper limbs.
Backstory: Created in Kyudai Garaki's secret laboratory, Mocha developed genuine attachment to his captor despite his artificial origin.
Additional Information: Mocha's Double Quirk allows creation of autonomous duplicates of individuals. As a small-scale Nomu, he poses minimal direct threat but serves as a loyal asset to Garaki's operations.

cardPool.title: Miyashita
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Miyashita
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Unknown
Occupation/Role: Detnerat Company Employee
Personality: Straightforward and honest, prone to casual joking, critical thinker who questions ideology.
Appearance: Middle-aged man with rodent-like features including circular ears, dark beady eyes, and small nose and muzzle. Short dark hair swept forward. Professional attire: white dress shirt, pale blazer, dark tie.
Backstory: Dedicated Detnerat Company employee in hero support gear division. Orphaned after mother's death with no remaining family. Known for candid rapport with boss Rikiya Yotsubashi, making light-hearted jabs about his appearance. Killed by Yotsubashi after expressing moral opposition to Destro's ideology and the Meta Liberation Army.
Additional Information: Not a UA student.

cardPool.title: Miu
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Miu

Alias: Feathers (with twin sister Yu)

Quirk Name: Unknown

Occupation/Role: Underground idol performer

Personality: Sharp-tongued and judgmental, though she warms to others as bonds deepen. Initially dismissive, she softens when befriending someone. Competitive and observant.

Appearance: Short-statured young girl with straight, shoulder-length light hair in a high left-side ponytail with side-swept bangs. Dark, stern eyes tilting slightly inward. Wears a sleeveless knee-length idol dress with pointed skirt, feather accent, tights, and one long glove—mirrored to her twin's reversed colors. Dark training tracksuit with pale side stripes when not performing.

Backstory: Half of the underground idol duo Feathers performing with twin sister Yu at local festivals. Known as "the mean one," she judges others harshly initially but learns to see past first impressions through genuine connections.

Additional Information: Possesses exceptional singing talent superior to other underground performers. Works within the underground idol community rather than formal institutions. Her contrasting costume and opposing personality to Yu creates a dynamic duo style.

cardPool.title: Mirai Sasaki
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Mirai Sasaki

Alias: Sir Nighteye

Quirk Name: Foresight

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero

Personality: Stoic and intimidating with sharp, cold demeanor, yet values humor and requires others to make him laugh. Pragmatic, protective of subordinates, and willing to admit mistakes. Fiercely devoted to All Might's ideals, though willing to disagree for the greater good.

Appearance: Tall and lean with sharp, angular features and stern yellow eyes behind triangular glasses. Dark green hair slicked back with three yellow streaks, parted left, and yellowish eyebrows matching his glasses. He wears a plain white suit with gold buttons, white dress shirt, and red tie with white dots.

Backstory: Former sidekick to All Might and the brains behind the Symbol of Peace. Became a respected Pro Hero and mentor figure, though his falling out with All Might over the successor choice shapes his current path. His prescient abilities burden him greatly.

Additional Information: Established Pro Hero and mentor to sidekicks. Deeply knowledgeable about All Might's history. Fears consequences of using Foresight, particularly death premonitions.

cardPool.title: Minotaurus
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Minotaurus
Quirk Name: Bull Head
Occupation/Role: E-rank Villain, League of Villains recruit
Personality: Temperamental and violent with a quick temper. Easily intimidated by superior strength and powerful opponents.
Appearance: A hulking man with bluish skin and a single cyclopean eye. Two large horns protrude from his head. He wears a ripped black sleeveless shirt, grayish-brown pants, and a large white belt. His muscular build reflects his aggressive nature.
Backstory: Recruited by Tomura Shigaraki for the U.S.J. assault to eliminate All Might and strike fear into UA students. His confidence wavered against Eraser Head and he was quickly subdued by All Might before arrest.
Additional Information: Minotaurus relies on his Quirk's physical advantages with no formal combat training. He depends on numerical superiority rather than individual skill. He serves as a minor antagonist in the U.S.J. Arc.

cardPool.title: Minoru Mineta
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Minoru Mineta

Alias: Grape Juice

Quirk Name: Pop Off

Occupation/Role: UA High School Student, Class 1-A

Personality: Timid yet perverted, earning a reputation for lewd behavior that makes him unpopular. Easily jealous and envious, he speaks with cynical harshness. Despite his crass exterior, he shows genuine kindness when others are in danger, though he panics under stress. His heroic motivations stem from wanting popularity and attention from girls.

Appearance: A short teenage boy with an unusually large, round head and puffy cheeks. Dark purple hair forms four ball-shaped clumps like a mohawk. Small stubby upturned nose, oval eyes with large pupils, and thin eyebrows. At UA, he wears the standard male uniform modified for his stature: light gray blazer with dark turquoise trim, white shirt, dark blue-green pants, red tie, and brown shoes.

Backstory: A first-year at UA High School determined to become a Pro Hero. Driven by desires for popularity and female attention alongside genuine heroic aspirations, Minoru trains with Class 1-A despite feeling his Quirk is underwhelming.

Additional Information: Attempts to act charming but comes across as obnoxious.

cardPool.title: Mina Ashido
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Mina Ashido

Alias:
Ridley Hero: Pinky

Quirk Name:
Acid

Occupation/Role:
UA High School Student, Class 1-A

Personality:
Cheerful, easygoing, and perpetually smiling. Highly social and excitable, she thrives in group settings with infectious enthusiasm that lifts those around her.

Appearance:
A girl of medium height with athletic build. Light pink skin contrasts with short, fluffy darker pink hair. She has distinctive square eyes with black sclera and yellow irises, long eyelashes, and two pale yellow hooked horns. At UA, she wears the standard female uniform: gray jacket with teal stripes, white shirt, red tie, and teal pleated skirt with brown shoes and knee-high socks.

Backstory:
A first-year student at UA High School training to become a Pro Hero. Mina joined Class 1-A to develop her Quirk and combat abilities, shaped by her confident social nature.

Additional Information:
Her hero costume "Prism Sky" features a white mask, purple and turquoise skintight bodysuit with camouflage pattern, and cropped beige waistcoat with white fur collar. Custom acid-proof boots with ventilation holes allow acid secretion from her feet for enhanced mobility.

cardPool.title: Mika Jiro
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Mika Jiro

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Earphone Jack

Occupation/Role: Musician; Mother

Personality: Kind-hearted and encouraging, Mika is a supportive parent who respects her daughter's choices. She maintains composure in tense situations and balances her husband's passionate nature with level-headed wisdom.

Appearance: A slender woman with short, straight dark purple hair and bangs. She wears black-framed glasses and typically dresses in professional casual attire—a collared shell top, pencil skirt, and tights. Her distinctive feature is her plug-like earlobes, inherited by her daughter Kyoka.

Backstory: Mika is an accomplished musician whose talent attracted her husband Kyotoku. She passed her love of music to her daughter but accepted when Kyoka chose to pursue heroics instead, encouraging her to help others through whatever path she chose.

Additional Information: Mika possesses the Earphone Jack Quirk, granting her plug-type jacks on her earlobes. She can channel vibrations through connected objects and extend her earlobes over distance. She is an established adult supporting her daughter's enrollment at UA.

cardPool.title: Mihaera
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Mihaera
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Unknown
Occupation/Role: Villain/Spy Infiltrator at U.A. High School
Personality: Serious and obedient, following orders without question. Pragmatic and focused on securing her future through loyalty to All For One's cause.
Appearance: A young woman with long hair concealed beneath a beanie, wearing a simple shirt and jacket. Deliberately unremarkable style designed for blending in.
Backstory: One of five undercover spies sent by All For One to infiltrate U.A. High School as a refugee. She participated in psychological operations against Izuku Midoriya and assisted in disrupting U.A.'s evacuation systems during the Final War.
Additional Information: Captured by Itsuka Kendo and Tetsutetsu Tetsutetsu while pinned with a bomb she could not detonate. Experienced with explosives and sabotage. Current status following All For One's defeat unknown, presumed in custody.

cardPool.title: Mick
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Mick
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Unknown
Occupation/Role: Pro Hero Sidekick, Oki Mariner Crew Member
Personality: Responsible and dependable, capable of managing crew operations independently.
Appearance: Muscular build with blond close-cropped hair and beard. Wears a white sailor's uniform with blue stripes.
Backstory: A seasoned sidekick under Pro Hero Selkie, Mick serves as a trusted member of the Oki Mariner crew with command responsibilities.
Additional Information: Not a UA student; operates as a professional hero with Selkie's aquatic-focused hero agency.

cardPool.title: Mezo Shoji
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Mezo Shoji

Alias: Tentacle Hero: Tentacole

Quirk Name: Dupli-Arms

Occupation/Role: UA High School Student, Class 1-A

Personality: Friendly, gentle, and selfless despite his intimidating appearance. Mezo is empathetic and mature, avoiding emotional impulses while remaining deeply protective of his classmates. He is thick-skinned, unbothered by prejudice, and willingly risks himself for others.

Appearance: A tall, muscular young man with pale gray hair swept forward over his eye. His most distinctive feature is six arms connected by webbing—the front two have hands while the others end in thin stumps. He has an elongated face with eyes set toward the sides, concealed by a light blue mask covering from below his eyes to his neck. He wears the standard UA male uniform with a sleeveless blazer to accommodate his tentacles, paired with brown shoes.

Backstory: From a hometown plagued by prejudice against heteromorphs, Mezo adopted his signature mask after his appearance upset a young girl. Despite discrimination rooted in his altered physique, he remained determined to become a Pro Hero.

cardPool.title: Meryl Hope
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Meryl Hope

Alias:
None

Quirk Name:
Unknown

Occupation/Role:
Weather Forecaster for BCD News

Personality:
Professional and bold with unwavering commitment to truth. Direct and courageous, willing to publicly oppose corruption at personal risk. Communicates efficiently while maintaining strong moral conviction.

Appearance:
Dark-skinned woman of average height with blue eyes and thick eyebrows. Light blonde hair to shoulder length. Wears an all-white thigh-length dress with matching white shoes and a wristwatch, maintaining professional broadcaster appearance.

Backstory:
Weather forecaster for BCD News in Washington State with a reputation for accurate reporting. Her journalism has evolved into active resistance against governmental corruption, positioning her as a voice of defiance.

Additional Information:
Not a UA High School student. Operates independently in US media. Quirk type unrevealed. Serves as a civilian voice of resistance and moral authority in her community.

cardPool.title: Melissa Shield
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Melissa Shield
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Quirkless
Occupation/Role: Third-year student at I-Island Academy
Personality: Kindhearted and intelligent with unwavering determination to become a hero despite lacking a Quirk. Outgoing and naturally curious, she quickly befriends others and remains calm under pressure. She believes indirect support through invention is a valid path to fighting for peace.
Appearance: A pale-skinned young woman with a round face, wavy blonde hair with side-swept bangs, aqua-blue eyes, and pink oval-framed glasses. She wears the I-Island Academy uniform: white short-sleeved shirt with plaid cuffs, matching bow at neck, dark waistcoat, pale gray Capri pants, plaid socks, and brown boots.
Backstory: Brilliant daughter of Professor David Shield, a renowned inventor and hero support scientist. Melissa inherited her father's genius and dedication to advancing heroics through technology. She demonstrated heroic courage at the I-Expo by assisting UA students against villains despite her Quirkless status.
Additional Information: Inventor of support equipment including the Full Gauntlet, designed to reduce strain on Quirk users.

cardPool.title: Mei Hatsume
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Mei Hatsume
Alias: The Support Department's Genius
Quirk Name: Zoom
Occupation/Role: UA High School Support Department student, Class 1-H
Personality: Smart, assertive, and shameless; obsessively passionate about inventions. Direct and opportunistic, often invading personal space. Shows no fear of failure and views setbacks as learning opportunities. Self-centered but driven by genuine motivation to improve her craft. Somewhat absent-minded and poor at reading social cues.
Appearance: Reasonably short with mature build. Salmon pink shoulder-length hair in thick dreadlocks swept right. Wide, upward-sloped green-yellow eyes with distinctive cross-shaped irises like scope lenses and notably long upper lashes. Wears modified UA gym uniform (dark blue tracksuit) with red and gold steampunk goggles, utility belt, oversized speed-assisting boots, and jet pack. Frequently adorned with various self-made gadgets.
Backstory: Naturally gifted inventor in UA's Support Department. Her talent for creating functional equipment earned recognition from experienced faculty like Power Loader.

cardPool.title: Mawata Fuwa
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Mawata Fuwa

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Unknowable

Occupation/Role: UA High School Class 2-A Student, Pro Hero in Training

Personality: Cheerful and carefree yet capable of serious responsibility when needed. Respects tough teaching methods and values difficult experiences that foster growth.

Appearance: Girl with layered light pink shoulder-length hair, straight bangs parted left. Round gray eyes with long eyelashes, dark eye makeup with star-shaped pupils. Wears standard female UA uniform and distinctive puffy cotton ball earrings. Hero costume features a fluffy white sleeveless jacket with black arm bracers.

Backstory: First-year student under Eraser Head's harsh training. Her class was expelled during a lesson then re-enrolled to experience growth as heroes. This formative experience strengthened her understanding of heroic purpose and class bonds.

Additional Information: Participated in the Final War against All For One at Mt. Fuji. Chosen as class point of contact for post-war restoration efforts, demonstrating leadership despite her casual personality.

cardPool.title: Master Driller
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown

Alias: Master Driller

Quirk Name: Drill

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero

Personality: Courageous and resolute, Master Driller demonstrates unwavering determination to protect civilians. He fights without hesitation even when facing overwhelming odds.

Appearance: Master Driller wears a maroon combat suit with reinforced metal leg protectors and asymmetrical shoulder armor. His left arm features a metallic guard, while his right arm is a massive mechanical drill. A black helmet with a white facial plate and yellow star design covers his head, with a blue visor protecting his eyes.

Backstory: A dedicated Pro Hero who answered the call during the Paranormal Liberation Front crisis in Jaku City. Master Driller fought against Near High-End Nomu, prioritizing civilian safety and supporting fellow heroes.

Additional Information: Master Driller operates as part of organized hero task forces. His Drill Quirk allows him to bore through materials and organic matter with precision, making him effective against armored or biological threats.

cardPool.title: Master Beast
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Master Beast
Quirk Name: Unnamed Werewolf Quirk
Occupation/Role: Underground fighter in the Underground Masquerade
Personality: Aggressive and brutal in combat. Shows resilience by continuing to fight despite injuries and recovering alongside defeated opponents without animosity.
Appearance: Muscular werewolf-like humanoid covered in thick fur. Wears dark pants, leather shoulder pads with chest straps, and a domino mask. Distinguished by razor-sharp claws and feral physiology.
Backstory: An illicit Underground Masquerade fighter whose true identity remains unknown. He suffered severe burns when defeated by Drunk Lee, whose Dragon Breath Quirk ignited his fur.
Additional Information: Not a UA High School student. His Quirk grants superhuman strength and razor-sharp claws for close-quarters combat. He later recovered alongside Drunk Lee, suggesting the Underground Masquerade maintains community among its fighters regardless of match outcomes.

cardPool.title: Mashirao Ojiro
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Mashirao Ojiro

Alias:
Tailman

Quirk Name:
Tail

Occupation/Role:
UA High School Student, Class 1-A

Personality:
Calm and noble with strong dignity, Mashirao is a reliable hard worker who avoids the spotlight due to his sheepish nature. Sensitive about being perceived as plain, he shocks easily but maintains composure in combat.

Appearance:
A muscular young man with short blond hair and thin eyes. His distinctive feature is a hairless, prehensile tail with a tufted tip. He wears the standard UA male uniform with pale gray sneakers and a hero costume of a karate gi with black belt, blue accessories, fur-lined collar, and black boots.

Backstory:
Mashirao trained at UA High School to become a Pro Hero. His martial arts knowledge and tail physiology earned him 7th place in the Quirk Apprehension Test, demonstrating early combat capabilities.

Additional Information:
Mashirao uses his tail for offensive attacks and mobility, launching himself airborne by striking the ground. He fights somewhat predictably due to his tail's natural patterns and works to eliminate this weakness through improved fundamentals.

cardPool.title: Masaki Mizushima
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Masaki Mizushima

Alias: Normal Hero: Manual

Quirk Name: Water Control

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero (No. 222), based in Hosu City

Personality: Kind, attentive, and inspiring with an ordinary demeanor. He possesses keen observational skills and aspires to be a role model for modern heroes.

Appearance: A man with messy brown hair and black eyes. He wears a blue and white skin-tight long-sleeved shirt tucked into orange gloves, dark pants, and white boots. His signature helmet features a fish-like fin and blue visor.

Backstory: Masaki rose through the hero ranks to become the No. 222 Pro Hero in Hosu City. He mentored young hero hopefuls and became known for his reliable, straightforward approach to heroism.

Additional Information: His Quirk allows him to manipulate pre-existing water but has a weakness to air pressure, which disrupts his control. He selected his intern based on recognizing similar qualities in them.

cardPool.title: Martial Hair
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Martial Hair
Quirk Name: Hair Control
Occupation/Role: F-rank Villain
Personality: Aggressive and combat-ready, confident despite her low rank.
Appearance: Young woman of average height with a lean build. Light brown hair in pigtails with side-swept bangs. Light brown oval eyes. Wears magenta boots, shorts, sports bra, and armbands.
Backstory: Recruited by Tomura Shigaraki for the U.S.J. invasion. She was quickly defeated by Eraser Head and arrested by pro heroes.
Additional Information: F-rank villain whose Quirk allows her to shape her hair into weapons like drills. Despite her low ranking, she willingly confronts professional heroes.

cardPool.title: Mario Kugutsu
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Mario Kugutsu

Alias: The Toy Man

Quirk Name: Playtime

Occupation/Role: Trigger Dealer and Instant Villain for the Villain Factory

Personality: Outwardly timid and apologetic with closed eyes, masking a cunning predator who targets vulnerable individuals. Under Trigger, he regresses to childlike behavior, treating people as toys. Manipulative, sinister, and obsessed with both toys and the drug.

Appearance: Average height, neatly combed black hair, plain salaryman clothing. Eyes normally shut; when opened they appear manic. Long protruding tongue adds to his creepy demeanor. Under Trigger's influence, his body becomes colossal and jet black with four arms instead of two.

Backstory: Mario operates as a Trigger dealer for the Villain Factory, exploiting desperate individuals by offering them the drug to amplify their Quirks. Skilled at deceiving heroes and authorities into believing he was an unwilling Instant Villain.

Additional Information: Mario's Quirk only manifests under Trigger's effects. His childlike behavior contradicts his monstrous appearance. He is an active criminal in the vigilante underworld.

cardPool.title: Manga Fukidashi
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Manga Fukidashi

Alias: Comicman

Quirk Name: Comic

Occupation/Role: UA High School Class 1-B Student, Hero-in-Training

Personality: Expressive and dramatically enthusiastic with a soft spot for children. Strategic team player who excels at supporting allies in combat.

Appearance: A short young man with fair skin and a distinctive blank, pale-white speech bubble head and neck that changes shape to display thoughts. He wears a blue shirt with red sleeves, ink bottle-patterned armor, a yellow manga panel-decorated belt, short gloves, and a manga page template mask.

Backstory: A UA High School student training to become a Pro Hero in Class 1-B. Despite his unusual quirk-based appearance, he demonstrates compassion and tactical intelligence, making him a valued team member.

Additional Information: Comic materializes onomatopoeia in midair, creating real effects matching spoken sounds for offensive, defensive, and support capabilities. Overuse causes severe throat soreness. His quirk application and teamwork impressed Pro Hero Wash during the Joint Training Battle.

cardPool.title: Manami Aiba
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Manami Aiba

Alias: La Brava

Quirk Name: Love

Occupation/Role: Villain Associate / Hacker

Personality: Deeply devoted and loyal with obsessive tendencies. Withdrawn after past rejection, but gains confidence through her admiration for Danjuro. Protective and supportive despite sensitivity to rejection. Fiercely committed once emotionally invested.

Appearance: A short young woman with a disproportionately large, round head and narrow body. She has raspberry pink hair in two high pigtails with a centered bang swept right. Her striking features include large, pointed-down eyes with dark under-eye rings and oval pink irises with two concentric circles. She wears a white bow at her neck, thick white gloves, an indigo shirt with large pink buttons and frilly sleeve cuffs, puffy white pinstriped pants with heart motifs, golden heart-buckled belts, shiny high-heeled boots over dark tights, and heart-shaped earrings.

Backstory: A lonely middle schooler who became depressed after her love confession was rejected and mocked. She withdrew from society until discovering Danjuro's online videos.

cardPool.title: Makoto Tsukauchi
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Makoto Tsukauchi

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Polygraph

Occupation/Role: General Manager of Captain Celebrity Corporation

Personality: Intelligent, independent, and determined with a pleasant demeanor masking subtle manipulation. Skilled at organizing groups and getting cooperation, with a rebellious streak and willingness to bend rules. Charming and social, adept at talking through difficult situations.

Appearance: Attractive young woman of slim build and above-average height with jet black hair to mid-lower back, parted right, and dark eyes behind bright green contacts. Small mole on lower left corner of mouth. Dresses fashionably for her corporate role and consistently wears gold hoop earrings.

Backstory: Younger sister of Detective Naomasa Tsukauchi, she leveraged intelligence and social skills to become General Manager of Captain Celebrity Corporation, effectively running the PR department. Her talent for manipulation mirrors her brother's detective work but in the corporate realm. Her rebellious nature has created childhood tension with her rule-abiding sibling.

cardPool.title: Mako Magi
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Mako Magi

Alias: None

Quirk Name: None

Occupation/Role: Homemaker, Grandmother

Personality: Caring toward her grandchildren but timid and conflict-averse. She witnessed abuse but feared confrontation. Despite her gentleness, she showed hidden courage by joining efforts to stop the violence.

Appearance: An elderly woman with a black bob-cut hairstyle and glasses. Her soft, aging face reflects decades of quiet domestic life. Her attire is simple and practical.

Backstory: Mako lived with her husband Chizuo in her daughter Nao's home, helping raise grandchildren Tenko and Hana. She grew distressed by her son-in-law Kotaro's violent abuse of the children but remained silent from fear of eviction. When his brutality escalated, she joined her family in confronting him—only to witness Tenko's Decay Quirk manifest uncontrollably, killing her entire family.

Additional Information: Deceased. She perished when Tenko Shimura's Quirk spiraled out of control. Her remains were later incorporated into the villain Tomura Shigaraki's costume, becoming twisted relics of a family tragedy.

cardPool.title: Maina Furasu
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Maina Furasu

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Not specified

Occupation/Role: UA High School Support Department student, Class 1-H

Personality: Timid and easily startled, yet dutiful and brave when needed. Less assertive than peers but capable of recognizing absurdity in desperate situations. Dedicated despite her shy nature.

Appearance: Dark brown hair in a ponytail with beige headband adorned with two blue bells and a flat screw detail on the left. Average build with wide, expressive eyes. Wears standard UA Support Department beige workshop coveralls.

Backstory: A talented support course student with no combat experience. Maina proved her bravery by joining the Heroes during the Final War against All For One's villain army, maintaining critical fortress systems under attack. Her technical aptitude earned her place among UA's support specialists.

Additional Information: Works with Momo Yaoyorozu for supply management. Capable of maintaining complex UA equipment under pressure. Essential infrastructure support personnel rather than frontline fighter. Quirk type undocumented.

cardPool.title: Mahoro Shimano
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Mahoro Shimano

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Hologram

Occupation/Role: Nabu Island resident; student

Personality: Stubborn and quick to judge, Mahoro fiercely protects her younger brother Katsuma. Initially cynical about heroes, she tests Class 1-A's resolve by creating false emergencies. Through genuine heroism, she develops appreciation for those dedicated to saving others.

Appearance: A small girl with dark brown eyes and straight brown hair in pigtails with dark pink bands. She has freckles and wears a pink dress with dark pink overall straps over a black tank top, white sandals with pink accents, and a sun hat with dark pink scarf and bow. Her left wrist bears a handmade floral charm bracelet from her mother.

Backstory: Living on Nabu Island with her younger brother after their mother's death, Mahoro became her family's emotional anchor while her father works away. Disillusioned with the hero system, she sees heroes as overrated. Her perspective shifts during Nine's invasion when Class 1-A and other heroes genuinely risk their lives to protect her and Katsuma.

cardPool.title: Maguma Iwata
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Maguma Iwata

Alias:
Volcano

Quirk Name:
Eruption

Occupation/Role:
Villain, Leader of the Volcano Thieves

Personality:
Commanding and ruthless, Maguma leads with confidence and tactical precision, relying on overwhelming power to dominate confrontations.

Appearance:
A tall, heavily muscular man with large brown eyes and distinctive orange, flame-shaped hair. He wears a navy blue bodysuit with rock-like boots, gauntlets, and shoulder pads lined with smoke-expelling pores. An orange belt cinches his waist, and a gas mask with a mercury thermometer hangs from his shoulder pads.

Backstory:
Maguma founded the Volcano Thieves criminal organization. His Quirk mastery and imposing physique have earned respect among subordinates and fear among enemies.

Additional Information:
His Eruption Quirk produces lava-like substance by burning fat cells. Technological gear amplifies his fire projection range and regulates his body temperature, making him formidable in direct combat.

cardPool.title: Madame Puppimil
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Madame Puppimil
Alias: The Dognapping Boss
Quirk Name: Trimming
Occupation/Role: Villain, Dognapper Leader
Personality: Callous and greed-driven yet surprisingly affectionate and charismatic. She commands loyalty through charm and genuine warmth toward favored individuals, though this masks her ruthless nature.
Appearance: A moderately-built woman with waist-length, right-parted hair adorned with a flower. She wears a spotted mini-dress beneath a fur-lined cape with fur stole, matching arm and leg bands, black tights, and black high-heels.
Backstory: A cunning criminal entrepreneur leading a dog-trafficking operation. She recognizes value in her acquisitions and views victims as both commodities and cherished possessions, making her a complex antagonist.
Additional Information: Operates a warehouse hideout stocked with caged dogs. Her Trimming Quirk allows her to groom and modify appearance of living beings. She was subdued by Class 1-A students during a missing puppy investigation, falling into a pit before capture.

cardPool.title: Madam President
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Madam President
Quirk Name: Unknown
Occupation/Role: Head of the Hero Public Safety Commission
Personality: Calm and steely, reassuring publicly but pragmatic and willing to make morally questionable decisions for perceived societal benefit. Balances ruthlessness with mercy while orchestrating manipulation and coercion.
Appearance: Middle-aged woman with turquoise eyes and ash-blonde hair slicked back. Wears a black suit jacket and dress with purple shirt and necklace, projecting professional authority.
Backstory: Former Vice President who witnessed her predecessor use Lady Nagant as an assassin. After Nagant killed the previous president, she assumed leadership and imprisoned rather than executed her. She discovered young Keigo Takami and recruited him as a commission operative to replace Nagant.
Additional Information: Operates through institutional power rather than personal Quirk strength. Shapes Japan's hero society via policy and strategic operative placement while maintaining public image and orchestrating covert operations.

cardPool.title: Madam
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Unknown

Alias:
Madam

Quirk Name:
Unknown

Occupation/Role:
Professional Shopper

Personality:
Highly competitive and charismatic, Madam thrives on sale events. She is cunning and exploits newcomers, yet respects those who outsmart her. Her passion for shopping borders on obsession—threats of bans distress her deeply. Despite aggressive tactics, she shows self-awareness.

Appearance:
A short, plump woman with voluminous curly black hair. She wears a tight-fitted dress with sharp pointed shoulder pads, a pearl necklace, and heavy makeup. Her bold style reflects her veteran status in competitive shopping.

Backstory:
Madam is a fixture at local department stores, renowned for her shopping prowess and ability to energize sales. Store staff recognize her value to events. She encountered Momo Yaoyorozu during a blowout sale, initially targeting the novice before being outwitted. A rule violation nearly resulted in permanent ban, but the store granted clemency due to her importance.

Additional Information:
Not a UA student. Operates independently in civilian world. Her Quirk ability remains unspecified. She serves as a foil to UA students experiencing normal life.

cardPool.title: Luminescent Baby
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Unknown

Alias:
Luminescent Baby

Quirk Name:
Luminescence

Occupation/Role:
Peace Activist, Historical Figure

Personality:
Charismatic and idealistic with unwavering conviction in peaceful coexistence. Possessed remarkable persuasive ability despite their young age, inspiring millions worldwide.

Appearance:
An infant with luminous skin capable of emitting brilliant light. Their distinctive glow drew worldwide attention and became instantly recognizable across continents.

Backstory:
Born in Qing Qing City, China, as the first officially recorded person to possess a Quirk. Their birth sparked global fascination and hope for a new era. They established a massive peace movement with over 10 million followers, advocating for safety and return to pre-Quirk society. All For One murdered them and seized their Quirk, erasing their direct influence but not their legacy.

Additional Information:
Deceased for many decades. Became a deity figure to Humarise, with an infant statue erected at their headquarters, symbolizing their enduring impact on quirk-related ideology and history.

cardPool.title: Leviathan
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Leviathan
Quirk Name: Helical Scythe
Occupation/Role: Humarise Villain
Personality: Devoted to Flect Turn's anti-Quirk cause but consumed by violent impulses when under Trigger influence; minimal distinct personality due to chemical enhancement.
Appearance: Under Trigger, a massive muscular man with bleach-white skin, black facial and forearm markings, and a brown spine of spikes. Small head with beady orange-yellow eyes and wide teeth. Spiraling red appendages extend from fingers, toes, and back, connecting to his head via tube-like structures. Wears torn black pants with brown belt. Without Trigger, fair-skinned and less muscular with smaller white spirals.
Backstory: A devoted member of Humarise deployed as a front-line operative during Flect Turn's global Trigger Bomb plot to intercept hero interference.
Additional Information: Relies heavily on Trigger drug enhancement to maximize combat effectiveness. His Helical Scythe Quirk becomes significantly more destructive when chemically augmented, allowing him to destroy barriers and wield semi-liquid appendages with lethal force.

cardPool.title: Lala Soul
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Lala Soul

Alias:
None

Quirk Name:
Unknown

Occupation/Role:
Student/Resident of Otheon Shantytown

Personality:
Kind-hearted and cheerful despite hardship, devoted to her brothers Rody and Roro. Resilient and hopeful even in poverty and ostracization. Obedient to Rody's protective instructions.

Appearance:
Small girl with brown noodle-textured hair in a high side ponytail with flower tie. Gray eyes and innocent expression. Wears a sundress with two flowers over dark leggings and slip-on sneakers.

Backstory:
Born to engineer Eddie Soul and deceased mother, raised by eldest brother Rody after their mother's death. When father abandoned them for anti-Quirk sect Humarise, the family faced ostracization, school expulsion, and homelessness in a shantytown caravan. She endured this with her siblings while maintaining her affection for them.

Additional Information:
Non-combatant civilian. Experiences Humarise's World Heroes' Mission crisis involving bombs across twenty-five countries. Reunites with Rody after his heroic actions save the city. Returns to normal school life afterward.

cardPool.title: L.A. Villains
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Red Villain (L.A. Villains)
Quirk Name: Rocket Launcher
Occupation/Role: Criminal/Villain
Personality: Selfish and greedy, willing to endanger innocents for profit. Cunning strategist who uses his Quirk to create escapes during combat.
Appearance: Slim build with blonde hair and a long, pointed nose. Wears a red skin-tight suit with white markings and large white "R" on the face mask.
Backstory: Member of L.A. Villains, a criminal duo that robbed a casino. Defeated by All Might while he studied in America.
Additional Information: Works with a six-armed blue villain. His Quirk fires two missiles from arm cannons. Arrested by Pro Heroes Elecplant and Cow Lady with All Might and David Shield.

cardPool.title: Kyudai Garaki
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Kyudai Garaki

Alias: Daruma Ujiko, Dr. Tsubasa, Doctor

Quirk Name: Life Force

Occupation/Role: Villain affiliated with the League of Villains; Chairman of Jaku General Hospital

Personality: Eccentric, deranged scientist devoted to All For One's will. Prideful of his Nomu creations, treating them as "children." Cautious and secretive, communicating through electronics to maintain anonymity. Genuinely loyal to those he deems worthy. Cowardly when threatened, prone to panic, yet capable of extreme joy over successful plans. Believes hatred strengthens individuals.

Appearance: Old man of portly, short stature with a bald head and large, bushy mustache. Wears gear-shaped goggles and a white labcoat as a villain. As hospital chairman, he wears circular black-framed glasses, a shirt and tie beneath a regular labcoat. His Quirk makes him appear younger; without it, his skin is pale and heavily wrinkled with sunken eyes.

Backstory: A disgraced scientist rejected by former colleagues, Kyudai found patronage and friendship in All For One, who believed in his unethical research.

cardPool.title: Kyotoku Jiro
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Kyotoku Jiro

Alias:
None

Quirk Name:
Earphone Jack

Occupation/Role:
Music Composer, Father

Personality:
Emotional and easygoing with a stern exterior. Supportive of his daughter's heroic ambitions. Playful and theatrical, known for his "concerned parent act."

Appearance:
A man with wavy, shoulder-length light-gold hair and triangular eyes. Casual and warm in demeanor.

Backstory:
A talented music composer who married Mika after falling in love with her musical abilities. He and his wife nurtured their daughter Kyoka's musical interests but embraced her dream of becoming a hero at UA High School.

Additional Information:
Kyotoku possesses deep knowledge of music theory and shares his daughter's love of rock music. He is a supporting parent figure who appears during UA-related family interactions.

cardPool.title: Kyoka Jiro
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Kyoka Jiro

Alias: Hearing Hero: Earphone Jack

Quirk Name: Earphone Jack

Occupation/Role: UA High School Student, Class 1-A

Personality: Pragmatic and blunt with a teasing nature. Despite appearing cold, she is genuinely friendly with close classmates and surprisingly sensitive beneath her sarcasm. Prefers intelligent approaches during hero activities and uses physical punishment via her Quirk to keep troublemakers in line.

Appearance: Petite girl with slender build, black triangular eyes with long lower eyelashes, and dark-purple asymmetrical chin-length hair with sound-wave-shaped reflections. Most distinctive are flexible plug-like earphone jacks hanging from her earlobes that function as controllable limbs. At UA she wears the standard female uniform: gray jacket with teal stripes and golden buttons over a white shirt, red tie, and teal pleated skirt.

Backstory: Training to become a hero at UA High School alongside Class 1-A. Her pragmatic worldview stems from her background, though early life details remain understated.

Additional Information: Gesticulates through her earlobes instead of hands. Best socializes with female classmates like Momo Yaoyorozu.

cardPool.title: Kurosagi
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Kurosagi
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Unknown
Occupation/Role: Former Assistant to Toy Company CEO
Personality: Greed-driven and opportunistic, willing to betray anyone for profit. Hypocritical—despises copying abilities despite producing bootlegs himself. Abandons loyalty when usefulness ends, prioritizing self-preservation.
Appearance: Adult man with short, light-colored hair and square jaw. Wears a business suit with kendama-shaped tie and square-framed shaded glasses.
Backstory: Kurosagi stole toy blueprints from his position as CEO assistant to manufacture bootlegs that flooded the market. When tasked with investigating the theft, he attempted to steal the master blueprint list and flee before Heroes intervened. He was apprehended by Phantom Thief and arrested.
Additional Information: Not a UA student. Corporate criminal with access to proprietary information. His downfall resulted from underestimating Hero involvement and the consequences of his greed.

cardPool.title: Kurogiri
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Oboro Shirakumo
Alias: Kurogiri
Quirk Name: Warp Gate
Occupation/Role: High-End Nomu and League of Villains member
Personality: Level-headed and polite, serving as a grounding force to Tomura's immaturity. Intensely loyal to his masters yet retains fragments of Oboro's caring nature, worrying about those he was programmed to protect.
Appearance: A humanoid figure of dark purple mist with glowing yellow eyes. Wears an elegant dark suit with tie and metal brace extending from collarbone to below his eyes.
Backstory: Originally Oboro Shirakumo, a U.A. High School student, before being transformed by Doctor Kyudai Garaki into a High-End Nomu. Created to serve Tomura Shigaraki under All For One's command.
Additional Information: As a Nomu, Kurogiri is programmed to obey select individuals and resist interrogation. Fragments of Oboro's original personality persist, occasionally manifesting through concern for others' safety, creating conflict between his programming and former human identity.

cardPool.title: Kuin Hachisuka
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Kuin Hachisuka

Alias: Queen Bee

Quirk Name: Queen Bee

Occupation/Role: Student (High School); Part-time Villain serving the Villain Factory

Personality: Cheerful and social facade masking sadistic, ruthless nature. Manipulative and cunning, finding entertainment in causing harm and death. Vengeful and possessive of her bee colony, which she calls her "babies."

Appearance: While possessing Tamao Oguro, wears dark green varsity jacket with white bee insignia and yellow "Queen Bee" logo, white dress shirt, and light orange bow tie. Short orange-brown hair with two small ahoge, green eyes, visibly sharp teeth. Medical patch covers missing left eye. Short blue skirt with black and orange knee-high socks and dark nail polish. True form is a bloated queen bee.

Backstory: A parasitic queen bee colony that achieved sentience and gained ability to possess human hosts. Kuin infiltrates victims' bodies and controls them entirely while maintaining appearance. Works under the Villain Factory distributing Trigger to create Instant Villains while hunting to sustain her colony through murder and theft.

cardPool.title: Kunieda
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Kunieda

Alias: None known

Quirk Name: Not specified in source material

Occupation/Role: Villain, serial killer, assassin for All For One

Personality: Pragmatic and cunning, viewing trust and hope as meaningless. Deeply sadistic with no conscience, deriving pleasure from violence and collection. Dismissive toward those he deems weak, yet shows unwavering loyalty to All For One as repayment for his freedom from Tartarus.

Appearance: A tall, skeletal man with long limbs and broad shoulders. He wears a tattered cloth hood over a triangle-patterned poncho with tassels. His face features inverted eyes with black scleras and white irises, a wide rectangular nose bridge, and a long dark mask covering his mouth. Black rolled-sleeve shirt with leather vambraces, pinstriped pants, a suit jacket worn around his hips, white dress shirt, and striped necktie-belt.

Backstory: A serial killer imprisoned in Tartarus for mass murder. Freed during All For One's prison break, Kunieda pledged absolute allegiance and joined as one of his deadliest assassins, viewing his liberation as a debt to repay.

cardPool.title: Kugo Sakamata
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Kugo Sakamata

Alias:
Aqua Hero: Gang Orca

Quirk Name:
Orcinus

Occupation/Role:
Pro Hero (No. 21), Director of Okuto Island Aquarium, Provisional License Exam Proctor

Personality:
A calm, serious hero with a menacing exterior who genuinely cares about aspiring heroes. Despite harsh teaching methods and intimidating demeanor, he enjoys mentoring students. Friendly with peers and unafraid to call out mistakes.

Appearance:
A tall, powerfully built man with killer whale features—deep white eyes with concentric red pupils and dark skin. Wears a white high-collared hero suit with diamond-shaped tooth patterns, pink tongue-like tie, and whale-like cape. Ranks third among heroes resembling villains.

Backstory:
A highly ranked Pro Hero serving as No. 21 after prior rankings of No. 10 and No. 12. Directs Okuto Island Aquarium while patrolling and teaching. Runs remedial courses for failed licensing exam candidates with strict methods.

Additional Information:
The Orcinus Quirk grants enhanced physical parameters and ability to generate paralyzing hypersonic waves for offense and defense. Effective in aquatic and land combat.

cardPool.title: Kotaro Shimura
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Kotaro Shimura
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Unknown (not manifested or undisclosed)
Occupation/Role: Civilian; Father and Husband
Personality: Resentful and controlling, harboring deep hatred for Heroes due to maternal abandonment in childhood. Emotionally and physically abusive toward his children to prevent them from pursuing Hero paths. Capable of remorse but rarely acts on these doubts. Easily manipulated by those he trusts.
Appearance: Short dark hair with a small cowlick on the right side. Wears a striped polo shirt and black pants. Average build with a stern, troubled expression.
Backstory: Son of Pro Hero Nana Shimura, placed in foster care as a child after his father's death. This abandonment festered into lifelong resentment toward Heroes. As an adult, he married Nao and had two children: Tenko and Hana. Unknown to him, the villain All For One manipulated his hatred and encouraged his abusive parenting.
Additional Information: Non-combatant civilian with no known Quirk. His abusive actions contributed to his son Tenko's tragic awakening and loss of control. Despite recognizing his destructive behavior, his cycle of violence led to his own death.

cardPool.title: Kotaba Honyakuji
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Kotoba Honyakuji
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Animal Communication
Occupation/Role: Zookeeper at Megalo-Safari
Personality: Energetic and passionate about animal welfare. Attentive and genuinely caring toward both animals and people, though cautious about human interference with natural behavior.
Appearance: A woman with black hair wearing a zoo uniform, hoodie tied at waist, work gloves, and a distinctive polka dot scarf.
Backstory: Kotoba works as a dedicated zookeeper at Megalo-Safari where her Quirk allows her to understand and communicate with animals. She assists Gang Orca in guiding UA students through team-up missions, teaching them about animal behavior and the park's topography while mediating between humans and wildlife.
Additional Information: Not a UA student. Her Quirk enables her to interpret animal communications through specialized devices. She was surprised to discover some animals can adapt to using human tools and behaviors.

cardPool.title: Kosei Tsuburaba
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Kosei Tsuburaba
Alias: Tsuburaba
Quirk Name: Solid Air
Occupation/Role: UA High School Student, Class 1-B
Personality: Enthusiastic and competitive with high standards. A reliable support player, generally mild-mannered compared to classmates.
Appearance: Young man with short auburn hair spiked at odd angles. Large oval eyes with prominent pupils. Wears a light blue high-collared jacket with black undershirt, pale pants with grey kneepads, and large brown boots.
Backstory: First-year student at UA High School training to become a Pro Hero. One of Class 1-B's pragmatic voices.
Additional Information: Solid Air allows him to solidify exhaled air into invisible walls and platforms. His Ultimate Move, Air Prison, creates soundproof barriers effective against voice-based Quirks. Functions best as a support specialist in team scenarios.

cardPool.title: Konako Haizono
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Konako Haizono

Alias: Dusty Ash

Quirk Name: Dust

Occupation/Role: Villain

Personality: Reserved and enigmatic with cunning tactical thinking. Her motivations remain unclear.

Appearance: A tall woman with a voluptuous build and long, wavy white hair in a ponytail with loose side locks. Her right eye is partially obscured by bangs. She wears a black low-cut sports bra, light purple panties, purple gloves, arm pads, black ankle boots, a thin face mask, and a large metal respirator around her neck. A utility belt with garters completes her combat gear.

Backstory: Konako emerged as a dangerous villain wielding her Dust Quirk with tactical precision. Her origins remain mysterious, though her equipment suggests long-term planning and awareness of her Quirk's limitations.

Additional Information: Her Quirk generates ash-like dust from her body, which she weaponizes by targeting opponents' sensory organs as distraction. Overuse causes dry, rough skin. She wields a ninjato-like club and relies on her dust-proof mask and metal respirator for protection during combat.

cardPool.title: Komari Ikoma
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Komari Ikoma

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Not specified

Occupation/Role: Elementary school teacher at Masegaki Primary School

Personality: Easily distressed and apologetic, struggling to maintain discipline. Despite her anxiety, she is deeply committed to her students' development and inspired by their growth. She is empathetic and cares about helping children develop safe Quirk abilities through proper counseling.

Appearance: A young woman with straight, shoulder-length dark hair and large navy blue eyes that frequently tear up. She wears a white blouse beneath a tan jacket, a long green skirt, and heeled work shoes.

Backstory: Komari teaches a rowdy class at Masegaki Primary School lacking sufficient Quirk counseling. She believes their misbehavior stems from closed hearts and inadequate emotional guidance. She arranges for them to meet aspiring heroes to inspire better behavior and show them their potential.

Additional Information: Komari is a professional educator, not a UA student. Her students were sheltered at UA during the Paranormal Liberation War crisis.

cardPool.title: Komako Masu
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Komako Masu

Alias:
None

Quirk Name:
Unknown

Occupation/Role:
UA High School Student, Department of Management

Personality:
Outgoing and charismatic with nerves of steel. A natural moodmaker focused on business and marketability of heroism rather than hero work itself. Pragmatic and observant, analyzing how heroes can be effectively promoted to society.

Appearance:
Young girl of below-average height with short, dark green hair slicked back and a single strand hanging in front. Large round eyes behind rounded glasses. Wears her UA gym uniform with a neat, put-together appearance.

Backstory:
First-year student in UA's Department of Management business course. Approaches heroism from an entrepreneurial angle. Gained attention at the UA Sports Festival for analyzing Izuku's marketability and potential as a hero brand.

Additional Information:
Often seen with classmates Ronaudo and Futo from the business course. Her business-focused perspective emphasizes the commercial and public relations aspects of professional heroism.

cardPool.title: Koku Hanabata
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Koku Hanabata

Alias: Trumpet

Quirk Name: Incite

Occupation/Role: Politician and Top Commander of the Meta Liberation Army

Personality: Calm, calculating, and manipulative. Koku is intelligent and level-headed, turning tragedy into opportunity. He is arrogant, demanding absolute respect and malicious toward those claiming equality. Fiercely loyal to his ideals yet pragmatic enough to accept new authority from those he respects.

Appearance: A man with long black hair swept back with one strand falling over his face. Thin eyebrows, small mustache, angular nose, and small feminine eyes with dark blue irises. He wears distinctive yellow glasses with purple-tinted lenses and formal business attire: white dress shirt, black tie, and black blazer.

Backstory: Koku rose to prominence as a politician leading the Hearts and Minds Party while secretly commanding the Meta Liberation Army. His dual role allowed him to influence both government and underground forces. He gained renown for exceptional leadership during military campaigns and inspiring loyalty in over 100,000 soldiers.

cardPool.title: Kojiro Bondo
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Kojiro Bondo

Alias: Plamo

Quirk Name: Cemedine

Occupation/Role: UA High School Student, Class 1-B

Personality: A gentle giant and shrinking violet who stammers despite being well-liked and easygoing. He maintains a calm demeanor despite his imposing stature.

Appearance: Tall and heavily muscular with wide shoulders, slender waist, and oversized hands. Yellow straw-colored skin with a glue-dispenser-shaped head topped with a lappet. Seven eye-holes dot his face as Quirk outlets. He wears a baggy yellow hero suit with red bottle-cap accessories at neck, wrists, waist, and ankles; white gloves and red-soled shoes; red-trimmed black squares on sleeves; and dual glue bottle emblems on his belt.

Backstory: A first-year UA High School student training to become a Pro Hero, managing his unusual appearance while harnessing his adhesive Quirk.

Additional Information: Possesses enhanced strength from his massive frame. His Cemedine Quirk sprays fast-drying adhesive from facial holes to trap enemies and bond objects, with controllable drying speed. Despite his intimidating size, he is one of the gentler personalities in his year group.

cardPool.title: Koji Koda
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Koji Koda

Alias: Petting Hero: Anima

Quirk Name: Anivoice

Occupation/Role: UA High School Student, Class 1-A

Personality: Timid and quiet, preferring sign language over speech. Kind-hearted and averse to violence. Deathly afraid of bugs despite commanding them. Gradually growing more confident, inspired by his father's courage.

Appearance: Tall young man with broad, muscular build and peach-colored skin. Head resembles an unevenly shaped rock with pointed crown and square jaw, with thick hair-like protrusions extending from the back. Wears standard UA male uniform: light gray blazer with dark turquoise trim, white dress shirt, dark blue-green pants, red tie, and brown shoes. Hero costume consists of a tight yellow suit reaching mid-thigh and mid-forearm, featuring a large red marking across the torso and mouth-like symbol on his chest.

Backstory: A UA High School student training to become a Pro Hero in Class 1-A. Inspired by his father, Koji has overcome his initial meekness through hero training, becoming more determined and vocal when his comrades need him.

cardPool.title: Koichi Haimawari
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Koichi Haimawari

Alias:
The Crawler, Nice Guy

Quirk Name:
Slide and Glide

Occupation/Role:
Vigilante, University Student

Personality:
Easy-going and mild-mannered with a heroic nature. Generous and helpful but socially awkward. Remains calm under pressure and willing to reason with criminals. Dreams of becoming a recognized hero.

Appearance:
A slim young man with short brown hair and large round brown eyes. Wears All Might-themed hoodies over black tactical gear with knee and elbow pads. Favors black sneakers with red accents. During vigilante work, wears a black medical mask and red-tinted shades.

Backstory:
Discovered his Quirk and began operating as a vigilante, helping citizens and fighting petty crime. Trained under mentor Knuckleduster and refined his methods, building confidence despite lacking official hero status. Has earned a reputation through his actions.

Additional Information:
Not a UA High School student. Operates independently as a vigilante, casually using his Quirk in public. Works various jobs while pursuing his dream of becoming a recognized hero.

cardPool.title: Koga Iga
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Koga Iga

Alias:
None

Quirk Name:
Unknown

Occupation/Role:
Aspiring Hero / Student

Personality:
Confident and cocky toward those he sees as weak, but willing to respect genuine courage or ability. Shows gratitude when others prove themselves worthy despite his arrogance.

Appearance:
A young boy with short black hair in two large bangs framing his face and a prominent strand at the back. He wears jeans with suspenders and themed ninja outfits for hero activities.

Backstory:
An aspiring hero who idolizes Pro Hero Edgeshot and dreams of becoming a ninja hero. At Hero Festa, Koga mocked Katsuma Shimano for weakness. During Edgeshot's trap house display, Koga injured his ankle but was rescued by Katsuma, leading to mutual respect and a shared promise to both become Heroes.

Additional Information:
Highly ambitious and influenced by Edgeshot's ninja-style heroics. Values courage and capability over appearances, capable of growth through positive influence.

cardPool.title: Kodama
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Kodama

Alias: Priestess of Kamino-ga-fuchi

Quirk Name: Plant Healing

Occupation/Role: Village Priestess and Guardian of the Sacred Tree

Personality: Devoted and protective, Kodama is initially suspicious of outsiders but quick to trust once proven trustworthy. She prioritizes her village and sacred tree above her own safety, displaying unwavering determination and quiet nobility.

Appearance: A young woman with short dark hair styled with side bangs and center part, secured by a light hairband adorned with leaf decorations near her ears. She wears traditional miko priestess clothing in white and red.

Backstory: Kodama serves as priestess of Kamino-ga-fuchi village, maintaining and healing the ancient Sacred Tree at its spiritual heart. When heroes visit, she initially suspects them of threatening the tree but becomes an invaluable ally during a catastrophic landslide.

Additional Information: Not a UA student; a civilian priestess with deep ties to her village. Her modest Quirk is essential to her role as protector of the Sacred Tree. Kodama demonstrates that heroism extends beyond combat—her determination and willingness to sacrifice embody heroic spirit.

cardPool.title: Kiruka Hasaki
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Kiruka Hasaki
Alias: Slice
Quirk Name: Slice
Occupation/Role: Villain
Personality: Confident and ruthless in combat, willing to threaten innocents for her goals. She shows concern for her teammates, particularly Nine, and values cooperation. She yearns for a world where power determines worth, having been ostracized by society. Vain about her appearance and hair.
Appearance: Fair-skinned young woman with inward-sloping blue eyes and full lips. Long, straight shiny red hair with chin-length bangs partially obscuring her right eye; the back reaches her thighs. She wears a pale purple blouse under a navy dress with a brown belt, dark red gloves, purple thigh-high socks, black knee-high boots with red calf binding, a black choker with red center, and a black domino mask.
Backstory: A powerful villain recruited by Nine to establish a new world order based on strength. Ostracized due to her formidable Quirk, she seeks validation through conquest and power alongside her teammates.
Additional Information: Highly skilled hand-to-hand combatant with excellent agility.

cardPool.title: Kirihito Kamachi
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Kirihito Kamachi

Alias: Kamayan

Quirk Name: Mantis

Occupation/Role: Manager at Hopper's Cafe

Personality: Not particularly intelligent but surprisingly insightful about society's treatment of mutant Quirk users. Values manners and privacy but hypocritically prejudges others with mutated bodies. Complains exaggeratedly about his condition yet maintains genuine friendships.

Appearance: Humanoid mantis form with scythe-like arms, insectoid chest, mantis abdomen, four additional legs, chitinous protuberances, and antennae. Wears waiter's uniform at the cafe.

Backstory: Ordinary person kidnapped and bio-engineered by the Villain Factory. His Quirk was artificially boosted to extreme levels through modification and Trigger drug use, forcing him into a new identity and appearance.

Additional Information: Close friends with brothers Ichiro and Jiro Hotta, who call him "Kamayan." Possesses enhanced strength capable of destroying concrete and augmented speed matching experienced fighters, though both diminish without Trigger supplementation. Easily defeated by Captain Celebrity despite enhanced abilities.

cardPool.title: Kinoko Komori
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Kinoko Komori

Alias: Shemage

Quirk Name: Mushroom

Occupation/Role: UA High School Class 1-B Student, aspiring Pro Hero

Personality: Initially shy and reserved, Kinoko grows confident and cheerful around peers. She has a gleeful obsession with mushrooms and makes puns using scientific nomenclature with affectionate honorifics. Despite her playful nature, she demonstrates genuine kindness and concern for others.

Appearance: A short, slender girl with honey-brown inward-curved hair in a mushroom-shaped bob. Long bangs cover her wide cat-like brown eyes with cross-shaped pupils. She has a large mouth and long lower eyelashes. Her hero costume features a turtleneck dress with red and white fly agaric patterns, a matching mushroom-shaped hat, furred sleeves, pale pink knee-high boots with frilled shafts, and a dark brown belt with golden buckle.

Backstory: A first-year student at UA High School training to become a Pro Hero, Kinoko struggles with social anxiety but builds confidence through combat training and teamwork. Her passion for mushrooms drives her scholarly interest and battle strategies.

cardPool.title: Kesagiri Man
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown

Alias: Kesagiri Man

Quirk Name: Enhanced Speed

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero

Personality: Quiet and composed with commanding presence. Speaks in deep, authoritative voice. Shows empathy when consoling others, remains focused during tactical discussions. Demonstrates sharp critical thinking.

Appearance: Tall, imposing figure in full-body suit of dense black fur covering everything except fingers. Sleek, predatory silhouette with deep voice suggesting maturity and professionalism.

Backstory: Experienced Pro Hero recruited by Sir Nighteye to investigate the Eight Bullets Yakuza and their connection to the League of Villains. Participates in strategic briefings and assault on the Yakuza base, using speed to neutralize threats.

Additional Information: Senior hero capable of independent field operations and tactical decision-making. Enhanced Speed allows incredible swiftness to intercept attacks and dispatch enemies quickly. Works alongside other Pro Heroes during major operations against organized crime.

cardPool.title: Kido
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Kido
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Not specified in source material
Occupation/Role: Pro Hero Sidekick at Endeavor Agency
Personality: Reserved and logical, maintaining composure in high-pressure situations. Fair-minded and treats all interns equally. Expresses quiet pride in his role and follows orders dutifully.
Appearance: Average build with gray eyes and brown hair. His entire face is covered in signature bandages with additional wrapping on arms and hands. Wears a flak jacket over a short-sleeved shirt as part of his hero costume.
Backstory: Became a Pro Hero approximately ten years before the Paranormal Liberation War. Works as one of over thirty sidekicks under Endeavor, earning respect through reliable service and calm judgment.
Additional Information: Experienced in villain apprehension and containment. Participated in the Jaku Hospital Raid and conflicts with the Paranormal Liberation Front. Survived the Decay attack during the hospital operation and continues active duty in post-war reconstruction.

cardPool.title: Kenji Tsuragamae
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Kenji Tsuragamae
Alias: Chief Tsuragamae
Quirk Name: Dog
Occupation/Role: Chief of the Police Force
Personality: Stern and rule-bound yet pragmatic, willing to bend enforcement for justice when warranted. Respectful of genuine heroism and carries himself with official dignity, though his dog-related speech tics undercut formality. Compassionate toward young heroes despite maintaining lawful order.
Appearance: An exceptionally tall, powerfully built man with the head of a beagle featuring dark brown markings around his eyes and ears separated by a tan line down his forehead, widening toward his muzzle with pale brown flecking. Large black nose, dark eyes, tan skin, and human body. Wears a formal black suit with dress shirt, waistcoat, black blazer, matching dress pants, large-buckled belt, and a black-and-white dalmatian-patterned tie.
Backstory: Rose through law enforcement to become Chief of Police after Quirks emerged. Witnessed the Police Force's initial rejection of Quirk users due to weaponization fears, allowing heroes to fill that void. Maintains strict adherence to law while understanding the moral complexities heroes face.

cardPool.title: Kenji Hikiishi
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Kenji Hikiishi
Alias: Magne
Quirk Name: Magnetism
Occupation/Role: Villain, League of Villains member
Personality: Cruel and brutal, driven by desire for freedom. Quick-thinking in combat and tactically intelligent.
Appearance: Muscular build with shoulder-length reddish-magenta hair and square jaw. Wears triangular white-framed sunglasses, dark orange unbuttoned shirt, white v-neck undershirt, blue jeans with belt, and dark brown boots.
Backstory: Hardened criminal with multiple armed robberies and murders on record. Joined the League of Villains seeking freedom from societal constraints. Skilled combatant using her Quirk with brutal efficiency.
Additional Information: Magnetism Quirk polarizes targets within 4.5-meter radius—males south, females north. Cannot magnetize herself. Carries a cloth-wrapped magnet as a weapon to draw magnetized targets. Expert at close-range combat and tactical ambushes.

cardPool.title: Kendo Rappa
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Kendo Rappa

Alias: The Rapper

Quirk Name: Strongarm

Occupation/Role: Eight Bullets member of the Shie Hassaikai

Personality: Hot-blooded and violence-driven, Kendo lives for combat and respects only strong challengers. Despite his brutality, he maintains strict honor—refusing weapons or allies when he can win alone. He shows mercy to worthy opponents.

Appearance: A massive, heavily muscular man with long light brown hair and a plague mask covering his face. He wears a tattered t-shirt beneath a light blue tunic, dark pants, and dual belts. His leather gloves feature metal-reinforced knuckles and multiple straps.

Backstory: An undefeated MMA fighter from the Underground Masquerade, Kendo caught Kai Chisaki's attention through his raw power. He sought to defeat Overhaul in single combat but was repeatedly overhauled. Now an Eight Bullets member, he pursues the ultimate fight.

Additional Information: Expert hand-to-hand combatant with cage-fighting techniques. Uses precise, rapid punches amplified by his Quirk with no openings in close-quarters duels. Effective in tag-team scenarios with defensive fighters.

cardPool.title: Ken Takagi
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Ken Takagi

Alias: Lock Hero: Rock Lock

Quirk Name: Lock Down

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero

Personality: Pragmatic and blunt, quick to judge others' competence. Critical of inexperienced students. Confident to the point of arrogance. Respects those who exceed his expectations.

Appearance: Average height man with short dark coily hair in an afro. Pierced ears with padlock earrings. Key-shaped fingertip protrusions. Yellow eye mask, red key necklace, yellow and dark green keyhole-patterned bodysuit, gray shoulder pads with keyhole designs, white boots, and brown belt with keys.

Backstory: Experienced Pro Hero with proven competence. Father to an infant son. Participated in major operations against organized crime using both his Quirk and tactical judgment.

Additional Information: His Quirk immobilizes nonliving objects he touches, freezing them in place. Can be overcome by sufficient force. Often uses thrown tiles as mobile footholds in combat. His confidence sometimes blinds him to threats, though his experience generally validates his self-assurance.

cardPool.title: Ken Ishiyama
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Ken Ishiyama
Alias: Cementoss
Quirk Name: Cement
Occupation/Role: Pro Hero and Modern Literature Teacher at UA High School
Personality: Serious yet pleasant, deeply caring about others' safety. Brave and principled in combat, willing to sacrifice for those he protects. Respectful of authority and devoted to his duties as educator and hero.
Appearance: A humanoid figure composed of gray cement with a blocky body. Black eyes with tiny pupils when opened, and gray hair in a short ponytail. Wears a sleeveless brown suit with yellow stripe accents, matching shorts, and gray shoes with yellow soles. Sturdy, imposing build.
Backstory: A seasoned Pro Hero serving on UA High's faculty, teaching Modern Literature to first-year students. Known for exceptional Quirk control and unwavering commitment to student safety.
Additional Information: His Quirk allows him to manipulate and reshape cement-based materials into various forms. Recovery Girl considers his Quirk among the most difficult to combat among UA teachers. He uses high-density weight bracelets to handicap himself when sparring with students. An admirer of All Might and keeper of his secret identity.

cardPool.title: Keigo Takami
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Keigo Takami

Alias: Wing Hero: Hawks

Quirk Name: Fierce Wings

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero (No. 2 on Hero Billboard Chart)

Personality: Highly intelligent with a deceptively carefree demeanor masking constant vigilance. Cocky and laid-back, speaking bluntly while maintaining emotional control. Follows orders with subtle cynicism, dislikes formalities, and acts unpredictably with joking submissiveness.

Appearance: Average height with slim build. Ash-blonde feathered hair swept messily back with front tufts in arcs. Golden-brown triangular eyes with black bird-like markings. Thick eyebrows, faint stubble, and square ear piercings. Hero costume features a black wavy-patterned shirt under tan shearling jacket with shoulder slits for large bright red folded wings. Black gloves, yellow-tinted visor, and yellow ear-protective headphones.

Backstory: Keigo rose to second-highest ranked Pro Hero through exceptional skill and intelligence. He operates under the Hero Public Safety Commission's direction.

Additional Information: Hawks possesses an elite Quirk granting large crimson wings enhancing aerial capabilities and speed.

cardPool.title: Kazuho Haneyama
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Kazuho Haneyama

Alias: Pop☆Step

Quirk Name: Not explicitly stated in source material

Occupation/Role: Freelance idol and former vigilante; student

Personality: Logical strategist with enthusiasm for performance and notable vanity. Fierce and sharp-tongued, quick to criticize. Secretive about vigilante activities, keeping them hidden from family. Cares deeply for companions despite harsh demeanor.

Appearance: Pink messy hair concealed by round blue-framed glasses; blue eyes. In civilian form, wears black long-sleeved seifuku with white collar, red tie and accents, white knee-high socks, and blue sneakers. As Pop☆Step, transforms into black backless leotard with pink heart-shaped chest opening, high pigtails, black mask with pink eye makeup, red bow tie, fingerless gloves, mini-skirt with purple hearts, and black knee-high boots.

Backstory: Talented vocalist leading a double life as idol and unlicensed street vigilante. Works alongside fellow vigilantes including Koichi, keeping activities secret from family. Driven by passion for entertainment and desire to help her community through unconventional means.

cardPool.title: Katsuma Shimano
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Katsuma Shimano
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Cell Activation
Occupation/Role: UA High School Student, Hero Course, Class 1-A
Personality: Timid and soft-spoken, easily influenced by his older sister despite heroic aspirations. Admires Pro Heroes and shows genuine remorse for mistakes. Selfless and brave when protecting loved ones, willing to sacrifice his own Quirk for others' safety.
Appearance: Young boy with brown eyes, curly light brown hair, and freckles. Wears UA school uniform with a yellow messenger bag, Edgeshot enamel pin, floral charm bracelet (handmade by his mother), and a sun hat with blue band.
Backstory: Originally from Nabu Island, Katsuma lived with his older sister Mahoro before enrolling at UA. He idolizes heroes and dreams of becoming one. When a villain named Nine invaded his island, Katsuma bravely protected his sister, cementing his resolve to walk the hero path.
Additional Information: His Cell Activation Quirk heals wounds and enhances physical performance through cellular stimulation via touch, but drains stamina with extended use.

cardPool.title: Kashiko Sekigai
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Kashiko Sekigai
Alias: Sensor Girl
Quirk Name: Holographic Map
Occupation/Role: Isami Academy High School Student, Class President
Personality: Responsible and level-headed with strong leadership qualities. Uninterested in casual romantic advances.
Appearance: Petite girl with round face and periwinkle-blue shoulder-length hair with inward-curling bangs. Gray eyes behind thick-framed triangular glasses. Wears Isami High uniform: white dress shirt, dark red bow tie, dark blue blazer, pleated gray skirt, socks, and brown loafers.
Backstory: Trusted Class President at Isami Academy earned through reliability and tactical thinking. Her Quirk makes her invaluable for reconnaissance and coordination.
Additional Information: Hero costume features navy turtleneck bodysuit with geometric patterns, shoulder-pads marked "S," visor, red gloves, wrist-mounted radar screens, and thigh-high boots. Participated in class team during Quirk Apprehension Test arc.

cardPool.title: Kameko
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Kameko
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Unnamed Tortoise Quirk
Occupation/Role: Hero School Student (Hiroshima)
Personality: Loyal and cautious friend who restrains impulsive companion Rumi; level-headed despite her tortoise-like nature.
