Appearance: Young woman with tortoise characteristics including a visible shell on her back, dark hair, small round eyes, and minimal nose. She maintains a humanoid form despite her reptilian features.
Backstory: A student at a Hiroshima hero school who befriended Rumi Usagiyama and Sameko. During a school trip to Osaka's Tsutenkaku Tower, the trio became lost before encountering a young Fat Gum for directions. Kameko witnessed Rumi's impulsive nature when she abandoned the group to investigate a nearby battle.
Additional Information: Not a UA High School student. Her Quirk grants tortoise attributes. She values her friendships and serves as her friend group's voice of reason.

cardPool.title: Kashiko Kashi
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Kashiko Kashi

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Unknown

Occupation/Role: Prison Escapee, Criminal

Personality: Pragmatic and calculating, Kashiko chooses to lie low rather than cause chaos. He views himself as intellectually superior to criminals who attract attention and possesses a cynical worldview. Despite his dark past, he finds contentment in quietude and smiles at the prospect of a peaceful suburban life.

Appearance: A young man with long, spiky orange hair. He has small, piercing pupils and wears earrings. His casual attire is simple and unremarkable, reflecting his fugitive status.

Backstory: Imprisoned for robbery and murder, Kashiko was freed during the chaos following the Paranormal Liberation War. Rather than joining other escapees in wreaking havoc, he sought refuge in an abandoned suburban home with a partner, believing society's collapse provided the perfect opportunity to disappear undetected.

Additional Information: Kashiko's Quirk remains unknown. He was killed by a corrupted Tomura Shigaraki who attempted to steal his Quirk to safely store the New Order ability. His body was later discovered by Endeavor, Hawks, and Best Jeanist.

cardPool.title: Kaoruko Awata
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Kaoruko Awata

Alias: Bubble Girl

Quirk Name: Bubble

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero Sidekick at Sir Nighteye's Hero Office

Personality: Serious and dedicated professional who remains composed under pressure and loyal to her work despite frequent threats of dismissal.

Appearance: Fair-skinned young woman with light blue complexion and short, ruffled dark blue hair parted to the right. She has wide yellow eyes with thick eyelashes. Her hero costume includes a dark blue crop top with white high collar and central zipper, black tights with white shorts marked by yellow stripes, and thick white boots with yellow rings. She wears a transparent visor with dual air filters and dark blue gloves.

Backstory: A dedicated sidekick working under Pro Hero Sir Nighteye, Kaoruko has built her career mastering her aromatic bubble abilities. She maintains her position despite her boss's temperamental management style, demonstrating strong resolve and commitment to hero work.

Additional Information: Kaoruko's Bubble Quirk enables her to generate bubbles filled with any aroma she has previously smelled, including pleasant and foul odors.

cardPool.title: Kamile Gollini
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Kamile Gollini
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Spatial Excursion
Occupation/Role: Member of the Gollini Family mafia
Personality: Devious and sadistic with a wicked smile, Kamile delights in tormenting enemies. Ruthless and merciless, yet lazy, preferring tea and pie while others fight. Loyal to Dark Might but quick to abandon when facing defeat.
Appearance: A short, elderly man with pale wrinkled skin and pronounced upper body. His large beaked nose, sharp chin, and white split-end hair are striking features. He dresses as a butler in a red tailcoat, white gloves, green neckcloth, navy-gray pants, and buckled shoes, adorned with a rose.
Backstory: A seasoned member of the Gollini Family criminal organization and trusted aide to Dark Might. Participated in schemes involving Symbol of Paradise fortress and target captures.
Additional Information: Not a UA student. His Quirk moves objects and people freely without gravity restrictions. When enhanced by Anna's Overmodification Quirk, his range expands to relocate entire structures. Defeated by Mirio during the fortress collapse.

cardPool.title: Kai Chisaki
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Kai Chisaki
Alias: Overhaul
Quirk Name: Overhaul
Occupation/Role: Villain, Leader of the Shie Hassaikai Yakuza organization
Personality: A mysophobic sociopath with an enormous ego and no moral compass. Despite obsessing over eradicating Quirks, he relies entirely on his own Quirk. Outwardly polite and strategic, but fundamentally manipulative and convinced he alone understands Quirks as humanity's plague.
Appearance: A pale young man with narrow build, short shaggy auburn hair parted right, small gold irises, and three left ear piercings. He wears a magenta plague doctor mask embroidered with gold, white surgical gloves, black dress shirt and pants with pale gray tie, dark olive-green bomber jacket with purple fur collar, and white lace-up sneakers.
Backstory: Driven by mysophobia and a discredited theory linking Quirks to rats, Kai became obsessed with returning the world to its pre-Quirk state. He rose to leadership of the Shie Hassaikai, believing only he possesses the enlightenment to reshape society according to his vision.
Additional Information: Kai operates through meticulous planning rather than brute force.

cardPool.title: Kagero Okuta
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Kagero Okuta

Alias: Giran

Quirk Name: Muddied

Occupation/Role: Villain broker and scout for the League of Villains

Personality: Indifferent and profit-driven with a constant smirk masking his calculating nature. Refuses lucrative deals with those he dislikes and protects client confidentiality even under torture. Shows unexpected kindness toward outcasts, offering genuine counsel when warranted. Eccentric tastes evident in his bunny-eared phone case and habit of lighting cigarettes with gunfire.

Appearance: Middle-aged man with moderate height and slight build. Notable squinted pink eyes, drawn-up eyebrows, short gray hair parted right with side bangs, thin mustache, small goatee, and gap-toothed grin. Wears matching dress pants and blazer over partially unbuttoned black shirt and plain black shoes. Thick golden segmented tube necklace, occasionally paired with intestine-shaped fluffy scarf. Circular glasses frame his face with cigarette frequently dangling from his lips.

Backstory: Built reputation as well-known underworld figure and the League of Villains' premier scout and supplier of illegal goods.

cardPool.title: Juzo Moashi
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Juzo Moashi

Alias: Centipeder

Quirk Name: Centipede

Occupation/Role: Sidekick at Sir Nighteye's Hero Office

Personality: A gentleman of impeccable manners and refined conduct. He is disciplined and loyal to his mentor's ideals.

Appearance: A tall, lean man with a distinctive centipede-like face of brown coloration. His most striking feature is his elongated centipede neck draped across his shoulders. He dresses formally in a black tuxedo.

Backstory: Juzo serves as a dedicated sidekick under Sir Nighteye's mentorship, learning heroism within the agency and being groomed as a potential successor.

Additional Information: Juzo's centipede-like limbs grant him exceptional reach and versatility in combat, allowing him to attack and restrain opponents from considerable distances. His refined demeanor and physical abilities make him a capable and trustworthy member of Sir Nighteye's team.

cardPool.title: Juzo Honenuki
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Juzo Honenuki

Alias:
Mudman

Quirk Name:
Softening

Occupation/Role:
Class 1-B Student at U.A. High School

Personality:
Calm and understanding with excellent judgment. Dislikes losing but respects deserved victories. Demonstrates flexible thinking in strategy and genuinely cares about classmates. Acknowledges needing more stubbornness to overcome unfavorable conditions.

Appearance:
Pale-skinned young man with angular eyes, mid-length spiky beige hair, and a flat nose. Most distinctive feature is protruding teeth with no visible lips, creating a skull-like appearance. Wears dark bodysuit under orange and black armor plating with rounded black helmet featuring white visor lines. Orange-accented vambraces, green boots with pipe-like shafts, and white gloves complete his hero costume.

Backstory:
Earned his place at U.A. through official recommendation. His Quirk allows him to soften any material into mud-like substances with remarkable control and precision.

Additional Information:
Recommended student with exceptional reflexes and battle awareness. Excels at controlling terrain through his Quirk to restrict enemy movement and dictate combat flow.

cardPool.title: Jurota Shishida
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Jurota Shishida
Alias: Gevaudan
Quirk Name: Beast
Occupation/Role: UA High School Student, Class 1-B
Personality: Intellectually refined and formally polite due to his well-mannered upbringing. When transformed, he becomes boisterous and energetic. He admires Hound Dog's freedom but feels constrained by propriety. Despite his bestial nature, he retains sharp tactical thinking even in Beast form.
Appearance: A tall young man with shaggy brown hair covering most of his body and sharp, prominent teeth with two lower canines protruding. He wears small rectangular glasses with thick black lenses. His hero costume features dark brown fur-lined boots, a shirt collar worn alone, and stylized goggles.
Backstory: Raised in a doting, well-mannered family that instilled formality and propriety in him. He developed his Beast Quirk early and trained at UA to become a Pro Hero, becoming one of Class 1-B's strongest members through disciplined control and strategic application of his power.
Additional Information: Transforms into a massive beast-man with increased size, thicker hair, and pronounced fangs. In this form, he runs on all fours and possesses incredible physical strength.

cardPool.title: Jube Namimaru
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Jube Namimaru
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Wooden Swords From His Hands
Occupation/Role: Middle School Student
Personality: Appears intimidating due to his delinquent style, but is genuinely kind and friendly to friends. Devoted Pop☆Step fan who aids vigilantes against Trigger drug distribution.
Appearance: Short, stocky middle schooler with prominent chops. Wears a black jacket with torn, folded sleeves over a white t-shirt, black pants, and sandals. Black cap with x-shaped buckle, torn at the back, giving him a rough Yankii aesthetic.
Backstory: A middle school student in the underground hero world through vigilante associations. Inspired by Pop☆Step, Jube uses his combat abilities to fight Trigger drug proliferation in his community.
Additional Information: Not a UA student; operates as a civilian vigilante supporter. His Quirk produces wooden swords from his wrists roughly the length of his arms. He represents civilian heroism outside formal hero training systems.

cardPool.title: Joi Irinaka
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Joi Irinaka

Alias:
Mimic

Quirk Name:
Mimicry

Occupation/Role:
General Manager of Shie Hassaikai, Yakuza member

Personality:
Hot-tempered and volatile, allowing anger to override strategy. Fiercely loyal to Overhaul and quick to rage at disrespect. Despite aggression, he demonstrates cunning in combat and competence managing finances and operations.

Appearance:
A tall, muscular man with pointed features including a spiked nose, long square chin, and large mouth. Long spiky blonde hair with matching goatee. Typically wears a black dress shirt with pinstriped pants and suspenders. When using his Quirk, he inhabits a small black cloak-like bodysuit and wears a white plague mask.

Backstory:
A high-ranking Shie Hassaikai member risen to general manager, overseeing financial and administrative duties. His unwavering loyalty to Overhaul defines his role within the yakuza hierarchy. He participates in key organizational decisions and conflicts, including negotiations with the League of Villains.

Additional Information:
Not a UA student.

cardPool.title: Johnny
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Johnny

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Warping

Occupation/Role: Nomu experiment subject; teleportation device under Daruma Ujiko's control

Personality: Minimal documented personality; appears docile and content; behavior heavily influenced by external control rather than independent agency.

Appearance: A small Nomu with dark skin, round eyes, and exposed brain tissue. Lower body replaced by a thick cable connecting to his torso. Wears pale lace-up shoes on upper limbs and a transparent helmet with mechanical protrusions; one serves as a manual Quirk activator.

Backstory: Created as a Nomu by Daruma Ujiko and imprisoned in a secret laboratory, Johnny was engineered to serve as a living teleportation apparatus under his creator's command rather than as an independent individual.

Additional Information: Johnny can only teleport individuals to and from his own location; requires a familiar person at the destination as an anchor point. Overuse causes tonsillitis. His Quirk is manually operated through his helmet device by Daruma, leaving Johnny with little autonomous control over his own abilities.

cardPool.title: Jiro Hotta
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Jiro Hotta

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Grasshopper

Occupation/Role: Trigger dealer and manager of Hopper's Cafe

Personality: Pragmatic and morally ambiguous, Jiro maintains ethics within his criminal enterprise—refusing adulterated Trigger despite profitability. Easily frustrated by interference in his business but loyal to friends. He balances self-interest with genuine concern for those close to him.

Appearance: Average-height man with pale brown hair, tanned skin, sharp eyes with small black pupils, and a goatee. He wears an open white hoodie with hood up, grey pants, white sneakers, blue apron, and an orange-yellow bandanna around his neck—the only garment surviving his transformations.

Backstory: Jiro operates as a Trigger dealer with his brother Ichiro through Hopper's Cafe. He refuses to distribute dangerous adulterated versions of the drug. His frustration with heroes using his establishment as a base drives much of his motivation.

Additional Information: When injected with legal Trigger, Jiro transforms into a large humanoid grasshopper with increased muscle mass, chitinous exoskeleton, and an insect-like head with jaws, antennae, and compound eyes.

cardPool.title: Jin Bubaigawara
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Jin Bubaigawara

Alias: Twice

Quirk Name: Double

Occupation/Role: Villain, League of Villains member, Vanguard Action Squad operative

Personality: Explosively manic and contradictory, Jin shifts between opposing statements with chaotic energy. Severe dissociative disorder and identity fragmentation from a nine-day conflict with his clones leaves him unsure of his originality. He craves acceptance desperately, making him loyal but vulnerable to betrayal. Without his mask, his fractured personalities argue; with it, he appears unified. His mental instability drives him between humor and aggression.

Appearance: Well-built man with shoulder-length blond hair and gray-blue eyes lacking eyebrows. Sparse facial hair above mouth and chin. Black-and-gray bodysuit with gray "T" and "W" patterns on chest. Red wristbands with green accents store measuring tapes. Dual-toned mask features gray upper half with white eye sockets and black lower half covering mouth.

Backstory: Jin created clones seeking companionship, enduring a traumatic nine-day conflict that questioned his existence.

cardPool.title: Iyaro Tenba
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Iyaro Tenba

Alias:
None

Quirk Name:
Multiple Arms

Occupation/Role:
Villain/Criminal

Personality:
Ruthless and violent, willing to kill without hesitation. Shows no regard for human life, treating victims as obstacles.

Appearance:
Muscular man of average height with short brown hair and round glasses. Wears gray tank top and green pants. Two extra sets of arms sprout from his back due to his Quirk.

Backstory:
Released from prison, Iyaro embarked on a two-month spree of armed robberies and murders across multiple locations. His escalating violence earned him high-priority villain status before being eliminated by Vigilante Stendhal.

Additional Information:
Iyaro's body was abandoned in an alley. He represents the dangerous criminal element in the underground villain network of the My Hero Academia universe.

cardPool.title: Iwao Oguro
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Iwao Oguro

Alias: Knuckleduster

Quirk Name: Overclock

Occupation/Role: Vigilante, former Pro Hero (High-Speed Hero: O'Clock)

Personality: Driven by an unwavering sense of justice, Knuckleduster is direct and aggressive, preferring action over deliberation. He thrives on challenging fights and grows bored with easy victories. Though reckless and violence-prone, he possesses surprising intelligence and perceptiveness. He shows no resentment toward Quirkless individuals and genuinely admires Heroes despite operating outside the law.

Appearance: A tall, heavily muscled man with short black hair, thick eyebrows, and heavy stubble. He wears a loose black ragged wrap-around mask, tight black shirt, khaki military pants with black belt, black boots, and a long hunter green trench coat. Black gloves topped with silver knuckledusters complete his outfit.

Backstory: Once a licensed Pro Hero, Oguro's Quirk was stolen by All For One, rendering him Quirkless. Rather than abandon his mission, he became a vigilante, patrolling his neighborhood each night to combat street-level crime and gangs that professional Heroes ignore.

cardPool.title: Itsuka Kendo
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Itsuka Kendo

Alias: Battle Fist

Quirk Name: Big Fist

Occupation/Role: UA High School Student, Class 1-B Representative

Personality: Spirited and thoughtful, Itsuka is Class 1-B's compassionate leader who corrects others when needed. She's analytical in combat, friendly across class lines, and willing to sacrifice for teammates. Despite her stern discipline, she holds no ill-will toward rivals and shows genuine concern for others.

Appearance: Medium height with slim build, sharp teal eyes with white pupils, and long orange hair in a high left-side ponytail with three-clump bangs. She wears a teal knee-length qipao with yellow accents over a black corset, black shorts, brown utility belt, thin black domino mask, and navy heeled boots with white trim.

Backstory: A natural leader and capable combatant, Itsuka earned 5th place in the UA Entrance Exam. Chosen as Class 1-B's representative, she balances competitive ambition with genuine kindness toward fellow heroes-in-training.

Additional Information: Itsuka's Big Fist Quirk enlarges her hands for devastating close-range attacks and utility—restraining criminals or protecting allies.

cardPool.title: Itejiro Toteki
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Itejiro Toteki

Alias: Boomerang Man

Quirk Name: Boomerang

Occupation/Role: Third-year student at Ketsubutsu Academy High School

Personality: Reserved and shy, but confident in his abilities. Maintains graceful composure though apologetic about his power usage.

Appearance: Young man with small black oval eyes, small mouth, and round nose. Wavy shoulder-length black hair pushed back at the forehead. Wears a black shirt with elbow-length sleeves, black capri pants with tights, and black sneakers. Accessorized with a wide red scarf, thin red wristbands, and dark red fingerless gloves.

Backstory: Training to become a Pro Hero at Ketsubutsu. Participated in the Provisional Hero License Exam as a second-year against Class 1-A. Demonstrated exceptional accuracy with projectile-throwing.

Additional Information: Known for precise combat tactics and cooperative teamwork. Excels in coordinated rescue operations.

cardPool.title: Invisible Wall
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown

Alias: Invisible Wall

Quirk Name: Chameleon

Occupation/Role: Villain, League of Villains recruit

Personality: Cunning and deceptive in combat, but arrogant and quick to underestimate opponents. Mocks foes mid-battle, relying too heavily on camouflage advantage.

Appearance: Tall and scrawny with bright green, scaly skin. Reptilian head with prominent spikes, large bulbous independent eyes, and elongated tongue. Wears black bodysuit, black sneakers, and communications headset.

Backstory: Minor villain recruited by Tomura Shigaraki for the U.S.J. assault. Attempted to ambush Bakugo and Kirishima by leaping from the ceiling while camouflaged, but was immediately defeated by a direct explosion to the head. Arrested after Pro Heroes arrived.

Additional Information: Specializes in stealth attacks using camouflage and wall-climbing. Carries a knife as primary weapon with basic proficiency. Overconfidence in his Quirk proved fatal against faster opponents.

cardPool.title: Innsmouth
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Innsmouth
Alias: None documented
Quirk Name: Octopus
Occupation/Role: Petty criminal and cargo smuggler
Personality: Greedy and ruthless, willing to use hostages and underhanded tactics. Highly aggressive when opposed, escalating to violence without hesitation.
Appearance: A semi-anthropomorphic octopus with reddish-dull bumpy skin. His head resembles an octopus mantle with ridges above his eyes and no visible nose. A trunk-like mouth with three suction cups on each side extends forward. Two prehensile tentacles flank the trunk, while four boneless arms have suction cups at shoulder, elbow, and wrist. He wears grey pants, red pointed-toe boots, a brown leather belt, a maroon sleeveless coat, and a red scarf as a hood, plus watches and bracelets.
Backstory: An independent smuggler involved in illegal drug trafficking who works with accomplices called his brothers. He coordinates cargo theft and contraband distribution. He has been arrested after confrontations with law enforcement.
Additional Information: Possesses enhanced strength to lift adults and strike rock and metal. Can lengthen and weaponize his tentacles in combat. Capable of secreting ink to blind opponents.

cardPool.title: Inko Midoriya
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Inko Midoriya

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Object Attraction

Occupation/Role: Homemaker, Mother of UA Student Izuku Midoriya

Personality: Kind and supportive, though prone to worry and panic that leads to fainting. She cries dramatically when emotional and shares her son's anxious tendencies. Protective and selfless, feeling guilty about her son's hardships.

Appearance: A woman in her late thirties with shoulder-length dark green hair and a small spiky ponytail. She has large, circular dark green eyes like her son's. She has a gentle, motherly quality.

Backstory: Inko is the devoted wife of Hisashi Midoriya and mother to Izuku. When her son was diagnosed as Quirkless, she felt overwhelming guilt. After Izuku gained his Quirk and was accepted to UA High School, she initially doubted the school's safety but came to support his heroic aspirations after All Might's assurance.

Additional Information: Skilled at tailoring and sewing; handcrafted Izuku's first hero costume. Her Quirk allows her to pull small objects toward herself from a distance. She remains hesitant about UA's dormitory system due to protective concerns for her son.

cardPool.title: Inasa Yoarashi
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Inasa Yoarashi
Alias: Gale Force
Quirk Name: Whirlwind
Occupation/Role: First-year student at Shiketsu High School
Personality: Energetic and exuberant, Inasa expresses himself with loud vigor and formal politeness. He believes passion is the core of heroism and despises those with "cold eyes." Pure-hearted beneath his boisterous exterior, he holds deep grudges against those he perceives as lacking passion, particularly Endeavor and Shoto Todoroki.
Appearance: A tall, well-built young man with buzzed dark brown hair and black eyes. He wears the standard Shiketsu uniform with the school's signature hat. His hero costume features a burgundy suit with yellow buttons, fur-collared cape, and jetpack-like propulsion on his back. His left arm is concealed in thick brown material with a tan glove featuring air pipes on the knuckles. Tubes run along his torso and ankles for wind expulsion, and he wears knee and shoulder pads resembling gas masks.
Backstory: Originally the top-recommended student for U.A. High School, Inasa withdrew his application and enrolled at Shiketsu instead.

cardPool.title: Ikkaku
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Ikkaku
Alias: Future Hero
Quirk Name: Horn
Occupation/Role: Student at Terakoya Private Hero School
Personality: Jovial, energetic prankster who craves attention and approval. Idolizes flashy heroes and looks down on modest Quirks, masking inferiority about his own abilities. Impulsive and mischievous, frequently scolded by teachers.
Appearance: A boy with long spiky hair covering his right eye and a prominent horn from his Quirk. Wears a short-sleeved shirt over a long-sleeved dark shirt, dark shorts, two small fanny packs, and a spotted neckerchief.
Backstory: A student dreaming of becoming a celebrated hero. Ikkaku doubts his unremarkable Quirk and compensates through pranks and boasting, believing true heroes need spectacular abilities and flashy Ultimate Moves rather than steady training.
Additional Information: Ikkaku's horn grants heightened sensory perception to detect vibrations and environmental changes. He has talent for crafting traps and obstacles. His perspective on heroism shifts after witnessing Mashirao Ojiro's competence, suggesting capacity for growth.

cardPool.title: Ikajiro Takobe
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Ikajiro Takobe

Alias: Octoid

Quirk Name: Octopus

Occupation/Role: Former Next-Level Villain, currently reforming

Personality: Once a violent brute under Trigger influence, Ikajiro is now kind and educated with deep regrets. He is apologetic, sensitive, and gentle—he loves cats and shows genuine remorse for past harm.

Appearance: A tall, muscular humanoid with jet-black skin and no hair. Six powerful arms line his torso, each covered in suction cups; two additional tentacles remain hidden within his body. His face is nearly featureless with faint lines concealing tiny eyes. He wears tank tops, shorts, foam clogs, and colored durags.

Backstory: Ikajiro was physically modified by the Villain Factory and enhanced with Trigger, becoming a mindless instrument of destruction. After the drug wore off and he regained consciousness, his true gentle nature emerged, leaving him horrified by his actions.

Additional Information: Possesses superhuman strength, speed, and durability from bio-engineering. His Quirk grants cephalopod attributes, making him exceptionally powerful. He seeks redemption and can be reasoned with once freed from chemical influence.

cardPool.title: Ichiro Hotta
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Ichiro Hotta
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Grasshopper
Occupation/Role: Trigger dealer and manager of Hopper's Cafe
Personality: Pragmatic business-minded man with underlying moral code; frustrated by unwanted interference but loyal to friends; protective of his reputation as a respectable dealer.
Appearance: Average-height man with pale brown hair showing early baldness, tanned skin, sharp eyes with small black pupils, light goatee, and small forehead bump. Wears backwards red cricket cap, green hoodie, black pants, white sneakers, white apron, and yellow bandanna around neck. When using Trigger, transforms into large humanoid grasshopper with chitinous exoskeleton, compound eyes, antennae, and powerful jaws.
Backstory: Drug dealer operating with brother Jiro at Hopper's Cafe. Ichiro deals exclusively in legal Trigger formulations to avoid dangerous black-market additives. Takes pride in his respectable racket despite its illegality and grows frustrated when heroes use his cafe as a meeting place or hideout.
Additional Information: Carries Trigger samples for self-enhancement in combat. His legal Trigger provides moderate power boosts without cognitive side effects.

cardPool.title: Ichimoku Samazu
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Ichimoku Samazu
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Beams From His Eyes
Occupation/Role: Middle School Student
Personality: Kind and polite despite intimidating appearance; devoted Pop☆Step fan; helps vigilantes combat crime and Trigger distribution.
Appearance: Tall middle schooler with short black hair in a pompadour and small moustache. Wears modified goggles with side mufflers and central slit visor to control his Quirk. Dressed in delinquent style: black gakuran, black shoes, and armlet completing his Yankii aesthetic.
Backstory: A delinquent-styled middle schooler with a good heart. Inspired by Pop☆Step, he joined vigilante efforts against Trigger distribution in his community.
Additional Information: Not a UA High School student. His visor goggles are essential for controlling eye beam output in combat.

cardPool.title: Ichi Anrakuki
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Ichi Anrakuki
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Static
Occupation/Role: Prisoner at Mikuzu Prison
Personality: Serious and embittered by betrayal, yet capable of kindness. Initially cynical about redemption, gradually rekindled to hope through witnessing genuine selflessness. Polite despite despair.
Appearance: Adult man with short black hair and perpetually scowling face. Wears standard prison clothing. Stern expression reflects years of hardship.
Backstory: Coerced into falsifying financial statements at a tech startup and framed by a trusted friend, Ichi was imprisoned for fraud. After release, unable to find employment as an ex-convict, he became homeless. Upon discovering his former friend's success, he attacked him and was re-incarcerated for assault. Now serving his second sentence, he has surrendered to despair—until meeting Danjuro Tobita's unwavering optimism.
Additional Information: Holds a mechanic certification earned during first imprisonment. His Quirk, Static, generates electrical discharge. He shows deep capacity for loyalty and willingness to sacrifice for those who show him compassion.

cardPool.title: Hoyo Makihara
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Hoyo Makihara

Alias: Mummy

Quirk Name: Mummification

Occupation/Role: Villain, member of Nine's criminal organization

Personality: Apathetic and merciless with no remorse. Highly cautious and tactical, preferring to control the battlefield through preparation rather than direct confrontation. Demonstrates calculated intelligence in attrition-based strategies.

Appearance: A tall, lanky man with pale orange, baggy forward-slanting eyes and straight gray hair. His entire body is wrapped in burgundy-colored bandages except for his hands and eyes. He wears a dark gray combat vest, light gray skin-tight pants with beige knee guards, black fingerless gloves, and grey dress shoes. A brown garter belt holds pouches, and he carries a small sword on his left shoulder.

Backstory: A skilled villain recruited into Nine's organization for the Nabu Island operation. Hoyo participated in attacking an urban settlement, overwhelming inexperienced UA students before being defeated by Bakugo's explosive counterattack.

Additional Information: Exceptionally proficient with his Quirk, capable of simultaneously controlling over a dozen mummified objects as combat puppets.

cardPool.title: Hokuto Hario
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Hokuto Hario

Alias: Compass Kid

Quirk Name: Pointer

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero (Lower-class rank)

Personality: Optimistic and amicable, Hokuto values his work bringing peace to civilians. He deeply loves his family and desires to be a hero they admire. His trusting nature makes him vulnerable to deception.

Appearance: A middle-aged man with small circular eyes, large chin, and short black hair parted left. His hero costume is a slightly-too-small bodysuit with exposed stomach, fastened by a C-shaped belt buckle. An eight-wind compass rose adorns the chest. He wears light gloves, a light cape, and dark boots decorated with arrows. A small domino mask with arrow eyebrows completes the look.

Backstory: Hokuto became a pro hero to protect civilians and be a role model for his children. During a patrol with hero Rock, he discovered Rock's true villainous identity while investigating attacks. His moral conviction led him to confront this betrayal, though it cost him his life.

Additional Information: Pointer requires Hokuto to spin to activate, allowing him to point toward targets in up to three directions simultaneously.

cardPool.title: Hisashi Midoriya
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Hisashi Midoriya
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Fire Breath
Occupation/Role: Businessman (abroad)
Personality: Unknown; absent from his son's life, suggesting either work dedication or emotional distance.
Appearance: Adult male with features potentially inherited by his son Izuku.
Backstory: Married Inko and fathered Izuku before taking a work post abroad. His whereabouts remain mysterious.
Additional Information: Not a UA student. His Fire Breath Quirk contrasts with his son's lack of a Quirk. Prolonged absence suggests no direct involvement in current UA events.

cardPool.title: Hiroshi Tameda
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Hiroshi Tameda

Alias:
"Can't You See?" Kid

Quirk Name:
Not specified

Occupation/Role:
Civilian/Endeavor Fan

Personality:
Passionate Endeavor fan who admires his determination. Initially naive but emotionally invested in hero society; prone to dramatic swings when beliefs are challenged. Remains fundamentally supportive and hopeful despite setbacks.

Appearance:
Plain young man of average height with distinctive spiky pink hair and large brown eyes. Youthful civilian clothing, clean-faced with no distinguishing marks.

Backstory:
Ordinary civilian devoted to Pro Hero Endeavor, admiring his pursuit of excellence. Became emotionally turbulent learning of Endeavor's abusive past through Dabi's broadcast. Experienced hero society's collapse from evacuation centers, his faith tested repeatedly.

Additional Information:
Not a UA student. Became an internet meme interrupting live broadcast to defend Endeavor during the High-End battle. Represents the civilian perspective on hero society's moral complexities and the emotional toll of hero worship during societal upheaval.

cardPool.title: Hiryu Rin
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Hiryu Rin
Alias: Long Weizi
Quirk Name: Scales
Occupation/Role: UA High School Class 1-B Student
Personality: Collaborative fighter with severe demeanor in combat, diligent in academics and Quirk mastery, strategic intellect with quick reflexes.
Appearance: Lightly tanned skin with black hair in a low braid; reptilian eyes with small irises. Wears high-collared black bodysuit with yellow clouds across torso, white knee-high boots with yellow straps, red belt with brown pouches, large yellow gauntlets with black sleeves, and yellow visor resembling a talisman.
Backstory: Class 1-B student training to become a Pro Hero at UA High School. Distinguished through strategic thinking and combat versatility, earning peer respect through collaboration.
Additional Information: Excels in close and long-range combat through scale projection with terrific accuracy and sharp tactical awareness. Scale armor has durability limitations against sufficient force. Specialized Scale Gauntlets enhance ranged offensive capability.

cardPool.title: Hizashi Yamada
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Hizashi Yamada

Alias: Voice Hero: Present Mic

Quirk Name: Voice

Occupation/Role: English Teacher at UA High School / Pro Hero (No. 45)

Personality: An eccentric, high-energy entertainer with a radio host persona who constantly poses and exaggerates events for hype. Despite his jovial nature, he harbors deep loyalty to friends and intense rage when betrayed. He suffers from entomophobia and prefers urban areas to forests.

Appearance: A tall, slim man with long blond hair spiked upward, small brown mustache, and rectangular eyes with greenish-yellow irises. He wears orange-tinted shades and black headphones labeled "HAGE." His hero costume consists of a black studded jacket with tall collar, black pants and knee-high boots, tan shoulder pads, red studded belt and elbow pads, black fingerless gloves, and a directional speaker around his neck.

Backstory: A Pro Hero and former UA High School student, Hizashi teaches English while maintaining his hero career. He shares a tragic history with classmate Shota Aizawa involving their deceased friend Oboro Shirakumo.

Additional Information: Known for commentating events and bringing entertainment value to situations.

cardPool.title: Himiko Toga
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Himiko Toga

Alias:
Toga

Quirk Name:
Transform

Occupation/Role:
UA High School Student (Class 1-A); Member of the League of Villains

Personality:
Cheerful and sadistic with twisted views on love, seeing absorption of others as intimacy. Mentally unstable and easily shifts between playful affection and dangerous aggression. Prone to excited blushing rather than embarrassment.

Appearance:
Fair-skinned girl with distinctive inward-tilting yellow cat-like eyes, thin slit pupils, and bags beneath them. Sharp canines give her a vampiric look. Pale ash-blonde hair in two messy buns with wild strands and chin-length side bangs. Wears a dark blue seifuku with white trim, red scarf, oversized beige cardigan, knee-length black socks, and dark brown school shoes.

Backstory:
A UA student with a dual life in the League of Villains. Her Quirk allows her to assume others' appearances after consuming their blood, which she views as love rather than predation. Her fractured mental state stems from childhood isolation due to her unusual nature.

Additional Information:
Combat-ready despite student status, carrying concealed blades and blood extraction equipment.

cardPool.title: Hime
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Hime

Alias:
None

Quirk Name:
Unknown

Occupation/Role:
Civilian Child

Personality:
Cheeky and demanding, Hime speaks her mind without hesitation. She quickly develops crushes and expresses gratitude readily. Her romantic inclinations drive her actions, though she remains earnest and endearing.

Appearance:
A small girl with short, slightly curly light hair held back by a black headband with butterfly motifs. She dresses sophisticatedly despite her youthful, petite frame.

Backstory:
While walking in Osaka, Hime was attacked by the Octo-Lover's Brigade. A slender hero rescued her, and she became infatuated. Unable to identify him, she requested help from the Fat Gum Agency, launching an investigation involving UA students Tamaki Amajiki, Tenya Ida, and Momo Yaoyorozu.

Additional Information:
Hime discovered her "prince" was Fat Gum in his muscular form. She was delighted to meet him again and requested he maintain his slender appearance instead.

cardPool.title: Higari Maijima
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Higari Maijima

Alias: Excavation Hero: Power Loader

Quirk Name: Iron Claws

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero and Support Course faculty member at U.A. High School; manages the Costume Development Studio

Personality: Strict, demanding teacher who pushes students to excel. Easily angered but acknowledges talent and effort. A self-described loner who prefers machinery to socializing, though he genuinely cares for colleagues and students beneath his gruff exterior.

Appearance: A short, lean man with youthful features and spiky ginger hair past his shoulders. Dull blue eyes, large mouth, and disproportionately large hands with orange L-shaped metallic claws. Wears a massive yellow rectangular excavator-claw helmet. Shirtless with large fingerless gray gloves and metal arm guards; cyan pants. In combat, uses a large steel mecha with articulated metal arms.

Backstory: An experienced Pro Hero specializing in excavation and support equipment who now teaches at U.A., training the next generation while developing hero costumes and mechanical inventions.

Additional Information: Licensed costume developer and creator.

cardPool.title: Hekiji Tengai
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Hekiji Tengai

Alias:
Shield of the Eight Bullets

Quirk Name:
Barrier

Occupation/Role:
Member of the Shie Hassaikai's Eight Bullets; Kendo Rappa's assigned partner

Personality:
Calm and composed with monk-like demeanor. Philosophically opposed to excessive violence, viewing fighting as a low, selfish desire. Analytical and observant with an enlightened perspective. Keeps his eyes closed while speaking, projecting wisdom and restraint.

Appearance:
Tall, slim man with pale spiky hair and straight dark eyebrows. Light irises with thin eyes usually kept closed. Wears a traditional dark yukata with white cloth belt and wooden geta sandals. Bears the Shie Hassaikai's brown plague mask secured with three belts.

Backstory:
Former Buddhist recruited by Overhaul to stabilize the volatile Kendo Rappa. Paired strategically with Kendo due to complementary Quirk synergy as "Spear and Shield." Newest member of the Eight Bullets.

Additional Information:
Specializes in creating defensive barriers that absorb and block powerful impacts. Works best alongside offensive partners, demonstrated against Fat Gum and Kirishima. Eventually arrested following the Shie Hassaikai's defeat.

cardPool.title: Haruaki Sun-Sun
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Haruaki Sun-Sun

Alias: Mr. Sunny

Quirk Name: Unnamed Sunflower Quirk

Occupation/Role: Orphanage Caretaker

Personality: Perpetually cheerful on the surface, though truly loyal to All For One's darker forces; capable of deception while raising children as potential vessels without visible mistreatment.

Appearance: A tall man with a distinctive yellow sunflower-like face, yellow ears and neck, brown hair on the back of his head, and tan hands. He wears a white hoodie with a pink apron and maintains a bright expression.

Backstory: Employed by Kyudai Garaki to oversee a secret orphanage cultivating spare vessels for All For One, Haruaki cared for children including burned Toya Todoroki. When Toya awoke from his coma in despair and set the orphanage ablaze while fleeing, Kyudai blamed Haruaki to protect the operation's secrecy.

Additional Information: His Quirk grants sunflower-like appearance with unknown full capabilities; he operates as part of a covert villain organization and manages vulnerable children through psychological manipulation.

cardPool.title: Ibara Shiozaki
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Ibara Shiozaki
Alias: Vine
Quirk Name: Vines
Occupation/Role: UA High School Student, Class 1-B
Personality: Modest and courteous with deep religious conviction. She speaks softly but firmly about her pure intentions. Beneath her graceful demeanor lies a vindictive streak and rigid moral code—she judges others harshly for dishonesty and refuses underhanded tactics, even when strategically advantageous. She values fairness and truth above all else.
Appearance: Medium-height girl with dark green eyes and long lower eyelashes. Her most distinctive feature is her hair of thorn-covered green vines kept just above her waist, with one set wrapped around her forehead in a cross pattern. She wears a plain white toga-like robe with dark brown knee-high boots.
Backstory: A talented student who earned fourth place in the UA Entrance Exam through balanced combat and rescue capabilities. Her vine Quirk and disciplined fighting style caught the attention of professional heroes, establishing her as a rising talent.

cardPool.title: Horse Man
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Horse Man
Quirk Name: Horse Quirk
Occupation/Role: Petty Thug/Villain; Later Dishwasher at Hopper's Cafe
Personality: Brash and aggressive with intimidating tendencies. Capable of rehabilitation when given legitimate opportunity. Shows enthusiasm cheering on heroes.
Appearance: Brown-skinned man with black hair styled like a horse's mane. Wears white tank top, black jacket, blue jeans, and green wristbands with shoulder tattoo. Quirk grants equine facial features.
Backstory: Small-time criminal in Naruhata's backstreets with Rhino Man, conducting robberies and extortion. Defeated by the Crawler and captured by Hopper's Cafe workers, who offered him employment instead of arrest.
Additional Information: Not a UA student. Quirk abilities unclear beyond physical alterations. Reformed and became ally to the Crawler during Naruhata Lockdown incident.

cardPool.title: Hood
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Unknown (formerly an underground fighter)

Alias:
Hood, High-End

Quirk Name:
Muscle Augmentation, Super Regeneration

Occupation/Role:
Intelligent High-End Nomu created by Doctor Kyudai Garaki

Personality:
Fiercely loyal to his master. Speaks with a stutter and broken grammar. Displays eager bloodlust for strong opponents but grows bored after victory. Uses tactical cunning and strategic diversions in combat.

Appearance:
Extraordinarily muscular with an unnaturally long neck lined with jutting vertebrae. Dark purple-black skin. Head shrouded by a skin hood with only glowing yellow eyes visible. Exposed brain, distorted red eyes, and jagged teeth lie beneath the hood.

Backstory:
An underground fighter transformed by Garaki into the first High-End Nomu. Enhanced with multiple Quirks, he became a weapon rivaling top Pro Heroes, driven by his master's will and hunger for worthy opponents.

Additional Information:
Not a UA student. Possesses multiple combat Quirks. Can summon weaker Nomu. Head destruction prevents regeneration. Demonstrates rare intelligence for strategic decision-making in battle.

cardPool.title: Hina
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Hina

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Unknown

Occupation/Role: Sophomore at Naruhata Women's College; Trigger drug dealer

Personality: Shy and withdrawn normally, but becomes fiercely protective and hostile when perceiving threats to her best friend Rin. Views all men as beasts and shows extreme jealousy over Rin's romantic interests. Willing to drug innocent people to protect her friend.

Appearance: Plain young woman with brown bob-cut hair and bangs concealing brown eyes. Wears drab clothing to avoid attention. When manipulating targets, she transforms into an attractive, adorable persona with cute outfits and makeup designed to deceive.

Backstory: College student deeply bonded with Rin Yaritezawa, her only genuine social connection. Began distributing Trigger drugs supplied by villain Number 6 at social mixers, targeting men interested in Rin. Her actions caused multiple uncontrolled Quirk incidents, drawing police attention. Apprehended after attempting to drug a student at a mixer.

Additional Information: Obtained oral Trigger variant requiring only ingestion. Connected to dealer with acceleration Quirk linked to Osaka Incident. Currently in police custody.

cardPool.title: Hikage Shinomori
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Hikage Shinomori

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Danger Sense

Occupation/Role: One For All User, Hermit Warrior

Personality: Valiant and noble, driven to defeat All For One yet realistic about his limits. Solitary by nature due to his Quirk's constant vigilance. Selfless in strengthening One For All for the next user.

Appearance: Lean, muscular man with short beige hair and thin, downward-slanting green eyes. Wears a dark baggy bodysuit with torn shin-length pants, large sage-colored belt, and padded kneecaps. Light puffy jacket cut at chest with right sleeve worn separately. Hardened physique from relentless training.

Backstory: Fourth wielder of One For All, inherited from Bruce. Spent life in solitary training, aware he lacked strength to defeat All For One alone. Devoted himself to perfecting the Quirk and preparing to pass his legacy to a stronger successor.

Additional Information: Danger Sense allows him to sense incoming threats, triggering a stabbing sensation for effortless evasion. One For All grants superhuman strength, speed, agility, and durability—could split boulders with ease. Constant alertness from his Quirk drove him toward isolation.

cardPool.title: Harusaburo Nanboku
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Harusaburo Nanboku

Alias:
The Enka Master

Quirk Name:
Unknown

Occupation/Role:
Professional Enka Singer

Personality:
Reserved and contemplative with deep affection for his hometown of Naruhata. Carries himself with dignity befitting an established performer.

Appearance:
Middle-aged man with short curly brown hair and warm eyes. Typically wears a purple yukata. Weathered features suggest years in entertainment.

Backstory:
Rose to prominence as an Enka master in Naruhata. His most celebrated work, "Yearning for Naruhata," became a long-running hit that cemented his connection to the city ward.

Additional Information:
Featured as headlining artist at Narufest on the rooftop of Marukane Department Store. His vocal mastery and emotional delivery made him a cultural fixture in Naruhata.

cardPool.title: Haruhisa
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Haruhisa
Alias: Haruhisa the Bare-Handed
Quirk Name: Unnamed Transformation Quirk
Occupation/Role: Yakuza Executive, Abegawa Tenchu Kai
Personality: Stoic and composed, maintaining calm even in combat. Disciplined and tactical in conflict.
Appearance: Large, imposing elderly man with defined jawline and prominent cheekbones. Dark hair swept back with whitened temples. Wears dark sunglasses and light yukata. Often smoking a cigar.
Backstory: Seasoned yakuza executive who rose through demonstrated combat prowess and loyalty. His reputation as "the Bare-Handed" reflects his formidable unarmed fighting capability.
Additional Information: Haruhisa's Quirk transforms him into a muscular gray hulk, dramatically increasing physical power in combat. He died defending yakuza headquarters against vigilante Stendhal.

cardPool.title: Hari Kurono
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Hari Kurono
Alias: Chronostasis
Quirk Name: Chronostasis
Occupation/Role: Yakuza member of the Shie Hassaikai; assistant to Overhaul
Personality: Composed and cold-hearted. Fiercely loyal to his leader with subservient tendencies. Tactical and analytical.
Appearance: Fair-skinned with thin dark eyes and pointed eyebrows. Pale chin-length hair styled into arrow-shaped clock needles. Wears a black plague mask with gold trim, circular glasses, and a long white raincoat with raised hood.
Backstory: A subordinate within the Shie Hassaikai, Hari serves as Kai Chisaki's right-hand man. His unwavering loyalty has bound him to Kai's ruthless decisions.
Additional Information: Expert marksman and espionage specialist. His Chronostasis Quirk slows target movements through contact with his hair for up to one hour. Relies on tactics and stealth rather than direct combat.

cardPool.title: Hard Head
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Hard Head
Quirk Name: Muscle Expansion
Occupation/Role: F-rank Villain, League of Villains Member
Personality: Confident and willing to challenge strong opponents despite low rank; otherwise unremarkable.
Appearance: Extremely tall and powerfully built man with massive arms. Wears a full-encasing helmet with eye slit, black sleeveless tank top, greenish-brown trousers, and brown shoes.
Backstory: Recruited by Tomura Shigaraki for the U.S.J. assault. Participated in the Mountain Zone ambush targeting Class 1-A, attacking Denki Kaminari but was quickly incapacitated by reflexive Electrification. Arrested upon U.A. staff arrival.
Additional Information: F-rank villain with no criminal notoriety. Muscle expansion quirk provides raw strength but proved ineffective against electrical attacks.

cardPool.title: Hanta Sero
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Hanta Sero

Alias: Taping Hero: Cellophane

Quirk Name: Tape

Occupation/Role: UA High School Student, Class 1-A

Personality: Amicable and sociable, often loud while trying to impress peers. Humorous and quick to call out eccentric behavior. Laid-back and confident despite odds. Has a teasing side and speaks freely, sometimes unintentionally insulting others. Shows interest in girls and enjoys gossip.

Appearance: Tall and lean young man with chin-length black hair spiked downward and jagged bangs. Large almond-shaped eyes with small pupils and broad grin. His elbows are cylindrical tape dispenser-shaped, serving as his Quirk's source. Wears standard UA male uniform: light gray blazer with dark turquoise trim, white dress shirt, dark blue-green pants, red tie, and brown shoes.

Backstory: First-year student at UA High School training to become a professional hero. Valued member of Class 1-A earning respect through competence and friendly demeanor. His Tape Quirk allows him to bind and restrain targets from distance, making him versatile despite lacking flashy offensive abilities.

Additional Information: Competed in the Sports Festival against Shoto Todoroki.

cardPool.title: Hana Shimura
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Hana Shimura
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Unknown
Occupation/Role: Student
Personality: Carefree and loving toward her brother, Hana aspired to become a hero like her grandmother. Despite genuine affection, she could be selfish and cowardly when afraid of punishment, prioritizing self-preservation over honesty.
Appearance: A young girl with shoulder-length dark hair in side pigtails with thick framing strands and short bangs. Distinctive dark brown, cat-like eyes that angled inward. Light-colored striped t-shirt with cuffed sleeves.
Backstory: Granddaughter of Pro Hero Nana Shimura, Hana lived under her abusive father Kotaro's strict rule forbidding hero worship. She discovered a photo of her grandmother and showed it to her younger brother Tenko. When discovered, she falsely blamed Tenko to escape punishment, leading to their father's beatings. Attempting to apologize that evening, she was accidentally disintegrated by Tenko's newly manifested Decay Quirk, becoming the catalyst for his descent into villainy.
Additional Information: Deceased. Not a UA student. Her death profoundly shaped her brother Tenko's transformation into the villain Tomura Shigaraki.

cardPool.title: Haishin
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Haishin

Alias: Haishin

Quirk Name: Not specified

Occupation/Role: Social media influencer and charity event host

Personality: Energetic, cheery, and enthusiastic. Genuine in his charitable nature and quick to appreciate heroic efforts, though his loud attitude may not suit everyone.

Appearance: A man with short two-tone hair and pointed ears with earrings. He has subtle stubble and typically wears a black long-sleeved shirt under a casual t-shirt bearing his own name.

Backstory: Haishin built a following as a social media influencer, hosting charitable events for the community. He distributes treats like sugar bombs during his videos, combining entertainment with generosity.

Additional Information: Haishin is not a UA High School student. He operates independently as a content creator and philanthropist, demonstrating genuine appreciation for heroic action. His popularity makes him recognizable to UA students.

cardPool.title: Habuko Mongoose
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Habuko Mongoose

Alias:
None

Quirk Name:
Paralysis

Occupation/Role:
Student of Isami Academy High School

Personality:
Once lonely, Habuko became sociable after befriending Tsuyu Asui in middle school. She remains shy around strangers but deeply values her friendships, showing remarkable loyalty even when afflicted by a zombie virus.

Appearance:
Habuko has a serpentine head and neck with gray patterned scales, bright yellow eyes with slit pupils, and spiky shoulder-length red hair. Her body is petite and fair-skinned. She wears the Isami Academy uniform: white dress shirt with dark red bow, dark blue blazer, gray pleated knee-length skirt, black socks, and brown loafers.

Backstory:
Two years before Tsuyu entered UA, Habuko attended the same middle school and initially stalked her, using her Quirk to paralyze her. Tsuyu's kind offer of friendship transformed Habuko's life. Though they attended different high schools, they remained close. Habuko has made new friends at Isami Academy.

Additional Information:
Habuko participated in the Survival Training exercise with Class 1-A during the Quirk Apprehension Test arc.

cardPool.title: Gyges
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Gyges
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Multiple Arms
Occupation/Role: Tartarus Prison Guard
Personality: Dutiful and serious with strong loyalty to his post; demonstrates courage against overwhelming danger.
Appearance: Lanky build with six arms providing exceptional reach and combat capability. Wears a distinctive horned helmet that completely conceals his face as centerpiece of his guard uniform.
Backstory: A dedicated guard at Tartarus' Bronze Gate alongside his brother Briareos. Maintains his post with unwavering commitment and calls for code-red alerts when detecting threats. Dies fighting Tomura Shigaraki and High-End Nomu during All For One's orchestrated prison break.
Additional Information: Possesses six functional permanent arms granting significant combat advantage in melee and defensive operations. His Quirk resembles Mezo Shoji's Dupli-Arms but with greater arm count. His final act was reporting his brother's death and initiating emergency lockdown protocols before being eliminated by All For One's power.

cardPool.title: Gunhead
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Gunhead
Quirk Name: Unknown
Occupation/Role: Pro Hero specializing in armed combat; internship mentor
Personality: Professional and friendly with excellent teaching values. Composed and fierce in combat but unexpectedly kind, with playful teasing.
Appearance: Wide-set, muscular man with long pale mint-green hair spiking backward. White mask with four gun-muzzle holes and padded combat vest over dark grayish-cyan bodysuit. Brown pants, black boots, silver revolver chamber-shaped bracers, and knuckle spikes.
Backstory: Established Pro Hero running an agency focused on armed combat training and crime suppression. Known for taking internship students and providing hands-on field training.
Additional Information: Gunhead Martial Arts is his signature fighting technique. He mentored UA Class 1-A student Ochaco Uraraka, teaching her practical combat skills and fighting form. Participated in civilian evacuation efforts during the Final War against All For One's forces.

cardPool.title: Goto Imasuji
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Goto Imasuji
Alias: Muscular
Quirk Name: Muscle Augmentation
Occupation/Role: Villain, League of Villains Vanguard Action Squad member
Personality: Sadistic and bloodthirsty, Muscular craves violence and killing. He joined the League to indulge his brutal nature rather than follow ideology. He holds a strict code: worth is determined by accomplishing stated intentions. He respects worthy opponents and bears no grudge against those who defeat him fairly. His fatal flaw is overconfidence—he underestimates opponents, toys with them, and dismisses tactics he deems cheap.
Appearance: An enormous, muscular man with wide shoulders and short, spiky sandy-blond hair. He has tiny black eyes and distinctive scars: one large scar across his left face and a smaller one on his right forehead. He wears a white hockey mask with multiple holes and a black hooded cloak over a red tank top, dark jacket, dark green pants, and black knee-high boots.
Backstory: A hardened criminal freed from Tartarus by All For One, Muscular was recruited into the League's Vanguard Action Squad. He previously killed the hero duo Water Hose, earning his facial scar—a wound he accepts without resentment.

cardPool.title: Gorilla
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown

Alias: Gorilla

Quirk Name: Gorilla Arm

Occupation/Role: League of Villains member, U.S.J. assault participant

Personality: Cautious and easily startled. Lacks independent initiative and follows orders within the villain hierarchy.

Appearance: Adult woman with shoulder-length maroon hair and bangs obscuring her left eye. Indigo markings surround her right eye with two diagonal lines extending toward her ear and cheek. Her arms are notably enlarged and covered in brown hair. She wears a short sleeveless purple dress with v-neck and three diagonal light purple stripes on the right side.

Backstory: Recruited as one of roughly seventy low-ranking villains by Tomura Shigaraki for the U.S.J. assault. She attacked Pro Hero Shota Aizawa but was overwhelmed when the League's long-range squad fell to his power.

Additional Information: Defeated and arrested following the U.S.J. incident. Her Quirk grants her gorilla-like arm strength and physiology for close-combat roles.

cardPool.title: Gori
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Gori
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Unknown
Occupation/Role: Police Force Officer
Personality: Firm yet fair, and perceptive. Gori believes in redemption and second chances, reading people's intentions with accuracy. He shows strictness with dangerous criminals but listens to understand circumstances. Compassionate, he offers tea to reformed criminals and recognizes genuine bonds between people.
Appearance: A bulky man with the head of a mountain gorilla, wearing a dark gray suit with a black tie. During combat, he wears armored police gear. His imposing physique contrasts with his measured demeanor.
Backstory: Gori serves as a Police Force officer handling interrogations and criminal intake. He interrogated Gentle Criminal after the UA School Festival infiltration, seeing through false confessions and recognizing Gentle's capacity for change. He later extracted information from Kyudai Garaki regarding Tomura's revival during post-war investigations.
Additional Information: Not a UA student. Gori discovered that Gentle had prevented mass prisoner escapes at Mikuzu Prison. He facilitated Gentle and La Brava's assistance to heroes in the Final War as repayment for their actions.

cardPool.title: Godzillo
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Godzillo

Alias: Godzillo

Quirk Name: Toho

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero

Personality: Friendly and charismatic, greeting fans warmly. Maintains a public presence befitting a celebrated hero with film star status.

Appearance: A massive anthropomorphic creature resembling Heisei Godzilla with dark gray scales, long tail, and bear-like head. Wide build with clawed paws for hands. Wears a white high-collared coat with tattered hem, baggy white pants with red flame patterns lined in yellow, a thick golden belt with matching patterns, spike-banded clawed feet, and silver-plated kneepads.

Backstory: Originally from Japan, Godzillo relocated to the United States and rose to prominence as both a Pro Hero and film star. He appears at prestigious events like the I-Island expo, mingling with other heroes and the public.

Additional Information: Godzillo is an unaffiliated Pro Hero. His Quirk grants kaiju-like attributes including immense size and strength. He collaborates with high-ranking heroes like Hawks.

cardPool.title: Gil Gollini
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Gil Gollini
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Teleportation
Occupation/Role: Member of the Gollini Family mafia
Personality: Emotionless and stoic, following orders loyally with minimal emotional response except when annoyed or shocked.
Appearance: A large, muscular man with wide shoulders and burly arms. He has a buzzcut with Dutch-styled beard and large, rough nose. His stern, squinted eyes are barely visible. He wears a well-tailored gray striped suit, black coat, and scarf with a rose emblem.
Backstory: Gil serves as a loyal operative of the Gollini Family mafia under boss Valdo, acting as transportation and backup for fellow member Ugo using his Quirk to position himself strategically in conflicts.
Additional Information: Gil demonstrates exceptional combat coordination with fluid, dance-like footwork during teleportation. His Quirk allows him to teleport himself and anyone he touches to any location within his line of sight. When enhanced by Anna's Overmodification, his activation speed increases dramatically.

cardPool.title: Giulio Gandini
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Giulio Gandini

Alias:
The Scervino Butler

Quirk Name:
Trigger (Disabled)

Occupation/Role:
Butler for the Scervino Family; Former combatant

Personality:
A stern, composed gentleman with fierce loyalty to those he serves. Once happier, he has become hardened by trauma, though his warm heart surfaces when shown genuine compassion. He views Heroes with cynicism yet demonstrates restraint in combat and respects honor in enemies. Relentless in pursuit of his goals, refusing to back down.

Appearance:
A man of average build with brownish-red hair in a short ponytail, thin greenish-blue eyes, and sharp teeth marked by a mole beneath his left eye. He dresses formally in a black tailcoat, grey vest, striped tie, and white undershirt. His right arm and left leg are Support Item prosthetics, with his right sleeve rolled up and left pant leg torn to expose them. Ammunition pouches and holster belts cross his torso.

Backstory:
Raised by the Scervino family after being taken in as a child, Giulio found purpose as their butler. Brutally attacked by the Gollini Family, he lost his right eye, arm, and left leg, disabling his Quirk.

cardPool.title: Ginji Kurau
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Ginji Kurau

Alias: Ginji

Quirk Name: Mad Gluttony

Occupation/Role: Escaped Villain, Former Tartarus Inmate

Personality: Opportunistic and ruthless, prioritizing personal gain over all else. Shows no remorse for casualties and readily betrays allies. Prone to arrogance and views cooperation as stepping stones to power.

Appearance: Young adult with scruffy white hair and gold eyes. Muscular frame marked by pronounced fangs. His Quirk manifests as a large monstrous mouth with serrated teeth centered on his stomach. Overmodification added mouth-like appendages on his shoulders.

Backstory: Dangerous villain captured by Best Jeanist and imprisoned in Tartarus. Escaped during All For One's prison break and allied with the Gollini Family. He deceived Quirk user Anna Scervino into modifying his Mad Gluttony ability, promising to help her escape. Upon receiving enhanced power, he betrayed her and rampaged through civilian areas, drawing Class 1-A's attention.

Additional Information: One of few individuals compatible with Overmodification. Currently holds Anna captive as leverage for her power. Enhanced form makes him significantly more dangerous.

cardPool.title: Gigantomachia
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Gigantomachia

Alias:
Gig

Quirk Name:
Unknown (Multiple Quirks via modification)

Occupation/Role:
Villain, former bodyguard to All For One, servant of the Paranormal Liberation Front

Personality:
Polite but impatient, becoming aggressive toward the uncooperative. Fiercely devoted to his master with unwavering loyalty. Respects only strength and acknowledged Tomura as worthy after witnessing his power.

Appearance:
A colossal giant three building levels tall with a musclebound, rocky frame. Spiky brown hair, jagged protrusions covering his body like stone, and prominently pointed teeth with protruding lower canines. Wears black pants, a hooded cloak, carries a portable radio on a rope around his neck, and later sports black armor.

Backstory:
Gigantomachia served All For One as a loyal bodyguard before receiving modifications granting multiple Quirks. When All For One went into hiding, he felt betrayed and transferred his loyalty to Tomura Shigaraki, fighting with the Paranormal Liberation Front until his arrest.

Additional Information:
Possesses a "Mole mode" transformation with retractable jaw visor, elongated canines, and digging claws.

cardPool.title: Giant Villain
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Giant Villain
Quirk Name: Gigantification
Occupation/Role: D-rank Villain
Personality: Selfish and reckless, willing to steal and challenge Pro Heroes despite repeated captures. Shows little regard for consequences.
Appearance: Brutish with a bestial head resembling a horse or shark. Massive, heavily muscled frame with long dark brown dreadlocks and reddish-brown beard. Wears a tattered black sleeveless shirt and worn blue jeans.
Backstory: A low-ranking criminal who commits petty crimes like theft, undeterred by confrontations with Pro Heroes. His selfish nature makes him a recurring nuisance for law enforcement.
Additional Information: D-rank criminal status. Defeated by multiple Pro Heroes including Kamui Woods, Death Arms, Backdraft, and Mt. Lady. His Gigantification Quirk enables size increases but lacks the skill to overcome experienced heroes.

cardPool.title: Giant Palm
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Giant Palm
Quirk Name: Unknown
Occupation/Role: Low-ranking villain, League of Villains recruit
Personality: Aggressive foot soldier willing to engage heroes despite weakness; lacks distinguishing traits or leadership qualities.
Appearance: Skinny man with brown hair and disproportionately large hands and arms. Wears a gray v-neck shirt under an open blue collared shirt, dark pants, and a dark visor. His lankiness contrasts with his oversized hands.
Backstory: One of roughly seventy villains recruited by Tomura Shigaraki for the League's coordinated assault on the Unforeseen Simulation Joint. Participated in the invasion wave against U.A. High School during the facility attack.
Additional Information: Defeated by Hizashi Yamada's Voice Quirk during the U.S.J. Arc and arrested with other League subordinates. Represents a common low-ranking villain archetype with no distinguishing combat abilities.

cardPool.title: Geten
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Himura Geten

Alias:
Iceman

Quirk Name:
Ice Ply

Occupation/Role:
Villain, Meta Liberation Army Member

Personality:
Fiercely loyal to Re-Destro and the Liberation Army's ideology. Prideful about his ice abilities and devoted to self-improvement through combat. Becomes enraged when his leader's plans are threatened. Views power as the sole measure of worth.

Appearance:
Geten wears a thick light blue parka with brown buttons, black baggy pants, and lace-up winter boots. A fur-lined hood frames messy white hair and striking silver-grey eyes with long white eyelashes.

Backstory:
Geten dedicated his life to honing his ice abilities through relentless training instead of formal schooling. Recruited by the Meta Liberation Army, he became one of their most valued warriors after Re-Destro recognized his potential and enhanced his power. His belief in strength-based supremacy shaped him into a devoted enforcer.

Additional Information:
Skilled combatant with sophisticated ice manipulation, capable of creating complex constructs and infusing ice into water sources. Fought Dabi to stalemate and suppressed multiple Pro Heroes.

cardPool.title: Gashly Eijiju
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Gashly Eijiju

Alias: The Shadow Gentleman

Quirk Name: Infant Puppets

Occupation/Role: Villain, High-Level Tartarus Prisoner, All For One's Assassin

Personality: Sadistic psychopath with refined manners and scholarly interests. Maintains cold composure in combat while reading. Indebted to All For One for his escape and sworn to his cause.

Appearance: Tall, slender figure cloaked in darkness with black top hat, cloak, and dark clothing. Wears stark white mask with eye holes concealing his eyes. Carries black umbrella and open book. Light-colored short hair visible when hat is displaced.

Backstory: Imprisoned in Tartarus for devastating cities with his Quirk, Gashly was freed during All For One's prison break. Grateful for liberation, he pledged allegiance to All For One's vision and joined the Paranormal Liberation Front.

Additional Information: One of Tartarus's most dangerous inmates. Relies on psychological warfare and overwhelming hordes of puppet infants rather than direct combat. Maintains aristocratic bearing despite his monstrous nature.

cardPool.title: Garvey
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Garvey

Alias: The Giant Toad Villain

Quirk Name: Stock

Occupation/Role: Villain

Personality: Acts on base instinct with no distinct personality, behaving like a wild animal driven by primal aggression under Trigger drug influence.

Appearance: A colossal olive-green toad standing 10 meters tall with a round, chunky body covered in warts. Small blank white eyes, short stubby tail, and a discolored tongue tip from Trigger use. Warts on his back absorb attacks.

Backstory: Enhanced by Trigger, Garvey was unleashed in Tasomiya Ward as a weapon by Kyudai Garaki and All For One. During his rampage, he absorbed multiple Quirks from heroes and caused massive destruction. He killed Oboro Shirakumo while the student saved children, though his true target was Shota Aizawa's Erasure Quirk. He was eventually defeated and captured by Aizawa.

Additional Information: Garvey possesses immense physical strength capable of destroying buildings. His Stock Quirk allows him to absorb and redirect offensive attacks, making him extremely dangerous. He appears in Vigilantes canon before UA's first-year timeline.

cardPool.title: Gantetsu
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Gantetsu

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Unknown

Occupation/Role: Soba restaurant owner

Personality: Stubborn and taciturn, but fair-minded and appreciative. Demands excellence in cooking and criticizes harshly, yet grants second chances to those who show genuine improvement. Grateful to helpers and resistant to intimidation.

Appearance: An elderly man of tall stature with a full, whitened beard and mustache with dark striping. He has bushy eyebrows, short-cropped hair, and a prominent scar from his right ear to his nose. He wears traditional Japanese chef's whites with kanji embroidery, a haramaki sash, a headband with kanji covering his left eye, and wooden geta sandals. He carries a long wooden pole.

Backstory: Gantetsu has owned his soba restaurant for decades, building a reputation for quality and demanding standards. Someone has persistently pressured him to sell, but he refuses. When four UA High School students mistakenly sought a hero named Gantetsu at his restaurant, he tested them through cooking. After recognizing their potential on a second attempt, he welcomed them as guests.

Additional Information: Not a UA student.

cardPool.title: Ganma Asui
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Ganma Asui

Alias:
None

Quirk Name:
Frog Physiology

Occupation/Role:
Businessman; Father and Provider for the Asui Household

Personality:
A caring, devoted father who demonstrates responsibility and calm support for his family. He trusts his eldest daughter with household duties while traveling for work.

Appearance:
A tall, stocky middle-aged man with pronounced frog-like features. He has short black hair, black eyes, and a toad-like head structure. He dresses professionally in a business suit with a blue-dotted tie and green frog clip.

Backstory:
Ganma married Bell and had three children: Tsuyu, Samidare, and Satsuki. Due to frequent work travel, he relies on his responsible eldest daughter to care for her younger siblings while providing stability for the family.

Additional Information:
Not a UA High School student. Father of Class 1-A student Tsuyu Asui. His family's Quirk grants frog-like abilities that manifest across all members with varying prominence. A supportive family man committed to his children's wellbeing.

cardPool.title: Gang Orca's Sidekicks
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Gang Orca's Sidekick
Quirk Name: Unknown
Occupation/Role: Professional Sidekick to Gang Orca; Provisional Hero License Exam Antagonist
Personality: Loyal and disciplined, working seamlessly under Gang Orca's command with tactical awareness and willingness to adapt strategy.
Appearance: Black skin-tight bodysuit covering entire body including face and hands, decorated with thin white lines across the torso. Tan-colored armor pads protect key areas. Diamond-shaped eye holes arranged in a circular pattern form their mask design. Blue and gray Cement Gun mounted on right arm.
Backstory: Enlisted by the Hero Public Safety Commission alongside Gang Orca to serve as mock villains during the Provisional Hero License Exam's second phase. Tasked with attacking and impeding UA students in a disaster zone scenario, they faced opponents including Shoto Todoroki, Inasa Yoarashi, and Yo Shindo.
Additional Information: Operates as part of a coordinated team capable of combining attacks with Gang Orca for increased effectiveness.

cardPool.title: Gale Villain
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Unknown

Alias:
Gale Villain

Quirk Name:
Gale

Occupation/Role:
Professional Thief, Villain

Personality:
Greedy and mission-focused, prioritizing profit over confrontation. Arrogant and boastful about his Quirk's superiority, but becomes overconfident and careless when distracted.

Appearance:
Rugged man with thick eyebrows, prominent sideburns, and unkempt facial hair. Notable for his large, long pompadour hairstyle. Wears a white and red coat with a horned skull emblem, golden chain necklace, dark pants, and spike-studded shoes.

Backstory:
Skilled wind-manipulating villain who partners with the Bomb Villain for high-value heists. Operates with calculated precision, focusing on acquiring valuables rather than confronting heroes. His overconfidence in his Quirk has proven his downfall.

Additional Information:
His Quirk creates a protective wind vortex around his body that deflects attacks and enables flight, but leaves his head exposed as a critical weakness. He carries a silver briefcase for stolen goods.

cardPool.title: Fuyumi Todoroki
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Fuyumi Todoroki
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Ice
Occupation/Role: Elementary School Teacher
Personality: Kind-hearted and nurturing with a teasing streak, Fuyumi cares deeply for her family despite household trauma. She is hopeful about reconciliation and worries constantly for loved ones, though she carries guilt about failing to protect Shoto. Brave and empathetic, she attempts to maintain peace within the fractured family.
Appearance: A young woman of average height with shoulder-length white hair flecked with crimson, ear-length side bangs, and turquoise eyes framed by red-rimmed rectangular glasses. Typically dressed in a white dress shirt with grayish peach cardigan, navy jeans, and brown dress shoes. She frequently wears turtleneck sweaters.
Backstory: The only daughter of Enji and Rei Todoroki, Fuyumi assumed a maternal role for younger brother Shoto during her mother's absence. Witnessing her father's abuse left her unable to intervene, a guilt she carries regarding Toya's fate. Inspired to protect children, she became an elementary school teacher.
Additional Information: Fuyumi possesses limited combat experience but demonstrates proficient Quirk control.

cardPool.title: Futo Nagashira
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Futo Nagashira

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Not specified

Occupation/Role: UA High School Student, Department of Management

Personality: Pragmatic and business-minded, focused on hero marketability and public relations. Beneath his commercial exterior lies genuine passion for heroism and transparency in documenting heroic achievements to shape public opinion positively.

Appearance: A young man of average height with distinctive long blonde hair styled into a rounded, beehive-like shape. He has small, thin-set eyes and thick downward-pointing eyebrows that give him a serious expression. He typically wears his UA gym uniform.

Backstory: A Department of Management student at UA High School who specializes in the business side of heroics. He analyzes hero marketability and public appeal, notably studying Izuku during the UA Sports Festival. He associates regularly with peers Ronaudo and Komako.
