Additional Information: Not a combat-focused hero course member. His interests lean toward media, public relations, and how society perceives heroes. He values transparency in heroic narratives.

cardPool.title: Funkman
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Funkman
Quirk Name: Unknown
Occupation/Role: Pro Hero
Personality: Dedicated and resolute, willing to stand against threats even in dire circumstances; demonstrates camaraderie with fellow heroes.
Appearance: Tall man with a prominent brown afro and black face mask. Wears a cowboy-style hero costume with a vest, "F" on his hat and belt buckle, and a holstered gun at his waist.
Backstory: An established Pro Hero who fought during the Paranormal Liberation War. Despite overwhelming odds and the destruction of Jaku City, Funkman fought against Tomura Shigaraki's forces until he was killed in combat.
Additional Information: Funkman's Quirk ability is undocumented; he relies on marksmanship and combat training. His death was one of many hero casualties during the war's final stages.

cardPool.title: Fumiko Noborizaka
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Fumiko Noborizaka

Alias: The Love Letter Villain

Quirk Name: Death Letter

Occupation/Role: Delivery Driver / Instant Villain

Personality: Insane and obsessively devoted, Fumiko expresses affection through kidnapping and violence. She becomes uncontrollable under Trigger, her obsession amplified destructively.

Appearance: Thin with a gaunt face and unnaturally long tongue. She has light-colored flowing hair and wears a dark shirt with shorts and loafers. As a delivery driver, she wears a bike helmet, fingerless gloves, and a backpack.

Backstory: Fumiko works as a delivery driver while harboring dangerous romantic obsessions. Her unstable mental state and violent expression of love mark her as a threat outside hero society.

Additional Information: Under Trigger influence, Fumiko transforms into a massive tornado of blood-written love letters with enormous eyes and a gaping mouth. Her Quirk's power scales with emotional intensity. She is not a UA student.

cardPool.title: Fumikage Tokoyami
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Fumikage Tokoyami

Alias: Jet-Black Hero: Tsukuyomi

Quirk Name: Dark Shadow

Occupation/Role: UA High School Student, Class 1-A

Personality: Reserved and serious yet noble, Fumikage speaks with archaic patterns and dramatic flair. Quiet but sociable in teams and dependable in combat. He's insecure about his dark interests and easily embarrassed, yet deeply cares for friends. He struggles controlling Dark Shadow's aggression and fears harming those close to him.

Appearance: A short young man with a crow-like black head, hooked yellow beak, thin red eyes with black pupils, and red choker. Fair skin, average human body. At UA he wears a light gray blazer with dark turquoise trimmings, white shirt, dark blue-green pants, red tie, and brown shoes. His hero costume is a black robe with dark purple tinting, knee-high black boots, and utility belt.

Backstory: Fumikage is a dedicated UA student training to become a hero despite his powerful but temperamental Quirk. His affinity for darkness and dramatic aesthetic stems from genuine passion, though he fears losing control to Dark Shadow during intense emotions or prolonged darkness exposure.

cardPool.title: Fuji Fukiyose
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Fuji Fukiyose
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Not yet revealed
Occupation/Role: Third-year middle school student, prospective U.A. High School applicant
Personality: Jovial and lighthearted with frequent laughter, yet wears emotions openly. Despite his carefree demeanor, he is serious about his future and dedicated to entering U.A.'s Hero Course.
Appearance: Dark-skinned boy with messy black hair and shadow over his eyes. Wears a bandana to hold back his hair and an open middle school jacket over a sweatshirt.
Backstory: Fuji visited U.A. High School's Prospective Students Day with friend Raito Sanda. During the Hero Course tag game, he was paired with Tsuyu Asui and quickly defeated. He supported Raito's decision to pursue the Business Course while remaining committed to becoming a hero.
Additional Information: Fuji is easily distracted but can refocus. He demonstrates loyalty and emotional maturity. His determination to enter U.A.'s Hero Course suggests significant potential despite his current inexperience.

cardPool.title: Four-Armed Zealot
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Unknown

Alias:
Four-Armed Zealot

Quirk Name:
Extra Arms

Occupation/Role:
F-rank Villain, League of Villains recruit

Personality:
Confident in combat, taciturn, focused on violence over dialogue.

Appearance:
Lean man with jet-black skin and four muscular arms. Wears insectoid mask with crimson lenses, sleeveless black tank top, brown cargo pants, and black combat boots.

Backstory:
Recruited by Tomura Shigaraki for the USJ assault. Participated in the League of Villains' coordinated attack on UA High School.

Additional Information:
Defeated by UA Pro Heroes during the USJ invasion. Extra arms provide combat advantage, though confidence exceeded actual threat level against professionals.

cardPool.title: Flect Turn
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Flect Turn

Alias: The Reflector, Prophet of Salvation

Quirk Name: Reflect

Occupation/Role: Cult Leader, Villain

Personality: Cold, calculated, and charismatic extremist driven by obsessive hatred of Quirks. Ruthless and remorseless, viewing mass violence as necessary salvation. Capable of reason but shows no mercy to traitors. Self-righteous yet hypocritical about his own Quirk usage.

Appearance: Tall, slim man with luminescent light blue skin and shaved head revealing dark blue hair. Sharp goatee, arrow-shaped earrings, and dark blue eye masks to prevent reflection-blindness. Wears red robe with golden belt, grey pants, and combat boots. Special prosthetic gloves with exposed fingertips. Villain outfit features flowing white cloak with dark red interior and energy-storage disks.

Backstory: His powerful Quirk caused physical harm to anyone who touched him, completely isolating him. Watched parents, friends, and loved ones abandon him. This rejection birthed his belief that Quirks are a disease, leading him to found the cult Humarise to eliminate all Quirks through the Quirk Singularity Doomsday Theory.

cardPool.title: Ethan Drive
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Ethan Drive

Alias:
None

Quirk Name:
None

Occupation/Role:
Fighter Pilot, U.S. Military Brigade Leader

Personality:
Disciplined soldier with unwavering loyalty to his comrades. Supportive mentor who offers emotional strength and encourages growth. Self-sacrificial, willing to risk everything for the greater good.

Appearance:
Tall, well-built man with military bearing. Buzz cut and prominent moustache. Wears U.S. Army fighter pilot gear and uniform.

Backstory:
Seasoned American military fighter pilot who developed a deep bond with Cathleen (Star and Stripe) and their brigade. Supported her through doubt and celebrated her growth as a hero. Mourned her sacrifice against Tomura Shigaraki and honored her final wish by sharing critical military intelligence with Japanese heroes.

Additional Information:
Exceptional non-Quirk combatant who defeated Star and Stripe in hand-to-hand training before her Quirk awakening. Extensive military training in combat tactics and survival. Member of the United States Armed Forces. Not affiliated with UA High School.

cardPool.title: Eri
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Eri
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Rewind
Occupation/Role: Student (U.A. High School resident)
Personality: Fearful and withdrawn from trauma, gradually becoming cheerful and trusting. She carries guilt over her Quirk's destructive potential but learns its positive uses. Silent and determined to protect others despite her suffering.
Appearance: A small girl with long, messy bluish off-white hair parted down the middle. Wide bright red eyes and a small brown horn on her right forehead that grows when activating her Quirk. Wears a white frilled dress shirt, red pinafore with golden buttons, gray tights, and tan boots with a small dark red messenger bag. Her hair appears neater, reflecting better self-care.
Backstory: Eri was used as a weapon by her grandfather's crime organization and experimented on by Kai Chisaki to create Quirk-Destroying drugs. Her mother disowned her after she accidentally erased her father. Rescued by U.A., she now lives in the dormitories, healing from severe trauma and learning her existence has value.
Additional Information: Her Quirk allows her to rewind events.

cardPool.title: Enma Kannagi
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Enma Kannagi
Alias: Magic Hero: Majestic
Quirk Name: Unknown
Occupation/Role: Pro Hero
Personality: Noble and selfless, willing to sacrifice for others. Composed and professional in high-pressure situations with strong leadership abilities.
Appearance: Slim adult man with a goatee. Wears a wizard-inspired hero costume with a short orange robe and scarlet pointy hat. Colorful fabrics and sashes adorn his outfit, with one sash serving as a blindfold.
Backstory: An established Pro Hero who mentors promising students. Participated in the Humarise raid and Villa Raid Team assault on the Paranormal Liberation Front, where he sacrificed himself protecting his students from Gigantomachia.
Additional Information: Served as work-study mentor to Momo Yaoyorozu and Setsuna Tokage. Operated under the World Heroes Association during major operations.

cardPool.title: Enji Todoroki
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Enji Todoroki

Alias:
Flame Hero: Endeavor

Quirk Name:
Hellflame

Occupation/Role:
Pro Hero (No. 2 ranked)

Personality:
Prideful and ambitious, driven by an obsessive goal to surpass All Might. Stern and demanding, he prioritizes achievement over relationships.

Appearance:
Tall, muscular man with short crimson spiky hair, sharp turquoise eyes, and flame-like facial hair. His Hero Costume is a navy-turquoise bodysuit with streaming flames across the chest, white patterned bracers, flame-engulfed boots, and a blue belt.

Backstory:
One of the nation's top Pro Heroes, Enji married Rei through a strategic Quirk Marriage to produce a powerful heir. They have four children: Toya, Fuyumi, Natsuo, and Shoto. His relentless pursuit of strength has defined his career and family life.

Additional Information:
Currently No. 2 ranked Pro Hero by case resolution. Father of Shoto Todoroki, a first-year UA High School student. His rivalry with All Might fuels his competitive nature and aggressive methodology.

cardPool.title: Enigma
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Fukakai Hatena

Alias: Enigma

Quirk Name: Gigantification

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero Sidekick of Ingenium, Team Idaten Member

Personality: Calm, friendly, and self-aware about her frightening appearance. Enigma remains composed in crises, offering reassurance and professionalism.

Appearance: A young woman with straight teeth, long dark hair in two low plaits with a neat fringe, and entirely blacked-out oval eyes. When her Quirk activates, she becomes a pitch-black blob with a white mask face, gaining elastic limbs.

Backstory: Enigma obtained her Hero License and was selected by Ingenium for Team Idaten. While traveling to Tokyo for an interview, she was mistaken for a villain but clarified her identity. She has proven herself a capable sidekick in rescue operations and public safety events.

Additional Information: Enigma controls her body size from a few meters to building-height. Her rubber-like blob form stretches, contracts, and absorbs attacks. She can create smaller clones from her giant form to use as drones. Her presence and composure make her valuable in rescue and crowd-management scenarios.

cardPool.title: Ending
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Ending
Quirk Name: Whiteline
Occupation/Role: Villain
Personality: Mentally unstable and suicidal, obsessed with Endeavor to the point of stalking and kidnapping. Believes the only choice in life is how one dies. Displays manic behavior with wide smiles and crazed eyes.
Appearance: Muscular man of average height wearing horizontal black and white-striped pants and shirt beneath a blue hooded jacket. Full-face mask with white parallel lines exposing only his mouth and eyes. Notable for his unnaturally wide smile and intense, wild eyes.
Backstory: Witnessed Endeavor apprehending a thief years ago, sparking an obsession with the hero. After imprisonment and release seven years later, he orchestrated a highway attack with Dabi's help to provoke Endeavor into killing him, kidnapping Natsuo Todoroki to force confrontation.
Additional Information: Uses Quirk-boosting Trigger drug to enhance his abilities. Capable of manipulating multiple road lane lines as binding tentacles. Defeated by Class 1-A interns during the highway incident and arrested.

cardPool.title: Emperor Yotsuura
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Emperor Yotsuura

Alias: Emperor Yotsuura

Quirk Name: Soccer

Occupation/Role: Villain, Thief

Personality: Cocky and showboating with an obsessive fascination for soccer. Treats crimes as performance art, displaying his skills even while stealing.

Appearance: A tall young man with tanned skin and penguin-like facial features. Wears a pale diver suit with a red "V" on the chest, baseball cap under a hood, knee-length shorts, gloves, tall sports socks, and webbed-foot soccer shoes. His entire aesthetic mimics penguin features.

Backstory: A low-level criminal operating in Naruhata who built his identity around his Quirk and soccer ability. He targets civilians while brazenly dribbling a soccer ball.

Additional Information: Emperor Yotsuura was apprehended by Ichimoku Samazu and Jube Namaru during a laptop theft. He later joined minor villains including Tommy S. Gordon, Willy Wanda, Rhino Man, and Horse Man to witness The Crawler's battle against Number 6 during the Naruhata Lockdown.

cardPool.title: Emi Fukukado
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Emi Fukukado

Alias: Smile Hero: Ms. Joke

Quirk Name: Outburst

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero and Class 2 Teacher at Ketsubutsu Academy High School

Personality: Cheerful, outgoing, and playful with a goofy sense of humor. She uses comedy as both a personal tool and combat strategy, enjoying teasing others. Despite her obnoxious demeanor, she takes her duties as teacher and hero seriously, valuing her students and their dreams.

Appearance: A young woman with an athletic build and muscular arms. She has seafoam-green hair with short fringe hidden beneath an orange bandana. Her dark green eyes and bright smile are her striking features. Her hero costume includes a sleeveless navy shirt, green-and-orange pinstriped shorts, a corset with yellow smiley-face pins, padded yellow gloves with golden knuckle plates, and orange-striped arm tubes with metal wrist-guards.

Backstory: A famous Pro Hero known for incapacitating opponents through unconventional, humorous methods. She now teaches at Ketsubutsu Academy, passing her combat expertise to the next generation. She holds strong opinions about hero education and skepticism toward U.A. High School's prestige.

cardPool.title: Eleph
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Eleph
Alias: Zō
Quirk Name: Arm Bulk Up
Occupation/Role: High-End Nomu, laboratory creation of Doctor Kyudai Garaki
Personality: Aggressive and combat-hungry, eager for battle; follows other Nomu without resistance; focuses on combat over strategy.
Appearance: A massive, obese elephant Nomu with gray musculature and a large trunk. Three glowing lines run down the trunk. Angular eyes glow with three linear diamond patterns beneath, containing tiny red pupils. Prominent vertebrae jut from his spine. When activating Arm Bulk Up, his arms swell with thick veins.
Backstory: Created by Doctor Kyudai Garaki as a pure-power specialist, Eleph was dormant in the lab beneath Jaku General Hospital. During the hero raid, he was awakened and released with four other High-End Nomu to repel Pro Hero Mirko and protect the doctor's escape with Tomura Shigaraki.
Additional Information: Possesses Super Regeneration and an unnamed Elephant Quirk granting his form, enhanced strength, and a functional trunk. Demonstrated power to tear clumps of hair from a hero's head before being overwhelmed by arriving Pro Heroes.

cardPool.title: Elecplant
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Elecplant
Quirk Name: Electricity Generation
Occupation/Role: Pro Hero
Personality: Dutiful and professional, committed to heroic service and international cooperation. Demonstrates competence in crisis situations and willingness to coordinate with other heroes.
Appearance: Tall figure in a black bodysuit with electric circuit patterns and golden lightning imagery. Face completely obscured by full-face covering with no visible features. Two lightning-bolt shaped radio antennae protrude over his ears. Long flowing red cape with golden lightning decorations extends from his shoulders.
Backstory: American Pro Hero operating primarily in the United States. Participated in major international incidents including casino robberies and counter-terrorism operations against Humarise. Served in the World Heroes Association's global task force and was dispatched to Japan during the Final War to assist against Tomura Shigaraki.
Additional Information: Operates within international hero networks and coordinates across borders. Costume incorporates circuitry designed to channel and amplify his electrical Quirk. Engaged in post-war reconstruction efforts worldwide.

cardPool.title: Eizo Tanuma
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Eizo Tanuma

Alias:
Detective Tanuma

Quirk Name:
Free Walker

Occupation/Role:
Police Force Detective

Personality:
Calm and affable with keen deductive abilities. Eizo maintains a composed demeanor while often knowing more than he reveals, contrasting with his more intense colleagues.

Appearance:
An older man with short, dark receding hair and thin beard. He dresses professionally in a dark suit, black waistcoat, and plain tie.

Backstory:
A veteran detective and former partner of Naomasa Tsukauchi, Eizo has spent years refining his investigative skills. He knows Knuckleduster's secret past as the hero O'Clock, indicating deep connections within the hero community.

Additional Information:
His Quirk, Free Walker, allows his legs to move without fatigue, granting enhanced mobility and endurance. Eizo's accurate assessments of criminal motives and villain plans make him valuable to law enforcement.

cardPool.title: Eijiro Kirishima
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Eijiro Kirishima

Alias: Red Riot

Quirk Name: Hardening

Occupation/Role: UA High School Student, Class 1-A

Personality: Boisterous and outgoing with a strong sense of manliness and chivalry. Determined and selfless, easily moved by displays of bravery. Values honesty and kindness, calling out cowardice while encouraging others. Devoted fan of Crimson Riot, aspiring to live without regret and prioritizing others' safety.

Appearance: Muscular young man of average height with sharp red eyes and small eyebrows. Distinctive bright red hair spiked dramatically with two horn-like tufts on his forehead. Sharp teeth. Wears standard UA uniform with dark red trainers. Hero costume includes dark red shoulder pads, red belt with "R" emblem, jagged sash, black pants, red half cape with ripped hem, dark red boots, and wired mask with spiked fangs.

Backstory: Changed his hair from black to bright red after UA acceptance, symbolizing commitment to his hero dreams inspired by Crimson Riot. Adopts a code of manliness to guide his path as a hero.

Additional Information: Hardening Quirk allows extreme body hardening for defense.

cardPool.title: Eiji Okameda
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Eiji Okameda
Alias: None known
Quirk Name: Gigantic Spinning Flying Turtle
Occupation/Role: Instant Villain (Trigger-enhanced)
Personality: Unknown; observed only under Trigger influence, appearing aggressive and destructive.
Appearance: True form unknown. When transformed by Trigger, becomes a colossal turtle resembling Gamera with a hard spinning shell and visible eyes beneath armored carapace. Likely average height and build in civilian form.
Backstory: An ordinary individual with a turtle-based Quirk. Injected with Trigger and sent to invade Naruhata, where he was quickly defeated by Captain Celebrity, returned to normal form, and possibly arrested.
Additional Information: Baseline Quirk capabilities unclear as only observed under heavy Trigger enhancement. True personality and motivations unknown. Not a UA student.

cardPool.title: Drill Criminal
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Unknown

Alias:
Drill Criminal

Quirk Name:
Unnamed Drill Shooting Quirk

Occupation/Role:
Villain/Bank Robber

Personality:
Aggressive and easily annoyed with a greedy streak. Quick to resort to violence but lacks skill against seasoned heroes.

Appearance:
Lean and athletic build. Red helmet with spike-like drill protrusions, black sleeveless tank top, blue pants, white boots with red accents, and metal gauntlets to channel his Quirk.

Backstory:
A small-time villain committing petty crimes for profit. Gained notoriety for a bank robbery interrupted by heroes Gang Orca and Shishido, where his inexperience led to swift capture.

Additional Information:
His Quirk launches sharp steel drills as projectiles, making him dangerous at range but vulnerable in close combat. A low-tier villain threat who was apprehended and imprisoned.

cardPool.title: Eddie Soul
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Eddie Soul
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Unknown
Occupation/Role: Engineer, Forced Researcher for Humarise
Personality: Loving father despite absences; brave and self-sacrificing, willing to betray captors to save millions. Maintained humanity under coercion.
Appearance: Tall man with short dark brown hair and gray eyes. Wears white buttoned shirt beneath dull blue overcoat.
Backstory: Renowned engineer from Otheon who raised three children after his wife's death. Kidnapped by anti-Quirk terrorist cult Humarise and forced to develop Trigger Bombs. Secretly created a deactivation key to sabotage their plans, prioritizing global safety over survival.
Additional Information: Executed by Humarise upon discovery of betrayal. Initially blamed by his community, but his son Rody later vindicated his heroic sacrifice.

cardPool.title: Drunk Lee
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Drunk Lee
Alias: Drunk Lee
Quirk Name: Dragon Breath
Occupation/Role: Underground fighter
Personality: Aggressive and opportunistic, driven by combat thrills. Cunning enough to weaponize his gear and relentless in pursuit of victory.
Appearance: Tall and muscular with prominent cheekbones and a distinctive two-tendril mustache. Dark suit, dark cap, long Chinese ponytail. Dark domino mask conceals upper face during matches.
Backstory: Earned reputation through Underground Masquerade's brutal fighting rings. His Quirk and combat experience make him formidable despite illegal status.
Additional Information: Carries two alcohol-filled gourds linked by string as fuel for Dragon Breath and secondary weapons. His alcohol reliance is both greatest asset and liability.

cardPool.title: Ectoplasm
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Ectoplasm

Alias: Pro Hero Ectoplasm

Quirk Name: Clones

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero and U.A. High School Mathematics Teacher

Personality: Steadfast and demanding, Ectoplasm pushes students to excel under pressure. He is analytical, intelligent, and respected in hero society for his unwavering commitment to heroism and education.

Appearance: A tall, slender man with short hair, blank inward-tilted eyes behind glasses, and a featureless face with full dentures. He wears a tan and black hero costume with high collar, golden neck detail, black helmet with jaw-guard, and lightweight prosthetic legs.

Backstory: Once a celebrated Pro Hero, Ectoplasm lost his legs during a villain encounter but continued his heroic career without hesitation. Now he shapes the next generation of heroes at U.A. High School through rigorous instruction.

Additional Information: Ectoplasm generates up to thirty clones from ectoplasm streams from his mouth as extensions of his consciousness. He excels in close-range combat despite his prosthetics and can create a giant clone for overwhelming force. His analytical knowledge and combat prowess make him ideal for testing students' abilities.

cardPool.title: Dragon (Villain)
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Dragon
Quirk Name: Dragon
Occupation/Role: Low-ranking villain, League of Villains member
Personality: Aggressive and combat-ready with typical thug mentality. Shows willingness to follow orders but no distinctive personality traits.
Appearance: Muscular build with reptilian snout, sharp teeth, and thick black spikes along his head. Wears purple sleeveless tank top, black armbands, and blue headphones. Dragon-like features give him a menacing appearance.
Backstory: Recruited by Tomura Shigaraki for the assault on the Unforeseen Simulation Joint. Deployed to the Landslide Zone but quickly subdued by Shoto Todoroki's ice quirk and arrested.
Additional Information: Minor antagonist serving as a disposable foot soldier in Shigaraki's invasion force. Easily neutralized by hero trainees. His actual name and background remain unknown.

cardPool.title: Dozaemon
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Dozaemon
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Water Control
Occupation/Role: E-rank Villain, League of Villains recruit
Personality: Impatient and aggressive with tactical awareness; confident in combat and knowledgeable about his Quirk's aquatic advantages; quick to act despite caution.
Appearance: Tall, muscular man in black full-body wetsuit with grey gloves and armored boots. Pale, noseless face with sunken eye sockets, grooved undereyes, protruding teeth, blue eyes with white pupils, and red cranial markings. Gold armor encircles his lower jaw and matches his belt.
Backstory: Recruited by Tomura Shigaraki for the League of Villains' assault on the Unforeseen Simulation Joint, Dozaemon was deployed to the Flood Zone. His water-based Quirk provided tactical advantage until Class 1-A students defeated him with coordinated attacks. He was arrested and later escaped during the Tartarus prison breaks.
Additional Information: Water Control Quirk manipulates water into sharp claws and powerful torrents; strategically skilled in aquatic combat but impulsive in execution; operates primarily in water-based environments.

cardPool.title: Dolphin Villain
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Unknown

Alias:
Dolphin Villain

Quirk Name:
Dolphin

Occupation/Role:
Criminal/Bank Robber

Personality:
Greedy and chaotic with unexpected confidence. Shows concern for environmental issues and demands eco-friendly getaway vehicles. Unfazed by Pro Heroes, willing to threaten hostages. Speaks with dolphin-like clicking sounds.

Appearance:
Humanoid with bottlenose dolphin physiology. Dark teal skin on upper head, diamond blue from chin down. Wears blue striped hoodie, tan pants, navy shoes, and olive-green headphones.

Backstory:
Minor independent villain who attempted a bank robbery for funds and an eco-friendly vehicle. Apprehended by Pro Hero Captain Celebrity and turned over to police.

Additional Information:
Wields a pump-action shotgun. His Dolphin Quirk grants distinctive appearance and echolocation-based verbal tics, though full extent of abilities remains unclear. Low-level threat quickly neutralized by established Pro Heroes.

cardPool.title: Dictator
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Dictator
Quirk Name: Despot
Occupation/Role: Villain, Tartarus escapee serving All For One
Personality: Cunning strategist who prefers overwhelming numbers over direct confrontation. Cowardly, using human shields to avoid combat and targeting exhausted opponents.
Appearance: A short man with severe spinal curvature causing his head to protrude from his torso. Possesses disproportionately long arms and extremely short legs. His round face features a wide mouth with vertical grooves extending from lower lip to chin, small beady eyes with crosshair-like patterns, and a small triangular nose. Wears a large black coat over a dress shirt with control wires stitched throughout.
Backstory: Defeated five years prior by hero Crust in the "Bloodless Surrender Case" and imprisoned in Tartarus. Freed during All For One's prison breakout and conscripted into service. Later confronted Izuku Midoriya in Kamino while controlling civilian puppets, but was defeated by Bakugo's AP Shot and apprehended by Todoroki and Yaoyorozu.
Additional Information: His Despot Quirk allows him to control dozens of people simultaneously via extruding threads.

cardPool.title: Denki Kaminari
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Denki Kaminari

Alias: Chargebolt, Stun Gun Hero

Quirk Name: Electrification

Occupation/Role: UA High School Student, Class 1-A

Personality: Friendly and energetic social butterfly who gets along with most classmates despite occasional recklessness. Well-meaning but blunt, he enjoys encouraging others and has a flirtatious side. He craves appearing cool, sometimes follows others into questionable schemes, but is genuinely kind-hearted beneath his jokester exterior.

Appearance: Light-skinned boy with messy golden-blond hair parted right, featuring a distinctive black lightning-shaped streak on his left fringe. He has slanted golden eyes and appears slimmer than most male classmates. At UA, he wears the standard uniform: light gray blazer with dark turquoise trim, white shirt, dark blue-green pants, red tie, and brown shoes.

Backstory: A first-year student at UA High School training to become a Pro Hero. Denki possesses natural electrical abilities he's learning to harness, driven by desire to make an impact and earn recognition.

cardPool.title: Deidoro Sakaki
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Deidoro Sakaki
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Sloshed
Occupation/Role: Eight Bullets member of Shie Hassaikai
Personality: Energetic and volatile, prone to irritability. Speaks with slurred words and elongates syllables due to constant intoxication. Displays eccentric behavior and remains focused on duties despite his altered state.
Appearance: Extremely thin yet muscular man with long, greasy black hair. Deep-set circular eyes and straight teeth. Wears a drainage mask with tubes channeling alcohol through eyeholes, a furry vest, dark pants, and black shoes. Perpetually disheveled from alcohol dripping down his body.
Backstory: Elite member of the Shie Hassaikai serving under Overhaul. His Quirk likely drove him toward alcoholism for combat effectiveness. Deployed to intercept heroes, he engaged Mirio Togata before being defeated.
Additional Information: Sloshed inflicts severe dizziness and balance disruption on nearby enemies, with strength correlating to blood alcohol content. He carries throwing daggers as secondary weapons. Currently arrested following Overhaul's defeat.

cardPool.title: Deborah Gollini
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Deborah Gollini
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Day Dream
Occupation/Role: Member of the Gollini Family mafia
Personality: Sadistic and snide, Deborah enjoys toying with victims and allies alike. She remains composed and confident, but becomes fearful when threatened by authority. She takes dark satisfaction in controlling victims.
Appearance: A tall woman with a voluptuous build, long black hair, and sharp green eyes with salmon eyeshadow and purple lipstick. She wears an elegant dark dress with spider cobweb pattern at the neckline, feathered sleeves and hem, a large brown belt, and falu red heels. A black-brimmed hat with a red rose and golden crescent earrings complete her outfit.
Backstory: Deborah operates as a trusted member of the Gollini Family criminal organization. She participates in their schemes with cruel enthusiasm, particularly enjoying the psychological manipulation her Quirk provides.
Additional Information: Day Dream renders victims helpless by forcing them into controllable dream states through eye contact alone. Normally limited to one target, her Quirk's effectiveness increases when amplified by Quirk modification.

cardPool.title: Death Arms
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Death Arms, Punching Hero: Death Arms
Quirk Name: Arm Strength
Occupation/Role: Pro Hero
Personality: Serious and disciplined, Death Arms dislikes reckless behavior. He is deeply affected by criticism and temporarily retired after negative public feedback. Despite his stern exterior, he possesses a genuine hero's heart and instinctively protects civilians.
Appearance: An exceptionally tall and muscular man with a wide build and tanned skin. He has a square jaw, small eyes, and short white hair spiked back. His hero costume features a yellow and black-striped caution headband, matching wrist-guards and belt with a square buckle, cyan cardigan exposing his chest, dark blue baggy pants with white side stripes, and black shoes.
Backstory: Death Arms earned recognition as a respected Pro Hero through his powerful arm-based abilities. Following severe criticism after the Paranormal Liberation War, he withdrew from hero work. During the Final War, he saved civilians from debris, rekindling his resolve and sense of purpose.

cardPool.title: David Shield
cardPool.value:
Real Name: David Shield

Alias: The Support Genius

Quirk Name: Squirmy Fingers

Occupation/Role: Scientist and Support Item Developer; Former Sidekick to All Might

Personality: Compassionate and altruistic, driven to help society. Deeply supportive of his daughter. His admiration for All Might borders on reverence, making him willing to bend ethical lines for what he believes serves the greater good. Despite his flaws, he demonstrates selfless courage and eventually accepts hard truths about change and legacy.

Appearance: A tall man of average build with aqua eyes and light brown hair styled short and messy with two prominent bangs. He has light wrinkles and a short goatee. David wears wide-rimmed square glasses, a blue button-up shirt, pale pants, dark belt with metal buckle, navy sneakers with red accents, a dark watch on his left arm, and a wedding ring.

Backstory: A genius inventor who chose to support heroes through costume and gadget design rather than pursue heroics himself, limited by his weak Quirk. He was All Might's trusted sidekick and confidant.

cardPool.title: Danjuro Tobita
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Danjuro Tobita

Alias: Gentle

Quirk Name: Elasticity

Occupation/Role: Independent Villain and Internet Celebrity

Personality: Polite and theatrical despite criminal pursuits. Lacks insight into consequences but means well. Confident and calm. Chases fame over wealth.

Appearance: Refined man with slicked-back black hair, curl at front, handlebar mustache, and medium beard. Black eyeliner. Wears black jacket with enlarged collars and coattails, white pinstriped pants, brown laced shoes, two brown belts with golden buckles, white cuffs, purple gloves, and woolly purple scarf. Carries white cane with golden tip.

Backstory: Once struggled as a high school student, later became a freeter before turning to villainy for internet fame. Orchestrates elaborate crimes for theatrical value and online appeal rather than profit.

Additional Information: Not a UA High School student. Operates through social media documenting his crimes. Works with La Brava, showing genuine care for those close to him despite his criminal pursuits.

cardPool.title: Daikaku Miyagi
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Daikaku Miyagi

Alias:
None

Quirk Name:
Big Horn

Occupation/Role:
Professional Newscaster

Personality:
Fair and professional in his reporting. Thick-skinned and resilient despite public controversy. Known for presenting complex information accessibly, earning widespread trust.

Appearance:
Middle-aged man with facial wrinkles and greenish, straw-colored hair slicked back. Single sheep-like horn on left forehead (right horn removed). Square-shaped glasses, dark blue blazer, pale pink shirt, brown tie.

Backstory:
Built his reputation through fair reporting and clear communication. Surgically removed one horn to perform his duties with greater ease, prioritizing his profession over his Quirk's natural appearance.

Additional Information:
Not a UA High School student. His Quirk naturally produces sheep-like horns on his forehead, though he modified it by removing one horn to reduce hindrances to his broadcasting career.

cardPool.title: Daigoro Banjo
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Daigoro Banjo

Alias: Lariat

Quirk Name: Blackwhip

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero

Personality: Energetic and confident, Daigoro enjoys good-natured teasing and possesses indomitable willpower to resist powerful threats.

Appearance: A large, muscular man with a square jaw, small dull blue eyes, no eyebrows, and a bald head. His hero costume features an open dark leather jacket with yellow shoulder pads, golden goggles, and a bandolier.

Backstory: A seasoned Pro Hero and fifth wielder of One For All, Daigoro received the Quirk from Hikage Shinomori and trained extensively to master both Blackwhip and One For All's power.

Additional Information: Daigoro creates black energy tendrils from his arms for grappling and mobility. As a One For All user, he possesses superhuman strength, speed, agility, and durability. His exceptional willpower allowed him to resist All For One's attempts to steal his Quirks. He is an established professional hero.

cardPool.title: Daigo
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Daigo
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Unnamed Beast Form
Occupation/Role: Wolfram's Minion
Personality: Loyal and battle-hungry, Daigo takes pride in combat abilities and respects skilled fighters. His arrogance leads him to underestimate opponents, a critical flaw.
Appearance: A middle-aged man with tanned skin, round head, small closed black eyes set close together, and a hooked nose. Short dark hair styled round with two visible stripes around the back. Wears a black combat suit with full-face mask featuring a pale X-shaped design.
Backstory: Daigo serves as one of Wolfram's loyal henchmen in the I-Island invasion. He helped restrain security and control the Central Tower before facing U.A. students attempting rescue. He confronted Katsuki Bakugo and was defeated by the student's Howitzer Impact technique.
Additional Information: Daigo's Beast Form Quirk grants dramatic transformation into a hulking purple gorilla-like creature with enhanced strength and exceptional durability, allowing him to break through ice and withstand explosions.

cardPool.title: Dai
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Dai
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Saucer
Occupation/Role: Middle School Student (Third Year)
Personality: Timid and self-doubting, yet caring and brave when others need help. Admires Pro Heroes deeply and acts instinctively to aid those in trouble.
Appearance: Soft-featured boy with squarish dark gray eyes and black hair with gray spots in a bowl cut. Wears beige and orange-brown middle school uniform with white shirt, green tie, and white loafers.
Backstory: Dreamed of becoming a Pro Hero since seeing All Might's statue. In third year, self-doubt grows when classmates mock his weak Quirk. At All Might's statue, he encounters Deku and attempts to save a falling child. Though he stumbles, Deku's encouragement reignites his determination.
Additional Information: Possesses a Quirk that produces stackable, combinable white saucers from his hair. Size and power are adjustable, making it more versatile than apparent. His earnest nature and willingness to help despite doubts show his potential.

cardPool.title: Dadan Tadan
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Dadan Tadan
Alias: Lucky Strike
Quirk Name: Flash Bang Sweat
Occupation/Role: Student, Isami Academy High School
Personality: Meek and timid, often nervous. Dislikes fighting but acts for his team. Conscientious and quick to make peace.
Appearance: A short boy with light chestnut hair, round nose, tiny eyes, and cat-like mouth. Distinctive proportions: thin upper arms with giant hands, wide hips with narrow shoulders, chubby lower stomach. Wears standard Isami High uniform tailored to fit his unusual frame.
Backstory: A student dreaming of becoming a hero named Lucky Strike. Despite his gentle nature and aversion to combat, he uses his abilities for good and demonstrates team loyalty.
Additional Information: His hero costume is a multicolored mech suit with segmented plating in yellow, green, blue, and red. Features missile ports on chest, knees, and lower torso, plus elbow and shoulder-blade boosters. Includes a radar display over his left eye and frames his head without enclosing it.

cardPool.title: Dabi
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Toya Todoroki

Alias: Dabi

Quirk Name: Hellflame

Occupation/Role: Villain, League of Villains member

Personality: Cold and calculating, driven by deep-seated resentment toward his father Endeavor. Dabi masks his emotional turmoil beneath a detached demeanor, speaking with measured precision. Methodical in his villainy, harboring intense hatred that fuels his vengeful ambitions.

Appearance: A tall, pale young man in his early twenties with a slim but muscular build. Distinctive patches of gnarled purple scar tissue cover his lower face, neck, torso, arms, and legs from losing control of his Quirk. He has spiky white hair with heavy bangs obscuring thin, turquoise, heavily-lidded eyes. Multiple silver cartilage piercings adorn both ears with triple nostril piercings on his right side. He wears a dark blue jacket with high ripped collar, matching pants cut above the ankles, a white scoop-neck shirt, and dark dress shoes with a gray patterned belt and brown leather satchel.

Backstory: The eldest son of Pro Hero Endeavor and Rei Todoroki, Toya was neglected by his father's selfish ambitions.

cardPool.title: Curator
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown

Alias: Curator

Quirk Name: Whale

Occupation/Role: Villain

Personality: Cold, calculating, and singularly focused on his goals. Disrespectful and manipulative, using brainwashing as a control tool. Becomes uncontrollable if his containment helmet is damaged.

Appearance: Two-faced figure split down the middle. Right side: fair skin, short messy black hair, tired bagged eye. Left side: dark blue skin, white hair, grotesquely wide red eye, blowhole on forehead, razor-sharp teeth. Wears a gray diving helmet with barnacle protrusions covering his left face, secured by a hanging lock. Black suit under a flamboyant light purple coat with tall fur-lined collar. Gold watches, bracelets, and rings adorn his wrists and fingers.

Backstory: Dangerous mastermind villain scheming to dominate humanity through his Quirk and manipulative abilities. Successfully brainwashed allies like Zookeeper to serve his ambitions.

Additional Information: His Whale Quirk allows full or partial body transformation into a sperm whale, enabling him to fire pressurized water streams. His containment helmet maintains his sanity and control.

cardPool.title: Crust
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Crust

Alias: Shield Hero

Quirk Name: Shield

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero (Rank No. 6)

Personality: Emotional and noble, prone to crying but unwavering in duty. Selfless and willing to sacrifice himself for others with steadfast courage.

Appearance: Well-built man with black hair slicked backward and a grayish-white streak from his hairline center. His right hand bears a crusty, stone-like layer from his Quirk. He wears a black eye mask, Spartan-inspired black armor with red stitching, and a green hooded cape.

Backstory: One of Japan's top ten Pro Heroes, Crust earned his elite ranking through exceptional combat prowess and tactical expertise. He felt deeply about All Might's retirement and regretted missing the Kamino Incident, channeling these emotions into dedicated heroic service.

Additional Information: Specializes in team-based combat and defensive strategies. His Shield Quirk generates hexagonal stone barriers he can enlarge, redirect, sharpen into weapons, and detach as projectiles. Can engage multiple High-End Nomu simultaneously. Known for his encouraging demeanor in dire circumstances.

cardPool.title: Crimson Riot
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Crimson Riot, Chivalrous Hero
Quirk Name: Hardening
Occupation/Role: Pro Hero
Personality: Unwavering in resolve despite inner fear, Crimson Riot believes willpower transcends Quirk ability. He defines "manly spirit" as determination and courage regardless of gender. Haunted by an early failure that cost civilian lives, he channels that trauma into fearless heroism, always charging forward to prevent repeating past mistakes.
Appearance: A sturdy, broad-shouldered man with striking spiky red hair. He wears a distinctive metal three-piece mask covering his mouth and nose, paired with a crimson outfit and a long red cape with a high, wide collar and ripped edges. His aesthetic projects strength and heroic presence.
Backstory: An established Pro Hero whose fearless reputation masks a deeper truth. Early in his career, hesitation resulted in civilian deaths—a tragedy that shaped his heroic philosophy. Rather than paralyzing him, this failure became his driving force to never abandon those within reach. His commitment has inspired countless aspiring heroes.

cardPool.title: Cow Lady
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown

Alias: Cow Lady

Quirk Name: Cow

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero

Personality: Dutiful and confident, Cow Lady is a committed hero willing to collaborate with allies. She maintains professional composure during crises and takes her responsibilities seriously.

Appearance: A tall woman with shoulder-length wavy blonde hair, curved horns, and cow-like ears. She wears a dark orange cropped laced top, sleeveless denim jacket with rope tie, ripped denim shorts, western belt with cow-head buckle, leather gloves, and knee-high boots. A cowboy hat hangs around her neck with tasseled rings on her upper arms and orange-tinted shades.

Backstory: An American Pro Hero from Los Angeles, Cow Lady has built a reputation as a dependable combatant. She responded to a casino robbery alongside Elecplant but was outmatched by the villains. Later, she was dispatched to Japan for international reconstruction efforts.

Additional Information: Cow Lady is a Pro Hero from the United States, not a UA student. Her Quirk allows her to transform into a minotaur-like form with enhanced strength for both combat and construction work.

cardPool.title: Cow Cowboy
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Unknown

Alias:
Cow Cowboy

Quirk Name:
Control Horn

Occupation/Role:
Villain

Personality:
Ruthless and extortive, using threats and intimidation for profit through blackmail with little regard for farmers or their communities.

Appearance:
A short man with small dark eyes behind round glasses and thick eyebrows. He wears a large cow-patterned cowboy hat with protruding horns, a tuxedo shirt under a plain overcoat, baggy pants, boots, and a pendant.

Backstory:
Cow Cowboy targeted rural farming communities using his Quirk to coerce farmers into meeting his demands. All Might confronted and defeated him while he threatened to destroy multiple farms, resulting in his arrest. His sidekicks abandoned him upon capture.

Additional Information:
His Quirk allows him to mind control cattle, which he uses for extortion schemes. Little is known about his relationships with his sidekicks beyond employment. He represents Quirk-based crime threats in isolated communities.

cardPool.title: Composer Hero
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown (Conjectural)

Alias: Composer Hero

Quirk Name: Unnamed Music Quirk

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero

Personality: Professional and composed, performing heroic duties with confidence. Remains calm under pressure during combat and excels in team operations.

Appearance: Tall, well-built man with chin-length blond hair and sharp green eyes. Wears an orange jacket resembling a violin with dangling flaps, golden collar buttons, three belt straps on each upper arm, and white gloves. Carries a long yellow conductor's baton.

Backstory: Accomplished Pro Hero invited to prestigious events like I-Island and selected for dangerous Humarise cult raids, indicating high status and exceptional combat experience.

Additional Information: His Quirk generates golden musical notes that pacify and incapacitate enemies for capture without lethal force. Can amplify effects through musical instruments for large-scale impact. Primarily used for support and villain subdual rather than direct combat.

cardPool.title: Clair Voyance
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Clair Voyance

Alias:
None

Quirk Name:
Voyance

Occupation/Role:
Pro Hero, World Heroes Association member, Otheon Task Force operative

Personality:
Calm, resolved, and serious. Dutiful and reliable, readily assisting others with information and support. Professional and composed under pressure.

Appearance:
A curvy woman with bright blue eyes hidden behind a visor with large blue-tinted lenses. She has straight blonde hair with a brown patch from her roots. She wears a form-fitting royal blue suit with a white high-collared dress shirt, dark magenta zipper down the middle, and short sleeves bearing the WHA logo. Black thigh-high boots with magenta lines and a brown holster on her right thigh complete her outfit.

Backstory:
An international pro hero recruited by the World Heroes Association for a global operation against Humarise, an anti-Quirk terrorist organization. She joined the Otheon Task Force led by Endeavor to raid Humarise headquarters and locate Trigger Bombs following a terrorist attack. During the raid, she used her Quirk to scan the building, though her search proved unsuccessful.

Additional Information:
Not a UA student.

cardPool.title: Chuma Yakumaru
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Chuma Yakumaru
Alias: The Junkie
Quirk Name: Bruiser
Occupation/Role: Instant Villain
Personality: Antisocial and volatile, Chuma is hostile to everyone around him. Mentally unstable with severe drug dependency, he becomes increasingly aggressive and unpredictable when under the influence of Trigger, turning violent without warning.
Appearance: A haggard man with greasy dark hair, sunken cheekbones, and stubble. He wears a dirty open shirt with dark pants. When enhanced by Trigger, his body transforms—becoming taller and bulkier with veiny reddish-purple skin and enlarged eyes.
Backstory: Chuma was supplied Trigger by Kuin Hachisuka to manifest his Quirk. Desperate for the drug's rush, he became an Instant Villain, attacking both Kuin and civilians before being defeated by Knuckleduster.
Additional Information: Chuma is a criminal operating in Naruhata. His Quirk allows him to power up individual limbs for devastating attacks. When amplified by Trigger, his entire body becomes supercharged, making him a dangerous but ultimately beatable threat.

cardPool.title: Chubs
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown (formerly a glutton)
Alias: Chubs
Quirk Name: Super Regeneration, Body Expansion, Mouth, Metal Teeth
Occupation/Role: High-End Nomu, Doctor Garaki's bioengineered creation
Personality: Obedient yet tactically aware; prefers direct confrontation; recognizes specific opponents; speaks with slight stuttering.
Appearance: Grotesquely bulbous body with excessive adipose tissue; robotic thrusters grafted at thighs; hands fused into mouths with teeth and tongues; additional mouths line torso; small vertebrae protrude from back; metal grid covers head.
Backstory: Originally a glutton, selected by Doctor Garaki and surgically transformed into a High-End Nomu through Quirk grafting and cybernetic enhancement for the League of Villains.
Additional Information: Deployed during the Paranormal Liberation War to defend Garaki's laboratory beneath Jaku General Hospital; held passage against Pro Heroes including Crust until Eraser Head nullified his Quirks; destroyed by Tomura Shigaraki's Decay.

cardPool.title: Christopher Skyline
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Christopher Skyline

Alias: Captain Celebrity, Playboy Hero

Quirk Name: Force Field

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero (American, operating in Japan)

Personality: Arrogant and attention-seeking with a bombastic personality, yet genuinely heroic in crises. Despite his flirtatiousness and poor judgment, he desires to make people smile. His lack of self-awareness regarding inappropriate behavior stems from obsession with his alpha male image rather than malice.

Appearance: Exceptionally tall and well-built with a chiseled jawline, cleft chin, and angular nose. Blonde hair in a swept-back mohawk with light blue, downward-tilting eyes and long eyelashes. He wears a cerulean skin-tight bodysuit trimmed in yellow with a red-starred chest logo, matching shin and shoulder-pads, yellow belt with large buckle, and a long red cape with dark blue visor.

Backstory: Once America's top-ranked hero, Christopher's controversial womanizing forced him to relocate to Japan to rebuild his career. Under management and facing fatherhood, he began genuine self-improvement, though his extravagant nature persists.

cardPool.title: Chomper
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Chomper
Quirk Name: Plant
Occupation/Role: F-rank Villain, League of Villains member
Personality: Confident in combat despite low rank; bold or reckless enough to assault U.A. High School.
Appearance: Average-height man in orange sweater and magenta pants. His head is a large venus flytrap continuously oozing green fluid.
Backstory: Recruited by Tomura Shigaraki for the U.S.J. assault. Origins unknown before joining the League of Villains.
Additional Information: Plant Quirk allows transformation of body parts into plant structures with healing properties for allies. Defeated at U.S.J., arrested by Pro Heroes. Later appeared in manipulated footage from Deika City battle.

cardPool.title: Chojuro Kon
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Chojuro Kon

Alias:
Chimera

Quirk Name:
Chimera

Occupation/Role:
Villain; member of Nine's criminal organization

Personality:
Driven by societal hatred from lifelong ostracization, Chojuro seeks to build a power-based society with Nine. Despite brutality, he shows occasional compassion toward allies. He displays hypocrisy mocking others' monstrous features while possessing animalistic traits himself.

Appearance:
An imposing man with blue fur covering his body and a wolf-like head. His hands and feet resemble eagle talons with a long reptilian tail. He wears a brown trench coat over a blue dress shirt with jeans, often smoking a cigar.

Backstory:
Rejected by society for his inhuman appearance, Chojuro lived as an outcast until Nine recruited him. Viewing Nine as his savior, he devoted himself to a vision of a new world ordered by power alone.

Additional Information:
Second-strongest member of Nine's team. Excels in hand-to-hand combat with tremendous physical strength and fire-breath attacks.

cardPool.title: Chizuo Magi
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Chizuo Magi
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Unknown
Occupation/Role: Retired; Grandfather and household resident
Personality: Loving and kind-hearted, deeply caring toward his family. Compassionate and attempts to comfort his grandchildren, but struggles with confrontation and fear of his abusive son-in-law. Eventually finds courage to stand against injustice, though too late to prevent tragedy.
Appearance: A relatively chubby elderly man with hair the same color as his daughter Nao. He has a gentle, grandfatherly demeanor.
Backstory: Chizuo lived in his daughter's home with his wife Mako and grandchildren Tenko and Hana. He witnessed years of abuse from his son-in-law Kotaro toward the children for admiring heroes. When Kotaro physically punished Tenko excessively, Chizuo finally joined his family in confronting him. That same night, Tenko's Decay Quirk manifested uncontrollably, killing the family dog, Hana, and ultimately Chizuo, his wife, and his daughter.
Additional Information: Deceased. His hands were recovered by All For One and incorporated into Tomura Shigaraki's villain costume.

cardPool.title: Chizome Akaguro
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Chizome Akaguro

Alias: Hero Killer: Stain, formerly Stendhal

Quirk Name: Bloodcurdle

Occupation/Role: Villain/Former Vigilante

Personality: A cruel ideologue obsessed with purging "false heroes" from society. He possesses uncompromising moral convictions and reveres only All Might as a true hero. Willful, calculating, and devoted to his twisted vision of justice, he justifies his murderous crusade as necessary cleansing.

Appearance: An intimidating muscular man with hunched posture and triangular face. His striking features include small red eyes, self-removed nose, and an extraordinarily long tongue with papillae. He has long messy black hair beneath a blood-red headband and tattered cloth mask. His dark combat suit features plated metal armor on the torso, sleeveless design revealing yellow bandages on forearms, black wristbands, metal knee pads, black boots with steel armor, and a crimson scarf.

Backstory: Once a vigilante named Stendhal, Chizome became the Hero Killer after concluding society's heroes were corrupt. He has killed numerous Pro Heroes to "stain his own hands" and reform the heroic system.

cardPool.title: Chiyo Shuzenji
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Chiyo Shuzenji

Alias: Recovery Girl, Youthful Heroine

Quirk Name: Heal

Occupation/Role: School Nurse at U.A. High School

Personality: Compassionate and caring, but maintains strict standards against reckless behavior and Quirk misuse. She offers sweets to counter her Quirk's stamina-draining effects and can be harsh when necessary, refusing to enable harmful patterns.

Appearance: A short, elderly woman with gray hair in a netted bun with a large syringe protruding from it. She has tiny dash-like eyes, a small nose, and deep nasolabial folds. She wears a white lab coat over a dress with yellow and red vest designs, yellow buttons, and a pink "R" belt buckle. Pink boots, a helmet framing her head, and a purple-tinted visor complete her outfit. She walks with a syringe-shaped cane.

Backstory: An experienced medical professional serving U.A. High School as its primary nurse with offices at the school and Sports Festival Stadium. Her decades of experience combine formal medical training with her powerful Quirk.

Additional Information: Chiyo possesses genuine surgical expertise beyond her Quirk.

cardPool.title: Chitose Kizuki
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Chitose Kizuki

Alias: Curious

Quirk Name: Lacquering

Occupation/Role: Executive Director of Shoowaysha Publishing, Meta Liberation Army Leader

Personality: Intensely curious and obsessively driven by journalism, Chitose pursues stories above all else. She is callous and manipulative, willing to weaponize subordinates and murder for the perfect narrative. Her obsessive nature causes her to lose all sense of danger, becoming entranced by compelling human drama.

Appearance: Chitose is a striking woman with long, pale lilac hair. She has black sclerae, green irises, and black pupils, framed by long eyelashes. Her skin is pale blue. She typically wears a navy blue, shoulderless dress with long sleeves, an X-shaped belt, and laced high boots. She wears gold earrings and an unbuttoned salmon-colored jacket with black fur collar.

Backstory: A passionate journalist, Chitose built her reputation at Shoowaysha Publishing before being recruited into the Meta Liberation Army by Rikiya Yotsubashi. She devoted herself to documenting stories that serve the Army's cause of liberating Quirk society.

cardPool.title: Chikuchi Togeike
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Chikuchi Togeike

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Not specified

Occupation/Role: Student, U.A. High School General Department

Personality: Initially envious of Class 1-A's popularity, viewing their success as undeserved. After witnessing their School Festival performance, she demonstrated capacity for remorse and appreciation. Generally sullen but willing to acknowledge others' achievements.

Appearance: Young woman of average build with dark, ear-length hair in low curved pigtails with upward-arching bangs. Thin, stern-looking eyes with prominent lower eyelashes and typically sullen expression. Wears standard U.A. High School uniform.

Backstory: A General Department student who resented Class 1-A until their School Festival performance prompted genuine self-reflection and apology. During the Final War, she assisted civilians in the U.A. Underground Evacuation Bunkers.

Additional Information: U.A. High School General Department student. Considers Nejire Hado an idol. Capable of growth when confronted with evidence contradicting her biases.

cardPool.title: Chikara Yotsubashi
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Chikara Yotsubashi

Alias: Destro

Quirk Name: Not specified in source

Occupation/Role: Infamous villain, founder and grand commander of the original Meta Liberation Army

Personality: Idealistic revolutionary who believed Quirk use was a fundamental human right. He viewed government regulation as oppressive and inspired devoted followers, though opponents saw only chaos in his methods.

Appearance: Long light brown hair in a ponytail with a distinctive black blotch around his eyes like a mask. He wore a dark green military jacket with a red-outlined rat patch on the right sleeve, gray shirt, and red ascot tie.

Backstory: Born during an era of Meta Ability prejudice, Chikara faced social rejection. His mother advocated for acceptance and coined the term "Quirk," earning her the title "Mother of Quirks." After her murder by anti-Meta opponents, he founded the Meta Liberation Army under the alias Destro to fight government suppression. Defeated and imprisoned, he wrote a biographical manifesto before taking his own life.

Additional Information: Though long dead, his published writings continue inspiring new generations of villains and liberate ideology followers.

cardPool.title: Cathleen Bate
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Cathleen Bate

Alias: Star and Stripe

Quirk Name: New Order

Occupation/Role: No. 1 Pro Hero of the United States of America

Personality: Brash, selfless, and fiercely protective with intense justice. Admires All Might and defies rules to save others. Kind and sisterly to her team. Willing to sacrifice everything for those she protects.

Appearance: Tall woman with athletic build and elegant features. Long blonde hair in eight backward-swept tufts like All Might's form, narrow brown eyes, and red domino mask. Skin-tight bodysuit with striped patterns, metal-studded gauntlets and collar with star designs, and a flag-patterned cape.

Backstory: Inspired by All Might saving her family, Cathleen dedicated herself to heroism. Once insecure about her Quirk as a young girl, she was encouraged by her squadron to embrace her own strength. She rose to become America's No. 1 hero, earning the nickname "Star" from her team.

Additional Information: Not a UA student. Operating at the highest level of international heroism. Known for disregarding protocol when civilian lives are at stake.

cardPool.title: Cargirl
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Cargirl
Quirk Name: Car
Occupation/Role: Pro Hero
Personality: Amiable and approachable with admirers. Reserved about personal details.
Appearance: Slender blonde woman with ponytail and spiral curls. Wears purple beret with visor, sleeveless white crop top, purple armor-like hood, white shorts with purple stripes, dark knee-high boots, and a purple skirt-shell with functioning wheels resembling a racing car rear.
Backstory: Established Pro Hero specializing in automotive-themed heroics. Background in or passion for auto-racing culture, though origins remain obscure.
Additional Information: Not a UA High School student. Quirk mechanics are car-related but ambiguous. Active during the Two Heroes film timeline.

cardPool.title: Camie Utsushimi
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Camie Utsushimi

Alias: Illus-o-Camie

Quirk Name: Glamour

Occupation/Role: Second-year student at Shiketsu High School

Personality: Bubbly, laid-back, and straightforward, Camie brushes off serious situations with ease. She speaks in trendy gyaru-like slang and appears naïve, but possesses genuine strategic cleverness and offers insightful advice.

Appearance: Average height with straight, light brown hair below her shoulders and large, dark brown eyes. Plump, glossy lips and curvaceous figure. Wears Shiketsu uniform with white-collared shirt and dark skirt. Hero costume is a black catsuit with patterned lines, white wrist cuffs, white heeled knee-high boots with gray patterns, and a loose black collar with metallic plates.

Backstory: A prestigious second-year at Shiketsu High School training to become a Pro Hero. Recently impersonated by villain Himiko Toga during the Provisional Hero License Exam, an incident she takes in stride. Her easy-going nature masks her tactical mind and growing experience.

Additional Information: Prefers being called by her first name. Clever with children and creative in problem-solving, favoring non-violent approaches.

cardPool.title: Bye-Bites
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Bye-Bites

Alias:
Sharukinara

Quirk Name:
Unnamed Shark Quirk

Occupation/Role:
Low-ranking villain recruited by the League of Villains for the U.S.J. assault

Personality:
Cruel and sadistic with no remorse. Cautious of unknown Quirks but eager to eliminate targets. Demonstrates patience in combat.

Appearance:
Humanoid shark with light blue skin, dark blue hair, and yellow eyes. Prominent fin and sharp teeth with elongated jaw. Wears sleeveless diving suit with diving mask and oxygen cylinder.

Backstory:
One of seventy villains conscripted by Tomura Shigaraki to assault U.A. High School's Unforeseen Simulation Joint. Deployed to the Flood Zone and engaged Class 1-A students before being defeated and arrested.

Additional Information:
Quirk grants enhanced swimming speed and powerful bite but requires oxygen cylinder for underwater breathing. Lacks knowledge of opponents' Quirks. Subdued when caught in Midoriya's whirlpool and trapped by Mineta's sticky spheres.

cardPool.title: Bruno Gollini
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Bruno Gollini

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Delay Spot

Occupation/Role: Member of the Gollini Family mafia

Personality: Sly and cunning, Bruno enjoys catching opponents off-guard. His confidence crumbles when outmatched, replaced by panic.

Appearance: A tall, slim middle-aged man with slicked greying hair, sharp black eyes, and defined jawline. His hairy hands are adorned with rings and jewelry. He wears a black suit jacket with blue tuxedo shirt, gray pants, plum ascot tie, and a rose pinned to his tux.

Backstory: Bruno operates as a trusted member of the Gollini Family, leveraging his Delay Spot Quirk to intimidate and control opponents during their operations.

Additional Information: Delay Spot creates a semi-spherical bubble trapping everything inside in slow motion while Bruno moves at normal speed. He can exempt people or objects by touching them. His Quirk's range expanded significantly after receiving Anna's Overmodification boost. The ability fails against extremely fast attacks, which retain enough momentum to cause serious damage.

cardPool.title: Bruce Lee
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Bruce Lee
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Fa Jin
Occupation/Role: Resistance Member, One For All User
Personality: Serious and apathetic from surviving society's collapse, with unwavering belief in justice. Views the world in black and white—victory means life, defeat means death. Initially skeptical of idealism but capable of empathy when convinced. Fiercely loyal to allies.
Appearance: Tall, athletic build with striking silver hair in an upward spiky ponytail. Dark eyes and sharp features. Wears a black forehead bandana and green combat jacket signifying resistance membership.
Backstory: Bruce survived Quirks' early emergence as a battle-hardened combatant. He joined Toshitsugu Kudo's resistance against All For One, becoming Kudo's trusted second-in-command. Kudo passed One For All to him as successor. Initially refusing to mentor Izuku Midoriya due to doubts about the boy's optimism, Yoichi Shigaraki's persuasion and Bruce's own empathy led him to teach the young hero Fa Jin. Bruce died alongside Kudo fighting All For One.
Additional Information: Third user of One For All. His Fa Jin Quirk accumulates kinetic energy through repetitive movements and releases it explosively.

cardPool.title: Briareos
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Briareos

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Multiple Arm

Occupation/Role: Tartarus Prison Guard

Personality: Duty-bound and resolute, Briareos demonstrates unwavering commitment to his post. He remains calm under pressure, issuing tactical orders even during catastrophic threats.

Appearance: An imposing figure in crimson and black armor plating with a sleek, intimidating helmet that obscures his face. His Quirk grants him ten arms, which he wields with practiced efficiency in combat.

Backstory: Briareos served as a senior guard at Tartarus prison's Bronze Gate alongside his brother Gyges. When the Paranormal Liberation Front breached the facility, he stood against High-End Nomu despite countless hero deaths and the escape of dangerous villains, including Tomura Shigaraki.

Additional Information: Briareos possessed enhanced strength proportional to his multiple limbs, capable of wielding heavy military-grade miniguns. He died defending Tartarus when a Nomu's spike barrage overwhelmed his position, demonstrating steadfast dedication to containing superhuman threats.

cardPool.title: Bombers
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Bomber (Designation Unknown)
Alias: Bomber, Next-Level Villain
Quirk Name: Explosive Detonation (varies by specimen)
Occupation/Role: Mass-produced combat entity created by the Villain Factory
Personality: Operates on programmed directives with absolute obedience. Devoid of self-preservation instinct or fear, making them ideal for suicide assault missions.
Appearance: Round, winged entity with jet-black skin and serpentine head lacking facial features save a wide mouth. Two bat wings protrude from the back. A swollen belly contains explosive energy reserves. Specialized variants exist, such as the Captain Celebrity hunter, which stands larger with six muscular arms.
Backstory: Manufactured by the Villain Factory at Onomura Pharma Corp., these creatures were engineered as expendable weapons. Deployed by villain Number 6 against Pro Hero Captain Celebrity during the Tokyo Sky Egg incident as part of an assassination plot.
Additional Information: Combat-oriented fabricated entities, not UA students. Each possesses an explosive Quirk in its abdominal cavity. Some feature specialized Quirks like Regeneration or EMP generation.

cardPool.title: Bomb Villain
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Bomb Villain
Quirk Name: Fire Cracker
Occupation/Role: Professional Villain, Jewelry Thief
Personality: Greedy and overconfident, arrogant in combat. Smirks at opponents he believes defeated before acting rashly.
Appearance: Tall with large afro, thick lips, prominent facial hair, sharp nose. Wears fringed blazer, belt with twinkle symbol, long pants, and spiked high-heeled boots.
Backstory: Career criminal in organized villain networks. Partners with the Gale Villain on heists, prioritizing material wealth over ideology.
Additional Information: Fire Cracker Quirk rips chunks of his hair to detonate as explosives—hurled as bombs or used for propulsion bursts. Destructive power rivals building-level damage but inferior to similar Explosion-type Quirks. Chronically underestimates opponents.

cardPool.title: Blackbelt
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Blackbelt, Martial Hero: Blackbelt
Quirk Name: Fast Fist
Occupation/Role: Pro Hero
Personality: Seeks recognition while maintaining genuine heroic duty. Affects Shakespearean speech but lapses into normal dialogue. Creates unnecessarily complex techniques for show. Prioritizes saving lives over fame when it matters.
Appearance: Young man with long, messy hair and muscular build. Wears martial artist-inspired hero costume with metal headband, loose robes, and large belt with light facial makeup.
Backstory: Became Pro Hero 10 years ago seeking fame and recognition. Faced mockery from doubters of his superhuman speed, earning the nickname "Hundo-Hit-Man." Nearly retired until UA students Momo Yaoyorozu, Denki Kaminari, and Mei Hatsume created a high-speed camera drone capturing evidence of his true abilities, vindicating him.
Additional Information: Fast Fist grants him 100 consecutive punches in under one second, appearing as a blur. Public acknowledgement came through his Team-Up Missions performance streamed via Mei's drone technology.

cardPool.title: Zookeeper
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Unknown

Alias:
Zookeeper

Quirk Name:
Cleaning

Occupation/Role:
Former Zookeeper, Villain (Brainwashed Companion of Curator)

Personality:
Once kind and cheerful with deep love for animals, now under Curator's mental control. Her gentle nature is suppressed by brainwashing.

Appearance:
Woman with shoulder-length white hair and white irises. Black and red buttoned outfit with white gloves and black boots.

Backstory:
A dedicated zookeeper captured and brainwashed by Curator, transformed into his loyal subordinate and stripped of free will.

Additional Information:
Her Quirk secretes a dish soap-like substance that weakens enemies by "cleaning" them and sanitizes crime scenes. She wields a wooden push broom as her primary weapon. Not a UA student. Part of the Clash! Heroes Battle arcade game universe.

cardPool.title: Yuyu Haya
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Yuyu Haya

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Unknown

Occupation/Role: UA High School Student, Class 3-A

Personality: Friendly and fashionable with a protective streak. Levelheaded and diligent as a hero-in-training, though her protective nature can cause her to jump to conclusions. Highly loyal and supportive, especially toward her best friend Nejire Hado.

Appearance: Fair-skinned girl with cropped salmon-colored hair, reddish-brown eyes with long lower eyelashes, and multiple grey ear piercings. Her school uniform is slightly disheveled with a crooked collar and rolled sleeves, paired with tights and two pink bracelets. Her hero costume features a black domino mask, purple suit with yellow markings, purple boots with white and yellow accents, black arm sleeves, and a white belt with cylinder attachments.

Backstory: A third-year student at UA High School and best friend to Nejire Hado since first year. Yuyu supported Nejire through multiple beauty pageant competitions and remains her dedicated confidant throughout their time at UA.

Additional Information: Yuyu assists in powering UA's flying fortress through her Quirk and mentors junior students.

cardPool.title: Yuga Aoyama
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Yuga Aoyama

Alias: Shining Hero: Can't Stop Twinkling

Quirk Name: Navel Laser

Occupation/Role: Class 1-A Student at UA High School

Personality: Vain and flamboyant with affected French mannerisms, Yuga speaks with stars (☆) and poses dramatically for attention. Beneath this facade lies deep insecurity from his Quirkless birth and complicated origins involving All For One.

Appearance: A slim young man with an effeminate face, long blonde hair spiked at the sides with curved fringe, long eyelashes, and bright indigo eyes. His hero costume features a black bodysuit beneath metallic lavender armor with golden accents, a high V-neck chest plate, spherical shoulder pads, elbow-length vambraces, and knee boots. A glittery indigo cape flows from his golden ring-buckled belt with blue crystal. A red-tinted wing-shaped visor frames his eyes.

Backstory: Born Quirkless, Yuga faced discrimination until his parents contacted All For One to grant him a Quirk, creating hidden burden and guilt.

Additional Information: UA Class 1-A first-year student carrying severe insecurity about his true nature and origins.

cardPool.title: Yui Kodai
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Yui Kodai

Alias:
Rule

Quirk Name:
Size

Occupation/Role:
UA High School Student, Class 1-B

Personality:
Quiet and emotionally reserved, rarely expressing feelings outwardly. Despite her silent nature, she genuinely cares for classmates and shows warmth through subtle actions. She communicates happiness with soft "Mm!" sounds and displays enthusiasm for tomatoes.

Appearance:
A young girl with shoulder-length bob-cut hair, side-swept bangs, and fair skin. Narrow cerulean eyes and athletic build. Her hero costume is a red bodysuit with white-collar trim and white "V" pattern across chest and upper arms, paired with a short white skirt. She wears white vambraces with yellow accents, a red baseball-cap-style hat with white U-shaped lines and yellow dots, and carries pouches filled with metal components.

Backstory:
A first-year student at UA High School training to become a Pro Hero. Yui is a reliable team player who excels during training exercises and combat scenarios.

Additional Information:
Her Quirk allows her to alter the size of any inanimate object she touches, returning them to normal by pressing her fingertips together.

cardPool.title: Yu Takeyama
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Yu Takeyama

Alias: Mt. Lady, Peak Hero: Mt. Lady

Quirk Name: Gigantification

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero (No. 23), UA High School Student, Class 1-A

Personality: Ambitious and egotistical, Yu thrives on attention and fame. Beneath her superficial nature lies genuine heroic courage—she protects civilians without hesitation and refuses to transform in confined spaces to prevent collateral damage.

Appearance: An above-average height young woman with fair skin and a curvaceous frame. She has striking magenta eyes with white pupils, long eyelashes, and voluminous creamy blonde hair reaching her waist with two shorter curled strands framing her face. Her hero costume consists of a purple and pale tan skin-tight bodysuit with orange stripe accents, purple gloves with orange cuffs, and thigh-cut purple boots. Three orange diamond-shaped marks sit beneath her chest, and she wears a purple domino mask with horn-like side protrusions.

Backstory: Yu discovered early that her Gigantification Quirk paired with her natural charisma could make her a star. She pursued heroics for the glamour and fame, becoming a rising hero who leverages her appearance as much as her powers.

cardPool.title: Yu Hojo
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Yu Hojo
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Crystallize
Occupation/Role: Eight Bullets member of the Shie Hassaikai yakuza organization
Personality: Serious and loyal to Overhaul. Yu harbors deep resentment from past abuse and views himself as worthless, but finds purpose through his yakuza family. He dismisses heroes as incapable of understanding bonds between outcasts.
Appearance: A tall, muscular man with a shaven head and shadowed, intense eyes. He wears a dark dress shirt with top buttons undone, plain pants, and black dress shoes. Unlike other Eight Bullets, he wears a simple white medical mask rather than their signature beaked masks.
Backstory: Yu was beaten and left for dead after producing worthless gems for a criminal. Overhaul discovered him and offered him a place in the Shie Hassaikai, giving him purpose and family. Yu accepted without hesitation, transforming his despair into absolute loyalty.
Additional Information: Yu operates as part of a three-member combat unit with fellow Eight Bullets members Toya Setsuno and Soramitsu Tabe. His Crystallize Quirk manifests sharp crystalline structures across his body to enhance melee attacks with tremendous force.

cardPool.title: Yosetsu Awase
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Yosetsu Awase

Alias:
Welder

Quirk Name:
Weld

Occupation/Role:
