Student, Class 1-B at U.A. High School

Personality:
Foul-mouthed and tense normally, but becomes talkative during crises. Selfless and willing to risk himself for others. Proud and confident in his abilities. Strategic combatant with excellent tactical awareness.

Appearance:
Long black hair spiked upward, rounded gray eyes tilted inward. Wears a wide blue and white zig-zag patterned headband low across his forehead. Hero costume is a burgundy baggy full-body suit with extended collar, dark brown shoulder pads, layered chest armor, white knee-high boots with brown accents, and two blue utility bags containing metal and wood blocks.

Backstory:
Ranked 10th in the U.A. Entrance Exam with the third-highest villain points. Trained rigorously to master his Quirk as both offensive and restraining tool, capable of outsmarting Class 1-A's strongest students.

Additional Information:
Weld allows atomic-level fusion of objects he touches simultaneously, working on organic and inorganic material. Uses steel logs as extensions to bind distant targets without contact.

cardPool.title: Yoroi Musha
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Yoroi Musha

Alias: Equipped Hero: Yoroi Musha

Quirk Name: Unknown

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero (No. 9 ranking), mentor to UA Work-Study interns

Personality: Traditional and duty-bound, Yoroi Musha presents himself as a steadfast upholder of heroic ideals, though he struggles with conviction under pressure. His heroism was motivated by fame and respect rather than genuine altruism.

Appearance: An elderly man with a bald head and long white beard, distinguished by pale orange eyes with black sclera. He wears a full suit of Japanese armor styled as his hero costume, complete with an upward-pointing horn on his helmet and a crimson cape.

Backstory: Yoroi Musha rose to prominence as the ninth-ranked Pro Hero through demonstrated combat skill. He mentored UA High School students during their Work-Study program, including Mina Ashido, Toru Hagakure, and Yuga Aoyama, establishing himself as a respected figure before the Paranormal Liberation War shattered public confidence in heroes.

Additional Information: His Quirk manifests as a white glow on his forehead.

cardPool.title: Yokumiru Mera
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Yokumiru Mera

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Unknown

Occupation/Role: Worker for the Hero Public Safety Commission; Acting President of the Commission

Personality: Perpetually sleep-deprived and blasé, Yokumiru complains about exhaustion while maintaining a disinterested demeanor. Despite his weariness, he demonstrates inspirational leadership and compassion, offering failed examinees remedial paths. He maintains a mentor-like rapport with those he supervises, having guided Hawks through morally complex training.

Appearance: A lanky, middle-aged man with chin-length beige disheveled hair framing hollow tired eyes marked by prominent under-eye bags. He wears a black shirt over white undershirt, black pants, and loose tie with black shoes. He carries a microphone for official announcements.

Backstory: A longtime Commission operative tasked with training hero candidates, Yokumiru earned respect through mentoring Hawks as a teenager. His competence led to supervising the Provisional Hero License Exam. Following the Paranormal Liberation Front's attack on headquarters and the original President's death, he assumed acting presidency before Hawks succeeded him.

cardPool.title: Yoichi Shigaraki
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Yoichi Shigaraki

Alias: The First One For All User

Quirk Name: One For All

Occupation/Role: Historical figure; deceased hero whose will persists within the One For All Quirk

Personality: Principled and compassionate despite hardship, Yoichi maintains unwavering moral conviction and hope for redemption even when betrayed. He refuses to use stolen power and advocates for justice, inspiring successive heroes through his embedded will. Though disgusted by his brother's cruelty, he never fully surrenders his love for him.

Appearance: A young man with sickly, malnourished features and chronically weak physique. He has shoulder-length white messy hair with bangs obscuring bright green eyes. He wore simple clothing—white shirt, dark pants, and occasionally a light blue jacket. His frail build reflected lifelong physical frailty.

Backstory: Born as younger twin to Zen Shigaraki during the era of Quirk emergence, Yoichi was presumed Quirkless while watching his brother massacre innocents to steal abilities. When forcibly given the Power Stock Quirk, it merged with his latent transfer ability, creating One For All.

cardPool.title: X-Less
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: X-Less, Eye-Gun Hero: X-Less
Quirk Name: Laser
Occupation/Role: Pro Hero
Personality: Cautious and methodical, X-Less prioritizes safety and thorough investigation over rushing forward. He eliminates unknown threats before advancing, showing restraint and strategic thinking.
Appearance: A lean man with an angular face, full lips, and a distinctive undercut extending from neck to forehead with hair combed rightward. His right eye lacks a visible pupil, defining his Quirk. He wears a blue hero costume with light upper and dark lower sections, dark blue striped sleeves with three yellow accents, and a red cape. A dark blue stripe wraps around his head over his right eye.
Backstory: X-Less rose through the ranks as a capable Pro Hero, earning recognition for his precision-based combat style. His cautious nature has served him well in field operations.
Additional Information: X-Less possesses the Laser Quirk, enabling him to fire concentrated energy beams from his right eye with significant destructive capability. His tactical mindset makes him a valuable member of hero raid teams.

cardPool.title: Yashamaru
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Yashamaru

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Unknown

Occupation/Role: Low-ranking villain, League of Villains recruit

Personality: Aggressive and direct, willing to charge into combat without hesitation. Follows orders from superiors like Tomura Shigaraki.

Appearance: Muscular build with spiky dark blond hair. Distinctive upward-curving horns protrude from his forehead. Sharp fangs visible in his mouth. Wears a black shirt and spiked bracelets on both wrists.

Backstory: A minor criminal recruited by the League of Villains for the coordinated assault on the Unforeseen Simulation Joint. Served as disposable infantry among seventy low-ranking villains in Tomura Shigaraki's plan to strike at UA High School.

Additional Information: Defeated during the U.S.J. incident by Ectoplasm's clones after being stunned by Present Mic's Voice Quirk. Represents the expendable foot soldiers utilized by the League of Villains in their early operations.

cardPool.title: Wolfram
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Wolfram

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Metal Manipulation

Occupation/Role: Villain, Leader of Thief Troupe

Personality: Avaricious and manipulative, Wolfram cares only for himself and wealth. He enjoys tormenting others and mocking heroic ideals. Cold and ruthless, he views people as tools to exploit.

Appearance: A tall, bulky man with dark red hair and a central tuft. Yellow eyes, sharp features with a scar on his left cheek. Wears a large white coat with gray trimmings over dark combat gear and combat boots. A metallic mask covers most of his face, and brown gloves conceal his hands. When powered by the Quirk Amplification Device, his eyes glow purple.

Backstory: Wolfram leads a criminal organization backed by All For One. He orchestrated a scheme to steal David Shield's Quirk Amplification Device and enslave him. His ambition is to challenge All Might armed with stolen technology and a second Quirk from All For One.

Additional Information: Wolfram possesses Metal Manipulation, allowing him to reshape metal for offense and defense, and Muscle Augmentation from All For One for increased strength.

cardPool.title: Woman
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Woman
Quirk Name: Multiple (Liquification, Rupture, and others absorbed)
Occupation/Role: High-End Nomu, Doctor Garaki's Combat Unit
Personality: Aggressive and bloodthirsty with analytical combat sense. Quickly deduces opponent abilities and speaks coherently despite her monstrous nature.
Appearance: Feminine humanoid with exposed musculature, visible brain at crown with flayed scalp fin, two rows of jagged teeth in chin, stitches along legs, protruding vertebrae, flayed skin on elbows, dark hair at back.
Backstory: Former combat villain transformed by Doctor Kyudai Garaki into a High-End Nomu. Released during Mirko's raid on Jaku General Hospital, she led assault against pro heroes but was defeated by Endeavor when her regeneration failed.
Additional Information: Possesses enhanced durability and multiple absorbed Quirks. Demonstrated tactical intellect by avoiding Eraser Head's line of sight and combining Liquification and Rupture for devastating attacks.

cardPool.title: Wolf Villain
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Wolf Villain
Quirk Name: Unnamed Wolf Quirk
Occupation/Role: Villain
Personality: Aggressive and predatory, targeting the weak. Shows sadistic tendencies toward children and animals. Impulsive and easily distracted.
Appearance: Wolf-like humanoid with brown fur, yellow bloodshot eyes, and black-tipped tongue from Trigger drug abuse. Wears navy-blue vest and tan pants over his fur.
Backstory: A Trigger-addicted villain encountered while hunting a child and kitten. Apprehended by Eraser Head and arrested.
Additional Information: Confirmed Trigger user with a wolf-based Quirk granting lupine appearance and enhanced physical abilities. Operates as a street-level threat.

cardPool.title: Willy Wanda
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Willy Wanda

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Diesel Engine

Occupation/Role: Former Next-Level Villain

Personality: Pragmatic and mechanical in demeanor, Willy operates with utilitarian mindset befitting his locomotive nature. He demonstrates loyalty to his faction but lacks charisma as a leader.

Appearance: Willy's head and upper body are a functioning diesel train engine with metallic plating, smokestacks, and mechanical components. His lower body remains human. He stands imposingly due to his locomotive modifications.

Backstory: A member of the Next-Level Villains, Willy used his Diesel Engine Quirk to enforce the group's will during operations. His transformation marked him as both a tool and soldier within the villain hierarchy, though he eventually moved away from active villainy.

Additional Information: Willy operates outside UA High School and conventional hero society. His Quirk grants enhanced strength and momentum-based offensive capabilities. He represents the dangerous intersection of Quirk modification and criminal intent within vigilante circles.

cardPool.title: Watchbird
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Watchbird
Quirk Name: Unknown
Occupation/Role: Pro Hero, Sidekick, Member of Ingenium's Team Idaten
Personality: Professional and communicative, focused on team coordination and tactical awareness during hero operations.
Appearance: Young woman with brown hair in a tight ponytail. Wears a light blue bodysuit with white tactical gear, gloves, and boots. Her costume features a white chest piece with mechanical wings attached at the back and a blue visor with integrated communicator displaying a green heads-up display.
Backstory: A sidekick under pro hero Ingenium as part of Team Idaten, Watchbird trained through professional experience in the field.
Additional Information: Her equipment emphasizes reconnaissance and team communication, focusing on support and tactical coordination rather than direct combat.

cardPool.title: Victor
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Victor

Alias:
None

Quirk Name:
Unnamed Finger Gun Quirk

Occupation/Role:
Villain, member of the League of Villains' Shooting Squad

Personality:
Confident in combat abilities, willing to challenge heroes. Limited personality data; obeys Tomura Shigaraki's commands.

Appearance:
A man with reddish-brown hair and matching eyes. His fingertips have mutated into gun muzzles. He wears a gray tank top and pants with gold chains on each wrist. A metallic helmet with greenish-blue luminous eye holes obscures most of his head.

Backstory:
Victor was recruited by Tomura Shigaraki as one of seventy low-ranking villains for the assault on the Unforeseen Simulation Joint. He served in the Shooting Squad alongside Stitched Giant and Needle Hair to ambush U.A. High School first-year students during their Quirk Apprehension Test.

Additional Information:
Victor was incapacitated by Eraser Head during the U.S.J. invasion when his Quirk was disabled by the hero's Erasure ability. He was defeated and arrested alongside other recruited villains. He was later included in manipulated footage of the Deika City battle as evidence against the League of Villains.

cardPool.title: Varanus
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Varanus

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Unknown

Occupation/Role: Low-ranking Villain, League of Villains member

Personality: Aggressive and combative; follows orders from higher-ranking villains with typical henchman mentality and little initiative.

Appearance: A short man with a pronounced hunchback and elongated neck, creating a reptilian silhouette. Wears a bleached animal skull as a mask, crimson lines tattooed across his arms, green pants with a black belt. His hunched posture and thin frame emphasize his lizard-like physiology.

Backstory: Varanus was recruited by Tomura Shigaraki for the assault on the Unforeseen Simulation Joint. He attacked Pro Hero Shota Aizawa but was quickly subdued by Aizawa's Binding Cloth technique and apprehended.

Additional Information: Minor antagonist from the U.S.J. Arc. His Quirk is undocumented. He represents the expendable foot soldier tier of League of Villains operations.

cardPool.title: Valdo Gollini
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Valdo Gollini

Alias: Dark Might

Quirk Name: Alchemy

Occupation/Role: Villain Leader of the Gollini Family Mafia (Europe-based criminal organization)

Personality: Ruthless and power-obsessed, driven by obsessive admiration for All Might's strength while lacking understanding of true heroism. Calculative and willing to eliminate anyone to achieve his goals. Arrogant, seeking to become the Symbol of Peace through force rather than virtue.

Appearance: Naturally a lean Italian man with sunken green eyes, slicked-back black hair, and thin stubble mustache. Wears dark formal attire—black blazers and bowties. His Dark Might form transforms him into a muscular blond figure resembling younger All Might, with bushier eyebrows, a hooked nose, and green eyes with dark markings. He wears a white tuxedo with black accents, pale blue bowtie, red rose lapel pin, and golden All Might-emblazoned rings.

Backstory: Born into the Gollini Family mafia, Valdo rose through ruthlessness, eventually murdering his own father to seize control. Obsessed with replicating All Might's power, he failed to recognize that true heroism stemmed from compassion rather than physical dominance.

cardPool.title: Uwabami
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Uwabami
Alias: Snake Hero: Uwabami
Quirk Name: Serpentine
Occupation/Role: Pro Hero, Celebrity, Mentor
Personality: Vain and celebrity-minded, prioritizing modeling over heroics, yet capable in crises. Charming but honest about shallow motivations. Mentors based on appearance but maintains professional standards.
Appearance: Curvy blonde woman with long ringlets held by a curved plate. Golden eyes with slit pupils. Three living snakes—rattlesnake, yellow King cobra, and Japanese rat snake—protrude from her hair. Wears a maroon scale-patterned dress, matching heels, choker, and golden snake bracelets.
Backstory: Celebrated Pro Hero who combined her serpent Quirk with a lucrative modeling career. Selected UA students Momo Yaoyorozu and Itsuka Kendo for internships based on appearance while providing genuine professional guidance through patrol work and commercial appearances.
Additional Information: Demonstrates genuine heroic capability despite superficial priorities. Participated in major rescue operations after All Might's final battle and high-stakes missions. Openly acknowledges heroes can pursue side careers while maintaining hero work obligations.

cardPool.title: Untenmaru Kurumada
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Untenmaru Kurumada
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Unknown
Occupation/Role: Endeavor's Personal Chauffeur
Personality: Stern and aggressive with a sharp tongue, unafraid to voice criticism even to his employer. Despite his gruff demeanor, he demonstrates loyalty and concern for Endeavor's safety.
Appearance: A middle-aged man with a rectangular face and narrow, furrowed eyes. He has short black hair swept upward and a distinctive large white fluffy mustache. He dresses professionally in a dark formal suit with black dress shirt and white tie, completing his look with white driving gloves.
Backstory: Long-serving chauffeur and trusted employee of hero Endeavor, Untenmaru has earned standing in the household to speak frankly about his boss's decisions. He serves as both driver and informal advisor, present during critical moments.
Additional Information: Not a UA High School student. Operates as support staff during Endeavor's internship program, transporting students and equipment. Demonstrates willingness to engage with volatile personalities despite rudeness.

cardPool.title: Ugo Gollini
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Ugo Gollini

Alias:
None

Quirk Name:
Telekinesis

Occupation/Role:
Member of the Gollini Family mafia

Personality:
Energetic and crude despite his elderly appearance, Ugo constantly mocks enemies with jokes and taunts. He toys with opponents but abandons banter immediately when family objectives take priority, revealing ruthless pragmatism beneath his playful demeanor.

Appearance:
A short, elderly man with disproportionately long arms and short legs. His striking features include a long, curved nose with thick grey moustache. He wears a dark tailored suit, grey bow-tie, black fedora, and dark sunglasses. Grey sideburns frame his face, and a red rose corsage adorns his jacket lapel.

Backstory:
Ugo is a seasoned enforcer for the Gollini Family crime organization. His long tenure and powerful Quirk make him a valuable asset to the family's criminal enterprises.

Additional Information:
His Telekinesis Quirk grants immense destructive power—capable of demolishing buildings and shattering ice. When augmented by Anna's Overmodification technique, his ability to control multiple objects simultaneously increases dramatically.

cardPool.title: Tsuyoshi
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Tsuyoshi
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Bristle
Occupation/Role: Civilian Child
Personality: Confident in his abilities but intimidated by bullies despite his bravado. Readily impressed by heroes yet quick to judge them. Passionate about football and willing to save money for what he wants.
Appearance: Young boy with dark, short hair spiked downward with a few upward spikes, notably one large spike. Wears a hooded shirt, shorts, and sneakers.
Backstory: A civilian boy in a world of heroes and villains, warned by his mother to be cautious of danger. He possesses confidence in his Quirk despite his inexperience with actual threats.
Additional Information: Not a UA student. His Quirk allows him to harden his hair to superhuman density as a defensive or offensive tool. His overconfidence in his powers contrasts sharply with his fear response to social confrontation.

cardPool.title: Tsutsutaka Agoyamato
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Tsutsutaka Agoyamato

Alias:
None

Quirk Name:
Unknown

Occupation/Role:
U.A. High School General Department Student

Personality:
Initially resented Class 1-A's prominence, believing their conflicts endangered the school. After witnessing their exceptional festival performance, he apologized for his negativity. Shows civic responsibility assisting civilians during crises and respects upperclassmen like Nejire Hado.

Appearance:
A tall young man with a distinctive large chin mirroring his dark pompadour hairstyle. Wears the standard male U.A. uniform. His angular facial features give him a stern appearance.

Backstory:
A General Department student harboring initial resentment toward Class 1-A for drawing villainous attention to the school. His prejudice was challenged at the school festival when Class 1-A exceeded expectations. During the Final War, he helped evacuate civilians from collapsing bunkers.

Additional Information:
Maintains friendships within the General Department, particularly with Chikuchi Togeike. Shows growth from initial antagonism toward the Hero Course students. His quirk ability remains undisclosed.

cardPool.title: Tsunagu Hakamada
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Tsunagu Hakamada

Alias:
Fiber Hero: Best Jeanist

Quirk Name:
Fiber Master

Occupation/Role:
Pro Hero (currently No. 5 ranked)

Personality:
Elegant and flamboyant, believing those with influence must maintain positive appearance and behavior. Selfless, brave, and charismatic, using fabric metaphors to inspire others. Takes heroism seriously and dislikes brutish individuals lacking refinement.

Appearance:
Exceptionally tall and slim with an unnaturally long, flexible neck and dark, inward-tilting eyes. Long blonde hair combed drastically left, covering his left eye. Wears a denim hero costume with high-collared shirt, denim waistcoat with large pockets, jeans, two belts, and short dark brown boots with gray shafts.

Backstory:
Once ranked No. 3 Hero and eight-time "Best Jeanist" award recipient, Tsunagu maintains his position as one of Japan's elite defenders. He mentors young hero students to refine their character, believing difficult individuals can improve with proper guidance.

Additional Information:
His Quirk unravels and manipulates fabric from his denim costume into controllable fiber strings for restraint and combat.

cardPool.title: Tsumuji Kazetani
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Tsumuji Kazetani

Alias: Gust Boy

Quirk Name: Fan

Occupation/Role: Villain

Personality: Strategic and calculated, Tsumuji approaches combat with precision. He respects his power's limitations and plans accordingly, avoiding overuse despite temptation.

Appearance: A lean man of average height with light brown skin, elongated face, and grayish-blue hair tied in a ponytail. His mutated hands are oversized with bright orange, flexible fingers functioning as fan blades. He wears a black sleeveless unitard with a purple belt, teal sneakers with small fans, goggles, and carries a desk fan on his back.

Backstory: Tsumuji's Quirk manifested as a hand mutation into functional fan blades. He weaponized this ability and turned to villainy, becoming a threat during Class 1-A's early days as heroes-in-training.

Additional Information: Fan Quirk generates wind and tornadoes but limited to one-minute intervals; exceeding this causes Tenosynovitis in his hands. Carries knives and a paper fan-shaped blade as backup weapons. Operates independently as a villain.

cardPool.title: Tsubasa
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Tsubasa

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Unnamed Wing Quirk

Occupation/Role: Civilian (formerly childhood friend of Bakugo)

Personality: Arrogant bully who admired strength and readily tormented the weak, particularly those without Quirks. Easily influenced by stronger personalities like Bakugo.

Appearance: Stocky youth with rounded face and short brown hair. Two prominent red, draconic wings protrude from his back at will. Childhood attire: simple tank top, green shorts, and geta sandals.

Backstory: Grew up in the same neighborhood as Katsuki Bakugo and Izuku Midoriya. Idolized Bakugo's talent and joined him in bullying Midoriya after he was declared Quirkless. The three boys once ventured into a forbidden forest where Bakugo fell into a stream, deeply affecting their friendships. They drifted apart entering middle school and parted ways entirely.

Additional Information: Grandson of Dr. Tsubasa. Not a UA High School student and has not pursued a hero career. Current whereabouts unknown as of the Quirk Apprehension Test arc.

cardPool.title: Trapezius Headgear
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Unknown

Alias:
Trapezius Headgear

Quirk Name:
Trap Flex

Occupation/Role:
C-rank Villain

Personality:
Cruel and cowardly, prone to mocking opponents while relying on hostage threats. Arrogant about his strength yet demonstrates cowardice when facing genuine threats.

Appearance:
An enormous, muscular humanoid with pink skin and a fleshy extension from his shoulders curving over his head like a hood, concealing most of his face except round white eyes and a large mouth. He wears an armored half-vest with a chain draped over his right shoulder and cargo pants with plating.

Backstory:
A minor criminal who terrorized towns using hostages. He was defeated by All Might during a hostage situation and imprisoned. Released when All For One escaped Tartarus, he was conscripted into the Paranormal Liberation Front's Final War.

Additional Information:
His Quirk grants enhanced strength and speed through extreme muscle flexion, though inferior to One For All. He demonstrates tactical cowardice by using hostages as shields rather than engaging heroes directly.

cardPool.title: Toya Setsuno
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Toya Setsuno

Alias: Eight Bullets member

Quirk Name: Larceny

Occupation/Role: Subordinate of Kai Chisaki and member of the Shie Hassaikai criminal organization

Personality: Fanatic and outspoken, mentally unstable from past trauma. Devoted to his organization and unafraid of death. Bitter and cynical, yet tactically sharp in combat.

Appearance: Tall, lean young man with light almond-shaped eyes and prominent dark circles. Chin-length bright golden-blond hair parted left to obscure his right eye. Wide mouth with a crazed expression. Wears a gray dress shirt, light orange tie, dark pants, and a beak-shaped plague mask.

Backstory: Betrayed by a lover and left in crushing debt, he attempted suicide by jumping from a cliff. Rescued by a hero, his despair deepened. Found by Kai Chisaki on the streets, he joined the Shie Hassaikai with nowhere else to turn.

Additional Information: Specializes in disarming opponents using Larceny to steal weapons and create openings for teammates. Works effectively with Yu Hojo and Soramitsu Tabe through coordinated teamwork.

cardPool.title: Toy-Toy
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Toy-Toy
Quirk Name: Unknown
Occupation/Role: Pro Hero
Personality: Spirited and vocal, quick to criticize unsportsmanlike behavior. Demonstrates camaraderie with fellow heroes and maintains composure during high-stakes missions.
Appearance: Young woman with long, messy light brown hair and matching eyes. Wears a light pink fluffy sleeveless crop top with matching skirt, arm sleeves, and boots. Grey gloves and a dog-headed hat with buggy eyes and round black nose, featuring red eyes with green irises.
Backstory: An established Pro Hero known for analytical field capabilities. Attended U.A. Sports Festival as observer and participated in the Jaku Hospital Raid and Final War against Tomura Shigaraki and All For One.
Additional Information: Specializes in data analysis to support search and reconnaissance during hero missions. Proven reliable in large-scale operations alongside other Pro Heroes.

cardPool.title: Toxic Chainsaw
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Toxic Chainsaw
Quirk Name: Unknown
Occupation/Role: Villain
Personality: Cruel, ruthless, and arrogant. Confronted All Might years ago.
Appearance: Shoulder-length slimy hair frames a sharp angular face. Heavily muscular build. Wears no shirt, baggy pants with skull-shaped kneepads, and army boots.
Backstory: Engaged All Might in combat five years before the series began and landed blows on the Number One Hero, earning infamy. Possibly inflicted All Might's chest scar, though All Might denies it. Current whereabouts unknown.
Additional Information: Wields a chainsaw as primary weapon. Possesses a powerful Quirk of unknown nature. Little concrete information exists about his true capabilities or origins.

cardPool.title: Tough Grab
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Tough Grab
Quirk Name: Unknown
Occupation/Role: Pro Hero, Sidekick to Ingenium
Personality: Professional and duty-bound, working efficiently in a support role.
Appearance: A burly man with a chiseled jaw and pupilless eyes. Short, flattop blonde hair. Hero costume includes black tank top over pale brown sleeveless vest, jeans with silver-buckled belt, brown shin-high work boots, and oversized armored gloves with cuffs extending to mid-forearm.
Backstory: An established pro hero and trusted sidekick to Ingenium with a reputation as a reliable field operative.
Additional Information: Quirk and combat abilities largely undocumented. Armor-heavy glove design suggests focus on grappling or physical restraint. Active during early hero society period.

cardPool.title: Toshitsugu Kudo
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Toshitsugu Kudo

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Gearshift

Occupation/Role: Resistance leader and second user of One For All

Personality: Battle-hardened and serious with stern justice and rigid morality shaped by warfare. Initially cynical in his mission to defeat All For One, but capable of empathy—he saved Yoichi rather than killing him. Prideful and fearless, showing no hesitation facing death.

Appearance: Short, spiky ginger-salmon hair with slanted red eyes. Wears a green combat jacket with large black collar and imposing gauntlets for his Quirk. Lean but muscular build from years of combat.

Backstory: A veteran soldier who led a resistance movement against All For One during the early Meta Abilities era. Dedicated his life to eliminating the tyrant. His mercy toward Yoichi Shigaraki made him the second One For All user and All For One's most hated enemy.

Additional Information: Deceased before the series begins. Ideological predecessor to Izuku Midoriya, eventually learning to value Izuku's belief that good exists in everyone's heart.

cardPool.title: Toru Hagakure
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Toru Hagakure

Alias:
Stealth Hero: Invisible Girl

Quirk Name:
Invisibility

Occupation/Role:
Class 1-A Student, UA High School

Personality:
Bubbly, cheery, and easygoing with an upbeat attitude. Socially eager and enjoys shopping and gossip. Romantically curious and energetic yet focused in battle. Observant and reliable, always ready to help teammates. Somewhat naive about her invisibility's social implications.

Appearance:
A short girl with an invisible body, identifiable only by clothing and accessories. When her Quirk glitches, she reveals a slim figure with long, wavy, multi-colored hair (chartreuse with lime, yellow, pink, turquoise, and light blue strands), colorful eyelashes, and large round eyes with teal-yellow irises. At UA, she wears the standard female uniform: gray jacket with teal stripes, white shirt, red tie, teal skirt, brown shoes, and knee-high socks. Her hero costume consists of pale pink-lined light blue gloves and beige shoes.

Backstory:
An aspiring pro hero training at UA High School. Her invisibility Quirk makes her ideal for stealth operations, though she's still mastering combat applications.

cardPool.title: Tomoyasu Chikazoku
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Tomoyasu Chikazoku

Alias: Skeptic

Quirk Name: Puppet Master

Occupation/Role: Board member at Feel Good, Inc.; Leading member of the Meta Liberation Army; Lieutenant of the Paranormal Liberation Front

Personality: Steadfast ideologue devoted to Quirk liberation doctrine and deeply loyal to his commanders. Stern and condescending, easily irritated by slow comprehension. Ruthless in combat, employing psychological warfare without hesitation. Becomes unhinged and obsessive when facing failure.

Appearance: Tall and lanky with shoulder-length shiny black hair parted by a neat fringe obscuring his wide eyes with small gray irises. Long nose and wide mouth with straight teeth. Wears a long-sleeved black turtleneck beneath a formal black jacket with dark pants.

Backstory: A brilliant technologist who built Feel Good, Inc.'s systems from scratch, Chikazoku secretly rose through the ranks of the Meta Liberation Army as a leading ideologue. He became instrumental in orchestrating Quirk liberation operations and secured a position as lieutenant when the Army merged with the League of Villains into the Paranormal Liberation Front.

Additional Information: Not a UA student.

cardPool.title: Tomoko Shiretoko
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Tomoko Shiretoko

Alias: Ragdoll

Quirk Name: Search

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero No. 32, Member of the Wild, Wild Pussycats

Personality: Hyperactive and energetic with wide-eyed enthusiasm, capable of genuine concern for others. Highly motivated and unwilling to let obstacles prevent her from helping those in need.

Appearance: Young woman of medium height with long emerald green hair and large round yellow eyes with three small eyelashes on each. She wears a yellow Pussycats hero costume with pink whisker marks on her cheeks and a pink circle around her right eye.

Backstory: A rescue and support hero known for exceptional ability to locate disaster victims and monitor allies. Kidnapped during a villain invasion and lost her Quirk.

Additional Information: Formerly capable of observing and monitoring up to 100 people simultaneously, tracking their locations and weak points with perfect recall. Now Quirkless but remains dedicated to hero work and her teammates through alternative means.

cardPool.title: Tommy S. Gordon
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Tommy S. Gordon

Alias:
Tank Engine

Quirk Name:
Tank Engine

Occupation/Role:
Former Next-Level Villain

Personality:
Aggressive and easily provoked, Tommy becomes enraged by opposition and continues attacking despite ineffective results. He demonstrates loyalty to allies.

Appearance:
Tommy's head and upper torso are a steam-powered locomotive with a cartoonish face. His lower half wears a dark bodysuit with gloves, boots, and decorative belt.

Backstory:
Once part of the Next-Level Villains in Naruhata, Tommy was arrested by Eraser Head after being confronted by heroes during a civilian pursuit. He later showed continued association with other former villains.

Additional Information:
Not a UA student. Tommy's Quirk provides considerable physical mass and locomotive-based power. His strength lies in direct confrontation rather than tactical fighting.

cardPool.title: Tomie Takami
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Tomie Takami
Alias: Mrs. Takami
Quirk Name: Unknown
Occupation/Role: Homemaker, Mother
Personality: Emotionally withdrawn and broken, Tomie harbors conflicted feelings—devoted to her husband yet resentful of their forced union, neglectful toward her son yet capable of regret. Cowardly and prone to avoidance, she struggles to confront difficult truths, though glimpses of maternal pride and remorse occasionally surface.
Appearance: A middle-aged woman of average height with thick, feathery copper-colored hair to her shoulders. Her sunken gray-blue eyes are distinctive, with two additional floating eyeballs circling her head. She wears either a tight white dress with black stripes or a baggy gray-blue dress with long sleeves.
Backstory: Tomie harbored her husband after he committed murder, forcing them into isolation where their son Keigo was conceived. She provided minimal emotional support during his childhood, watching passively as her husband abused the boy. When her husband was arrested by Endeavor, she and Keigo became homeless.

cardPool.title: Togaru Kamakiri
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Togaru Kamakiri

Alias: Jack Mantis

Quirk Name: Razor Sharp

Occupation/Role: UA High School Student, Class 1-B

Personality: Hotblooded and aggressive with passion for combat, yet cordial and supportive of classmates. Competitive in battle, respecting rivals like Bakugo. Excitable during fights but level-headed enough to encourage teammates after defeats.

Appearance: Tall and slender with pale yellow-green skin and bright green mohawk. Pointed dark green eyes, two hooked blades on cheeks, mantis-like head with no visible nose. Wears dark green rugged cloak over zigzag-patterned shirt, black trousers, dark green three-toed boots, and eye mask.

Backstory: Dedicated hero student at UA High School in Class 1-B. Gym buddies with Tetsutetsu and rivals with Bakugo. Known for sharp reflexes and combat prowess, demonstrated when blocking Bakugo's point-blank explosion.

Additional Information: Quirk produces blades from any body part, capable of cutting steel and iron while withstanding explosive force. Participates eagerly in training exercises and shows genuine care for teammates' growth.

cardPool.title: Timothy Agpar
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Timothy Agpar

Alias: Commander Agpar

Quirk Name: Unknown

Occupation/Role: American Military Commander, U.S. Armed Forces

Personality: Calm and principled despite chaos. Maintains composure in crisis while respecting allies. Demonstrates strong moral conviction, opposing appeasement to villains and advocating decisive action. Deeply respects heroism and places faith in heroes as inspirational figures.

Appearance: A man with turquoise skin, elongated bald head, bushy whiskers, and large protruding eyes. Dresses formally in business suits befitting his military command position.

Backstory: Timothy serves as a high-ranking commander in the U.S. military and trusted ally of hero Star and Stripe. Following Japan's hero society collapse during the Paranormal Liberation War, he coordinated international response efforts and authorized military strikes against Tomura Shigaraki, including thermonuclear missiles in an attempt to contain the threat.

Additional Information: Timothy is an American military official operating at the international level. He values heroic sacrifice and fiercely opposes political surrender to villainous forces.

cardPool.title: Thousand Eyes
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Thousand Eyes
Quirk Name: Curse
Occupation/Role: Villain, League of Villains Associate
Personality: Confident in combat despite limited skill; willing to assault UA High School; deeper personality unknown.
Appearance: A humanoid figure composed entirely of paper runes with a pale inscribed surface. Large red eyes mark his face, chest, and limbs—one on his face, two on each arm, one on each thigh, one at his chest. He has five square fingers on each hand and featureless square feet.
Backstory: A minor villain recruited by Tomura Shigaraki for the USJ assault. His origins remain obscure, though his willingness to face UA faculty suggests confidence or desperation.
Additional Information: E-rank villain; defeated by Eraser Head during the USJ invasion. His paper-composite body grants extreme lightness, enabling rapid movement and evasion.

cardPool.title: The Realist
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: The Realist
Quirk Name: Truth Inducement
Occupation/Role: Villain
Personality: Bitter, disenchanted idealist driven by rejection and resentment. Once passionate, he became manipulative and vengeful, spreading misery as compensation for his suffering and rationalizing cruelty as exposing truth.
Appearance: Bald man of average height wearing a black hoodie with a large white "R" on the chest. Black makeup runs in straight lines down his face from beneath both eyes.
Backstory: An ardent idol fan humiliated at a meet-and-greet, he accidentally discovered his idol's contempt for fans. This rejection made him a zealot determined to expose idol industry exploitation. He gathered scorned fans and systematically destroyed idols' reputations at public events.
Additional Information: His Quirk forces victims to speak their true thoughts involuntarily upon physical contact without their awareness. He was captured by Mirko's Team-Up mission at an idol convention while attempting to use his Quirk on disguised Class 1-B heroes.

cardPool.title: The Mother of Quirks
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: The Mother of Quirks
Quirk Name: Unknown
Occupation/Role: Activist, Mother
Personality: Affectionate and protective toward her son, displaying remarkable willpower and idealism despite fierce opposition. She was compassionate and vocal about equality for Quirk users, refusing to accept the hatred and discrimination of her era.
Appearance: A woman with long, brown hair. Historical records of her are limited.
Backstory: Born during the chaotic early era when Meta Abilities were feared and violently persecuted, she gave birth to a son with a Quirk. Witnessing his marginalization, she became an outspoken advocate against discrimination, coining the term "Quirk" to reframe Meta Abilities as natural traits rather than monstrous powers. She was murdered by an Anti-Quirk faction, but her legacy endured—the government adopted her terminology, immortalizing her as "The Mother of Quirks."
Additional Information: Her son, Chikara Yotsubashi (Destro), founded the Meta Liberation Army to reclaim what he believed was his mother's true vision of freedom, feeling the government corrupted her ideals through restrictive Quirk regulations.

cardPool.title: The Fly
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: The Fly
Quirk Name: Fly
Occupation/Role: Pro Hero
Personality: Reserved and professional; demonstrates courage and teamwork in dangerous situations.
Appearance: Tall man with long, light blond hair and bangs covering his left side. Wears a short-sleeved shirt, white shorts, dark boots, armbands on his biceps, and a red headband. Two long wing-like appendages protrude from his arms.
Backstory: An established Pro Hero in Japan's hero society. Present during a major Nomu attack in Hosu City orchestrated by Tomura Shigaraki, where he fought alongside other heroes until Endeavor arrived.
Additional Information: The Fly's wing-like appendages grant him aerial mobility and combat capabilities. He demonstrates competence in crisis situations and cooperation with other heroes.

cardPool.title: Tetsutetsu Tetsutetsu
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Tetsutetsu Tetsutetsu

Alias: Real Steel

Quirk Name: Steel

Occupation/Role: UA High School Student, Class 1-B

Personality: Hotheaded and outspoken, determined to prove Class 1-B's worth. Confident but stubborn, yet loyal and protective of his peers despite his abrasiveness.

Appearance: A young man with chin-length messy gray hair and black inward-tilted eyes rimmed with thick jagged eyelashes. Sharp pointed teeth and no visible eyebrows. His hero costume features a dark pale green jumpsuit, black boots with metal plating, steel shoulder straps and arm bands with a red oval chest piece, brown sash with pouches, and gray back container. A thick metal jaw-guard stamped with "Fe" covers his face. Athletic, muscular build.

Backstory: A UA student training to become a Pro Hero. He resented Class 1-A's perceived superiority and Bakugo's arrogance. He placed 8th in the Entrance Exam through brute strength, ranking fourth in villain points.

Additional Information: His Steel Quirk hardens his body to withstand extreme damage, making him an effective shield for allies. Competitive yet capable of friendship, eventually bonding with Kirishima despite their rivalry.

cardPool.title: Tesla
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Tesla
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Electric Charge
Occupation/Role: E-rank Villain, League of Villains Member
Personality: Cruel and strategic, Tesla exploits opponent weaknesses with calculated precision. He shows reluctance to harm fellow electric Quirk users despite his villainy.
Appearance: Tesla is a tall, lean man with slanted grey eyes and beige skin. He wears a dark green sleeveless bodysuit with white belt and black boots, and a skull-shaped mask obscuring his face.
Backstory: Recruited by Tomura Shigaraki for the U.S.J. assault, Tesla served as a minor operative. During the invasion, he jammed communication signals to prevent faculty alerts.
Additional Information: Tesla's Quirk allows him to harvest and manipulate electrical currents for attacks and block electrical signals. He took Denki Kaminari hostage, exploiting his immunity to electrification. He was arrested when UA teachers intervened.

cardPool.title: Teruo Unagisawa
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Teruo Unagisawa

Alias:
None

Quirk Name:
Eel

Occupation/Role:
Civilian/Pop☆Step Fan

Personality:
Naïve and self-deprecating, Teruo lacks confidence and openly acknowledges his weakness. He is obsessively devoted to the idol Pop☆Step, making reckless decisions driven by fandom. Despite his meek demeanor, he maintains this obsession even under extreme circumstances.

Appearance:
A deceptively young-looking 19-year-old with a rounded face, large soft eyes, and a wide nose. Nearly completely bald except for a tuft of black hair on top, giving him a childlike appearance. His small stature makes him look no older than a middle schooler.

Backstory:
An ordinary civilian and devoted Pop☆Step fan, Teruo was kidnapped by the Villain Factory and subjected to experimentation that transformed his Quirk. He later joins Hopper's Cafe, suggesting a path toward redemption.

Additional Information:
Under Trigger's influence, Teruo transforms into a large eel-like creature with slimy skin. His modified form grants him the ability to discharge electrical surges, though doing so causes unconsciousness. He is not a UA High School student.

cardPool.title: Teruo Hazukashi
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Teruo Hazukashi
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Shame
Occupation/Role: Disgruntled Office Worker
Personality: Resentful and bitter toward authority, Teruo harbors deep grudges after three years of service. Inspired by Destro's philosophy, he seeks liberation through rebellion and is willing to debase himself publicly to achieve his goals.
Appearance: An average-sized man with short, spiky brown hair. During his uprising attempt, he wore only a long coat and kneesocks, having stripped to trigger his Quirk.
Backstory: After three years of unfair treatment at his corporate job, Teruo read Destro's autobiography on liberation and became motivated to take violent action against his workplace.
Additional Information: Teruo's Quirk amplifies his physical power proportionally to his embarrassment. He activates it by publicly exposing himself to maximize shame. Hawks intercepted and defeated him before his Quirk's full potential could be realized.

cardPool.title: Tenya Ida
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Tenya Ida

Alias: Turbo Hero: Ingenium

Quirk Name: Engine

Occupation/Role: Class 1-A Student, Class Representative at UA High School

Personality: Serious and disciplined with strong responsibility. Earnest and formal, driven by duty to uphold his family's heroic legacy. Takes his class representative role with utmost seriousness and maintains composure under pressure.

Appearance: Tall muscular young man with short dark blue hair neatly parted on the right with a shaved patch at the base. Sharp-featured with square blue eyes, pointed eyebrows, pointed jawline, and rectangular glasses. His calves are thick and engine-shaped with six silver exhaust pipes protruding from each leg. Wears standard UA male uniform: light gray blazer with dark turquoise trim, white shirt, dark blue-green pants, and red tie.

Backstory: Born into the prestigious Ida Family of heroes, Tenya was raised to carry on their legacy. His older brother Tensei inspired him to pursue heroics. Now a first-year at UA High School, Tenya earned class representative through his dedication and leadership, beginning his Pro Hero journey.

cardPool.title: Tensei Ida
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Tensei Ida

Alias: Turbo Hero: Ingenium

Quirk Name: Engine

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero

Personality: Laid-back and supportive, Tensei embodies a "cool" heroic ideal centered on rapid rescue. He values teamwork and quick response, helping others develop their Quirks informally. Joyful and inspiring to those around him.

Appearance: Tensei has square facial features with short, spiky dark blue-black hair and arrow-shaped eyebrows. Gold-colored engine exhausts protrude from both elbows. He maintains a stocky build and typically wears his hero costume with airbags for aerodynamic adjustments.

Backstory: Older brother of UA student Tenya Ida, Tensei built a reputation as a formidable Pro Hero under the Ingenium name. He pursued dangerous villains relentlessly, notably the speed criminal Batto Yobayakawa across three encounters. His career was cut short when the Hero Killer: Stain left him severely paralyzed, forcing temporary retirement.

Additional Information: Tensei operates as a Pro Hero with his own agency. Known for incredible fortitude and high-speed combat powered by his Engine Quirk, he prioritizes saving people quickly above all else.

cardPool.title: Tenma Nakaoji
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Tenma Nakaoji

Alias: His Purple Highness

Quirk Name: Not explicitly stated

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero

Personality: Extravagant and flamboyant yet deeply committed to heroics. Recognizes talent in others and prioritizes victim safety over villain capture. Possesses strong self-sacrifice and protective instincts, willing to risk his life for civilians.

Appearance: Tall man with slim build and tanned skin. Purple eyes, lengthy dark brown hair tied in a long ponytail with long bangs. Wears a short trimmed mustache and beard. Sports a two-piece suit featuring a frilled, open-chested jacket with epaulets and a belt adorned with P-emblazoned badges.

Backstory: An established Pro Hero who mentors UA High School students during their Work-Studies program. Trains students including Nemuri, emphasizing heroic presentation and proper conduct. Faces the rampaging villain Garvey to buy time for civilian evacuation, suffering severe injuries.

Additional Information: Acts as a Work-Studies mentor to UA students. Values showmanship in heroics but proves his dedication through genuine sacrifice and courage when confronting dangerous threats.

cardPool.title: Tenko Tejina
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Tenko Tejina

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Conjure

Occupation/Role: Clerk at Got-It-All Mall

Personality: Earnest and overzealous, Tenko is helpful and determined, driven by gratitude and need to prove loyalty. Prone to anxiety due to past job rejections, yet remains eager to assist others.

Appearance: Young man with straight, medium-length hair and cheerful grin. Wears traditional mall clerk uniform with matching hat. Friendly and welcoming expression.

Backstory: Repeatedly rejected from jobs due to employers fearing his Quirk could enable theft, Tenko was finally hired by Got-It-All Mall. Grateful for the opportunity, he works with dedication to prove himself trustworthy and dispel stigma around his abilities.

Additional Information: Tenko's Quirk allows him to conjure objects into his hand, explaining the employment prejudice he faces. He works at Got-It-All Mall, a shopping center frequented by hero course students.

cardPool.title: Tech Villain
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Tech Villain
Quirk Name: Unknown
Occupation/Role: Villain, Wolfram's minion and tactical operator
Personality: Serious and efficient, focused on objectives. Cowardly when confronted by powerful opponents. Attempts to assert command despite subordinate status.
Appearance: Tall man with pale skin and long white hair partially obscuring his left eye. Wears black combat suit with full-face mask featuring an X-shaped design. Technological headgear with monocle-style goggle scope over right eye.
Backstory: Recruited as one of Wolfram's elite minions for the I-Island infiltration. Served as tactical operator managing security systems and monitoring hero movements. Survived the helicopter crash from All Might's intervention, rendered unconscious by the explosion.
Additional Information: Operates in support and command roles, not direct combat. Shows reluctance engaging skilled fighters. More confident against unpowered targets. Status following I-Island unknown, arrest likely.

cardPool.title: Tatsuyuki Tokoname
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Tatsuyuki Tokoname

Alias: Slidin' Go

Quirk Name: Slide

Occupation/Role: Former Pro Hero, Member of the Meta Liberation Army

Personality: Affable and chipper on the surface, but harbors darker loyalty to Destro's ideals regarding Quirk freedom. Strict about etiquette and hierarchy, willing to defer to superiors.

Appearance: A tall, well-built man with small black eyes, circular nose, and prominent square jaw. His hero costume consists of a purple skin-tight bodysuit with black arrow markings, knee-high boots with arrow cavities, black mask, elbow-length green gloves with golden scales, and a short green scarf-cape with golden aiguillettes. A thick black belt with large buckle and green circles completes the ensemble.

Backstory: Once a legitimate Pro Hero, Tatsuyuki became a secret operative for the Meta Liberation Army, maintaining his hero facade while serving their ideology of absolute Quirk freedom. He assisted in integrating the League of Villains into their organization before his allegiance was exposed and he was arrested.

Additional Information: Not a UA student. His true allegiance masks his public persona, making him a dangerous double agent.

cardPool.title: Tatami Nakagame
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Tatami Nakagame

Alias: Turtle Neck

Quirk Name: Shell

Occupation/Role: Third-year student at Ketsubutsu Academy High School

Personality: Cheerful and outgoing, Tatami is friendly with peers and unafraid to approach rivals. Direct and fault-finding, she calls out others' shortcomings without hesitation but works well in group settings despite her critical nature.

Appearance: A pale, curvaceous girl with muscular build and large pointed teeth in a constant smile. Wide rectangular eyes with small blue irises, thick lashes, and short ash-blonde hair with two fin-like spikes and a chin-length right bang. Wears turquoise fish-shaped earrings. Her hero costume is an aquamarine turtleneck bodysuit with central zipper, salmon pink gloves and thigh-high boots with hexagonal turtle-foot patterns, and a thin cyan belt with pink buckle centered by a white turtle shell gem.

Backstory: A dedicated hero student, Tatami competed against Class 1-A at the U.A. Sports Festival. She faced them again during the Provisional Hero License Exam at Takoba National Stadium when Ketsubutsu's Class 2 attempted their traditional "Crushing of U.A." ambush.

cardPool.title: Taneo Tokuda
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Taneo Tokuda

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Not stated

Occupation/Role: Freelance journalist for Juzo News magazine publisher

Personality: Relaxed and charming with manipulative tendencies, yet deeply ethical and sentimental beneath the surface. A devoted All Might fan who respects heroism above exclusive scoops. Deceptively perceptive and analytical.

Appearance: Tall, slender man with black wavy hair, short sideburns, and angular face with high cheekbones. Wears thin-framed circular glasses and has distinctive mismatched pupils—one white and one black. Dresses in a beige blazer over an untucked black dress shirt with dark slacks. Carries a black camera around his neck.

Backstory: As a child, Taneo witnessed All Might rescue his father and twenty-three others from an industrial bombing. His accidental photograph of the rescue, published in newspapers, inspired him to become a journalist and forged his lifelong admiration for All Might and heroism.

Additional Information: Highly skilled investigator capable of deducing hidden truths from minimal evidence.

cardPool.title: Tamashiro
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Tamashiro
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Binging Balls
Occupation/Role: Student, Masegaki Primary School
Personality: Arrogant and boisterous with a rebellious streak, yet genuinely aspires to be a hero. Pride in his Quirk inflates his ego, causing him to criticize others. Beneath his stand-offish exterior lies playfulness and willingness to help.
Appearance: Small elementary school boy with messy blonde hair, dark marks circling brown eyes, and sharp pointed teeth. His youthful features contrast with his cocky demeanor.
Backstory: A primary school student from Masegaki who participated in a hero license exam trial alongside classmates, facing UA heroes Bakugo, Todoroki, Yoarashi, and Utsushimi. Despite initial arrogance, he demonstrated genuine heroic spirit and accepted Todoroki's praise for his potential in disaster rescue work.
Additional Information: Not a UA student; attends Masegaki Primary School. Uses Binging Balls Quirk offensively during the exam, successfully damaging Bakugo's equipment. Maintains optimism and faith in heroes despite witnessing society's collapse.

cardPool.title: Tamao Oguro
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Tamao Oguro

Alias: Former Host of Queen Bee

Quirk Name: None (formerly shared Queen Bee while possessed)

Occupation/Role: Student (status unknown; hospitalized after possession)

Personality: Originally confrontational with a rebellious streak, frustrated by her father's control and desire to pursue music. She craves his attention and approval despite their conflict.

Appearance: Young girl with green eyes and shoulder-length brown hair in a ponytail. Black eyepatch over left eye from permanent injury during possession. Slender build with calm demeanor reflecting recovery.

Backstory: Daughter of Iwao Oguro, Tamao was possessed by villain Kuin Hachisuka, losing control of her body and left eye. Her possession stemmed partly from defiance of her father's strict parenting and refusal to let her become a musician. After being freed, she was hospitalized and begun recovering, though trauma and damaged family relationships remain unresolved.

Additional Information: Current Quirk status unknown—she lost Queen Bee upon Kuin's removal and may possess her own latent Quirk. Not confirmed as UA student and remains in recovery during current timeline.

cardPool.title: Tamao
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Tamao

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Tree Frog

Occupation/Role: Student at Masegaki Primary School, Aspiring Hero

Personality: Energetic and fearless with a dismissive attitude toward authority. Driven by ambition but initially doubted her Quirk's combat potential. She sneaks away when rules inconvenience her and holds high standards for heroes. Capable of changing her mind when shown compelling evidence and becomes inspired by those she admires.

Appearance: A young girl with short, light-colored hair standing up from the back of her head in a tadpole-like silhouette. Large, expressive eyes and full cheeks. Wears an oversized dark shirt with black shorts and running shoes.

Backstory: During a school trip to Takoba National Stadium, Tamao snuck away from her class to explore the arena, disappointed by the heroes on display. After being rescued by Froppy during a near-fall, she witnessed the impressive versatility of frog-based Quirks. An encounter with what she believed was a dangerous snake terrified her but fundamentally changed her perspective on her own Tree Frog Quirk.

Additional Information: Tamao has an irrational fear of snakes.

cardPool.title: Tamaki Amajiki
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Tamaki Amajiki

Alias: Suneater, Omnivore Hero

Quirk Name: Manifest

Occupation/Role: UA High School Student, Class 3-A

Personality: Extremely shy, anxious, and introverted with pessimistic outlook. Despite crippling social anxiety and lack of self-confidence, he harbors a brave heart and unwavering moral convictions. Looks to Mirio Togata as inspiration and pushes beyond his fears when duty calls. Quick to dismiss compliments and overlook his achievements.

Appearance: Tall with pale skin and pointed, elf-like ears. Dark indigo hair is messy and partially covers thin, tired eyes. Shoulders hunched and posture withdrawn. Wears school uniform with loosened tie and large golden-buckled belt. Hero costume features black bodysuit with beige shoulder plating, white tunic, white cape, and hooded scarf-collar. Silver front mask and thin beige mask with transparent purple lens. Purple carrier vest with brown straps and pouches. Fights barefoot.

Backstory: Member of UA's Big 3 who earned ranking despite overwhelming self-doubt. Partnership with Mirio Togata and mentorship under Fat Gum shaped his moral code.

cardPool.title: Takuto
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Takuto
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Unknown
Occupation/Role: Student at Masegaki Primary School
Personality: Enthusiastic about heroes but emotionally sensitive; prone to crying when frightened or yelled at. Displays childlike boldness without understanding consequences.
Appearance: Small elementary school boy with bird-like protruding face, sharp teeth, and side-mounted eyes. Light spiky hair frames his avian features.
Backstory: Primary school student selected as a test subject during hero licensing exams. Encounters Pro Hero Gang Orca and hero license candidates, including volatile Katsuki Bakugo, whose explosive personality frightens him.
Additional Information: Enrolled at Masegaki Primary School, not UA High School. Quirk type unspecified. Demonstrates typical childhood behavior mixing boldness with emotional fragility.

cardPool.title: Takeshita
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Takeshita

Alias: Unknown

Quirk Name: Unknown (Bamboo-related)

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero

Personality: Friendly and polite with professional demeanor. Greets civilians courteously and works well with other heroes.

Appearance: Spiky blond hair with stubble and faint moustache, average build. Wears a green jacket with fur cuffs and shoulder pads over black top. Hero costume features half-bamboo stalks over ears, brown fingerless gloves, and crossed bamboo stalks on back.

Backstory: Prominent UA High School graduate who became an independent Pro Hero with recognition across Japan. Failed to recognize former classmate Danjuro Tobita years later, traumatizing him and inadvertently pushing him toward villainy.

Additional Information: Assigned to Hospital Raid Team under Endeavor during operations against the Paranormal Liberation Front. Quirk presumed bamboo-related based on costume design.

cardPool.title: Takeshi Bushijima
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Takeshi Bushijima
Alias: The Masked Man
Quirk Name: Poison Gas
Occupation/Role: Civilian
Personality: Kind and considerate, isolated by his dangerous Quirk. He carries guilt about harming others and envies Heroes who use their abilities freely. He responds to genuine kindness and can be persuaded to trust.
Appearance: A young man in his early-mid teens with short, scruffy hair and soft features. He wears a dark hoodie and mask concealing most of his face. Before releasing his Quirk, he appeared pale and sickly; after release, he looks noticeably healthier.
Backstory: Takeshi has suppressed his uncontrollable Poison Gas Quirk for years to avoid harming others, as using dangerous Quirks is prohibited by law. The suppression has severely damaged his physical health. When his condition worsens during a chance meeting with UA students, he releases his gas in a populated area—an incident marking him as a potential villain despite his good intentions.
Additional Information: Not a UA student.

cardPool.title: Takami
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Takami

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Unnamed Feather Quirk

Occupation/Role: Fugitive Criminal/Villain

Personality: Cruel, paranoid, and volatile. A desperate thief prone to violent outbursts fueled by alcoholism and fear of capture. Shows no empathy toward family, viewing them as burdens. Easily angered and quick to blame others.

Appearance: Tall, middle-aged man with brown hair swept back and a gaunt, bearded face with gaps in his eyebrows and a missing front tooth. Golden-brown eyes hold a hardened gleam. Small brown feathers line both arms. Wears a dark jacket and pants, appearing weathered and unkempt.

Backstory: A petty criminal from Fukuoka, Takami murdered someone over pocket change and became a fugitive. He hid with his wife Tomie, using her Quirk to watch for authorities. When his son Keigo was born, Takami viewed him as a mistake. He kept the boy imprisoned indoors and abused both wife and child, demanding Tomie find him criminal work. He was captured by Pro Hero Endeavor while attempting to steal a car.

Additional Information: Dangerous enough that Endeavor personally warned police to remain vigilant. His Quirk grants combat-capable feathers.

cardPool.title: Takaie Kanigumo
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Takaie Kanigumo

Alias:
None

Quirk Name:
Unnamed Arthropod Meta Ability

Occupation/Role:
Second-ranked Adviser, Paranormal Liberation Front Vanguard Action Support Regiment: Brown

Personality:
Fanatically dedicated to heteromorph liberation through violence. Contemptuous toward peaceful resistance but respects militant figures like Spinner. Acts as preacher and propagandist to radicalize fellow heteromorphs.

Appearance:
Heteromorphic man with arthropod form. Two spider legs protrude from his back with spider-like teeth around his mouth. Six wavy green marks cross his forehead with a scar on the left side. Wears black long shirt with yellow fur collar and black mask.

Backstory:
Meta Liberation Army member who rose to prominence in the Paranormal Liberation Front after the merger. Vocal advocate for heteromorph uprising, viewing societal prejudice as justification for revolutionary violence. Participated in battles against heroes and spread radicalization propaganda throughout the Paranormal Liberation War.

Additional Information:
Combat strength comparable to an average Pro Hero. Participates in raids and recruitment efforts.

cardPool.title: Takahiro
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Takahiro
Alias: Eagle Hero (Professional Hero name unknown)
Quirk Name: Eagle
Occupation/Role: Pro Hero
Personality: Reserved and composed with strong mental fortitude.
Appearance: Bird-headed humanoid with brown spiked feathers covering his head. Feather ruffles extend from neck to chest. Massive wings protrude from his back. Bird-like clawed hands with long black talons. Wears sleek hero costume with headphones, high-collared vest, baggy parachute pants, utility belt, and boots.
Backstory: Established Pro Hero who attended the I-Expo reception. Apprehended by villain Wolfram but liberated when Melissa Shield restored I-Island's security systems.
Additional Information: Takahiro's Quirk grants avian characteristics including enhanced aerial mobility via wings. Operates at professional hero level with significant combat training and experience.

cardPool.title: Tajima
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Tajima

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Electrification

Occupation/Role: Villain/Spy (Infiltrator at U.A. High School)

Personality: Outwardly stern and composed while undercover, but prone to anxiety depending on circumstances. Driven by fear of All For One's judgment, leading to blind loyalty and willingness to harm innocents. Believes All For One's world domination is inevitable.

Appearance: Young man with short dark hair. Wears a dark sweater over a plaid shirt. Clean-faced with an unremarkable appearance suited to blending in as a refugee.

Backstory: Sent by All For One to infiltrate U.A. posing as a refugee alongside four other spies. Tasked with creating discord and pressuring Izuku Midoriya to leave. He reported Class 1-A's planned departure to All For One, believing it would accelerate their master's goals. During the Final War, he sabotaged U.A.'s evacuation systems under Skeptic's command before being discovered by Gunhead and captured by Kendo, Tetsutetsu, and Gunhead.

Additional Information: His Quirk generates electricity from his thumbs, strong enough to disrupt U.A.'s digital systems. Arrested following the Final War and All For One's defeat.

cardPool.title: Taishiro Toyomitsu
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Taishiro Toyomitsu

Alias: BMI Hero: Fat Gum

Quirk Name: Fat Absorption

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero (currently No. 11), mentor to hero trainees

Personality: Constantly hungry and playful, yet earnest when duty calls. Friendly with civilians and allies, but determined when lives are threatened. Recognizes potential in others and cares deeply for those under his care. Knowledge of Japan's underworld makes him a shrewd operative who prioritizes saving lives.

Appearance: A massive round man with small nose, towering over most adults. Beneath the fat lies surprising muscularity visible when he burns reserves. Wears a black and yellow zippered hood with white striped sleeves, red-orange gloves with black knuckles, matching boots with grey metallic knee guards, and a black mask.

Backstory: Ranked No. 58 eight years prior, Taishiro has climbed to No. 11 through dedication and hero work. He mentors promising young heroes including Suneater, Red Riot, and Real Steel, recognizing their potential and determination.

Additional Information: Despite his size, Taishiro subdues targets with impressive speed.

cardPool.title: Swordkil
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Swordkil
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Unnamed Sword Quirk
Occupation/Role: Mercenary, Second-in-Command of Wolfram's crew
Personality: Arrogant and dedicated, Swordkil is a ruthless mercenary loyal only to Wolfram. He is quick to threaten and disdains those who "play hero." His pride clouds his judgment, making him boastful and short-sighted in critical moments.
Appearance: A middle-aged man with lightly tanned skin and shoulder-length desaturated pink hair that flares outward. His thin honey-brown eyes are marked by curved, dark purplish-pink linear tattoos beneath them and down his cheeks. He wears a sleek black combat suit with a full-face mask featuring a pale X-shaped design.
Backstory: Wolfram's trusted second-in-command, Swordkil has earned authority over the mercenary crew through combat prowess. During the I-Island incident, his arrogance proved fatal when he was defeated by Izuku Midoriya.
Additional Information: Swordkil's Quirk generates cone-shaped, collapsible blades covering his forearms, making him a lethal melee combatant. He operates as a professional villain for hire and demonstrates how overconfidence can undermine even capable fighters.

cardPool.title: Susugu Mitarai
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Susugu Mitarai

Alias: Laundry Hero: Wash

Quirk Name: Wash

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero (No. 8 ranked)

Personality: Maintains a cheerful, child-friendly public demeanor while taking heroic duties seriously. Grows irritated when criticized and drops his theatrical manner to address pressing situations directly.

Appearance: Wears a washing machine-themed hero costume with a top-loading design featuring two exaggerated eyes protruding from the lid. His arms emerge from thick grey hoses ending in yellow rubber gloves. He wears waterproof pants with a belt and large boots decorated with wave patterns and bubble-release circles.

Backstory: Ranked among Japan's elite Pro Heroes, Wash uses his Quirk for rescue operations and public safety. He mentors younger heroes and takes an active role in community protection.

Additional Information: Not a UA student. His Quirk allows him to generate large cleansing bubbles capable of safely evacuating multiple people from danger and protecting them from environmental threats.

cardPool.title: Stitched Giant
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Stitched Giant
Quirk Name: Mutant Bovini
Occupation/Role: Villain, League of Villains recruit
Personality: Confident in combat abilities, willing to challenge professional heroes despite low rank.
Appearance: A hulking, obese man in a custom pale green stitched suit. A dark grey gas mask with three bovine horns dominates his face; the respirator holes glow red when channeling his Quirk. Small black boots contrast his imposing frame.
Backstory: Recruited by Tomura Shigaraki for the U.S.J. assault, Stitched Giant was tasked with overwhelming U.A. staff. His confidence proved misplaced when he faced Eraser Head, whose Erasure Quirk disabled his powers, leading to swift defeat.
Additional Information: F-rank villain; arrested after the U.S.J. incident. His Quirk enables laser fire projection from his face, making him a ranged combatant, though he becomes defenseless against Erasure users.

cardPool.title: Starservant
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Starservant
Quirk Name: Control Glass
Occupation/Role: Independent Villain, Street Preacher
Personality: Delusional and unstable, Starservant speaks in cryptic apocalyptic prophecies about impending darkness. He genuinely believes himself chosen to prevent the world's end, though his methods involve attacking innocents. Cowardly in direct confrontation, he prefers ambushes with devoted followers.
Appearance: An elderly man with a gaunt, wrinkled face and blank, pupil-less eyes. He has a long unkempt white beard and constant nosebleed. His attire blends monk and magician aesthetics: dark disheveled cloak over light robes, wrist bracelets, and a tall cylindrical cap with trailing cloth.
Backstory: Once a harmless street preacher warning of societal collapse, Starservant grew increasingly radical and violent, convinced he alone could stop approaching darkness. Dabi later enlisted him to harass Endeavor, leading to his capture after a failed alley ambush.
Additional Information: Starservant manipulates glass on massive scales, reshaping it into floating orbs for transportation and attacks.

cardPool.title: Stanleyk
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Stanleyk

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Unknown

Occupation/Role: Bar owner and criminal informant in Otheon's Shanty Town

Personality: Shrewd and morally flexible, willing to facilitate criminal activities. Stern when business fails, yet capable of unexpected kindness—he offered Rody legitimate bartending work. Distrustful but maintains mutual trust with key contacts despite occasional friction over debts.

Appearance: A stout, middle-aged man with a bald crown and curly dark brown hair on the sides, thick eyebrows, and visible arm and chest hair. Wrinkles line his weathered face. He wears a black shirt with rolled-up sleeves beneath a purple vest with dull yellow buttons.

Backstory: Stanleyk built his reputation as a reliable middleman connecting Otheon's criminal underworld with street operatives like Rody Soul. His bar distributes illicit jobs while maintaining plausible deniability. He demonstrated capacity for legitimate business by promoting Rody from street work to bartending.

Additional Information: Operates primarily in Otheon. Possesses extensive connections throughout the criminal circuit and serves as an information broker for various illegal factions.

cardPool.title: Spike
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Spike
Quirk Name: Unknown
Occupation/Role: League of Villains member, U.S.J. Incident participant
Personality: Aggressive and brutal, willing to kill without hesitation. Demonstrates pack mentality as part of Shigaraki's horde.
Appearance: A large, bulky man with gold-yellow skin covered in prominent spikes on his shoulders. His angular head features two sloped planes meeting at a sharp apex, with a black crater-like depression in his forehead. He has glowing red eyes and visible fangs.
Backstory: One of seventy low-ranking villains recruited by Tomura Shigaraki for the U.S.J. assault. Deployed to the Squall Zone to eliminate Koji Koda. He was quickly subdued by Fumikage Tokoyami's Dark Shadow and apprehended by authorities.
Additional Information: Operates as a disposable foot soldier with limited combat effectiveness against trained opponents.

cardPool.title: Soramitsu Tabe
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Soramitsu Tabe

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Food

Occupation/Role: Eight Bullets member of the Shie Hassaikai yakuza organization

Personality: Unhinged and perpetually ravenous, driven by insatiable hunger. Despite his apparent insanity, he values his fellow Eight Bullets as true friends and is utterly devoted to Overhaul, though he won't consume those he considers friends.

Appearance: A gaunt man with pale skin, large boney hands, and oversized fingers. Circular eyes with pinprick pupils and heavy dark bags. Black, disheveled hair. His unnaturally large mouth filled with straight teeth results from his Quirk. He wears a ragged burlap sack mask with eye holes and stitched smile, secured by rope around his neck. Beneath it: purple dress shirt and grey pants.

Backstory: A societal outcast unable to conform due to his Quirk and fractured mind, Soramitsu was discovered by Overhaul and given purpose within the Shie Hassaikai. Finding belonging among the other Eight Bullets members with similarly tragic pasts, he surrendered completely to the organization.

cardPool.title: Sorahiko Torino
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Sorahiko Torino

Alias: Gran Torino

Quirk Name: Jet

Occupation/Role: Retired Pro Hero, Former UA High School Teacher, Mentor

Personality: Deceptively senile in demeanor, Gran Torino masks his sharp intellect behind forgetfulness and name-mixing as a teaching tactic. He is brutally demanding with students, employing harsh criticism and physical discipline to forge stronger heroes. Despite his gruff exterior, he genuinely cares for his proteges.

Appearance: An extremely short, elderly man with a scrawny, shriveled frame and heavy wrinkles. He has light complexion, brown eyes, grey spiky hair with forward bangs, and a trimmed beard. His hero costume is a monochrome full-body suit with a yellow cape, thick yellow gloves and boots, a "G" belt buckle, and a dark diamond-shaped domino mask.

Backstory: Once a tall hero rivaling All Might, Gran Torino trained the Symbol of Peace himself and mentored countless heroes. Now retired and aging, he takes selective proteges under his wing, recognizing untapped potential in young heroes-in-training.

Additional Information: Despite his age and frail appearance, Gran Torino remains exceptionally formidable in combat.

cardPool.title: Soji
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Soji
Alias: Soji the Hammer
Quirk Name: Unnamed Lightning Quirk
Occupation/Role: Yakuza enforcer for the Abegawa Tenchu Kai
Personality: Aggressive and loyal to his organization; willing to engage threats directly without hesitation.
Appearance: A muscular man with short black hair and thick beard. He bears the kanji 雷 ("thunder") tattooed on his left shoulder and wears practical construction worker attire.
Backstory: Soji served as an enforcer for the Abegawa Tenchu Kai. During an assault on their headquarters by vigilante Stendhal, he fought alongside executives Tetsu, Haruhisa, and Rojiya Yonenaga in defense. He was defeated and killed by Stendhal.
Additional Information: Soji wielded a hammer as his primary weapon, combining it with his lightning generation abilities for devastating close-range attacks. He was one of four executives present during the headquarters breach.

cardPool.title: Soga Kugisaki
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Soga Kugisaki
Alias: Spike
Quirk Name: Spike
Occupation/Role: Vigilante, ally to Naruhata Vigilantes, former criminal
Personality: Initially cruel due to discrimination, but reformed into a principled vigilante with strong loyalty to the marginalized. Defiant, ideological, and fiercely protective. Shows mental instability from being labeled a monster, yet genuine care for allies.
Appearance: Tall, lean young man with wild spiky turquoise hair and inward-slanting yellow eyes. Sharp pointed front teeth and small eyebrows. Wears a sleeveless vest over a tank top, jeans, and leather shoes. Later adopts a brown trench coat and hat. Under Trigger influence, his physique expands with spikes across his back and arms.
