Backstory: Discriminated against for his Quirk appearance, Soga turned to violence with friends Moyuru and Rapt. Rescued by Naruhata Vigilantes from the murderous Stendhal, he underwent reformation. Now a devoted vigilante student of Knuckleduster, fighting for society's abandoned.
Additional Information: Refuses to acknowledge legal definitions of villainy for the undeserving.

cardPool.title: Snipe
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Snipe
Alias: Cowboy Hero
Quirk Name: Homing
Occupation/Role: Pro Hero and UA High School Teacher (Third Year Class Instructor)
Personality: Intelligent and levelheaded with strong moral convictions. Displays tactical expertise and rational judgment, though flustered by awkward social situations. Humble despite considerable skill. Professional and measured in demeanor.
Appearance: Cowboy-themed figure with tan gas mask featuring triangular eye holes and silver ear-defenders. Dark bluish dreadlocks to shoulders. Brown cowboy hat with metallic "S" plate, gray knee-high boots with silver trims and spurs. Large red frayed cloak over black tank top with white right-side torso armor. Black armguards, tan gloves, baggy dark pants with light brown chaps, brown belt with gun holster.
Backstory: Accomplished Pro Hero and marksmanship specialist recognized as Japan's second-greatest long-range combatant. Selected to lead UA's third-year students for tactical brilliance and commitment to hero mentorship.
Additional Information: Exceptional marksmanship and strategic thinking. Wields modified dual guns and smoke grenades.

cardPool.title: Slugger
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Slugger
Quirk Name: Unknown
Occupation/Role: Pro Hero
Personality: Professional and determined, though cautious in combat. Frustrated when unable to act against threats, particularly fluid-based villains. Respects heroic protocol.
Appearance: Tall, lanky man with vibrant orange hair and white umpire-style mask. Wears dark underclothing under a beige pinstriped baseball uniform with shoulder pads, wide belt, and shin cuffs. White knee-high socks and oversized orange-green shoes. Massive gray, orange, and green gauntlet on right arm.
Backstory: Established Pro Hero who responded to the Sludge Villain incident threatening Katsuki Bakugo alongside other heroes. His abilities proved ineffective against the fluid villain. Witnessed All Might's intervention.
Additional Information: Quirk is baseball-themed but undisclosed. Cannot engage fluid-based villains effectively. Seasoned professional hero, not a UA student.

cardPool.title: Sludge Villain
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Unknown

Alias:
Sludge Villain, Hedoro Viran

Quirk Name:
Sludge Body

Occupation/Role:
D-rank Villain, Criminal

Personality:
Selfish, cruel, and sadistic with cowardly streaks. Bold enough to steal in daylight but flees when outmatched. Shows no remorse for endangering lives and values self-preservation above all. Gleeful when victory seems assured.

Appearance:
A humanoid figure of dark green mud-like substance with sharp teeth and large round eyes. No fixed facial features beyond these, appearing as amorphous sludge capable of shifting shape.

Backstory:
A low-ranking Tokyo villain committing petty crimes without regard for civilians. First encountered by All Might during a bank robbery. Later freed during the Paranormal Liberation War and conscripted into the final assault on Jaku City.

Additional Information:
His Sludge Body allows him to possess individuals by absorbing them. Vulnerable to acidic substances that can dissolve his composition. Despite D-rank status, he poses danger when controlling stronger Quirk users. Prefers evasion and coercion over direct combat.

cardPool.title: Sirius
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Sirius
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Good Ear
Occupation/Role: Pro Hero Sidekick on the Oki Mariner
Personality: Friendly and approachable with keen interest in mentoring aspiring heroes. Respectful of her Captain despite embarrassment at his antics. Selfless and determined, willing to sacrifice herself to prevent criminals from escaping.
Appearance: Young woman with smart blue eyes and shoulder-length light blue hair swept right. Wears sleeveless white sailor uniform with dark blue collar, short skirt, red scarf, and blue gloves with white striped wrist guards. Thigh-high boots with wavy patterns and flat hat with ribbon base. Large fin-shaped communication earpieces.
Backstory: Dedicated sidekick under Captain Selkie aboard the Oki Mariner. Her Quirk makes her invaluable for long-distance team coordination. She has developed strong professional bonds with her captain and teammates while supporting the next generation of heroes.
Additional Information: Proficient in Morse code. Carries retractable steel baton concealed in uniform. Fin-shaped earpieces amplify her Quirk during maritime patrols and rescue operations.

cardPool.title: Simon Gollini
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Simon Gollini

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Monster Summon

Occupation/Role: Member of the Gollini Family mafia

Personality: Enthusiastic and playful with an obsessive love for games and RPGs. He enjoys tormenting enemies and prolonging fights for entertainment. Despite his chill demeanor, he becomes flustered when caught off-guard or his monsters are defeated unexpectedly.

Appearance: A lanky young man with artichoke green hair featuring yellow streaks, kept long on one side with a curled end. He has a matching green goatee, multiple jeweled rings and piercings, and wears a mulberry pink tuxedo with blue floral jacket, navy tie, and tan oxfords with a rose pin. He often wears elaborate wizard cosplay with staff, cloak, and crooked hat.

Backstory: Simon is an active member of the Gollini Family, a criminal organization that captures and places heroes in dungeon scenarios for entertainment. His fascination with games and dungeon mechanics has made him skilled at orchestrating these twisted tournaments.

Additional Information: Simon's Quirk summons various video game-like monsters.

cardPool.title: Sidero
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Sidero

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Iron Balls

Occupation/Role: Villain, Humarise member

Personality: Devoted to Humarise's anti-Quirk agenda but pragmatic and self-preserving. Quick to betray his organization when facing capture. Suggests tactical improvements in combat.

Appearance: Tall man with slicked-back brown and black hair, squarish stubbled jaw, and wide mouth. Wears a pale gold horned mask covering his upper face, gray combat suit with short sleeves, and cream-colored boots. Black iron balls protrude from his knuckles on all fingers except his thumbs.

Backstory: Joined Humarise under coercion to avoid execution for possessing a Quirk. Operates as an enforcer for Flect Turn's terrorist organization. Values self-preservation over ideological commitment.

Additional Information: Manipulates iron ball projectiles to increase in mass and size before impact. Surrenders to Shoto Todoroki in exchange for information about Humarise operations.

cardPool.title: Shuichi Iguchi
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Shuichi Iguchi
Alias: Spinner
Quirk Name: Scales
Occupation/Role: Villain, League of Villains member, Vanguard Action Squad operative
Personality: Devoted to Stain's ideals with surprising moral restraint for a villain. Lifelong discrimination shaped his worldview. He questions the League's extreme actions and maintains unexpected compassion, holding himself to a code of honor inspired by his idol.
Appearance: A reptilian humanoid with bright green scales, lizard-shaped face, and pink eyes. Long swept-back desaturated pinkish-purple hair. Wears a white tattered cloth mask like Stain with goggles on his forehead, red scarf, arm bandages under black wristbands, sleeveless shirt, dark baggy pants with brown holsters, and black boots. Carries an enormous sword made of many smaller blades bound together and wears pale metallic knee guards with two belts and blue-white polka chest armor.
Backstory: Ostracized due to his Mutant Quirk's appearance, Spinner found purpose in Stain's hero reform ideals.

cardPool.title: Shota Aizawa
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Shota Aizawa

Alias:
Erasure Hero: Eraser Head

Quirk Name:
Erasure

Occupation/Role:
Homeroom Teacher of Class 1-A, UA High School

Personality:
Stern, reserved, and logic-driven with high expectations for his students. Appears cold and impatient, though deeply committed to nurturing heroes. Once plagued by self-doubt, his friendships transformed him into a determined educator.

Appearance:
Tall, slender man with pale skin and shoulder-length, messy black hair. Dark eyes are half-opened and typically bloodshot. His hero costume consists of a baggy black long-sleeved shirt and pants tucked into boots, utility belt, and signature wrap scarf with bright yellow goggles underneath. When formally dressed, he wears a black suit with blue tie, hair in a low bun.

Backstory:
As a UA student, Aizawa struggled with self-doubt about his Quirk until friendships with Oboro Shirakumo and Hizashi Yamada revealed his potential. He became a Pro Hero and now dedicates himself to teaching Class 1-A.

Additional Information:
Prefers to conserve energy and often sleeps in his sleeping bag during downtime.

cardPool.title: Shoko Haimawari
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Shoko Haimawari
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Unknown Slapping Quirk
Occupation/Role: Mother, Civilian
Personality: Strict and domineering with a sharp tongue, though genuinely caring beneath her harsh exterior. Protective of her son to the point of overcontrol, with deep skepticism toward Heroes due to past dangers. Capable of kindness when she lowers her guard.
Appearance: Tall, fair-skinned, slim middle-aged woman with dark eyes and neck-length olive-brown hair in a bouffant style. She wears a navy blazer over a dark brown high-neck top, matching body-con skirt, dark magenta stockings, and black flats with a gold necklace.
Backstory: Raised her son Koichi in the countryside and became overprotective after witnessing his Quirk manifest at infancy. She used her Quirk to strike him whenever he floated, suppressing his ability. Her fear stems from his reckless hero fantasies that endangered him and cost him his high school entrance exam. She struggles to balance her love for Koichi with keeping him safe.
Additional Information: Not a UA student. Mother of Koichi Haimawari from the Vigilantes spinoff series.

cardPool.title: Sho
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Sho

Alias:
None

Quirk Name:
Unknown

Occupation/Role:
Student at Masegaki Primary School

Personality:
Cheerful and popular, easily flustered in unexpected situations. Displays typical rebellious behavior.

Appearance:
A small boy with large round eyes and dark hair. Wears a red collared shirt and light brown shorts.

Backstory:
A Masegaki Primary student selected for a Provisional Hero License exam trial to test social abilities of UA hero candidates Bakugo, Todoroki, Inasa, and Camie during their second licensing attempt.

Additional Information:
Not a UA student. Exceptionally popular in his class. Briefly acquainted with hero candidate Camie Utsushimi during the licensing examination.

cardPool.title: Shishido
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Shishido

Alias: Lion Hero: Shishido

Quirk Name: Lion-based enhancement quirk granting increased strength and physical prowess

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero (No. 13 ranked), Hero Work-Study mentor

Personality: Fiery and hot-blooded, easily provoked yet capable of compassion. Prideful but willing to set aside rivalries for the greater good.

Appearance: A powerfully muscular man with long, spiky brown hair resembling a lion's mane. He wears a golden fur-covered hero costume with prominent spikes designed like fangs and a black maw with exposed teeth. Beneath: fitted black top, brown hide tied at waist, turquoise knee-length jeans, tan spiky-cuffed gloves, and dark boots with golden fur trim.

Backstory: A decorated pro hero known for his leonine features and aggressive combat style, Shishido has risen to No. 13 ranking through raw power and determination. He maintains a complex rivalry with Gang Orca yet proves capable of setting aside differences when duty calls.

Additional Information: Mentors UA students during hero work-studies. Participates in major hero operations including the Villa Raid Team and Final War, commanding respect despite his volatile temperament.

cardPool.title: Shinya Kamihara
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Shinya Kamihara

Alias: Ninja Hero: Edgeshot

Quirk Name: Foldabody

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero (No. 4 ranked), Leader of The Lurkers

Personality: Calm and focused with unwavering composure in crisis. Intelligent strategist who quickly analyzes situations and enemy tactics. Selfless and brave, willing to take personal risks to protect others. Maintains shinobi composure and consoles panicked allies.

Appearance: Slim, muscular man of shorter stature. Gray hair styled into three sharp points covering the right side of his face, dark gray eyes, thin moustache. Wears blue mask over lower face tied with red yarn. Ninja-inspired costume features red shinobi shozoku under blue robe, dark arm cloth with white forearm sleeves, dark gloves, and red scarf with white chest patch. Gold mask on right shoulder, red belt and robe straps. Blue socks and yellow zori sandals complete the look.

Backstory: Elite Pro Hero who rose to No. 4 rank through masterful Quirk control and ninja combat prowess. Leads The Lurkers as trusted strategic operative against overwhelming threats.

cardPool.title: Shinjiro Hohoemi
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Shinjiro Hohoemi

Alias:
Mr. Smiley

Quirk Name:
Smile

Occupation/Role:
Former Villain, Aspiring Artist

Personality:
Passionate artist disillusioned by rejection who turned to vandalism for recognition. Not malicious but initially resistant to authority. Shows bravery and empathy against greater threats, capable of genuine remorse and self-reflection.

Appearance:
Lean muscular man with long blonde hair in ponytail with light green tips. Large blue eyes and wide grin. Disproportionate forearms and large rounded hands. Wears pink long-sleeved v-neck shirt with white frills, burgundy pants with gray cutaway and yellow buttons, yellow-buckled belt, black eye mask, and red cowboy hat with two paintbrushes bearing blue and magenta bristles.

Backstory:
Failed art school acceptance despite talent, turning to vandalism and graffiti as rebellion. Initially used his Quirk only to evade capture. Later recognized he was running from failure rather than confronting it.

Additional Information:
Carries spring-loaded shoe attachments for enhanced mobility. Uses a holographic projector to activate his Quirk remotely.

cardPool.title: Shinji Nishiya
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Shinji Nishiya
Alias: Kamui Woods
Quirk Name: Arbor
Occupation/Role: Pro Hero (No. 7 ranked), Member of The Lurkers
Personality: Serious during hero work but emotionally sensitive and easily discouraged when others take credit for his accomplishments. Deeply moved by recognition from respected heroes.
Appearance: Muscular young man of below-average height for a Pro Hero. Distinctive puffy red leaf-like hair visible beneath his dark blue bodysuit. Wears a face-concealing helmet, wooden belt, wooden knee pads, and wooden shoes. Two wooden rings with branches hang from his shoulders. A small bundle of roses decorates his belt.
Backstory: A talented hero who rose to No. 7 rank through exceptional skill and dedication. Gained the respect of elite heroes like Edgeshot, who invited him to join The Lurkers, an honor that moved him deeply.
Additional Information: His Quirk allows enlargement and control of wooden body parts strong as tree branches, excellent for binding and restraint. Vulnerable to fire-based attacks. Considered a standout hero of the next generation.

cardPool.title: Shin Nemoto
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Shin Nemoto

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Confession

Occupation/Role: Eight Bullets member of the Shie Hassaikai criminal organization

Personality: Cynical and emotionally detached. Exceptionally loyal to Overhaul, whom he trusts implicitly. Holds himself in high esteem and specializes in psychological manipulation and guerrilla tactics rather than direct combat.

Appearance: A slim man with short, light-colored hair and bangs. He wears a black cape over baggy 3/4-length pants, pale sneakers, and a black bowler hat. Like all Eight Bullets, he sports a black plague mask.

Backstory: A former con artist turned criminal operative, Shin joined the Shie Hassaikai and earned his position through cunning intellect and unwavering devotion to Overhaul. His Quirk made genuine connection impossible until meeting his boss.

Additional Information: Shin lacks direct combat prowess but excels at marksmanship and psychological warfare. His Confession Quirk forces truthful answers, which he combines with con artist techniques. He works effectively with fellow Eight Bullets member Deidoro Sakaki.

cardPool.title: Shikkui Makabe
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Shikkui Makabe

Alias: Mr. Smith

Quirk Name: Hardening

Occupation/Role: Third-year student at Ketsubutsu Academy High School, aspiring Pro Hero

Personality: Smooth and cool popular student. Reserved but determined to become a hero. Strategic thinker who values collective strength and trusts his classmates.

Appearance: Distinctly inhuman with entirely blue, rough, rock-like skin resembling a carapace. No visible hair, nose, or ears; wide jagged mouth with upward-protruding spikes. Blue eyes with grooved patterns. Neck composed of stacked dark blue rings. Wears a black puffed parka with high collar over a thin white shirt, gold chain necklace, baggy cyan pants, and thick dark blue ski boots with furred shafts.

Backstory: Third-year student at Ketsubutsu Academy training under Ms. Joke. Participated in the Provisional Hero License Exam against Class 1-A using strategic ambushes. Works with Yo Shindo in coordinated operations, demonstrating professionalism in combat and rescue scenarios.

Additional Information: Member of Ketsubutsu Second-Year Class 2. Uses Hardening Quirk to strengthen projectiles for combat. Known for tactical awareness and strategic adaptability.

cardPool.title: Shihai Kuroiro
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Shihai Kuroiro

Alias: Scheming Hero: Vantablack

Quirk Name: Black

Occupation/Role: UA High School Class 1-B Student

Personality: A sly schemer who catches opponents off guard with dramatic flair. He enjoys dark concepts and is nervous around girls, often misinterpreting their friendliness as romantic interest. Despite his cunning nature, he shows genuine admiration for those he respects.

Appearance: A tall young man with fluffy white hair and long, thin black eyes. His pitch-black skin ties directly to his Quirk. He wears a high-collared black jumpsuit with light shoes featuring dark collars, large silver wristbands with three rectangular indentations, and matching tongue designs.

Backstory: A UA High School student training to become a Pro Hero, Shihai has honed his abilities through rigorous combat experience. His mastery of stealth and tactical cunning make him Class 1-B's stealthiest member, specializing in espionage and ambush tactics.

Additional Information: Shihai can merge his body with dark-colored objects and move through them at high speeds, even while carrying others.

cardPool.title: Shie Hassaikai Boss
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown (Conjectural)
Alias: Shie Hassaikai Boss
Quirk Name: Unknown
Occupation/Role: Former Yakuza Leader, now imprisoned
Personality: A man of strong moral principles who upholds traditional yakuza code and honor over profit. Fatherly despite his criminal past, he attempted to guide his wards toward righteousness. Dignified and resolute, accepting decline with grace rather than compromising his values.
Appearance: An elderly man with a deeply lined face and graying hair. Formerly wore formal black kuro montsuki kimono with dark gray hakama. Post-Final War, he is severely weakened and emaciated, confined to a wheelchair.
Backstory: Once led the Shie Hassaikai yakuza organization. As Heroes rose and the yakuza declined, he refused to resort to cruelty or exploitation. He adopted orphaned Kai Chisaki and later took in his granddaughter Eri. When Kai proposed using Eri to create a Quirk-Destroying Drug, the Boss refused and demanded Kai leave. Kai put him in a coma. He was awakened after the Final War and now visits Kai in prison to admonish him.
Additional Information: Not a UA student. Operates under a strict code of honor that distinguishes yakuza from villains.

cardPool.title: Sharp Blade
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Sharp Blade
Quirk Name: Unknown
Occupation/Role: Low-ranking villain, League of Villains recruit
Personality: Irritable and impatient, easily frustrated. Lacks composure and tactical experience.
Appearance: Lean build with backward-swept brown hair. Black bodysuit with half-mask, pointed shades, gray elbow gloves, utility belt, and shoulder braces. Carries twin knives.
Backstory: Recruited by Tomura Shigaraki for the U.S.J. assault as an expendable villain. Deployed to the Conflagration Zone where he engaged Class 1-A students with minimal skill.
Additional Information: Defeated and captured by Mashirao Ojiro during the U.S.J. incident. Arrested with other assault team members. Unidentified Quirk suggests he relied on knives and physical training.

cardPool.title: Sensoji
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Sensoji
Alias: Mister Blaster
Quirk Name: Blast
Occupation/Role: UA High School Student, Class 2-B
Personality: Arrogant and self-centered, viewing himself as superior to weaker Quirk users. A poor loser who resents those who defeat him, especially Shota Aizawa. Hypocritical, claiming others' ideas while accusing them of copying. Despite his flaws, he acknowledges genuine heroic accomplishments from rivals.
Appearance: A large, muscular man with a square jaw, sharp eyes, and no eyebrows. Short orange hair with long strands at the nape and pointed pompadour with sideburns. Dark sleeveless tank top with contrasting chest panel, dark trousers with knee pads, and fingerless gloves with forearm guards. Circular ring-like elements on glove palms where his Quirk activates, mirrored as decorative rings on shoulders, belt, and knee pads. Wears dark-lensed shades to manage his Quirk's blinding side effects.
Backstory: A Class 2-B student at UA High School with a powerful Quirk and inflated ego. His dismissive attitude toward weaker Quirks created friction with classmates, particularly Shota Aizawa, whom he deeply resents for defeating him.

cardPool.title: Serpenters
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Ena and Dio (Twin Brothers)
Alias: The Serpenters
Quirk Name: Sword Kill
Occupation/Role: Humarise Terrorist Operatives
Personality: Identical twins with erratic, excitable temperaments devoted to Flect Turn's cause. Maniacal and gleeful in combat, they laugh constantly while attacking. Opportunistic cowards beneath their violent enthusiasm, they joined Humarise seeking survival rather than from genuine ideology.
Appearance: Twin men of average build with fair skin, bowl-cut indigo hair, and yellow reptilian eyes with dark purple markings. They have large fangs and wear matching red and white tunics with gray snake-skin boots.
Backstory: Twin brothers who gained Quirks but allied with anti-Quirk terrorist organization Humarise. They agreed to serve Flect Turn in exchange for exemption from the planned Quirk genocide, operating as devoted operatives without question.
Additional Information: Their Quirk grants extendable blade weapons capable of cutting through explosives. When enhanced by Trigger drugs, they become more vicious and snake-like with stretched mouths, spiky hair, and sharper teeth.

cardPool.title: Sen Kaibara
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Sen Kaibara
Alias: Spiral
Quirk Name: Gyrate
Occupation/Role: UA High School Student, Class 1-B
Personality: Levelheaded and calm with a plain demeanor. He's open with his opinions and unafraid to disagree, showing maturity beyond his peers. Despite his serious nature, he warms up during combat and can be enthusiastic. Rather belligerent, he gets drawn into friends' antics but remains composed overall.
Appearance: A young man of average height with dark brown, shaggy hair and distinctive black eyes with white pupils. He has a modest athletic build with a slight tan. His hero costume consists of a white windbreaker with spiral tube grommets, dark blue undershirt with drill-patterned rings, white sweatpants with matching patterns, red holsters, brown shoes, and spiral-patterned gloves covering only his fingers.
Backstory: Sen trains at UA High School to become a Pro Hero in his first year. He demonstrates capability with his Quirk and hand-to-hand combat, using gyrating techniques to augment his physical strikes. Bilingual and skilled, he's proven himself against talented martial artists.
Additional Information: Sen is considered ikemen for his good looks.

cardPool.title: Selkie
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Selkie
Quirk Name: Spotted Seal
Occupation/Role: Pro Hero and Captain of the Oki Mariner
Personality: Confident, kind, and professional with a stern side when needed. Prioritizes hero work and crew protection. Deliberately appears cute despite intimidating appearance, much to his sidekicks' annoyance.
Appearance: Muscular humanoid spotted seal with gray beard, red eye markings, and whiskers. Wears navy blue wetsuit with silver accents, yellow goggles, and stylized "S" on left shoulder. Features retractable flippers.
Backstory: Seasoned Pro Hero commanding the Oki Mariner rescue vessel. Earned his position through dedication to maritime rescue and crew leadership.
Additional Information: Proficient in Morse code. Quirk abilities include extended breath-holding, diving to 1500 meters depth, echolocation in dark waters, and above-human strength. Uses specialized retractable flipper footwear for amphibious combat.

cardPool.title: Seiji Shishikura
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Seiji Shishikura

Alias:
Shishikross

Quirk Name:
Meatball

Occupation/Role:
Second-year student at Shiketsu High School

Personality:
Proud and dignified, valuing obligation and decorum. Eloquent and formal in speech. Critical and prone to snap judgements. Insecure about his small eyes despite denying it. Dislikes Bakugo and Class 1-A for lacking dignity. Shows hidden compassion beneath stern demeanor but struggles with self-reflection and imposing his values on others.

Appearance:
Average height with thin, slanted eyes and tiny black pupils. Straight purple fringe covering his left eye with fluffy tufts at the back. Wears standard Shiketsu uniform: white collared shirt, dark pants, and signature hat. Hero costume features black overcoat with red trimmings, high collar, red-rimmed shoulder flaps, elbow-length sleeves with red cuffs, black apron with red strings, fingerless gloves, and black boots.

Backstory:
A Shiketsu High student training to become a Pro Hero under the school's rigorous teachings of dignity and obligation. Influenced by the Hero Killer's philosophy though he refuses to acknowledge it.

cardPool.title: Satsuki Asui
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Satsuki Asui

Alias:
None

Quirk Name:
Unknown

Occupation/Role:
Student (younger sibling, not a UA student)

Personality:
Inquisitive and caring toward her family. She idolizes her older sister Tsuyu despite often being left in her care while their parents work.

Appearance:
A young girl with a tadpole-like appearance featuring large round eyes with three upper eyelashes and small eyebrows. She has light-tanned skin, a pout-like mouth, and dark green hair in low pigtails, reflecting her family's froggy theme.

Backstory:
The youngest daughter of the Asui family, Satsuki grew up primarily under Tsuyu's care while their parents traveled for work. She developed a close bond with her sister despite their age gap.

Additional Information:
Satsuki has a younger brother named Samidare. She idolizes Tsuyu, who attends UA High School. The family relocated to an evacuation center during the Paranormal Liberation War while Tsuyu joined the final conflict efforts.

cardPool.title: Sasori Nimaru
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Sasori Nimaru
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Unknown
Occupation/Role: Fashion Designer
Personality: Dedicated and detail-oriented, Sasori commands respect through innovative work and high standards. She approaches costume design with artistic vision.
Appearance: A young woman with shoulder-length red hair tied back with a purple rope. She wears a white top and skirt with black dots, red spider-web fishnet stockings, and a black collar accent.
Backstory: Sasori rose to prominence as a fashion designer and earned recognition designing hero costumes. She has created costumes for UA students including Katsuki Bakugo and Ochaco Uraraka. Her designs are industry standard.
Additional Information: Not a UA student. She maintains professional relationships with prominent heroes like Best Jeanist.

cardPool.title: Sansa Tamagawa
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Sansa Tamagawa

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Unknown

Occupation/Role: Police Force Member

Personality: Professional and duty-focused, maintaining composure in formal settings. Little is known of his personal nature beyond his dedication to law enforcement.

Appearance: A lean man with feline features—a ginger tabby cat's head and large yellow eyes. He wears a pale blue button-up shirt beneath a police vest, with a golden bell at his neck. His uniform matches standard Police Force issue.

Backstory: Sansa serves as a dedicated member of the Police Force, working within Japan's law enforcement system. He supports hero society through official channels.

Additional Information: Not a UA High School student. His professional demeanor suggests experience and rank within the Police Force hierarchy. The golden bell appears to be a distinctive personal or official marker.

cardPool.title: Sankyaku Kamehara
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Sankyaku Kamehara

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Third Leg

Occupation/Role: Professional Photographer

Personality: Obsessive perfectionist devoted to capturing ideal moments. Plagued by self-consciousness and inferiority complex, assuming others resent him. Despite passivity, capable of growth—Izuku's sincerity inspired him to be more assertive in his craft.

Appearance: Young man with a distinctive third leg protruding from his body. Short, light-colored hair frames squinting eyes suggesting focused concentration. Wears a dark vest jacket over matching dark pants. Inseparable from his professional camera.

Backstory: A skilled photographer hired by Midnight to document Class 1-A's adjustment to public attention. Successfully captured perfect shots of every student except Izuku Midoriya. His inability to photograph Deku became an obsessive pursuit that tested his patience and methods.

Additional Information: Not a UA student. When scaffolding collapsed during one of Deku's rescue efforts, Izuku saved him from the falling debris.

cardPool.title: Sanctum
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Sanctum
Alias: None known
Quirk Name: Unknown
Occupation/Role: Top-ranked adviser in the Vanguard Action Tactics Regiment: Black of the Paranormal Liberation Front; former Meta Liberation Army member
Personality: Ideologically devoted and unwavering, Sanctum is brave and steadfast. He serves as a mentor figure, lecturing younger members on organizational mission and values. He defends his cause directly against opposition.
Appearance: Fair-skinned with dark-black eye irises and long dark-black hair marked by white stripes on both sides. A thin strand runs down his middle. He sports a long, thick dark-black mustache and wears thin-framed golden eyeglasses. His attire consists of a dark-blue overcoat with golden rectangular bars and button-like epaulettes on the collar.
Backstory: Sanctum is among the oldest Meta Liberation Army members and became a trusted adviser. He was instrumental in mentoring recruits. When the Meta Liberation Army merged with the League of Villains to form the Paranormal Liberation Front, he retained his high position.

cardPool.title: Samuel Abraham
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Samuel Abraham
Alias: Sam
Quirk Name: Unknown
Occupation/Role: Scientist and assistant to David Shield at I-Island
Personality: Initially appears dedicated to research, but becomes resentful and greedy when unrecognized; willing to betray colleagues for money, yet capable of genuine surprise at selfless sacrifice.
Appearance: An older, heavyset man with short blonde hair and closed blue eyes; wears formal business attire including a dark suit, tie, suspenders, and dress shoes.
Backstory: Sam co-developed the Quirk Amplification Device with David Shield, a revolutionary headset capable of enhancing Quirks without side effects. When governments pressured I-Island to confiscate the research, Sam grew bitter about lacking compensation. During the I-Expo incident, he hired villains to recover the device and planned to sell it to criminal Wolfram for payment—a betrayal that nearly cost his life until David shielded him from a bullet.
Additional Information: Sam represents how greed corrupts scientific progress; his arc shows how unrecognized effort can turn idealism into villainy, though redemption remains possible through witnessing sacrifice.

cardPool.title: Samidare Asui
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Samidare Asui

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Frog

Occupation/Role: Student (youngest Asui sibling)

Personality: Laid-back and carefree, relying on his older sister Tsuyu for support. He displays typical younger sibling behavior with familial affection and pride in Tsuyu's accomplishments.

Appearance: A young boy with a frog-like appearance. He has black hair obscuring his right eye, dark green half-closed eyes, and blush marks on his cheeks, giving him a sleepy, unbothered appearance.

Backstory: The youngest Asui son, raised primarily by Tsuyu while their parents traveled for work. After the Paranormal Liberation War, his family relocated to an evacuation center while Tsuyu joined the heroes in battle.

Additional Information: Second-youngest of Tsuyu's siblings, with older sister Satsuki. He shares the family's frog-type quirk and watched the final war broadcast, cheering for Tsuyu's heroic efforts.

cardPool.title: Sajin Higawara
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Sajin Higawara
Alias: Sand Hero: Snatch
Quirk Name: Sandstorm
Occupation/Role: Pro Hero and Police Force Bodyguard
Personality: Compassionate and justice-driven, caring deeply about crime victims. Courageous but principled, willing to abandon battles to save innocents. Easily angered by remorseless villains.
Appearance: Muscular man with turquoise eyes and light ash-blond hair in a long ponytail. Dark blue mask, distinctive long mustache. Wears a green and silver combat vest with connected tubes running to his back.
Backstory: Dedicated Pro Hero known for heroic principles and empathy. Served as bodyguard during Overhaul's transport when the League of Villains ambushed the police convoy. Fought to protect both officers and prisoners.
Additional Information: Sandstorm Quirk transforms his upper body into controllable sand, allowing him to form constructs and resist Tomura's Decay. Sand body resists fire but his lower body remains vulnerable to attacks.

cardPool.title: Sameko
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Sameko
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Unnamed Shark Quirk
Occupation/Role: Hero School Student (Hiroshima)
Personality: Loyal and cautious friend who values companions' safety. Friendly and appreciative of kindness.
Appearance: Young woman with shark characteristics including sharp teeth, dorsal fin on head, long dark hair, large rounded eyes, and minimal nose. Aquatic physique.
Backstory: Hiroshima hero school alumnus who befriended Rumi Usagiyama and Kameko. During an Osaka school trip, the trio got lost near Tsutenkaku Tower. A young Fat Gum provided directions. While preparing to continue, Rumi sensed a nearby battle and leaped away before Sameko and Kameko could stop her.
Additional Information: Calls Rumi "Ruko." Her shark Quirk grants shark-like attributes with unclear full extent. Not a UA High School student.

cardPool.title: Salaam
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Salaam
Alias: The Papyrus Hero
Quirk Name: Papyrus
Occupation/Role: Top Egyptian Pro Hero
Personality: Composed and motivating, projecting calm confidence. Dependable and willing to aid allies internationally, though frustrated by bureaucratic delays.
Appearance: A brown-skinned man with a two-dimensional silhouette reminiscent of ancient Egyptian hieroglyphics. He wears a pharaoh-inspired costume with pleated linen top, shendyt skirt, striped nemes headcloth, ornamental jewelry, and flowing cape.
Backstory: Egypt's premier hero, known for exceptional skill and inspiring confidence. Enigmatic quality—no one has ever seen his back. Coordinated with international heroes during the Humarise crisis and assisted Japan after the Paranormal Liberation War.
Additional Information: His Papyrus Quirk grants extraordinary speed and mobility. Professional, internationally minded, and committed to global security. His origins remain mysterious.

cardPool.title: Saito
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Saito

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Unknown

Occupation/Role: Middle School Student

Personality: Popular and well-liked among peers, though his true character remains largely undocumented.

Appearance: A striking doppelgänger for Izuku Midoriya with the same wide eyes and fluffy dark hair, but with black hair and eyes instead of green and lacking freckles. He wore his school uniform of light dress shirt, tie, and dark blue blazer.

Backstory: An ordinary middle school student who became the catalyst for Himiko Toga's descent into villainy. After being injured in a fight, his bloodied appearance triggered Toga's Quirk influence, leading her to attack him with a box cutter and drink his blood.

Additional Information: Saito was a classmate of Himiko Toga. He remains a peripheral figure significant only for his role in Toga's origin story. His Quirk and current whereabouts are unknown.

cardPool.title: Saiko Intelli
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Saiko Intelli

Alias:
None

Quirk Name:
IQ

Occupation/Role:
Second Year Student at Seiai Academy

Personality:
Arrogant and confident in her intellectual superiority, Saiko formulates complex strategies with precision. She struggles to understand emotional reasoning and empathy, viewing decisions through pure logic. She can recognize humility in defeat and value bonds beyond self-interest.

Appearance:
A pale girl of average height with thin, cat-like eyes featuring bluish-lilac irises. Her straight hair cascades to her waist in a hime cut, colored pale blue-lavender-gray. She wears the Seiai Academy uniform: white double-breasted blazer with gold trim, dark blue long-sleeved shirt, matching dress pants, white gloves and boots, and white beret with black trim. A golden monocle adorns her left eye, suspended by a chain.

Backstory:
A prodigy with an IQ of 150, Saiko dominated her academy through intellect. During the Provisional Hero License Exam, she led classmates against Class 1-A, devising a plan to neutralize their Quirks through environmental manipulation. Her defeat exposed her blind spot regarding human connection.

cardPool.title: Saguri-chan
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Saguri

Alias: Explorer Hero: Saguri-chan

Quirk Name: Not specified

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero running the Saguri Agency

Personality: Curious and obsessive about insects with deep entomological knowledge. Easily distracted by perceived specimens and prone to misidentification despite expertise. Adventurous and willing to travel uncharted territories in pursuit of villainy and discovery.

Appearance: Young woman with long blonde hair in a ponytail and two face-framing bangs, wide pinkish-red eyes. Wears a light skintight bodysuit ending at the thighs, black belt with boots, black shoulder pads connected by chest belt, side satchels, and explorer goggles.

Backstory: An unconventional Pro Hero known for roaming uncharted lands pursuing villains. Her independent agency allows freedom to pursue insect collection and study. Her methods are unorthodox and sometimes dangerous.

Additional Information: Not a UA student. During a Team-Up Mission with Class 1-A students Minoru Mineta and Hanta Sero, she mistakenly identified Mineta as an undiscovered insect species and attempted to preserve him in alcohol, causing him significant distress.

cardPool.title: Ryuko Tatsuma
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Ryuko Tatsuma

Alias: Dragoon Hero: Ryukyu

Quirk Name: Dragon

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero (No. 10), Mentor

Personality: Humble and composed, Ryuko praises talent without seeking gratitude. She maintains calm in combat and delegates to capable individuals. Despite her rank, she carries self-doubt from failing to save someone. She is protective and nurturing toward trainees, caring deeply for children's welfare.

Appearance: A woman with chin-length blonde hair swept back with a headband, long fringe covering her right eye. Thin yellow eyes with reptilian slit pupils and sharp teeth. She wears a dark red qipao with yellow collar trim, pale green scale-textured shoulder trim, and side-slit skirt with claw-mark designs. Black knee-high boots, long white disconnected sleeves, and a green scale-textured headband with four silver claws. Small black dragon wings protrude from the back of her head, with gold spiked ear piercings on her left ear.

Backstory: A seasoned Pro Hero who mentored promising students. Once ranked No. 9, she dropped to No. 10, blaming herself entirely. She experienced trauma witnessing child exploitation and takes child welfare personally.

cardPool.title: Ryuichi Gojiyama
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Ryuichi Gojiyama

Alias: The Kaiju

Quirk Name: Kaiju

Occupation/Role: Instant Villain

Personality: Wild and bestial when influenced by Trigger. Loses rational thought and becomes purely instinct-driven, acting as a destructive force.

Appearance: When transformed, a 15-meter tall bipedal theropod with grey scales, jagged spikes down his back, horns on his snout, digitigrade legs with clawed feet and fingers, and a Tyrannosaurus-like mouth. His tongue is blackened from Trigger use. His human form remains unseen.

Backstory: Ryuichi appeared mysteriously in Naruhata city. Administered Trigger by Kuin Hachisuka, he transformed into a rampaging kaiju that destroyed buildings and damaged the Marukane Department Store before being defeated by Pro Hero Captain Celebrity.

Additional Information: Not a UA student. His Quirk's normal capabilities are unknown, observed only under Trigger's influence. He was apprehended after reverting to human form.

cardPool.title: Ryu Yoshida
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Ryu Yoshida
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Unknown
Occupation/Role: Doctor at Central Hospital
Personality: Professional, brave, and well-meaning; stands against dangerous threats to protect patients; known for saving those considered beyond saving.
Appearance: Dinosaur-like features with teal skin, four dark blue plates atop his head, and a white beak. Large eyes with small green pupils. Wears a white doctor's coat over a dark blue shirt.
Backstory: Head doctor at Central Hospital treating severe injuries from major conflicts. Witnessed Japan's darkest hours from the Paranormal Liberation War through societal collapse, remaining steadfast in his duty to heal. Stood with staff against mutant forces to protect vulnerable patients.
Additional Information: Not a UA student; established medical professional. Performs critical surgeries on high-profile patients including top Heroes. His calm demeanor and moral conviction make him a pillar of stability in crises.

cardPool.title: Ryo Inui
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Ryo Inui

Alias: Hound Dog

Quirk Name: Dog

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero and Head of Student Discipline at U.A. High School

Personality: Gruff and volatile with aggressive outbursts that manifest as growls and barks. Despite his rough demeanor, he possesses a sense of justice and can be fair, praising students when warranted but holding them accountable for rule violations.

Appearance: Dog-like features including a scruffy blond mane sticking straight out behind his head and a slightly pointed snout. He wears a black muzzle as part of his hero costume. His frame is muscular and bestial due to his Quirk's influence.

Backstory: A seasoned Pro Hero known as the Hunting Dog Hero, Ryo was recruited to serve as Head of Student Discipline at U.A. He oversees student conduct and safety, though he ultimately seeks to guide them toward becoming responsible heroes.

Additional Information: Ryo is a staff member and Pro Hero at U.A., not a student. His Quirk grants him enhanced smell and the ability to manifest clones. He struggles with emotional control when frustrated, causing his speech to devolve into animalistic sounds.

cardPool.title: Roro Soul
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Roro Soul

Alias:
None

Quirk Name:
Unknown

Occupation/Role:
Student (formerly); Resident of Otheon Shantytown

Personality:
Kind-hearted and cheerful despite hardship, Roro shows unwavering loyalty to his older brother Rody and emotional support for his younger sister Lala. He accepts his circumstances without complaint.

Appearance:
A small boy with flat brown hair and gray eyes. He wears a patched cadet blue and white shirt with visible repairs on the left sleeve and right waist, reflecting his impoverished life.

Backstory:
Born in Otheon to engineer Eddie Soul and a deceased mother, Roro had a happy early childhood until his father abandoned the family to join the anti-Quirk sect Humarise. The Soul siblings were expelled from school, ostracized, and forced to abandon their home for a caravan in the shantytown. Roro remained emotionally dependent on Rody for protection and care.

Additional Information:
Roro survived the Humarise crisis when Rody disarmed the Trigger Bombs worldwide. He and Lala re-enrolled in school and rebuilt their lives with restored standing in Otheon.

cardPool.title: Ronaudo Keage
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Ronaudo Keage

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Not specified

Occupation/Role: UA High School Student, Department of Management

Personality: Enterprising and analytical, focused on hero marketing and public perception. Demonstrates business acumen in assessing hero marketability and recognizes the importance of media documentation.

Appearance: Young man of average height with short, dark purple hair. Has small round eyes and distinctive counter-clockwise swirl-like blush marks on his cheeks. Typically wears his UA gym uniform.

Backstory: A Department of Management student at UA High School specializing in heroic commerce. Analyzes hero marketability during events like the UA Sports Festival. His focus extends to media production and public relations for heroes.

Additional Information: Associates with classmates Futo and Komako. Part of the business-focused track within UA's Management Department. His work involves understanding how heroes are perceived and marketed to society.

cardPool.title: Romero Fujimi
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Romero Fujimi

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Zombie Virus

Occupation/Role: Isami Academy High School Student

Personality: Arrogant and condescending, Romero looks down on others with little regard for consequences. He is gruff and reckless with his abilities, though classmates claim he isn't truly malicious. He idolizes All Might despite his abrasive demeanor.

Appearance: Romero has a slouched, unkempt appearance with desaturated bluish-gray hair messily spiked over his right eye, no eyebrows, and wide bug-like eyes. He wears the Isami High uniform: white dress shirt, red tie, dark blue blazer, gray pants, and brown loafers. His hero costume consists of a black double-breasted coat with high collar, thick gray cuffs, wires and nozzles around waist and limbs, pinstriped pants, and pointed shoes. A translucent purple-tinted mask covers his mouth.

Backstory: A student of Isami Academy, Romero developed a rivalry with Katsuki Bakugo upon meeting Class 1-A.

cardPool.title: Rojiya Yonenaga
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Rojiya Yonenaga

Alias:
None

Quirk Name:
Strength Enhancement

Occupation/Role:
Executive Member of Abegawa Tenchu Kai (Yakuza Organization)

Personality:
Serious and composed man with unflinching demeanor. Shows indifference to external pressures and philosophical detachment. Never displays drunkenness. Collects manhole covers as an unusual habit, weaponizing them in combat.

Appearance:
Tall man with strong physical bearing. Large scar marks his left eyebrow. Wears a white suit with blue blouse and star-logo overcoat. Dark hair with intimidating presence befitting his yakuza status.

Backstory:
Seasoned executive within the Abegawa Tenchu Kai who earned respect through composure and capability. His unconventional combat approach—collecting and throwing manhole covers—demonstrates resourcefulness and eccentric character. Maintains philosophical acceptance of the criminal underworld's realities.

Additional Information:
Strength Enhancement Quirk activates with right arm glowing and emitting sparks, enabling devastating manhole cover throws with precision. Combat-tested executive with exceptional durability and accuracy.

cardPool.title: Rikiya Yotsubashi
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Rikiya Yotsubashi

Alias: Re-Destro

Quirk Name: Stress

Occupation/Role: President and CEO of Detnerat Company; Grand Commander of the Meta Liberation Army

Personality: Outwardly affable but ruthless fanatic devoted to his ancestor Destro's vision of Quirk liberation. Kills without hesitation when disrespected. Intelligent and manipulative, he recruits followers by exploiting society's flaws while viewing himself as a savior.

Appearance: Tall, odd-looking middle-aged man with long pointed nose and protruding chin. Short orange-brownish hair swept back with widow's peak, small dark eyes, no eyebrows, and two dark moles on left forehead. Muscular build despite slim appearance. Always wears black pinstriped suit with green dress shirt and tie, often with black hat and coat.

Backstory: Descendant of villain Destro, Rikiya inherited leadership of the modernized Meta Liberation Army while building Detnerat into a corporate front. He believes society oppresses those with unconventional Quirks and recruits the disenfranchised through manipulation and violence to achieve total Quirk liberation.

Additional Information: Not a UA student.

cardPool.title: Rogone
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Rogone
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Transformation
Occupation/Role: Humarise Terrorist Agent
Personality: Ruthless and devoted to Flect Turn's anti-Quirk ideology. Shows no mercy to surrendering targets and dismisses pleas for compassion.
Appearance: A slim man with red skin, sunken eyes, thin mustache, sharp protruding teeth, and a single pointed horn. He wears a dark Humarise operative costume. When transformed, he becomes massive and muscular with darker crimson skin, two large horns, grotesque features, and iron clubs for arms.
Backstory: Elite operative for anti-Quirk terrorist organization Humarise. Deployed to capture Izuku Midoriya and Rody Soul after they obtained a classified briefcase. Confronted Rody and transformed to eliminate him, but was defeated by Izuku and knocked unconscious.
Additional Information: His Transformation Quirk grants immense strength and durability, allowing him to withstand powerful air-based attacks. Captured when Humarise's terrorist plot was foiled.

cardPool.title: Rody Soul
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Rody Soul

Alias:
None

Quirk Name:
Pino

Occupation/Role:
Resident of Otheon; Aspiring Pilot

Personality:
Carefree smooth-talker who masks insecurity through humor. Deeply protective of his younger siblings. Cynical about fairness due to poverty, willing to steal for survival, yet capable of genuine trust. Embarrassed by his Quirk's emotional transparency.

Appearance:
Young man with auburn hair in a spiky ponytail and half-lidded gray eyes. Sun-kissed skin, red bandanna, pale blue patched shirt, tan jacket with orange flower accent, striped tie, gray gloves, patched black pants, and dark brown shoes with gray cloth wrapping.

Backstory:
Abandoned by his father and shunned by his Otheon community for his father's ties to the terrorist cult Humarise, Rody became sole provider for his younger siblings Roro and Lala. He survives through odd jobs, parkour, and morally gray means, developing cynicism shaped by the slums' inequality.

Additional Information:
Skilled acrobat and negotiator despite scarcity. His Quirk involuntarily reveals his true emotions. Dreams of becoming a pilot to escape his circumstances and secure his siblings' futures.

cardPool.title: Robot
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Robot
Quirk Name: Spatial Distortion, Eye Beam, Super Regeneration
Occupation/Role: High-End Nomu, Doctor Kyudai Garaki's combat unit
Personality: Obedient to orders, prefers ranged combat, methodical and cold.
Appearance: Humanoid frame with extensive robotic augmentation. Mechanical legs and metallic plating. Head encased in sleek robotic helmet with glowing eyes for beam attacks.
Backstory: Combat-focused villain handpicked by Doctor Garaki for High-End Nomu conversion. Enhanced with multiple Quirks and robotic upgrades, he guarded Garaki's lab beneath Jaku General Hospital. Unleashed during the hero raid to defend Garaki and Tomura Shigaraki.
Additional Information: High-End Nomu classification grants enhanced durability and power. Spatial distortion allows remote attacks via hand gestures. Eye beams serve as secondary offense. Killed by hero Mirko during the Paranormal Liberation War Arc.

cardPool.title: Robber Villain
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown

Alias: Robber Villain

Quirk Name: Smoke

Occupation/Role: Petty criminal and fugitive

Personality: Fierce and moody with a quick temper, but strategically cautious. Avoids direct confrontation, preferring escape over combat. Uses violence only as a last resort.

Appearance: A stout figure with dark blue skin, rounded noseless head with pointed ears, and striking green eyes. A single antenna protrudes from his crown, with three smoke-emitting holes on each shoulder. He wears a black vest with yellow trim, white pants, brown boots, black armbands with yellow lining, and a green handkerchief around his neck. He perpetually smokes three cigarettes simultaneously.

Backstory: A small-time criminal who has committed multiple robberies across Tasomiya Ward using his Quirk to evade heroes. He clashed with Midnight, Loud Cloud, His Purple Highness, and Eraser Head multiple times. Eventually apprehended when Eraser Head wore protective eyewear to neutralize his smoke evasion.

Additional Information: Not a UA High School student. Operates independently rather than with organized villain groups.

cardPool.title: Rin Yaritezawa
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Rin Yaritezawa

Alias:
None

Quirk Name:
Not specified

Occupation/Role:
Sophomore at Naruhata Women's College; Event Organizer

Personality:
Outwardly sociable but privately bitter from being exploited for her skills. Deeply appreciates genuine kindness and reciprocal warmth.

Appearance:
Sharp green eyes, short dark brown hair parted right. Pink nail polish, gold star-drop earrings. Wears stylish V-neck sweaters, skirts, and coordinating jewelry.

Backstory:
College student skilled at organizing mixers and social events. Years of planning while being taken advantage of has made her cynical about romance and human nature, masking deeper emotional wounds beneath surface friendliness.

Additional Information:
Not a UA High School student. Appears in My Hero Academia: Vigilantes. Prone to drinking at social events. Responds warmly to genuine kindness and concern.

cardPool.title: Rikiya Katsukame
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Rikiya Katsukame

Alias:
Eight Bullets member

Quirk Name:
Energy Suck

Occupation/Role:
Member of the Shie Hassaikai yakuza organization under Overhaul

Personality:
Lazy and energy-dependent. Enjoys draining others' stamina. Obedient to Overhaul with a perverted streak when enhanced by Trigger drug.

Appearance:
Tall, exceptionally muscular man in black sleeveless tank top, olive drab jeans, and armored belt. Black plague mask with red lines and white eyes. Massive gauntlets and knuckledusters on both fists. Metallic seat protrudes from his back for transporting members.

Backstory:
Rikiya became Overhaul's loyal associate and was recruited as one of the Eight Bullets, serving as a key enforcer for the Hassaikai yakuza.

Additional Information:
His Quirk absorbs stamina and vitality from nearby individuals, strengthening him while weakening opponents. When enhanced by Trigger drug, he can drain vitality through inhalation without physical contact. He was defeated and arrested during the Shie Hassaikai Raid.

cardPool.title: Ribby
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Ribby (formerly unnamed serial killer)
Alias: High-End Nomu Ribby
Quirk Name: Super Regeneration, Extendable Antennae, Rib Cage Manipulation
Occupation/Role: High-End Nomu under Doctor Kyudai Garaki
Personality: Unhinged and homicidal with immediate bloodlust. Possesses tactical intelligence to recognize environments and exploit weaknesses. Capable of cunning strategy and mid-combat adaptation.
Appearance: Humanoid Nomu with emaciated, skeletal frame. Distinctive protruding ribs visible through chest cavity. Long antenna-like protrusions extend from head, capable of elongating significantly. Gaunt physiology compared to other High-Ends.
Backstory: Originally a psychotic serial killer, deliberately selected by Doctor Garaki for conversion into a High-End Nomu due to his violent nature. Awakened during the Paranormal Liberation War as defense against the hero raid on Jaku General Hospital. Fought against top-tier Pro Heroes including Mirko and Endeavor before being destroyed by Crust's sacrifice.
Additional Information: High-End Nomu with enhanced combat capabilities and regenerative durability. Antennae capable of piercing reinforced targets.

cardPool.title: Rikiya Eno
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Rikiya Eno

Alias:
The Instant Villain

Quirk Name:
Big Monkey

Occupation/Role:
Vigilante/Petty Criminal

Personality:
Reckless and easily influenced, prone to destructive behavior when chemically enhanced. Limited baseline personality data.

Appearance:
Unremarkable in normal form. When transformed via Trigger, becomes a massive rotund ape with dark fur, several meters tall, wearing only black shorts. Muscular yet barrel-chested.

Backstory:
Minor criminal who uses Trigger drug to amplify his quirk for petty crimes and street chaos. Attempted mayhem atop a city tower before being defeated by Captain Celebrity in a single punch near the Naruhata Festival.

Additional Information:
Quirk requires chemical enhancement via Trigger to manifest. Transformation is temporary and reversible. Street-level threat operating outside formal villain organizations.

cardPool.title: Rikido Sato
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Rikido Sato

Alias:
Sweets Hero: Sugarman

Quirk Name:
Sugar Rush

Occupation/Role:
UA High School Student, Class 1-A

Personality:
Optimistic and good-natured, Rikido genuinely loves baking and sharing sweets with classmates. He remains humble about his talents and maintains an earnest demeanor.

Appearance:
A tall, muscular young man with short, spiky brown hair, small square eyes, bushy eyebrows, and a round nose. He wears the standard UA male uniform with light gray blazer and turquoise trim. His hero costume is a yellow full-body suit with white gloves, boots, and a utility belt for sugar pouches.

Backstory:
Rikido developed his baking skills out of necessity—his Quirk requires sugar to function, making homemade sweets more economical. His culinary talents have earned him respect as a reliable member of Class 1-A.

Additional Information:
Sugar Rush requires 10 grams of sugar to activate, granting five-fold strength for three minutes. Each additional 10 grams extends duration by three minutes. Extended use causes cognitive decline and drowsiness. He trains with weightlifting while consuming large quantities of sweets to maximize his Quirk's effectiveness.

cardPool.title: Reiko Yanagi
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Reiko Yanagi

Alias:
Emily

Quirk Name:
Poltergeist

Occupation/Role:
Hero Course Student, Class 1-B, U.A. High School

Personality:
Quiet and emotionally reserved with a fascination for horror. Despite her timid nature and cryptic speech, she is helpful and has good fashion sense. She maintains an eerie, undead-like posture with elbows tucked and hands dangling.

Appearance:
Pallid, slender young woman with pale silver pin-straight hair in an unkempt pixie-bob. Dark prussian-blue half-lidded eyes with pointed lower lashes and plumb lips. Her hero costume is a light periwinkle-blue kimono with puffy hood, flared sleeves, white and navy striping, and matching boots.

Backstory:
A first-year student at U.A. High School's Hero Course, Reiko has honed her telekinetic abilities under professional guidance. Her analytical mind and strategic thinking make her valuable in team exercises.

Additional Information:
Her Poltergeist Quirk allows telekinetic control of nearby objects with significant weight capacity. She works effectively in teams, identifying threats and coordinating long-range attacks without exposure.

cardPool.title: Rei Todoroki
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Rei Todoroki

Alias:
Rei Himura (maiden name)

Quirk Name:
Frost

Occupation/Role:
Homemaker, Mother

Personality:
Rei is a kind, caring woman who endures hardship with quiet resilience. Years of abuse left her mentally fragile, but recovery has restored her compassionate nature. She maintains hope and smiles despite trauma, showing deep love for her children while struggling with lingering psychological wounds.

Appearance:
A middle-aged woman of average height with shoulder-length straight white hair parted in three sections with long bangs. She has round, gentle features with tired brown-gray eyes. Her expression is typically mellow and kind. She favors plain civilian clothing in soft colors like yellow and orange.

Backstory:
Rei married Enji Todoroki in an arranged Quirk Marriage to help her family financially. She bore four children while suffering escalating abuse from her husband. A psychological breakdown caused her to severely burn her youngest son Shoto. Now institutionalized at Fujani Hospital, she has regained stability and reconciled with Shoto. She receives visits from her other children but remains afraid to face Enji.

cardPool.title: Red
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Red
Alias: Aka
Quirk Name: Unknown
Occupation/Role: Top-ranked Adviser, Vanguard Action Intelligence Regiment: Carmine (Paranormal Liberation Front)
Personality: Casual and composed, maintains calm even in tense situations. Unfazed by interruptions from allies.
Appearance: Tall, well-built young man with blonde hair in a ponytail, left eye obscured by hair. Wears military-style army green outfit with black vest and boots, brown pouch at waist.
Backstory: Former Meta Liberation Army member who rose through ranks after its merger with the League of Villains to become trusted adviser in the reorganized Paranormal Liberation Front's intelligence regiment.
Additional Information: Quirk ability undisclosed. Proven strength exceeds average Pro Hero level. Associates with high-level figures like Hawks and Twice.

cardPool.title: Raito Sanda
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Raito Sanda

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Unnamed Electricity Quirk

Occupation/Role: Third-year middle school student; prospective UA applicant

Personality: Serious and studious with strong analytical abilities. Dedicated to deep learning and technical discussion. Initially follows others' expectations but demonstrates independence when reconsidering his true ambitions.

Appearance: Boy with wild, spiky hair and electricity-bundle-shaped eyebrows. Pitch-black eyes with white pupils. Wears standard male middle school uniform with book bag. Youthful, unblemished appearance.

Backstory: Top-performing student considered a strong UA Hero Course candidate. During UA's Prospective Students Day, he engaged with Support Course innovations and faced Hero Course student Katsuki Bakugo in a tag game. Though his electrical Quirk proved effective defensively, Bakugo's aggression overwhelmed him. This encounter prompted Raito to reconsider his path and realize he pursued heroics only from external pressure. After debating with Business Course students, he decided the Business Course better suited his true interests.

cardPool.title: Rapt Tokage
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Rapt Tokage

Alias: Instant Villain

Quirk Name: Lizard

Occupation/Role: Vigilante, Former Villain

Personality: A reformed bully with humor and self-deprecation. Despite his cruel past mocking others, he shows genuine concern and learns from consequences. Quick to joke but capable of difficult choices for the greater good.

Appearance: A reptilian humanoid with turquoise scales, long oval head, and sharp-toothed mouth. Large reptilian eyes dominate his face with small nostrils. A muscular tail extends from his lower spine. He wears a casual hooded jacket, brown waistcoat, and shorts.

Backstory: Originally part of a bullying clique, Rapt humiliated classmates for entertainment. Trigger use granted temporary flight and altered his appearance, but hospitalization forced him to confront his drug use. He abandoned Trigger and became a vigilante seeking redemption while maintaining his sardonic personality.

Additional Information: His Lizard Quirk grants enhanced reptilian traits. Trigger amplifies these into pterosaur-like wings and increased mutation with severe health risks.

cardPool.title: President Tanuki
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: President Tanuki
Quirk Name: Tanuki
Occupation/Role: Manager of Marukane Department Store
Personality: Jovial and community-minded, eager to promote his business through cultural events; generous with store incentives.
Appearance: A rotund man with light brown fur resembling a tanuki. He has a muzzle with four whiskers, small black nose, round ears, and thinning black hair. He wears a brown blazer, navy-blue vest, white dress shirt, green tie, oval-frame glasses, and dress pants.
Backstory: President Tanuki manages the Marukane Department Store with focus on community engagement and festive promotions, seeking visibility through events like Narufest.
Additional Information: Not a UA High School student. His Quirk's full capabilities are unknown. He demonstrates entrepreneurial acumen and friendliness toward his professional circle.

cardPool.title: Pony Tsunotori
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Pony Tsunotori

Alias:
Rocketti

Quirk Name:
Horn Cannon

Occupation/Role:
UA High School Student, Class 1-B

Personality:
Friendly and naive with innocent charm, easily manipulated. Determined and thoughtful in combat, preferring tactical draws to reckless victories. Reverts to English when angered or flustered. Shares passion for anime and manga.

Appearance:
Short girl with round face, equine muzzle, and thick wavy blonde hair to mid-back with bangs. Large round Prussian blue eyes. Tall pale tan lyre-shaped horns. Horse-like calves with brown hooves and short tail. Jockey-themed hero costume: orange skin-tight shirt with markings, matching pants, fingerless orange-tipped gloves, horse halter with lead rope, and belted boots with stirrups for transporting allies.

Backstory:
American of Japanese descent raised in the US. Came to UA High School to train as a Pro Hero despite incomplete Japanese fluency. Unique physiology and Quirk grant exceptional mobility and combat versatility, making her one of Class 1-B's fastest combatants.

Additional Information:
Horn Cannon fires rapid projectiles and physically manipulates horns for piercing or pinning.

cardPool.title: Paulo Gollini
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Paulo Gollini

Alias:
None

Quirk Name:
Erasure Spot

Occupation/Role:
Member of the Gollini Family mafia

Personality:
Cautious and dutiful, Paulo prefers swift execution over prolonged torment. However, beneath his stern exterior lies cowardice—he panics when cornered, quickly abandoning confidence to beg for mercy.

Appearance:
Paulo has purple skin, small black eyes, and no visible mouth. His face tapers to a pointed muzzle with jagged fin-shaped ears. He dresses in a black suit with leather tailcoat, white gloves, purple tie, black pants, and brown derby shoes. A black fedora with ear holes and a red rose on his tailcoat complete his ensemble.

Backstory:
Paulo earned his place in the Gollini Family through diligent service. He carries shame from allowing Ginji Kurau to escape with Anna Scervino and seeks redemption by eliminating threats to the family.

Additional Information:
Erasure Spot creates a dome-shaped energy wave that deactivates Quirks within range, though Paulo can form smaller bubbles where Quirks remain active. When artificially overmodified, the range expands to cover mountain ranges.

cardPool.title: Pankration
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Pankration
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Power
Occupation/Role: Pro Hero
Personality: Friendly and approachable despite his imposing stature. Professional and reliable in heroic duties.
Appearance: Tall, heavily muscular man with long blonde hair. Wears a red sleeveless breastplate with white chiton draped over shoulders and belted at waist. Large metallic vambraces with frilled hems cover his arms. A silver circlet adorns his forehead. Greaves and sandals complete his ancient Greek-inspired costume.
Backstory: An established Greek Pro Hero known for his immense physical strength. He operates internationally on major operations including rescue missions and criminal apprehension.
Additional Information: A seasoned Pro Hero selected for specialized task forces. His Power Quirk allows him to absorb and unleash raw power, making him one of the physically strongest heroes available.

cardPool.title: Pamela
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Pamela
Alias: Mrs. Captain Celebrity
Quirk Name: Unknown
Occupation/Role: Former wife of Pro Hero Captain Celebrity, mother, businesswoman
Personality: Gruff and sharp-tongued, Pamela voices harsh opinions and dislikes unsolicited help. Her perpetual frown masks a kind heart that softens for those she cares about, though trust issues from past betrayals run deep.
Appearance: A short woman with a rounded face, long blonde hair, small nose, and freckles. Large green eyes shadowed by a permanent frown give her an intimidating demeanor despite her diminutive stature.
Backstory: Pamela met Christopher in high school and was unmoved by his charm, seeing him as an attention-seeker. His persistence eventually won her over and they married, but his infidelity caused estrangement. She became pregnant with their son before Christopher left for Japan.
Additional Information: Raising her son as a single mother while managing legal matters from infidelity lawsuits. She deeply loves Christopher despite his flaws and worries for his wellbeing, expressing concern through anger rather than affection.

cardPool.title: Oxy-Man
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Oxy-Man
Quirk Name: Unnamed Oxygen Production Quirk
Occupation/Role: Low-ranking villain, League of Villains recruit
Personality: Cautious and tactical, willing to follow orders. Bold only when outnumbered in his favor.
Appearance: Young man of average height with ash blond hair. Wears a black jumpsuit, transparent blue goggles, and wireless headset. Carries a spear.
Backstory: Recruited by Tomura Shigaraki for the assault on Unforeseen Simulation Joint. Deployed to the Flood Zone where his water-breathing ability provided tactical advantage.
Additional Information: His Quirk enables oxygen production for extended underwater combat. Arrested after the U.S.J. incident when UA staff intervened. Defeated by Class 1-A students Midoriya, Asui, and Mineta.

cardPool.title: Ordinary Woman
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Ordinary Woman
Quirk Name: Mutant-type Quirk
Occupation/Role: Civilian Refugee
Personality: Compassionate and fearful, affected by discrimination and war trauma. Despite suffering, she remains grateful yet emotionally vulnerable, seeking normalcy while wrestling with rejection and mistrust.
Appearance: A tall woman with foxlike features including pointed ears, green fur with white underbelly, and blonde shoulder-length hair. Large blue eyes and expressive face. She wears an orange buttoned shirt, black pants, orange headband, orange wristbands, and cream slip-on shoes.
Backstory: During the Paranormal Liberation War, she was attacked by panicked civilians who mistook her for a villain due to her mutant appearance. Saved by Izuku Midoriya, she was rejected from multiple shelters because of her Quirk before finding refuge at UA High School.
Additional Information: Not a UA student, but a civilian refugee. Her Mutant-type Quirk marks her as a heteromorph, subjecting her to discrimination. She became involved in discussions about heteromorph solidarity and wartime treatment.

cardPool.title: Onima
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Onima
Alias: Onima
Quirk Name: Not specified
Occupation/Role: Pro Hero Sidekick at Endeavor Agency
Personality: Dedicated and professional, friendly toward interns. Supportive colleague who maintains composure during crises and focuses on hero operations.
Appearance: Man of average build with dull purple slicked-back hair. Wears a horned happuri hat, flak jacket over short-sleeved shirt marked with a white X symbol.
Backstory: A sidekick at Endeavor's agency among 30+ staff members. Participated in the Hosu Incident, Humarise operations, and the Paranormal Liberation War. Survived the Jaku Hospital Raid despite witnessing catastrophic events.
Additional Information: Works alongside partner Kido. Interacted with Work Study interns Izuku Midoriya, Katsuki Bakugo, and Shoto Todoroki. An established Pro Hero, not a UA student.

cardPool.title: Onemu Shinya
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Onemu Shinya

Alias: None known

Quirk Name: Unknown

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero Sidekick of Ingenium's Team Idaten Agency

Personality: Perpetually drowsy and laid-back, Onemu maintains calm composure during high-stakes operations. Her sleepy nature doesn't impede her professional competence.

Appearance: A young woman with short, slightly curly blonde hair and ram horns. She has a drowsy facial expression. Her hero costume consists of a Chinese Cheongsam mini dress, long funnel-shaped sleeves, black domino mask, and high heels.

Backstory: Onemu serves as a dedicated sidekick under Ingenium at Team Idaten Agency in Naruhata. She participates in villain apprehension, crowd control, and rescue operations. Her career includes pursuing the Bat Villain and coordinating blockade tactics against dangerous fugitives.

Additional Information: While her Quirk remains undocumented, Onemu proves capable as an active field operative. She functions as both combatant and support personnel depending on mission requirements.

cardPool.title: One-Eyed Green Dragon
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: One-Eyed Green Dragon
Quirk Name: Unknown
Occupation/Role: Low-ranking Villain, League of Villains Recruit
Personality: Aggressive and bold, willing to insult allies to maintain focus. Shows confidence even when outmatched.
Appearance: Muscular man with shoulder-length brown hair and green skin patches on torso. Upper right face is entirely black with single white spot where right eye would be. Strong angular jaw with wide zigzag-shaped mouth.
Backstory: Recruited by Tomura Shigaraki for the U.S.J. assault alongside roughly seventy low-ranking villains. Fought Shota Aizawa's forces and attempted to rally others during All Might's arrival.
Additional Information: Participated in U.S.J. Arc invasion; knocked out by All Might and arrested. Minor antagonist with no confirmed Quirk ability documented.

cardPool.title: Oboro Shirakumo
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Oboro Shirakumo

Alias: Loud Cloud

Quirk Name: Cloud

Occupation/Role: UA High School Student, Class 2-A, Hero-in-Training

Personality: Jovial and energetic with a love of jokes and witty banter, Oboro is casual and irreverent toward protocol. Beneath his goofy exterior lies genuine selfless altruism—he readily helps others in need.

Appearance: A tall young man with light blue wavy hair swept back, framed by shorter ear-length tufts. He has blue inward-tilting eyes often squeezed shut in an excited grin and wears a white bandage over his nose bridge. His hero costume consists of a blue martial arts gi with black obi, black fingerless gloves, and a dark brown aviator jacket with white fur lining, blue aviator hat with large mufflers, beige goggles with silver lenses, and black boots with white accents. He carries a red quarterstaff in a red sheath on his back, wears an orange speaker on his belt, and displays the kanji for "cloud" in white on his jacket back.

Backstory: A first-year student at UA High School with Shota Aizawa and Hizashi Yamada, Oboro trained to become a Pro Hero.

cardPool.title: Oji Harima
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Oji Harima

Alias:
The Peerless Thief

Quirk Name:
Unknown

Occupation/Role:
Infamous Villain, Robin Hood-like Thief

Personality:
Philosophical idealist driven by justice against corrupt systems. Steals from wealthy heroes to redistribute wealth to the poor, challenging the established hero system itself.

Appearance:
Dark maroon spiked hair with orange bandana across forehead. Heavy clown-like makeup with dark lipstick and eye shadow. White male kimono shirt with black symbol on back, black belt, and blue striped shirt beneath. Light baggy striped pants and maroon calf-high boots. Two bracelets on each forearm complete his theatrical jester aesthetic.

Backstory:
Oji emerged during the early hero system's establishment, recognizing systemic corruption among heroes. He became legendary redistributing stolen wealth to common people, earning comparisons to All For One and Destro as one of the world's greatest antagonists.

Additional Information:
His revolutionary ideals passed through his entire lineage to his great-great-grandson, Atsuhiro Sako. His actual Quirk remains undocumented, though his legendary status suggests considerable power rivaling formidable villains.

cardPool.title: Omori Furiko
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Omori Furiko

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Weight Increasing

Occupation/Role: High School Student (Non-UA)

Personality: Flamboyant and romantic with an overactive imagination. Self-aware despite his delusions, respectful of others, and persistent in his convictions.

Appearance: A teenage boy with short, blocky dark hair, bushy eyebrows, and large pale eyes. Dresses casually but owns a formal white suit he had tailor-made for a confession attempt.

Backstory: Omori fell in love at first sight with hero Uravity after witnessing her heroic actions during a train incident. Obsessed with confessing, he researched her identity, discovered she attended UA High School, and traveled there in his suit. His lovesickness caused him to collapse outside the school gates. Class 1-A students helped him prepare for his confession. When he finally met Ochaco, she accidentally slammed him to the ground, forcing him to confront that he had fallen in love with an imagined version of her.
