Additional Information: Omori attends a different school. His Quirk—the inverse of Ochaco Uraraka's Zero Gravity—led him to believe their pairing was destined, though his romantic pursuit proved one-sided.

cardPool.title: Odd-Eye
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Odd-Eye
Quirk Name: Mind Reaper
Occupation/Role: Pro Hero
Personality: Melodramatic and theatrical, obsessed with darkness and the arcane. Enjoys acting mysteriously important but nervously cackles when genuinely panicked, masking insecurity beneath dramatic flair.
Appearance: Young man with neck-length mint green hair and yellow eyes. Scrawny build wearing an all-dark costume with oversized-collared jacket, dark pants, gloved hands with magical symbols, and multiple belts. An eye-patch covers his right eye purely for effect.
Backstory: Runs his own hero agency with sidekicks called "contracted familiars." Built reputation as eccentric Pro Hero fascinated by darkness and the mystical. Recruits young heroes through cryptic invitations to test their worthiness.
Additional Information: His Mind Reaper Quirk forces targets to reveal hidden truths and secrets by touch. The eye-patch serves no actual purpose. He panics easily despite confident demeanor and relies on sidekicks to manage situations he cannot control.

cardPool.title: Number 6
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Rokuro Nomura

Alias: Number 6, Rock, High-Speed Hero: O'Clock II

Quirk Name: Overclock

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero (undercover), Villain Factory member

Personality: Confident with a perpetual smirk, Number 6 remains calm under pressure. He avoids unnecessary confrontation but employs violence without hesitation when needed. Vengeful and ruthless, he shows no remorse endangering innocents for his objectives.

Appearance: Athletic build with long, curly black hair tied in a ponytail. A diagonal scar runs across his face and over his nose, self-inflicted. Sharp, calculating eyes. He wears a black full-body hero suit with blue and yellow accents, paired with a trench coat and black fedora hat.

Backstory: Experimented on by All For One since childhood, Number 6 suffered from agnosia. All For One molded him into a confident operative. He now works as a covert Pro Hero while secretly collaborating with villainous organizations, using his Quirk to infiltrate and manipulate.

Additional Information: Number 6 possesses extraordinary disguise abilities through his Quirk, perfectly mimicking other appearances and hiding his scar.

cardPool.title: Nyikang
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Nyikang

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Spirit Possession

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero (Sudan)

Personality: Composed and professional. Works cooperatively with other heroes to neutralize threats.

Appearance: Tall figure in riveted metal armor with wrist gauntlets and a red-yellow sash. Black branch-like protrusions extend from his head, and a riveted metal mask covers his face completely.

Backstory: A Pro Hero from Sudan invited to the I-Expo preview. Captured by Wolfram's forces during the I-Expo incident, he was freed and aided in locating the Trigger Bomb and combating Humarise operatives in Egypt.

Additional Information: Carries a large sword as his primary weapon. Spirit Possession allows remote consciousness projection to incapacitate or control targets, making him a strategic asset in combat.

cardPool.title: Nomu (U.S.J.)
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: U.S.J. Nomu
Quirk Name: Multiple Quirks (Shock Absorption, High-Density Muscle, Regeneration, possibly others)
Occupation/Role: Artificial Human Enforcer for the League of Villains
Personality: Mindless and obedient, incapable of independent thought or speech. Brutal in combat, following orders without question. Becomes docile when without command.
Appearance: A towering, muscular humanoid monster with jet-black skin exceeding All Might's height. His exposed brain sits atop his head surrounded by large, unblinking eyes. He has a prominent beak-like mouth filled with sharp teeth. Wears only beige pants and ornate skull-emblazoned metal knee-pads, leaving his torso and feet bare. Scars cover his muscular frame.
Backstory: Originally a small-time thug subjected to extreme body modification by Doctor Kyudai Garaki under All For One's direction. His body received DNA injections from multiple individuals, granting him multiple Quirks and transforming him into an artificial human weapon designed to overpower All Might.
Additional Information: Deployed during the U.S.J. attack as a primary combatant.

cardPool.title: Nomu (Hosu)
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Hosu Nomu (Trio)
Alias: Lower-Tier White Nomu, Middle-Tier Winged Nomu, Upper-Tier Black Nomu
Quirk Name: Absorption and Release (White), Flight (Winged), Super Regeneration (Black)
Occupation/Role: Artificial combat creatures deployed by the League of Villains
Personality: Mindless, aggressive, and obedient; attack without mercy
Appearance: Three biomechanical entities—a bulky white humanoid with enhanced musculature, a skeletal winged creature, and a massive jet-black monstrosity with regenerative capabilities; all possess grotesque features
Backstory: Created by All For One, this trio was deployed by Tomura Shigaraki to terrorize Hosu City and eliminate Stain
Additional Information: The white Nomu combines Muscle Augmentation and Tongue Web techniques; the black Nomu was destroyed by Endeavor's heat; the winged Nomu was killed by Stain

cardPool.title: Nomu (Chainsaw)
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Chainsaw Nomu
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Tool Arms
Occupation/Role: Vanguard Action Squad Member
Personality: Emotionless and obedient; executes orders without hesitation or mercy.
Appearance: Massive muscular humanoid with mint green skin and exposed brain under a shiny purple helmet with red visors and metal gag. Black ripped trousers and brown belt. Six retractable arms from its back wield chainsaws, a drill, and a claw hammer.
Backstory: Created by the League of Villains, Chainsaw Nomu was deployed to the U.A. Forest Training Camp as the Vanguard Action Squad's tenth member under Dabi's command. It serves as an expendable instrument of destruction.
Additional Information: Not a U.A. student. Operates under villain command only. Primary threat during Forest Training Camp Arc; later apprehended by Mt. Lady during the Hideout Raid.

cardPool.title: Nobu
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Nobu
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Displacement
Occupation/Role: Wolfram's minion and henchman
Personality: Impatient and aggressive, Nobu enjoys conflict and shows little mercy. He is a loyal subordinate who follows orders without question.
Appearance: A skinny, pale yellow-skinned man with a goat-like face featuring two small triangular ears, slanted dark eyes, sharp teeth, and a small goatee. His dark green mohawk connects around his ears and cheekbones. He wears a black combat suit with a full-face mask featuring an X-shaped pale design.
Backstory: Nobu serves as one of Wolfram's trusted minions in an attack on I-Island. He helps seize the Central Tower control room and hunts down UA High School students. His speed and displacement abilities complement close-range fighters like his partner Daigo.
Additional Information: Not a UA student. Nobu's Quirk allows him to enlarge his hands into webbed claws that displace matter from existence. His high footspeed makes him a mobile threat, though he was defeated by Bakugo and Todoroki's combined strategy.

cardPool.title: Nirengeki Shoda
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Nirengeki Shoda

Alias: Mines

Quirk Name: Twin Impact

Occupation/Role: UA High School Class 1-B Vice Class Representative, Hero-in-Training

Personality: Humble and conscientious, Nirengeki refuses unearned credit and serves as his class's moral compass. Reliable and mature, he excels at reading situations and working tactically with allies.

Appearance: A chubby young man of below-average height with short, ice-blue hair and a round, boyish face. Large eyes with small pupils give him a sheepish expression. He wears a black high-collared hero costume trimmed with white lines, black pants, white knee-high boots, a blue scouter over his left eye, and a connected radar on one gloved hand.

Backstory: A dedicated Class 1-B student at UA High School, Nirengeki earned his position as vice class representative through dependability. He impressed Pro Hero Shishido during training, securing an internship.

Additional Information: Twin Impact allows Nirengeki to remotely trigger a second, amplified repetition of any impact or attack. He can amplify his own strikes or magnify those of teammates, making him a pivotal support combatant.

cardPool.title: NHA Reporter
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown (Conjectural)
Alias: NHA Reporter
Quirk Name: Unknown
Occupation/Role: News Reporter for NHA TV; UA High School Correspondent
Personality: Ambitious and ratings-driven, gradually developing genuine compassion and journalistic integrity as she witnesses heroic sacrifice.
Appearance: Young woman with large black eyes and medium-length brown hair in a ponytail. She wears a formal dark suit with an NHA armband and carries an NHA-labeled microphone.
Backstory: A determined reporter for NHA TV who gained access to UA High School. Initially motivated by ratings and scandal, she pursued interviews following the USJ Incident, believing controversy would boost viewership.
Additional Information: Civilian press correspondent, not a UA student. Frequently present at major hero events. Develops emotional investment in her subjects' stories over time.

cardPool.title: Nemuri Kayama
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Nemuri Kayama

Alias: Midnight, R-Rated Hero

Quirk Name: Somnambulist

Occupation/Role: UA High School Faculty, Modern Hero Art History Teacher

Personality: Playful, flirtatious, and perverted with an unpredictably serious side. Easily angered by interruptions or insults, particularly sensitive about her age. Acts on whims without shame regarding sexual behavior. Genuinely excited by displays of youth and chivalry.

Appearance: Tall, curvaceous woman with sky-blue downward-tilting eyes and long lashes. Long, thick, spiky dark purple hair with layered lengths and split bangs, one crossing diagonally. Small beauty mark below left eye, pink rectangular-frame glasses, and pink-painted nails. Wears a revealing hero costume: black leather leotard over thin white bodysuit with red gemstone accessories, light purple thigh-high stockings, burgundy utility belt with gold studs, black stiletto boots, red eye mask, wrist handcuffs, and a flogger-style whip.

Backstory: Pro Hero and faculty member at UA High School during Class 1-A's first year. Known for her R-rated hero persona and unconventional teaching methods. Occasionally goes undercover on missions.

cardPool.title: Nejire Hado
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Nejire Hado

Alias: Wonder Hero: Nejire Chan

Quirk Name: Wave Motion

Occupation/Role: UA High School Student, Class 3-A, Member of The Big 3

Personality: Naturally kind, talkative, and endlessly curious about others. Her bluntness can seem invasive. She grew distant in middle school due to misunderstandings, but regained her warmth through friendships with Tamaki Amajiki and Mirio Togata at UA.

Appearance: Fair-skinned girl with wide, round light royal blue eyes. Her periwinkle blue hair reaches past her knees with two spiral twists at the waist and side-swept bangs. She wears the standard UA female uniform. Her hero costume is a dark royal blue bodysuit with pale mint green markings, turquoise accents, knee-high boots with spiral anklets, yellow gauntlets, and spiral hair-shaped protrusions behind her ears.

Backstory: A prodigious student whose powerful Quirk initially caused others to distance themselves. Her isolation ended when Amajiki and Togata befriended her early in her UA career, helping her overcome emotional barriers.

Additional Information: Third-year student and part of UA's elite trio known as The Big 3, indicating exceptional ability among her peers.

cardPool.title: Neito Monoma
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Neito Monoma

Alias: Phantom Thief

Quirk Name: Copy

Occupation/Role: UA High School Class 1-B Student

Personality: Loud, sarcastic, and mocking toward Class 1-A, driven by envy and inferiority complex. Calm and kind otherwise, but prone to unhinged verbal tirades that earn strikes from Itsuka Kendo. Deliberately provocative to push classmates forward, though sometimes crossing into cruelty.

Appearance: Average height with slick blonde hair parted right, bangs over right eye. Periwinkle blue irises with white pupils, downward-slanting eyes usually half-closed, characteristic smirk and head tilt. Wears black double-breasted tuxedo tailcoat with upturned collar, light and dark blue dotted tie, small blue handkerchief, plain black pants and white shoes. Three clocks on belt track Quirk's time limit.

Backstory: Class 1-B student harboring deep resentment toward Class 1-A after the USJ Incident made them the center of attention. His envy masks genuine respect for his classmates' abilities and desire for Class 1-B recognition.

Additional Information: Divides society into "main characters" with hero-suited Quirks and "side characters.

cardPool.title: Needle Hair
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Needle Hair
Quirk Name: Hair Control
Occupation/Role: F-rank Villain
Personality: Confident in combat despite low ranking. Willing to engage professional heroes directly with little known of her deeper character.
Appearance: Young woman of average height with brown eyes and long gray dreadlocks. Wears a dark purple bodysuit with gray and light purple patterned sleeves and black boots.
Backstory: Recruited by Tomura Shigaraki as one of seventy villains for the League of Villains' assault on the Unforeseen Simulation Joint. Served in long-range combat alongside Stitched Giant and Victor against U.A. High School's pro heroes.
Additional Information: Her Quirk allows her to control and harden her hair while firing strands as projectiles for ranged attacks. She was neutralized by Eraser Head's Erasure ability during the U.S.J. incident and arrested.

cardPool.title: Natsuo Todoroki
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Natsuo Todoroki

Alias:
None

Quirk Name:
Ice

Occupation/Role:
College Student

Personality:
Appears friendly and easy-going but carries deep resentment toward his father Enji for family trauma and neglect. Cares deeply for his siblings, especially Shoto. Struggles with forgiveness despite acknowledging his father's attempts at redemption.

Appearance:
A young man of above-average height with an athletic build. He has distinctive white spiky hair with crimson-red streaks down the middle of his forehead. Gray eyes and a gentle expression reflect his approachable nature.

Backstory:
Second son of Enji Todoroki, Natsuo grew up in a fractured household marked by his father's obsessive hero pursuit and emotional neglect. Separated from Shoto during childhood and witnessing his mother's hospitalization shaped his worldview. His older brother Toya's mysterious disappearance further damaged family bonds.

Additional Information:
College student, not UA High School. Possesses Ice Quirk but lacks formal combat training. Represents the collateral damage of Endeavor's ambitions—caught between family duty and justified anger toward parental abuse.

cardPool.title: Native
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Native
Quirk Name: Unknown
Occupation/Role: Pro Hero
Personality: Easily irritated but fundamentally selfless and grateful. Shows concern for others' safety and humility about his limitations.
Appearance: A muscular man wearing feathered headgear and matching cape over a dark jumpsuit with the letter "N" on the chest. Wears open-toed sandals and carries himself professionally.
Backstory: An established Pro Hero attacked by the Hero Killer Stain in an alleyway. Saved by UA students Tenya Iida, Izuku Midoriya, and Shoto Todoroki. Grateful for their intervention, he rewarded them with theme park tickets. Later participated in the hospital raid against the League of Villains.
Additional Information: Native's Quirk remains unspecified. Despite being overpowered by Stain, he is respected and called upon for major hero operations. His willingness to protect younger heroes demonstrates his heroic character.

cardPool.title: Naomasa Tsukauchi
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Naomasa Tsukauchi
Alias: Detective Tsukauchi
Quirk Name: Polygraph
Occupation/Role: Police Detective
Personality: Earnest and hardworking, strict about law yet pragmatic when justice demands it. Maintains close confidences with All Might and values loyalty deeply. Despite his by-the-book nature, shows willingness to work with unconventional allies if their intentions prove genuine.
Appearance: A tall man with short black hair and rectangular black eyes. Wears a tan trench coat with matching fedora over a white collared shirt and dark pale green tie, brown dress shoes, and white gloves. His formal bearing reflects his professional detective status.
Backstory: A dedicated police officer who earned All Might's trust through years of earnest service and discretion, becoming one of the few aware of the hero's true weakened form. His relationship with his sister Makoto, who possesses a Polygraph Quirk, shaped his understanding of law and human complexity.
Additional Information: Possesses above-average deductive intellect suited to detective work. Not a UA student but operates as a law enforcement contact.

cardPool.title: Nao Shimura
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Nao Shimura

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Unknown

Occupation/Role: Homemaker, Mother

Personality: A kind, compassionate woman troubled by family dysfunction. Gentle-natured yet possessing quiet strength, she stood against her husband's violence toward their children. A loving, protective mother despite her inability to fully prevent her husband's harsh treatment of Tenko.

Appearance: A woman in her early thirties with light brown eyes and shoulder-length light brown hair parted in the middle with uneven waves and bangs. Curvaceous build, typically wore casual clothing such as black shirts with jeans or corduroy skirts. Her face often bore a worried expression.

Backstory: Nao married Kotaro Shimura and had two children, Hana and Tenko. She lived in her husband's large house alongside her own parents. Understanding Kotaro's complicated past, she respected his household rules while privately supporting Tenko's heroic ambitions. When Kotaro's abuse of Tenko escalated, Nao confronted him alongside her parents, declaring she would no longer tolerate his violence toward their children.

cardPool.title: Nana Shimura
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Nana Shimura

Alias:
The Seventh One For All User

Quirk Name:
One For All

Occupation/Role:
Pro Hero and former mentor to All Might

Personality:
A kind woman with strong sense of justice who believes true heroes must smile to save both lives and hearts. She valued bravery, emotional resilience, and self-sacrifice above all else.

Appearance:
A tall, fair-skinned woman with dark, straight shoulder-length hair in a half-up-half-down bun with short bangs, sharp intelligent eyes, and a small mole below her bottom lip. Her hero costume features a dark sleeveless bodysuit with high collar, yellow gloves, white knee-high boots, an angular golden belt buckle, and a small cape.

Backstory:
The seventh One For All user and symbol of hope for her generation, Nana mentored Toshinori Yagi and instilled in him the philosophy of the smiling hero. She placed her son in foster care to protect him from her dangerous life, a decision that led to her grandson Tenko's corruption into the villain Tomura Shigaraki.

Additional Information:
Deceased prior to the current timeline, killed by All For One.

cardPool.title: Nagamasa Mora
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Nagamasa Mora

Alias: Chewyee

Quirk Name: Not explicitly stated in source material

Occupation/Role: Second Year Student at Shiketsu High School, Class Representative

Personality: Polite and diplomatic, willing to build goodwill with rival schools. Maintains strict standards and refuses to tolerate actions that shame Shiketsu.

Appearance: Entirely covered in light brown hair with no distinct facial features except his eyes. Wears Shiketsu's standard dark pants, belt, and peaked cap as part of his hero costume.

Backstory: A promising student at Shiketsu High School, one of Japan's most prestigious hero academies. Selected as class representative, Nagamasa demonstrates exceptional composure. During the Provisional Hero License Exam, he passed the first phase through skill and strategy rather than confrontation.

Additional Information: Represents Shiketsu's measured approach to hero training. Known for seeking peaceful coexistence with UA students and apologizing on behalf of disruptive classmates. A natural leader who prioritizes institutional reputation over personal glory.

cardPool.title: Mustard
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Mustard
Alias: Mustard
Quirk Name: Gas
Occupation/Role: C-rank villain, League of Villains Vanguard Action Squad
Personality: Pragmatic and merciless, valuing function over style. Highly intelligent and calculating. Arrogant and boastful, harboring deep jealousy toward UA students whom he views as undeserving. Shows exceptional cruelty and kills without hesitation.
Appearance: Skinny young man with short, wavy light brown hair and tan skin. Brown eyes peer from behind a green gas mask connected to two oxygen tanks on his back. Wears a black gakuran school uniform with teal gloves and white shoes.
Backstory: Member of the League of Villains participating in raids with the Vanguard Action Squad. His resentment toward UA High School drives his motivation, viewing student success as unearned privilege.
Additional Information: Lacks hand-to-hand combat skills and relies entirely on his Gas Quirk and revolver marksmanship. Must continuously produce gas to maintain its effects; it dissipates quickly if he stops. Cannot survive his own gas without his mask and oxygen supply. Can sense enemy movement within his gas by detecting fluctuations.

cardPool.title: Muscle Man
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Muscle Man
Quirk Name: Charging Muscles
Occupation/Role: F-rank Villain
Personality: Confident and aggressive, overestimating his combat abilities and willing to challenge authority.
Appearance: Tall and heavily muscular with tanned skin, spiky dark brown hair, and a full-face mask. Wears a green t-shirt, baggy jeans, and brown shoes.
Backstory: A low-ranking villain recruited by Tomura Shigaraki for the League of Villains' U.S.J. assault. He attempted a sneak attack on Eraser Head but was quickly defeated and arrested.
Additional Information: His Quirk enhances muscle strength into powerful attacks, but overcharging causes severe muscle soreness and limits sustained combat. He operates as a foot soldier for the League of Villains.

cardPool.title: Mummy (U.S.J.)
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Mummy
Quirk Name: Unknown
Occupation/Role: Low-ranking villain, League of Villains recruit
Personality: Aggressive and violent. Follows orders without hesitation as part of a coordinated horde.
Appearance: A muscular man with gray bandages covering his entire face and body, obscuring distinguishing features.
Backstory: Recruited by Tomura Shigaraki for the U.S.J. invasion assault as part of the League of Villains' operation.
Additional Information: Engaged Shota Aizawa during the U.S.J. Arc but was defeated when Aizawa used his Binding Cloth to drop Steel Bulwark on him. Apprehended following the invasion's failure. His Quirk remains unspecified.

cardPool.title: Mr. Plastic
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Unknown

Alias:
Mr. Plastic

Quirk Name:
Plastic Transformation

Occupation/Role:
Pro Hero

Personality:
Confident and direct, confronting dangerous criminals without hesitation. Professional and composed in crises, dedicated to justice.

Appearance:
A muscular man with spiky grey hair and grey eyes. Wears a hero costume with two large mechanical arms featuring armored pauldrons bound to his chest with black cloth and brown straps. Equipped with a headset sporting dual blue visors and tactical pants with belt.

Backstory:
An established Pro Hero invited to the I-Expo reception where he was captured by criminal Wolfram. He attempted interrogation but was overpowered and detained until Melissa Shield restored facility security.

Additional Information:
After rescue, Mr. Plastic participated in raids against Humarise operatives at their Otheon base. His Quirk grants body-stretching abilities. He remains active in hero operations despite limited public information about his identity.

cardPool.title: Mr. Brave
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Mr. Brave
Quirk Name: Hair-Raiser
Occupation/Role: Pro Hero
Personality: Reserved and professional with steadfast dedication to heroic duty. Little is publicly known about his personal character.
Appearance: Average height and build with messy black hair and light gray eyes. He wears a dark blue bodysuit with gray patches on forearms and thighs, a chest stripe, belt, neck cloth, and protective headgear.
Backstory: Mr. Brave earned his Pro Hero license through rigorous training. He participated in the Yakuza assault and the Jaku General Hospital raid against Tomura Shigaraki.
Additional Information: His Quirk allows hair manipulation for offense, though the physical toll of plucking hair limits extended combat capability.

cardPool.title: Moyuru Tochi
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Moyuru Tochi

Alias:
None

Quirk Name:
Ignition

Occupation/Role:
Reformed Vigilante

Personality:
Once a callous bully, Moyuru underwent dramatic change after his arrest. He is now calm, respectful, and genuinely remorseful, showing unexpected kindness toward former victims.

Appearance:
A large, portly young man with dark brown skin and bald head. A small flame grows from his scalp like hair, extinguishing when unconscious. He has rounded, pupilless eyes and typically wears a purple open shirt, shorts, and slippers.

Backstory:
Moyuru was an Instant Villain who used Trigger to enhance his abilities and terrorize citizens with accomplices Soga and Rapt. His defeat and arrest by Knuckleduster sparked genuine reformation, transforming him from a remorseless aggressor into a thoughtful individual.

Additional Information:
Under Trigger's influence, his physique expands, skin develops stony texture, and flames spread across his upper body, increasing his power. He respectfully calls Koichi, a former victim, "Big Man."

cardPool.title: Moonfish
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Moonfish (true name unknown)
Alias: Moonfish
Quirk Name: Blade-Tooth
Occupation/Role: Villain, League of Villains Vanguard Action Squad member
Personality: Insane and laconic, Moonfish is consumed by obsessive hunger for flesh. He mutters constantly to maintain focus, easily distracted by any source of flesh. He prioritizes hunger above ideology and shows no mercy, willing to kill allies and enemies alike.
Appearance: A tall man with fair skin and black eyes, almost entirely obscured by restraint gear. He wears a black straitjacket with black restraints decorated with red spikes. Metal clamps cover his head, forcing his lips open. Additional straps cross his torso, waist, and boots. His shaven head bears a large cut on his left ear. Only his mouth remains exposed, revealing his weapon.
Backstory: A member of the League of Villains' Vanguard Action Squad, Moonfish joined primarily for access to hunting grounds. He serves as primary antagonist during the Forest Training Camp Arc, pursuing victims with single-minded determination. His violent nature leads to imprisonment in Tartarus.

cardPool.title: Monika Kaniyashiki
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Monika Kaniyashiki

Alias: Kaniko

Quirk Name: Snip Clip

Occupation/Role: Police Officer (Undercover)

Personality: Cheerful and goofy with humor that makes her easy to befriend. Despite her joking demeanor, she is intelligent and serious about her work. She willingly risks herself to protect others.

Appearance: A short, petite girl with a round face and semicircular orange-brown eyes. Her dull red hair is styled in two high crab-claw-shaped bunches with six tufts protruding from the sides. Split bangs frame each eye. When undercover, she wears a pinkish-red knee-length kimono over a black combat vest, pale green shorts, black 3/4 leggings, black fingerless gloves, geta sandals, and a yellow-black striped headband.

Backstory: A member of the Japanese Police Force who works undercover to investigate criminal activity. Her friendly demeanor makes her ideal for covert operations, as people rarely take her seriously. She has demonstrated sharp investigative skills in uncovering major criminal operations.

cardPool.title: Airjet
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Airjet, Buster Hero
Quirk Name: Air Blast
Occupation/Role: Pro Hero
Personality: Serious and dedicated, Airjet possesses an uncontrollable compulsion to apprehend villains. He is confident, respectful toward fellow heroes, and driven by a strong sense of justice.
Appearance: Airjet wears a crimson bodysuit with white armor plating on elbows, knees, and lower arms. He dons matching knee-high boots and a box-like helmet covering his entire face. A cannon mounted on his left arm and a twin-jet backpack define his silhouette.
Backstory: A veteran Pro Hero known for his participation in major heroic operations and inter-agency meetings. He has built a reputation for unwavering commitment to villain apprehension and is a recognized community presence.
Additional Information: His Quirk allows him to discharge powerful air blasts in combat. His signature Ultimate Move is Buster Shot. The jet pack enables sustained aerial flight and pursuit of airborne threats. His equipment design has influenced support heroes like Mei Hatsume.

cardPool.title: Alan Kay
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Alan Kay

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Unknown

Occupation/Role: Scientist/Researcher

Personality: Brave and determined despite captivity. Demonstrates unwavering conviction and willingness for self-sacrifice to stop Humarise's genocidal plans. Maintains moral principles even when threatened by terrorists.

Appearance: A disheveled adult man with dark brown hair and gray eyes. Wears an eye patch over his right eye with a scar underneath. Typically dressed in a white shirt, brown pants, and brown shoes. Shows physical and mental strain from captivity.

Backstory: Kidnapped by Humarise along with other scientists, Alan was forced to develop Trigger Bombs under threat of his family's execution. When colleague Eddie Soul created a deactivation key before being executed, Alan escaped with it. Disguised as a masked Humarise member, he attempted to deliver the key to authorities by car but was pursued and crashed on a highway by Humarise member Beros. The briefcase was lost and swapped with stolen jewelry.

Additional Information: Currently hospitalized in critical condition following the crash. Police guard him during recovery.

cardPool.title: Anan Kurose
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Anan Kurose

Alias: Space Hero: Thirteen

Quirk Name: Black Hole

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero and UA High School Faculty Member

Personality: Wise and well-mannered, passionate about rescue work and saving lives. Advocates for constructive Quirk use while acknowledging her own Quirk's lethal potential. Brave and selfless despite not being combat-oriented.

Appearance: Young woman with short navy blue hair and blonde spiral patch at the roots. Hazel irises ringed like black holes. Black substance coating her hands and forearms. Wears white puffy space suit-style jacket, black helmet with white eye markings, and yellow boots.

Backstory: Dedicated Pro Hero specializing in search and rescue. Developed the Unforeseen Simulation Joint facility to teach future heroes rescue tactics. Serves as faculty member at UA High School.

Additional Information: Uses specialized gloves with flippable fingertips to control Quirk output. Non-combat teacher who uses high-density weight handicaps during evaluations.

cardPool.title: Anna Scervino
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Anna Scervino

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Overmodification

Occupation/Role: Civilian (formerly imprisoned by the Gollini Family mafia)

Personality: Frightened and melancholic from trauma and Quirk-induced pain, but naturally joyful when given safety. Harbors deep PTSD from losing her family to the mafia and suffers from an aversion to violence. Capable of returning to optimism when freed from her burden.

Appearance: A young woman with waist-length light peach hair and blue eyes that darken when her Quirk activates. She wears a long-sleeved pink and white dress with a red bow on her chest and head, and a pink choker. Her delicate appearance contrasts with the dangerous power she harbored.

Backstory: Anna grew up isolated due to her dangerous Quirk that caused excruciating pain to incompatible individuals. Only her butler Giulio Gandini could safely remain near her with his Neutralization Quirk. After the Paranormal Liberation War, the Gollini Family mafia kidnapped and imprisoned her to exploit her power. She was rescued by Class 1-A students and Giulio, whose enhanced Neutralization permanently deactivated her Quirk.

cardPool.title: Bee☆Pop
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Kazuho Haneyama (possessed by Queen Bee parasitic Quirk)
Alias: Bee☆Pop
Quirk Name: Queen Bee
Occupation/Role: Villain/Performer (formerly Pop☆Step Vigilante)
Personality: Sadistic performer who stages destructive attacks as "shows," masking psychological instability. Obsessed with Koichi Haimawari, confusing love and hate. Cannot distinguish right from wrong. Uses Trigger drug to enhance abilities.
Appearance: Wears bee-themed Pop☆Step variant with honey stripes, bee wings, red heart belt buckles, and thick black eyeshadow and lipstick. Hair swept over left eye. Carries trigger canisters at belt. When on Trigger, skin darkens and tongue blackens.
Backstory: Originally a bee swarm from Kuin Hachisuka's control, cultivated by Number 6 for years before possessing Kazuho. The fusion drives obsession with Koichi and desire for a destructive finale.
Additional Information: Dangerous minor villain who destroyed multiple buildings. Registered threat requiring immediate intervention. Skilled singer who broadcasts performances through hacked feeds.

cardPool.title: Boomerang Villain
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Unknown

Alias:
Boomerang Villain

Quirk Name:
Boomerang

Occupation/Role:
Villain, escaped prisoner freed by All For One

Personality:
Hostile toward civilians, greedy, but cowardly when facing genuine resistance.

Appearance:
Bright orange messy hair, dark purple jacket with ripped sleeves and matching pants, white T-shirt, black tactical boots, black knee pads, grey arm guards with boomerangs attached, grey face mask.

Backstory:
A villain freed from prison by All For One who operates in criminal gangs, robbing civilians and shelters for supplies. His destructive tendencies make him a minor threat, though his cowardice limits his effectiveness.

Additional Information:
His Quirk allows him to throw purple-glowing boomerangs that detonate on command. Defeated by Class 1-A students during a robbery attempt and captured by Uravity. Associated with the Truck Jailbreaker and Bouncy Jailbreaker.

cardPool.title: Eel Boy
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Eel Boy
Quirk Name: Eel
Occupation/Role: Professional Hero
Personality: Brave, morally principled, and compassionate. He demonstrates strong conviction in protecting society and remains resolute when facing dangerous villains.
Appearance: Average build with a distinctive yellow bodysuit decorated with bold black lines, matching utility belt, and yellow boots with tan rims. Circular protrusions on his hands accommodate his Quirk. His mask features a torn-open mouth revealing jagged teeth.
Backstory: A dedicated hero within Japan's hero society who has earned public trust. He was assigned to high-stakes villain apprehensions, demonstrating his rank and reliability.
Additional Information: Eel Boy's Quirk generates giant eel-like appendages from his hands capable of attacking, restraining, and swallowing opponents. The eels possess enhanced sensory abilities to track targets.

cardPool.title: Fourth Kind
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown

Alias: Fourth Kind

Quirk Name: Quad Arms

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero

Personality: Strict disciplinarian who demands excellence from interns. Easily angered by minor infractions and quick to physically punish mistakes, yet hides gruff care beneath harsh methods. Believes community service is integral to heroism.

Appearance: Large, wide-set man with four muscular arms. Buzzed grayish-brown hair, small wide eyes without visible eyebrows, and heavy brow skin. Straight teeth and a stitched scar diagonally across his left eye. Wears a black four-sleeved suit, cyan tie with yellow diamonds, and gold rings on all fingers. Metal encases his jaw and neck.

Backstory: Earned his reputation as a chivalrous hero through rigorous professionalism and unwavering standards. Selected interns Eijiro Kirishima and Tetsutetsu Tetsutetsu after being impressed by their UA Sports Festival performance.

Additional Information: Skilled in close quarters combat using his four arms to devastating effect. Participated in the raid against the Paranormal Liberation Front at Gunga Mountain Villa and prisoner transport operations.

cardPool.title: Glutton God
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Glutton God
Quirk Name: Unnamed Slime Quirk
Occupation/Role: Villain and gang leader
Personality: A brutal bully who exploits chaos for personal gain. Enjoys looting and dominating through force, with an appetite matching his villain moniker.
Appearance: A large, obese man with a magenta Mohawk protruding through a dark mask covering his upper face. Wears dark overalls with kanji reading "Glutton God," heavy boots, and exudes imposing physical presence.
Backstory: Emerged as a gang leader during Japan's hero society crisis following the Paranormal Liberation War. With prisons emptied and heroes stretched thin, he raided shopping districts and terrorized civilians before being defeated by Best Jeanist.
Additional Information: His Slime Quirk generates dense yellow gelatinous substance from his arms capable of shattering wooden structures. He was apprehended by Best Jeanist's superior combat ability and Fiber Master Quirk.

cardPool.title: Gravitational Spring
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Gravitational Spring
Quirk Name: Unnamed Tether Quirk
Occupation/Role: Low-ranking villain, League of Villains recruit
Personality: Volatile and easily agitated; becomes aggressive when cornered or pressured.
Appearance: A skeletal man with spiky brown hair and extraordinarily long, thin arms. He wears a yellow sleeveless shirt with matching pants. Black material wraps his limbs with armor-like pieces on each arm. A white perforated mask and armor-plated kneecaps complete his eerie look.
Backstory: A minor villain recruited by Tomura Shigaraki for the League of Villains' assault on the Unforeseen Simulation Joint. He ambushed Class 1-A students before being apprehended.
Additional Information: His Quirk enables extreme arm extension for manipulating objects and distant attacks. Despite his gaunt build, he possesses surprising strength and can lift large boulders single-handedly. He was defeated during the USJ incident and arrested.

cardPool.title: Greedy Gaping Jaw
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Greedy Gaping Jaw
Quirk Name: Unnamed Laser Quirk
Occupation/Role: Low-ranking villain, League of Villains member
Personality: Overconfident in combat abilities despite limited strength; reckless and willing to assault U.A. High School.
Appearance: Obese villain with gray skin wearing a blue shirt, black pants, and brown boots. His head resembles a worm's mouth filled with sharp teeth.
Backstory: Recruited by Tomura Shigaraki as one of seventy low-ranking villains for the U.S.J. assault on U.A. High School's training facility.
Additional Information: Quickly defeated by Shota Aizawa during the invasion. His Quirk fires lasers from his mouth but has limited combat effectiveness.

cardPool.title: Lunch Rush
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Cook Hero: Lunch Rush
Quirk Name: Unknown
Occupation/Role: Pro Hero and U.A. High School cafeteria chef
Personality: Upbeat and enthusiastic, communicates primarily through thumbs-up gestures and nonverbal cues. Dedicated and supportive of students.
Appearance: Wears a white chef hat and cooking apron over casual attire, white gloves, and white shoes. A tube extends from his mouth to his back, and he wears a face mask that obscures his features. Medium build.
Backstory: An accomplished Pro Hero who dedicated himself to feeding U.A. students rather than traditional heroics. Six years prior, he single-handedly prepared full-course French meals for ten-thousand typhoon victims. Now serves as the primary chef for the entire student body.
Additional Information: Renowned for exceptional cuisine quality and variety. Assigned to support operations during critical missions. His Quirk remains unconfirmed.

cardPool.title: Master of the Waves
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Master of the Waves
Quirk Name: Unnamed Sea Animal Control Quirk
Occupation/Role: Villain
Personality: Aggressive and tyrannical, driven by resentment toward land society. Ruthless and opportunistic, exploiting sea creatures without regard for their welfare.
Appearance: A lean, muscular man whose head is replaced by a squid's body and tentacles. Fin-like appendages jut from his wrists, webbed hands and feet, pointed nose, and deeply sunken beady eyes. He wears only dark, skintight pants.
Backstory: An aquatic villain embittered when land society rejected his demands for obedience. He seized control of sea animals from Takoba Aquarium and attacked UA High School students investigating the disappearances.
Additional Information: His Quirk grants control over nearby sea life, including whales. He was defeated by Koji Koda and arrested after the students disrupted his animal control.

cardPool.title: Midnight Boys
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Midnight Boy (Member of Midnight Boys)
Quirk Name: Unknown
Occupation/Role: Sidekick under Pro Hero Midnight
Personality: Devoted and protective of Midnight with intense loyalty. Professional yet shows jealousy toward threats to her reputation.
Appearance: Attractive young man in sharp gray suit with white undershirt and black tie, identical to his three counterparts. Well-groomed and polished.
Backstory: One of four sidekicks employed by Pro Hero Midnight after she established her Hero Office. Works with three identical-looking teammates in hero operations across Japan.
Additional Information: Participates in criminal apprehension, emergency response, and public safety events. Follows Midnight's orders without hesitation and maintains professional standards.

cardPool.title: Near High-End Nomu
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Near High-End Nomu (Designation Unknown)
Alias: Flying Nomu, Near High-End Specimen
Quirk Name: Multiple (includes Wing, Burst, enhanced durability)
Occupation/Role: Villain; artificially created combat unit under All For One's command
Personality: Feral and animalistic upon awakening; gradually stabilize into obedient soldiers following orders without question
Appearance: Grotesque human-beast amalgamation with reinforced musculature; some possess functional wings; grey chitinous plating; 8-10 feet tall with distorted features
Backstory: Created as incomplete High-End Nomu by All For One and Tomura Shigaraki, dormant beneath Jaku General Hospital until radio waves reactivated them during the Paranormal Liberation War; deployed as living weapons to eliminate heroes
Additional Information: Expendable shock troops with multiple stolen Quirks grafted into their biology; lack individual regeneration, making them vulnerable to sustained damage; the Flying variant proved instrumental in All For One's assault on Tartarus and Star and Stripe operations before self-destructing as a tactical decoy

cardPool.title: Nine
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Nine
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Weather Manipulation
Occupation/Role: Villain
Personality: Frigid and callous, Nine is goal-oriented and dismissive of obstacles. He values strength above all else with a "might makes right" philosophy. Despite his ruthlessness, he respects those who demonstrate impressive capabilities and won't harm without provocation.
Appearance: A tall man with fair skin, thin rectangular gray eyes with white pupils, and shoulder-length white hair. He wears a form-fitting black bodysuit with armored plating outlined by dark violet grooves. Two glowing purple liquid canisters mount at his shoulders. A lilac blazer and dress pants overlay the suit, with a large mask-corset covering his chest to nose featuring nine gray plugs and a metal-bound muzzle-like lower face covering.
Backstory: Nine was experimented on by Kyudai Garaki, resulting in a specialized bodysuit designed to dampen and regulate his behavior. His Weather Manipulation Quirk grants control over skies and weather, but prolonged usage causes cellular degeneration. He believes superhuman society should be ruled by strength alone, free from Hero and Villain distinctions.

cardPool.title: Nomu
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown (Originally a Small-Time Thug)
Alias: Nomu
Quirk Name: Shock Absorption, Super Regeneration
Occupation/Role: Bio-engineered Super-Soldier for the League of Villains
Personality: Mindless and obedient; operates without higher brain function or independent will, requiring direct commands from superiors. Displays no emotion or resistance.
Appearance: A grotesquely modified humanoid creature with heavily muscled, pale flesh. Possesses an elongated head with visibly enlarged brain cavity. Body bears evidence of extreme surgical alterations with bulging muscles and unnatural gait. Eyes are vacant and unfocused.
Backstory: A deceased small-time thug whose corpse was stolen and subjected to radical bio-engineering by Doctor Kyudai Garaki. Reconstructed to hold multiple Quirks and become a weapon rivaling All Might. Deployed with Tomura Shigaraki during the U.S.J. assault.
Additional Information: Nomu are reanimated corpses with no free will, designed as mindless super-soldiers. This specimen was engineered with Shock Absorption and Super Regeneration to withstand tremendous punishment. Ultimately defeated by All Might through superior speed and arrested by Police Force.

cardPool.title: Sisters of Saint Lila's Academy
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown (Sisters of Saint Lila's Academy)
Alias: The Little Sisters
Quirk Name: Unknown
Occupation/Role: Student Performers at Saint Lila's Academy for Girls; Members of Marukane Performers
Personality: Innocent and enthusiastic young girls who readily ask adults for explanations. Devoted fans of Captain Celebrity who find joy in simple entertainment. Capable of genuine appreciation and emotional connection.
Appearance: Three identical-height girls with youthful physiques and luminescent blushes. Each has distinct hairstyles and subtle variations in face and hair color. They wear matching sailor fuku uniforms with flower-decorated berets.
Backstory: The trio performs as singers in the Marukane Performers troupe and gained prominence at the Naruhata Festival. They were promised a meeting with their idol Captain Celebrity and were thrilled when he arrived to save them from a villain attack.
Additional Information: The girls deeply admire Pro-Hero Captain Celebrity and appreciate kindness from others. They share a strong bond with Christopher Skyline, who protects them during dangerous situations. Their innocence and enthusiasm endear them to adult heroes and performers.

cardPool.title: Steel Bulwark
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Steel Bulwark
Quirk Name: Body Morph
Occupation/Role: Villain, League of Villains recruit
Personality: Brash and overconfident, prone to underestimating opponents. Charges recklessly into combat assuming invulnerability. Lacks strategic thinking and experience.
Appearance: A heavily muscular man with a rocky greyish-blue stone-like body and four total limbs, including two extra arms from his back. Wears a black mask with yellow angular lines, beige cargo pants, and black boots.
Backstory: Recruited by Tomura Shigaraki for the assault on the Unforeseen Simulation Joint. Attempted to overwhelm Eraser Head but was dodged and incapacitated with a single punch. Arrested but escaped during the Tartarus prison breaks orchestrated by All For One.
Additional Information: E-rank villain. His Body Morph Quirk provides superhuman strength and additional limbs but offers no protection against skilled combat or tactics. Participated in a heteromorphic mob riot at Central Hospital and was recaptured.

cardPool.title: Suicide Bomber
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Suicide Bomber
Quirk Name: Suicide Bomb
Occupation/Role: Villain
Personality: Mentally unstable and consumed by rage toward law enforcement. Willing to cause mass casualties. Cannot be reasoned with once committed to his destructive path.
Appearance: A massive man with a spherical black head resembling a cartoon bomb with a protruding fuse. Large eyes and gaping mouth occupy his face. "Suicide Bomber" is written across his forehead. His fingers resemble dynamite sticks. He wears a blue-collar worker outfit with an explosives-laden belt and bomb packages strapped across his chest.
Backstory: Driven to extremism by years of mistreatment from police officers. His hatred festered into suicidal rage, leading him to plan an attack on a police station with intent to detonate himself and kill everyone inside.
Additional Information: His Quirk allows self-detonation with destructive force capable of leveling buildings, though activation is fatal to himself. He was subdued at a police station by Midnight's Quirk after being intercepted by Eraser Head.

cardPool.title: Absorption and Release
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Absorption and Release

Description:
The user absorbs incoming emitter-type attacks and redirects them back at opponents with equal or greater force, turning enemy offense into counterattacks.

Functions/Applications:
Absorb fire, electricity, energy blasts, and similar projectiles; store absorbed energy briefly; release stored attacks in any direction; chain absorptions for increased output; reflect ranged threats back at their source.

Limits:
The user takes full damage from initial impact despite absorption. Only works on emitter-type attacks; physical strikes cannot be absorbed. Absorbed energy degrades over time if not released quickly. Overwhelming attacks may exceed storage capacity, causing internal damage.

Additional Notes:
Most effective against ranged, energy-focused opponents. Vulnerable to melee combatants who close distance quickly. Requires precise timing and positioning to redirect effectively. Weak against opponents who adapt their attack patterns.

cardPool.title: Assault Dust
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Assault Dust

Description:
The user generates and manipulates fine dust particles from their body, projecting them at high velocity as weapons or tools. The dust can be controlled mid-flight and shaped into various forms for offense or utility.

Functions/Applications:
Fire concentrated dust bursts at targets with considerable force. Dust clouds obscure vision, create diversions, or track movements. Dust can form barriers or protective screens with sufficient density.

Limits:
Effectiveness decreases in wet or humid environments. User must maintain line of sight to manipulate dust. Large-scale generation drains stamina quickly. Wind disperses dust unpredictably, reducing accuracy.

Additional Notes:
Best suited for ranged combat and tactical situations. Works poorly in enclosed spaces or against water-based opponents.

cardPool.title: Tetsu
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Tetsu
Alias: Tetsu the Tank
Quirk Name: Unnamed Armor Quirk
Occupation/Role: Yakuza Executive, Abegawa Tenchu Kai
Personality: Hot-tempered, enjoys drinking with fellow yakuza members. Easily infuriated by slights to his organization's honor, yet capable of camaraderie with peers.
Appearance: Middle-aged man with dark hair and full beard. Wears dark sunglasses, light-colored fancy jacket with matching pants, and a scarf. Athletic build.
Backstory: A ruthless yakuza member of the Abegawa Tenchu Kai who rose to executive rank through formidable combat abilities and Quirk mastery. Often found in bars debating organizational matters with fellow executives.
Additional Information: Tetsu's Quirk grants him control over metallic armor capable of firing powerful laser beams. He typically operates as part of a coordinated team with other yakuza executives, though their combined strength proved insufficient against the vigilante Stendhal.

cardPool.title: Navel Laser
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Navel Laser

Description:
A light-based offensive quirk that fires brilliant laser beams from the user's navel. The beams can pierce concrete and destroy metal at various ranges. Originally stolen and implanted by All For One, this quirk requires external support to function properly.

Functions/Applications:
Beams can be reshaped into blades or projectiles and manipulated in size. Strong recoil propels the user through the air for mobility. Intense brightness illuminates dark areas. With specialized equipment, beams can be fired from multiple body points. User can manipulate beam properties with precision.

Limits:
Without the Sparkle Belt, the quirk cannot be controlled or aimed properly. Continuous firing causes internal damage and overuse risks loss of bowel control. User can only naturally fire straight from the front, leaving rear exposure vulnerable. Constant energy leakage without equipment support. Extended activation causes stomach pain and leaves the user defenseless.

Additional Notes:
Training increases duration, frequency, and power output. The user has developed a flamboyant fighting style with this quirk.

cardPool.title: Big Red Dot
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown

Alias: Big Red Dot

Quirk Name: Tidal Bore

Occupation/Role: Number 1 Pro Hero of Singapore

Personality: Caring and loyal with strong justice ideals. Demonstrates leadership and composure under pressure.

Appearance: A well-built man with a lion's head and webbed feet. He wears a sleeveless light blue wetsuit with water-design belt, elbow-length arm guards, and shoulder pads bearing the Singaporean flag. A small domino mask completes his costume.

Backstory: Singapore's top-ranked hero and trusted ally of All Might. Has proven capability in coordinated multi-national operations against terrorist threats, including the Humarise organization.

Additional Information: Leads international hero task forces. His Quirk manipulates water with tremendous force, capable of lifting large objects to high altitudes. Maintains strong bonds with fellow heroes and eagerly aids allies in crisis.

cardPool.title: All For One
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Zen Shigaraki

Alias: All For One

Quirk Name: All For One

Occupation/Role: Founder and leader of the League of Villains; Japan's most powerful villain

Personality: Cold, calculating tyrant obsessed with world domination. Patient and manipulative, willing to orchestrate elaborate schemes across decades. Values power above all else.

Appearance: Towering, muscular man with severe scarring across his head and face from his battle with All Might. No visible nose, ears, or hair; faded white eyes barely discernible. Wears a dark formal suit with white collared shirt and dark navy skull-like gas mask with angular tubes and life-support collar system.

Backstory: Japan's most powerful villain and All Might's arch-nemesis, All For One sought to steal One For All from his younger twin brother. He founded the League of Villains and adopted Tomura Shigaraki as his successor, grooming him as a vessel for consciousness transfer. Imprisoned in Tartarus but escaped months later, determined to destroy Izuku Midoriya.

Additional Information: Blind from injuries; compensates with Infrared Quirk and vibration sensing. Possesses small holes in each palm to steal and transfer Quirks.

cardPool.title: Toshinori Yagi
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Toshinori Yagi

Alias:
All Might

Quirk Name:
One For All

Occupation/Role:
Foundational Hero Studies Teacher, UA High School

Personality:
Charismatic and heroic with unwavering justice. Burdened by his title as Symbol of Peace but dedicated to inspiring others through conviction and example.

Appearance:
In empowered form, imposingly muscular with chiseled features and strong jawline. Short blond hair swept back with two distinctive front tufts and deep blue eyes with shadowed sockets. Wears iconic blue bodysuit with red "Y" symbol, white diamond at center, white hip patches with red trim, yellow forearm sleeves, and yellow belt with silver buckle.

Backstory:
Eighth holder of One For All, inherited from Nana Shimura. Japan's No. 1 Pro Hero and world Symbol of Peace. Now teaches at UA High School while training successor Izuku Midoriya.

Additional Information:
Still active as hero and teacher during Class 1-A's first year. Shadowed eyes mark the toll of his battles, especially his first confrontation with All For One.

cardPool.title: Yo Shindo
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Yo Shindo

Alias:
Grand

Quirk Name:
Vibrate

Occupation/Role:
Third-year student at Ketsubutsu Academy High School

Personality:
Polite and friendly on the surface, but calculating beneath. Strategically lowers others' guards while remaining calm in chaos. Competitive yet willing to exploit weaknesses. His demeanor shifts when angered.

Appearance:
Tall and muscular with shaggy, dark brown hair sticking up in all directions. Warm brown, diamond-shaped eyes and frequent smile. Wears a gold jaw-guard, thick green shoulder straps, short black jacket with golden trimmings, black elbow pads, green wrist-guards, black baggy pants with green markings, and black boots.

Backstory:
A capable student and natural leader at Ketsubutsu Academy, Yo rose to prominence through strategic brilliance and Quirk mastery. He demonstrated his tactical prowess during the Provisional Hero License Exam by dividing UA Class 1-A students with coordinated earthquake attacks.

Additional Information:
Yo uses vibrations to generate earthquakes that disrupt formations and weaken opponents' footing. His strategic mind and composure in chaos make him effective in outnumbered scenarios.

cardPool.title: Energy Suck
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Energy Suck

Description:
By making physical contact and inhaling, the user absorbs vitality from others, gaining increased stamina, size, and strength while weakening the target. Normally requires direct contact to activate.

Functions/Applications:
Drain enemy stamina while boosting physical prowess. Absorb multiple targets in succession for compounded strength gains. Enhanced size provides combat advantages. When augmented by Trigger drug, the quirk activates at range through inhalation alone, bypassing contact requirements and functioning while unconscious.

Limits:
Requires physical contact for standard use, making it ineffective at range. Cannot absorb untouchable targets. Range enhancement only occurs under Trigger influence and is temporary. Overuse depletes targets and creates vulnerability when the drug wears off. Weakened targets can coordinate once enhancement fades.

Additional Notes:
Excels at turning prolonged battles through cumulative power increases but relies on close proximity and multiple opponents. Trigger drug transforms it into devastating area effect but creates dependency and crashes when effects end.

cardPool.title: Erasure Spot
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Erasure Spot

Description:
Paulo Gollini manifests a dome-shaped energy wave that deactivates all Quirks within its range. He can create a protective bubble inside where Quirks remain active. When boosted, the range expands to cover mountain ranges.

Functions/Applications:
Creates a nullification field stripping enemies of Quirk abilities. The inner bubble allows allies with non-Quirk skills to function while outside enemies remain powerless. Useful for disorienting opponents and controlling battlefield positioning.

Limits:
The dome nullifies Quirks indiscriminately, affecting allies outside the inner bubble. Fast opponents can bypass the field to reach the user. The strategy becomes predictable once support units are eliminated. The user cannot selectively disable only enemy Quirks.

Additional Notes:
Paulo relies on minions with non-Quirk combat abilities. The Quirk excels at area denial and crowd control but requires careful positioning and team coordination. Without allies or defensive support, Paulo lacks direct offense against Quirk-users who breach his defenses.

cardPool.title: En Tayutai
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
En Tayutai

Alias:
Smoke-Eater

Quirk Name:
Smokescreen

Occupation/Role:
Former Pro Hero, Sixth User of One For All

Personality:
Reserved but friendly with strong willpower. Generally composed, though emotions surface when others are in danger. Self-deprecating about his Quirk's weakness, yet warm when witnessing creative uses of his abilities.

Appearance:
A short man with short, dark hair parted away from narrow eyes. His hero costume features a large red jacket with straps and buttons, high collar obscuring his mouth and nose, dark baggy pants, large white hiking boots, and sports tape wrapped around his forearms.

Backstory:
En received One For All from Daigoro after the previous user fell to All For One. He resisted All For One's attempts to steal the Quirk twice, showing exceptional willpower. He founded a resistance movement with other heroes and ultimately sacrificed himself in combat while transferring One For All to the next user.

Additional Information:
As a One For All user, En possessed superhuman strength, speed, agility, and durability. His Smokescreen Quirk generated purple smoke to obscure vision.

cardPool.title: Ground Beta
cardPool.value:
Name: Ground Beta

Location: Urban training facility with interconnected streets and multi-story buildings for combat exercises.

Inhabitants: Security robots, instructors in basement monitoring rooms, student combatants during trials.

Appearance: Replica urban district with realistic street layouts and reinforced office buildings. Basement levels contain observation decks with screens and communication systems. Sturdy but functional architecture designed to withstand repeated combat training.

cardPool.title: Ground Gamma
cardPool.value:
Name:
Ground Gamma

Location:
An abandoned industrial complex with interconnected factories, machinery, cranes, pipelines, and metal structures creating multiple elevation levels and precarious pathways.

Inhabitants:
Pro Heroes conducting training exercises, students undergoing combat trials, and authority figures like Principal Nezu overseeing practical examinations.

Appearance:
A sprawling maze of rust-streaked factories and towering industrial equipment. Massive cranes loom overhead, pipelines crisscross at various heights, and metal catwalks offer unstable footing. The ground is littered with debris and fallen machinery. Vertical movement is heavily favored with treacherous narrow passages and crane-based traversal routes. The environment tests agility, endurance, and adaptability under pressure.

cardPool.title: Ground Omega
cardPool.value:
Name:
Ground Omega

Location:
A vast walled training grounds with a single omega-marked entrance, containing dense woods and rocky hills. An observation post building stands adjacent to monitor activities.

Inhabitants:
Teachers including Shota Aizawa and All Might supervise training exercises. Student groups from multiple academies use the grounds for survival drills and joint practice sessions.

Appearance:
A sprawling forest landscape with rocky outcroppings and uneven terrain for combat training. The perimeter is secured by a stone wall with a single guarded entrance. The observation post offers commanding views of the entire grounds.

cardPool.title: Beams From His Eyes
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Beams From His Eyes

Description:
A Quirk that allows the user to fire concentrated laser beams from their eyes. The intensity and size of the blast scales with the user's focus and concentration. Activation requires a specialized visor with a switch.

Functions/Applications:
Fire beams at targets within line of sight by activating the visor switch. Concentrate to channel larger, more powerful blasts for significant damage. Useful for ranged combat and precision targeting.

Limits:
Requires manual activation via visor switch. Each blast demands direct line of sight on the target. Larger blasts require sustained concentration, leaving the user vulnerable during charging. Overuse may cause eye strain or fatigue.

Additional Notes:
The visor switch suggests this Quirk has uncontrolled firing potential without safeguards. Loss or damage to the visor would severely compromise combat effectiveness. Works best in open environments with clear sightlines.

cardPool.title: Air Walk
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Air Walk

Description:
The user can stand on and manipulate air, creating invisible platforms for levitation and mid-air movement. This stolen quirk grants freedom of vertical mobility without physical support.

Functions/Applications:
Users can float upward, walk on invisible air platforms, and hover at varying heights. This enables superior positioning for ranged attacks and evasion across terrain. The quirk pairs well with ranged abilities for elevated vantage points.

Limits:
The user must maintain active focus to keep platforms stable; loss of concentration causes falling. The quirk cannot support movement while unconscious or severely incapacitated. Sustained flight exhausts stamina over time.

Additional Notes:
Air Walk is a stolen quirk, suggesting it may be removable or transferable. Its advantage lies in vertical positioning rather than raw offensive power, making it best suited for tactical support, reconnaissance, and ranged combat.

cardPool.title: Air Cannon
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Air Cannon

Description:
A powerful ranged Quirk releasing devastating shockwaves of compressed air from the palms. Blast form varies based on arm motion—from concentrated linear shots to crescent-shaped air blades. Versatile for offense and defense.

Functions/Applications:
Primary ranged attack capable of destroying buildings and overwhelming multiple opponents. Can form barriers to block incoming attacks. Combines with other Quirks to amplify destructive power. Useful for initiating combat and wearing down enemies at range.

Limits:
Requires hand positioning and arm motion—interrupting mid-attack prevents discharge. Raw power mitigated by strong defensive abilities. Less effective against mobile or shielded targets. Each blast requires brief preparation, leaving user momentarily vulnerable if repeated rapidly.

Additional Notes:
Originally stolen by All For One; inherited by Tomura Shigaraki upon receiving All For One's collection Quirk. Becomes exponentially more dangerous when augmented by power-boosting Quirks. Most effective as opening move to establish dominance and control battlefield distance.

cardPool.title: Air Wall
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Air Wall

Description:
The user generates circular shields of densely compressed air from their hands to defend against incoming attacks. These barriers can be layered for enhanced protection or expanded into a protective dome. Their durability fluctuates based on the user's focus and physical condition.

Functions/Applications:
Create defensive barriers in any direction the user raises their hand. Stack multiple shields for cumulative defense. Expand into a full-body dome against multi-directional threats. Fire compressed air bursts as offensive blasts.

Limits:
Shields only manifest where the user directs their hand—agile foes can circle around unprotected areas. Durability degrades when physically weakened, injured, or mentally unfocused. Cannot protect unanticipated areas. Sustained or layered barriers drain stamina over time.

Additional Notes:
Air Wall's true name remains unknown. The quirk was stolen from an unnamed hero. Enhanced by quirk-amplifying drugs, the user can generate larger, rectangular barriers.

cardPool.title: Big Horn
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Big Horn

Description:
The user manifests a pair of large, bull-like horns from their head. These horns are physical extensions of the user's body and can be severed, though this is irreversible. The horns serve as a distinctive physical trait rather than a primary combat tool.

Functions/Applications:
The horns can be used for charging attacks or melee combat. Severing a horn is rumored to improve communication or perception abilities. The horns mark the user as distinctive and may carry social significance.

Limits:
Horns cannot be regrown once removed. The user cannot fully control horn growth or retraction. Severing a horn causes permanent disfigurement and may alter the quirk's effectiveness.

Additional Notes:
Big Horn is a simple, appearance-based quirk with limited versatility. Users must carefully consider any permanent modification to their horns, as the decision is irreversible.

cardPool.title: Big Fist
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Big Fist

Description:
Itsuka enlarges one or both hands to three times her body size with instant activation. Physical strength scales proportionally, granting immense crushing and striking power without affecting movement or balance.

Functions/Applications:
Close-range combat with devastating striking force capable of shattering tungsten defenses. Enlarged hands serve as restraint tools, transport vessels for allies, and protective barriers. Fist-flapping disperses gas traps and airborne threats.

Limits:
Short-range only with no ranged application. Enlarged hands obstruct vision and fine manipulation. Cannot be maintained indefinitely. Wind generation is limited in power and range. Large size eliminates surprise against aware opponents.

Additional Notes:
Optimal for rescue missions, restraint operations, and defense-breaking. Versatile utility quirk combining offense, defense, and support. Strength scaling prevents user fatigue from enlarged limb weight.

cardPool.title: Blade-Tooth
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Blade-Tooth

Description:
The user can enlarge, reshape, and manipulate their teeth into sharpened, blade-like incisors of varying sizes and lengths. These dental weapons can be fired or extended at will with incredible speed and range, functioning as both melee and ranged attacks.

Functions/Applications:
Deploy torrents of tooth blades to barrage enemies. Use elongated teeth as projectiles or stabbing weapons at distance. Employ teeth as extra limbs for mobility and climbing. Reshape teeth to suit tactical needs—piercing points for penetration or broader blades for cutting.

Limits:
Teeth can be shattered under sufficient blunt force. Extended dental blades require stamina to maintain and repeatedly generate. Physical restraints limit but do not fully prevent Quirk use. Opponents with hardened defenses can resist or redirect tooth attacks if fast enough.

Additional Notes:
Mastery is achieved through constant offensive pressure and creative mobility exploitation. The Quirk excels in sustained barrages rather than single devastating strikes. Users gain advantage in unprepared or confined combat scenarios due to versatility of tooth manipulation.

cardPool.title: Blazing Hair
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Blazing Hair

Description:
The user's hair burns with controllable flames that can be shaped and weaponized at will. The fire originates from and remains anchored to the user's head, allowing dynamic combat applications and enhanced mobility through aerial propulsion.

Functions/Applications:
Detach flaming hair strands as projectiles. Reshape flames into melee weapons. Generate thrust for flight and increased speed. Combine applications for complex aerial maneuvers and ranged-melee hybrid attacks.

Limits:
Sustained combat depletes hair and flame reserves. Flight requires active concentration. Flames cannot extend far from the body or persist independently. Water-based counters and close-range overwhelming defense can extinguish flames.

Additional Notes:
Most effective at range and aerial advantage. Hair attacks telegraph slightly, requiring tactical timing. Synergizes with speed-focused combat styles.

cardPool.title: Body Bulk
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Body Bulk

Description:
A transformation quirk that expands and densifies the user's body, increasing muscle mass, size, and strength. Activates most powerfully during intense negative emotions like rage, hatred, or fear.

Functions/Applications:
Enhanced physical strength for combat and lifting; increased durability from thickened muscle tissue; emotional triggers amplify transformation for temporary power surges. User can control the degree of bulk from partial to full transformation.

Limits:
Requires emotional intensity for peak effectiveness; prolonged use causes fatigue and muscle soreness; increased mass reduces speed and agility. Control becomes difficult during extreme emotional states, potentially causing recklessness.

Additional Notes:
Originally stolen by All For One and gifted to the user. The quirk's reliance on negative emotions makes strategic use difficult in situations requiring calm judgment. Best suited for direct confrontation rather than finesse-based combat.

cardPool.title: Cell Activation
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Cell Activation

Description:
A touch-based Quirk that stimulates cellular activity to accelerate healing, speed recovery, and temporarily enhance physical performance. Effects are immediate upon contact but drain the user's stamina with continued use.

Functions/Applications:
Rapidly heal wounds by accelerating tissue regeneration. Speed up recovery and reduce fatigue in allies. Temporarily boost physical performance and strength in oneself or others. Useful in combat support or medical emergencies.

Limits:
Incompatible with certain blood types; most variants only work on specific blood groups (Type A, O, and B documented). Cannot be used on incompatible blood types. Drains user stamina significantly with prolonged activation, causing fatigue if overused. Extended sessions require recovery time before reliable reactivation.

Additional Notes:
Different versions exist with varying blood-type compatibility. Requires direct physical contact; cannot be used remotely. Effects are temporary enhancements requiring repeated usage for sustained benefits.

cardPool.title: Dark Shadow
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Dark Shadow

Description:
A sentient, shadowy entity manifesting from the user's body as a loyal guardian. It remains tethered through an umbilical connection and communicates telepathically. Dark Shadow is composed of solid dark energy capable of limited shapeshifting and limb extension.

Functions/Applications:
Dark Shadow serves as offensive weapon and defensive shield, stretching to grapple enemies while the user maintains distance. It provides mobility support, climbing aid, and simulated flight when trained. In darkness, it becomes a large, ferocious beast capable of devastating physical attacks.

Limits:
Dark energy depletes with extended distance from host, rapid impacts, or overuse. Light exposure weakens it significantly, rendering it docile and small. In darkness, Dark Shadow may defy commands if the host's negative emotions intensify, potentially forcing the user's body to act against their will. The host and entity cannot share sensations, so one being incapacitated doesn't affect the other.

cardPool.title: Diesel Engine
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Diesel Engine

Description:
The user's head and upper body transform into a powerful diesel locomotive, granting enhanced speed and locomotive-like capabilities beyond normal human limits.

Functions/Applications:
Accelerated running speed for pursuit and evasion. Enables forceful charging attacks. Hardened metal construction provides defensive plating against impacts.

Limits:
Transformation limited to head and upper body; lower body remains human, creating balance issues. Heavy and cumbersome form reduces agility and turning speed. Requires fuel or energy consumption to maintain performance. Ineffective in tight spaces.

Additional Notes:
Creates distinctive silhouette that sacrifices stealth for raw power. Most effective in open terrain. User requires practice to manage weight distribution between transformed and untransformed body parts.

cardPool.title: Electric Charge
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Electric Charge

Description:
A Quirk that grants the ability to harvest, store, and manipulate electrical currents from the environment. The user can channel electricity for offensive attacks, defensive maneuvers, and signal disruption. Tesla demonstrates natural immunity to external electrical-based Quirks due to constant electrical saturation within his body.

Functions/Applications:
Electric attacks that deal direct damage; jamming electronic systems and wireless signals; creating electrical barriers for defense; powering mechanical devices; neutralizing opponent electricity Quirks through immunity.

Limits:
Requires continuous access to electrical sources to maintain efficiency—prolonged use without recharging depletes effectiveness. Cannot generate electricity independently; relies on harvesting existing currents. Overuse risks circuit burnout in the nervous system. Insulated or isolated environments severely hinder the Quirk's utility.

Additional Notes:
The Quirk's strength depends on environmental electrical availability, making it situational in combat.

cardPool.title: Electrification
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Electrification

Description:
Denki stores electrical energy and discharges it as a protective aura that shocks on contact. Higher outputs create omnidirectional bursts. He can absorb incoming electrical attacks and power electronics.

Functions/Applications:
Close-range electroshock defense that paralyzes on contact. Area discharge when sufficient power releases. Absorbs enemy electrical attacks. Energizes devices. Equipment allows directing electricity through projectiles.

Limits:
Ineffective at range without equipment. Lacks directional control, risking friendly fire. Exceeding wattage capacity causes complete brain short-circuit for one hour. Insulation and non-conductive Quirks negate effectiveness. Panic triggers uncontrolled discharge. Restraint limits combat potential.

Additional Notes:
Denki restrains himself in group combat to prevent harming teammates. Battery training improved his maximum output. Non-conductive Quirks present tactical challenges.

cardPool.title: Energy Saver
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Energy Saver

Description:
The user's body operates with exceptional metabolic efficiency, requiring minimal nutrition, hydration, and sleep to function while maintaining peak physical performance for extended periods.

Functions/Applications:
Sustain continuous high-intensity activity for 48+ hours without rest. Resume full functionality after only 3 hours of sleep. Survive on drastically reduced food and water intake while maintaining strength and endurance.
