Limits:
The user still requires some nutrition, hydration, and sleep—complete deprivation will eventually cause failure. Does not enhance actual physical power, only sustainability. Mental fatigue may still accumulate despite physical resilience.

Additional Notes:
Energy Saver is a support Quirk best paired with high-endurance or strength-based abilities. Users become formidable through attrition, outlasting opponents through persistence.

cardPool.title: Fast Fist
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Fast Fist

Description:
The user's hands and arms move at supernatural speed, striking up to 100 times in less than a second. Strikes appear as a blur to observers. Precision pressure point strikes can render targets unconscious.

Functions/Applications:
Rapid hand combat providing overwhelming offense through strike frequency. Pressure point targeting enables knockout incapacitation without lethal force. Speed creates openings against slower opponents and allows defensive blocking.

Limits:
Confined to hands and arms only. User must move their body normally, limiting pursuit. Requires precision targeting for knockout effect. Fatigue limits sustained use.

Additional Notes:
Most effective against unarmored targets. Close-range Quirk with minimal distance utility. Control is difficult with accidental injury risk. User relies on conventional movement for positioning.

cardPool.title: Physical Enhancement
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Physical Enhancement

Description:
A transformation Quirk that envelops the user's body in a vibrant green flame-like aura, dramatically amplifying physical capabilities including strength, speed, and durability. The user becomes a powerful close-combat fighter.

Functions/Applications:
Activate the aura to boost muscle power and reflexes for enhanced striking force and mobility. The green flame provides offensive striking power and defensive durability. Effective against multiple enemies through physical dominance.

Limits:
Requires conscious activation and sustained focus to maintain. Duration and intensity are limited, causing stamina depletion with extended use. Offers no special mobility, flight, or ranged capabilities. Powerful foes may still overwhelm the user.

Additional Notes:
This Quirk was wielded by a Pro Hero who fell against High-End Nomus. The green flame aura makes the user highly visible, eliminating stealth advantages. Best suited for direct confrontation rather than tactical engagements.

cardPool.title: Rivet Stab
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Rivet Stab

Description:
The user generates black tendrils marked with red cracked lines from their fingers, spine, palms, or other body parts. These tendrils are sharp, piercing weapons capable of impaling flesh and slicing through buildings.

Functions/Applications:
Tendrils can be launched individually or spread into mesh-like webs for area attacks. They regenerate and can be deployed repeatedly. The user controls whether tendrils cause harm or simply make contact. Advanced users combine Rivet Stab with other Quirks—using tendrils as conduits to activate distant targets' abilities, or fusing them with mouth-based Quirks to create composite weapons.

Limits:
Tendrils can be destroyed through sufficient force. The Quirk requires the user's concentration to target accurately. Extended mesh deployments consume stamina, making them resource-intensive for prolonged combat.

Additional Notes:
This Quirk excels at both precision strikes and large-scale devastation. Its versatility increases when combined with complementary abilities. Non-lethal control makes it useful for subdual or interrogation.

cardPool.title: Self-Detonation
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Self-Detonation

Description:
The user's body accumulates explosive energy, causing targeted body parts to swell and glow before detonating. Explosion force scales with the user's size and modifications. Most users perish or suffer severe mutilation unless enhanced with regeneration.

Functions/Applications:
Generate devastating area-of-effect explosions by concentrating energy in specific limbs. Concentrate detonative power into strikes for explosive melee attacks. With regeneration, repeatedly perform explosive attacks without permanent injury. Can be remotely triggered through external devices for controlled demolition or suicide missions.

Limits:
Unmodified detonation results in death or permanent mutilation. Smaller users generate reduced blast radius and damage. Requires external activation for automatons; varies by individual otherwise. Cannot be partially contained—explosion occurs fully once initiated. Regeneration Quirk necessary for sustained combat use.

Additional Notes:
Used by bioengineered warriors and specialized operatives. Most effective as kamikaze weapon or desperation tactic. Synergizes with Regeneration and Overclock Quirks.

cardPool.title: Shock Absorption
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Shock Absorption

Description:
The user absorbs kinetic energy and impact force from physical blows, reducing damage taken from strikes and collisions. This allows them to withstand significant punishment, though it cannot nullify attacks—only diminish them.

Functions/Applications:
Reduces incoming physical damage by dispersing shock waves throughout the body. Effective against melee attacks, falls, and explosive force. Grants exceptional durability in direct combat against powerful opponents.

Limits:
The Quirk has a cumulative threshold; continuous attacks will eventually overwhelm its capacity. Gradual, sustained damage bypasses effectiveness more efficiently than single powerful blows. Cannot absorb energy-based attacks or non-impact damage. Only reduces harm rather than eliminating it entirely.

Additional Notes:
Best countered by overwhelming force exceeding absorption capacity or persistent, incremental damage. Specifically designed to neutralize raw physical power but fails against creative attack strategies that don't rely on immediate impact shock.

cardPool.title: Slide and Glide
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Slide and Glide

Description:
Projects repulsive (blue) and attractive (green) force from hands and feet. User can propel across surfaces at high speed, cling to vertical surfaces, launch energy blasts, and achieve limited flight through momentum boosts. Mastery allows full-body force coating for protection and mobility.

Functions/Applications:
Slide rapidly across ground and walls; climb vertical surfaces by attraction; fire repulsion beams from close-range to piercing projectiles; perform mid-air jumps for altitude and flight; project protective force fields for damage mitigation and light levitation.

Limits:
No built-in braking—user must reverse acceleration to stop, risking collision. Repulsion beams can cause lethal damage. Multiple mid-air jumps require significant willpower; most users believe limited to two jumps. User takes damage from their own Quirk if struck directly.

Additional Notes:
Initially required three-point contact; improves with training and confidence. Deadly potential requires moral restraint. Reclassifies as "Flight" upon mastery. Synergizes with acrobatic or precision combat styles.

cardPool.title: Tank Engine
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Tank Engine

Description:
The user's head and upper body transform into a functional steam locomotive. This grants superhuman strength and durability while maintaining consciousness and control. The transformation is permanent and always active.

Functions/Applications:
The user generates locomotive power for ramming attacks and unstoppable momentum. The metal chassis provides enhanced defense. Steam pressure can be vented for propulsion boosts or defensive bursts. Heavy weight allows breaking through obstacles.

Limits:
Transformation severely restricts mobility and agility. Overheating causes exhaustion. Water sources become critical for sustained use. High center of gravity makes the user vulnerable to toppling. Mechanical joints can jam or corrode without maintenance.

Additional Notes:
The Quirk suits direct powerful assaults rather than tactical combat. Users gain advantage in prolonged confrontations relying on raw force. Environmental factors directly impact effectiveness.

cardPool.title: Tool Arms
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Tool Arms

Description:
The user manifests and retracts limbs embedded with functional tools and weapons like chainsaws, hammers, and drills. These organic components grow from the body, making them difficult to disarm.

Functions/Applications:
Transform arms into melee weapons for combat. Use specialized tools for environmental destruction or tactical advantage. Retract limbs instantly for defensive repositioning or concealment.

Limits:
Manifested tool limbs reduce mobility and dexterity. Tool selection limited to previously manifested types. Rapid transformation causes fatigue with extended use.

Additional Notes:
Excels in direct combat but sacrifices precision handling. The grotesque appearance may intimidate opponents. Works best against singular targets or in confined spaces.

cardPool.title: Fiber Master
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Fiber Master

Description:
Telekinetic control over all types of fiber and fabric. The user can manipulate threads, cloth, and synthetic materials with precision, constraining enemies through their clothing or unraveling garments into controllable strands. Denim is easiest to control; sweats are most difficult.

Functions/Applications:
Restrain or immobilize targets by controlling their clothing. Unravel fabric into whip-like strings for offense or defense. Redirect allies' movements by manipulating garments. Requires concentration and available fabric sources.

Limits:
Naked or fiber-free targets cannot be controlled. Strong-willed foes can resist. User loses control if distracted. Effectiveness depends on quantity and type of available fabric. Among the few Quirks deemed too difficult for All For One to steal.

Additional Notes:
Ideal users wear denim-heavy costumes for constant fiber availability in combat. Synergizes with high intelligence and tactical awareness for multi-target control.

cardPool.title: Half-Cold Half-Hot
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Half-Cold Half-Hot

Description:
The user generates ice and frost from their right side and fire and flames from their left side. Both elements originate internally and cannot be manipulated from external sources. The power is perfectly balanced between both halves. Advanced mastery allows combining both elements into "cold fire" that simultaneously burns and freezes.

Functions/Applications:
Ice side: Freeze structures, create barriers, form platforms, generate mobility waves, precision attacks, ground skating. Fire side: Generate intense heat and flames, propel forward, regulate warmth. Combined technique: Merge both elements for enhanced attacks with immunity to extreme temperatures.

Limits:
Overuse of either side without alternating causes fatal frostbite or overheating. Maximum output depletes reserves immediately. Prolonged ice usage reduces body temperature dangerously. The user instinctively favors their ice side, creating predictability. Elements cannot be manipulated once generated externally—only created from the body itself.

Additional Notes:
The quirk stems from genetic fusion of Hellflame and Frost abilities.

cardPool.title: Masaru Bakugo
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Masaru Bakugo

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Not specified (presumed Quirkless or minor Quirk)

Occupation/Role: Fashion designer; father of UA High School student Katsuki Bakugo

Personality: Calm and composed, serving as the voice of reason in his volatile family. Loving and supportive, though often unsettled by conflict. Disapproves of his son's arrogance despite acknowledging his abilities.

Appearance: Middle-aged man of average height with short brown hair, rectangular glasses, and a short mustache. Dresses in casual professional attire.

Backstory: Once dreamed of becoming a Pro Hero but pursued fashion design instead. Met his wife Mitsuki at work and they married. Fathered Katsuki and has spent years balancing his son's gifted but arrogant nature with parental guidance.

Additional Information: Entrusts Katsuki's education to UA High School, believing the institution can properly guide him. Represents the stabilizing parental influence in Katsuki's life, contrasting with his wife's volatile personality.

cardPool.title: Mitsuki Bakugo
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Mitsuki Bakugo

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Glycerin

Occupation/Role: Housewife; Mother of UA Class 1-A student Katsuki Bakugo

Personality: Assertive and aggressive like her son, but capable of composure and politeness. Recognizes Katsuki's arrogance stems from his talent and childhood praise; disapproves of it and disciplines him occasionally. Supportive of his hero aspirations and respectful toward UA staff.

Appearance: Spiky ash-blonde hair and sharp red eyes, maintained youthful by her Quirk despite being in her late thirties. Typically wears a white blouse under a lavender cardigan, black skirt, and reddish-purple house slippers. Refined and put-together.

Backstory: Wife to Masaru Bakugo and mother to talented but arrogant Katsuki. She recognizes his exceptional abilities have cultivated his worst traits through constant praise. Now that Katsuki attends UA High School, she remains invested in his development as a hero.

Additional Information: Not a UA student or Pro Hero, but integral to Katsuki's character development. Her Glycerin Quirk maintains her skin through natural moisturizing secretion.

cardPool.title: Bakugo House
cardPool.value:
Name: Bakugo House

Location: A prosperous residential district in an urban settlement behind a protective stone wall.

Inhabitants: The Bakugo family—merchants or nobility who value learning and refinement. The master of the house commands respect.

Appearance: A large, well-maintained detached mansion with sturdy construction and elegant design. The front features a manicured garden and defensive wall with ornamental window. The interior has a spacious living room with floor-to-ceiling bookshelves of leather-bound volumes, fine furnishings, and polished wood, exuding wealth and intellectual pursuits.

cardPool.title: Brightman Air Force Base
cardPool.value:
Name: Brightman Air Force Base

Location: Military installation serving as a primary deployment hub for fighter aircraft operations and hero training.

Inhabitants: Military personnel, pilot trainees, combat officers, and the hero Star and Stripe who uses the base as her operational headquarters.

Appearance: A sprawling airfield with concrete runways and hangars housing X-66 fighter jets. Steel-reinforced facilities include barracks, command centers, and training grounds. Chain-link fences and guard posts secure the perimeter; the sky frequently fills with jet engine roars and aircraft formations.

cardPool.title: Wooden Swords From His Hands
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name: Wooden Swords From His Hands

Description: The user manifests solid wooden swords from their wrists on demand. The swords are durable, fully formed weapons suitable for combat and can be generated repeatedly without apparent limit.

Functions/Applications: Create wooden swords for melee combat, dual-wield multiple swords simultaneously, generate weapons quickly in surprise encounters, or equip allies with melee weapons. The wooden construction makes them safer for sparring.

Limits: Swords are wooden rather than metal, reducing cutting power and durability against hardened materials. Generation requires conscious effort from the wrists, limiting use if those limbs are restrained or injured. The swords cannot be customized beyond basic form.

Additional Notes: This Quirk prioritizes rapid weapon deployment over destructive power, making it tactically flexible but dependent on wielder skill. Best suited for close-quarters fighters with strong swordsmanship training.

cardPool.title: Quirk Bestowal
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Quirk Bestowal

Description:
A transfer-based Quirk with no combat function. The user can pass their Quirk to another through DNA contact (hair, blood, saliva). Transfer requires the user's consent but not the recipient's. Immune to theft and cannot be stolen by All For One.

Functions/Applications:
Grants voluntary transfer of the Quirk and absorbed Quirks to a successor through biological material. Transfer can be selective. Hostile transfer can weaponize the process against the recipient.

Limits:
No offensive or defensive capabilities. Manifested late and remained undetectable due to weakness. Cannot be forced upon unwilling user. Requires direct physical contact. Recipient must handle transferred power or suffer rejection.

Additional Notes:
Assimilates with other Quirks, growing stronger through combination. Original user's will can persist as spiritual remnants. Cannot be sensed or stolen by All For One.

cardPool.title: Quirk Singularity
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Quirk Singularity (Theoretical Concept)

Description:
A postulated phenomenon where Quirks grow exponentially stronger and more complex across generations through genetic blending. Human bodies cannot evolve quickly enough to control these increasingly powerful abilities, eventually reaching critical instability where Quirks become uncontrollable and dangerous.

Functions/Applications:
Users can recognize signs of Quirk evolution in themselves or others through enhanced power, ability mutation, or involuntary manifestations. Those aware of the theory may attempt to manage or suppress their evolving Quirk before critical instability, or weaponize the knowledge to justify control of society.

Limits:
Not a combat Quirk but a framework for understanding ability growth. Cannot be actively used in battle. The theory remains controversial and unproven to most. Only those with multiple powerful Quirks or rapidly mutating abilities directly experience its effects. Control becomes impossible once evolution surpasses the user's physical and mental capacity.

Additional Notes:
Characters with combat-oriented or absorptive Quirks are most vulnerable to Singularity effects.

cardPool.title: Quirkless
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Quirkless

Description:
A complete absence of superhuman abilities or meta-powers. Quirkless individuals are born without superpowers in a world where 80% of humans possess them, making them genetic outliers and social minorities.

Functions/Applications:
Immunity to Quirk-targeted attacks including Trigger Bombs, Erasure-type Quirks, and Quirk Factor manipulation. Unaffected by Quirk Singularity phenomena. Can pursue non-hero careers without disadvantage. Cannot be classified as villains since villainy requires Quirk use.

Limits:
Vulnerable to all conventional physical threats and weapons. Prohibited from most hero work. Subject to severe social discrimination. Immunities are negated if a Quirk Factor is ever acquired. Cannot legally become a Pro Hero in most societies.

Additional Notes:
Increasingly rare trait with recessive genetic inheritance. The only advantage against a Quirk-dependent population. Some Quirkless individuals maintain positive relationships despite discrimination, while others face mockery based on perceived weakness.

cardPool.title: Humarise
cardPool.value:
[Humarise]

Type: Extremist Cult Organization

Humarise was a global cult-like organization led by Flect Turn, originating from Otheon. The group based its ideology on the Quirk Singularity Doomsday Theory — the belief that Quirks will evolve until they become uncontrollable and destroy humanity.

Members viewed Quirks as a disease threatening mankind. People with Quirks were labeled "infected" or "diseased," while Quirkless individuals were regarded as "pure humans." Believing themselves humanity's saviors, Humarise dedicated itself to eradicating Quirks by any means necessary.

Operating across multiple countries through hidden cells and loyal followers, Humarise became a dangerous extremist movement feared for its fanaticism, secrecy, and willingness to commit mass destruction.

cardPool.title: Fa Jin
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Fa Jin

Description:
Fa Jin allows the user to accumulate kinetic energy through repetitive movements, manifesting as red glowing energy. When released, this stored energy grants explosive bursts of speed and power applicable through any body part. Partial amounts can be deployed for sequential bursts rather than expending everything at once.

Functions/Applications:
Fa Jin amplifies physical strikes and movement speed upon release. It synergizes with other Quirks—enhancing Blackwhip for restraints, boosting Float for increased flight speed, and combining with Gearshift for devastating acceleration. Stored kinetic energy stacks with other power sources for composite attacks without proportional bodily strain.

Limits:
Building kinetic energy requires significant time and repetitive motion—premature release reduces power output. The Quirk demands sustained setup phases, making it vulnerable to interruption. Synergy with other Quirks increases complexity and depends on managing multiple Quirk interactions.

Additional Notes:
Fa Jin's power scales dramatically when combined with high-tier Quirks or energy reserves.

cardPool.title: Yu
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Yu

Alias: Member of Feathers idol duo

Quirk Name: Unknown

Occupation/Role: Underground idol performer, student at East Naruhata High School

Personality: Kind and sensitive, contrasting with her twin sister Miu. Yu gently moderates Miu's gossip and offensive remarks while maintaining genuine empathy.

Appearance: Short stature with straight, shoulder-length light hair in a high right-side ponytail and left-swept bangs. Dark, softly tilted eyes. Her idol costume mirrors Miu's but inverted—darker bodice, paler skirt, with feather accents. She wears knee-length sleeveless dresses, tights, and long gloves. With FeatherHATS, she adds a small top hat with feather detail.

Backstory: Yu performs in Feathers with her twin sister Miu. They performed at the Marukane Department Store Live Event and later joined FeatherHATS alongside Pop☆Step, East Naruhata High Dance Squad, and the Mad Hatters.

Additional Information: Yu possesses exceptional singing talent that surpasses Pop☆Step's vocal ability. Her kind nature serves as an emotional anchor to Miu's sharper personality, creating dynamic balance in their partnership.

cardPool.title: Lizard Tail Splitter
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Lizard Tail Splitter

Description:
The user can detach and telekinetically control multiple body segments simultaneously. Each piece floats independently at high speed. Vital organ segments (eyes, brain, mouth, heart) remain fully functional when separated, enabling remote sensory input and organ operation.

Functions/Applications:
Multi-angle reconnaissance using eye segments. Distributed melee attacks with numerous fast-moving pieces. Long-range harassment through hard-to-hit projectiles. Organ-based spying via detached jaw or eyes. Evasion through body dispersal.

Limits:
Separated segments have limited function duration. Maximum 50 pieces depending on segment length. Exhausted regeneration forces physical regrouping, exposing user location. Individual segments are weak and vulnerable to destruction. Controlling many pieces requires intense focus.

Additional Notes:
Distributed state creates strategic vulnerability; enemies can track position by locating regrouping segments. Small piece size and speed aid evasion but limit offensive power per segment. Optimal use combines reconnaissance with coordinated multi-directional attacks.

cardPool.title: Tail
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Tail

Description:
A prehensile appendage extending from the lower posterior with a blonde tuft at the tip. Functions as a fully capable third limb with considerable strength and durability.

Functions/Applications:
The tail serves as a melee weapon capable of breaking metal and restraining enemies. It launches the user upward when slapped against the ground, enables climbing by wrapping around objects, and supports acrobatic maneuvers. Can point directionally or perform simple gestures.

Limits:
The tail is vulnerable to damage and cannot replicate hand complexity for intricate tasks. Its permanent nature restricts comfortable sitting and lying down, requiring specialized clothing. Combat movement becomes predictable as the tail drives fighting patterns. Strength increases only through intensive training against resistant opponents.

Additional Notes:
Most effective when combined with martial arts training and close-quarters combat. Best used for supplementing mobility, evasion, and directional pressure rather than as a primary ranged weapon. The quirk is limited primarily by the user's creativity and physical conditioning.

She wears the UA female uniform—gray dress jacket with teal stripes, white shirt, red tie, and teal pleated skirt with brown shoes and knee-high socks. Her hero costume features a bright green turtleneck bodysuit with black lines outlined in yellow, beige gloves with green buckles, black boots with yellow V-markings, and green webbed flippers.

Class 1-A. Demonstrates frog-like mannerisms including hopping on all fours.

cardPool.title: Search
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Search

Description:
A surveillance Quirk allowing the user to monitor up to one hundred individuals simultaneously by targeting their Quirk Factor and DNA. Targets appear as star-like vestiges trackable from miles away. The Quirk's eyes glow rainbow-colored during activation and permanently stores gathered data.

Functions/Applications:
Locate multiple targets across vast distances; identify vulnerabilities of observed individuals; distinguish between multiple Quirk Factors in one person; maintain a permanent database of scanned subjects; coordinate long-distance tactical operations.

Limits:
Vulnerable to deception through misdirection and over-reliance on data without verification. Cannot distinguish between actual targets and false readings if the target's biological material is present elsewhere. Requires initial contact or proximity to store data on a subject.

Appearance:
Young woman with brown eyes and burgundy-red hair styled into three prominent bangs. Wears a red Pussycats hero costume with cat-ear headphones and red whisker-like markings beneath her eyes. Cat gloves with sharp claws and brown palm pads. In civilian dress, she favors knee-length skirt, dark leggings, high-heeled shoes, and turtleneck sweater.

Backstory:
Seasoned Pro Hero and measured leader of the Wild, Wild Pussycats team. Proven combat ability against dangerous villains, including League of Villains members. Demonstrates tactical skill and physical capability while mentoring younger heroes and civilians.

Additional Information:
Telepath Quirk allows one-way mental transmission to dozens simultaneously but cannot receive messages. Wields cat gloves with functional claws and uses cat-ear headphones for team communication.

cardPool.title: Electricity Generation
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Electricity Generation

Description:
The user produces and manipulates electricity within their body, releasing controlled lightning bolts with precision aiming and selective discharge to target enemies while avoiding allies.

Functions/Applications:
Fire lightning bolts at distant targets. Electrify conductive surfaces for tactical advantage. Provide illumination in dark environments. Stun or damage multiple foes through chain reactions.

Limits:
Continuous use drains stamina rapidly. Range decreases with discharge intensity. Wet environments amplify power but risk uncontrolled spread. User risks self-harm without proper control. Insulated targets resist damage.

Additional Notes:
Requires focus to aim; panic reduces accuracy. Overcharging risks explosive backfire. Most effective against metallic or conductive targets.

cardPool.title: Nezu
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Nezu

Alias: Mr. Principal

Quirk Name: High Specs

Occupation/Role: Principal of U.A. High School, Pro Hero

Personality: Eccentric and polite, persistently educational yet with a darker side from past human abuse. He enjoys toying with opponents and holds grudges, though he genuinely cares for student safety. Self-aware and slightly unpredictable in conflict.

Appearance: A small white-furred stoat-like creature with circular black eyes, one marked by a scar, rectangular ears with pale pink insides, and an elongated muzzle. He wears a white dress shirt, dark red tie, black waistcoat, matching pants, and oversized orange sneakers.

Backstory: A rare animal who manifested a Quirk, Nezu endured severe mistreatment and experimentation before rising to prominence. He now leads U.A. High School, dedicating himself to hero education and student protection.

Additional Information: Possesses enhanced senses, exceptional strategic planning abilities, industrial crane operation skills, and security management expertise. His combat prowess is formidable despite his small stature.

cardPool.title: Telekinesis
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Telekinesis

Description:
A mental power granting the ability to move and manipulate inanimate objects through force of will alone, without physical contact.

Functions/Applications:
Move objects across distances, construct barriers or projectiles mid-combat, solve environmental puzzles, lift multiple items simultaneously.

Limits:
Only affects inanimate objects; cannot move living creatures or organic matter. Control weakens with larger or heavier objects. Requires concentration. Cannot be used while unconscious or mentally incapacitated.

Additional Notes:
Power scales significantly when enhanced through Overmodification, allowing control of far more objects than typical use permits. Versatile in combat and utility roles, though output depends on user's mental fortitude and focus.

Resentful toward those with naturally heroic Quirks, he masks his longing for acceptance behind a calculating demeanor. Despite claiming indifference to friendship, he secretly desires validation as a true hero.

Wears the standard UA uniform; during combat training, he wears a dark blue PE uniform with white UA markings, a detachable artificial vocal cord device over his mouth, a capturing weapon around his neck, and green-white sneakers.

Backstory: Persecuted for possessing a Quirk perceived as villainous, Hitoshi has internalized resentment toward those with naturally heroic abilities. Despite discrimination from peers, his determination to become a Pro Hero never wavered.

cardPool.title: Mirio Togata

Quirk Name: Permeation

Occupation/Role: Class 3-B Student at UA High School, Member of The Big 3

Personality: Goofy and energetic with infectious optimism and constant smile. Makes corny jokes and fools himself for others' amusement. Despite his laid-back nature, he is extremely dedicated and hard-working with serious determination to master his Quirk and become a symbol of peace.

Hero costume features white skin-tight top with "1000000" across the chest, green belt lines, baggy dark blue pants with white backing, white knee-high boots with yellow soles, red cape, and thick red gloves.

cardPool.title: Zoom
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Zoom

Description:
A vision enhancement Quirk granting extraordinary magnification abilities. The user's eyes transform with distinctive crosshair-shaped irises and can focus on distant targets with perfect clarity up to 5 kilometers away.

Functions/Applications:
The user can zoom vision on specific points to observe people, objects, and details from extreme distances. Exceptional for reconnaissance, surveying crowds, identifying individuals, or examining distant locations unnoticed.

Limits:
Requires active focus to magnify vision—passive sight remains normal. Distances beyond 5 kilometers become blurry. Cannot zoom while moving quickly without losing focus. Environmental obstructions like fog, darkness, or rain significantly impair effectiveness. Provides no combat advantage in direct confrontation.

Additional Notes:
Crosshair irises are permanent physical markers of this Quirk. Extended use causes mild eye strain. Excels for information gathering and observation rather than active combat or defense.

cardPool.title: Darth Revan
cardPool.value:

Akira Kurose

High

Independent

A Force-delusional vigilante who believes himself to be Darth Revan.

Unlike Vader, Maul, or Tyranus, Revan rejects simple labels such as hero or villain. He assists heroes when civilians are threatened, hunts villains relentlessly, and opposes anyone he believes abuses power.

Because of this, neither the Hero Commission nor the criminal underworld can reliably predict his actions.

PERSONALITY

Calm, intelligent, analytical, and deeply introspective.

Revan constantly questions morality, authority, and justice. He values results over ideology and is one of the few Sith-delusional individuals capable of openly criticizing both heroes and villains.

APPEARANCE

• Distinctive mask resembling Darth Revan

QUIRK — BALANCE

Revan specializes in versatility rather than overwhelming power.

LIGHTSABER

Among the Sith-delusional individuals, Revan is considered the most likely to cooperate with heroes — and the least likely to stay on anyone's side for long.

cardPool.title: One For All
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
One For All

Description:
A transferable stockpiling Quirk from merging a power accumulation ability with a Quirk transference ability. Accumulates and stores immense physical power that compounds with each user's training and transfers via blood contact.

Functions/Applications:
Grants superhuman strength, speed, and durability multiplying across user generations. The user inherits accumulated power from previous hosts and adds their own strength. Power transfers through direct blood contact with a new host.

Limits:
Possession dramatically shortens lifespan due to maintaining two Quirks simultaneously. Transfers only through direct blood contact requiring willing acceptance or forced integration.

cardPool.title: Gearshift
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Gearshift

Description:
Gearshift manipulates acceleration and speed, allowing users to alter movement velocity while ignoring inertia. It evolved dramatically after merging with One For All, becoming a devastating power that envelops targets in blue energy aura.

Functions/Applications:
Drastically accelerates the user's body or external targets to sonic-boom speeds with massive impact force. Effective when combined with other abilities. Works at cellular levels when fully evolved.

Limits:
Initial use limited to five minutes before severe incapacitation. Prolonged use causes oxygen deprivation. Repeated activation stacks exponential damage—second use doubles blowback, risking paralysis. Extended strain leaves the user vulnerable and immobile.

cardPool.title: New Order
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
New Order

Description:
A reality-warping Quirk allowing the user to impose rules onto targets by touching them and speaking their name. Rules can redefine properties of objects, beings, environments, or other Quirks, including conditional cause-and-effect relationships.

Functions/Applications:
Grant temporary abilities, manipulate bodily functions, affect intangible things like air and energy, suppress other Quirks, create conditional effects. Rules persist even if the Quirk transfers.

Limits:
User can only maintain two active rules simultaneously. Rules require direct physical contact and verbal naming. Living beings with strong self-awareness can resist if the user's understanding doesn't match their identity. Rules cannot affect targets indirectly.

cardPool.title: Wave Motion
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Wave Motion

Description:
Wave Motion converts the user's vitality into golden spiral energy discharged as powerful blast waves. The user adjusts intensity at will, releasing energy from palms or feet. This drains stamina, but training builds vitality reserves.

Functions/Applications:
Offensive blasts; mobility enhancement through levitation and repositioning; close-range combat amplification; support for rescue and object manipulation; mid to long-range defense.

Limits:
Spiraling energy travels slower than direct projectiles. Overuse causes fatigue and stamina depletion. Prolonged discharge leads to exhaustion. Requires conscious control to avoid harming allies.

Additional Notes:
The Quirk's strength lies in battlefield control and versatility rather than speed.

cardPool.title: Accelerator Rings
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Accelerator Rings

Description:
The user generates yellow rings of energy from their hands and feet that release directional force bursts before dissipating. Originally manifested in infancy but stolen before full development, the Quirk has grown stronger through exposure to other Quirks.

Functions/Applications:
Launch self across distances and achieve aerial maneuverability through multiple ring activations. Deliver swift blows using velocity bursts. Scales to building-size rings when combined with other Quirks for long-range flight and massive force delivery.

Limits:
Variable delay between generation and force release creates timing vulnerability. Rings dissipate after activation, requiring continuous generation for sustained movement.

cardPool.title: Acid
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Acid

Description:
The user secretes corrosive gray acid from their skin while remaining naturally resistant to it. Skin pigmentation turns purple-pink when active. They can generate acid in high quantities from any body part and manipulate its solubility and viscosity.

Functions/Applications:
Create corrosive barriers, burn through walls, melt handholds into surfaces, generate slippery acid pools for mobility. At Maximum Output, condense acid for devastating penetrative force. Lower solubility to reduce harm to living targets.

Limits:
Prolonged use causes skin to lose acid resistance, risking severe corrosion and dehydration. Poor precision control around living beings. Accidental dissolution of clothing without careful focus.

cardPool.title: Alchemy
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Alchemy

Description:
Valdo transmutes non-living matter he touches into objects, energy forms, constructs that obey commands, and kinetic shockwave attacks. He can reshape objects while maintaining contact and create durable bodysuits that enhance his appearance.

Functions/Applications:
Create weapons, tools, and devices. Fashion protective bodysuits. Generate kinetic energy attacks. Construct golems for combat or labor. Manipulate terrain. Repair creations while touching them.

Limits:
Cannot transmute living organisms or create life. Bodysuits are hollow and tear to reveal weaker true form. Creations collapse if user is incapacitated. Kinetic shockwaves don't match true strength. Requires physical contact to transmute.

cardPool.title: Anivoice
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Anivoice

Description:
A sound-based Quirk allowing the user to communicate with and command animals through speech. The user's head progressively hardens and develops horns, amplifying range and eventually enabling telepathic animal communication. Humans and artificial creatures are immune.

Functions/Applications:
Command diverse animals for tactical purposes—insects for infiltration, birds for reconnaissance, predators for combat. Vocal training and amplification enable control of large animal groups across extended distances. Telepathic horns enable silent communication when fully developed.

Limits:
Range depends on vocal strength and equipment; requires speech to function. Loud sounds disrupt commands. Animals only understand basic intent, not complex dialogue.

cardPool.title: Antigen Swap
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Antigen Swap

Description:
The user can alter their blood type at will, changing their biochemical composition instantaneously. This allows them to leave no biological trace and evade identification through blood evidence.

Functions/Applications:
Eliminates forensic tracking via blood samples. Bypasses blood-type-specific effects or abilities. Counters blood-based restraints or curses.

Limits:
Does not affect physical injuries or wound closure. Cannot be used while severely blood-depleted or unconscious. Rapid changes are exhausting. Does not fool abilities that detect Quirk usage.

Additional Notes:
Primarily defensive and evasive. Most effective for espionage and avoiding investigation. Requires knowledge of compatible blood types to prevent biological incompatibility.

cardPool.title: Attraction of Small Objects
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name: Attraction of Small Objects

Description: A gravity-based telekinetic ability allowing the user to pull lightweight objects toward themselves through hand gestures. Objects are drawn gradually, requiring sustained concentration and repeated movements to guide items across distance.

Functions/Applications: Retrieving distant items, gathering scattered objects, pulling lightweight tools during combat, manipulating objects in puzzles without contact.

Limits: Only affects objects lighter than a book. Requires multiple hand movements rather than instant activation. Works within moderate room-range. Cannot function on living creatures or organic matter.

Additional Notes: Manipulates localized gravity fields rather than pure telekinesis.

cardPool.title: Black Hole
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Black Hole

Description:
A destructive ability that creates small black holes from the user's fingers, pulling in and atomizing matter and certain energy forms. The user's hands bear dark markings from prolonged use.

Functions/Applications:
Generate suction fields to pull enemies within range. Disintegrate debris. Prevent escape by creating gravitational zones. Neutralize energy-based attacks.

Limits:
User is not immune to their own black hole. Must deactivate before targets reach atomic disintegration. Unsuitable for close combat. Enemies with redirection or spatial manipulation Quirks can redirect the suction. Loss of fingers or hands eliminates Quirk functionality.

Additional Notes:
Originally developed for rescue and disaster relief, not combat.

cardPool.title: Blackwhip
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Blackwhip

Description:
The user generates controllable energy tendrils from any body part, appearing black with teal luminescent outlines. Power scales with emotional intensity, particularly anger and hatred. Gains exponential potential when integrated with One For All.

Functions/Applications:
Offensive restraint and enemy binding; mobility via grappling and swinging; object manipulation; internal reinforcement for protection; puppeteering one's own body when paralyzed; creating protective armor coating.

Limits:
Control tied to emotional stability—uncontrolled anger causes loss of precision and self-harm risk. High-power usage causes severe numbness and pain. Extended high-percentage duration risks injury.

cardPool.title: Blood Control
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Blood Control

Description:
Manipulate your own blood after it leaves your body, controlling its flow and hardening it into solid constructs. You can withstand massive blood loss and reabsorb expelled blood through specialized equipment.

Functions/Applications:
Harden blood into restraints or barriers. Release blood through gloves for pressure attacks. Reabsorb blood to recover resources mid-combat. Create whip-like blood streams for striking or grappling.

Limits:
Blood must leave your body before you can control it. Requires specialized gloves and tubing system. Excessive blood loss causes weakness. Blood hardens slowly and can be destroyed before solidifying.

Additional Notes:
This Quirk trades health for combat utility—strategic blood management is essential.

cardPool.title: Bloodcurdle
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Bloodcurdle

Description:
A parasitic quirk granting an extraordinarily long, textured tongue covered in small papillae. By making contact between the tongue and a target's blood, the user can ingest it and trigger temporary paralysis lasting up to 8 minutes, with duration varying by blood type.

Functions/Applications:
The user collects blood samples from wounds or surfaces, then licks the blood to activate paralysis and immobilize their target. Works on any opponent regardless of strength, making it effective for ambushes or one-on-one combat where the user gains first blood contact.

Limits:
Paralysis duration is unpredictable since blood type cannot be identified beforehand; blood type O causes shortest paralysis while type B causes longest.

cardPool.title: Bloodlet
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Bloodlet

Description:
A dangerous Quirk allowing the user to expel and absorb their own blood at will, withstanding extreme blood loss that would kill a normal person.

Functions/Applications:
Expel blood as a weapon or distraction; absorb expelled blood to recover fluids and maintain combat capability; survive injuries reliant on blood loss.

Limits:
Cannot manipulate others' blood. Expelling all blood leaves the user vulnerable during reabsorption. Does not heal wounds, only prevents death from blood loss. Requires proximity to expelled blood for recovery.

Additional Notes:
Most effective when paired with other Quirks. Blood expulsion can disorient opponents. Extended use risks organ damage despite survival.

cardPool.title: Blueflame
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Blueflame

Description:
A fire-generation Quirk creating intensely hot blue flames anywhere on the body. Burns exceed 2,000°C and ignite instantaneously. Power scales with emotional state—greater anger produces hotter, more uncontrollable flames.

Functions/Applications:
Instantly combust objects and living creatures on contact. Deploy flames across the body or concentrate for offense. Brightness effective against shadow-based opponents. Extreme emotional distress triggers secondary ice-based abilities.

Limits:
User's body cannot withstand generated heat despite cold-resistant genetics. Prolonged use causes severe burns, skin deterioration, and numbness. Emotional instability triggers uncontrollable ignition risking self-harm.

cardPool.title: Bombify
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Bombify

Description:
The user mutates body parts to grow bombs of various sizes from their surface through specialized Bomber cells embedded in their body, allowing rapid manifestation of explosive ordnance across multiple limbs.

Functions/Applications:
Create bombs on fists, arms, and other body parts for ranged or melee explosive attacks. Bombs vary in size and yield. Synergizes with Self-Detonation and Regeneration to restore damaged limbs after detonation.

Limits:
Requires Bomber cells to function. Bomb generation takes time proportional to size. Each detonation leaves the user temporarily limbless unless Regeneration is active. Cannot create explosives faster than the user's mutation speed allows.

cardPool.title: Boomerang
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Boomerang

Description:
A trajectory-manipulation Quirk allowing the user to control the path of thrown objects with precision, causing them to home in on targets and change direction mid-flight. The user's hands and affected projectiles glow purple during activation.

Functions/Applications:
The user can throw any object and redirect it multiple times before impact. Objects curve around obstacles, strike from unexpected angles, and return to the user. Effective for ranged combat, trapping opponents, or retrieving distant items.

Limits:
Projectiles remain subject to physics and can be stopped by sufficiently hard impacts or viscous substances. The Quirk requires direct contact to throw objects and cannot function without physical projectiles.

cardPool.title: Brainwashing
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Brainwashing

Description:
A mental control ability activated when a target verbally responds to the user's speech. Once triggered, the victim enters a fog-like state where their body obeys all commands while their mind remains trapped and aware. Their eyes turn milky white.

Functions/Applications:
The user can control one target at a time through direct concentration and simple verbal commands. Advanced training allows victims to speak while emotionally blocked. Multiple people can be controlled sequentially but not simultaneously. Works only on living beings capable of speech.

Limits:
Requires verbal response to activate—silence breaks the Quirk entirely. Victims cannot perform complex mental tasks. Physical trauma or strong pain breaks control instantly.

cardPool.title: Bubble
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Bubble

Description:
The user creates bubbles filled with any aroma they have previously smelled. These aromatic bubbles can be deployed offensively or defensively, from pleasant fragrances to putrid stinks. When panicked, involuntary foul bubbles form and detonate spontaneously.

Functions/Applications:
Deploy sweet-smelling bubbles to mask scents or create diversions. Produce foul-smelling bubbles to disorient enemies. Use bubbles for non-lethal crowd control or olfactory camouflage.

Limits:
User must have previously experienced an aroma to replicate it. Bubbles are vulnerable to destruction mid-creation. Panic triggers involuntary foul bubbles that explode unpredictably. Ineffective against those immune to olfactory distraction or wearing scent-blocking gear.

cardPool.title: Bull Head
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Bull Head

Description:
A transformation quirk granting large, robust bull-like horns from the head. Sharp and durable, suited for ramming and goring attacks.

Functions/Applications:
Powerful charging tackles using horns as battering rams and goring strikes in close combat. Horns provide armor-piercing capability and can breach barriers.

Limits:
Horns cannot retract, limiting stealth and social situations. Damage causes direct pain. Requires running start for maximum impact. Twisting movements are awkward with extra head weight.

Additional Notes:
Best for aggressive, direct combat. Effective against rigid defenses but poor against evasive opponents. Trades mobility for raw power.

cardPool.title: Bullet Laser
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Bullet Laser

Description:
The user fires purple laser beams from their fingertips with precision and destructive force. These lasers can travel straight or curve mid-flight through deliberate manipulation.

Functions/Applications:
Direct offensive blasts that pierce structures; explosive impact upon contact; curved trajectory firing for striking targets behind cover; suitable for close and distance combat.

Limits:
Requires line of sight from fingertips; energy expenditure increases with distance and power; curved beams are slower than direct shots; no defensive capabilities; reduced effectiveness against resistances or reflective surfaces.

Additional Notes:
This Quirk was stolen rather than naturally inherited, suggesting potential instability.

cardPool.title: Bullhorn
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Bullhorn

Description:
The user's voice becomes unnaturally loud and powerful, amplifying sound output far beyond normal human limits without strain.

Functions/Applications:
Project voice across vast distances; intimidate enemies through volume; disrupt concentration; communicate across battlefields instantly.

Limits:
No directional control; cannot modulate frequency or create focused sonic attacks; prolonged use causes throat damage; ineffective in soundproofed environments; relies on base voice quality.

Additional Notes:
Utility-focused with limited offensive potential. Best for crowd control, psychological pressure, and tactical communication rather than direct combat.

cardPool.title: Cemedine
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Cemedine

Description:
The user secretes a versatile adhesive liquid from cranial orifices that can be sprayed at targets. The glue can harden into rigid binding or remain tacky, with the user controlling solidification rate.

Functions/Applications:
Restrain opponents by spraying glue on limbs or bodies; create sticky traps; adjust drying speed; seal objects or wounds temporarily.

Limits:
Glue requires direct contact; excessive spraying depletes supply; hardened glue breaks with sufficient strength; adhesive cannot affect user's body; drying adjustment has limits; ranged application is less precise than melee contact.

Additional Notes:
Most effective in close-to-mid range combat. High heat accelerates drying unpredictably. User needs clear line of sight to spray effectively.

cardPool.title: Centipede
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Centipede

Description:
Grants elongated, segmented limbs resembling a centipede's body. Arms, legs, and head can extend dramatically from the body and remain concealed within clothing until deployed.

Functions/Applications:
Extended reach for grappling and restraint. Venomous pincers deliver paralyzing toxin. Multi-limb coordination enables entanglement. Concealment provides tactical surprise.

Limits:
Limbs constrained by clothing when retracted, limiting sudden extensions. Venom requires direct pincer contact and time to take effect. Extended limbs difficult to control with precision at maximum range. Head extension exposes vulnerable center point.

Additional Notes:
Effective against unarmored foes. High stealth potential.

cardPool.title: Chameleon
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Chameleon

Description:
The user gains chameleon physiology including adhesive skin for climbing, independently rotating eyes, an extendable tongue, and color-changing camouflage.

Functions/Applications:
Scale vertical surfaces with sticky limbs. Monitor multiple directions using independent eye rotation. Extend a prehensile tongue for attacks or utility. Activate full-body camouflage for ambushes, reconnaissance, or evasion. Enhanced agility and climbing speed.

Limits:
Camouflage is imperfect and detectable under close observation. Adhesive grip weakens on smooth surfaces. Extendable tongue has limited reach and strength. Independent eye rotation may be disorienting in combat. Camouflage breaks if the user moves too quickly or attacks.

cardPool.title: Chimera
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Chimera

Description:
The user manifests animal characteristics, maintaining a permanent blue werewolf form as their base state. They can temporarily shift to adopt traits of birds, lizards, dragons, and other creatures, enlarging features to monstrous proportions for enhanced combat capability.

Functions/Applications:
Grants strength and durability scaling with the adopted form. Dragon form enables fire breath and energy beams. Bird traits provide flight or mobility; lizard traits offer climbing and flexibility. Each form stacks animal advantages—claws, teeth, wings, scales—making the user a versatile transformer in combat.

Limits:
Transformations consume stamina; extended use drains energy quickly. Larger transformations reduce speed despite increased power.

cardPool.title: Chronostasis
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Chronostasis

Description:
The user's hair transforms into arrow-shaped projectiles that cut targets. Hair is divided into two sections: the "Minute Hand" on the forehead and the "Hour Hand" at the nape. Upon impact, targets experience slowdown effects whose duration depends on which hand struck them.

Functions/Applications:
Launch hair arrows as offensive weapons with varying slowdown durations. The Minute Hand inflicts shorter slowdown, while the Hour Hand inflicts longer slowdown. Use slowdown effects to immobilize enemies during combat.

Limits:
The user must remain completely stationary to fire hair arrows; any movement cancels the ability. Hair regenerates with a recharge time between uses. Slowdown effects have finite duration and do not permanently disable targets.

cardPool.title: Clean Bubbler
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Clean Bubbler

Description:
Susugu Mitarai generates pressurized soapy water and large soap bubbles from his body. The bubbles possess surprising strength and buoyancy, capable of lifting multiple people while remaining controllable. The solution carries disinfectant properties useful for medical aid.

Functions/Applications:
Create streams of soapy water for offensive pressure or propulsion. Generate large bubbles to lift, transport, or contain targets. Use bubbles to cleanse wounds and provide medical treatment. Combine streams and bubbles for crowd control or rescue operations.

Limits:
Requires finite internal reserves of soapy solution. Bubbles are fragile and burst from sharp objects or excessive force. Non-lethal and struggles against determined resistance.

cardPool.title: Cleaning
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Cleaning

Description:
The user secretes a potent dish soap-like substance from their body that weakens or temporarily negates the Quirks of others through direct contact. This substance also removes biological evidence like blood and fingerprints from surfaces.

Functions/Applications:
Apply the secreted soap by brushing or rubbing it onto an opponent's skin to suppress their Quirk. Use it to cleanse crime scenes and eliminate forensic evidence. The soap works best on exposed skin and active Quirk manifestations.

Limits:
Requires direct physical contact. Effectiveness diminishes as the substance dries or is washed away. Works better against external Quirks than internal ones. Overuse causes skin irritation and dryness.

cardPool.title: Clones
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Clones

Description:
Ectoplasm expels glowing viscous fluid from his mouth that he shapes into exact duplicates of himself. He can create up to thirty clones, each sharing his consciousness and capable of speech. All clones can be willfully dispersed at any time.

Functions/Applications:
Deploy clones for numerical advantage in combat or to patrol vast areas. Use clones for surveillance and reconnaissance, as the user perceives through all duplicates. Redirect clones to individual tasks for teaching, search operations, or crowd control. Create a single massive clone capable of trapping enemies within its body, though this prevents spawning additional clones.

Limits:
Each clone is fragile and destroyed by a single strong blow.

cardPool.title: Cloud
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Cloud

Description:
The user generates solid, touchable clouds of varying sizes and densities that support people and objects. These clouds float freely, enabling aerial mobility and item storage.

Functions/Applications:
Cloud grants rapid vertical and horizontal movement for escapes or reconnaissance. Clouds can shield allies through density manipulation, create diversions, provide hiding spots, and obscure vision.

Limits:
Vulnerable to gas-dispersing or elemental attacks. Larger clouds are slower but sturdier. Users cannot generate clouds faster than once per few seconds. Clouds dissipate if the user loses concentration or becomes incapacitated.

cardPool.title: Compress
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Compress

Description:
Compress allows the user to shrink anything within a spherical area into a small, weightless marble by touching it with their hand. The compressed objects retain their properties but become pocket-sized and portable. Release is triggered by snapping fingers, restoring marbles to full size instantly.

Functions/Applications:
Capture and transport enemies, allies, or environmental objects. Create traps by releasing marbles to restore obstacles in enemy paths. Compress body parts to inflict damage. Combine with environmental hazards by compressing targets alongside fire or debris.

Limits:
Activation requires hand contact with the target; user's own arm cannot be compressed. After losing the left arm, Compress functions only through the right arm.

cardPool.title: Confession
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Confession

Description:
After posing a question, the user compels the target to answer with absolute truthfulness. The victim cannot lie, resist, or refuse to respond, revealing their deepest secrets, intentions, and emotions. Answers reflect what the target believes to be true, not necessarily objective reality.

Functions/Applications:
Extract intelligence from enemies and allies. Expose hidden loyalties, fears, and shameful truths. Prevent betrayal by interrogating suspects. Manipulate opponents emotionally through forced admissions.

Limits:
Non-offensive; cannot damage or fight directly. Ineffective if either party cannot speak or communicate. Answers are interpreted literally with potential loopholes if the target's understanding differs from reality.

cardPool.title: Conjure
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name: Conjure

Description: A warping ability that instantly teleports small objects into the user's hand from their line of sight. The user focuses on a target and the object materializes in their grasp.

Functions/Applications: Retrieve weapons and tools instantly. Disarm opponents by conjuring away held objects. Gather resources quickly. Snatch items mid-air or from secured locations.

Limits: Only works on small objects. Requires clear line of sight. Cannot conjure abstract things or pull from sealed containers. Moderate range. User must have hand capacity to receive the item.

Additional Notes: Useful for theft, procurement, and combat advantage. Effectiveness depends on environmental awareness and quick thinking.

cardPool.title: Control Horn
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Control Horn

Description:
The user possesses specialized horns that project psychic dominion over bovine creatures. By maintaining both horns intact, the user can establish mental command over cattle, forcing them to obey through direct neural influence.

Functions/Applications:
Control herds of cattle for stampedes or intimidation. Redirect cattle to block passages or create diversions. Compel cattle to attack or defend on command.

Limits:
Only functions on bovine animals. Requires both horns undamaged; loss of one horn disables the Quirk. Control range and herd size limited by user focus and stamina. Cannot control already-trained attack animals with strong will.

Additional Notes:
Dependent on nearby cattle for offensive use.

cardPool.title: Copy
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Copy

Description:
Copy allows the user to replicate any Quirk after brief physical contact with its user. The user gains instinctive knowledge of how to use the copied Quirk at a basic level and can store multiple copied Quirks simultaneously, switching between them as needed.

Functions/Applications:
Instantly acquire an opponent's Quirk for tactical advantage. Adapt to any situation by switching between stored Quirks. Stack up to four or more Quirks within the body through training.

Limits:
Active duration is 10 minutes per copied Quirk before it expires. Only one Quirk can be activated at a time. Requires physical contact to function. Cannot replicate Quirks dependent on accumulated resources or stockpiled power.

cardPool.title: Cow
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Cow

Description:
The user transforms portions of their body to gain bovine characteristics including hooves, horns, and hardened hide. This grants enhanced speed and strength comparable to large cattle.

Functions/Applications:
Transform legs into hooves for rapid movement and enhanced kicking. Grow horns for charging attacks. Thicken hide for damage resistance. Stack multiple traits for cumulative benefits.

Limits:
Transformations are partial rather than complete. Increased body mass limits agility. Sustained transformation drains stamina.

Additional Notes:
Optimal in direct combat but struggles with finesse-based encounters. Transformation is visually obvious, limiting stealth. Works best against speed-reliant opponents.

cardPool.title: Creation
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Creation

Description:
Momo transmutes her body's fat cells into physical matter, materializing objects from her skin with a blue-pink glow. She can create virtually any non-living object if she understands its atomic structure, limited by her knowledge and lipid reserves.

Functions/Applications:
Creates weapons and cannons for combat. Can produce objects larger than her body by expending fat reserves. Partial materialization allows multitasking. Creations can be shared with allies. Her mastery of matryoshka dolls enables rapid production and storage of items.

Limits:
Requires food to replenish lipids; overuse causes weakness. Complex creations demand extended preparation time, leaving her vulnerable. Cannot create living beings.

cardPool.title: Crystallize
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name: Crystallize

Description: Yu Hojo rapidly grows durable crystals across his body, coating his skin in protective armor. Crystals form near-instantaneously and can be shaped into bladed gauntlets for extended melee range.

Functions/Applications: Deploy crystalline armor for defense. Form crystal blades along arms for reach. Layer crystals for targeted protection. Use rapid crystallization to counter attacks or break restraints.

Limits: Crystals shatter with sufficient force. Hair inhibits crystallization, requiring the user to remain shaved. Crystals destroy clothing during formation. Generated crystals have no monetary or structural value.

Additional Notes: Best suited for close-range combat and defense.

cardPool.title: Danger Sense
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Danger Sense

Description:
A sixth sense detecting potential threats through sharp, stabbing sensations visualized as lightning bolts. Reads intent and negative emotions, enabling threat anticipation.

Functions/Applications:
Warns of hostile intentions and threat levels. Enables rapid dodging. Detects multiple sources. Works passively. Effectiveness scales with training.

Limits:
Fails against those without true malice. Overwhelmed by high emotional concentrations in crowds. Ineffective against sufficiently fast attacks. Misdirected by aware opponents using decoys. Weakened by multiple weaker threats. Does not function against perceived non-threats.

Additional Notes:
Initial use caused severe physical strain, mitigated through training.

cardPool.title: Decay
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Decay

Description:
A destructive Quirk that disintegrates anything touched by the user's hands, reducing targets to dust. The disintegration spreads rapidly across organic and inorganic matter. Originally reverse-engineered from Overhaul, stripped of restoration properties.

Functions/Applications:
Touch-based destruction of matter and living tissue. Spreads through victims' bodies unless the affected limb is severed or interrupted. At full power, capable of destroying structures and multiple enemies simultaneously.

Limits:
Requires direct finger contact to activate—gloves or distance negates effect. Cannot affect fluid or particle-based matter. High-power usage causes severe recoil damage to user's body. Loses effectiveness if hands or fingers are lost.

cardPool.title: Despot
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Despot

Description:
The user extrudes thin, nearly invisible threads from their body that puppeteer other humans. Victims remain conscious but cannot resist commands, functioning as extensions of the user's will. Several dozen individuals can be controlled simultaneously.

Functions/Applications:
Create an army of controlled soldiers while maintaining their skills. Send puppets into danger without risk. Gather intelligence through multiple perspectives. Overwhelm opponents through coordinated numbers.

Limits:
Control breaks from sudden physical shock. Control ceases if the user loses consciousness. Victims cannot be forced to harm themselves fatally. Thread range is limited to moderate distances.

cardPool.title: Dog
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Dog

Description:
A canine-based transformation quirk granting enhanced senses of smell and hearing, alongside physical dog characteristics. Manifestation varies between users—some develop full dog features while others display partial transformations. All users gain acute sensory perception for tracking targets across vast distances.

Functions/Applications:
Users detect and identify individuals by scent from miles away, track prey through forests, and perceive threats via heightened hearing. Physical dog traits provide combat advantages and climbing ability. The quirk enhances strength and agility.

Limits:
Sensory abilities can be overwhelmed by strong odors or noise pollution. Physical transformations are permanent and unchangeable, affecting social interactions.

cardPool.title: Double
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Double

Description:
Double allows the user to create up to two identical copies of any person or object by touching them with viscous dark fluid from their hands. Duplicates possess the original's memories, personalities, and full abilities, making them nearly indistinguishable.

Functions/Applications:
Create perfect clones for combat, labor, or infiltration. Self-duplication enables exponential multiplication if copies duplicate themselves. Clones retain all original abilities and knowledge. Can replicate objects with precise structural knowledge. Clone destruction is detectable regardless of distance.

Limits:
User can maintain only two active copies at a time.

cardPool.title: Dragon
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Dragon

Description:
The user transforms into a massive dragon with reptilian features including wings, scales, powerful jaws, and sharp claws. Grants extraordinary physical prowess and durability far exceeding normal human limits.

Functions/Applications:
Flight via functional wings, devastating melee attacks with claws and fangs, powerful biting force, enhanced grappling, blocking heavy impact damage, overpowering opponents with raw strength.

Limits:
Transformation has energy costs or duration constraints limiting sustained use. Weakened by opposing Quirks targeting physical capability or countering strength and durability.

Additional Notes:
The dragon form retains the user's fighting technique and combat intelligence for tactical holds and submissions.

cardPool.title: Dragon Breath
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Dragon Breath

Description:
A fire-expulsion quirk enabling the user to exhale intense flames from their mouth. Requires alcohol consumption to activate and function, with intoxication levels directly affecting combat capability.

Functions/Applications:
Projects streams or bursts of fire for offensive attacks. Power scales with alcohol intake. Can destroy terrain or create flame barriers.

Limits:
Completely dependent on prior alcohol consumption; no fire when sober. Accuracy and control diminish at high intoxication levels. Prolonged use causes fatigue.

Additional Notes:
High-risk playstyle requiring careful resource management and balance between intoxication and control.

cardPool.title: Dupli-Arms
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Dupli-Arms

Description:
Mezo manifests arm-like tentacles capable of transforming into enhanced duplicates of any body part. Multiple different parts can manifest simultaneously, stacking their benefits.

Functions/Applications:
Enhanced sensory reconnaissance: Eye duplicates grant 360° vision; ear duplicates detect distant sounds. Combat multiplier: Replicated arms generate half-ton force per set. Mobility: Webbed tentacles enable wall-climbing and gliding. Communication: Mouth replicas bypass facial restrictions. Scalability: Pods can self-replicate to extend tentacle length.

Limits:
Tentacles and duplicated parts are vulnerable to injury. Regrowing severed duplicates is painful and time-consuming. Manifesting multiple organs from single pods reduces control.

cardPool.title: Eagle
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name: Eagle

Description: The user transforms into an eagle-like humanoid with feathered wings, sharp talons, and enhanced predatory senses.

Functions/Applications: Functional wings enable flight for aerial mobility and reconnaissance. Enhanced vision spots distant targets. Sharp talons serve as melee weapons. The user gains eagle-like strength and agility.

Limits: Extended flight is limited by fatigue. Transformation restricts fine manual dexterity and prevents use of human tools.

Additional Notes: An animalistic transformation with combat and mobility applications. Mastery level and partial transformation possibilities remain unclear.

cardPool.title: Earphone Jack
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Earphone Jack

Description:
The user has cable-like earlobes stretching up to 6 meters, tipped with jack-shaped plugs. They are prehensile, can pierce hard materials, and detect sound through barriers up to 12 meters. The user channels heartbeat vibrations through the jacks to damage objects internally.

Functions/Applications:
Sound reconnaissance through obstacles. Offensive combat via heartbeat vibrations for internal or directional damage. Functions as actual headphone cables. Earlobes serve as extra limbs for gripping and manipulation.

Limits:
Range limited to 6 meters stretch, 12 meters detection. Overuse causes ear bleeding and fatigue. Loud sounds cause sensory overload and incapacitation. Multiple noise sources mask targets. Losing an ear reduces effectiveness.

cardPool.title: Earth Flow
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Earth Flow

Description:
The user manipulates soil and earth with precise control, molding it into desired forms. This Quirk grants destructive and constructive power for creating avalanches, terrain shifts, and earthen structures.

Functions/Applications:
Create animated earth golems for combat. Reshape terrain for rescue operations. Construct training grounds and obstacles. Trigger geological hazards through remote manipulation.

Limits:
Ineffective without accessible soil or earth. Useless on barren stone, metal, or open water. Range is limited to manipulable earth within sight or sensory range. Requires sustained concentration for complex constructs.

Additional Notes:
Mastery allows earth golems to pass as natural creatures.

cardPool.title: Elasticity
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Elasticity

Description:
A touch-based Quirk that grants elasticity to any object or surface the user contacts, transforming them into bouncy, flexible materials. The user can make floors into trampolines, structures into slingshots, and create invisible elastic barriers in midair. Effects persist for a set duration with no manual deactivation.

Functions/Applications:
Create springy surfaces for mobility and bouncing; launch objects or self across distances; generate aerial platforms for navigation and defense; weaken enemy footing by elasticizing ground; apply elasticity to clothing for grappling protection.

Limits:
Effects automatically wear off after a time period with no early deactivation option. Opponents who adapt to the elastic environment can exploit it.

cardPool.title: Electromagnetic Bullets
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Electromagnetic Bullets

Description:
The user projects an electromagnetic field around thrown objects, accelerating them to high velocities and turning small items into potent weapons.

Functions/Applications:
Launch projectiles with force and precision; create rapid-fire barrages; useful for ranged combat and area denial.

Limits:
Requires objects to throw; depends on throwing accuracy and arm strength; consumes stamina with repeated use; moderate effective range; cannot enhance objects already in flight.

Additional Notes:
Best suited for users with good aim. Vulnerable at close range.

cardPool.title: Erasure
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Erasure

Description:
The user nullifies any target's Quirk Factor by maintaining eye contact. The Quirk affects multiple targets simultaneously while the user's eyes remain open. When deactivated, the user's hair returns to normal, signaling a cooldown period.

Functions/Applications:
Disable an opponent's Quirk for hand-to-hand combat. Effective against Quirk-dependent fighters and Transformation abilities. Creates minor anti-gravity around the user's head.

Limits:
Requires direct line of sight; obstacles block activation. Ineffective on Quirkless individuals or physical enhancements. Mutant-type appendages remain impaired but functional. Causes severe dry eye syndrome. Recharge interval creates counterattack openings.

cardPool.title: Explosion
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Explosion

Description:
The user excretes nitroglycerin-like sweat from their palms and ignites it at will for devastating explosions. Immune to own blasts except minor recoil. Power scales with sweat production, stronger during physical activity and warm conditions.

Functions/Applications:
Create shockwaves that burn and shatter; self-propulsion for mobility; blind opponents; launch long-range blasts; fire multiple explosions simultaneously. Counters darkness-based abilities.

Limits:
Cold weather slows detonation. Dual-palm use disperses strength. Repeated large explosions cause arm and shoulder pain. Loss of palms renders Quirk unusable. Requires conscious ignition.

Additional Notes:
User employs close-range bombardment strategy.

cardPool.title: Extend-o-Hair
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Extend-o-Hair

Description:
The user manipulates their hair's growth and movement with precision control. Hair is indestructible and can form armor, grapple enemies, or create barriers.

Functions/Applications:
Deploy hair as whips or restraints. Form full-body armor. Create nets to trap groups. Establish barriers. Use hair for mobility or sensing.

Limits:
Hair tangles easily, restricting movement. Extended hair requires concentration. Control range limited to 30 feet.

Additional Notes:
User maintains an unusually hairy appearance. Quirk excels in group combat and defense but fails when tangled. Requires patience and tactical thinking.

cardPool.title: Extra Arms
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Extra Arms

Description:
A mutation-type Quirk granting an additional set of functional arms, for four limbs total. All arms possess equal strength and dexterity.

Functions/Applications:
The user performs multiple actions simultaneously—wielding dual weapons, grappling while striking, or manipulating objects independently. Provides enhanced climbing, melee combat versatility, and complex physical tasks.

Limits:
Extra arms provide no superhuman strength. Coordination requires conscious effort, and simultaneous actions may diminish reflexes. Clothing must be specially fitted.

Additional Notes:
Excels in close-quarters combat and grappling. Martial training maximizes tactical benefits.

cardPool.title: Fan
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Fan

Description:
A wind-generation quirk activated by rapidly spinning the user's wrists. The user can produce localized gusts or devastating tornadoes depending on rotation speed and intensity.

Functions/Applications:
Create directional wind attacks to knock back opponents. Generate tornadoes for area-of-effect damage. Deflect projectiles or create barriers.

Limits:
Maximum continuous use of one minute before risking tendon inflammation. Overuse causes severe wrist pain and joint damage. Cannot generate wind without active wrist rotation.

Additional Notes:
Highly effective at range and against multiple opponents, but requires strategic timing due to strict time constraints.

cardPool.title: Fat Absorption
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Fat Absorption

Description:
The user can adhere objects and living beings to their body upon contact, causing them to sink into accumulated body fat. This grants exceptional protection against blades, bullets, and conventional attacks. Maintaining this Quirk requires constant high body mass through regular food consumption.

Functions/Applications:
