Absorbs impact force and releases it in a devastating counterattack punch. Restrains opponents by enveloping them with the user's large frame. Acts as a mobile shield protecting allies from incoming damage.

Limits:
Requires substantial body fat to function; a slim build renders it ineffective. Counterattack technique burns significant fat reserves, leaving the user vulnerable if it fails. Recovery takes three days.

cardPool.title: Fierce Gains
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Fierce Gains

Description:
The user's muscles harden to exceptional toughness on command, creating an nearly impenetrable defensive state. Muscular tissue becomes dense and rock-like, dramatically increasing durability against piercing and slashing attacks.

Functions/Applications:
Hardens muscles to deflect or absorb damage from weapons and impacts. Can be layered with other defensive abilities for exponential protection. Allows the user to withstand attacks that would normally pierce flesh.

Limits:
Requires conscious activation and cannot protect against blunt force trauma equally well. Hardened muscles still conduct kinetic energy, so crushing impacts transfer damage internally. Cannot be maintained indefinitely without exhaustion.

cardPool.title: Foldabody
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Foldabody

Description:
Foldabody grants the user the ability to manipulate their body's thickness and stretch their limbs into paper-thin forms. The user can flatten, fold, and reshape their entire body or individual sections at will, transforming into blades, drills, or threads while maintaining consciousness and control.

Functions/Applications:
The user can slip through narrow spaces undetected, transform body parts into piercing weapons, and strike vital points to incapacitate enemies. Mid-air combat is possible by twisting the body into drill-like shapes. The Quirk allows slow body regeneration.

Limits:
Extreme thinning shortens the user's lifespan and causes physical deterioration. Thread-size transformation causes severe weakness and requires extended recovery.

cardPool.title: Foresight
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Foresight

Description:
A prediction Quirk granting the user ability to perceive a target's future actions and movements up to one hour ahead. The user witnesses events from third-person perspective. Activation requires physical touch followed by eye contact.

Functions/Applications:
Combat evasion becomes near-perfect when eye contact is maintained. Investigative work benefits greatly, revealing targets' plans and locations. The Quirk can perceive events years into the future, though distant events require rough estimation.

Limits:
A 24-hour cooldown must pass before reactivating on any target. Breaking eye contact halts prediction. The Quirk is purely visual—the user cannot hear dialogue. The foreseen future cannot be changed through normal means.

cardPool.title: Free Walker
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Free Walker

Description:
A mobility Quirk granting exceptional leg movement and fatigue resistance. Users move their legs with unprecedented speed and agility without typical muscular exhaustion.

Functions/Applications:
Enhanced sprinting, rapid directional changes, extended physical activity without leg fatigue, superior footwork in combat or traversal.

Limits:
Unknown speed threshold, fatigue affects other body parts, prolonged use duration unclear, no strength or jumping enhancement, affects only legs.

Additional Notes:
Free Walker is largely undocumented. It focuses on movement and endurance rather than offense or defense. Best suited for pursuits, escapes, and sustained exertion.

cardPool.title: Frost
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Frost

Description:
The user generates and manipulates ice, coating their body in frozen armor and projecting ice blasts. This Quirk provides natural resistance to cold and freezing temperatures, making the user difficult to harm with ice-based attacks.

Functions/Applications:
Create protective ice armor; launch ice projectiles or waves; lower ambient temperature in localized areas; shield allies from heat or fire by absorbing thermal energy; sustain defensive positions through ice barriers.

Limits:
Prolonged use causes frostbite and hypothermia. Extended combat drains stamina quickly. Users without sufficient fire resistance risk severe burns when exposed to intense heat.

Additional Notes:
Most effective in defensive or support roles rather than sustained offense.

cardPool.title: Gale Gale
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Gale Gale

Description:
The user manipulates wind currents around their body, creating vortexes for flight and a protective barrier that deflects attacks and projectiles.

Functions/Applications:
Flight, deflection of physical and ranged attacks, offensive wind blasts, enhanced mobility. User maintains a defensive wind shell while airborne.

Limits:
The user's head remains completely exposed. Maintaining the Quirk requires constant concentration; disruption weakens the wind shield. Stamina consumption increases with flight duration and deflection intensity.

Additional Notes:
The Quirk is deceptively powerful defensively. Opponents must exploit the head vulnerability through elevated angles or coordinated attacks to overcome the wind shield.

cardPool.title: Gas
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Gas

Description:
The user generates a massive, swirling cloud of purple, sleep-inducing poison gas. Anyone inhaling it falls unconscious immediately. The gas forms a typhoon centered on the user, strongest nearby and weaker at edges. The user can sense creatures within it through fluctuations.

Functions/Applications:
Crowd control and area denial for trapping enemies and blocking escape routes. Detection of movement allows tracking without sight. Best used as support during ambushes, keeping distance from threats.

Limits:
Gas masks provide immunity. The gas cannot be manipulated for precision attacks. Wind easily disperses it. The user is not immune and needs a gas mask. If the user loses consciousness, the gas dissipates. Range is limited.

cardPool.title: Gatling
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Gatling

Description:
The user's arms transform into gun-like biological organs that fire claw-like keratin projectiles in rapid bursts, serving as a natural ranged weapon.

Functions/Applications:
Fire keratin claws rapidly for suppressive fire and area control. Effective in close-quarters combat to force opponents back or create distance.

Limits:
Projectiles have limited range and stopping power. Sustained firing depletes keratin reserves, requiring recovery time. The organs cannot be concealed.

Additional Notes:
Best used defensively with hand-to-hand combat. Keratin regeneration rate determines firing duration.

cardPool.title: Gigantification
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Gigantification

Description:
The user drastically increases their body size to colossal proportions, gaining immense mass and strength. Control and maximum height vary by user. The transformation grants devastating physical power but demands substantial space.

Functions/Applications:
Enables overpowering larger opponents, destroying structures, intimidating enemies, and serving as mobile transportation. Some variants allow blob-like transformation with stretching capabilities or creation of smaller clones.

Limits:
Most users cannot assume intermediate sizes. The Quirk demands open spaces—enclosed areas severely hamper effectiveness. Some variants force automatic shrinkage after prolonged activation. Emotional instability may trigger uncontrolled transformation.

cardPool.title: Glamour
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Glamour

Description:
The user emits mist from their mouth that materializes into vivid visual and auditory illusions capable of filling entire rooms to deceive, distract, or misdirect opponents.

Functions/Applications:
Create convincing illusions of people, monsters, or environments to confuse enemies. Use illusions as decoys to protect allies. Craft illusions based on real individuals by studying their appearance and traits. Illusions can range from charming to horrifying.

Limits:
Illusions are temporary and dissipate unpredictably. Cannot cause physical damage. User must expel visible mist, revealing the casting action. Large-scale illusions require more effort and cannot be maintained indefinitely.

cardPool.title: Good Ear
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name: Good Ear

Description: A sensory enhancement Quirk granting perception of ultrasonic frequencies beyond normal human hearing. The user detects high-frequency vibrations and sounds.

Functions/Applications: Long-distance communication with compatible allies, crowd assessment via acoustic signatures, surveillance through sound analysis, and echolocation-like environmental mapping.

Limits: Requires sound-based information; ineffective in silence or against sound-dampening. Long-distance communication needs recipients capable of compatible frequencies. Overexposure causes disorientation.

Additional Notes: Most effective in coordinated team settings. Effectiveness increases with familiarity of sound patterns. Environmental noise interferes with precision detection at range.

cardPool.title: Grasshopper
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Grasshopper

Description:
A transformation Quirk allowing users to morph into a large humanoid grasshopper form, enhancing physical prowess. The Hotta Brothers typically activate this ability through Trigger injections.

Functions/Applications:
Grants increases to strength, agility, and jumping height in grasshopper form. Users can perform synchronized combo attacks when coordinated. Primary application is close-quarters combat with enhanced mobility.

Limits:
True limitations unknown due to Trigger reliance. Independent functionality without external stimulants has never been tested. Transformation requires preparation or chemical activation.

Additional Notes:
Most effective when two users coordinate attacks. Trigger-dependent usage suggests potential dependency.

cardPool.title: Gyrate
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Gyrate

Description:
Sen Kaibara's Quirk allows him to rotate any part of his body at extreme speeds, transforming his limbs into spinning drill-like weapons. Spiral-patterned finger gloves amplify strikes into devastating cutting and piercing attacks.

Functions/Applications:
Enhanced close-range melee combat with rotating limbs that drill through defenses. Gloved hands amplify offensive damage, making physical blocking ineffective. Excels at rapid rotational strikes and maintains effectiveness when grappled.

Limits:
Purely close-range with no long-distance applications. Cannot prevent being grabbed or carried. Effectiveness relies heavily on spiral gloves for maximum damage.

cardPool.title: Hair Control
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Hair Control

Description:
A Quirk allowing manipulation of one's own hair with precision and force. The user can harden, extend, and weaponize hair strands for offensive and defensive purposes. Control varies based on hair length, density, and training.

Functions/Applications:
Hair can be fired as projectiles with bullet-like velocity or shaped into weapons like whips and blades for melee combat. Hair serves as an extension of the body for grappling, binding, or striking from range.

Limits:
Control is restricted to the user's own hair only. Hardened hair is vulnerable to sharp cuts and fire. Extended hair strands deplete stamina with prolonged use. Short or thin hair reduces offensive potential significantly.

cardPool.title: Hair-Raiser
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Hair-Raiser

Description:
The user can extend, harden, and detach hair strands at will, transforming them into malleable weapons or tools for combat and utility.

Functions/Applications:
Hardened hair can form spears, whips, or blades for offense, or serve as grappling hooks, restraints, and construction tools. The user maintains control over detached strands for dynamic repositioning.

Limits:
Excessive use causes baldness and vulnerability. Hardened hair can be cut or broken by sharp or strong forces. Hair regrows at normal rates, creating a finite resource per engagement.

Additional Notes:
Rewards creative, tactical fighters who use resourcefulness over wasteful approaches. Offers versatility in combat and non-combat scenarios.

cardPool.title: Hardening
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Hardening

Description:
The user hardens any part or all of their body into rock-like material, transforming skin into an impenetrable, jagged surface. This grants extreme durability against physical trauma and increases striking power through rough, cutting edges.

Functions/Applications:
Provides defense against bullets, blades, and blunt force. Offensive applications include devastating strikes and grazing cuts from hardened skin. Can shield allies. Hardness improves with repeated damage during activation.

Limits:
Requires close-range combat with no long-distance capability. Cannot protect against extreme temperatures. Stamina depletes under sustained damage. Eyes remain vulnerable if entire body is hardened. Effect weakens under psychological stress.

cardPool.title: Hardflame Fan
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Hardflame Fan

Description:
The user generates walls of solidified fire that harden into barriers for defensive protection. Heat exceeding the Quirk's own temperature penetrates these defenses.

Functions/Applications:
Deploy fire walls to shield against attacks. Create multiple defensive layers for increased protection. Hardened fire absorbs moderate-level heat-based strikes.

Limits:
Fire hotter than the user's flames passes through unimpeded. Cannot be used offensively. Requires continuous focus to maintain barriers. Each additional layer drains stamina progressively.

Additional Notes:
This is a stolen Quirk, suggesting the original user was relatively unknown or weaker. Best used defensively as part of a layered tactical approach.

cardPool.title: Heal
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Heal

Description:
The user accelerates a target's natural healing by kissing them. Injuries taking months to heal can be fully restored in seconds. The user maintains fine control over healing intensity and stamina drain.

Functions/Applications:
Rapidly mend wounds, broken bones, and internal injuries. Works best combined with surgery for life-threatening conditions. User can selectively refuse to heal certain injuries.

Limits:
Healing consumes the receiver's stamina; severe healing can cause exhaustion or death. Cannot regrow lost limbs or fully heal extremely severe injuries. Requires the receiver to be alive and capable of natural healing. Most dangerous injuries need surgical intervention first.

cardPool.title: Hellflame
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Hellflame

Description:
A powerful fire-based Quirk allowing the user to generate and control flames of varying temperatures, from low-heat warnings to devastating blue-hot infernos. The user can cover their body in flames, project fire as blasts and rays, and achieve limited flight through controlled flame expulsion.

Functions/Applications:
Large-scale flamethrower attacks, precise heat rays, flame-wreathed melee strikes, aerial propulsion via jets, wall-running by creating molten footprints, and fire-conjured weapon shapes. Signature technique Flashfire Fist raises flames to maximum temperature for a vaporizing heat ray.

Limits:
Overuse causes dangerous body temperature buildup impairing physical abilities; user requires external cooling assistance.

cardPool.title: High Specs
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
High Specs

Description:
An intellect-enhancing quirk that elevates mind and body far beyond normal limits. Grants superhuman intelligence, perception, reaction speed, and comprehension. The user gains enhanced strength, dexterity, and growth, becoming fully sapient with human-level cognition and speech regardless of original species.

Functions/Applications:
Devise complex strategies instantly from minimal information. Execute intricate plans with precise calculations. Perfect recall of all experienced events and knowledge. Leadership and tactical command at highest level. Enhanced physical coordination for delicate or demanding tasks.

Limits:
Cannot increase physical power beyond enhanced baseline.

cardPool.title: Hologram
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Hologram

Description:
Mahoro Shimano projects illusory holograms of any object or creature she visualizes. The projections scale from small decoys to massive constructs visible from great distances. They exist as pure light with no physical substance.

Functions/Applications:
Create diversionary illusions to confuse opponents. Generate emergency signal constructs visible across wide areas. Project multiple holograms simultaneously to overwhelm perception.

Limits:
Holograms possess zero tangibility—they cannot interact with physical matter or deal damage. Strong winds disperse projections instantly. Requires active concentration; losing focus causes immediate dissipation. Ineffective against keen perception or battle-hardened opponents.

cardPool.title: Homing
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Homing

Description:
The user locks onto visible targets within 600 meters and launches projectiles that automatically chase their prey. Projectiles home in with relentless accuracy, but strikes lack significant force, prioritizing tracking over impact damage.

Functions/Applications:
Lock onto distant enemies for guaranteed hit tracking; maintain pressure on mobile targets; suppress enemy movement; execute precise strikes from range; work effectively in open terrain.

Limits:
Requires visual line of sight at lock-on moment; effective range capped at 600 meters; projectiles deal minimal damage; user cannot dictate hit location; useless against invisible or obscured enemies; projectile speed allows brief reaction time.

cardPool.title: Horn Cannon
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Horn Cannon

Description:
Pony can detach and launch her horns as independent projectiles with near-instant regeneration. She maintains telekinetic control over up to four horns simultaneously, allowing mid-air trajectory adjustments. The horns are dense and curved, ideal for piercing, restraining, or transporting targets.

Functions/Applications:
Launch multiple horns in rapid succession for offense. Remotely steer horns around obstacles. Restrain or pin enemies. Transport allies and objects via horn. Assist mobility and climbing.

Limits:
Only four horns controlled remotely at once. Horns weaken without keratin intake and are breakable. Transporting multiple people reduces horn speed. Holding horns in place prevents detachment.

cardPool.title: Hula Hoop
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Hula Hoop

Description:
The user generates large hoops of concentrated energy and hurls them as projectile weapons. The hoops are solid enough to impact with force.

Functions/Applications:
Primary offensive ranged attack through energy hoop projection. Can strike multiple targets in sequence for medium-range combat.

Limits:
Requires arm-raising motion before each hoop, telegraphing the attack. Hoops dissipate after moderate distance with slow generation cooldown.

Additional Notes:
Best for direct combat rather than stealth. Most potent against stationary or slow targets.

cardPool.title: Hydra
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Hydra

Description:
A stolen Quirk allowing the user to summon massive serpentine shark-like creatures from their back. These beasts possess immense strength and can crush humans in their jaws.

Functions/Applications:
Summon snake creatures to attack enemies. Summoned creatures split into two heads when damaged. Two heads can lift the user airborne. Enhancement drugs enable multiple simultaneous summons.

Limits:
Initially limited to one creature; splitting occurs only when damaged. Multiple summons require enhancement drugs. Ineffective in confined spaces due to creature size.

Additional Notes:
The stolen Quirk is unstable in some conditions. Enhancement drugs expand combat potential but create dependency.

cardPool.title: Impact Recoil
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Impact Recoil

Description:
A defensive Quirk that reverses incoming physical force back upon the attacker, redirecting kinetic damage rather than absorbing it.

Functions/Applications:
Reflects melee strikes, projectiles, and collision-based attacks back at their source with amplified force.

Limits:
Does not fully negate impact; the user still experiences incapacitation from extremely powerful strikes. Cannot reflect indirect damage like energy, heat, or environmental hazards. Requires physical contact or proximity to active force.

Additional Notes:
Most effective against direct, forceful attackers. Less reliable against heat-based, elemental, or ranged abilities.

cardPool.title: Impure Beam
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name: Impure Beam

Description: A powerful light-based Quirk that fires massive beams of concentrated luminous energy capable of obliterating large targets in a single strike.

Functions/Applications: Unleash devastating beam attacks dealing extreme damage to targets. Can be charged for increased potency and combined with other Quirks to amplify output. Effective against most defenses.

Limits: Maximum output causes severe recoil damage to the user's body. Vulnerable to refraction or redirection by light-manipulating Quirks. Extended use risks catastrophic self-injury. Requires enhanced durability or regeneration to use safely at full power.

Additional Notes: Best suited for users with healing factors. Most effective as a finishing move.

cardPool.title: Incite
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Incite

Description:
The user's voice carries an electromagnetic pulse that physically and mentally enhances loyal followers. Power scales with volume—louder speech means stronger effects. Enhancement drains the recipient's body.

Functions/Applications:
Amplifies physical strength, speed, and mental fortitude in loyal followers. Can temporarily push them beyond normal limits. Works best through amplification devices or in crowds.

Limits:
Only functions on those with genuine loyalty; wavering faith nullifies effects. Cannot compel unwilling targets or create loyalty where none exists. Repeated use exhausts recipients.

Additional Notes:
The user must actively speak to activate Incite; silence negates it. External amplification increases effectiveness.

cardPool.title: Infrared
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Infrared

Description:
The user perceives surroundings through infrared radiation, gaining thermal vision like heat-sensing predators. This enables navigation independent of light and compensates for blindness. The quirk extends to sensing emotional states through thermal fluctuations in living beings.

Functions/Applications:
Navigate in darkness. Detect living creatures by heat signatures. Read emotional states through thermal changes. Bypass visual obstacles and camouflage.

Limits:
Effective only at close range. Electromagnetic interference disrupts perception. Cannot sense uniform temperature objects or heat-isolated targets. Requires cognitive processing to interpret data.

Additional Notes:
This stolen quirk suggests moderate compatibility.

cardPool.title: Invisibility
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Invisibility

Description:
The user's body unconsciously refracts light, rendering them invisible. The Quirk is permanently active. Clothing and carried objects remain visible, requiring complete nudity for stealth. Extreme temperatures damage exposed skin.

Functions/Applications:
Enables stealth, infiltration, and evasion. With training, the user can manipulate refracted light to blind opponents or redirect light-based attacks.

Limits:
Clothed users remain visible. Complete nudity exposes skin to environmental damage. Sensory detection—sound, thermal, touch, scent, tracking—bypasses the Quirk. Powerful light sources can malfunction the Quirk and reveal the user's silhouette. The ability cannot be turned off.

cardPool.title: IQ
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
IQ

Description:
A mental enhancement Quirk that multiplies intellectual capacity to genius levels. Activation requires consuming tea and closing one's eyes. Yellow equations and orange circuit diagrams materialize visually around the user's head during activation.

Functions/Applications:
Enables complex strategic planning, enemy analysis, behavior prediction, and tactical problem-solving. Excels at information gathering, trap construction, and multi-target coordination. Different tea varieties produce varying enhancement effects.

Limits:
Activation requires tea consumption. Generated plans have exploitable flaws. Provides no physical combat, defensive, or reflexive enhancement.

cardPool.title: Iron Ball
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Iron Ball

Description:
User produces and launches iron spheres from their knuckles with considerable force. Projectiles range from egg-sized to larger than the user's body with control over mass and density.

Functions/Applications:
Ranged offense; generates ammunition for allies; large projectiles create barriers or crush obstacles; variable sizing provides tactical flexibility.

Limits:
Sustained production drains stamina; larger spheres require more energy; accuracy decreases with distance and extreme sizes; user must have knuckles available; projectiles lack remote control.

Additional Notes:
Best in offensive or support roles; balances power with tactical versatility through size manipulation; effective in group combat.

cardPool.title: Iron Claws
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Iron Claws

Description:
The user's fingertips transform into hard metallic claws. Size and sharpness vary—some develop large slashing weapons, others maintain dexterous claws for excavation.

Functions/Applications:
Claws can pierce tough materials, slash opponents, or dig through earth. Users can burrow for mobility, concealment, or surprise attacks. Claws retain enough precision for climbing and manipulation.

Limits:
Claws are only as strong as the user's physical strength. Extended burrowing drains stamina. The quirk doesn't increase speed or reflexes. Claws can break under superior force or materials.

Additional Notes:
Manifestation varies—bulky variants sacrifice dexterity for power, while refined versions maintain control.

cardPool.title: Iron Club
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Iron Club

Description:
The user transforms their arms into massive iron clubs covered in jagged spikes. Body mass and height increase to 229cm, granting an imposing ogre-like appearance.

Functions/Applications:
Devastating melee strikes capable of crushing boulders and shattering fortifications. Spikes inflict additional trauma on impact.

Limits:
Arms cannot perform fine manipulation while transformed. Transformation requires significant stamina. Speed and agility decrease due to increased mass. Vulnerable during transformation.

Additional Notes:
Offensive-focused Quirk best suited for direct combat. Spike coverage prevents disarming or grappling. Limited defensive capability; user relies on durability rather than evasion.

cardPool.title: Jet
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Jet

Description:
Jet allows the user to expel compressed air from holes in the soles of their feet, propelled by breath from their lungs. This grants extreme speed in flight and ground movement with superhuman acceleration and direction changes.

Functions/Applications:
The user achieves short-range flight and ground acceleration by releasing air pulses. Each directional change requires breath intake. Momentum amplifies physical strikes for devastating tackles and kicks. Useful for evasion, pursuit, high-impact attacks, and rapid repositioning in combat.

Limits:
Flight duration is restricted by lung capacity—cannot sustain hover. Each direction shift costs breath, limiting maneuverability. Physical deterioration weakens stamina.

cardPool.title: Kaiju
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Kaiju

Description:
A transformation Quirk that allows the user to metamorphose into a colossal dinosaur-like beast resembling Godzilla, granting massive size and power.

Functions/Applications:
Grants enormous physical strength and size for combat. The beast form can devastate large areas through sheer mass and destructive capability.

Limits:
Transformation requires Trigger drug activation. The user cannot access this power naturally without chemical enhancement. The massive form reduces mobility and agility despite increased strength.

Additional Notes:
True capabilities remain mysterious due to limited observed usage. Dependency on Trigger presents significant vulnerability when unavailable. Long-term effects of repeated transformations are unknown.

cardPool.title: Kinetic Booster
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Kinetic Booster

Description:
A Quirk that amplifies kinetic energy from movement and actions. Multiple copies multiply the effect exponentially. All For One's four copies make him devastatingly powerful.

Functions/Applications:
Enhanced striking force, explosive speed, amplified jumping, and increased momentum. Multiple copies compound effects for simultaneous energy bursts or sustained acceleration beyond normal limits.

Limits:
Requires active physical exertion. Energy depletes with repeated use. Effectiveness depends on physical conditioning and control. Multiple copies require significant mental focus to manage safely.

Additional Notes:
Originally stolen by All For One. True power emerges only when multiple copies combine.

cardPool.title: Leafipulation
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Leafipulation

Description:
The user manipulates leaves from nearby plant life, shaping and launching them as sharp projectiles. This Quirk grants control over vegetation in the immediate environment, turning natural foliage into weapons.

Functions/Applications:
Fire leaves as ranged attacks; create leaf shields for defense; strike multiple targets; scout using leaves as extensions of sight.

Limits:
User cannot generate leaves from their own body—must rely on existing plant sources. Ineffective in barren or urban environments lacking vegetation. Leaf projectiles lack stopping power. Range and potency depend on plant availability.

Additional Notes:
Best utilized in forests, gardens, or natural settings. Urban combat severely restricts effectiveness.

cardPool.title: Leap
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Leap

Description:
A mobility quirk granting extraordinary jumping distance and height. Provides landing cushioning during intentional jumps, negating fall damage. Requires solid ground.

Functions/Applications:
Execute massive jumps for traversal and evasion. Land from heights safely when activated. Clear obstacles and reach elevated positions.

Limits:
Requires stable ground—soft surfaces reduce effectiveness. Only cushions activated leaps, not accidental falls. User vulnerable to fall damage if knocked down without triggering the quirk.

Additional Notes:
Leap is pure mobility with defensive applications, not flight. Success depends on environmental conditions and timing activation before impact.

cardPool.title: Life Force
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Life Force

Description:
Doubles natural lifespan and slows aging dramatically. A 120-year-old user may appear only sixty.

Functions/Applications:
Grants extended longevity and youthful appearance for centuries. Can be duplicated and transferred to others.

Limits:
Cancellation causes rapid aging into decrepitude or death. Naturally reduces physical mobility and reflexes, making combat difficult.

Additional Notes:
Trades vitality for duration. Rapid aging upon cancellation is dangerous mid-conflict. Duplication requires mastery.

cardPool.title: Liquification
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Liquification

Description:
The user can transform their body into liquid at will, allowing them to flow and reshape themselves. This serves primarily as a defensive mechanism to avoid physical harm by becoming intangible to solid attacks.

Functions/Applications:
Evasion of melee and projectile attacks. Can be combined with other Quirks to amplify offense. Grants mobility through confined spaces by flowing through gaps.

Limits:
Cannot liquify selectively—entire body must transform or remain solid. Liquified form is vulnerable to elemental attacks like fire or freezing. Maintaining liquified state drains stamina. Cannot interact with solid objects while liquefied. Requires concentration to reform.

cardPool.title: Lizard
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Lizard

Description:
A reptilian transformation quirk granting scaled, lizard-like appearance with tail and forked tongue. The user gains enhanced resilience and accelerated healing.

Functions/Applications:
Provides superior endurance for extended combat and physical exertion. Enhanced regeneration allows faster wound recovery. Under Trigger drug influence, arms morph into pterosaur-like wings enabling sustained flight.

Limits:
Does not grant superhuman strength or speed without Trigger. Flight only possible under Trigger's effects. Reptilian form vulnerable to extreme temperatures. Trigger creates dependency and addiction risks.

Additional Notes:
Full capabilities remain unexplored. Forked tongue suggests enhanced sensory perception.

cardPool.title: Lock Down
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Lock Down

Description:
A spatial locking ability that freezes touched objects into a fixed point in space, rendering them completely immobile. Activation requires key-tooth-like protrusions extending from fingertips to make direct contact with the target.

Functions/Applications:
Immobilize environmental hazards, falling debris, and moving obstacles. Secure objects during combat or construction. Create barriers by locking structural elements.

Limits:
Cannot affect living beings or organic matter. Effectiveness decreases with object size and force. Requires direct finger contact to activate. Duration and energy cost scale with object mass.

Additional Notes:
Most effective against environmental hazards and inanimate objects. Works defensively but lacks offensive capability.

cardPool.title: Longbow
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name: Longbow

Description: The user transforms their left hand's thumb and pinky finger into a functional bow. Arrows fired possess absolute trajectory control and pierce-through power capable of penetrating vehicles. Projectiles can actively pursue moving targets.

Functions/Applications: Transform left hand into a ranged weapon for combat. Fire guided arrows to track targets. Penetrate fortified positions and vehicles.

Limits: User cannot generate ammunition and must rely on found arrows or makeshift projectiles. Only the left hand can form the bow, limiting versatility if injured or restrained.

Additional Notes: Strategic dependency on resource management makes this Quirk powerful in prepared engagements but vulnerable in prolonged conflicts.

cardPool.title: Longleg
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Longleg

Description:
A transformation Quirk that grants the ability to extend legs to extraordinary lengths. The limbs become elastic and elongated, allowing rapid travel and access to distant areas.

Functions/Applications:
Extended leg length enables fast movement, scaling structures, far-reaching kicks, and escaping confined spaces. The user can reach distant objects and traverse obstacles.

Limits:
Extension has a maximum range before instability. Overextension causes loss of balance and reduced effectiveness. The Quirk cannot function if legs are immobilized. Speed decreases with extension distance.

Additional Notes:
Effective for theft and reconnaissance. Works best in open environments. Usefulness diminishes in cramped spaces or against opponents who restrict movement.

cardPool.title: Mad Gluttony
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Mad Gluttony

Description:
A consumption-based Quirk granting a massive mouth in the stomach capable of rapidly inhaling, crushing, and destroying objects. When enhanced, additional mouths sprout across the body as prehensile, biting tendrils for ranged attacks and restraint.

Functions/Applications:
Devour solid materials at extreme speed. Deploy mouth-tendrils for offense, grappling, and bites. Inhale to create suction for environmental manipulation. Enhanced form provides combat versatility and crowd control.

Limits:
The stomach mouth has finite capacity and requires processing time. Tendrils are vulnerable to concentrated, powerful attacks—kinetic and impact damage are particularly effective. Requires close proximity for base form.

cardPool.title: Magnetism
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name: Magnetism

Description: The user magnetizes targets within a 4.5-meter radius by sex—men become south-aligned (blue aura), women north-aligned (red aura). Same-sex targets repel; opposite-sex targets attract. The user cannot be magnetized and cannot affect those outside range.

Functions/Applications: Launch allies between opposing polarities. Separate enemies by matching polarities. Pin or crush foes using attraction between opposite-polarized targets. Combine with external magnetic objects to amplify effects.

Limits: Only functions within 4.5 meters. User is immune to their own Quirk. Requires line of effect. Power scales with number of targets and drains focus with complex coordination. Metallic objects need external magnetism to interact.

cardPool.title: Metal Manipulation
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Metal Manipulation

Description:
Wolfram controls and reshapes pre-existing metal by touching it, causing his hand to glow with blue electrical energy. He bends metal into offensive and defensive structures.

Functions/Applications:
Creates iron pillars, walls, and cubes for attack or defense. Constructs fortifications and barriers. Excels in metal-rich environments.

Limits:
Requires pre-existing metal to function. Ineffective in metal-scarce areas and at close range. Strength depends on available metal quantity and quality.

Additional Notes:
Best used in industrial settings. Blue hand glow signals activation. Defensive structures withstand powerful physical attacks.

cardPool.title: Mimicry
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Mimicry

Description:
The user transfers consciousness and body into solid objects, controlling them as if they were their own physical form. Without enhancement, objects are limited to refrigerator-size; with Trigger drug, manipulation extends to entire structures and landscapes.

Functions/Applications:
Inhabit and animate solid matter for combat and mobility; reshape environments by twisting corridors and creating barriers; manifest body parts externally to perceive surroundings; launch attacks while remaining hidden inside objects.

Limits:
Perception severely limited without exposing body parts. Standard objects capped at refrigerator-size without Trigger enhancement. Emotional manipulation can force exposure. Direct damage to inhabited objects remains a threat.

cardPool.title: Mind Reaper
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Mind Reaper

Description:
Upon physical contact, Mind Reaper forces victims to involuntarily expose their deepest secrets and hidden truths through uncontrollable verbal disclosure.

Functions/Applications:
Extract concealed information. Incapacitate targets psychologically by revealing shameful secrets. Interrogate without traditional torture. Humiliate opponents.

Limits:
Requires direct physical touch. Strong-willed victims can resist, though the Quirk will reveal secrets less accurately with gaps. Exceptionally resolute individuals may resist entirely. Cannot force revelations the user doesn't suspect exist.

Additional Notes:
Effectiveness depends on victim's mental fortitude versus user's activation strength.

cardPool.title: Monster Cat (Quirk)
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Monster Cat

Description:
Monster Cat allows the user to merge with and control objects or machinery. The user can detach at will. Chemical boost enables control of large vehicles.

Functions/Applications:
Merge with objects to pilot them, assume their physical form, control movement completely, detach at any time, infiltrate or commandeer vehicles and devices.

Limits:
Cannot merge with living beings; detachment requires time and concentration; merged form limited by host object's durability; larger objects need significant power boost.

Additional Notes:
Monster Cat is non-humanoid, making stealth easier but limiting independent combat. Chemical enhancement increases control range and object size capacity.

cardPool.title: Monster Summon
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Monster Summon

Description:
Simon Gollini conjures eyeless, blob-like creatures with large mouths. Forms vary—bulky, multi-headed, winged, or resembling wyverns and dinosaurs. The mechanics are mysterious and possibly magical.

Functions/Applications:
Summon diverse monsters for combat, scouting, and overwhelming opponents. Each creature can be customized. Overmodification enables nearly limitless production for swarm tactics.

Limits:
Summoning requires focus and energy; sustained use causes fatigue. Creatures lack intelligence and need direction. Quantity and power are inversely balanced.

Additional Notes:
Effectiveness scales with Overmodification enhancement. Best in open terrain where swarms maneuver freely. Struggles against single powerful opponents or confined spaces.

cardPool.title: Mummification
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Mummification

Description:
Hoyo animates red bandages wrapped around his body to control inanimate objects, transforming them into humanoid mummy constructs that obey his commands. He can control dozens simultaneously.

Functions/Applications:
Animate objects into controllable mummy soldiers for combat. Indirectly control enemies by manipulating their clothing and equipment. Restrain targets through bandage entanglement.

Limits:
Cannot directly control living beings—only inanimate objects. Bandages break under sufficient force. Quirk deactivates if Hoyo is unconscious. Each mummy requires sustained focus to maintain.

Additional Notes:
Hoyo's strength lies in overwhelming numbers rather than raw power. Damage to bandages weakens his abilities.

cardPool.title: Muscle Augmentation
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Muscle Augmentation

Description:
The user amplifies and manipulates muscle fibers to achieve superhuman strength, speed, and durability. Muscle layers can protrude visibly or glow internally. Users can augment specific body parts and stack up to 12,000+ muscle layers for maximum effect.

Functions/Applications:
Grants immense physical strength capable of shattering cliffs. Enhanced speed allows blurred movement and attack avoidance. Muscle fibers act as natural armor absorbing impacts. Selective augmentation enables tactical flexibility. Can contend with top-tier power users.

Limits:
Depleted muscle fibers tear and rip away, leaving users temporarily vulnerable and weakened. Vibration-based attacks efficiently destroy multiple fiber strands.

cardPool.title: Muscle Expansion
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Muscle Expansion

Description:
The user can expand and strengthen their muscles at will, dramatically increasing physical power and size beyond normal human capability.

Functions/Applications:
Enhanced striking force, grappling power, and lifting capacity. Increased durability from muscle mass. Can be applied to specific body parts or full-body.

Limits:
Sustained expansion consumes stamina and causes fatigue. Overuse risks muscle strain. Expanded form is slower and less agile. Cannot be maintained indefinitely.

Additional Notes:
Best for close-range combat and heavy lifting. Poor against speed-based opponents. Requires activation time, leaving user vulnerable.

cardPool.title: Mushroom
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Mushroom

Description:
Kinoko Komori generates and spreads fungus spores from her body that rapidly grow into full-sized mushrooms upon contact with solid surfaces. Spore dispersal accelerates in high-humidity environments. Mushrooms persist for two to three hours before withering.

Functions/Applications:
Terrain control via rapid mushroom proliferation. Asphyxiation attacks by forcing mushroom growth in an opponent's throat. Area denial when combined with humidity spray bottles. Provides allies with cover or hiding spots.

Limits:
Spores indiscriminately affect all organisms, including allies, requiring pre-treatment with anti-fungal spray. Fungicides and ethanol neutralize spores. Fire destroys airborne spores. Dry environments reduce effectiveness.

cardPool.title: Mutant Bovini
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Mutant Bovini

Description:
A transformation quirk granting bovine facial features capable of emitting powerful directional energy beams from the face.

Functions/Applications:
The user fires lasers from their face in sustained or burst patterns for ranged combat and crowd control. Beams vary in intensity and can be aimed by turning the head.

Limits:
Sustained firing causes facial strain and overheating. Accuracy decreases at extreme ranges. The user cannot fire while moving without losing precision. Eyes and facial area are vulnerable pressure points.

Additional Notes:
This quirk suits offensive-focused fighters who position themselves strategically. Recovery time between volleys prevents overload. Close-range opponents pose tactical threats.

cardPool.title: Neutralization
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name: Neutralization

Description: A touch-based Quirk that temporarily nullifies a target's Quirk abilities through contact with the user's right hand, which glows bright light blue when activated. The glow's intensity and duration correlate with the target Quirk's power level. Can spread throughout the body if modified by external Quirk factors.

Functions/Applications: Suppresses active Quirks temporarily, allowing treatment of harmful Quirk side effects. Works through gloved contact. Can potentially render a target completely Quirkless with sufficient power or modification.

Limits: Taxing on the user when neutralizing powerful Quirks; prolonged use risks severe injury or death. Originally required right arm contact, creating vulnerability if disabled.

cardPool.title: Octopus
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Octopus

Description:
The user manifests eight elastic tentacle appendages with powerful suckers for gripping and climbing. They can expel ink clouds for concealment or offense.

Functions/Applications:
Tentacles provide exceptional reach, grappling strength, and dexterity. Suckers enable scaling vertical surfaces and restraining targets. Ink expulsion creates visual obstruction for escape or tactical advantage. Multiple appendages allow simultaneous actions.

Limits:
Tentacles tire with sustained exertion. Ink reserves are finite and must regenerate. Sucker adhesion weakens on dry surfaces. No enhanced speed or durability. Water environments may reduce ink effectiveness.

Additional Notes:
Best suited for close-quarters combat, reconnaissance, and environmental navigation.

cardPool.title: Overclock
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Overclock

Description:
A speedster Quirk that accelerates brain function and perception. User moves 3-10 times faster than normal, or dozens of times faster during adrenaline spikes. Heightened senses process ultra-fast input. Healing factor accelerates cellular growth to repair injuries or fuse biological material.

Functions/Applications:
Sprint at supersonic speeds to evade attacks. Read subconscious reactions to predict behavior. Heal wounds in seconds. Grow new limbs or fuse biological material.

Limits:
Severely limited by oxygen deprivation—usable only seconds before mandatory cooldown. Brain injury or oxygen starvation temporarily seals the Quirk. Intense focus drains activation time. Sustained use risks permanent lockout. Useless if airborne.

cardPool.title: Overhaul
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Overhaul

Description:
A deconstruction and reconstruction ability activated by bare-handed touch. The user instantly disassembles matter and reassembles it into original or new forms. A single finger contact triggers the effect.

Functions/Applications:
Reshape terrain into walls, spikes, and platforms for offense and defense. Merge separate objects or beings into hybrids. Heal injuries by reconstructing bodies. Extract components from targets. Dual-hand merging combines quirks from different subjects.

Limits:
Requires physical contact. Short cooldown between uses. Cannot function if arms are destroyed. Disassembly causes extreme pain to living subjects.

cardPool.title: Overmodification
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Overmodification

Description:
A perpetually active Quirk that amplifies other Quirks through physical contact. Hair turns black and rose petals bloom around the user. Compatible recipients gain boosted abilities or new powers; incompatible ones suffer severe pain and unconsciousness. Cannot be controlled or deactivated without a cancellation ability.

Functions/Applications:
Enhances compatible Quirks dramatically, sometimes granting new functions. Transforms weak single-target abilities into multi-target powers. Works through skin contact; effects persist and stack with repeated applications. Rose petals indicate compatibility or rejection.

Limits:
Compatibility is rare and unpredictable. Incompatible contact causes severe backlash pain.

cardPool.title: Pain Blocker
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Pain Blocker

Description:
The user becomes unable to sense pain from any source. This allows them to sustain massive damage without distraction. With practice, the quirk can be toggled on and off for precise control.

Functions/Applications:
The user can withstand extreme attacks including intense heat and blunt force trauma while fighting at full capacity. Injuries that would incapacitate normal fighters become obstacles. Combined with durability or endurance quirks, the user gains significant combat advantage.

Limits:
Pain blocking does not prevent actual damage—injuries still accumulate. This risks death from unnoticed critical damage. The quirk requires active concentration; sudden shocks may reactivate pain sensation.

cardPool.title: Permeation
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Permeation

Description:
The user phases their body through matter by rendering themselves intangible. They can selectively phase individual body parts or their entire form, allowing passage through obstacles and evasion of attacks. Mastery requires intense concentration and training.

Functions/Applications:
Phase through walls and solid objects. Dodge incoming attacks by becoming intangible. Perform combat maneuvers by phasing body parts independently. Navigate unrestricted by physical barriers.

Limits:
Clothing and carried objects slip off unless made from user's hair. Full-body phasing negates all senses except falling sensation, causing disorientation. Cannot extend phasing to others. Ineffective against sudden attacks.

cardPool.title: Plant
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Plant

Description:
The user transforms body parts into living plant structures including vines, roots, and flora with regenerative properties that can mend wounds in allies through contact or proximity.

Functions/Applications:
Transform limbs into vines for restraint; sprout roots for stability and movement; generate healing flora to restore ally health; create plant barriers for defense.

Limits:
Transformations consume stamina and require concentration. Plant structures are vulnerable to fire, ice, and toxins. Healing is limited by user's vitality. Extended transformation causes fatigue. User must remain conscious to sustain growth.

Additional Notes:
Most effective in natural environments with soil and sunlight. Better for supporting teammates than direct combat.

cardPool.title: Playtime
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Playtime

Description:
A transformation quirk that enlarges the user to gigantic proportions while darkening their skin, manifesting an extra pair of arms, and regressing their intellect to childlike behavior.

Functions/Applications:
Grants immense size and strength. Extra limbs enable multi-directional attacks. Regressed mental state removes inhibitions, making the user unpredictable and fearless.

Limits:
Full capabilities poorly understood. Intelligence regression removes tactical thinking, leaving the user vulnerable to cunning opponents. Size restricts mobility in confined spaces. Requires Trigger enhancement.

Additional Notes:
Whether the transformation is natural or Trigger-induced remains unclear.

cardPool.title: Pliabody
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Pliabody

Description:
A transformation quirk allowing the user to stretch and flatten their body at will, granting superhuman flexibility and elasticity. The body becomes malleable like clay for compression, extension, and reshaping.

Functions/Applications:
Combat evasion through body deformation. Restraining opponents by wrapping around limbs or torso. Navigation through tight spaces. Enhanced grappling and unconventional positioning.

Limits:
Cannot stretch beyond 2-3 times normal body length. Extreme flattening reduces combat effectiveness and increases vulnerability. Requires conscious control—panic or unconsciousness reverts the body to normal form. Sharp weapons still cause injury.

Additional Notes:
Most effective in rescue and reconnaissance.

cardPool.title: Pointer
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Pointer

Description:
A navigational quirk that allows the user to locate people, places, and things. The user's limbs act as directional indicators, pointing toward desired targets with accuracy.

Functions/Applications:
The user must spin in place to activate the quirk. Once activated, their arms and legs point toward up to three different targets simultaneously. Useful for tracking, navigation, rescue operations, and locating objectives.

Limits:
The user can only point toward three directions at once. Activation requires a full spin, creating vulnerability during combat. The quirk only works for consciously sought targets.

Additional Notes:
Best used for preparation and scouting rather than active combat. Works as support for team operations and navigation challenges.

cardPool.title: Poison Gas
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Poison Gas

Description:
Takeshi Bushijima continuously generates toxic fog from his body that causes illness. Unreleased poison accumulates within him, poisoning his own body if buildup exceeds critical limits.

Functions/Applications:
Creates noxious clouds to incapacitate enemies through inhalation. Can be withheld temporarily to protect bystanders, though prolonged retention damages the user. The gas is highly flammable and ignites when exposed to combustion.

Limits:
Generates involuntarily with no on-off switch. User must periodically release toxins or suffer severe health degradation. Unusable in crowded areas without harming innocents. Combustion destroys the gas entirely.

Additional Notes:
Takeshi must balance offense with self-preservation.

cardPool.title: Poltergeist
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Poltergeist

Description:
A telekinetic Quirk granting the ability to mentally manipulate objects and people within close proximity with precise control over multiple targets simultaneously.

Functions/Applications:
The user can lift and move swarms of objects to barrage opponents, restrain people through telekinetic force, and create coordinated movement patterns. Excels at area control and multi-target offense.

Limits:
Maximum weight is approximately that of a single adult human (roughly 62 kg or 137 lbs). Only functions on objects and people in close proximity. Precise range and maximum object count remain unclear.

Additional Notes:
Requires significant mental focus to manage multiple targets. Fatigue from sustained use or managing numerous objects impacts performance.

cardPool.title: Polygraph
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Polygraph

Description:
Allows the user to detect truth and falsehood through direct physical contact. Green-yellow lightning sparks from the user's hands reveal speech authenticity.

Functions/Applications:
Interrogation of suspects and witnesses. Detection of deception in negotiations. Verification of claims during combat.

Limits:
Requires unbroken physical contact to function. Vulnerable to technicalities and precise wording. Cannot detect lies about intentions, only spoken falsehoods. Targets may bypass using subjective truths.

Additional Notes:
Most effective in controlled environments. Unreliable against opponents who exploit semantic loopholes. The sparking effect may alert targets they're being scanned.

cardPool.title: Pop Off
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Pop Off

Description:
The user produces sticky spheres from their scalp that can be plucked painlessly and regrow instantly. These spheres adhere to any surface except the user's own body. Water does not diminish their adhesive properties.

Functions/Applications:
Launch spheres as projectiles to restrain opponents or bind weapons. Construct traps and obstacle courses. Use spheres as bouncing platforms to traverse terrain. Chain spheres together as whip-like weapons.

Limits:
Adhesive strength depends on health and physical condition, lasting hours to a day when rested but weakening when exhausted. Rapid removal causes scalp bleeding and limits output. Spheres do not stick to the user. The ability requires close proximity and is unsuitable for long-distance engagement.

cardPool.title: Power Stock
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Power Stock

Description:
A meta ability that stockpiles raw power and speed through training. Users can release accumulated energy in devastating bursts. The quirk grows exponentially stronger when transferred between users, with each successor building upon previous generations' stockpiled strength.

Functions/Applications:
Users channel accumulated power into explosive bursts of strength and speed. Power grows stronger with each transfer, creating a compounding effect. Users can apply power selectively to specific limbs or across their entire body. With sufficient training, users can combine Power Stock with other quirks to exceed normal limitations.

Limits:
Power Stock requires extensive training to safely control; excessive output causes severe injury.

cardPool.title: Propagation
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Propagation

Description:
The user can grow and duplicate body parts across their form, multiplying them at will. Power scales proportionally with duplicates—three duplicates yield triple strength. Pairs dangerously with regenerative abilities.

Functions/Applications:
Duplicate limbs for enhanced striking force and combat versatility. Create fused composite forms by merging duplicates. Generate independent mini-entities from duplicate cells for autonomous action. Stack duplicates for exponential power increases.

Limits:
Power gain is linear and dependent on duplicate count. Requires significant biological mass; overextension causes resource depletion. Mini-entities are individually weaker and vulnerable to dispersal. User stamina and durability apply.

cardPool.title: Quad Arms
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Quad Arms

Description:
Grants the user a second pair of functional arms. The extra appendages are fully capable and proportional, enabling multi-tasking and enhanced physical combat.

Functions/Applications:
Wield multiple weapons simultaneously; perform manual tasks at double speed; execute advanced grappling combinations in combat; gain positional advantage through increased attack angles.

Limits:
Requires conscious control of all four arms—divided attention reduces effectiveness. Strength is distributed across limbs rather than concentrated. Standard two-armed equipment becomes cumbersome.

Additional Notes:
Best utilized by trained combatants. Psychological adjustment needed to avoid arm interference. Most effective in close-range engagements with simultaneous attacks.

cardPool.title: Rabbit
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Rabbit

Description:
A transformation quirk granting rabbit-like anatomy and heightened animal instincts. The user develops functional rabbit features including long ears, powerful hind legs, and fluffy tail, along with enhanced sensory perception and survival awareness.

Functions/Applications:
Enhanced hearing and smell detect distant threats. Powerful leg muscles enable rapid bouncing and devastating kicks. Ground stomps generate wind pressure strong enough to disperse fire. Rabbit instincts provide automatic danger awareness in combat.

Limits:
Power is primarily lower-body focused. Enhanced senses vulnerable to overload. Bouncing restricted in tight spaces. User vulnerable to attacks targeting ears or tail.

cardPool.title: Razor Sharp
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Razor Sharp

Description:
The user generates sharp blades of varying shapes and sizes from any body part. These blades are composed of an unknown material strong enough to cut steel and withstand explosions, serving as both offensive and defensive tools.

Functions/Applications:
Blades can be produced from forearms, feet, or any body part as needed. The user controls blade geometry and deployment in real-time, allowing simultaneous offense and defense.

Limits:
Blade generation requires conscious effort and energy expenditure. Sustained combat depletes stamina. The user must be within melee range, and blades cannot be thrown or separated from the body.

Additional Notes:
Best suited for close-quarters combat specialists.

cardPool.title: Reflect
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Reflect

Description:
An always-active Quirk that absorbs incoming energy and rebounds it in spiraling waves. The user's skin glows blue during use. Reflects all contact indiscriminately, preventing physical touch and causing blindness from light reflection without special eye masks.

Functions/Applications:
Automatic defense against melee and ranged attacks. Reflected energy can be redirected through technology to alter trajectory or enable flight. Works best with stationary positioning and external firepower.

Limits:
Stamina drains proportionally to reflected energy strength. Cannot be disabled, eliminating all physical contact and emotional bonds. Light reflection blinds the user without protective gear. Overloads under relentless powerful attacks.

cardPool.title: Rewind
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Rewind

Description:
A rare mutant Quirk allowing the user to reverse a living being's body to a previous physical state. Activation causes a small horn on the forehead to grow and glow brightly. The power can theoretically rewind a target back to non-existence, making it exceptionally dangerous.

Functions/Applications:
Restores injured bodies to pre-injury states, heals wounds and broken limbs, reverses genetic modifications, and can restore erased Quirks. User can consciously control which targets are affected through training. Effective range requires close proximity or physical contact.

Limits:
Only affects living things; cannot rewind objects or non-organic matter. Requires accumulation of "Rewind Energy" to activate; once used, the horn shrinks and must recharge.

cardPool.title: Rifle
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Rifle

Description:
Kaina can extrude a functional rifle from her right elbow that fires ammunition crafted from her own hair. The weapon operates silently using organic muscle and bone propulsion rather than gunpowder. She manifests a flesh tendril scope for precision targeting and can increase output power at the cost of jamming risk.

Functions/Applications:
Fire custom hair-bullets up to 3km with superior penetration and no audible report. Mold hair into specialized rounds: hollow-point, tracking, or curved trajectory variants. Bullets are reusable and caseless. Increase firepower for devastating shots. Deploy flesh scope for enhanced accuracy.

Limits:
Hair length determines ammunition capacity. Individual round loading creates reload delays.

cardPool.title: Rivet
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Rivet

Description:
A transformation quirk enabling the user to generate metallic rivet-like growths from their arms. These hardened projectiles can be expelled with force or extended as defensive protrusions.

Functions/Applications:
The user launches rivets as high-velocity projectiles for ranged attacks or extends them along their arms for melee enhancement. The growths provide armor-like protection and aid climbing.

Limits:
Rivet generation depletes stamina with each use and is limited to the arms. Once expelled, rivets take time to regrow. The quirk offers no protection against quirks that bypass physical defense.

Additional Notes:
A straightforward combat quirk for aggressive fighters. Effectiveness diminishes in prolonged battles due to stamina drain.

cardPool.title: Sandstorm
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Sandstorm

Description:
The user transforms their upper body into manipulable sand, gaining a fluid, shapeshifting form. This grants enhanced adaptability and the ability to reform after damage, making them difficult to restrain.

Functions/Applications:
Transform limbs into sand constructs for attacking and defending. Manipulate sand to shield against strikes or restrain opponents. Exploit fluidity to slip free from contact-dependent Quirks.

Limits:
Provides no defense against area-of-effect attacks. Cannot protect the lower body or head. Sand form is vulnerable to blunt force trauma and extreme pressure. Requires concentration to maintain shapes; rapid shifting drains stamina.

Additional Notes:
Most effective against contact-dependent Quirks.

cardPool.title: Scalemail
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Scalemail

Description:
The user's body generates sharp, dark red armored scales covering their skin for enhanced defense and strength. Activation causes bleeding as scales rupture through skin, making deployment painful.

Functions/Applications:
Deploy scales across the body or selectively on specific areas for increased durability against physical attacks. Grants moderate strength enhancement.

Limits:
Scales shatter under sustained high-force impact. Generating armor causes pain and bleeding with each activation. Repeated use risks severe blood loss and exhaustion.

Additional Notes:
This Quirk was stolen and implanted by All For One, suggesting different performance in its original owner.

cardPool.title: Scales
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Scales

Description:
The user generates hard, sharp reptilian scales across their body for protection and ranged attacks. Scale production requires adequate collagen and calcium intake. Scales are sharp enough to cut through vines and damage metal.

Functions/Applications:
Deploy scales as full-body armor for damage mitigation. Launch individual scales as cutting projectiles at medium to long range. Switch between melee and ranged combat. Scales can be stored in specialized gauntlets for rapid-fire attacks.

Limits:
Scales break easily under sufficient force, providing inferior protection compared to hardening quirks. Continuous production depletes collagen and calcium reserves. Projectile accuracy depends on user skill and line of sight.

cardPool.title: Scatter
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Scatter

Description:
A stolen Quirk allowing the user to split and multiply projectiles mid-flight, expanding coverage area and destructive potential. Transforms focused attacks into devastating dispersed barrages.

Functions/Applications:
Multiplies incoming or outgoing projectiles into numerous smaller ones across a wider radius. Increases range and impact area of long-range attacks. Can combine with other Quirks like Reflect to redirect and amplify enemy fire.

Limits:
Requires projectiles to function—cannot create attacks from nothing. Multiplied projectiles are individually weaker than the original. Does not enhance melee combat. Effectiveness diminishes against mobile targets.

Additional Notes:
Best utilized in mid-to-long range engagements.

cardPool.title: Serpentress
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Serpentress

Description:
The user possesses three living serpents integrated into their hair as biological extensions. These snakes possess heightened sensory perception, allowing detection of hidden targets and disaster victims beyond normal human limits.

Functions/Applications:
The snakes scout ahead and sense concealed individuals or survivors in dangerous environments. They enable rapid victim location during rescue operations and provide reconnaissance advantages. The snakes move independently under the user's control while remaining part of their body.

Limits:
The snakes cannot be separated from the user's body for extended periods. Detection range is constrained by sensory reach, and they cannot pierce physical barriers like dense earth or sealed structures.

cardPool.title: Shoulder-Mounted Jets
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Shoulder-Mounted Jets

Description:
Four retractable jet boosters on the user's upper back enable high-speed flight with powerful thrust. Sustained control requires significant effort and coordination.

Functions/Applications:
Grants speed-boosted flight for traversal and aerial combat positioning. Jets deploy or retract at will for quick escapes or pursuit. Works with other quirks to stabilize mid-air maneuvers.

Limits:
Flight lacks precise maneuverability without additional support. User needs arms or other abilities to maintain balance during extended flight. Stamina-dependent. Ineffective while restrained.

Additional Notes:
Most effective when paired with stabilizing or manipulative abilities. Boosters are durable but vulnerable to direct damage.

cardPool.title: Slice
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Slice

Description:
The user can move, harden, and sharpen their own hair at will, transforming it into a weapon and tool. Hair can be weaponized as blades, fired as projectiles, or used defensively as shields and mobility aids.

Functions/Applications:
Offensive strikes using hardened hair as cutting blades; launching hair strands as projectiles; defensive barriers and shields; parrying attacks; mobility enhancement using hair as stilts or climbing aids.

Limits:
Hair is vulnerable to corrosive substances and extreme heat. Reduced hair length decreases effectiveness and range. Hair cannot be regrown mid-combat. Requires conscious control to harden and shape, limiting reaction speed.

Additional Notes:
Slice excels in close-to-mid-range combat with strong defensive utility.

cardPool.title: Smokescreen
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Smokescreen

Description:
The user generates thick purple smoke from their body that spreads across wide areas to obscure vision and disorient opponents. The smoke can be emitted as a breath weapon. Enhanced through One For All, making it denser and more expansive than the original version.

Functions/Applications:
Creates visual obstruction to hide movements, catch enemies by surprise, or guide them toward desired locations. Can be combined with other abilities for tactical advantage. Useful for reconnaissance and escape.

Limits:
No offensive damage capability. Loses effectiveness in humid or rainy environments. Powerful shockwaves dispel the smoke. Excessive release can disorient the user and obscure their own vision and movement.

cardPool.title: Snip Clip
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Snip Clip

Description:
The user can cut through nearly any material by placing it between their index and middle fingers, then performing a scissor motion. The cutting force is proportional to the user's strength. Larger cuts are possible when material is positioned between the user's legs.

Functions/Applications:
Precision cutting of objects, armor, and structural materials. Can disable mechanical suits by severing limbs or joints. Works on organic and inorganic matter.

Limits:
Space between fingers restricts what can be cut to thin or narrow objects. Larger cuts require repositioning between the legs, leaving the user vulnerable. Cannot cut beyond physical reach. Effectiveness depends on strength and leverage.

cardPool.title: Softening
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Softening

Description:
Juzo Honenuki transforms solid objects into semi-liquid mud through touch, then reverts them with a second touch. Works on ice, metal, stone, and structures but not living beings. Softened materials trap and sink anything on them.

Functions/Applications:
Creates environmental traps by softening ground or structures. Restricts enemy mobility and controls battle positioning. Allows rapid traversal or escape through softened material. Neutralizes solid-based attacks.

Limits:
Cannot affect living organisms. Targets with propulsion abilities can escape softened traps. All softened objects revert if Juzo loses consciousness. Requires direct physical contact to activate and deactivate.

Additional Notes:
Pairs with Juzo's reflexes for defensive countering.

cardPool.title: Solid Air
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Solid Air

Description:
The user solidifies air through breath to create floating constructs—walls, platforms, and barriers—that remain suspended without support. These barriers are soundproof, blocking voice-based abilities and external noise. Durability scales with lung capacity and training.

Functions/Applications:
Create defensive walls and platforms for mobility or protection. Form soundproof enclosures to contain or isolate targets. Shape constructs by hand-shaping exhaled air. Counter sound-dependent quirks with solidified barriers.

Limits:
Breakable by sufficient physical force. Maximum construct size limited by lung capacity; prolonged use causes fatigue. Cannot create animated or mobile constructs.

cardPool.title: Somnambulist
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Somnambulist

Description:
The user exudes a sleep-inducing lavender-purple aroma that renders targets unconscious. The fragrance is more potent against males than females. Sufficient inhalation causes deep slumber, making close-range combat hazardous for opponents.

Functions/Applications:
Release aroma passively or actively to incapacitate enemies at medium range. Use hand fans to spread and direct the fragrance with greater accuracy and distance. Effective for crowd control and subduing opponents. Can be concentrated for stronger effect on resistant targets.

Limits:
Requires exposed skin; tight clothing reduces effectiveness. Air-filtering masks or mouth covering avoid the aroma entirely. Less effective against female targets unless concentrated.

cardPool.title: Spray Art
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Spray Art

Description:
The user generates colorful spray paint clouds that induce mild hallucinations. By wielding spray paint cans, they release massive paint clouds similar to smoke that linger until dispersed or the user is incapacitated.

Functions/Applications:
Create disorienting illusions to confuse enemies and obscure vision. Control cloud duration and deployment area. Useful for escape, misdirection, or area denial.

Limits:
The user must have spray paint cans available. Hallucinations are only mild. Clouds dissipate if the user is immobilized or unconscious. The Quirk affects allies and enemies alike. Effectiveness diminishes against those with strong mental resistance.

Additional Notes:
This Quirk emphasizes battlefield control and confusion over direct damage.

cardPool.title: Squirmy Fingers
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Squirmy Fingers

Description:
The user gains supernatural control over their fingers, allowing them to bend and manipulate them in any direction with perfect precision. This grants exceptional dexterity far beyond normal human capability.

Functions/Applications:
Craft intricate mechanisms and detailed work with unmatched speed. Manipulate small objects with flawless control. Pick locks and perform delicate assembly tasks impossible for ordinary hands.

Limits:
Only affects the user's fingers and cannot extend beyond the hands. Requires direct physical contact with objects. Provides no offensive combat capability.

Additional Notes:
Best suited for crafting and engineering support roles rather than direct combat.

cardPool.title: Static
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Static

Description:
By rubbing their body to generate friction, the user accumulates electrical charge. They can discharge electrical currents in controlled bursts, though power remains modest compared to developed electrical quirks.

Functions/Applications:
The user builds up electrical energy through friction, then releases it as a shock for stunning, repelling, or disorienting targets. Useful for short-range combat and defense.

Limits:
Requires active charging time—cannot generate charge instantly. Output damage is weak against heavy armor. Extended use causes fatigue. Wet conditions neutralize effectiveness.

Additional Notes:
This quirk demands tactical patience and preparation rather than spontaneous activation.

cardPool.title: Steel
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Steel

Description:
The user transforms their entire body into steel, becoming a nigh-impenetrable living weapon. This dramatically increases physical strength to superhuman levels and provides exceptional resistance to physical damage, extreme cold, and moderate heat with training.

Functions/Applications:
Steel allows the user to withstand bullets, blades, and extreme cold without injury. Enhanced strength enables breaking through obstacles and delivering powerful strikes. The user can serve as a human shield. Iron intake extends duration and potency.

Limits:
Prolonged use causes iron fatigue, reducing hardness until deactivation is necessary. Steel has a hardness ceiling that cannot be improved through training.

cardPool.title: Stock
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Stock

Description:
A storage-based quirk that allows the user to absorb incoming attacks and convert them into physical lumps on their back. These stored attacks can be released at will for tactical flexibility and counteroffensive capability.

Functions/Applications:
The user devours incoming attacks to absorb their energy, manifesting as lumps on their back. When needed, a lump detaches and floats toward the user's face before releasing the absorbed attack at an opponent.

Limits:
Storage capacity is limited by the number of lumps the user can grow on their back. The floating lump requires time to position before releasing, making it vulnerable to interruption. Attacks must make direct contact to be absorbed.

cardPool.title: Strongarm
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Strongarm

Description:
Shoulders rotate at superhuman speeds, enabling rapid, powerful punches in quick succession with immense force.

Functions/Applications:
Rapid-fire punching combinations effective for close-range combat and penetrating defenses through accumulated strike trauma.

Limits:
Usable for only a few seconds before muscle fatigue sets in. Cannot break through absolute barrier-type Quirks. Requires recovery time between uses.

Additional Notes:
Best suited for short, explosive engagements. User must manage stamina carefully to avoid physical incapacity mid-combat.

cardPool.title: Sugar Rush
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Sugar Rush

Description:
By consuming sugar, Rikido multiplies his physical strength five-fold for three minutes per ten grams ingested. His body visibly bulks up during activation.

Functions/Applications:
Ideal for breaking through obstacles, overpowering opponents, and heavy lifting. Rikido carries granulated sugar in belt pouches for quick activation.

Limits:
Requires sugar consumption to activate. Causes severe hypoglycemia: lowered intelligence and lethargy during the boost. Cannot be sustained without additional sugar. Becomes unable to execute complex strategies while empowered.

Additional Notes:
Rikido's weightlifting regimen maximizes his Quirk's potency.

cardPool.title: Suicide Bomb
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Suicide Bomb

Description:
