A volatile Quirk generating devastating explosions centered on the user's body. Creates massive destructive force capable of razing areas and can be triggered by will or external sources.

Functions/Applications:
Deploy large-scale area-denial explosions for combat or destruction. Functions as both offensive weapon and defensive measure. External triggers like intense heat can activate detonations involuntarily.

Limits:
The user is vulnerable to their own explosions and can suffer lethal damage. Fire-based Quirks risk accidental detonation. Outside-triggered detonations appear uncontrollable.

Additional Notes:
Represents extreme danger to user and environment. Most effective as a last-stand tactic.

cardPool.title: Super Regeneration
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Super Regeneration

Description:
A rare artificially engineered Quirk enabling rapid regeneration of physical damage including severed limbs and catastrophic wounds, making users exceptionally difficult to permanently disable through conventional injury.

Functions/Applications:
The user recovers from nearly any physical trauma—burns, lacerations, amputation, blunt force damage—as long as their brain remains active. Regeneration speed scales with physical condition.

Limits:
Cannot heal cauterized wounds, spiritual damage, or Quirk Factor damage. Regeneration requires active brain function; unconsciousness or brain destruction halts healing. Damage faster than regeneration speed will overwhelm the user. Complete incineration or molecular disintegration bypasses regeneration.

cardPool.title: Swan
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Swan

Description:
The user manifests two large, pristine white wings resembling a swan's on their back, enabling aerial locomotion with grace and speed.

Functions/Applications:
Flight across distances and terrain. Enhanced mobility for escape, pursuit, or reconnaissance. Wings generate significant wind gusts when deployed.

Limits:
Flight requires the user to strip naked, as clothing weight prevents takeoff. Wings are vulnerable to damage during flight, leaving the user defenseless if injured mid-air.

Additional Notes:
The quirk's awkward activation requirement makes it impractical in combat or emergencies. Best suited for scouting or travel in private settings. The user's nakedness creates tactical disadvantages.

cardPool.title: Sword Kill
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Sword Kill

Description:
The user generates flexible, accordion-like swords from their arms and shoulders that extend and retract at will. When enhanced by Trigger, the Quirk produces up to six blades simultaneously, including from the mouth, and the user's face becomes serpentine.

Functions/Applications:
Deploy multiple melee weapons for combat versatility and defense. Extended blades allow mid-range strikes while maintaining close-quarters capability. Trigger enhancement multiplies offensive potential.

Limits:
Base form limited to two primary swords. Continuous blade generation taxes stamina. Trigger dependence creates vulnerability without enhancement. Accordion flexibility reduces blade rigidity.

cardPool.title: Tape
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name: Tape

Description: The user's elbows function as biological tape dispensers, ejecting strong adhesive tape of variable length and thickness. The tape supports body weight and restrains opponents but breaks under extreme force. Continuous overuse causes dry skin irritation.

Functions/Applications: Fire tape strands for binding targets; swing or rappel using anchored tape; create traps and blockades; shoot multiple strands; produce double-sided tape; craft improvised tools; coordinate with allies for combo effects.

Limits: Finite tape supply per cycle. Tape breaks under sufficient stress. Overuse causes skin degradation. User must manually cut tape to reset firing. Ineffective against non-adhesive surfaces.

Additional Notes: Most effective at medium range.

cardPool.title: Telekinesis
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Telekinesis

Description:
A mental power granting the ability to move and manipulate inanimate objects through force of will alone, without physical contact.

Functions/Applications:
Move objects across distances, construct barriers or projectiles in combat, solve environmental puzzles, lift multiple items simultaneously.

Limits:
Only affects inanimate objects. Control becomes difficult with larger or heavier objects. Requires concentration. Cannot be used while unconscious or mentally incapacitated.

Additional Notes:
Power scales significantly when enhanced through Overmodification. Versatility makes it effective in combat and utility roles, though output depends on the user's mental fortitude and focus.

cardPool.title: Telepath
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Telepath

Description:
One-way telepathic ability to broadcast thoughts directly into others' minds. Can target individuals or groups across considerable distances.

Functions/Applications:
Send tactical instructions during combat. Broadcast warnings across large areas. Distract enemies with disorienting messages to create attack openings.

Limits:
Communication is one-way; cannot receive responses. Limited effective range. Cannot force actions, only deliver messages. Overuse or contacting many people simultaneously causes mental strain.

Additional Notes:
Effective for battlefield coordination and psychological tactics. Useless against deaf or mentally shielded opponents. Works best paired with combat abilities or team strategies.

cardPool.title: Teleportation
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Teleportation

Description:
Gil Gollini instantly moves himself and anything he touches to any location within his line of sight. Enhanced through Overmodification, activation speed becomes dramatically faster.

Functions/Applications:
Repositioning in combat or exploration. Transport of allies and objects by contact. Rapid escape from danger. Near-instantaneous consecutive teleports when overmodified.

Limits:
User must maintain clear line of sight to destination. Cannot teleport outside visual range. Vision obstruction leaves user vulnerable.

Additional Notes:
Strength lies in mobility and unpredictability. Weakness exploitable through vision denial. Overmodification increases effectiveness but strains the user.

cardPool.title: Telescopic
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Telescopic

Description:
The user rapidly retracts body parts into themselves like a turtle. Retraction is nearly instantaneous for evasion, but unretracting takes several seconds and leaves them vulnerable.

Functions/Applications:
Defensive evasion against projectiles and melee attacks; quick dodge-and-counter tactics; protection from piercing or cutting damage while retracted.

Limits:
Unretracting is slow and exposes the user. Cannot retract selectively—must withdraw entire body or specific limbs at once. Ineffective against area-of-effect attacks. User remains conscious but unable to act offensively while retracted.

Additional Notes:
Best suited for defensive combat roles requiring quick reflexes. Works well with counterattack strategies.

cardPool.title: Tidal Bore
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Tidal Bore

Description:
The user expels massive quantities of water from their mouth with tremendous force, capable of manipulating heavy objects and creating destructive floods.

Functions/Applications:
Generate powerful water jets to lift or push heavy objects. Create widespread flooding to disrupt terrain and enemies. Use water discharge as offensive blast or defensive barrier. Output scales with emotional state and intensifies around favorite foods.

Limits:
Water generation drains stamina quickly with prolonged use. The quirk activates involuntarily around favorite foods, causing indiscriminate flooding and loss of directional control. Effectiveness reduces in arid environments. Water originates from the mouth, limiting range.

cardPool.title: Toho
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name: Toho

Description: Grants kaiju-like attributes, transforming the user into a massive reptilian creature with enormous size, superhuman strength, and scaled skin.

Functions/Applications: Devastating melee combat; intimidation through monstrous appearance; crushing objects and structures; enhanced durability; living siege weapon.

Limits: Extreme size prevents stealth and confined spaces; high energy consumption; slow movement; vulnerable to agility tactics; psychological strain.

Additional Notes: Transformation appears permanent or semi-permanent. Effectiveness scales with physical conditioning and combat experience. Best for direct assault roles.

cardPool.title: Tongue Tank
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Tongue Tank

Description:
The user's tongue transforms into a retractable tank cannon housed within their mouth. When the mouth opens, the tongue-cannon extends and fires hard, rock-like projectiles. The ammunition generation mechanism is unclear.

Functions/Applications:
Fires projectile attacks at moderate to long range by opening the mouth. Useful for ranged combat, area denial, and breaking obstacles. The cannon retracts for protection when not in use.

Limits:
Projectile capacity and firing rate unknown. Must open mouth to fire, creating predictable patterns. Close-quarters combat severely hampered. Mouth remains vulnerable.

Additional Notes:
Quirk manifests in young users, suggesting development potential.

cardPool.title: Transforming Arms
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Transforming Arms

Description:
The user reshapes their arms at will, extending them elastically for long-range strikes or splitting them to attack simultaneously. Arms can enlarge, harden, or transform into different shapes to suit combat needs.

Functions/Applications:
Stretch arms to grab distant targets. Enlarge fists for power. Split arms to strike multiple directions. Transform arms into alternative shapes like wings for mobility. Combine with other Quirks for hybrid combat.

Limits:
Rigid fighting styles create lag between transformation and execution. Transformation speed drains stamina with extended use. Arm durability decreases when stretched thin or spread.

Additional Notes:
Most effective with flexible, unconventional fighting styles.

cardPool.title: Trap Flex
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Trap Flex

Description:
The user can flex their trapezius muscles to extraordinary degrees, allowing their shoulders to expand and envelop their head. This grants enhanced speed and strength beyond normal human capability.

Functions/Applications:
Provides boosts to physical speed and striking power. The expanded shoulder coverage offers partial defensive protection for the head and neck. Useful for close-quarters combat and evasive maneuvers.

Limits:
Strength output is modest compared to dedicated strength Quirks. Continuous flexing causes fatigue. Head protection is incomplete, leaving the back vulnerable.

Additional Notes:
Best suited for hit-and-run tactics rather than prolonged brawls. Works optimally with tactical positioning and speed-based strategies.

cardPool.title: Tree Frog
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Tree Frog

Description:
A frog-type Quirk granting an extendable, curling tongue and webbed fingers. The user develops tadpole-like features suited for climbing and aquatic environments.

Functions/Applications:
The tongue enables grappling and object manipulation with adhesive climbing properties. Webbed fingers enhance swimming and grip on wet surfaces. The user gains improved agility in arboreal and aquatic settings.

Limits:
Minimal tongue extension limits reach. Effectiveness diminishes in dry environments; requires moisture for optimal performance. Cannot compete with specialized amphibian Quirks in combat.

Additional Notes:
Tree Frog is utility-focused for mobility and environmental adaptation.

cardPool.title: Vibration Detection
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Vibration Sense

Description:
The user perceives surroundings through detection of subtle vibrations in air and matter, functioning as sensory replacement similar to echolocation. This compensates for visual impairment by mapping spatial awareness through vibration patterns.

Functions/Applications:
The user can navigate complex environments, detect nearby objects and beings, track movement through tremors, and identify threats in darkness, allowing combat awareness without sight.

Limits:
Cannot penetrate vibration-dampening materials like thick stone. Requires environments where vibrations propagate; silence or dampening fields severely limit effectiveness. Cannot discern fine details like facial features or colors.

cardPool.title: Vines
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Vines

Description:
The user's hair transforms into controllable, thorny vines capable of piercing skin and cutting concrete. They are non-conductive to electricity.

Functions/Applications:
Vines can restrain opponents, grapple distant objects, form barriers, and be severed as weapons. Thorns inflict cutting damage. The user gains electrical resistance.

Limits:
Vines require cutting to regenerate and depend on sunlight and water for strength. Extended use without these resources weakens them. Vines remain anchored to the user's head.

Additional Notes:
A versatile middle-range Quirk effective for offense and defense. Users should position themselves in well-lit, moist environments for sustained effectiveness.

cardPool.title: Viral Cosmos
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Viral Cosmos

Description:
Two flowers grow from the user's head and generate endless petals that can be hurled as projectile weapons to inflict damage on impact.

Functions/Applications:
Throw petals as ranged attacks. Adjust velocity and volume for different situations. Continuous generation allows sustained offense without ammunition limits.

Limits:
Petals lose effectiveness over distance. Flowers can be targeted and damaged. Petal attacks deal moderate damage. User cannot control trajectory mid-flight.

Additional Notes:
Best for ranged harassment and mid-range combat. Vulnerable to fire attacks and environmental hazards. Less effective in confined spaces.

cardPool.title: Voice
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name: Voice

Description: A sonic amplification Quirk that projects voice at devastating volumes and frequencies, generating high-pitched sounds capable of rupturing eardrums and incapacitating targets through auditory trauma.

Functions/Applications: Create sonic attacks that disorient and damage enemies; drown out sound-based Quirks; project commands across distances; use directional speakers to shield allies.

Limits: Prolonged use causes vocal strain. Ineffective underground or in soundproof environments. Requires speaker equipment for directional control; uncontrolled use endangers allies.

Additional Notes: User wears a directional speaker support item around the neck to control sound propagation and protect companions. Most effective in open terrain against multiple opponents.

cardPool.title: Voyance
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Voyance

Description:
The user can see through solid objects and barriers within their line of sight. Living organisms remain opaque. By peering through a finger-formed aperture, the user narrows their vision field, extending duration and reducing mental strain.

Functions/Applications:
Locate hidden objects, bombs, or contraband behind walls. Scout enemy positions behind cover. Detect structural weaknesses or hidden compartments. Track mechanical devices through barriers.

Limits:
Cannot see through living matter. Continuous use without the finger-aperture technique exhausts the user quickly. Only works within direct line of sight. Cannot penetrate certain dense or specially designed materials.

cardPool.title: Warp Gate
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Warp Gate

Description:
The user generates dark purple and black mist that forms portals, transporting anything touching the fog to predetermined locations. They can cloak themselves in mist, becoming nearly invisible while channeling teleportation. This artificial Quirk is synthesized from multiple sources with Cloud Quirk as its base.

Functions/Applications:
Create coordinate-based portals for instant transportation. Cloak the user's body to obscure form and location. Transport multiple targets simultaneously. Establish escape routes or ambush points during combat.

Limits:
The user's neck cannot be covered by mist, creating a critical weak point. Portals require precise coordinate knowledge. Closing a portal while someone is partially inside causes severe bisection.

cardPool.title: Water Control
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Water Control

Description:
A water-manipulation Quirk granting command over nearby water. The user shapes water into offensive constructs and projectiles with precision, from claws to torrents. Power scales with available water supply.

Functions/Applications:
Form water into bladed weapons for melee combat. Launch pressurized water jets as ranged attacks. Create barriers from solidified water. Redirect or absorb water-based attacks.

Limits:
Requires proximity to a water source; ineffective in arid environments. Cannot generate water from nothing. Sustained constructs drain stamina proportionally to size and density. Water defenses are vulnerable to evaporation or freezing.

Additional Notes:
Most effective near bodies of water, rain, or humid conditions.

cardPool.title: Water Gun
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name: Water Gun

Description: The user projects pressurized water streams from their hands with precision and force. A straightforward offensive and utility Quirk for combat and environmental solutions.

Functions/Applications: Fire suppression; tactical distraction; crowd control; environmental hazard assistance.

Limits: Limited to stored water. Pressure and range decrease with sustained use. Ineffective against water-resistant opponents. Requires hand positioning; cannot function if restrained.

Additional Notes: Most effective in supporting roles and rescue operations. Strength lies in versatility and non-lethal control.

cardPool.title: Water Pump
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Water Pump

Description:
The user's hands are replaced with functional water hose spigots capable of generating pressurized water on demand. Water can be shaped and controlled with precision into various forms, from barriers to implements.

Functions/Applications:
Create defensive barriers, generate water constructs for manipulation, deliver pressurized attacks, and extinguish fires with fine control over flow rate and shape.

Limits:
Requires a water source or internal reserves to function. Prolonged use depletes reserves. The hose-hand design limits fine manipulation tasks. Water constructs disperse if pressure is lost.

Additional Notes:
Best suited for defensive and utility roles. Highly effective in firefighting.

cardPool.title: Weather Manipulation
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Weather Manipulation

Description:
The user controls weather phenomena including storms, lightning, wind, and tornadoes on massive scale. They can summon devastating weather events and achieve flight via wind manipulation.

Functions/Applications:
Create storm systems and tornadoes for area denial. Summon precise lightning bolts for targeted offense. Generate powerful winds for propulsion and flight. Scale attacks from localized strikes to island-wide devastation.

Limits:
Using the Quirk causes severe cellular degeneration and pain, forcing conservative use. Overuse leads to loss of control and collapse. Lightning can be redirected by electricity-based Quirks. Simultaneous application of multiple powers accelerates deterioration and risks fatal exhaustion.

cardPool.title: Whirlwind
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Whirlwind

Description:
Inasa commands air itself, generating powerful gusts and tornadoes with minimal movement. He manipulates multiple wind currents simultaneously with precise control, propelling objects, allies, and himself.

Functions/Applications:
Offensive wind blasts that knock enemies away; defensive deflection of projectiles and evasive maneuverability; support to amplify allies' attacks. Flight through costume-enhanced tornadoes or ground-burst propulsion. Can combine with heat-based Quirks to create flame tornadoes.

Limits:
Weakened if limbs cannot move freely. High temperatures disrupt airflow and destabilize control.

Additional Notes:
Whirlwind excels in versatility across offense, defense, and support.

cardPool.title: Whiteline
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Whiteline

Description:
The user manipulates painted lane lines on roads as flexible tentacles. These white lines can extend, coil, and move with considerable force to ensnare targets or hurl objects with devastating impact.

Functions/Applications:
Entangle and immobilize enemies by wrapping animated lane lines around them. Lift and throw heavy objects like vehicles. Create barriers by manipulating road markings. Requires painted road surfaces to function.

Limits:
Only works on existing painted lane lines; bare pavement provides no material to manipulate. True power level unknown as user was only observed under external enhancement. Effectiveness diminishes in areas lacking road infrastructure.

Additional Notes:
Best suited for urban or highway environments.

cardPool.title: Whole-Body Lens
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Whole-Body Lens

Description:
The user's body functions as a living camera system, capable of generating lens-like apertures anywhere on their skin to capture images. Photographs can be printed from the user's chest at will.

Functions/Applications:
Create optical lenses across any body surface for surveillance and reconnaissance. Print physical photographs on demand from stored images.

Limits:
Cannot modify or edit captured images. Printing consumes stamina and requires chest access. Lenses are vulnerable while active. Cannot capture images in complete darkness.

Additional Notes:
Best suited for support and intelligence roles. Weakness to damage near the chest or eyes may hinder combat performance.

cardPool.title: Zero Gravity
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name: Zero Gravity

Description: Touching objects with fingertip pads removes gravity, rendering targets weightless. Contact must be maintained; releasing cancels the effect. After Awakening, the user generates anti-gravity bubbles at range and spreads effects between connected objects.

Functions/Applications: Float objects and opponents up to three tons; disable enemies by eliminating footing; manipulate environmental wreckage as weapons; transport allies; increase agility by removing self-weight; create levitating decoys; generate repelling shockwaves.

Limits: Pre-Awakening requires direct hand contact; prolonged use causes nausea; loss of hands disables the Quirk; vulnerable to ranged opponents; Awakened bubbles lack precise control; three-ton limit pre-Awakening only.

cardPool.title: Zombie Virus

Zombie Virus

Romero Fujimi releases pinkish gas that temporarily transforms those who inhale it into zombies with enhanced strength and endurance. Infected victims gain bluish-gray skin, sunken eyes, and an urge to bite others to spread the virus. The user must wear a mask to avoid self-infection.

Functions/Applications:
Creates temporary undead soldiers through viral gas dispersal. Zombified victims retain fragmented personality, sometimes allowing friendships to override infection instinct. Zombie appearances enable infiltration or escape.

Limits:
The user is not immune to their own virus and risks self-infection if bitten. Zombification is temporary but reversal mechanics are unclear.

cardPool.title: Zoom
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Zoom

Description:
A vision enhancement Quirk that grants extraordinary magnification abilities. The user's eyes develop crosshair-shaped irises and can focus on distant targets with perfect clarity up to 5 kilometers away.

Functions/Applications:
The user can zoom vision on specific points to observe people, objects, and details from extreme distances. Exceptional for reconnaissance, surveying crowds, identifying individuals, or examining distant locations unnoticed.

Limits:
Requires active focus to magnify vision—passive sight remains normal. Distances beyond 5 kilometers become blurry. Cannot zoom while moving quickly without losing focus. Environmental obstructions like fog, darkness, or heavy rain significantly impair effectiveness.

The dome bears scars from a catastrophic attack—nearly destroyed but saved from collapse, with visible damage and ongoing repairs.

cardPool.title: Villain Factory
cardPool.value:
[Villain Factory]

Type: Criminal Organization

The Villain Factory is an underground organization conducting illegal Quirk-based experiments. They create artificial villains, posing a major threat to the Naruhata area.

Named by the Police Force for its mass production of villains, the organization is secretly led by All For One and Dr. Kyudai Garaki. Their goal is to create a weapon powerful enough to rival All Might.

Using Quirk manipulation and biological experimentation, the organization operates in secrecy while expanding criminal influence.

cardPool.title: Shie Hassaikai
cardPool.value:
[Shie Hassaikai]

Type: Yakuza Organization

The Shie Hassaikai is a former Yakuza organization that operated in Japan's criminal underworld. Originally led by The Boss, it followed traditional Yakuza values of loyalty and discipline. Kai Chisaki, known as Overhaul, was raised by The Boss and eventually took control.

Unlike the older generation, Chisaki sought to restore the Yakuza's power through ruthless methods and dangerous experimentation. During the rise of Pro Heroes, the organization lost authority and influence, forcing it into the shadows. Under Overhaul's leadership, the Shie Hassaikai became feared for its brutality and ambition to reclaim dominance.

cardPool.title: Paranormal Liberation Front
cardPool.value:
[Paranormal Liberation Front]

Type: Villain Organization

The Paranormal Liberation Front is a massive villain faction formed by merging the League of Villains and the Meta Liberation Army. Led by Grand Commander Tomura Shigaraki, it aims to destroy hero society and establish a world of absolute freedom.

The Front is divided into color-coded regiments, each specializing in different warfare aspects. Each regiment is commanded by a Lieutenant supported by three elite Advisers who oversee operations and expand the organization's influence.

With substantial manpower, resources, and military structure, the Paranormal Liberation Front is one of Japan's most dangerous villain organizations.

cardPool.title: Octo-Lover's Brigade
cardPool.value:
[Octo-Lover's Brigade]

Type: Animal Rights Organization

The Octo-Lover's Brigade is an animal rights group from Osaka campaigning against octopus capture and consumption. Members believe octopuses are intelligent creatures deserving protection and possess sea-creature mutations with fish, mollusk, and cephalopod traits.

Members wear dark cloth accessories marked with white spots as octopus sucker symbols. While many engage in peaceful activism, extremist factions use sabotage and violence to force acceptance of their beliefs, giving the Brigade a controversial reputation throughout Japan.

cardPool.title: Meta Liberation Army
cardPool.value:
[Meta Liberation Army]

Type: Villain Organization

The Meta Liberation Army, or M.L.A., is a large villain organization centered on the belief that unrestricted Quirk use is a fundamental human right. Founded by Destro to free society from Quirk restrictions, the organization inspired countless followers. Years later, Destro's descendant Re-Destro rebuilt it into a massive, well-organized force with political, financial, and military influence across Japan. Unlike groups driven by chaos, the M.L.A. pursues liberation through ideology and overwhelming power. Following conflict with the League of Villains, the M.L.A. merged with them to form the Paranormal Liberation Front under Tomura Shigaraki's leadership.

cardPool.title: League of Villains
cardPool.value:
[League of Villains]

Type: Villain Organization

The League of Villains was a criminal organization of powerful villains united by hatred of hero society. Founded by All For One and led by Tomura Shigaraki, it became one of Japan's greatest threats.

Unlike traditional criminal organizations, the League sought to collapse the entire hero system and society built around it. It attracted dangerous criminals, outcasts, and extremists with powerful Quirks and deep resentment toward heroes.

After the Revival Celebration, the League merged with the Meta Liberation Army to form the Paranormal Liberation Front under Shigaraki's command.

cardPool.title: Gollini Family
cardPool.value:
[Gollini Family]

Type: Mafia Crime Family

The Gollini Family is a powerful European mafia organization led by ruthless Valdo Gollini. Established long before the rise of All Might, it became one of the most feared criminal syndicates in the region. The original leader valued honor and loyalty but was murdered by his own son, Valdo, who seized control and transformed the family into a brutal, ambitious organization. Under Valdo's leadership, the family expanded across Europe through violence and intimidation, remaining beyond the reach of Heroes and law enforcement. Infamous for its wealth, secrecy, and deadly reputation in the criminal underworld.

cardPool.title: Creature Rejection Clan
cardPool.value:
[Creature Rejection Clan (CRC)]

Type: Extremist Religious Organization

The Creature Rejection Clan is a villainous cult-like organization driven by extreme ideology and religious fervor. Members wear ritualistic skull-shaped masks that conceal identities and reinforce collective doctrine.

The CRC rejects individuals with physical "abnormalities," particularly those with Mutant-type Quirks. Despite modern superpowered society, the group upholds deep-rooted prejudice and exclusionary beliefs.

Originally a protest movement, the organization became increasingly radical, escalating from demonstrations to violence and targeted attacks. This shift damaged their reputation and public support significantly.

cardPool.title: Abegawa Tenchu Kai
cardPool.value:
[Abegawa Tenchu Kai]

Type: Former Yakuza Organization

The Abegawa Tenchu Kai was a Yakuza syndicate that operated in the criminal underworld until law enforcement designated it as a villain organization. Heavy scrutiny weakened the group's structure. The vigilante Stendhal assaulted the headquarters, killing all high-ranking executives. With its leadership destroyed, the organization collapsed.

cardPool.title: World Heroes Association
cardPool.value:
[World Heroes Association]

Type: International Hero Governing Body

The World Heroes Association is a global organization overseeing Hero activity across multiple nations. It comprises representatives from various countries coordinating international Hero operations.

The organization organizes cross-border missions, facilitates cooperation between Hero agencies, and responds to large-scale threats. During crises, it deploys Pro Heroes to assist nations in need.

Due to uneven Hero distribution, some regions experience higher crime rates, presenting an ongoing challenge for the Association.

cardPool.title: Police Force
cardPool.value:
[Police Force]

Type: Law Enforcement Organization

The Police Force maintains public order and handles criminal activity through arrest, detention, and processing of suspects and Villains. In Quirk's early days, they avoided recruiting Quirk-users, creating space for Pro Heroes to emerge. Today, the Police Force coordinates with Heroes on non-Quirk crimes and lower offenses, while Heroes must transfer ordinary criminals to police custody. The Police Force manages interrogation, investigation, and incarceration while ensuring due process.

cardPool.title: Hero Public Safety Commission
cardPool.value:
[Hero Public Safety Commission]

Type: Government Law Enforcement Agency

The Hero Public Safety Commission is a national authority regulating Heroes and overseeing their role in society. Led by non-Hero officials, it maintains balance and prevents excessive Hero influence over civilian governance.

The Commission administers the Provisional Hero License Exam twice yearly in June and September. It investigates high-level crimes and coordinates with the Police Force on operations and emergency responses.

cardPool.title: FeatherHATS
cardPool.value:
[FeatherHATS]

Type: Music Band

FeatherHATS is a music group formed by Makoto Tsukauchi and sponsored by the Marukane Department Store. The band showcases young musical talents from Naruhata and performs at organized events to introduce emerging artists to wider audiences.

The group is known for its collaborative structure, blending different musical styles while maintaining a cohesive, youthful performance identity.

cardPool.title: Heroes
cardPool.value:
[Heroes / Pro Heroes]

Type: Licensed Quirk Users / Public Protectors

Heroes are individuals legally authorized to use their Quirks to protect civilians from Villains and danger. Pro Heroes operate professionally through Hero Agencies regulated by the Hero Public Safety Commission in Japan and the World Heroes Association internationally.

Hero work centers on three core responsibilities: rescue, evacuation, and combat. Heroes are widely respected and operate with public visibility in civilian areas.

cardPool.title: Villains
cardPool.value:
[Villains]

Type: Criminal Individuals / Organizations

Villains are individuals who use their Quirks to commit crimes, cause destruction, and endanger innocent lives. They exist as thieves, murderers, extremists, and terrorist organizations.

Crime rates remain relatively low due to Pro Heroes, yet Villains persist as a societal threat.

Motivations vary widely: economic hardship, political ideology, social rejection, or personal tragedy. Quirks enable more complex and dangerous crimes.

Some become Villains after trauma, rejecting societal norms. Some operate alone; others form organized groups with hierarchies.

All Villains share illegal Quirk activity that places society at risk.

cardPool.title: Vigilantes
cardPool.value:
[Vigilantes]

Type: Unauthorized Quirk Users / Civilian Protectors

Vigilantes are individuals who carry out Hero-like activities without legal authorization, operating independently of Hero agencies. Their actions are illegal due to strict Hero licensing laws.

Though unlawful, Vigilantes exist in a legal and moral gray area. When Pro Heroes are unavailable, they can save lives. Some cooperate with Heroes during emergencies.

This creates debate within law enforcement on whether to treat Vigilantes as criminals or unofficial assets in crises.

cardPool.title: Sidekicks
cardPool.value:
[Sidekicks]

Type: Hero Agency Support Staff

Sidekicks are licensed Hero assistants who work under a Pro Hero's supervision at a Hero Agency. Less experienced than the lead Hero, they provide operational support during missions and emergencies.

While the Pro Hero serves as primary field operative, Sidekicks assist with coordination, logistics, and on-site response.

Sidekick team sizes vary widely. Some agencies employ a few, others maintain large teams. Certain Pro Heroes operate without Sidekicks.

Hiring decisions rest with the agency head, based on experience, skills, or Quirk utility. Unlicensed Vigilantes may be recruited as Sidekicks, providing legal entry into Hero society.

cardPool.title: Todoroki Family
cardPool.value:
[Todoroki Family]

Type: Family

The Todoroki Family is a prominent Hero family consisting of Enji Todoroki (Endeavor), his wife Rei, and their four children: Toya, Fuyumi, Natsuo, and Shoto.

Enji is a top-ranked Pro Hero known for exceptional combat ability and leadership. Rei is the family's mother. Their children have distinct paths shaped by the family's complex history.

cardPool.title: Shimura Family
cardPool.value:
[Shimura Family]

Type: Family

The Shimura Family was the birth family of Tomura Shigaraki before he became a Villain. They were an ordinary household whose history became tied to the origins of one of society's most dangerous criminals. The family is connected to Nana Shimura, a former Pro Hero whose lineage influenced later events involving Tomura Shigaraki.

cardPool.title: Ida Family
cardPool.value:
[Ida Family]

Type: Hero Family Lineage

The Ida Family is a prestigious hero family with generations of Pro Heroes known for discipline, responsibility, and service to society.

Most members possess the Engine Quirk, characterized by engine-like exhaust pipes that grant enhanced speed and mobility. This trait is particularly associated with Tenya Ida.

Tenya's grandfather developed a unique training method to enhance the Engine Quirk. The process involves removing exhaust organs through intense means, followed by rigorous training. Stronger components regrow over time, improving speed and endurance.

Through this tradition, the Ida Family has maintained their Quirk abilities and passed down both their hero legacy and specialized training methods.

cardPool.title: Wild, Wild Pussycats
cardPool.value:
========================================
STORYCARD — WILD WILD PUSSYCATS
========================================

[OVERVIEW]
Professional Hero team specializing in rescue operations, wilderness survival training, and disaster response. Excel in coordination, mobility, and field-based Hero work.

Members:
- Shino Sosaki (Mandalay) - strategic leader and communicator
- Ryuko Tsuchikawa (Pixie-Bob) - terrain manipulation through earth-based Quirk
- Tomoko (Ragdoll) - enhanced sensory tracking and Quirk analysis
- Tiger - close-combat powerhouse and physical trainer

----------------------------------------

[ROLE IN HERO SOCIETY]
Prioritize survival training, evacuation strategy, and environmental adaptability. Assist in U.A. student development programs for real-world disaster scenarios.

cardPool.title: Kota Izumi
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Kota Izumi

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Water Control

Occupation/Role: UA High School Hero Course Student, Class 1-A

Personality: Initially withdrawn and cynical after his parents' deaths, Kota was cold toward heroes. After Izuku Midoriya rescued him, he slowly opened to others, though remains somewhat indifferent and prideful. He is principled and refuses indecency, punishing rule-breakers without hesitation.

Appearance: A short boy with spiky black hair, roughly Mineta's height. He wears a short-sleeved collared shirt with dark shorts and a red cap with golden spike horns. His hero costume features a dark green vest with gray helmet matching his parents' design, complete with large spike horns. He wears red high-top sneakers.

cardPool.title: Arc 1
cardPool.value:
ARC 1 — U.A. ENTRANCE EXAM

Izuku Midoriya arrives at U.A. for the Hero Course entrance exam. Candidates enter a simulated city with combat robots, earning points for destruction and rescue.

Izuku struggles controlling One For All. When Uraraka is trapped under debris, he destroys a zero-point robot to save her, earning rescue points instead of combat points.

Izuku is accepted for his rescue performance. Bakugo is accepted as a top scorer. Class 1-A is formed.

cardPool.title: Arc 2
cardPool.value:
========================================
ARC 2 — QUIRK APPREHENSION TEST
========================================

Class 1-A undergoes Aizawa's Quirk Apprehension Test on their first day with sprinting, grip strength, ball throw, endurance, and agility measurements using Quirks.

Aizawa warns the lowest performer may be expelled, creating pressure.

Izuku breaks his fingers controlling One For All during the ball throw. Uraraka uses zero-gravity to send the ball out of range. Bakugo dominates through explosive mobility.

Students are ranked by Quirk efficiency and physical output. Aizawa later reveals the expulsion threat was a bluff to measure potential under pressure.

cardPool.title: Arc 3
cardPool.value:
========================================
ARC 3 — U.S.J. INCIDENT
========================================

Class 1-A arrives at U.S.J. for rescue training. Kurogiri warps the League of Villains into the facility, scattering students across disaster zones.

Shigaraki targets Aizawa and Izuku. Villains coordinate attacks across multiple groups.

A Nomu is deployed to kill All Might. All Might defeats it in combat.

The villains retreat through Kurogiri's warp gate. The attack confirms organized villain coordination targeting Hero society.

cardPool.title: Arc 4
cardPool.value:
========================================
ARC 4 — U.A. SPORTS FESTIVAL
========================================

U.A. hosts a national sports festival broadcast across Japan with obstacle races, cavalry battles, and elimination tournaments.

Izuku modifies One For All to avoid injury. Todoroki refuses to use his fire Quirk. Bakugo advances through brute force.

In finals, Todoroki uses fire against Izuku after confronting his past. Bakugo defeats Todoroki in the final match and wins overall.

Hero agencies recruit students for internships based on performance.

cardPool.title: Arc 5
cardPool.value:
========================================
ARC 5 — HERO INTERNSHIPS & STAIN INCIDENT
========================================

Students begin internships at Hero agencies. Izuku trains under Gran Torino on advanced movement control. Iida joins Ingenium's agency.

In Hosu City, Stain attacks Pro Heroes, targeting those he deems unworthy. His Quirk allows paralysis through blood ingestion.

Iida confronts Stain alone and is paralyzed. Izuku and Todoroki intervene. Endeavor defeats a Nomu while Stain is subdued. Stain is arrested, but his ideology spreads among Villain groups, destabilizing Hero perception.

cardPool.title: Arc 6
cardPool.value:
========================================
ARC 6 — FOREST TRAINING CAMP ARC
========================================

Class 1-A trains in wilderness survival and Quirk control at a remote camp. The League of Villains attacks, scattering students into the forest. Bakugo is captured during the chaos. Multiple students are injured before villains withdraw.

cardPool.title: Arc 7
cardPool.value:
========================================
ARC 7 — KAMINO INCIDENT
========================================

League of Villains holds Bakugo in Kamino Ward. Heroes launch a rescue operation with Pro Heroes and All Might.

All Might confronts All For One during the raid. A large battle unfolds across Kamino Ward.

All Might defeats All For One using his remaining power in his weakened state.

Bakugo is rescued and All For One critically injured.

All Might's final form is revealed, ending his era as Symbol of Peace.

cardPool.title: Arc 8
cardPool.value:
========================================
ARC 8 — PROVISIONAL HERO LICENSE EXAM
========================================

Students take the national Hero License Exam through large-scale rescue simulations competing against other schools. Successful candidates gain legal authorization for supervised Hero work.

cardPool.title: Arc 9
cardPool.value:
========================================
ARC 9 — SHIE HASSAIKAI RAID ARC
========================================

Hero teams investigate Shie Hassaikai operations. Eri is identified as the Quirk-erasing bullet source. A coordinated underground raid begins. Mirio fights Overhaul alone and is hit by a Quirk-erasing bullet, losing his Quirk permanently. Izuku reaches Eri and defeats Overhaul. Eri is rescued and placed under Hero protection.

cardPool.title: Arc 11
cardPool.value:
========================================
ARC 11 — META LIBERATION ARMY ARC
========================================

League of Villains clashes with Meta Liberation Army in Deika City. Twice dies in early combat. Shigaraki's Quirk fully awakens during battle with Re-Destro, destroying much of the city. Re-Destro is defeated and MLA submits to Shigaraki. Paranormal Liberation Front is formed.

cardPool.title: Arc 13
cardPool.value:
========================================
ARC 13 — PARANORMAL LIBERATION WAR
========================================

Heroes attack Jaku Hospital and Gunga Mountain.

High-End Nomu engage Hero teams.

Shigaraki awakens and unleashes massive destruction.

Dabi reveals identity as Toya Todoroki.

Twice is killed, collapsing Villain coordination.

Gigantomachia advances across Japan.

Shigaraki expands decay across battlefields.

Heroes begin nationwide evacuation operations.

cardPool.title: Arc 14
cardPool.value:
========================================
ARC 14 — DARK HERO ARC
========================================

Izuku Midoriya leaves U.A. and operates independently across Japan as a solo Hero, tracking Villain activity and protecting civilians without agency support.

He encounters escaped prisoners in isolated urban battles while transporting civilians to safety zones.

Izuku is ambushed by Kaina Tsutsumi (Lady Nagant), a former Hero Public Safety Commission assassin deployed to capture him alive.

Nagant uses long-range precision rifle Quirks, forcing Izuku to adapt One For All usage with Blackwhip, Fa Jin, and Danger Sense in combination.

Nagant reveals the Hero Commission's corruption and her past role executing covert eliminations of targets labeled threats to Hero society.

cardPool.title: Arc 15
cardPool.value:
========================================
ARC 15 — FINAL WAR ARC
========================================

Heroes launch coordinated final war against All For One and Shigaraki.

Bakugo engages Shigaraki.

Todoroki confronts Dabi.

Ochaco engages Toga.

All Might confronts All For One with armored support.

Izuku fights Shigaraki as One For All vestiges appear.

All For One is separated from Shigaraki.

Shigaraki collapses after final exchange.

Major battles conclude across all fronts.

Heroes win at great cost.

A highly ranked Pro Hero at No. 21 who directs Okuto Island Aquarium while patrolling and teaching.

First-year student in UA's Department of Management. Approaches heroism entrepreneurially and gained attention during the UA Sports Festival for analyzing Izuku's marketability as a hero brand.

Wears baggy yellow hero suit with red bottle-cap accessories at neck, wrists, waist, and ankles; white gloves and red-soled shoes.

Backstory: UA High School student training to become a Pro Hero in Class 1-A.

Easy-going and mild-mannered with heroic nature. Generous but socially awkward. Calm under pressure and willing to reason with criminals. Dreams of becoming a recognized hero.

Slim young man with short brown hair and large round brown eyes. Wears All Might hoodies over black tactical gear with knee and elbow pads. Black sneakers with red accents. Discovered his Quirk and began operating as a vigilante helping citizens and fighting petty crime.

Pale purple blouse with frilled cuffs under navy dress with brown belt. Dark red gloves, purple frilled thigh-high socks, black knee-high boots with red binding, black choker with red center, and black domino mask.

Hero costume: red and white fly agaric turtleneck dress, matching mushroom hat, furred sleeves, pale pink frilled knee-high boots, dark brown belt with golden buckle for Shroom-Shooters.

Yellow eye mask, red key necklace, yellow and dark green keyhole-patterned bodysuit, light gray shoulder pads with keyhole designs, white boots, and brown belt with keys.

Additional Information: His Quirk allows him to manipulate and reshape cement-based materials.

Golden-brown triangular eyes with black bird-like markings, thick eyebrows, faint stubble, and ear piercings. Hero costume features black wavy-patterned shirt under tan shearling jacket with shoulder slits for large bright red wings. Black gloves, yellow visor, and headphones.

cardPool.value:
Real Name: Gil Gollini
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Teleportation
Occupation/Role: Gollini Family mafia operative
Personality: Emotionless and stoic, loyal to orders. Shows minimal emotion except when annoyed or shocked.
Appearance: Large muscular man with buzzcut, Dutch-styled beard, and stern squinted eyes. Wears well-tailored gray suit with black stripes, black coat, scarf, and rose emblazoned on his coat.
Backstory: Loyal operative serving under boss Valdo. Acts as transportation and backup for fellow member Ugo, using his Quirk strategically in conflicts.
Additional Information: Demonstrates exceptional combat coordination with fluid footwork during teleportation. His Quirk allows him to teleport himself and anyone he touches to any location within his line of sight.

cardPool.title: Giulio Gandini
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Giulio Gandini

Alias:
The Scervino Butler

Quirk Name:
Trigger (Disabled)

Occupation/Role:
Butler for the Scervino Family; Former combatant

Personality:
Stern and composed with fierce loyalty. Once warmer, now hardened by trauma, though genuine compassion surfaces. Cynical of Heroes but respects honor. Relentless and refuses to back down.

Appearance:
Average build with brownish-red hair in short ponytail, thin greenish-blue eyes, sharp teeth, and a mole beneath his left eye. Black tailcoat, grey vest, striped tie, and white undershirt with popped collar. Right arm and left leg are Support Item prosthetics with exposed padding. Ammunition pouches and holster belts cross his torso and left leg.

Backstory:
Raised by the Scervino family, Giulio found purpose as their butler.

cardPool.title: Gigantomachia
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Gigantomachia

Alias:
Gig

Quirk Name:
Unknown (Multiple Quirks via modification)

Occupation/Role:
Villain, former bodyguard to All For One, servant of the Paranormal Liberation Front

Personality:
Polite but impatient, aggressive toward the uncooperative. Fiercely devoted to his master with unwavering loyalty. Respects only strength. Acknowledged Tomura as worthy after witnessing his power.

Appearance:
A colossal giant three building levels tall with a musclebound, rocky frame. Spiky brown hair and jagged stone protrusions cover his body. Pointed teeth with protruding lower canines. Wears black pants, a hooded cloak, and carries a portable radio on a rope around his neck. Later sporting black armor.

cardPool.title: Ganma Asui
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Ganma Asui

Alias:
None

Quirk Name:
Frog Physiology

Occupation/Role:
Businessman; Father and Provider for the Asui Household

Personality:
Caring and devoted father. Calm, supportive, and proud of his family's accomplishments.

Appearance:
Tall, stocky middle-aged man with frog-like features. Short black hair, black eyes, toad-like head structure. Wears business suits with blue-dotted tie and green frog clip.

Backstory:
Married Bell and has three children: Tsuyu, Samidare, and Satsuki. Relies on responsible eldest daughter to care for siblings while he provides financial stability through frequent work travel.

Additional Information:
Father of Class 1-A student Tsuyu Asui. His family's Quirk grants frog-like abilities.

cardPool.title: Gang Orca's Sidekicks
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Gang Orca's Sidekick
Quirk Name: Unknown
Occupation/Role: Professional Sidekick to Gang Orca; Provisional Hero License Exam Antagonist
Personality: Loyal and disciplined with tactical awareness and adaptability under command.
Appearance: Black bodysuit with white lines, tan armor pads, and diamond-patterned mask. Armed with Cement Gun on right arm.
Backstory: Enlisted by the Hero Public Safety Commission as mock villain during UA's Provisional Hero License Exam, attacking students in a disaster scenario.
Additional Information: Works with Gang Orca in coordinated attacks and shows concern for his leader's safety.

cardPool.title: Fuyumi Todoroki
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Fuyumi Todoroki
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Ice
Occupation/Role: Elementary School Teacher
Personality: Kind-hearted and nurturing with a teasing streak. She deeply cares for her family despite household trauma and hopes for reconciliation. She worries constantly for loved ones but carries guilt about failing to protect Shoto. Brave and empathetic, she maintains peace within the fractured family.
Appearance: A young woman of average height with shoulder-length white hair flecked with crimson, ear-length side bangs, and turquoise eyes framed by red-rimmed rectangular glasses. She wears a white dress shirt with grayish peach cardigan, navy jeans, and brown dress shoes. She frequently wears various turtleneck sweaters.

cardPool.title: Fumikage Tokoyami
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Fumikage Tokoyami

Alias: Jet-Black Hero: Tsukuyomi

Quirk Name: Dark Shadow

Occupation/Role: UA High School Student, Class 1-A

Personality: Reserved and serious yet noble, Fumikage speaks with archaic patterns and dramatic flair. Quiet but sociable in teams and dependable in combat. Insecure about his dark interests and easily embarrassed, he deeply cares for friends. He struggles controlling Dark Shadow's aggression, fearing harm to others.

Appearance: A short young man with a crow-like black head, yellow beak, thin red eyes, and red choker. Fair-skinned with average build. At UA, he wears a light gray blazer with turquoise trimmings, white shirt, and dark blue-green pants. His hero costume is a black robe with purple tinting and knee-high black boots.

cardPool.title: Eri
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Eri
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Rewind
Occupation/Role: Student (U.A. High School resident)
Personality: Fearful from trauma but gradually becoming cheerful around kind people. She feels guilt over her Quirk's destructive potential while learning its positive uses. Silent and accepting, yet determined to protect others.
Appearance: A small girl with long messy bluish off-white hair parted down the middle. Wide bright red eyes and a small brown horn on her right forehead that grows when activating her Quirk. White frilled shirt, red pinafore with golden buttons, gray tights, tan boots, and a dark red messenger bag with flowers.
Backstory: Eri was used as a living weapon by her grandfather's organization and experimented on by Kai Chisaki.

cardPool.title: Enji Todoroki
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Enji Todoroki

Alias:
Flame Hero: Endeavor

Quirk Name:
Hellflame

Occupation/Role:
Pro Hero (No. 2 ranked)

Personality:
Prideful and ambitious, driven to surpass All Might. Stern and demanding, prioritizing achievement over relationships.

Appearance:
Tall, muscular man with short crimson spiked hair, sharp turquoise eyes, and flame-like facial hair. Navy-turquoise Hero Costume with streaming flames across chest, white cage-patterned bracers, flame-engulfed boots, and blue belt armor.

Backstory:
Top Pro Hero who married Rei through a strategic Quirk Marriage to produce a powerful heir. Father of four children including Shoto. His relentless pursuit of strength has defined his career and family.

Additional Information:
No. 2 ranked Pro Hero by case resolution.

cardPool.title: Enigma
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Fukakai Hatena

Alias: Enigma

Quirk Name: Gigantification

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero Sidekick of Ingenium, Team Idaten Member

Personality: Calm, friendly, and self-aware. Forgiving about her appearance and composed in crises, offering reassurance and professionalism.

Appearance: Young woman with straight teeth, long dark hair in two low plaits, and neat fringe. Entirely blacked-out oval eyes with no visible iris or pupil. When her Quirk activates, she becomes a pitch-black blob with a white mask face and elastic limbs.

Backstory: Obtained her Hero License and was selected by Ingenium for Team Idaten. Mistaken for a villain while traveling to Tokyo for an interview but clarified her identity.

cardPool.title: Emi Fukukado
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Emi Fukukado

Alias: Smile Hero: Ms. Joke

Quirk Name: Outburst

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero and Class 2 Teacher at Ketsubutsu Academy High School

Personality: Cheerful and playful with goofy humor. Uses comedy in combat and as a personal tool, enjoying teasing others—especially Shota Aizawa. Takes her duties seriously and deeply values her students.

Appearance: Athletic young woman with muscular arms. Seafoam-green hair past shoulders with short fringe beneath an orange bandana. Dark green eyes with bright pupils and joyous smile. Hero costume includes sleeveless navy shirt, green-and-orange pinstriped shorts, corset with yellow smiley-face pins, padded yellow gloves with golden knuckle plates, and orange-striped arm tubes with metal wrist-guards.

cardPool.title: Eijiro Kirishima
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Eijiro Kirishima

Alias: Red Riot

Quirk Name: Hardening

Occupation/Role: UA High School Student, Class 1-A

Personality: Boisterous and outgoing with strong values of manliness and chivalry. Determined and selfless, he values honesty and kindness. A devoted fan of Crimson Riot, he aspires to live without regret and prioritizes others' safety.

Appearance: A muscular young man with sharp red eyes and dramatically spiked bright red hair with horn-like tufts on his forehead. He has naturally sharp teeth. His hero costume features dark red shoulder pads, red belt with "R" emblem, jagged sash, black pants, red half cape with ripped hem, dark red boots, and a spiked mask resembling an Oni.

cardPool.title: Ectoplasm
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Ectoplasm

Alias: Pro Hero Ectoplasm

Quirk Name: Clones

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero and U.A. High School Mathematics Teacher

Personality: Steadfast, demanding instructor who pushes students to excel. Analytical and intelligent, he is popular in hero society for his commitment to heroism and education.

Appearance: Tall, slender man with short hair, blank inward-tilted eyes behind glasses, and featureless face. Wears tan and black hero costume with high collar, golden striped neck detail, black helmet with jaw-guard, and lightweight prosthetic legs.

Backstory: Once a celebrated Pro Hero, Ectoplasm lost his legs in a villain encounter but continued his heroic career. Now at U.A. High School, he shapes the next generation through rigorous instruction and mentorship.

cardPool.title: Denki Kaminari
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Denki Kaminari

Alias: Chargebolt, Stun Gun Hero

Quirk Name: Electrification

Occupation/Role: UA High School Student, Class 1-A

Personality: Friendly social butterfly who gets along with most classmates. Well-meaning but blunt, he enjoys encouraging others with a flirtatious side. Sometimes follows others into questionable schemes, though genuinely kind-hearted beneath his jokester exterior.

Appearance: Light-skinned boy with messy golden-blond hair with a distinctive black lightning-shaped streak on his left fringe. He has slanted golden eyes and appears slimmer than most classmates. Wears the standard UA uniform with light gray blazer and dark turquoise trim.

cardPool.title: Deidoro Sakaki
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Deidoro Sakaki
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Sloshed
Occupation/Role: Eight Bullets member of Shie Hassaikai
Personality: Energetic and volatile, prone to irritability. Speaks with slurred words due to intoxication. Remains focused on duties despite his altered state.
Appearance: Extremely thin yet muscular man with long, greasy black hair and deep-set circular eyes. Wears a drainage mask with tubes channeling alcohol through eyeholes, a furry vest, dark pants, and black shoes.
Backstory: Deidoro is an Eight Bullets member serving under Overhaul. His Quirk likely drove him toward alcoholism for combat effectiveness. He was deployed with Shin Nemoto to intercept heroes and engaged Mirio Togata before being defeated.

cardPool.title: Deborah Gollini
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Deborah Gollini
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Day Dream
Occupation/Role: Member of the Gollini Family mafia
Personality: Sadistic and snide, she toys with victims and allies. Confident but fearful when threatened. Takes dark satisfaction in controlling victims through "nice dreams."
Appearance: Tall woman with voluptuous build, long black hair, and sharp green eyes. Salmon eyeshadow and purple lipstick. Dark dress with spider cobweb neckline, feathered sleeves and hem, large brown belt, and falu red heels. Black-brimmed hat with red rose and golden crescent earrings.
Backstory: Trusted member of the Gollini Family criminal organization. Uses her Quirk for psychological manipulation with cruel enthusiasm.

cardPool.title: David Shield
cardPool.value:
Real Name: David Shield

Alias: The Support Genius

Quirk Name: Squirmy Fingers

Occupation/Role: Scientist and Support Item Developer; Former Sidekick to All Might

Personality: Compassionate and altruistic, driven to help society and support his daughter. Deeply admires All Might to the point of reverence, willing to bend ethics for what he believes serves the greater good. Demonstrates selfless courage and eventually accepts hard truths about change and legacy.

Appearance: Tall man of average build with aqua eyes and light brown hair styled short and messy with two prominent bangs. Light wrinkles and short goatee. Wears wide-rimmed square glasses, blue button-up shirt, pale pants, dark belt, navy sneakers with red accents, and wedding ring.

cardPool.title: Danjuro Tobita
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Danjuro Tobita

Alias: Gentle

Quirk Name: Elasticity

Occupation/Role: Independent Villain and Internet Celebrity

Personality: Polite and theatrical despite criminal pursuits. Lacks insight into consequences. Confident facing heroes. Chases fame over wealth.

Appearance: Refined man with slicked-back black hair, handlebar mustache, and medium beard. Black eyeliner around eyes. Villain costume: black jacket with enlarged collars and coattails, white pinstriped pants, brown laced shoes, two brown belts with golden buckles, white cuffs, purple gloves, and purple scarf. Carries a white cane with golden tip.

Backstory: Former high school student turned freeter who pursued villainy for internet fame. Orchestrates elaborate crimes for theatrical value rather than profit.

cardPool.title: Daigoro Banjo
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Daigoro Banjo

Alias: Lariat

Quirk Name: Blackwhip

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero

Personality: Energetic and confident with good-natured humor. Possesses indomitable willpower to resist powerful threats.

Appearance: Large, muscular man with square jaw, small dull blue eyes, no eyebrows, bald head, and short beard. Dark leather jacket with yellow shoulder pads, golden goggles, and bandolier.

Backstory: Fifth wielder of One For All, trained by Hikage Shinomori. Mastered both Blackwhip and One For All to become a formidable Pro Hero.

Additional Information: Creates black energy tendrils from arms for grappling and mobility. Possesses superhuman strength, speed, agility, and durability from One For All. Exceptional willpower resisted All For One's Quirk theft attempts.

cardPool.title: Dadan Tadan
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Dadan Tadan
Alias: Lucky Strike
Quirk Name: Flash Bang Sweat
Occupation/Role: Student, Isami Academy High School
Personality: Meek and timid, nervous and apologetic. Dislikes fighting but acts for his team. Conscientious and quick to make peace.
Appearance: Short boy with light chestnut hair swept left, round nose, tiny black eyes, and cat-like mouth. Thin upper arms with giant hands, wide hips with narrow shoulders, and chubby lower stomach. Wears standard Isami uniform tailored to his unusual frame.
Backstory: Dreams of becoming hero Lucky Strike. Despite his gentle nature and aversion to combat, he recognizes his duty to use his abilities for good. Demonstrates humility and team loyalty.

cardPool.title: Dabi
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Toya Todoroki

Alias: Dabi

Quirk Name: Hellflame

Occupation/Role: Villain, League of Villains member

Personality: Cold and calculating, driven by deep resentment toward his father Endeavor. He masks emotional turmoil beneath detached precision and methodical villainy.

Appearance: Tall, pale young man in early twenties with slim muscular build. Purple scar tissue covers lower face, neck, torso, arms, and legs from Quirk loss of control. Spiky white hair with heavy bangs, thin turquoise eyes. Multiple silver ear piercings and nostril piercing. Wears dark blue jacket with ripped collar, matching pants, white scoop-neck shirt, dark dress shoes, gray patterned belt, and brown leather satchel.

cardPool.title: Crust
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Crust

Alias: Shield Hero

Quirk Name: Shield

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero (Rank No. 6)

Personality: Emotional and noble, prone to crying but unwavering in duty. Selfless and willing to sacrifice himself.

Appearance: Well-built man with black hair and grayish-white streak. Right hand has a crusty, stone-like layer. Wears black eye mask, Spartan-inspired black armor with red stitching, and green hooded cape.

Backstory: Top ten Pro Hero who earned his ranking through exceptional combat prowess and tactical expertise. Carried deep emotions about All Might's retirement.

Additional Information: Specializes in team-based combat and defensive strategies. Shield Quirk generates hexagonal stone barriers he can enlarge, redirect, sharpen into weapons, and detach as projectiles.

cardPool.title: Crimson Riot
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Crimson Riot, Chivalrous Hero
Quirk Name: Hardening
Occupation/Role: Pro Hero
Personality: Unwavering despite inner fear, Crimson Riot believes willpower transcends Quirk ability. He defines "manly spirit" as determination and courage regardless of gender. Haunted by an early failure costing civilian lives, he channels trauma into fearless heroism.
Appearance: A sturdy, broad-shouldered man with striking spiky red hair. He wears a distinctive metal three-piece mask covering his mouth and nose, paired with a crimson outfit and long red cape with a high, wide collar and ripped edges.
Backstory: An established Pro Hero whose fearless reputation masks deeper truth. Early hesitation resulted in civilian deaths.

cardPool.title: Cow Lady
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown

Alias: Cow Lady

Quirk Name: Cow

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero

Personality: Dutiful and confident, Cow Lady is a committed hero who maintains professional composure during crises and takes her responsibilities seriously.

Appearance: A tall woman with shoulder-length wavy blonde hair, prominent curved horns, and pointed cow-like ears. She wears a dark orange cropped laced top, sleeveless denim jacket with rope tie, ripped denim shorts, western belt with cow-head buckle, leather gloves, and knee-high boots. A cowboy hat hangs around her neck, tasseled rings adorn her arms, and orange-tinted shades complete her look.

Backstory: An American Pro Hero from Los Angeles, Cow Lady is dependable and well-regarded.

cardPool.title: Christopher Skyline
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Christopher Skyline

Alias: Captain Celebrity, Playboy Hero

Quirk Name: Force Field

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero (American, operating in Japan)

Personality: Arrogant and attention-seeking yet genuinely heroic in crises. Flirtatious with poor judgment, but wants to help people. His insensitivity stems from obsession with his alpha male image rather than malice.

Appearance: Exceptionally tall and well-built with chiseled features, blonde swept-back mohawk, light blue eyes, and long lashes. Wears a cerulean skin-tight bodysuit trimmed in yellow with red-starred chest logo, matching pads, yellow belt, and long red cape with dark blue visor.

Backstory: America's top-ranked hero until womanizing and poor behavior forced relocation to Japan.

cardPool.title: Chojuro Kon
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Chojuro Kon

Alias:
Chimera

Quirk Name:
Chimera

Occupation/Role:
Villain; member of Nine's criminal organization

Personality:
Driven by hatred from lifelong ostracization, Chojuro seeks a power-based society with Nine. Despite brutality, he shows occasional compassion toward allies, though displays hypocrisy mocking others' monstrous features while possessing animalistic traits himself.

Appearance:
An imposing man with blue fur, wolf-like head, eagle talon hands and feet, and a long reptilian tail. He wears a brown trench coat over a blue dress shirt with jeans and belt, often smoking a cigar.

Backstory:
Rejected by society for his inhuman appearance, Chojuro lived as an outcast until Nine recruited him.

cardPool.title: Chizome Akaguro
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Chizome Akaguro

Alias: Hero Killer: Stain, formerly Stendhal

Quirk Name: Bloodcurdle

Occupation/Role: Villain/Former Vigilante

Personality: A cruel ideologue obsessed with purging false heroes. He possesses indomitable conviction and reveres only All Might as truly heroic. Willful, calculating, and utterly devoted to his twisted vision of justice.

Appearance: A muscular man with hunched posture and triangular face. Small red eyes with tiny irises, self-removed nose, and extraordinarily long tongue. Long black hair beneath a blood-red headband and tattered mask. Dark combat suit with plated metal armor, yellow forearm bandages, black wristbands, metal knee pads, and crimson scarf.

cardPool.title: Chiyo Shuzenji
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Chiyo Shuzenji

Alias: Recovery Girl, Youthful Heroine

Quirk Name: Heal

Occupation/Role: School Nurse at U.A. High School

Personality: Compassionate and kind, offering sweets to counteract her Quirk's stamina drain. She maintains a strict attitude toward reckless behavior, refusing to enable harmful patterns even by withholding aid when necessary.

Appearance: A short, elderly woman with gray hair in a netted bun with a large syringe protruding from it. She wears a white lab coat over a dress with yellow and red vest-like designs, a pink "R"-shaped belt buckle, pink boots, and a helmet with purple visor. She walks with a syringe-shaped cane.

Backstory: An experienced medical professional serving U.A. High School as its primary nurse.

cardPool.title: Chitose Kizuki
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Chitose Kizuki

Alias: Curious

Quirk Name: Lacquering

Occupation/Role: Executive Director of Shoowaysha Publishing, Meta Liberation Army Leader

Personality: Intensely curious and obsessively driven by journalism, Chitose pursues stories above all else, even her own safety. She is callous and manipulative, willing to weaponize subordinates for the perfect narrative. Her obsessive nature causes her to lose all sense of danger.

Appearance: Chitose is a striking woman with long, pale lilac hair parted to her right side. She has unusual eyes with black sclerae, green irises, and black pupils. Her skin is pale blue. She typically wears a navy blue, shoulderless dress with long sleeves, an X-shaped belt, and laced high boots.

cardPool.title: Chikuchi Togeike
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Chikuchi Togeike

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Not specified

Occupation/Role: Student, U.A. High School General Department

Personality: Initially envious of Class 1-A but showed remorse after their School Festival performance. Generally sullen but willing to acknowledge others' achievements.

Appearance: Young woman with dark, ear-length hair in low curved pigtails and upward-arching bangs. Thin, stern eyes with prominent lower eyelashes and sullen expression. Wears standard U.A. uniform.

Backstory: A General Department student who resented Hero Course Class 1-A until their School Festival performance prompted self-reflection. During the Final War, she assisted civilians in U.A. Underground Evacuation Bunkers.

Additional Information: Considers Nejire Hado an idol.

cardPool.title: Chikara Yotsubashi
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Chikara Yotsubashi

Alias: Destro

Quirk Name: Not specified in source

Occupation/Role: Infamous villain, founder and grand commander of the Meta Liberation Army

Personality: Idealistic revolutionary who believed Quirk use was a fundamental human right. Viewed government regulation as oppressive and inspired devoted followers.

Appearance: Long light brown hair in a ponytail with a black blotch marking around his eyes. Wore a dark green military jacket with a red-outlined rat patch on the right sleeve, gray shirt, and red ascot tie.

Backstory: Born during an era of Meta Ability prejudice, Chikara faced social rejection. His mother advocated for acceptance and coined the term "Quirk.

cardPool.title: Cathleen Bate
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Cathleen Bate

Alias: Star and Stripe

Quirk Name: Amplification

Occupation/Role: No. 1 Pro Hero of the United States of America

Personality: Brash, selfless, and fiercely protective. Defies rules to save others. Kind and sisterly toward her team. Willing to sacrifice everything for those she protects.

Appearance: A tall, athletic woman with long blonde hair in eight backward-swept tufts, narrow brown eyes, and a red domino mask. She wears a high-collared striped bodysuit with metal-studded gauntlets and collar featuring star designs, and a long flag-patterned cape.

Backstory: Inspired by All Might saving her family, Cathleen dedicated herself to heroism. Once insecure about her Quirk's limits, her squadron encouraged her to embrace her strength. She became America's No.

cardPool.title: Bruno Gollini
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Bruno Gollini

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Delay Spot

Occupation/Role: Member of the Gollini Family mafia

Personality: Sly and cunning, Bruno enjoys catching opponents off-guard. His confidence crumbles when outmatched, replaced by panic.

Appearance: A tall, slim middle-aged man with slicked greying hair, sharp black eyes, and defined jawline. His hands are hairy and adorned with rings and jewelry. He wears a black suit jacket with blue tuxedo shirt, gray pants, and a plum ascot tie with a rose pin.

Backstory: Bruno operates as a trusted member of the Gollini Family criminal organization, leveraging his Delay Spot Quirk to intimidate opponents.

cardPool.title: Bruce Lee
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Bruce Lee
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Fa Jin
Occupation/Role: Resistance Member, One For All User
Personality: Serious, apathetic survivor with unwavering belief in justice. Views world in black and white—victory means life, defeat means death. Initially skeptical of idealism but capable of empathy and mentorship. Fiercely loyal to allies.
Appearance: Tall, athletic build with striking silver hair in upward spiky ponytail. Dark eyes and sharp features. Wears black forehead bandana and green combat jacket.
Backstory: Bruce survived Quirk emergence and became battle-hardened. He joined Toshitsugu Kudo's resistance against All For One as trusted second-in-command. Kudo passed One For All to him as successor.

cardPool.title: Briareos
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Briareos

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Multiple Arm

Occupation/Role: Tartarus Prison Guard

Personality: Duty-bound and resolute, remaining calm under pressure while issuing tactical orders.

Appearance: An imposing figure in crimson and black armor with an intimidating helmet. His Quirk grants him ten arms, wielded with practiced efficiency in combat.

Backstory: Senior guard at Tartarus prison's Bronze Gate. During the Paranormal Liberation Front's assault, he fought High-End Nomu as villains escaped, including Tomura Shigaraki.

Additional Information: Possessed enhanced strength proportional to his multiple limbs, capable of wielding heavy military-grade miniguns. Died defending Tartarus when a Nomu's spike barrage overwhelmed his position.

cardPool.title: Bombers
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Bomber (Designation Unknown)
Alias: Bomber, Next-Level Villain
Quirk Name: Explosive Detonation (varies by specimen)
Occupation/Role: Mass-produced combat entity created by the Villain Factory
Personality: Operates on programmed directives with absolute obedience and no self-preservation instinct, ideal for suicide missions.
Appearance: Round, winged entity with jet-black skin and serpentine head lacking facial features except a wide mouth. Two bat wings protrude from the back. Swollen belly contains explosive energy reserves.
Backstory: Manufactured by the Villain Factory at Onomura Pharma Corp. as expendable weapons. Deployed by villain Number 6 against Pro Hero Captain Celebrity during the Tokyo Sky Egg incident.

cardPool.title: Blackbelt
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Blackbelt, Martial Hero: Blackbelt
Quirk Name: Fast Fist
Occupation/Role: Pro Hero
Personality: Seeks recognition while maintaining heroic duty. Uses affected Shakespearean speech but lapses into normal dialogue. Creates unnecessarily complex techniques for show. Prioritizes saving lives over fame when it matters.
Appearance: Young man with long, messy hair and muscular build. Wears martial artist-inspired hero costume with metal headband, loose robes, and large belt. Light facial makeup completes his martial arts master image.
Backstory: Became Pro Hero 10 years ago seeking fame. Faced relentless mockery from civilians doubting his superhuman speed claims, earning the nickname "Hundo-Hit-Man.

cardPool.title: Yuyu Haya
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Yuyu Haya

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Unknown

Occupation/Role: UA High School Student, Class 3-A

Personality: Friendly and fashionable with a protective streak. Levelheaded as a hero-in-training, though she jumps to conclusions. Highly loyal and supportive, especially toward best friend Nejire Hado.

Appearance: Fair-skinned girl with cropped salmon-colored hair and reddish-brown eyes. Grey ear piercings. School uniform worn with cropped collar, rolled sleeves, tights, and two pink bracelets. Hero costume features black domino mask, purple suit with yellow markings, purple boots, black arm sleeves, and white belt.

Backstory: Third-year student at UA and best friend to Nejire Hado since first year.

cardPool.title: Yuga Aoyama
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Yuga Aoyama

Alias: Shining Hero: Can't Stop Twinkling

Quirk Name: Navel Laser

Occupation/Role: Class 1-A Student at UA High School

Personality: Vain and flamboyant with a closed smile, Yuga presents himself as superior and attention-seeking. He speaks with affected French mannerisms and ends sentences with stars (☆). Beneath this facade lies deep insecurity from his Quirkless birth. He is prone to upset if interrupted or questioned.

Appearance: A slim young man with long blonde hair spiked at the sides with a curved fringe and bright indigo eyes. His hero costume features a black bodysuit beneath metallic lavender armor with golden accents, a high V-neck chest plate, spherical shoulder pads, and knee boots. A glittery indigo cape flows from his golden ring-buckled belt.

cardPool.title: Yui Kodai
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Yui Kodai

Alias:
Rule

Quirk Name:
Size

Occupation/Role:
UA High School Student, Class 1-B

Personality:
Quiet and reserved with a kūdere demeanor. She cares deeply for her classmates and shows warmth through subtle actions. She communicates happiness with soft "Mm!" sounds and shows particular enthusiasm for tomatoes.

Appearance:
A young girl with shoulder-length bob-cut hair, side-swept bangs, and fair skin. She has narrow cerulean eyes and an athletic build. Her hero costume consists of a red bodysuit with white-collar trim and a white "V" pattern across her chest and upper arms, paired with a short white skirt. Inquisitive and caring. Idolizes her older sister Tsuyu.

A young girl with a tadpole-like appearance featuring large round eyes, small eyebrows, light-tanned skin, and a pout-like mouth. Dark green hair in low pigtails reflects her family's froggy theme.

Backstory:
The youngest daughter of the Asui family, raised primarily by her older sister Tsuyu while their parents worked. The siblings developed a close bond.

Additional Information:
Satsuki has a younger brother named Samidare. She idolizes her sister Tsuyu, who attends UA High School. The family evacuated during the Paranormal Liberation War.
