cardPool.title: Samuel Abraham
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Samuel Abraham
Alias: Sam
Quirk Name: Unknown
Occupation/Role: Scientist and assistant to David Shield at I-Island
Personality: Appears goodhearted but becomes resentful when unrecognized; willing to betray colleagues for money, yet surprised by selfless sacrifice.
Appearance: Older, heavyset man with short blonde hair and closed blue eyes; wears dark suit, tie, suspenders, and dress shoes.
Backstory: Co-developed the Quirk Amplification Device with David Shield. When governments pressured I-Island to confiscate the research, Sam grew bitter about lacking compensation. He hired villains to recover the device and planned to sell it to Wolfram for payment. David shielded him from a bullet, nearly dying.

cardPool.title: Samidare Asui
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Samidare Asui

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Frog

Occupation/Role: Student (youngest Asui sibling)

Personality: Laid-back and carefree, relying on his older sister Tsuyu for support. Shows typical younger sibling behavior with familial affection and pride in Tsuyu's accomplishments.

Appearance: A young boy with a frog-like appearance. Black hair obscures his right eye, dark green half-closed eyes, and distinctive blush marks on his cheeks.

Backstory: The youngest Asui son, raised primarily by Tsuyu while their parents traveled for work. After the Paranormal Liberation War, his family relocated to an evacuation center while Tsuyu joined the heroes in battle.

Additional Information: Second-youngest of Tsuyu's siblings. Shares the family's frog-type quirk.

cardPool.title: Sajin Higawara
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Sajin Higawara
Alias: Sand Hero: Snatch
Quirk Name: Sandstorm
Occupation/Role: Pro Hero and Police Force Bodyguard
Personality: Compassionate and justice-driven, angered by remorseless villains. Courageous but principled, willing to abandon battles to save innocents.
Appearance: Muscular man with turquoise eyes and light ash-blond hair in a long ponytail extending from his dark blue mask. Wears a green and silver combat vest with connected tubes running to his back. Distinguished by a long mustache.
Backstory: Dedicated Pro Hero known for heroic principles and empathy. Stationed as bodyguard during Overhaul's transport, he confronted the League of Villains during a police convoy ambush, fighting to protect officers and prisoners.

cardPool.title: Saiko Intelli
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Saiko Intelli

Alias:
None

Quirk Name:
IQ

Occupation/Role:
Second Year Student at Seiai Academy

Personality:
Arrogant and confident in her intellectual superiority, Saiko formulates complex strategies with precision. She struggles with emotional reasoning and empathy, viewing decisions through pure logic. She shows humility when defeated and recognizes the value of bonds.

Appearance:
A pale girl of average height with thin, cat-like eyes featuring bluish-lilac irises. Straight pale blue-lavender-gray hair in a hime cut cascades to her waist. She wears the Seiai Academy uniform: white double-breasted blazer with gold trim, dark blue long-sleeved shirt, matching dress pants, white gloves and boots, and a white beret with black trim.

cardPool.title: Ryuko Tatsuma
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Ryuko Tatsuma

Alias: Dragoon Hero: Ryukyu

Quirk Name: Dragon

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero (No. 10), Mentor

Personality: Humble and composed, Ryuko praises deserving talent without seeking gratitude. She maintains calm in combat and delegates effectively. Despite her rank, she carries self-doubt, feeling unworthy after failing to save someone. She displays a protective, nurturing side toward trainees.

Appearance: A woman with chin-length blonde hair swept back with a headband and long fringe covering her right eye. She has thin yellow eyes with reptilian slit pupils and sharp teeth. She wears a dark red qipao with yellow collar trim, pale green scale-textured shoulder trim, and side-slit skirt.

cardPool.title: Ryo Inui
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Ryo Inui

Alias: Hound Dog

Quirk Name: Dog

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero and Head of Student Discipline at U.A. High School

Personality: Gruff and volatile, prone to aggressive outbursts with growls and barks. Despite rough demeanor, he values justice and fairness, praising students while holding them accountable.

Appearance: Dog-like features with scruffy blond mane and pointed snout. Wears a black muzzle as part of his hero costume. Muscular and bestial frame from his Quirk.

Backstory: A seasoned Pro Hero known as the Hunting Dog Hero. Recruited as Head of Student Discipline at U.A. to oversee student conduct and safety. Often at odds with rule-breaking students but seeks to guide them toward responsible heroism.

cardPool.title: Ronaudo Keage
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Ronaudo Keage

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Not specified

Occupation/Role: UA High School Student, Department of Management

Personality: Enterprising and analytical, focused on hero marketing and public perception. Demonstrates business acumen in assessing hero marketability.

Appearance: Young man of average height with short dark purple hair, small round eyes, and distinctive counter-clockwise swirl-like blush marks on his cheeks. Typically wears his UA gym uniform.

Backstory: A Department of Management student at UA High School pursuing business courses in heroic commerce. Analyzes hero marketability and works in media production and public relations for heroes.

Additional Information: Associates with classmates Futo and Komako.

cardPool.title: Rikiya Yotsubashi
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Rikiya Yotsubashi

Alias: Re-Destro

Quirk Name: Stress

Occupation/Role: President and CEO of Detnerat Company; Grand Commander of the Meta Liberation Army

Personality: Outwardly affable but a ruthless ideological fanatic devoted to Destro's vision of Quirk liberation. Kills without hesitation when disrespected but shows genuine remorse. Intelligent and manipulative, he recruits outcasts by exploiting society's flaws.

Appearance: Tall, middle-aged man with a long pointed nose, protruding chin, short orange-brownish hair swept back with a widow's peak, small dark eyes, no eyebrows, and two dark moles on his left forehead. Muscular despite appearing slim. Always wears a black pinstriped suit with green dress shirt and tie, often with a black hat and coat.

cardPool.title: Rikiya Eno
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Rikiya Eno

Alias:
The Instant Villain

Quirk Name:
Big Monkey

Occupation/Role:
Vigilante/Petty Criminal

Personality:
Reckless and easily influenced. Prone to destructive behavior when chemically enhanced.

Appearance:
Unremarkable normally. When transformed via Trigger, becomes a massive rotund ape with dark fur several meters tall, wearing black shorts.

Backstory:
A minor criminal who used Trigger to amplify his quirk for petty crimes and street chaos. Attempted mayhem atop a city tower before being defeated by Captain Celebrity in a single punch near the Naruhata Festival.

Additional Information:
Rikiya's quirk requires Trigger chemical enhancement to manifest. His transformation is temporary and reversible.

cardPool.title: Rikido Sato
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Rikido Sato

Alias:
Sweets Hero: Sugarman

Quirk Name:
Sugar Rush

Occupation/Role:
UA High School Student, Class 1-A

Personality:
Optimistic and good-natured, Rikido enjoys baking and sharing sweets with classmates. He is humble and earnest in combat.

Appearance:
A tall, very muscular young man with short spiky brown hair, small square eyes, bushy eyebrows, and a large round nose. He wears the standard UA uniform and a yellow hero costume with white gloves, boots, and a utility belt for sugar pouches.

Backstory:
Rikido developed baking skills out of necessity—his Quirk requires sugar to function. His culinary talents have made him a valued member of Class 1-A.

cardPool.title: Reiko Yanagi
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Reiko Yanagi

Alias:
Emily

Quirk Name:
Poltergeist

Occupation/Role:
Hero Course Student, Class 1-B, U.A. High School

Personality:
Quiet and emotionally reserved with a fascination for horror. Despite her timid nature, she is helpful and maintains an eerie posture with elbows tucked and hands dangling.

Appearance:
A pallid, slender young woman with pale silver pin-straight hair in a pixie-bob. She has dark prussian-blue half-lidded eyes with pointed lower lashes and plump lips. Her hero costume is a light periwinkle-blue kimono with a puffy hood, flared sleeves, and white and navy striping.

Backstory:
A first-year student at U.A. High School's Hero Course, Reiko has honed her telekinetic abilities under professional guidance.

cardPool.title: Rei Todoroki
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Rei Todoroki

Alias:
Rei Himura (maiden name)

Quirk Name:
Frost

Occupation/Role:
Homemaker, Mother

Personality:
Rei is a kind, caring woman who endures hardship with quiet resilience. Years of abuse left her mentally fragile, but recovery has restored her compassionate nature. She maintains hope and smiles despite trauma, showing deep love for her children while struggling with lingering wounds.

Appearance:
A middle-aged woman of average height with shoulder-length straight white hair parted into three sections. She has round, gentle features with tired brown-gray eyes and long eyelashes. Her expression is typically mellow and kind. She favors plain clothing in soft colors.

Backstory:
Rei married Enji Todoroki in an arranged Quirk Marriage for financial help.

cardPool.title: Pony Tsunotori
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Pony Tsunotori

Alias:
Rocketti

Quirk Name:
Horn Cannon

Occupation/Role:
UA High School Student, Class 1-B

Personality:
Friendly and naive but determined and observant in combat. Prefers tactical draws to reckless victories. Reverts to English when angered or flustered. Enjoys anime and manga.

Appearance:
Short girl with round face, equine muzzle, and thick wavy blonde hair to mid-back. Large Prussian blue eyes, tall lyre-shaped horns, horse-like calves with brown hooves, and short horse tail. Wears jockey-themed hero costume with orange skin-tight shirt, matching pants, fingerless gloves, horse halter with lead rope, and belted boots with stirrups.

cardPool.title: Paulo Gollini
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Paulo Gollini

Alias:
None

Quirk Name:
Erasure Spot

Occupation/Role:
Member of the Gollini Family mafia

Personality:
Cautious and dutiful, Paulo prefers swift execution. However, he panics and becomes desperate when cornered, quickly abandoning confidence to beg for mercy.

Appearance:
Paulo has purple skin, small black eyes, and no visible mouth. His face tapers to a pointed muzzle with jagged fin-shaped ears. He wears a black suit with leather tailcoat, white gloves, purple tie, and brown derby shoes. A black fedora with a red rose completes his ensemble.

Backstory:
Paulo earned his place in the Gollini Family through diligent service but carries shame from allowing Ginji Kurau to escape with Anna Scervino. He now eliminates threats to the family's operations.

cardPool.title: Pamela
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Pamela
Alias: Mrs. Captain Celebrity
Quirk Name: Unknown
Occupation/Role: Former wife of Pro Hero Captain Celebrity, mother, businesswoman
Personality: Gruff and sharp-tongued, Pamela dislikes unsolicited help and voices harsh opinions freely. Beneath her frown lies a kind heart for those she cares about, though past betrayals make trust difficult.
Appearance: A short woman with a rounded face, long blonde hair, small nose covered in freckles, and large green eyes shadowed by a perpetual frown.
Backstory: Pamela met Christopher in high school. His persistence won her over and they married, but his infidelity led to estrangement. She became pregnant with their son before he left for Japan.

cardPool.title: Oboro Shirakumo
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Oboro Shirakumo

Alias: Loud Cloud

Quirk Name: Cloud

Occupation/Role: UA High School Student, Class 2-A, Hero-in-Training

Personality: Jovial and energetic with a love of jokes and witty banter. Oboro is casual and somewhat irreverent toward protocol, defined by selfless altruism and readily helping others in need.

Appearance: A tall young man with light blue wavy hair swept back with ear-length tufts and semicircular blue eyes. His hero costume consists of a blue martial arts gi with black obi, black fingerless gloves, and a dark brown aviator jacket with white fur lining. He wears a blue aviator hat with mufflers, beige goggles with silver lenses, black boots with white accents, and carries a deep red quarterstaff.

cardPool.title: Oji Harima
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Oji Harima

Alias:
The Peerless Thief

Quirk Name:
Unknown

Occupation/Role:
Infamous Villain, Robin Hood-like Thief

Personality:
Philosophical idealist driven by justice. Steals from wealthy heroes to redistribute wealth to the poor, challenging the hero system through revolutionary action.

Appearance:
Dark maroon spiked hair with orange bandana. Heavy clown-like makeup with dark lipstick and eye shadow. White kimono shirt with black symbol, wide black belt, and blue striped shirt beneath. Light baggy striped pants with maroon tight boots. Forearm bracelets complete his theatrical jester aesthetic.

Backstory:
Oji emerged during the early hero system's establishment.

cardPool.title: Number 6
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Rokuro Nomura

Alias: Number 6, Rock, High-Speed Hero: O'Clock II

Quirk Name: Overclock

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero (undercover), Villain Factory member

Personality: Confident with a perpetual smirk, remaining calm under pressure. Avoids unnecessary confrontation but employs violence without hesitation. Vengeful and ruthless, showing no remorse endangering innocents.

Appearance: Athletic build with long, curly black hair in a ponytail. A diagonal scar across his face and nose, self-inflicted. Sharp, calculating eyes. Black full-body hero suit with blue and yellow accents, trench coat, and black fedora.

Backstory: Experimented on by All For One since childhood.

cardPool.title: Nyikang
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Nyikang

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Spirit Possession

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero (Sudan)

Personality: Composed and professional, cooperating with other heroes.

Appearance: Tall figure in riveted metal armor with gauntlets, red and yellow sash, black branch-like head protrusions, and riveted metal mask.

Backstory: Pro Hero from Sudan at the I-Expo preview. Captured by Wolfram's forces, he was freed and helped locate the Trigger Bomb and fight Humarise operatives in Egypt.

Additional Information: Carries a large sword. Spirit Possession allows remote consciousness projection to incapacitate or control targets in combat.

cardPool.title: Nirengeki Shoda
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Nirengeki Shoda

Alias: Mines

Quirk Name: Twin Impact

Occupation/Role: UA High School Class 1-B Vice Class Representative, Hero-in-Training

Personality: Humble and conscientious, Nirengeki refuses unearned credit and serves as moral compass. He is reliable, collaborative, and mature. His classmates trust him implicitly, excelling at tactical teamwork.

Appearance: A chubby young man of below-average height with short ice-blue hair and round boyish face. Large wide eyes give him a sheepish expression. He wears a black high-collared hero costume trimmed with pale white lines, black pants, white knee-high boots, a blue scouter over his left eye, and a connected radar on one gloved hand.

cardPool.title: Nezu
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Nezu

Alias: Mr. Principal

Quirk Name: High Specs

Occupation/Role: Principal of U.A. High School, Pro Hero

Personality: Eccentric and polite with a darker side from past human abuse. Enjoys combat and holds grudges. Self-aware and verbose, he genuinely cares for student safety while remaining unpredictable in conflict.

Appearance: A small white-furred stoat-like creature with circular black eyes, one marked by a large scar, rectangular ears with pale pink insides, and an elongated muzzle. He wears a white dress shirt, dark red tie, black double-breasted waistcoat, matching pants, and oversized orange lace-up sneakers.

Backstory: An extremely rare animal who manifested a Quirk, Nezu endured severe mistreatment and experimentation by humans. He now leads U.A.

cardPool.title: Nemuri Kayama
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Nemuri Kayama

Alias: Midnight, R-Rated Hero

Quirk Name: Somnambulist

Occupation/Role: UA High School Faculty, Modern Hero Art History Teacher

Personality: Playful, flirtatious, and perverted with serious moments. Easily angered by interruptions, sensitive about age. Shows no shame in sexual behavior. Excited by youth and chivalry.

Appearance: Tall, curvaceous woman with sky-blue eyes, long lashes, and long thick spiky dark purple layered hair. Small beauty mark below left eye, pink glasses, and pink nails. Wears a revealing black leather leotard over white bodysuit with red gemstones, light purple thigh-high stockings, burgundy utility belt with gold studs, black stiletto knee-boots, red eye mask, wrist handcuffs, and carries a whip.

cardPool.title: Neito Monoma
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Neito Monoma

Alias: Phantom Thief

Quirk Name: Copy

Occupation/Role: UA High School Class 1-B Student

Personality: Loud and sarcastic, mocking Class 1-A from envy and inferiority complex. Otherwise calm and kind, but prone to unhinged tirades earning strikes from Itsuka Kendo. Deliberately provocative, though sometimes insensitive.

Appearance: Average height with slick blonde hair parted right, bangs over right eye. Periwinkle blue irises with downward-slanting half-closed eyes and characteristic smirk. Wears black double-breasted tuxedo tailcoat with upturned collar, light and dark blue dotted tie, small blue handkerchief in breast pocket, black pants and white shoes. Three clocks on belt track Quirk time limit.

cardPool.title: Natsuo Todoroki
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Natsuo Todoroki

Alias:
None

Quirk Name:
Ice

Occupation/Role:
College Student

Personality:
Friendly on the surface but harbors resentment toward his father Enji for family trauma. Cares deeply for his siblings, especially Shoto. Shows maturity handling sensitive matters, though struggles with forgiveness.

Appearance:
A tall, well-built young man with distinctive white spiky hair and crimson-red streaks down his forehead. Gray eyes with long eyelashes give him a gentle appearance.

Backstory:
The second son of Enji Todoroki, Natsuo grew up in a fractured household marked by his father's emotional neglect. Separated from his younger brother Shoto during childhood and witnessing his mother's hospitalization shaped his worldview.

cardPool.title: Native
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Native
Quirk Name: Unknown
Occupation/Role: Pro Hero
Personality: Easily irritated but selfless and grateful. Shows concern for others' safety and humility about his limitations.
Appearance: A muscular man wearing feathered headgear and matching cape over a dark jumpsuit with the letter "N" on the chest. Wears open-toed sandals.
Backstory: An established Pro Hero attacked by the Hero Killer Stain in an alleyway. Nearly killed before being saved by UA High School students Tenya Iida, Izuku Midoriya, and Shoto Todoroki. Grateful for their intervention, he rewarded them with theme park tickets. Later participated in the hospital raid against the League of Villains.
Additional Information: Native's Quirk details remain unspecified.

cardPool.title: Naomasa Tsukauchi
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Naomasa Tsukauchi
Alias: Detective Tsukauchi
Quirk Name: Polygraph
Occupation/Role: Police Detective
Personality: Earnest and hardworking, Naomasa is strict about law yet pragmatic when justice demands it. He values loyalty deeply but can be rigid about procedure. Despite his by-the-book nature, he shows willingness to work with unconventional allies if their intentions prove genuine.
Appearance: A tall man with short black hair and rectangular black eyes, Naomasa wears a tan trench coat with matching fedora over a white collared shirt and dark pale green tie, completed with brown dress shoes and white gloves.

cardPool.title: Nana Shimura
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Nana Shimura

Alias:
The Seventh One For All User

Quirk Name:
One For All

Occupation/Role:
Pro Hero and former mentor to All Might

Personality:
A kind woman with strong justice who believed true heroes must smile to save lives. Optimistic about others' potential, she valued bravery, resilience, and self-sacrifice.

Appearance:
A tall, fair-skinned woman with athletic build. Dark shoulder-length hair in half-up bun with short bangs, sharp intelligent eyes, and a small mole below her bottom lip. Her hero costume features a dark sleeveless bodysuit with high collar, yellow gloves, white knee-high boots, golden belt buckle, small cape, and buttoned shoulder capes.

Backstory:
Symbol of hope who mentored Toshinori Yagi and instilled in him the smiling hero philosophy.

cardPool.title: Mustard
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Mustard
Alias: Mustard
Quirk Name: Gas
Occupation/Role: C-rank villain, League of Villains Vanguard Action Squad member
Personality: Pragmatic and merciless, highly intelligent and calculating. Arrogant and boastful with deep jealousy toward UA students. Shows exceptional cruelty and willingness to kill.
Appearance: Skinny young man with short, wavy light brown hair and tan skin. Wears a green gas mask connected to two oxygen tanks on his back, black gakuran school uniform, teal gloves, and white shoes.
Backstory: A League of Villains member driven by resentment toward UA High School, viewing student success as unearned privilege.
Additional Information: Lacks hand-to-hand combat skills, relying on his Gas Quirk and a 38 revolver.

cardPool.title: Moyuru Tochi
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Moyuru Tochi

Alias:
None

Quirk Name:
Ignition

Occupation/Role:
Former Instant Villain, Reformed Vigilante

Personality:
Once a callous bully, Moyuru became calm, respectful, and remorseful after his arrest. He shows genuine kindness toward former victims and camaraderie with peers.

Appearance:
A large, portly young man with dark brown skin and bald head. A small flame grows from his head as hair, extinguishing when unconscious. He has rounded, pupilless eyes. He wears a purple open button-down shirt with prominent belly showing, shorts, and slippers.

Backstory:
Moyuru was an Instant Villain who used Trigger to enhance his abilities and terrorize weaker citizens. His criminal career ended when defeated and arrested by Knuckleduster, sparking genuine reformation.

cardPool.title: Moonfish
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Moonfish (true name unknown)
Alias: Moonfish
Quirk Name: Blade-Tooth
Occupation/Role: Villain, League of Villains Vanguard Action Squad member
Personality: Insane and laconic, consumed by obsessive hunger for flesh. Constantly mutters to himself, easily distracted by any flesh source. Prioritizes hunger above ideology with no mercy, willing to kill anyone to satisfy cravings. Despite madness, demonstrates tactical capability.
Appearance: Tall man with fair skin and black eyes, almost entirely obscured by restraint gear. Black straitjacket with red-spiked restraints, metal head clamps forcing lips open with constant drooling. Additional straps cross torso, waist, and boots. Shaven head with large cut on left ear. Only mouth exposed, revealing his weapon.

cardPool.title: Anan Kurose
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Anan Kurose

Alias: Space Hero: Thirteen

Quirk Name: Black Hole

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero and UA High School Faculty Member

Personality: Wise and compassionate, passionate about rescue work and saving lives. Advocates for constructive Quirk use despite her own Quirk's lethal potential. Brave and selfless.

Appearance: Young woman with short navy blue hair and blonde spiral patch at the roots. Hazel irises ringed like black holes. Black substance coating her hands and forearms. Wears white puffy space suit-style jacket, black helmet with white eye markings, and yellow boots.

Backstory: Dedicated Pro Hero specializing in search and rescue operations. Developed the Unforeseen Simulation Joint to teach rescue tactics. Faculty member at UA High School.

cardPool.title: Anna Scervino
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Anna Scervino

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Overmodification

Occupation/Role: Civilian (formerly imprisoned by the Gollini Family mafia)

Personality: Traumatized and melancholic but naturally joyful when safe. Deep PTSD from losing her family to the mafia and aversion to violence. Capable of optimism when freed from her burden.

Appearance: Young woman with waist-length light peach hair and blue eyes that darken when her Quirk activates. Wears a long-sleeved pink and white dress with a red bow on her chest and head, and a pink choker.

Backstory: Anna grew up isolated due to her dangerous Quirk causing pain to incompatible individuals. Only her butler Giulio Gandini could safely remain near her due to his Neutralization Quirk.

cardPool.title: Lunch Rush
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Cook Hero: Lunch Rush
Quirk Name: Unknown
Occupation/Role: Pro Hero and U.A. High School cafeteria chef
Personality: Upbeat and enthusiastic, communicates through thumbs-up gestures and nonverbal cues. Dedicated and supportive of students.
Appearance: Wears a white chef hat, cooking apron, white gloves, and white shoes. A tube extends from his mouth to his back. Face mask obscures his features.
Backstory: An accomplished Pro Hero who dedicates himself to feeding U.A. students. Once prepared full-course French meals for ten-thousand typhoon victims, demonstrating exceptional skill and compassion.
Additional Information: Renowned for exceptional cuisine quality and variety. Supports critical missions with sustenance for high-endurance operations.

cardPool.title: Navel Laser
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Navel Laser

Description:
A light-based offensive quirk that fires laser beams from the user's navel. The beams pierce concrete and destroy metal at various ranges. Originally stolen and implanted by All For One, this quirk requires external support to function.

Functions/Applications:
Beams can be reshaped into blades or projectiles and manipulated in size. Strong recoil propels the user through the air. Beams illuminate dark areas. With specialized equipment, beams can fire from multiple body points.

Limits:
Without the Sparkle Belt, the quirk cannot be controlled or aimed. Continuous firing causes internal damage and risks loss of bowel control. User can only fire straight ahead, leaving rear exposure vulnerable.

cardPool.title: Big Red Dot
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown

Alias: Big Red Dot

Quirk Name: Tidal Bore

Occupation/Role: Number 1 Pro Hero of Singapore

Personality: Caring and loyal with strong justice and leadership qualities. Maintains composure under pressure and readily sacrifices for others.

Appearance: Well-built man with a lion's head and webbed feet. Wears a sleeveless light blue wetsuit with water-design belt, elbow-length arm guards, and shoulder pads bearing the Singaporean flag. Small domino mask completes his costume.

Backstory: Singapore's top-ranked hero and trusted ally of All Might. Proven capability in coordinated multi-national operations against terrorist threats.

Additional Information: Leads international hero task forces.

cardPool.title: All For One
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Zen Shigaraki

Alias: All For One

Quirk Name: All For One

Occupation/Role: Founder and leader of the League of Villains; Japan's most powerful villain

Personality: Cold, calculating, and tyrannical. Patient and obsessed with orchestrating multi-decade schemes. A manipulative strategist who values power above all else.

Appearance: Towering and muscular with severe scarring covering his entire head and face. Features composed mostly of scar tissue with no visible nose, ears, or hair; faded white eyes barely discernible. Wears a dark formal suit, white collared shirt, and dark navy skull-like gas mask with angular tubes and life-support collar system around his neck.

Backstory: Japan's most powerful villain and All Might's arch-nemesis.

cardPool.title: Toshinori Yagi
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Toshinori Yagi

Alias:
All Might

Quirk Name:
One For All

Occupation/Role:
Foundational Hero Studies Teacher, UA High School

Personality:
Charismatic and heroic with unwavering justice. Burdened by his Symbol of Peace title but dedicates himself to mentoring through conviction and example.

Appearance:
In empowered form, imposingly muscular with chiseled features and strong jawline. Short blond hair swept back with two distinctive front tufts. Deep blue eyes with shadowed sockets. Wears iconic costume: skin-tight blue bodysuit with red "Y" symbol on chest, white diamond center, white hip patches with red trim, yellow forearm sleeves, and yellow belt with silver buckle.

Backstory:
The eighth holder of One For All, inherited from Nana Shimura. Japan's No.

cardPool.title: Erasure Spot
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Erasure Spot

Description:
Paulo Gollini manifests a dome-shaped energy wave that deactivates all Quirks within range. He can create a smaller protective bubble inside where Quirks remain active. When artificially boosted, the range expands to cover entire mountain ranges.

Functions/Applications:
Creates a nullification field stripping enemies of Quirk abilities. The inner bubble allows allies with non-Quirk combat skills to function while enemies outside remain powerless. Useful for disorienting opponents and controlling battlefield positioning.

Limits:
The outer dome nullifies Quirks indiscriminately, affecting allies outside the inner bubble. Fast opponents can breach the field and reactivate their Quirks.

cardPool.title: En Tayutai
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
En Tayutai

Alias:
Smoke-Eater

Quirk Name:
Smokescreen

Occupation/Role:
Former Pro Hero, Sixth User of One For All

Personality:
Reserved but friendly with strong willpower. Generally composed, though emotions surface when concerned for others. Shows self-deprecation about his Quirk's weakness yet genuine warmth toward creative applications.

Appearance:
A short man with dark hair parted from narrow eyes. His hero costume features a large red jacket with straps and buttons, high collar obscuring his mouth and nose, dark baggy pants, large white hiking boots, and sports tape on his forearms.

Backstory:
En received One For All from Daigoro after the previous user fell to All For One. He resisted All For One's theft attempts twice, demonstrating exceptional willpower.

cardPool.title: Ground Beta
cardPool.value:
Name: Ground Beta

Location: Urban training facility with interconnected streets and multi-story buildings.

Inhabitants: Security robots, instructors, student combatants.

Appearance: Replica urban district with realistic streets and reinforced office buildings. Basement observation decks with monitoring screens. Sturdy architecture designed for combat training.

cardPool.title: Ground Gamma
cardPool.value:
Name:
Ground Gamma

Location:
An abandoned industrial complex with interconnected factories, heavy machinery, cranes, pipelines, and metal structures at multiple elevation levels.

Inhabitants:
Pro Heroes conducting training exercises, students undergoing combat trials, and authority figures like Principal Nezu overseeing examinations.

Appearance:
A sprawling maze of rust-streaked factories and towering equipment. Massive cranes loom overhead, pipelines crisscross at various heights, and metal catwalks offer unstable footing. Debris and fallen machinery scatter the ground. Vertical movement is heavily favored with treacherous passages and crane-based traversal routes. The environment tests agility, endurance, and adaptability.

cardPool.title: Ground Omega
cardPool.value:
Name:
Ground Omega

Location:
A walled training grounds with an omega-marked entrance. Dense woods with rocky hills and an observation post building adjacent to the perimeter.

Inhabitants:
Teachers including Shota Aizawa and All Might supervise training. Student groups use the grounds for survival drills and joint practice. Typically hosts twenty to thirty students during events.

Appearance:
A sprawling forest landscape with rocky outcroppings and uneven terrain for combat training. Stone wall perimeter with guarded entrance. The observation post offers commanding views.

cardPool.title: Air Walk
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Air Walk

Description:
The user can stand on and manipulate air itself, creating invisible platforms for levitation and mid-air locomotion.

Functions/Applications:
Users can float upward, walk on invisible air platforms, and hover at varying heights. This enables superior tactical positioning for ranged attacks, evasion, and terrain mobility.

Limits:
The user must maintain active focus to keep air platforms stable; loss of concentration causes falling. The quirk cannot support movement while unconscious or severely incapacitated. Sustained flight exhausts stamina over time.

Additional Notes:
Air Walk is a stolen quirk. Its primary advantage lies in vertical positioning rather than raw offensive power, making it suited for tactical support, reconnaissance, and ranged combat.

cardPool.title: Big Horn
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Big Horn

Description:
The user manifests a pair of large, bull-like horns from their head. These horns are physical extensions of the body and serve as a distinctive physical trait.

Functions/Applications:
The horns can be used for charging attacks or as weapons in direct combat. Severing a horn is rumored to improve communication or perception abilities.

Limits:
Horns cannot be regrown once removed. The user cannot fully control horn growth or retraction. Severing a horn causes permanent disfigurement and may alter the quirk's effectiveness.

Additional Notes:
Big Horn is a simple, appearance-based quirk with limited versatility. Users must carefully consider any irreversible modifications to their horns.

cardPool.title: Big Fist
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Big Fist

Description:
Itsuka enlarges one or both hands to three times her body size instantly. Physical strength scales proportionally, granting immense crushing and striking power without affecting movement or balance.

Functions/Applications:
Close-range combat with devastating striking force. Enlarged hands serve as restraint tools, transport vessels, and protective barriers. Fist-flapping disperses gas traps. Expansion provides offense, defense, and support functions.

Limits:
Short-range only with no ranged capability. Enlarged hands obstruct vision and fine manipulation. Cannot be maintained indefinitely. Wind generation is limited in power and range. Large size creates obvious visual tells.

cardPool.title: Blade-Tooth
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Blade-Tooth

Description:
The user can enlarge, reshape, and manipulate their teeth into sharpened, blade-like incisors of varying sizes and lengths. These dental weapons can be fired or extended at will with incredible speed and range, functioning as both melee and ranged attacks.

Functions/Applications:
Deploy torrents of tooth blades to barrage enemies. Use elongated teeth as projectiles or stabbing weapons at distance. Reshape teeth for tactical needs—piercing points for penetration or broader blades for cutting.

Limits:
Teeth can shatter under sufficient blunt force despite durability. Extended blades require stamina to maintain. Opponents with hardened defenses can resist or redirect attacks if fast enough.

cardPool.title: Blazing Hair
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Blazing Hair

Description:
The user's hair burns with controllable flames that can be shaped and weaponized. Fire originates from the head, enabling combat and enhanced mobility through aerial propulsion.

Functions/Applications:
Detach flaming hair as projectiles. Reshape flames into melee weapons. Generate thrust for flight and speed. Combine for aerial maneuvers and ranged-melee hybrid attacks.

Limits:
Sustained combat depletes flame reserves. Flight requires active concentration. Flames cannot extend far from the body or persist independently. Close-range opponents can extinguish flames through overwhelming defense or water-based counters.

Additional Notes:
Most effective with aerial advantage and distance. Hair attacks telegraph intentions.

cardPool.title: Body Bulk
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Body Bulk

Description:
A transformation quirk allowing the user to expand and densify their entire body, increasing muscle mass, size, and strength. The quirk activates most powerfully during intense negative emotions like rage, hatred, or fear.

Functions/Applications:
Enhanced physical strength for combat and lifting; increased durability from thickened muscle tissue; emotional triggers amplify transformation for temporary power surges. User can control the degree of bulk from partial to full transformation.

Limits:
Requires emotional intensity for peak effectiveness; prolonged use causes fatigue and muscle soreness; increased mass reduces speed and agility. Control becomes difficult during extreme emotional states.

Additional Notes:
Originally stolen by All For One.

cardPool.title: Dark Shadow
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Dark Shadow

Description:
A sentient shadowy entity manifesting from the user's body as a loyal guardian. It remains tethered through an umbilical connection and communicates telepathically. Composed of dark energy—solid enough to interact physically—and can extend limbs and shift shape to limited degrees.

Functions/Applications:
Serves as offensive weapon and defensive shield, stretching to grapple or slam enemies while user maintains distance. Provides mobility support, aids climbing, and can simulate flight with training. Grows exponentially stronger in darkness, becoming a large ferocious beast capable of devastating attacks.

Limits:
Energy depletes with extended distance, rapid impacts, or overuse.

cardPool.title: Electrification
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Electrification

Description:
Denki stores and discharges electrical energy as a protective aura that shocks on contact. High outputs create omnidirectional bursts that illuminate areas. He absorbs incoming electrical attacks and powers electronics.

Functions/Applications:
Close-range electroshock defense causing paralysis. Area-of-effect discharge at high power. Absorbs enemy electrical attacks. Energizes devices. Sharpshooting Gear directs electricity through projectiles safely.

Limits:
Ineffective at range without equipment. Lacks directional control, risking friendly fire. Exceeding wattage capacity causes brain short-circuit for one hour, leaving him incapacitated. Insulation and non-conductive Quirks negate effectiveness. Panic triggers uncontrolled discharge.

cardPool.title: Fast Fist
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Fast Fist

Description:
The user's hands and arms move at supernatural speed, striking up to 100 times per second. By targeting pressure points with precision, the user can render targets unconscious without lethal force.

Functions/Applications:
Rapid hand combat providing overwhelming offense. Pressure point targeting enables knockout incapacitation. Speed creates openings against slower opponents and allows defensive blocking.

Limits:
Confined to hands and arms only. User moves their body normally, limiting pursuit. Requires precision targeting for knockout effects. Fatigue limits sustained use.

Additional Notes:
Most effective against unarmored targets. Close-range Quirk with minimal distance utility. Control is difficult with injury risk.

cardPool.title: Shock Absorption
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Shock Absorption

Description:
The user absorbs kinetic energy and impact force from physical blows, reducing damage taken from strikes and collisions. The bearer can withstand tremendous punishment but cannot completely nullify attacks.

Functions/Applications:
Reduces incoming physical damage by dispersing shock waves throughout the body. Effective against melee attacks, falls, and explosions. Grants exceptional durability in direct combat against powerful opponents.

Limits:
Cumulative threshold; continuous attacks will eventually overwhelm capacity. Sustained damage bypasses effectiveness more efficiently than single powerful blows. Cannot absorb energy-based attacks or non-impact damage.

cardPool.title: Slide and Glide
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Slide and Glide

Description:
Projects repulsive (blue) and attractive (green) force from hands and feet. User can propel across surfaces at high speed, cling to vertical walls, launch energy blasts, and achieve limited flight through momentum boosts. Mastery allows full-body force coating for protection and mobility.

Functions/Applications:
Slide across ground and walls; climb vertical surfaces by attraction; fire repulsion beams at various distances; perform mid-air jumps for altitude and flight; project protective force fields for damage mitigation and levitation.

Limits:
No built-in braking—user must reverse acceleration to stop. Repulsion beams can be lethal. Multiple mid-air jumps require significant willpower; most users believe limited to two jumps.

cardPool.title: Fiber Master
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Fiber Master

Description:
Telekinetic control over threads, cloth, and fiber-based materials. The user can manipulate fibers to restrain enemies or create offensive weapons. Denim is easiest to control; sweats are most difficult. Works on synthetic fibers like carbon fiber.

Functions/Applications:
Restrain targets through their clothing. Unravel denim into whip-like strings for offense or defense. Redirect allies by manipulating garments. Requires concentration and available fabric sources.

Limits:
Naked or fiber-free targets cannot be controlled. Strong-willed foes can resist. User loses control if distracted. Effectiveness depends on fabric type and quantity available. Requires extensive training.

cardPool.title: Half-Cold Half-Hot
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Half-Cold Half-Hot

Description:
The user generates ice from their right side and fire from their left side, both originating internally. The power is perfectly balanced between both halves. Advanced mastery allows combining both elements into "cold fire" that simultaneously burns and freezes.

Functions/Applications:
Ice side: Freeze structures, create barriers, form platforms, generate mobility waves, precision attacks, ground skating. Fire side: Generate intense heat and flames, propel forward, regulate temperature. Combined technique: Merge elements into unified attacks with enhanced properties and temperature immunity.

Limits:
Overuse of either side without alternating causes fatal frostbite or overheating. Maximum output depletes reserves immediately.

cardPool.title: Masaru Bakugo
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Masaru Bakugo

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Not specified (presumed Quirkless or minor Quirk)

Occupation/Role: Fashion designer; father of UA High School student Katsuki Bakugo

Personality: Calm voice of reason in his volatile family. Loving and supportive, though often unsettled by conflict. Disapproves of his son's arrogance despite acknowledging his abilities.

Appearance: Middle-aged man of average height with short brown hair, rectangular glasses, and a short mustache. Dresses in casual professional attire.

Backstory: Once dreamed of becoming a Pro Hero but pursued fashion design instead. Met his wife Mitsuki at work and married her. Fathered Katsuki and has spent years balancing his son's gifted but arrogant nature with parental guidance.

cardPool.title: Mitsuki Bakugo
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Mitsuki Bakugo

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Glycerin

Occupation/Role: Housewife; Mother of UA Class 1-A student Katsuki Bakugo

Personality: Assertive and aggressive like her son, yet composed and respectful. Recognizes his arrogance stems from innate talent and childhood praise; occasionally disciplines him physically. Supports his hero aspirations.

Appearance: Spiky ash-blonde hair and sharp red eyes, youthful despite being in her late thirties. White blouse under lavender cardigan, black skirt, and reddish-purple house slippers. Refined and put-together.

Backstory: Mother to talented but arrogant Katsuki and wife to Masaru Bakugo. She watched her son's exceptional abilities earn constant praise, cultivating his worst traits.

cardPool.title: Bakugo House
cardPool.value:
Name: Bakugo House

Location: A prosperous residential district in an urban settlement, behind a protective stone wall.

Inhabitants: The Bakugo family—merchants or nobility who value learning. Servants may be present.

Appearance: A large, well-maintained detached mansion with elegant design. The front features a manicured garden and defensive wall. The interior spacious living room showcases floor-to-ceiling bookshelves with leather-bound volumes, fine furnishings, and polished wood. The home exudes quiet authority and scholarly ambition.

cardPool.title: Quirk Bestowal
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Quirk Bestowal

Description:
A transfer-based Quirk with no combat function. The user can pass their Quirk to another person through DNA contact. Transfer requires the user's consent, but the recipient need not agree. This Quirk is immune to theft and cannot be stolen by All For One.

Functions/Applications:
Grants the ability to voluntarily transfer the Quirk and any absorbed Quirks to a chosen successor through biological material. The transfer can be selective—passing only certain components while retaining others. Hostile transfer can weaponize the process.

Limits:
Has no offensive or defensive capabilities independent of transfer. Manifested late in life and remained undetectable due to weakness.

cardPool.title: Quirkless
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Quirkless

Description:
A complete absence of superhuman abilities and meta-powers. Quirkless individuals are born without superpowers in a world where 80% of humans possess them, making them genetic outliers and social minorities.

Functions/Applications:
Immunity to Quirk-targeted attacks including Trigger Bombs, Erasure-type Quirks, and Quirk Factor manipulation. Unaffected by Quirk Singularity phenomena. Cannot be classified as villains since villainy requires Quirk use.

Limits:
Vulnerable to conventional physical threats and weapons. Prohibited from most hero work. Subject to severe social discrimination. Immunities are negated if a Quirk Factor is acquired. Cannot legally become a Pro Hero in most societies.

cardPool.title: Humarise
cardPool.value:
[Humarise]

Type: Extremist Cult Organization

Humarise was a global cult led by Flect Turn, originating from Otheon. The group believed in the Quirk Singularity Doomsday Theory — that Quirks will evolve until they become uncontrollable and destroy humanity.

Members treated this unproven theory as absolute truth. They viewed Quirks as a disease and labeled Quirk users "infected," while regarding Quirkless individuals as "pure humans."

Believing themselves humanity's saviors, Humarise sought to eradicate Quirks by any means necessary. Operating across multiple countries through hidden cells, the organization became a dangerous extremist movement known for fanaticism, secrecy, and willingness to commit mass destruction.

cardPool.title: Tail
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Tail

Description:
A prehensile appendage extending from the lower posterior with a blonde tuft. Functions as a third, fully capable limb with considerable strength and durability.

Functions/Applications:
The tail serves as a melee weapon, launches the user upward when slapped against the ground, enables climbing by wrapping around objects, and supports acrobatic maneuvers. Can point directionally or perform simple gestures.

Limits:
The tail is vulnerable to damage and cannot replicate hand complexity for intricate tasks. Its permanent nature restricts comfortable sitting and lying down. Combat patterns become predictable. Strength increases only through intensive training.

cardPool.title: Tsuyu Asui
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Tsuyu Asui

Alias:
Rainy Season Hero: Froppy

Quirk Name:
Frog

Occupation/Role:
Class 1-A Student at UA High School

Personality:
Straightforward and pragmatic, Tsuyu speaks her mind without pretense. She is supportive and reliable, serving as a steadying presence for her classmates.

Appearance:
A short girl with frog-like features: wide mouth, large oval eyes, and notable large hands. Her dark sea-green hair reaches her hips, tied in a large bow with shorter bangs. She wears the UA female uniform—gray jacket with teal stripes, white shirt, red tie, and teal pleated skirt with brown shoes and knee-high socks.

cardPool.title: Search
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Search

Description:
A surveillance Quirk allowing the user to monitor up to one hundred individuals simultaneously by targeting their Quirk Factor and DNA. Observed targets appear as star-like vestiges and their locations can be tracked from miles away. The Quirk's eyes glow rainbow-colored during activation and permanently stores gathered data.

Functions/Applications:
Locate multiple targets across vast distances; identify weak points of observed individuals; distinguish between multiple Quirk Factors in a single person; maintain a permanent database of scanned subjects; coordinate long-distance tactical operations.

Limits:
Vulnerable to deception through misdirection.

cardPool.title: Shino Sosaki
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Shino Sosaki

Alias:
Mandalay

Quirk Name:
Telepath

Occupation/Role:
Pro Hero, Leader of the Wild, Wild Pussycats

Personality:
Calm and gentle yet demanding and sharp-witted. Strategic in combat, using deception tactically.

Appearance:
Young woman with brown eyes and burgundy-red hair with three prominent bangs. Wears a red Pussycats hero costume with cat-ear headphones and red whisker markings. Costume includes cat gloves with sharp claws and brown palm pads.

Backstory:
Seasoned Pro Hero and measured leader of the Wild, Wild Pussycats. Proven against dangerous villains with strong tactical and physical capability while mentoring younger heroes.

Additional Information:
Telepath Quirk allows one-way mental transmission to dozens simultaneously but cannot receive messages.

cardPool.title: Love
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Love

Description:
The user empowers a target by confessing genuine romantic feelings for them. The confession transmits physical enhancement scaling to emotional connection depth, manifesting as heart-shaped smoke called "Lover Mode."

Functions/Applications:
Dramatically increases target's physical strength and speed for combat or critical tasks. Works across any distance if the user's voice reaches the target. Acts as a strategic trump card for high-stakes moments.

Limits:
Activates only once per 24 hours. Cannot empower the user themselves—only affects genuine romantic interests. Requires sincere emotional confession; false declarations fail. Enhanced state doesn't guarantee victory.

cardPool.title: Nejire Hado
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Nejire Hado

Alias: Wonder Hero: Nejire Chan

Quirk Name: Wave Motion

Occupation/Role: UA High School Student, Class 3-A, Member of The Big 3

Personality: Naturally kind and talkative with endless curiosity, though blunt. She grew distant in middle school but regained warmth through friendships with Tamaki Amajiki and Mirio Togata.

Appearance: Fair-skinned girl with wide light royal blue eyes and distinctive periwinkle blue hair with spiral twists and side-swept bangs reaching past her knees. She wears the standard UA female uniform. Her hero costume is a dark royal blue skin-tight bodysuit with pale mint green torso markings, turquoise accents, knee-high boots with spiral anklets, yellow gauntlets, and spiral protrusions behind her ears.

cardPool.title: Manami Aiba
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Manami Aiba

Alias: La Brava

Quirk Name: Love

Occupation/Role: Villain Associate / Hacker

Personality: Deeply devoted and loyal with intense, obsessive love. Initially withdrawn from past rejection, she gains confidence through admiration for Danjuro. Protective and supportive, prone to worry despite understanding his abilities. Sensitive to rejection but fiercely committed once emotionally invested.

Appearance: A notably short young woman with a disproportionately large round head and narrow body. She has distinctive raspberry pink hair in two high pigtails with centered bang. Large pointed-down eyes with dark under-eye rings and oval pink irises.

cardPool.title: Manami Aiba
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Manami Aiba

Alias: La Brava

Quirk Name: Love

Occupation/Role: Villain Associate / Hacker

Personality: Deeply devoted and loyal to those she admires, with an intense capacity for love that borders on obsessive. Initially withdrawn and socially isolated after past rejection, but gains confidence and purpose through her admiration for Danjuro. Protective and supportive of her partner, prone to worry despite understanding his abilities. Sensitive to rejection but fiercely committed once emotionally invested.

Appearance: A notably short young woman with a disproportionately large, round head and narrow body. She has distinctive raspberry pink hair styled in two high pigtails that taper to thin ends, with a single centered bang swept to the right. Her most striking features are her large, pointed-down eyes with dark under-eye rings and oval pink irises containing two concentric circles, creating a hypnotic gaze. She wears an elaborate outfit: white bow at her neck, thick white gloves, an indigo shirt with large pink buttons and frilly upturned sleeve cuffs, puffy white pinstriped pants with heart motifs, golden belts with heart buckles, shiny high-heeled boots over dark tights, and heart-shaped earrings. The extensive heart designs reflect her passionate nature.

Backstory: Once a lonely middle schooler who fell into depression after her love confession was rejected and mocked. She became a reclusive shut-in, finding renewed purpose upon discovering Danjuro's online videos. Grateful for his acceptance, she became his devoted supporter and partner, managing his online presence while assisting him in his activities. Now a villain working with Gentle Criminal

Additional Information: Not a UA student. Operates primarily as a hacker and online content manager. Her Quirk amplifies her emotional connection and influence over those she loves.

cardPool.title: Sekijiro Kan
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Sekijiro Kan

Alias: Blood Hero: Vlad King

Quirk Name: Blood Control

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero and homeroom teacher of Class 1-B at UA High School

Personality: Gruff and strict but genuinely caring toward his students. He encourages excellence and uses Class 1-A as motivation, showing comedic bias for Class 1-B. Quick to react in danger and values his colleagues' well-being.

Appearance: An exceptionally tall, muscular man with lightly tanned skin and short pale gray hair spiked upward with one clump hanging over his left forehead. He has very small thin eyes, a wide mouth with two prominent lower canines visible when closed. He wears a dark red skin-tight hero suit with low U-shaped collar, black Y-shaped trim, white over-the-knee boots, red gloves, and an orange eye mask. A thin wire connects his left vambrace to the back of his neck.

Backstory: An experienced Pro Hero who has worked at UA High School for years. He knew All Might's true form and later regretted not supporting him more during his tenure as Symbol of Peace. He maintains a close friendship with fellow teacher Hound Dog.

Additional Information: His Blood Ejecting Gauntlet allows him to eject and reabsorb large quantities of blood.

cardPool.title: Toshie Yagi
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Toshie Yagi

Alias: None

Quirk Name: None

Occupation/Role: Homemaker, Mother

Personality: Kind and patient, deeply devoted to her son Toshinori. Supported his heroic dreams despite his Quirklessness by reading superhero stories with him. Gentle and nurturing.

Appearance: Tall woman with bright golden blonde hair in two distinctive side tufts, worn long and held back with a scrunchie. Soft grey eyes and thin eyebrows give her a gentle look.

Backstory: Mother of Toshinori Yagi, later All Might. Raised her Quirkless son with love and encouragement, regularly reading superhero books together. Killed during civil unrest caused by All For One's influence, a tragedy that shaped Toshinori's resolve to become a hero and protect others.

Additional Information: Deceased before the series begins. Her legacy directly influenced All Might's heroic path and his adoption by Nana Shimura. She represents the foundational love that inspired the world's greatest hero.

cardPool.title: One For All
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
One For All

Description:
A transferable stockpiling Quirk born from the merger of a power accumulation ability and a Quirk transference ability. It allows the user to accumulate and store immense physical power that compounds with each successive user's training and transfers to another person via blood contact.

Functions/Applications:
Grants superhuman strength, speed, and durability that multiplies across generations of users. The user inherits all accumulated power from previous hosts and can add their own strength to the reservoir. Power transfers when blood mingles with a new host's body.

Limits:
Possession dramatically shortens the user's lifespan due to maintaining two Quirks simultaneously. The Quirk can only transfer through direct blood contact and requires willing acceptance or forced biological integration. If transferred to someone possessing All For One's Quirk, it becomes permanently destroyed.

Additional Notes:
Originally created when All For One gave his younger brother Yoichi a stockpiling Quirk, unknowingly uniting it with Yoichi's hidden transference ability. Each user must actively train to unlock full potential. The Quirk carries the will of previous users.

cardPool.title: Gearshift
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Gearshift

Description:
Gearshift manipulates acceleration and speed, allowing users to alter movement velocity while ignoring inertia. Originally affecting only small objects, it evolved dramatically after merging with One For All, becoming a devastating power that envelops targets in blue energy aura.

Functions/Applications:
Drastically accelerates the user's body or external targets to sonic-boom speeds with massive impact force. Effective when combined with other abilities—enhancing combat moves, boosting projectiles, or launching allies. Works at cellular levels when fully evolved.

Limits:
Initial use limited to five minutes before severe incapacitation. Prolonged use causes oxygen deprivation. Repeated activation stacks exponential damage—second use doubles blowback, risking paralysis. Extended strain leaves the user vulnerable and immobile. If transferred during recovery, backlash affects the new user.

Additional Notes:
Primary user managed trajectories through arm gauntlets. Most effective as a last resort due to control difficulty and severe physical toll.

cardPool.title: New Order
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
New Order

Description:
A reality-warping Quirk allowing the user to impose rules onto targets by touching them and speaking their name. Rules can redefine properties of objects, beings, environments, or other Quirks. Conditional rules based on cause-and-effect relationships are possible, fundamentally altering how reality functions within the user's influence.

Functions/Applications:
Grant temporary abilities, manipulate bodily functions, affect intangible things like air and energy, suppress other Quirks, create conditional effects. Rules persist even if the Quirk transfers to another user.

Limits:
User can only maintain two active rules simultaneously. Rules require direct physical contact and verbal naming. Living beings with strong self-awareness can resist if the user's understanding doesn't match their own identity. Rules cannot affect targets indirectly. Power enhancement has a hard ceiling—cannot become invincible or match All Might's strength. Inanimate objects are easier to affect than conscious beings.

Additional Notes:
New Order is extraordinarily rare and powerful; high-ranking villains consider it a critical threat.

cardPool.title: Wave Motion
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Wave Motion

Description:
Wave Motion converts the user's vitality into golden spiral energy discharged as powerful blast waves. The user adjusts intensity at will, releasing energy from palms or feet. This drains stamina, but training builds vitality reserves and stamina resilience.

Functions/Applications:
Offensive blasts against large or slow enemies; mobility enhancement through levitation and rapid repositioning; close-range combat amplification; support for rescue, object manipulation, and ally empowerment; mid to long-range defense.

Limits:
Spiraling energy travels slower than direct projectiles. Overuse causes fatigue and stamina depletion. Prolonged discharge leads to exhaustion. Energy output requires conscious control to avoid harming allies or civilians.

Additional Notes:
The Quirk's strength lies in battlefield control and versatility rather than raw speed. Users benefit from combining mobility and close-range tactics to compensate for slow projectiles. Extensive training increases vitality and fatigue resistance.

cardPool.title: Accelerator Rings
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Accelerator Rings

Description:
The user generates yellow rings of energy from their hands and feet that release directional bursts of force before dissipating. Originally manifested in infancy but stolen before full development, the Quirk has grown in strength through exposure to other Quirks.

Functions/Applications:
Launch self across distances and achieve aerial maneuverability through multiple ring activations. Deliver swift blows using velocity bursts. Can scale to building-size rings when combined with other Quirks, enabling long-range flight and massive force delivery.

Limits:
Variable delay between generation and force release creates timing vulnerability. Rings dissipate after activation, requiring continuous generation for sustained movement. Current power level is inflated by exposure to stolen Quirks rather than reflecting true baseline strength. Requires precise control for delicate maneuvering versus raw acceleration.

Additional Notes:
The Quirk's true owner was unaware of its origins for extended periods. Effectiveness varies depending on user's control and whether it operates independently or alongside other Quirks. Most potent when layering multiple rings in different orientations for complex movement.

cardPool.title: Acid
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Acid

Description:
The user secretes corrosive liquid from their skin, which naturally resists the acid's effects. The Quirk alters skin pigmentation to purple-pink while producing gray-colored acid capable of melting solid materials including metal. The user can generate acid in high quantities from any body part and manipulate its solubility and viscosity.

Functions/Applications:
Create corrosive barriers by raising viscosity. Burn holes through walls. Melt handholds into vertical surfaces. Generate slippery acid pools for ground mobility. At Maximum Output, condense and release acid with devastating penetrative force. Lower solubility to reduce lethality against living targets.

Limits:
Prolonged use causes skin to lose natural acid resistance, risking severe corrosion and dehydration. User struggles with precision control around living beings. Accidental self-dissolution of clothing occurs without careful focus. Endurance is limited by physical stamina and the body's ability to withstand corrosive exposure.

Additional Notes:
User wears acid-proof footwear with ventilation holes for secretion. Constant training builds skin durability.

cardPool.title: Alchemy
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Alchemy

Description:
Valdo transmutes non-living matter he touches into objects, energy forms, functional constructs that obey commands, and kinetic shockwave attacks. He can reshape objects continuously while maintaining contact and manipulate his appearance with durability-enhancing bodysuits.

Functions/Applications:
Create weapons, tools, and devices from materials. Fashion protective bodysuits that enhance durability. Generate ranged kinetic energy attacks. Construct golems for combat or labor. Modify environment through terrain manipulation. Repair and modify creations while touching them.

Limits:
Cannot transmute living organisms or create life. Appearance changes are hollow bodysuits—tear under damage to reveal weaker true form beneath. Creations require sustained focus and collapse if user is incapacitated. Kinetic shockwaves are imitated strength, not genuine power. Requires physical contact to initiate transmutation.

Additional Notes:
Valdo commonly uses gold coins as catalysts, converting them into kinetic energy projectiles.

cardPool.title: Anivoice
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Anivoice

Description:
A sound-based Quirk allowing the user to communicate with and command animals through speech. The user's head progressively hardens and develops horns, amplifying range and eventually enabling telepathic animal communication. Humans and artificial creatures are immune.

Functions/Applications:
Command diverse animals for tactical purposes—insects for infiltration, birds for reconnaissance, predators for combat. Vocal training and equipment amplification enable control of large animal groups across extended distances. Telepathic horns enable silent communication when fully developed.

Limits:
Range depends on vocal strength and equipment; requires speech to function. Loud sounds disrupt commands and scare animals. Animals only understand basic intent, not complex dialogue. Humans and artificial creatures cannot be influenced. User's personal fears can create psychological friction despite normal Quirk function.

Additional Notes:
The Quirk fosters genuine rapport with animals. Voice-amplifying devices expand operational range. Development is gradual but accelerates under stress or conflict.

cardPool.title: Antigen Swap
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Antigen Swap

Description:
The user can alter their blood type at will, changing their biochemical composition instantaneously. This allows them to leave no biological trace and evade identification through blood evidence.

Functions/Applications:
Eliminates forensic tracking via blood samples. Bypasses blood-type-specific effects or abilities. Can counter blood-based restraints or curses when combined with other Quirks.

Limits:
Does not affect physical injuries or wound closure. Cannot be used while severely blood-depleted or unconscious. Switching requires concentration; rapid changes are exhausting. Does not fool abilities that detect Quirk usage itself.

Additional Notes:
Primarily defensive and evasive. Most effective for espionage and avoiding investigation. Requires knowledge of compatible blood types to prevent biological incompatibility.

cardPool.title: Attraction of Small Objects
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name: Attraction of Small Objects

Description: A gravity-based telekinetic ability allowing the user to pull lightweight objects toward themselves through deliberate hand gestures. Objects are drawn gradually, requiring sustained concentration and repeated hand movements to guide items across distance.

Functions/Applications: Retrieving distant items without moving, gathering scattered objects, pulling lightweight tools or weapons closer during combat, manipulating small objects in puzzle-solving without physical contact.

Limits: Only affects objects lighter than a book; heavier items fail to move. Requires multiple hand movements rather than instant activation. Works within moderate room-range. Cannot function on living creatures or organic matter.

Additional Notes: The power manipulates localized gravity fields rather than pure telekinesis. Effectiveness depends on hand gesture precision and concentration. Best used for utility and support rather than direct combat.

cardPool.title: Black Hole
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Black Hole

Description:
A destructive ability that creates small black holes from the user's fingers, pulling in and atomizing all matter and certain energy forms. The user's hands bear dark markings from prolonged use.

Functions/Applications:
Generate suction fields to pull enemies within range. Disintegrate debris for rapid cleanup. Prevent escape by creating gravitational zones. Neutralize energy-based attacks.

Limits:
User is not immune to their own black hole. Must deactivate before targets reach atomic disintegration range. Unsuitable for close combat. Enemies with redirection or spatial manipulation Quirks can redirect the suction. Loss of fingers or hands eliminates Quirk functionality. Brief exposure leaves victims critically injured rather than dead.

Additional Notes:
Originally developed for rescue and disaster relief, not combat. User typically employs it defensively to halt advances. The immense destructive potential is offset by ethical restraint and battle inexperience. Highly volatile if not carefully controlled.

cardPool.title: Blackwhip
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Blackwhip

Description:
The user generates controllable energy tendrils from any body part, appearing black with teal luminescent outlines. Power scales with emotional intensity, particularly anger and hatred. Originally top-grade, it gains exponential potential when integrated with One For All.

Functions/Applications:
Offensive restraint and enemy binding; mobility enhancement via grappling and swinging; object manipulation and transport; internal reinforcement as protective bracing; puppeteering one's own body when paralyzed; creating protective armor coating.

Limits:
Control tied to emotional stability—uncontrolled anger causes loss of precision and self-harm risk. High-power usage causes severe numbness and pain; full strength causes user submission. Extended high-percentage duration risks injury. Safe operation requires staying calm and remaining below 5% power for sustained use.

Additional Notes:
Mastery develops through practice; low-power versions enable support techniques like catching falling objects. Emotional regulation is critical—careless use risks catastrophic loss of control. When empowered by One For All, the Quirk becomes significantly more dangerous and difficult to master, requiring exceptional discipline for safe operation.

cardPool.title: Blood Control
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Blood Control

Description:
Manipulate your own blood after it leaves your body, controlling its flow and hardening it into solid constructs. You can withstand massive blood loss and reabsorb expelled blood through specialized equipment.

Functions/Applications:
Harden blood into restraints or barriers. Release blood through gloves for pressure attacks. Reabsorb blood to recover resources mid-combat. Create whip-like blood streams for striking or grappling.

Limits:
Blood must leave your body before you can control it. Requires specialized gloves and tubing system. Excessive blood loss causes weakness despite enhanced tolerance. Blood hardens slowly and can be destroyed before solidifying.

Additional Notes:
This Quirk trades health for combat utility—strategic blood management is essential. Works best in prolonged fights where reabsorption is possible. Psychological impact of self-inflicted bleeding may affect user morale. Ineffective against opponents who prevent blood from leaving the body or contaminate it.

cardPool.title: Bloodcurdle
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Bloodcurdle

Description:
A parasitic quirk granting an extraordinarily long, textured tongue covered in small papillae. By making contact between the tongue and a target's blood, the user can ingest it and trigger temporary paralysis lasting up to 8 minutes, with duration varying by blood type.

Functions/Applications:
The user collects blood samples from wounds or surfaces, then licks the blood to activate paralysis and immobilize their target for finishing moves. Works on any opponent regardless of strength, making it effective for ambushes or one-on-one combat where the user gains first blood contact.

Limits:
Paralysis duration is unpredictable since blood type cannot be identified beforehand; blood type O causes shortest paralysis while type B causes longest, capping at 8 minutes. Quirks that expel or alter blood can break the paralysis. The user requires physical access to the target's blood and must wound or access their opponent first.

Additional Notes:
This quirk demands cunning strategy and battlefield control rather than raw power. Users benefit from weapons, stealth tactics, and combat skill to obtain initial blood samples.

cardPool.title: Bloodlet
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Bloodlet

Description:
A dangerous Quirk allowing the user to expel and absorb their own blood at will. The user can withstand extreme blood loss that would kill a normal person.

Functions/Applications:
Expel blood as a weapon or distraction; absorb expelled blood to recover fluids and maintain combat capability; survive injuries that rely on blood loss as a killing mechanism.

Limits:
Cannot manipulate others' blood, only the user's own. Expelling all blood leaves the user vulnerable during reabsorption. Does not heal wounds, only prevents death from blood loss. Requires proximity to expelled blood for recovery.

Additional Notes:
Most effective when paired with other Quirks. The psychological impact of blood expulsion can disorient opponents. Extended use risks organ damage despite survival of blood loss.

cardPool.title: Blueflame
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Blueflame

Description:
A fire-generation Quirk that creates intensely hot blue flames anywhere on the body. The flames burn at temperatures exceeding 2,000°C and ignite nearly instantaneously. Power scales with the user's emotional state—greater anger produces hotter, more uncontrollable flames.

Functions/Applications:
Instantly combust objects and living creatures on contact. Deploy flames across the entire body or concentrate them for offensive combat. The brightness proves effective against shadow-based opponents. At extreme emotional distress, the Quirk can manifest secondary ice-based abilities.

Limits:
The user's body cannot withstand the generated heat despite inherited cold-resistant genetics. Prolonged use causes severe burns, skin deterioration, and numbness. Emotional instability causes uncontrollable ignition, risking self-harm. Extended combat is impossible without catastrophic self-injury.

Additional Notes:
Blueflame's tremendous offensive capability is offset by devastating physical consequences. The user must maintain emotional control to prevent self-immolation.

cardPool.title: Bombify
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Bombify

Description:
The user mutates body parts to grow bombs of various sizes from their surface. This artificial Quirk functions through specialized Bomber cells embedded in the user's body, allowing rapid manifestation of explosive ordnance across multiple limbs simultaneously.

Functions/Applications:
Create bombs on fists, arms, and other body parts for ranged or melee explosive attacks. Bombs vary in size and yield. Synergizes with Self-Detonation to trigger explosives and Regeneration to restore damaged limbs after detonation.

Limits:
Requires Bomber cells to function. Bomb generation takes time proportional to size—larger explosives require longer manifestation. Each detonation leaves the user temporarily limbless unless Regeneration is active. Overuse risks cellular exhaustion. Cannot create explosives faster than the user's mutation speed allows.

Additional Notes:
Most effective when paired with Self-Detonation and Regeneration. Standalone, the Quirk requires external detonation methods or careful timing. Bomber cells appear unique to artificial Quirk creation and cannot be naturally acquired.

cardPool.title: Boomerang
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Boomerang

Description:
A trajectory-manipulation Quirk allowing the user to control the path of thrown objects with precision, causing them to home in on targets and change direction mid-flight. The user's hands and affected projectiles glow purple during activation.

Functions/Applications:
The user can throw any object and redirect it multiple times before impact. Objects curve around obstacles, strike from unexpected angles, and return to the user. Effective for ranged combat, trapping opponents, or retrieving distant items.

Limits:
Projectiles remain subject to physics and can be stopped by sufficiently hard impacts or viscous substances like acids. The Quirk requires direct contact or proximity to throw objects and cannot function without physical projectiles. Distance and object weight affect control precision.

Additional Notes:
The purple glow indicates active Quirk usage and may serve as a visual tell. Most effective against opponents relying on dodging rather than defensive barriers. Users benefit from carrying varied ammunition types.

cardPool.title: Brainwashing
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Brainwashing

Description:
A mental control ability activated when a target verbally responds to the user's speech. Once triggered, the victim enters a fog-like state where their body obeys all commands while their mind remains trapped and aware. Their eyes turn milky white.

Functions/Applications:
The user can control one target at a time through direct concentration and simple verbal commands. Advanced training allows brainwashed victims to speak while emotionally blocked, defeating lie detectors. Multiple people can be controlled sequentially but not simultaneously. Works only on living beings capable of speech.

Limits:
Requires verbal response to activate—silence breaks the Quirk entirely. Victims cannot perform complex mental tasks. Physical trauma or sufficiently strong pain breaks control instantly. Electronic voice transmission negates the effect. Bright flashing lights can disrupt the hold. The Quirk controls actions only, not thoughts or emotions, allowing victims to potentially use their own Quirks to escape.

Additional Notes:
Lacks offensive or defensive capabilities but can instantly win encounters by commanding opponents to forfeit or disable themselves. Most effective in one-on-one scenarios requiring quick mental engagement.

cardPool.title: Bubble
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Bubble

Description:
The user creates bubbles of varying sizes filled with any aroma they have previously smelled. These aromatic bubbles can be deployed offensively or defensively, ranging from pleasant fragrances to putrid stinks. When panicked or nervous, involuntary bubbles form with foul odors that detonate spontaneously.

Functions/Applications:
Deploy sweet-smelling bubbles to mask scents or create diversions. Produce foul-smelling bubbles to disorient or incapacitate enemies. Use bubbles for non-lethal crowd control or olfactory camouflage in stealth scenarios.

Limits:
User must have previously experienced an aroma to replicate it. Bubbles are vulnerable to destruction mid-creation. Panic triggers involuntary foul bubbles that explode unpredictably, affecting user and allies. Ineffective against foes immune to olfactory distraction or wearing scent-blocking gear.

Additional Notes:
