This Quirk excels at non-lethal incapacitation and tactical support but lacks direct damage output. Success depends on target psychology and environmental factors. User must maintain composure during high-stress combat.

cardPool.title: Bull Head
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Bull Head

Description:
A transformation quirk granting large, robust bull-like horns from the head. Sharp and durable, suited for ramming and goring attacks.

Functions/Applications:
Powerful charging tackles using horns as battering rams, devastating charges that increase force with momentum, and goring strikes in close combat. Horns provide armor-piercing capability and can breach barriers.

Limits:
Horns cannot retract once manifested, limiting stealth and social situations. Damage to them causes direct pain. Requires running start for maximum impact; stationary strikes deal reduced damage. Twisting movements are awkward with extra head weight.

Additional Notes:
Best for aggressive, direct combat. Effective against rigid defenses but poor against evasive opponents. Trades mobility and finesse for raw power and intimidation.

cardPool.title: Bullet Laser
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Bullet Laser

Description:
The user fires purple laser beams from their fingertips with precision and destructive force. These lasers can travel straight or curve mid-flight through deliberate manipulation, making them difficult to evade.

Functions/Applications:
Direct offensive blasts that pierce and demolish structures; explosive impact upon contact; curved trajectory firing for striking targets behind cover; suitable for close-range and distance combat.

Limits:
Requires line of sight from fingertips; energy expenditure increases with distance and power; curved beams are slower than direct shots; no defensive capabilities; reduced effectiveness against resistances or reflective surfaces.

Additional Notes:
This Quirk was stolen rather than naturally inherited, suggesting potential instability in some users. Considerable destructive power requires precise aim and tactical awareness for optimal effectiveness.

cardPool.title: Bullhorn
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Bullhorn

Description:
The user's voice becomes unnaturally loud and powerful, amplifying sound output far beyond normal human limits without strain.

Functions/Applications:
Project voice across vast distances with clarity; intimidate enemies through sheer volume; disrupt concentration; communicate across battlefields instantly.

Limits:
No directional control—amplification affects all sound equally in all directions; cannot modulate frequency or create focused sonic attacks; prolonged use may cause throat damage; ineffective in soundproofed environments; relies on base voice quality.

Additional Notes:
Utility-focused with limited offensive potential. Works best for crowd control, psychological pressure, and tactical communication rather than direct combat damage.

cardPool.title: Cemedine
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Cemedine

Description:
The user secretes a versatile adhesive liquid from cranial orifices that can be sprayed at targets. The glue can harden into rigid binding or remain tacky, with the user controlling solidification rate.

Functions/Applications:
Restrain opponents by spraying glue around limbs or bodies; create sticky traps that slow movement; adjust drying speed for fast targets or repositioning; seal objects or wounds temporarily.

Limits:
Glue requires direct contact; excessive spraying depletes supply; hardened glue breaks with sufficient strength; adhesive cannot affect user's body; drying adjustment has minimum and maximum thresholds; ranged application is less precise than melee contact.

Additional Notes:
Most effective in close-to-mid range combat. High heat may accelerate drying unpredictably. User needs clear line of sight to spray effectively.

cardPool.title: Centipede
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Centipede

Description:
Grants elongated, segmented limbs resembling a centipede's body. Arms, legs, and head can extend dramatically from the body and remain concealed within clothing until deployed.

Functions/Applications:
Extended reach for grappling and restraint. Venomous pincers deliver paralyzing toxin. Multi-limb coordination enables entanglement tactics. Concealment provides tactical surprise.

Limits:
Limbs constrained by clothing when retracted, limiting sudden extensions. Venom requires direct pincer contact and time to take effect. Extended limbs difficult to control with precision at maximum range. Head extension exposes vulnerable center point.

Additional Notes:
Effective against unarmored foes. High stealth potential due to concealment. Favors grappling and control strategies over direct striking power.

cardPool.title: Chameleon
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Chameleon

Description:
The user gains chameleon physiology including adhesive skin for climbing, independently rotating eyes, an extendable tongue, and color-changing camouflage. This Quirk transforms the user into a hybrid creature capable of blending seamlessly with surroundings.

Functions/Applications:
Scale vertical surfaces and ceilings with sticky limbs. Monitor multiple directions using independent eye rotation. Extend a prehensile tongue for attacks or utility. Activate full-body camouflage for ambushes, reconnaissance, or evasion. Enhanced agility and climbing speed.

Limits:
Camouflage is imperfect and detectable under close observation. Adhesive grip weakens on smooth, non-porous surfaces. Extendable tongue has limited reach and strength. Independent eye rotation may be disorienting in combat. Camouflage breaks if the user moves too quickly or attacks.

Additional Notes:
Chameleon excels at hit-and-run tactics, infiltration, and defensive positioning. Most effective in environments with varied colors and terrain. Direct confrontation is disadvantageous; the user should rely on surprise and mobility rather than brute strength.

cardPool.title: Chimera
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Chimera

Description:
The user can manifest characteristics of various animals, permanently adopting a blue werewolf form as their base state. They can temporarily shift to gain traits of birds, lizards, dragons, and other creatures, enlarging these features to monstrous proportions for enhanced combat capability.

Functions/Applications:
Grants tremendous strength and durability scaling with the animal form adopted. Dragon form enables fire breath and concentrated energy beams. Bird traits provide flight or enhanced mobility; lizard traits offer climbing and flexibility. Each form stacks its animal advantages—claws, teeth, wings, scales—making the user a versatile transformer in combat.

Limits:
Transformations consume stamina; extended use drains energy quickly. Larger transformations reduce speed despite increased power. The user cannot access all animal traits simultaneously—only one primary form at a time. Dragon-form beam attacks are exhausting with cooldown periods.

Additional Notes:
The permanent werewolf state makes the user always partly transformed, functioning as a hybrid fighter by default. This Quirk excels in prolonged battles through form versatility but requires tactical switching to avoid fatigue.

cardPool.title: Chronostasis
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Chronostasis

Description:
The user's hair transforms into arrow-shaped projectiles that extend in straight lines and cut targets. Hair is divided into two sections: the "Minute Hand" on the forehead and the "Hour Hand" at the nape, each representing different time units. Upon impact, targets experience slowdown effects whose duration depends on which hand struck them.

Functions/Applications:
Launch hair arrows as offensive weapons with varying slowdown durations. The Minute Hand inflicts shorter slowdown periods, while the Hour Hand inflicts longer ones. Use slowdown effects to immobilize enemies during combat. Position strategically before attacking to maximize effectiveness.

Limits:
The user must remain completely stationary to extend and fire hair arrows; any movement cancels the ability. This creates vulnerability windows where the user cannot both attack and defend. Hair regenerates with a recharge time between uses. Slowdown effects have finite duration and do not permanently disable targets.

Additional Notes:
Chronostasis rewards tactical gameplay over aggression. Users benefit from cover or defensive positioning while channeling attacks.

cardPool.title: Clean Bubbler
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Clean Bubbler

Description:
Susugu Mitarai generates pressurized soapy water and large soap bubbles from his body. The bubbles possess surprising strength and buoyancy, capable of lifting multiple people while remaining controllable. The solution carries disinfectant properties useful for medical aid.

Functions/Applications:
Create powerful streams of soapy water for offensive pressure or propulsion. Generate large bubbles to lift, transport, or contain targets. Use bubbles to cleanse wounds and provide basic medical treatment. Combine streams and bubbles for crowd control or rescue operations.

Limits:
Requires finite internal reserves of soapy solution. Bubbles are fragile and burst from sharp objects or excessive force. Non-lethal and struggles against determined resistance. Extended use depletes reserves, requiring time to replenish.

Additional Notes:
Clean Bubbler excels in support and utility roles rather than direct combat. The disinfectant quality makes Mitarai valuable in humanitarian situations. Opponents with piercing weapons gain significant advantage. Water-based Quirks may interact unpredictably with the soapy medium.

cardPool.title: Cleaning
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Cleaning

Description:
The user secretes a potent dish soap-like substance from their body that can weaken or temporarily negate the Quirks of others through direct contact. This substance also removes biological evidence like blood and fingerprints from surfaces.

Functions/Applications:
Apply the secreted soap by brushing or rubbing it onto an opponent's skin to suppress their Quirk's effectiveness. Use it to cleanse crime scenes and eliminate forensic evidence. The soap works best on exposed skin and active Quirk manifestations.

Limits:
Requires direct physical contact; cannot affect Quirks from a distance. Effectiveness diminishes as the substance dries or is washed away. Works better against external Quirks than internal ones. Overuse causes skin irritation and dryness. The soap temporarily weakens Quirks but does not permanently destroy them.

Additional Notes:
This Quirk is utility-focused rather than combat-oriented, making the user valuable for law enforcement and reconnaissance. The user must be close enough to make contact, creating personal risk. The substance has a limited supply per secretion cycle.

cardPool.title: Clones
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Clones

Description:
Ectoplasm expels glowing viscous fluid from his mouth that he shapes into exact duplicates of himself. He can create up to thirty clones (thirty-six when in a good mood), each sharing his consciousness and capable of speech. All clones can be willfully dispersed at any time.

Functions/Applications:
Deploy clones for overwhelming numerical advantage in combat or to patrol vast areas simultaneously. Use clones for surveillance and reconnaissance, as the user perceives through all duplicates regardless of distance. Redirect clones to individual tasks for teaching, search operations, or crowd control. Create a single massive clone capable of trapping enemies within or on its body, though this prevents spawning additional clones.

Limits:
Each clone is fragile and destroyed by a single strong blow. Creating the giant clone eliminates the ability to generate smaller clones simultaneously. The Quirk requires oral expulsion of fluid, making it vulnerable during channeling. Clones cannot exceed the user's own physical capabilities or knowledge.

Additional Notes:
This Quirk excels at force multiplication and surveillance rather than raw power. The shared consciousness creates a hive-mind advantage for coordination.

cardPool.title: Cloud
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Cloud

Description:
The user generates solid, touchable clouds of varying sizes and densities that support people and objects. These clouds float freely, granting exceptional aerial mobility and item storage capability.

Functions/Applications:
Cloud enables rapid vertical and horizontal movement for swift escapes or reconnaissance. Clouds can shield allies through defensive density manipulation, create diversionary tactics, provide hiding spots for ambushes, and obscure vision for tactical advantage.

Limits:
The Quirk is vulnerable to gas-dispersing or elemental attacks. Larger clouds are slower but sturdier. Users cannot generate clouds faster than once per few seconds. Clouds dissipate if the user loses concentration or becomes incapacitated.

Additional Notes:
Cloud is primarily a mobility and evasion Quirk. Its greatest strength lies in tactical positioning and escape routes.

cardPool.title: Compress
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Compress

Description:
Compress allows the user to shrink anything within a spherical area into a small, weightless marble by touching it with their hand. The compressed objects retain their properties but become pocket-sized and portable. Release is triggered by snapping fingers, restoring marbles to full size instantly.

Functions/Applications:
Capture and transport enemies, allies, or environmental objects. Create traps by releasing marbles to restore obstacles in enemy paths. Compress body parts to inflict damage. Combine with environmental hazards by compressing targets alongside fire or debris. Use marbles as decoys or launch platforms.

Limits:
Activation requires hand contact with the target; user's own arm cannot be compressed. After losing the left arm, Compress functions only through the right arm. Selective compression of body parts risks mutilation. Large-scale compression drains focus and requires precise targeting.

Additional Notes:
The user's background in stage magic enhances this Quirk through illusion tactics and decoy creation. Compress is silent, allowing covert capture without alerting nearby allies. Weight reduction makes it ideal for escape scenarios and breaking through solid obstacles.

cardPool.title: Confession
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Confession

Description:
After posing a question, the user compels the target to answer with absolute truthfulness. The victim cannot lie, resist, or refuse to respond, revealing their deepest secrets, intentions, and emotions. Answers reflect what the target believes to be true, not necessarily objective reality.

Functions/Applications:
Extract intelligence from enemies and allies. Expose hidden loyalties, fears, and shameful truths. Prevent betrayal by interrogating suspects. Manipulate opponents emotionally through forced admissions. Verify subordinate honesty.

Limits:
Non-offensive; cannot damage or fight directly. Ineffective if either party cannot speak or communicate. Answers are interpreted literally—loopholes exist if the target's understanding differs from reality. Requires specific questions; vague inquiries yield vague answers. Does not compel physical action.

Additional Notes:
Most effective during interrogation or investigation rather than combat. Prepare targeted questions in advance for maximum utility. The Quirk's strength lies in information gathering and organizational security, not direct confrontation.

cardPool.title: Conjure
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name: Conjure

Description: A warping ability that instantly teleports small objects into the user's hand from their line of sight. The user focuses on a target and the object materializes in their grasp.

Functions/Applications: Retrieve weapons and tools from distance instantly. Disarm opponents by conjuring away held objects. Gather resources quickly. Snatch items mid-air or from secured locations within range.

Limits: Only works on small objects. Requires clear line of sight. Cannot conjure abstract things or pull from sealed containers. Range is moderate, not unlimited. User must have hand capacity to receive the item.

Additional Notes: Useful for theft, procurement, and combat advantage. Effectiveness depends on environmental awareness and quick thinking.

cardPool.title: Control Horn
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Control Horn

Description:
The user possesses specialized horns that project psychic dominion over bovine creatures. By maintaining both horns intact, the user can establish mental command over cattle, forcing them to obey through direct neural influence.

Functions/Applications:
Control herds of cattle simultaneously for stampedes or mass intimidation. Redirect cattle movements to block passages or create diversions. Compel cattle to attack or defend on command. Useful for agriculture, siege tactics, or livestock-based extortion.

Limits:
Only functions on bovine animals. Requires both horns undamaged; loss of one horn completely disables the Quirk. Control range and herd size limited by user focus and mental stamina. Cannot control already-trained attack animals with strong independent will.

Additional Notes:
Entirely dependent on nearby cattle for offensive use. Opponents can target or destroy the horns to neutralize the ability instantly. Most effective as area-control rather than direct combat. Urban environments with limited livestock reduce tactical advantage.

cardPool.title: Copy
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Copy

Description:
Copy allows the user to replicate any Quirk after brief physical contact with its user. The user gains instinctive knowledge of how to use the copied Quirk at a basic level and can store multiple copied Quirks simultaneously, switching between them as needed.

Functions/Applications:
Instantly acquire an opponent's Quirk for tactical advantage. Adapt to any situation by switching between stored Quirks. Preserve lingering effects of used Quirks even after switching. Stack up to four or more Quirks within the body through training.

Limits:
Active duration is 10 minutes per copied Quirk before it expires. Only one Quirk can be activated at a time. Requires physical contact to function. Cannot replicate Quirks dependent on accumulated resources or stockpiled power. User lacks the physical conditioning of the original Quirk wielder and may sustain injury using powerful Quirks. Mastery requires repeated copying and practice; initial use is basic.

Additional Notes:
Copy is fundamentally parasitic, offering no inherent combat ability. The user must rely on tactical thinking, deception, and rapid adaptation rather than raw power.

cardPool.title: Cow
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Cow

Description:
The user transforms portions of their body to gain bovine characteristics including hooves, horns, and hardened hide. This grants enhanced speed and strength comparable to large cattle, making them a formidable physical force.

Functions/Applications:
Transform legs into hooves for rapid movement and enhanced kicking force. Grow horns for goring and charging attacks. Thicken hide for damage resistance. Stack multiple traits simultaneously for cumulative benefits.

Limits:
Transformations are partial rather than complete. Bovine form is slower than dedicated speed-type quirks. Increased body mass limits agility and precision. Sustained transformation drains stamina.

Additional Notes:
Optimal in direct combat and charging scenarios but struggles with finesse-based encounters. Transformation is visually obvious, limiting stealth. Works best against speed-reliant opponents rather than those using raw power.

cardPool.title: Creation
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Creation

Description:
Momo transmutes her body's fat cells into physical matter, materializing objects from her skin with a distinctive blue-pink glow. She can create virtually any non-living object if she understands its atomic structure, from weapons to machinery, limited only by her knowledge and lipid reserves.

Functions/Applications:
Creates melee weapons and cannons for combat. Can produce objects larger than her body by expending fat reserves. Partial materialization allows dual-tasking. Creations can be shared with allies. Her mastery of matryoshka dolls allows near-instantaneous production and storage of items within them.

Limits:
Requires substantial food intake to replenish lipids; overuse causes weakness and exhaustion. Complex or large creations demand extended preparation time, leaving her vulnerable. Cannot create living beings. Requires deep atomic-level knowledge of objects before creation. Sustained pressure forces defensive positioning.

Additional Notes:
Momo's intelligence enables creative problem-solving through fabricated tools. Close-range combat suits her best; long-range engagements require pre-planned cannons.

cardPool.title: Crystallize
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name: Crystallize

Description: Yu Hojo can rapidly grow durable crystals across his body, coating his skin in protective crystalline armor. The crystals form near-instantaneously and can be shaped into weapons like bladed gauntlets to extend his combat reach.

Functions/Applications: Deploy crystalline armor for defense and durability. Form crystal blades along the arms for extended melee range. Layer crystals for targeted protection. Use rapid crystallization to counter attacks or break restraints.

Limits: Crystals can be shattered with sufficient force. Hair inhibits crystallization, requiring the user to remain shaved for optimal growth. Crystals destroy clothing during formation. Generated crystals have no monetary or structural value and cannot be salvaged or repurposed.

Additional Notes: Best suited for close-range combat and defensive strategies. Rapid deployment is effective for surprise blocking or counterattacks. Users must maintain appearance upkeep for reliable activation. Crystal formation is visually distinctive, eliminating stealth options.

cardPool.title: Danger Sense
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Danger Sense

Description:
A sixth sense detecting potential threats through sharp, stabbing sensations visualized as lightning bolts striking the mind. Reads intent and negative emotions from individuals and threats, enabling anticipation of danger.

Functions/Applications:
Warns of hostile intentions and threat levels by sensing malice. Enables rapid dodging and evasion. Detects multiple simultaneous sources. Works passively without conscious activation. Effectiveness scales with training, reducing physical toll.

Limits:
Fails against those with no true malice, even if objectively dangerous. Overwhelmed by high concentrations of negative emotions in crowds. Ineffective against sufficiently fast attacks allowing no reaction time. Misdirected by aware opponents using decoys. Weakened when multiple weaker threats converge. Does not function against perceived non-threats, even genuine dangers.

Additional Notes:
Initial use caused severe physical strain, mitigated through training. Reads emotional intent rather than objective danger, making it unreliable against emotionally complex attackers. Originally used by Hikage Shinomori in conjunction with One For All.

cardPool.title: Decay
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Decay

Description:
A destructive Quirk that disintegrates anything touched by the user's hands, reducing targets to dust. The disintegration spreads rapidly across organic and inorganic matter. Originally a reverse-engineered copy of Overhaul, stripped of restoration properties.

Functions/Applications:
Touch-based destruction of matter and living tissue. Can trigger chain reactions across multiple targets. Spreads through victims' bodies unless the affected limb is severed or process is interrupted. At full power, capable of destroying structures and multiple enemies simultaneously.

Limits:
Requires direct finger contact to activate—gloves or distance negates effect. Cannot affect fluid or particle-based matter. High-power usage causes severe recoil damage to user's body. Loses effectiveness if hands or fingers are lost. Disintegration can be interrupted by destroying the affected area or erasing the Quirk effect itself.

Additional Notes:
Manifests as cracks and degradation on user's body over prolonged use. Originally manifested in childhood with uncontrolled destruction. Quirk factor is localized in the hands, making hand-loss a critical vulnerability.

cardPool.title: Despot
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Despot

Description:
The user extrudes thin, nearly invisible threads from their body that puppeteer other humans. Victims remain conscious but cannot resist commands, functioning as extensions of the user's will. Several dozen individuals can be controlled simultaneously.

Functions/Applications:
Create an army of controlled soldiers while maintaining their skills. Send puppets into danger without risk. Gather intelligence through multiple perspectives. Overwhelm opponents through coordinated numbers.

Limits:
Control breaks from sudden physical shock. Control ceases if the user loses consciousness. Victims cannot be forced to harm themselves fatally. Thread range is limited to moderate distances. Cannot control those with defensive Quirks or exceptional willpower without difficulty.

Additional Notes:
Victims retain muscle memory and combat training but execute only the user's decisions. The psychological toll on controlled individuals creates moral complications. Power scales with the user's ability to coordinate multiple bodies.

cardPool.title: Dog
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Dog

Description:
A canine-based transformation quirk granting enhanced senses of smell and hearing, alongside physical dog characteristics. Manifestation varies between users—some develop full dog features while others display partial transformations. All users gain acute sensory perception capable of tracking targets across vast distances.

Functions/Applications:
Users detect and identify individuals by scent from miles away, track prey through forests, and perceive threats via heightened hearing. Physical dog traits provide combat advantages and climbing ability. The quirk enhances overall physical attributes including strength and agility.

Limits:
Sensory abilities can be overwhelmed by strong odors or noise pollution. Physical transformations are permanent and unchangeable, affecting social interactions. The quirk does not grant animal control or communication abilities. Tracking effectiveness diminishes in heavily scented environments or during storms.

Additional Notes:
Manifestation varies significantly between users. The quirk scales with user strength; more powerful individuals demonstrate greater sensory range. Dog-like behavioral quirks may occasionally emerge involuntarily.

cardPool.title: Double
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Double

Description:
Double allows the user to create up to two identical copies of any person or object by touching them with a viscous dark fluid secreted from their hands. The duplicates possess the original's memories, personalities, and full abilities, making them nearly indistinguishable from the real thing.

Functions/Applications:
Create perfect clones for combat, labor, or infiltration. Self-duplication enables exponential multiplication if copies duplicate themselves. Clones retain all original abilities and knowledge. Can replicate objects with precise structural knowledge. Detection of clone destruction is possible regardless of distance.

Limits:
User can maintain only two active copies at a time. Creation requires flawless mental image of target—physical changes to the original require new measurements or the clone will be malformed. Clones possess full autonomy and may refuse orders or turn hostile. Copies are less durable than originals, dissolving into viscous liquid after significant damage. Clones of damaged individuals inherit their injuries. Objects without precise compositional data decompose quickly. Second copies are notably more fragile than first duplicates.

Additional Notes:
Self-duplication is significantly faster than copying others.

cardPool.title: Dragon
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Dragon

Description:
The user transforms into a massive dragon form with reptilian features including wings, scales, powerful jaws, and sharp claws. Grants extraordinary physical prowess and durability far exceeding normal human limits.

Functions/Applications:
Flight via functional wings, devastating melee attacks with claws and fangs, powerful biting force, enhanced grappling using multiple limbs, blocking heavy impact damage, overpowering opponents with raw strength.

Limits:
Transformation has energy costs or duration constraints limiting sustained use. Weakened by opposing Quirks targeting physical capability. Reduced effectiveness against Quirks countering physical strength or durability.

Additional Notes:
The dragon form retains the user's fighting technique and combat intelligence, allowing skilled martial artists to utilize grappling submissions and tactical holds. Excels in direct confrontation but vulnerable to ranged attacks, speed-based tactics, or environmental manipulation.

cardPool.title: Dragon Breath
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Dragon Breath

Description:
A fire-expulsion quirk enabling the user to exhale intense flames from their mouth. Requires alcohol consumption to activate and function, with intoxication levels directly affecting combat capability.

Functions/Applications:
Projects streams or bursts of fire for offensive attacks. Power scales with alcohol intake, enabling ranged combat superiority. Can destroy terrain or create flame barriers.

Limits:
Completely dependent on prior alcohol consumption; no fire without it. Accuracy and control diminish at high intoxication levels. Prolonged use causes fatigue. Cannot function if sober or when alcohol is metabolized.

Additional Notes:
High-risk playstyle rewarding careful resource management. Users must balance intoxication to maintain effectiveness without losing control.

cardPool.title: Dupli-Arms
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Dupli-Arms

Description:
Mezo manifests arm-like tentacles capable of transforming into enhanced duplicates of any body part. The replicated organs emerge from pods at each tentacle's tip. Multiple different parts can manifest simultaneously, stacking their benefits.

Functions/Applications:
Enhanced sensory reconnaissance: Eye duplicates grant 360° vision; ear duplicates detect distant or obstructed sounds. Combat multiplier: Replicated arms generate half-ton force per set. Mobility: Webbed tentacles enable wall-climbing, gliding, and carrying multiple people. Communication: Mouth replicas bypass facial mask restrictions. Scalability: Pods can self-replicate to extend tentacle length indefinitely.

Limits:
Tentacles and duplicated parts are vulnerable to injury. Regrowing severed duplicates is painful and time-consuming. Manifesting multiple organs from single pods reduces control and effectiveness. Gliding duration is limited. Tentacles lack precision for fine manipulation despite strength.

Additional Notes:
Dupli-Arms excels in reconnaissance, defense, and strength-based tasks but struggles in close-quarters combat requiring dexterity. Extended tentacles via pod self-replication risk uncontrolled growth if overused.

cardPool.title: Eagle
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name: Eagle

Description: The user transforms into an eagle-like humanoid with feathered wings, sharp talons, and enhanced predatory senses comparable to a natural eagle.

Functions/Applications: Functional wings enable flight for aerial mobility and reconnaissance. Enhanced vision allows spotting distant targets. Sharp talons serve as melee weapons. The user gains eagle-like strength and agility.

Limits: Full extent remains unknown. Extended flight is limited by fatigue. Transformation restricts fine manual dexterity and prevents effective use of human tools or equipment.

Additional Notes: A straightforward animalistic transformation with combat and mobility applications. Mastery level and partial transformation possibilities remain unclear.

cardPool.title: Earphone Jack
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Earphone Jack

Description:
The user possesses elongated, cable-like earlobes that stretch up to 6 meters and terminate in jack-shaped plugs. These prehensile earlobes can pierce hard materials and detect sound across 12 meters through barriers. The user channels heartbeat vibrations through the jacks to damage objects from within.

Functions/Applications:
Reconnaissance via sound detection through obstacles. Offensive combat by weaponizing heartbeat vibrations as internal damage or directional sound blasts. Utility function as actual headphone cables. The earlobes serve as extra limbs for gripping and manipulating objects.

Limits:
Stretching range limited to 6 meters, sound detection to 12 meters. Overuse causes ear bleeding and fatigue. Loud sounds cause sensory overload and incapacitation. Multiple simultaneous noise sources mask target sounds. Losing an ear severely reduces effectiveness. Sound-based counterattacks of equal or greater volume neutralize offensive applications.

Additional Notes:
Originally a dual-ear ability, now limited to single-ear operation. A prosthetic jack replacement exists but effectiveness remains uncertain.

cardPool.title: Earth Flow
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Earth Flow

Description:
The user manipulates soil and earth with precise control, molding it into desired forms. This Quirk grants destructive and constructive power, enabling creation of avalanches, terrain shifts, and detailed earthen structures.

Functions/Applications:
Create animated earth golems capable of independent combat. Reshape terrain across distances for rescue operations. Construct custom training grounds and obstacles. Trigger geological hazards like avalanches through remote manipulation.

Limits:
Ineffective without accessible soil or earth; useless on barren stone, metal, or open water. Range is extensive but finite, limited to manipulable earth within sight or sensory range. Requires sustained concentration; complex constructs demand mental effort.

Additional Notes:
Mastery allows earth golems to pass as natural creatures. Primarily suited for mountain and forest environments. High skill ceiling with experts achieving remarkable precision and scale.

cardPool.title: Elasticity
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Elasticity

Description:
A touch-based Quirk that grants elasticity properties to any object or surface the user contacts, transforming them into bouncy, flexible materials. The user can make floors into trampolines, crane structures into slingshots, and create invisible elastic barriers in midair. Effects persist for a set duration with no manual deactivation.

Functions/Applications:
Create springy surfaces for mobility and bouncing movement; launch objects or self across distances; generate aerial platforms for navigation and defense; weaken enemy footing by elasticizing ground; apply elasticity to personal clothing for protection against grappling.

Limits:
Effects automatically wear off after a time period with no early deactivation option. Opponents who adapt to the elastic environment can exploit it. Requires direct physical contact to activate. Overuse risks exhausting the user.

Additional Notes:
Most effective for escape and evasion tactics. User's dramatic fighting style conceals Quirk activation, catching enemies off-guard. Works best against unprepared opponents; skilled fighters can exploit its predictability. Combines well with deceptive combat strategies.

cardPool.title: Electromagnetic Bullets
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Electromagnetic Bullets

Description:
The user projects an electromagnetic field around thrown objects, accelerating them to high velocities. This enhances projectiles like pebbles, coins, or debris into potent weapons.

Functions/Applications:
Launch projectiles with force and precision; create rapid-fire barrages; turn small objects dangerous; useful for ranged combat and area denial.

Limits:
Requires objects to throw; effectiveness depends on throwing accuracy and arm strength; consumes stamina with repeated use; moderate effective range; cannot enhance objects already in flight.

Additional Notes:
Best suited for users with good aim and environmental ammunition access. Straightforward but tactical, rewarding clever use of surroundings. Vulnerable at close range.

cardPool.title: Erasure
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Erasure

Description:
The user nullifies any target's Quirk Factor by maintaining eye contact. The Quirk affects multiple targets simultaneously while the user's eyes remain open. When deactivated, the user's hair returns to normal, signaling a cooldown before reactivation.

Functions/Applications:
Disable an opponent's Quirk for hand-to-hand combat. Effective against Quirk-dependent fighters and Transformation abilities. Creates minor anti-gravity around the user's head for equipment manipulation.

Limits:
Requires direct line of sight to the target's body; obstacles block activation. Ineffective on Quirkless individuals or physical enhancements unrelated to Quirks. Mutant-type appendages remain impaired but functional. Causes severe dry eye syndrome, limiting sustained use. Recharge interval between deactivations creates counterattack openings.

Additional Notes:
Vision loss severely weakens or eliminates the Quirk. User relies on goggles to conceal which targets are observed and when blinking occurs. Most effective against opponents with heavy Quirk reliance.

cardPool.title: Explosion
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Explosion

Description:
The user excretes nitroglycerin-like sweat from their palms and ignites it at will to create devastating explosions of varying sizes. The user is immune to their own blasts except for minor recoil. Power scales with sweat production, growing stronger during extended physical activity and in warm conditions.

Functions/Applications:
Create fiery shockwaves that burn and shatter targets; propel self through air for mobility; blind opponents with flash; launch long-range blasts; fire multiple condensed explosions simultaneously after Quirk Awakening. Naturally counters darkness-based abilities.

Limits:
Cold weather slows detonation time. Dual-palm simultaneous use disperses overall strength. Repeated large explosions cause arm and shoulder pain. Loss of palms renders Quirk unusable. Indiscriminate use causes collateral damage. Requires conscious ignition effort.

Additional Notes:
User employs all-out offensive strategy, closing distance before unleashing close-range bombardments. Grenadier bracers reduce physical strain from overuse. Versatile for creative combat applications when paired with tactical intelligence.

cardPool.title: Extend-o-Hair
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Extend-o-Hair

Description:
The user manipulates their hair's growth and movement with precision control. Their hair is unnaturally resilient and indestructible. The user can extend hair to form protective armor, grapple enemies, or create barriers.

Functions/Applications:
Deploy hair as offensive whips or restraints. Form full-body armor for defense. Create nets or cages to trap groups. Establish barriers or shields. Use hair as mobility aids or sensory extensions.

Limits:
Hair becomes easily tangled, restricting movement. Extended hair requires concentration; distraction weakens control. Tangled hair reduces combat effectiveness. Control range diminishes beyond 30 feet.

Additional Notes:
User typically maintains an unusually hairy appearance. Quirk excels in group combat and defense but falters when tangled. Best suited for users with patience and tactical thinking.

cardPool.title: Extra Arms
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Extra Arms

Description:
A mutation-type Quirk that grants the user an additional set of functional arms, doubling their limb count to four total. All arms possess equal strength and dexterity.

Functions/Applications:
The user can perform multiple actions simultaneously—wielding dual weapons, grappling while striking, or manipulating objects independently. Provides enhanced climbing, melee combat versatility, and complex physical tasks requiring more than two limbs.

Limits:
The extra arms do not grant superhuman strength. Coordination requires conscious effort initially, and simultaneous actions may diminish reflexes. Armor and clothing must be specially fitted for the extra limbs.

Additional Notes:
This Quirk excels in close-quarters combat and grappling but offers no ranged advantage. Martial training maximizes the tactical benefits of four-limb operation.

cardPool.title: Fan
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Fan

Description:
A wind-generation quirk activated by rapidly spinning the user's wrists. The user can produce localized gusts or devastating tornadoes depending on rotation speed and intensity.

Functions/Applications:
Create directional wind attacks to knock back opponents. Generate tornadoes for area-of-effect damage. Use wind to deflect projectiles or create barriers.

Limits:
Maximum continuous use of one minute before risking tendon inflammation. Overuse causes severe wrist pain and potential joint damage. Cannot generate wind without active wrist rotation; immobilized wrists nullify the quirk.

Additional Notes:
Highly effective at range and against multiple opponents, but requires strategic timing due to strict time constraints. Users must manage fatigue carefully to avoid debilitating injury.

cardPool.title: Fat Absorption
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Fat Absorption

Description:
The user can adhere objects and living beings to their body upon contact, causing them to sink into accumulated body fat. This grants exceptional physical protection against blades, bullets, and conventional attacks. Maintaining this Quirk requires constant high body mass through regular food consumption.

Functions/Applications:
Absorbs impact force from attacks and releases it in a devastating counterattack punch. Restrains opponents by enveloping them with the user's large frame. Acts as a mobile shield, protecting allies from incoming damage.

Limits:
Requires substantial body fat to function; a slim build renders it ineffective. Counterattack technique burns significant fat reserves, leaving the user vulnerable if it fails. Recovery of lost body mass takes three days. Quirks that consume flesh or fat rapidly deplete the user's mass and disable the ability mid-combat.

Additional Notes:
Best suited for defensive roles and restraint operations. Users must maintain a disciplined eating regimen. Physical speed and agility are compromised due to large body mass, making this Quirk dependent on positioning and anticipation rather than evasion.

cardPool.title: Fierce Gains
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Fierce Gains

Description:
The user's muscles harden to exceptional toughness on command, creating an nearly impenetrable defensive state. Muscular tissue becomes dense and rock-like, dramatically increasing durability against piercing and slashing attacks.

Functions/Applications:
Hardens muscles to deflect or absorb damage from weapons and impacts. Can be layered with other defensive abilities for exponential protection. Allows the user to withstand attacks that would normally pierce flesh.

Limits:
Requires conscious activation and cannot protect against blunt force trauma equally well. Hardened muscles still conduct kinetic energy, so crushing impacts transfer damage internally. Cannot be maintained indefinitely without exhaustion. Works only on the user's own musculature.

Additional Notes:
Most effective when combined with high pain tolerance or insensitivity. Works best on users with naturally large muscle mass. Does not enhance strength or speed, only defensive capability.

cardPool.title: Foldabody
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Foldabody

Description:
Foldabody grants the user the ability to manipulate their body's thickness and stretch their limbs into paper-thin forms. The user can flatten, fold, and reshape their entire body or individual sections at will, transforming into blades, drills, or threads while maintaining consciousness and control.

Functions/Applications:
The user can slip through narrow spaces undetected, transform body parts into piercing weapons that strike faster than sound, and strike vital points to incapacitate enemies by cutting blood flow to the brain. Mid-air combat is possible by twisting the body into drill-like shapes. The Quirk allows slow body regeneration.

Limits:
Extreme thinning shortens the user's lifespan and causes progressive physical deterioration. The ultimate technique of thread-size transformation causes severe weakness, unconsciousness, and requires extended medical recovery. Regeneration is slow, taking years to fully restore damaged parts.

Additional Notes:
Mastery allows transformation at supersonic speeds. The user employs a ninja combat style with speed and precision strikes. Even severely weakened, the user retains tiny functional forms with regenerative capacity, though at drastically reduced capability.

cardPool.title: Foresight
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Foresight

Description:
A prediction Quirk granting the user ability to perceive a target's future actions and movements up to one hour ahead. The user witnesses events from third-person perspective, including the target and immediate surroundings. Activation requires physical touch followed by eye contact.

Functions/Applications:
Combat evasion becomes near-perfect when eye contact is maintained, as the user predicts every opponent move. Investigative work benefits greatly, revealing targets' plans, locations, and associates. The Quirk can perceive events years into the future, though dating distant events requires rough estimation.

Limits:
A 24-hour cooldown must pass before reactivating on any target. Breaking eye contact halts prediction. The Quirk is purely visual—the user cannot hear dialogue or interpret actions lacking visual context. The foreseen future cannot be changed through normal means, though strong collective will may alter outcomes. Both touch and eye contact are required for activation.

Additional Notes:
Users tend toward fatalistic thinking, believing foreseen outcomes are inevitable.

cardPool.title: Free Walker
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Free Walker

Description:
A mobility-based Quirk that grants exceptional freedom of leg movement and resistance to fatigue. The user can move their legs with unprecedented speed and agility without typical muscular exhaustion.

Functions/Applications:
Enhanced sprinting and sustained running, rapid directional changes without losing momentum, extended physical activity without leg fatigue, superior footwork in combat or traversal.

Limits:
Unknown upper speed threshold; fatigue may affect other body parts; prolonged use duration unclear; does not grant strength enhancement or jumping ability beyond normal limits; affects only the legs.

Additional Notes:
Free Walker remains largely undocumented. It is a movement and endurance-focused ability rather than offensive or defensive. Best suited for pursuits, escapes, and sustained physical exertion.

cardPool.title: Frost
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Frost

Description:
The user generates and manipulates ice, coating their body in frozen armor and projecting ice blasts outward. This Quirk provides natural resistance to cold and freezing temperatures, making the user difficult to harm with ice-based attacks.

Functions/Applications:
Create protective ice armor; launch ice projectiles or waves; lower ambient temperature in localized areas; shield allies from heat or fire by absorbing thermal energy; sustain defensive positions through ice barriers.

Limits:
Prolonged use causes frostbite and rapid body temperature drops, potentially leading to hypothermia. Extended combat drains stamina quickly. Users without sufficient fire resistance risk severe burns when exposed to intense heat while defending.

Additional Notes:
Most effective in defensive or support roles rather than sustained offense. Works best when combined with other Quirks or used cooperatively with allies. The Quirk's true strength emerges when protecting others rather than attacking independently.

cardPool.title: Gale Gale
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Gale Gale

Description:
The user manipulates wind currents around their body, creating powerful vortexes that enable flight and act as a protective barrier. The winds deflect incoming attacks and projectiles with ease.

Functions/Applications:
Flight through sustained wind manipulation, deflection of physical and ranged attacks, creating offensive wind blasts, enhanced mobility in combat. The user maintains a defensive wind shell while moving freely through the air.

Limits:
The user's head remains completely exposed and unprotected by the wind barrier, creating a critical vulnerability. Maintaining the Quirk requires constant concentration; disruption or exhaustion weakens the wind shield. The Quirk consumes stamina proportional to flight duration and deflection intensity.

Additional Notes:
The Gale Gale Quirk is deceptively powerful due to its defensive properties. Opponents must exploit the head vulnerability through elevated angles or coordinated attacks to overcome the wind shield's protection.

cardPool.title: Gas
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Gas

Description:
The user generates a massive, swirling cloud of purple, sleep-inducing poison gas from their body. Anyone inhaling it falls unconscious immediately until treated. The gas forms a typhoon centered on the user, with highest concentration near them and weakening at the edges. The user can sense creatures within the gas through its fluctuations.

Functions/Applications:
Crowd control and area denial for trapping enemies and blocking escape routes. Detection of movement allows tracking without direct sight. Best used as support during ambushes rather than direct combat, keeping the user at distance from threats.

Limits:
Gas masks and breathing apparatus provide immunity. The gas cannot be manipulated for precision attacks. Wind or physical force easily disperses it. The user is not immune and will fall unconscious if exposed, requiring a gas mask. If the user loses consciousness, the gas immediately dissipates. Range is limited despite its area effect.

Additional Notes:
The user must remain vigilant against masked opponents and typically carries a handgun as backup. Success depends on maintaining distance and reading gas movements.

cardPool.title: Gatling
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Gatling

Description:
The user's arms transform into gun-like biological organs that fire claw-like projectiles made of keratin in rapid bursts, serving as a natural ranged weapon system.

Functions/Applications:
Fire keratin claws rapidly for suppressive fire and area control. Effective in close-quarters combat to force opponents back or create distance. High volume of fire can deter multiple enemies simultaneously.

Limits:
Projectiles have limited range and stopping power compared to firearms. Sustained firing depletes keratin reserves, requiring recovery time. The organs cannot be concealed and immediately reveal combat capabilities.

Additional Notes:
Best used defensively rather than as a finisher. Works well with hand-to-hand combat to maintain pressure. Keratin regeneration rate determines firing duration.

cardPool.title: Gigantification
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Gigantification

Description:
The user drastically increases their body size to colossal proportions, gaining immense mass and strength. Different users experience varying limits and control—some grow to fixed maximum heights, others can adjust size fluidly. The transformation grants devastating physical power but demands substantial space.

Functions/Applications:
Enables overpowering larger opponents, destroying structures with ease, intimidating enemies through sheer presence, and serving as mobile transportation. Some variants allow blob-like transformation with stretching capabilities or creation of smaller clones for reconnaissance.

Limits:
Most users cannot assume intermediate sizes, requiring full commitment to transformation. The Quirk demands open spaces—enclosed areas severely hamper mobility and effectiveness. Some variants force automatic shrinkage after prolonged activation. Emotional instability may trigger uncontrolled transformation. Maximum size varies by user: standard limit ~67 feet, though some exceed 82 feet or possess lower thresholds with time restrictions.

Additional Notes:
Exceptionally effective against giant-class villains and in urban combat with space. However, the Quirk often causes substantial collateral damage.

cardPool.title: Glamour
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Glamour

Description:
The user emits a mist-like substance from their mouth that materializes into vivid visual and auditory illusions. These illusions can fill entire rooms and are designed to deceive, distract, or misdirect opponents and allies alike.

Functions/Applications:
Create convincing illusions of people, monsters, or environments to confuse enemies in combat. Use illusions as decoys to protect allies from incoming attacks. Craft illusions based on real individuals by studying their appearance and personality traits. Illusions can range from charming to horrifying depending on intent.

Limits:
Illusions are temporary and dissipate unpredictably. Illusions cannot cause physical damage. The user must expel mist from their mouth, creating a visible casting action. Large-scale illusions require more effort and cannot be maintained indefinitely. Illusions may fail against opponents with heightened awareness or sensory resistance.

Additional Notes:
The Quirk's effectiveness relies on the user's creativity and knowledge of what they're mimicking. Training involves studying others to improve illusion quality and versatility. Best used in supportive roles or tactical situations rather than direct combat engagement.

cardPool.title: Grasshopper
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Grasshopper

Description:
A transformation Quirk allowing users to morph into a large humanoid grasshopper form, enhancing physical prowess. The Hotta Brothers typically activate this ability through Trigger injections, though baseline capabilities remain largely unexplored.

Functions/Applications:
Grants increases to strength, agility, and jumping height in grasshopper form. Users can perform synchronized combo attacks when coordinated. Primary application is close-quarters combat with enhanced mobility and striking force.

Limits:
True limitations unknown due to Trigger enhancement reliance. Independent functionality without external stimulants has never been tested. Transformation requires preparation or chemical activation rather than instantaneous deployment.

Additional Notes:
Most effective when two users coordinate attacks. Trigger-dependent usage suggests potential dependency or artificial modification. Full potential awaits discovery without chemical enhancement.

cardPool.title: Gyrate
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Gyrate

Description:
Sen Kaibara's Quirk allows him to rotate any part of his body at extreme speeds, transforming his limbs into spinning drill-like weapons. His spiral-patterned finger gloves amplify strikes into devastating cutting and piercing attacks.

Functions/Applications:
Enhanced close-range melee combat with rotating limbs that drill through defenses. His gloved hands significantly amplify offensive damage, making physical blocking ineffective. Gyrate excels at rapid rotational strikes and maintains effectiveness even when grappled.

Limits:
Purely close-range with no long-distance applications. The Quirk cannot prevent being grabbed or carried, limiting mobility. Effectiveness relies heavily on the spiral gloves for maximum damage.

Additional Notes:
Sen's Quirk transforms hand-to-hand combat into a lethal engagement zone where rotation speed becomes weaponized. The gloves are essential equipment functioning as force multipliers that unlock the Quirk's true potential.

cardPool.title: Hair Control
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Hair Control

Description:
A Quirk allowing manipulation of one's own hair with precision and force. The user can harden, extend, and weaponize hair strands for offensive and defensive purposes. Control and application vary based on hair length, density, and training.

Functions/Applications:
Hair can be fired as projectiles with bullet-like velocity. Hair can be shaped into weapons like whips, blades, or bludgeons for melee combat. Hair serves as an extension of the body for grappling, binding, or striking from range.

Limits:
Control is restricted to the user's own hair only. Hardened hair is vulnerable to sharp cuts and fire. Extended hair strands deplete stamina with prolonged use. Hair growth rate limits available material for sustained combat. Short or thin hair reduces offensive potential significantly.

Additional Notes:
Effectiveness scales with hair length and density. Training determines precision and speed of manipulation. Hair-based attacks leave the head exposed if overextended. Works best in close-to-mid range combat.

cardPool.title: Hair-Raiser
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Hair-Raiser

Description:
The user can extend, harden, and detach hair strands from their scalp at will. These strands become malleable weapons or tools that can be shaped and manipulated during combat or utility tasks.

Functions/Applications:
Hair strands can be hardened into spears, whips, or cutting implements for offense. They can serve as grappling hooks, restraints, or construction tools. The user maintains control over detached strands, allowing dynamic repositioning mid-combat.

Limits:
Effectiveness diminishes as hair depletes—excessive use leaves the user bald and vulnerable. Hardened hair can be cut or broken by sufficiently sharp or strong forces. Hair regrows at normal human rates, creating a finite resource per engagement.

Additional Notes:
Best suited for creative, tactical fighters. Hair-Raiser rewards resourcefulness but punishes wasteful approaches and offers versatility in both combat and non-combat scenarios.

cardPool.title: Hardening
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Hardening

Description:
The user hardens any part or all of their body into rock-like material, transforming skin into an impenetrable, jagged surface. This grants extreme durability against physical trauma and increases striking power through rough, cutting edges.

Functions/Applications:
Provides defense against bullets, blades, and blunt force. Offensive applications include devastating strikes and grazing cuts from hardened skin. Can shield allies. Hardness improves with repeated damage during activation, making the user progressively stronger through combat.

Limits:
Requires close-range combat with no long-distance capability. Cannot protect against extreme temperatures. Stamina depletes under sustained damage. Eyes remain vulnerable if entire body is hardened. Effect weakens under psychological stress.

Additional Notes:
Maximum hardness state provides temporary near-invulnerability but demands significant stamina. Requires intense training to reach peak effectiveness. Dangerous in rescue situations due to rough texture causing accidental injury. Comparable to Steel-type Quirks but distinctly adaptive through damage accumulation.

cardPool.title: Hardflame Fan
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Hardflame Fan

Description:
The user generates walls of solidified fire that harden into barriers for defensive protection. Heat exceeding the Quirk's own temperature penetrates these defenses.

Functions/Applications:
Deploy layered fire walls to shield against physical and thermal attacks. Position barriers around vulnerable areas. Create multiple defensive layers for increased protection. Hardened fire absorbs moderate-level heat-based strikes.

Limits:
Fire hotter than the user's flames passes through unimpeded. Cannot be used offensively—purely defensive. Requires continuous focus to maintain barriers; dissipates if concentration breaks. Each additional layer drains stamina progressively. Users with significantly higher heat output bypass this defense entirely.

Additional Notes:
This is a stolen Quirk, suggesting the original user was relatively unknown or weaker. Best used defensively as part of a layered tactical approach. Most effective against moderate-powered fire users or physical attackers.

cardPool.title: Heal
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Heal

Description:
The user accelerates a target's natural healing by kissing them. Injuries taking months to heal can be fully restored in seconds. The user maintains fine control over healing intensity and stamina drain.

Functions/Applications:
Rapidly mend wounds, broken bones, and internal injuries. Heal severe trauma in multiple sessions. Works best combined with surgery for life-threatening conditions. User can selectively refuse to heal certain injuries.

Limits:
Healing consumes the receiver's stamina; severe healing can cause exhaustion or death from stamina depletion. Cannot regrow lost limbs or body parts. Cannot fully heal extremely severe injuries or permanent scarring. Requires the receiver to be alive and capable of natural healing. Most dangerous injuries need surgical intervention before use.

Additional Notes:
The user must be in close proximity and have willing contact to activate the Quirk. Repeated overuse of self-damaging Quirks may result in refusal to heal. User's medical knowledge is vital for critical situations. Stamina depletion is the primary risk factor.

cardPool.title: Hellflame
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Hellflame

Description:
An extremely powerful fire-based Quirk allowing the user to generate and control flames of varying temperatures, from low-heat warnings to devastating blue-hot infernos. The user can cover their body in flames, project fire as blasts and rays, and achieve limited flight through controlled flame expulsion.

Functions/Applications:
Large-scale flamethrower attacks, precise heat rays, flame-wreathed melee strikes, aerial propulsion via jets, wall-running by creating molten footprints, cellular-level burning to bypass regeneration, and fire-conjured weapon shapes. Signature technique Flashfire Fist raises flames to maximum temperature for a vaporizing heat ray.

Limits:
Overuse causes dangerous body temperature buildup impairing physical abilities; user requires external cooling assistance with no internal temperature regulation. Rain and wet conditions hinder performance. High-temperature attacks carry severe bodily strain and backfire risk. User is heat-resistant but not immune and can sustain burns. Extended battles without cooling recovery become progressively dangerous.

Additional Notes:
Low-temperature flames minimize strain and serve as tactical warnings; high-temperature attacks are finishing moves with catastrophic cost.

cardPool.title: High Specs
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
High Specs

Description:
An intellect-enhancing quirk that elevates mind and body far beyond normal limits. Grants superhuman intelligence, perception, reaction speed, and comprehension. The user gains enhanced strength, dexterity, and growth, becoming fully sapient with human-level cognition and speech regardless of original species.

Functions/Applications:
Devise complex strategies instantly from minimal information. Execute intricate plans involving chain reactions and precise calculations. Perfect recall of all experienced events and knowledge. Leadership and tactical command at highest level. Enhanced physical coordination for delicate or demanding tasks.

Limits:
Cannot increase physical power beyond enhanced baseline—remains dependent on strategy over brute force. Perfect memory creates emotional baggage; past traumas persist with clarity, potentially clouding judgment. Intelligence does not grant invulnerability or precognition. Requires time to formulate strategies in novel situations. Physical body remains limited by biological constraints.

Additional Notes:
The quirk fundamentally transforms a non-human user into a fully sapient being, making it transformative rather than purely combat-oriented.

cardPool.title: Hologram
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Hologram

Description:
Mahoro Shimano projects illusory holograms of any object or creature she visualizes. The projections scale from small decoys to massive constructs visible from great distances. They exist as pure light with no physical substance.

Functions/Applications:
Create diversionary illusions to confuse opponents. Generate emergency signal constructs visible across wide areas. Project multiple holograms simultaneously to overwhelm perception.

Limits:
Holograms possess zero tangibility—they cannot interact with physical matter, deal damage, or block attacks. Strong winds or physical force disperses projections instantly. Targets with keen perception easily see through deception. Requires active concentration; losing focus causes immediate dissipation. Ineffective against analytical or battle-hardened opponents.

Additional Notes:
Best suited for psychological warfare, tactical misdirection, and non-combat scenarios. Pairs well with escape strategies or information gathering.

cardPool.title: Homing
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Homing

Description:
The user locks onto visible targets within 600 meters and launches projectiles that automatically chase their prey. Once released, projectiles home in with relentless accuracy, making evasion difficult. However, strikes lack significant force, prioritizing tracking over impact damage.

Functions/Applications:
Lock onto distant enemies for guaranteed hit tracking; maintain pressure on mobile or fleeing targets; suppress enemy movement; execute precise strikes from range; work effectively in open terrain where targets remain visible.

Limits:
Requires visual line of sight at lock-on moment; effective range capped at 600 meters; projectiles deal minimal damage; user cannot dictate hit location; useless against invisible or obscured enemies; projectile speed allows skilled opponents brief reaction time.

Additional Notes:
Best suited for harassment, area denial, and target tracking rather than direct combat damage. Pairs well with sustained volleys rather than single shots. Ineffective against heavily armored opponents who can endure repeated low-impact strikes.

cardPool.title: Horn Cannon
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Horn Cannon

Description:
Pony can detach and launch her horns as independent projectiles, with new horns regenerating almost instantly. She maintains remote telekinetic control over up to four horns simultaneously, allowing mid-air trajectory adjustments. The horns are dense and curved, ideal for piercing, restraining, or transporting targets.

Functions/Applications:
Launch multiple horns in rapid succession for offensive strikes. Remotely steer horns around obstacles to bypass defenses. Restrain or pin enemies due to horn strength. Transport allies and objects by riding horns or having them carry cargo. Assist mobility and climbing in navigation.

Limits:
Only four horns can be controlled remotely at once. Horns weaken without regular keratin intake and are breakable. Transporting multiple people or objects reduces horn speed. Holding Pony's horns in place prevents detachment and negates the Quirk. Horns require time to regenerate if destroyed faster than production rate.

Additional Notes:
Best suited for long-range and mid-range combat. Control requires hand gestures mimicking horn positions. Curved shape allows precision targeting but may limit damage against heavily armored foes. Regeneration is nearly instant in typical combat conditions.

cardPool.title: Hula Hoop
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Hula Hoop

Description:
The user generates large hoops of concentrated energy by raising their arm, then hurls them as projectile weapons. The hoops are solid enough to impact with force.

Functions/Applications:
Primary offensive ranged attack through energy hoop projection. Can strike multiple targets in sequence. Useful for medium-range combat.

Limits:
Requires arm-raising motion before each hoop, telegraphing the attack. Hoops dissipate after moderate distance. Cannot be fired rapidly due to generation cooldown.

Additional Notes:
Best for direct combat rather than stealth. Effectiveness depends on aim and distance. Most potent against stationary or slow targets.

cardPool.title: Hydra
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Hydra

Description:
A stolen Quirk allowing the user to summon massive serpentine shark-like creatures from their back. These beasts possess immense strength and can crush humans in their jaws.

Functions/Applications:
Summon snake creatures to attack enemies. Summoned creatures split into two heads when damaged, multiplying offensive capability. Two heads can lift the user airborne for mobility. Enhancement drugs enable multiple simultaneous summons.

Limits:
Initially limited to one creature; splitting occurs only when damaged. Multiple summons require enhancement drugs. Most effective as surprise attacks from behind.

Additional Notes:
The stolen, unnamed Quirk is unstable or unreliable in some conditions. Enhancement drugs expand combat potential but create dependency. Large creature size is a liability in confined spaces.

cardPool.title: Impact Recoil
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Impact Recoil

Description:
A defensive Quirk that reverses incoming physical force back upon the attacker, redirecting kinetic damage rather than absorbing it. The user becomes a conduit for impact, turning an opponent's own power against them.

Functions/Applications:
Reflects melee strikes, projectiles, and collision-based attacks back at their source with amplified force. Can be chained with other abilities using objects or people as intermediary shields to redirect attacks indirectly.

Limits:
Does not fully negate impact; the user still experiences incapacitation from extremely powerful strikes. Cannot reflect indirect damage like energy, heat, or environmental hazards. Requires physical contact or proximity to active force; ranged non-kinetic attacks bypass it entirely.

Additional Notes:
Most effective against direct, forceful attackers. Becomes less reliable against opponents using heat-based, elemental, or ranged abilities. Timing and positioning are critical to success.

cardPool.title: Impure Beam
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name: Impure Beam

Description: A powerful light-based Quirk that fires massive beams of concentrated luminous energy capable of obliterating large targets and structures in a single strike.

Functions/Applications: Unleash a devastating beam attack dealing extreme damage to single or multiple targets. Can be charged for increased potency and combined with other Quirks to amplify destructive output. Effective against most physical defenses and organic matter.

Limits: At maximum output, the user's arm and body suffer severe recoil damage or explosive trauma. Light-based beams are vulnerable to refraction or redirection by light-manipulating Quirks. Extended use risks catastrophic self-injury. Requires enhanced durability or regenerative ability to use safely at full power.

Additional Notes: Best suited for users with healing factors. Most effective as a finishing move rather than sustained combat. Combinations with complementary Quirks increase potency but proportionally increase recoil risk.

cardPool.title: Incite
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Incite

Description:
The user's voice carries an electromagnetic pulse that physically and mentally enhances loyal followers. Power scales with volume—louder speech means stronger effects. Enhancement drains the recipient's body.

Functions/Applications:
Amplifies physical strength, speed, and mental fortitude in loyal followers. Can temporarily push them beyond normal limits. Works best through amplification devices or in crowds where volume maximizes effect.

Limits:
Only functions on those with genuine loyalty; wavering faith nullifies effects. Fear and conflicting emotions override the ability. Repeated use exhausts recipients. Cannot compel unwilling targets or create loyalty where none exists.

Additional Notes:
The user must actively speak to activate Incite; silence negates it. External amplification dramatically increases effectiveness. Best for rallying groups rather than individuals. Followers develop dependency, making them vulnerable if separated from the user.

cardPool.title: Infrared
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Infrared

Description:
The user perceives surroundings through infrared radiation, gaining thermal vision like heat-sensing predators. This enables navigation independent of light, compensating for blindness. The quirk extends to sensing emotional states through thermal fluctuations in living beings.

Functions/Applications:
Navigate in darkness with clarity. Detect living creatures by heat signatures. Read emotional states through thermal changes. Bypass visual obstacles and camouflage.

Limits:
Effective only at close range. Electromagnetic interference disrupts thermal perception. Cannot sense objects with uniform temperature or heat-isolated targets. Requires cognitive processing to interpret thermal data.

Additional Notes:
This quirk is stolen rather than innate, suggesting moderate compatibility. Most effective as a defensive and navigational tool rather than offensive combat ability. Extreme heat or cold impairs accuracy.

cardPool.title: Invisibility
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Invisibility

Description:
The user's body unconsciously refracts all light, rendering them completely invisible. The Quirk is permanently active and cannot be toggled off. Clothing and carried objects remain visible, forcing complete nudity for effective use. Extreme temperatures directly damage exposed skin.

Functions/Applications:
Perfect stealth and infiltration for ambushes, reconnaissance, and evasion. With training, the user can consciously manipulate refracted light to blind opponents or redirect light-based attacks through their prism-like body.

Limits:
Permanence leaves clothed users visible. Complete nudity is required for stealth but exposes skin to environmental damage. Sensory detection methods—sound, thermal, touch, scent, tracking—bypass the Quirk entirely. Extremely powerful light sources can cause the Quirk to malfunction and reveal the user's silhouette. The user cannot turn the ability off.

Additional Notes:
Ideal for hit-and-run tactics and information gathering.

cardPool.title: IQ
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
IQ

Description:
A mental enhancement Quirk that multiplies intellectual capacity to genius levels. Activation requires consuming tea and closing one's eyes to enter deep thinking. Yellow equations and orange circuit diagrams materialize visually around the user's head during activation.

Functions/Applications:
Enables complex strategic planning, enemy analysis, behavior prediction, and tactical problem-solving. Excels at information gathering, trap construction, and multi-target containment coordination. Different tea varieties produce varying enhancement effects.

Limits:
Activation requires tea consumption—without it, the Quirk cannot function. Generated plans have exploitable flaws. Provides no physical combat, defensive, or reflexive enhancement. Highly versatile or unpredictable opponents introduce variables that exceed calculation accuracy, causing strategic failure.

Additional Notes:
IQ is purely cerebral and unsuitable for direct confrontation. Users require physical support or allies to execute plans. Strength lies in preparation and foresight, not real-time adaptation or combat adjustment.

cardPool.title: Iron Ball
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Iron Ball

Description:
The user produces and launches iron spheres from their knuckles with considerable force. Projectiles vary in size from egg-sized to larger than the user's body, with fair control over mass and density.

Functions/Applications:
Primary ranged offensive weapon; generates ammunition for allies; larger projectiles create barriers or crush obstacles; variable sizing provides tactical flexibility.

Limits:
Sustained production drains stamina; larger spheres require more energy and slower generation; accuracy decreases with distance and extreme sizes; user must have knuckles available; projectiles cannot be remotely controlled.

Additional Notes:
Best used in offensive or support roles; balances raw power with tactical versatility through size manipulation; effective in group combat.

cardPool.title: Iron Claws
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Iron Claws

Description:
The user's fingertips transform into hard metallic claws. Size, sharpness, and application vary by user—some develop large slashing weapons, others maintain dexterous claws for excavation and tunneling.

Functions/Applications:
Claws can pierce tough materials, slash opponents, or dig through earth and stone. Users can burrow underground for mobility, concealment, or surprise attacks. Claws retain enough precision for climbing and manipulation tasks.

Limits:
Claws are only as strong as the user's physical strength allows. Extended burrowing drains stamina. The quirk doesn't increase speed or reflexes. Claws can be damaged or broken by superior materials or force.

Additional Notes:
Manifestation varies significantly. Bulky variants sacrifice dexterity for power, while refined versions maintain control. Underground tunnels may reveal the user's position.

cardPool.title: Iron Club
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Iron Club

Description:
The user transforms their arms into massive iron clubs covered in jagged spikes. Body mass and height increase to 229cm, granting an imposing ogre-like appearance.

Functions/Applications:
Devastating melee strikes capable of crushing boulders and shattering fortifications. Spikes inflict additional trauma on impact. Useful for intimidation and demolition.

Limits:
Arms cannot perform fine manipulation while transformed. Transformation requires significant stamina to maintain. Speed and agility decrease due to increased mass. Transformation is permanent until deactivated, creating vulnerability during the change.

Additional Notes:
Iron Club is an offensive-focused Quirk best suited for direct combat. Spike coverage prevents disarming or grappling. Limited defensive capability; user relies on durability rather than evasion.

cardPool.title: Jet
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Jet

Description:
Jet allows the user to expel compressed air from holes in the soles of their feet, propelled by breath from their lungs. This grants extreme speed in flight and ground movement, enabling superhuman acceleration and direction changes with explosive bursts.

Functions/Applications:
The user achieves short-range flight and ground acceleration by releasing air pulses. Each directional change requires new breath intake. The momentum amplifies physical strikes, enabling devastating tackles and kicks. Useful for evasion, pursuit, high-impact attacks, rescue operations, and rapid repositioning in combat.

Limits:
Flight duration is restricted by lung capacity—cannot sustain hover. Each direction shift costs breath, limiting maneuverability in prolonged engagements. Advanced age or physical deterioration weakens stamina and bone integrity. Warping-type Quirks can bypass the speed advantage.

Additional Notes:
Peak effectiveness requires mastery of impact timing and momentum control. Users develop exceptional combat instinct and spatial awareness.

cardPool.title: Kaiju
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Kaiju

Description:
