A transformation Quirk that allows the user to metamorphose into a colossal dinosaur-like beast resembling Godzilla. The transformation grants massive size and power comparable to Gigantification Quirks.

Functions/Applications:
Grants enormous physical strength and size for combat. The beast form can devastate large areas through sheer mass and destructive capability.

Limits:
Transformation requires Trigger drug activation to manifest. The user cannot access this power naturally without chemical enhancement. The massive form likely reduces mobility and agility despite increased strength.

Additional Notes:
This Quirk's true capabilities remain mysterious due to limited observed usage. The dependency on Trigger presents significant vulnerability when unavailable. Long-term effects of repeated transformations are unknown.

cardPool.title: Kinetic Booster
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Kinetic Booster

Description:
A Quirk that amplifies kinetic energy from the user's movement and actions. Multiple copies multiply the effect exponentially. All For One holds four copies, making him devastatingly powerful.

Functions/Applications:
Enhanced striking force, explosive speed, amplified jumping, and increased momentum. Multiple copies compound effects, enabling simultaneous energy bursts or sustained acceleration far beyond normal limits.

Limits:
Requires active physical exertion; passive use gains minimal benefit. Energy depletes with repeated use. Effectiveness depends on physical conditioning and control. Multiple copies require significant mental focus to manage without backfire.

Additional Notes:
Originally stolen by All For One. True power emerges only when multiple copies combine, suggesting baseline form is modest. Control is essential—raw power without technique risks self-injury or collateral damage.

cardPool.title: Leafipulation
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Leafipulation

Description:
The user manipulates leaves from nearby plant life, shaping and launching them as sharp projectiles. This Quirk grants control over vegetation in the immediate environment, turning natural foliage into weapons.

Functions/Applications:
Fire leaves as ranged attacks; create leaf shields for defense; strike multiple targets with dispersed projectiles; scout by controlling leaves as extensions of sight.

Limits:
User cannot generate leaves from their own body—must rely on existing plant sources. Ineffective in barren or urban environments lacking vegetation. Leaf projectiles lack stopping power. Range and potency depend on plant availability.

Additional Notes:
Best utilized in forests, gardens, or natural settings. Urban combat severely restricts effectiveness. Leaves deteriorate quickly once separated from plants, limiting sustained offense.

cardPool.title: Leap
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Leap

Description:
A mobility quirk granting extraordinary jumping distance and height. Provides landing cushioning during intentional jumps, negating fall damage. Requires solid ground and does not protect against accidental falls.

Functions/Applications:
Execute massive jumps for traversal and evasion. Land from heights safely when consciously activated. Clear obstacles and reach elevated positions in combat or exploration.

Limits:
Requires stable ground—soft surfaces reduce effectiveness. Only cushions activated leaps, not unintended falls. User vulnerable to fall damage if knocked down without triggering the quirk first.

Additional Notes:
Leap is a pure mobility tool with defensive applications, not flight. Success depends on environmental conditions and user awareness. Requires timing activation before impact for maximum protection.

cardPool.title: Life Force
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Life Force

Description:
Doubles the user's natural lifespan and slows aging dramatically. A user of 120 years may appear only sixty.

Functions/Applications:
Grants extended longevity and youthful appearance for centuries. Can be duplicated and transferred to another person.

Limits:
If cancelled or removed, the user rapidly ages into extreme decrepitude, potentially causing severe physical deterioration or death. The Quirk naturally causes reduced physical mobility and slower reflexes, making combat difficult.

Additional Notes:
This Quirk trades vitality for duration. Rapid aging upon cancellation makes it dangerous to lose mid-conflict. Duplicating requires mastery of its mechanics.

cardPool.title: Liquification
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Liquification

Description:
The user can transform their body into a liquid state at will, allowing them to flow and reshape themselves. This serves primarily as a defensive mechanism to avoid physical harm by becoming intangible to solid attacks.

Functions/Applications:
Evasion of melee and projectile attacks. Can be combined with other Quirks to amplify offense, such as launching liquefied body matter as a projectile. Grants mobility through confined spaces by flowing through gaps.

Limits:
Cannot liquify selectively—entire body must transform or remain solid. Liquified form is vulnerable to elemental attacks like fire or freezing. Maintaining liquified state drains stamina. Cannot interact with solid objects while liquefied. Requires concentration to reform.

Additional Notes:
Most effective as a defensive tool rather than primary offense. Best utilized with complementary Quirks that weaponize the liquified form. The evasive nature limits aggressive combat options.

cardPool.title: Lizard
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Lizard

Description:
A reptilian transformation quirk granting scaled, lizard-like appearance with tail and forked tongue. The user gains enhanced resilience and accelerated healing beyond normal human limits.

Functions/Applications:
Provides superior endurance for extended combat and physical exertion. Enhanced regeneration allows faster recovery from wounds. Under Trigger drug influence, transformation intensifies—arms morph into pterosaur-like wings enabling sustained flight.

Limits:
Does not grant superhuman strength or speed without Trigger. Flight only possible under Trigger's effects. Reptilian form vulnerable to extreme temperatures affecting cold-blooded creatures. Trigger creates dependency risks and addiction hazards.

Additional Notes:
Full capabilities remain partially unexplored. Forked tongue suggests enhanced sensory perception, though unconfirmed. Trigger transforms physiology dramatically with unknown long-term health consequences.

cardPool.title: Lock Down
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Lock Down

Description:
A spatial locking ability that freezes touched objects into a fixed point in space, rendering them completely immobile. Activation requires key-tooth-like protrusions extending from fingertips to make direct contact with the target.

Functions/Applications:
Immobilize environmental hazards, falling debris, and moving obstacles. Secure objects during combat or construction. Create barriers by locking structural elements. Neutralize dynamic threats for tactical advantage.

Limits:
Cannot affect living beings or organic matter. Effectiveness decreases with object size and force. Requires direct finger contact to activate. Duration and energy cost scale with object mass.

Additional Notes:
Most effective against environmental hazards and inanimate objects. Works defensively but lacks offensive capability. Synergizes with battlefield manipulation strategies.

cardPool.title: Longbow
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name: Longbow

Description: The user transforms their left hand's thumb and pinky finger into a functional bow. Arrows fired possess absolute trajectory control and pierce-through power capable of penetrating vehicles. Projectiles can actively pursue moving targets.

Functions/Applications: Transform left hand into a ranged weapon for combat. Fire guided arrows to track targets. Penetrate fortified positions and vehicles. Use scavenged ammunition when supplies deplete.

Limits: User cannot generate ammunition and must rely on found arrows or makeshift projectiles. Once ammunition runs out, the Quirk becomes useless. Only the left hand can form the bow, limiting versatility if injured or restrained.

Additional Notes: Strategic dependency on resource management makes this Quirk powerful in prepared engagements but vulnerable in prolonged conflicts. Guided arrow capability provides accuracy advantage over conventional archery, compensating for ammunition scarcity through precision.

cardPool.title: Longleg
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Longleg

Description:
A transformation Quirk that grants the ability to extend legs to extraordinary lengths. The limbs become elastic and elongated, allowing the user to cover vast distances and reach otherwise inaccessible areas.

Functions/Applications:
Extended leg length enables rapid travel, scaling structures, executing far-reaching kicks, and escaping confined spaces. The user can reach distant objects and traverse obstacles.

Limits:
Extension has a maximum range before instability. Overextension causes loss of balance and reduced combat effectiveness. The Quirk cannot function if legs are immobilized. Speed decreases with extension distance.

Additional Notes:
Effective for theft and reconnaissance. Works best in open environments with space to maneuver. Usefulness diminishes in cramped spaces or against opponents who restrict movement.

cardPool.title: Mad Gluttony
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Mad Gluttony

Description:
A consumption-based Quirk granting a massive mouth in the stomach capable of rapidly inhaling, crushing, and destroying objects. When artificially enhanced, additional mouths sprout across the body as prehensile, biting tendrils for ranged attacks and restraint.

Functions/Applications:
Devour and destroy solid materials with extreme speed. Deploy mouth-tendrils for multi-directional offense, grappling, and ranged bites. Inhale to create suction for environmental manipulation. Enhanced form provides combat versatility and crowd control.

Limits:
The stomach mouth has finite capacity and requires processing time. Tendrils are destructible by concentrated, powerful attacks—kinetic and impact damage are particularly effective. Requires close proximity; enhanced form extends range but weakens defenses. Overmodification is unstable without external support.

Additional Notes:
Mad Gluttony transforms into a multi-vector threat when enhanced, becoming formidable but tactically vulnerable to focused strikes on individual tendrils.

cardPool.title: Magnetism
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name: Magnetism

Description: The user magnetizes targets within a 4.5-meter radius, polarizing them by sex—men become south-aligned (blue aura), women north-aligned (red aura). Same-sex targets repel; opposite-sex targets attract. The user cannot be magnetized and cannot affect those outside range.

Functions/Applications: Launch allies by positioning them between opposing polarities. Separate enemies by matching polarities to force repulsion. Pin or crush foes using attraction between opposite-polarized targets. Combine with external magnetic objects to amplify effects.

Limits: Only functions within 4.5 meters. User is immune to their own Quirk. Requires line of effect. Power scales with number of targets; complex coordination drains focus. Metallic objects need external magnetism to interact with effects.

Additional Notes: Most effective in coordinated team settings. Useless against solo opponents outside radius. Environmental factors like walls or crowds limit options. Works best combined with ranged or mobility-based allies.

cardPool.title: Metal Manipulation
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Metal Manipulation

Description:
Wolfram can control and reshape pre-existing metallic materials by touching them, causing his hand to glow with blue electrical energy. He bends metal freely into offensive and defensive structures.

Functions/Applications:
Creates iron pillars, walls, and cubes to attack or defend. Can construct large fortifications and barriers. Excels in metal-rich environments where abundant materials amplify his power.

Limits:
Requires pre-existing metal to function—useless in metal-scarce environments. Ineffective at close-range combat. Strength depends entirely on available metal quantity and quality. Power remains stationary-focused.

Additional Notes:
Best utilized in industrial or metallic settings. Creates visual tell through blue hand discharge when activating. Defensive capabilities proven capable of withstanding powerful physical attacks when properly fortified.

cardPool.title: Mimicry
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Mimicry

Description:
The user transfers their consciousness and body into solid objects, controlling them as if they were their own physical form. Without enhancement, objects are limited to refrigerator-size; with Trigger drug, manipulation extends to entire structures and landscapes.

Functions/Applications:
Inhabit and animate solid matter for combat and mobility; reshape environments by twisting corridors and creating barriers; manifest body parts externally to perceive surroundings; launch attacks while remaining hidden inside objects.

Limits:
Perception severely limited without exposing body parts on the object's exterior. Standard objects capped at refrigerator-size without Trigger enhancement. Emotional manipulation can force exposure of position. Quirk-negating abilities cannot affect the user while hidden, but direct damage to the inhabited object remains a threat.

Additional Notes:
User Joi Irinaka typically inhabits a small black cloak. Most effective in structured environments with manipulable terrain. Requires Trigger drug for large-scale reality warping capabilities.

cardPool.title: Mind Reaper
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Mind Reaper

Description:
Upon physical contact with a target, Mind Reaper forces the victim to involuntarily expose their deepest secrets, embarrassing memories, and hidden truths. The compulsion manifests as uncontrollable verbal disclosure.

Functions/Applications:
Extract concealed information through forced confession. Incapacitate targets psychologically by revealing shameful secrets. Interrogate prisoners without traditional torture. Humiliate opponents by exposing vulnerabilities.

Limits:
Requires direct physical touch to activate. Victims with strong willpower can resist full disclosure, though Mind Reaper will then reveal secrets itself—less accurately and with gaps. Exceptionally resolute individuals may resist entirely, preventing the Quirk from functioning. Cannot force revelations the user doesn't suspect exist.

Additional Notes:
Effectiveness depends on the victim's mental fortitude versus the user's activation strength. The Quirk prioritizes the target's own confessions over secondhand revelation, making willing resistance strategically valuable. Works best on psychologically vulnerable or guilt-ridden individuals.

cardPool.title: Monster Cat (Quirk)
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Monster Cat

Description:
Monster Cat allows the user to merge with and assume the shape of objects or machinery, gaining complete control over the merged form. The user can detach at will. Without enhancement, capacity remains unknown, but chemical boost enables control of large vehicles.

Functions/Applications:
Merge with objects to pilot them, assume their physical form, control movement completely, detach at any time, infiltrate or commandeer vehicles and devices.

Limits:
Capacity restricted without enhancement; cannot merge with living beings; detachment requires time and concentration; merged form limited by host object's durability; larger objects need significant power boost.

Additional Notes:
Monster Cat is non-humanoid, making stealth easier but limiting independent combat. True potential unexplored naturally. Chemical enhancement increases control range and object size capacity.

cardPool.title: Monster Summon
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Monster Summon

Description:
Simon Gollini conjures eyeless, blob-like creatures with large mouths. Forms vary—bulky, multi-headed, winged, or resembling wyverns, dinosaurs, and frogs. The mechanics are mysterious and possibly magical.

Functions/Applications:
Summon diverse monsters for combat, scouting, and overwhelming opponents. Each creature can be tailored in appearance and capabilities. Overmodification enables nearly limitless production for swarm tactics.

Limits:
Summoning requires focus and energy; sustained use causes fatigue. Creatures lack intelligence and need direction. Quantity and power are inversely balanced. The creation method is unknown.

Additional Notes:
Effectiveness scales with Overmodification enhancement. Best in open terrain where swarms maneuver freely. Struggles against single powerful opponents or in confined spaces.

cardPool.title: Mummification
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Mummification

Description:
Hoyo animates red bandages wrapped around his body to control inanimate objects, transforming them into humanoid mummy constructs that obey his commands. He can control dozens simultaneously.

Functions/Applications:
Animate objects into controllable mummy soldiers for combat. Indirectly control enemies by manipulating their clothing and equipment. Restrain targets through bandage entanglement.

Limits:
Cannot directly control living beings—only inanimate objects. Bandages break under sufficient force. Captured enemies can discard equipment to escape. Quirk deactivates if Hoyo is unconscious. Each mummy requires sustained focus to maintain.

Additional Notes:
Hoyo's strength lies in overwhelming numbers rather than raw power. Aware targets can strategically discard gear to break free. Damage to the bandages weakens his abilities.

cardPool.title: Muscle Augmentation
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Muscle Augmentation

Description:
The user amplifies and manipulates muscle fibers to achieve superhuman strength, speed, and durability. Muscle layers can protrude visibly or glow internally. Users can augment specific body parts and stack up to 12,000+ muscle layers for maximum effect.

Functions/Applications:
Grants immense physical strength capable of shattering cliffs. Enhanced speed allows blurred movement and attack avoidance. Muscle fibers act as natural armor absorbing impacts. Selective augmentation enables tactical flexibility—concentrating power in legs for speed or arms for striking force. Can contend with top-tier power users.

Limits:
Depleted muscle fibers tear and rip away, leaving users temporarily vulnerable and weakened. Vibration-based attacks efficiently destroy multiple fiber strands. The Quirk can be overwhelmed by sufficiently greater power levels. Exposed muscle architecture creates exploitable weak points if fibers are trapped or damaged. Regeneration is not inherent unless combined with healing Quirks.

Additional Notes:
Different users display variations: some manifest visible muscle bulges, others show internal glowing. Effectiveness scales with user's physical conditioning and control.

cardPool.title: Muscle Expansion
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Muscle Expansion

Description:
The user can expand and strengthen their muscles at will, dramatically increasing physical power and size for feats beyond normal human capability.

Functions/Applications:
Enhanced striking force and grappling power. Ability to lift heavy objects. Increased durability from muscle mass expansion. Can be applied selectively to specific body parts or full-body.

Limits:
Sustained expansion consumes stamina and causes fatigue. Overuse risks muscle strain or injury. Expanded form is slower and less agile. Cannot be maintained indefinitely without rest.

Additional Notes:
Best suited for close-range combat and heavy lifting. Works poorly against speed-based opponents. Requires activation time, leaving user vulnerable during transformation.

cardPool.title: Mushroom
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Mushroom

Description:
Kinoko Komori generates and spreads fungus spores from her body that rapidly grow into full-sized mushrooms upon contact with solid surfaces. Spore dispersal accelerates in high-humidity environments. Mushrooms persist for two to three hours before withering.

Functions/Applications:
Terrain control via rapid mushroom proliferation. Asphyxiation attacks by forcing mushroom growth in an opponent's throat. Area denial when combined with humidity spray bottles. Provides allies with cover or hiding spots. Works synergistically with allies who manipulate humidity.

Limits:
Spores indiscriminately affect all organisms, including allies, requiring pre-treatment with anti-fungal spray. Fungicides and ethanol neutralize spores. Fire destroys airborne spores before germination. Dry environments severely reduce effectiveness. Mushroom lifespan is only two to three hours.

Additional Notes:
Kinoko must sterilize teammates before deployment. The asphyxiation application is a high-risk, last-resort tactic. Humidity-control allies exponentially amplify her capability.

cardPool.title: Mutant Bovini
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Mutant Bovini

Description:
A transformation quirk that grants bovine-like facial features capable of emitting powerful directional energy beams from the face.

Functions/Applications:
The user fires lasers from their face in sustained or burst patterns for ranged combat and crowd control. Beams vary in intensity and can be aimed by turning the head.

Limits:
Sustained firing causes facial strain and overheating. Accuracy decreases at extreme ranges. The user cannot fire while moving without losing precision. Eyes and facial area are vulnerable pressure points.

Additional Notes:
This quirk suits offensive-focused fighters who position themselves strategically. Recovery time between volleys prevents overload. Close-range melee opponents pose significant tactical threats.

cardPool.title: Neutralization
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name: Neutralization

Description: A touch-based Quirk that temporarily nullifies a target's Quirk abilities through contact with the user's right hand, which glows bright light blue when activated. The glow's intensity and duration correlate with the target Quirk's power level. Originally limited to the right arm, but can spread throughout the body if modified by external Quirk factors.

Functions/Applications: Suppresses active Quirks temporarily, allowing treatment of harmful Quirk side effects like seizures or dangerous overmodification. Works through gloved contact, not requiring direct skin touch. Can potentially render a target completely Quirkless with sufficient power or modification.

Limits: Taxing on the user when neutralizing powerful Quirks; prolonged use risks severe injury or death. Originally required right arm contact, making the user vulnerable if that limb is disabled or lost. Cannot permanently destroy Quirks, only temporarily suppress them. Weaker Quirks may resist or require extended contact time.

Additional Notes: Quirk Factor naturally resides in the right arm, creating a critical vulnerability—loss of this limb results in complete inability to use the Quirk unless the factor spreads to other body parts through external modification.

cardPool.title: Octopus
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Octopus

Description:
The user manifests eight elastic tentacle appendages with powerful suckers for gripping and climbing. They can expel ink clouds from a specialized mouth structure for concealment or offense.

Functions/Applications:
Tentacles provide exceptional reach, grappling strength, and dexterity. Suckers enable scaling vertical surfaces and restraining targets. Ink expulsion creates visual obstruction for escape or tactical advantage. Multiple appendages allow simultaneous actions.

Limits:
Tentacles require conscious control and tire with sustained exertion. Ink reserves are finite and must regenerate. Sucker adhesion weakens on dry surfaces. No enhanced speed or durability beyond elastic tissue properties. Water environments may reduce ink effectiveness.

Additional Notes:
Best suited for close-quarters combat, reconnaissance, and environmental navigation. Offers creative problem-solving but lacks cutting power of harder-bodied quirks. Works synergistically with aquatic or confined spaces.

cardPool.title: Overclock
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Overclock

Description:
A speedster Quirk that accelerates the user's brain function and perception, making the world appear frozen. The user can move 3-10 times faster than normal, or dozens of times faster when adrenaline surges. Heightened senses perceive ultra-fast audio and visual input. A healing factor allows acceleration of cellular growth to repair injuries or fuse biological material with the body.

Functions/Applications:
Sprint at supersonic speeds to evade attacks and outpace projectiles. Read subconscious reactions to predict opponent behavior. Accelerate cell regeneration to heal wounds in seconds. Grow new limbs or fuse biological material. Process hyper-accelerated sensory information to navigate frozen time.

Limits:
Severely limited by oxygen deprivation—only usable for seconds before mandatory cooldown. Brain injury, concussions, or oxygen starvation seal the Quirk temporarily. Intense focus drains activation time. Sustained focused use risks permanent oxygen-deprivation lockout. Useless if airborne. Extensive physical trauma beyond the head can seal access.

Additional Notes:
The Quirk's true power lies in perception acceleration rather than pure speed. Synergizes dangerously with regenerative abilities.

cardPool.title: Overhaul
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Overhaul

Description:
A deconstruction and reconstruction ability activated by bare-handed touch. The user can instantly disassemble matter—living or non-living—and reassemble it into its original form, a new shape, or leave it destroyed. A single finger contact triggers the effect.

Functions/Applications:
Reshape terrain into walls, spikes, platforms, and holes for offense and defense. Merge separate objects or beings into hybrid entities. Heal injuries by reconstructing bodies to perfect condition. Extract components from targets. Dual-hand merging allows combining quirks from different subjects.

Limits:
Requires physical contact. Short cooldown between uses prevents rapid activation. Fractured terrain reduces effectiveness. Cannot function if arms are destroyed or disabled. Disassembly causes extreme pain to living subjects.

Additional Notes:
Overhaul becomes deadlier when merged with others, gaining additional limbs and access to their quirks. The ability's versatility makes it dangerous at any combat range. Deconstructing and perfectly reconstructing targets leaves no evidence.

cardPool.title: Overmodification
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Overmodification

Description:
A perpetually active Quirk that amplifies other Quirks through physical contact. When activated, the user's hair turns black and rose petals bloom around them. Compatible recipients gain boosted abilities or new powers; incompatible ones suffer severe pain and unconsciousness. The Quirk cannot be controlled or deactivated without a cancellation ability.

Functions/Applications:
Enhances compatible Quirks dramatically, sometimes granting entirely new functions. Can transform weak single-target abilities into multi-target powers. Works through skin contact; effects persist and stack with repeated applications. Rose petals indicate compatibility or rejection.

Limits:
Compatibility is rare and unpredictable. Incompatible contact causes severe backlash pain. The Quirk is always active and uncontrollable, dangerous in social situations. If not regularly discharged, it builds up and causes agonizing seizures. Overcharging expands range and spawns destructive plant life. Multiple-Quirk users nearby trigger negative feedback automatically. Enhanced abilities fade if the modified user sustains overwhelming damage.

Additional Notes:
Neutralization-type Quirks can cancel or be enhanced by this ability to permanently nullify Overmodification.

cardPool.title: Pain Blocker
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Pain Blocker

Description:
The user becomes unable to sense pain from any source. This allows them to sustain massive damage without distraction. With practice, the quirk can be toggled on and off for precise control.

Functions/Applications:
The user can withstand extreme attacks including intense heat and blunt force trauma while fighting at full capacity. Injuries that would incapacitate normal fighters become obstacles. Combined with durability or endurance quirks, the user gains advantage in prolonged combat.

Limits:
Pain blocking does not prevent actual damage—injuries still accumulate. This risks death from unnoticed critical damage. The quirk requires active concentration; sudden shocks may reactivate pain sensation. Unconsciousness or severe trauma can force it offline involuntarily.

Additional Notes:
Most effective paired with superhuman durability or strength quirks. The user must rely on visual and tactical awareness to judge their condition. Long-term use without monitoring injuries can cause catastrophic hidden damage.

cardPool.title: Permeation
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Permeation

Description:
The user phases their body through all matter by rendering themselves intangible. They can selectively phase individual body parts or their entire form, allowing passage through obstacles and evasion of attacks. Mastery requires intense concentration and training.

Functions/Applications:
Phase through walls and solid objects. Dodge incoming attacks by becoming intangible at precise moments. Perform combat maneuvers by phasing body parts independently. Navigate unrestricted by physical barriers.

Limits:
Clothing and carried objects slip off unless made from user's own hair. Full-body phasing negates all senses except falling sensation, causing disorientation and downward pull through solid ground. Cannot extend phasing to others. Ineffective against sudden attacks. Reactivating while phased inside solid matter repels user to surface, risking injury. Requires precise footwork and concentration; fails under time pressure without extensive training.

Additional Notes:
Extremely difficult to master with fatal consequences if misused. Mastery demands rigorous training to develop muscle memory and mental discipline for split-second activation control.

cardPool.title: Plant
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Plant

Description:
The user transforms body parts into living plant structures including vines, roots, and flora with regenerative properties that can mend wounds in allies through contact or proximity.

Functions/Applications:
Transform limbs into vines for restraint; sprout roots for stability and movement; generate healing flora to restore ally health; create plant barriers for defense.

Limits:
Transformations consume stamina and require concentration. Plant structures are vulnerable to fire, ice, and toxins. Healing is limited by user's vitality. Extended transformation causes fatigue. User must remain conscious to sustain growth.

Additional Notes:
Most effective in natural environments with soil and sunlight. Better for supporting teammates than direct combat. Unconsciousness ends all active transformations immediately.

cardPool.title: Playtime
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Playtime

Description:
A transformation quirk that enlarges the user to gigantic proportions while altering their physiology and mental state. The user's skin darkens, an additional pair of arms manifests, and their intellect regresses to childlike behavior, treating surroundings like toys.

Functions/Applications:
Grants immense size and strength for overwhelming physical force. Extra limbs enable multi-directional attacks. Regressed mental state removes inhibitions, making the user unpredictable and fearless in battle.

Limits:
Full capabilities poorly understood. Intelligence regression removes tactical thinking, leaving the user vulnerable to cunning opponents. Size may restrict mobility in confined spaces. Requires Trigger enhancement, suggesting instability.

Additional Notes:
Whether the transformation is the quirk's natural function or a Trigger effect remains unclear. The childlike mentality makes combat "play," potentially increasing destructiveness but reducing strategy. Duration and exhaustion effects unknown.

cardPool.title: Pliabody
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Pliabody

Description:
A transformation quirk allowing the user to stretch and flatten their body at will, granting superhuman flexibility and elasticity. The user's body becomes malleable like clay for compression, extension, and reshaping.

Functions/Applications:
Combat evasion through body deformation. Restraining opponents by wrapping around limbs or torso. Navigation through tight spaces during rescue operations. Enhanced grappling and unconventional combat positioning.

Limits:
Cannot stretch beyond 2-3 times normal body length without losing structural integrity. Extreme flattening reduces combat effectiveness and increases vulnerability. Requires conscious control—panic or unconsciousness reverts the body to normal form. Sharp weapons bypass flexibility and still cause injury.

Additional Notes:
Most effective in rescue and reconnaissance scenarios. Works best against unprepared opponents unfamiliar with elastic fighters. Extended extreme deformations require significant stamina.

cardPool.title: Pointer
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Pointer

Description:
A navigational quirk that allows the user to locate people, places, and things they're searching for. The user's limbs act as directional indicators, pointing toward desired targets with accuracy.

Functions/Applications:
The user must spin in place to activate the quirk. Once activated, their arms and legs point toward up to three different targets or directions simultaneously. Useful for tracking, navigation, rescue operations, and locating objectives.

Limits:
The user can only point toward three directions at once. Activation requires a full spin, creating vulnerability during combat. The quirk only works for consciously sought targets—vague searches won't function.

Additional Notes:
Best used for preparation and scouting rather than active combat. The spinning activation makes this quirk tactically predictable. Works as support for team operations and navigation challenges.

cardPool.title: Poison Gas
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Poison Gas

Description:
Takeshi Bushijima continuously generates toxic fog from his body that causes illness and sickness. Unreleased poison accumulates dangerously within him, poisoning his own body if buildup exceeds critical limits.

Functions/Applications:
Creates noxious clouds to incapacitate enemies through inhalation. Can be withheld temporarily to protect bystanders, though prolonged retention damages the user. The gas is highly flammable and ignites easily when exposed to combustion or explosives.

Limits:
Generates involuntarily with no on-off switch. User must periodically release accumulated toxins or suffer severe health degradation. Unusable in crowded areas without harming innocents. Combustion destroys the gas entirely. Effectiveness depends on accumulation time.

Additional Notes:
Takeshi must balance offense with self-preservation. Holding poison too long becomes counterproductive. Potency increases with prolonged accumulation but creates a dangerous threshold beyond which his health fails. Strategic release timing is crucial for combat effectiveness and survival.

cardPool.title: Poltergeist
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Poltergeist

Description:
A telekinetic Quirk that grants the user the ability to mentally manipulate objects and people within close proximity with precise control over multiple targets simultaneously.

Functions/Applications:
The user can lift and move swarms of objects to barrage opponents, restrain or manipulate people through telekinetic force, and create coordinated movement patterns. This Quirk excels at area control and multi-target offense.

Limits:
The maximum weight the user can manipulate is approximately that of a single adult human (roughly 62 kg or 137 lbs). The Quirk only functions on objects and people in close proximity to the user. The precise range and maximum object count remain unclear.

Additional Notes:
Poltergeist requires significant mental focus to manage multiple targets effectively. Fatigue from sustained use or managing numerous objects simultaneously impacts performance. Effectiveness depends on the user's concentration and tactical awareness.

cardPool.title: Polygraph
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Polygraph

Description:
Allows the user to detect truth and falsehood through direct physical contact. Green-yellow lightning sparks from the user's hands and around the target, revealing speech authenticity.

Functions/Applications:
Interrogation of suspects and witnesses. Detection of deception in negotiations. Verification of claims during combat by maintaining contact.

Limits:
Requires unbroken physical contact to function. Vulnerable to technicalities and precise wording. Cannot detect lies about intentions, only spoken falsehoods. Targets may bypass the Quirk by speaking subjective truths based on misunderstandings.

Additional Notes:
Most effective in controlled environments where physical contact can be maintained. Unreliable against opponents who exploit semantic loopholes. The sparking visual effect may alert the target they're being scanned.

cardPool.title: Pop Off
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Pop Off

Description:
The user produces sticky spheres from their scalp that can be plucked painlessly and regrow instantly. These spheres adhere to any surface except the user's own body. Water does not diminish their adhesive properties.

Functions/Applications:
Launch spheres as projectiles to restrain opponents or bind weapons. Construct ground traps and obstacle courses. Use spheres as bouncing platforms to traverse terrain or scale surfaces. Chain spheres together as whip-like weapons for medium-range combat.

Limits:
Adhesive strength depends on the user's health and physical condition, lasting hours to a full day when well-rested but weakening when exhausted. Rapid sphere removal causes scalp bleeding and limits sustained output. Spheres do not stick to the user. The ability requires close proximity for most applications and is unsuitable for long-distance engagement.

Additional Notes:
This quirk is often underestimated, granting users tactical advantage against overconfident opponents. Effective users should focus on trap-setting and environmental manipulation rather than direct combat.

cardPool.title: Power Stock
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Power Stock

Description:
A meta ability that stockpiles raw power and speed through training. The user can release accumulated energy in devastating bursts. Originally designed for users with fragile bodies, it grows exponentially stronger when transferred between users, with each successor building upon previous generations' stockpiled strength.

Functions/Applications:
Users channel accumulated power into explosive bursts of strength and speed beyond normal capability. The quirk grows stronger with each transfer, creating a compounding effect. Users can apply power selectively to specific limbs or across their entire body. With sufficient training, users can combine Power Stock with other quirks to exceed normal limitations.

Limits:
Power Stock requires extensive training to safely control; excessive output causes severe injury. As accumulated power grows across generations, it eventually exceeds what a single user can safely handle without specialized training. Rapid or forced transfer between incompatible users can destabilize and collapse the quirk. Users must gradually increase capacity over time or risk permanent damage to their body.

cardPool.title: Propagation
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Propagation

Description:
The user can grow and duplicate body parts across their form, multiplying them at will. Power scales proportionally with duplicates—three duplicates yield triple strength. Pairs dangerously with regenerative abilities for creating independent entities.

Functions/Applications:
Duplicate limbs for enhanced striking force and combat versatility. Create fused composite forms by merging duplicates into larger mass. Generate independent mini-entities from duplicate cells for autonomous action. Stack duplicates for exponential power increases.

Limits:
Power gain is linear and dependent on duplicate count. Requires significant biological mass; overextension causes resource depletion. Mini-entities are individually weaker and vulnerable to dispersal. Practical constraints from user stamina and durability apply.

Additional Notes:
Most effective when combined with regeneration or self-detonation abilities. Duplication quality and control may degrade with quantity. Emphasizes quantity-over-quality tactics rather than precision combat.

cardPool.title: Quad Arms
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Quad Arms

Description:
Grants the user a second pair of functional arms, creating four limbs total. The extra appendages are fully capable and proportional to the user's body, enabling simultaneous multi-tasking and enhanced physical combat capability.

Functions/Applications:
Wield multiple weapons or tools simultaneously; perform complex manual tasks at double speed; execute advanced grappling and striking combinations in unarmed combat; gain positional advantage in melee fights through increased attack angles.

Limits:
Requires conscious control of all four arms—divided attention reduces combat effectiveness. Strength is distributed across four limbs rather than concentrated, preventing superhuman power individually. Standard armor and equipment designed for two arms become cumbersome.

Additional Notes:
Best utilized by trained combatants who can leverage extra limbs for tactical advantage. Psychological adjustment needed to avoid arm interference during movement. Most effective in close-range engagements with simultaneous attacks or defensive positions.

cardPool.title: Rabbit
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Rabbit

Description:
A transformation quirk granting rabbit-like anatomy and heightened animal instincts. The user develops functional rabbit features including long ears, powerful hind legs, and fluffy tail, along with enhanced sensory perception and survival awareness.

Functions/Applications:
Enhanced hearing and smell detect distant threats and locations. Powerful leg muscles enable rapid bouncing and devastating kick attacks. A single ground stomp generates wind pressure strong enough to disperse fire. Rabbit instincts provide automatic danger awareness and tactical advantage in combat.

Limits:
Power is primarily lower-body focused, limiting upper-body versatility. Enhanced senses vulnerable to sensory overload. Bouncing mobility restricted in tight spaces or difficult terrain. User remains vulnerable to attacks targeting the ears or tail.

Additional Notes:
Combat-oriented quirk suited for aggressive, mobile fighting styles. Wind pressure from stomps allows engagement of multiple enemies or environmental hazards. Survival instinct provides defensive awareness and tactical positioning benefits in prolonged engagements.

cardPool.title: Razor Sharp
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Razor Sharp

Description:
The user generates sharp blades of varying shapes and sizes from any part of their body. These blades are composed of an unknown material strong enough to cut steel and withstand explosions, serving as both offensive and defensive tools.

Functions/Applications:
Blades can be produced from forearms for slashing, feet for stability, or any body part as needed. The user controls blade geometry and deployment in real-time, allowing simultaneous offense and defense.

Limits:
Blade generation requires conscious effort and energy expenditure. Sustained combat depletes stamina. The user must be within melee range, and blades cannot be thrown or separated from the body.

Additional Notes:
Best suited for close-quarters combat specialists. The quirk's strength lies in tactical flexibility and unpredictable blade placement.

cardPool.title: Reflect
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Reflect

Description:
An always-active Quirk that absorbs incoming energy—physical or ranged—and rebounds it back at the attacker in a spiraling wave. The user's skin glows blue during use. However, the Quirk reflects all contact indiscriminately, preventing any physical touch and rendering the user blind due to light reflection from their eyes, necessitating special eye masks to see.

Functions/Applications:
Automatic defense against melee and ranged attacks. Can redirect reflected energy through technological augmentation to change trajectory or fuel flight. Works best when combined with stationary positioning and external firepower.

Limits:
Drains stamina proportionally to reflected energy strength; sustained barrages quickly deplete reserves. Cannot be disabled, making all physical contact with anyone impossible and eliminating emotional bonds. The constant reflection of light blinds the user without protective gear. Overloads under relentless, powerful multi-hit attacks.

Additional Notes:
The Quirk's curse is as significant as its power—the inability to touch others creates severe social ostracization and psychological trauma. Requires technological support to maximize effectiveness in combat.

cardPool.title: Rewind
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Rewind

Description:
A rare mutant Quirk allowing the user to reverse a living being's body to a previous physical state. Activation causes a small horn on the forehead to grow and glow brightly, affecting all living creatures in contact or nearby. The power can theoretically rewind a target back to non-existence, making it exceptionally dangerous.

Functions/Applications:
Restores injured bodies to pre-injury states, heals wounds and broken limbs, reverses genetic modifications, and can restore erased Quirks. User can consciously control which targets are affected through training. Effective range requires close proximity or physical contact.

Limits:
Only affects living things; cannot rewind objects or non-organic matter. Requires accumulation of "Rewind Energy" to activate; once used, the horn shrinks and must recharge. User lacks innate control and risks catastrophic consequences without proper training. Emotional state influences power potency. Cannot be safely practiced on living beings without supervision.

Additional Notes:
Manifests as a small brown horn on the right forehead that grows during activation. Emotional determination and hope amplify Quirk strength. User is young and inexperienced; control improves through training on small organisms.

cardPool.title: Rifle
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Rifle

Description:
Kaina can extrude a functional rifle from her right elbow that fires ammunition crafted from her own hair. The weapon operates silently using organic muscle and bone sinew propulsion rather than gunpowder. She manifests a flesh tendril scope for precision targeting and can increase output power at the cost of jamming risk.

Functions/Applications:
Fire custom hair-bullets up to 3km with superior penetration and no audible report. Mold hair into specialized rounds: hollow-point, tracking, or curved trajectory variants. Bullets are reusable and caseless. Increase firepower for devastating shots. Deploy flesh scope tendril for enhanced accuracy at range.

Limits:
Hair length determines ammunition capacity. Individual round loading creates reload delays. Rifle is fragile in close combat and doesn't self-repair. Distinctive dark blue and pink bullet coloring is identifiable. Using the Quirk while injured reopens wounds and strains her body.

Additional Notes:
Ideal for assassins and snipers. Vulnerable to close-range combatants, making positioning critical. Requires tactical patience and hair maintenance. Limited by ammunition reserves in prolonged engagements.

cardPool.title: Rivet
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Rivet

Description:
A transformation quirk enabling the user to generate metallic rivet-like growths from their arms. These hardened projectiles can be expelled with force or extended as defensive protrusions.

Functions/Applications:
The user launches rivets as high-velocity projectiles for ranged attacks or extends them along their arms for melee enhancement. The growths provide armor-like protection and aid climbing or anchoring.

Limits:
Rivet generation depletes stamina with each use and is limited to the arms. Once expelled, rivets take time to regrow. The quirk offers no protection against quirks that bypass physical defense.

Additional Notes:
A straightforward combat quirk for aggressive fighters. Effectiveness diminishes in prolonged battles due to stamina drain. Pairs well with close-range combat but is vulnerable to speed-based or energy-type quirks.

cardPool.title: Sandstorm
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Sandstorm

Description:
The user transforms their upper body into manipulable sand, gaining a fluid, shapeshifting form. This grants enhanced adaptability and the ability to reform after damage, making them difficult to restrain.

Functions/Applications:
Transform limbs into sand constructs for attacking and defending. Manipulate sand to shield against strikes, create barriers, or restrain opponents. Swing sand densely to repel projectiles. Exploit fluidity to slip free from contact-dependent Quirks.

Limits:
Provides no defense against area-of-effect or wide-radius attacks. Cannot protect the lower body or head. Sand form is vulnerable to blunt force trauma and extreme pressure. Requires concentration to maintain shapes; rapid shifting drains stamina.

Additional Notes:
Most effective against contact-dependent Quirks and single-target attacks. Strategic weakness to elemental or crowd-control abilities. User's skill and creativity determine sand manipulation effectiveness.

cardPool.title: Scalemail
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Scalemail

Description:
The user's body generates sharp, dark red armored scales that cover their skin, providing enhanced physical defense and strength. Activating the scales causes bleeding as they rupture through the skin, making each deployment painful.

Functions/Applications:
Deploy scales across the body for increased durability against strikes and physical attacks. The scales grant moderate strength enhancement and can be selectively activated on specific body areas or full-body coverage.

Limits:
The scales shatter under sustained high-force impact. Generating the armor causes physical pain and bleeding each time activated. Repeated use risks severe blood loss and exhaustion from rupturing skin.

Additional Notes:
This Quirk was stolen and implanted by All For One, suggesting it may perform differently in its original owner's body. Durability is significant against standard attacks but fails against concentrated power. The pain cost makes prolonged deployment strategically risky.

cardPool.title: Scales
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Scales

Description:
The user generates hard, sharp reptilian scales across their body for protection and ranged attacks. Scale production requires adequate collagen and calcium intake. Scales are sharp enough to cut through vines and damage metal.

Functions/Applications:
Deploy scales as full-body armor for damage mitigation. Launch individual scales as cutting projectiles with accuracy at medium to long range. Switch between melee and ranged combat. Scales can be stored in specialized gauntlets for rapid-fire projectile attacks.

Limits:
Scales break easily when struck with sufficient force, providing inferior protection compared to hardening quirks. Continuous production depletes collagen and calcium reserves. Projectile accuracy depends on user skill and line of sight. Gauntlets have limited storage capacity.

Additional Notes:
Hiryu Rin demonstrates exceptional accuracy with small targets and minimal collateral damage. The quirk enables combat versatility across ranges, though sustained use requires nutritional awareness.

cardPool.title: Scatter
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Scatter

Description:
A stolen Quirk allowing the user to split and multiply projectiles mid-flight, expanding coverage area and destructive potential. Originally used by Tomura Shigaraki, it transforms focused attacks into devastating dispersed barrages.

Functions/Applications:
Multiplies incoming or outgoing projectiles into numerous smaller ones across a wider radius. Increases range and impact area of long-range attacks. Can combine with other Quirks like Reflect to redirect and amplify enemy fire. Effective for overwhelming defenses and area denial.

Limits:
Requires projectiles to function—cannot create attacks from nothing. Multiplied projectiles are individually weaker than the original. Does not enhance melee combat. Effectiveness diminishes against mobile targets. Cannot be used continuously without a projectile source.

Additional Notes:
This stolen Quirk suggests the user lacks innate mastery and may face unpredictable limitations. Best utilized in mid-to-long range engagements. Synergizes well with reflection-based or projectile-generating abilities. Strategic timing is crucial for maximum impact.

cardPool.title: Serpentress
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Serpentress

Description:
The user possesses three living serpents integrated into their hair as biological extensions. These snakes possess heightened sensory perception, allowing the user to detect hidden targets and locate disaster victims through enhanced detection capabilities beyond normal human limits.

Functions/Applications:
The snakes can scout ahead and sense concealed individuals or survivors in dangerous environments. They enable rapid victim location during rescue operations and provide reconnaissance advantages in stealth situations. The snakes move independently under the user's control while remaining part of their body.

Limits:
The snakes cannot be separated from the user's body for extended periods. Detection range is constrained by sensory reach, and they cannot pierce physical barriers like dense earth or sealed structures. The user cannot operate effectively while unconscious or restrained at the head.

Additional Notes:
Serpentress is primarily a utility Quirk for reconnaissance and rescue operations rather than direct combat. The snakes' exact offensive potential and maximum sensory range should be determined by campaign context.

cardPool.title: Shoulder-Mounted Jets
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Shoulder-Mounted Jets

Description:
Four retractable jet boosters mounted on the user's upper back enable high-speed flight with powerful thrust for rapid acceleration and aerial movement. Sustained control requires significant effort and coordination.

Functions/Applications:
Grants speed-boosted flight for traversal and aerial combat positioning. Jets deploy or retract at will, enabling quick escapes or pursuit of airborne targets. Works with other physical quirks to stabilize mid-air maneuvers.

Limits:
Flight lacks precise maneuverability without additional support quirks. User's arms or other abilities needed to maintain balance and directional control during extended flight. Stamina-dependent with prolonged use. Ineffective while fully restrained or immobilized.

Additional Notes:
Most effective when paired with stabilizing or manipulative abilities. The jets alone lack fine maneuverability. Boosters are durable for combat but vulnerable to direct damage.

cardPool.title: Slice
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Slice

Description:
The user can move, harden, and sharpen their own hair at will, transforming it into a weapon and tool. Hair can be weaponized as blades, fired as projectiles, or used defensively as shields and mobility aids.

Functions/Applications:
Offensive strikes using hardened hair as cutting blades; launching hair strands as high-speed projectiles; defensive barriers by interweaving hair into shields; parrying attacks; mobility enhancement using hair locks as stilts or climbing aids.

Limits:
Hair is vulnerable to corrosive substances like acid. Reduced hair length decreases combat effectiveness and range. Hair cannot be regrown mid-combat, making attrition a tactical concern. Requires conscious control to harden and shape hair, limiting reaction speed in surprises.

Additional Notes:
Slice excels in close-to-mid-range combat with strong defensive utility. Effectiveness depends on hair maintenance and length preservation, making it vulnerable to caustic agents or extreme heat. Best used by strategic fighters who manage resources carefully.

cardPool.title: Smokescreen
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Smokescreen

Description:
The user generates thick purple smoke from their body that spreads across wide areas to obscure vision and disorient opponents. The smoke can be emitted from the mouth as a breath weapon. Enhanced through One For All's stockpiling, making it denser and more expansive than the original user's version.

Functions/Applications:
Creates visual obstruction to hide movements, catch enemies by surprise, or guide them toward desired locations. Can be combined with other abilities for tactical advantage. Useful for reconnaissance and escape.

Limits:
No offensive damage capability. Loses effectiveness in humid or rainy environments where it dissipates rapidly. Powerful shockwaves dispel the smoke. Excessive release can disorient the user and obscure their own vision and movement.

Additional Notes:
Most effective when deployed strategically and combined with other Quirks. Requires experience to control output and prevent self-hindrance. Environmental conditions significantly impact reliability and coverage duration.

cardPool.title: Snip Clip
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Snip Clip

Description:
The user can cut through nearly any material by placing it between their index and middle fingers, then performing a scissor motion. The cutting force is proportional to the user's strength and can sever solid objects like reinforced exoskeletons. Larger cuts are possible when material is positioned between the user's legs.

Functions/Applications:
Precision cutting of objects, armor, and structural materials. Can disable mechanical suits by severing limbs or joints. Works on organic and inorganic matter alike.

Limits:
The space between the user's fingers severely restricts what can be cut—only thin or narrow objects fit. Larger cuts require repositioning between the legs, leaving the user vulnerable. Cannot cut beyond physical reach. Effectiveness depends on strength and leverage.

Additional Notes:
Excels at tactical dismantling but struggles against thick or wide objects. Ineffective at range and requires maintaining contact and positioning to execute cuts.

cardPool.title: Softening
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Softening

Description:
Juzo Honenuki transforms solid objects into semi-liquid mud through touch, then reverts them with a second touch. Works on ice, metal, stone, and structures but not living beings. Softened materials trap and sink anything on them.

Functions/Applications:
Creates environmental traps by softening ground or structures that collapse when stepped on. Restricts enemy mobility. Allows swimming through softened material for rapid traversal or escape. Neutralizes solid-based attacks. Controls battle flow and enemy positioning.

Limits:
Cannot affect living organisms. Targets with propulsion abilities can escape softened traps. All softened objects revert if Juzo loses consciousness. Requires direct physical contact to activate and deactivate. Loses effectiveness against mobility-independent opponents.

Additional Notes:
Pairs with Juzo's reflexes for defensive countering. Functions as both offensive trap-laying tool and defensive escape mechanism. Range depends on available solid materials in the environment.

cardPool.title: Solid Air
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Solid Air

Description:
The user solidifies air through breath to create floating constructs—walls, platforms, and barriers—that remain suspended without support. These barriers are soundproof, blocking voice-based abilities and external noise. Durability scales with lung capacity and training.

Functions/Applications:
Create defensive walls and platforms mid-air for mobility or protection. Form soundproof enclosures to contain or isolate targets. Shape constructs into complex forms by hand-shaping exhaled air. Counter sound-dependent quirks with solidified barriers.

Limits:
Remains breakable by sufficient physical force. Maximum construct size limited by lung capacity—prolonged use causes fatigue. Cannot create animated or mobile constructs; all formations are static. Requires conscious breath control; suffocation disables the quirk.

Additional Notes:
Early barriers are fragile but become more resilient with training. Soundproofing makes this quirk effective against vocally-dependent opponents. Transparency of constructs provides tactical advantage by obscuring their presence visually.

cardPool.title: Somnambulist
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Somnambulist

Description:
The user exudes a sleep-inducing lavender-purple aroma that renders targets unconscious. The fragrance is significantly more potent against males than females. Anyone breathing in sufficient amounts falls into deep slumber, making close-range combat hazardous for opponents.

Functions/Applications:
Release aroma passively or actively to incapacitate enemies at medium range. Use hand fans to spread and direct the fragrance with greater accuracy and distance. Effective crowd control tool for preventing dangerous actions or subduing opponents. Can be concentrated for stronger effect on resistant targets.

Limits:
Requires exposed skin; tight clothing reduces effectiveness. Opponents with air-filtering masks or who cover their mouths avoid the aroma entirely. Significantly less effective against female targets unless the user concentrates extra power. Low ventilation environments improve effectiveness; open spaces reduce potency. Breath-holding provides temporary resistance.

Additional Notes:
The Quirk makes the user an excellent referee or law enforcement officer due to non-lethal incapacitation. Support items like fans enhance range and directional control.

cardPool.title: Spray Art
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Spray Art

Description:
The user generates colorful spray paint clouds that induce mild hallucinations in those caught within them. By wielding spray paint cans, they release massive paint clouds similar to smoke that linger until dispersed or the user is incapacitated.

Functions/Applications:
Create disorienting illusions to confuse enemies and obscure vision. Control cloud duration and deployment area. Use hallucinations to separate groups or gain tactical advantages. Useful for escape, misdirection, or area denial.

Limits:
The user must have spray paint cans available. Hallucinations are only mild. Clouds dissipate if the user is immobilized or unconscious. The Quirk affects allies and enemies alike. Effectiveness diminishes against those with strong mental resistance.

Additional Notes:
This Quirk emphasizes battlefield control and confusion over direct damage. The user retains awareness within their own clouds, making positioning critical. Duration appears indefinite while active.

cardPool.title: Squirmy Fingers
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Squirmy Fingers

Description:
The user gains supernatural control over their fingers, allowing them to bend and manipulate them in any direction with perfect precision. This grants exceptional dexterity and fine motor control far beyond normal human capability.

Functions/Applications:
Craft intricate mechanisms and detailed work with unmatched speed and accuracy. Manipulate small objects with flawless control. Create complex costumes and advanced equipment. Pick locks or perform delicate assembly tasks impossible for ordinary hands.

Limits:
Only affects the user's fingers and cannot extend beyond the hands. Requires direct physical contact with objects. Provides no offensive combat capability and is barely useful in direct conflict.

Additional Notes:
Best suited for crafting and engineering support roles rather than direct combat. The Quirk's true value lies in creation and construction rather than combat applications.

cardPool.title: Static
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Static

Description:
By rubbing their body to generate friction, the user accumulates electrical charge similar to natural static electricity. They can discharge electrical currents from their body in controlled bursts, though the power remains modest compared to developed electrical quirks.

Functions/Applications:
The user builds up electrical energy through deliberate friction, then releases it as a shock for stunning, repelling, or disorienting targets. Useful for short-range combat, defense, or temporarily incapacitating nearby opponents.

Limits:
Requires active charging time through rubbing—cannot generate charge instantly. Output damage is weak and unsuitable for heavy combat or armored foes. Extended use causes fatigue. Wet conditions severely diminish or neutralize effectiveness.

Additional Notes:
This quirk demands tactical patience and preparation rather than spontaneous activation. Most effective in dry environments against unarmored or lightly-armored opponents. The user must remain mobile and maintain composure during charging to avoid interruption.

cardPool.title: Steel
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Steel

Description:
The user transforms their entire body into steel, becoming a nigh-impenetrable living weapon. The steel form dramatically increases physical strength to superhuman levels while providing exceptional resistance to physical damage, extreme cold, and moderate heat with training. The user's body takes on a metallic sheen, turning reddish when exposed to flames.

Functions/Applications:
Steel allows the user to withstand bullets, blades, falling debris, and extreme cold without injury. Enhanced strength enables breaking through obstacles and delivering powerful close-range strikes. The user can serve as a human shield. Iron intake from food extends duration and potency of activation.

Limits:
Prolonged use causes iron fatigue, reducing hardness until deactivation is necessary. Steel has a hardness ceiling that cannot be improved through training. Poisonous gas and toxic vapors remain effective since breathing is required. Extreme heat can melt the steel form without sufficient training. The quirk does not protect against all damage types.

Additional Notes:
Steel functions similarly to hardening-type quirks but lacks potential for unlimited improvement. Users benefit from iron-rich diets and heat-resistance training to maximize effectiveness.

cardPool.title: Stock
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Stock

Description:
A storage-based quirk that allows the user to absorb incoming attacks and convert them into physical lumps on their back. These stored attacks can be released at will during combat for tactical flexibility and counteroffensive capability.

Functions/Applications:
The user devours incoming attacks to absorb their energy, manifesting as lumps on their back. When needed, a lump detaches and floats toward the user's face before releasing the absorbed attack at an opponent. This enables defense-turned-offense strategies.

Limits:
Storage capacity is limited by the number of lumps the user can grow on their back. The floating lump requires time to position before releasing, making it vulnerable to interruption. Attacks must make direct contact to be absorbed.

Additional Notes:
Stock excels at turning defensive situations into offensive advantages. The quirk's effectiveness depends on absorbing powerful attacks; weak strikes provide minimal benefit. The user must maintain awareness of their back's storage capacity during prolonged combat.

cardPool.title: Strongarm
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Strongarm

Description:
The user's shoulders rotate at superhuman speeds, enabling rapid, powerful punches in quick succession. Each strike carries immense force capable of wearing down even defensive Quirk users.

Functions/Applications:
Rapid-fire punching combinations with extreme velocity and power. Can penetrate defenses through accumulated strike trauma. Effective for close-range combat against armored opponents.

Limits:
Usable for only a few seconds before muscle fatigue sets in. Cannot break through absolute barrier-type Quirks. Shoulder joints require recovery time between uses.

Additional Notes:
Best suited for short, explosive engagements. User must manage stamina carefully to avoid physical incapacity mid-combat.

cardPool.title: Sugar Rush
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Sugar Rush

Description:
By consuming sugar, Rikido multiplies his physical strength five-fold for three minutes per ten grams ingested. His body visibly bulks up during activation, converting glucose into raw muscle power.

Functions/Applications:
Ideal for breaking through obstacles, overpowering opponents, and heavy lifting. Rikido carries granulated sugar in belt pouches for quick activation. His baking skills provide reliable sugar sources.

Limits:
Requires sugar consumption to activate. Causes severe hypoglycemia: lowered intelligence, reduced cognition, and lethargy during the boost. Cannot be sustained without additional sugar. Becomes a straightforward brawler unable to execute complex strategies while empowered.

Additional Notes:
Rikido's weightlifting regimen maximizes his Quirk's potency. Effect duration and strength multiplier scale with sugar quantity consumed, making careful rationing essential for prolonged conflicts.

cardPool.title: Suicide Bomb
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Suicide Bomb

Description:
A volatile Quirk that generates devastating explosions centered on the user's body. The ability creates massive destructive force capable of razing entire areas and can be triggered by will or external sources.

Functions/Applications:
Deploy large-scale area-denial explosions for combat or destruction. Functions as both offensive weapon and last-resort defensive measure. External triggers like intense heat can activate detonations involuntarily.

Limits:
The user is vulnerable to their own explosions and can suffer lethal damage. Fire-based Quirks that control heat externally pose severe disadvantages by risking accidental detonation. Outside-triggered detonations appear uncontrollable.

Additional Notes:
Represents extreme danger to user and environment. Most effective as a last-stand tactic rather than sustained combat ability.

cardPool.title: Super Regeneration
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Super Regeneration

Description:
A rare artificially engineered Quirk enabling rapid regeneration of physical damage including severed limbs and catastrophic wounds at incredible speeds, making users exceptionally difficult to permanently disable through conventional injury.

Functions/Applications:
The user recovers from nearly any physical trauma—burns, lacerations, amputation, blunt force damage—as long as their brain remains active. Regeneration speed scales with physical condition. Allows survival from attacks that would instantly kill most combatants.

Limits:
Cannot heal cauterized wounds, spiritual damage, or Quirk Factor damage. Regeneration requires active brain function; unconsciousness or brain destruction halts healing. Damage faster than regeneration speed will overwhelm the user. Complete incineration or molecular disintegration bypasses regeneration. Non-physical death methods like heart stoppage or suffocation circumvent the Quirk. Unprepared bodies experience dramatically slower regeneration.

Additional Notes:
Super Regeneration is one of the most dangerous Quirks due to its near-invulnerability potential. Targeting the head is the most reliable method to disable users.

cardPool.title: Swan
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Swan

Description:
The user manifests two large, pristine white wings resembling those of a swan on their back. These wings enable aerial locomotion, granting the ability to soar through the skies with grace and speed.

Functions/Applications:
Flight across distances and terrain. Enhanced mobility for escape, pursuit, or reconnaissance. The wings generate significant wind gusts when deployed.

Limits:
Flight requires the user to strip naked, as clothing weight prevents takeoff. Wings are vulnerable to damage during flight, leaving the user defenseless if injured mid-air.

Additional Notes:
The quirk's awkward activation requirement makes it impractical in combat or emergencies. Best suited for scouting or travel in private settings. The user's vulnerability while unclothed creates tactical disadvantages.

cardPool.title: Sword Kill
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Sword Kill

Description:
The user generates flexible, accordion-like swords from their arms and shoulders that extend and retract at will. When enhanced by Trigger, the Quirk produces up to six blades simultaneously, including from the mouth, and the user's face becomes serpentine and menacing.

Functions/Applications:
Deploy multiple melee weapons for combat versatility, defense, or crowd control. Extended blades allow mid-range strikes while maintaining close-quarters capability. Trigger enhancement multiplies offensive potential.

Limits:
Base form limited to two primary swords. Continuous blade generation taxes stamina. Trigger dependence creates vulnerability without enhancement. Accordion flexibility reduces blade rigidity compared to solid weapons.

Additional Notes:
Blade retraction speed and extension range scale with user control and experience. Trigger enhancement is temporary and may alter judgment. The serpentine transformation suggests possible psychological side effects from prolonged enhancement use.

cardPool.title: Tape
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name: Tape

Description: The user's elbows function as biological tape dispensers, ejecting strong adhesive tape of variable length and thickness. The tape supports body weight and restrains opponents but breaks under extreme force. Continuous overuse causes dry skin irritation.

Functions/Applications: Fire tape strands for binding targets; swing or rappel using anchored tape; create traps and blockades; shoot multiple strands simultaneously; produce double-sided tape; craft improvised tools; coordinate with allies for combo effects.

Limits: Tape supply is finite per cycle. Tape breaks under sufficient stress. Overuse causes skin degradation. User must manually cut tape to reset firing. Ineffective against non-adhesive surfaces.

Additional Notes: Most effective at medium range. Versatile support Quirk enabling mobility, restraint, and environmental control. Synergizes with mobility or levitation Quirks. Physical conditioning increases capacity, tensile strength, and firing speed.

cardPool.title: Telekinesis
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Telekinesis

Description:
A mental power that grants the ability to move and manipulate inanimate objects through force of will alone, without physical contact.

Functions/Applications:
Move objects across distances, construct barriers or projectiles in combat, solve environmental puzzles, lift multiple items simultaneously.

Limits:
Only affects inanimate objects. Control becomes difficult with larger or heavier objects. Requires concentration. Cannot be used while unconscious or mentally incapacitated.

Additional Notes:
Power scales significantly when enhanced through Overmodification. Versatility makes it effective in combat and utility roles, though output depends on the user's mental fortitude and focus.

cardPool.title: Telepath
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Telepath

Description:
A one-way telepathic ability allowing the user to broadcast thoughts directly into the minds of others. Can target single individuals or multiple people simultaneously across considerable distances.

Functions/Applications:
Send tactical instructions to allies during combat. Broadcast warnings across large areas. Distract enemies by projecting disorienting messages into their minds, creating openings for attacks.

Limits:
Communication is strictly one-way; the user cannot receive telepathic responses. Effective range is limited. Cannot force actions, only deliver messages. Overuse or contacting too many people simultaneously may cause mental strain.

Additional Notes:
Effective for battlefield coordination and psychological tactics. Useless against deaf or mentally shielded opponents. Works best when paired with combat abilities or team strategies.

cardPool.title: Teleportation
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Teleportation

Description:
Gil Gollini can instantly move himself and anything he touches to any location within his line of sight. Enhanced through Overmodification, activation speed becomes dramatically faster, making him difficult to predict.

Functions/Applications:
Instantaneous repositioning in combat or exploration. Transport of allies and objects by physical contact. Rapid escape from danger. Enhanced speed allows near-instantaneous consecutive teleports when overmodified.

Limits:
User must maintain clear line of sight to destination. Cannot teleport outside visual range. Environmental hazards can force unsafe positions. Vision obstruction leaves user vulnerable.

Additional Notes:
Strength lies in mobility and unpredictability. Weakness exploitable through vision denial or environmental control. Overmodification increases combat effectiveness but may strain the user.

cardPool.title: Telescopic
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Telescopic

Description:
The user can rapidly retract their body parts into themselves like a turtle. Retraction is nearly instantaneous for evasion, but unretracting takes several seconds and leaves them vulnerable.

Functions/Applications:
Defensive evasion against projectiles and melee attacks; quick dodge-and-counter tactics; protection from piercing or cutting damage while retracted.

Limits:
Unretracting is slow and leaves the user exposed and immobile. Cannot retract selectively—must withdraw entire body or specific limbs at once. Ineffective against area-of-effect attacks. User remains conscious but unable to act offensively while retracted.

Additional Notes:
Best suited for defensive combat roles requiring quick reflexes. Works well with counterattack strategies. Requires spatial awareness to position safely before unretracting.

cardPool.title: Tidal Bore
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Tidal Bore

Description:
The user expels massive quantities of water from their mouth with tremendous force, capable of manipulating heavy objects and creating destructive floods.

Functions/Applications:
Generate powerful water jets to lift or push heavy objects. Create widespread flooding to disrupt terrain and enemies. Use water discharge as an offensive blast or defensive barrier. Output scales with emotional state and intensifies around favorite foods.

Limits:
Water generation drains stamina quickly with prolonged use. The quirk activates involuntarily around favorite foods, causing indiscriminate flooding and loss of directional control. Effectiveness reduces in arid environments. Water originates from the mouth, limiting range and maneuverability.

Additional Notes:
Best suited for large-scale environmental control rather than precise combat. Involuntary activation is both a weakness and liability in social situations. Most effective near bodies of water or in wet climates.

cardPool.title: Toho
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name: Toho
