Description: Grants the user kaiju-like attributes, transforming them into a massive reptilian creature with enormous size, superhuman strength, and scaled skin.

Functions/Applications: Devastating melee combat through size and strength; intimidation through monstrous appearance; crushing objects and structures; enhanced durability from scaled skin; use as a living siege weapon.

Limits: Extreme size prevents stealth and navigation of confined spaces; high energy consumption; slow movement speed; vulnerable to agility-based tactics; psychological strain from transformation.

Additional Notes: The transformation appears permanent or semi-permanent. Effectiveness scales with physical conditioning and combat experience. Best suited for direct assault roles.

cardPool.title: Tongue Tank
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Tongue Tank

Description:
The user's tongue transforms into a retractable tank cannon housed within their mouth. When the mouth opens, the tongue-cannon extends and fires hard, rock-like projectiles with considerable force. The ammunition generation mechanism is unclear—whether internal production or material consumption.

Functions/Applications:
Fires projectile attacks at moderate to long range. Deploys quickly by opening the mouth. Useful for ranged combat, area denial, and breaking obstacles. The cannon retracts for protection when not in use.

Limits:
Projectile capacity and firing rate unknown. Must open mouth to fire, creating predictable attack patterns. Close-quarters combat severely hampered. Ammunition source uncertain, potentially limiting sustained fire. Mouth remains vulnerable.

Additional Notes:
Quirk manifests in young users, suggesting development potential. Practical applications depend on whether ammunition is finite or self-regenerating. Users require tactical positioning to maximize effectiveness while maintaining defense.

cardPool.title: Transforming Arms
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Transforming Arms

Description:
The user reshapes their arms at will, extending them elastically for long-range strikes or splitting them to attack from multiple angles simultaneously. Arms can enlarge, harden, or transform into different shapes to suit combat needs.

Functions/Applications:
Stretch arms to grab distant targets. Enlarge fists for close-range power. Split arms to strike from multiple directions. Transform arms into alternative shapes like wings for mobility. Combine with other Quirks for hybrid combat.

Limits:
Rigid fighting styles create lag between transformation and execution. Transformation speed and complexity drain stamina with extended use. Arm durability decreases when stretched thin or spread.

Additional Notes:
Most effective with flexible, unconventional fighting styles. Users favoring pure hand-to-hand combat may find the Quirk burdensome, reducing overall efficiency despite raw power potential.

cardPool.title: Trap Flex
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Trap Flex

Description:
The user can flex their trapezius muscles to extraordinary degrees, allowing their shoulders to expand and envelop their head. This grants enhanced speed and strength beyond normal human capability.

Functions/Applications:
Provides boosts to physical speed and striking power. The expanded shoulder coverage offers partial defensive protection for the head and neck. Useful for close-quarters combat, grappling, and evasive maneuvers.

Limits:
Strength output is modest compared to dedicated strength Quirks. Continuous flexing causes fatigue. Head protection is incomplete, leaving the back of the head vulnerable.

Additional Notes:
Best suited for hit-and-run tactics rather than prolonged brawls. Works optimally with tactical positioning and speed-based strategies rather than direct power contests.

cardPool.title: Tree Frog
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Tree Frog

Description:
A frog-type Quirk granting an extendable, curling tongue and webbed fingers. The user develops tadpole-like features suited for climbing and aquatic environments.

Functions/Applications:
The tongue enables grappling and object manipulation with adhesive climbing properties. Webbed fingers enhance swimming and grip on wet surfaces. The user gains improved agility in arboreal and aquatic settings.

Limits:
Minimal tongue extension limits reach and grappling power, best for close-range use only. Effectiveness diminishes in dry environments; requires moisture for optimal performance. Cannot compete with specialized amphibian Quirks in combat.

Additional Notes:
Tree Frog is a utility-focused Quirk for mobility and environmental adaptation rather than direct confrontation. Users excel in jungle, swamp, or aquatic terrain but struggle in arid conditions.

cardPool.title: Vibration Detection
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Vibration Sense

Description:
The user perceives surroundings through detection of subtle vibrations in air and matter, functioning as sensory replacement similar to echolocation. This Quirk compensates for visual impairment by mapping spatial awareness through vibration patterns.

Functions/Applications:
The user can navigate complex environments, detect nearby objects and beings, track movement through tremors, and identify threats in darkness. This allows combat awareness and spatial navigation without sight.

Limits:
The Quirk cannot penetrate vibration-dampening materials like thick stone or specialized absorption surfaces. It requires environments where vibrations propagate; total silence or dampening fields severely limit effectiveness. It cannot discern fine details like facial features or colors.

Additional Notes:
This Quirk's primary strength lies in adapting to sensory loss, making it valuable for users who have lost eyesight. It works best in environments with active movement or sound; still environments reduce range and clarity. The Quirk pairs well with other compensatory sensory abilities.

cardPool.title: Vines
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Vines

Description:
The user's hair transforms into controllable, thorny vines that can be manipulated and detached. The vines are durable, capable of piercing skin and cutting concrete, and are non-conductive to electricity.

Functions/Applications:
Vines can restrain opponents, grapple distant objects, form defensive barriers, and be severed as weapons. Thorns inflict cutting damage on contact. The user gains resistance to electrical attacks.

Limits:
The vines can be cut or severed, requiring time to regenerate. Growth and regeneration depend on sunlight and water. Extended use without these resources diminishes vine strength and length. The vines remain anchored to the user's head.

Additional Notes:
The vines are sharp enough to cause significant abrasion wounds. They function as both offensive and defensive tools, making this a versatile middle-range Quirk. Users should prioritize positioning in well-lit, moist environments for sustained effectiveness.

cardPool.title: Viral Cosmos
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Viral Cosmos

Description:
Two distinctive flowers grow from the user's head and generate an endless supply of petals. These petals can be hurled as projectile weapons that inflict harm on impact.

Functions/Applications:
Throw petals as ranged attacks to damage enemies from distance. Adjust petal velocity and volume for different combat situations. Continuous generation allows sustained offensive pressure without ammunition limits.

Limits:
Petals have limited effective range and lose velocity over distance. The flowers can be targeted and damaged by opponents. Petal attacks deal moderate damage. User cannot control petal trajectory mid-flight, only initial launch force.

Additional Notes:
Best suited for ranged harassment and mid-range combat. Vulnerable to fire-type attacks and environmental hazards. Effectiveness decreases in confined spaces where petals cannot disperse properly.

cardPool.title: Voice
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name: Voice

Description: A sonic amplification Quirk that allows the user to project their voice at devastating volumes and frequencies, generating high-pitched sounds capable of reaching extreme decibel levels sufficient to rupture eardrums and incapacitate targets through auditory trauma.

Functions/Applications: Create sonic attacks that disorient and damage enemies; drown out competing sound-based Quirks; project commands across large distances; use directional speakers to shield nearby allies.

Limits: Prolonged use causes vocal strain, limiting sustained combat duration. Ineffective against underground opponents or those in soundproof environments. Requires speaker equipment for directional control; uncontrolled use endangers allies.

Additional Notes: The user typically wears a directional speaker support item around the neck to control sound propagation and protect companions. Most effective in open terrain and against multiple opponents. Valuable for civilian rescue operations beyond combat.

cardPool.title: Voyance
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Voyance

Description:
The user can see through solid objects and barriers within their line of sight. Living organisms remain opaque and cannot be seen through. By peering through a finger-formed aperture, the user narrows their vision field, extending duration and reducing mental strain.

Functions/Applications:
Locate hidden objects, bombs, or contraband behind walls. Scout enemy positions behind cover. Detect structural weaknesses or hidden compartments. Track mechanical devices through barriers.

Limits:
Cannot see through living matter. Continuous use without the finger-aperture technique exhausts the user quickly. Only works on objects within direct line of sight. Cannot penetrate certain dense or specially designed materials.

Additional Notes:
The finger-aperture focusing method is essential for sustained use without rapid stamina drain. Best suited for reconnaissance, detective work, and bomb-detection. Ineffective against hidden enemies or creatures.

cardPool.title: Warp Gate
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Warp Gate

Description:
The user generates dark purple and black mist that forms portals, transporting anything touching the fog to predetermined locations. They can cloak themselves in mist, becoming nearly invisible while channeling teleportation. This artificial Quirk is synthesized from multiple sources with Cloud Quirk as its base.

Functions/Applications:
Create coordinate-based portals for instant transportation across distances. Cloak the user's body to obscure form and location. Open portals from sight-based or memorized coordinates. Transport multiple targets simultaneously. Establish escape routes or ambush points during combat.

Limits:
The user's neck cannot be covered by mist, creating a critical weak point. Portals require precise coordinate knowledge. Cannot locate missing persons without knowing their exact location. Closing a portal while someone is partially inside causes severe bisection. Overuse causes physical exhaustion and deterioration. Coordinate-based nature makes it slower than instinctive warping.

Additional Notes:
Warp Gate is exceptionally useful for large-scale tactical operations. The mist shifts to light blue when the user's original personality influences the Quirk.

cardPool.title: Water Control
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Water Control

Description:
A water-manipulation Quirk granting command over nearby water. The user shapes water into offensive constructs and projectiles with precision, from razor-sharp claws to devastating torrents. Power scales with available water supply.

Functions/Applications:
Form water into bladed weapons for melee combat. Launch pressurized water jets as ranged attacks. Create temporary barriers from solidified water. Redirect or absorb incoming water-based attacks.

Limits:
Requires proximity to a water source; effectiveness diminishes in arid environments. Cannot generate water from nothing. Sustained constructs drain stamina proportionally to size and density. Water defenses are vulnerable to evaporation or freezing.

Additional Notes:
Most effective near bodies of water, rain, or humid conditions. User skill determines attack precision and construct complexity. Environmental water remains useful even against dehydrated opponents.

cardPool.title: Water Gun
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name: Water Gun

Description: The user projects pressurized streams of water from their hands with precision and force. A straightforward offensive and utility Quirk for combat and environmental solutions.

Functions/Applications: Fire suppression and water dispersal; tactical distraction by targeting faces or eyes; crowd control through water spray; assistance with environmental hazards.

Limits: Limited to water already present or internally stored. Pressure and range decrease with sustained use. Ineffective against water-resistant or aquatic opponents. Requires hand positioning and aim; cannot function if hands are restrained.

Additional Notes: Most effective in supporting roles rather than primary offense. Valuable in rescue operations and disaster response. Strength lies in versatility and non-lethal control rather than raw damage.

cardPool.title: Water Pump
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Water Pump

Description:
The user's hands are replaced with functional water hose spigots capable of generating pressurized water on demand. Water can be shaped and controlled with precision into various forms, from barriers to implements.

Functions/Applications:
Create defensive barriers, generate hand-like water constructs for manipulation, deliver pressurized water attacks, and extinguish fires. The user maintains fine control over water flow rate and shape.

Limits:
Requires a water source or internal reserves to function. Prolonged use depletes reserves. The hose-hand design limits fine manipulation tasks. Water constructs disperse if pressure is lost.

Additional Notes:
Best suited for defensive and utility roles. Highly effective in firefighting. User must manage water reserves carefully during extended engagements.

cardPool.title: Weather Manipulation
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Weather Manipulation

Description:
The user controls weather phenomena including storms, lightning, wind, and tornadoes on massive scale. They can envelope islands in storm clouds and summon devastating weather events. The Quirk grants flight via wind manipulation.

Functions/Applications:
Create storm systems and tornadoes for area denial. Summon precise lightning bolts for targeted offense. Generate powerful winds for propulsion and flight. Scale attacks from localized strikes to island-wide devastation.

Limits:
Using the Quirk causes severe cellular degeneration and pain, forcing conservative use. Overuse leads to loss of control and collapse. Lightning can be redirected by electricity-based Quirks. Simultaneous application of multiple powers accelerates deterioration and risks fatal exhaustion.

Additional Notes:
This Quirk isolates users socially and psychologically. The user cannot sustain full-power weather manipulation without external aid like cell regeneration. Rage or desperation triggers uncontrolled massive storms. The burden often warps the user's worldview toward social Darwinism.

cardPool.title: Whirlwind
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Whirlwind

Description:
Inasa commands air itself, generating powerful gusts and tornadoes with minimal physical movement. He can manipulate multiple wind currents simultaneously with precise control, propelling objects, allies, and himself without collisions.

Functions/Applications:
Offensive wind blasts that knock enemies away; defensive deflection of projectiles and evasive maneuverability; support to amplify allies' attacks. Flight achieved through costume-enhanced tornadoes or ground-burst propulsion. Can combine with heat-based Quirks to create flame tornadoes.

Limits:
Weakened if limbs cannot move freely. High temperatures and large fire sources disrupt airflow and destabilize control. Initially incompatible with cold-heat manipulation Quirks.

Additional Notes:
Whirlwind excels in versatility across offense, defense, and support. Effectiveness scales with Inasa's physical freedom and environmental conditions. Synergizes with complementary Quirks when users coordinate tactically.

cardPool.title: Whiteline
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Whiteline

Description:
The user manipulates and controls painted lane lines on roads as if they were flexible tentacles. These white lines can extend, coil, and move with considerable force, allowing the user to ensnare targets or hurl objects with devastating impact.

Functions/Applications:
Entangle and immobilize enemies by wrapping animated lane lines around them. Lift and throw heavy objects like vehicles. Create barriers by manipulating road markings. Requires painted road surfaces to function.

Limits:
The Quirk only works on existing painted lane lines; bare pavement provides no material to manipulate. Raw power level remains unknown as the user was only observed under external enhancement. Effectiveness diminishes in areas lacking road infrastructure.

Additional Notes:
Best suited for urban or highway environments where painted lines exist. The Quirk's true baseline strength is untested. Works as a tactical tool for restraint and object manipulation rather than direct damage.

cardPool.title: Whole-Body Lens
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Whole-Body Lens

Description:
The user's body functions as a living camera system, capable of generating lens-like apertures anywhere on their skin to capture images. Photographs can be printed from the user's chest at will.

Functions/Applications:
Create optical lenses across any body surface for surveillance and reconnaissance. Print physical photographs on demand from stored images. Useful for gathering intelligence and evidence without external equipment.

Limits:
Cannot modify or edit captured images. Printing consumes stamina and requires chest access. Lenses are vulnerable while active. Cannot capture images in complete darkness. Storage has unknown constraints.

Additional Notes:
Best suited for support and intelligence roles. Weakness to damage near the chest or eyes may hinder combat performance.

cardPool.title: Zero Gravity
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name: Zero Gravity

Description: Touching solid objects with fingertip pads removes gravitational effects, rendering targets weightless. Contact must be maintained; releasing cancels the effect. After Awakening, the user can generate anti-gravity bubbles at range and spread effects between connected objects.

Functions/Applications: Float objects and opponents up to three tons; disable enemies by eliminating footing; manipulate environmental wreckage as weapons; transport unconscious allies; increase personal agility by removing self-weight; create diversions with levitating decoys; generate repelling shockwaves through bubble compression.

Limits: Pre-Awakening requires direct hand contact; prolonged use causes nausea and vomiting; loss of hands means total Quirk inability; vulnerable to ranged opponents maintaining distance; Awakened bubbles lack precise control; three-ton limit applies pre-Awakening only.

Additional Notes: Training reduces nausea severity. Awakened form removes weight restrictions and enables remote bubble generation, but control difficulties persist.

cardPool.title: Zombie Virus
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Zombie Virus

Description:
Romero Fujimi releases pinkish gas that temporarily transforms those who inhale it into zombies with enhanced strength and endurance. Infected victims gain bluish-gray skin, sunken eyes, and an urge to bite others to spread the virus. Quirk users lose control of their powers when zombified. The user must wear a mask to avoid self-infection.

Functions/Applications:
Creates temporary undead soldiers through viral gas dispersal. Zombified Quirk users become unpredictable weapons with compromised ability control. Victims retain fragmented personality, sometimes allowing friendships to override infection instinct. Zombie appearances enable infiltration or escape.

Limits:
The user is not immune to their own virus and risks self-infection if bitten. Zombification is temporary but reversal mechanics are unclear. Zombified Quirk users focus only on biting uninfected targets. Victims with retained personality may resist compulsions. The virus spreads only through gas inhalation or infectious bites, not touch alone.

Additional Notes:
Highly contagious but requires proximity for gas dispersal. Zombified individuals maintain some self-awareness, making control unreliable.

cardPool.title: Zoom
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Zoom

Description:
A vision enhancement Quirk that grants extraordinary magnification abilities. The user's eyes develop crosshair-shaped irises and can focus on distant targets with perfect clarity up to 5 kilometers away.

Functions/Applications:
The user can zoom vision on specific points to observe people, objects, and details from extreme distances. Exceptional for reconnaissance, surveying crowds, identifying individuals, or examining distant locations unnoticed. Practical uses include scouting, investigation, and identifying potential contacts from afar.

Limits:
Requires active focus to magnify vision—passive sight remains normal. Distances beyond 5 kilometers become blurry. Cannot zoom while moving quickly without losing focus. Environmental obstructions like fog, darkness, or heavy rain significantly impair effectiveness. Provides no combat advantage in direct confrontation.

Additional Notes:
The crosshair irises are a permanent physical marker. Extended use causes mild eye strain. This Quirk excels for information gathering and observation rather than active combat or defense.

cardPool.title: Villain Factory
cardPool.value:
[Villain Factory]

Type: Criminal Organization

The Villain Factory is an underground organization conducting illegal Quirk-based experiments. They create Instant Villains and Next-Level Villains, posing a major threat to the Naruhata area.

Named by the Police Force for its mass production of artificial villains, the organization is secretly led by All For One and Dr. Kyudai Garaki. Their goal is to create a perfect weapon powerful enough to rival All Might.

Using Quirk manipulation, biological experimentation, and human testing, the Villain Factory operates in secrecy while expanding criminal influence.

cardPool.title: Shie Hassaikai
cardPool.value:
[Shie Hassaikai]

Type: Yakuza Organization

The Shie Hassaikai is a former Yakuza organization that operated within Japan's criminal underworld. Originally led by The Boss, the group followed traditional Yakuza values of loyalty, discipline, and honor. The Boss raised Kai Chisaki, who became known as Overhaul and eventually took control of the organization.

Unlike the older generation, Chisaki sought to restore the Yakuza's lost power through ruthless methods and dangerous experimentation. During the rise of Pro Heroes, the Yakuza lost much authority and influence, forcing the Shie Hassaikai into the shadows under constant surveillance.

Under Overhaul's leadership, the organization became feared for its brutality and ambition to reclaim dominance over the criminal world.

cardPool.title: Paranormal Liberation Front
cardPool.value:
[Paranormal Liberation Front]

Type: Villain Organization

The Paranormal Liberation Front is a massive villain faction formed by merging the League of Villains and the Meta Liberation Army.

Led by Grand Commander Tomura Shigaraki, the organization aims to destroy hero society and establish a world of absolute freedom and power.

The Front is divided into multiple color-coded regiments, each specializing in different warfare aspects and commanded by a Lieutenant. Each Lieutenant is supported by three elite Advisers who oversee operations and expand the organization's influence.

With substantial manpower, resources, and military structure, the Paranormal Liberation Front is one of Japan's most dangerous villain organizations.

cardPool.title: Octo-Lover's Brigade
cardPool.value:
[Octo-Lover's Brigade]

Type: Animal Rights Organization

The Octo-Lover's Brigade is an animal rights group from Osaka campaigning against octopus capture, cooking, and consumption. Members believe octopuses are intelligent creatures deserving protection.

The organization comprises individuals with sea-creature mutations, including fish, mollusk, and cephalopod-like traits.

Members wear dark cloth accessories marked with white spots resembling octopus suckers as identifying symbols.

While many engage in peaceful activism, extremist factions use intimidation, sabotage, and violence to force acceptance of their beliefs.

The Brigade has gained a controversial reputation throughout Japan due to these radical elements.

cardPool.title: Meta Liberation Army
cardPool.value:
[Meta Liberation Army]

Type: Villain Organization

The Meta Liberation Army, or M.L.A., is a large villain organization centered on the belief that unrestricted Quirk use is a fundamental human right. Founded by the infamous Destro to free society from Quirk restrictions, the organization inspired countless followers. Years later, Destro's descendant Re-Destro rebuilt it into a massive, well-organized force with political, financial, and military influence across Japan. Unlike groups driven by pure chaos, the M.L.A. pursues liberation through ideology, propaganda, and overwhelming power. Following conflict with the League of Villains, the Meta Liberation Army merged with them to form the Paranormal Liberation Front under Tomura Shigaraki's leadership.

cardPool.title: League of Villains
cardPool.value:
[League of Villains]

Type: Villain Organization

The League of Villains was a criminal organization of powerful villains united by hatred of hero society. Founded by All For One, it was groomed under Tomura Shigaraki's leadership into one of Japan's greatest threats.

Unlike traditional criminal organizations, the League sought to collapse the entire hero system and society built around it. It attracted dangerous criminals, outcasts, and extremists with powerful Quirks and deep resentment toward heroes.

After the Revival Celebration, the League merged with the Meta Liberation Army to form the Paranormal Liberation Front under Shigaraki's command.

cardPool.title: Gollini Family
cardPool.value:
[Gollini Family]

Type: Mafia Crime Family

The Gollini Family is a powerful European mafia organization led by ruthless Valdo Gollini. The family was established long before the rise of All Might and became one of the most feared criminal syndicates in the region.

The original leader valued honor and loyalty, but was murdered by his own son, Valdo Gollini, who seized control and transformed the family into a brutal, ambitious organization.

Under Valdo's leadership, the Gollini Family expanded its influence across Europe through violence and intimidation, remaining beyond the reach of Heroes and law enforcement. The family became infamous for its wealth, secrecy, and deadly reputation in the criminal underworld.

cardPool.title: Creature Rejection Clan
cardPool.value:
[Creature Rejection Clan (CRC)]

Type: Extremist Religious Organization

The Creature Rejection Clan, commonly known as CRC, is a villainous cult-like organization driven by extreme ideology and religious fervor. Members wear ritualistic skull-shaped masks that conceal identities and reinforce collective doctrine.

The CRC rejects individuals with physical "abnormalities," particularly those possessing Mutant-type Quirks. Despite modern superpowered society, the group upholds deep-rooted prejudice and exclusionary beliefs.

Originally a protest movement, the organization became increasingly radical, escalating from public demonstrations to violence and targeted attacks. This extremist shift damaged their reputation and public support significantly.

As a result, the CRC lost influence and membership, fragmenting into smaller scattered cells operating independently in secrecy.

cardPool.title: Abegawa Tenchu Kai
cardPool.value:
[Abegawa Tenchu Kai]

Type: Former Yakuza Organization

The Abegawa Tenchu Kai was a Yakuza syndicate operating in the criminal underworld before law enforcement classified it as a villain organization. This designation brought heavy scrutiny, weakening the group's structure. The vigilante Stendhal then assaulted the headquarters, killing all high-ranking executives in combat. With its leadership destroyed and operations disrupted, the organization collapsed shortly after.

cardPool.title: World Heroes Association
cardPool.value:
[World Heroes Association]

Type: International Hero Governing Body

The World Heroes Association is a global organization responsible for overseeing and coordinating Hero activity across multiple nations. It comprises representatives from various countries working together to regulate Hero operations internationally.

The organization organizes cross-border missions, facilitates cooperation between Hero agencies, and responds to large-scale threats requiring global coordination. During crises, the Association can deploy Pro Heroes to assist nations in need.

Due to uneven Hero distribution worldwide, some regions experience higher crime rates. Addressing this imbalance remains an ongoing challenge for the Association.

cardPool.title: Police Force
cardPool.value:
[Police Force]

Type: Law Enforcement Organization

The Police Force is the official law-enforcing body responsible for maintaining public order and handling criminal activity. Their primary role is to arrest, detain, and process Villains subdued by Pro Heroes.

In the early days of Quirks, the Police Force avoided recruiting officers with Quirks due to concerns about misuse. This gap led to the rise of Pro Heroes, who took on the role of licensed Quirk users fighting crime under strict regulations.

Today, the Police Force coordinates with Heroes but focuses on non-Quirk-related crimes and lower-level offenses. Heroes must transfer ordinary criminals to police custody, as such cases fall outside Hero jurisdiction.

The Police Force handles interrogation, investigation, and incarceration of suspects and captured Villains, ensuring due process within the legal system.

cardPool.title: Hero Public Safety Commission
cardPool.value:
[Hero Public Safety Commission]

Type: Government Law Enforcement Agency

The Hero Public Safety Commission is a national authority regulating Heroes and overseeing their role in society. It manages Pro Hero relations with the public, ensuring lawful and effective Hero activity.

Led by non-Hero officials, the Commission maintains balance and prevents excessive Hero influence over civilian governance. It investigates high-level crimes and complex cases involving serious threats.

The Commission administers the Provisional Hero License Exam twice yearly in June and September. Successful candidates receive official Hero licenses to legally perform Hero duties.

It coordinates closely with the Police Force on operations, team assignments, and emergency responses requiring law enforcement and Hero cooperation.

cardPool.title: FeatherHATS
cardPool.value:
[FeatherHATS]

Type: Music Band

FeatherHATS is a music group formed by Makoto Tsukauchi and sponsored by the Marukane Department Store. The band showcases young musical talents from Naruhata.

Supported by corporate sponsorship, FeatherHATS performs at organized events and promotional stages to introduce emerging artists to wider audiences.

The group is known for its collaborative structure, blending different musical styles while maintaining a cohesive, youthful performance identity.

cardPool.title: Heroes
cardPool.value:
[Heroes / Pro Heroes]

Type: Licensed Quirk Users / Public Protectors

Heroes are individuals legally authorized to use their Quirks to protect civilians from Villains and danger. Those pursuing heroism professionally are known as Pro Heroes.

In Japan, Heroes are regulated by the Hero Public Safety Commission. International coordination is handled by the World Heroes Association. Most Heroes operate through Hero Agencies, which organize missions, training, and public safety operations.

Hero work centers on three core responsibilities: rescue, evacuation, and combat. Hero Agencies may specialize in one area or handle all three roles.

Heroes are widely respected and operate with public visibility, with civilians witnessing their battles against Villains.

cardPool.title: Villains
cardPool.value:
[Villains]

Type: Criminal Individuals / Organizations

Villains are individuals who use their Quirks to commit crimes, cause destruction, and endanger innocent lives. They exist in many forms, including thieves, murderers, extremist groups, and terrorist organizations.

According to Naomasa Tsukauchi, crime rates remain relatively low due to Pro Heroes. However, Villains persist as a threat across society.

Motivations for becoming a Villain vary widely, including economic hardship, political ideology, social rejection, or personal tragedy. Quirks enable more complex and dangerous forms of crime.

Some individuals become Villains after experiencing trauma, leading them to reject societal norms. While some operate alone, others form organized groups with clear hierarchies.

All Villains share one common trait: the use of illegal Quirk activity that places society at risk.

cardPool.title: Vigilantes
cardPool.value:
[Vigilantes]

Type: Unauthorized Quirk Users / Civilian Protectors

Vigilantes are individuals who carry out Hero-like activities without legal authorization, operating independently of Hero agencies. Due to strict Hero licensing laws, their actions are illegal.

Though unlawful, Vigilantes exist in a legal and moral gray area. When Pro Heroes are unavailable, their intervention can save lives. Some cooperate with Heroes during emergencies.

This dual nature creates debate within law enforcement on how to treat Vigilantes—as criminals or unofficial assets in crises.

Vigilantes remain controversial, balancing public necessity against legal violation.

cardPool.title: Sidekicks
cardPool.value:
[Sidekicks]

Type: Hero Agency Support Staff

Sidekicks are licensed Hero assistants who work under the supervision of a Pro Hero at a Hero Agency. Typically less experienced than the agency's lead Hero, Sidekicks provide operational support during missions and emergencies.

While the Pro Hero serves as the primary field operative, Sidekicks act as backup, assisting with coordination, logistics, and on-site response.

The size and structure of Sidekick teams vary widely. Some agencies employ only a few Sidekicks, while others maintain large teams. Certain Pro Heroes may operate without any Sidekicks at all.

Hiring decisions are made at the agency head's discretion, based on experience, skills, or Quirk utility. In some cases, unlicensed Vigilantes may be recruited as Sidekicks, providing a legal pathway into Hero society.

cardPool.title: Todoroki Family
cardPool.value:
[Todoroki Family]

Type: Family

The Todoroki Family is a prominent Hero family consisting of Enji Todoroki (Endeavor), his wife Rei Todoroki, and their four children: Toya, Fuyumi, Natsuo, and Shoto Todoroki.

Enji is a top-ranked Pro Hero known for his exceptional combat ability and leadership. Rei is the family's mother. Their children each have distinct paths shaped by the family's complex history and connection to Hero society.

cardPool.title: Shimura Family
cardPool.value:
[Shimura Family]

Type: Family

The Shimura Family was the birth family of Tomura Shigaraki before he became a Villain. They were an ordinary household whose history became tied to the origins of one of society's most dangerous criminals. The family is notably connected to Nana Shimura, a former Pro Hero whose lineage indirectly influenced later events involving Tomura Shigaraki. Very little is known about them.

cardPool.title: Ida Family
cardPool.value:
[Ida Family]

Type: Hero Family Lineage

The Ida Family is a prestigious hero family with generations of Pro Heroes building a reputation rooted in discipline, responsibility, and service to society.

Most members possess the Engine Quirk, characterized by engine-like exhaust pipes that grant enhanced speed and mobility. This trait is particularly associated with Tenya Ida.

Tenya's grandfather developed a unique training method to enhance the Engine Quirk's performance. The process involves removing the exhaust organs through intense means, followed by rigorous training. Stronger engine components regrow over time, resulting in improved speed and endurance.

Through this tradition, the Ida Family has maintained and refined their Quirk abilities, passing down both their hero legacy and specialized training methods.

cardPool.title: Wild, Wild Pussycats
cardPool.value:
========================================
STORYCARD — WILD WILD PUSSYCATS
========================================

[OVERVIEW]
The Wild, Wild Pussycats are a professional Hero team specializing in rescue operations, wilderness survival training, and disaster response. They excel in coordination, mobility, and field-based Hero work.

Members:
- Shino Sosaki (Mandalay) - strategic leader and communicator
- Ryuko Tsuchikawa (Pixie-Bob) - terrain manipulation through earth-based Quirk
- Tomoko (Ragdoll) - enhanced sensory tracking and Quirk analysis
- Tiger - close-combat powerhouse and physical trainer

----------------------------------------

[ROLE IN HERO SOCIETY]
The Wild, Wild Pussycats prioritize survival training, evacuation strategy, and environmental adaptability rather than urban combat. They assist in U.A. student development programs, preparing students for real-world disaster scenarios.

Ragdoll's Quirk enables simultaneous monitoring of multiple individuals, making the team highly effective in locating missing persons and coordinating rescue operations across large territories.

cardPool.title: Kota Izumi
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Kota Izumi

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Water Control

Occupation/Role: UA High School Hero Course Student, Class 1-A

Personality: Initially withdrawn and cynical after his parents' deaths, Kota was cold toward heroes. After Izuku Midoriya rescued him, he slowly opened to others, though remains somewhat indifferent and prideful. He is principled and refuses indecency, punishing rule-breakers without hesitation.

Appearance: A short boy with spiky black hair, roughly Mineta's height. He wears a short-sleeved collared shirt with dark shorts and a red cap with golden spike-shaped horns. His hero costume features a dark green vest with gray helmet matching his parents' design, complete with large spike horns. He wears red high-top sneakers.

Backstory: Kota is the son of pro hero team Water Hose, both deceased. Raised by his aunt Shino Sosaki of the Wild Wild Pussycats, he initially despised heroes, believing they abandoned him. Being rescued from villain Muscular by Izuku proved transformative, allowing Kota to understand his parents' noble sacrifice and that heroes prioritize others' lives.

Additional Information: Kota enrolled at UA High School to follow his parents' and Izuku's example.

cardPool.title: Arc 1
cardPool.value:
ARC 1 — U.A. ENTRANCE EXAM

Izuku Midoriya arrives at U.A. for the Hero Course entrance exam. Candidates enter a simulated city with combat robots, earning points for destruction and rescue actions.

Izuku struggles to control One For All safely. When Uraraka becomes trapped under debris, he destroys a zero-point robot to save her instead of pursuing points, earning rescue points.

Izuku is accepted despite a low combat score due to his rescue performance. Bakugo is accepted as a top scorer. Class 1-A is formed.

cardPool.title: Arc 2
cardPool.value:
========================================
ARC 2 — QUIRK APPREHENSION TEST
========================================

Class 1-A undergoes Aizawa's Quirk Apprehension Test on their first day, including sprinting, grip strength, ball throw, endurance, and agility measurements using Quirks.

Aizawa warns the lowest performer may be expelled, creating immediate pressure.

Izuku breaks his fingers controlling One For All during the ball throw. Uraraka uses zero-gravity to send the ball out of range. Bakugo dominates through explosive mobility.

Students are ranked by Quirk efficiency and physical output. Aizawa later reveals the expulsion threat was a bluff to measure potential under pressure.

cardPool.title: Arc 3
cardPool.value:
========================================
ARC 3 — U.S.J. INCIDENT
========================================

Class 1-A arrives at U.S.J. for rescue training. Kurogiri warps the League of Villains into the facility, scattering students across disaster zones.

Shigaraki targets Aizawa and Izuku. Villains coordinate attacks across multiple groups.

A Nomu is deployed to kill All Might. All Might arrives and defeats it in extended combat.

The villains retreat through Kurogiri's warp gate. The attack confirms organized villain coordination targeting Hero society.

cardPool.title: Arc 4
cardPool.value:
========================================
ARC 4 — U.A. SPORTS FESTIVAL
========================================

U.A. hosts a national sports festival broadcast across Japan. Students compete in obstacle races, cavalry battles, and elimination tournaments.

Izuku modifies One For All usage to avoid injury. Todoroki refuses to use his fire Quirk due to family conflict. Bakugo advances through brute force.

During finals, Todoroki uses fire against Izuku after confronting his past. Bakugo defeats Todoroki in the final match.

Bakugo wins overall. Hero agencies recruit students for internships based on performance.

cardPool.title: Arc 5
cardPool.value:
========================================
ARC 5 — HERO INTERNSHIPS & STAIN INCIDENT
========================================

Students begin internships at Hero agencies. Izuku trains under Gran Torino on advanced movement control. Iida joins Ingenium's agency.

In Hosu City, Stain attacks Pro Heroes, targeting those he deems unworthy. His Quirk allows paralysis through blood ingestion.

Nomu activity occurs in the city. Iida confronts Stain alone and is paralyzed. Izuku and Todoroki intervene during overlapping combat.

Endeavor defeats a Nomu while Stain is subdued after combined efforts. Stain is arrested, but his ideology spreads among Villain groups, causing instability in Hero perception.

cardPool.title: Arc 6
cardPool.value:
========================================
ARC 6 — FOREST TRAINING CAMP ARC
========================================

Class 1-A trains in wilderness survival and Quirk control at a remote camp. The League of Villains Vanguard Action Squad attacks the facility, splitting students across forest terrain into survival situations. Bakugo is captured during the chaos. Multiple students are injured during escape and regrouping before villains withdraw after achieving their capture objective.

cardPool.title: Arc 7
cardPool.value:
========================================
ARC 7 — KAMINO INCIDENT
========================================

League of Villains holds Bakugo in a hidden Kamino Ward location.

Hero intelligence locates the hideout and launches a rescue operation with multiple Pro Heroes.

All Might confronts All For One during the raid.

A large-scale battle unfolds across Kamino Ward.

All Might defeats All For One in his weakened state using his remaining power.

Bakugo is rescued and All For One is critically injured.

All Might's final form is publicly revealed, ending his era as Symbol of Peace.

cardPool.title: Arc 8
cardPool.value:
========================================
ARC 8 — PROVISIONAL HERO LICENSE EXAM
========================================

Students take the national Hero License Exam.

Candidates complete large-scale rescue simulations competing against other schools.

Successful students gain legal authorization for supervised Hero work.

cardPool.title: Arc 9
cardPool.value:
========================================
ARC 9 — SHIE HASSAIKAI RAID ARC
========================================

Hero teams investigate Shie Hassaikai operations. Eri is identified as the source of Quirk-erasing bullets. A coordinated raid begins underground. Mirio fights Overhaul alone and is hit by a Quirk-erasing bullet, losing his Quirk permanently. Izuku reaches Eri and engages Overhaul. Overhaul is defeated. Eri is rescued and placed under Hero protection.

cardPool.title: Arc 11
cardPool.value:
========================================
ARC 11 — META LIBERATION ARMY ARC
========================================

League of Villains enters Deika City and clashes with Meta Liberation Army forces.

Twice is killed in early combat.

Shigaraki battles Re-Destro across the collapsing city as his Quirk fully awakens, destroying large areas.

Re-Destro is defeated and MLA submits to Shigaraki.

Paranormal Liberation Front is formed.

cardPool.title: Arc 13
cardPool.value:
========================================
ARC 13 — PARANORMAL LIBERATION WAR
========================================

Heroes attack Jaku Hospital and Gunga Mountain.

High-End Nomu engage Hero teams.

Shigaraki awakens mid-operation and unleashes massive destruction.

Dabi reveals identity as Toya Todoroki.

Twice is killed, collapsing Villain coordination.

Gigantomachia advances across Japan.

Shigaraki expands decay across battlefield zones.

Heroes begin nationwide evacuation and containment operations.

cardPool.title: Arc 14
cardPool.value:
========================================
ARC 14 — DARK HERO ARC
========================================

Izuku Midoriya leaves U.A. and operates independently across Japan as a solo Hero, tracking Villain activity and protecting civilians without agency support.

He encounters multiple escaped prisoners in isolated urban battles while transporting civilians to safety zones.

Izuku is ambushed by Kaina Tsutsumi (Lady Nagant), a former Hero Public Safety Commission assassin deployed to capture him alive.

Nagant engages Izuku using long-range precision rifle Quirks, forcing him to adapt One For All usage with Blackwhip, Fa Jin, and Danger Sense in combination.

Nagant reveals the Hero Commission's internal corruption and her past role executing covert eliminations of targets labeled threats to Hero society.

Izuku refuses to kill her and attempts to break her resolve while avoiding lethal retaliation.

During extended combat, Izuku closes distance despite sniper suppression and defeats Nagant without killing her.

After defeat, Nagant suffers Quirk overload collapse and is captured alive. She later provides intelligence on Hero Commission operations and deeper control structures influencing Hero society.

cardPool.title: Arc 15
cardPool.value:
========================================
ARC 15 — FINAL WAR ARC
========================================

Heroes launch coordinated final war against All For One and Shigaraki.

Bakugo engages Shigaraki.

Todoroki confronts Dabi.

Ochaco engages Toga.

All Might confronts All For One using armored support.

Izuku fights Shigaraki as One For All vestiges appear.

All For One is separated from Shigaraki.

Shigaraki collapses after final exchange.

Major battles conclude across all fronts.

Heroes win - but at great cost.

An adult operative with extensive combat and marksmanship training.

Personality: Tough, blunt, and fearless with an independent streak. Rumi respects those who speak their mind and disdains team-based heroism, preferring to rely on her own strength. Despite her brash demeanor, she will assist others when needed.

Her Quirk grants her long white rabbit ears and a small tail. She wears a sleeveless white leotard with dark purple trim, a yellow crescent moon design across her chest, purple thigh-high boots, thick white gloves, and a metal plate around her midriff.

Appearance: Woman with sharp blue eyes and long blonde hair swept back except for bangs. Wears a light blue Pussycats hero costume with pink-padded paw gloves and two blue dots on her cheeks during missions. A tinted visor aids her Quirk use.

Her confidence in her abilities matches her eccentric personality, though genuine care for the next generation of heroes lies beneath her wackiness.
Additional Information: Demonstrates combat prowess by overwhelming Class 1-A students with her Quirk during the Quirk Apprehension Test arc. Her Earth Flow is recognized as dangerous enough to threaten formidable villains, making her a valuable asset to hero society.

Ridiculously long eyelashes, dark makeup, and dark lipstick. Typically wears ornate kimono-inspired dresses with intricate patterns, beaded necklaces, decorative hairpins, and elaborate crowns.

During the Paranormal Liberation War's aftermath, the family evacuated to a safety center while Tsuyu joined the Heroes in the Final War.

Quirk Name: Permeation

Occupation/Role: Class 3-B Student at UA High School, Member of The Big 3

Personality: Highly goofy and energetic with infectious optimism and constant smile. Known for corny humor and making a fool of himself for others' amusement. Despite his laid-back nature, he is extremely dedicated and hard-working with serious determination to master his Quirk and become a symbol of peace.

Appearance: Tall with muscular build. Distinctive beady blue eyes with no visible sclera, rounded nose, and blond quiff. Wears UA uniform with golden carnivorous mouth-shaped buckle belt. Hero costume features white skin-tight top with "1000000" across chest in yellow, green belt lines, baggy dark blue pants with white backing, white knee-high boots with yellow soles, red cape, and thick red gloves.

Backstory: A top-tier UA student and Big 3 member, Mirio has spent considerable time mastering his nearly unmasterable Permeation Quirk through relentless training. He cut his former ponytail to allow the support department to craft a specialized hero costume compatible with his abilities, demonstrating his commitment to heroism.

cardPool.title: Mirai Sasaki
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Mirai Sasaki

Alias: Sir Nighteye

Quirk Name: Foresight

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero

Personality: Stoic and intimidating with sharp, cold demeanor, yet values humor deeply and requires those around him to laugh. Pragmatic, protective of subordinates, and unafraid to admit mistakes. Fiercely devoted to All Might's ideals, though willing to disagree when he believes the greater good is at stake.

Appearance: Tall and lean with sharp, angular features and stern yellow eyes behind triangular glasses. Dark green hair slicked back with three yellow streaks, parted to his left. He dresses in a plain white suit with gold buttons, white dress shirt, and red tie with white dots—practical office wear that belies his combat capability.

Backstory: A former sidekick to All Might who served as the brains behind the Symbol of Peace. He became a respected Pro Hero and mentor figure, though his falling out with All Might over the successor choice shapes his current path. His prescient abilities burden him greatly.

Additional Information: Not a UA student; an established Pro Hero and mentor to sidekicks. Deeply knowledgeable about All Might's heroic history. Fears the consequences of using his Foresight, particularly regarding death premonitions.

cardPool.title: Minoru Mineta
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Minoru Mineta

Alias: Grape Juice

Quirk Name: Pop Off

Occupation/Role: UA High School Student, Class 1-A

Personality: Timid yet perverted, making him unpopular. Easily jealous and envious of classmates, he speaks with cynical harshness. Despite his crude exterior, he shows genuine kindness and concern when others are in danger. His primary motivation for heroism is gaining popularity and attention from girls.

Appearance: A short teenage boy with an unusually large, round head and puffy cheeks. His dark purple hair forms four ball-shaped clumps like a mohawk. Small upturned nose, oval eyes with large black pupils, and thin eyebrows. He wears the standard male UA uniform modified for his short stature: light gray blazer with dark turquoise trim, white dress shirt, dark blue-green pants, red tie, and brown shoes.

Backstory: A first-year student at UA High School determined to become a Pro Hero, driven by desires for popularity and female attention as much as genuine heroic aspirations. He trains with his Class 1-A peers despite feeling his Quirk is underwhelming.

Additional Information: Often attempts to act charming but comes across as obnoxious. Can be hypocritical and enjoys teasing, yet demonstrates capacity for genuine apology when confronted with mistakes.

cardPool.title: Mina Ashido
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Mina Ashido

Alias:
Ridley Hero: Pinky

Quirk Name:
Acid

Occupation/Role:
UA High School Student, Class 1-A

Personality:
Cheerful, easygoing, and perpetually smiling. Highly social and excitable, thriving in group settings with infectious enthusiasm that lifts those around her.

Appearance:
A girl of medium height with athletic build. Light pink skin contrasts with short, fluffy darker pink hair. Distinctive square-shaped eyes with black sclera and yellow irises. Two pale yellow horns protrude diagonally from her head. Wears UA's standard female uniform: gray jacket with teal stripes, white shirt, red tie, and teal pleated skirt with knee-high socks.

Backstory:
A first-year student at UA High School training to become a Pro Hero. She joined Class 1-A to develop her Quirk and combat abilities, with her background at Mustafa Private Middle School shaping her confident personality.

Additional Information:
Hero costume "Prism Sky" features a white mask, purple and turquoise skintight bodysuit with camouflage pattern, and beige waistcoat with white fur collar. Custom acid-proof boots with ventilation allow her to secrete acid from her feet for mobility. Her Quirk grants control over acidic secretions from her body.

cardPool.title: Mezo Shoji
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Mezo Shoji

Alias: Tentacle Hero: Tentacole

Quirk Name: Dupli-Arms

Occupation/Role: UA High School Student, Class 1-A

Personality: Friendly, gentle, and selfless. Empathetic and mature, he remains protective of his classmates while avoiding emotional impulses. Thick-skinned and unbothered by prejudice, he harbors no grudges and willingly risks himself for others.

Appearance: A tall, muscular young man with pale gray hair swept forward over his eye. He has six arms connected by webbing—the front two have hands while the others end in thin stumps. His elongated face has eyes set toward the sides, concealed by a light blue mask covering from below his eyes to his neck, which he wears constantly. He wears the standard UA male uniform with a sleeveless blazer and brown shoes.

Backstory: From a hometown plagued by prejudice against heteromorphs, Mezo adopted his signature mask after his appearance upset a young girl. Despite societal discrimination rooted in his altered physique, he remained determined to become a Pro Hero. Now training at UA High School, he channels his experiences into protecting others and proving his character transcends his appearance.

Additional Information: Mezo is a UA Class 1-A student.

cardPool.title: Melissa Shield
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Melissa Shield
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Quirkless
Occupation/Role: Third-year student at I-Island Academy
Personality: Kindhearted and intelligent with unwavering determination to become a hero despite lacking a Quirk. Outgoing, generous, and naturally curious. She remains calm under pressure and believes indirect support through invention is a valid path to fighting for peace.
Appearance: A pale-skinned young woman of slightly above average height with a round face. She has wavy blonde hair reaching midway down her back with side-swept bangs, aqua-blue eyes, and wears pink oval-framed glasses. Typically dressed in the I-Island Academy uniform: white short-sleeved dress shirt with plaid cuffs, large matching bow at neck, dark raspberry waistcoat, pale gray Capri pants, plaid pink socks, and heeled brown boots.
Backstory: The brilliant daughter of Professor David Shield, a renowned inventor and hero support scientist. Melissa inherited her father's genius and dedication to advancing heroics through technology. She displayed heroic courage by assisting UA students against villains at the I-Expo despite her Quirkless status.
Additional Information: Inventor of support equipment including the Full Gauntlet, designed to reduce strain on Quirk users.

cardPool.title: Mei Hatsume
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Mei Hatsume
Alias: The Support Department's Genius
Quirk Name: Zoom
Occupation/Role: UA High School Support Department student, Class 1-H
Personality: Smart, assertive, and shameless; obsessed with her inventions. Direct and opportunistic, often invading others' personal space. Shows no fear of failure and views setbacks as learning opportunities. Self-centered but driven to improve her craft. Somewhat absent-minded and poor at reading social cues.
Appearance: Reasonably short with mature build. Salmon pink shoulder-length dreadlocks swept right. Wide, upward-sloped green-yellow eyes with distinctive cross-shaped irises and long upper lashes. Wears modified UA gym uniform with red and gold steampunk goggles, utility belt, oversized speed boots, and jet pack. Frequently adorned with self-made gadgets.
Backstory: Naturally gifted inventor with exceptional talent for functional equipment. Recognized by experienced faculty like Power Loader. Believes support items are vital to heroics and that inventors play a crucial role in the hero industry.
Additional Information: Expert at rapid prototyping, creating new inventions in seconds. Proved surprisingly combat-capable against Tenya Iida during the Quirk Apprehension Test, lasting ten minutes before forfeiting.

cardPool.title: Mawata Fuwa
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Mawata Fuwa

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Unknowable

Occupation/Role: UA High School Class 2-A Student, Pro Hero in Training

Personality: Cheerful and carefree yet capable of serious responsibility when needed. Respects tough teaching methods and understands their value. Shows fondness for difficult experiences that foster growth.

Appearance: Girl with layered light pink shoulder-length hair, straight bangs parted left. Round gray eyes with long eyelashes, dark eye makeup, and star or cloud-shaped pupils. Wears standard female UA uniform with distinctive puffy cotton ball earrings. Hero costume consists of a fluffy white sleeveless jacket with black arm bracers and enlarged cotton ball earrings.

Backstory: A first-year student under Eraser Head's instruction, Mawata initially feared his harsh training methods. She was expelled with her entire class during a lesson, then immediately re-enrolled to experience "a death" and grow as heroes. This formative experience shaped her understanding of heroic purpose and strengthened her class bonds.

Additional Information: Participated in the Final War against All For One at Mt. Fuji. Chosen as class point of contact for post-war restoration efforts, demonstrating leadership despite her casual personality.

cardPool.title: Mashirao Ojiro
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Mashirao Ojiro

Alias:
Tailman

Quirk Name:
Tail

Occupation/Role:
UA High School Student, Class 1-A

Personality:
Calm and noble with strong dignity, Mashirao is a hard worker who avoids the spotlight due to his sheepish nature. Despite his humble demeanor, he is reliable and focused during hero work. Sensitive about being perceived as "plain," he maintains composure in combat.

Appearance:
A muscular young man with short blond hair and thin eyes. His most distinctive feature is a hairless, prehensile tail tinted like his hair with a tufted tip. At UA, he wears the standard male uniform with pale gray sneakers. His hero costume consists of a karate gi with a black belt, blue accessories, fur-lined collar, and black boots.

Backstory:
Mashirao trained at UA High School in Class 1-A to become a Pro Hero. His martial arts knowledge combined with his tail physiology earned him 7th place in the Quirk Apprehension Test, demonstrating his combat capabilities early in his hero journey.

Additional Information:
Mashirao uses his tail for offensive attacks and mobility, launching himself airborne by striking the ground. However, he fights somewhat predictably due to his tail's natural movement patterns. He works to eliminate this weakness through improved fundamentals.

cardPool.title: Masaki Mizushima
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Masaki Mizushima

Alias: Normal Hero: Manual

Quirk Name: Water Control

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero (No. 222), based in Hosu City

Personality: Kind and inspiring with an ordinary demeanor. Possesses keen observational skills to discern others' motivations with ease.

Appearance: A man with messy brown hair and black eyes. He wears a blue and white long-sleeved shirt, orange gloves, dark pants, and white boots. His signature helmet features a fish-like fin and blue visor.

Backstory: Masaki rose to become the No. 222 Pro Hero in Hosu City. He mentored young hero hopefuls and became known for his reliable, straightforward approach to heroism.

Additional Information: His Quirk allows him to manipulate pre-existing water but has a weakness to air pressure, which disrupts his control. He selects interns based on recognizing similar qualities in them.

cardPool.title: Manga Fukidashi
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Manga Fukidashi

Alias: Comicman

Quirk Name: Comic

Occupation/Role: UA High School Class 1-B Student, Hero-in-Training

Personality: Expressive and enthusiastic with a soft spot for children. Strategic team player who excels at supporting allies in combat.

Appearance: A short young man with fair skin and a distinctive blank speech bubble head that changes shape to display his thoughts. He wears a blue shirt with red sleeves, ink bottle-patterned armor, a yellow manga panel belt, short gloves, and a manga page template mask.

Backstory: A UA High School student training to become a Pro Hero in Class 1-B. Despite his unusual appearance, he demonstrates compassion and tactical intelligence, making him a valued team member.

Additional Information: Comic allows him to materialize onomatopoeia in midair, creating real effects that match the sounds he speaks for offense, defense, and support. Overuse causes severe throat soreness. His quirk application and teamwork impressed Pro Hero Wash during the Joint Training Battle.

cardPool.title: Makoto Tsukauchi
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Makoto Tsukauchi

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Polygraph

Occupation/Role: General Manager of Captain Celebrity Corporation

Personality: Intelligent, independent, and determined with a pleasant demeanor that masks subtle manipulation. Skilled at organizing groups and getting cooperation, she possesses a rebellious streak and isn't afraid to bend rules. Charming and social, she talks her way through difficult situations.

Appearance: An attractive young woman of slim build and above-average height. Jet black hair extends to mid-lower back, parted right. Dark eyes concealed behind bright green contacts. Small mole on lower left corner of mouth. Dresses fashionably in corporate style and wears gold hoop earrings.

Backstory: Younger sister of Detective Naomasa Tsukauchi. Leveraged her intelligence and social skills to become General Manager at Captain Celebrity Corporation, effectively running PR. Her talent for manipulation mirrors her brother's detective work but applied corporately. Her rebellious nature has created lifelong tension with her rule-abiding sibling.

Additional Information: Makoto's Quirk detects lies through physiological monitoring when touching someone, though it fails if the subject is relaxed or genuinely believes their statement.

cardPool.title: Madam President
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Madam President
Quirk Name: Unknown
Occupation/Role: Head of the Hero Public Safety Commission
Personality: Calm and steely, reassuring in public but pragmatic and willing to make morally questionable decisions for societal benefit. Balances ruthlessness with mercy, disagreeing with her predecessor's extreme methods while still orchestrating manipulation and coercion.
Appearance: Middle-aged woman with turquoise eyes and ash-blonde hair slicked back. She wears a black suit jacket with purple shirt and necklace, projecting professional authority and control.
Backstory: Former Vice President under a brutal predecessor, she witnessed the commission's use of Lady Nagant as an assassin. After Nagant killed the previous president out of disillusionment, she assumed leadership and imprisoned rather than executed her. She recruited young Keigo Takami after discovering his heroic Quirk, grooming him to replace Nagant as their operative hero.
Additional Information: Operates through institutional power rather than personal Quirk strength. Her influence shapes Japan's hero society through policy and strategic placement of operatives.

cardPool.title: Kyudai Garaki
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Kyudai Garaki

Alias: Daruma Ujiko, Dr. Tsubasa, Doctor

Quirk Name: Life Force

Occupation/Role: Villain affiliated with the League of Villains; Chairman of Jaku General Hospital

Personality: Eccentric scientist devoted to All For One's will. Prideful of his Nomu creations, treating them as masterpieces. Overly cautious and secretive, communicating through electronics. Despite unethical practices, he shows genuine loyalty to those he deems worthy. Cowardly when threatened, prone to panic, yet capable of extreme joy over successful plans. Believes hatred strengthens individuals.

Appearance: Portly, short elderly man with bald head and large bushy mustache. Wears gear-shaped goggles and white labcoat as a villain. As hospital chairman, he wears black-framed glasses, shirt and tie beneath a regular labcoat. His Quirk makes him appear younger; without it, his skin is pale and wrinkled with sunken eyes.

Backstory: A disgraced scientist rejected by former colleagues, Kyudai found patronage in All For One, who believed in his unethical research. He became the faithful servant of All For One and later Tomura Shigaraki, dedicating himself to creating powerful Nomu.

Additional Information: Maintains a public persona as a benevolent medical researcher.

cardPool.title: Kyotoku Jiro
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Kyotoku Jiro

Alias:
None

Quirk Name:
Earphone Jack

Occupation/Role:
Music Composer, Father

Personality:
Emotional and easygoing despite his stern exterior. Supportive of his daughter's heroic ambitions. Playful and theatrical, known for his "concerned parent act."

Appearance:
Man with wavy, shoulder-length light-gold hair and triangular eyes. Casual demeanor with a warm presence.

Backstory:
Talented music composer who married Mika after falling in love with her musical abilities. He and his wife nurtured their daughter Kyoka's musical interests but embraced her dream of becoming a hero at UA High School.

Additional Information:
Kyotoku possesses deep knowledge of music theory and shares his daughter's love of rock music. A supportive parent figure who appears during UA family interactions.

cardPool.title: Kyoka Jiro
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Kyoka Jiro

Alias: Hearing Hero: Earphone Jack

Quirk Name: Earphone Jack

Occupation/Role: UA High School Student, Class 1-A

Personality: Pragmatic and blunt with a teasing nature. Despite appearing cold, she is genuinely friendly with close classmates and surprisingly sensitive beneath her sarcasm. Prefers intelligent approaches during hero activities and uses physical punishment via her Quirk to keep troublemakers in line.

Appearance: Petite girl with slender build, black triangular eyes with long lower eyelashes, and dark-purple chin-length asymmetrical hair with sound-wave reflections. Her distinctive features are flexible, plug-like earphone jacks hanging from her earlobes that function as controllable limbs. At UA she wears the standard female uniform: gray jacket with teal stripes and golden buttons over white shirt, red tie, and teal pleated skirt with brown shoes and knee-high socks.

Backstory: Training to become a hero at UA High School with Class 1-A. Her pragmatic worldview stems from her background, though early life details remain understated.

Additional Information: Often gesticulates through her earlobes instead of using her hands. Best socializes with female classmates like Momo Yaoyorozu.

cardPool.title: Kurogiri
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Oboro Shirakumo
Alias: Kurogiri
Quirk Name: Warp Gate
Occupation/Role: High-End Nomu and League of Villains member
Personality: Level-headed and polite, grounding Tomura's immaturity. Fiercely loyal to his masters yet retains fragments of Oboro's caring nature, worrying about those he protected.
Appearance: Humanoid figure of dark purple mist with glowing yellow eyes. Wears a dark suit, matching tie, and metal brace from collarbone to below his eyes. His mist-form occasionally reveals human features.
Backstory: Originally U.A. High School student Oboro Shirakumo before Doctor Kyudai Garaki transformed him into a High-End Nomu. Created to serve Tomura Shigaraki under All For One's command, he was imprisoned in Tartarus.
Additional Information: Programmed to obey select individuals and resist interrogation. A fragment of Oboro's personality persists, creating conflict between his Nomu programming and former human identity.

cardPool.title: Kugo Sakamata
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Kugo Sakamata

Alias:
Aqua Hero: Gang Orca

Quirk Name:
Orcinus

Occupation/Role:
Pro Hero (No. 21), Director of Okuto Island Aquarium, Provisional License Exam Proctor

Personality:
A calm, serious hero with a menacing exterior who genuinely cares about aspiring heroes. Despite harsh teaching methods, he secretly enjoys mentoring students. Friendly with peers and unafraid to call out mistakes.

Appearance:
A tall, powerfully built man with killer whale features—deep white eyes with concentric red pupils and dark skin. He wears a white high-collared hero suit with diamond tooth patterns, a pink tie styled like a tongue, and a whale-like cape.

Backstory:
A highly ranked Pro Hero serving as No. 21. He directs Okuto Island Aquarium while patrolling and teaching. He runs remedial courses for failed licensing exam candidates despite his strict methods.

Additional Information:
Kugo's Orcinus Quirk grants enhanced physical parameters and the ability to generate paralyzing hypersonic waves for offense and defense. He's equally effective in aquatic and land-based combat. His marine biology expertise and combat prowess make him a formidable, respected pro hero.

cardPool.title: Kotaro Shimura
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Kotaro Shimura
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Unknown (not manifested or undisclosed)
Occupation/Role: Civilian; Father and Husband
Personality: Resentful and controlling, harboring deep hatred for Heroes due to maternal abandonment in childhood. Emotionally and physically abusive toward his children to prevent them from pursuing Hero paths. Capable of remorse but rarely acts on doubts. Easily manipulated by those he trusts.
Appearance: Short dark hair with a small cowlick on the right side. Wears a striped polo shirt and black pants. Average build with a stern, troubled expression.
Backstory: Son of Pro Hero Nana Shimura, placed in foster care after his father's death. This abandonment festered into lifelong resentment toward Heroes. He married Nao and had two children: Tenko and Hana. Unknown to him, villain All For One manipulated his hatred and encouraged his abusive parenting.
Additional Information: Non-combatant civilian with no known Quirk. His actions directly contributed to his son Tenko's tragic awakening and loss of control. His cycle of violence ultimately led to his death.

cardPool.title: Kosei Tsuburaba
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Kosei Tsuburaba
Alias: Tsuburaba
Quirk Name: Solid Air
Occupation/Role: UA High School Student, Class 1-B
Personality: Enthusiastic and competitive, holding high standards while remaining level-headed. A reliable support player rather than offensive combatant. Generally mild-mannered compared to classmates.
Appearance: Young man with short auburn hair spiked at odd angles. Large oval eyes with prominent pupils. Wears light blue high-collared jacket with black undershirt, pale pants with grey kneepads, and large brown boots.
Backstory: First-year UA student training to become a Pro Hero. One of Class 1-B's pragmatic voices alongside Kaibara, Awase, and Rin. Develops his Quirk through rigorous training.
Additional Information: Solid Air solidifies exhaled air into invisible walls and platforms. Initially fragile but improves significantly during first year. His Ultimate Move, Air Prison, creates soundproof barriers effective against voice-based Quirks. Functions best as support specialist in team scenarios.

cardPool.title: Komako Masu
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Komako Masu

Alias:
None

Quirk Name:
Unknown

Occupation/Role:
UA High School Student, Department of Management (Business Course)

Personality:
Outgoing and charismatic with nerves of steel. A natural moodmaker focused on the business and marketability aspects of heroism. Pragmatic and observant, analyzing how heroes can be effectively promoted to society.

Appearance:
A young girl of below-average height with short, dark green hair slicked back with a single strand hanging in front. Large, round eyes behind rounded glasses. Always wears her UA gym uniform in a neat, put-together manner.

Backstory:
A first-year student in UA's Department of Management business course, Komako approaches heroism from an entrepreneurial angle. She gained attention during the UA Sports Festival for analyzing Izuku's marketability and potential as a hero brand.

Additional Information:
Often seen with classmates Ronaudo and Futo from the business course. Her business-focused perspective emphasizes the commercial and public relations aspects of professional heroism.

cardPool.title: Kojiro Bondo
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Kojiro Bondo

Alias: Plamo

Quirk Name: Cemedine

Occupation/Role: UA High School Student, Class 1-B

Personality: A gentle giant who stammers with teammates despite being easygoing and well-liked. He maintains a calm demeanor despite his imposing stature.

Appearance: Tall and heavily muscular with wide shoulders, slender waist, and oversized hands. Yellow straw-colored skin with a glue-dispenser-shaped head topped with a lappet. Seven eye-holes dot his face as Quirk outlets. Wears a baggy yellow hero suit with red bottle-cap accessories at neck, wrists, waist, and ankles; white gloves and red-soled shoes; red-trimmed black squares on sleeves; and dual glue bottle emblems on belt.

Backstory: A first-year UA student training to become a Pro Hero, managing his unusual appearance while learning to harness his adhesive Quirk.

Additional Information: Possesses enhanced strength from his massive frame. His Cemedine Quirk sprays fast-drying adhesive from facial holes to trap enemies and bond objects, with controllable drying speed. Despite his intimidating size, he remains gentle-natured.

cardPool.title: Koji Koda
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Koji Koda

Alias: Petting Hero: Anima

Quirk Name: Anivoice

Occupation/Role: UA High School Student, Class 1-A

Personality: Timid and quiet, preferring sign language over speech. Kind-hearted and averse to violence, he enjoys animals and cute things. Deathly afraid of bugs despite commanding them. Growing more confident, inspired by his father's courage.

Appearance: Tall young man with broad, muscular build and peach-colored skin. Head resembles an unevenly shaped rock with a pointed crown, square jaw, and thick hair-like protrusions from the back. Wears standard UA uniform: light gray blazer with dark turquoise trim, white shirt, dark blue-green pants, red tie, and brown shoes. Hero costume is a tight yellow suit with large red chest marking and mouth-like symbol.

Backstory: UA High School student training to become a Pro Hero in Class 1-A. Inspired by his father, Koji has overcome his initial meekness through hero training, becoming more vocal when his comrades need him.

Additional Information: Commands animals through his Quirk for reconnaissance and surveillance. Despite his fearsome appearance, he is genuinely gentle and kind. Owns a pet rabbit and animal decorations in his dorm room.

cardPool.title: Koichi Haimawari
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Koichi Haimawari

Alias:
The Crawler, Nice Guy

Quirk Name:
Slide and Glide

Occupation/Role:
Vigilante, University Student

Personality:
Easy-going and mild-mannered with a heroic nature. Generous and helpful but socially awkward. Remains calm under pressure and willing to reason with criminals. Dreams of becoming a recognized hero.

Appearance:
Slim young man with short brown hair and large round brown eyes. Wears All Might-themed hoodies over black tactical gear with knee and elbow pads. Black sneakers with red accents. During vigilante work, he wears a black medical mask and red-tinted shades. Casually wears a black gakuran uniform with yellow buttons.

Backstory:
Discovered his Quirk and began operating as a vigilante, helping citizens and fighting petty crime. Trained under mentor Knuckleduster and refined his methods. Gradually built confidence despite lacking official hero status. Has earned a reputation through his independent actions.

Additional Information:
Not a UA High School student. Operates independently as a vigilante without official hero credentials. Works various jobs while pursuing his dream of becoming a recognized hero.

cardPool.title: Kiruka Hasaki
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Kiruka Hasaki
Alias: Slice
Quirk Name: Slice
Occupation/Role: Villain
Personality: Confident and ruthless in combat, willing to cause destruction for her goals. Shows concern for teammates, particularly Nine. Yearns to create a world where power determines worth after being ostracized by society. Vain about her appearance, especially her hair.
Appearance: Fair-skinned young woman with inward-sloping blue eyes and full lips. Long, straight shiny red hair with chin-length bangs and front strands looping to her knees. Pale purple blouse with frilled cuffs under navy dress with brown belt. Dark red gloves, purple frilled thigh-high socks, black knee-high boots with red binding, black choker with red center, and black domino mask.
Backstory: Powerful villain recruited by Nine to help establish a world order based on strength. Ostracized due to her formidable Quirk, she seeks validation through conquest and power alongside her teammates.
Additional Information: Highly skilled hand-to-hand combatant with excellent agility and reflexes. Slice Quirk allows her to manipulate hair for offense, defense, and mobility—hardening, sharpening, elongating, and projecting it as weaponized strands. Weakness: Suppressed Quirk significantly reduces combat effectiveness.

cardPool.title: Kinoko Komori
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Kinoko Komori

Alias: Shemage

Quirk Name: Mushroom

Occupation/Role: UA High School Class 1-B Student, aspiring Pro Hero

Personality: Initially shy and reserved, Kinoko grows increasingly confident and cheerful around peers. She possesses a gleeful obsession with mushrooms, frequently making puns and using scientific nomenclature. Despite her playful nature, she demonstrates genuine kindness and concern for others.

Appearance: A short, slender girl with honey-brown inward-curved hair in a mushroom-shaped bob. Long bangs cover her wide, cat-like warm brown eyes with cross-shaped pupils.
