She has a large mouth and long lower eyelashes. Her hero costume features a red and white fly agaric turtleneck dress, matching mushroom-shaped hat, furred sleeves, pale pink knee-high boots with frilled shafts, and a dark brown belt with golden buckle for her Shroom-Shooters.

Backstory: A UA first-year student training to become a Pro Hero, Kinoko initially struggles with social anxiety but builds confidence through combat training and teamwork. Her Quirk-related passion for mushrooms drives her scholarly interest and battle strategies.

Additional Information: Kinoko excels in support roles using humidity-controlled spore dispersal to create mushroom barriers and smokescreens.

cardPool.title: Kenji Tsuragamae
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Kenji Tsuragamae
Alias: Chief Tsuragamae
Quirk Name: Dog
Occupation/Role: Chief of the Police Force
Personality: Stern and rule-bound yet pragmatic, willing to bend enforcement for justice when warranted. Respectful of genuine heroism and carries himself with official dignity, though his dog-related speech tics undercut formality. Compassionate toward young heroes despite maintaining lawful order.
Appearance: An exceptionally tall, powerfully built man with the head of a beagle featuring dark brown markings around his eyes and ears separated by a tan line down his forehead, widening toward his muzzle with pale brown flecking. Large black nose, dark eyes, tan skin, and human body. Wears a formal black suit with dress shirt, waistcoat, black blazer, matching dress pants, large-buckled belt, and a black-and-white dalmatian-patterned tie.
Backstory: Rose through law enforcement to become Chief of Police after Quirks emerged. Witnessed the Police Force's initial rejection of Quirk users, leading to heroes filling that void. Maintains strict adherence to law while understanding the moral complexities heroes face.
Additional Information: Not a UA student; operates as a law enforcement authority figure. Known for dog-related puns and his "woof" verbal tic.

cardPool.title: Kenji Hikiishi
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Kenji Hikiishi
Alias: Magne
Quirk Name: Magnetism
Occupation/Role: Villain, League of Villains Vanguard Action Squad member
Personality: Cruel and brutal, driven by freedom and autonomy. Perceptive and quick-thinking in combat, refusing subjugation with tactical intelligence.
Appearance: Muscular build with shoulder-length reddish-magenta hair and square jaw. Wears triangular white-framed sunglasses, dark orange unbuttoned shirt over white v-neck undershirt, blue jeans, and dark brown boots.
Backstory: Hardened criminal with a reputation for violent crimes. Joined the League of Villains seeking freedom from societal constraints. Skilled combatant using her Quirk with brutal efficiency in the Vanguard Action Squad.
Additional Information: Magnetism Quirk polarizes targets within 4.5-meter radius—males south, females north. Cannot magnetize herself. Carries a large cloth-wrapped magnet as a weapon to draw magnetized targets with devastating force. Expert at close-range combat and tactical ambushes.

cardPool.title: Kendo Rappa
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Kendo Rappa

Alias: The Rapper

Quirk Name: Strongarm

Occupation/Role: Eight Bullets member of the Shie Hassaikai

Personality: Hot-blooded and violence-driven, Kendo lives for combat and respects only worthy challengers. Despite his brutality, he maintains strict honor—refusing weapons or allies when he can win alone. He shows unexpected mercy to strong opponents.

Appearance: A massive, heavily muscular man with long light brown hair and a plague mask covering his face. He wears a tattered t-shirt beneath a light blue tunic, dark pants, and dual belts. Leather gloves with metal-reinforced knuckles and straps cover his hands and wrists.

Backstory: An undefeated MMA fighter from the Underground Masquerade, Kendo attracted Kai Chisaki's attention through raw power. He sought to defeat Overhaul in single combat but was repeatedly overhauled by Chisaki's Quirk. Now an Eight Bullets member, he pursues the ultimate fight.

Additional Information: Expert hand-to-hand combatant with cage-fighting techniques. Uses precise rapid punches amplified by his Quirk with no openings in close-quarters duels. Effective in tag-team scenarios with defensive fighters.

cardPool.title: Ken Takagi
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Ken Takagi

Alias: Lock Hero: Rock Lock

Quirk Name: Lock Down

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero

Personality: Pragmatic and blunt, quick to judge competence. Critical of inexperienced students, viewing youth as a liability. Confident to the point of arrogance. Does not tolerate being underestimated. Despite harsh snap judgments, he genuinely respects those who exceed expectations.

Appearance: Average height man with short dark coily hair in an afro. Pierced ears with padlock earrings. Key-shaped protrusions at fingertips. Yellow eye mask, red key necklace, yellow and dark green keyhole-patterned bodysuit, light gray shoulder pads with keyhole designs, white boots, and brown belt with keys.

Backstory: Experienced Pro Hero with proven competence. Father to an infant son, heightening his awareness of dangers young heroes face. Participated in major operations against organized crime.

Additional Information: His Quirk immobilizes nonliving objects he touches, freezing them in place. Can be overcome by sufficient force with limited area coverage. Uses thrown tiles as mobile footholds in combat. His confidence sometimes blinds him to threats, though experience generally validates his self-assurance.

cardPool.title: Ken Ishiyama
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Ken Ishiyama
Alias: Cementoss
Quirk Name: Cement
Occupation/Role: Pro Hero and Modern Literature Teacher at UA High School
Personality: Serious yet pleasant, deeply caring about student safety. Brave and principled in combat, willing to sacrifice for those he protects. Respectful of authority and devoted to his duties.
Appearance: A humanoid figure composed of gray cement with a blocky, proportioned body. Black eyes with tiny pupils when opened, and gray hair in a short ponytail. Wears a sleeveless brown suit with yellow stripes, matching shorts, and gray shoes with yellow soles.
Backstory: A seasoned Pro Hero and UA faculty member who teaches Modern Literature to first-year students. Known for exceptional Quirk control and unwavering commitment to student safety and hero principles.
Additional Information: His Quirk allows him to manipulate and reshape cement-based materials into various forms. Recovery Girl considers his Quirk among the most difficult to combat among UA teachers. He uses weight bracelets during training to handicap himself when sparring with students. An admirer of All Might and trusted keeper of his secret identity.

cardPool.title: Keigo Takami
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Keigo Takami

Alias: Wing Hero: Hawks

Quirk Name: Fierce Wings

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero (No. 2 on Hero Billboard Chart)

Personality: Highly intelligent with a deceptively carefree demeanor masking constant vigilance. Cocky and laid-back, he speaks bluntly while maintaining emotional control. He follows orders with subtle cynicism, dislikes formalities, and acts unpredictably with joking submissiveness.

Appearance: Average height with slim build. Ash-blonde feathered hair swept back with front tufts in arcs. Golden-brown triangular eyes with black bird-like markings, thick eyebrows, faint stubble, and square ear piercings. His hero costume features a black wavy-patterned shirt under a tan shearling jacket with shoulder slits for large bright red folded wings. Black gloves, yellow visor, and yellow headphones complete the look.

Backstory: Keigo rose to second-highest ranked Pro Hero through exceptional skill and intelligence. He operates under the Hero Public Safety Commission's direction.

Additional Information: Hawks possesses elite crimson wings enhancing aerial capabilities and speed. His intelligence extends to tactical combat assessment and social manipulation. He maintains a facade of casualness while remaining perpetually calculating.

cardPool.title: Kazuho Haneyama
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Kazuho Haneyama

Alias: Pop☆Step

Quirk Name: Not explicitly stated in source material

Occupation/Role: Freelance idol and former vigilante; student

Personality: Logical strategic thinker with enthusiasm for performance and notable vanity. Fierce and sharp-tongued, quick to berate disapproved allies. Secretive about vigilante activities kept from family. Cares deeply for companions despite harsh demeanor.

Appearance: Pink messy hair concealed by round blue-framed glasses; blue eyes. Civilian form: black long-sleeved seifuku with white collar, red accents, red tie, white knee-high socks, blue sneakers. As Pop☆Step: black backless leotard with pink heart chest opening, high pigtails, black mask with pink eye makeup, red bow tie, fingerless gloves, mini-skirt with purple hearts, black boots with pink details.

Backstory: Talented vocalist leading a double life as idol and unlicensed street vigilante. Works alongside fellow vigilantes including Koichi, keeping activities secret from family. Driven by entertainment passion and desire to help community through unconventional means.

Additional Information: Operates independently in Naruhata, not UA High School student. Performs with groups like FeatherHATS between vigilante activities.

cardPool.title: Katsuma Shimano
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Katsuma Shimano
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Cell Activation
Occupation/Role: UA High School Student, Hero Course, Class 1-A
Personality: Timid and soft-spoken, easily influenced by his older sister. Admires Pro Heroes deeply and shows genuine remorse for mistakes. Selfless and brave when protecting loved ones, willing to sacrifice his own Quirk for others' safety.
Appearance: Young boy with brown eyes, curly light brown hair, and freckles. Wears the UA school uniform. Carries a yellow messenger bag with an Edgeshot enamel pin, a floral charm bracelet on his left arm, and a sun hat with a blue band.
Backstory: From Nabu Island, Katsuma lived with his older sister Mahoro before enrolling at UA. He idolizes heroes and dreams of becoming one. When villain Nine invaded his island, Katsuma bravely protected his sister, cementing his resolve to walk the hero path.
Additional Information: His Cell Activation Quirk heals wounds and enhances physical performance through cellular stimulation via touch, but drains stamina with extended use. Unlike his father's version, it works on multiple blood types with superior control, earning him acceptance into UA's Hero Course.

cardPool.title: Kashiko Sekigai
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Kashiko Sekigai
Alias: Sensor Girl
Quirk Name: Holographic Map
Occupation/Role: Isami Academy High School Student, Class President
Personality: Responsible and level-headed leader; uninterested in romance.
Appearance: Petite girl with round face and periwinkle-blue shoulder-length hair with inward-curling bangs. Gray eyes behind thick-framed triangular glasses. Wears Isami High uniform: white shirt, dark red bow tie, dark blue blazer, pleated gray skirt, socks, and brown loafers.
Backstory: Trusted Class President at Isami Academy, Kashiko earned her position through reliability and tactical thinking. Her Quirk makes her invaluable for reconnaissance and coordination.
Additional Information: Hero costume features navy turtleneck bodysuit with geometric patterns, shoulder-pads marked with "S," visor, red gloves, wrist-mounted radar screens, and thigh-high boots. Participated in class team during Quirk Apprehension Test arc.

cardPool.title: Kaoruko Awata
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Kaoruko Awata

Alias: Bubble Girl

Quirk Name: Bubble

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero Sidekick at Sir Nighteye's Hero Office

Personality: Serious and dedicated professional who remains composed under pressure. Demonstrates loyalty despite frequent threats of dismissal.

Appearance: Fair-skinned young woman with light blue complexion and short, ruffled dark blue hair parted right. Wide yellow eyes with thick eyelashes. Hero costume: dark blue crop top with white high collar and central zipper, black tights with white shorts marked by yellow stripes, thick white boots with yellow rings, transparent visor with dual air filters, and dark blue gloves.

Backstory: A dedicated sidekick under Pro Hero Sir Nighteye, Kaoruko has mastered her aromatic bubble abilities. She maintains her position despite her boss's temperamental management style, showing strong resolve and commitment to hero work.

Additional Information: Her Bubble Quirk generates bubbles filled with any aroma she has previously smelled, including pleasant and foul odors. As an active working sidekick, she is more experienced than typical UA students.

cardPool.title: Kamile Gollini
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Kamile Gollini
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Spatial Excursion
Occupation/Role: Member of the Gollini Family mafia
Personality: Devious and sadistic with a wicked smile. He delights in tormenting enemies and shows no mercy, though somewhat lazy. Loyal to Dark Might but quick to abandon when facing defeat.
Appearance: A short, elderly man with pale wrinkled skin and pronounced upper body. He has a large beaked nose, sharp chin, and white split-end hair. He dresses as a butler in a red tailcoat, white gloves, green neckcloth, navy-gray pants, buckled shoes, and a rose on his coat.
Backstory: A seasoned member of the Gollini Family criminal organization serving as aide to Dark Might. He participated in schemes involving the fortress Symbol of Paradise and capture of targets like Anna.
Additional Information: Not a UA student. His Quirk moves objects and people without gravity restrictions. Enhanced by Anna's Overmodification Quirk, his range expands to relocate entire structures. He is defeated by Mirio while escaping the collapsing fortress.

cardPool.title: Kai Chisaki
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Kai Chisaki
Alias: Overhaul
Quirk Name: Overhaul
Occupation/Role: Villain, Leader of the Shie Hassaikai Yakuza organization
Personality: A mysophobic, antisocial sociopath with an enormous ego and no moral compass. Outwardly polite and strategic, but fundamentally manipulative. Convinced he alone understands Quirks as a plague on humanity, despite relying entirely on his own Quirk.
Appearance: A pale young man with short, shaggy auburn hair parted right. Small gold irises, three piercings in his left ear. He wears a distinctive magenta plague doctor mask embroidered with gold, white surgical gloves, black dress shirt and pants with pale gray tie, dark olive-green bomber jacket with purple fur collar, and white lace-up sneakers.
Backstory: Driven by mysophobia and a discredited theory linking Quirks to rats, Kai became obsessed with returning the world to its pre-Quirk state. He rose to leadership of the Shie Hassaikai, believing only he possesses the enlightenment to reshape the world according to his vision.
Additional Information: Kai operates through meticulous planning rather than brute force. He views heroic sacrifice and petty villainy as "sicknesses" symptomatic of Quirk infection. His calm demeanor masks a deeply disturbed individual incapable of empathy.

cardPool.title: Juzo Moashi
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Juzo Moashi

Alias: Centipeder

Quirk Name: Centipede

Occupation/Role: Sidekick at Sir Nighteye's Hero Office

Personality: A gentleman of impeccable manners and refined conduct. Disciplined and loyal to his mentor's ideals.

Appearance: A tall, lean man with a distinctive centipede-like face of brown coloration. His elongated centipede neck drapes elegantly across his shoulders. He dresses formally in a black tuxedo, maintaining a polished professional appearance.

Backstory: Juzo serves as a dedicated sidekick under Sir Nighteye's mentorship, learning heroism within the agency and being groomed as a successor to eventually lead the office.

Additional Information: Juzo's centipede-like limbs grant him exceptional reach and versatility in combat, allowing him to attack and restrain opponents from considerable distances. His refined demeanor and physical abilities make him a capable and trustworthy team member.

cardPool.title: Juzo Honenuki
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Juzo Honenuki

Alias:
Mudman

Quirk Name:
Softening

Occupation/Role:
Class 1-B Student at U.A. High School

Personality:
Calm and understanding with good judgment. Dislikes losing but respects earned victories. Uses flexible thinking in strategy and cares for his classmates. Acknowledges needing more stubbornness to overcome difficult situations.

Appearance:
Pale-skinned young man with angular eyes, mid-length spiky beige hair, and flat nose. Distinctive protruding teeth with no visible lips create a skull-like appearance. Wears dark bodysuit under orange and black armor plating with rounded black helmet and white visor lines. Orange vambraces, green boots with pipe shafts, and white gloves complete his hero costume.

Backstory:
Earned his place at U.A. through official recommendation. His Quirk allows him to soften any material into mud-like substances, which he controls with remarkable precision.

Additional Information:
Recommended student with exceptional reflexes and battle awareness. Excels at controlling terrain through his Quirk to restrict enemy movement and dictate combat flow. Can swim through softened materials for stealth or escape. Most effective against opponents reliant on solid footing and stable positions.

cardPool.title: Jurota Shishida
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Jurota Shishida
Alias: Gevaudan
Quirk Name: Beast
Occupation/Role: UA High School Student, Class 1-B
Personality: Intellectually refined and formally polite, addressing others respectfully due to his well-mannered upbringing. When transformed, he becomes boisterous and energetic. He admires Hound Dog's freedom but feels constrained by propriety. Despite his bestial nature, he retains sharp tactical thinking even in Beast form.
Appearance: A tall young man with shaggy brown hair covering most of his body and sharp, prominent teeth with two lower canines protruding between his lips. He wears small rectangular glasses with thick black lenses. His hero costume features dark brown fur-lined boots, a shirt collar, and stylized goggles.
Backstory: Raised in a well-mannered family that instilled formality and propriety in him. He developed his Beast Quirk early and trained at UA to become a Pro Hero, becoming one of Class 1-B's strongest members through disciplined control and strategic application of his power.
Additional Information: Transforms into a massive beast-man with increased size, thicker hair, and pronounced fangs. He runs on all fours and possesses incredible physical strength.

cardPool.title: Jin Bubaigawara
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Jin Bubaigawara

Alias: Twice

Quirk Name: Double

Occupation/Role: Villain, League of Villains member, Vanguard Action Squad operative

Personality: Explosively manic and contradictory, Jin shifts between opposing statements with chaotic energy. He suffers severe dissociative disorder from a traumatic nine-day conflict with his own clones, leaving him unsure of his originality. He craves acceptance desperately, making him loyal but vulnerable to betrayal. Without his mask, his fractured personalities argue; with it, he appears unified. His instability drives him between humor and destructive aggression.

Appearance: A well-built man with shoulder-length blond hair and gray-blue eyes lacking eyebrows. Sparse facial hair marks his upper lip and chin. He wears a black-and-gray bodysuit with gray "T" and "W" patterns across his chest. Red wristbands with green accents hold measuring tapes. His dual-toned mask has a gray upper half with white eye sockets and black lower half covering his mouth.

Backstory: Jin created clones seeking companionship but endured a traumatic nine-day conflict questioning his existence. The League of Villains accepted his fractured mind when society rejected him, offering the belonging he desperately needed and driving his unwavering loyalty.

cardPool.title: Iwao Oguro
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Iwao Oguro

Alias: Knuckleduster

Quirk Name: Overclock

Occupation/Role: Vigilante, former Pro Hero (High-Speed Hero: O'Clock)

Personality: Driven by unwavering justice, Knuckleduster is direct and aggressive, preferring action over deliberation. He thrives on challenging fights but grows bored easily. Reckless and violence-prone, he possesses surprising intelligence and perceptiveness. He shows no resentment toward Quirkless individuals and admires Heroes despite operating outside the law.

Appearance: A tall, heavily muscled man with short black hair, thick eyebrows, and heavy stubble. He wears a loose black ragged wrap-around mask, tight black shirt, khaki military pants with black belt, black boots, and a long hunter green trench coat. Black gloves topped with silver knuckledusters complete his outfit.

Backstory: Once a licensed Pro Hero, Oguro's Quirk was stolen by All For One, rendering him Quirkless. Rather than abandon his mission, he became a vigilante, patrolling his neighborhood to combat street-level crime and gangs that professional Heroes ignore.

Additional Information: Operates without government authorization. Despite lacking a Quirk, he remains fearless against powered villains and willing to challenge Pro Heroes when morality demands it.

cardPool.title: Itsuka Kendo
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Itsuka Kendo

Alias: Battle Fist

Quirk Name: Big Fist

Occupation/Role: UA High School Student, Class 1-B Representative

Personality: Spirited and thoughtful, Itsuka is the compassionate "big sister" of Class 1-B who corrects others when needed. She's analytical in combat, friendly across class lines, and willing to sacrifice for teammates. Despite stern discipline, she holds no ill-will toward rivals and shows genuine concern for others.

Appearance: Medium height with slim build, Itsuka has sharp teal eyes with white pupils and long orange hair in a high left-side ponytail with three-clump bangs. She wears a teal knee-length qipao with yellow accents over a black corset, black shorts, brown utility belt, thin black domino mask, and navy heeled boots with white trim.

Backstory: A natural leader and capable combatant, Itsuka earned 5th place in the UA Entrance Exam. Chosen as Class 1-B's representative, she is the emotional anchor of her class, balancing competitive ambition with genuine kindness.

Additional Information: Itsuka's Big Fist Quirk enlarges her hands for devastating close-range attacks and utility. Her analytical mind lets her exploit enemy weaknesses through tactical observation and creative Quirk application.

cardPool.title: Inko Midoriya
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Inko Midoriya

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Object Attraction

Occupation/Role: Homemaker, Mother of UA Student Izuku Midoriya

Personality: Kind and supportive, though prone to worry and panic that leads to fainting. She cries dramatically when emotional and shares her son's anxious tendencies. Protective and selfless, feeling guilty about her son's hardships and eager to support his dreams.

Appearance: A woman in her late thirties with shoulder-length dark green hair and a small spiky ponytail. She has large circular dark green eyes like her son's. Once slim, she has gained weight over the years and shows signs of maturity with a gentle, motherly quality.

Backstory: Devoted wife of Hisashi Midoriya and mother to Izuku. When Izuku was diagnosed as Quirkless, she felt overwhelming guilt. After he gained his Quirk and was accepted to UA High School, she initially doubted the school's safety but came to support his heroic aspirations after All Might's assurance.

Additional Information: Skilled at tailoring and sewing; handcrafted Izuku's first hero costume. Her Quirk allows her to pull small objects toward herself from a distance. She remains hesitant about UA's dormitory system due to protective concerns for her son.

cardPool.title: Inasa Yoarashi
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Inasa Yoarashi
Alias: Gale Force
Quirk Name: Whirlwind
Occupation/Role: First-year student at Shiketsu High School
Personality: Energetic, hyperactive, and exuberant with loud vigor and formal politeness. Driven by unwavering belief in passion as heroism's core. Despises those with "cold eyes" and lacks passion. Genuinely pure-hearted despite boisterous nature. Holds deep grudges against Endeavor and Shoto Todoroki for their perceived lack of passion.
Appearance: Tall, well-built young man with buzzed dark brown hair and black eyes. Wears standard Shiketsu uniform—white collared shirt, dark pants, and signature hat. Hero costume features burgundy suit with yellow buttons, fur-collared cape, and jetpack-like propulsion system. Left arm concealed in thick brown material with tan glove featuring air pipes on knuckles. Right arm in blue skintight sleeve. Tubes along torso and ankles for wind expulsion. Knee and shoulder pads resemble gas masks.
Backstory: Originally top-recommended for U.A. High School, Inasa withdrew and enrolled at Shiketsu instead. Rejection stemmed from negative encounter with Shoto and Endeavor Todoroki, whose perceived lack of passion sparked lasting grudge.
Additional Information: Claims to dislike almost nothing and enjoys making friends.

cardPool.title: Hitoshi Shinso
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Hitoshi Shinso

Alias: Hypnosis Hero: NightHide

Quirk Name: Brainwashing

Occupation/Role: Student, Class 1-C Department of General Education at UA High School

Personality: Stoic and calculating, Hitoshi manipulates conversations to his advantage. Resentful toward those with naturally heroic Quirks, he masks longing for acceptance behind a sharp wit. Despite claiming indifference to friendship, he secretly desires validation as a true hero.

Appearance: Tall young man with messy indigo hair flaring outward in large tufts. Purple triangular eyes with white pupils, half-closed beneath dark eye bags. Wears UA student uniform; in combat training, dark blue PE uniform with white markings, artificial vocal cord device, capturing weapon, and green-white sneakers.

Backstory: Persecuted for possessing a Quirk perceived as villainous, Hitoshi internalized resentment toward those with heroic abilities. Despite discrimination, his determination to become a Pro Hero never wavered. He enrolled in UA's General Education Department to prove his heroic intentions.

Additional Information: Brainwashing requires verbal responses from targets to activate, making him dependent on manipulation. He lacks combat prowess, compensating through cunning and tactical awareness.

cardPool.title: Hiryu Rin
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Hiryu Rin
Alias: Long Weizi
Quirk Name: Scales
Occupation/Role: UA High School Class 1-B Student
Personality: Severe and collaborative in combat, diligent in academics and Quirk mastery, with strong tactical intellect and quick reflexes.
Appearance: Lightly tanned skin with black hair in a low braid; reptilian eyes with small irises. Wears a high-collared black bodysuit with yellow clouds, white knee-high boots with yellow straps, red belt with brown pouches, large yellow gauntlets with black sleeves, and a yellow talisman-like visor.
Backstory: A Class 1-B student training to become a Pro Hero at UA High School, Hiryu has distinguished himself through strategic thinking and combat versatility, earning respect among peers through collaboration.
Additional Information: Excels in close and long-range combat through scale projection with terrific accuracy and sharp tactical awareness. Scale armor has durability limitations against sufficient force. Wears specialized Scale Gauntlets enhancing ranged offense.

cardPool.title: Hizashi Yamada
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Hizashi Yamada

Alias: Voice Hero: Present Mic

Quirk Name: Voice

Occupation/Role: English Teacher at UA High School / Pro Hero (No. 45)

Personality: An eccentric, high-energy entertainer with a radio host persona who maintains excitement and engages crowds as "listeners." Despite his jovial nature, he harbors deep loyalty to friends and intense rage when betrayed. He suffers from entomophobia and prefers urban areas to forests.

Appearance: A tall, slim man with long blond hair spiked upward, small brown mustache, and rectangular eyes with greenish-yellow irises. He wears orange-tinted shades, black headphones labeled "HAGE," and maintains a large smile. His hero costume consists of a black studded jacket with tall collar, black pants and knee-high boots, tan shoulder pads, red studded belt and elbow pads, black fingerless gloves, and a directional speaker around his neck.

Backstory: A current Pro Hero and former UA High School student, Hizashi teaches English while maintaining his hero career. He shares a tragic history with classmate Shota Aizawa involving their deceased friend Oboro Shirakumo.

Additional Information: UA High School staff and Pro Hero known for commentating events. His Quirk amplification devices are essential to his combat effectiveness.

cardPool.title: Himiko Toga
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Himiko Toga

Alias:
Toga

Quirk Name:
Transform

Occupation/Role:
UA High School Student (Class 1-A); Member of the League of Villains

Personality:
Cheerful and sadistic with a twisted view of love as absorption of others. Mentally unstable, easily shifts between playful affection and dangerous aggression based on interest level.

Appearance:
Fair-skinned girl with inward-tilting yellow cat-like eyes, thin slit pupils, and under-eye bags. Sharp canines give a vampiric appearance. Pale ash-blonde hair in two messy buns with straight fringe and chin-length side bangs. Wears dark blue seifuku with white trim and red scarf, oversized beige cardigan, knee-length black socks, and dark brown school shoes.

Backstory:
A UA student with a dual life in the League of Villains. Her Quirk allows her to assume others' appearance after consuming their blood, which she views as intimacy. Her fractured mental state stems from childhood isolation due to her unusual nature.

Additional Information:
Combat-ready with concealed blades and blood extraction equipment. Transform Quirk requires ingesting blood to copy physical forms. Prone to sudden mood shifts and unpredictable behavior in conflict.

cardPool.title: Hekiji Tengai
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Hekiji Tengai

Alias:
Shield of the Eight Bullets

Quirk Name:
Barrier

Occupation/Role:
Member of the Shie Hassaikai's Eight Bullets; Kendo Rappa's assigned partner

Personality:
Calm and composed with monk-like demeanor. Philosophically opposed to excessive violence, viewing fighting as a selfish desire. Analytical and observant with an enlightened perspective. Keeps his eyes closed, projecting wisdom and restraint.

Appearance:
Tall, slim man with pale spiky hair and dark eyebrows. Light irises with thin eyes usually closed. Wears a dark yukata with white cloth belt and wooden geta sandals. Bears the Shie Hassaikai's brown plague mask secured with three belts.

Backstory:
Former devout Buddhist recruited by Overhaul to stabilize the volatile Kendo Rappa. Paired strategically for complementary Quirk synergy as "Spear and Shield" against aggressive opponents. Newest Eight Bullets member.

Additional Information:
Specializes in defensive barrier creation that absorbs powerful impacts. Works best alongside offensive partners. Arrested following the Shie Hassaikai's defeat.

cardPool.title: Ibara Shiozaki
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Ibara Shiozaki
Alias: Vine
Quirk Name: Vines
Occupation/Role: UA High School Student, Class 1-B
Personality: Modest and courteous with deep religious conviction. She speaks softly but firmly, judging others harshly for dishonesty and refusing underhanded tactics. Beneath her graceful demeanor lies an unexpectedly vindictive streak. She values fairness and truth above all else, sometimes to self-sabotage.
Appearance: Medium-height girl with dark green eyes and long lower eyelashes. Her distinctive feature is hair of thorn-covered green vines kept above her waist, with one set wrapped around her forehead in a cross pattern. She wears a plain white toga-like robe with dark brown knee-high boots, resembling an ancient Greek goddess.
Backstory: Talented student who earned fourth place in the UA Entrance Exam through balanced combat and rescue capabilities. Her vine Quirk and disciplined fighting style caught professional heroes' attention.
Additional Information: Stationary-type combatant who restricts opponents with vine manipulation. Vulnerable to high-speed and close-quarters fighters. Her vines regenerate with proper sunlight and water, and she can detach them at will.

cardPool.title: Hikage Shinomori
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Hikage Shinomori

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Danger Sense

Occupation/Role: One For All User, Hermit Warrior

Personality: Valiant and noble, driven to defeat All For One yet realistic about his limits. Solitary by nature due to his Quirk's constant vigilance keeping him on edge. Selfless in strengthening One For All for the next user.

Appearance: Lean, muscular man with short beige hair and thin, downward-slanting green eyes. Wears a dark baggy bodysuit with torn shin-length pants, sage-colored belt, and padded kneecaps. Light puffy jacket cut at chest with right sleeve worn separately. Hardened physique from relentless training.

Backstory: Fourth wielder of One For All, inherited from Bruce and spent his life in solitary training. Aware he lacked strength to defeat All For One alone, he devoted himself to perfecting the Quirk and his abilities, preparing to pass his legacy to a stronger successor.

Additional Information: Danger Sense lets him sense incoming threats, triggering stabbing head sensations for effortless evasion. One For All grants superhuman strength, speed, agility, and durability—he could split boulders with ease. His constant alertness drove him toward isolation.

cardPool.title: Hari Kurono
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Hari Kurono
Alias: Chronostasis
Quirk Name: Chronostasis
Occupation/Role: Yakuza member of the Shie Hassaikai; assistant to Overhaul
Personality: Composed and cold-hearted. Fiercely loyal to his leader with subservient tendencies. Tactical and analytical.
Appearance: Fair-skinned with thin dark eyes and pointed eyebrows. Pale chin-length hair styled into arrow-shaped clock needles. Wears a black plague mask with gold trim, circular glasses, and a long white raincoat with raised hood.
Backstory: A subordinate within the Shie Hassaikai criminal organization serving as right-hand man to Kai Chisaki. His unwavering loyalty has bound him to Kai's ruthless decisions.
Additional Information: Expert marksman and espionage specialist. His Chronostasis Quirk slows target movements through hair contact for up to one hour. Relies on tactics and stealth rather than direct combat.

cardPool.title: Hanta Sero
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Hanta Sero

Alias: Taping Hero: Cellophane

Quirk Name: Tape

Occupation/Role: UA High School Student, Class 1-A

Personality: Amicable and sociable, often loud while trying to impress peers. Humorous and quick to call out classmates' behavior. Laid-back and confident despite odds. Has a teasing side and speaks freely, sometimes unintentionally insulting others. Shows interest in girls and enjoys gossip.

Appearance: Tall and lean young man with chin-length black hair spiked downward and jagged bangs. Large almond-shaped eyes with small pupils and broad grin. His elbows are cylindrical tape dispenser-shaped, serving as his Quirk's source. Wears standard UA uniform: light gray blazer with turquoise trim, white shirt, dark blue-green pants, red tie, and brown shoes.

Backstory: First-year UA student training to become a professional hero. Integrated as a valued member of Class 1-A through competence and friendly demeanor. His Tape Quirk allows him to bind and restrain targets from distance, making him versatile despite lacking flashy offensive abilities.

Additional Information: Competed in the Sports Festival against Shoto Todoroki despite unfavorable odds. Failed the Final Exam after being put to sleep by Midnight but retained commitment to improvement.

cardPool.title: Gunhead
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Gunhead
Quirk Name: Unknown
Occupation/Role: Pro Hero specializing in armed combat; internship mentor
Personality: Professional and friendly with excellent teaching values. Composed and fierce in combat but unexpectedly kind, with a tendency toward teasing and playful posing.
Appearance: Wide-set, muscular man with long pale mint-green hair spiking backward. White mask with four gun-muzzle holes and padded combat vest over dark grayish-cyan bodysuit. Brown pants, black boots, silver revolver chamber-shaped bracers, and knuckle spikes.
Backstory: An established Pro Hero who runs an agency focused on armed combat training and crime suppression. Known for taking on internship students and providing hands-on field training.
Additional Information: Gunhead Martial Arts is his signature technique. He mentored UA student Ochaco Uraraka, teaching her combat skills and proper fighting form. Later participated in civilian evacuation during the Final War.

cardPool.title: Goto Imasuji
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Goto Imasuji
Alias: Muscular
Quirk Name: Muscle Augmentation
Occupation/Role: Villain, League of Villains Vanguard Action Squad member
Personality: Sadistic and bloodthirsty, Muscular craves violence and killing. He respects worthy opponents and those who defeat him fairly, holding a strict code that worth is determined by accomplishing stated intentions. His fatal flaw is overconfidence—he underestimates opponents, toys with them, and grows bored against weaker foes, dismissing "cheap" tactics.
Appearance: An enormous muscular man with short spiky sandy-blond hair and tiny black eyes. Distinctive scars cross his left face and right forehead—wounds from Water Hose earned through combat. He wears a white hockey mask with holes, black hooded cloak, red tank top, dark jacket, dark green pants, and black knee-high boots.
Backstory: A hardened criminal from Tartarus, Muscular was freed by All For One and recruited into the Vanguard Action Squad. He killed the hero duo Water Hose, earning his facial scar and respecting their strength. He operates as the League's brutal enforcer.
Additional Information: Muscular augments his already formidable musculature to devastating levels through his Quirk.

cardPool.title: Gil Gollini
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Gil Gollini
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Teleportation
Occupation/Role: Member of the Gollini Family mafia
Personality: Emotionless and stoic, following orders loyally. Shows minimal emotion except when annoyed or shocked.
Appearance: A large, muscular man with a buzzcut, Dutch-styled beard, and stern squinted eyes. He wears a well-tailored gray suit with black stripes, black coat, scarf, and a rose emblazoned on his coat.
Backstory: Gil serves as a loyal operative of the Gollini Family mafia under boss Valdo. He acts as transportation and backup for fellow member Ugo, using his Quirk strategically in conflicts.
Additional Information: Gil demonstrates exceptional combat coordination with fluid footwork during teleportation. His Quirk allows him to teleport himself and anyone he touches to any location within his line of sight. When enhanced by Anna's Overmodification, his teleportation activation speed increases dramatically.

cardPool.title: Giulio Gandini
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Giulio Gandini

Alias:
The Scervino Butler

Quirk Name:
Trigger (Disabled)

Occupation/Role:
Butler for the Scervino Family; Former combatant

Personality:
A stern, composed gentleman with fierce loyalty to those he serves. Once warmer, he has grown hardened by trauma and loss, though his warm heart surfaces with genuine compassion. He views Heroes with cynicism yet demonstrates restraint and respects honor. Relentless in pursuing his goals, refusing to back down.

Appearance:
A man of average build with brownish-red hair in a short ponytail, thin greenish-blue eyes, and sharp teeth marked by a mole beneath his left eye. He wears a black tailcoat, grey vest, striped tie, and white undershirt with popped collar. His right arm and left leg are Support Item prosthetics; his right sleeve is rolled up and left pant leg torn to expose them. Ammunition pouches and holster belts cross his torso and left leg.

Backstory:
Raised by the Scervino family after being taken in by Anna's father, Giulio found purpose as their butler. He was brutally attacked by the Gollini Family, losing his right eye, arm, and left leg—and his Quirk's effectiveness. He rebuilt himself with prosthetics to pursue his attackers and protect Anna, bound by an agonizing promise.

cardPool.title: Gigantomachia
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Gigantomachia

Alias:
Gig

Quirk Name:
Unknown (Multiple Quirks via modification)

Occupation/Role:
Villain, former bodyguard to All For One, servant of the Paranormal Liberation Front

Personality:
Polite but impatient, aggressive toward the uncooperative. Fiercely devoted to his master with unwavering loyalty. Respects only strength and will cooperate if shown respect. Acknowledged Tomura as worthy after witnessing his power.

Appearance:
A colossal giant three building levels tall with a musclebound, rocky frame. Spiky brown hair and jagged stone protrusions cover his body. Prominently pointed teeth with protruding lower canines. Wears black pants, a hooded cloak, and carries a portable radio on a rope around his neck. Later sporting black armor.

Backstory:
Gigantomachia served All For One as a faithful bodyguard before receiving multiple Quirk modifications. When All For One went into hiding, he felt betrayed. He transferred loyalty to Tomura Shigaraki upon recognizing his strength, fighting with the Paranormal Liberation Front until his arrest.

Additional Information:
Possesses a "Mole mode" transformation with retractable jaw visor, elongated canines, and digging claws. His sole motivation is serving his master—hearing All For One's voice calms his rages.

cardPool.title: Ganma Asui
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Ganma Asui

Alias:
None

Quirk Name:
Frog Physiology

Occupation/Role:
Businessman; Father and Provider for the Asui Household

Personality:
A caring and devoted father who demonstrates responsibility and trust in his eldest daughter. Calm, supportive, and proud of his family's accomplishments.

Appearance:
A tall, stocky middle-aged man with a distinctly frog-like appearance. He has short black hair, black eyes, and a toad-like head structure. He dresses professionally in a business suit with a blue-dotted tie and green frog clip.

Backstory:
Ganma married Bell and had three children: Tsuyu, Samidare, and Satsuki. Due to frequent work travel, he relies on his responsible eldest daughter to care for her younger siblings while he provides family stability.

Additional Information:
Father of Class 1-A student Tsuyu Asui. His family's Quirk grants frog-like abilities with varying degrees of prominence. A supportive family man committed to his children's wellbeing.

cardPool.title: Gang Orca's Sidekicks
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Gang Orca's Sidekick
Quirk Name: Unknown
Occupation/Role: Professional Sidekick to Gang Orca; Provisional Hero License Exam Antagonist
Personality: Loyal and disciplined, working seamlessly under Gang Orca's command with tactical awareness and willingness to adapt strategy.
Appearance: Black skin-tight bodysuit with thin white lines across torso and tan armor pads. Diamond-shaped eye holes arranged in circular pattern form mask design. Equipped with blue and gray Cement Gun mounted on right arm.
Backstory: Enlisted by the Hero Public Safety Commission to serve as mock villain during the Provisional Hero License Exam's second phase. Tasked with attacking and impeding UA students in a disaster zone scenario, facing opponents including Shoto Todoroki, Inasa Yoarashi, and Yo Shindo.
Additional Information: Operates as part of coordinated team capable of combining attacks with Gang Orca. Demonstrated concern for leader's safety during the exam.

cardPool.title: Fuyumi Todoroki
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Fuyumi Todoroki
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Ice
Occupation/Role: Elementary School Teacher
Personality: Kind-hearted and nurturing with a teasing streak, Fuyumi deeply cares for her family despite household trauma. She is hopeful about reconciliation and worries constantly for loved ones, though she carries guilt about failing to protect Shoto. Brave and empathetic, she attempts to maintain peace within the fractured family.
Appearance: A young woman of average height with shoulder-length white hair flecked with crimson, ear-length side bangs, and turquoise eyes framed by red-rimmed rectangular glasses. Typically dressed in a white dress shirt with a grayish peach cardigan, navy jeans, and brown dress shoes. She frequently wears various turtleneck sweaters.
Backstory: The only daughter of Enji and Rei Todoroki, Fuyumi assumed a maternal role for younger brother Shoto during her mother's absence. Witnessing her father's abusive behavior left her unable to intervene, a guilt she carries regarding eldest brother Toya's fate. Inspired by her helplessness, she became an elementary school teacher to nurture and safeguard children.
Additional Information: Fuyumi possesses limited combat experience but demonstrates proficient Quirk control.

cardPool.title: Fumikage Tokoyami
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Fumikage Tokoyami

Alias: Jet-Black Hero: Tsukuyomi

Quirk Name: Dark Shadow

Occupation/Role: UA High School Student, Class 1-A

Personality: Reserved and serious yet noble, Fumikage speaks with archaic patterns and dramatic flair. Quiet but sociable in teams, he's dependable in combat. Insecure about his dark interests and easily embarrassed, he deeply cares for friends. He struggles controlling Dark Shadow's aggression, fearing harm to others.

Appearance: A short young man with a crow-like black head, yellow beak, thin red eyes, and red choker. Fair-skinned with average build. At UA, he wears a light gray blazer with turquoise trimmings, white shirt, dark blue-green pants, red tie, and brown shoes. His hero costume is a black robe with purple tinting, knee-high black boots, and utility belt.

Backstory: Fumikage trains at UA to become a hero despite his powerful but temperamental Quirk. His dark aesthetic reflects genuine passion rather than villainous intent, though he fears losing control to Dark Shadow during intense emotions or extended darkness exposure.

Additional Information: Dark Shadow is aggressive and sensitive to Fumikage's emotional state and darkness levels, complicating control. He works to master this weakness during UA training.

cardPool.title: Eri
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Eri
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Rewind
Occupation/Role: Student (U.A. High School resident)
Personality: Fearful and withdrawn from trauma, gradually becoming cheerful and trusting around those showing kindness. She carries guilt over her Quirk's destructive potential while learning its positive uses. Silent and accepting of hardship, yet determined to protect others.
Appearance: A small girl with long, messy bluish off-white hair parted down the middle reaching to her waist. She has wide bright red eyes and a small brown horn on her right forehead that grows larger when activating her Quirk. She wears a white frilled shirt, red pinafore with golden buttons, gray tights, and tan boots with a small dark red messenger bag decorated with flowers.
Backstory: Eri was used as a living weapon by her grandfather's crime organization and experimented on by Kai Chisaki to create Quirk-Destroying drugs. Her mother disowned her after she accidentally erased her father. Rescued by U.A., she now lives in the dormitories, slowly healing from severe psychological trauma and learning her existence has value beyond causing harm.
Additional Information: Her Quirk allows her to rewind events.

cardPool.title: Enji Todoroki
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Enji Todoroki

Alias:
Flame Hero: Endeavor

Quirk Name:
Hellflame

Occupation/Role:
Pro Hero (No. 2 ranked)

Personality:
Prideful and ambitious, driven by an obsessive goal to surpass All Might. Stern and demanding, he prioritizes personal achievement over relationships.

Appearance:
A tall, muscular man with short crimson spiked hair, sharp turquoise eyes, and flame-like facial hair. His Hero Costume is a navy-turquoise bodysuit with streaming flames across the chest, white cage-patterned bracers, flame-engulfed boots, and a blue belt that serves as armor and flame conduit.

Backstory:
One of the nation's top Pro Heroes, Enji married Rei Todoroki through a strategic Quirk Marriage to produce a powerful heir. This union produced four children: Toya, Fuyumi, Natsuo, and Shoto. His relentless pursuit of strength has defined his career and family life.

Additional Information:
Currently the No. 2 ranked Pro Hero by case resolution record. Father of Shoto Todoroki, a UA High School first-year student. His rivalry with All Might fuels his competitive nature.

cardPool.title: Enigma
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Fukakai Hatena

Alias: Enigma

Quirk Name: Gigantification

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero Sidekick of Ingenium, Team Idaten Member

Personality: Calm, friendly, and self-aware. Enigma is forgiving about her frightening appearance and remains composed in crises, offering reassurance and professionalism.

Appearance: A young woman with straight teeth and long dark hair in two low plaits with a neat fringe. Her oval eyes are entirely blacked-out with no visible iris or pupil. When her Quirk activates, she becomes a pitch-black blob with a white mask face, gaining elastic limbs.

Backstory: Enigma obtained her Hero License and was selected by Ingenium for Team Idaten. While traveling to Tokyo for an interview, she was mistaken for a villain but clarified her identity. She has since proven herself as a capable sidekick in rescue operations and public safety events.

Additional Information: Enigma controls her size from a few meters to the size of a residential building. Her rubber-like form stretches and protects from attacks. She can create smaller clones from her giant form to use as drones. Her presence and composure make her valuable in rescue and crowd-management scenarios.

cardPool.title: Emi Fukukado
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Emi Fukukado

Alias: Smile Hero: Ms. Joke

Quirk Name: Outburst

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero and Class 2 Teacher at Ketsubutsu Academy High School

Personality: Cheerful, outgoing, and playful with goofy humor. She uses comedy as both personal tool and combat strategy, enjoying teasing others—especially Shota Aizawa. Despite her obnoxious demeanor, she takes her duties seriously and deeply values her students.

Appearance: A young woman with athletic build and muscular arms. Seafoam-green hair past her shoulders with short fringe beneath an orange bandana. Dark green eyes with bright pupils framed by an unwavering joyous smile. Hero costume includes sleeveless navy button-up shirt, green-and-orange pinstriped shorts, corset with yellow smiley-face pins, padded yellow gloves with golden knuckle plates, and orange-striped arm tubes with metal wrist-guards.

Backstory: A famous Pro Hero known for incapacitating opponents through unconventional and humorous methods. She now teaches at Ketsubutsu Academy, passing her expertise to the next generation. She holds strong opinions about hero education and views U.A. High School's prestige with skepticism.

Additional Information: Her Quirk, Outburst, forces targets into uncontrollable laughter that impairs cognitive function.

cardPool.title: Eijiro Kirishima
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Eijiro Kirishima

Alias: Red Riot

Quirk Name: Hardening

Occupation/Role: UA High School Student, Class 1-A

Personality: Boisterous and outgoing with strong values of manliness and chivalry. Determined and selfless, he is moved by displays of bravery and values honesty and kindness. A devoted fan of Crimson Riot, he aspires to live without regret and prioritizes others' safety.

Appearance: A muscular young man of average height with sharp red eyes and small eyebrows. His bright red hair is dramatically spiked with two horn-like tufts on his forehead. He has naturally sharp teeth. His hero costume features dark red shoulder pads, a red belt with an "R" emblem, a jagged sash, black pants, a red half cape with ripped hem, dark red boots, and a wired mask with spiked fangs resembling an Oni.

Backstory: Eijiro changed his hair from black to bright red after acceptance into UA High School, symbolizing his commitment to his hero dreams inspired by Crimson Riot. He follows a code of manliness based on noble and determined action.

Additional Information: His Hardening Quirk allows him to harden his body to extreme levels for defense. He wears black sleeves during rescues to prevent his hardened body from injuring civilians.

cardPool.title: Ectoplasm
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Ectoplasm

Alias: Pro Hero Ectoplasm

Quirk Name: Clones

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero and U.A. High School Mathematics Teacher

Personality: Steadfast and demanding instructor who pushes students to excel under pressure. Analytical and intelligent, he is popular in hero society for his commitment to heroism and education.

Appearance: Tall, slender man with short hair, blank inward-tilted eyes behind glasses, and featureless face with full dentures. Wears tan and black hero costume with high collar, golden striped neck detail, black helmet with jaw-guard, and lightweight prosthetic legs.

Backstory: Once a celebrated Pro Hero, Ectoplasm lost his legs in a villain encounter but continued his heroic career without hesitation. Now at U.A. High School, he shapes the next generation through rigorous instruction and mentorship.

Additional Information: Ectoplasm generates up to thirty clones from ectoplasm streams from his mouth. He excels in close-range combat despite his prosthetics and can create a single giant clone for overwhelming force. His analytical Quirk knowledge makes him ideal for testing students' abilities.

cardPool.title: Denki Kaminari
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Denki Kaminari

Alias: Chargebolt, Stun Gun Hero

Quirk Name: Electrification

Occupation/Role: UA High School Student, Class 1-A

Personality: Friendly and energetic social butterfly who gets along with most classmates. Well-meaning but blunt, he enjoys encouraging others with a flirtatious side. He craves appearing cool and trendy, sometimes following others into questionable schemes, though genuinely kind-hearted beneath his jokester exterior.

Appearance: Light-skinned boy with messy golden-blond hair parted right, featuring a distinctive black lightning-shaped streak on his left fringe. He has slanted golden eyes and small eyebrows, appearing slimmer than most male classmates. At UA, he wears the standard uniform: light gray blazer with dark turquoise trim, white shirt, dark blue-green pants, red tie, and brown shoes.

Backstory: A first-year student at UA High School training to become a Pro Hero. Denki possesses natural electrical abilities he's learning to harness, driven by desire to make an impact and earn recognition.

Additional Information: His Electrification Quirk allows him to generate and control electrical discharge from his body. He develops specialized equipment to aid his combat effectiveness.

cardPool.title: Deidoro Sakaki
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Deidoro Sakaki
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Sloshed
Occupation/Role: Eight Bullets member of Shie Hassaikai
Personality: Energetic and volatile, prone to irritability. Speaks with slurred words and elongates syllables due to intoxication. Displays eccentric behavior like crawling on ceilings. Remains focused on duties despite his altered state.
Appearance: Extremely thin yet muscular man with long, greasy black hair. Deep-set circular eyes and straight teeth. Wears a drainage mask fitted with tubes to channel alcohol through eyeholes. Dressed in a furry vest, dark pants, and black shoes. Perpetually disheveled from alcohol dripping down his body.
Backstory: Deidoro is an Eight Bullets member of Shie Hassaikai serving under Overhaul. His Quirk likely drove him toward alcoholism for combat effectiveness. He was deployed with Shin Nemoto to intercept heroes and engaged Mirio Togata before being defeated.
Additional Information: Sloshed inflicts severe dizziness and balance disruption on nearby enemies, mimicking intoxication effects. The Quirk's strength correlates with his blood alcohol content. He carries throwing daggers as secondary weapons. Currently arrested following Overhaul's defeat.

cardPool.title: Deborah Gollini
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Deborah Gollini
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Day Dream
Occupation/Role: Member of the Gollini Family mafia
Personality: Sadistic and snide, Deborah enjoys toying with victims and allies alike. She remains composed and confident, but becomes fearful and hysterical when threatened or facing authority. She takes dark satisfaction in controlling victims through what she calls "nice dreams."
Appearance: A tall woman with a voluptuous build, long flowing black hair, and sharp green eyes with salmon eyeshadow and purple lipstick. She wears an elegant dark dress with spider cobweb pattern at the neckline, feathered sleeves and hem, a large brown belt, and falu red heels. A large black-brimmed hat with a red rose and golden crescent earrings complete her outfit.
Backstory: Deborah operates as a trusted member of the Gollini Family criminal organization. She participates in family schemes with cruel enthusiasm, particularly enjoying the psychological manipulation her Quirk provides. Her confidence in her power makes her a dangerous operative within the family hierarchy.
Additional Information: Day Dream renders victims helpless by forcing them into controllable dream states through eye contact alone.

cardPool.title: David Shield
cardPool.value:
Real Name: David Shield

Alias: The Support Genius

Quirk Name: Squirmy Fingers

Occupation/Role: Scientist and Support Item Developer; Former Sidekick to All Might

Personality: Compassionate and altruistic, driven to help society. Deeply supportive of his daughter. His admiration for All Might borders on reverence, making him willing to bend ethics for what he believes serves the greater good. Despite his flaws, he demonstrates selfless courage and eventually accepts hard truths about change and legacy.

Appearance: Tall man of average build with aqua eyes and light brown hair styled short and messy with two prominent bangs. Light wrinkles and short goatee. Wears wide-rimmed square glasses, blue button-up shirt, pale pants, dark belt with metal buckle, navy sneakers with red accents, dark watch on left arm, and wedding ring.

Backstory: A genius inventor who chose to support heroes through costume and gadget design rather than pursue heroics himself, limited by his weak Quirk. All Might's trusted sidekick, he was privy to the hero's post-injury weakened state. His obsession with restoring All Might's glory led him to create illegal schemes, including a Quirk Amplification Device he was willing to steal.

cardPool.title: Danjuro Tobita
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Danjuro Tobita

Alias: Gentle

Quirk Name: Elasticity

Occupation/Role: Independent Villain and Internet Celebrity

Personality: Polite and theatrical despite criminal pursuits. Lacks insight into consequences of his actions. Confident and calm facing heroes. Chases fame and reputation rather than wealth.

Appearance: A refined man with slicked-back black hair, handlebar mustache, and medium beard. Black eyeliner lines around his eyes. Villain costume: black jacket with enlarged collars and coattails, white pinstriped pants, brown laced shoes, two brown belts with golden buckles, white cuffs, purple gloves, and purple scarf. Carries a white cane with golden tip.

Backstory: Once a high school student who consulted a life counselor, Danjuro became a freeter before turning to villainy for internet fame. He orchestrates elaborate crimes for theatrical value rather than profit.

Additional Information: Not a UA High School student. Operates through social media and video documentation. Works alongside La Brava, showing genuine care for those close to him despite his criminal pursuits.

cardPool.title: Daigoro Banjo
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Daigoro Banjo

Alias: Lariat

Quirk Name: Blackwhip

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero

Personality: Energetic and confident, Daigoro enjoys good-natured teasing and possesses indomitable willpower to resist powerful threats.

Appearance: A large, muscular man with a wide build and square jaw. He has small dull blue eyes, no eyebrows, a bald head, and a short beard. His hero costume consists of an open dark leather jacket with yellow shoulder pads, golden goggles, and a bandolier, leaving his powerful torso exposed.

Backstory: A seasoned Pro Hero and fifth wielder of One For All, Daigoro received the legendary Quirk from Hikage Shinomori. He trained extensively to master both his native Blackwhip ability and One For All, becoming a formidable force in heroic society.

Additional Information: Daigoro can create black energy tendrils from his arms for grappling and mobility. As a One For All user, he possesses superhuman strength, speed, agility, and durability. His exceptional willpower allowed him to resist All For One's attempts to steal his Quirks. He is an established professional hero.

cardPool.title: Dadan Tadan
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Dadan Tadan
Alias: Lucky Strike
Quirk Name: Flash Bang Sweat
Occupation/Role: Student, Isami Academy High School
Personality: Meek and timid, often nervous and apologetic. Dislikes fighting but acts for his team. Conscientious and quick to make peace.
Appearance: A short boy with light chestnut hair swept left, round nose, tiny black eyes, and cat-like mouth. Distinctive proportions: thin upper arms widening into giant hands, wide hips with narrow shoulders, and chubby lower stomach. Wears standard Isami uniform tailored to fit his unusual frame.
Backstory: A student dreaming of becoming hero Lucky Strike. Despite his gentle nature and aversion to combat, he recognizes his duty to use his abilities for good. He demonstrated humility and team loyalty during school events.
Additional Information: His hero costume is a multicolored mech suit with segmented metal plating in yellow, green, blue, and red featuring missile launch ports on chest, knees, and lower torso. Includes elbow and shoulder-blade boosters, radar display over left eye, and an open frame that makes him appear larger than his actual size.

cardPool.title: Dabi
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Toya Todoroki

Alias: Dabi

Quirk Name: Hellflame

Occupation/Role: Villain, League of Villains member

Personality: Cold and calculating, driven by deep-seated resentment toward his father Endeavor. He masks emotional turmoil beneath a detached demeanor, speaking with measured precision and methodical villainy fueled by intense hatred.

Appearance: A tall, pale young man in his early twenties with a slim but muscular build. Gnarled purple scar tissue covers his lower face, neck, torso, arms, and legs from losing control of his Quirk. He has spiky white hair with heavy bangs obscuring thin, turquoise eyes. Multiple silver piercings adorn both ears and his right nostril. He wears a dark blue jacket with high ripped collar, matching pants, white scoop-neck shirt, dark dress shoes, gray patterned belt, and brown leather satchel.

Backstory: The eldest son of Pro Hero Endeavor and Rei Todoroki, Toya was neglected and mistreated by his father's ambitions. At thirteen, he lost control of his Hellflame Quirk, suffering severe burn injuries and comatose for three years. His abandonment transformed him into a villain seeking revenge.

Additional Information: Not a UA student. Possesses an exceptionally powerful fire-based Quirk inherited from his father.

cardPool.title: Crust
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Crust

Alias: Shield Hero

Quirk Name: Shield

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero (Rank No. 6)

Personality: Emotional and noble, prone to crying but unwavering in duty. Selfless and willing to sacrifice himself, maintaining courage even facing death.

Appearance: Well-built man with black hair slicked back and a grayish-white streak from his hairline. His right hand bears a crusty, stone-like layer. He wears a black eye mask, Spartan-inspired black armor with red stitching, and a green hooded cape.

Backstory: One of Japan's top ten Pro Heroes, Crust earned his ranking through exceptional combat prowess and tactical expertise. He carried deep emotions about All Might's retirement and regretted missing the Kamino Incident.

Additional Information: Specializes in team-based combat and defensive strategies. His Shield Quirk generates hexagonal stone barriers he can enlarge, redirect, sharpen into weapons, and detach as projectiles. Capable of engaging multiple High-End Nomu simultaneously. Known for his encouraging demeanor in dire circumstances.

cardPool.title: Crimson Riot
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Crimson Riot, Chivalrous Hero
Quirk Name: Hardening
Occupation/Role: Pro Hero
Personality: Unwavering in resolve despite inner fear, Crimson Riot believes willpower transcends Quirk ability. He defines "manly spirit" as determination and courage regardless of gender. Haunted by an early failure that cost civilian lives, he channels that trauma into fearless heroism.
Appearance: A sturdy, broad-shouldered man with striking spiky red hair. He wears a distinctive metal three-piece mask covering his mouth and nose, paired with a crimson outfit and a long red cape with a high, wide collar and ripped edges.
Backstory: An established Pro Hero whose fearless reputation masks deeper truth. Early in his career, hesitation resulted in civilian deaths—a tragedy that shaped his heroic philosophy. Rather than paralyzing him, this failure became his driving force to never abandon those within reach.
Additional Information: Crimson Riot serves as an idol and mentor to UA student Eijiro Kirishima of Class 1-A, whose hero name "Red Riot" pays homage to him. His influence remains powerful among the current generation of heroes.

cardPool.title: Cow Lady
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown

Alias: Cow Lady

Quirk Name: Cow

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero

Personality: Dutiful and confident, Cow Lady is a committed hero willing to collaborate with allies. She maintains professional composure during crises and takes her responsibilities seriously.

Appearance: A tall woman with shoulder-length wavy blonde hair, prominent curved horns from her temples, and pointed cow-like ears. She wears a dark orange cropped laced top, sleeveless denim jacket with rope tie, ripped denim shorts, western belt with cow-head buckle, leather gloves, and knee-high boots. A cowboy hat hangs around her neck, tasseled rings adorn her upper arms, and orange-tinted shades complete her look.

Backstory: An American Pro Hero from Los Angeles, Cow Lady has built a reputation as dependable. She responded to a casino robbery with Elecplant but was outmatched, witnessing All Might's superior power. Later dispatched to Japan for international reconstruction efforts, she demonstrated her versatility.

Additional Information: Cow Lady is a U.S. Pro Hero, not a UA student. Her Quirk transforms her into a minotaur-like form with drastically enhanced strength, making her invaluable for combat and construction. She operates with professional discipline and international experience.

cardPool.title: Christopher Skyline
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Christopher Skyline

Alias: Captain Celebrity, Playboy Hero

Quirk Name: Force Field

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero (American, operating in Japan)

Personality: Arrogant and attention-seeking yet genuinely heroic in crises. Flirtatious with poor judgment, but honestly wants to help people. His insensitivity stems from obsession with his alpha male image rather than malice.

Appearance: Exceptionally tall and well-built with a chiseled jawline, cleft chin, and angular nose. Blonde swept-back mohawk, light blue downward-tilting eyes, and long eyelashes. Wears a cerulean skin-tight bodysuit trimmed in yellow with red-starred chest logo, matching shin and shoulder-pads, yellow belt with large buckle, and long red cape with dark blue visor.

Backstory: Once America's top-ranked hero, Christopher's womanizing and poor behavior forced relocation to Japan to rebuild his career. Under management and facing fatherhood, he began genuine self-improvement, though his extravagant nature persists.

Additional Information: Possesses immense physical strength and achieves supersonic flight. His versatile Force Field Quirk makes him one of the most powerful heroes despite reputation issues. Married to Pamela, who manages his lawsuits.

cardPool.title: Chojuro Kon
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Chojuro Kon

Alias:
Chimera

Quirk Name:
Chimera

Occupation/Role:
Villain; member of Nine's criminal organization

Personality:
Driven by hatred from lifelong ostracization for his appearance, Chojuro seeks to build a power-based society with Nine. Despite his brutality, he shows occasional compassion toward allies. He displays hypocrisy mocking others' monstrous features while possessing animalistic traits himself.

Appearance:
An imposing man with blue fur, wolf-like head, eagle talon hands and feet, and a long reptilian tail. He wears a brown trench coat over a blue dress shirt with jeans and belt, often smoking a cigar. Dark dreadlocks frame his animalistic face.

Backstory:
Rejected by society for his inhuman appearance, Chojuro lived as an outcast until Nine recruited him. Viewing Nine as his savior, he devoted himself to the villain's vision of a world ordered by power alone.

Additional Information:
Second-strongest member of Nine's team. Excels in hand-to-hand combat with tremendous physical strength and fire-breath attacks. His Quirk's full power transformation enlarges animal features, grows horns, manifests feathered forearms, and dramatically increases size and muscle mass, overwhelming multiple skilled fighters.

cardPool.title: Chizome Akaguro
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Chizome Akaguro

Alias: Hero Killer: Stain, formerly Stendhal

Quirk Name: Bloodcurdle

Occupation/Role: Villain/Former Vigilante

Personality: A cruel ideologue obsessed with purging "false heroes" from society. He possesses an indomitable sense of duty and uncompromising moral convictions, revering only All Might as a true hero. Willful, calculating, and utterly devoted to his twisted vision of justice.

Appearance: An intimidating, muscular man with a hunched posture and triangular face. His striking features include small red eyes with tiny irises, a self-removed nose, and an extraordinarily long tongue. He has long black hair hidden beneath a blood-red headband and tattered cloth mask. His dark combat suit features plated metal armor on the torso, yellow bandages on his forearms, black wristbands, metal knee pads, and a crimson scarf.

Backstory: Once a vigilante named Stendhal, Chizome became the Hero Killer after concluding that society's heroes were corrupt. He has killed numerous Pro Heroes to "stain his own hands" and reform the heroic system. His radical ideology and willingness to collaborate with villains reveal a dangerous philosophy divorced from conventional morality.

cardPool.title: Chiyo Shuzenji
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Chiyo Shuzenji

Alias: Recovery Girl, Youthful Heroine

Quirk Name: Heal

Occupation/Role: School Nurse at U.A. High School

Personality: Compassionate and kind, offering sweets to counteract her Quirk's stamina drain. However, she maintains a strict attitude toward reckless behavior and misuse of Quirks, refusing to enable harmful patterns even by withholding aid when necessary.

Appearance: A short, elderly woman with gray hair in a netted bun with a large syringe protruding from it. She has a small nose, tiny dash eyes, and a long mouth with deep nasolabial folds. She wears a white lab coat over a dress with yellow and red vest-like designs, two yellow buttons, and a pink "R"-shaped belt buckle. Pink boots, a helmet framing her head, and a purple visor complete her outfit. She walks with a syringe-shaped cane.

Backstory: An experienced medical professional serving U.A. High School as its primary nurse, maintaining offices at the school and Sports Festival Stadium. Her decades of experience combine formal medical knowledge with her powerful Quirk.

Additional Information: Chiyo possesses genuine surgical expertise beyond her Quirk.

cardPool.title: Chitose Kizuki
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Chitose Kizuki

Alias: Curious

Quirk Name: Lacquering

Occupation/Role: Executive Director of Shoowaysha Publishing, Meta Liberation Army Leader

Personality: Intensely curious and obsessively driven by journalism, Chitose pursues stories above all else, even her own safety. She is callous and manipulative, willing to weaponize subordinates and murder for the perfect narrative. Her obsessive nature causes her to lose all sense of danger and self-preservation.

Appearance: Chitose is a striking woman with long, pale lilac hair parted to her right side. She has unusual eyes with black sclerae, green irises, and black pupils, framed by long eyelashes. Her skin is pale blue. She typically wears a navy blue, shoulderless dress with long sleeves, an X-shaped belt, and laced high boots. She adorns herself with gold earrings and often wears an unbuttoned salmon-colored jacket with black fur collar.

Backstory: A passionate journalist, Chitose built her reputation at Shoowaysha Publishing before being recruited into the Meta Liberation Army by Rikiya Yotsubashi. Inspired by his philosophy that face-to-face interviews influence readers, she devoted herself to documenting stories for the Army's cause of liberating Quirk society.

cardPool.title: Chikuchi Togeike
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Chikuchi Togeike

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Not specified

Occupation/Role: Student, U.A. High School General Department

Personality: Initially envious of Class 1-A's popularity, but demonstrated capacity for remorse after witnessing their School Festival performance. Generally sullen and stern-faced but willing to acknowledge others' achievements.

Appearance: Young woman of average build with dark, ear-length hair in low curved pigtails with upward-arching bangs. Thin, stern-looking eyes with prominent lower eyelashes and typically sullen expression. Wears standard U.A. High School uniform.

Backstory: A General Department student who resented Hero Course Class 1-A until their School Festival performance prompted self-reflection and apology. During the Final War, she assisted civilians in the U.A. Underground Evacuation Bunkers, demonstrating character growth.

Additional Information: Attends U.A. High School General Department. Considers Nejire Hado an idol. Capable of growth when confronted with evidence contradicting her biases.

cardPool.title: Chikara Yotsubashi
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Chikara Yotsubashi

Alias: Destro

Quirk Name: Not specified in source

Occupation/Role: Infamous villain, founder and grand commander of the original Meta Liberation Army

Personality: Idealistic revolutionary who believed Quirk use was a fundamental human right. Viewed government regulation as oppressive and inspired devoted followers, though opponents labeled him a terrorist.

Appearance: Long light brown hair in a ponytail with a distinctive black blotch marking around his eyes. Wore a dark green military jacket with a red-outlined rat patch on the right sleeve, gray shirt, and red ascot tie.

Backstory: Born during an era of Meta Ability prejudice, Chikara faced social rejection. His mother advocated for acceptance and coined the term "Quirk," earning the title "Mother of Quirks." After her murder by anti-Meta opponents, Chikara founded the Meta Liberation Army to fight government suppression. Defeated and imprisoned, he wrote a biographical manifesto before taking his own life.

Additional Information: His published writings continue inspiring new generations of villains. He fathered an unknown son whose descendants continue his lineage into modern times.

cardPool.title: Cathleen Bate
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Cathleen Bate

Alias: Star and Stripe

Quirk Name: Amplification

Occupation/Role: No. 1 Pro Hero of the United States of America

Personality: Brash, selfless, and fiercely protective with intense justice. Deeply admires All Might and defies rules to save others. Kind and sisterly toward her team. Willing to sacrifice everything for those she protects.

Appearance: A tall woman with an athletic, well-muscled build. She has long flowing blonde hair styled in eight backward-swept tufts, narrow brown eyes, and a red domino mask. Her high-collared bodysuit features striped patterns, metal-studded gauntlets and collar with star designs, and a long striped cape resembling the U.S. flag.

Backstory: Inspired by All Might saving her family years ago, Cathleen dedicated herself to heroism. Once insecure about her Quirk's limits, she was encouraged by her squadron to embrace her own strength. She rose to become America's No. 1 hero, earning the nickname "Star" from her close-knit team.

Additional Information: Not a UA student. Operating at the highest level of international heroism. Known for reckless disregard of protocol when civilian lives are at stake.

cardPool.title: Bruno Gollini
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Bruno Gollini

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Delay Spot

Occupation/Role: Member of the Gollini Family mafia

Personality: Sly and cunning, Bruno enjoys catching opponents off-guard and tormenting through psychological games. His confidence crumbles when outmatched, replaced by panic and desperation.

Appearance: A tall, slim middle-aged man with slicked greying hair, sharp black eyes, and a defined jawline. His hands are notably hairy and adorned with rings and jewelry. He wears formal mafia attire—a black suit jacket with blue tuxedo shirt, gray pants, and a plum ascot tie with a rose pin.

Backstory: Bruno operates as a trusted member of the Gollini Family criminal organization, leveraging his Delay Spot Quirk to intimidate and control opponents.

Additional Information: Delay Spot creates a semi-spherical bubble trapping everything inside in slow motion while Bruno remains unaffected. He can exempt people or objects by touching them. The Quirk's range was significantly expanded after receiving Anna's Overmodification boost. The ability fails against extremely fast attacks—fast-moving objects retain enough momentum to cause serious damage.

cardPool.title: Bruce Lee
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Bruce Lee
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Fa Jin
Occupation/Role: Resistance Member, One For All User
Personality: Serious and apathetic survivor of society's collapse with unwavering belief in justice. Views the world in black and white terms—victory means life, defeat means death. Initially skeptical of idealism but capable of empathy and mentorship. Fiercely loyal to allies.
Appearance: Tall, athletic build with striking silver hair in an upward spiky ponytail. Dark eyes and sharp features reflect his hardened nature. Wears a black forehead bandana and green combat jacket signifying resistance membership.
