Backstory: Bruce survived the chaotic early era when Quirks emerged, becoming battle-hardened. He joined Toshitsugu Kudo's resistance against All For One, becoming Kudo's trusted second-in-command. Kudo passed One For All to him as successor. Though initially refusing to mentor Izuku Midoriya due to doubts about the boy's optimism, Yoichi Shigaraki's persuasion led him to teach the young hero Fa Jin techniques.
Additional Information: Bruce is the third One For All user. His Fa Jin Quirk accumulates kinetic energy through repetitive movements and releases it explosively. He fought and died alongside Kudo against All For One.

cardPool.title: Briareos
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Briareos

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Multiple Arm

Occupation/Role: Tartarus Prison Guard

Personality: Duty-bound and resolute, remaining calm under pressure while issuing tactical orders despite overwhelming odds.

Appearance: An imposing figure in crimson and black armor with a sleek, intimidating helmet. His Quirk grants him ten arms, which he wields with practiced efficiency in combat.

Backstory: Briareos served as a senior guard at Tartarus prison's Bronze Gate. During the Paranormal Liberation Front's assault, he stood against High-End Nomu as dangerous villains escaped, including Tomura Shigaraki.

Additional Information: Briareos possessed enhanced strength proportional to his multiple limbs, capable of wielding heavy military-grade miniguns. He died defending Tartarus when a Nomu's spike barrage overwhelmed his position.

cardPool.title: Bombers
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Bomber (Designation Unknown)
Alias: Bomber, Next-Level Villain
Quirk Name: Explosive Detonation (varies by specimen)
Occupation/Role: Mass-produced combat entity created by the Villain Factory
Personality: Operates solely on programmed directives with absolute obedience. Completely devoid of self-preservation instinct or fear, making them ideal for suicide assault missions.
Appearance: Round, winged entity with jet-black skin and serpentine head lacking facial features save a wide mouth. Two bat wings protrude from the back. A swollen belly contains explosive energy reserves. Specialized variants exist, such as larger six-armed Captain Celebrity hunters.
Backstory: Manufactured en masse by the Villain Factory at Onomura Pharma Corp., these creatures were engineered as expendable weapons. Deployed by villain Number 6 against Pro Hero Captain Celebrity during the Tokyo Sky Egg incident as part of an assassination plot.
Additional Information: Combat-oriented fabricated entities, not UA students. Each possesses an explosive Quirk in its abdominal cavity capable of devastating detonation. Some specimens feature Regeneration or EMP generation. Nearly destroyed by Pro Heroes and Detective Naomasa Tsukauchi's police force during a laboratory raid.

cardPool.title: Blackbelt
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Blackbelt, Martial Hero: Blackbelt
Quirk Name: Fast Fist
Occupation/Role: Pro Hero
Personality: Seeks recognition while maintaining heroic duty. Attempts affected Shakespearean speech but lapses into normal dialogue. Creates unnecessarily complex techniques for show. Prioritizes saving lives over fame when it matters despite prior mockery nearly driving retirement.
Appearance: Young man with long, messy hair and muscular build. Wears martial artist-inspired hero costume with metal headband, loose robes, and large belt. Light facial makeup completes his stereotypical martial arts master image.
Backstory: Became Pro Hero 10 years ago seeking fame and recognition. Faced relentless mockery from civilians doubting his superhuman speed claims, earning the nickname "Hundo-Hit-Man." Nearly abandoned heroics until UA students Momo Yaoyorozu, Denki Kaminari, and Mei Hatsume created a high-speed camera drone capturing proof of his abilities, vindicating him and restoring motivation.
Additional Information: Fast Fist grants ability to deliver 100 consecutive punches in under one second, appearing as a blur. His Team-Up Missions performance, streamed via Mei's drone technology, finally earned him public acknowledgement.

cardPool.title: Yuyu Haya
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Yuyu Haya

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Unknown

Occupation/Role: UA High School Student, Class 3-A

Personality: Friendly and fashionable with a protective streak. Levelheaded and diligent as a hero-in-training, though her protective nature causes her to jump to conclusions. Highly loyal and supportive, especially toward best friend Nejire Hado.

Appearance: Fair-skinned girl with cropped salmon-colored hair, reddish-brown eyes with long lower eyelashes, and grey ear piercings. Her school uniform is disheveled with crooked collar and rolled sleeves, paired with tights and two pink bracelets. Her hero costume features a black domino mask, purple suit with yellow markings, purple boots with white and yellow accents, black arm sleeves, and a white belt with cylinders.

Backstory: A third-year student at UA and best friend to Nejire Hado since first year. Yuyu suggested Nejire enter the Miss Con Beauty Pageant and supported her through multiple competitions, remaining her dedicated attendant and confidant.

Additional Information: Yuyu assists in powering UA's flying fortress through her Quirk and mentors junior students. She is diligent and trustworthy despite her emotional investment in friendships.

cardPool.title: Yuga Aoyama
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Yuga Aoyama

Alias: Shining Hero: Can't Stop Twinkling

Quirk Name: Navel Laser

Occupation/Role: Class 1-A Student at UA High School

Personality: Vain and flamboyant with a closed smile, Yuga presents himself as superior and attention-seeking, often posing dramatically. He speaks with affected French mannerisms and ends sentences with stars (☆). Beneath this facade lies deep insecurity from his Quirkless birth and complicated origins. He is prone to upset if interrupted or questioned.

Appearance: A slim young man with an effeminate face, long blonde hair spiked at the sides with a curved fringe, notably long eyelashes, and bright indigo eyes. His hero costume features a black bodysuit beneath metallic lavender armor with golden accents, a high V-neck chest plate, spherical shoulder pads, elbow-length vambraces, and knee boots. A glittery indigo cape flows from his golden ring-buckled belt with blue crystal. A red-tinted wing-shaped visor frames his eyes.

Backstory: Born Quirkless, Yuga faced discrimination and parental concern about his difference. His parents contacted All For One to grant him a Quirk, creating hidden burden and complicated circumstances.

Additional Information: UA Class 1-A first year student.

cardPool.title: Yui Kodai
cardPool.value:

Yui Kodai

Alias:
Rule

Quirk Name:
Size

Occupation/Role:
UA High School Student, Class 1-B

Personality:
Quiet and reserved with a kūdere demeanor. She cares deeply for her classmates and shows warmth through subtle actions. She communicates happiness with soft "Mm!" sounds and shows particular enthusiasm for tomatoes.

Appearance:
A young girl with shoulder-length bob-cut hair, side-swept bangs, and fair skin. She has narrow cerulean eyes and an athletic build. Her hero costume consists of a red bodysuit with white-collar trim and a white "V" pattern across her chest and upper arms, paired with a short white skirt. She wears white vambraces with yellow accents, a red baseball-cap-style hat with white lines and yellow dots, and shoulder pouches filled with metal components.

Backstory:
A first-year student at UA High School training to become a Pro Hero. Yui joined Class 1-B and has proven herself a reliable team player, particularly in training exercises where her support abilities excel.

Additional Information:
Her Quirk allows her to alter the size of any inanimate object she touches by pressing her fingertips together to revert them. She excels in collaborative tactics, enlarging weapons for allies or shrinking items for surprise attacks.

cardPool.title: Yu Takeyama
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Yu Takeyama

Alias: Mt. Lady, Peak Hero: Mt. Lady

Quirk Name: Gigantification

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero (No. 23), UA High School Student, Class 1-A

Personality: Ambitious and egotistical, Yu thrives on attention and fame, unashamed of her vanity and sex appeal. She has a fierce temperament and lazy streak, but beneath her superficiality lies genuine heroic courage—she protects civilians without hesitation and refuses to transform in confined spaces to prevent collateral damage.

Appearance: An above-average height young woman with fair skin and curvaceous frame. She has striking magenta eyes with white pupils, long eyelashes, and voluminous creamy blonde hair reaching her waist with two shorter curled strands framing her face. Her hero costume consists of a purple and pale tan skin-tight bodysuit with orange stripe accents, purple gloves with orange cuffs, and thigh-cut purple boots. Three orange diamond-shaped marks sit beneath her chest, and she wears a purple domino mask with horn-like side protrusions.

Backstory: Yu discovered early that her Gigantification Quirk paired with her natural charisma could make her a star. She pursued heroics for the glamour and fame the profession offers, becoming a rising hero who leverages her appearance as much as her powers.

cardPool.title: Yu Hojo
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Yu Hojo
Alias: None
Quirk Name: Crystallize
Occupation/Role: Eight Bullets member of the Shie Hassaikai yakuza organization
Personality: Serious and loyal to Overhaul. Yu resents his past abuse and sees himself as worthless, but finds purpose through his yakuza family. He dismisses heroes as unable to understand bonds between outcasts like himself.
Appearance: A tall, muscular man with a shaven head and shadowed, intense eyes. He wears a dark dress shirt with top buttons undone, plain pants, and black dress shoes. Unlike other Eight Bullets, he wears a simple white medical mask rather than their beaked masks.
Backstory: Yu was brutally beaten and left for dead after producing worthless gems for a criminal. Overhaul discovered him and offered him a place in the Shie Hassaikai, giving him new purpose and family. Yu accepted without hesitation, transforming his despair into absolute loyalty.
Additional Information: Yu operates as part of a three-member combat unit with Toya Setsuno and Soramitsu Tabe, employing devastating teamwork. His Crystallize Quirk manifests sharp crystalline structures across his body to enhance melee attacks with tremendous force. He was arrested after Overhaul's defeat.

cardPool.title: Yosetsu Awase
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Yosetsu Awase

Alias:
Welder

Quirk Name:
Weld

Occupation/Role:
Student, Class 1-B at U.A. High School

Personality:
Foul-mouthed and tense normally, but becomes talkative during crises. Selfless and willing to risk himself for others. Proud and confident in his abilities. Strategic combatant with excellent tactical awareness.

Appearance:
Long black hair spiked upward, rounded gray eyes tilted inward. Wears a wide blue and white zig-zag patterned headband pulled low across his forehead. His hero costume is a burgundy baggy full-body suit with extended collar, dark brown shoulder pads, layered chest armor, white knee-high boots with brown accents, and two blue utility bags containing metal and wood blocks.

Backstory:
Ranked 10th in the U.A. Entrance Exam with the third-highest villain points. Trained rigorously to master his Quirk as both an offensive and restraining tool, proving capable of subduing even Class 1-A's strongest students.

Additional Information:
Weld allows atomic-level fusion of objects he touches simultaneously, working on organic and inorganic material. Uses steel logs to bind distant targets without simultaneous contact. Demonstrates excellent stealth capabilities and tactical planning.

cardPool.title: Yoroi Musha
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Yoroi Musha

Alias: Equipped Hero: Yoroi Musha

Quirk Name: Unknown

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero (No. 9 ranking), mentor to UA Work-Study interns

Personality: Traditional and duty-bound, Yoroi Musha presents himself as a steadfast upholder of heroic ideals, though he struggles with conviction under pressure. His heroism was motivated by fame and respect rather than genuine altruism.

Appearance: An elderly man with a bald head and long white beard, distinguished by pale orange eyes with black sclera. He wears a full suit of Japanese armor styled as his hero costume, complete with an upward-pointing horn on his helmet and a crimson cape.

Backstory: Yoroi Musha rose to prominence as the ninth-ranked Pro Hero through demonstrated skill in combat. He mentored UA High School students during their Work-Study program, including Mina Ashido, Toru Hagakure, and Yuga Aoyama, before the Paranormal Liberation War shattered public confidence in heroes.

Additional Information: His Quirk manifests as a white glow on his forehead. Despite his high ranking, he lacks resolve to withstand public scrutiny and ultimately retires when heroic ideals are questioned.

cardPool.title: Yoichi Shigaraki
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Yoichi Shigaraki

Alias: The First One For All User

Quirk Name: One For All

Occupation/Role: Historical figure; deceased hero whose will persists within the One For All Quirk

Personality: Principled and compassionate despite hardship, Yoichi maintains unwavering moral conviction and hope for redemption even when betrayed. He refuses to use stolen power and advocates for justice, inspiring successive heroes through his embedded will. Though disgusted by his brother's cruelty, he never fully surrenders his love for him.

Appearance: A young man with sickly, malnourished features and chronic physical weakness. He has shoulder-length white messy hair with bangs obscuring bright green eyes. He wore simple clothing—a white shirt with dark pants and occasionally a light blue jacket.

Backstory: Born as the younger twin to Zen Shigaraki during Quirk emergence, Yoichi was presumed Quirkless while watching his brother massacre innocents. When forcibly given the Power Stock Quirk, it merged with his latent transfer ability, creating One For All. Too physically weak to wield it effectively, he was killed by his brother—but his justice-driven will lived on within the Quirk, passing to rescuer Toshitsugu Kudo and countless successors sworn to stop All For One.

cardPool.title: Victor
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Victor

Alias:
None

Quirk Name:
Unnamed Finger Gun Quirk

Occupation/Role:
Villain, member of the League of Villains' Shooting Squad

Personality:
Confident in combat abilities. Limited personality data available; demonstrates obedience to Tomura Shigaraki's command structure.

Appearance:
A man with reddish-brown hair and matching eyes. His fingertips have mutated into gun muzzles. He wears a gray tank top and pants with gold chains on each wrist. A metallic helmet with greenish-blue luminous eye holes obscures most of his head.

Backstory:
Victor was recruited by Tomura Shigaraki for the assault on the Unforeseen Simulation Joint. He served in the Shooting Squad alongside Stitched Giant and Needle Hair, positioned to ambush U.A. High School's first-year students during their Quirk Apprehension Test.

Additional Information:
Victor was incapacitated by Eraser Head during the U.S.J. invasion when his Quirk was disabled. He was arrested alongside other recruited villains and later included in manipulated footage of the Deika City battle as evidence against the League of Villains.

cardPool.title: Valdo Gollini
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Valdo Gollini

Alias: Dark Might

Quirk Name: Alchemy

Occupation/Role: Villain Leader of the Gollini Family Mafia (Europe-based criminal organization)

Personality: Ruthless and power-obsessed, driven by obsessive admiration for All Might's strength while lacking understanding of true heroism. Calculative and willing to eliminate anyone to achieve his goals. Arrogant and vain, seeking to become the next Symbol of Peace through force rather than virtue.

Appearance: A lean Italian man with sunken green eyes, slicked-back black hair, and thin stubble mustache. Typically wears dark formal attire. His Dark Might form transforms him into a muscular blond figure resembling a younger All Might, with bushier eyebrows, a larger hooked nose, and green eyes with dark markings. He wears a white tuxedo suit with black accents, pale blue bowtie, red rose lapel pin, and eight golden All Might-emblazoned rings.

Backstory: Born into the Gollini Family mafia in Europe, Valdo rose through ruthlessness and ambition, eventually murdering his father to seize control. A devoted admirer of All Might's power, he became obsessed with replicating that strength, failing to recognize that All Might's heroism stemmed from compassion rather than physical dominance.

cardPool.title: Uwabami
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Uwabami
Alias: Snake Hero: Uwabami
Quirk Name: Serpentine
Occupation/Role: Pro Hero, Celebrity, Mentor
Personality: Celebrity-minded and vain, prioritizing modeling over heroics, yet capable in crises. Charming but honest about shallow motivations. Mentors based on appearance rather than merit, though maintains professional obligations.
Appearance: Curvy woman with long blonde ringlets held by a curved plate. Golden eyes with vertically slit pupils. Three living snakes—rattlesnake, yellow King cobra, and Japanese rat snake—protrude from her hair. Wears maroon scale-patterned dress, matching heels, and a choker with golden snake bracelets on wrists and ankles.
Backstory: Celebrated Pro Hero who leveraged her Quirk into a lucrative celebrity career combining heroics with modeling. Selected UA students Momo Yaoyorozu and Itsuka Kendo for internships based on appearance while providing genuine professional guidance.
Additional Information: Uwabami demonstrates genuine heroic capability despite superficial priorities, participating in major rescue operations and high-stakes missions. She openly acknowledges heroes can pursue side careers while maintaining hero work obligations.

cardPool.title: Untenmaru Kurumada

Personality: Stern and aggressive with a sharp tongue, unafraid to voice criticism even to his employer. Despite his gruff demeanor, he demonstrates loyalty and concern for Endeavor's safety, offering practical advice after dangerous incidents.
Appearance: A middle-aged man with a rectangular face and narrow, furrowed eyes giving him a perpetually stern expression. He has short black hair swept upward at the crown and a distinctive large white fluffy mustache parting in the middle with matching facial hair on his chin. He dresses professionally in a dark formal suit with black shirt and white tie, wearing white driving gloves.
Backstory: Long-serving chauffeur and trusted employee of hero Endeavor, Untenmaru has earned standing in the household to speak frankly about his boss's decisions. He serves as both driver and informal advisor during critical moments.
Additional Information: Not a UA High School student. Operates as support staff during Endeavor's internship program, transporting students and equipment. Demonstrates willingness to engage with volatile personalities despite their rudeness.

cardPool.title: Ugo Gollini

Telekinesis

Member of the Gollini Family mafia

Energetic and crude despite his elderly appearance, constantly mocking enemies with jokes and taunts. He enjoys toying with opponents but abandons banter immediately when family objectives take priority, showing ruthless pragmatism beneath his playful demeanor.

Appearance:
A short, elderly man with disproportionately long arms and short legs. His striking features include a long curved nose with thick grey moustache, dark tailored suit with gray bow-tie, black fedora, and dark sunglasses. Grey sideburns frame his face, and a red rose corsage adorns his jacket.

Backstory:
A seasoned Gollini Family enforcer whose long tenure and powerful Quirk make him a valuable asset to the family's criminal enterprises.

Additional Information:
His Telekinesis grants immense destructive power—capable of demolishing buildings and shattering ice. When augmented by Anna's Overmodification technique, his ability to control multiple objects increases dramatically. He will eliminate family members without hesitation if mission objectives demand it.

cardPool.title: Tsutsutaka Agoyamato

Initially critical of Class 1-A's prominence, believing their conflicts endanger the school. After witnessing their exceptional festival performance, he apologizes for his negativity. Shows civic responsibility during crises and respects upperclassmen like Nejire Hado.

Appearance:
A tall young man with a distinctively large, prominent chin and dark pompadour hairstyle. Wears the standard male U.A. uniform. His angular facial features give him a stern appearance.

Backstory:
A General Department student who resented Class 1-A for drawing villainous attention to the school. His prejudice was challenged at the school festival when their performance exceeded expectations, prompting remorse. During the Final War, he helped evacuate civilians from collapsing bunkers.

Additional Information:
Maintains friendships within the General Department, particularly with Chikuchi Togeike. Shows growth from his initial antagonism toward Hero Course students.

Appearance:
Exceptionally tall and slim with an unnaturally long, flexible neck and dark, heavily-lashed eyes. His long blonde hair is combed drastically to the left, covering his left eye. He wears a denim hero costume consisting of a high-collared shirt, denim waistcoat with large breast pockets, jeans, two belts, and short dark brown boots.

Once ranked No. 3 Hero and recipient of the "Best Jeanist" award for eight consecutive years, Tsunagu mentors young hero students to refine their character, believing even difficult individuals can improve with proper guidance.

Quirk Name: Larceny

Occupation/Role: Subordinate of Kai Chisaki and member of the Shie Hassaikai criminal organization

Personality: Fanatic and unstable from past trauma. Devoted to his organization, viewing members as "human garbage" bonded by despair. Bitter yet capable of tactical thinking in combat.

Appearance: Tall, lean young man with light almond-shaped eyes and dark circles. Chin-length bright golden-blond hair parted left. Wide mouth and thin upturned eyebrows giving a crazed expression. Wears gray dress shirt, light orange tie, dark pants, and beak-shaped plague mask.

Backstory: Betrayed by a lover and trapped in debt, he attempted suicide but was rescued. Found by Kai Chisaki on the streets, he joined the Shie Hassaikai with nowhere else to turn.

Additional Information: Specializes in disarming opponents using Larceny to steal weapons. Works effectively with Yu Hojo and Soramitsu Tabe through coordinated teamwork and tactical combat strategies.

cardPool.title: Toshitsugu Kudo
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Toshitsugu Kudo

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Gearshift

Occupation/Role: Resistance leader and second user of One For All

Personality: Battle-hardened and serious with stern justice, holding rigid black-and-white moral views shaped by warfare. Initially cynical and uncompromising in his mission to defeat All For One, though capable of empathy when he chose to save Yoichi rather than kill him. Prideful and fearless.

Appearance: Short, spiky ginger-salmon hair with slanted red eyes. Wears a green combat jacket with black collar and imposing gauntlets to channel his Quirk offensively. Lean but muscular build.

Backstory: A veteran soldier who led a resistance movement against All For One during the early era of Meta Abilities. Devoted his life to eliminating the tyrannical villain. His act of mercy—saving Yoichi Shigaraki—led him to become the second user of One For All, making him All For One's most despised enemy.

Additional Information: Deceased before the series begins. Ideological predecessor to Izuku Midoriya, eventually learning to value Izuku's belief that good exists in everyone's heart.

cardPool.title: Toru Hagakure
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Toru Hagakure

Alias:
Stealth Hero: Invisible Girl

Quirk Name:
Invisibility

Occupation/Role:
Class 1-A Student, UA High School

Personality:
Bubbly, cheery, and easygoing with an upbeat attitude. Socially eager and enjoys shopping and gossip. Energetic yet focused and reliable in battle. Observant despite her playful demeanor. Maintains optimism even in grim situations.

Appearance:
A short girl with a completely invisible body, identifiable only through clothing and accessories. When her Quirk glitches, she reveals a slim, curvy figure with long, wavy, multi-colored hair in chartreuse, lime, yellow, pink, turquoise, and light blue. She has bushy colorful eyelashes and large round eyes with teal-yellow irises. At UA, she wears the standard female uniform: gray jacket with teal stripes, white shirt, red tie, teal pleated skirt, brown shoes, and knee-high socks. Her hero costume consists of light blue gloves with pale pink lining and beige lace-up shoes.

Backstory:
An aspiring pro hero training at UA High School. Her invisibility Quirk makes her ideal for stealth operations, though she's still learning to master combat applications. She forms strong bonds with her female classmates.

cardPool.title: Tomoyasu Chikazoku
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Tomoyasu Chikazoku

Alias: Skeptic

Quirk Name: Puppet Master

Occupation/Role: Board member at Feel Good, Inc.; Leading member of the Meta Liberation Army; Lieutenant of the Paranormal Liberation Front

Personality: Devoted ideologue for Quirk liberation, deeply loyal to commanders. Stern and condescending, easily irritated, yet tactical when serving shared goals. Ruthless in combat with psychological warfare tactics. Becomes obsessive and unhinged when facing failure.

Appearance: Tall and lanky with shoulder-length shiny black hair parted by a fringe obscuring wide gray eyes. Long nose and wide mouth with straight teeth. Wears a long-sleeved black turtleneck beneath a formal black jacket with dark pants.

Backstory: Brilliant technologist who built Feel Good, Inc.'s systems and secretly rose through Meta Liberation Army ranks as a leading ideologue. Became instrumental in Quirk liberation operations and secured a lieutenant position when the Army merged with the League of Villains into the Paranormal Liberation Front.

Additional Information: Not a UA student. Highly intelligent strategist who commands from secure positions using puppet duplicates as expendable assets. Deep-seated fear of failure triggers psychological instability.

cardPool.title: Tomoko Shiretoko
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Tomoko Shiretoko

Alias: Ragdoll

Quirk Name: Search

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero No. 32, Member of the Wild, Wild Pussycats

Personality: Hyperactive and energetic with wide-eyed enthusiasm, capable of genuine concern for others. Highly motivated and unwilling to let obstacles prevent her from helping those in need.

Appearance: Young woman of medium height with long emerald green hair and large round yellow eyes. She wears a yellow Pussycats hero costume with pink whisker marks on her cheeks and a pink circle around her right eye.

Backstory: A powerful rescue hero known for exceptional ability to locate disaster victims and monitor allies during operations. Kidnapped during a villain invasion and stripped of her Quirk by a powerful enemy.

Additional Information: Formerly capable of observing up to 100 people simultaneously, tracking their locations and weak points with perfect recall. Now Quirkless but remains dedicated to hero work through alternative means.

cardPool.title: Togaru Kamakiri
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Togaru Kamakiri

Alias: Jack Mantis

Quirk Name: Razor Sharp

Occupation/Role: UA High School Student, Class 1-B

Personality: Hotblooded and aggressive with passion for combat, yet cordial and supportive of classmates. Competitive in battle, respecting rivals like Bakugo. Excitable during fights but level-headed in offering encouragement.

Appearance: Tall and slender with pale yellow-green skin and bright green mohawk. Pointed dark green eyes, hooked blades protruding from cheeks, mantis-like head shape with no visible nose. Wears dark green rugged cloak over zigzag-patterned shirt, black trousers, dark green three-toed boots, and eye mask.

Backstory: UA High School student in Class 1-B training to become a hero. Gym buddies with Tetsutetsu Tetsutetsu and rivals with Bakugo. Known for sharp reflexes and combat skill, including blocking Bakugo's point-blank explosions.

Additional Information: Quirk produces blades from any body part capable of cutting steel and iron while withstanding explosive force. Participates in Joint Training and shows genuine care for teammates.

cardPool.title: Tetsutetsu Tetsutetsu
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Tetsutetsu Tetsutetsu

Alias: Real Steel

Quirk Name: Steel

Occupation/Role: UA High School Student, Class 1-B

Personality: Hotheaded and outspoken, determined to prove Class 1-B's worth against Class 1-A. Confident but stubborn. Despite his abrasiveness, he is loyal and protective of his classmates.

Appearance: A young man with chin-length messy gray hair and black inward-tilted eyes rimmed with thick, jagged tan-colored eyelashes. Sharp, pointed teeth with no visible eyebrows. His hero costume features a dark pale green jumpsuit, black boots with metal plating, steel shoulder straps and arm bands with a red chest piece, brown sash with pouches, and a gray container on his back. A metal jaw-guard stamped with "Fe" covers his face. Athletic, muscular build.

Backstory: A UA High School student training to become a Pro Hero. Burned with resentment toward Class 1-A's superiority and Bakugo's arrogance. Earned 8th place in the Entrance Exam, ranking fourth in villain points.

Additional Information: His Steel Quirk hardens his body to withstand extreme damage, making him an effective shield for allies. Competitive yet capable of genuine friendship, as shown by his bond with Eijiro Kirishima.

cardPool.title: Tenya Ida
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Tenya Ida

Alias: Turbo Hero: Ingenium

Quirk Name: Engine

Occupation/Role: Class 1-A Student, Class Representative at UA High School

Personality: Serious and disciplined with strong responsibility. Earnest and formal, driven by duty to his family's heroic legacy. Takes his class representative role with utmost seriousness and maintains composure under pressure.

Appearance: Tall and muscular young man with short dark blue hair parted right, with a small shaved patch at the base. Sharp-featured with square blue eyes and pointed jawline; wears rectangular glasses. Most distinctively, his calves are engine-shaped with six silver exhaust pipes protruding from each leg. At UA, he wears the standard male uniform: light gray blazer with dark turquoise trim over white shirt, dark blue-green pants, and red tie.

Backstory: Born into the prestigious Ida Family of heroes, Tenya was raised to carry on their legacy. His older brother Tensei, the original Turbo Hero: Ingenium, inspired him to pursue heroics. Now a first-year student at UA High School, he earned class representative through dedication and leadership, beginning his journey toward becoming a Pro Hero.

Additional Information: Tenya's Engine Quirk grants him extraordinary leg-based speed and propulsion.

cardPool.title: Tensei Ida
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Tensei Ida

Alias: Turbo Hero: Ingenium

Quirk Name: Engine

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero

Personality: Laid-back and easy-going, Tensei embodies a "cool" heroic ideal centered on rapid rescue. He values teamwork and quick response over strict rule adherence, helping others develop their Quirks informally. Joyful and supportive, he takes pride in inspiring those around him.

Appearance: Tensei has square facial features with short, spiky dark blue-black hair and arrow-shaped eyebrows. Gold-colored engine exhausts protrude from both elbows as a result of his Quirk. He maintains a stocky build and typically wears his hero costume with airbags for aerodynamic adjustments during combat.

Backstory: The older brother of UA student Tenya Ida, Tensei established himself as a formidable Pro Hero under the Ingenium name. He built a reputation pursuing dangerous villains, most notably the speed-based criminal Batto Yobayakawa. His hero career was cut short when he suffered severe paralysis during a confrontation with the Hero Killer: Stain, forcing him into temporary retirement.

Additional Information: Tensei operates as a Pro Hero with his own agency and staff. He is known for his incredible fortitude and high-speed combat style powered by his Engine Quirk.

cardPool.title: Tatami Nakagame
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Tatami Nakagame

Alias: Turtle Neck

Quirk Name: Shell

Occupation/Role: Third-year student at Ketsubutsu Academy High School

Personality: Cheerful and socially outgoing, Tatami is friendly with peers and unafraid to ask rivals for autographs. She is direct and fault-finding, quick to call out others' shortcomings. She works well in group settings despite her critical nature.

Appearance: A pale, curvaceous girl with a muscular build and notably large, pointed teeth displayed in a constant smile. She has wide rectangular eyes with small blue irises and thick lashes. Her short ash-blonde hair features two longer spikes resembling fish fins on either side and a chin-length bang on her right. She wears turquoise fish-shaped earrings. Her hero costume is an aquamarine turtleneck bodysuit with a central zipper, salmon pink gloves and thigh-high boots with hexagonal turtle-foot patterns, and a cyan belt with a pink circular buckle centered by a white turtle shell gem.

Backstory: A dedicated hero student at Ketsubutsu Academy, Tatami competed against Class 1-A during the U.A. Sports Festival. She encountered them again during the Provisional Hero License Exam at Takoba National Stadium, where Ketsubutsu attempted the traditional "Crushing of U.A." ambush.

cardPool.title: Tamaki Amajiki
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Tamaki Amajiki

Alias: Suneater, Omnivore Hero

Quirk Name: Manifest

Occupation/Role: UA High School Student, Class 3-A

Personality: Extremely shy and anxious with pessimistic outlook. Despite crippling self-doubt, he harbors a brave heart and strong moral convictions. Inspired by Mirio Togata, he pushes beyond his fears when duty calls. Quick to dismiss compliments.

Appearance: Tall with pale skin and pointed elf-like ears. Dark indigo messy hair partially covers tired eyes. Hunched posture. Wears school uniform with loosened tie and large golden-buckled belt. Hero costume features black bodysuit with beige shoulder plating, white tunic and cape, hooded scarf-collar, silver front mask, and beige mask with purple lens. Purple carrier vest with brown straps and pouches. Fights barefoot.

Backstory: Member of UA's Big 3 despite overwhelming self-doubt. His partnership with Mirio and mentorship under Fat Gum shaped his moral code. Though anxious, he shows genuine courage when convictions are tested.

Additional Information: Tamaki's Quirk lets him manifest physical traits of consumed organisms, making him exceptionally powerful despite his timid nature. His pessimism contrasts with Fat Gum's optimism, creating tension he misinterprets as mockery.

cardPool.title: Sorahiko Torino
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Sorahiko Torino

Alias: Gran Torino

Quirk Name: Jet

Occupation/Role: Retired Pro Hero, Former UA High School Teacher, Mentor

Personality: Deceptively senile in demeanor, Gran Torino masks his sharp intellect behind forgetfulness and name-mixing as a teaching tactic. He is brutally demanding with his students, employing harsh criticism and physical discipline to forge stronger heroes. Despite his gruff exterior, he genuinely cares for his proteges.

Appearance: An extremely short, elderly man with a scrawny, shriveled frame and heavy wrinkles. He has light complexion, brown eyes, grey spiky hair styled short with forward bangs, and a trimmed beard. His hero costume is a monochrome full-body suit with a yellow cape, thick yellow gloves and boots, a "G" belt buckle, and a dark diamond-shaped domino mask.

Backstory: Once a tall, handsome hero rivaling All Might's build, Gran Torino trained the Symbol of Peace himself. Now retired and aging, he takes selective protégés under his wing, recognizing untapped potential in young heroes-in-training.

Additional Information: Despite his age and frail appearance, Gran Torino remains exceptionally formidable in combat. His Jet Quirk allows rapid propulsion.

cardPool.title: Snipe
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Snipe
Alias: Cowboy Hero
Quirk Name: Homing
Occupation/Role: Pro Hero and UA High School Teacher (Third Year Class Instructor)
Personality: Intelligent and levelheaded with strong moral convictions. Displays tactical expertise and tactical judgment. Humble despite considerable skill. Professional and measured.
Appearance: A cowboy-themed figure with a tan gas mask featuring triangular eye holes and silver ear-defenders. Dark bluish dreadlocks fall to his shoulders. He wears a brown cowboy hat with metallic "S" front plate, gray knee-high boots with silver trims and spurs, and a large red frayed cloak over a black tank top with white right-side armor. Black armguards, tan gloves, baggy dark pants with light brown chaps, and a brown belt with gun holster complete his outfit.
Backstory: An accomplished Pro Hero and marksmanship specialist, Snipe earned his reputation as Japan's second-greatest long-range combatant. Selected to lead UA's third-year students, demonstrating commitment to proper hero education and mentorship.
Additional Information: Commands exceptional marksmanship and strategic thinking. Wields modified dual guns and smoke grenades.

cardPool.title: Simon Gollini
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Simon Gollini

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Monster Summon

Occupation/Role: Member of the Gollini Family mafia

Personality: Enthusiastic and playful with an obsessive love for games and RPGs. He enjoys tormenting enemies and prolonging fights for entertainment. Despite his chill demeanor, he becomes flustered when caught off-guard or his monsters are defeated unexpectedly.

Appearance: A lanky young man with artichoke green hair featuring yellow streaks, long on one side with a curled end. He has a matching green goatee, multiple jeweled finger rings and piercings. He wears a mulberry pink tuxedo with blue floral suit jacket, navy tie, and tan oxford shoes with a rose pinned to it. He often wears elaborate wizard cosplay attire.

Backstory: Simon is an active member of the Gollini Family, a criminal organization that captures and places heroes in dungeon scenarios for entertainment. His fascination with games and dungeon mechanics has made him well-suited for orchestrating these twisted tournaments.

Additional Information: Simon's Quirk summons various video game-like monsters. When enhanced through Anna's Overmodification, his summoning capacity becomes nearly limitless, making him formidable despite lacking combat abilities.

cardPool.title: Shuichi Iguchi
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Shuichi Iguchi
Alias: Spinner
Quirk Name: Scales
Occupation/Role: Villain, League of Villains member, Vanguard Action Squad operative
Personality: Devoted to Stain's ideals with surprising moral restraint. Discriminated against his entire life, he questions the League's extreme actions and maintains unexpected compassion. Disrespects Heroes but holds himself to a code of honor inspired by his idol.
Appearance: A reptilian humanoid with bright green scales, pink eyes, and long desaturated pinkish-purple hair. Wears a white tattered cloth mask like Stain with goggles on his forehead, red scarf, arm bandages, sleeveless shirt, dark baggy pants with holsters, black boots, and metallic knee guards. Carries an enormous sword made of smaller blades bound together.
Backstory: Ostracized due to his Mutant Quirk's appearance, Spinner found purpose in Stain's ideals of hero reform. He joined the League of Villains, emulating his idol's aesthetic and philosophy while struggling with the group's increasingly destructive agenda that diverges from Stain's original vision.
Additional Information: Not a UA student. Member of the Vanguard Action Squad serving as antagonist during the Forest Training Camp Arc.

cardPool.title: Shoto Todoroki
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Shoto Todoroki

Alias:
A.C. Hero: Shoto

Quirk Name:
Half-Cold Half-Hot

Occupation/Role:
UA High School Student, Class 1-A

Personality:
Serious and reserved with a calm demeanor. Despite his stoic appearance, he forms genuine connections with peers, though he struggles with emotional expression due to his traumatic upbringing.

Appearance:
A tall, well-muscled young man with short hair split between white on his right side and red on his left. Heterochromatic eyes—turquoise left and dark gray right. A large burn scar runs from his left hairline to mid-cheek. He wears the standard UA blazer with turquoise trimmings, dark blue-green pants, and red tie with pale cyan sneakers.

Backstory:
Born as the youngest son of Endeavor and Rei Todoroki, Shoto was engineered as a Quirk marriage product to surpass All Might. Subjected to intense childhood training, he rejected his fire-based heritage. Accepted into UA through official recommendation, he seeks to forge his own path independent of his father's shadow.

Additional Information:
One of two students admitted to UA through official recommendation. His Quirk grants simultaneous control over ice and fire, though he initially favors only ice.

cardPool.title: Shota Aizawa
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Shota Aizawa

Alias:
Erasure Hero: Eraser Head

Quirk Name:
Erasure

Occupation/Role:
Homeroom Teacher of Class 1-A, UA High School

Personality:
Stern and logic-driven with high expectations for his students. Appears cold and impatient, preferring rest to unnecessary interaction. Despite his reserved demeanor, he is deeply committed to nurturing the next generation of heroes. Once a self-doubting student, his friendships transformed him into a determined educator.

Appearance:
Tall and slender with pale skin and shoulder-length, messy black hair partially obscuring his face. His dark eyes are half-opened, bloodshot, and fatigued-looking. He maintains a perpetually stubbled appearance. His hero costume consists of a baggy black long-sleeved shirt and matching pants tucked into boots, with a utility belt and signature wrap scarf. Bright yellow goggles are kept beneath the scarf for combat use. When formally dressed, he wears a black suit with blue tie, his hair pulled back in a low bun.

Backstory:
As a UA student, Aizawa struggled with self-doubt regarding his Quirk until his friendships with Oboro Shirakumo and Hizashi Yamada helped him recognize his potential.

cardPool.title: Shinya Kamihara
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Shinya Kamihara

Alias: Ninja Hero: Edgeshot

Quirk Name: Foldabody

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero (No. 4 ranked), Leader of The Lurkers

Personality: Calm and focused with unwavering composure in crisis. Intelligent strategist who quickly analyzes situations and enemy tactics. Selfless and brave, willing to take great personal risks. Maintains true shinobi composure.

Appearance: Slim, muscular man of shorter stature. Gray hair styled into three sharp points covering the right side of his face, with dark gray eyes and thin moustache. Wears a blue mask over his lower face tied with red yarn. His ninja-inspired costume features red shinobi shozoku under a blue robe, dark arm cloth with white forearm sleeves, dark gloves, and red scarf with white patch across his chest. Gold mask on right shoulder; red straps extend from belt and robe. Blue socks and yellow zori sandals complete the look.

Backstory: Elite Pro Hero who rose to No. 4 rank through masterful control of his Quirk and ninja-style combat. Leads The Lurkers as a strategic operative against overwhelming threats.

Additional Information: Master of Foldabody technique—can flatten and reshape his body into razor-thin blades, drills, and flat forms to navigate tight spaces or pierce enemies.

cardPool.title: Shinjiro Hohoemi
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Shinjiro Hohoemi

Alias:
Mr. Smiley

Quirk Name:
Smile

Occupation/Role:
Former Villain, Aspiring Artist

Personality:
Passionate artist who became disillusioned after art school rejection, turning to vandalism for recognition. Initially resistant to authority but not inherently malicious. Shows bravery and empathy when facing greater threats, capable of genuine remorse and self-reflection.

Appearance:
Lean yet muscular man with long blonde hair in a ponytail, light green tips. Large blue eyes and wide grin. Disproportionate forearms with large rounded hands. Wears a pink long-sleeved v-neck shirt with white frills, burgundy pants with gray cutaway and yellow buttons, yellow-buckled belt, black eye mask, and red cowboy hat adorned with two paintbrushes.

Backstory:
Failed to gain acceptance to art school despite talent. Pursued art through vandalism and graffiti as rebellion, initially using his Quirk only to evade capture. Eventually recognized his real problem was avoiding failure rather than confronting it.

Additional Information:
Carries spring-loaded shoe attachments for enhanced mobility. Uses a holographic projector to activate his Quirk remotely.

cardPool.title: Shinji Nishiya
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Shinji Nishiya
Alias: Kamui Woods
Quirk Name: Arbor
Occupation/Role: Pro Hero (No. 7 ranked), Member of The Lurkers
Personality: Serious during hero work but emotionally sensitive and discouraged when others take credit. Deeply moved by recognition from respected heroes.
Appearance: Muscular young man of below-average height. Distinctive puffy red leaf-like hair beneath dark blue bodysuit. Wears concealing helmet, wooden belt, knee pads, and shoes. Two wooden rings with branches hang from shoulders. Small rose bundle on left belt side.
Backstory: Talented hero who reached No. 7 rank through exceptional skill and dedication. Gained respect of elite heroes like Edgeshot, who invited him to join The Lurkers, an honor that deeply moved him.
Additional Information: Quirk allows enlargement and control of wooden body parts strong as tree branches, excellent for binding. Vulnerable to fire-based attacks. Considered a standout hero of the next generation.

cardPool.title: Shin Nemoto
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Shin Nemoto

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Confession

Occupation/Role: Eight Bullets member of the Shie Hassaikai criminal organization

Personality: Cynical and emotionally detached, viewing feelings as obstacles. Exceptionally loyal to Overhaul, whom he trusts implicitly. Specializes in psychological manipulation and guerrilla tactics rather than direct combat.

Appearance: A slim man with short, light-colored hair and bangs. He wears a black cape, baggy 3/4-length pants, pale sneakers, and a black bowler hat. Like all Eight Bullets, he wears a black plague mask.

Backstory: A former con artist turned criminal, Shin joined the Shie Hassaikai and earned his Eight Bullets position through cunning intellect and devotion to Overhaul. His Quirk made genuine connection impossible until meeting his boss, whom he views as uniquely trustworthy.

Additional Information: Shin lacks direct combat prowess but excels at marksmanship and psychological warfare. His Confession Quirk forces truthful answers, which he combines with con artist techniques to demoralize opponents. He works effectively with Deidoro Sakaki, who disrupts balance while Shin shoots exposed targets.

cardPool.title: Shikkui Makabe
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Shikkui Makabe

Alias: Mr. Smith

Quirk Name: Hardening

Occupation/Role: Third-year student at Ketsubutsu Academy High School, aspiring Pro Hero

Personality: Smooth and cool, popular among peers. Reserved but determined to become a hero. Strategic thinker who values collective strength and trusts his classmates' abilities.

Appearance: Entirely blue, rough, rock-like skin resembling a carapace. No visible hair, nose, or ears; wide jagged mouth with upward-protruding spikes on his face. Blue eyes with grooved patterns. Neck composed of stacked darker blue rings. Wears a black puffed parka with high collar over a thin white shirt, gold chain necklace, baggy cyan pants, and thick dark blue ski boots.

Backstory: Third-year student at Ketsubutsu Academy trained by Ms. Joke. Participated in the Provisional Hero License Exam against Class 1-A using strategic ambushes. Works with Yo Shindo in coordinated team operations, showing professionalism in combat and rescue operations.

Additional Information: Member of Ketsubutsu Second-Year Class 2. Hardens projectiles with his Quirk for combat effectiveness. Known for tactical awareness and strategic adaptation.

cardPool.title: Shihai Kuroiro
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Shihai Kuroiro

Alias: Scheming Hero: Vantablack

Quirk Name: Black

Occupation/Role: UA High School Class 1-B Student

Personality: A sly, deceitful schemer who catches opponents off guard with dramatic flair. He enjoys dark concepts and is nervous around girls, often misinterpreting friendliness as romantic interest. Despite his cunning, he shows genuine admiration for those he respects.

Appearance: A tall young man with fluffy white hair and long, thin black eyes. His pitch-black skin is tied to his Quirk. He wears a high-collared black jumpsuit with light shoes, large silver wristbands with rectangular indentations, and matching tongue designs.

Backstory: A UA student training to become a Pro Hero, Shihai has honed his abilities through rigorous combat. His mastery of stealth and tactical cunning make him Class 1-B's stealthiest member, excelling in espionage and ambush tactics.

Additional Information: Shihai merges his body with dark-colored objects and moves through them at high speeds, even while carrying others. He demonstrates exceptional tactical intellect and can briefly control other darkness-based Quirks when merged with them.

cardPool.title: Setsuna Tokage
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Setsuna Tokage

Alias: Lizardy

Quirk Name: Lizard Tail Splitter

Occupation/Role: UA High School Student, Class 1-B

Personality: Chatty, confident, and sharp-witted. Strategic in combat with a severe fighting demeanor. Reliable and commands respect from teammates. Naturally confident and strong-willed, though she can underestimate opponents.

Appearance: Average height with large upturned dusky green eyes and long pointed teeth. Dark moss green hair with a short center forelock. First hero costume features a purple scaly mask, matching bodysuit, black knee-high boots, black fingerless gloves with purple knuckle guards, and a black belt with a yellow jewel centerpiece.

Backstory: Admitted to UA through recommendation, Setsuna entered Class 1-B with exceptional talent. Her Quirk's versatility and natural leadership quickly established her as one of the class's elite students.

Additional Information: Her Quirk allows body separation for espionage and reconnaissance. Autonomous parts are individually weak but difficult targets. Among Class 1-B's strongest despite losing to Bakugo in Joint Training Battle. One of few Class 1-B students without animosity toward Class 1-A.

cardPool.title: Sensoji
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Sensoji
Alias: Mister Blaster
Quirk Name: Blast
Occupation/Role: UA High School Student, Class 2-B
Personality: Arrogant and self-centered, viewing himself as superior to weaker Quirk users. He is a poor loser who resents those who defeat him, particularly Shota Aizawa. Hypocritical, he claims others' ideas as his own while accusing them of copying. Despite his flaws, he acknowledges genuine heroic accomplishments from rivals.
Appearance: A large, muscular man with a square jaw, sharp eyes, and no eyebrows. His short orange hair features long strands at the nape and a pointed pompadour with sideburns. He wears a dark sleeveless tank top with a contrasting chest panel separated by white lines, dark trousers with knee pads, and fingerless gloves with forearm guards. Ring-like elements adorn his glove palms where his Quirk activates, mirrored as decorative rings on his shoulders, belt, and knee pads. He wears dark-lensed shades to manage his Quirk's blinding side effects.
Backstory: Sensoji is a Class 2-B student with a powerful Quirk and an inflated ego. His dismissive attitude toward weaker Quirks created friction with classmates, most notably Shota Aizawa, whom he deeply resents for defeating him in combat.

cardPool.title: Sen Kaibara
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Sen Kaibara
Alias: Spiral
Quirk Name: Gyrate
Occupation/Role: UA High School Student, Class 1-B
Personality: Levelheaded and calm with a plain demeanor. Open with opinions and unafraid to disagree. Matures quickly in combat situations and becomes enthusiastic. Belligerent enough to join friends' antics but remains composed overall.
Appearance: Average height with dark brown shaggy hair and distinctive black eyes with thin white pupils. Athletic build with slight tan. Hero costume features white windbreaker with spiral tube grommets, dark blue undershirt with drill-patterned rings, white sweatpants with matching patterns, red holsters, brown shoes, and spiral-patterned finger gloves.
Backstory: First-year UA student training to become a Pro Hero. Demonstrates skill with his Quirk and hand-to-hand combat using gyrating techniques to augment strikes. Bilingual and proficient against talented martial artists.
Additional Information: Considered attractive. Drill gloves amplify his Quirk's cutting power, making physical defense against his attacks difficult. Proficient in close-quarters combat combined with rotation-based fighting style.

cardPool.title: Satsuki Asui
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Satsuki Asui

Alias:
None

Quirk Name:
Unknown

Occupation/Role:
Student (younger sibling, not a UA student)

Personality:
Inquisitive and caring toward her family. She idolizes her older sister Tsuyu despite often being left in her care while their parents work.

Appearance:
A young girl with a tadpole-like appearance featuring large round eyes, small eyebrows, light-tanned skin, and a naturally pout-like mouth. Dark green hair styled in low pigtails reflects her family's froggy theme.

Backstory:
The youngest daughter of the Asui family, raised primarily by her older sister Tsuyu while their parents traveled for work. The siblings developed a close bond through their time together.

Additional Information:
Satsuki has a younger brother named Samidare. She idolizes her sister Tsuyu, who attends UA High School. The family evacuated during the Paranormal Liberation War while Tsuyu joined the final hero efforts.

cardPool.title: Samuel Abraham
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Samuel Abraham
Alias: Sam
Quirk Name: Unknown
Occupation/Role: Scientist and assistant to David Shield at I-Island
Personality: Initially appears goodhearted and dedicated to research, but becomes resentful and greedy when unrecognized; willing to betray colleagues for monetary gain, yet capable of genuine surprise at selfless sacrifice.
Appearance: An older, heavyset man with short blonde hair and closed blue eyes; wears formal business attire including a dark suit, tie, suspenders, and dress shoes.
Backstory: Sam co-developed the Quirk Amplification Device with David Shield, a revolutionary headset that enhances Quirks without side effects. When world governments pressured I-Island to confiscate the research, Sam grew bitter about lacking compensation for his contributions. During the I-Expo incident, he hired villains and conspired with them to recover the device, planning to sell it to the criminal Wolfram for payment. David shielded him from a bullet, nearly costing his life.
Additional Information: Sam represents how greed corrupts scientific progress. His arc shows how unrecognized effort can turn idealism into villainy, though witnessing genuine sacrifice offers redemption.

cardPool.title: Samidare Asui
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Samidare Asui

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Frog

Occupation/Role: Student (youngest Asui sibling)

Personality: Laid-back and carefree, relying on his older sister Tsuyu for support. Shows typical younger sibling behavior with familial affection and pride in Tsuyu's accomplishments.

Appearance: A young boy with a frog-like appearance. Black hair obscures his right eye, dark green half-closed eyes, and distinctive blush marks on his cheeks. Has a lethargic, unbothered demeanor.

Backstory: The youngest Asui son, raised primarily by Tsuyu while their parents traveled for work. Grew up in a loving household despite the hardship on Tsuyu. After the Paranormal Liberation War, his family relocated to an evacuation center while Tsuyu joined the heroes in battle.

Additional Information: Second-youngest of Tsuyu's siblings, with older sister Satsuki. Shares the family's frog-type quirk. Watched the final war broadcast with his family, cheering for Tsuyu's heroic efforts.

cardPool.title: Sajin Higawara
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Sajin Higawara
Alias: Sand Hero: Snatch
Quirk Name: Sandstorm
Occupation/Role: Pro Hero and Police Force Bodyguard
Personality: Compassionate and justice-driven, caring deeply about victims. Courageous but principled, willing to abandon battles to save innocents. Angered by remorseless villains.
Appearance: Muscular man with turquoise eyes and light ash-blond hair in a long ponytail extending from his dark blue mask. Wears a green and silver combat vest with connected tubes running to his back. Distinguished by a long mustache.
Backstory: Dedicated Pro Hero known for heroic principles and empathy. Stationed as bodyguard during Overhaul's transport, he confronted the League of Villains during their police convoy ambush, fighting to protect officers and prisoners.
Additional Information: His Sandstorm Quirk transforms his upper body into controllable sand, allowing him to form constructs and gain immunity to Tomura's Decay. His sand resists fire, but his lower body remains vulnerable to exploitation.

cardPool.title: Saiko Intelli
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Saiko Intelli

Alias:
None

Quirk Name:
IQ

Occupation/Role:
Second Year Student at Seiai Academy

Personality:
Arrogant and confident in her intellectual superiority, Saiko assumes leadership and formulates complex strategies with precision. She struggles with emotional reasoning and empathy, viewing decisions through pure logic. She is capable of humility when defeated and can recognize the value of bonds.

Appearance:
A pale girl of average height with thin, cat-like eyes featuring bluish-lilac irises. Her straight hair cascades to her waist in a hime cut, colored in pale blue-lavender-gray tones. She wears the Seiai Academy uniform: white double-breasted blazer with gold trim, dark blue long-sleeved shirt, matching dress pants, white gloves and boots, and a white beret with black trim. A golden monocle adorns her left eye, suspended by a chain with a matching blue-tinted jewel.

Backstory:
A prodigy with an IQ of 150, Saiko dominated her academy through intellect alone. During the Provisional Hero License Exam, she led her classmates against Class 1-A students with an elaborate plan to neutralize their Quirks through environmental manipulation. Her defeat exposed her blind spot regarding human connection and compassion.

cardPool.title: Ryuko Tatsuma
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Ryuko Tatsuma

Alias: Dragoon Hero: Ryukyu

Quirk Name: Dragon

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero (No. 10), Mentor

Personality: Humble and composed, Ryuko praises deserving talent without seeking gratitude. She maintains calm in combat and delegates tasks to capable individuals. She carries self-doubt despite her rank, feeling unworthy after failing to save someone. She displays a protective, nurturing side toward trainees and cares deeply for children's welfare.

Appearance: A woman with chin-length blonde hair swept back with a headband, long fringe covering her right eye. She has thin yellow eyes with reptilian slit pupils and sharp teeth. She wears a dark red qipao with yellow collar trim, pale green scale-textured shoulder trim, and side-slit skirt with claw-mark designs. Black knee-high boots, long white disconnected sleeves, and a green scale-textured headband with four silver claws adorn her face. Small black dragon wings protrude from the back of her head, with gold spiked ear piercings on her left ear.

Backstory: A seasoned Pro Hero who has mentored promising students through Hero Work-Studies. Once ranked No. 9, she dropped to No. 10, a decline she blames entirely on herself.

cardPool.title: Ryo Inui
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Ryo Inui

Alias: Hound Dog

Quirk Name: Dog

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero and Head of Student Discipline at U.A. High School

Personality: Gruff and volatile, prone to aggressive outbursts manifesting as growls and barks. Despite his rough demeanor, he possesses justice and fairness, praising students when warranted while holding them accountable for rule violations.

Appearance: Dog-like features including a scruffy blond mane sticking straight out and a slightly pointed snout. He wears a black muzzle as part of his hero costume. His frame is muscular and bestial due to his Quirk's influence.

Backstory: A seasoned Pro Hero known as the Hunting Dog Hero, Ryo was recruited as Head of Student Discipline at U.A. to oversee student conduct and safety. His role places him at odds with rule-breaking students, though he seeks to guide them toward becoming responsible heroes.

Additional Information: Ryo is a staff member and Pro Hero at U.A., not a student. His Quirk grants dog-like abilities including enhanced smell and the ability to manifest clones. He struggles with emotional control when frustrated, causing his speech to devolve into animalistic sounds.

cardPool.title: Ronaudo Keage
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Ronaudo Keage

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Not specified

Occupation/Role: UA High School Student, Department of Management

Personality: Enterprising and analytical, focused on hero marketing and public perception. Demonstrates business acumen in assessing hero marketability and recognizes the importance of media documentation.

Appearance: Young man of average height with short dark purple hair. Small round eyes and distinctive counter-clockwise swirl-like blush marks on his cheeks. Typically wears his UA gym uniform.

Backstory: A Department of Management student at UA High School pursuing business courses in heroic commerce. Analyzes hero marketability during events like the UA Sports Festival, studying figures like Izuku. Works in media production and public relations for heroes.

Additional Information: Associates with classmates Futo and Komako. Part of the business-focused track within UA's Management Department. His work involves understanding hero perception and marketing in society.

cardPool.title: Rikiya Yotsubashi
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Rikiya Yotsubashi

Alias: Re-Destro

Quirk Name: Stress

Occupation/Role: President and CEO of Detnerat Company; Grand Commander of the Meta Liberation Army

Personality: Outwardly affable but a ruthless ideological fanatic devoted to Destro's vision of Quirk liberation. Kills without hesitation when disrespected but shows genuine remorse. Intelligent and manipulative, he recruits outcasts by exploiting society's flaws.

Appearance: A tall, odd-looking middle-aged man with a long pointed nose and protruding chin. Short orange-brownish hair swept back with a widow's peak, small dark eyes, no eyebrows, and two dark moles on his left forehead. Despite appearing slim, he is muscular. Always wears a black pinstriped suit with a green dress shirt and tie, often with a black hat and coat.

Backstory: Descendant of the infamous villain Destro, Rikiya inherited leadership of the modernized Meta Liberation Army while building Detnerat into a corporate front. He genuinely believes society oppresses those with unconventional Quirks and recruits the disenfranchised to his cause of total Quirk liberation.

Additional Information: Not a UA student. Operates as a corporate villain-terrorist hybrid.

cardPool.title: Rikiya Eno
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Rikiya Eno

Alias:
The Instant Villain

Quirk Name:
Big Monkey

Occupation/Role:
Vigilante/Petty Criminal

Personality:
Reckless and easily influenced. Prone to destructive behavior when chemically enhanced. Limited baseline personality data.

Appearance:
Unremarkable in normal form. When transformed via Trigger, becomes a massive rotund ape with dark fur standing several meters tall, wearing only black shorts. Muscular yet barrel-chested.

Backstory:
A minor criminal who used Trigger to amplify his quirk for petty crimes and street chaos. Attempted to cause mayhem atop a city tower before being defeated by Captain Celebrity in a single punch near the Naruhata Festival.

Additional Information:
Rikiya's quirk requires Trigger chemical enhancement to manifest meaningfully. His transformation is temporary and reversible. He operates as a street-level threat outside official hero society.

cardPool.title: Rikido Sato
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Rikido Sato

Alias:
Sweets Hero: Sugarman

Quirk Name:
Sugar Rush

Occupation/Role:
UA High School Student, Class 1-A

Personality:
Optimistic and good-natured, Rikido enjoys baking and sharing sweets with classmates. He is humble about his talents and maintains an earnest demeanor in combat.

Appearance:
A tall, very muscular young man with short spiky brown hair, small square eyes, bushy eyebrows, and a large round nose. He wears the standard UA male uniform and a yellow full-body hero costume with white gloves, white boots, and a utility belt for sugar pouches.

Backstory:
Rikido developed baking skills out of necessity—his Quirk requires sugar to function, and homemade sweets proved more economical than store-bought alternatives. His culinary talents have made him a valued member of Class 1-A.

Additional Information:
Sugar Rush requires 10 grams of sugar to activate, granting five-fold strength increases for three minutes. Additional sugar extends duration by three minutes per 10 grams. Extended use causes cognitive decline and drowsiness. He trains extensively with weightlifting while consuming large quantities of sweets to maximize his Quirk's effectiveness.

cardPool.title: Reiko Yanagi
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Reiko Yanagi

Alias:
Emily

Quirk Name:
Poltergeist

Occupation/Role:
Hero Course Student, Class 1-B, U.A. High School

Personality:
Quiet and emotionally reserved with a fascination for horror. Despite her timid nature and cryptic speech, she is helpful. She maintains an eerie posture with elbows tucked and hands dangling.

Appearance:
A pallid, slender young woman with pale silver pin-straight hair in an unkempt pixie-bob. Her left face is partially obscured by sharp side-swept hair. She has dark prussian-blue half-lidded eyes with pointed lower lashes and plump lips. Her hero costume is a light periwinkle-blue kimono with a puffy hood, flared sleeves, white and navy striping across the abdomen, and matching boots with an off-piece neck mask.

Backstory:
A first-year student at U.A. High School's Hero Course, Reiko has honed her telekinetic abilities under professional guidance. Her analytical mind makes her a valuable team member.

Additional Information:
Her Poltergeist Quirk allows telekinetic control of nearby objects with significant weight capacity. She works effectively in teams, identifying threats and coordinating long-range attacks without exposing herself. She hosts horror movie watch parties and demonstrates strong tactical intellect in combat.

cardPool.title: Rei Todoroki
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Rei Todoroki

Alias:
Rei Himura (maiden name)

Quirk Name:
Frost

Occupation/Role:
Homemaker, Mother

Personality:
Rei is a kind, caring woman who endures hardship with quiet resilience. Once stoic and reserved, she became mentally fragile due to years of abuse. Recovery has restored her compassionate nature. She maintains hope and smiles despite trauma, showing deep love for her children while struggling with lingering psychological wounds.

Appearance:
A middle-aged woman of average height with shoulder-length straight white hair parted into three sections with long bangs. She has round, gentle features with tired brown-gray eyes and long eyelashes. Her expression is typically mellow and kind. She favors plain civilian clothing in soft colors.

Backstory:
Rei married Enji Todoroki in an arranged Quirk Marriage to help her family financially. She bore four children while suffering escalating abuse from her husband. The psychological toll caused a breakdown where she severely burned her youngest son Shoto. Currently institutionalized at Fujani Hospital, she has regained mental stability and reconciled with Shoto. She receives visits from her other children while remaining afraid to face Enji.

Additional Information:
Not a UA student.

cardPool.title: Pony Tsunotori
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Pony Tsunotori

Alias:
Rocketti

Quirk Name:
Horn Cannon

Occupation/Role:
UA High School Student, Class 1-B

Personality:
Friendly and naive, susceptible to manipulation but determined and observant in combat. She prefers tactical draws to reckless victories. When angered or flustered, she reverts to English. She enjoys anime and manga.

Appearance:
A short girl with a round face, delicate equine muzzle, and thick wavy blonde hair to mid-back with bangs. Large round Prussian blue eyes, tall lyre-shaped pale tan horns, horse-like calves with brown hooves, and a short horse tail. Her jockey-themed hero costume features an orange skin-tight shirt with pale markings, matching pants, fingerless gloves, a horse halter with lead rope, and belted boots with stirrups.

Backstory:
Born and raised American of Japanese descent, Pony came to UA High School to train as a Pro Hero despite incomplete Japanese fluency. Her unique physiology and Quirk grant her exceptional mobility and combat versatility, making her one of Class 1-B's fastest combatants.

Additional Information:
Horn Cannon enables rapid projectile fire and physical manipulation for piercing or pinning enemies. Her horns transport allies at high speeds.

cardPool.title: Paulo Gollini
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Paulo Gollini

Alias:
None

Quirk Name:
Erasure Spot

Occupation/Role:
Member of the Gollini Family mafia

Personality:
Cautious and dutiful, Paulo prefers swift execution over prolonged torment. However, beneath his stern exterior lies cowardice—he panics and becomes desperate when cornered, quickly abandoning confidence to beg for mercy.

Appearance:
Paulo has purple skin, small black eyes, and no visible mouth. His face tapers to a pointed muzzle with jagged fin-shaped ears. He dresses formally in a black suit with leather tailcoat, white gloves, purple tie, and black pants with brown derby shoes. A black fedora with ear holes and a red rose on his tailcoat complete his ensemble.

Backstory:
Paulo earned his place in the Gollini Family through diligent service but carries shame from allowing Ginji Kurau to escape with Anna Scervino. Seeking redemption, he eliminates threats to the family's operations.

Additional Information:
Paulo's Erasure Spot creates a dome-shaped energy wave that deactivates Quirks within range, though he can form bubbles where Quirks remain active. When artificially overmodified, its range expands to cover entire mountain ranges. He lacks the fortitude to withstand sustained combat pressure.

cardPool.title: Pamela
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Pamela
Alias: Mrs. Captain Celebrity
Quirk Name: Unknown
Occupation/Role: Former wife of Pro Hero Captain Celebrity, mother, businesswoman
Personality: Gruff and sharp-tongued, Pamela dislikes unsolicited help and voices harsh opinions freely. Beneath her perpetual frown lies a kind heart for those she cares about, though past betrayals make trust difficult.
Appearance: A short woman with a rounded face, long blonde hair, small nose covered in freckles, and large green eyes shadowed by a perpetual frown that gives her an intimidating demeanor.
Backstory: Pamela met Christopher in high school, unmoved by his charm. His persistence eventually won her over and they married, but his infidelity and womanizing led to estrangement. She became pregnant with their son before he left for Japan.
Additional Information: Currently raising her young son as a single mother while managing legal matters from infidelity lawsuits. She deeply loves Christopher despite his flaws and worries for his wellbeing, though she expresses concern through anger rather than affection.

cardPool.title: Oboro Shirakumo
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Oboro Shirakumo

Alias: Loud Cloud

Quirk Name: Cloud

Occupation/Role: UA High School Student, Class 2-A, Hero-in-Training

Personality: Jovial and energetic with a love of jokes and witty banter, Oboro is casual and somewhat irreverent toward protocol. His defining trait is selfless altruism—he readily helps others in need.

Appearance: A tall young man with light blue, wavy hair swept back with ear-length tufts. He has semicircular blue eyes often squeezed shut in an excited grin and a small white bandage over his nose bridge. His hero costume consists of a closed blue martial arts gi with black obi, black fingerless gloves, and a dark brown aviator jacket with white fur lining. He wears a blue aviator hat with large mufflers, beige goggles with silver lenses, black boots with white accents, and carries a deep red quarterstaff. An orange speaker hangs from his belt, and his jacket displays the kanji for "cloud" in white.

Backstory: A first-year student at UA High School alongside Shota Aizawa and Hizashi Yamada, Oboro trained to become a Pro Hero. His promising future was cut short when he was killed during a Hero Work-Studies battle.

cardPool.title: Oji Harima
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Oji Harima

Alias:
The Peerless Thief

Quirk Name:
Unknown

Occupation/Role:
Infamous Villain, Robin Hood-like Thief

Personality:
Philosophical and idealistic, driven by justice against corrupt systems. Steals from wealthy heroes to redistribute wealth to the poor, challenging the established hero system through revolutionary action.

Appearance:
Dark maroon spiked hair with orange bandana across forehead. Heavy clown-like makeup with dark lipstick and eye shadow. White male kimono shirt with black symbol, wide black belt, and blue striped shirt beneath. Light baggy striped pants with maroon tight boots. Bracelets on each forearm complete his theatrical jester aesthetic.

Backstory:
Oji emerged during the early hero system's establishment. Recognizing systemic corruption among heroes, he became a legendary criminal redistributing stolen wealth to the poor. His legacy earned comparison to history's greatest villains, cementing his place among the world's greatest antagonists.

Additional Information:
His revolutionary ideals passed through his lineage to his great-great-grandson, Atsuhiro Sako. Oji's actual Quirk remains undocumented, though his legendary status suggests considerable power rivaling formidable villains.

cardPool.title: Number 6
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Rokuro Nomura

Alias: Number 6, Rock, High-Speed Hero: O'Clock II

Quirk Name: Overclock

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero (undercover), Villain Factory member

Personality: Confident with a perpetual smirk, remaining eerily calm under pressure. Avoids unnecessary confrontation but employs violence without hesitation. Vengeful and ruthless, showing no remorse endangering innocents for his objectives.

Appearance: Athletic build with long, curly black hair in a ponytail. A diagonal scar runs across his face and nose, self-inflicted. Sharp, calculating eyes. Black full-body hero suit with blue and yellow accents, trench coat, and black fedora hat.

Backstory: Experimented on by All For One since childhood, suffering from agnosia without self-awareness. Molded into a confident operative, he now works as a covert Pro Hero while secretly operating with villainous organizations.

Additional Information: Possesses extraordinary disguise abilities through his Quirk, perfectly mimicking other appearances and hiding his scar. Can merge Bomber cells with his body to enhance transformations. His true allegiances remain deeply questionable despite Pro Hero status.

cardPool.title: Nyikang
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Nyikang

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Spirit Possession

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero (Sudan)

Personality: Composed and professional, working cooperatively with other heroes to neutralize threats.

Appearance: Tall figure in riveted metal armor with gauntlets, red and yellow sash, black branch-like head protrusions, and a riveted metal mask.

Backstory: Accomplished Pro Hero from Sudan invited to the I-Expo preview. Captured by Wolfram's forces, he was freed and aided in locating the Trigger Bomb and combating Humarise operatives in Egypt.

Additional Information: Carries a large sword as his primary weapon. Spirit Possession allows remote consciousness projection to incapacitate or control targets, making him a strategic asset in combat.

cardPool.title: Nirengeki Shoda
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Nirengeki Shoda

Alias: Mines

Quirk Name: Twin Impact

Occupation/Role: UA High School Class 1-B Vice Class Representative, Hero-in-Training

Personality: Humble and conscientious, Nirengeki refuses unearned credit and serves as his class's moral compass. He is reliable, collaborative, and mature. His classmates trust him implicitly, and he excels at reading situations and working tactically with allies.

Appearance: A chubby young man of below-average height with short, ice-blue hair and a round, boyish face. Large, wide eyes typically give him a sheepish expression. He wears a black high-collared hero costume trimmed with pale white lines, black pants, white knee-high boots, a blue scouter device over his left eye, and a connected radar on one gloved hand.

Backstory: A dedicated Class 1-B student at UA High School, Nirengeki earned his position as vice class representative through dependability and integrity. He impressed Pro Hero Shishido enough to secure an internship.

Additional Information: Twin Impact allows Nirengeki to remotely trigger a second, amplified repetition of any impact or attack. He can amplify his own strikes or magnify those of teammates, making him a pivotal supporting combatant. His power scales with base attack potency.

cardPool.title: Nezu
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Nezu

Alias: Mr. Principal

Quirk Name: High Specs

Occupation/Role: Principal of U.A. High School, Pro Hero

Personality: Eccentric and polite but with a darker side from past human abuse. Enjoys toying with opponents in combat and holds grudges. Self-aware and verbose, he genuinely cares for student safety while remaining unpredictable in conflict.

Appearance: A small white-furred stoat-like creature with circular black eyes, one marked by a large scar, rectangular ears with pale pink insides, and an elongated muzzle. He wears a white dress shirt, dark red tie, black double-breasted waistcoat, matching pants, and oversized orange lace-up sneakers.

Backstory: An extremely rare animal who manifested a Quirk, Nezu endured severe mistreatment and experimentation by humans before rising to prominence. He now leads U.A. High School, dedicating himself to hero education and student protection.
