Additional Information: Possesses enhanced senses, exceptional strategic planning abilities, industrial crane operation skills, and extensive security management expertise. Formidable combatant despite small stature. Adult authority figure and pro hero in administrative role.

cardPool.title: Nemuri Kayama
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Nemuri Kayama

Alias: Midnight, R-Rated Hero

Quirk Name: Somnambulist

Occupation/Role: UA High School Faculty, Modern Hero Art History Teacher

Personality: Playful, flirtatious, and perverted with unpredictable serious moments. Easily angered by interruptions or insults, sensitive about her age. Shows no shame in sexual behavior around students. Excited by displays of youth and chivalry.

Appearance: Tall, curvaceous woman with sky-blue downward-tilting eyes, long lashes, and long thick spiky dark purple layered hair with split bangs. Small beauty mark below left eye, pink rectangular-frame glasses, and pink nails. Wears a revealing black leather leotard over white bodysuit with red gemstones down the center, light purple thigh-high stockings, burgundy utility belt with gold studs, black stiletto knee-boots, red eye mask, wrist handcuffs, and carries a whip.

Backstory: Pro Hero and UA High School faculty member during Class 1-A's first year. Known for her R-rated persona and unconventional teaching methods. Goes undercover on missions, demonstrating commitment beyond classroom instruction.

Additional Information: Uses tearable white bodysuit material to activate her Quirk. Has monitored student tournament matches.

cardPool.title: Neito Monoma
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Neito Monoma

Alias: Phantom Thief

Quirk Name: Copy

Occupation/Role: UA High School Class 1-B Student

Personality: Loud, sarcastic, and mocking toward Class 1-A, driven by envy and inferiority complex. Calm and kind otherwise, but prone to unhinged tirades earning strikes from Itsuka Kendo. Deliberately provocative to push classmates forward, though sometimes insensitive and cruel.

Appearance: Average height with slick blonde hair parted right, shorter at ends with bangs over right eye. Periwinkle blue irises with white pupils, downward-slanting eyes usually half-closed, characteristic smirk and head tilt. Wears black double-breasted tuxedo tailcoat with long tails, upturned collar, light and dark blue dotted tie, small blue handkerchief in breast pocket, black pants and white shoes. Three clocks on belt track Quirk time limit.

Backstory: Class 1-B student harboring deep resentment toward Class 1-A after the USJ Incident brought them center stage. His envy masks genuine respect for his classmates' abilities and desire for equal recognition.

Additional Information: Divides society into "main characters" with hero-suited Quirks and "side characters." His Copy Quirk steals and uses other Quirks for limited duration.

cardPool.title: Natsuo Todoroki
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Natsuo Todoroki

Alias:
None

Quirk Name:
Ice

Occupation/Role:
College Student

Personality:
Friendly on the surface but harbors deep resentment toward his father Enji for family trauma and neglect. Cares deeply for his siblings, especially Shoto. Shows maturity handling sensitive matters, though struggles with forgiveness despite acknowledging his father's redemption attempts.

Appearance:
A tall, well-built young man with distinctive white spiky hair and two crimson-red streaks down the middle of his forehead. Gray eyes with long eyelashes give him a gentle appearance. His relaxed posture reflects his approachable nature.

Backstory:
The second son of Enji Todoroki, Natsuo grew up in a fractured household marked by his father's obsessive hero pursuit and emotional neglect. Separated from his younger brother Shoto during childhood and witnessing his mother's hospitalization shaped his worldview. His older brother Toya's mysterious disappearance further scarred the family.

Additional Information:
Not a UA High School student; currently attending college. Possesses Ice Quirk but lacks formal combat training. Represents the collateral damage of Endeavor's ambitions—caught between family duty and justified anger toward parental abuse.

cardPool.title: Native
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Native
Quirk Name: Unknown
Occupation/Role: Pro Hero
Personality: Easily irritated but fundamentally selfless and grateful. Shows concern for others' safety even in danger and demonstrates humility about his limitations.
Appearance: A muscular man wearing feathered headgear and matching cape over a dark jumpsuit with the letter "N" on the chest. Wears open-toed sandals and carries himself with professional bearing.
Backstory: An established Pro Hero attacked by the Hero Killer Stain in an alleyway. He was nearly killed before being saved by UA High School students Tenya Iida, Izuku Midoriya, and Shoto Todoroki. Grateful for their intervention, he rewarded them with theme park tickets. Later participated in the hospital raid against the League of Villains during the war.
Additional Information: Native's Quirk details remain unspecified. He is respected enough to be called upon for major hero operations despite being overpowered by Stain. His willingness to protect younger heroes demonstrates his heroic character.

cardPool.title: Naomasa Tsukauchi
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Naomasa Tsukauchi
Alias: Detective Tsukauchi
Quirk Name: Polygraph
Occupation/Role: Police Detective
Personality: Earnest and hardworking, Naomasa is strict about the law yet pragmatic when justice demands it. He values loyalty deeply but can be rigid about procedure. Despite his by-the-book nature, he shows willingness to work with unconventional allies if their intentions prove genuine.
Appearance: A tall man with short black hair and rectangular black eyes, Naomasa typically wears a tan trench coat with matching fedora over a white collared shirt and dark pale green tie, completed with brown dress shoes and white gloves.
Backstory: A dedicated officer in the Police Force, Naomasa earned the trust of All Might through years of earnest service and discretion, becoming one of the few aware of the hero's true weakened form. His sister Makoto, who possesses a Polygraph Quirk, shaped his understanding of both law and human complexity from childhood.
Additional Information: Naomasa possesses above-average deductive intellect suited to detective work. He is not a UA student but operates as a law enforcement contact. His pragmatism has led him to form strategic alliances with vigilantes when the greater good demands cooperation.

cardPool.title: Nana Shimura
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Nana Shimura

Alias:
The Seventh One For All User

Quirk Name:
One For All

Occupation/Role:
Pro Hero and former mentor to All Might

Personality:
A kind woman with strong sense of justice who believes true heroes must smile to save lives and hearts. Grounded yet optimistic about others' potential, she valued bravery, emotional resilience, and self-sacrifice.

Appearance:
A tall, fair-skinned woman with athletic build. She has dark shoulder-length hair in a half-up-half-down bun with short bangs, sharp intelligent eyes, and a small mole below her bottom lip. Her hero costume features a dark sleeveless bodysuit with high collar, yellow gloves, white knee-high boots, golden belt buckle, a small cape, and buttoned shoulder capes.

Backstory:
Once the symbol of hope for her generation, Nana mentored Toshinori Yagi and instilled in him the smiling hero philosophy. She placed her son Kotaro in foster care to protect him from her dangerous hero life—a decision that led to her grandson Tenko's corruption into the villain Tomura Shigaraki.

Additional Information:
Deceased prior to the current timeline, killed by All For One. She remains a legendary figure whose ideals shaped All Might's heroic philosophy and whose tragic family legacy haunts the present.

cardPool.title: Mustard
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Mustard
Alias: Mustard
Quirk Name: Gas
Occupation/Role: C-rank villain, League of Villains Vanguard Action Squad member
Personality: Pragmatic and merciless, valuing function over style. Highly intelligent and calculating. Arrogant and boastful, harboring deep jealousy toward UA students whom he views as undeserving. Shows exceptional cruelty and willingness to kill without hesitation.
Appearance: Skinny young man with short, wavy light brown hair and tan skin. Brown eyes peer from behind a green gas mask connected to two oxygen tanks on his back. Wears a black gakuran school uniform with teal gloves and white shoes.
Backstory: A League of Villains member in the Vanguard Action Squad. His resentment toward UA High School drives his motivation, viewing student success as unearned privilege.
Additional Information: Lacks hand-to-hand combat skills, relying entirely on his Gas Quirk and a 38 revolver. Must continuously produce gas to maintain effects; it dissipates quickly when he stops. Cannot survive his own gas without his mask and oxygen supply. Can sense enemy movement within his gas by detecting fluctuations.

cardPool.title: Moyuru Tochi
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Moyuru Tochi

Alias:
None

Quirk Name:
Ignition

Occupation/Role:
Former Instant Villain, Reformed Vigilante

Personality:
Once a callous bully, Moyuru underwent dramatic personality shift after his defeat and arrest. He is now calm, respectful, and remorseful. He shows genuine kindness toward former victims and camaraderie with peers.

Appearance:
A large, portly young man with dark brown skin and bald head. A small flame grows from the top of his head as hair, extinguishing when unconscious. He has rounded, pupilless eyes. He wears a purple open button-down shirt with prominent belly showing, shorts, and slippers.

Backstory:
Moyuru was an Instant Villain who used Trigger to enhance his abilities and terrorize weaker citizens with accomplices Soga and Rapt. His criminal career ended when defeated and arrested by Knuckleduster, sparking genuine reformation.

Additional Information:
Under Trigger's influence, his physique expands, skin develops stony texture, and flames spread across his upper body, increasing his power significantly. He respectfully refers to Koichi, a former victim, as "Big Man."

cardPool.title: Moonfish
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Moonfish (true name unknown)
Alias: Moonfish
Quirk Name: Blade-Tooth
Occupation/Role: Villain, League of Villains Vanguard Action Squad member
Personality: Insane and laconic, consumed by obsessive hunger for flesh. Constantly mutters to himself, easily distracted by any source of flesh. Prioritizes hunger above ideology and shows no mercy, willing to kill allies and enemies alike to satisfy cravings. Despite madness, demonstrates tactical capability.
Appearance: Tall man with fair skin and black eyes, almost entirely obscured by restraint gear. Black straitjacket with black restraints decorated with red spikes. Metal clamps on head force lips open, causing constant drooling. Additional straps cross torso, waist, and boots. Shaven head bears large cut on left ear. Only mouth exposed, revealing his weapon.
Backstory: Member of League of Villains' Vanguard Action Squad, likely joined for access to hunting grounds rather than ideology. Serves as primary antagonist during Forest Training Camp Arc, pursuing victims with single-minded determination. Eventually imprisoned in Tartarus awaiting execution.
Additional Information: Formidable long-range combatant capable of dominating multiple opponents.

cardPool.title: Anan Kurose
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Anan Kurose

Alias: Space Hero: Thirteen

Quirk Name: Black Hole

Occupation/Role: Pro Hero and UA High School Faculty Member

Personality: Wise and well-mannered, passionate about rescue work and saving lives. Advocates for constructive Quirk use despite her own Quirk's lethal potential. Brave and selfless, willing to engage in combat despite not being combat-oriented.

Appearance: Young woman with short navy blue hair and a blonde spiral patch at the roots. Hazel irises ringed like black holes. Black substance coating her hands and forearms. Wears a white puffy space suit-style jacket, black helmet with white eye markings, and yellow boots.

Backstory: Dedicated Pro Hero specializing in search and rescue operations. Developed the Unforeseen Simulation Joint to teach future heroes rescue tactics. Serves as faculty at UA High School, guiding the next generation of heroes.

Additional Information: Uses specialized gloves with flippable fingertips to control her Quirk's destructive output. More open fingers equal greater power. Non-combat teacher who uses high-density weight handicaps during student evaluations.

cardPool.title: Anna Scervino
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Anna Scervino

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Overmodification

Occupation/Role: Civilian (formerly imprisoned by the Gollini Family mafia)

Personality: Frightened and melancholic from trauma, but naturally joyful when given safety. Harbors deep PTSD from losing her family to the mafia and has an aversion to violence. Desperate enough to seek dark solutions, yet capable of optimism when freed from her burden.

Appearance: A young woman with waist-length light peach hair and blue eyes that darken when her Quirk activates. She wears a long-sleeved pink and white dress with a red bow on her chest and head, and a pink choker. Her delicate appearance contrasts with the dangerous power she harbors.

Backstory: Anna grew up isolated due to her dangerous Quirk that causes pain to those incompatible with it. Only her butler Giulio Gandini could safely remain near her due to his Neutralization Quirk. After the Paranormal Liberation War, the Gollini Family kidnapped her to exploit her power. She was rescued by Class 1-A students and Giulio, whose enhanced Neutralization permanently deactivated her Quirk.

Additional Information: Not a UA student; a civilian victim of organized crime. Her Quirk reached Singularity levels.

cardPool.title: Lunch Rush
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown
Alias: Cook Hero: Lunch Rush
Quirk Name: Unknown
Occupation/Role: Pro Hero and U.A. High School cafeteria chef
Personality: Upbeat and enthusiastic, communicates through thumbs-up gestures and nonverbal cues. Dedicated and supportive of students.
Appearance: Wears a white chef hat, cooking apron, white gloves, and white shoes. A tube extends from his mouth to his back. Face mask obscures his features. Medium build.
Backstory: An accomplished Pro Hero who dedicated himself to feeding U.A. students. Six years prior, he prepared full-course French meals for ten-thousand typhoon victims, demonstrating exceptional skill and compassion.
Additional Information: Renowned for exceptional cuisine quality and variety. Students never tire of his meals. Assigned to support critical missions with sustenance for high-endurance operations. His Quirk remains unconfirmed.

cardPool.title: Navel Laser
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Navel Laser

Description:
A light-based offensive quirk that fires brilliant laser beams from the user's navel. The beams can pierce concrete and destroy metal, ranging from short to long-range. Originally stolen and implanted by All For One, this quirk requires external support to function properly.

Functions/Applications:
Beams can be reshaped into blades or projectiles and manipulated in size. Strong recoil propels the user through the air for mobility. Intense brightness illuminates dark areas. With specialized equipment, beams can be fired from multiple body points. User can manipulate beam properties with precision.

Limits:
Without the Sparkle Belt, the quirk cannot be controlled or aimed. Continuous firing causes internal damage and overuse risks loss of bowel control. User can only naturally fire straight ahead, leaving rear exposure vulnerable. The implanted nature causes constant energy leakage without equipment support.

Additional Notes:
Training increases duration, frequency, and power output. The user has developed a flamboyant fighting style with this quirk.

cardPool.title: Big Red Dot
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Unknown

Alias: Big Red Dot

Quirk Name: Tidal Bore

Occupation/Role: Number 1 Pro Hero of Singapore

Personality: Caring and loyal with strong justice and leadership qualities. Maintains composure under pressure and readily sacrifices for others.

Appearance: Well-built man with a lion's head and webbed feet. Wears a sleeveless light blue wetsuit with water-design belt, elbow-length arm guards, and shoulder pads bearing the Singaporean flag. Small domino mask completes his costume.

Backstory: Singapore's top-ranked hero and trusted ally of All Might. Proven capability in coordinated multi-national operations against terrorist threats, including the Humarise organization.

Additional Information: Leads international hero task forces. His Quirk manipulates water with tremendous force, capable of lifting large objects to high altitudes. Maintains strong bonds with fellow heroes and eagerly aids allies in crisis.

cardPool.title: All For One
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Zen Shigaraki

Alias: All For One

Quirk Name: All For One

Occupation/Role: Founder and leader of the League of Villains; Japan's most powerful villain

Personality: Cold, calculating, and tyrannical with unwavering conviction in world domination. Patient and obsessed, willing to orchestrate schemes across decades. A manipulative strategist who values power above all else.

Appearance: Towering and muscular with severe scarring covering his entire head and face. Features composed almost entirely of scar tissue with no visible nose, ears, or hair; faded white eyes barely discernible. Wears a dark formal suit, white collared shirt, and dark navy skull-like gas mask with angular tubes and life-support collar system with connecting pipes around his neck.

Backstory: Japan's most powerful villain and All Might's arch-nemesis, All For One sought to steal One For All from his younger twin brother. He founded the League of Villains and adopted Tomura Shigaraki, grooming him as a successor and consciousness vessel for his century-long conquest plan. Imprisoned in Tartarus, he escaped months later and seeks to destroy Izuku Midoriya.

Additional Information: Blind from his injuries, he compensates using an Infrared Quirk and vibration sensing.

cardPool.title: Toshinori Yagi
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Toshinori Yagi

Alias:
All Might

Quirk Name:
One For All

Occupation/Role:
Foundational Hero Studies Teacher, UA High School

Personality:
Charismatic and heroic with unwavering justice. Burdened by his title as Symbol of Peace but dedicates himself to mentoring through conviction and example.

Appearance:
In empowered form, imposingly muscular with chiseled features and strong jawline. Short blond hair swept back with two distinctive front tufts. Deep blue eyes with shadowed sockets. Wears iconic Golden Age costume: skin-tight blue bodysuit with red "Y" symbol on chest, white diamond at center, large white hip patches with red trim, yellow forearm sleeves, and yellow belt with silver buckle.

Backstory:
The eighth holder of One For All, inherited from Nana Shimura. Japan's No. 1 Pro Hero and Symbol of Peace. Now teaches at UA High School while training successor Izuku Midoriya to carry on his legacy.

Additional Information:
Active as hero and teacher during Class 1-A's first year. The shadowed appearance around his eyes marks the toll of heroic battles, particularly his confrontation with All For One.

cardPool.title: Erasure Spot
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Erasure Spot

Description:
Paulo Gollini manifests a dome-shaped energy wave that deactivates all Quirks within range indiscriminately. He can create a smaller protective bubble inside where Quirks remain active. When artificially boosted, the range expands to cover entire mountain ranges.

Functions/Applications:
Creates a nullification field that strips enemies of Quirk abilities, forcing reliance on physical prowess. The inner bubble allows allies with non-Quirk combat skills to function while enemies outside remain powerless. Useful for disorienting opponents and controlling battlefield positioning.

Limits:
The outer dome nullifies Quirks indiscriminately, affecting allies outside the inner bubble. Fast opponents can breach the field to reach the user and reactivate their Quirks. The strategy becomes predictable once support units are eliminated. Cannot selectively disable only enemy Quirks.

Additional Notes:
Paulo relies heavily on minions with non-Quirk abilities or Quirks that function within the field. Excels at area denial and crowd control but requires careful positioning and team coordination. Without allies or defensive support, Paulo lacks direct offensive capability against Quirk-users who breach his defenses.

cardPool.title: En Tayutai
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
En Tayutai

Alias:
Smoke-Eater

Quirk Name:
Smokescreen

Occupation/Role:
Former Pro Hero, Sixth User of One For All

Personality:
Reserved but friendly with strong willpower. Generally composed, though emotions surface when concerned for others. Shows self-deprecation about his Quirk's weakness, yet genuine warmth toward creative applications of his abilities.

Appearance:
A short man with dark hair parted away from narrow eyes. His hero costume features a large red jacket with straps and buttons, high collar obscuring his mouth and nose, dark baggy pants, large white hiking boots, and sports tape on his forearms.

Backstory:
En received One For All from Daigoro after the previous user fell to All For One. He resisted All For One's attempts to steal the Quirk twice, demonstrating exceptional willpower. He founded a resistance movement with other heroes to fight All For One, sacrificing himself in combat while transferring One For All to the next user.

Additional Information:
As a One For All user, En possessed superhuman strength, speed, agility, and durability. His Smokescreen Quirk generated purple smoke to obscure vision. He survived severe injuries to fulfill his duty as Quirk bearer, embodying the resolve of One For All's guardians.

cardPool.title: Ground Beta
cardPool.value:
Name: Ground Beta

Location: Urban training facility with interconnected streets and multi-story buildings for combat exercises.

Inhabitants: Security robots, instructors in basement monitoring rooms, student combatants during trials.

Appearance: A replica urban district with realistic streets and reinforced office buildings. Basement levels contain observation decks with monitoring screens. Architecture is sturdy and designed to withstand repeated combat training.

cardPool.title: Ground Gamma
cardPool.value:
Name:
Ground Gamma

Location:
An abandoned industrial complex with interconnected factories, heavy machinery, cranes, pipelines, and metal structures creating multiple elevation levels and precarious pathways.

Inhabitants:
Pro Heroes conducting training exercises, students undergoing combat trials, and authority figures like Principal Nezu overseeing practical examinations.

Appearance:
A sprawling maze of rust-streaked factories and towering industrial equipment. Massive cranes loom overhead, pipelines crisscross at various heights, and metal catwalks offer unstable footing. The ground is littered with debris and fallen machinery. Vertical movement is heavily favored with treacherous passages and crane-based traversal routes. The environment tests agility, endurance, and adaptability under pressure.

cardPool.title: Ground Omega
cardPool.value:
Name:
Ground Omega

Location:
A walled training grounds with a single entrance marked by an omega symbol. Dense woods interspersed with rocky hills. An observation post building stands adjacent to monitor activities.

Inhabitants:
Teachers including Shota Aizawa and All Might supervise training. Student groups from multiple academies use the grounds for survival drills and joint practice. Typically hosts twenty to thirty students during events.

Appearance:
A sprawling forest landscape with rocky outcroppings and uneven terrain for combat training. Perimeter secured by a stone wall with a guarded entrance. The observation post offers commanding views from above.

cardPool.title: Air Walk
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Air Walk

Description:
The user can stand on and manipulate air itself, creating invisible platforms for levitation and mid-air locomotion. This stolen quirk grants freedom of vertical movement without physical support.

Functions/Applications:
Users can float upward, walk on invisible air platforms, and hover at varying heights. This enables superior tactical positioning for ranged attacks, evasion, and terrain mobility. The quirk pairs well with ranged abilities, allowing attacks from elevated vantage points while airborne.

Limits:
The user must maintain active focus to keep air platforms stable; loss of concentration causes falling. The quirk cannot support movement while unconscious or severely incapacitated. Sustained flight exhausts stamina over time.

Additional Notes:
Air Walk is a stolen quirk, suggesting it may be removable or transferable. Its primary advantage lies in vertical positioning rather than raw offensive power, making it suited for tactical support, reconnaissance, and ranged combat rather than direct melee engagement.

cardPool.title: Big Horn
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Big Horn

Description:
The user manifests a pair of large, bull-like horns from their head. These horns are physical extensions of the body and serve as a distinctive physical trait rather than a primary combat tool.

Functions/Applications:
The horns can be used for charging attacks or as weapons in direct combat. Severing a horn is rumored to improve communication or perception abilities, though the exact mechanism is debated.

Limits:
Horns cannot be regrown once removed. The user cannot fully control horn growth or retraction. Severing a horn causes permanent disfigurement and may alter the quirk's effectiveness. The horns provide no defensive capability beyond their physical mass.

Additional Notes:
Big Horn is a relatively simple, appearance-based quirk with limited versatility. Users must carefully consider any modification to their horns, as the decision is irreversible.

cardPool.title: Big Fist
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Big Fist

Description:
Itsuka enlarges one or both hands to three times her body size with instantaneous activation. Physical strength scales proportionally, granting immense crushing and striking power without affecting movement or balance.

Functions/Applications:
Close-range combat with devastating striking force. Enlarged hands serve as restraint tools, transport vessels, and protective barriers. Fist-flapping generates wind to disperse gas traps. Hand expansion provides offense, defense, and support functions.

Limits:
Exclusively short-range with no ranged capability. Enlarged hands obstruct vision and fine manipulation. Cannot be maintained indefinitely. Wind generation is limited in power and range. Large size creates obvious visual tells, eliminating surprise against aware opponents.

Additional Notes:
Optimal for rescue missions, restraint operations, and defense-breaking scenarios. Strength scaling prevents user fatigue from enlarged limb weight, differentiating from pure size-based abilities.

cardPool.title: Blade-Tooth
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Blade-Tooth

Description:
The user can enlarge, reshape, and manipulate their teeth into sharpened, blade-like incisors of varying sizes and lengths. These dental weapons can be fired or extended at will with incredible speed and range, functioning as both melee and ranged attacks.

Functions/Applications:
Deploy torrents of tooth blades to barrage enemies. Use elongated teeth as projectiles or stabbing weapons at distance. Employ teeth as extra limbs for mobility and climbing. Reshape teeth to suit tactical needs—piercing points for penetration or broader blades for cutting.

Limits:
Teeth can shatter under sufficient blunt force despite durability. Extended blades require stamina to maintain and generate. Physical restraints limit but do not fully prevent Quirk use. Opponents with hardened defenses can resist or redirect attacks if fast enough.

Additional Notes:
Users demonstrate mastery through constant offensive pressure and creative mobility. The Quirk excels in sustained barrages rather than single strikes. Users gain advantage in unprepared or confined combat due to tooth manipulation versatility.

cardPool.title: Blazing Hair
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Blazing Hair

Description:
The user's hair burns with controllable flames that can be shaped and weaponized at will. Fire originates from and remains anchored to the user's head, enabling combat applications and enhanced mobility through aerial propulsion.

Functions/Applications:
Detach flaming hair strands as fireballs or projectiles. Reshape flames into melee weapons. Generate thrust by manipulating hair flames downward for flight and speed. Combine applications for complex aerial maneuvers and ranged-melee hybrid attacks.

Limits:
Hair regeneration and flame supply are finite; sustained combat depletes reserves. Flight requires active concentration and continuous manipulation. Flames cannot extend far from the body or persist independently. Close-range opponents can smother or extinguish flames through overwhelming defense or water-based counters.

Additional Notes:
Most effective with aerial advantage and distance. Hair attacks telegraph intentions, requiring tactical timing. Synergizes well with speed-focused combat styles. Works best against ground-bound or slower opponents.

cardPool.title: Body Bulk
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Body Bulk

Description:
A transformation quirk allowing the user to expand and densify their entire body, increasing muscle mass, size, and strength. The quirk activates most powerfully during intense negative emotions like rage, hatred, or fear.

Functions/Applications:
Enhanced physical strength for combat and lifting; increased durability from thickened muscle tissue; emotional triggers amplify transformation for temporary power surges. The user can control the degree of bulk from partial to full transformation.

Limits:
Requires emotional intensity for peak effectiveness; prolonged use causes fatigue and muscle soreness; increased mass reduces speed and agility. Control becomes difficult during extreme emotional states, making the user reckless in battle.

Additional Notes:
Originally stolen by All For One and gifted to the user. The quirk's reliance on negative emotions makes strategic use difficult in situations requiring calm judgment. Best suited for direct confrontation rather than finesse-based combat.

cardPool.title: Dark Shadow
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Dark Shadow

Description:
A sentient shadowy entity manifesting from the user's body as a loyal monster-like guardian. It remains tethered through an umbilical connection and communicates telepathically. Dark Shadow is composed of dark energy—solid enough to interact with the physical world—and can extend limbs and shift shape to limited degrees.

Functions/Applications:
Dark Shadow serves as both offensive weapon and defensive shield, stretching arms to grapple or slam enemies while the user maintains distance. It provides mobility support, aids climbing, and can simulate flight with training. It grows exponentially more powerful in darkness, becoming a large ferocious beast capable of devastating physical attacks.

Limits:
Dark Shadow's energy depletes with extended distance from host, rapid impacts, or overuse. Light exposure dramatically weakens it and renders it docile and small. In darkness, it becomes uncontrollable and may defy commands if the host's negative emotions intensify, potentially forcing the user's body to act against their will. Host and entity cannot share sensations, so one being incapacitated doesn't stop the other.

cardPool.title: Electrification
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Electrification

Description:
Denki stores electrical energy and discharges it as a protective aura that shocks on contact. Higher outputs create omnidirectional bursts that illuminate areas. He can absorb incoming electrical attacks and power electronics.

Functions/Applications:
Close-range electroshock defense causing paralysis. Area-of-effect discharge at high power. Absorbs enemy electrical attacks. Energizes devices. Sharpshooting Gear directs electricity through projectiles safely.

Limits:
Ineffective at range without equipment. Lacks directional control, risking friendly fire. Exceeding wattage capacity causes brain short-circuit for one hour, leaving him incapacitated. Insulation and non-conductive Quirks negate effectiveness. Panic triggers uncontrolled discharge. Restraint limits combat potential.

Additional Notes:
Denki restrains himself in group combat to prevent teammate harm. Training with high-capacity batteries increased maximum output. Non-conductive Quirks present tactical challenges.

cardPool.title: Fast Fist
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Fast Fist

Description:
The user's hands and arms move at supernatural speed, striking up to 100 times per second in blurred motions. By targeting pressure points with precision, the user can render targets unconscious without lethal force.

Functions/Applications:
Rapid hand combat providing overwhelming offensive capability. Pressure point targeting enables knockout incapacitation. Speed creates openings against slower opponents and allows defensive blocking.

Limits:
Confined to hands and arms only. User must move their body normally, limiting pursuit. Requires precision targeting for knockout effects. Fatigue limits sustained use duration.

Additional Notes:
Most effective against unarmored targets. Close-range Quirk with minimal distance utility. Control is difficult with risk of accidental injury. User relies on conventional movement for positioning despite hand speed advantage.

cardPool.title: Shock Absorption
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Shock Absorption

Description:
The user absorbs kinetic energy and impact force from physical blows, reducing damage taken from strikes and collisions. This allows the bearer to withstand tremendous punishment, though it cannot completely nullify attacks—only diminish them.

Functions/Applications:
Reduces incoming physical damage by dispersing shock waves throughout the body. Effective against melee attacks, falls, and explosive force. Grants exceptional durability in direct combat, allowing the user to engage powerful opponents without sustaining critical injuries.

Limits:
The Quirk has a cumulative threshold; continuous attacks will eventually overwhelm its capacity. Gradual, sustained damage bypasses its effectiveness more efficiently than single powerful blows. Cannot absorb energy-based attacks or non-impact damage. Shock Absorption merely reduces harm rather than eliminating it entirely.

Additional Notes:
Best countered by overwhelming force exceeding absorption capacity or through persistent, incremental damage rather than single catastrophic strikes. The Quirk neutralizes raw physical power but fails against creative attack strategies that don't rely on immediate impact shock.

cardPool.title: Slide and Glide
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Slide and Glide

Description:
Projects repulsive (blue) and attractive (green) force from hands and feet. The user can propel themselves across surfaces at high speed, cling to vertical surfaces, launch energy blasts, and achieve limited flight through momentum boosts. Mastery allows full-body force coating for protection and mobility.

Functions/Applications:
Slide rapidly across ground and walls; climb vertical surfaces by attraction; fire repulsion beams from close-range to long-distance; perform mid-air jumps for altitude and flight; project protective force fields for damage mitigation and light levitation.

Limits:
No built-in braking mechanism—user must reverse acceleration to stop, risking collision. Repulsion beams can cause lethal damage. Multiple mid-air jumps require significant willpower; most users believe limited to two jumps before landing. User takes damage from their own Quirk if struck directly.

Additional Notes:
Initially required three-point contact to function; improves with training and confidence. Deadly potential requires moral restraint in combat. Reclassifies as "Flight" upon mastery. Synergizes well with acrobatic or precision-based combat styles.

cardPool.title: Fiber Master
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Fiber Master

Description:
Telekinetic control over all types of fiber and fabric. The user can manipulate threads, cloth, and fiber-based materials to restrain enemies or create offensive weapons. Denim is easiest to control; sweats are most difficult. Works on synthetic fibers like carbon fiber.

Functions/Applications:
Restrain or immobilize targets through their clothing. Unravel denim into whip-like strings for offense or defense. Redirect allies by manipulating their garments. Requires concentration and available fabric sources.

Limits:
Naked or fiber-free targets cannot be controlled. Strong-willed foes can resist. User loses control if distracted. Effectiveness depends on fabric type and quantity available. Requires extensive training; considered too difficult even for All For One to steal.

Additional Notes:
Ideal users wear denim-heavy costumes for constant fiber availability in combat. Synergizes with high intelligence and tactical awareness.

cardPool.title: Half-Cold Half-Hot
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Half-Cold Half-Hot

Description:
The user generates ice and frost from their right side and fire and flames from their left side. Both elements originate internally and cannot be manipulated from external sources. The power is perfectly balanced between both halves. Advanced mastery allows combining both elements into "cold fire" that simultaneously burns and freezes.

Functions/Applications:
Ice side: Freeze structures, create barriers, form platforms, generate waves for mobility, precision attacks, ground skating. Fire side: Generate intense heat and flames, propel the user forward, provide warmth regulation. Combined technique: Merge both elements into unified attacks with enhanced properties and immunity to extreme temperatures.

Limits:
Overuse of either side without alternating causes fatal frostbite or overheating. Maximum output depletes temperature reserves immediately. Prolonged ice usage reduces body temperature dangerously, lowering attack effectiveness. The user instinctively favors their ice side, creating tactical predictability. Neither element can be manipulated once generated externally.

Additional Notes:
The quirk stems from a genetic fusion of Hellflame and Frost abilities.

cardPool.title: Masaru Bakugo
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Masaru Bakugo

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Not specified (presumed Quirkless or minor Quirk)

Occupation/Role: Fashion designer; father of UA High School student Katsuki Bakugo

Personality: Calm and composed voice of reason in his volatile family. Loving and supportive, though often unsettled by conflict. Disapproves of his son's arrogance despite acknowledging his abilities.

Appearance: Middle-aged man of average height with short brown hair, rectangular glasses, and a short mustache. Dresses in casual professional civilian attire.

Backstory: Once dreamed of becoming a Pro Hero but pursued fashion design instead. Met his wife Mitsuki at work and married her. Fathered Katsuki and has spent years balancing his son's gifted but arrogant nature with parental guidance.

Additional Information: Entrusts Katsuki's education to UA High School, believing the institution can properly guide him. Represents the stabilizing parental influence in Katsuki's life, contrasting with his wife's volatile personality.

cardPool.title: Mitsuki Bakugo
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Mitsuki Bakugo

Alias: None

Quirk Name: Glycerin

Occupation/Role: Housewife; Mother of UA Class 1-A student Katsuki Bakugo

Personality: Assertive and aggressive like her son, yet composed and respectful. Recognizes Katsuki's flaws stem from innate talent and childhood praise; disapproves of his arrogance and occasionally disciplines him physically. Supportive of his hero aspirations.

Appearance: Spiky ash-blonde hair and sharp red eyes, maintained youthful by her Quirk despite being in her late thirties. Wears a white blouse under a lavender cardigan, black skirt, and reddish-purple house slippers. Refined and put-together.

Backstory: Mother to talented but arrogant Katsuki and wife to Masaru Bakugo. She has watched her son's exceptional abilities earn constant praise, cultivating his worst traits. Now that Katsuki attends UA High School, she remains invested in his development as a hero.

Additional Information: Not a UA student or Pro Hero, but integral to understanding Katsuki's character. Her Glycerin Quirk maintains youthful skin through natural moisturizing secretion. She demonstrates that aggressive temperament can be tempered with maturity—a lesson her son has yet to learn.

cardPool.title: Bakugo House
cardPool.value:
Name: Bakugo House

Location: A prosperous residential district in an urban settlement, set back from the street behind a protective stone wall.

Inhabitants: The Bakugo family—merchants or nobility who value learning and refinement. Servants may be present, though the master commands respect.

Appearance: A large, well-maintained detached mansion with sturdy construction and elegant design. The front features a manicured garden and a defensive wall with ornamental window. The interior spacious living room showcases floor-to-ceiling bookshelves with leather-bound volumes, fine furnishings, and polished wood. The home exudes quiet authority and scholarly ambition.

cardPool.title: Quirk Bestowal
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Quirk Bestowal

Description:
A transfer-based Quirk with no combat function. The user can pass their Quirk to another person through DNA contact (hair, blood, or saliva). Transfer requires the user's consent, but the recipient need not agree. This Quirk is immune to theft and cannot be stolen by All For One.

Functions/Applications:
Grants the ability to voluntarily transfer the Quirk itself and any absorbed Quirks to a chosen successor through biological material. The transfer can be selective—passing only certain components while retaining others. Hostile transfer can weaponize the process against the recipient.

Limits:
The Quirk has no offensive or defensive capabilities independent of transfer. It manifested late in life and remained undetectable due to extreme weakness. Cannot be forced upon an unwilling user and requires direct physical contact. The recipient must be capable of handling transferred power or may suffer rejection.

Additional Notes:
Quirk Bestowal grows stronger through combination with other Quirks rather than individual strength. The original user's will can persist within transferred Quirks as spiritual remnants. This Quirk cannot be sensed or stolen, making it immune to All For One's power.

cardPool.title: Quirkless
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Quirkless

Description:
A complete absence of superhuman abilities, Quirk Factor, or meta-powers. Quirkless individuals are born without superpowers in a world where 80% of humans possess them, making them genetic outliers and social minorities.

Functions/Applications:
Immunity to Quirk-targeted attacks including Trigger Bombs, Erasure-type Quirks, Quirk-Destroying Drugs, and Quirk Factor manipulation. Unaffected by Quirk Singularity phenomena and life-draining effects from multi-Quirk hosts. Legally cannot be classified as villains since villainy requires Quirk use.

Limits:
Vulnerable to all conventional physical threats and weapons. Prohibited from most hero work. Subject to severe social discrimination. Immunities are negated if a Quirk Factor is ever acquired. Cannot legally become a Pro Hero in most societies.

Additional Notes:
Increasingly rare trait with recessive genetic inheritance. The only advantage in a Quirk-dependent population. Some Quirkless individuals maintain positive relationships despite discrimination, while others face mockery based on perceived weakness.

cardPool.title: Humarise
cardPool.value:
[Humarise]

Type: Extremist Cult Organization

Humarise was a global cult-like organization led by Flect Turn, originating from Otheon. The group based its ideology on the Quirk Singularity Doomsday Theory — the belief that Quirks will evolve until they become uncontrollable and destroy humanity.

Although unproven, Humarise treated this theory as absolute truth. Members viewed Quirks as a disease threatening mankind's survival. People with Quirks were labeled "infected" or "diseased," while Quirkless individuals were regarded as "pure humans."

Believing themselves humanity's saviors, Humarise dedicated itself to eradicating Quirks from society by any means necessary. Operating across multiple countries with hidden cells and loyal followers, the organization grew into a dangerous extremist movement feared for its fanaticism, secrecy, and willingness to commit mass destruction.

cardPool.title: Tail
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Tail

Description:
A prehensile appendage extending from the lower posterior with a blonde tuft. Functions as a third, fully capable limb with considerable strength and durability.

Functions/Applications:
The tail serves as a melee weapon strong enough to break metal and restrain enemies. It launches the user upward when slapped against the ground, enables climbing by wrapping around objects, and supports acrobatic maneuvers. Can point directionally or perform simple gestures.

Limits:
The tail is vulnerable to damage and cannot replicate hand complexity for intricate tasks. Its permanent nature restricts comfortable sitting and lying down, requiring tailor-made clothing. Combat patterns become predictable as the tail drives recognizable fighting styles. Strength increases only through intensive training against resistant opponents.

Additional Notes:
Most effective when combined with martial arts training and close-quarters combat knowledge. Best used for supplementing mobility, evasion, and directional pressure rather than as a primary ranged weapon. Limited primarily by the user's creativity and physical conditioning.

cardPool.title: Tsuyu Asui
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Tsuyu Asui

Alias:
Rainy Season Hero: Froppy

Quirk Name:
Frog

Occupation/Role:
Class 1-A Student at UA High School

Personality:
Straightforward and pragmatic, Tsuyu speaks her mind without pretense. She is supportive and reliable, serving as a steadying presence for her classmates.

Appearance:
A short girl with a distinctly frog-like appearance: wide mouth, large oval eyes, and notable large hands. Her dark sea-green hair reaches her hips, tied in a large bow, with face-framing clumps and shorter bangs. She wears the UA female uniform—gray dress jacket with teal stripes, white dress shirt, red tie, and teal pleated skirt—paired with brown dress shoes and knee-high socks. Her hero costume features a bright green turtleneck bodysuit with black lines outlined in yellow, beige gloves with green buckles, matching belts, black boots with yellow V-markings, and green webbed flippers.

Backstory:
Selected to attend UA High School's elite hero course, Tsuyu brings her natural frog-like abilities to becoming a professional hero. Her practical nature and unique Quirk make her a valuable asset to her class.

Additional Information:
Class 1-A. Demonstrates frog-like mannerisms including hopping on all fours.

cardPool.title: Search
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Search

Description:
A surveillance Quirk allowing the user to monitor up to one hundred individuals simultaneously by targeting their Quirk Factor and DNA. Observed targets appear as star-like vestiges and their locations can be tracked from miles away. The Quirk's eyes glow rainbow-colored during activation and permanently stores all gathered data.

Functions/Applications:
Locate multiple targets across vast distances; identify weak points of observed individuals; distinguish between multiple Quirk Factors within a single person; maintain a permanent database of scanned subjects; coordinate long-distance tactical operations.

Limits:
Vulnerable to deception through misdirection. Cannot distinguish between actual targets and false readings if the target's biological material is present elsewhere. Requires initial contact or proximity to store data on a subject.

cardPool.title: Shino Sosaki
cardPool.value:
Real Name:
Shino Sosaki

Alias:
Mandalay

Quirk Name:
Telepath

Occupation/Role:
Pro Hero, Leader of the Wild, Wild Pussycats

Personality:
Calm and gentle yet demanding and sharp-witted. Caring toward others but strategic in combat, using deception tactically to catch opponents off-guard.

Appearance:
A young woman with brown eyes and burgundy-red hair with three prominent bangs. She wears a red Pussycats hero costume with cat-ear headphones and red whisker markings beneath her eyes. Her costume includes cat gloves with sharp claws and brown palm pads. In civilian dress she wears a knee-length skirt, dark leggings, high-heeled shoes, and a turtleneck sweater.

Backstory:
A seasoned Pro Hero and measured leader of the Wild, Wild Pussycats team. She has proven herself against dangerous villains and demonstrates tactical skill and physical capability while mentoring younger heroes and civilians.

Additional Information:
Telepath Quirk allows one-way mental transmission to dozens of people simultaneously but cannot receive telepathic messages. She wields cat gloves with functional claws and uses cat-ear headphones for team communication. Serves as mentor and trainer to Class 1-A during forest training exercises.

cardPool.title: Love
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Love

Description:
The user empowers a target by confessing genuine romantic feelings for them. The confession transmits a surge of physical enhancement, with intensity scaling to emotional connection depth. The empowered state manifests as heart-shaped smoke, called "Lover Mode."

Functions/Applications:
Dramatically increases target's physical strength and speed for combat or critical tasks. Works across any distance if the user's voice reaches the target. Acts as a strategic trump card for high-stakes moments requiring decisive power boosts.

Limits:
Activates only once per 24 hours. Cannot empower the user themselves—only affects genuine romantic interests. Requires sincere emotional confession; false declarations fail. Enhanced state doesn't guarantee victory against skilled opponents.

Additional Notes:
The user must consciously choose their target based on authentic feelings. Lover Mode is most effective when the user's love is most intense. Best employed as a last-resort tactic due to severe cooldown. Strategic value lies in timing rather than raw power output.

cardPool.title: Nejire Hado
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Nejire Hado

Alias: Wonder Hero: Nejire Chan

Quirk Name: Wave Motion

Occupation/Role: UA High School Student, Class 3-A, Member of The Big 3

Personality: Naturally kind and talkative with endless curiosity about others, though her bluntness can seem invasive. She grew distant in middle school but regained her warmth through friendships with Tamaki Amajiki and Mirio Togata at UA.

Appearance: Fair-skinned girl with wide, round light royal blue eyes and distinctive periwinkle blue hair reaching past her knees with spiral twists, side-swept bangs, and face-framing strands. She wears the standard UA female uniform. Her hero costume is a dark royal blue skin-tight bodysuit with pale mint green torso markings, turquoise accents, knee-high boots with spiral anklets, yellow gauntlets, and spiral hair-shaped protrusions behind her ears.

Backstory: A prodigious student whose powerful Quirk initially caused others to distance themselves. Her isolation ended when Amajiki and Togata befriended her, allowing her to overcome emotional barriers.

Additional Information: Third-year student and part of UA's elite trio known as The Big 3, indicating exceptional ability among her peers.

cardPool.title: Manami Aiba
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Manami Aiba

Alias: La Brava

Quirk Name: Love

Occupation/Role: Villain Associate / Hacker

Personality: Deeply devoted and loyal, with intense love that borders on obsessive. Initially withdrawn after past rejection, she gains confidence through her admiration for Danjuro. Protective and supportive, prone to worry despite understanding his abilities. Sensitive to rejection but fiercely committed once emotionally invested.

Appearance: A notably short young woman with a disproportionately large round head and narrow body. She has distinctive raspberry pink hair in two high pigtails with a centered bang. Her striking features include large pointed-down eyes with dark under-eye rings and oval pink irises with concentric circles. She wears a white bow at her neck, thick white gloves, an indigo shirt with large pink buttons and frilly sleeve cuffs, puffy white pinstriped pants with heart motifs, golden heart-buckled belts, shiny high-heeled boots over dark tights, and heart-shaped earrings.

Backstory: A lonely middle schooler who fell into depression after her love confession was rejected and mocked. She became a reclusive shut-in until discovering Danjuro's online videos.

cardPool.title: Nao Main Estate
cardPool.value:
Name: Nao Main Estate

Type:
Major Sorcerer Clan Estate

Location:
Mountainous outskirts of Kyoto Prefecture

Description:
The Nao Main Estate is a vast traditional compound hidden behind private roads, forest, stone walls, and layered security.

The public-facing grounds resemble an old aristocratic residence maintained by the Naogumi family. Deeper sections are restricted even to many relatives.

The estate contains:
• Main family residence
• Branch-family quarters
• Training courtyards
• Underground sparring halls
• Medical wing
• Archive buildings
• Ritual chambers
• Artifact vaults
• Private gardens
• Servant housing

Security:
The outer estate relies on conventional guards, cameras, gates, and private security.

Inner grounds use sorcerer barriers, concealed seals, Quirk-Energy detection, and restricted access rules.

Important areas are deliberately separated so most residents never see the entire compound.

Atmosphere:
Quiet, formal, wealthy, and oppressive.

The estate is beautiful but rarely comfortable. Etiquette, rank, and family hierarchy affect nearly every interaction.

cardPool.title: Kyoto Jujutsu Academy
cardPool.value:
Name: Kyoto Jujutsu Academy

Type:
Sorcerer Training School

Location:
Secluded grounds outside Kyoto

Description:
Kyoto Jujutsu Academy is the older and more traditional of the two major sorcerer schools.

It maintains closer relationships with the major clans and Jujutsu Higher-Ups.

Students study:
• Quirk-Energy control
• Reinforcement
• Innate Techniques
• Barrier methods
• Remnant exorcism
• Artifact use
• Binding Vows
• Sorcerer law and tradition
• Combat

Campus:
The grounds contain traditional dormitories, lecture halls, ritual courtyards, underground training rooms, archive buildings, medical facilities, and heavily warded artifact storage.

Atmosphere:
Formal, competitive, conservative, and highly political.

Clan affiliation matters more here than at Tokyo, and students from influential families often arrive with established expectations and rivalries.

Additional Information:
Kyoto produces many technically refined sorcerers, but its close relationship with the Higher-Ups gives it a reputation for obedience, elitism, and internal politics.

cardPool.title: Tokyo Jujutsu Academy
cardPool.value:
Name: Tokyo Jujutsu Academy

Type:
Sorcerer Training School

Location:
Hidden within Tokyo

Description:
Tokyo Jujutsu Academy is one of two primary schools responsible for training young sorcerers.

Publicly, the property is registered through layered private foundations and appears to be an old religious educational site with limited access.

Students study:
• Quirk-Energy control
• Reinforcement
• Innate Techniques
• Barrier fundamentals
• Remnant identification
• Exorcism
• Artifact handling
• Combat
• Field survival

Campus:
The school contains dormitories, classrooms, training grounds, medical rooms, storage buildings, barrier halls, and access to restricted underground facilities.

Classes are extremely small compared to ordinary schools because capable sorcerers are rare.

Students frequently participate in supervised field assignments.

Atmosphere:
Informal by clan standards, dangerous by normal educational standards.

Teachers often have considerable freedom in how they train students.

Additional Information:
The school remains completely separate from U.A., hero education, and public Quirk institutions.

cardPool.title: Tachibana Inner Residence
cardPool.value:
Name: Tachibana Inner Residence

Type:
Major Sorcerer Clan Estate

Location:
Private district outside Tokyo

Description:
The Tachibana estate is disguised as a collection of luxury residences, gardens, studios, guest villas, and corporate retreat properties.

There is no obvious fortress.

That is intentional.

The estate contains:
• Main family residence
• Guest villas
• Performance halls
• Private studios
• Training rooms
• Sensory chambers
• Media offices
• Information archives
• Hidden artifact rooms
• Underground meeting spaces

Security:
Tachibana defenses focus on concealment, attention manipulation, controlled access, and social screening.

An outsider may walk near a restricted building several times without realizing it matters.

Visitors are monitored constantly, often without noticing who is doing the monitoring.

Atmosphere:
Beautiful, polished, welcoming, and deeply deceptive.

Nothing feels hostile until someone realizes they have already revealed too much.

Additional Information:
The public sections regularly host celebrities, executives, and cultural events, allowing sorcerer activity to hide inside legitimate high-society traffic.

cardPool.title: Kuma Mountain Compound
cardPool.value:
Name: Kuma Mountain Compound

Type:
Major Sorcerer Clan Estate

Location:
Remote mountain valley in Nagano Prefecture

Description:
The Kuma Compound is less decorative than other major clan estates.

It is built around stone courtyards, timber halls, training fields, workshops, bathhouses, and reinforced underground chambers designed to survive destructive combat.

The estate contains:
• Main residence
• Clan dormitories
• Outdoor training grounds
• Reinforcement halls
• Weapon workshops
• Artifact storage
• Medical facilities
• Mountain trails
• Underground combat rooms

Security:
The compound has relatively few subtle defenses.

Instead, access routes are difficult, heavily watched, and protected by barriers designed to reveal intruders rather than quietly misdirect them.

Anyone reaching the inner estate still has to deal with the Kuma themselves.

Atmosphere:
Harsh, practical, loud, and strangely communal.

Meals are large, training begins early, injuries are common, and rank matters less during practice than actual performance.

Additional Information:
Many young Kuma sorcerers spend years living almost entirely inside the compound before being trusted with independent field work.

cardPool.title: Fujiwara Archive Estate
cardPool.value:
Name: Fujiwara Archive Estate

Type:
Major Sorcerer Clan Estate

Location:
Northern Kyoto

Description:
The Fujiwara estate resembles a combination of aristocratic manor, private university, and fortified archive.

Its architecture is deliberately orderly, with long covered walkways, enclosed gardens, libraries, lecture halls, and barrier chambers arranged around several inner courtyards.

The estate contains:
• Clan residences
• Extensive libraries
• Barrier laboratories
• Contract halls
• Record vaults
• Technique classrooms
• Restricted archives
• Formal audience chambers
• Underground document storage

Security:
Fujiwara security emphasizes identification, permissions, and layered restrictions rather than brute force.

Doors, hallways, and archives may require specific bloodlines, spoken conditions, seals, or Binding Vows to access safely.

Unauthorized entry can trigger containment barriers rather than alarms.

Atmosphere:
Elegant, silent, scholarly, and intensely controlled.

Visitors are often more disturbed by how little seems accidental than by anything openly threatening.

Additional Information:
The deepest archives contain centuries of Technique records, clan agreements, exorcism reports, and sealed information unavailable to ordinary sorcerers.

cardPool.title: Kaoru Tachibana
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Kaoru Tachibana

Alias: Blindspot

Clan: Tachibana Clan

Occupation/Role: Heir / Field Sorcerer

Personality: Kaoru is playful, theatrical, observant, vain, and deeply unsettling when serious. He enjoys confusing people and deliberately performs harmlessness until it becomes useful to stop. He lies easily, flirts casually, loves gossip, fashion, and psychological games, and often treats social situations like experiments. Unlike many Tachibana elders, he genuinely enjoys field work and prefers seeing people's reactions firsthand. His cheerful demeanor vanishes completely when he decides someone is a threat.

Appearance: A slim, flexible 178 cm man with pale blond hair showing dark roots, violet eyes, soft androgynous features, multiple ear piercings, and an almost permanent smile. He dresses in elaborate layered outfits combining traditional Japanese clothing with modern designer pieces.

Innate Technique: Blind Spot. Kaoru manipulates attention rather than visibility. Selected targets unconsciously fail to prioritize a chosen person, object, movement, or area within their perception. Victims may technically see him while their minds continually dismiss his presence as irrelevant. He can hide an approaching strike, make a weapon go unnoticed, or cause someone to repeatedly overlook an exit. The Technique weakens if the concealed subject becomes impossible to ignore through direct pain, extreme movement, or overwhelming contradiction.

Quirk: Flexible Joints. Kaoru can flex his joints like they are made out of soft rubber, allowing him to escape handcuffs and other restraints with ease. This is also useful in combat, as it also prevents Kaoru's bones from breaking, as the Flexible part of her Quirks comes from the fact that her bones take a rubber-like quality when activated. Skin is not included.


Additional Information: Kaoru is extremely difficult to track in combat and considered brilliant, useful, and profoundly untrustworthy by his own clan.

cardPool.title: Reika Tachibana
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Reika Tachibana

Alias: None

Clan: Tachibana Clan

Occupation/Role: Clan Head

Personality: Reika is elegant, charming, calculating, emotionally ruthless, and extraordinarily good at making people underestimate her. She rarely threatens anyone directly. Instead, she makes them comfortable enough to reveal what she needs, then quietly acts on it. Reika understands public image, celebrity culture, and modern media better than most old clan leaders. She can be genuinely affectionate, but usefulness and loyalty strongly affect how long that affection lasts.

Appearance: A graceful 171 cm woman with a slender build, long dark auburn hair, golden-brown eyes, immaculate makeup, and refined features that make her appear younger than her age. She wears expensive modern kimono, formal dresses, understated jewelry, and is almost never seen looking anything less than perfectly composed.

Innate Technique: False Familiarity. Reika alters how socially familiar, trustworthy, or emotionally safe she feels to a target. She cannot directly control thoughts, but can make suspicion feel unreasonable, make herself seem strangely known, or make another person feel socially distant and untrustworthy. The Technique works best when reinforcing plausible impressions rather than creating impossible beliefs. Strong awareness and emotional shocks can disrupt it.

Quirk: Flexible Joints. Reika can flex her joints like they are made out of soft rubber, allowing her to escape handcuffs and other restraints with ease. This is also useful in combat, as it also prevents Reika's bones from breaking, as the Flexible part of her Quirks comes from the fact that her bones take a rubber-like quality when activated. Skin is not included.

Additional Information: Reika maintains extensive influence through entertainment, fashion, hospitality, and media companies while keeping her sorcerer identity completely hidden.

cardPool.title: Shin Kuma
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Shin Kuma

Alias: None

Clan: Kuma Clan

Occupation/Role: Branch Heir

Personality: Shin is serious, stubborn, competitive, and painfully sensitive about being underestimated. He trains obsessively because he believes inherited talent means nothing without the body and discipline to use it. He is socially awkward and often sounds rude without intending to. Shin dislikes ceremony, hates being treated like a child, and becomes visibly angry when older sorcerers dismiss him.

Appearance: A compact 176 cm teenager with a dense athletic build, short messy black hair, dark green eyes, heavy eyebrows, and hands that are almost always bruised or bandaged. He wears simple dark training clothes, tabi, and carries a short reinforced iron staff.

Innate Technique: Anchor. Shin can establish a fixed relationship between himself and a chosen point in physical space. While anchored, external force has enormous difficulty moving, throwing, dragging, or knocking him away from that point. He can anchor individual limbs, weapons, or his entire body. Advanced use lets him abruptly release the anchor and convert stored opposing force into movement or counterattacks. The Technique does not make him invulnerable; enough force can injure him without moving him.

Quirk: Enhanced Regeneration. Shin's regeneration factor speed is increased by %400, meaning he heals faster. This Quirk can seal up bleeds, internal and external, in just a minute, and also speeds up the recovery for the user drastically in a longer period.

Additional Information: Shin is considered highly promising but not yet exceptional by major-clan standards.

cardPool.title: Mio Kuma
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Mio Kuma

Alias: Breaker

Clan: Kuma Clan

Occupation/Role: Elite Clanswoman

Personality: Mio is cheerful, violent, competitive, impulsive, and disturbingly enthusiastic about difficult fights. She laughs when injured and becomes more excited when an opponent proves stronger than expected. Outside combat she is surprisingly friendly, informal, and protective of younger sorcerers. She despises bullies and arrogant nobles, though her own idea of "friendly sparring" frequently ends with structural damage.

Appearance: A tall 183 cm woman with a powerful athletic build, tan skin, thick dark hair tied high, gold-brown eyes, and several small scars across her face and arms. She wears sleeveless hakama, a short haori, and heavy metal prayer beads wrapped around one forearm.

Innate Technique: Impact Bank. Mio stores a portion of kinetic force delivered into her body and can release it later through physical attacks. Punches, kicks, throws, weapon strikes, or impacts against the ground can discharge accumulated force all at once. She deliberately allows controlled hits to build reserves before returning them with greater efficiency. Storage has a hard limit, excessive impact can injure her before absorption completes, and stored force gradually leaks away.

Quirk: Enhanced Regeneration. Mio's regeneration factor speed is increased by %400, meaning he heals faster. This Quirk can seal up bleeds, internal and external, in just a minute, and also speeds up the recovery for the user drastically in a longer period.

Additional Information: Mio is one of the Kuma Clan's strongest active combatants and has destroyed multiple training halls by accident.

cardPool.title: Daigo Kuma
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Daigo Kuma

Alias: The Iron Bear

Clan: Kuma Clan

Occupation/Role: Clan Head

Personality: Daigo is blunt, disciplined, intimidating, and brutally straightforward. He hates political games and prefers people who say exactly what they mean. He respects courage, endurance, and reliability more than pedigree. Daigo is harsh with his relatives but not casually abusive; failure is acceptable if the person genuinely tried, while cowardice and dishonesty are not. He has little patience for sorcerers who rely entirely on inherited Techniques without training their bodies.

Appearance: A massive 198 cm man with an extremely muscular frame, shaved head, heavy black beard, broad nose, scarred knuckles, and dark brown eyes. He wears sleeveless traditional work robes, heavy hakama, and permanently wrapped forearms. He looks more like a retired heavyweight fighter than clan nobility.

Innate Technique: Iron Pulse. Daigo converts Quirk-Energy into violent reinforcement surges throughout his muscles, bones, and connective tissue. Rather than maintaining constant enhancement, he releases explosive pulses at the exact moment of impact, movement, or defense. This produces tremendous striking force, sudden acceleration, and momentary durability. Proper timing makes the Technique extremely efficient; mistiming wastes output or damages his own body.

Quirk: Enhanced Regeneration. Daigo's regeneration factor speed is increased by %400, meaning he heals faster. This Quirk can seal up bleeds, internal and external, in just a minute, and also speeds up the recovery for the user drastically in a longer period.

Additional Information: Daigo personally trains promising Kuma sorcerers and is respected even by rival clans for keeping his word.

cardPool.title: Shiori Fujiwara
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Shiori Fujiwara

Alias: None

Clan: Fujiwara Clan

Occupation/Role: Senior Archivist

Personality: Shiori is soft-spoken, polite, curious, obsessive, and profoundly invasive. She values information more highly than privacy, loyalty, or dignity. Once she becomes interested in a secret, she can pursue it with frightening persistence while remaining perfectly pleasant. She dislikes direct combat and considers violence an inelegant substitute for preparation. Shiori is not openly sadistic, but her curiosity often overrides her empathy.

Appearance: A slender 166 cm woman with dark brown hair worn in a loose bun, tired amber eyes, thin rectangular glasses, and permanently ink-stained fingers. She wears layered cream and navy robes and usually carries several notebooks, seals, and document cases.

Innate Technique: Closed Record. Shiori can transfer memories, knowledge, conversations, sensory impressions, names, or Technique information into prepared written media. While sealed, the source may lose conscious access to that information. Records can be locked behind blood conditions, passwords, Binding Vows, or designated readers. Recent memories are relatively easy to extract; deeply embedded knowledge requires prolonged contact and greater Quirk-Energy. Destroying a sealed record can permanently destroy what was stored inside.

Quirk: Capture. Allows Shiori to recall most things with perfect accuracy, surpassing photographic memory users in terms of accuracy. Can only recall perfectly up to 50 years old. This Quirk also puts a bit of a burden on Shiori's mind, but it is manageable with training.

Additional Information: Shiori knows enough restricted information to seriously damage all four major clans and is rarely allowed to travel without protection.

cardPool.title: Ren Fujiwara
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Ren Fujiwara

Alias: None

Clan: Fujiwara Clan

Occupation/Role: Primary Heir

Personality: Ren is quiet, arrogant, clinical, and frighteningly gifted. He treats combat like mathematics and conversation like information exchange. He rarely insults people directly because he considers obvious inferiority self-evident. Ren dislikes sloppy technique, emotional decision-making, and people who confuse recklessness with creativity. He becomes genuinely interested when someone breaks one of his predictions, which is one of the few things capable of making him visibly excited.

Appearance: A slim, athletic 179 cm young man with straight black hair cut to the jaw, pale gray eyes, fine symmetrical features, and thin silver-framed glasses he does not medically need. He wears a white haori over dark traditional clothing and usually carries brushes, ink, and folded paper strips.

Innate Technique: Vector Script. Ren writes directional instructions into surfaces using Quirk-Energy. Anything contacting a marked surface can have its momentum redirected according to the assigned vector. He can bend projectile paths, redirect strikes, turn floors into acceleration lanes, reverse falls, or build predetermined movement routes across a battlefield. Advanced scripts can chain several directional changes together. Destroying the marked surface removes the script, and complex networks require intense concentration.

Quirk: Plane Folding, Ren can change the property of any surface he touches, within the limit of a 200 metre-square area, and as long as it does not break the rules of physics too much. 

Ren can for example, make the floor bouncy, or make it slippery, or make it hot (up to 1000 celcius). It is a powerful and versatile Quirk, with limits.

Additional Information: Ren is regarded as a prodigy and likely future clan head. He considers most senior Fujiwara technically competent but intellectually slow.

cardPool.title: Masanori Fujiwara
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Masanori Fujiwara

Alias: None

Clan: Fujiwara Clan

Occupation/Role: Clan Head

Personality: Masanori is cultured, patient, manipulative, and deeply conservative. He prefers winning through contracts, obligations, precedent, and carefully prepared traps rather than direct violence. He loves technicalities and quietly despises people who agree to terms they do not understand. Masanori can discuss tea while arranging someone's execution and genuinely believes institutional stability matters more than individual freedom. He rarely becomes emotional because he prefers making other people emotional first.

Appearance: A thin but upright 181 cm elderly man with neatly combed white hair, narrow gray eyes, refined features, and deep smile lines that make his politeness difficult to read. He wears expensive muted kimono and almost always carries a folding fan. He is never seen hurried, disheveled, or visibly angry.

Innate Technique: Edict. Masanori creates binding verbal rules that affect those who hear and understand them. Examples include forbidding a target from crossing a threshold, drawing a weapon, speaking a name, or activating a Technique. Breaking an accepted Edict triggers a predetermined punishment such as paralysis, pain, Quirk-Energy loss, Technique disruption, or internal injury. More restrictive rules require harsher conditions or concessions from Masanori himself. He frequently strengthens Edicts through Binding Vows.

Quirk: Plane Folding, Masanori can change the property of any surface he touches, within the limit of a 200 metre-square area, and as long as it does not break the rules of physics too much. 

Masanori can for example, make the floor bouncy, or make it slippery, or make it hot (up to 1000 celcius). It is a powerful and versatile Quirk, with limits.

Additional Information: Masanori possesses enormous political influence among conservative sorcerers and rarely needs to fight personally.

cardPool.title: Akari Nao
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Akari Nao

Alias: None

Clan: Nao Clan

Occupation/Role: Senior Heir

Personality: Akari is elegant, proud, calculating, vindictive, and intensely status-conscious. She maintains perfect manners while insulting people and rarely loses composure in public. She despises weakness in prestigious relatives and believes high birth creates obligations rather than privilege. Akari is cruel, but not foolish; if someone is stronger than her, she studies them instead of challenging them recklessly. She remembers humiliation for years and has a vicious streak toward relatives she considers embarrassing or wasteful.

Appearance: A graceful 174 cm woman with a slim athletic build, waist-length black hair tied with dark red cord, pale skin, narrow reddish-brown eyes, and delicate features. Her expression is usually calm and faintly contemptuous. She favors formal red-and-black kimono adapted for movement and carries a narrow ritual dagger.

Innate Technique: Grave Measure. Akari inherited the same core Technique as Kenshin, but her expression is more immediate. She assigns extreme weight to specific body parts, weapons, or objects rather than building it gradually. She can pin a foot to the floor, make a sword arm collapse under its own burden, increase the effective weight of loose debris, or burden the chest enough to disrupt breathing. Her version is faster but less efficient and cannot accumulate indefinitely.

Quirk: Speedy Acceleration, allows Akari to accelerate his speed whilst running. Takes a bit of time, and the upper limit is Mach 2.1, usually seen with a smoke like trail, very useful and versatile.

Additional Information: Akari is a major succession candidate.

cardPool.title: Kenshin Nao
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Kenshin Nao

Alias: None

Clan: Nao Clan

Occupation/Role: Clan Head

Personality: Kenshin is severe, controlled, patient, and almost impossible to read. He treats emotion as useful only when disciplined or weaponized, rarely raises his voice, and becomes quieter when genuinely angry. He values bloodline, secrecy, usefulness, and self-control above affection. Failure can be forgiven; publicly embarrassing the clan cannot. Kenshin is not needlessly cruel, but he will ruin a relative's future, arrange a marriage, disinherit an heir, or authorize lethal action if he believes the clan benefits. He respects strength, intelligence, and composure, even in people he dislikes.

Appearance: A tall, broad-shouldered man of 188 cm with an aging but still imposing build. He has long black hair streaked heavily with gray, sharp charcoal eyes, deep-set features, and a severe expression. He usually wears layered black kimono with a formal haori and carries an antique walking cane concealing a reinforced blade.

Innate Technique: Grave Measure. Kenshin assigns metaphysical "weight" to chosen actions, movements, or objects. Repeated actions accumulate burden: steps become heavier, arms become harder to raise, weapons become increasingly difficult to swing, and even breathing can grow laborious. He excels at forcing opponents into repetitive patterns before crushing them under accumulated weight. He can also temporarily increase the effective mass behind his own strikes.

Quirk: Speedy Acceleration, allows Kenshin to accelerate his speed whilst running. Takes a bit of time, and the upper limit is Mach 2.1, usually seen with a smoke like trail, very useful and versatile.

Additional Information: Kenshin is one of the strongest living clan heads and controls succession, restricted archives, artifact access, and internal discipline.

cardPool.title: Tachibana Clan
cardPool.value:
Tachibana Clan

Entry:
The Tachibana Clan is one of the four major sorcerer clans.

Publicly, they are a wealthy family with interests in entertainment, media, fashion, hospitality, and luxury brands.

Privately, they specialize in perception, concealment, influence, and highly subtle Techniques.

TRADITION
The Tachibana value:
• Social control
