Hana is a slender young woman with long, light-colored hair reaching well past her shoulders. Her hair is soft and slightly tousled, with straight bangs and longer strands framing her face.

She has youthful, gentle facial features and a generally approachable appearance. Her clothing is ordinary modern civilian wear, giving no outward indication that anything supernatural is connected to her.

Angel:
Hana has been prepared as a vessel for Angel, an ancient sorcerer.

At present, Angel has not awakened into active coexistence with her. Hana does not display Angel's halo, wings, second mouth, or abilities and is unaware of the full nature of what resides within her.

Technique Extinguishment:
Angel possesses Technique Extinguishment, which can nullify Cursed Techniques and other jujutsu phenomena.

Its supreme application, Jacob's Ladder, directs an intense pillar of light onto a target and forcefully extinguishes cursed techniques and related effects.

Current Status:
Hana presently lives as an ordinary civilian and has no active role in Jujutsu Society. ]

cardPool.title: Reggie Star
cardPool.value:
[ REGGIE STAR

Name:
Reggie Star

Affiliation:
Incarnated sorcerer

Grade / Classification:
Dormant incarnated sorcerer

Jujutsu:
Contractual Re-Creation. By burning a receipt, Reggie reproduces the goods or services recorded on it. He can manifest weapons, appliances, vehicles, and other purchased items; service contracts can reproduce their effects. Each receipt is consumed after use, so preparation is essential.

Personality:
Reggie is cunning, patient, manipulative, and highly analytical. He prefers making opponents act on false assumptions rather than winning through raw power. He constantly evaluates terrain, resources, escape routes, and how much the enemy understands about his technique. Smug and self-interested, he cooperates when useful and abandons alliances when they stop benefiting him. Even under pressure, he searches for another trick or favorable exchange.

Appearance:
Reggie is an adult man with light-colored hair and a lean build. Numerous paper receipts cover his body, hanging from his torso, waist, and limbs in overlapping strips like improvised clothing. The loose papers create a ragged, layered silhouette. Despite the strange outfit, he carries himself with relaxed confidence.

Combat Style:
Reggie combines physical combat with rapid use of prepared receipts. He creates objects at useful angles, overwhelms opponents with weight or numbers, alters the battlefield, and uses stored contracts to answer specific problems.

Relationships and Background:
Reggie is a sorcerer from the past incarnated into a modern vessel. His technique rewards preparation, so he keeps a broad collection of receipts for different situations.

Field Conduct:
Reggie fights cleverly and underhandedly, using deception, terrain, disposable resources, and opportunistic alliances. He rarely cooperates without personal benefit and thinks highly of his own judgment. ]

cardPool.title: Ryu Ishigori
cardPool.value:
[ RYU ISHIGORI

Name:
Ryu Ishigori

Affiliation:
Incarnated ancient sorcerer

Grade / Classification:
Elite Culling Game combatant

Jujutsu:
Ryu possesses the highest recorded Cursed Energy output. His Cursed Technique, Cursed Energy Discharge, releases enormous amounts of raw CE with exceptional force.

Granite Blast is his signature attack, firing a devastating concentrated beam from his pompadour. He can also release rapid blasts and maintain extremely high output even when his technique is unavailable after Domain Expansion.

Personality:
Ryu is confident, bold, sociable, competitive, and intensely hungry for excitement. He compares life and battle to a meal, believing his first life was satisfying but still lacked a proper "dessert."

That dessert is a fight intense enough to completely satisfy him. He genuinely enjoys strong opponents, becomes excited when someone survives his attacks, and rarely backs down from overwhelming strength. Though arrogant, he is straightforward about his desires and capable of respecting opponents who give him the battle he wants.

Appearance:
Ryu is a tall, heavily muscular man with sharp features and an enormous dark pompadour shaped like a cannon barrel. He wears a fur-lined dark jacket over his bare chest with loose trousers, giving him a flamboyant retro appearance.

Combat Style:
Ryu favors overwhelming ranged attacks with Granite Blast but is equally dangerous in close combat, reinforcing his body and strikes with immense CE output.

Relationships and Background:
Ryu is a sorcerer from roughly 400 years ago who incarnated to seek the fulfillment his first life lacked.

Field Conduct:
Ryu actively seeks powerful opponents. He prefers explosive ranged exchanges but readily fights hand-to-hand and becomes more enthusiastic as a battle grows more dangerous. ]

cardPool.title: Takako Uro
cardPool.value:
[ TAKAKO URO

Name:
Takako Uro

Affiliation:
Incarnated ancient sorcerer; former Sun, Moon, and Stars Squad Captain

Grade / Classification:
Elite Culling Game combatant

Jujutsu:
Sky Manipulation lets Uro treat the sky as a tangible surface, grabbing and warping space like fabric. She can distort attack paths, move through the air, and use Thin Ice Breaker to strike the surface of space itself, producing a powerful spatial impact. She also possesses Domain Expansion, though its effect is unknown.

Personality:
Uro is proud, volatile, independent, and deeply resentful of being used by others. In her first life, she served as an assassin under the Fujiwara clan and was discarded despite her loyalty. That betrayal shaped her obsession with living for herself and becoming someone whose existence has meaning. She is sharp-tempered, suspicious, emotionally expressive, and especially hostile toward anything tied to the Fujiwara. Despite her ruthlessness, she notably avoids killing ordinary civilians.

Appearance:
Uro is a tall, athletic woman with long light-pink hair and inverted eyes with black sclera and pink irises. She wears only accessories such as a dark choker, hoop earrings, bracelets, and piercings. Her body is otherwise unclothed, with Sky Manipulation distorting the surrounding space to obscure it.

Combat Style:
Uro fights through aerial mobility, spatial distortion, redirection, and sudden counters. She prefers making attacks miss or bend away before retaliating with Thin Ice Breaker.

Relationships and Background:
Uro lived during the Heian era as captain of the Fujiwara clan's Sun, Moon, and Stars assassination squad.

Field Conduct:
Uro is cautious, opportunistic, and difficult to pin down. She analyzes techniques quickly, avoids unnecessary commitments, and fights primarily for her own survival and fulfillment. ]

cardPool.title: Fumihiko Takaba
cardPool.value:
[ FUMIHIKO TAKABA

Name:
Fumihiko Takaba

Affiliation:
None

Grade / Classification:
Dormant modern sorcerer

Jujutsu:
Takaba possesses the dormant Cursed Technique Comedian. When active, anything he genuinely believes would be funny can become reality, producing absurd effects that ignore normal combat logic.

Takaba is unaware he has a Cursed Technique. Its effectiveness depends on confidence in his own humor; doubt can weaken it.

Personality:
Takaba is energetic, eccentric, stubborn, and deeply committed to comedy despite years of failure. He launches into jokes without warning and gets irritated when they fall flat.

Beneath the loud behavior, he is sensitive to rejection and originally pursued comedy because he wanted people to understand him and ease his loneliness. Repeated failure made him defensive, but he still genuinely values laughter and refuses to take it away from others.

Appearance:
Takaba is a 35-year-old man with dark hair, thick eyebrows, a broad expressive face, and a stocky build. He normally looks like an ordinary struggling comedian.

His later stage-style outfit is based on Centerman, leaving one side of his torso exposed while the other is covered in a superhero-like costume.

Combat Style:
After awakening, Takaba fights through unpredictable gag-like reality manipulation mixed with surprisingly effective physical attacks. He does not intentionally kill opponents.

Relationships and Background:
Takaba is an unsuccessful solo comedian who previously worked as part of a duo. He receives little recognition but continues because being funny and connecting with others matter deeply to him.

Field Conduct:
Takaba improvises constantly, acts on instinct, readily protects others, and avoids lethal force even against enemies. ]

cardPool.title: Hajime Kashimo
cardPool.value:
[ HAJIME KASHIMO

Name:
Hajime Kashimo

Affiliation:
Incarnated ancient sorcerer

Grade / Classification:
Dormant incarnated sorcerer

Jujutsu:
Kashimo's Cursed Energy has an innate electrical property. His strikes transfer charge into an opponent; once enough separation builds, he can release a lightning discharge that tracks between the charges and is extremely difficult to avoid.

His Cursed Technique, Mythical Beast Amber, transforms his body through electricity to manifest electrical phenomena. It catastrophically strains his flesh and can only be used once.

Personality:
Kashimo is aggressive, proud, blunt, impatient, and obsessed with fighting the strongest opponent available. Weak enemies bore him, while powerful opponents immediately earn his attention.

He is fearless and extremely confident, caring little for status or ideology. Kashimo values strength itself and seeks a battle intense enough to answer the isolation of dominating his era.

Appearance:
Kashimo has a lean, athletic build and light cyan hair tied into two high buns, with loose strands framing his face. Dark markings sit beneath his eyes. He wears simple light clothing with a dark sash and carries a long staff.

Combat Style:
Kashimo is an exceptional close-range fighter who combines hand-to-hand combat, staff techniques, and electrified CE. He builds charge through contact before finishing opponents with lightning.

Relationships and Background:
Kashimo lived roughly 400 years ago and reached old age without finding a satisfying opponent. He accepted incarnation for the chance to eventually fight Ryomen Sukuna.

Field Conduct:
Kashimo seeks direct combat, dislikes wasted time, and rarely backs down from strong opponents. He saves Mythical Beast Amber for someone worthy of its single use. ]

cardPool.title: Hiromi Higuruma
cardPool.value:
[ HIROMI HIGURUMA

Name:
Hiromi Higuruma

Affiliation:
None

Grade / Classification:
Dormant modern sorcerer

Jujutsu:
Higuruma possesses a dormant Cursed Technique centered on law and judgment. When awakened, it manifests the shikigami Judgeman and Domain Expansion: Deadly Sentencing, forcing targets into a courtroom trial where violence is prohibited.

Guilty verdicts can impose Confiscation, removing access to a Cursed Technique or Cursed Energy. A death sentence grants the Executioner's Sword, which kills the sentenced target with a successful strike.

Personality:
Higuruma is intelligent, serious, introspective, and strongly driven by justice. As a defense attorney, he accepts difficult cases and refuses to abandon clients simply because conviction seems likely.

He is deeply sensitive to unfairness and frustrated by a legal system that can value procedure over truth. Beneath his reserved professionalism is stubborn compassion for people condemned by others. Repeated injustice can turn that idealism into bitterness and anger.

Appearance:
Higuruma is a tall, slim man in his mid-thirties with short dark hair, heavy-lidded eyes, pronounced brows, and a tired expression. He normally wears a dark business suit, white shirt, and tie, giving him the plain appearance of an overworked attorney.

Combat Style:
Before awakening, Higuruma has no active jujutsu combat style. After awakening, he rapidly learns CE reinforcement and fights with a shape-changing gavel, after Deadly Sentencing weakens his opponent.

Relationships and Background:
Higuruma is a defense attorney known for taking difficult cases. His commitment to defendants others have already judged guilty defines his worldview.

Field Conduct:
Higuruma is analytical, methodical, and rule-focused. He prefers understanding a situation and exploiting its rules precisely rather than acting impulsively. ]

cardPool.title: Uraume
cardPool.value:
[ URAUME

Name:
Uraume

Affiliation:
Ryomen Sukuna's attendant

Grade / Classification:
Ancient incarnated sorcerer

Jujutsu:
Ice Formation lets Uraume create and manipulate ice by lowering temperatures to extreme levels.

Frost Calm releases supercooled mist that rapidly freezes targets in thick ice. Icefall creates large masses of ice that can be directed or dropped onto enemies. Uraume also knows Reverse Cursed Technique and can heal serious injuries.

Personality:
Uraume is calm, severe, disciplined, and utterly devoted to Sukuna. They treat most others with open contempt and rarely waste words on people they consider beneath them.

Their loyalty is absolute. Uraume is patient, efficient, and willing to prepare for Sukuna without seeking recognition. They stay composed under pressure but become openly hostile when someone interferes with or disrespects Sukuna.

Appearance:
Uraume has a slender, androgynous build, pale skin, and straight white hair cut around the jaw with a dark red-pink section at the back. Their eyes are dark pink, and their delicate features make their gender difficult to determine by appearance alone.

They usually wear traditional monk-like robes with wide sleeves and a dark sash.

Combat Style:
Uraume controls the battlefield with large-scale freezing, immobilizing groups before crushing or piercing them with ice. They are also capable of strong reinforcement at close range.

Relationships and Background:
Uraume served Sukuna during the Heian era and remains one of the few people he personally tolerates. They are also an exceptional cook, valued by Sukuna for preparing human flesh.

Field Conduct:
Uraume is cold, efficient, and ruthless. They prioritize Sukuna above everything else and prefer ending fights quickly through overwhelming area control. ]

cardPool.title: Nanako Hasaba
cardPool.value:
[ NANAKO HASABA

Name:
Nanako Hasaba

Affiliation:
Suguru Geto's Group

Grade / Classification:
Curse User

Jujutsu:
Nanako has an unnamed Cursed Technique that uses her smartphone camera as a medium. It affects subjects captured in photographs, though its full rules are unexplained. She has shown the ability to alter a photographed target and negate damage to herself after taking a picture. Her phone is central to the technique.

Personality:
Nanako is outspoken, sharp-tongued, emotional, and fiercely loyal to those she considers family. More expressive than her quiet twin Mimiko, she readily shows anger, impatience, and excitement.

Her devotion to Suguru Geto is absolute. He rescued the twins from abuse and became the person they trusted most, leaving Nanako intensely hostile toward anyone who threatens or disrespects him. She shares Geto's contempt for non-sorcerers, but still has ordinary teenage interests and a strong attachment to Mimiko.

Appearance:
Nanako is a teenage girl with light brown-blonde hair, brown eyes, and a fashionable gyaru-inspired look. She usually wears her long hair in a bun with loose strands framing her face.

She wears a light cardigan over a sailor-style school uniform with a short dark skirt, loose socks, and loafers. Her smartphone has a distinctive bunny-eared case and is almost always close at hand.

Combat Style:
Nanako relies on her phone-based technique, timing, and surprise rather than direct physical combat. She is most dangerous when able to photograph a target before they understand her ability.

Relationships and Background:
Nanako and her twin Mimiko were abused and imprisoned by villagers because they could see curses. Geto rescued them, and both became devoted members of his family and group.

Field Conduct:
Nanako is aggressive, opportunistic, protective of Mimiko, and willing to use lethal force against enemies. ]

cardPool.title: Mimiko Hasaba
cardPool.value:
[ MIMIKO HASABA

Name:
Mimiko Hasaba

Affiliation:
Suguru Geto's Group

Grade / Classification:
Curse User

Jujutsu:
Mimiko possesses an unnamed Cursed Technique involving a stitched doll and a noose. Actions performed on the doll are reflected onto the target, with hanging as her preferred method. She can also attack vital points through the doll. The exact activation rules are unknown.

Personality:
Mimiko is quiet, reserved, loyal, and deeply attached to her twin sister Nanako and Suguru Geto. Compared with Nanako, she is less openly expressive and tends to remain calm and withdrawn.

Her devotion to Geto is absolute. He rescued the twins after years of abuse and imprisonment, becoming the person they trusted most. Mimiko shares his sorcerer-supremacist beliefs and can be ruthless toward people she considers enemies, but her strongest emotional bonds are centered on Nanako and Geto.

Appearance:
Mimiko is a teenage girl with short brown hair cut into a neat bob, straight bangs, brown eyes, and a small, slender build. She wears a dark sailor-style school uniform, knee-high socks, and loafers.

She almost always carries a stitched stuffed doll with a noose tied around its neck, an object directly connected to her technique.

Combat Style:
Mimiko relies on her doll-and-noose technique rather than prolonged close combat. She can kill targets remotely or indirectly once her technique is established and has used it effectively against weaker jujutsu personnel.

Relationships and Background:
Mimiko and Nanako were abused and imprisoned by villagers because they could see curses. Geto rescued them, after which both became devoted members of his family and organization.

Field Conduct:
Mimiko is cautious, quiet, and lethal when necessary. She usually stays close to Nanako and fights with little hesitation when protecting her sister or Geto. ]

cardPool.title: Larue
cardPool.value:
[ LARUE

Name:
Larue

Affiliation:
Suguru Geto's Group

Grade / Classification:
Curse User

Jujutsu:
Heart Catch creates a large virtual hand that can grab, throw, or crush targets from a distance. If the hand is destroyed, Larue can recreate it, though one-tenth of the damage is transferred to his real body.

After Heart Catch has grabbed someone, Larue can use Cutie Honey to seize their attention instead, forcibly drawing their gaze and focus toward him. The target's pupils become heart-shaped while affected.

Personality:
Larue is calm, affectionate, loyal, and unusually diplomatic among Geto's followers. He considers the group a family and dislikes pointless conflict between its members.

His loyalty to Geto is sincere rather than fanatical ambition for himself; Larue simply wants to see Geto become "king." He is emotionally perceptive, willing to mediate disputes, and does not automatically treat disagreement as betrayal.

Appearance:
Larue is a large, muscular man with light-colored eyes and medium-length blond hair held down by a blue headband. He is usually shirtless and barefoot, wearing only loose pants.

Two large heart-shaped markings replace his areolas, giving him an immediately recognizable appearance.

Combat Style:
Larue uses Heart Catch for ranged control, repositioning, crushing force, and openings for allies. He is durable enough to remain active after severe punishment and fights effectively as support rather than relying on straightforward melee.

Relationships and Background:
Larue is one of Geto's commanders and shares his anti-non-sorcerer ideology. He is especially close to the group as a whole and sees its members as family.

Field Conduct:
Larue prefers coordinated fighting, battlefield control, and creating openings. He stays composed, supports allies well, and avoids unnecessary internal conflict. ]

cardPool.title: Miguel
cardPool.value:
[ MIGUEL ODUOL

Name:
Miguel Oduol

Affiliation:
Formerly Suguru Geto's Group; currently unaffiliated

Grade / Classification:
Foreign Sorcerer / Curse User

Jujutsu:
Miguel's Innate Technique, Prayer Song, uses a rhythm carved into his body. By moving to that beat, he enhances his physical abilities while weakening the curses affecting an opponent, functioning like a buff and debuff without a Domain.

He is also highly skilled with Cursed Energy reinforcement. During the Night Parade, Miguel wielded the Black Rope, a rare cursed tool woven in his homeland over decades. Contact with it disrupts Cursed Techniques, though the rope is consumed through use.

Personality:
Miguel is confident, composed, practical and difficult to intimidate. He stays calm even against overwhelming opponents and is willing to retreat when a situation turns unfavorable. He is proud of his homeland and its jujutsu traditions, blunt in conversation, and dislikes being stereotyped. Though he once followed Geto, he is not blindly loyal to a lost cause.

Appearance:
Miguel is a tall, heavily built Black man with dark skin, a muscular frame, short tightly curled black hair, thick eyebrows, and a trimmed beard. He usually wears a light long-sleeved shirt, dark pants, and practical shoes. His size and relaxed posture make him imposing even while calm.

Combat Style:
Miguel is an exceptional close-range fighter who combines reinforcement, physical strength, evasive movement, and rhythmic footwork. He was durable and skilled enough to delay Satoru Gojo.

Relationships and Background:
Miguel was one of Geto's strongest followers. After the Night Parade, Gojo recruited him to train Yuta Okkotsu overseas, where Yuta improves his Cursed Energy control and fundamentals.

Field Conduct:
Miguel fights efficiently, favors movement and close combat, and does not stay in hopeless fights purely for pride. ]

cardPool.title: Shiu Kong
cardPool.value:
[ SHIU KONG

Name:
Shiu Kong

Affiliation:
Independent broker; former police officer

Grade / Classification:
Non-sorcerer intermediary

Jujutsu:
Shiu has no known Cursed Technique and is not shown using Cursed Energy in combat. His value comes from information, contacts, logistics, and arranging work between clients and dangerous operatives.

Personality:
Shiu is calm, pragmatic, discreet, and businesslike. He rarely shows strong emotion and approaches supernatural work with the attitude of someone used to dealing with dangerous people. He is observant, cautious, and prefers negotiation, preparation, and competent specialists over direct involvement.

Appearance:
Shiu is a slim adult man with short dark hair, narrow eyes, and a composed expression. He usually wears a neat dark suit with a collared shirt and tie, giving him the appearance of an ordinary professional rather than someone connected to sorcerers and assassins.

Combat Style:
Shiu is not presented as a frontline fighter. He avoids direct combat and instead supports operations through planning, intelligence, payments, introductions, and coordination.

Relationships and Background:
Shiu is a former police officer who became an intermediary in the jujutsu underworld. He acted as Toji Fushiguro's business partner and broker, arranging the Time Vessel Association's assassination contract on Riko Amanai and passing the job to Toji.

Field Conduct:
Shiu remains professional, keeps his distance from unnecessary danger, and treats jobs as transactions. He relies on information and trusted specialists rather than fighting personally. ]

cardPool.title: Yu Haibara
cardPool.value:
[ YU HAIBARA

Name:
Yu Haibara

Affiliation:
Tokyo Jujutsu High

Grade / Classification:
Grade 2 Sorcerer

Jujutsu:
Steam Cursed Technique. Haibara's technique creates a steam-engine-like mechanism within his body. His Cursed Energy acts as water while the technique serves as the boiler, producing steam that explosively enhances his physical abilities.

It greatly boosts his speed, acceleration, and striking power, making him a close-range fighter. Its weakness is poor efficiency: extended use drains energy quickly and leaves him extremely hungry.

Personality:
Haibara is cheerful, sincere, energetic, and openly friendly. He approaches people warmly, speaks without much cynicism, and tends to see the good in others.

He is hardworking and brave despite lacking the overwhelming talent of sorcerers like Gojo or Geto. Haibara takes dangerous missions seriously but remains optimistic, making him easy to like and especially close to Nanami. His straightforward positivity leaves a lasting impression on those around him.

Appearance:
Haibara is a teenage boy with short dark hair, thick eyebrows, a youthful face, and a compact athletic build. He usually wears the standard dark Tokyo Jujutsu High uniform with practical shoes.

His expressions are lively and easy to read, often smiling or reacting openly rather than hiding what he feels.

Combat Style:
Haibara fights at close range using sudden bursts of speed, forceful charges, reinforced strikes, and aggressive movement powered by Steam Cursed Technique.

Relationships and Background:
Haibara is a first-year student alongside Kento Nanami and the junior of Gojo, Geto, and Shoko. His upbeat nature contrasts strongly with Nanami's seriousness, and the two form a close partnership. ]

cardPool.title: Misato Kuroi
cardPool.value:
Name:
Misato Kuroi

Affiliation:
Caretaker of Riko Amanai; historical

Grade / Classification:
Non-combatant support, nonsorcerer, Quirkless

Jujutsu:
No notable Innate Technique.

Personality:
Kuroi is composed, competent, protective, and deeply devoted to Riko without treating her merely as a ritual object. She can handle danger and logistics but knows she is not a combat sorcerer on the level of Gojo or Geto. Her priorities remain practical: keep Riko safe, preserve normalcy where possible, and avoid becoming an additional burden during an escort mission.

Appearance:
An adult woman with straight dark hair, rectangular glasses, and a formal black-and-white maid uniform that reflects her role in Riko's household. The clothing is neat and traditional rather than tactical. Her calm posture and professional manner make her easy to mistake for an ordinary attendant, which is largely what she is despite her connection to jujutsu affairs.

Combat Style:
Capable civilian/support figure but not a high-level sorcerer.

Relationships and Background:
Riko Amanai's caretaker and the closest thing she has to immediate family. Kuroi accompanies the Star Plasma Vessel mission but relies on professional sorcerers when threats exceed ordinary human capability.

Operational Role:
Misato Kuroi is defined more by field support, coordination, access, and judgment than by direct exorcism. Capable civilian/support figure but not a high-level sorcerer.

cardPool.title: Riko Amanai
cardPool.value:
[ RIKO AMANAI

Name:
Riko Amanai

Affiliation:
Renchoku Girls' Junior High; Star Plasma Vessel

Grade / Classification:
Non-combatant Star Plasma Vessel

Jujutsu:
Riko could perceive Cursed Energy, cursed spirits, and techniques, and had exceptional compatibility with Master Tengen as a Star Plasma Vessel. She had no known Cursed Technique and was not trained for combat.

Personality:
Riko was outspoken, energetic, stubborn, and proudly dramatic about her role as the Star Plasma Vessel. Much of that confidence was a facade hiding an ordinary fourteen-year-old girl afraid of losing the life and people she loved.

She was social, affectionate, and deeply attached to Misato Kuroi and her school friends. Although she initially accepted merging with Tengen as her purpose, time with Gojo, Geto, and Kuroi made her admit that she wanted to keep living. Riko could be impulsive and feisty, but her emotions were sincere and she cared intensely for those close to her.

Appearance:
Riko was a slim fourteen-year-old girl with long navy-blue hair braided at the back, bangs over her forehead, and a light-colored headband. She usually wore a white sailor-style school top with striped collar and cuffs, a blue pleated skirt, black stockings, and dark shoes. She also wore casual dresses and beachwear while traveling.

Combat Style:
Riko was a non-combatant who relied on her escorts for protection and had no established fighting style.

Relationships and Background:
Riko lost her parents in a car accident at age four and was raised by Misato Kuroi, whom she loved as family. She was chosen to merge with Tengen and escorted by Satoru Gojo and Suguru Geto.

Field Conduct:
Riko was brave but inexperienced. She could recognize jujutsu phenomena, but generally relied on her escorts in dangerous situations and prioritized people she cared about over her own safety. ]

cardPool.title: Junpei Yoshino
cardPool.value:
[ JUNPEI YOSHINO

Name:
Junpei Yoshino

Affiliation:
Satozakura High School; formerly associated with Mahito

Grade / Classification:
Novice Curse User

Jujutsu:
After Mahito altered his brain with Idle Transfiguration, Junpei gained the ability to use Cursed Energy and summon Moon Dregs, a jellyfish-like shikigami.

Moon Dregs protects him with its soft body and attacks using tendrils or stingers. Its poison, formed from Junpei's Cursed Energy, causes painful burns, paralysis, and impaired movement.

Personality:
Junpei is quiet, withdrawn, cynical, and deeply distrustful. Years of bullying and isolation left him expecting cruelty and emotionally detached from others.

He is not naturally heartless, however. Junpei is sensitive, thoughtful, loves movies, and wants genuine connection. Yuji quickly reaches the part of him that still wants friendship and normalcy. His anger and grief make him vulnerable to Mahito, who validates his resentment and pushes him toward revenge.

Appearance:
Junpei is a thin seventeen-year-old boy with dark chin-length hair, dark eyes, and long bangs covering much of the right side of his face. They hide circular burn scars left by classmates pressing cigarettes against his forehead.

He usually wears casual shirts, cropped pants, and sneakers. After his mother's death, he wears one of her black jackets.

Combat Style:
Junpei stays behind Moon Dregs and relies on its reach, poison, and cushioning body rather than direct physical combat.

Relationships and Background:
Junpei lives with his mother, Nagi, and is very close to her. Severe bullying isolated him before Mahito manipulated him into becoming a curse user. Yuji later befriends him through their shared love of movies.

Field Conduct:
Junpei is inexperienced and emotionally driven. He uses Moon Dregs defensively and becomes reckless when acting from grief or anger. ]

cardPool.title: Jinichi Zenin
cardPool.value:
[ JINICHI ZENIN

Name:
Jinichi Zenin

Affiliation:
Zenin Clan; Hei

Grade / Classification:
Special Grade 1 Sorcerer

Jujutsu:
Jinichi possesses an unnamed Cursed Technique that creates multiple gigantic fists of Cursed Energy. The fists are propelled alongside his own punches and can strike over a wide area with enough force to smash through buildings. He can manifest several at once for a destructive barrage.

Personality:
Jinichi is stern, serious, emotionally restrained, and quick to act when angered. He rarely wastes words or openly shows irritation, but expects respect and has a reputation severe enough that lower-ranking clan members avoid provoking him.

He is deeply invested in the Zenin Clan's traditions, status, and authority. Jinichi can be calculating when clan interests are involved and has little patience for disrespect, especially comparisons involving his younger brother Toji.

Appearance:
Jinichi is a large, heavily muscular middle-aged man with wild spiky black hair, thick eyebrows, small dark eyes, sideburns, and a short mustache and goatee. A prominent X-shaped scar crosses his forehead. He usually wears a plain gray kimono and goes barefoot.

Combat Style:
Jinichi combines strong close-quarters combat and reinforcement with his technique, using his own punches as the basis for barrages of enormous projected fists. His attacks favor overwhelming force and broad-area destruction.

Relationships and Background:
Jinichi is a high-ranking Zenin Clan member, part of the Hei, and the older brother of Toji Fushiguro. He is therefore Megumi Fushiguro's uncle and remains closely tied to the clan's internal power structure.

Field Conduct:
Jinichi is direct, forceful, and disciplined in battle. He prefers decisive attacks over elaborate tricks and responds aggressively when challenged or disrespected. ]

cardPool.title: Ogi Zenin
cardPool.value:
[ OGI ZENIN

Name:
Ogi Zenin

Affiliation:
Zenin Clan

Grade / Classification:
Special Grade 1 Sorcerer

Jujutsu:
Ogi's Innate Technique, Blazing Courage, allows him to generate flames through his weapon. He channels the technique into his katana, coating the blade in fire or replacing a broken blade entirely with a flaming edge.

He also knows Falling Blossom Emotion, an anti-domain technique that can shroud both himself and his sword in Cursed Energy, automatically countering anything that enters its range.

Personality:
Ogi is stern, prideful, bitter, and deeply self-centered. He places clan status above family and believes his daughters' lack of talent is the reason he was never chosen to lead the Zenin Clan.

He is highly traditionalist, easily angered by disrespect, and obsessed with proving his worth against Naobito. Ogi resents Maki and Mai so strongly that he treats them as stains on his life rather than as daughters, showing little compassion even toward his own family.

Appearance:
Ogi is a tall, slim elderly man with slicked-back black hair tied into a long ponytail. He has narrow black eyes with unusually large pupils, thin eyebrows, sharp cheekbones, and an austere expression.

He wears traditional clothing consisting of a white shitagi and kosode with black hakama, white socks, and zori sandals. He normally carries a katana.

Combat Style:
Ogi is an expert swordsman who combines fast draw attacks, Cursed Energy reinforcement, Blazing Courage, and Falling Blossom Emotion. He favors decisive single-strike exchanges and close-range sword combat.

Relationships and Background:
Ogi is Naobito Zenin's younger brother, father of Maki and Mai, and a senior member of the Zenin Clan. He considers himself equal to Naobito as a sorcerer and blames his daughters for his lower standing within the clan. ]

cardPool.title: Naoya Zenin
cardPool.value:
[ NAOYA ZENIN

Name:
Naoya Zenin

Affiliation:
Zenin Clan; Head of the Hei

Grade / Classification:
Special Grade 1 Sorcerer

Jujutsu:
Projection Sorcery divides one second into twenty-four frames. Naoya preplans his movement along that sequence, allowing explosive bursts of speed that make him extremely difficult to track.

Anyone touched by his palm must also obey the twenty-four-frame movement rule. If they fail, they are frozen inside an animation frame for one second, leaving them open to attack.

Personality:
Naoya is arrogant, cruel, competitive, and obsessed with superiority. Praised as a genius from childhood, he grew convinced he was destined to lead the Zenin Clan and openly looks down on anyone he considers weak.

He is deeply misogynistic, dismissive of most relatives, and quick to insult even senior clan members. The rare exception is Toji Fushiguro, whose overwhelming strength shattered Naoya's assumptions about people without Cursed Energy. Naoya genuinely respects Toji and measures others against that standard.

Appearance:
Naoya is a tall, slim young man with brown eyes and dyed blond hair showing dark green roots. He wears several earrings and usually carries an arrogant grin.

His clothing is traditional Zenin attire: a white underlayer beneath a teal kimono, light hakama, dark tabi socks, and waraji sandals.

Combat Style:
Naoya is an elite close-range fighter who combines Projection Sorcery with sharp timing, rapid acceleration, and precise strikes. He repeatedly builds speed through chained movements, overwhelms opponents before they can react, and exploits the one-second freeze created by his technique.

Relationships and Background:
Naoya is Naobito Zenin's youngest son and believed himself to be the clan's rightful successor. He leads the Hei, the Zenin Clan's elite combat unit, and considers most other members beneath him. ]

cardPool.title: Naobito Zenin
cardPool.value:
[ NAOBITO ZENIN

Name:
Naobito Zenin

Affiliation:
Zenin Clan — 26th Head

Grade / Classification:
Special Grade 1 Sorcerer

Jujutsu:
Projection Sorcery divides one second into twenty-four frames. Naobito predetermines a sequence of movements within that second and executes them at extreme speed.

Anyone touched by his palm must obey the same twenty-four-frame rule. Failure freezes them inside an animation frame for one second. Repeated use lets Naobito build tremendous speed, earning him a reputation as the fastest sorcerer aside from Satoru Gojo.

He also knows Falling Blossom Emotion, an anti-domain technique that counters a Domain's guaranteed-hit attack with Cursed Energy.

Personality:
Naobito is confident, blunt, traditional, and self-assured. He drinks heavily even in serious situations and often appears relaxed or dismissive, but becomes focused and excited once a real fight begins.

He values strength and clan status, shares many of the Zenin family's elitist attitudes, and can be condescending toward weaker relatives. Despite his age and drinking habits, he remains sharp and calm under pressure. He is also fond of animation.

Appearance:
Naobito is a tall, muscular elderly man with swept-back white hair, thick eyebrows, a long curled mustache, and sharp eyes. Despite being seventy-one, he remains physically powerful and athletic.

He wears traditional Zenin clothing, usually a light kimono with dark hakama, tabi socks, and sandals. He is frequently seen carrying alcohol.

Combat Style:
Naobito is an elite close-range fighter who combines Projection Sorcery with precise movement, rapid acceleration, reinforcement, and experienced hand-to-hand combat. His speed lets him overwhelm opponents before they can react.

Relationships and Background:
Naobito is the 26th head of the Zenin Clan, father of Naoya, older brother of Ogi, and uncle of Toji Fushiguro. ]

cardPool.title: Toji Fushiguro
cardPool.value:
[ TOJI FUSHIGURO

Name:
Toji Fushiguro

Affiliation:
Independent mercenary; former Zenin Clan

Grade / Classification:
Non-sorcerer / Sorcerer Killer

Jujutsu:
Toji has no Cursed Energy due to a complete Heavenly Restriction. In exchange, he possesses extreme strength, speed, durability, reflexes, and senses sharp enough to perceive curses.

With zero CE, he is nearly invisible to jujutsu detection and cannot exorcise curses barehanded, so he relies on cursed tools.

Personality:
Toji is cold, confident, pragmatic, and highly opportunistic. He treats assassination as business, enjoys gambling, and prefers efficient solutions over flashy fights.

He is ruthless and exploits exhaustion, surprise, misinformation, or hostages. His hatred of the Zenin Clan and damaged self-worth shape his decisions. Despite his detachment, he is capable of genuine attachment, especially toward Megumi, though he expresses it poorly and indirectly.

Appearance:
Toji is a tall, heavily muscular man with straight black hair, sharp green eyes, and a scar running from the right corner of his mouth across his cheek. He usually wears a tight black shirt, loose white pants, and black shoes.

Combat Style:
Toji is an elite close-range fighter and weapons specialist who combines overwhelming physical ability with speed, stealth, feints, and precise cursed-tool use.

Cursed Tools:
His arsenal includes the Inverted Spear of Heaven, which nullifies Cursed Techniques on contact; the Split Soul Katana, which cuts the soul directly; the Chain of a Thousand Miles, which extends as long as its far end remains hidden; and Playful Cloud, a three-section staff whose power scales with physical strength.

Relationships and Background:
Born Toji Zenin, he was abused and rejected by the clan for having no CE. He later left, took the Fushiguro name, became the Sorcerer Killer, and is Megumi Fushiguro's father. ]

cardPool.title: Kechizu
cardPool.value:
[ KECHIZU

Name:
Kechizu

Affiliation:
Mahito's Group

Grade / Classification:
Special Grade Cursed Womb: Death Painting

Jujutsu:
Kechizu possesses the Rot Technique, allowing him to produce corrosive, poisonous blood. He usually attacks by spitting rotten blood at close or mid-range, burning flesh on contact.

If his or Eso's blood enters a target through a wound or mucous membrane, Eso can activate Decay. A flower-like mark spreads from the entry point as the victim's body decomposes, with death expected within roughly 10–15 minutes if not stopped.

Personality:
Kechizu is simple-minded, aggressive, and far less articulate than Choso or Eso. He relies heavily on his brothers and quickly follows Eso's lead in dangerous situations.

Despite his monstrous appearance and brutality toward enemies, Kechizu shares the Death Painting brothers' genuine familial bond. He values his brothers above outsiders and reacts strongly when they are harmed.

Appearance:
Kechizu has the most curse-like body of the three incarnated brothers. He is short, hunched, turquoise-skinned, and bulky, with clawed hands and dark blood leaking from his face.

He has two mouths: a small human-like face near the top of his head and a much larger jagged-toothed mouth beneath it. His distorted appearance reflects his weaker incarnation compared with Choso and Eso.

Combat Style:
Kechizu fights aggressively at close range, combining physical attacks with blasts of corrosive blood. He is physically strong but comparatively crude and predictable, relying on Eso's coordination and Decay to make his blood more dangerous.

Relationships and Background:
Kechizu is Death Painting Womb No. 3 and the youngest of Choso, Eso, and Kechizu. He was sealed for roughly 150 years before being incarnated into a human vessel and chose to side with Mahito alongside his brothers. ]

cardPool.title: Eso
cardPool.value:
[ ESO

Name:
Eso

Affiliation:
Mahito's Group

Grade / Classification:
Special Grade Cursed Womb: Death Painting

Jujutsu:
Eso possesses the Rot Technique, giving him poisonous, corrosive blood that he can manipulate.

His Maximum Technique, Wing King, shapes blood from his back into large wasp-like wings that improve mobility and fire long-range streams of blood.

If his or Kechizu's blood enters a target through a wound or mucous membrane, Eso can activate Decay. A flower-like mark spreads from the entry point as the victim's body decomposes, with death expected within roughly 10–15 minutes. By revealing how the technique works, Eso can strengthen its effect through a binding vow.

Personality:
Eso is confident, theatrical, proud, and more intelligent and articulate than Kechizu. He enjoys intimidating opponents and can become furious when embarrassed or mocked, especially about his back.

Despite his cruelty toward enemies, Eso genuinely loves his brothers. Choso, Eso, and Kechizu see themselves as a family above everything else, and Eso readily puts his younger brother's safety before his own advantage.

Appearance:
Eso has a muscular humanoid body with dark markings, a broad chest, and a strange face on his back that he is extremely self-conscious about. He has long dark hair, sharp features, and a distinctly inhuman appearance while still resembling a man more than Kechizu.

Combat Style:
Eso fights with corrosive blood, aerial movement, ranged pressure, and Decay. He can also manipulate blood from wounds into temporary shapes, including replacing a lost arm with a blood-made limb.

Relationships and Background:
Eso is Death Painting Womb No. 2 and the middle brother of Choso and Kechizu. He was sealed for roughly 150 years before being incarnated into a human vessel and sided with Mahito alongside his brothers. ]

cardPool.title: Choso
cardPool.value:
[ CHOSO

Name:
Choso

Affiliation:
Mahito's Group

Grade / Classification:
Special Grade Cursed Womb: Death Painting

Jujutsu:
Choso possesses Blood Manipulation, giving him precise control over his own blood. His Death Painting physiology lets him convert Cursed Energy into blood, greatly reducing the usual danger of blood loss.

Convergence compresses blood for other techniques. Piercing Blood fires a high-speed beam; Supernova detonates compressed droplets; Slicing Exorcism launches cutting streams; Flowing Red Scale: Stack boosts his physical abilities by controlling blood flow.

Personality:
Choso is quiet, serious, protective, and defined by his role as an older brother. He values his siblings above ideology, status, or personal safety and will kill without hesitation for them.

He is reserved and blunt rather than sadistic. Choso forms intense emotional bonds, takes family obligations extremely seriously, and carries deep guilt when he believes he has failed his brothers.

Appearance:
Choso is a tall, muscular young man with long dark hair tied into two high sections and loose strands framing his face. He has heavy-lidded purple eyes, dark shadows beneath them, and a distinctive horizontal blood mark across the bridge of his nose.

He wears a loose light robe beneath a dark sleeveless vest, baggy pants, and dark boots.

Combat Style:
Choso is an elite mid-range fighter who combines Blood Manipulation with strong reinforcement and skilled hand-to-hand combat. He shifts quickly between ranged pressure, traps, and close combat.

Relationships and Background:
Choso is Death Painting Womb No. 1 and the eldest of nine brothers. He was sealed for roughly 150 years before incarnation. Eso and Kechizu are the younger brothers closest to him, and their safety is his highest priority. ]

cardPool.title: Kokichi Muta
cardPool.value:
[ KOKICHI MUTA

Name:
Kokichi Muta

Affiliation:
Kyoto Jujutsu High — Second Year

Grade / Classification:
Semi-Grade 1 Sorcerer

Jujutsu:
Puppet Manipulation lets Kokichi remotely control mechanical puppets through Cursed Energy. His Heavenly Restriction leaves his real body severely disabled and painfully fragile, but grants enormous technique range and increased CE output, allowing him to operate puppets across Japan.

Ultimate Mechamaru is his primary combat puppet, equipped with reinforced limbs, blades, shields, and high-output CE cannons such as Ultra Cannon and Pigeon Viola.

Personality:
Kokichi is intelligent, cautious, bitter, and intensely private. Years of constant pain and isolation made him resent the body he was born with and desperate to experience ordinary life.

Despite his detached behavior, he genuinely cares about his Kyoto classmates, especially Kasumi Miwa. He can be calculating and secretive, but his harsh choices come largely from his desire to gain a healthy body and meet his friends in person rather than from loyalty to enemies.

Appearance:
Kokichi's real body is extremely frail. He is missing his right arm and both legs below the knees, has pale scarred skin, dark hair, and must remain secluded because even weak light can burn him.

He normally interacts through Ultimate Mechamaru, a tall humanoid puppet with a metallic body, armored limbs, a helmet-like head, and a single mechanical eye.

Combat Style:
Kokichi fights remotely through Mechamaru, using ranged CE blasts, mechanical weapons, mobility, and prepared puppets while keeping his true body hidden.

Relationships and Background:
Kokichi secretly supplies information to Mahito and Geto's side under a Binding Vow promising that Mahito will heal his body. His loyalty remains with Kyoto Jujutsu High, and he especially longs to stand beside Miwa in person. ]

cardPool.title: Suguru Geto
cardPool.value:
[ SUGURU GETO

Name:
Suguru Geto

Affiliation:
Independent Curse User; former Tokyo Jujutsu High

Grade / Classification:
Special Grade Sorcerer

Jujutsu:
Cursed Spirit Manipulation lets Geto absorb, store, summon, and control cursed spirits he has conquered. Weaker curses can be absorbed directly, while stronger ones must first be subdued.

Maximum: Uzumaki combines absorbed curses into a single blast of highly condensed Cursed Energy. Geto can command many curses at once for combat, surveillance, transport, restraint, and deception.

Personality:
Geto is intelligent, composed, charismatic, and deeply ideological. As a student he was courteous, principled, and believed sorcerers existed to protect non-sorcerers. Repeated trauma and disgust toward the endless cycle of exorcising curses gradually destroyed that belief.

He later became a cold sorcerer supremacist, viewing non-sorcerers as the source of curses and seeking a world inhabited only by sorcerers. Despite this extremism, he remains calm, persuasive, affectionate toward his followers, and capable of genuine bonds. He treats his group as family and retains complicated feelings toward Satoru Gojo.

Appearance:
Geto is a tall, lean man with long black hair usually tied into a bun, narrow dark eyes, large circular earrings, and a composed expression. He commonly wears Buddhist-style robes with a dark kasaya over lighter garments.

Combat Style:
Geto is highly versatile, overwhelming opponents with varied cursed spirits while remaining dangerous in close combat. He is an accomplished martial artist and can fight effectively with Playful Cloud.

Relationships and Background:
Geto studied at Tokyo Jujutsu High alongside Gojo and Shoko under Masamichi Yaga. After abandoning the school, he became a curse user, gathered followers, and built a religious organization to acquire money and cursed spirits. ]

cardPool.title: Ryomen Sukuna
cardPool.value:
[ RYOMEN SUKUNA

Name:
Ryomen Sukuna

Affiliation:
None; attended by Uraume

Grade / Classification:
King of Curses / Special Grade Cursed Object

Jujutsu:
Sukuna's Innate Technique, Shrine, uses invisible slashes. Dismantle cuts directly, while Cleave adjusts to a target's toughness and Cursed Energy.

Divine Flame is a powerful fire attack accessed through Shrine. Sukuna also possesses exceptional Reverse Cursed Technique, barrier skill, and immense Cursed Energy control.

Domain Expansion:
Malevolent Shrine manifests without enclosing space in a normal barrier. Cleave and Dismantle relentlessly strike targets across its range, while the open structure permits an enormous effective radius.

Personality:
Sukuna is arrogant, cruel, hedonistic, and completely self-assured. He values strength, appetite, and personal desire above morality, treating most people as disposable entertainment.

He is highly intelligent, observant, and adaptive in battle, quickly analyzing unfamiliar techniques. Sukuna respects strength when it interests him but shows little compassion, fear, or attachment.

True Appearance:
Sukuna's original Heian body is enormous, heavily muscled, and distinctly inhuman. He has four powerful arms, four fully functional eyes, and a second mouth across his abdomen, allowing him to form hand signs and chant while fighting simultaneously.

Black markings cover his face and body. The right side of his face bears a large flesh-like plate or growth around the upper eye, creating an asymmetrical two-faced appearance.

Combat Style:
Sukuna combines overwhelming physical ability, reinforcement, slashes, fire, RCT, and domain mastery.

Relationships and Background:
Sukuna was the strongest sorcerer of the Heian era. After death, his power remained within twenty fingers preserved as Special Grade Cursed Objects. ]

cardPool.title: Master Tengen
cardPool.value:
[ TENGEN

Name:
Tengen

Affiliation:
Jujutsu Society; Tombs of the Star

Grade / Classification:
Immortal Barrier Master

Jujutsu:
Tengen's Innate Technique, Immortality, grants endless life but not eternal youth. As their body ages, the technique eventually forces evolution. To prevent the loss of self that can follow, Tengen normally merges with a compatible Star Plasma Vessel about once every 500 years to rewrite their body's information.

Tengen is the greatest barrier user in jujutsu society. Their barriers conceal and protect Jujutsu High, reinforce barrier techniques used by auxiliary managers, and maintain several major pure barriers across Japan.

Personality:
Tengen is calm, knowledgeable, formal, and generally cooperative with sorcerers who approach them properly. Centuries of isolation have made them detached from ordinary life, but they remain concerned with the stability of jujutsu society and humanity.

They are patient, direct, and willing to explain complex matters without unnecessary hostility. Despite their immense importance, Tengen is not a frontline fighter and relies on others for physical protection.

Appearance:
Tengen's evolved body is small and humanoid with a smooth, cylindrical bald head, pale skin, and four eyes arranged in two pairs. Their facial structure is simplified and distinctly inhuman, reflecting how far their body has evolved beyond normal humanity.

They wear simple, loose, light-colored robes and usually remain within the Tombs of the Star.

Relationships and Background:
Tengen has existed since the Nara period and helped establish the foundations of modern jujutsu. After Riko Amanai's death prevented their latest merger, Tengen continued evolving while maintaining their sense of self through barrier techniques. ]

cardPool.title: Kasumi Miwa
cardPool.value:
[ KASUMI MIWA

Name:
Kasumi Miwa

Affiliation:
Kyoto Jujutsu High — Second Year

Grade / Classification:
Grade 3 Sorcerer

Jujutsu:
Miwa has no Innate Cursed Technique. She fights with New Shadow Style swordsmanship and Simple Domain.

Her Simple Domain creates a 2.21-meter defensive radius around her. Anything entering that space is automatically met with a reflexive sword draw. The domain ends if Miwa moves from where she activated it, and it can also counter the guaranteed-hit effect of a Domain Expansion.

Personality:
Miwa is sincere, hardworking, modest, and unusually normal compared with many sorcerers. She is polite, responsible, and takes her duties seriously, but can also be excitable, awkward, and self-deprecating.

She became a sorcerer largely to earn money for her family and is careful about expenses. Miwa admires strong sorcerers, especially Satoru Gojo, and can become visibly flustered around people she looks up to. Despite calling herself useless at times, she is brave and genuinely wants to help others.

Appearance:
Miwa is a slim teenage girl with shoulder-length light-blue hair, straight bangs, and a long side strand framing one side of her face. She has blue eyes and a soft, youthful appearance.

She wears the standard dark Kyoto Jujutsu High uniform with a white shirt and tie, along with dark stockings and shoes. She usually carries a katana.

Combat Style:
Miwa is a close-range swordswoman who relies on timing, precision, and defensive positioning rather than raw power. She uses Simple Domain to create a controlled space where she can automatically counter anything that enters.

Relationships and Background:
Miwa was scouted into Kyoto Jujutsu High and became a sorcerer to support her poor family. She is classmates with Momo Nishimiya and Kokichi Muta and has a particularly important bond with Kokichi. ]

cardPool.title: Mai Zenin
cardPool.value:
[ MAI ZENIN

Name:
Mai Zenin

Affiliation:
Kyoto Jujutsu High — Second Year; Zenin Clan

Grade / Classification:
Grade 3 Sorcerer

Jujutsu:
Mai possesses Construction, an Innate Technique that creates matter from Cursed Energy. Anything she constructs remains afterward, but the CE cost is extremely inefficient.

Because Mai has low CE reserves, she can normally create only one additional bullet per day. Doing so heavily drains her and can cause backlash such as nosebleeds.

Personality:
Mai is blunt, sarcastic, defensive, and often deliberately rude. She resents being forced into sorcery and takes that frustration out on others, especially Maki.

Beneath the hostility, Mai is deeply hurt that Maki left the Zenin Clan after promising they would stay together. She never wanted to rebel or become stronger; she would have preferred a quiet life, even under the clan's restrictions. Her cruelty toward Maki masks abandonment, jealousy, and a strong attachment she struggles to express. With people she trusts, Mai can be noticeably softer.

Appearance:
Mai is a slim teenage girl with short dark-green hair cut around her neck, side-swept bangs, dark amber eyes, and thin eyebrows. She closely resembles her twin Maki but has shorter hair and a more polished appearance.

She wears the standard Kyoto Jujutsu High uniform and carries a Colt Python .357 Magnum revolver.

Combat Style:
Mai is an excellent marksman who prefers range. She reinforces bullets with CE and uses the revolver's six-shot limit as a bluff, creating a hidden seventh bullet with Construction to catch opponents off guard.

Relationships and Background:
Mai is Maki Zenin's younger twin sister and daughter of Ogi Zenin. Both were mistreated by the clan, but Mai resents Maki for leaving and forcing her into sorcerer training as a consequence. ]

cardPool.title: Yoshinobu Gakuganji
cardPool.value:
[ YOSHINOBU GAKUGANJI

Name:
Yoshinobu Gakuganji

Affiliation:
Kyoto Jujutsu High — Principal

Grade / Classification:
Senior Jujutsu Sorcerer

Jujutsu:
Gakuganji's Cursed Technique uses his body as an amplifier for an electric guitar. By playing through it, he converts the sound into Cursed Energy and releases it as destructive mid-range sound waves or shockwaves.

The technique depends on both CE control and musical skill, and Gakuganji is proficient with multiple string instruments.

Personality:
Gakuganji is stern, conservative, disciplined, and deeply committed to preserving the established order of jujutsu society. He distrusts dangerous exceptions and believes rules exist to prevent catastrophic losses, even when enforcing them makes him seem cold or ruthless.

He frequently clashes with Satoru Gojo's reformist attitude and openly supports conservative higher-ups, but he is not reckless or needlessly cruel. Gakuganji can recognize competence, accepts responsibility for difficult decisions, and takes threats to jujutsu society seriously.

Appearance:
Gakuganji is a 76-year-old man with a bald head, long white eyebrows, a long white beard, and numerous piercings across his ears, nose, and mouth. His lined face and severe expression give him an intimidating, traditional appearance.

He usually wears formal traditional robes, contrasting sharply with the electric guitar he uses in battle.

Combat Style:
Gakuganji fights at mid-range by playing his guitar to project amplified Cursed Energy attacks. He remains an active sorcerer despite his age and relies on controlled ranged pressure rather than direct brawling.

Relationships and Background:
Gakuganji is the principal of Kyoto Jujutsu High and a prominent conservative figure within jujutsu society. He frequently opposes Gojo's methods and works closely with the higher-ups. ]

cardPool.title: Utahime Iori
cardPool.value:
[ UTAHIME IORI

Name:
Utahime Iori

Affiliation:
Kyoto Jujutsu High — Teacher

Grade / Classification:
Semi-Grade 1 Sorcerer

Jujutsu:
Utahime's Innate Technique, Solo Forbidden Area, temporarily amplifies the total Cursed Energy and output of sorcerers within its range.

Rather than simplifying activation, Utahime performs the full ritual of hand signs, incantations, music, and dance. Completing every step raises the technique's effectiveness to 120%, greatly strengthening allies inside the area.

Personality:
Utahime is responsible, compassionate, serious, and highly protective of her students. She takes teaching duties personally and reacts quickly when any of them are placed in danger.

She is generally mature and dependable, but becomes openly irritated around Satoru Gojo, whose constant teasing genuinely annoys her. Utahime can be stern and sharp-tempered when provoked, yet she is warm toward people she trusts. Her Kyoto students respect and adore her, and she maintains a close friendship with Shoko Ieiri.

Appearance:
Utahime is a slim woman with long dark-purple hair, brown eyes, and a prominent scar running across the right side of her face. The scar was absent during her student years.

She usually wears traditional shrine-maiden-inspired clothing: a white kosode-style top with wide sleeves, dark red hakama, and dark footwear. Her long hair is usually tied back, reinforcing her formal and traditional appearance.

Combat Style:
Utahime functions primarily as a support sorcerer. She strengthens allied sorcerers through Solo Forbidden Area rather than relying on direct offense and is most effective when given time and space to complete its ritual.

Relationships and Background:
Utahime teaches at Kyoto Jujutsu High. She is Gojo's senior, a trusted friend of Shoko, and someone Gojo relies on when investigating sensitive internal matters. ]

cardPool.title: Arata Nitta
cardPool.value:
[ ARATA NITTA

Name:
Arata Nitta

Affiliation:
Kyoto Jujutsu High — First Year

Grade / Classification:
Support Sorcerer

Jujutsu:
Arata possesses an unnamed Cursed Technique that prevents existing injuries from worsening. By applying it to a wounded person, he can stop bleeding, reduce pain, and stabilize the damage at its current state.

The technique does not actually heal injuries or restore damaged tissue, and any new wounds received afterward are unaffected. Its value lies in emergency treatment, buying critically injured sorcerers time until proper medical care or Reverse Cursed Technique is available.

Personality:
Arata is kind, cautious, compassionate, and somewhat timid, especially compared with more aggressive sorcerers around him. He gets visibly nervous in dangerous situations, but does not abandon people who need help.

He is practical and honest about the limits of his technique, avoiding false promises even when emotions are high. At the same time, he tries to give people enough hope to keep moving, showing a gentle and supportive nature beneath his anxiety.

Appearance:
Arata is a slim teenage boy with short light-brown hair, soft facial features, and a youthful appearance. He wears a customized Kyoto Jujutsu High uniform resembling formal Western clothing, including a light shirt, gray vest, dark trousers, a tailcoat-style jacket, and white gloves.

Combat Style:
Arata is primarily a support sorcerer rather than a frontline fighter. He stays close enough to stabilize wounded allies, then withdraws or escorts casualties away from active combat.

Relationships and Background:
Arata is the younger brother of Akari Nitta and the only first-year student at Kyoto Jujutsu High. His rare stabilization technique makes him especially valuable during large-scale emergencies where immediate healing is unavailable. ]

cardPool.title: Momo Nishimiya
cardPool.value:
[ MOMO NISHIMIYA

Name:
Momo Nishimiya

Affiliation:
Kyoto Jujutsu High — Third Year

Grade / Classification:
Semi-Grade 2 Sorcerer

Jujutsu:
Momo's Innate Technique, Tool Manipulation, lets her telekinetically control her broom after imbuing it with Cursed Energy. She uses it primarily for flight, scouting, transport, and ranged attacks.

Her extension technique, Wind Scythe, swings the broom to generate sharp gusts of wind capable of cutting or battering targets at range.

Personality:
Momo is sharp-tongued, practical, protective, and highly aware of how harshly female sorcerers are judged. She believes women in jujutsu are expected to be both strong and attractive, and this makes her defensive of Mai, whose struggles she understands deeply.

She can be blunt, critical, and quick to anger, especially when someone insults her friends, but she is genuinely caring toward her juniors and reliable in dangerous situations. Momo values teamwork and often takes responsibility for keeping others informed and out of danger.

Appearance:
Momo is a petite eighteen-year-old girl with pale skin, light-blue eyes, and long blonde hair styled into two curled pigtails. She wears earrings and a dark choker, reinforcing her witch-like appearance.

Her Kyoto uniform is a loose black dress with short sleeves and dark shoes. She almost always carries her bamboo broom, which is both her transport and primary combat tool.

Combat Style:
Momo specializes in aerial support. She stays above the battlefield to scout, relay information, reposition allies, and attack from hard-to-reach angles with Wind Scythe rather than engaging in close combat.

Relationships and Background:
Momo is especially close to Mai Zenin and Kasumi Miwa. She respects Mai's resilience and is fiercely protective of her against people she feels dismiss her struggles. ]

cardPool.title: Noritoshi Kamo
cardPool.value:
[ NORITOSHI KAMO

Name:
Noritoshi Kamo

Affiliation:
Kyoto Jujutsu High — Third Year; Kamo Clan

Grade / Classification:
Semi-Grade 1 Sorcerer

Jujutsu:
Noritoshi possesses Blood Manipulation, the inherited technique of the Kamo Clan. He can control his own blood and prepared blood packs for offense, restraint, and physical enhancement.

Convergence compresses blood for stronger attacks. Piercing Blood fires it at high speed; Slicing Exorcism launches cutting projectiles; Crimson Binding restrains targets; Flowing Red Scale: Stack boosts his physical abilities by controlling blood flow.

Personality:
Noritoshi is calm, disciplined, serious, and highly responsible. Raised under the expectations of the Kamo Clan, he places duty, order, and family reputation above personal comfort and often seems rigid or cold.

He is pragmatic enough to make harsh decisions when necessary, but is not needlessly cruel. Beneath his formal attitude, Noritoshi cares deeply about his mother and carries much of his ambition for her sake. He also acts as a natural leader among the Kyoto students.

Appearance:
Noritoshi is an eighteen-year-old young man with long black hair tied back, narrow dark eyes, and a composed expression. He usually wears traditional dark robes with white tabi socks and sandals, giving him a formal appearance that reflects his clan upbringing.

Combat Style:
Noritoshi is a versatile mid-range fighter who combines blood projectiles, restraints, enhanced physical ability, and tactical planning. He carries prepared blood packs to reduce the strain of using his own blood.

Relationships and Background:
Noritoshi was born to the head of the Kamo Clan and his mistress. Despite being considered illegitimate, he was accepted as heir because he inherited Blood Manipulation, and he strives to secure his mother's place and prove his worth within the clan. ]

cardPool.title: Aoi Todo
cardPool.value:
[ AOI TODO

Name:
Aoi Todo

Affiliation:
Kyoto Jujutsu High — Third Year

Grade / Classification:
Grade 1 Sorcerer

Jujutsu:
Todo's Innate Technique, Boogie Woogie, swaps the positions of two targets with sufficient Cursed Energy when he claps. He can swap himself, allies, enemies, or CE-infused objects, and frequently uses fake claps to mislead opponents.

He also knows Simple Domain, has landed Black Flash, and is highly skilled at Cursed Energy reinforcement.

Personality:
Todo is loud, eccentric, fearless, and intensely confident. He judges people by asking their preferred type of woman, believing the answer reveals whether they are interesting.

Despite his bizarre behavior, Todo is an exceptional tactical thinker. He jokingly claims to have an IQ of 530,000, but his actual combat intelligence is genuinely extraordinary: he analyzes techniques, predicts opponents, and adapts almost instantly. He is brutally honest, hates boredom, and respects strength and conviction more than status. After hearing Yuji's answer to his question, Todo immediately declares him his best friend.

Appearance:
Todo is an extremely tall, heavily muscular eighteen-year-old with tan skin, small dark eyes, thick eyebrows, and long black hair tied into a high topknot. A large scar runs down the left side of his face.

He usually wears the Kyoto Jujutsu High uniform with the jacket open or removed, emphasizing his massive build.

Combat Style:
Todo is an elite close-range fighter with immense strength, speed, durability, and martial skill. Boogie Woogie turns fights into constant positional traps, letting him redirect attacks, create openings, and coordinate seamlessly with allies.

Relationships and Background:
Todo comes from a non-sorcerer family and was scouted after meeting Special Grade sorcerer Yuki Tsukumo, who later trained him. He is an obsessive fan of tall idol Takada-chan. ]

cardPool.title: Ui Ui
cardPool.value:
[ UI UI

Name:
Ui Ui

Affiliation:
Independent Sorcerer; works alongside Mei Mei

Grade / Classification:
Young Jujutsu Sorcerer

Jujutsu:
Ui Ui possesses Spatial Transference, an Innate Technique that teleports marked targets across large distances. He can transport himself and others, typically concealing the transfer beneath a sheet.

If the target is a person, the technique normally moves body and soul together. With permission, Ui Ui can instead transfer only the soul between marked people, allowing limited soul-swapping without altering their bodies.

He also knows New Shadow Style: Simple Domain and can use it to counter a Domain's guaranteed-hit effect.

Personality:
Ui Ui is polite, composed, intelligent, and almost completely devoted to his older sister Mei Mei. He constantly seeks her praise, follows her instructions without hesitation, and willingly accepts danger if she asks it of him.

Despite his young age and obsessive attachment to Mei Mei, Ui Ui is capable under pressure and understands jujutsu far beyond what his appearance suggests. He can be smug or dismissive toward others, especially when he feels they are beneath his sister.

Appearance:
Ui Ui is a small young boy with pale skin, light-blue hair styled neatly around his face, and soft, androgynous features. He usually wears formal dark clothing with a light shirt and tie, giving him a tidy, mature appearance despite his age.

Combat Style:
Ui Ui is primarily a support sorcerer. He uses Simple Domain for protection and Spatial Transference for extraction, repositioning, and transport rather than direct combat.

Relationships and Background:
Ui Ui is Mei Mei's biological younger brother. He has a Binding Vow that restricts his use of jujutsu until Mei Mei gives him permission, a condition created from his own desire to belong entirely to her. ]

cardPool.title: Mei Mei
cardPool.value:
[ MEI MEI

Name:
Mei Mei

Affiliation:
Independent Sorcerer

Grade / Classification:
Grade 1 Sorcerer

Jujutsu:
Mei Mei's Innate Technique, Black Bird Manipulation, lets her control crows and share their vision, making them useful for surveillance, scouting, and coordinated attacks.

Her signature move, Bird Strike, forces a crow to make a Binding Vow sacrificing its own life in exchange for massively increased Cursed Energy, turning it into a lethal projectile capable of killing powerful curses.

Personality:
Mei Mei is calm, intelligent, pragmatic, and openly motivated by money. She judges work by risk and compensation rather than ideals and is comfortable admitting that financial reward matters to her.

Despite her greed, she is highly competent, observant, and professional. Mei Mei remains composed under pressure, quickly evaluates enemy abilities, and rarely wastes effort on unnecessary risks. She has strong confidence in her own judgment and fighting ability.

Appearance:
Mei Mei is a tall, slim woman with pale skin, light-blue hair, and dark eyes. Her very long hair is usually styled into thick braids that hang in front of her face, sometimes obscuring one eye.

She wears dark, fitted clothing suited for combat and is often seen carrying a large battle axe.

Combat Style:
Mei Mei is an accomplished close-range fighter despite possessing a technique better suited for support. She combines strong Cursed Energy reinforcement, precise axe strikes, and her crows to pressure opponents from multiple angles.

Relationships and Background:
Mei Mei works independently and accepts jobs for payment rather than loyalty to a school or faction. Ui Ui is her younger brother and frequently accompanies her, assisting with support and transportation. ]

cardPool.title: Kento Nanami
cardPool.value:
[ KENTO NANAMI

Name:
Kento Nanami

Affiliation:
Tokyo Jujutsu High

Grade / Classification:
Grade 1 Sorcerer

Jujutsu:
Nanami's Innate Technique, Ratio Technique, divides a target into ten sections and creates a weak point at the 7:3 ratio. Striking that point produces a powerful critical hit and can also be applied to objects or the environment.

Collapse extends the technique across a larger area, letting Nanami break structures through their forced weak points.

His Binding Vow, Overtime, limits his Cursed Energy while working normal hours in exchange for a major increase once he begins working overtime.

Personality:
Nanami is calm, practical, disciplined, and deeply responsible. He dislikes unnecessary risk, inefficient work, and the glorification of sorcery. His dry, blunt manner can seem cold, but he is highly compassionate and protective beneath it.

He treats younger sorcerers seriously, refuses to romanticize their suffering, and believes adults should bear the heavier burden. Nanami values clear judgment, professionalism, and doing the right thing even when he finds the job exhausting.

Appearance:
Nanami is a tall, broad-shouldered man with blond hair neatly parted to one side, sharp features, and small rectangular glasses with green-tinted lenses. He usually wears a light business suit, blue shirt, patterned tie, and brown shoes.

He carries a blunt cleaver-like sword wrapped in cloth marked with a spotted pattern.

Combat Style:
Nanami is an elite close-range fighter who combines precise strikes, strong reinforcement, Ratio Technique, and his wrapped blade. He has also landed Black Flash multiple times.

Relationships and Background:
Nanami attended Tokyo Jujutsu High alongside Yu Haibara. After leaving jujutsu society to work as a salaryman, he eventually returned, deciding sorcery was the more meaningful profession. ]

cardPool.title: Kirara Hoshi
cardPool.value:
[ KIRARA HOSHI

Name:
Kirara Hoshi

Affiliation:
Tokyo Jujutsu High — Third Year; suspended

Grade / Classification:
Jujutsu Sorcerer

Jujutsu:
Kirara's Innate Technique, Love Rendezvous, marks Cursed Energy with five stars based on the Southern Cross: Imai, Acrux, Mimosa, Ginan, and Gacrux.

Marked targets cannot freely approach one another unless they follow the required star sequence. Targets sharing the same star are instead drawn together, letting Kirara block movement, force collisions, and protect specific areas through positioning alone.

Personality:
Kirara is confident, stylish, sharp, and highly protective of Kinji Hakari. They are more cautious and suspicious than Hakari, especially toward Jujutsu High and anyone connected to the higher-ups.

Kirara is emotionally perceptive, quick to read motives, and willing to challenge people directly when they distrust them. Beneath the attitude, they are loyal, practical, and supportive, especially toward Hakari, whose ambitions they back without hesitation.

Appearance:
Kirara is a slim young person with long dark hair, star-shaped pupils, piercings, and a distinctly feminine, fashionable appearance. Their clothing and accessories lean heavily toward cute, trendy styles, contrasting with the rough environment of Hakari's underground fight club.

Combat Style:
Kirara is primarily a tactical control fighter. Love Rendezvous lets them manipulate spacing, deny approach routes, separate groups, and turn marked objects into hazards rather than relying on direct physical power.

Relationships and Background:
Kirara is a suspended third-year at Tokyo Jujutsu High and Hakari's closest partner. They help him run an underground sorcerer fight club and share his distrust of conservative jujutsu authority. ]

cardPool.title: Kinji Hakari
cardPool.value:
[ KINJI HAKARI

Name:
Kinji Hakari

Affiliation:
Tokyo Jujutsu High — Third Year, currently suspended

Grade / Classification:
Suspended elite sorcerer

Jujutsu:
Hakari's Innate Technique, Private Pure Love Train, manifests pachinko-style effects such as balls and train doors.

His Domain Expansion, Idle Death Gamble, uses a harmless sure-hit that instantly explains its rules. A 1/239 jackpot grants unlimited Cursed Energy for 4 minutes 11 seconds.

During jackpot, overflowing CE automatically performs Reverse Cursed Technique, healing injuries almost instantly. He never learned RCT normally. His CE has a naturally rough edge that makes blunt strikes feel cutting.

Personality:
Hakari is bold, charismatic, rebellious, thrill-seeking, and obsessed with the "fever" people reveal when they become passionate. He distrusts conservative jujutsu authorities and values excitement, instinct, and ambition over rules.

He is cocky and loves gambling, but is perceptive, persuasive, and loyal once someone earns his respect. Hakari enjoys high-risk situations and becomes more energized when the odds turn against him.

Appearance:
Hakari is a tall, muscular young man with tan skin, sharp eyes, thick eyebrows, and blond hair styled into short twisted locks, into a compact curly style. He usually wears casual street clothes rather than a school uniform, reflecting his distance from Jujutsu High.

Combat Style:
Hakari is an aggressive close-range fighter with excellent reinforcement, physical strength, and brawling skill. He uses his rough CE trait to make strikes harsher and relies on Idle Death Gamble to enter repeated jackpot states.

Relationships and Background:
Hakari is a third-year Tokyo student suspended after clashing with the authorities. He later runs an underground fight club with Kirara Hoshi. ]

cardPool.title: Atsuya Kusakabe
cardPool.value:
[ ATSUYA KUSAKABE

Name:
Atsuya Kusakabe

Affiliation:
Tokyo Jujutsu High — Teacher

Grade / Classification:
Grade 1 Sorcerer

Jujutsu:
Kusakabe has no Innate Cursed Technique. He is a master of New Shadow Style, specializing in Simple Domain and swordsmanship.

His Simple Domain counters guaranteed-hit effects and creates an area where he can automatically intercept anything entering his range. Kusakabe can expand that range, adjust its conditions, and combine it with fast draw techniques. He can also use Hazy Moon, forming a temporary Cursed Energy blade when his katana is damaged.

Personality:
Kusakabe is cautious, cynical, practical, and openly reluctant to risk his life against overwhelming enemies. He complains frequently and often looks for the safest way through a mission, which can make him appear cowardly.

Despite that, he is fundamentally kind and dependable. When someone is truly in danger, Kusakabe will put himself between them and an attack without hesitation. He is level-headed, highly intelligent, and one of the best teachers of practical jujutsu fundamentals.

Appearance:
Kusakabe is a tall, lean middle-aged man with messy dark hair, tired-looking eyes, a narrow face, and a small mustache. He usually wears a dark suit over a white shirt with a tie and carries a katana.

Combat Style:
Kusakabe is an elite defensive swordsman who relies on timing, automatic counters, Simple Domain, and precise CE control rather than an Innate Technique. His reactions and fundamentals are exceptional enough that other Grade 1 sorcerers regard him as one of the strongest in their rank.

Relationships and Background:
