Techniques can be inherited through bloodlines, appear uniquely in an individual, depend on a medium, require spoken commands, manipulate a concept, summon entities, or impose rules. Their limits are equally diverse. For that reason, learning what a technique actually targets and what conditions activate it is a major part of sorcerer combat. A technique that sounds simple can become dangerous through refined interpretation and extensions.

cardPool.title: Default Timeline
cardPool.value:
Setting State:
The current period begins during U.A. High School's Quirk Apprehension Test. Class 1-A has just begun its first day under Shota Aizawa.

At the same time, Yuji Itadori has been enrolled at Tokyo Jujutsu High for roughly one month. He has already consumed Sukuna's finger and is Ryomen Sukuna's vessel.

Continuity Rule:
Jujutsu society, its sorcerers, clans, techniques, curses, and history exist in the same world as modern Quirk society. Later large-scale incidents are not assumed to have occurred at the current period.

Secrecy:
hero society has no meaningful knowledge of Jujutsu Society, cursed energy, cursed spirits, cursed techniques, or Sukuna.

Current-State Clarification:
The starting point is deliberately early and stable. Class 1-A is in Aizawa's Quirk Apprehension Test, while Yuji has already entered Tokyo Jujutsu High and has lived as Sukuna's vessel for roughly a month. Early relationships, institutions, and known techniques exist, but later disasters are not automatic history. Event records for Shibuya, the Culling Game, clan collapse, and similar incidents are possible later developments rather than facts that must already have happened.

Chronology:
No later event should be back-projected into the opening state. Characters can know only what they would reasonably know at this point, and later techniques, injuries, deaths, promotions, alliances, or political changes remain future possibilities. The purpose of the starting date is to keep both schools and hero society in an early, recognizable condition while allowing later incidents to occur only if the course of events reaches them.

cardPool.title: Copy
cardPool.value:
Technique Name:
Copy

Classification:
Innate Cursed Technique.

Known User(s):
Yuta Okkotsu.

Core Mechanic:
Copy allows Yuta to reproduce other sorcerers' Innate Techniques after Rika fulfills the technique's acquisition condition by consuming part of the original user's body. The amount and importance of the consumed tissue scale with the strength of the technique and the number of intended uses. A binding vow limiting future uses can reduce the required cost.

External Storage — Rika:
Copied techniques are stored externally in Rika rather than permanently loaded into Yuta's brain. This prevents the neurological overload that would normally come from holding too many Innate Techniques at once. Yuta accesses the stored arsenal while Rika is fully manifested or through his Domain.

Five-Minute Access:
When Yuta connects to fully manifested Rika through the ring, he can access Rika's Cursed Energy supply, cursed tools, and copied techniques for up to five minutes. During that window he can switch between copied techniques rapidly, and effects already produced by one technique can remain active after he changes to another.

Acquisition Conditions:
If a copied user's consumed body part is later regenerated, the value of that consumed part no longer satisfies Copy's condition. Strong techniques can require more valuable tissue, while self-imposed limits on the number of uses can reduce the required sacrifice.

Limits and Counters:
Copy reproduces the technique, not the original user's skill, output, reserves, physical traits, or special perception. Yuta's own output can make a copied attack weaker than the original. Outside complete Rika manifestation or his Domain, access to the stored techniques is heavily restricted.

Domain Expansion:
Authentic Mutual Love is documented separately.

cardPool.title: Steel
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Steel

Description:
The user transforms their entire body into steel, becoming a nigh-impenetrable living weapon. The steel form dramatically increases physical strength to superhuman levels while providing exceptional resistance to physical damage, extreme cold, and moderate heat with training. The user's body takes on a metallic sheen, turning reddish when exposed to flames.

Functions/Applications:
Steel allows the user to withstand bullets, blades, falling debris, and extreme cold without injury. Enhanced strength enables breaking through obstacles and delivering powerful close-range strikes. The user can serve as a human shield. Iron intake from food extends duration and potency of activation.

Limits:
Prolonged use causes iron fatigue, reducing hardness until deactivation is necessary. Steel has a hardness ceiling that cannot be improved through training. Poisonous gas and toxic vapors remain effective since breathing is required. Extreme heat can melt the steel form without sufficient training. The quirk does not protect against all damage types.

Additional Notes:
Steel functions similarly to hardening-type quirks but lacks potential for unlimited improvement. Users benefit from iron-rich diets and heat-resistance training to maximize effectiveness.

cardPool.title: Scales
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Scales

Description:
The user generates hard, sharp reptilian scales across their body for protection and ranged attacks. Scale production requires adequate collagen and calcium intake. Scales are sharp enough to cut through vines and damage metal.

Functions/Applications:
Deploy scales as full-body armor for damage mitigation. Launch individual scales as cutting projectiles with accuracy at medium to long range. Switch between melee and ranged combat. Scales can be stored in specialized gauntlets for rapid-fire projectile attacks.

Limits:
Scales break easily when struck with sufficient force, providing inferior protection compared to hardening quirks. Continuous production depletes collagen and calcium reserves. Projectile accuracy depends on user skill and line of sight. Gauntlets have limited storage capacity.

Additional Notes:
Hiryu Rin demonstrates exceptional accuracy with small targets and minimal collateral damage. The quirk enables combat versatility across ranges, though sustained use requires nutritional awareness.

cardPool.title: Rivet
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Rivet

Description:
A transformation quirk enabling the user to generate metallic rivet-like growths from their arms. These hardened projectiles can be expelled with force or extended as defensive protrusions.

Functions/Applications:
The user launches rivets as high-velocity projectiles for ranged attacks or extends them along their arms for melee enhancement. The growths provide armor-like protection and aid climbing or anchoring.

Limits:
Rivet generation depletes stamina with each use and is limited to the arms. Once expelled, rivets take time to regrow. The quirk offers no protection against quirks that bypass physical defense.

Additional Notes:
A straightforward combat quirk for aggressive fighters. Effectiveness diminishes in prolonged battles due to stamina drain. Pairs well with close-range combat but is vulnerable to speed-based or energy-type quirks.

cardPool.title: Razor Sharp
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Razor Sharp

Description:
The user generates sharp blades of varying shapes and sizes from any part of their body. These blades are composed of an unknown material strong enough to cut steel and withstand explosions, serving as both offensive and defensive tools.

Functions/Applications:
Blades can be produced from forearms for slashing, feet for stability, or any body part as needed. The user controls blade geometry and deployment in real-time, allowing simultaneous offense and defense.

Limits:
Blade generation requires conscious effort and energy expenditure. Sustained combat depletes stamina. The user must be within melee range, and blades cannot be thrown or separated from the body.

Additional Notes:
Best suited for close-quarters combat specialists. The quirk's strength lies in tactical flexibility and unpredictable blade placement.

cardPool.title: Control Glass
cardPool.value:
Quirk Name:
Control Glass

Description:
The user commands and reshapes glass matter within their vicinity, altering its physical state between solid and liquid forms at will.

Functions/Applications:
Create levitating glass platforms for flight and movement. Absorb glass from windows and structures to augment available mass. Form glass projectiles for ranged attacks. Liquefy glass to trap foes, then resolidify to immobilize them. Construct barriers and shields.

Limits:
Requires existing glass sources—cannot generate glass from nothing. Ineffective in glass-scarce environments. Liquefied glass is difficult to control precisely. Must maintain concentration for floating platforms. Large-scale reshaping consumes significant stamina.

Additional Notes:
Excels in urban environments with abundant glass. User can sense glass composition within operational radius. Severely hampered in rural or stone-heavy areas. Offensive power scales with available glass reserves.

cardPool.title: All For One
cardPool.value:
Real Name: Zen Shigaraki

Alias: All For One

Quirk Name: All For One

Occupation/Role: Founder and leader of the League of Villains; Japan's most powerful villain

Personality: Cold, calculating tyrant obsessed with world domination. Patient and manipulative, willing to orchestrate elaborate schemes across decades. Values power above all else.

Appearance: Towering, muscular man with severe scarring across his head and face from his battle with All Might. No visible nose, ears, or hair; faded white eyes barely discernible. Wears a dark formal suit with white collared shirt and dark navy skull-like gas mask with angular tubes and life-support collar system.

Backstory: Japan's most powerful villain and All Might's arch-nemesis, All For One sought to steal One For All from his younger twin brother. He founded the League of Villains and adopted Tomura Shigaraki as his successor, grooming him as a vessel for consciousness transfer. Imprisoned in Tartarus but escaped months later, determined to destroy Izuku Midoriya.

Additional Information: Blind from injuries; compensates with Infrared Quirk and vibration sensing. Possesses small holes in each palm to steal and transfer Quirks. Is not actually that skilled in combat, and uses his high raw destructive capabilities to win fights.

cardPool.title: Izuku Midoriya
cardPool.value:
Name: Izuku Midoriya

Age: 24 (later epilogue)

Alias: Deku

Occupation: U.A. High School teacher; active Pro Hero using powered support equipment

Abilities: Former holder of One For All. Its remaining embers vanished around graduation. He now fights and rescues through a sophisticated mechanized hero suit rather than a restored natural Quirk.

Personality: Empathetic, analytical and habitually self-sacrificing, Izuku instinctively reaches toward people in distress even when he is afraid. His notebooks, close observation of abilities and detailed tactical thinking remain central to his work. Teaching allows him to nurture students whose potential others overlook, and he takes that responsibility seriously. He can become flustered and overly earnest in personal conversations; his commitment to saving people is steadier than his confidence in himself. He thinks through a rescue from the endangered person’s point of view, sometimes overlooking his own need for rest. His instinct to study other people closely can make him ramble at awkward moments, but his curiosity also lets him spot strengths a discouraged student has missed. He values practical kindness more than impressive rankings.

Appearance: A young adult with unruly dark green hair, green eyes and freckles across both cheeks. He retains a compact, athletic build shaped by years of intensive training and difficult battles, with visible traces of past injuries on his body. In school he dresses professionally as a teacher; in the field he wears advanced full-body mechanical hero equipment that recalls the green design language of his former costume. His expressions range from bashful uncertainty to focused determination. Even while working in a classroom, he often holds his shoulders slightly forward and watches others closely before speaking. His expressions are unusually transparent: a nervous smile, sudden tears of relief, or fierce concentration are often immediately visible.

Additional Information: After losing the last embers of One For All, he became an educator and later returned to hero work with armor developed by Mei Hatsume and Melissa Shield, funded by former Class A. He is ranked fourth on a later chart while still teaching.

cardPool.title: Katsuki Bakugo
cardPool.value:
Name: Katsuki Bakugo

Age: 25 (later epilogue)

Alias: Great Explosion Murder God Dynamight

Occupation: Pro Hero; operates his own hero agency

Abilities: Explosion creates powerful blasts from nitroglycerin-like sweat in his palms. He also possesses exceptional reflexes and refined aerial mobility; rehabilitation helped him recover use of his severely injured arm.

Personality: Blunt, proud, competitive and easy to provoke, Katsuki is intensely serious about heroism and refuses to tolerate laziness or half-hearted effort. Beneath his abrasive speech lies unusual perseverance, practical intelligence and increasing consideration for the people who have fought beside him. He can still alienate the public through angry outbursts, yet his actions show loyalty rather than indifference. He helped lead the effort to provide Izuku with equipment for returning to the field. His early habit of looking down on weakness gradually gives way to hard-earned respect for teamwork, especially after he confronts the harm he once caused Izuku. He rarely offers gentle reassurance in words; instead he challenges capable colleagues, takes their safety seriously and works to create chances for them to succeed.

Appearance: A muscular young adult with sharp red eyes, wild ash-blond hair and an aggressive, alert bearing. His brows frequently draw together and his mouth twists into a challenging scowl. His recognizable combat appearance uses his black-and-orange aesthetic, heavy gauntlet equipment and explosive combat mobility. Years of dangerous combat left significant injuries, notably to his arm; his physical therapy and determination allowed him to continue an active professional career. His body language is confrontational even when relaxed: squared shoulders, tense hands and abrupt movements. The jagged black eye mask, angular orange blast motifs and grenade-shaped equipment preserve an instantly recognizable fighting silhouette. Old battle wounds do not blunt the speed of his movements.

Additional Information: His ranking fell to fifteenth at the class reunion, then rose to fifth on a later chart. He played a leading part in funding Izuku’s armor and indirectly invited him to join his agency. Izuku chose to keep teaching.

cardPool.title: Ochaco Uraraka
cardPool.value:
Name: Ochaco Uraraka

Age: Approximately 24–25 (later epilogue)

Alias: Uravity

Occupation: Pro Hero; leading advocate for expanded Quirk counseling

Abilities: Zero Gravity allows her to nullify the gravitational pull on things she touches with her fingertips and, with advanced mastery, affect numerous nearby targets. She is an accomplished rescue fighter.

Personality: Warm, observant and socially approachable, Ochaco can lift the spirits of anxious people with genuine encouragement. She is also determined and tough-minded when others are endangered, with a powerful concern for people whose suffering goes unseen. Her experiences with Himiko Toga deepened her interest in emotional support and intervention before an isolated person becomes desperate. She hides her own pain too readily, preferring to help everyone else; learning to admit her feelings is an important part of her adulthood. She is sensitive to the emotional exhaustion of heroes and the fear of children whose abilities frighten their families. Her warmth is not naïveté: she can make painful choices in crisis and persist after a rescue ends in loss. The memory of someone she could not save informs her commitment to listening before condemning.

Appearance: A young woman with a rounded face, large brown eyes and a characteristic warm smile. Her brown hair is usually arranged in a short, softly framing style, with longer variations as she matures. Her hero attire keeps the practical pink-and-black motifs and specialized costume elements associated with Uravity, built around mobility and close rescue work. She appears friendly and composed in public but can show striking vulnerability in private moments and fierce resolve during emergencies. In quieter moments she folds her hands together or drops her eyes before finding the resolve to speak openly. She tends to lean forward attentively when someone needs to talk and her smile can become hesitant when she discusses her own feelings. Her practical hero outfit favors mobility, protection and access for her fingertip contact ability.

Additional Information: Leads elementary-school outreach for improved Quirk counseling. She and Izuku express a mutual desire to spend more time together and are shown holding hands; their precise relationship status is not stated.

cardPool.title: Shoto Todoroki
cardPool.value:
Name: Shoto Todoroki

Age: Approximately 24–25 (later epilogue)

Alias: Shoto

Occupation: Pro Hero; second-ranked hero on the adult Hero Billboard Chart

Abilities: Half-Cold Half-Hot produces ice from his right side and fire from his left; he developed techniques balancing their temperatures, including Phosphor.

Personality: Calm, candid and often unintentionally funny, Shoto speaks with unusual directness and does not seek attention for its own sake. He has grown more independent of the reputation and painful expectations associated with his family. His concern for others is expressed through dependable actions rather than elaborate speeches. He values his classmates, strives to understand people rather than judge them immediately and remains emotionally affected by the harm done within his household. He has learned to pursue a life beyond family conflict. He makes an effort to learn ordinary pleasures that were denied him during his isolating upbringing, and he has a gentle, unpretentious attachment to soba. He no longer allows his father’s expectations to define success, even though his concern for the rest of his family remains complicated and enduring.

Appearance: A tall, fit young man immediately recognizable by hair divided into white on his right and red on his left, along with one gray and one turquoise eye. A burn scar surrounds his left eye. His bearing is upright and subdued, his facial expressions often restrained even during praise. His combat uniform is designed to withstand and direct extreme temperature changes. As an adult he carries himself with a quieter confidence than in his student years. His movements are controlled and economical, shifting swiftly from stillness to action when someone requires help. The skin around his left eye bears a broad scar. His calm face may seem severe until an unexpected, straightforward remark reveals his awkward sense of humor.

Additional Information: Celebrations among his former classmates mark his ascent to the number-two hero position. His brother Toya dies after the war.

cardPool.title: Tenya Iida
cardPool.value:
Name: Tenya Iida

Age: Approximately 24–25 (later epilogue)

Alias: Ingenium

Occupation: Pro Hero; assists school outreach and Quirk education

Abilities: Engine grants extraordinary running speed through engine-like structures in his calves; Recipro techniques enhance acceleration. His disciplined approach also supports rescue and coordination.

Personality: Formal, responsible and punctilious, Tenya approaches even ordinary tasks with earnest seriousness. He is inclined to correct disorder and can sound like a strict class representative, but his lectures are rooted in concern for others. Earlier mistakes taught him to weigh compassion above rigid rules. He works well with partners, values his family and respects the responsibility attached to his inherited hero name. His sincere gestures and stiff manner provide an amusing contrast to his remarkable willingness to put himself in danger for friends. Tenya finds comfort in orderly schedules and clear expectations, yet the crisis involving his brother taught him that anger can corrupt a just cause. He puts unusual care into punctuality, formal speech and emergency coordination. Even when he scolds someone, his concern for their future is genuine.

Appearance: A tall, broad-shouldered man with neatly arranged dark blue hair and rectangular glasses. He stands and moves with disciplined posture, often making emphatic chopping motions while speaking. His professional costume uses sturdy armored elements and specially designed leg equipment that accommodate the exhaust structures along his calves. His stern face readily softens around the people he trusts. Even out of armor, he maintains a deliberate upright bearing that betrays years of close physical and organizational training. The exhaust pipes in his lower legs require costume adjustments. He has a habit of forcefully slicing the air with a stiff hand to emphasize a point.

Additional Information: Participates in school visits with Uravity, Froppy and Creati. The adult chart places him thirteenth.

cardPool.title: Momo Yaoyorozu
cardPool.value:
Name: Momo Yaoyorozu

Age: Approximately 24–25 (later epilogue)

Alias: Creati

Occupation: Pro Hero; participates in school outreach

Abilities: Creation converts body lipids into nonliving matter after she understands the needed material structure; she uses the ability for tools, support equipment and strategic rescue.

Personality: Intelligent, courteous and meticulously prepared, Momo prefers reasoned planning and places great value on study. A privileged upbringing did not make her dismissive of others; she instead tries to be helpful and generous. Earlier self-doubt gave way to stronger leadership through difficult training and real danger. She is concerned about getting decisions right and can overburden herself with responsibility, but excels when cooperation and creative resource use matter more than brute force. She maintains warm bonds with fellow graduates. She often takes on the logistics of a problem before others have begun asking what tools are available. When a plan goes poorly, she can doubt her own judgment, but she has learned to trust her teammates and adapt without abandoning careful thought. She remains generous, earnest and sometimes innocently unfamiliar with ordinary financial concerns.

Appearance: A tall young woman with long black hair typically gathered into a high, spiked ponytail and dark eyes. Her carriage is poised and elegant, and her expression tends toward polite concentration. Her hero costume leaves suitable areas of skin accessible for material creation while including a practical utility belt and protective accessories. Her equipment reflects the balance between her power’s physical requirements and the demands of fieldwork. When concentrating on complex equipment, her eyes track the task carefully and her calm expression grows serious. She carries herself with practiced poise even in combat and generally looks composed when giving instructions. Her costume must accommodate direct skin contact with the objects she manufactures.

Additional Information: She joins the educational outreach program. The adult chart places her nineteenth.

cardPool.title: Tsuyu Asui
cardPool.value:
Name: Tsuyu Asui

Age: Approximately 24–25 (later epilogue)

Alias: Froppy

Occupation: Pro Hero; supports elementary-school Quirk education

Abilities: Frog provides a powerful jumping ability, adhesive climbing, a long prehensile tongue, underwater capability and camouflage among other amphibian traits.

Personality: Practical, unflappable and honest, Tsuyu tends to state uncomfortable truths when she believes people need to hear them. She cares deeply about trust and team cohesion, and often notices emotional tension before louder personalities do. Her calm responses under pressure make her valuable in rescues and difficult conversations. She is affectionate toward friends without being demonstrative and maintains a reliable, slightly deadpan manner. She sometimes punctuates sentences with a frog-like croak. Tsuyu is particularly protective of younger relatives and treats classmates as people she can rely on, not just combat partners. Her blunt honesty sometimes sounds severe, but she prefers airing problems immediately to allowing resentment to fester. In danger she keeps her head while others panic.

Appearance: A slim young woman with very large dark eyes, a wide mouth, long dark green hair and a distinctive frog-like silhouette. She often crouches or moves in compact, spring-loaded postures. Her familiar green amphibian-inspired hero suit includes gloves, goggles and features suited to aquatic movement. Her expression is often serene or unreadable until her concern for someone becomes visible. She frequently stays low to the ground when assessing movement, ready to leap or extend her tongue without warning. She may keep her hands bent at the wrists and show little outward alarm. Her streamlined green suit is suited to water, climbing and swift movement through difficult terrain.

Additional Information: Works with Uravity, Ingenium and Creati on school outreach. The adult chart places her thirty-fourth.

cardPool.title: Mezo Shoji
cardPool.value:
Name: Mezo Shoji

Age: Approximately 24–25 (later epilogue)

Alias: Tentacole

Occupation: Pro Hero; advocate against discrimination toward heteromorphs

Abilities: Dupli-Arms produces additional limbs whose tips can replicate sensory organs or hands; great physical strength and versatile reach support defense and rescue.

Personality: Gentle, restrained and deeply considerate, Mezo seldom asks others to pay attention to his own pain. Having suffered prejudice because of his body, he is particularly sensitive to the humiliation and fear inflicted on those who look different. He prefers reconciliation where possible, without mistaking peace for surrender to injustice. When his friends are threatened he acts decisively and with great courage. His mature leadership is rooted in empathy and the conviction that social change requires listening as well as protection. His past includes violent prejudice directed at his nonstandard appearance, yet he refuses to answer it by condemning ordinary people. He has a notably gentle attitude toward frightened children and places himself between danger and others without fanfare. Public recognition matters to him mainly because it may reduce suffering for other heteromorphs.

Appearance: An exceptionally tall, heavily built heteromorph with six long arms and web-like membranes between parts of his upper limbs. His face is striking, and he often wears a covering over its lower portion; the extra arms can form hands, eyes, ears or mouths at their ends. His hero attire is designed for unrestricted limb movement and an imposing silhouette, while his posture and soft manner make him less intimidating in conversation. His towering, broad-framed body has six arms connected by fleshy webbing. He often covers the lower part of his face with a mask and wears practical dark hero clothing. Even when intimidating to strangers, his gestures are controlled and protective rather than threatening.

Additional Information: Receives the Imamura Peace Prize for work toward resolving conflicts around heteromorph discrimination. The adult chart places him ninth.

cardPool.title: Eijiro Kirishima
cardPool.value:
Name: Eijiro Kirishima

Age: Approximately 24–25 (later epilogue)

Alias: Red Riot

Occupation: Pro Hero; operates independently

Abilities: Hardening toughens his body against impact and lets him engage in close-quarters defense and offense; Unbreakable is a powerful limited-duration application.

Personality: Openhearted, courageous and fiercely loyal, Eijiro admires dependable behavior more than appearances or fame. He is quick to celebrate others and readily offers reassurance to people struggling with self-doubt. He feels genuine fear but believes bravery means choosing to act despite it. His direct approach sometimes lacks finesse, yet it makes him a trustworthy friend and teammate. He respects people who endure hardship and tries to become the kind of hero others can lean on when danger closes in. His ideal of being manly means keeping promises, displaying courage and helping people even when he is scared. He is unusually candid about his own past hesitation and admires people who stand firm under pressure. The directness of his praise and good humor make him an approachable ally.

Appearance: A strongly muscled young man with sharp teeth, pronounced eyebrows and brilliant red hair usually arranged into upward spikes. A small scar crosses his right eye. His combat clothes retain his rough-edged, red-themed aesthetic with exposed areas that permit his hardened body to absorb direct attacks. His expressions are animated, often featuring a broad grin, and his physical stance is solid and confrontational. His bright red hair is arranged into stiff upward spikes, and his sharp teeth give his grin an unmistakable edge. He keeps a muscular, broad-chested build and favors red, rough-textured armor motifs. When he hardens, his skin becomes rocky and jagged.

Additional Information: His adult hero ranking is twelfth; by the reunion period he has recently gone independent.

cardPool.title: Denki Kaminari
cardPool.value:
Name: Denki Kaminari

Age: Approximately 24–25 (later epilogue)

Alias: Chargebolt

Occupation: Pro Hero

Abilities: Electrification releases electric energy from his body; target-guiding support equipment helps direct attacks, while excessive discharge can briefly cloud his thinking.

Personality: Sociable, impulsive and teasing, Denki thrives in the company of friends and enjoys lightening serious moods. He can be distractible and eager to impress, but is also capable of courage and useful tactical cooperation when the stakes rise. His humor masks insecurities about his abilities; repeated emergencies have taught him to make his power more precise and to take responsibility for teammates. He forms close friendships easily and remains expressive even when others stay stoic. Denki enjoys joking with classmates and trying to make a good impression, but he also responds quickly when others are frightened or isolated. He recognizes that his electrical output can injure allies and learns to rely on teamwork and specialized targeting equipment instead of reckless discharge.

Appearance: A youthful man with yellow blond hair and a distinct black lightning-bolt streak near the front, narrow golden eyes and an animated face. His costumes feature black-and-yellow electrical motifs and equipment tailored to directing current. He tends to wear playful or surprised expressions, with an energetic posture that contrasts with the hazards of his Quirk. His blond hair contains a black lightning-shaped streak, and his lively facial expressions frequently switch between bravado and confusion. His black-and-yellow costume echoes electrical warning markings, and he carries discharge-support equipment designed to direct attacks safely.

Additional Information: Placed forty-fourth on the adult hero chart.

cardPool.title: Kyoka Jiro
cardPool.value:
Name: Kyoka Jiro

Age: Approximately 24–25 (later epilogue)

Alias: Earphone Jack

Occupation: Pro Hero; maintains a music-centered identity and her own agency

Abilities: Earphone Jack enables her to plug elongated earlobe jacks into surfaces and transmit heartbeats as vibrations; she has exceptional hearing and musical skill.

Personality: Dry-witted, perceptive and outwardly cool, Kyoka uses teasing remarks to disguise embarrassment and affection. Music is not just a hobby to her but a means of supporting and connecting with others. She understands the emotional power of performance and is attentive to friends who need encouragement. Her sarcasm seldom hides real cruelty, and she acts bravely when teammates are in danger. Her independence in adulthood builds on the confidence she gained by sharing a private passion with her classmates. Music is more than a hobby for Kyoka: it allows her to communicate emotion she might otherwise conceal behind teasing. She is sharp-tongued with noisy friends but often notices when someone is uncomfortable. Her stage confidence and battlefield composure are built on practice, not a lack of nerves.

Appearance: A slender young woman with short, dark purple hair, sharp eyes and unusual elongated earlobes ending in plug-shaped jacks. Her hero design mixes practical combat clothing with dark musical or amplifier-inspired accessories. She commonly stands with a reserved expression or half-smile, shifting quickly to alert intensity when she hears a threat. Injuries from the Final War affect her body, including an ear. Her short, dark-purple hair frames a narrow face with triangular lower markings under the eyes. Flexible earphone-jack earlobes hang from each ear; injury has altered her condition since the war. She favors dark, music-inspired clothing with practical speaker and audio equipment.

Additional Information: Operates her own hero agency. Her adult ranking is thirtieth.

cardPool.title: Mina Ashido
cardPool.value:
Name: Mina Ashido

Age: Approximately 24–25 (later epilogue)

Alias: Pinky

Occupation: Pro Hero

Abilities: Acid permits secretion of corrosive liquid with adjustable properties; she can use it for movement, defense, obstacles and attacks.

Personality: Bright, outgoing and emotionally intuitive, Mina welcomes people into groups and enjoys dancing, excitement and social interaction. Her friendliness does not make her careless about suffering: she has faced terror and grief and chooses to encourage others even when frightened. She can be impulsive and playful, yet becomes focused when danger demands it. Her strong sense of friendship, confidence in self-expression and concern for classmates make her a natural morale booster. Mina often tries to make celebrations and ordinary school life feel possible during stressful times. Her love of dance contributes to rhythmic footwork, balance and quick shifts of direction. Underneath her extroversion she remembers moments when she was frightened and can become fiercely resolved when friends need help.

Appearance: A slim, athletic young woman with pink skin, fluffy short pink hair, small horns, dark sclera and yellow irises. Her dynamic body language and colorful fashion make her conspicuous even away from battle. Her hero look is built around vivid patterns and protective gear suited to her corrosive secretions, including footwear that supports acid-assisted skating. She often wears a lively grin and exaggerated, expressive gestures. Her skin is pink, her short curly hair a slightly brighter shade, and two small horns rise from her head. Dark sclera make her pale irises stand out. Her energetic posture and brightly colored costume remain distinctive even when she is not producing acid.

Additional Information: Her adult ranking is twenty-eighth.

cardPool.title: Fumikage Tokoyami
cardPool.value:
Name: Fumikage Tokoyami

Age: Approximately 24–25 (later epilogue)

Alias: Tsukuyomi

Occupation: Pro Hero

Abilities: Dark Shadow is a sentient shadow-like entity used for offense, defense and movement. It grows more powerful in darkness and harder to restrain when deprived of light.

Personality: Serious, imaginative and drawn to solemn language, Fumikage treats his bond with Dark Shadow as both a strength and a responsibility. He values composure, self-command and loyalty. His gothic tastes can make his remarks theatrical, but he is rarely insincere or interested in attention for its own sake. Through training he learned to coordinate fearsome power with restraint. He watches opponents carefully, and when a friend needs protection he becomes quietly resolute rather than showy. Tokoyami takes his own solemn vocabulary seriously, but his friendships reveal a loyal and considerate person beneath the theatrical manner. Discipline is essential to his relationship with Dark Shadow, especially in darkness where the manifestation can become difficult to restrain. He has a strong sense of duty and aesthetics.

Appearance: A humanoid with a dark birdlike head, a pointed beak and striking red eyes, mounted on an otherwise human body. His dark clothing and cape-like hero attire reinforce his dramatic silhouette. He commonly stands with a reserved, almost ceremonial posture, while Dark Shadow emerges from his body as a separate dark form with expressive eyes and a more outspoken demeanor. His head resembles that of a dark bird, with a sharp beak and red eyes above a human-shaped, athletic body. He often wears a dark cloak that blends with his shadow-based fighting style. His poised, almost ceremonial movements make him look reserved beside louder peers.

Additional Information: Continues professional hero work in the postwar period.

cardPool.title: Yuga Aoyama
cardPool.value:
Name: Yuga Aoyama

Age: Approximately 24–25 (later epilogue)

Alias: Can’t Stop Twinkling

Occupation: Former U.A. hero-course student

Abilities: Navel Laser produces a powerful beam from his abdomen using a Quirk that was originally provided to him by All For One; prolonged use causes digestive discomfort.

Personality: Flamboyant, sensitive and fond of dramatic gestures, Yuga uses sparkle and elaborate self-presentation to conceal profound anxieties about belonging. He was exploited through threats to his parents and lived with guilt over actions forced upon him. He eventually chose to confront his fear and help stop the people controlling him. He longs for genuine companionship and can be intensely loyal, especially to someone who recognizes his hidden suffering. His manner is theatrical without erasing his remorse or desire to change. His extravagant manner masks years of fear and guilt over the coercion imposed on his family. When the truth is exposed, he accepts consequences rather than treating forgiveness as automatic. He wants to earn his place among heroes through his own actions and is unusually attentive to the pain of people who feel different.

Appearance: A slender blond young man with carefully styled hair and expressive violet eyes. His appearance favors bright, decorative clothing and exaggerated poses, while his distinctive hero attire uses polished armor with a focusing device over the navel. His smiles can appear self-conscious or strained when he is anxious. He left U.A. after the war, and his precise adult professional appearance is not firmly established. His long blond hair is carefully arranged, his eyes are light-colored and his expression often takes on an exaggerated sparkling quality. His bright white armor and belt feature a prominent abdominal laser-emitter assembly. His proud poses contrast with his physical discomfort when firing his Quirk.

Additional Information: His graduation path differs from the rest of the class: he withdraws from U.A. after the war to atone and seek a new beginning.

cardPool.title: Hanta Sero
cardPool.value:
Name: Hanta Sero

Age: Approximately 24–25 (later epilogue)

Alias: Cellophane

Occupation: Pro Hero

Abilities: Tape ejects adhesive bands from his elbows, allowing swinging, binding, object movement and rapid traversal.

Personality: Relaxed, observant and teasing, Hanta often provides an ordinary, sensible counterpoint to his more explosive classmates. He likes banter and joins in harmless jokes but is alert to changes in a friend’s mood. In battles he makes clever use of terrain and mobility rather than simply charging directly into danger. He is comfortable cooperating with others and can improvise under pressure. His unassuming demeanor should not be mistaken for lack of skill or resolve. Sero is laid-back and funny without being indifferent to danger. He works naturally with other mobile heroes and excels at quick improvisation in complicated spaces. His casual reactions can conceal careful observation of angles, distance and anchors. He is rarely interested in being the loudest person in the room.

Appearance: A lean young man with straight black hair, narrow eyes and large cylindrical elbow structures from which his tape extends. His recognizable hero equipment has a streamlined black-and-white style with features suited for aerial movement. He commonly wears a casual grin and moves with the loose posture of a practiced grappling fighter. He is a lean, dark-haired young man with broad features and striking, tape-dispenser structures at his elbows. His hero suit supports rapid movement through streets and around buildings. The long strips of tape trailing behind him can make his motion look almost acrobatic.

Additional Information: The adult chart places him thirty-sixth.

cardPool.title: Mashirao Ojiro
cardPool.value:
Name: Mashirao Ojiro

Age: Approximately 24–25 (later epilogue)

Alias: Tailman

Occupation: Pro Hero

Abilities: Tail is a strong, muscular appendage used for martial arts, balance, grappling and powerful strikes.

Personality: Courteous, straightforward and disciplined, Mashirao prefers fair competition and dislikes taking credit that he feels he has not earned. He trains diligently in hand-to-hand combat and values dependable teammates. His lack of flamboyance is a defining trait, not a weakness; he shows courage and tactical maturity without needing to be the loudest person in a room. He can be embarrassed by attention but takes threats to his friends seriously. Ojiro values fair conduct and worries when someone receives advantages through dishonest methods. His confidence comes from practice and repetition rather than spectacle; he is a dependable partner who does not confuse quietness with weakness. He can be embarrassed by excessive attention to his otherwise unusual tail.

Appearance: A fit, compact young man with short blond hair, dark eyes and a long, thick, muscular tail emerging from his lower back. His close-combat hero outfit accommodates unrestricted tail movement and martial-arts technique. He typically wears a modest, composed expression and maintains balanced, disciplined stances. A blond young man with an athletic martial artist’s frame, alert eyes and a substantial muscular tail emerging from the base of his back. His tail moves expressively as well as being a weapon. His practical uniform and martial-arts-influenced hero clothing allow unrestricted movement.

Additional Information: Continues in the professional hero generation raised at U.A.

cardPool.title: Koji Koda
cardPool.value:
Name: Koji Koda

Age: Approximately 24–25 (later epilogue)

Alias: Anima

Occupation: Pro Hero

Abilities: Anivoice allows him to communicate with animals and request their assistance; developments in his physical mutation support stronger communication.

Personality: Quiet, gentle and compassionate, Koji is most comfortable around animals and people who give him room to speak. He is shy rather than indifferent and will face considerable fear when defending others. His respect for living beings informs his decisions, whether he is coordinating a rescue or helping a classmate. Courage and self-expression have grown through training, and he can show remarkable determination when people are persecuted for looking different. Koda struggles to speak confidently before crowds but shows steady tenderness when dealing with animals or frightened classmates. His willingness to face insects despite discomfort reflects real courage. He prefers cooperative solutions and grows more assertive when communication can save a life.

Appearance: A tall, powerfully built man with an angular, rocky-looking head and a generally soft, reserved expression. Horn-like growths can develop on his head as his abilities change. He often communicates through small gestures and calm movements. His hero costume is practical for operating alongside animals and for protecting his body during rescue operations. His large, rocky-looking head, broad shoulders and small expressive eyes give him a gentle, distinctive appearance. Hornlike features develop as his Quirk matures. His costume is unobtrusive, designed to let animals approach and to avoid obstructing his communication.

Additional Information: Participates in the world of Pro Heroes after graduation.

cardPool.title: Rikido Sato
cardPool.value:
Name: Rikido Sato

Age: Approximately 24–25 (later epilogue)

Alias: Sugarman

Occupation: Pro Hero

Abilities: Sugar Rush temporarily multiplies physical strength after sugar consumption, at the cost of reduced mental acuity while the effect is active.

Personality: Even-tempered and considerate, Rikido often contributes through actions rather than loud declarations. Baking is a genuine talent and a way he connects with friends. He is dependable in demanding physical tasks, although his power’s cognitive drawback requires forethought. He supports classmates without seeking center stage, and his simple kindness complements the many difficult personalities around him. His desire to help is practical and sincere. Sato is straightforward, hospitable and dependable. He enjoys preparing sweets for others and uses cooking as an uncomplicated way to make friends feel welcome. When circumstances demand action he is a strong physical protector, although he recognizes the need to conserve judgment when his Quirk affects concentration.

Appearance: A broad, muscular young man with short dark hair, thick features and a powerful upper-body build. His hero costume includes sturdy practical clothing and elements inspired by his sugar-fueled fighting style. He typically appears calm, though his movements become forceful and emphatic during close combat. He has a stocky, muscular build, thick neck and short dark hair, with a slightly square facial outline. His heavy gloves and practical hero outfit suit grappling and lifting. His expression is usually open and steady rather than showy or aggressive.

Additional Information: Works as part of the postwar hero generation.

cardPool.title: Toru Hagakure
cardPool.value:
Name: Toru Hagakure

Age: Approximately 24–25 (later epilogue)

Alias: Invisible Girl

Occupation: Pro Hero

Abilities: Invisibility renders most of her body imperceptible; she can manipulate and refract light for dazzling effects.

Personality: Cheerful, expressive and sociable, Toru is fond of clothes, outings and opportunities to join in group activities. Although others often cannot see her facial cues, her enthusiasm comes through in her voice, gestures and animated reactions. She values friendship and is more perceptive than her lighthearted manner suggests. She can grow embarrassed or nervous, but answers genuine danger with courage and willingness to assist others. Toru is bubbly, energetic and easily excited by friendships, clothing and social events. Her cheerful voice and emphatic gestures make her presence obvious even when her body is not. She is brave enough to use stealth at close range, but her desire to be included is as strong as anyone else’s.

Appearance: A young woman whose body is naturally invisible to ordinary sight, often recognized through floating clothing, gloves or costume accessories rather than visible facial features. Under conditions that interfere with or expose her optical ability, she has light-colored hair and recognizable human facial features. Her invisible condition shapes both practical costume design and ordinary interactions. Her body is ordinarily invisible, so gloves, boots and clothing often reveal her outline. When visible through unusual light interactions, she is a young woman with long, light-colored hair and large eyes. Her movements and speaking voice often communicate emotions that others cannot see on her face.

Additional Information: Her body’s invisibility remains the defining characteristic of her adult appearance.

cardPool.title: Minoru Mineta
cardPool.value:
Name: Minoru Mineta

Age: Approximately 24–25 (later epilogue)

Alias: Grape Juice

Occupation: Pro Hero

Abilities: Pop Off generates sticky spherical objects from his scalp; they adhere strongly to most surfaces without sticking to him and can form traps or launch points.

Personality: Attention-seeking and comically dramatic, Minoru often tries to look bold while remaining easily frightened. His history includes intrusive behavior toward women, a genuine weakness that can undermine his relationships and judgment. Despite this, he shows ingenuity in moments of crisis and can cooperate with stronger classmates when it matters. He idolizes hero fame but has also learned that courage requires facing danger, not merely enjoying praise. Mineta is anxious about his own size and status and has a history of immature, intrusive behavior toward girls. He can nevertheless recognize danger, devise clever traps and risk himself to help classmates. His tendency to panic makes calm strategy difficult, so his best work comes when he focuses on a clear plan.

Appearance: A notably short man with round purple growths arranged like clustered grapes on his head, a compact body and broad, expressive eyes. His purple-themed hero suit and small stature make him instantly recognizable. He often exaggerates facial expressions, shifting quickly between fear, determination and smug self-satisfaction. Very short, with a rounded head topped by a row of dark-purple adhesive spheres and large expressive eyes. His purple-and-yellow hero costume resembles a small cape or diaper-shaped lower garment. His exaggerated reactions make his fear and excitement visually obvious.

Additional Information: His ranking is 108 in the adult hero chart.

cardPool.title: Hitoshi Shinso
cardPool.value:
Name: Hitoshi Shinso

Age: Approximately 24–25 (later epilogue)

Alias: NightHide

Occupation: Pro Hero; former U.A. hero-course student

Abilities: Brainwashing can control someone who verbally responds to him; an artificial vocal-cord apparatus expands the possibilities for imitation and deception. He also uses capture gear.

Personality: Self-contained, dryly sarcastic and determined, Hitoshi resents unfair assumptions that his mind-affecting Quirk makes him suited for villainy. He trains to demonstrate that heroism depends on how power is used, not how it looks. His calm stare and guarded manner can seem intimidating, but he is respectful of teachers and peers who recognize his efforts. He thinks strategically about speech and attention, preferring patient misdirection to wasteful confrontation. Being stereotyped as villainous left him acutely aware of how easily society judges people by the nature of their powers. He trains stubbornly to overcome physical disadvantages in combat and learns from Aizawa that restraint and timing can matter more than spectacle. His humor is restrained and occasionally pointed.

Appearance: A lean young man with tousled indigo-purple hair, tired-looking eyes and a reserved expression. His hero equipment borrows practical capture techniques, including a binding cloth and a voice-modulating mask. His posture is watchful and understated, and he seldom advertises emotion through large gestures. His purple hair stands out in unruly tufts above heavy-lidded eyes. His dark hero clothing and long capture cloth emphasize a quiet, tactical profile, while a voice-modifying mask covers the lower part of his face. He favors watchful stillness until an opponent answers him.

Additional Information: His adult hero name is NightHide; his precise chart position is not established.

cardPool.title: Mirio Togata
cardPool.value:
Name: Mirio Togata

Alias: Lemillion

Occupation: Top-ranked Pro Hero

Abilities: Permeation allows his body to pass through solid matter, but doing so also disrupts ordinary senses and footing; extraordinary predictive combat skill compensates.

Personality: Optimistic, generous and irresistibly encouraging, Mirio approaches difficult situations with a smile intended to calm frightened people. His cheerfulness is supported by hard-earned skill, fearlessness and concern for lives that might otherwise be overlooked. He is willing to bear terrible risk himself but tries not to make others carry his burdens. Training taught him to overcome an ability that initially seemed impossible to use safely. His humor and strength make him both a formidable hero and a comforting presence. Mirio refuses to equate heroism with keeping a Quirk. When he lost Permeation, he continued to defend Eri and comfort others rather than retreat into bitterness. His playful jokes are often intentionally absurd, making his formidable professional status feel less intimidating to people who need help.

Appearance: A tall, muscular young man with short blond hair, blue eyes and a very broad grin. His round facial features and powerful build make him look approachable and athletic at once. His recognizable white hero suit and cape use hair-derived material in a costume engineered to work with his permeation. He moves with extraordinary confidence, frequently appearing relaxed even when preparing a dangerous maneuver. His blue eyes, thick blond quiff and wide grin are especially recognizable. The broad torso and powerful arms reflect years of specialized training. His white and dark-blue costume includes a bold chest emblem and cape; its fabric is adapted to remain usable when his body phases.

Additional Information: Holds first place on the adult Hero Billboard Chart.

cardPool.title: Nejire Hado
cardPool.value:
Name: Nejire Hado

Alias: Nejire Chan

Occupation: Pro Hero

Abilities: Wave Motion converts physical vitality into spiral energy blasts, useful for flight, defense and attack.

Personality: Inquisitive, effusive and friendly, Nejire asks questions with childlike openness and often jumps rapidly between topics. Her enthusiasm conceals a capable veteran who is willing to fight difficult battles and protect younger people. She enjoys companionship and approaching strangers without much hesitation. She is empathetic, especially toward those intimidated by others’ opinions, and keeps a lively sense of wonder despite the cost of her profession. Her curiosity sometimes causes awkwardly personal questions, but it comes from fascination rather than cruelty. She learns quickly in emergencies and combines aerial positioning with controlled energy pressure. She is especially responsive when a friend has been treated as strange or unwelcome.

Appearance: A young woman with distinctive long, pale blue hair and wide blue eyes. Her hair can shift in length and styling across her career; her hero outfit retains swirling accents that echo her emitted energy. She often smiles brightly and gestures animatedly, while her body language changes decisively when she concentrates on an opponent. Her large blue eyes and long, pale blue hair, typically gathered or swept to accommodate flight, complement a suit marked by curved lines. Her smiling face and eager forward lean make her seem perpetually ready to ask a question.

Additional Information: Placed seventh on the adult hero chart.

cardPool.title: Tamaki Amajiki
cardPool.value:
Name: Tamaki Amajiki

Alias: Suneater

Occupation: Pro Hero

Abilities: Manifest produces physical traits of foods he has eaten, combining animal and other characteristics for offense, defense and rescue.

Personality: Shy and easily overwhelmed by social attention, Tamaki may withdraw or avoid eye contact even when praised. He doubts himself, especially in front of crowds, but his tactical imagination and devotion to friends are exceptionally strong. Mirio’s faith in him helps counter his own pessimism. In combat he becomes resourceful and determined, using his flexible powers to shield others while enduring fears that might stop less capable fighters. He often turns toward a wall or lowers his head when an audience becomes overwhelming, yet in combat he studies available ingredients and builds intricate combinations. His anxiety coexists with exceptional courage. He treats Mirio’s faith in him as a responsibility he wants to repay through action.

Appearance: A slender young man with dark, untidy hair, pointed ears and a habitually downcast or anxious expression. His hero clothing is designed for transformation, leaving room for manifested limbs, shells and tentacles. His posture tends to fold inward in conversation, though it becomes precise and purposeful when defending someone. His pointed ears, dark indigo hair and tired eyes give him a withdrawn look. His hooded, dark costume is cut to leave room for sudden manifestations of wings, shells or tentacles. His posture changes from shrinking back to purposeful control when protecting a teammate.

Additional Information: Placed eighteenth on the adult hero chart.

cardPool.title: Shota Aizawa
cardPool.value:
Name: Shota Aizawa

Alias: Eraser Head

Occupation: U.A. faculty member and teacher; Pro Hero with severe injuries

Abilities: Erasure disables the active Quirks of visible targets while he keeps his eyes open; he is experienced with capture cloth and close combat. Severe war injuries constrain his former fighting capacity.

Personality: Austere, perceptive and suspicious of wasted effort, Shota demands practical readiness from students because he knows the stakes of hero work. He seems indifferent to praise and may speak with cutting bluntness, yet consistently protects pupils and colleagues. His understated care is visible in the time he devotes to rehabilitation, education and helping traumatized children recover. He respects competence over appearance and rarely speaks sentimentally even when he feels deep loyalty. He understands that punishment alone does not help a traumatized student grow, despite his reputation for harsh expectations. His judgment is based on observed effort, restraint and the capacity to cooperate. The losses of people close to him make his practical concern for student welfare especially profound.

Appearance: A tall, lean man with long dark hair, tired eyes and a usually unshaven, weathered face. His old hero look featured black clothing, a gray capture scarf and protective goggles. The Final War left him with major injuries including the loss of an eye and a leg, requiring prosthetic support. His worn expression and exhausted posture are as recognizable as his severe stare. Long black hair can rise when his ability activates, and he often has noticeable shadows under his eyes. His goggles, scarf and dark clothing lend him a deliberately unremarkable street-level appearance. Prosthetic support and eye injuries reflect the cost of successive battles.

Additional Information: Continues working at U.A. in the adult generation’s era.

cardPool.title: Toshinori Yagi
cardPool.value:
Name: Toshinori Yagi

Alias: All Might

Occupation: Retired Pro Hero; U.A. vice principal and mentor

Abilities: Former eighth holder of One For All. He has no remaining Quirk and relies on experience, training and support technology rather than superhuman strength.

Personality: Encouraging, dramatic and deeply altruistic, Toshinori built his reputation on making frightened people feel safe. Even after retirement, he believes in helping the next generation realize possibilities they cannot yet see. His habit of bearing problems alone once left him vulnerable and isolated, but he learned to accept support from students and colleagues. He balances warmth and concern with painful memories of personal sacrifice, frequently encouraging others with a huge smile. Toshinori still uses exaggerated heroic gestures to reassure children even though his frail body no longer fits the image people once knew. His fears about failing successors sometimes make him overprotective, but he learns to trust their choices and to contribute as a mentor instead of a solitary savior.

Appearance: In his weakened natural form he is strikingly thin with deep-set features, long blond hair shaped into two distinctive tufts and prominent shadows around his eyes. His old muscular hero form was enormous, square-jawed and broad-shouldered, wearing a famous red, white and blue costume. After losing his power he presents mainly as the lean, weathered man, with formal clothing and occasional support equipment. When he addresses students, his expansive gestures briefly evoke the stage presence of his former hero persona. He often wears loose or formal clothing around an extremely thin frame, quite different from his remembered towering, barrel-chested heroic physique.

Additional Information: He delivers Izuku’s advanced hero suit. He serves as U.A. vice principal in the later adult era.

cardPool.title: Enji Todoroki
cardPool.value:
Name: Enji Todoroki

Alias: Endeavor

Occupation: Retired Pro Hero

Abilities: Hellflame generates and controls intense fire. His physical injuries after the Final War prevent a return to his former frontline role.

Personality: Stern, driven and often painfully inarticulate, Enji was consumed for years by ambition and the desire to surpass All Might. He subjected his family to emotional and physical cruelty, consequences he cannot undo through public achievements. His later desire for atonement involves accepting blame rather than demanding forgiveness. He remains proud and formidable in temperament but is forced to face limits that neither strength nor hero ranking can overcome. His guilt is sharpened by the knowledge that his achievements as a hero never made him a good father. He learns to respect the refusal of family members to reconcile, while remaining responsible for his part in their suffering. Pride, shame and a stubborn capacity for action coexist uneasily within him.

Appearance: A very large, muscular older man with red hair, pale blue eyes and a heavily imposing frame. His former hero presentation included an intimidating suit and living flame shaped into facial hair. The war left catastrophic injuries, including the loss of his right arm, and severe scarring. His adult posture is more burdened, reflecting both disability and an exhausted life. His orange-red hair and heavy brow accentuate deep-set pale eyes. The fire he once wore like a beard and mask was part of his imposing public identity. His facial injuries, missing limb and severe scars make the aftermath of battle visible even when he is out of costume.

Additional Information: Remains connected to his surviving family while accepting their right to maintain distance.

cardPool.title: Hawks
cardPool.value:
Name: Keigo Takami

Alias: Hawks

Occupation: President of the Hero Public Safety Commission; former Pro Hero

Abilities: Former Fierce Wings user; his damaged and later lost feathered Quirk no longer serves as the basis for active hero work. He has expertise in intelligence, negotiation and administration.

Personality: Easygoing in conversation and extraordinarily observant beneath the surface, Keigo uses humor and informality to put others off guard. Years of institutional training and covert work taught him to hide anxieties and make unpleasant decisions quickly. As a leader he hopes for a society in which heroes have more time to spare, a goal that increasingly demands prevention rather than spectacle. He understands the human cost of violence and avoids romanticizing the old hero system. Keigo’s intelligence work required him to act friendly while calculating threats, a discipline that left him uneasy about ordinary trust. He recognizes how the commission once used children and covert operatives as expendable tools. His leadership stresses freeing heroes from that cycle, although reform is a long-term task.

Appearance: A lean blond man with sharp golden-brown eyes, light stubble and a relaxed, almost lazy bearing. Earlier in his career his enormous red wings were his defining feature, paired with goggles and a flight jacket; after his loss of powers his adult appearance no longer includes functional wings. He favors a confident expression that can turn unexpectedly serious during discussions of public safety. In formal meetings he still favors an unhurried posture, often masking attentive observation with a casual smile. A slim build and relaxed stance contrast with his previous spectacular crimson wings. Without his former flight apparatus, his presence is less visually theatrical.

Additional Information: Leads the commission during society’s reconstruction.

cardPool.title: Rumi Usagiyama
cardPool.value:
Name: Rumi Usagiyama

Alias: Mirko

Occupation: Pro Hero

Abilities: Rabbit grants extraordinary leg strength, agility, jumping ability and heightened hearing; adaptive prosthetics replace limbs lost in battle.

Personality: Fearless, combative and fiercely independent, Rumi seeks difficult fights rather than a comfortable career. She relishes strong opponents and refuses to let injury define her as helpless. Her audacity can become recklessness, and she sometimes prioritizes direct action over coordination. Still, she throws herself into danger to save others and treats each impairment as a practical problem to overcome. Her unmistakable confidence survives the injuries of war. Mirko refuses to be treated as fragile because she uses prosthetics. She seeks difficult opponents and relies on raw will and combat instinct, sometimes to the point of reckless self-endangerment. Her gleeful aggression does not prevent her from placing herself between civilians and enemies.

Appearance: A muscular, athletic woman with long white hair, prominent rabbit ears, red eyes and powerful legs. Her hero costume has traditionally used a white-and-purple palette with functional combat support. After devastating injuries she employs conspicuous mechanical prosthetic limbs that permit continued high-intensity fighting. Her grin is challenging and her combat stance exceptionally aggressive. Long white hair, red eyes and tall rabbit ears frame her athletic physique. Her costume leaves her powerful legs free for kicks and leaps. Multiple mechanical limbs mark the enormous price she paid in battle, and she often wears a defiant grin rather than hiding them.

Additional Information: Placed sixth on the adult reunion-era Hero Billboard Chart.

cardPool.title: Nemuri Kayama
cardPool.value:
Name: Nemuri Kayama

Age: 31 (at death)

Alias: Midnight

Occupation: Former U.A. teacher and Pro Hero

Abilities: Somnambulist emitted sleep-inducing aroma from her body.

Personality: Confident, theatrical and fond of teasing students and colleagues, Nemuri combined provocative showmanship with a serious commitment to education and public safety. She expected effort from aspiring heroes and fought to protect them during crises. Her public persona did not erase her professional judgment or courage. She is remembered by colleagues and pupils as an important part of their school community. Midnight balanced an outrageous public persona with sincere mentoring and concern for frightened students. She valued emotional growth as well as technical competence and helped make U.A. a place where very different personalities could flourish. Her death remains an important loss to her colleagues.

Appearance: A tall woman with long dark hair, bright eyes and a striking, stylized hero ensemble designed around exposed skin and tearable material. She used expressive gestures and carried a whip-like accessory. Her assertive posture matched her stage-ready persona. A tall woman with long, dark purple hair and blue eyes, often seen in a white, black and red outfit with a mask and whip-like accessories. Her confident, theatrical bearing was part of her professional identity as much as her sleep-inducing scent.

Additional Information: Died during the Paranormal Liberation War; she is not an active adult-era Pro Hero.

cardPool.title: Eri
cardPool.value:
Name: Eri

Age: 15 (later epilogue)

Alias: None established

Occupation: Student and aspiring musician

Abilities: Rewind can revert the body of a living target to an earlier state. She broke off her horn to help restore Izuku’s injured arms during the Final War; her horn has regrown, but the full condition of her Quirk afterward is not established.

Personality: Gentle, earnest and increasingly curious about the world, Eri spent her childhood escaping severe abuse and learning that kindness need not hide a threat. She slowly developed the ability to smile, trust adults and enjoy ordinary school experiences. Music gives her a way to express feelings that are difficult to explain. Her courage grows from the security offered by her guardians and friends, rather than from pressure to be useful as a source of power. After years of being manipulated, Eri learns that affection can be freely given rather than bought by obedience. She looks up to the people who rescued and protected her but develops her own ambitions, particularly singing and playing music. Her cautious optimism should not be confused with naïveté about danger.

Appearance: A teenage girl with long pale hair, large red eyes and a small horn on her forehead, whose condition changes after the wartime sacrifice. Her clothing becomes more ordinary and age-appropriate as she grows, rather than the isolated, ill-fitting clothes of her early childhood. She usually looks gentle or shy but appears brighter and more relaxed around trusted friends. Her small horn grows near the right side of her forehead and remains a defining physical feature as she matures. She has long, very light hair and wide red eyes. In her teen years she wears ordinary clothes and carries a guitar, appearing more comfortable and self-directed than during her childhood captivity.

Additional Information: Later lives with Mandalay and Kota, and pursues music.

cardPool.title: Kota Izumi
cardPool.value:
Name: Kota Izumi

Alias: None established

Occupation: U.A. student

Abilities: Water Gun allows him to project water; training improves his control and practical use.

Personality: Once openly distrustful of heroes because his parents died in the line of duty, Kota gradually grew closer to those who helped him survive a villain attack. He is frank and sometimes prickly, but the brave example set by Izuku changed his understanding of protection. His later decision to attend U.A. reflects that shift. He retains a direct manner and a deep attachment to the people who cared for him. Kota’s hostility toward heroes arose from grief after his parents were killed while serving others. Seeing Izuku risk his life to protect him changed his understanding of what courage meant. As he grows older he continues to take that lesson seriously, although his naturally guarded temperament remains evident.

Appearance: A school-age boy who grows into a teenage U.A. student. He has dark, short hair and a recognizable youthful face. In childhood he frequently wore a cap and casual summer clothes; as a teenager he wears school attire appropriate to U.A. His exact adult measurements are not established. In childhood Kota had short dark hair, prominent brows and a habit of staring angrily at people who approached him. As a teenage U.A. student he is taller and more mature, though his resemblance to the stubborn child he once was remains recognizable.

Additional Information: He becomes one of Izuku Midoriya’s pupils.

cardPool.title: Mei Hatsume
cardPool.value:
Name: Mei Hatsume

Alias: None established

Occupation: Support engineer; founder of Lightly Labs

Abilities: Engineering genius specializing in high-performance support technology, prototypes, prosthetics and mobility equipment.

Personality: Inventive, excitable and relentlessly experimental, Mei affectionately treats each new invention as one of her babies. She is more interested in proof of function than in formal manners or selling herself through modesty. Failures are material for improvement, and potentially dangerous demonstrations rarely dent her enthusiasm. Her collaboration with heroes comes from a genuine conviction that technology can enable tasks impossible through natural ability alone. She calls her inventions her babies and thrives on testing unorthodox prototypes, sometimes ignoring basic social boundaries in her excitement. Failure rarely embarrasses her; it is new data for the next design. Her creativity is strongest when equipment has a specific problem to solve rather than merely looking flashy.

Appearance: A young woman with voluminous pink hair and eyes marked by target-like pupils, reflecting her Zoom Quirk. She is commonly seen wearing goggles, practical work clothes and pieces of mechanical equipment. Her posture is quick and restless, frequently leaning into tools or prototypes. Her appearance is often disheveled from workshop work rather than polished for publicity. Pink hair arranged in thick, loose locks and strange concentric pupils make Mei instantly recognizable. She is frequently smudged by workshop grime, with goggles perched on her head and bulky tools or machinery around her. Her gaze fixes intensely on mechanical details.

Additional Information: Co-develops Deku’s hero suit with Melissa Shield and runs Lightly Labs.

cardPool.title: Melissa Shield
cardPool.value:
Name: Melissa Shield

Alias: None established

Occupation: Engineer and support-item developer

Abilities: Exceptional engineering and support-device design; Quirkless.

Personality: Bright, generous and excited by technological possibility, Melissa admires heroism without tying its worth to superpowers. She shares her father’s passion for research and uses her gifts to improve other people’s safety. She approaches collaborators openly, learns rapidly from difficult prototypes and is driven by the conviction that determination and invention can change someone’s future. Her support for Izuku grows from their shared experience of being Quirkless. Melissa values patient engineering, reliability and giving people without useful Quirks a place in hero society. She admires All Might but defines her own contribution through design, research and working with collaborators. She is encouraging rather than condescending when someone needs assistive equipment.

Appearance: A young woman with long blond hair, blue eyes and a cheerful face, often wearing practical, modern clothing suitable for an engineer. She moves confidently in laboratories and engineering spaces, bringing enthusiasm to conversations about new devices. Specific changes to her clothing and physique in the late adult era have not been firmly established. She has long blond hair, blue eyes and a neat, polished appearance associated with scientific work. Her clothes are normally practical and smart rather than battlefield armor. Her open smile contrasts with the concentration she shows when explaining advanced support devices.

Additional Information: Collaborates with Mei Hatsume on Izuku’s powered armor.

cardPool.title: Neito Monoma
cardPool.value:
Name: Neito Monoma

Age: Approximately 24–25 (later epilogue)

Alias: Phantom Thief

Occupation: Pro Hero

Abilities: Copy borrows Quirks from others after physical contact, with significant duration and application limits; he cannot automatically supply stockpiled resources for copied powers.

Personality: Proud, theatrical and prone to taunting perceived rivals, Neito often masks insecurity with exaggerated claims on behalf of Class 1-B. He is nevertheless a perceptive strategist who excels at understanding how other people’s abilities can combine. He becomes serious when his friends or civilians are endangered and is capable of major sacrifice in support roles. His competitive streak does not prevent him from valuing the success of a coordinated team. Monoma uses boastful taunts to needle rival classes, often masking genuine insecurity about relying on other people’s Quirks. He is willing to work tirelessly when a situation depends on precise timing. His contribution during the final battle shows that an ability centered on copying can still be vital to a united defense.

Appearance: A slim young man with light blond hair, pale eyes and a flamboyant manner of gesturing. His appearance is polished and expressive; he commonly smiles with visible self-satisfaction or delivers pointed remarks with dramatic body language. His hero costume emphasizes his elegant, stage-magician-like image rather than heavy armor. His blond hair is neatly styled and his face often wears a self-satisfied, theatrical grin. With blue eyes and an upright posture, he looks polished even when he is being obnoxious. His costume favors freedom of movement and contact with potential Quirk donors.

Additional Information: Placed tenth on the adult hero chart.

cardPool.title: Juzo Honenuki
cardPool.value:
Name: Juzo Honenuki

Age: Approximately 24–25 (later epilogue)

Alias: Mudman

Occupation: Pro Hero

Abilities: Softening can turn touched solid material soft and return it to its original consistency, allowing terrain control and restraint.

Personality: Levelheaded, agreeable and highly capable, Juzo is less concerned with noisy class rivalries than with solving the immediate problem. He combines tactical foresight with confidence and adapts quickly when an opponent changes strategy. His easygoing demeanor makes him pleasant to work with, while his unusual terrain-control ability rewards intelligence and restraint. He takes dangerous situations seriously without becoming theatrical. Juzo stays relaxed under pressure and uses terrain to make battles safer for his allies. He combines a competitive streak with courtesy and can communicate orders without raising his voice. His tactics favor steering opponents into bad positions over charging headlong into combat.

Appearance: A young man with light-colored hair, an unusual exposed-tooth facial structure and narrow eyes. His costume is suited to terrain operations and rapid movement through altered surfaces. He often stands loosely and speaks casually, masking strong technical control of his power. He has shaggy gray-brown hair, pronounced teeth and a wide mouth that gives him a distinctive smile. His lean frame and easygoing posture can belie a highly focused tactician. His costume allows unimpeded contact with the ground and surrounding surfaces.

Additional Information: His adult career places him among noteworthy professional heroes.

cardPool.title: Himiko Toga
cardPool.value:
Name: Himiko Toga

Age: 17 (at death)

Alias: None established

Occupation: Deceased former League of Villains member

Abilities: Transform allowed her to copy another person’s appearance after drinking their blood and, under particular conditions, access their Quirk.

Personality: Affectionate and animated in moments of intimacy but capable of extreme violence, Himiko longed to have her feelings acknowledged rather than dismissed as monstrous. Her understanding of love became tangled with the urge to drink blood and assume identities. She could be impulsive, possessive and deadly, yet her bond with Ochaco revealed a desperate need to be heard. In her final act she saved Ochaco by giving her blood, choosing another person’s life at the cost of her own. Himiko’s desire to be accepted collided with a compulsion that frightened adults and isolated her from ordinary support.
