She conflated love with taking on someone else’s identity and struggled to understand why others recoiled. In her final encounter with Ochaco she experienced a measure of genuine recognition rather than merely being hunted.

Appearance: A slight girl with yellow-blond hair arranged in two messy side buns, yellow eyes and pronounced canine teeth. Her expressions shift rapidly between an eager grin, dreamy affection and frightening intensity. She was commonly seen in a school-uniform-inspired outfit with specialized blood-storage equipment when transformed for combat. She was a slender blonde young woman with hair tied into two messy buns, loose strands framing yellow-gold eyes and pointed canine teeth. Her expression could shift suddenly from cheerful affection to frightening intensity. Her schoolgirl-inspired villain outfit held blood-collection equipment.

Additional Information: Ochaco continues to remember her years after the war.

cardPool.title: Toya Todoroki
cardPool.value:
Name: Toya Todoroki

Alias: Dabi

Occupation: Deceased former villain

Abilities: Blueflame generated extraordinarily hot blue fire, severely damaging his own body because of inadequate heat tolerance.

Personality: Bitter, vindictive and fixated on making his father face the consequences of abuse, Toya weaponized his identity and suffering. He was cruel to numerous people unrelated to his family, and his obsession inflicted further harm on those closest to him. Beneath his nihilistic sarcasm lay a child’s intense longing to be seen. His final period was defined by profound bodily damage and fraught contact with surviving family members rather than reconciliation that could erase the past. Toya’s obsessive need to be acknowledged hardened into rage at the father whose ambitions dominated his childhood. He weaponized his own suffering against people who had not caused it. Beneath his cruelty remained a painful wish to be seen, and his final conversations with family allowed only brief, incomplete understanding.

Appearance: A lanky man with dark, dyed hair, pale blue eyes and extensive purplish scarred skin fixed by metal staples across his face, torso and limbs. His black clothing and smoldering flames created a stark, threatening silhouette. After the war his injuries were catastrophic and required intensive life-sustaining medical care. His body bore extensive grafted purple scar tissue secured by staples; pale hair and blue eyes linked him visually to the Todoroki family. His gaunt frame and dark clothes created an unsettling silhouette, frequently surrounded by blue flame that his own skin could not withstand.

Additional Information: Dies sometime during the years following the Final War.

cardPool.title: Tomura Shigaraki
cardPool.value:
Name: Tomura Shigaraki

Age: 21 (at death)

Alias: None established

Occupation: Deceased leader of the League of Villains

Abilities: Decay disintegrated touched matter and eventually spread destruction rapidly over connected surfaces. His body was altered by All For One’s schemes.

Personality: Rageful, alienated and destructive, Tomura was shaped by abuse, abandonment and manipulation. He came to despise a society in which suffering people could be ignored while everyone assumed someone else would help. He built bonds with fellow outcasts even while pursuing mass destruction, and his actions brought catastrophe to strangers. Izuku’s attempt to reach the suffering child beneath that hatred did not undo the lives lost, but exposed the tragic origins of his hostility. Tenko’s need for help as an abused and isolated child was exploited by All For One until rage became the center of his identity. He formed genuine attachments to others in the League even as he pursued indiscriminate destruction. His final confrontation revealed the person underneath the cultivated hatred.

Appearance: A gaunt young man with pale hair, red eyes and damaged, dry-looking skin. His early appearance often included numerous hands covering his face and body, with later looks emphasizing disheveled white hair and black clothing. Post-surgical alterations transformed his physical condition and made him an extraordinarily dangerous opponent. His pale hair became long and disordered, framing red eyes and scarred skin. Early outfits often included severed-hand ornaments; later his increasingly altered body and dark clothing made him more monstrous in battle. Scratching at his neck was a recurring sign of agitation.

Additional Information: Killed during the final conflict that ended All For One’s control.

cardPool.title: All For One
cardPool.value:
Name: All For One

Alias: None established

Occupation: Deceased criminal mastermind

Abilities: All For One allowed its holder to steal, transfer and combine Quirks; numerous stolen powers granted extraordinary offense, mobility and longevity.

Personality: Patient, possessive and narcissistic, he treated other human beings as pieces in a story of his own dominance. He cultivated dependency and fear, offered gifts that bound recipients to him and ruthlessly exploited the vulnerabilities of children and adults. His outward courtesy hid absolute contempt for others’ autonomy. His rivalry with One For All shaped generations of hero conflict, and his efforts to overwrite Tomura’s identity revealed his inability to accept any will beyond his own. He treats dependence as a form of ownership, distributing or withholding abilities to bind people to his will. His manner can be genial and paternal while he manipulates others’ worst vulnerabilities. Any apparent affection is constrained by his need for control, and he is willing to discard successors rather than accept their independence.

Appearance: A tall, broad man who once had ordinary facial features but later bore profound facial injuries, leaving a smooth, damaged upper face. He often wore formal dark clothing and heavy life-support equipment. His stolen powers could dramatically alter his body, producing grotesque combat forms. He has appeared as both a heavily scarred, largely faceless man requiring a breathing apparatus and a physically younger figure after artificial rejuvenation. His expensive clothing and composed gestures project authority even when his body has become grotesquely altered.

Additional Information: Defeated and destroyed during the Final War.

cardPool.title: Shuichi Iguchi
cardPool.value:
Name: Shuichi Iguchi

Alias: Spinner

Occupation: Former League of Villains member; author

Abilities: Gecko grants reptilian climbing and adhesion; additional Quirks forced onto him in wartime placed enormous strain on his body.

Personality: Withdrawn and self-conscious about his reptilian appearance, Shuichi found identity among people who promised to oppose the prejudice he had suffered. His loyalty to Tomura Shigaraki mattered more to him than abstract political slogans, even while extremist groups sought to use him as a symbol. He is capable of sincere grief and attachment but participated in severe violence. After the war he attempts to preserve the memory of his friends in writing. Spinner’s attachment to Shigaraki gave him purpose after years of exclusion and self-loathing. He is less ideologically confident than some of the League and often follows people he trusts rather than abstract slogans. After the conflict, remembering lost comrades becomes a major part of how he tries to live with what happened.

Appearance: A human-reptile heteromorph with green scaly skin, lizardlike facial features and a sturdy build. His League clothing drew inspiration from the Hero Killer Stain, incorporating practical combat gear and carried blades. His wartime bodily modifications produced a bulkier and more unstable form. His green, scaly skin, reptilian face and narrow eyes reflect his gecko-like physiology. He has a lean frame and frequently wears layered, rough clothing with equipment for carrying blades. Later forced physical alterations affected his size and coordination.

Additional Information: Writes a book recounting the League of Villains.

cardPool.title: Atsuhiro Sako
cardPool.value:
Name: Atsuhiro Sako

Alias: Mr. Compress

Occupation: Imprisoned former League of Villains member

Abilities: Compress reduces touched objects or people into marble-like forms that can later be released.

Personality: Courtly, playful and fascinated by dramatic reveals, Atsuhiro treats the battlefield as a stage. His manners and theatricality conceal a criminal willing to commit grave harm to achieve his group’s aims. He places value on companionship within the League and later follows accounts of the people with whom he fought. His showmanship and skill with misdirection can make even desperate actions appear effortless. Compress performs even under pressure, treating deception and dramatic timing as an art. His manners are theatrical but his loyalty to the League is serious. He takes pleasure in outsmarting enemies and willingly sacrifices his own safety for comrades when escape seems impossible.

Appearance: A lean man typically associated with formal stage-magician clothing, a top hat and a distinctive mask. He carries himself with a performer’s exaggerated flourishes. After sacrificing part of his body during an escape, he survives with severe injuries and remains identifiable by his polished, theatrical demeanor. A slim figure with a formal coat, tall hat and polished mask, often carrying marbles and other magician-like props. His costume obscures facial expressions deliberately. Injury and the loss of an arm become part of his later physical history.

Additional Information: Is shown reading Spinner’s account of the League.

cardPool.title: Danjuro Tobita
cardPool.value:
Name: Danjuro Tobita

Alias: Gentle

Occupation: Rehabilitated entrepreneur; head of GeL Inc.

Abilities: Elasticity makes touched surfaces springy and resilient; useful for movement, protective redirection and containment.

Personality: Polite, eccentric and committed to flamboyant presentation, Gentle once pursued attention through elaborate unlawful stunts. His longing to matter drove him into wrongdoing, but kindness from La Brava and encounters with genuine heroes changed him. He becomes more willing to use his talents to protect people rather than stage spectacles. He favors elaborate speech, refined gestures and mutually supportive partnership. Gentle was once desperate to be remembered for a grand act, and that desperation led him into crime despite a desire to help people. He has a polite, grandiose speaking style and soft spot for romantic gestures. Given a chance to protect others, he proves capable of genuine bravery without an audience.

Appearance: A tall older man with distinctive gray hair, an exaggerated curled mustache and theatrical clothing, including a cape-like coat and accessories. His dramatic movements resemble those of a performer. He retains a refined, slightly old-fashioned appearance into his rehabilitated professional life. He is a slender older man with a large curled mustache, carefully groomed white hair, dark eye markings and a gentlemanly costume. His cape, hat and gloves convey the appearance of a theatrical stage performer. His facial movements are expressive and exaggerated.

Additional Information: Runs GeL Inc. with La Brava; they are married in adulthood.

cardPool.title: Manami Aiba
cardPool.value:
Name: Manami Aiba

Alias: La Brava

Occupation: Technology specialist; leader at GeL Inc.

Abilities: Love amplifies the strength of a person she profoundly loves through an expression of affection; she also possesses outstanding hacking and computing skill.

Personality: Passionate, excitable and intensely loyal, Manami found purpose through her bond with Gentle when isolation had nearly overwhelmed her. She is affectionate and protective, and her emotional directness contrasts with his elaborate performance style. Her computer expertise is formidable and her past illegal activity gives way to more constructive work. She can be possessive but is also capable of courageous decisions when someone’s safety is at stake. La Brava is technically brilliant, emotional and fiercely loyal to the person who accepted her. Isolation and rejection made online communities both a refuge and a source of pain. Her commitment to ethical work after imprisonment shows how her abilities can help society rather than undermine it.

Appearance: A very short young woman with pink hair, large eyes and a doll-like appearance, often wearing dark clothing with bright accents. She uses dramatic facial expressions and fast, enthusiastic movements. Her appearance retains its recognizable heart-themed sensibility in adulthood. She is exceptionally short, with pink hair styled in large heart-shaped curls and dark, prominent eyes. Her carefully coordinated outfit often uses red and black accents and heart motifs. She is demonstrative when excited and rarely hides anger, worry or affection.

Additional Information: Works alongside Gentle in their company GeL Inc.

cardPool.title: Inko Midoriya
cardPool.value:
Name: Inko Midoriya

Alias: None established

Occupation: Civilian; Izuku Midoriya’s mother

Abilities: No demonstrated combat-oriented Quirk; can attract small objects toward herself.

Personality: Affectionate, sensitive and highly concerned about her son’s safety, Inko is quick to blame herself when she feels unable to protect him. She initially feared that a dangerous hero career would destroy him, but gradually learned to trust his resolve and the adults supporting him. Her love is practical, emotional and sometimes tearful. She remains an important presence in Izuku’s life beyond the war. Inko has worried for years that her son’s desire to be a hero would leave him permanently injured or dead. Her love can become overprotective, but she listens when he explains what matters to him. She represents ordinary parental responsibility in a world that often expects children to face extraordinary danger.

Appearance: A middle-aged woman with green hair, green eyes and soft facial features resembling her son’s. She has a fuller figure than in her youth and favors everyday, comfortable clothing. Her expressive face can move quickly from anxious tears to relieved warmth. She is a short woman with dark green hair, usually kept in a modest shoulder-length style, and gentle green eyes. Her rounded face and ordinary home clothing distinguish her from the flamboyant heroes around her. As years pass, her posture and features reflect age and enduring worry.

Additional Information: Remains part of Izuku’s adult life.

cardPool.title: Fuyumi Todoroki
cardPool.value:
Name: Fuyumi Todoroki

Alias: None established

Occupation: Former elementary-school teacher; later seeking a different position after the war

Abilities: See the corresponding ability record where applicable.

Personality: Compassionate, patient and devoted to family connection, she repeatedly tried to bring estranged relatives together while knowing reconciliation could not be forced. She deserves her own life beyond the disputes surrounding her father. Fuyumi repeatedly tried to bring the fractured household together, though she could not erase the history that divided it. Her instinct is to mediate, welcome and feed others, often placing difficult emotions below the immediate need for peace. She respects that other family members may not want reconciliation.

Appearance: A young adult woman with predominantly white hair broken by small red sections, light eyes and a gentle demeanor. She favors modest everyday clothing and often projects reassuring warmth. Her white hair is streaked with red and cut to about shoulder length. She wears glasses with red frames, and her blue-gray eyes resemble the colder side of her family’s features. She dresses in comfortable, practical outfits rather than hero gear, typically wearing layered sweaters or cardigans.

Additional Information: She works in education and remains connected to the family after Toya’s death.

cardPool.title: Natsuo Todoroki
cardPool.value:
Name: Natsuo Todoroki

Alias: None established

Occupation: Civilian; brother of Shoto and Toya

Abilities: See the corresponding ability record where applicable.

Personality: Outspoken, protective of his siblings and deeply resentful of Enji’s mistreatment of the family, Natsuo refuses to pretend the harm of childhood has vanished. His decision to seek a separate future reflects a desire for safety and independence, not simple spite. Natsuo is openly angry about the suffering caused by Enji’s obsession and refuses to pretend it did not happen. He remains protective of Fuyumi, Rei and Shoto while insisting that forgiveness cannot be demanded of him. His decision to begin his own household reflects a wish to protect his future from that history.

Appearance: A tall young man with short white hair, light eyes and a broad build. He usually appears in ordinary casual clothing and wears an earnest, sometimes stern expression. A broad young man with white hair, light eyes and a more casual appearance than the professional heroes in his family. He typically wears plain shirts and relaxed clothes. His open expressions, especially his sternness toward his father, are less restrained than Shoto’s.

Additional Information: He distances himself from Enji and pursues life with his partner.

cardPool.title: Rei Todoroki
cardPool.value:
Name: Rei Todoroki

Alias: None established

Occupation: Civilian; mother of the Todoroki children

Abilities: See the corresponding ability record where applicable.

Personality: Gentle but traumatized by years of domestic abuse and the breakdown of her family, Rei has spent long periods receiving psychiatric care. She ultimately chooses to face painful family responsibilities and acknowledges that her children need lives beyond their parents’ failures. Rei endured coercion and years of domestic fear, with lasting damage to her mental health and relationship with her children. During recovery she becomes more willing to face the family’s past without excusing the cruelty she suffered. Her gentleness coexists with painful guilt about her own actions under extreme distress.

Appearance: A pale, slim woman with light-colored hair that includes red accents and a subdued expression. Her bearing often reflects fatigue or emotional strain, although she can also show unexpected resolve. She has long white hair and pale eyes, with a slight and elegant figure. Her neat, quiet clothing and controlled gestures give her a soft presence. The scars and emotional weight of her earlier life are expressed through hesitant looks and a tendency to speak carefully.

Additional Information: She survives the Final War and remains involved in the aftermath of Toya’s injuries.

cardPool.title: Shino Sosaki
cardPool.value:
Name: Shino Sosaki

Alias: Mandalay

Occupation: Wild, Wild Pussycats member and guardian

Abilities: Telepath allows the broadcast of messages directly into other people’s minds, making her effective at group coordination and warning civilians.

Personality: Composed and team-oriented, Mandalay is an experienced rescue hero who helps manage a coordinated wilderness rescue squad. She protects Kota with the commitment of a family member and offers stability to children who have survived serious trauma. Mandalay uses calm communication to coordinate rescue work across difficult terrain. She has an especially strong protective instinct toward Kota, whose parents were her family, and provides a home where a grieving child can grow. She tends to be firm without humiliating the people in her care.

Appearance: An athletic woman with reddish hair, distinctive hero accessories and a feline-inspired rescue uniform. Her professional demeanor combines warmth with tactical focus. She is a tall adult woman with short brown hair, cat-themed goggles and an orange-and-black suit suited to outdoor operations. A confident stance and sharp, expressive eyes help her appear reassuring during dangerous missions.

Additional Information: Her Quirk Telepath allows mental broadcasts. Later lives with and cares for Kota and Eri.

cardPool.title: Tsunagu Hakamada
cardPool.value:
Name: Tsunagu Hakamada

Alias: Best Jeanist

Occupation: Senior Pro Hero

Abilities: Fiber Master permits precise control of textile fibers for binding, protection and rescue.

Personality: Disciplined, discerning and proud of good conduct, Best Jeanist promotes responsibility, self-control and the social impact of a hero’s public behavior. He serves as a mentor and insists that heroism includes dignity outside combat. Best Jeanist prizes restraint, steady improvement and public conduct alongside combat effectiveness. He has little patience for boastfulness without discipline, but he can guide an abrasive younger hero toward responsibility. His elegant manner is deliberate rather than an indication that he avoids dangerous work.

Appearance: A tall blond man with his lower face commonly concealed by an unusually high-collared denim outfit. His sleek hero style reflects his fiber-control abilities. His exceptionally long blond hair and narrow eyes are visible above a denim collar that often covers his mouth almost entirely. Tight-fitting denim clothing and high-waisted silhouettes define his unmistakable look. He stands ramrod straight and gestures sparingly.

Additional Information: Fiber Master manipulates textile fibers. Adult ranking: fifth at the reunion-era chart.

cardPool.title: Yu Takeyama
cardPool.value:
Name: Yu Takeyama

Alias: Mt. Lady

Occupation: Pro Hero

Abilities: Gigantification allows her to enlarge her body into an enormous giant form.

Personality: Confident, media-savvy and adaptable, Yu Takeyama initially embraced fame but became a dependable frontline defender after repeated disasters. She is willing to endure brutal punishment to protect people. Mt. Lady initially chased attention and endorsement opportunities with great enthusiasm, yet repeated crises showed her willingness to absorb enormous danger for other people. She recognizes the collateral risks of her growth and can choose restraint when a narrow street or crowded site makes transformation hazardous.

Appearance: A glamorous young woman with long blond hair and a purple-and-cream hero uniform. Gigantification transforms her into a towering version of herself. Her long blond hair and vivid purple eyes accompany a tall, shapely build at ordinary size. In costume she wears a purple-and-cream suit with orange details and a mask with pointed decorative protrusions. Enlarging makes her tower above buildings without changing the basic costume design.

Additional Information: Her Quirk is Gigantification. Adult ranking: third.

cardPool.title: Shinji Nishiya
cardPool.value:
Name: Shinji Nishiya

Alias: Kamui Woods

Occupation: Pro Hero

Abilities: Arbor allows him to produce and control wooden branches for binding, movement and rescue.

Personality: Calm, careful and highly conscientious, Shinji Nishiya approaches rescue and crowd protection with restraint. His skill at binding targets makes him a patient rather than reckless fighter. Kamui Woods treats physical restraint as a way to resolve conflict without unnecessarily injuring people. He is methodical in teamwork and publicly dignified, often acting as a dependable anchor when louder heroes draw attention. His professionalism grew through the insecurity of early hero work.

Appearance: A tall hero whose exterior looks like shaped wood, with a narrow helmetlike head and long wooden limbs. He wears a restrained dark combat ensemble. His whole exposed body has a wooden, bark-like appearance, with an elongated head and branching appendages that can extend like tree limbs. He wears a dark, fitted hero outfit over parts of his wooden exterior. His movements tend to be precise and composed.

Additional Information: Arbor controls growing wood from his body. Adult ranking: fourth on the reunion-era chart.

Professional conduct: He has repeatedly chosen careful capture and rescue over display, making a controlled public impression as a veteran hero.

cardPool.title: Taishiro Toyomitsu
cardPool.value:
Name: Taishiro Toyomitsu

Alias: Fat Gum

Occupation: Pro Hero and mentor

Abilities: Fat Absorption allows him to absorb blows and convert the stored energy into counterattacks.

Personality: Warm, friendly and generous with food, Taishiro Toyomitsu combines cheerful mentoring with powerful commitment to protecting young heroes. He knows when to become stern and is respected for reliable, practical action. Fat Gum encourages younger heroes with food, jokes and the confidence that they can improve. Beneath that friendly exterior he notices who is overwhelmed and who needs direct instruction. When a fight threatens civilians, he willingly spends the reserves that normally protect his body.

Appearance: Usually a very large man with a rounded silhouette and a bright yellow hero ensemble. His build changes drastically when the stored energy within his fat is spent. His usual appearance is enormously round, with a cheerful face and a yellow costume that makes him easy to spot. Expending his stored fat can leave a dramatically thinner, muscular version of the same man. He usually wears a ready smile and a relaxed stance.

Additional Information: Fat Absorption cushions blows and stores impact energy. Adult ranking: eleventh.

cardPool.title: Ryuko Tatsuma
cardPool.value:
Name: Ryuko Tatsuma

Alias: Ryukyu

Occupation: Pro Hero

Abilities: Dragon allows her to transform into a huge flying dragon.

Personality: Levelheaded, kind and responsible, Ryuko Tatsuma mentors younger heroes and prioritizes civilian safety even during large-scale threats. Her leadership is steady rather than theatrical. Ryukyu approaches mentorship patiently and expects trainees to prioritize people needing rescue. She is confident without boasting and accepts difficult orders even when the conditions are frightening. Her professional steadiness helped younger heroes work effectively alongside veterans.

Appearance: A tall woman with long pale hair and dragon-inspired accessories; her transformed form is an enormous winged dragon with claws, scales and a long tail. In human form she is tall with long pale blond hair and striking pointed accessories. Her blue-gray costume includes dragon-themed features. Her Quirk transforms her into a massive dragon with wings, scales, claws and a long tail, capable of carrying people in flight.

Additional Information: Dragon allows transformation into a dragon. Adult ranking: fortieth.

Professional history: Her mentorship of young trainees provides a practical example of leadership through rescue, coordination and composure during disaster.

cardPool.title: Dai
cardPool.value:
Name: Dai

Alias: None established

Occupation: Middle-school student and aspiring hero

Abilities: His Quirk produces saucer-like plate shapes from his hair, which can be tossed; its potential applications require practice and experimentation.

Personality: Initially uncertain whether his modest ability can ever support meaningful heroism, Dai gains courage when Izuku treats the urge to help others as more important than headline-grabbing power. Dai desperately wants to be a hero but has grown unsure because professional opportunities seem narrower and his Quirk appears unremarkable next to more spectacular powers. Even before receiving encouragement, he moves instinctively to help a child in danger. That impulse gives him a reason to keep trying.

Appearance: A young school-age boy with short dark hair and youthful features, seen in everyday clothing. More detailed adult appearance is not established. A young boy with short dark hair and an ordinary school-age build. He is dressed as a student rather than a trained professional and lacks the elaborate equipment associated with licensed heroes. His expression alternates between self-doubt and surprised excitement.

Additional Information: Encounters Izuku Midoriya during the eight-years-later era.

cardPool.title: Koichi Haimawari
cardPool.value:
Name: Koichi Haimawari

Alias: The Crawler

Occupation: Pro Hero in the United States

Abilities: Slide and Glide enables movement and propulsion across surfaces and eventually supports sophisticated aerial movement.

Personality: Kindhearted, scrappy and persistent, Koichi has experience helping strangers without waiting for fame or formal recognition. His improvisational instincts and street-level rescue habits inform his professional life. Koichi began helping strangers without a license, frequently getting caught between the rules and a genuine need for immediate aid. His politeness makes him appear unassuming, but he grows daring and resourceful when lives are threatened. He carries a lasting concern for the neighborhoods and people he once protected.

Appearance: A lean young man with dark hair and a casual, approachable appearance, often associated with goggles and streamlined hero clothing. He has a youthful face, dark hair and a lean build adapted to quick movement. His early improvised equipment included goggles and casual clothing; later professional equipment is sleeker and better suited to airborne action. His approachable expressions contrast with his rapid combat mobility.

Additional Information: Slide and Glide enables movement along surfaces and later remarkable midair propulsion and defense.

cardPool.title: Kurogiri
cardPool.value:
Name: Kurogiri

Alias: None established

Occupation: Destroyed former League of Villains transporter

Abilities: Warp Gate generates transport portals within black mist.

Personality: Originally an artificial being built around Oboro Shirakumo’s remains, Kurogiri was conditioned to guard Tomura Shigaraki. His protective behavior sometimes revealed a deeply buried human connection. Kurogiri is unfailingly formal and protective toward Tomura, even when that protection supports terrible acts. Beneath the programmed behavior are fragments of Oboro Shirakumo’s attachments, creating painful conflict for people who once knew him. His divided identity is inseparable from his treatment as a modified being.

Appearance: A tall, dark-suited figure whose head and neck are enveloped in dense black mist above a metallic collar. His silhouette resembles a formal attendant. His head appears as a rolling cloud of dark violet-black mist surrounding glowing eyes, above a clean suit and metallic neck structure. Rather than ordinary hair or facial features, the mist shifts with his movements. His tall frame and measured gestures resemble a solemn attendant.

Additional Information: Warp Gate creates transport portals through black mist. He is destroyed during the Final War.

cardPool.title: Oboro Shirakumo
cardPool.value:
Name: Oboro Shirakumo

Alias: Loud Cloud

Occupation: Deceased U.A. hero-course student

Abilities: Cloud lets him produce tangible clouds suitable for movement and support.

Personality: Easygoing, cheerful and generous, Oboro formed a close friendship with Shota Aizawa and Hizashi Yamada. His supportive nature shaped their memories of school and the tragedy surrounding his death. Oboro was cheerful, outgoing and ready to share credit with quieter classmates. He encouraged Shota to believe his unusual powers could support heroism and imagined a future working with his friends. His premature death left a deep, unresolved wound in their lives.

Appearance: A young man with light hair and relaxed features, remembered wearing U.A. training clothes and goggles with cloud-themed hero equipment. He had light blue hair swept loosely away from his face and a sunny expression. His goggles and school-age hero costume emphasized the cloud-riding powers he hoped to develop. He was a lanky teenager rather than the mist-shrouded being later created from his remains.

Additional Information: Cloud generated rideable and manipulable clouds; his remains were used to create Kurogiri.

Legacy: The discovery that his body was used to construct an artificial villain was especially painful for the friends who remembered his generosity and unrealized plans.

cardPool.title: Hizashi Yamada
cardPool.value:
Name: Hizashi Yamada

Alias: Present Mic

Occupation: U.A. teacher and Pro Hero

Abilities: Voice amplifies his voice to dangerous levels suitable for sonic attack and widespread communication.

Personality: Boisterous, charismatic and caring, Hizashi adopts an energetic radio-host persona even when he is angry or afraid. His strong attachment to Shota and Oboro reveals his profound loyalty. Present Mic turns every announcement into a performance, but he knows when that energy is a shield against grief. He has fierce loyalty toward old friends and can react with genuine fury to cruelty carried out in the name of scientific progress. Teaching and broadcasting both suit his love of communicating.

Appearance: A tall blond man with hair swept upward, dark glasses and flamboyant audio-themed combat clothing. He carries himself with the energy of an announcer. Tall and slender, with extremely long blond hair swept upward, orange-tinted eyewear and large headphones around his neck. His black-and-leather ensemble is packed with audio-inspired styling. Broad hand gestures and a permanent announcer’s grin form his signature manner.

Additional Information: Voice greatly amplifies vocal sound and can unleash destructive sonic force.

cardPool.title: Chizome Akaguro
cardPool.value:
Name: Chizome Akaguro

Alias: Stain

Occupation: Deceased vigilante-killer and former villain

Abilities: Bloodcurdle permits paralysis of someone whose blood he tastes.

Personality: Fanatically devoted to what he considered authentic heroism, Stain attacked heroes whom he judged shallow or self-serving. His rigid principles could inspire others but never excused his violence. Stain’s philosophy demands self-sacrifice and purity from heroes but grants him no authority to mutilate or kill those who fail his private tests. His rigid moral code drove his isolation and murderous campaign. Despite his brutality, he recognized All Might’s genuine resolve and later tried to act against an even greater threat.

Appearance: A lean, scarred man with an exceptionally long tongue, dark combat gear and a red scarf. He wielded bladed weapons and moved with acrobatic menace. A wiry, intimidating fighter with a long tongue, coarse dark hair and a rough, heavily wrapped costume. A red scarf trails from his neck, and he carries multiple cutting weapons. His narrow eyes and slouched, ready-to-spring stance communicate constant suspicion.

Additional Information: Bloodcurdle causes temporary paralysis after tasting the target’s blood. He dies opposing All For One.

cardPool.title: Kai Chisaki
cardPool.value:
Name: Kai Chisaki

Alias: Overhaul

Occupation: Former acting leader of the Shie Hassaikai; held in custody after his downfall

Abilities: Overhaul allows disassembly and reassembly of matter via touch; the loss of his arms deprived him of normal use.

Personality: Controlling, ruthless and obsessively focused on undoing Quirk-based society, Kai exploited Eri and destroyed lives while claiming to pursue a larger purpose. The injuries and downfall of his organization leave him stripped of the authority he once exercised. Chisaki feels intense disgust toward contamination and responds to perceived disrespect with violence. His desire to repay the yakuza boss’s kindness becomes distorted into domination and cruelty. His insistence that Quirks are a disease allows him to rationalize the horrific experiments he inflicted on Eri.

Appearance: A slim, dark-haired man associated with a beaked mask and formal dark clothing. The loss of his arms severely affects his physical condition and former capabilities. His dark hair is cut short and he often wears a plague-doctor beak mask, dark overcoat and protective gloves. His eyes are narrow and watchful. Following the loss of both arms, the imposing physical control he once projected is visibly compromised.

Additional Information: Overhaul disassembled and reassembled touched matter, but losing his hands originally prevented ordinary use.

cardPool.title: Kaina Tsutsumi
cardPool.value:
Name: Kaina Tsutsumi

Alias: Lady Nagant

Occupation: Former Hero Public Safety Commission operative; chose to remain imprisoned after being offered release

Abilities: Rifle transforms part of her arm into a precision firearm. She also temporarily received Air Walk.

Personality: Disillusioned by covert political violence, Kaina struggled with guilt and the hypocrisy of institutions that hid their own brutality. Encounters with Izuku help her choose survival and personal judgment over cynical resignation. Lady Nagant once believed that dangerous covert missions were necessary to preserve public peace, then became sickened by political murders disguised as clean hero work. She distrusts easy promises yet can recognize sincerity. Her reserved speech conceals a longing for a system that does not demand the same sacrifices of its agents.

Appearance: A tall woman with two-tone hair and a reserved, weary expression. Her right arm can transform into a specialized firearm, and her hair can be shaped into ammunition. She has long hair in contrasting dark-purple and pale-pink tones, with sharp eyes and a composed face. Her right elbow and forearm can transform into a large organic rifle. Her clothing often includes a sleek dark bodysuit and a practical mantle suited to sniping.

Additional Information: Rifle produces an organic sniper weapon; Air Walk was also imposed on her by All For One.

cardPool.title: Cathleen Bate
cardPool.value:
Name: Cathleen Bate

Age: 42 (at death)

Alias: Star and Stripe

Occupation: Deceased American number-one Pro Hero

Abilities: New Order let her apply up to two reality-altering rules to touched, accurately identified subjects.

Personality: Bold, fiercely patriotic and deeply inspired by All Might, Cathleen treats courage as a public commitment. She embraces overwhelming danger with composure and cares deeply about her squadron. Cathleen’s confidence was shaped by an early rescue that made her determined to become a protector worthy of All Might’s example. She trusts her fighter-pilot team and shows fierce loyalty to them. She accepts the stakes of her choices without using patriotism as an excuse to abandon the people beside her.

Appearance: A tall, extremely muscular blonde woman with dramatic swept hair, a star-themed uniform and a commanding posture. She has a towering, heavily muscled frame, long blonde hair swept into dramatic pointed tufts and an angular face. Her star-emblazoned red, white and blue uniform combines a cape, gloves and tall boots. Her stance and grin convey bold, theatrical assurance.

Additional Information: New Order imposed rules on named targets touched by the user; she dies fighting Tomura Shigaraki.

cardPool.title: Yoichi Shigaraki
cardPool.value:
Name: Yoichi Shigaraki

Alias: None established

Occupation: Deceased first bearer of One For All

Abilities: Transference of his own Quirk fused with a stockpiling ability to form One For All.

Personality: Compassionate and physically frail, Yoichi opposed his elder brother’s tyranny and believed that power must not justify the domination of others. His resistance became the foundation of a generational struggle. Yoichi resisted his older brother’s belief that taking power created rightful ownership over other people. He remained gentle and hopeful despite imprisonment and physical vulnerability. His trust in the possibility of passing strength to another person ultimately gave his resistance an enduring legacy.

Appearance: A slim young man with long pale hair and delicate features. He is often remembered in simple light clothing. He is a very slender young man with long, pale white hair falling around a delicate face. His simple clothing and fragile posture make him look far less threatening than the powers bound up in his history. His eyes and expression are ordinarily soft rather than commanding.

Additional Information: His ability to transfer his Quirk merged with a stockpiling power to form One For All.

cardPool.title: Nana Shimura
cardPool.value:
Name: Nana Shimura

Alias: None established

Occupation: Deceased seventh bearer of One For All

Abilities: Float permits levitation; she also possessed One For All as its seventh holder.

Personality: Courageous and self-sacrificing, Nana combined affection with painful resolve when her family’s safety was threatened. She mentored Toshinori and left a complicated legacy through her descendants. Nana tried to separate family life from a dangerous fight against All For One, choosing secrecy and distance to keep her son safe. That decision had tragic consequences she could not foresee. She balanced a warm, reassuring manner with fierce determination and remained an important mentor to Toshinori.

Appearance: An athletic woman with dark hair swept back into a high style and a confident smile, usually remembered in a cape and hero costume. She was a tall, athletic woman with dark hair pulled back and a broad, confident smile. Her hero costume included a cape and fitted garments that left her arms free for action. Her strong upright posture made her look reassuring even when a situation was dangerous.

Additional Information: Float permits levitation. Her family connection to Tenko Shimura shaped the later conflict.

cardPool.title: Gran Torino
cardPool.value:
Name: Sorahiko Torino

Alias: Gran Torino

Occupation: Veteran Pro Hero and mentor; gravely injured in the war

Abilities: Jet propels him by releasing air from his feet, enabling extraordinary speed and agile movement.

Personality: Brusque, cunning and extremely experienced, Sorahiko uses humor and harsh lessons to sharpen younger heroes. His speed and fighting instincts conceal deep sadness about past mistakes. Sorahiko is sharp-eyed, gruff and more mischievous than his age suggests. His lessons can appear ridiculous until a student grasps how important speed, angles and anticipation are. He is protective of Toshinori and carries enduring sorrow about Nana Shimura and the threats surrounding her family.

Appearance: An elderly, very short man with white hair and compact, muscular posture, wearing yellow flight gear and a cape. Very short and elderly, he has a wrinkled face, white hair and a compact, wiry build. His yellow hero suit, white cape and goggles evoke an old-fashioned speedster. In combat his rapid movements contrast sharply with his apparently frail appearance.

Additional Information: Jet expels air from his soles for high-speed movement; he survives severe injuries in the war.

cardPool.title: Quirks
cardPool.value:
Ability: Quirks

Overview: Quirks are inherited or spontaneously arising superhuman traits typically expressed by early childhood. Abilities fall broadly into emitter, transformation and heteromorphic forms; distinctions can overlap. Quirk factors provide the biological basis. Powers differ in range, cost, bodily compatibility and trainability. Overuse commonly causes exhaustion or injury, and an impressive power does not guarantee skilled use. Society built schooling, registration, hero licensing, medical care, support engineering and public norms around Quirk prevalence. Discrimination and inadequate counseling can create serious social harm.

Biology and expression: The trait responsible for an ability is commonly called a Quirk factor. It may alter ordinary anatomy, produce substances, or activate an effect under special conditions. Children often manifest powers by roughly four years of age, but onset and inheritance are variable. Two inherited factors can combine in unexpected ways; identical Quirks are not required among relatives. Most people have a Quirk, while being Quirkless is uncommon in later generations.

Social consequences: The public generally restricts unlicensed use of dangerous abilities. Schools, hospitals, police and support companies must therefore handle abilities as both personal traits and sources of public risk. A mutation-type appearance can remain visible even when the person does nothing. Quirk counseling is intended to address these differences; inadequate help and prejudice have contributed to isolation and abuse.

cardPool.title: One For All
cardPool.value:
Ability: One For All

Overview: One For All emerged from the combination of a transferable Quirk and a power-stockpiling Quirk. It passed voluntarily through successive holders, accumulating enormous strength and traces of previous users’ wills. Later successors could access individual predecessor abilities: Gearshift, Fa Jin, Danger Sense, Blackwhip, Smokescreen and Float. The accumulated energy imposed dangerous physical strain; bodies already bearing Quirks could suffer shortened lives. Izuku Midoriya sacrificed the power in the struggle against Tomura Shigaraki. Its remaining embers eventually disappeared, leaving him Quirkless again.

Operation: A transferable Quirk factor was merged with an ability to stockpile strength. Successive bearers accumulated power through effort and inheritance; a chosen successor could receive it through DNA supplied with the bearer’s intention. The stockpiled power amplified physical performance but could shatter an unprepared body. Early users could not freely summon every predecessor’s innate ability. As the stored power increased, later manifestations of those abilities became possible.

Limits and end state: A bearer born with another Quirk could suffer an abnormally shortened life from carrying multiple factors. Transfer did not simply grant immunity to injury; Izuku trained to use safe fractions of output. The inherited will and accumulated factors could be contested in a mental realm. Izuku deliberately passed the vestiges during the struggle with Shigaraki, leaving temporary embers that finally faded; they do not naturally regenerate.

cardPool.title: All For One Quirk
cardPool.value:
Ability: All For One Quirk

Overview: All For One permits taking Quirks from other people, using combinations of stolen abilities and giving Quirks to recipients. A stolen ability can be difficult to use because of compatibility, training or the accumulation of multiple factors. Transfers were used to create dependent followers and augment modified beings. The power enabled generations of organized exploitation; the man who bore its name sought to overtake Tomura Shigaraki’s body and will. This system is separate from One For All, which grew through voluntary succession rather than theft.

Operation: The factor can seize another person’s Quirk and store it in the wielder, then deploy it or graft it into a recipient. Multiple stolen powers can be layered for mobility, sensing, force and survival. The recipient’s body may be unable to bear unfamiliar or excessive Quirks, requiring modification or artificial support. Some combinations interfere with one another.

Exploitation: Gifts of power were used to create dependency, build organizations and strengthen Nomu. Stolen Quirk factors can carry traces of their original owners’ wills; holding many abilities does not erase the danger of resistance. The ability is neither ordinary mimicry nor a harmless temporary copy. The defeat of its principal wielder did not retroactively return every stolen Quirk to its former owner.

cardPool.title: Explosion
cardPool.value:
Ability: Explosion

Overview: Explosion lets Katsuki Bakugo ignite nitroglycerin-like sweat secreted through his palms. Output varies with sweat production and exertion; repeated blasts grant acceleration and aerial maneuverability, while recoil and bodily strain impose limits. Sophisticated combat training enables compact bursts, directional changes and large-area attacks. His damaged right arm needed prolonged rehabilitation after the Final War. Explosive output is a natural Quirk, not a property of his costume.

Technique: Sweat production in the palms supplies the explosive material, so heat, exertion and perspiration affect output. Small controlled ignitions provide agile directional propulsion; focused blasts deliver concentrated impacts while larger releases cover a broad area. Specialized gauntlets can store sweat and permit major releases without requiring all the discharge from a bare palm at once.

Risks: Sudden heavy output can strain the arms and create blast damage around fragile structures. Cold conditions can reduce available sweat until the user warms up. Cluster techniques involve rapid small detonations, requiring precise coordination rather than simply increasing the size of one blast. Repeated injuries and recovery affect the user’s ability to capitalize on the Quirk.

cardPool.title: Zero Gravity
cardPool.value:
Ability: Zero Gravity

Overview: Zero Gravity makes physical targets effectively weightless after contact through Ochaco Uraraka’s fingertip pads. She can release the effect intentionally and, following advanced development, spread it through nearby targets. Floating objects retain inertia and can collide dangerously with surroundings. Nausea and overload were important limits in earlier training. Rescue uses include stabilizing debris, moving victims and creating space during evacuation. The Quirk cannot automatically guarantee safe landings without movement control.

Activation: The pads at the ends of the fingers remove the felt effect of gravity on touched targets. Earlier use required deliberate contact and release; advanced control allowed an expanded spread among targets. The power is especially valuable for freeing people pinned by wreckage, redistributing heavy burdens and managing airborne hazards.

Control: Zero weight is not the same as stopping momentum. A thrown object can continue to travel quickly, a falling person needs safe deceleration, and released rubble can become deadly if the effect ends above a crowd. Heavy or numerous targets once caused intense nausea and vomiting; conditioning expanded practical capacity without removing the importance of planning.

cardPool.title: Half-Cold Half-Hot
cardPool.value:
Ability: Half-Cold Half-Hot

Overview: Half-Cold Half-Hot gives Shoto Todoroki independent ice production from his right side and fire production from his left. Using only one side risks dangerous bodily temperature imbalance; dual-side training allows sustained use. Ice creates barriers and large formations; fire supplies heat, propulsion and ranged force. Phosphor circulates balanced thermal energy and enables cold-flame techniques. The ability is inherited through parents with distinct elemental Quirks.

Thermal balance: The two halves of the body counterbalance one another. Ice spreads rapidly outward from one side, while the other generates searing flame for attacks and regulating temperature. Separately pushing either side too far can result in freezing or dangerous overheating. Balanced technique lets both outputs support longer engagements.

Specialized use: Fire and ice can control routes, impede pursuers, seal openings, create cover and regulate local temperatures in rescues. Phosphor uses a controlled circulation of heat and cold for an unusual form of flame; it is not the same as summoning a second independent Quirk. Enormous outputs require concentration and careful consideration of people nearby.

cardPool.title: Engine
cardPool.value:
Ability: Engine

Overview: Engine grows exhaust engines in Tenya Iida’s calves, producing high-speed running and short bursts of rapid acceleration. Reciprocating techniques maximize power over limited windows; training and maintenance matter. The engines may stall or overheat, and aggressive acceleration demands safe paths and control. The Quirk supports transport, evacuation and close combat but is not equivalent to teleportation.

Physical structure: Engine housings protrude from the calves and release the force for rapid running. Specialized footwear and clothing accommodate the exhausts. Recipro Burst provides a brief, extreme acceleration; later training improves both duration and efficiency. The power can deliver urgent supplies and evacuate people more quickly than ordinary transport on open routes.

Maintenance and hazards: The engines cannot ignore friction, obstacles or the need to turn. Damage, blockage and overheating can interrupt performance. Intense training once involved removing the mufflers so stronger replacements could grow, an extremely painful process. Speed without visibility or coordination can endanger bystanders.

Field detail: Combat practice: Burst acceleration favors straight-line approaches but offers only a narrow time window to change direction. Rapid maneuvers can shield someone from impact or carry them out of a hazardous area; misjudging distance could instead produce a collision. Recipro Turbo is a later refinement built through difficult training, not a passive always-on level of speed.

cardPool.title: Creation
cardPool.value:
Ability: Creation

Overview: Creation converts stored lipids in Momo Yaoyorozu’s body into nonliving materials through her skin. The user must understand the molecular structure of whatever is produced. Larger or more complex items consume more resources and time; food intake and advance planning are important. The power cannot directly produce living beings. Weapons, shields, tools and medical equipment can all be created if their composition is known.

Process: The user calculates a nonliving object’s chemical and structural composition, then expends body lipids to manifest the material from exposed skin. Complex machinery requires unusually detailed prior study; metal beams, insulation sheets, ropes, shields and medical supplies are attainable when the structure is known. The technique favors preparedness and accurate knowledge.

Limits: It does not create living organisms, replace training or automatically supply whatever device would be most useful. Large masses require greater reserves and more creation time; repeated production can exhaust the user. Open space and enough room for an emerging object are important, and a team must handle heavy creations responsibly once they appear.

cardPool.title: Frog
cardPool.value:
Ability: Frog

Overview: Frog grants Tsuyu Asui amphibian traits including huge leaps, wall adhesion, a long prehensile tongue, extended swimming endurance and adaptive camouflage. Cold temperatures can interfere with her mobility and alertness. Some abilities operate differently in water and on land. Her Quirk makes her especially capable in flooded environments and at reaching trapped or distant people.

Traits: The body combines strong jumping muscles, adhesive extremities, swimming ability and an extensible tongue that can pull small people or objects. The tongue can grapple, rescue and surprise opponents without requiring direct hand contact. Amphibious skill makes the power useful in rivers, flood zones and confined aquatic searches.

Constraints: Severe cold can produce sluggishness and hibernation-like effects, reducing the ability to act. Camouflage disguises the user against some backgrounds but does not grant perfect optical invisibility. A tongue can be seized, cut or entangled; underwater rescue still depends on available air for people being saved.

Field detail: Rescue practice: A tongue can act as an extended hand, pulling a teammate across a gap or retrieving someone drifting in water. Wall adhesion and strong legs provide alternatives when staircases fail. The combination favors nonlethal restraint and recovery of people in places where a normal person would need climbing equipment.

cardPool.title: Dupli-Arms
cardPool.value:
Ability: Dupli-Arms

Overview: Dupli-Arms gives Mezo Shoji multiple strong, flexible upper limbs with surfaces that can generate copies of hands and sensory organs. Duplicated mouths, eyes and ears extend awareness and communication; replicated limbs support shields, transport and restraint. The many appendages require coordination and do not constitute independent individuals. Visible heteromorphic traits contributed to Shoji’s experiences with public prejudice.

Morphology: Several strong arms extend from the torso, with branching ends capable of sprouting additional appendages or sensory organs. Extra eyes and ears expand situational awareness; multiple mouths help relay messages while hands can grip debris or shield a person. The power is particularly effective when several actions must occur at once.

Limits: A duplicated organ is not a separate thinking ally, and all motion must be coordinated through one person. Creating many exposed sensory organs increases opportunities for enemy attacks. The bodily mutation remains visible permanently and is distinct from temporary transformation powers.

Field detail: Search and protection: Multiple ears can listen to different parts of a damaged structure while spare arms clear obstructions and support an injured person. Duplicated mouths make communication possible from several positions. Large numbers of appendages improve coverage but can become tangled or expose the body to attacks through a wider surface.

cardPool.title: Hardening
cardPool.value:
Ability: Hardening

Overview: Hardening lets Eijiro Kirishima toughen his body into rugged armor, improving defense and increasing close-range striking power. Unbreakable is a stronger, temporary mode that exacts a serious physical cost. Repeated heavy impacts can break down his defense and leave vulnerable openings. The Quirk is most useful where a hero must endure punishment, protect others or break through obstacles.

Defense: Hardened tissue takes on angular, rocky ridges across the body, providing protection against blunt force and cutting attacks. It also makes charges and punches more effective, though technique and physical fitness remain essential. Red Riot Unbreakable reinforces the transformation to a far greater degree for a short period.

Limits: Continuous punishment can chip away at the defense, while the strongest form cannot be sustained indefinitely. The Quirk does not protect an ally standing outside its hardened surface. It favors front-line interception and close-range fights; distant opponents may force the user to depend on teammates for approach.

Field detail: Battlefield use: Hardening can protect the user while taking a charge intended for another person, or let them break a barrier obstructing rescue. Stronger stances are more effective when feet are braced; simple toughness does not grant effortless flight, exceptional speed or range. Defensive timing matters when a teammate must pass behind the user.

cardPool.title: Electrification
cardPool.value:
Ability: Electrification

Overview: Electrification allows Denki Kaminari to discharge electrical energy around him. High-voltage attacks can incapacitate opponents but also threaten allies, civilians and sensitive equipment. Aiming devices improve selective targeting. Excessive output can temporarily reduce the user’s mental clarity. Power management and coordination are essential in confined environments.

Discharge: Electricity spreads rapidly from the body and can overwhelm groups or interfere with machinery. Targeting discs and pointer equipment help draw it toward chosen opponents. Conductive objects and wet conditions can change where current travels, so arena control and allied positions matter.

Overload: Excessive release causes a temporary confused, mentally dulled state in the user. Powerful attacks are therefore short tactical choices rather than constant output. The ability generates electrical danger, not reliable mind control or an unlimited energy supply for other devices.

Field detail: Team applications: Electrical discharge can disable groups while another hero handles physical restraint, but a team must first establish safe zones. Metal structures and nearby electronics change the risks. The user’s specialized aiming equipment is a technical answer to indiscriminate spread, not evidence that he can control every current in the environment.

cardPool.title: Earphone Jack
cardPool.value:
Ability: Earphone Jack

Overview: Earphone Jack gives Kyoka Jiro long, flexible audio-jack earlobes. Inserting them into surfaces allows detection of vibrations; she can amplify her heartbeat through specialized equipment to create intense sonic shocks. Its utility depends on sound transmission and the environment. An injury sustained during the Final War affected her ear, making her later physical circumstances distinct from her student years.

Sound handling: Cordlike earlobes can be inserted into surfaces to hear internal vibrations, locate hidden movement and track distant noises. With speaker amplifiers, the user’s heartbeat becomes a damaging vibration wave, useful for disrupting balance or breaking fragile obstacles. The ability is valuable in searches as well as direct confrontation.

Tradeoffs: The appendages have finite reach and can be injured; hearing can be confused by many overlapping signals. The user must distinguish useful vibration from ordinary background noise. Serious injuries to an ear during the last war alter later deployment, so earlier two-sided techniques cannot automatically be assumed unchanged.

Field detail: Reconnaissance: Pressing a jack against a wall may reveal movement behind it when ordinary sight is blocked. Vibrations can also identify structural weaknesses or approaching footsteps. In a noisy disaster, sensing depends on interpretation as much as on raw sensitivity; a loud echo is not a guaranteed map of every person trapped under rubble.

cardPool.title: Acid
cardPool.value:
Ability: Acid

Overview: Acid allows Mina Ashido to exude corrosive fluid and vary its concentration and viscosity. Applications include melting obstructions, creating sliding surfaces and coating herself in protective or offensive layers. Precision matters to avoid damaging people or surrounding structures. Stronger corrosive output imposes stress on the user’s body and is not suited to indiscriminate rescue work.

Control: Corrosive secretions can be made more or less viscous and adjusted for different degrees of dissolving power. Low-friction flows permit sliding movement, while dense coatings or concentrated jets can cut through obstacles. The user’s own skin has natural resistance, making controlled close-range use possible.

Safety: Acid can harm bystanders, uniforms and the materials needed to support a damaged building. Increasing concentration and output stresses the body and risks dehydration or compromised skin protection. Precision and restraint are essential where rescue victims cannot get clear of the spray.

Field detail: Named techniques: Acid Shot and Acidman demonstrate very different approaches: launching concentrated corrosive material and enveloping the body with a dense protective coating. Strong output may resist or dissolve obstacles but cannot be used carelessly around injured people. Less damaging concentrations remain useful for friction control and controlled access.

cardPool.title: Dark Shadow
cardPool.value:
Ability: Dark Shadow

Overview: Dark Shadow is a sentient shadowlike manifestation linked to Fumikage Tokoyami. It can move, strike, shield and carry him, and speaks with a distinct personality. Darkness greatly increases power but can compromise restraint; bright light weakens it and helps regain control. Its coordination with Tokoyami determines effectiveness. The shadow has an expressive personality but remains part of Tokoyami’s Quirk.

Manifestation: A mobile dark creature with speech and a distinct temperament emerges from the user and acts as both weapon and shield. It can seize opponents, carry weight and assist aerial movement. Cooperation between user and shadow yields complex feints and protection from several angles.

Light dependence: In bright surroundings the manifestation is smaller and easier to control; strong darkness greatly magnifies strength and makes rage harder to restrain. Light-based attacks can weaken or force it back. Its independence is behavioral, not proof that it is a second autonomous person separate from the Quirk factor.

Field detail: Coordination techniques: When kept within a suitable range, Dark Shadow can surround the user as armor, strike from outside an opponent’s reach or assist with aerial positioning. Its temperament responds to command and environmental light. The best results involve constant spoken or intuitive cooperation rather than simply ordering a blind charge.

cardPool.title: Navel Laser
cardPool.value:
Ability: Navel Laser

Overview: Navel Laser emits a concentrated beam through Yuga Aoyama’s abdomen, often directed through a focusing belt. The power was given to him rather than naturally inherited and creates abdominal pain with extended use. It supports ranged attacks and propulsion, but equipment and bodily compatibility affect performance.

Projection: A focused light beam travels from the navel region and may provide thrust for short airborne movements. Costume support helps aim the stream and manage instability. It is effective at penetrating or destroying obstacles when fired with care, but the beam has a clear direction and may be dodged.

Compatibility: The power was artificially given to a child born without one, and his body reacts poorly to prolonged output. Stomachaches, digestive problems and leakage are practical limitations. Hero equipment manages these symptoms; it does not remove the biological mismatch between person and Quirk.

Field detail: Specialized handling: The beam can be fired in short controlled pulses or sustained at greater cost. The focusing belt is especially important when the user needs a precise line through a target rather than a broad destructive sweep. Unintended abdominal leakage or physical discomfort can turn an otherwise impressive ability into a serious liability.

cardPool.title: Tape
cardPool.value:
Ability: Tape

Overview: Tape permits Hanta Sero to eject adhesive ribbons from structures on his elbows. Ribbons serve as grappling lines, restraints, anchors and swinging cables. Environmental anchor points and tape supply determine maneuver options. Powerful opponents can sever or tear the tape, making route choice important.

Movement: The elbow dispensers launch adhesive lengths that attach to distant supports and can be reeled, detached or used to swing. They bind enemies, bridge gaps, reposition debris and provide rapid high-level traversal. Skilled use requires constant awareness of structure strength and the angle of a pull.

Constraints: The ribbons can be cut, burned, peeled from weak surfaces or pulled free by stronger opponents. An extended line makes the user vulnerable if the anchor collapses. Open spaces with no handholds reduce mobility even when tape can still be released.

Field detail: Capture techniques: Several overlapping lines can interfere with an opponent’s footing while the user swings around a support to approach from another angle. The adhesive material is also suitable for pulling light debris clear of a passage. Rapid disengagement is critical if an enemy seizes a line and tries to drag its owner into danger.

cardPool.title: Tail
cardPool.value:
Ability: Tail

Overview: Tail is Mashirao Ojiro’s muscular prehensile appendage. It supports balance, grappling, agile movement and powerful martial-arts blows. Training is crucial because the Quirk grants a physical tool rather than automatic expertise. Restraint or damage to the tail can sharply reduce maneuverability.

Function: The thick, muscular appendage supplies extra balance, a third point of support, a grappling tool and heavy close-range blows. The user can brace with it during a punch or change direction midair. Martial-arts practice transforms an otherwise straightforward anatomy into adaptable offense and defense.

Limits: The tail is attached and physically vulnerable; binding it removes much of its utility. It does not inherently improve ranged attacks, create additional limbs or make a user immune to injury. Its large size also has practical consequences when wearing clothing or entering tight spaces.

Field detail: Practical technique: The tail can strike while both hands are occupied, anchor the user during a throw or sweep the legs of an opponent. Martial-arts drills develop timing so the movement of the tail does not unbalance the hips. The Quirk remains useful in an empty training hall even where there are no projectiles or structures to manipulate.

cardPool.title: Anivoice
cardPool.value:
Ability: Anivoice

Overview: Anivoice permits Koji Koda to communicate with animals and request assistance. Birds, mammals and insects can aid scouting, navigation, rescue and coordinated movement. Animals retain their own physical limitations and may be frightened by hostile conditions. Developments in Koda’s horn-like anatomy are linked to improved communication.

Communication: Vocal calls can convey intentions to birds, insects and mammals, directing them to gather, search or carry out straightforward actions. Animals can scout places too small for people, notice scents and signs inaccessible to humans, or help find missing victims. Training and familiarity with animal behavior make requests more effective.

Limits: Animals have ordinary strength, speed and comprehension, and the user cannot make an insect carry a person or assume every animal can perform intricate tactics. Noise and distance hinder contact; a frightened creature may be unable to help. Later horn development improves expression of the ability but does not turn it into human telepathy.

Field detail: Operational examples: Birds can survey rooftops and insects can enter narrow gaps, while larger creatures may help search open ground. Instructions must be framed around actions animals can physically understand, such as approaching a place, making noise or leading a person toward something. Training reduces panic but never abolishes an animal’s instincts.

cardPool.title: Sugar Rush
cardPool.value:
Ability: Sugar Rush

Overview: Sugar Rush temporarily raises Rikido Sato’s strength after sugar intake. The enhancement consumes available energy and can diminish higher-order thinking while active, making timing and preparation vital. The power suits rescue lifting and straightforward close defense but becomes less useful in complicated tactical situations.

Activation: Consuming sugar yields a marked but temporary increase in muscle strength, allowing heavy lifting and forceful hand-to-hand combat. The user commonly prepares sweets or another reliable source of sugar before an assignment. The strength gain must still be directed using good technique.

Cost: The power is tied to sugar intake rather than an unlimited reserve. Each period of enhanced strength diminishes sharp mental processing, making delicate operations difficult. Appropriate doses and timing matter, and exhausting the available fuel can leave a responder less capable during a rescue.

Field detail: Rescue tradeoff: A strengthened user can temporarily lift beams or move heavy rubble, but a complicated evacuation may require a teammate to plan while the power is active. The useful duration depends on intake and individual conditioning. Excessive consumption is not a shortcut to unlimited ability or permanent muscular transformation.

cardPool.title: Invisibility
cardPool.value:
Ability: Invisibility

Overview: Invisibility makes Toru Hagakure’s body extremely difficult to see and can refract or redirect light. Her physical presence remains tangible, and footsteps, clothing and environmental disturbance can reveal her location. Flashing light effects can disorient observers. The power does not grant silence, intangibility or immunity to damage.

Optics: The body is invisible to ordinary sight and can bend light to create dazzling flashes or redirect some incoming illumination. Sneaking through sightlines is much easier than for most opponents, and the user can scout while remaining hard to target. Visible objects carried or worn do not automatically share the full invisibility.

Limits: Sound, touch, scent, tracks and moving clothing can reveal position. Optical invisibility does not hide impacts or protect against attacks covering an entire space. Strong light interactions can temporarily reveal outlines or a face, so apparent visibility depends on circumstances rather than a permanent switch.

Field detail: Tactical use: Stealth allows the user to approach a lookout or scout an exposed corridor while the enemy is focused elsewhere. Refracting a bright flash can briefly blind pursuers. It remains necessary to account for clothing, falling rain, disturbed dust and the physical noise of movement, any of which could disclose position.

cardPool.title: Pop Off
cardPool.value:
Ability: Pop Off

Overview: Pop Off lets Minoru Mineta pull sticky spheres from his head. These cling stubbornly to many surfaces but do not adhere to him; strategic placement forms traps and movement aids. Removing too many causes bleeding and physical distress. The spheres do not explode and require creativity rather than raw striking strength.

Material: Soft, purple spheres detach from the scalp and adhere powerfully to most other surfaces. They can form walls of obstacles, glue footwear to the ground or create paths across difficult terrain. The user is exempt from their adhesion and can bounce off deployed spheres with practiced movement.

Limits: The balls do not explode and are not effective as ordinary damaging projectiles. Pulling too many from the scalp in a short time causes pain and bleeding. Enemies with unusual strength or wide-ranging attacks can bypass traps, and placement must avoid trapping teammates.

Field detail: Movement use: Properly placed adhesive balls can create improvised footholds and bouncy landing sites for their owner. They are best treated as a limited set of tactical objects rather than a stream of damage. Placing them where a frightened civilian might step is dangerous, because the same adhesion that traps an enemy can also obstruct rescue.

cardPool.title: Brainwashing
cardPool.value:
Ability: Brainwashing

Overview: Brainwashing allows Hitoshi Shinso to control a target who verbally replies to him. Physical shocks can break the effect, and complex thinking cannot simply be commanded into existence. His voice-changing mask enables imitation, increasing opportunities to elicit a response. The power does not require the victim to agree with him, nor does it permanently rewrite personality.

Condition: The target must answer the user’s spoken words, after which simple commands can direct their body. The victim remains a conscious person rather than losing their memories or moral beliefs. Voice imitation equipment can lure an answer without changing how the Quirk actually activates.

Resistance and limits: A substantial physical jolt can end the state, and sustained control requires care when ordering several people. The ability cannot force someone to use hidden knowledge they do not possess. A suspicious opponent may stay silent, rely on written messages or avoid engaging the speaker.

Field detail: Tactical uncertainty: A target who has already learned the activation rule can force the user to create a convincing surprise. The control may direct body movement but cannot erase a person’s judgment when it ends. Restraining the controlled person safely matters, because a stray blow or sufficiently painful shock can immediately release them.

cardPool.title: Permeation
cardPool.value:
Ability: Permeation

Overview: Permeation makes Mirio Togata intangible to solid matter and certain forces. While phased he cannot ordinarily see, hear or breathe; the ground stops supporting him, requiring carefully timed activation. He uses deliberate repositioning and sudden reappearance to strike or evacuate people. The ability is difficult to master despite its deceptively simple description.

Physics of use: Phasing causes ordinary light, sound and air to pass through the body, removing sight, hearing and breathing while fully intangible. Gravity still affects the user, so sinking below the ground and returning at chosen angles require painstaking timing. Deactivation inside solid matter forces the body outward.

Training: The technique is not effortless invulnerability. The user must learn when to leave specific body parts tangible to strike, block or grip another person. Long fights depend on predicting attacks and managing short windows of vulnerability. Costume materials were specially engineered to phase with the wearer.

Field detail: A skilled user shifts only the body parts needed to avoid contact, preserving the ability to strike with the rest. Phasing through a floor or wall creates a surprise route but also temporarily eliminates visual information. A wrong timing choice can drop the user into dangerous depth; repeated drills are crucial before field work.

cardPool.title: Wave Motion
cardPool.value:
Ability: Wave Motion

Overview: Wave Motion transforms Nejire Hado’s vitality into spiraling energy waves released through her limbs. The beams can provide propulsion, flight, destructive force and support. Sustained use consumes stamina, and the spiraling projectiles are not always as fast as direct lightlike attacks. Her effectiveness comes from control, coordination and energy management.

Output: Spiral waves emerge from the hands or feet and can push against the air to maintain flight or strike at targets from a distance. The energy can be varied in intensity, letting the user alternate rescue support with powerful blasts. Broad arcs work well against large opponents.

Tradeoffs: The twisting discharge is slower than a direct linear strike of similar apparent intensity, and prolonged high output exhausts the user. Precision requires attention to people near the beam’s route. Flight depends on continued application of the same finite physical energy.

Field detail: Careful bursts under the feet permit sustained aerial movement and quick changes of altitude. More intense spirals can hold back a large enemy or remove obstacles that are too dangerous to approach. This flexibility does not remove the physical cost: prolonged effort leaves the user increasingly tired and vulnerable to follow-up attacks.

cardPool.title: Manifest
cardPool.value:
Ability: Manifest

Overview: Manifest gives Tamaki Amajiki temporary physical characteristics from foods he has consumed. The resulting claws, wings, shells, tentacles and other traits can be combined in strategic ways. Access is limited by what he has eaten and by his knowledge of animal properties. The Quirk does not generate unrestricted matter or duplicate other people’s powers.

Expression: Consumed foods provide temporary biological characteristics: seafood can form tentacles or shells, birds can provide wings, and other ingredients yield their own body traits. Several features may appear at once, giving the user a remarkable choice of range, armor and movement.

Limitations: No trait appears without the corresponding substance first being eaten. The Quirk does not recreate arbitrary tools, give possession of someone else’s Quirk or remove the need to understand each food’s capabilities. Special combinations take preparation and may be awkward in crowded areas.

Field detail: Food selection is a form of advance planning. Shellfish traits may provide armor, tentacles can restrain and a birdlike appendage may help with mobility.
