Abilities: Wave Motion converts physical vitality into spiral energy blasts, useful for flight, defense and attack.

Personality: Inquisitive, effusive and friendly, Nejire asks questions with childlike openness and often jumps rapidly between topics. Her enthusiasm conceals a capable veteran who is willing to fight difficult battles and protect younger people. She enjoys companionship and approaching strangers without much hesitation. She is especially responsive when a friend has been treated as strange or unwelcome.

Appearance: A young woman with distinctive long, pale blue hair and wide blue eyes. Her hair can shift in length and styling across her career; her hero outfit retains swirling accents that echo her emitted energy. She often smiles brightly and gestures animatedly, while her body language changes decisively when she concentrates on an opponent.

cardPool.title: Tamaki Amajiki
cardPool.value:
Name: Tamaki Amajiki

Alias: Suneater

Occupation: Pro Hero

Abilities: Manifest produces physical traits of foods he has eaten, combining animal and other characteristics for offense, defense and rescue.

Personality: Shy and easily overwhelmed by social attention, Tamaki may withdraw or avoid eye contact even when praised. He doubts himself, especially in front of crowds, but his tactical imagination and devotion to friends are exceptionally strong. Mirio’s faith in him helps counter his own pessimism. His anxiety coexists with exceptional courage. He treats Mirio’s faith in him as a responsibility he wants to repay through action.

Appearance: A slender young man with dark, untidy hair, pointed ears and a habitually downcast or anxious expression. His hero clothing is designed for transformation, leaving room for manifested limbs, shells and tentacles. His posture tends to fold inward in conversation, though it becomes precise and purposeful when defending someone.

cardPool.title: Shota Aizawa
cardPool.value:
Name: Shota Aizawa

Alias: Eraser Head

Occupation: U.A. faculty member and teacher; Pro Hero with severe injuries

Abilities: Erasure disables the active Quirks of visible targets while he keeps his eyes open; he is experienced with capture cloth and close combat. Severe war injuries constrain his former fighting capacity.

Personality: Austere, perceptive and suspicious of wasted effort, Shota demands practical readiness from students because he knows the stakes of hero work. He seems indifferent to praise and may speak with cutting bluntness, yet consistently protects pupils and colleagues. His judgment is based on observed effort, restraint and the capacity to cooperate.

Appearance: A tall, lean man with long dark hair, tired eyes and a usually unshaven, weathered face. His old hero look featured black clothing, a gray capture scarf and protective goggles. The Final War left him with major injuries including the loss of an eye and a leg, requiring prosthetic support.

cardPool.title: Toshinori Yagi
cardPool.value:
Name: Toshinori Yagi

Alias: All Might

Occupation: Retired Pro Hero; U.A. vice principal and mentor

Abilities: Former eighth holder of One For All. He has no remaining Quirk and relies on experience, training and support technology rather than superhuman strength.

Personality: Encouraging, dramatic and deeply altruistic, Toshinori built his reputation on making frightened people feel safe. Even after retirement, he believes in helping the next generation realize possibilities they cannot yet see. He balances warmth and concern with painful memories of personal sacrifice, frequently encouraging others with a huge smile.

Appearance: In his weakened natural form he is strikingly thin with deep-set features, long blond hair shaped into two distinctive tufts and prominent shadows around his eyes. His old muscular hero form was enormous, square-jawed and broad-shouldered, wearing a famous red, white and blue costume.

cardPool.title: Enji Todoroki
cardPool.value:
Name: Enji Todoroki

Alias: Endeavor

Occupation: Retired Pro Hero

Abilities: Hellflame generates and controls intense fire. His physical injuries after the Final War prevent a return to his former frontline role.

Personality: Stern, driven and often painfully inarticulate, Enji was consumed for years by ambition and the desire to surpass All Might. He subjected his family to emotional and physical cruelty, consequences he cannot undo through public achievements. His later desire for atonement involves accepting blame rather than demanding forgiveness.

Appearance: A very large, muscular older man with red hair, pale blue eyes and a heavily imposing frame. His former hero presentation included an intimidating suit and living flame shaped into facial hair. The war left catastrophic injuries, including the loss of his right arm, and severe scarring. His adult posture is more burdened, reflecting both disability and an exhausted life.

cardPool.title: Hawks
cardPool.value:
Name: Keigo Takami

Alias: Hawks

Occupation: President of the Hero Public Safety Commission; former Pro Hero

Abilities: Former Fierce Wings user; his damaged and later lost feathered Quirk no longer serves as the basis for active hero work. He has expertise in intelligence, negotiation and administration.

Personality: Easygoing in conversation and extraordinarily observant beneath the surface, Keigo uses humor and informality to put others off guard. Years of institutional training and covert work taught him to hide anxieties and make unpleasant decisions quickly. He understands the human cost of violence and avoids romanticizing the old hero system.

Appearance: A lean blond man with sharp golden-brown eyes, light stubble and a relaxed, almost lazy bearing. Earlier in his career his enormous red wings were his defining feature, paired with goggles and a flight jacket; after his loss of powers his adult appearance no longer includes functional wings.

cardPool.title: Rumi Usagiyama
cardPool.value:
Name: Rumi Usagiyama

Alias: Mirko

Occupation: Pro Hero

Abilities: Rabbit grants extraordinary leg strength, agility, jumping ability and heightened hearing; adaptive prosthetics replace limbs lost in battle.

Personality: Fearless, combative and fiercely independent, Rumi seeks difficult fights rather than a comfortable career. She relishes strong opponents and refuses to let injury define her as helpless. Her audacity can become recklessness, and she sometimes prioritizes direct action over coordination. Her unmistakable confidence survives the injuries of war. Mirko refuses to be treated as fragile because she uses prosthetics.

Appearance: A muscular, athletic woman with long white hair, prominent rabbit ears, red eyes and powerful legs. Her hero costume has traditionally used a white-and-purple palette with functional combat support. After devastating injuries she employs conspicuous mechanical prosthetic limbs that permit continued high-intensity fighting.

cardPool.title: Nemuri Kayama
cardPool.value:
Name: Nemuri Kayama

Age: 31 (at death)

Alias: Midnight

Occupation: Former U.A. teacher and Pro Hero

Abilities: Somnambulist emitted sleep-inducing aroma from her body.

Personality: Confident, theatrical and fond of teasing students and colleagues, Nemuri combined provocative showmanship with a serious commitment to education and public safety. She expected effort from aspiring heroes and fought to protect them during crises. Her public persona did not erase her professional judgment or courage. Her death remains an important loss to her colleagues.

Appearance: A tall woman with long dark hair, bright eyes and a striking, stylized hero ensemble designed around exposed skin and tearable material. She used expressive gestures and carried a whip-like accessory. Her assertive posture matched her stage-ready persona. A tall woman with long, dark purple hair and blue eyes, often seen in a white, black and red outfit with a mask and whip-like accessories.

cardPool.title: Eri
cardPool.value:
Name: Eri

Age: 15 (later epilogue)

Alias: None established

Occupation: Student and aspiring musician

Abilities: Rewind can revert the body of a living target to an earlier state. She broke off her horn to help restore Izuku’s injured arms during the Final War; her horn has regrown, but the full condition of her Quirk afterward is not established.

Personality: Gentle, earnest and increasingly curious about the world, Eri spent her childhood escaping severe abuse and learning that kindness need not hide a threat. She slowly developed the ability to smile, trust adults and enjoy ordinary school experiences. Music gives her a way to express feelings that are difficult to explain.

Appearance: A teenage girl with long pale hair, large red eyes and a small horn on her forehead, whose condition changes after the wartime sacrifice. Her clothing becomes more ordinary and age-appropriate as she grows, rather than the isolated, ill-fitting clothes of her early childhood.

cardPool.title: Kota Izumi
cardPool.value:
Name: Kota Izumi

Alias: None established

Occupation: U.A. student

Abilities: Water Gun allows him to project water; training improves his control and practical use.

Personality: Once openly distrustful of heroes because his parents died in the line of duty, Kota gradually grew closer to those who helped him survive a villain attack. He is frank and sometimes prickly, but the brave example set by Izuku changed his understanding of protection. His later decision to attend U.A. reflects that shift.

Appearance: A school-age boy who grows into a teenage U.A. student. He has dark, short hair and a recognizable youthful face. In childhood he frequently wore a cap and casual summer clothes; as a teenager he wears school attire appropriate to U.A. His exact adult measurements are not established. In childhood Kota had short dark hair, prominent brows and a habit of staring angrily at people who approached him.

cardPool.title: Mei Hatsume
cardPool.value:
Name: Mei Hatsume

Alias: None established

Occupation: Support engineer; founder of Lightly Labs

Abilities: Engineering genius specializing in high-performance support technology, prototypes, prosthetics and mobility equipment.

Personality: Inventive, excitable and relentlessly experimental, Mei affectionately treats each new invention as one of her babies. She is more interested in proof of function than in formal manners or selling herself through modesty. Failures are material for improvement, and potentially dangerous demonstrations rarely dent her enthusiasm. Failure rarely embarrasses her; it is new data for the next design.

Appearance: A young woman with voluminous pink hair and eyes marked by target-like pupils, reflecting her Zoom Quirk. She is commonly seen wearing goggles, practical work clothes and pieces of mechanical equipment. Her posture is quick and restless, frequently leaning into tools or prototypes. Her gaze fixes intensely on mechanical details.

cardPool.title: Melissa Shield
cardPool.value:
Name: Melissa Shield

Alias: None established

Occupation: Engineer and support-item developer

Abilities: Exceptional engineering and support-device design; Quirkless.

Personality: Bright, generous and excited by technological possibility, Melissa admires heroism without tying its worth to superpowers. She shares her father’s passion for research and uses her gifts to improve other people’s safety. She approaches collaborators openly, learns rapidly from difficult prototypes and is driven by the conviction that determination and invention can change someone’s future.

Appearance: A young woman with long blond hair, blue eyes and a cheerful face, often wearing practical, modern clothing suitable for an engineer. She moves confidently in laboratories and engineering spaces, bringing enthusiasm to conversations about new devices. Specific changes to her clothing and physique in the late adult era have not been firmly established.

cardPool.title: Neito Monoma
cardPool.value:
Name: Neito Monoma

Age: Approximately 24–25 (later epilogue)

Alias: Phantom Thief

Occupation: Pro Hero

Abilities: Copy borrows Quirks from others after physical contact, with significant duration and application limits; he cannot automatically supply stockpiled resources for copied powers.

Personality: Proud, theatrical and prone to taunting perceived rivals, Neito often masks insecurity with exaggerated claims on behalf of Class 1-B. He is nevertheless a perceptive strategist who excels at understanding how other people’s abilities can combine. He is willing to work tirelessly when a situation depends on precise timing.

Appearance: A slim young man with light blond hair, pale eyes and a flamboyant manner of gesturing. His appearance is polished and expressive; he commonly smiles with visible self-satisfaction or delivers pointed remarks with dramatic body language. His hero costume emphasizes his elegant, stage-magician-like image rather than heavy armor.

cardPool.title: Juzo Honenuki
cardPool.value:
Name: Juzo Honenuki

Age: Approximately 24–25 (later epilogue)

Alias: Mudman

Occupation: Pro Hero

Abilities: Softening can turn touched solid material soft and return it to its original consistency, allowing terrain control and restraint.

Personality: Levelheaded, agreeable and highly capable, Juzo is less concerned with noisy class rivalries than with solving the immediate problem. He combines tactical foresight with confidence and adapts quickly when an opponent changes strategy. He takes dangerous situations seriously without becoming theatrical.

Appearance: A young man with light-colored hair, an unusual exposed-tooth facial structure and narrow eyes. His costume is suited to terrain operations and rapid movement through altered surfaces. He often stands loosely and speaks casually, masking strong technical control of his power. His lean frame and easygoing posture can belie a highly focused tactician.

cardPool.title: Himiko Toga
cardPool.value:
Name: Himiko Toga

Age: 17 (at death)

Alias: None established

Occupation: Deceased former League of Villains member

Abilities: Transform allowed her to copy another person’s appearance after drinking their blood and, under particular conditions, access their Quirk.

Personality: Affectionate and animated in moments of intimacy but capable of extreme violence, Himiko longed to have her feelings acknowledged rather than dismissed as monstrous. Her understanding of love became tangled with the urge to drink blood and assume identities. She conflated love with taking on someone else’s identity and struggled to understand why others recoiled.

Appearance: A slight girl with yellow-blond hair arranged in two messy side buns, yellow eyes and pronounced canine teeth. Her expressions shift rapidly between an eager grin, dreamy affection and frightening intensity. She was commonly seen in a school-uniform-inspired outfit with specialized blood-storage equipment when transformed for combat.

cardPool.title: Toya Todoroki
cardPool.value:
Name: Toya Todoroki

Alias: Dabi

Occupation: Deceased former villain

Abilities: Blueflame generated extraordinarily hot blue fire, severely damaging his own body because of inadequate heat tolerance.

Personality: Bitter, vindictive and fixated on making his father face the consequences of abuse, Toya weaponized his identity and suffering. He was cruel to numerous people unrelated to his family, and his obsession inflicted further harm on those closest to him. Beneath his nihilistic sarcasm lay a child’s intense longing to be seen. Toya’s obsessive need to be acknowledged hardened into rage at the father whose ambitions dominated his childhood.

Appearance: A lanky man with dark, dyed hair, pale blue eyes and extensive purplish scarred skin fixed by metal staples across his face, torso and limbs. His black clothing and smoldering flames created a stark, threatening silhouette. After the war his injuries were catastrophic and required intensive life-sustaining medical care.

cardPool.title: Tomura Shigaraki
cardPool.value:
Name: Tomura Shigaraki

Age: 21 (at death)

Alias: None established

Occupation: Deceased leader of the League of Villains

Abilities: Decay disintegrated touched matter and eventually spread destruction rapidly over connected surfaces. His body was altered by All For One’s schemes.

Personality: Rageful, alienated and destructive, Tomura was shaped by abuse, abandonment and manipulation. He came to despise a society in which suffering people could be ignored while everyone assumed someone else would help. He built bonds with fellow outcasts even while pursuing mass destruction, and his actions brought catastrophe to strangers.

Appearance: A gaunt young man with pale hair, red eyes and damaged, dry-looking skin. His early appearance often included numerous hands covering his face and body, with later looks emphasizing disheveled white hair and black clothing. Post-surgical alterations transformed his physical condition and made him an extraordinarily dangerous opponent.

cardPool.title: All For One
cardPool.value:
Name: All For One

Alias: None established

Occupation: Deceased criminal mastermind

Abilities: All For One allowed its holder to steal, transfer and combine Quirks; numerous stolen powers granted extraordinary offense, mobility and longevity.

Personality: Patient, possessive and narcissistic, he treated other human beings as pieces in a story of his own dominance. He cultivated dependency and fear, offered gifts that bound recipients to him and ruthlessly exploited the vulnerabilities of children and adults. His outward courtesy hid absolute contempt for others’ autonomy. He treats dependence as a form of ownership, distributing or withholding abilities to bind people to his will.

Appearance: A tall, broad man who once had ordinary facial features but later bore profound facial injuries, leaving a smooth, damaged upper face. He often wore formal dark clothing and heavy life-support equipment. His stolen powers could dramatically alter his body, producing grotesque combat forms.

cardPool.title: Shuichi Iguchi
cardPool.value:
Name: Shuichi Iguchi

Alias: Spinner

Occupation: Former League of Villains member; author

Abilities: Gecko grants reptilian climbing and adhesion; additional Quirks forced onto him in wartime placed enormous strain on his body.

Personality: Withdrawn and self-conscious about his reptilian appearance, Shuichi found identity among people who promised to oppose the prejudice he had suffered. His loyalty to Tomura Shigaraki mattered more to him than abstract political slogans, even while extremist groups sought to use him as a symbol. After the war he attempts to preserve the memory of his friends in writing.

Appearance: A human-reptile heteromorph with green scaly skin, lizardlike facial features and a sturdy build. His League clothing drew inspiration from the Hero Killer Stain, incorporating practical combat gear and carried blades. His wartime bodily modifications produced a bulkier and more unstable form. Later forced physical alterations affected his size and coordination.

cardPool.title: Atsuhiro Sako
cardPool.value:
Name: Atsuhiro Sako

Alias: Mr. Compress

Occupation: Imprisoned former League of Villains member

Abilities: Compress reduces touched objects or people into marble-like forms that can later be released.

Personality: Courtly, playful and fascinated by dramatic reveals, Atsuhiro treats the battlefield as a stage. His manners and theatricality conceal a criminal willing to commit grave harm to achieve his group’s aims. He places value on companionship within the League and later follows accounts of the people with whom he fought. His manners are theatrical but his loyalty to the League is serious.

Appearance: A lean man typically associated with formal stage-magician clothing, a top hat and a distinctive mask. He carries himself with a performer’s exaggerated flourishes. After sacrificing part of his body during an escape, he survives with severe injuries and remains identifiable by his polished, theatrical demeanor. His costume obscures facial expressions deliberately.

cardPool.title: Danjuro Tobita
cardPool.value:
Name: Danjuro Tobita

Alias: Gentle

Occupation: Rehabilitated entrepreneur; head of GeL Inc.

Abilities: Elasticity makes touched surfaces springy and resilient; useful for movement, protective redirection and containment.

Personality: Polite, eccentric and committed to flamboyant presentation, Gentle once pursued attention through elaborate unlawful stunts. His longing to matter drove him into wrongdoing, but kindness from La Brava and encounters with genuine heroes changed him. He becomes more willing to use his talents to protect people rather than stage spectacles.

Appearance: A tall older man with distinctive gray hair, an exaggerated curled mustache and theatrical clothing, including a cape-like coat and accessories. His dramatic movements resemble those of a performer. He retains a refined, slightly old-fashioned appearance into his rehabilitated professional life. His facial movements are expressive and exaggerated.

cardPool.title: Manami Aiba
cardPool.value:
Name: Manami Aiba

Alias: La Brava

Occupation: Technology specialist; leader at GeL Inc.

Abilities: Love amplifies the strength of a person she profoundly loves through an expression of affection; she also possesses outstanding hacking and computing skill.

Personality: Passionate, excitable and intensely loyal, Manami found purpose through her bond with Gentle when isolation had nearly overwhelmed her. She is affectionate and protective, and her emotional directness contrasts with his elaborate performance style. Her computer expertise is formidable and her past illegal activity gives way to more constructive work.

Appearance: A very short young woman with pink hair, large eyes and a doll-like appearance, often wearing dark clothing with bright accents. She uses dramatic facial expressions and fast, enthusiastic movements. Her appearance retains its recognizable heart-themed sensibility in adulthood. She is demonstrative when excited and rarely hides anger, worry or affection.

cardPool.title: Inko Midoriya
cardPool.value:
Name: Inko Midoriya

Alias: None established

Occupation: Civilian; Izuku Midoriya’s mother

Abilities: No demonstrated combat-oriented Quirk; can attract small objects toward herself.

Personality: Affectionate, sensitive and highly concerned about her son’s safety, Inko is quick to blame herself when she feels unable to protect him. She initially feared that a dangerous hero career would destroy him, but gradually learned to trust his resolve and the adults supporting him. Her love is practical, emotional and sometimes tearful. She remains an important presence in Izuku’s life beyond the war.

Appearance: A middle-aged woman with green hair, green eyes and soft facial features resembling her son’s. She has a fuller figure than in her youth and favors everyday, comfortable clothing. Her expressive face can move quickly from anxious tears to relieved warmth. She is a short woman with dark green hair, usually kept in a modest shoulder-length style, and gentle green eyes.

cardPool.title: Fuyumi Todoroki
cardPool.value:
Name: Fuyumi Todoroki

Alias: None established

Occupation: Former elementary-school teacher; later seeking a different position after the war

Abilities: See the corresponding ability record where applicable.

Personality: Compassionate, patient and devoted to family connection, she repeatedly tried to bring estranged relatives together while knowing reconciliation could not be forced. She deserves her own life beyond the disputes surrounding her father. Fuyumi repeatedly tried to bring the fractured household together, though she could not erase the history that divided it.

Appearance: A young adult woman with predominantly white hair broken by small red sections, light eyes and a gentle demeanor. She favors modest everyday clothing and often projects reassuring warmth. Her white hair is streaked with red and cut to about shoulder length. She wears glasses with red frames, and her blue-gray eyes resemble the colder side of her family’s features.

cardPool.title: Natsuo Todoroki
cardPool.value:
Name: Natsuo Todoroki

Alias: None established

Occupation: Civilian; brother of Shoto and Toya

Abilities: See the corresponding ability record where applicable.

Personality: Outspoken, protective of his siblings and deeply resentful of Enji’s mistreatment of the family, Natsuo refuses to pretend the harm of childhood has vanished. His decision to seek a separate future reflects a desire for safety and independence, not simple spite. Natsuo is openly angry about the suffering caused by Enji’s obsession and refuses to pretend it did not happen.

Appearance: A tall young man with short white hair, light eyes and a broad build. He usually appears in ordinary casual clothing and wears an earnest, sometimes stern expression. A broad young man with white hair, light eyes and a more casual appearance than the professional heroes in his family. He typically wears plain shirts and relaxed clothes.

cardPool.title: Rei Todoroki
cardPool.value:
Name: Rei Todoroki

Alias: None established

Occupation: Civilian; mother of the Todoroki children

Abilities: An ice-producing Quirk inherited by her children; she has not pursued a public hero career.

Personality: Gentle but traumatized by years of domestic abuse and the breakdown of her family, Rei has spent long periods receiving psychiatric care. She ultimately chooses to face painful family responsibilities and acknowledges that her children need lives beyond their parents’ failures. Her gentleness coexists with painful guilt about her own actions under extreme distress.

Appearance: A pale, slim woman with light-colored hair that includes red accents and a subdued expression. Her bearing often reflects fatigue or emotional strain, although she can also show unexpected resolve. She has long white hair and pale eyes, with a slight and elegant figure. Her neat, quiet clothing and controlled gestures give her a soft presence.

cardPool.title: Shino Sosaki
cardPool.value:
Name: Shino Sosaki

Alias: Mandalay

Occupation: Wild, Wild Pussycats member and guardian

Abilities: Telepath allows the broadcast of messages directly into other people’s minds, making her effective at group coordination and warning civilians.

Personality: Composed and team-oriented, Mandalay is an experienced rescue hero who helps manage a coordinated wilderness rescue squad. She protects Kota with the commitment of a family member and offers stability to children who have survived serious trauma. Mandalay uses calm communication to coordinate rescue work across difficult terrain. She tends to be firm without humiliating the people in her care.

Appearance: An athletic woman with reddish hair, distinctive hero accessories and a feline-inspired rescue uniform. Her professional demeanor combines warmth with tactical focus. She is a tall adult woman with short brown hair, cat-themed goggles and an orange-and-black suit suited to outdoor operations.

cardPool.title: Tsunagu Hakamada
cardPool.value:
Name: Tsunagu Hakamada

Alias: Best Jeanist

Occupation: Senior Pro Hero

Abilities: Fiber Master permits precise control of textile fibers for binding, protection and rescue.

Personality: Disciplined, discerning and proud of good conduct, Best Jeanist promotes responsibility, self-control and the social impact of a hero’s public behavior. He serves as a mentor and insists that heroism includes dignity outside combat. Best Jeanist prizes restraint, steady improvement and public conduct alongside combat effectiveness.

Appearance: A tall blond man with his lower face commonly concealed by an unusually high-collared denim outfit. His sleek hero style reflects his fiber-control abilities. His exceptionally long blond hair and narrow eyes are visible above a denim collar that often covers his mouth almost entirely. Tight-fitting denim clothing and high-waisted silhouettes define his unmistakable look. He stands ramrod straight and gestures sparingly.

cardPool.title: Yu Takeyama
cardPool.value:
Name: Yu Takeyama

Alias: Mt. Lady

Occupation: Pro Hero

Abilities: Gigantification allows her to enlarge her body into an enormous giant form.

Personality: Confident, media-savvy and adaptable, Yu Takeyama initially embraced fame but became a dependable frontline defender after repeated disasters. She is willing to endure brutal punishment to protect people. Mt. Lady initially chased attention and endorsement opportunities with great enthusiasm, yet repeated crises showed her willingness to absorb enormous danger for other people.

Appearance: A glamorous young woman with long blond hair and a purple-and-cream hero uniform. Gigantification transforms her into a towering version of herself. Her long blond hair and vivid purple eyes accompany a tall, shapely build at ordinary size. In costume she wears a purple-and-cream suit with orange details and a mask with pointed decorative protrusions. Enlarging makes her tower above buildings without changing the basic costume design.

cardPool.title: Shinji Nishiya
cardPool.value:
Name: Shinji Nishiya

Alias: Kamui Woods

Occupation: Pro Hero

Abilities: Arbor allows him to produce and control wooden branches for binding, movement and rescue.

Personality: Calm, careful and highly conscientious, Shinji Nishiya approaches rescue and crowd protection with restraint. His skill at binding targets makes him a patient rather than reckless fighter. Kamui Woods treats physical restraint as a way to resolve conflict without unnecessarily injuring people. His professionalism grew through the insecurity of early hero work.

Appearance: A tall hero whose exterior looks like shaped wood, with a narrow helmetlike head and long wooden limbs. He wears a restrained dark combat ensemble. His whole exposed body has a wooden, bark-like appearance, with an elongated head and branching appendages that can extend like tree limbs. He wears a dark, fitted hero outfit over parts of his wooden exterior. His movements tend to be precise and composed.

cardPool.title: Taishiro Toyomitsu
cardPool.value:
Name: Taishiro Toyomitsu

Alias: Fat Gum

Occupation: Pro Hero and mentor

Abilities: Fat Absorption allows him to absorb blows and convert the stored energy into counterattacks.

Personality: Warm, friendly and generous with food, Taishiro Toyomitsu combines cheerful mentoring with powerful commitment to protecting young heroes. He knows when to become stern and is respected for reliable, practical action. Fat Gum encourages younger heroes with food, jokes and the confidence that they can improve. Beneath that friendly exterior he notices who is overwhelmed and who needs direct instruction.

Appearance: Usually a very large man with a rounded silhouette and a bright yellow hero ensemble. His build changes drastically when the stored energy within his fat is spent. His usual appearance is enormously round, with a cheerful face and a yellow costume that makes him easy to spot. Expending his stored fat can leave a dramatically thinner, muscular version of the same man.

cardPool.title: Ryuko Tatsuma
cardPool.value:
Name: Ryuko Tatsuma

Alias: Ryukyu

Occupation: Pro Hero

Abilities: Dragon allows her to transform into a huge flying dragon.

Personality: Levelheaded, kind and responsible, Ryuko Tatsuma mentors younger heroes and prioritizes civilian safety even during large-scale threats. Her leadership is steady rather than theatrical. Ryukyu approaches mentorship patiently and expects trainees to prioritize people needing rescue. She is confident without boasting and accepts difficult orders even when the conditions are frightening.

Appearance: A tall woman with long pale hair and dragon-inspired accessories; her transformed form is an enormous winged dragon with claws, scales and a long tail. In human form she is tall with long pale blond hair and striking pointed accessories. Her blue-gray costume includes dragon-themed features. Her Quirk transforms her into a massive dragon with wings, scales, claws and a long tail, capable of carrying people in flight.

cardPool.title: Dai
cardPool.value:
Name: Dai

Alias: None established

Occupation: Middle-school student and aspiring hero

Abilities: His Quirk produces saucer-like plate shapes from his hair, which can be tossed; its potential applications require practice and experimentation.

Personality: Initially uncertain whether his modest ability can ever support meaningful heroism, Dai gains courage when Izuku treats the urge to help others as more important than headline-grabbing power. Even before receiving encouragement, he moves instinctively to help a child in danger. That impulse gives him a reason to keep trying.

Appearance: A young school-age boy with short dark hair and youthful features, seen in everyday clothing. More detailed adult appearance is not established. A young boy with short dark hair and an ordinary school-age build. He is dressed as a student rather than a trained professional and lacks the elaborate equipment associated with licensed heroes.

cardPool.title: Koichi Haimawari
cardPool.value:
Name: Koichi Haimawari

Alias: The Crawler

Occupation: Pro Hero in the United States

Abilities: Slide and Glide enables movement and propulsion across surfaces and eventually supports sophisticated aerial movement.

Personality: Kindhearted, scrappy and persistent, Koichi has experience helping strangers without waiting for fame or formal recognition. His improvisational instincts and street-level rescue habits inform his professional life. Koichi began helping strangers without a license, frequently getting caught between the rules and a genuine need for immediate aid.

Appearance: A lean young man with dark hair and a casual, approachable appearance, often associated with goggles and streamlined hero clothing. He has a youthful face, dark hair and a lean build adapted to quick movement. His early improvised equipment included goggles and casual clothing; later professional equipment is sleeker and better suited to airborne action.

cardPool.title: Kurogiri
cardPool.value:
Name: Kurogiri

Alias: None established

Occupation: Destroyed former League of Villains transporter

Abilities: Warp Gate generates transport portals within black mist.

Personality: Originally an artificial being built around Oboro Shirakumo’s remains, Kurogiri was conditioned to guard Tomura Shigaraki. His protective behavior sometimes revealed a deeply buried human connection. Kurogiri is unfailingly formal and protective toward Tomura, even when that protection supports terrible acts. His divided identity is inseparable from his treatment as a modified being.

Appearance: A tall, dark-suited figure whose head and neck are enveloped in dense black mist above a metallic collar. His silhouette resembles a formal attendant. His head appears as a rolling cloud of dark violet-black mist surrounding glowing eyes, above a clean suit and metallic neck structure. Rather than ordinary hair or facial features, the mist shifts with his movements.

cardPool.title: Oboro Shirakumo
cardPool.value:
Name: Oboro Shirakumo

Alias: Loud Cloud

Occupation: Deceased U.A. hero-course student

Abilities: Cloud lets him produce tangible clouds suitable for movement and support.

Personality: Easygoing, cheerful and generous, Oboro formed a close friendship with Shota Aizawa and Hizashi Yamada. His supportive nature shaped their memories of school and the tragedy surrounding his death. Oboro was cheerful, outgoing and ready to share credit with quieter classmates. He encouraged Shota to believe his unusual powers could support heroism and imagined a future working with his friends. His premature death left a deep, unresolved wound in their lives.

Appearance: A young man with light hair and relaxed features, remembered wearing U.A. training clothes and goggles with cloud-themed hero equipment. He had light blue hair swept loosely away from his face and a sunny expression. His goggles and school-age hero costume emphasized the cloud-riding powers he hoped to develop.

cardPool.title: Hizashi Yamada
cardPool.value:
Name: Hizashi Yamada

Alias: Present Mic

Occupation: U.A. teacher and Pro Hero

Abilities: Voice amplifies his voice to dangerous levels suitable for sonic attack and widespread communication.

Personality: Boisterous, charismatic and caring, Hizashi adopts an energetic radio-host persona even when he is angry or afraid. His strong attachment to Shota and Oboro reveals his profound loyalty. Present Mic turns every announcement into a performance, but he knows when that energy is a shield against grief. Teaching and broadcasting both suit his love of communicating.

Appearance: A tall blond man with hair swept upward, dark glasses and flamboyant audio-themed combat clothing. He carries himself with the energy of an announcer. Tall and slender, with extremely long blond hair swept upward, orange-tinted eyewear and large headphones around his neck. His black-and-leather ensemble is packed with audio-inspired styling.

cardPool.title: Chizome Akaguro
cardPool.value:
Name: Chizome Akaguro

Alias: Stain

Occupation: Deceased vigilante-killer and former villain

Abilities: Bloodcurdle permits paralysis of someone whose blood he tastes.

Personality: Fanatically devoted to what he considered authentic heroism, Stain attacked heroes whom he judged shallow or self-serving. His rigid principles could inspire others but never excused his violence. Stain’s philosophy demands self-sacrifice and purity from heroes but grants him no authority to mutilate or kill those who fail his private tests. His rigid moral code drove his isolation and murderous campaign.

Appearance: A lean, scarred man with an exceptionally long tongue, dark combat gear and a red scarf. He wielded bladed weapons and moved with acrobatic menace. A wiry, intimidating fighter with a long tongue, coarse dark hair and a rough, heavily wrapped costume. A red scarf trails from his neck, and he carries multiple cutting weapons.

cardPool.title: Kai Chisaki
cardPool.value:
Name: Kai Chisaki

Alias: Overhaul

Occupation: Former acting leader of the Shie Hassaikai; held in custody after his downfall

Abilities: Overhaul allows disassembly and reassembly of matter via touch; the loss of his arms deprived him of normal use.

Personality: Controlling, ruthless and obsessively focused on undoing Quirk-based society, Kai exploited Eri and destroyed lives while claiming to pursue a larger purpose. The injuries and downfall of his organization leave him stripped of the authority he once exercised. His desire to repay the yakuza boss’s kindness becomes distorted into domination and cruelty.

Appearance: A slim, dark-haired man associated with a beaked mask and formal dark clothing. The loss of his arms severely affects his physical condition and former capabilities. His dark hair is cut short and he often wears a plague-doctor beak mask, dark overcoat and protective gloves. His eyes are narrow and watchful.

cardPool.title: Kaina Tsutsumi
cardPool.value:
Name: Kaina Tsutsumi

Alias: Lady Nagant

Occupation: Former Hero Public Safety Commission operative; chose to remain imprisoned after being offered release

Abilities: Rifle transforms part of her arm into a precision firearm. She also temporarily received Air Walk.

Personality: Disillusioned by covert political violence, Kaina struggled with guilt and the hypocrisy of institutions that hid their own brutality. Encounters with Izuku help her choose survival and personal judgment over cynical resignation. She distrusts easy promises yet can recognize sincerity.

Appearance: A tall woman with two-tone hair and a reserved, weary expression. Her right arm can transform into a specialized firearm, and her hair can be shaped into ammunition. She has long hair in contrasting dark-purple and pale-pink tones, with sharp eyes and a composed face. Her right elbow and forearm can transform into a large organic rifle.

cardPool.title: Cathleen Bate
cardPool.value:
Name: Cathleen Bate

Age: 42 (at death)

Alias: Star and Stripe

Occupation: Deceased American number-one Pro Hero

Abilities: New Order let her apply up to two reality-altering rules to touched, accurately identified subjects.

Personality: Bold, fiercely patriotic and deeply inspired by All Might, Cathleen treats courage as a public commitment. She embraces overwhelming danger with composure and cares deeply about her squadron. Cathleen’s confidence was shaped by an early rescue that made her determined to become a protector worthy of All Might’s example.

Appearance: A tall, extremely muscular blonde woman with dramatic swept hair, a star-themed uniform and a commanding posture. She has a towering, heavily muscled frame, long blonde hair swept into dramatic pointed tufts and an angular face. Her star-emblazoned red, white and blue uniform combines a cape, gloves and tall boots. Her stance and grin convey bold, theatrical assurance.

cardPool.title: Yoichi Shigaraki
cardPool.value:
Name: Yoichi Shigaraki

Alias: None established

Occupation: Deceased first bearer of One For All

Abilities: Transference of his own Quirk fused with a stockpiling ability to form One For All.

Personality: Compassionate and physically frail, Yoichi opposed his elder brother’s tyranny and believed that power must not justify the domination of others. His resistance became the foundation of a generational struggle. Yoichi resisted his older brother’s belief that taking power created rightful ownership over other people.

Appearance: A slim young man with long pale hair and delicate features. He is often remembered in simple light clothing. He is a very slender young man with long, pale white hair falling around a delicate face. His simple clothing and fragile posture make him look far less threatening than the powers bound up in his history. His eyes and expression are ordinarily soft rather than commanding.

cardPool.title: Nana Shimura
cardPool.value:
Name: Nana Shimura

Alias: None established

Occupation: Deceased seventh bearer of One For All

Abilities: Float permits levitation; she also possessed One For All as its seventh holder.

Personality: Courageous and self-sacrificing, Nana combined affection with painful resolve when her family’s safety was threatened. She mentored Toshinori and left a complicated legacy through her descendants. Nana tried to separate family life from a dangerous fight against All For One, choosing secrecy and distance to keep her son safe. That decision had tragic consequences she could not foresee.

Appearance: An athletic woman with dark hair swept back into a high style and a confident smile, usually remembered in a cape and hero costume. She was a tall, athletic woman with dark hair pulled back and a broad, confident smile. Her hero costume included a cape and fitted garments that left her arms free for action.

cardPool.title: Gran Torino
cardPool.value:
Name: Sorahiko Torino

Alias: Gran Torino

Occupation: Veteran Pro Hero and mentor; gravely injured in the war

Abilities: Jet propels him by releasing air from his feet, enabling extraordinary speed and agile movement.

Personality: Brusque, cunning and extremely experienced, Sorahiko uses humor and harsh lessons to sharpen younger heroes. His speed and fighting instincts conceal deep sadness about past mistakes. Sorahiko is sharp-eyed, gruff and more mischievous than his age suggests. His lessons can appear ridiculous until a student grasps how important speed, angles and anticipation are.

Appearance: An elderly, very short man with white hair and compact, muscular posture, wearing yellow flight gear and a cape. Very short and elderly, he has a wrinkled face, white hair and a compact, wiry build. His yellow hero suit, white cape and goggles evoke an old-fashioned speedster. In combat his rapid movements contrast sharply with his apparently frail appearance.

cardPool.title: Quirks
cardPool.value:
Ability: Quirks

Overview: Quirks are inherited or spontaneously arising superhuman traits typically expressed by early childhood. Abilities fall broadly into emitter, transformation and heteromorphic forms; distinctions can overlap. Quirk factors provide the biological basis. Powers differ in range, cost, bodily compatibility and trainability.

Biology and expression: The trait responsible for an ability is commonly called a Quirk factor. It may alter ordinary anatomy, produce substances, or activate an effect under special conditions. Children often manifest powers by roughly four years of age, but onset and inheritance are variable.

Social consequences: The public generally restricts unlicensed use of dangerous abilities. Schools, hospitals, police and support companies must therefore handle abilities as both personal traits and sources of public risk. A mutation-type appearance can remain visible even when the person does nothing.

cardPool.title: One For All
cardPool.value:
Ability: One For All

Overview: One For All emerged from the combination of a transferable Quirk and a power-stockpiling Quirk. It passed voluntarily through successive holders, accumulating enormous strength and traces of previous users’ wills. Later successors could access individual predecessor abilities: Gearshift, Fa Jin, Danger Sense, Blackwhip, Smokescreen and Float.

Operation: A transferable Quirk factor was merged with an ability to stockpile strength. Successive bearers accumulated power through effort and inheritance; a chosen successor could receive it through DNA supplied with the bearer’s intention. The stockpiled power amplified physical performance but could shatter an unprepared body.

Limits and end state: A bearer born with another Quirk could suffer an abnormally shortened life from carrying multiple factors. Transfer did not simply grant immunity to injury; Izuku trained to use safe fractions of output.

cardPool.title: All For One Quirk
cardPool.value:
Ability: All For One Quirk

Overview: All For One permits taking Quirks from other people, using combinations of stolen abilities and giving Quirks to recipients. A stolen ability can be difficult to use because of compatibility, training or the accumulation of multiple factors. Transfers were used to create dependent followers and augment modified beings.

Operation: The factor can seize another person’s Quirk and store it in the wielder, then deploy it or graft it into a recipient. Multiple stolen powers can be layered for mobility, sensing, force and survival. The recipient’s body may be unable to bear unfamiliar or excessive Quirks, requiring modification or artificial support.

Exploitation: Gifts of power were used to create dependency, build organizations and strengthen Nomu. Stolen Quirk factors can carry traces of their original owners’ wills; holding many abilities does not erase the danger of resistance.

cardPool.title: Explosion
cardPool.value:
Ability: Explosion

Overview: Explosion lets Katsuki Bakugo ignite nitroglycerin-like sweat secreted through his palms. Output varies with sweat production and exertion; repeated blasts grant acceleration and aerial maneuverability, while recoil and bodily strain impose limits. Sophisticated combat training enables compact bursts, directional changes and large-area attacks.

Technique: Sweat production in the palms supplies the explosive material, so heat, exertion and perspiration affect output. Small controlled ignitions provide agile directional propulsion; focused blasts deliver concentrated impacts while larger releases cover a broad area. Specialized gauntlets can store sweat and permit major releases without requiring all the discharge from a bare palm at once.

Risks: Sudden heavy output can strain the arms and create blast damage around fragile structures. Cold conditions can reduce available sweat until the user warms up.

cardPool.title: Zero Gravity
cardPool.value:
Ability: Zero Gravity

Overview: Zero Gravity makes physical targets effectively weightless after contact through Ochaco Uraraka’s fingertip pads. She can release the effect intentionally and, following advanced development, spread it through nearby targets. Floating objects retain inertia and can collide dangerously with surroundings. Nausea and overload were important limits in earlier training.

Activation: The pads at the ends of the fingers remove the felt effect of gravity on touched targets. Earlier use required deliberate contact and release; advanced control allowed an expanded spread among targets. The power is especially valuable for freeing people pinned by wreckage, redistributing heavy burdens and managing airborne hazards.

Control: Zero weight is not the same as stopping momentum. A thrown object can continue to travel quickly, a falling person needs safe deceleration, and released rubble can become deadly if the effect ends above a crowd.

cardPool.title: Half-Cold Half-Hot
cardPool.value:
Ability: Half-Cold Half-Hot

Overview: Half-Cold Half-Hot gives Shoto Todoroki independent ice production from his right side and fire production from his left. Using only one side risks dangerous bodily temperature imbalance; dual-side training allows sustained use. Ice creates barriers and large formations; fire supplies heat, propulsion and ranged force.

Thermal balance: The two halves of the body counterbalance one another. Ice spreads rapidly outward from one side, while the other generates searing flame for attacks and regulating temperature. Separately pushing either side too far can result in freezing or dangerous overheating.

Specialized use: Fire and ice can control routes, impede pursuers, seal openings, create cover and regulate local temperatures in rescues. Phosphor uses a controlled circulation of heat and cold for an unusual form of flame; it is not the same as summoning a second independent Quirk.

cardPool.title: Engine
cardPool.value:
Ability: Engine

Overview: Engine grows exhaust engines in Tenya Iida’s calves, producing high-speed running and short bursts of rapid acceleration. Reciprocating techniques maximize power over limited windows; training and maintenance matter. The engines may stall or overheat, and aggressive acceleration demands safe paths and control.

Physical structure: Engine housings protrude from the calves and release the force for rapid running. Specialized footwear and clothing accommodate the exhausts.

Maintenance and hazards: The engines cannot ignore friction, obstacles or the need to turn. Damage, blockage and overheating can interrupt performance.

Field detail: Combat practice: Burst acceleration favors straight-line approaches but offers only a narrow time window to change direction. Rapid maneuvers can shield someone from impact or carry them out of a hazardous area; misjudging distance could instead produce a collision.

cardPool.title: Creation
cardPool.value:
Ability: Creation

Overview: Creation converts stored lipids in Momo Yaoyorozu’s body into nonliving materials through her skin. The user must understand the molecular structure of whatever is produced. Larger or more complex items consume more resources and time; food intake and advance planning are important.

Process: The user calculates a nonliving object’s chemical and structural composition, then expends body lipids to manifest the material from exposed skin. Complex machinery requires unusually detailed prior study; metal beams, insulation sheets, ropes, shields and medical supplies are attainable when the structure is known. The technique favors preparedness and accurate knowledge.

Limits: It does not create living organisms, replace training or automatically supply whatever device would be most useful. Large masses require greater reserves and more creation time; repeated production can exhaust the user.

cardPool.title: Frog
cardPool.value:
Ability: Frog

Overview: Frog grants Tsuyu Asui amphibian traits including huge leaps, wall adhesion, a long prehensile tongue, extended swimming endurance and adaptive camouflage. Cold temperatures can interfere with her mobility and alertness.

Traits: The body combines strong jumping muscles, adhesive extremities, swimming ability and an extensible tongue that can pull small people or objects. The tongue can grapple, rescue and surprise opponents without requiring direct hand contact.

Constraints: Severe cold can produce sluggishness and hibernation-like effects, reducing the ability to act. Camouflage disguises the user against some backgrounds but does not grant perfect optical invisibility.

Field detail: Rescue practice: A tongue can act as an extended hand, pulling a teammate across a gap or retrieving someone drifting in water. Wall adhesion and strong legs provide alternatives when staircases fail.

cardPool.title: Dupli-Arms
cardPool.value:
Ability: Dupli-Arms

Overview: Dupli-Arms gives Mezo Shoji multiple strong, flexible upper limbs with surfaces that can generate copies of hands and sensory organs. Duplicated mouths, eyes and ears extend awareness and communication; replicated limbs support shields, transport and restraint.

Morphology: Several strong arms extend from the torso, with branching ends capable of sprouting additional appendages or sensory organs. Extra eyes and ears expand situational awareness; multiple mouths help relay messages while hands can grip debris or shield a person.

Limits: A duplicated organ is not a separate thinking ally, and all motion must be coordinated through one person. Creating many exposed sensory organs increases opportunities for enemy attacks.

Field detail: Search and protection: Multiple ears can listen to different parts of a damaged structure while spare arms clear obstructions and support an injured person.

cardPool.title: Hardening
cardPool.value:
Ability: Hardening

Overview: Hardening lets Eijiro Kirishima toughen his body into rugged armor, improving defense and increasing close-range striking power. Unbreakable is a stronger, temporary mode that exacts a serious physical cost. Repeated heavy impacts can break down his defense and leave vulnerable openings.

Defense: Hardened tissue takes on angular, rocky ridges across the body, providing protection against blunt force and cutting attacks. It also makes charges and punches more effective, though technique and physical fitness remain essential.

Limits: Continuous punishment can chip away at the defense, while the strongest form cannot be sustained indefinitely. The Quirk does not protect an ally standing outside its hardened surface.

Field detail: Battlefield use: Hardening can protect the user while taking a charge intended for another person, or let them break a barrier obstructing rescue.

cardPool.title: Electrification
cardPool.value:
Ability: Electrification

Overview: Electrification allows Denki Kaminari to discharge electrical energy around him. High-voltage attacks can incapacitate opponents but also threaten allies, civilians and sensitive equipment. Aiming devices improve selective targeting.

Discharge: Electricity spreads rapidly from the body and can overwhelm groups or interfere with machinery. Targeting discs and pointer equipment help draw it toward chosen opponents. Conductive objects and wet conditions can change where current travels, so arena control and allied positions matter.

Overload: Excessive release causes a temporary confused, mentally dulled state in the user. Powerful attacks are therefore short tactical choices rather than constant output.

Field detail: Team applications: Electrical discharge can disable groups while another hero handles physical restraint, but a team must first establish safe zones. Metal structures and nearby electronics change the risks.

cardPool.title: Earphone Jack
cardPool.value:
Ability: Earphone Jack

Overview: Earphone Jack gives Kyoka Jiro long, flexible audio-jack earlobes. Inserting them into surfaces allows detection of vibrations; she can amplify her heartbeat through specialized equipment to create intense sonic shocks.

Sound handling: Cordlike earlobes can be inserted into surfaces to hear internal vibrations, locate hidden movement and track distant noises. With speaker amplifiers, the user’s heartbeat becomes a damaging vibration wave, useful for disrupting balance or breaking fragile obstacles.

Tradeoffs: The appendages have finite reach and can be injured; hearing can be confused by many overlapping signals. The user must distinguish useful vibration from ordinary background noise.

Field detail: Reconnaissance: Pressing a jack against a wall may reveal movement behind it when ordinary sight is blocked. Vibrations can also identify structural weaknesses or approaching footsteps.

cardPool.title: Acid
cardPool.value:
Ability: Acid

Overview: Acid allows Mina Ashido to exude corrosive fluid and vary its concentration and viscosity. Applications include melting obstructions, creating sliding surfaces and coating herself in protective or offensive layers. Precision matters to avoid damaging people or surrounding structures.

Control: Corrosive secretions can be made more or less viscous and adjusted for different degrees of dissolving power. Low-friction flows permit sliding movement, while dense coatings or concentrated jets can cut through obstacles.

Safety: Acid can harm bystanders, uniforms and the materials needed to support a damaged building. Increasing concentration and output stresses the body and risks dehydration or compromised skin protection.

Field detail: Named techniques: Acid Shot and Acidman demonstrate very different approaches: launching concentrated corrosive material and enveloping the body with a dense protective coating.

cardPool.title: Dark Shadow
cardPool.value:
Ability: Dark Shadow

Overview: Dark Shadow is a sentient shadowlike manifestation linked to Fumikage Tokoyami. It can move, strike, shield and carry him, and speaks with a distinct personality.

Manifestation: A mobile dark creature with speech and a distinct temperament emerges from the user and acts as both weapon and shield. It can seize opponents, carry weight and assist aerial movement. Cooperation between user and shadow yields complex feints and protection from several angles.

Light dependence: In bright surroundings the manifestation is smaller and easier to control; strong darkness greatly magnifies strength and makes rage harder to restrain. Light-based attacks can weaken or force it back.

Field detail: Coordination techniques: When kept within a suitable range, Dark Shadow can surround the user as armor, strike from outside an opponent’s reach or assist with aerial positioning. Its temperament responds to command and environmental light.

cardPool.title: Navel Laser
cardPool.value:
Ability: Navel Laser

Overview: Navel Laser emits a concentrated beam through Yuga Aoyama’s abdomen, often directed through a focusing belt. The power was given to him rather than naturally inherited and creates abdominal pain with extended use.

Projection: A focused light beam travels from the navel region and may provide thrust for short airborne movements. Costume support helps aim the stream and manage instability.

Compatibility: The power was artificially given to a child born without one, and his body reacts poorly to prolonged output. Stomachaches, digestive problems and leakage are practical limitations.

Field detail: Specialized handling: The beam can be fired in short controlled pulses or sustained at greater cost. The focusing belt is especially important when the user needs a precise line through a target rather than a broad destructive sweep.

cardPool.title: Tape
cardPool.value:
Ability: Tape

Overview: Tape permits Hanta Sero to eject adhesive ribbons from structures on his elbows. Ribbons serve as grappling lines, restraints, anchors and swinging cables. Environmental anchor points and tape supply determine maneuver options.

Movement: The elbow dispensers launch adhesive lengths that attach to distant supports and can be reeled, detached or used to swing. They bind enemies, bridge gaps, reposition debris and provide rapid high-level traversal.

Constraints: The ribbons can be cut, burned, peeled from weak surfaces or pulled free by stronger opponents. An extended line makes the user vulnerable if the anchor collapses.

Field detail: Capture techniques: Several overlapping lines can interfere with an opponent’s footing while the user swings around a support to approach from another angle. The adhesive material is also suitable for pulling light debris clear of a passage.

cardPool.title: Tail
cardPool.value:
Ability: Tail

Overview: Tail is Mashirao Ojiro’s muscular prehensile appendage. It supports balance, grappling, agile movement and powerful martial-arts blows. Training is crucial because the Quirk grants a physical tool rather than automatic expertise.

Function: The thick, muscular appendage supplies extra balance, a third point of support, a grappling tool and heavy close-range blows. The user can brace with it during a punch or change direction midair.

Limits: The tail is attached and physically vulnerable; binding it removes much of its utility. It does not inherently improve ranged attacks, create additional limbs or make a user immune to injury.

Field detail: Practical technique: The tail can strike while both hands are occupied, anchor the user during a throw or sweep the legs of an opponent. Martial-arts drills develop timing so the movement of the tail does not unbalance the hips.

cardPool.title: Anivoice
cardPool.value:
Ability: Anivoice

Overview: Anivoice permits Koji Koda to communicate with animals and request assistance. Birds, mammals and insects can aid scouting, navigation, rescue and coordinated movement. Animals retain their own physical limitations and may be frightened by hostile conditions.

Communication: Vocal calls can convey intentions to birds, insects and mammals, directing them to gather, search or carry out straightforward actions. Animals can scout places too small for people, notice scents and signs inaccessible to humans, or help find missing victims.

Limits: Animals have ordinary strength, speed and comprehension, and the user cannot make an insect carry a person or assume every animal can perform intricate tactics. Noise and distance hinder contact; a frightened creature may be unable to help.

Field detail: Operational examples: Birds can survey rooftops and insects can enter narrow gaps, while larger creatures may help search open ground.

cardPool.title: Sugar Rush
cardPool.value:
Ability: Sugar Rush

Overview: Sugar Rush temporarily raises Rikido Sato’s strength after sugar intake. The enhancement consumes available energy and can diminish higher-order thinking while active, making timing and preparation vital.

Activation: Consuming sugar yields a marked but temporary increase in muscle strength, allowing heavy lifting and forceful hand-to-hand combat. The user commonly prepares sweets or another reliable source of sugar before an assignment.

Cost: The power is tied to sugar intake rather than an unlimited reserve. Each period of enhanced strength diminishes sharp mental processing, making delicate operations difficult.

Field detail: Rescue tradeoff: A strengthened user can temporarily lift beams or move heavy rubble, but a complicated evacuation may require a teammate to plan while the power is active. The useful duration depends on intake and individual conditioning.

cardPool.title: Invisibility
cardPool.value:
Ability: Invisibility

Overview: Invisibility makes Toru Hagakure’s body extremely difficult to see and can refract or redirect light. Her physical presence remains tangible, and footsteps, clothing and environmental disturbance can reveal her location. Flashing light effects can disorient observers.

Optics: The body is invisible to ordinary sight and can bend light to create dazzling flashes or redirect some incoming illumination. Sneaking through sightlines is much easier than for most opponents, and the user can scout while remaining hard to target.

Limits: Sound, touch, scent, tracks and moving clothing can reveal position. Optical invisibility does not hide impacts or protect against attacks covering an entire space.

Field detail: Tactical use: Stealth allows the user to approach a lookout or scout an exposed corridor while the enemy is focused elsewhere. Refracting a bright flash can briefly blind pursuers.

cardPool.title: Pop Off
cardPool.value:
Ability: Pop Off

Overview: Pop Off lets Minoru Mineta pull sticky spheres from his head. These cling stubbornly to many surfaces but do not adhere to him; strategic placement forms traps and movement aids. Removing too many causes bleeding and physical distress.

Material: Soft, purple spheres detach from the scalp and adhere powerfully to most other surfaces. They can form walls of obstacles, glue footwear to the ground or create paths across difficult terrain. The user is exempt from their adhesion and can bounce off deployed spheres with practiced movement.

Limits: The balls do not explode and are not effective as ordinary damaging projectiles. Pulling too many from the scalp in a short time causes pain and bleeding.

Field detail: Movement use: Properly placed adhesive balls can create improvised footholds and bouncy landing sites for their owner. They are best treated as a limited set of tactical objects rather than a stream of damage.

cardPool.title: Brainwashing
cardPool.value:
Ability: Brainwashing

Overview: Brainwashing allows Hitoshi Shinso to control a target who verbally replies to him. Physical shocks can break the effect, and complex thinking cannot simply be commanded into existence. His voice-changing mask enables imitation, increasing opportunities to elicit a response.

Condition: The target must answer the user’s spoken words, after which simple commands can direct their body. The victim remains a conscious person rather than losing their memories or moral beliefs.

Resistance and limits: A substantial physical jolt can end the state, and sustained control requires care when ordering several people. The ability cannot force someone to use hidden knowledge they do not possess.

Field detail: Tactical uncertainty: A target who has already learned the activation rule can force the user to create a convincing surprise. The control may direct body movement but cannot erase a person’s judgment when it ends.

cardPool.title: Permeation
cardPool.value:
Ability: Permeation

Overview: Permeation makes Mirio Togata intangible to solid matter and certain forces. While phased he cannot ordinarily see, hear or breathe; the ground stops supporting him, requiring carefully timed activation.

Physics of use: Phasing causes ordinary light, sound and air to pass through the body, removing sight, hearing and breathing while fully intangible. Gravity still affects the user, so sinking below the ground and returning at chosen angles require painstaking timing. Deactivation inside solid matter forces the body outward.

Training: The technique is not effortless invulnerability. The user must learn when to leave specific body parts tangible to strike, block or grip another person.

Field detail: A skilled user shifts only the body parts needed to avoid contact, preserving the ability to strike with the rest. Phasing through a floor or wall creates a surprise route but also temporarily eliminates visual information.

cardPool.title: Wave Motion
cardPool.value:
Ability: Wave Motion

Overview: Wave Motion transforms Nejire Hado’s vitality into spiraling energy waves released through her limbs. The beams can provide propulsion, flight, destructive force and support.

Output: Spiral waves emerge from the hands or feet and can push against the air to maintain flight or strike at targets from a distance. The energy can be varied in intensity, letting the user alternate rescue support with powerful blasts. Broad arcs work well against large opponents.

Tradeoffs: The twisting discharge is slower than a direct linear strike of similar apparent intensity, and prolonged high output exhausts the user. Precision requires attention to people near the beam’s route.

Field detail: Careful bursts under the feet permit sustained aerial movement and quick changes of altitude. More intense spirals can hold back a large enemy or remove obstacles that are too dangerous to approach.

cardPool.title: Manifest
cardPool.value:
Ability: Manifest

Overview: Manifest gives Tamaki Amajiki temporary physical characteristics from foods he has consumed. The resulting claws, wings, shells, tentacles and other traits can be combined in strategic ways.

Expression: Consumed foods provide temporary biological characteristics: seafood can form tentacles or shells, birds can provide wings, and other ingredients yield their own body traits. Several features may appear at once, giving the user a remarkable choice of range, armor and movement.

Limitations: No trait appears without the corresponding substance first being eaten. The Quirk does not recreate arbitrary tools, give possession of someone else’s Quirk or remove the need to understand each food’s capabilities.

Field detail: Food selection is a form of advance planning. Shellfish traits may provide armor, tentacles can restrain and a birdlike appendage may help with mobility.

cardPool.title: Erasure
cardPool.value:
Ability: Erasure

Overview: Erasure temporarily nullifies affected Quirks when Shota Aizawa maintains visual focus on targets. Blinking and obstructed sight interrupt the effect. It cannot remove permanent anatomical features already present in heteromorphic bodies.

Sight requirement: The user can prevent many active Quirks from functioning as long as a chosen target remains in view and the effect is maintained. Hair rising is a visible sign of activation. Hiding behind obstacles, shutting the eyes or losing consciousness can interrupt the suppression.

Boundaries: The ability does not reverse physical changes already made, erase a permanent extra limb or neutralize inert damage already caused by a Quirk. Mechanical weapons remain functional.

Field detail: An erasing gaze may shut down an enemy’s emitted ability while an ally closes for a safe capture. It cannot reverse a fire already burning or remove the claws of someone born with claws.

cardPool.title: Rewind
cardPool.value:
Ability: Rewind

Overview: Rewind allows Eri to reverse the physical condition of a living body to an earlier state. The ability is hazardous without fine control and once required strict supervision. It cannot be treated as routine, consequence-free healing; catastrophic overuse might reverse someone beyond a survivable state.

Biological reversal: The Quirk returns a living body to an earlier condition. It can close injuries, restore a missing limb or undo bodily changes, but a severe uncontrolled application can move a target before existence.

Uncertainty: The mechanism involves accumulation over time, so the user cannot simply provide endless healing. It does not reverse broken buildings or alter history outside a living body.

Field detail: Restoring a lost ability or healed limb requires the target’s body to have existed in a suitable prior state. A powerful reversal without accurate control can kill rather than heal.

cardPool.title: Water Gun
cardPool.value:
Ability: Water Gun

Overview: Water Gun permits Kota Izumi to eject water from his hands. Although initially limited compared with destructive combat Quirks, practice can improve handling.

Expression: Water is propelled from the palms, creating jets that can knock small threats aside or supply a limited amount for emergency use. Training increases control and confidence, especially where a stream must be directed through a narrow opening.

Practical limits: Available water, pressure and technique determine how much weight the stream can move. The power does not grant oceanic manipulation or the ability to control ordinary water across a city. Its apparent modesty should not be mistaken for an inability to perform useful rescue work.

Field detail: The water streams can startle an opponent or assist with extinguishing small flames when enough output is available. They can also offer a safer alternative to a damaging punch in close quarters.

cardPool.title: Zoom
cardPool.value:
Ability: Zoom

Overview: Zoom allows Mei Hatsume to focus her vision on very distant details. Its long-distance magnification supports analysis and field observation, while her engineering expertise is a separate learned skill. A remarkable invention is not an automatic function of the Quirk.

Vision: The eyes magnify distant targets, allowing close inspection of objects many meters away without relying on a handheld telescope. This helps testing prototypes and reading small mechanical details from a safer position.

Limits: Magnification does not guarantee understanding of what is being seen or grant the power to build machines without study. Physical obstruction and poor lighting remain problems.

Field detail: An inventor can inspect whether a component moves as intended at a distance, track a prototype in flight or study details without entering a hazardous test zone. That observation must still be interpreted and recorded.

cardPool.title: Copy
cardPool.value:
Ability: Copy

Overview: Copy permits Neito Monoma to reproduce a Quirk after touching its user. Borrowed powers expire after a limited duration and depend on physiological compatibility; Quirks requiring externally accumulated energy or resources may be unusable without those reserves.

Mechanism: Contact with another Quirk wielder temporarily duplicates their factor for a limited period. The borrowed function can be activated if its biological conditions are met.

Blanks: Quirks that stockpile something over time are copied without automatically receiving the stockpiled reserve. A copy of a healing or accumulation factor may thus be useless without energy already built up.

Field detail: Quick contact in crowded combat can supply an unexpected answer to a specific threat. Advanced preparation involves knowing which Quirk to borrow, the duration left on it and whether another user’s anatomy is needed to operate it.

cardPool.title: Softening
cardPool.value:
Ability: Softening

Overview: Softening lets Juzo Honenuki change solid, nonliving material into a softer state by touching it. He can alter terrain to capture enemies, slow approaches or create pathways. The material can be restored toward its original hardness.

Surface control: Solid ground, walls and other nonliving matter can become pliable or mudlike under contact, creating pits and slowing enemy movement. Restoring the affected surface to hardness permits rapid containment or makeshift protective structures.

Hazards: The technique can destabilize structures and endanger trapped civilians if used casually. Liquids and living beings are not interchangeable with the solid materials it softens.

Field detail: Terrain can be turned into a temporary trap beneath an advancing opponent, then hardened again to keep them from escaping. The same idea can open a shallow route through obstructed ground.

cardPool.title: New Order
cardPool.value:
Ability: New Order

Overview: New Order enabled Cathleen Bate to set extraordinary rules on targets touched and named by her. She could maintain only two rules at a time.

Rule setting: A touched subject must be named, and the user must understand its identity. A rule can alter such things as the behavior of surrounding air or impose a specific property on a target.

Boundaries: The Quirk cannot grant absolutely limitless personal strength and cannot reliably alter a living target if the named identity conflicts with the person’s self-conception. Losing contact is not always the same as dropping a rule, but creating a third requires replacing one.

Field detail: Large environmental changes are particularly useful because inanimate things do not have self-conceptions that resist identification. Rules can be set to shield comrades or affect a nearby material, but their wording and named subject matter.

cardPool.title: Decay
cardPool.value:
Ability: Decay

Overview: Decay disintegrated matter through Tomura Shigaraki’s touch and, after developing, could spread through connected surfaces. Its enormous danger included collapsing structures and chain destruction. Intervention before spread completed could sometimes limit losses.

Progression: Early activation involved all five fingers touching an object; severe emotional trauma and later growth expanded the reach and contagious spread across linked material. Floors, buildings and bodies could crumble through connected contact, producing chain destruction on a catastrophic scale.

Limits: Interrupted contact, separation of affected material or other defensive interventions can sometimes stop the advance. The original power was engineered by removing the rebuilding function from a derivative of Overhaul.

Field detail: A spreading disintegration wave turns the ground itself into a hazard; leaping away or isolating pieces of material can buy time.

cardPool.title: Transform
cardPool.value:
Ability: Transform

Overview: Transform enabled Himiko Toga to take on the appearance of someone whose blood she consumed. The available transformation time depended on the quantity consumed. Under special emotional conditions she could also reproduce some transformed subjects’ Quirks.

Disguise: A quantity of consumed blood determines how long a copied body can be maintained. Clothing can shift with the impersonated appearance, enabling deceptive social entry.

Limits: The user must obtain actual blood and cannot transform into someone chosen at random. Copying an appearance does not confer independent knowledge of that person’s private experiences.

Field detail: After transformation, imitated mannerisms, speech and knowledge must still be learned independently if the disguise is to survive conversation. Consumed blood is a finite physical resource, so an infiltrator has to plan how much is available.

cardPool.title: Blueflame
cardPool.value:
Ability: Blueflame

Overview: Blueflame generated extremely hot blue fire from Toya Todoroki’s body. His natural resistance to cold could not protect him adequately against the resulting heat, so continued use destroyed his tissue.

Heat: Brilliant blue combustion burns hotter than conventional orange flames and can incinerate massive targets. The user may form sweeping streams or tightly directed blasts, overwhelming many ordinary defenses.

Self-harm: The body inherited a poor resistance to its own heat, so every sustained attack damages skin, muscle and internal tissues. Severe burns and extensive scarring were consequences of repeated use, not a costume effect.

Field detail: The extreme heat can overpower defensive constructs and create broad walls of fire, but every extended discharge worsens damage to its own wielder. Controlling direction does not confer full resistance to heat radiating back toward the body.

cardPool.title: Gecko
cardPool.value:
Ability: Gecko

Overview: Gecko gave Shuichi Iguchi reptilian adhesion for climbing on walls and other surfaces. His heteromorphic appearance was always visible and made him a target of prejudice.

Physiology: Reptilian limbs and adhesive skin enable the user to move across walls, cling to steep surfaces and climb where ordinary footing is impossible. A scaly exterior is part of the body, not a temporary disguise.
